_0.Title: Digital World_Whole
_0.Description:
I want to ask you about the Piyomon who was near me not too long ago. I am so curious about how she's doing in the Digital World so badly. I would find Piyomon myself, if only I could go. But my mom says it's too dangerous, so she won't let me... Perhaps you can show me traces of Piyomon?
Bring back 10 each of Piyomon feathers and Piyomon claws.
_0.Objective: You bring back 10 feathers and 10 claws of Piyomon from the Digital World.
_0.CompletionText: By becoming a @<tc:930>Dats formal member@</tc>, one can pass freely to the @<tc:930>Digital World@</tc>.
_0.CompletionSummary: Hm, so is Piyomon doing well?

_1.Title: Yokohama_Wooden Bench Park
_1.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Are you with me!? Now, you are the member of Dats Center. However, only the partner digimon can't make you great Tamer. You have to hatch mercenary digimon and nurture it as a strong digimon. It is also the condition for great Tamer. I will let you know the method to hatch mercenary digimon. Acquire 1 mercenary DigiEgg from Kunemon in front of you...Size and shape of mercenary DigiEgg are different from those of other DigiEgg so you will identify it easily.
_1.CompletionText: You need mercenary DigiEgg and material DATA to hatch mercenary digimon.
_1.CompletionSummary: Great...Now, you acquired Kunemon mercenary DigiEgg.

_2.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_2.Description: The NeoDevimon, Vikaralamon, and SaberLeomon, which have been verified in Oil Refinery-3, are very dangerous when they exist in the Real World...Go defeat them..
_2.CompletionText: If we can just gain control of this area, the flood of Digimon can be stabilized to some extent.
_2.CompletionSummary: Well done. With this, the oil refinery area will find stability again.

_3.Title: Yokohama Park
_3.Description: The Tsunomon and Upamon... The Tsunomon... was cute, so I went up to it, but it threatened me with its big horn... Will you go fight Tsunomon and Upamon?
_3.Objective: Capture 5 each of Tsunomon and Upamon
_3.CompletionText: I can ask my father, but my dad has to prepare for a big match.
_3.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I'll make sure to tell my dad.

_4.Title: Yokohama_Village
_4.Description: This is Richard Sampson...The DATA of mercenary DigiEgg you acquired are not perfect so hatching is not possible. If you take the mercenary DigiEgg to <Incubator> of Yokohama Village, you will get Kunemon mercenary DigiEgg and material DATA required for hatching. You can get mercenary digimon by putting mercenary DigiEgg you received to <Incubator> and add the material required for mercenary DigiEgg hatching. Go to Yokohama Village and try it...
_4.CompletionText: Now you are seeing a mercenary DigiEgg hatching NPC Incubator. If you obtain mercenary DigiEgg, you can hatch it in Incubator. Of course you have to prepare material DATA required for hatching…
_4.CompletionSummary: I will give you three DATA that is a material DATA required for hatching Kunemon mercenary DigiEgg and insectoid digimon. Try hatching by using Incubator that is mercenary DigiEgg hatching NPC …

_5.Title: Yokohama_Village
_5.Description: It seems that you hatched Kunemon successfully. Then, you have to train a new mercenary digimon. When it comes to digimon, actual battle is the best training method It can get XP by fighting against monster digimon and its level will be upgraded by meeting requested XP. All digimons can evolve into Champion at level 11 with Ultimate at level 25 and Mega existence at level 41.
_5.CompletionText: Some type of digimon can evolve into evolved existence beyond Mega existence.
_5.CompletionSummary: I will test your ability as a Tamer. Train hatched Kunemon mercenary digimon until it becomes level 6…

_6.Title: Yokohama Park
_6.Description: I run a bakery in Yokohama Village. You can come pay me a visit any time you need bread. Of course it won't be free... However, the problem is that the Digimon that have suddenly appeared have gobbled up all the precious bread I've made. Will you go teach them a lesson? Don't let them come near my bakery again. ? You can find Koromon at Small Forest Park or Wood Bench Park.
_6.CompletionText: I think I might eat all the bread we baked today...
_6.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much. I feel relieved now.

_7.Title: Yokohama_Village
_7.Summary: Let me make you a Normal Egg Roll.
_7.Description: Goodness, you've worked very hard. I want to make you a delicious omelet, but Tanemon have run off with the ingredients. Bring me back some Normal Eggs, and I'll make you a delicious Egg Roll. My Egg Rolls, such as they are, are said to be in a different sphere from regular Egg Rolls. If you don't find the Tanemon at Small Forest Park, you'll find them at Wood Bench Park.
_7.Objective: You obtain five Normal Eggs from Tanemon and bring them to Sarah Damon.
_7.CompletionText: You want a delicious omelet, don't you?
_7.CompletionSummary: Here you go . Here's a piping hot omelet, made specially by Sarah Damon.

_8.Title: Yokohama_Village
_8.Description: This is Richard Sampson of Dats Center. You nurtured the hatched Kunemon greatly. Good job. If digimons become your side, they will be very helpful in the future. I mentioned your story to Megumi Shirakawa at Yokohama Village so visit her to get reward... I will keep an eye on how you will grow as a member of Dats. Good bye.
_8.CompletionText: I heard about you from Captain Richard Sampson…
_8.CompletionSummary: I heard about you from Captain Richard Sampson... Size and power of mercenary digimon depend on hatching step. You can't hatch mercenary digimon in the 1st or 2nd step but you can get mercenary digimon from the 3rd step. If you hatch mercenary digimon in

_9.Title: Small Forest Trail
_9.Summary: I will make you a Premium Egg Roll
_9.Description:
Hohoho. Sarah Damon's Egg Rolls are always said to be the best. Anyway, if you enjoy my Egg Rolls this much, this is certainly a shame. It weren't for the Elecmon, I could make you a Premium Egg Roll.
If you bring me three Premium Eggs from the Elecmon on the Small Forest Trail, I'll make you a Premium Egg Roll.
_9.Objective: You obtain Custom-Made Eggs from Elecmon and bring them to Sarah Damon.
_9.CompletionText: Why have the Digimon become so violent lately?
_9.CompletionSummary: Here you go . Here's a piping hot omelet, made specially by Sarah Damon.

_11.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_11.Description:
Kristy's birthday is coming soon, so I got her a present, but Digimon have gone and stolen it.
What can I do? The present was hard to come by, so what should I do?
Do you think I'll be able to find it? The Digimon that took it looked like a chicken... I've heard that a lot of Digimon have appeared in the oil refinery area. Can't you try looking for them there ?
_11.Objective: You bring Kristy's Birthday Present to Sarah Damon.
_11.CompletionText: Her birthday is coming up soon. What should I do? Kristy will be so disappointed if she doesn't get that present...
_11.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much. This will be Kristy's best birthday ever!

_12.Title: Jumping Project
_12.Summary: Jumping Digimon Payment for New Tamer
_12.CompletionSummary: I heard it's near here somewhere.

_13.Title: Jumping Digimon
_13.Summary: Agumon's Request from the Silver Lake
_13.Description: You came at the right time~ I heard you can get stronger if you meet Shine Grammon.
_13.CompletionText: Use the Time Dimension Bomb to teleport to Silver Lake.
_13.CompletionSummary: Welcome, buddy. I desperately need your help now! My friends here are gone mad!

_14.Title: Jumping Digimon
_14.Summary: How to use the Jumping Digimon Box
_14.Objective: Use the Items of Jumping Digimon Box
_14.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use the Moon Stone and EXP Ruby%qe %cc1/%mc1
_14.CompletionText: You can right-click on the DigiEgg to make it hatch. Then use the Moon Stone of Fortune to raise Digimon's level. This item has no effect on your default partner Digimon. After that, use the EXP Ruby [Tamer]. It will instantly increase your level to 30.
_14.CompletionSummary:
Wow! You're looking much better now!
Do you know that your Jumping Digimon can be improved at level 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 99? You'll see.
Now, follow the guiding arrow marked on the ground.
You'll get to meet Dr. Yushima on the way.

_15.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_15.Description: If you find Shine Greymon, be sure to meet him
_15.Objective: Find traces of Keenan Krier in the Digital World!!
_15.ObjectiveProgress: Find traces of Keenan Krier in the Digital World!
_15.CompletionText: Please do this for me... He's our only flesh and blood. He might still be alive.
_15.CompletionSummary: Hmm...a human child? Gosh... I don't know... Ohh... you have a picture?

_16.Title: Jumping Project
_16.Description: Do you want to be a strong?

_17.Title: Jumping Project
_17.Description:
I feel strongly that I want to be strong...
Then take the New Tamer Growth Boost Ticket that I just gave you and go through me to the Silver Lake and go to Kamemon.
_17.CompletionSummary:
wellcome.
Shine Greymon sent me here...

_18.Title: Yokohama_Village
_18.Description: Michelle Krier, Doctor Kevin Krier's wife, seems to have a problem. Go find out what the problem is and help her!
_18.Objective: You go to the village and speak with Michelle Krier.
_18.CompletionText: The best you can do If you do the best you know how and always try to maintain that attitude, unlimited possibilities will open up to you.
_18.CompletionSummary: Thank you.~ Our family has a problem... It might be difficult, but would you like me to tell you what it is?

_19.Title: Yokohama_Village
_19.Description:
I want to give Asanuma a guitar as a present... How can I get a hold of one?
Ah! That's right Neon... Neon might have a nice guitar.
Neon is a childhood friend of mine, so he might grant a request I make.
Would you go find Neon and ask him for a guitar for me?
Neon will be deep in thought on the Wood bench trail because of his new recording.
_19.Objective: Go to the Wood Bench Trail and find Neon.
_19.CompletionText: Physical strength is national strength! Get going!
_19.CompletionSummary: Huh? You were sent by Teacher Mori? I don't know who that is...

_20.Title: Yokohama_Village
_20.Description:
In order to solve the problem with the Digimon
, you're best off starting by finding Teacher Mori, the physical education teacher, and undergoing physical training!
_20.Objective: You go to the village and speak with Teacher Mori
_20.CompletionText: Whatever you decide to do, you have to be the best at it. And to be the best, you have to realize you need to be physical fit. Because a healthy mind needs to occupy a healthy body.
_20.CompletionSummary: Hahaha! So you've come for physical training? Hahaha, of course. I'll have to help you guys out.
_20.ReservedText: I've always told you you had to become physically fit, but you pretended not to hear me... But when that person tells you to, you fellows come running to me.

_21.Title: Yokohama_Village
_21.Description:
If you receive recognition as a Dats formal member, you can enter the Digital World. But you still have a long way to go.
A request for help from Inoue Mama, who manages the items shop in Yokohama Village, has arrived. Demonstrate your abilities, so that you can become a formal member.
Go find Inoue Mama in Yokohama Village to listen to her request...
_21.Objective: You go to Yokohama Village and speak to Inoue Mama.
_21.CompletionText: What are you doing? Those people are waiting for our help at this very moment! Get going!
_21.CompletionSummary: So you've come here from Dats. Thanks very much...

_22.Title: Yokohama_Village
_22.Description:
Marcus Damon's little sister, Kristy, is having a problem.
Go find out what the problem is and help her!
_22.Objective: You go to the village and speak to Kristy
_22.CompletionText: What are you doing? Those people are waiting for our help at this very moment! Get going!
_22.CompletionSummary: Ah! Thanks! I haven't been able to find Piyomon yet, but I will definitely find it myself someday!
_22.ReservedText: Oh! That scary-looking man was the one who tried to send my Piyomon back!

_23.Title: Dats Center
_23.Description:
Thanks for always helping me out.
I will tell the Dats Center Commander how
active you've been.
Commander Richard Sampson will be at the Dats Center.
If your great deeds are reported, you will become a Dats Official Agent and be able to go to the Digital World.
_23.CompletionSummary: You did excellent work. Don't forget that even minor issues with Digimon can later grow into huge problems.

_24.Title: Jumping Digimon
_24.Summary: How to use the Jumping Digimon Box
_24.Description:
You can complete this quest by following the instructions
1. Exchange New Tamer Growth Boost Ticket to Jumping Digimon Box (choose one) 2. Right-click to open the Jumping Digimon Box 3. Right-click on the Jumping Digimon DigiEgg 4. Switch Partnermon to the newly hatched Jumping Digimon 5. Use the Moon Stone of Fortune 6. Use EXP Ruby [Tamer]
_24.Objective: Use the Items of Jumping Digimon Box
_24.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use the Moon Stone and EXP Ruby%qe %cc1/%mc1
_24.CompletionText: You can right-click on the DigiEgg to make it hatch. Then use the Moon Stone of Fortune to raise Digimon's level. This item has no effect on your default partner Digimon. After that, use the EXP Ruby [Tamer]. It will instantly increase your level to 30.
_24.CompletionSummary:
Wow! You're looking much better now!
Do you know that your Jumping Digimon can be improved at level 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 99? You'll see.
Now, follow the guiding arrow marked on the ground.
You'll get to meet Dr. Yushima on the way.
_24.ReservedText:
You can complete this quest by following the instructions
1. Exchange New Tamer Growth Boost Ticket to Jumping Digimon Box (choose one) 2. Right-click to open the Jumping Digimon Box 3. Right-click on the Jumping Digimon DigiEgg 4. Switch Partnermon to t

_25.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outskirts
_25.Description:
These Suspicious Items seem to be the direct cause of this situation. This problem does not seem to be limited to the Western area. I need to find out what exactly this is.
I'll go now to check the outer Western Village.
If you plan to help me, come find me in the outskirts of the Western Village, which you reach by passing through the Western Village.
You wouldn't perhaps...plan to help me?
_25.Objective: Go find the Starmon of Passion in the outskirts of the Western Village in the Digital World.
_25.CompletionText: What on Earth is going on in the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc>?
_25.CompletionSummary: It's quite serious... It feels as if all the @<tc:800>Digimon@</tc> are @<tc:800>flooding@</tc> in...

_26.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outskirts
_26.Description:
To find out whether these objects are causing the flood of Digimon, we need to find out whether these objects come from the Digimon here.
Fight Dgimon that have flooded in here and bring 10 Suspicious Items to me.
_26.Objective: Let's find 10 Suspicious Items and bring them to the Starmon of Passion.
_26.CompletionText: This could be even more serious than I thought.
_26.CompletionSummary: Hmmm... I was right. It is more serious than I thought. If these items were to spread throughout the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc>...

_27.Title: Dats Center
_27.Description:
It does not look like these were created in the Digital World.
You should probably go back to your world and find out exactly
what these items are.
Since these items were discovered in the Digital World, you should take them to your commander.
_27.Objective: Take these Suspicious Items to Commander Richard Sampson!!
_27.CompletionText: Hmm...if this is the reason the number of Digimon has increased...
_27.CompletionSummary: So these items are the cause of the increase in the number of Digimon!?

_28.Title: Dats Center
_28.Description: If these are items from the Digital World, you should ask Doctor Akihiro Kurata, who is an expert in this subject...but since he's in the Digital World now... Oh, wait, I've got an idea! You should take them to Doctor Kevin Krier. Tell Doctor Kevin Krier, the Digital Gate expert, of my request that he investigate these objects.
_28.CompletionText: This looks like something that needs my immediate attention.

_29.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_29.Description: Hmm... I'm sorry to let you down, but these items are not in my field of expertise. These items fall within Akihiro Kurata's area of expertise. But heard that he went to the Digital World recently to do research... He is not a type to write reports. What? Wait, you saw Akihiro Kurata at the Western Village in the Digital World? Yes...then you're best off bringing them to him.
_29.Objective: Go find Akihiro Kurata in the Digital World
_29.CompletionText: He's not very ethical, but he's second to none in his area of expertise.
_29.CompletionSummary: Ha!! You better have a good reason to be talking to me...you make the mistake of thinking everybody's time is equal, don't you? But, that's not true! Some people are busier than others...My time is way more valuable than yours... What?! What's this ite

_30.CompletionSummary: Thanks for getting me a Jack-O-Lantern. Here is a gift for you in return.
_30.ReservedText: I don't think there are enough items required... You can probably get Jack-O'-Lanterns from monster Digimons.

_31.Title: Yokohama Park
_31.Description:
Oh... No...
I've been searching for my flour, but it's gone.
Things are disappearing left and right.
I'm going to lose my mind...
Maybe it was the Tanemon? Those rascals!
Tanemon have run off to Small Forest Park and Wood Bench Park.
_31.Objective: You bring back five bags of Flour.
_31.CompletionText: Without it, our dumpling shop will come to ruin...sob..
_31.CompletionSummary: Oh, my. Thank you so much. You've taken a load off my back.

_32.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_32.Description:
Damn it!
How much could I earn in life by selling these little Mooncakes!! Ay!! (Crash!!)
And what are you guys doing here!! Huh?
Goodness... You're telling me to live a life of poverty while I sell these little Mooncakes?
Don't be ridiculous!
(He seems to have encountered the PicoDevimon, which can brainwash humans. If we don't capture PicoDevimon and take action soon, this person....
?
There was information that PicoDevimon have appeared at the Small Forest Trail and Wood Bench Trail. )
_32.Objective: You capture PicoDevimon and free Conner Shiratori from the brainwashing.
_32.CompletionText: What's this! Get out of here!!!!! ? (Being brainwashed by the PicoDevimon seems to have affected him greatly)
_32.CompletionSummary: Oh...my head... My head hurts so much it feels like it's going to explode. Ohhh... What's happened?

_33.Title: Yokohama_Tree Bench Park
_33.Summary: Please capture the culprits who killed the rabbits
_33.Description:
All the rabbits I take care of were killed during the night.
I took such good care of them...but now it's over...
Please find the person who killed the rabbits.
Kristy has said that she saw a caterpillar-like creature do this.
Please go capture them.
?
(Was it a Kunemon? You'll have to investigate Wood Bench Park.)
_33.Objective: You find and kill the Kunemon that killed the rabbits.
_33.CompletionText: The Digimon look like caterpillars. I believe they're Kunemon.
_33.CompletionSummary: Whew...thank you very much. It serves those rotten Digimon right . Hehe.

_34.Title: Yokohama_Village
_34.Description:
Young people have to exercise hard.
That way, their bodies and minds will become healthier. Hmm
If you just do as I say, you'll grow very strong!
Look toward the middle of the village. That's where Marcus Damon's house is. Now, I want you to run there and back!!
And you'll need to prove that you actually ran there, so check with Sarah Damon in front of the house!
And I'll check with her later.
_34.Objective: You run to where Sarah Damon is in front of Marcus Damon's house and speak to her.
_34.CompletionText:
Ha!
That isn't very far at all. Run there and back, quick!
_34.CompletionSummary:
Hmm... A minute and thirty seconds. Not bad at all.. . Good job. Now, breathe in, breathe out...
I'm in a pretty good mood, so I'm giving you a pair of shoes to wear, so wear them around. They might make you feel like you're flying. But remember that
_34.ReservedText: Hoho. So Teacher Mori told you to run here and back? When I see him later on, I'll tell him you were here.

_35.Title: Yokohama_Tree Bench Park
_35.Summary: Do you know what excellent exercise jogging is?
_35.Description:
You certainly ran that short distance slowly...
You see Wood bench Park over there, don't you. Now, run there and back!! You'll need proof that you were really there, so check in with Kidosin, in front of the park!
And I'll definitely confirm with it later.
_35.Objective: You run to where Kidosin in front of Wood Bench Park.
_35.CompletionText:
Ha!
That isn't very far at all. Run there and back, quick!
_35.CompletionSummary: Hmm...three minutes and thirty seconds. Not bad at all.. . Good job. Now, breathe in, breathe out...

_36.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_36.Summary: Do you like boxer Hayase Harris?
_36.Description:
Do you perhaps know of the athlete,
boxer Hayase Harris?
I'm very proud to say this champion is a graduate of our school. He is now training in this village in preparation for a match...
If you go to Wood bench trail, you'll find Hayase Harris training.
Go find him and hear his advice.
You'll find Wood Bench Trail when you pass through Wood bench Park.
_36.Objective: You run to where Hayase Harris is training at Wood Bench Trail and back.
_36.CompletionText: He is a rare breed of athlete. I hope you realize what an honor it is to meet him.
_36.CompletionSummary: How was it? Even the way he carries himself is different, isn't it? Here, take this. Commander Richard Sampson has requested this, you know... This is a @<tc:800>DATS Emblem@</tc>. I hope you become a @<tc:800>formal member@</tc> soon.
_36.ReservedText: Hahaha. Your teacher told you to come all the way here? Sounds like you have a great teacher. There is no greater gift in life than a great teacher. And doing your best in everything you do will pay off in the end! More power to you!! Hahaha~!

_37.Title: Yokohama_Village
_37.Description:
Would you perhaps..
Would you mind telling me what you like?
Hahaha
No... I shouldn't say it to you...
_37.Objective: You find out what Asanuma, in front of the hospital, likes.
_37.CompletionText: Haha...ha No... Just because you look bored... ? I mean... Nothing.
_37.CompletionSummary:
Oh, is that so? So you're interested in playing guitar lately? Well, everyone wants to play it...
(looks as if escaping from reality...)
_37.ReservedText: You want to know what I like? Why? And nobody made you ask me that? Hoho... Well, I don't know... I like that singer, Neon, who's so popular these days. You know who that is too, right? I love the way he plays the guitar...

_38.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_38.Summary: Medicine has been stolen from the Infirmary.
_38.Description:
What should I do about this?
Today, when I went into the Infirmary, I saw that all the medicines had been stolen.
Who could have taken it?
I can't treat the students without
it...
Some people say they saw Gotsumon take them.
Will you get the medicine from the Gotsumon for me?
?
You can find Gotsumon if you go to the Wood Bench Trail.
_38.Objective: You bring back medicine from Gotsumon.
_38.CompletionText: Who on earth has taken the Medicine?
_38.CompletionSummary: Oh, my. It was you guys? Oh, it wasn't? Ohhhh, I see. So you're bringing them back to me! Sorry about that. I said that because I was just so agitated... Thank you.

_39.Title: Yokohama Village
_39.Summary: Tell him to devote himself to match preparations.
_39.Description:
There's only little time left before the match, and Hayase Harris is unable to focus lately.
I don't know whether it's because he's worried about his only daughter, but anyhow, tell him I said not to worry and to devote himself to the match. ? Hayase Harris will be training on the Wood Bench Trail...
_39.Objective: You seek out Hayase Harris and convey Shiraki's request.
_39.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1You convey Shiraki's request to Hayase Harris%qe
_39.CompletionText: Hayase Harris will be exercising in the park near the village.
_39.CompletionSummary: Hahaha... You were worried for no reason, unlike a good manager.

_40.Title: Yokohama_Small Forest Park
_40.Description:
The day of the match is fast approaching. Hayase Harris's daughter, Minnie, seems to be
acting a little strange...
Since you are somewhat knowledgeable about problems related to Digimon, why not go there yourselves?
?
Minnie will be at Small Forest Park...

_41.Title: Dats Center
_41.Description:
There's a summons from Commander Richard Sampson at the Dats Center. It sounds like he has something important to say.
Maybe he wants to recognize you as a Dats Official Agent?
Just by becoming a Dats Official Agent, you can move freely to and from the Digital World. It's incredible...
You should go now to find out.
_41.CompletionText: @<tc:800>Official Agent@</tc>...aren't you excited about the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc>?
_41.CompletionSummary: Oh, you're here. I heard you were helping Doctor Akihiro Kurata with his work. He's working for the Real World, but his methods are all wrong. Using those extreme methods will not solve any problems and will just make them hate us more First you must bec

_42.Title: Dats Center
_42.Description: I have collected the DATS Emblems as I promised.
_42.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Yes, this is definitely a @<tc:800>DATS Emblem@</tc>. Good job... To recognize you for your incredible work, @<tc:800>I present you with a Dats Official Agent uniform@</tc>.

_43.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_43.Summary: Humans are to blame for all of this!!
_43.Description:
It's the humans' fault!
The reason the Digimon have become violent is that...
They are responding to evil human emotions like rage, lust, sloth, envy,greed,
and arrogance...
As a tamer, you must be aware of this, right?
That's why I feel sorry for Digimon that follow humans around!
Humans are nothing but beings that plant negative emotions in us!!
The reason Digimon have become this violent is that you keep coming to the Digital World!! It's not my fault!
Although those Impmon you see over there used to work for me...they don't listen to me at all now.
I'm about to go teach those bastards a lesson now...
Are you going to help me out?
Take on the task of defeating 5 Impmon
_43.Objective: Humans are to blame for all of this!!
_43.CompletionText: Don't mistake this for a request. It's an order. I want you to resolve this, because, as a human, you too are partially to blame for this.
_43.CompletionSummary: So you are back from resolving the situation. Since you guys are human, you are not absolutely free from the strange problems of the @<tc:800>Digital World</tc>!

_44.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_44.Description: I obtained these suspicious items while fighting off those bastards who rebelled against me. I have a funny feeling about them... Find out what these are. It seems like the violence from the Digimon has something to do with these items . Huh? It's your job to investigate this, not mine! Bring it to that stuffy Starmon of Passion in the Western Village.
_44.Objective: Let's go find the Starmon of Passion who manages the Western Village.
_44.CompletionText: I refuse to associate with humans any longer!! Get out of here now. This is my turf !!
_44.CompletionSummary: So Impmon is being harmed by this incident too, is that it? Hmm... Any way I look at it, these objects are not from the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc>...

_45.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_45.Description: If you go north from here, you'll find an old building. Digimon avoid the place like the plague. Anyway, recently a strange human like you arrived there and is doing something. Give him this message. Tell him I don't care what he's doing there, but he shouldn't let me catch sight of him.
_45.CompletionText: You should go back to the @<tc:800>Real World@</tc> soon too. I hate humans, you know...
_45.CompletionSummary: What!? Who said this!? Good grief... What an arrogant fool... How dare he try to give the great Doctor Akihiro Kurata a warning... I'll have to make him the subject of my next experiment. Kekekeke....

_46.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_46.Description: Well, while you're passing on that useless information to me, can't you do something to make yourself useful? You can't think of anything constructive to do? Tsk tsk... Even though you're an Official Agent now, you've still got a long way to go... What was Richard Sampson thinking? Tsk... As you may already know, I was dispatched from Dats to research the hateful Digimon in the Digital World. If you are a Dats member as well, you should help me out. Consider yourself lucky that Digimon like Impmon aren't on my research list!! The creatures you see when you survey this area are called Digimon. They are characterized by their armor which is as strong as it looks. Bring me back five of their Back skins!
_46.CompletionText: Get moving, now! Because I want to get out of this place as fast as I can!! Show me that you're still useful!!
_46.CompletionSummary: Ha! It looks worn... But it's still worth using as it is... Tut tut. I've finished investigation in this area, so I plan to go to the outskirts now. Come find me there.

_47.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_47.Summary: Go give support to Doctor Akihiro Kurata
_47.Description:
Since you're now a Dats Official agent, you will receive tasks of increasing importance from now on.
Doctor Akihiro Kurata will be in the Digital World handling an important task,
so find him so you can lend him your support...
Commander Richard Sampson seems to recognize your abilities, so I'll judge them for myself.
_47.Objective: Go give support to Doctor Akihiro Kurata
_47.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Chuchidarumon in Western Village
_47.CompletionSummary: Huh? An adult, male human? Since humans come from the @<tc:800>Real World@</tc> so often now, I don't know who is who... Ah! That's right. If you go north from the Western Village, you'll find an old building, and there is apparently a human doing somet

_48.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_48.Description: Strangely enough, other Digimon seemed to have become strange these days. They've become very violent... The Western Village is important as a bridge between the Real World and Digital World. If we don't preserve the safety here, the humans who have entered the Digital World will be unable to return to the Real World. And if this happens, the balance between the two worlds will be destroyed. I want you to quiet down the violent Digimon in the Western Station area. Kill 5 Woodmon and 5 Togemon. You'll find them easily when you go outside the village.
_48.CompletionText: Hmm... It looks like I'll have to search for the fundamental reason the Digimon have become violent.
_48.CompletionSummary: Good work. Well, this makes me feel a little better, but I still feel anxious that the Digimon might become violent again... And I won't always have you around to do things for me.

_49.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_49.Description:
There probably is a leader for the Digimon that have become violent.
If there weren't, there would be no reason
for them to become suddenly violent like this...
Find out who is leading these Digimon and subdue him.
Togemon (Leader) and Woodmon (Leader) will be there. So go subdue them.
?
But be cautious because those Digimon are extremely dangerous.
_49.CompletionText: And while you're fighting off those Digimon, you should find out some information too...
_49.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Thank you. You're a very fast worker. But it seems like there's something special about the humans who come here. You haven't discovered anything unusual?

_50.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_50.Description:
So you didn't discover anything special...?
Hmm... I heard that there were Impmon in this area.
These Digimon are extremely mischievous. And they're also violent.
They're very difficult to become friendly with..
Is it possible that the Devil Impmon is leading them?
They always hated when humans entered here and became more threatening...
Devil Impmon are always causing trouble in the Western Village.
Go find that Digimon and investigate the reason that the Digimon have become more violent.
The Impmon will be at the center of Western Village.
_50.Objective: Go find the evil Impmon in the center of Western Village.
_50.CompletionText: Why has this area been thrown into such chaos recently ? And humans are coming in frequently too...
_50.CompletionSummary: Huh!? I didn't do anything wrong!! I hate humans, but that doesn't mean I want to harm them!! The rampaging Digimon these days are hurting me a great deal!!

_51.Title: Yokohama Park
_51.Description:
You should listen to what I say if you want to be a Dats Center Official Agent. I have a different way of doing things from Richard Sampson, you see... Richard Sampson doesn't have the right method of approach for dealing with Digimon. He's too spineless. We can't handle the growth of Digimon. With harsher measures, we can eliminate the possibility of a bigger problem...and Directory Hashiba, who manages the Dats Center, agrees with me. And since you're a Dats member, you should help me too... Teehee... Now, go out into the field and collect research material about the Dragon Digimon. .
You can obtain this research material Dragon Digimon by capturing the Koromon you can see in Small Forest Park or Wood Bench Park.
_51.Objective: Obtain three pieces of research material on Dragon Digimon
_51.CompletionText: Go out and capture Koromon to collect information on Dragone Digimon...!!....!
_51.CompletionSummary: Very good... You've brought me some good research material to use.

_52.Title: Yokohama Village
_52.Description:
Since we now have enough information about Dragon Digimon...
now I need research material on Beast Digimon
After observing how you collect research material,
You seem like you would be a good subordinate to me...
Capture Tsunomon to
obtain research material on Beast Digimon...
That won't be very difficult, with your abilities,
will it?
Isn't that right?
Apparently, Upamon and Tsunomon have been confirmed in Small Forest Park and Wood Bench Park.
_52.Objective: Obtain three pieces of research material on Beast Digimon.
_52.CompletionText: What's this! You haven't finished your task yet? What's so hard about capturing those little squirts?
_52.CompletionSummary: Hahaha... This is good DATA.. Huh? What are you waiting around here for, a prize!? You're better off not expecting anything like that from me...

_53.Title: Yokohama Village
_53.Description:
Thanks to the DATA you've brought me
I was able to make a good foundation to do
my research on..
eh!? But don't let this praise go to your head...
Oops, too late...hahahaha!
Now go report the research results to Director Hashiba at the Dats Center.
And don't even think of peeking at them on the way there...
Never mind. You wouldn't even understand what it said even if you did look.
_53.CompletionText: We don't have an hour to lose! Every hour is precious! That's all you have for me, a report that the Real World is in danger!?
_53.CompletionSummary:
Goodness! Can't you see how busy I am? I can't just waste time talking to one Dats member!
What? Akihiro Kurata said what? I see...

_54.Title: <Digimon Arena>
_54.Description:
Welcome to Digimon Arena!
Currently, Digimon Arena is running with @<tc:900>Open Ranking system@</tc>. We can provide you @<tc:900>2 Digimon Arena Admission tickets@</tc> a day, so don't forget to attend the duel match and consume the Battle Points to get all the daily rewards. Be aware that the Digimon Arena Admission expires at @<tc:900>every 00:00@</tc>, so you don't miss your chance!
The Digimon Arena will be constantly updated, so stay tuned.
_54.CompletionText: Take the Digimon Arena Admission with you
_54.CompletionSummary: Digimon Arena will be adopting various events and more challenging Digimon opponents eventually.

_55.Title: Small Forest Trail
_55.Description: You've arrived at just the right time... See that Digimon there? It's called Palmon. It might look docile but it is a vicious creature with powerful poison attack capabilities. Since I can't go on with my research until my safety is secured, go chase those Digimon out of this area...
_55.CompletionText: I can't concentrate on my research! Kill them off, at once! And that's an order!
_55.CompletionSummary: And don't ask me any questions about my research. Kekeke...

_56.Title: Small Forest Trail
_56.Description:
Hohoho...
I have to acknowledge that your Digimon-fighting skills
are top-notch. They're truly excellent...
Although, I don't know if you're if you've got the brains
to match your fighting skills. Ha! Anyway, there's a substance I plan to research
next. It's very unusual...
If I am just able to analyze and develop that substance,
I will be able to order people to do as I please.
And then, I will be able to destroy anyone who
dares to disagree with me.
Doesn't that sound amazing?
This substance is found in the syringe that the PicoDevimon you see over there always carries around.
And the PicoDevimon attacks people with the syringe
and has them do as he pleases...
When you attack that bastard, be careful
of the syringe.
And bring that mysterious substance to me.
_56.Objective: Kill PicoDevimon and bring back 5 syringes.
_56.CompletionSummary: Oh...! Great! Now I have to analyze the ingredients quickly.

_57.Title: Small Forest Trail
_57.Description:
Hehehe..
Let me tell you about Elecmon.
They generate powerful electricity from their
eight tails... They're truly amazing creatures.
And I want to use them as the subject
of my research...Capture 8 Elecmon and bring
them back to me.
What...? You want me to do it? Very funny!
You're the one who should face off against
them, not me! And don't you know that if I can't use you for that purpose, then you're no use to
me all!?
_57.CompletionText: Not done yet!!? I'm still waiting!!
_57.CompletionSummary: Hmmm... I'm not happy with this research material.

_58.Title: Small Forest Trail
_58.Description:
What do you think the fundamentals of a weapon is?
Ha....why did I even bother asking?
There's no way you'd know. Kekeke
Now, for the next research material! Do you see the Bearmon over there?
Doesn't it look cute? Well, don't by deceived by its appearance, or you won't be able to carry out your task. Because now it's your turn to show me what you can do!
Capture both Bearmon and Bearmon (Leader)
and bring them to me.
_58.CompletionText: Keep going, just a little bit longer... Kekekeke...
_58.CompletionSummary:
Very good. Excellent job. It looks like I can now make a weapon for protecting the Real World ...
But keep this a secret from Commander Richard Sampson. Kekeke....

_59.Title: D-Terminal
_59.Description: Hi! I've heard that Starmon in Western Village is worried about the strange incidents happening in that area. If you want to know further, go see him in D-Terminal and ask what's going on.
_59.CompletionText: You can go to D-Terminal through me.
_59.CompletionSummary: Are you a DATS member?? Hmm… it's not a good time for humans to visit here…

_60.Title: Western Village
_60.Description: It's not such a proud thing to be supported by humans, but I see that I don't have a choice. If you wish to leave Western Village and return to DATS Center, you can do it through me. There's no need to hesitate.
_60.Objective: Go to Western Village and talk to Starmon of Passion.
_60.CompletionText: You can go to Western Village through me.

_61.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_61.Description:
I don't know who this Teacher Mori is, but considering that he sent you all this way, he must be a great fan of mine...
He told you to ask me for a guitar? Hmm...that's a pretty tall order...
If you help me out with something, I can give you a much-loved guitar of mine. What do you say?
?
I'm currently planning a recording project, but Digimon have carried off my precious notes.
I've recovered most of them, but..
. ?
I want you to bring back page 3 from Drimogemon and page 10 from Gotsumon.
_61.Objective: Find page 3 and page 10 of Neon's notes
_61.CompletionText: There was an excellent melody running through my head. Would you like to listen to it?
_61.CompletionSummary: Oh, yes! This is it! It's gotten a little dirty, but it's legible...

_62.Title: Yokohama_Village
_62.Description: Thank you... Give my guitar to my fan, Teacher Mori... I even signed my name right on it. He might like it. It's a little strange that a middle-aged man would be such a big fan of mine...but I guess it's because I'm a super-star! Hahaha!!
_62.Objective: Let's go back to Teacher Mori at Yokohama Village
_62.CompletionText: Shouldn't you be on your way now? He's probably waiting for you patiently right at this moment...
_62.CompletionSummary: Did he give you this because you told him I had asked for it? He really is a good friend to give me such an expensive-looking guitar... I'll have to treat you to a beer later on. Hahahah... Now, I'm going to give you a present..some headphones, so you

_63.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_63.Description:
So you've come from Dats to help!
I'm very happy to see you, because
we're in a very dire situation...
Digimon have suddenly appeared...
and, as you can see, are destroying
facilities left and right.
Because the oil refinery handles
very dangerous materials , this could turn into a disaster if we don't do something. I sent my colleagues to assess the situation
...but our communication is cut off now, so I can't even comprehend it.
Find my colleagues and bring me back the report...
_63.CompletionText: You still haven't found it!?!? Hurry back... We are all dead if we don't find out what's going on!!

_64.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_64.Description:
Hmmm... The situation's worse than I thought?
According to the report, there's something wrong with the control device.
It looks like it will have to be repaired promptly, but...
Digimon seem to have stolen the repair equipment... What rotten luck..
Find the Repairman tools those thieves carried off...
_64.Objective: You kill the Digimon in the refinery area and bring back 15 repairman tools
_64.CompletionText: I can't repair control equipment without @<tc:800>Repair Equipment@</tc>, and if I can't repair it... Well, I will spare you the gruesome detail.
_64.CompletionSummary: Very good. With the dangerous situation we're in, you've come back at just the right time. Thanks... I can use this to repair the Control Device!

_65.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_65.Description:
Huh...a report?
So you've come to pick up the report...
Thanks. The truth is that I wrote the
report, but I was unable to budge from here?
because I was surrounded
by Digimon.
?
Please find some way to chase off those Digimon?
?surrounding me. ? Kill 10 each of the WaruMonzaemon and SkullGreymon.
_65.Objective: You kill 10 each of WaruMonzaemon and SkullGreymon.
_65.CompletionText: With the situation now, I'll be burning the midnight oil.
_65.CompletionSummary: Here, take the report. Now you can go and make the report quickly... What...you want to know if I'm going? Hmm...

_66.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_66.Description:
Goodness! How could you have taken so long?!
Don't you know how urgent the situation is!
Huh? You're not an employee of our company? Were you dispatched from Dats?
Well, I'm glad you're here. The WaruMonzaemon ran off with the report on the current situation and
tore it into pieces...
Could you find the pieces of the report and bring
them to me?
Please bring back five pieces of the report.
_66.Objective: Let's capture WaruMonzemon and find the Report Pieces.
_66.CompletionText: Still...you're still not done!?! I need this now!! Quickly!
_66.CompletionSummary: Good, now I'm finished... Now! Now you can pass on this message Deliver the message that the situation here is dire!!

_67.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_67.Summary: I need an accurate grasp of the situation!
_67.Description:
Finally, you're here to see me...Well. You're late,
but it's alright. Go take on those rascals...
Because they're so violent...
I have to keep updating my report.?
When they begin quieting down...
I'll give you an updated report...
Kill 10 SkullSatamon and 5 SkullSatamon (Leader)...
_67.Objective: You kill 10 of SkullSatamon and 5 SkullSatamon (Leader)
_67.CompletionText: If those rascals don't stop destroying everything in sight, I won't be able to write an accurate report...
_67.CompletionSummary: This isn't a satisfactory solution, but this is an accurate report of the situation as it is? Make sure to tell them to take into account a margin of error

_68.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_68.Description: This is really disastrous... Digimon everywhere are behaving violently. This area has stabilized somewhat,but I still haven't received a report on Oil Refinery-2. The situation looks dire. Can you go to oil refinery-2 and verify the situation there?
_68.Objective: Go to oil refinery-2 and find the refinery employees!
_68.CompletionSummary: You want a report on the situation, you say?!! There's no time for that!!

_69.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_69.Description: I can't give you a report now on why the Digimon are suddenly behaving this violently. It's more important to find out if my subordinate workers are safe... The people who said they would do the most they could to prevent damage have not come back yet... They'll be at oil refinery-2, so please make sure they're safe...
_69.Objective: You verify that the refinery employees in the oil refinery-2 area are safe.
_69.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Verifying Safety of Repairman B%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Verifying Safety of Repairman C%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Verifying Safety of Repairman D%qe %cc3/%mc3
_69.CompletionSummary: Well, it's a relief that you're safe...Whew That's very good to hear...
_69.ReservedText: Well, I'm safe, so tell him not to worry...

_70.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_70.Description: I know that uniform!! So you're a DATS Agent... You've come at the right time... Do you see that container there!? It contains dangerous chemical substances. If it explodes, it'll be a disaster. We have to move the truck fast to another location before it explodes... However, I've lost the Truck Key.. Find two Truck Keys... You'll find them if you kill Digimon in this area... ?
_70.Objective: Destroy Digimon in the area and find two Truck Keys and give them to Repairman B
_70.CompletionText: Wow... This is a disaster... If that explodes...
_70.CompletionSummary: Ah.! That's right...it's this one... Found it! What a relief!

_71.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_71.Description: The electricity's gone dead... It looks like a powerful electricity current runs through here. Sunduramon must be the culprit. Because those Digimon use powerful electricity...We won't be able to communicate if the walkie talkies go dead, so the situation will grow more severe. Can you kill 10 Sinduramon? I'm asking you for this favor because you're a DATS Agent.
_71.Objective: You kill10 Sinduramon and make a report to Repairman C.
_71.CompletionSummary: (Crackle...Crackle...) It's on! There's still a lot of static, but it's good enough.

_72.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_72.Description: Whew, you're just in time... As you can see, Volcamon and Cherrymon are threatening port facilities. You might be aware as well, but it take a long time to repair port facilities... You must do whatever it takes to protect the port facilities!! Please go after 10 each of Volcamon and Cherrymon
_72.Objective: Kill 10 each of Volcamon and Cherrymon and make a report to Repairman D
_72.CompletionText: I don't have anything against Digimon either...but I can't help this.
_72.CompletionSummary: Whew, thank you...would it be ok to relax for a little while?

_73.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_73.Description: I'm still optimistic about the situation, but... it looks like you'll have to move fast to the oil refinery-2 area. Of course, the situation here has not been resolved either, but I have to go too... So come find me when you arrive at oil refinery-2!
_73.CompletionText: The situation is urgent!! You have to do something!
_73.CompletionSummary: Well, we're in a difficult situation, but shall we begin?

_74.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_74.Summary: Taking Care of Problems at Oil Refinery-2!!
_74.Description: Here it is!! This will be difficult... Let's get moving toward resolving the situation. I want you to defeat 10 each of Sinduramon, Volcamon, Cherrymon, Meteormon... Those are very dangerous Digimon. You should be careful when facing them.
_74.Objective: You defeat 10 each of Sinduramon, Volcamon, Cherrymon, and Meteormon and make a report to Miki.
_74.CompletionText: Ha, just as long as it doesn't get any worse...

_75.Title: Dats Center
_75.Description: There's an urgent summons from Commander Richard Sampson at the Dats Center... If you go there immediately yourself, you'll find out what the matter is... ?
_75.Objective: Make a report to Commander Richard Sampson at the Dats Center
_75.CompletionText: I'm going now to oil refinery-3.

_76.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_76.Description: SaberLeomon seems to be the leader of the Digimon attack on the oil refinery. A report has arrived that this Digimon has been discovered at oil refinery. It will be a very difficult opponent. But I feel sure you will do as well on this task as you have until now! Good luck.!!
_76.CompletionText: If you don't kill it at once, the Real World will be in danger.
_76.CompletionSummary: Wow, the amount you've grown is truly incredible. You've been through a lot.

_77.Title: Small Forest Trail
_77.Description:
I'm up a creek. There's not much time left until the match, but Those rotten Digimon
stormed into the dojo and ran off with my gloves, boxing shoes, and mouthpiece.
They're nothing but playthings to them...but they're extremely important to us!
Will you bring them back to me??
Palmon took the gloves,
PicoDevimon took the boxing shoes,
and Elecmon took the mouthpiece.
_77.Objective: You bring him 1 pair of gloves, 1 pair of boxing shoes, and 1 mouthpiece.
_77.CompletionText: Those are a world champion's boxing gloves. You have to find them!!!
_77.CompletionSummary: Oh oh... You found them!? Thank you... Now I have nothing to worry about at the match.

_78.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_78.Description:
......................................................
........................................................
I don't want to see my father beaten
anymore! I'm going to kill all of them!
?
( Huh!? I feel Digimon energy. Is it a Togemon!? Togemon have been discovered in the Real World. I have to go to the Digital World. )
_78.CompletionSummary: Oh, so my dad was worried about me... You can tell him that his daughter Minnie is fine.

_79.Title: Dats Center
_79.Description:
Thanks to all your help, it looks like I can devote myself entirely to match
preparations. Would you tell Commander Richard Sampson what I told
you?
_79.CompletionText: I'm busy, I said! Don't just stand there fidgeting! Be on your way!
_79.CompletionSummary: You have dealt with Shiraki's situation very well Good job... I present you with a @<tc:800>DATS Emblem@</tc>.

_80.Title: Yokohama_Village
_80.Description: It looks like Doctor Akihiro Kurata has caused problems in the Digital World. A lot of Digimon have appeared in the oil refinery recently and are destroying everything in their path. Now listen to what Miki Kurosaki, now at Yokohama Village, has to say in detail...
_80.Objective: You find Miki at Yokohama Village
_80.CompletionText: You go promptly to the zone where the problem is. These are the basic principles of Dats.
_80.CompletionSummary: You're pretty late... Were you doing something else before you came here?

_81.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_81.Description:
You might know a little about the situation, but a lot of Digimon have appeared currently in the oil refinery zone. This hasn't been verified yet, but it's said that some of them are in the mega stage.
The situation has become very dire.
It looks like you'll have to go quickly to oil refinery-1 and resolve the problems that the Digimon are causing.
I'll be going there in advance.
Look for me when you get to the Oil Refinery.
_81.CompletionText: This situation is urgent! There's no time to stand around!
_81.CompletionSummary: You're always late... I have to make a report to Commander Richard Sampson!!

_82.Title: Oil Refinery-1
_82.Description:
Now that I'm here at last...
I see that situation is more severe than was reported. Just seeing the Digimon's violent behavior like this will
only spread hostility toward Digimon.
Now...off you go!
?The first priority is to stop the increase of WaruMonzaemon, WereGarurumon, SkullSatamon, and SkullGreymon.
?The people being hurt now in the area will need our help.
_82.CompletionText: This situation is urgent! There's no time to stand around like this!
_82.CompletionSummary: Good work. I wonder if this will bring peace to this region?

_83.Title: Dats Center
_83.Description:
Welcome to Dats.
You are still too inexperienced in many ways to become a new member You should go to Yokohama and hear some things Miki Kurosaki has to say.
?
Miki Kurosaki will be at the Dats vehicle area in the Yokohama Village. You should try using the NPC search function inside Yokohama Village.
_83.CompletionText: Miki will be in the Yokohama Village. If you don't know where you are, you can click on the <N> mark in the upper right-hand portion of the screen, and use the @<tc:800>NPC search@</tc> function.
_83.CompletionSummary: Huh? I don't recognize your face, so you must be a new member.

_84.Title: Yokohama_Village
_84.Description: I am in charge of collecting and scanning of DigiEggs. Collecting returned DigiEggs is the basic duty a Dats member usually has to do. So, while we're on the subject, how about bringing some DigiEggs for me to collect? I heard Inoue Papa, who sells equipment in Yokohama Village, might have some refundable cracked DigiEggs. Will you find Inoue Papa and bring back the cracked DigiEggs?
_84.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Inoue Papa at Yokohama Village
_84.CompletionText: Inoue Papa will be at Yokohama Village.

_85.Title: Yokohama_Village
_85.Description:
DigiEggs are divided broadly into three categories: Cracked DigiEggs which are still refundable when returned to the NPC, Scannable DigiEggs which you can scan because they have DATA remaining, and Mercenary DigiEggs for acquiring mercenaries. By scanning DigiEggs with DATA remaining with a DigiEgg Scan, you can acquire items. However, keep in mind that a fixed amount is also spent when scanning.
So, will you bring a Scannable DigiEgg? Sarah Damon in Yokohama Village discovered Scannable DigiEggs by chance. Go recover and bring them back.
_85.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Sarah Damon in Yokohama
_85.CompletionText: @<tc:800>Scannable DigiEggs@</tc> can be used to acquire various items because they still contain DATA...
_85.CompletionSummary: Wow, how thorough I am. I discovered these while cleaning my house.

_86.Title: Yokohama_Village
_86.Description:
Now, should I make a direct DATA scan? Here's a Practice DigiEgg. Try scanning this one yourself. To do a DATA scan, select Scan DigiEgg after you tell me.
You can press automatic registration, or drag and put up the DigiEgg you want to scan in the inventory.
Bring the items you receive when you scan the DigiEgg back to me....
Try it yourself to see the item you'll receive...hoho...
_86.CompletionText: What do you think you'll get? Aren't you curious?
_86.CompletionSummary: Hahaha... This is a Practice DigiEgg, so you got the item I put in beforehand. When you scan a regular DigiEgg, you can receive or not receive all kinds of different items. So now you have a basic understanding of @<tc:800>DigiEgg scanning@</tc>, right?

_87.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_87.Description: This is the last place I saw Keenan Krier. I couldn't stand it any longer because I can't evolve in the strange field while fighting with someone. I thought I could easily beat Wormmon. Go find clues from Wormmon.
_87.CompletionText: I don't know why I can't evolve...
_87.CompletionSummary: I couldn't find a single trace... There has to be a clue somewhere.

_88.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_88.Summary: Endless Quest to Research Dark Towers
_88.Description: Oho! Finally, I've found a proper Dark Tower.This is quite a desirable item... You guys have to continue to help me with my research! There are a lot of Dark Towers here, but it is very difficult to approach them because Digimon are blocking the way...Let's start with the Dark Tower to the south Now, go at once to clear this area!!
_88.CompletionText: You still haven't left!! Go, at once, so I can prepare!!
_88.CompletionSummary: Oh, you've finished tidying up. Now, we will take a magnificent first step in @<tc:800>Dark Tower@</tc> research. Remember that this is a great honor!

_89.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_89.Summary: Searching for traces of Keenan Krier...
_89.Description: I came here when I received information that Keenan Krier was seen here recently... Take a look around first.
_89.Objective: Searching for traces of Keenan Krier...
_89.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1South Dark Tower%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Southwest Dark Tower%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Central Dark Tower%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Northwest Dark Tower%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Eastern Dark Tower%qe %cc5/%mc5
_89.CompletionText: We have to find it quickly...
_89.CompletionSummary: Hmm, maybe we're a step behind... If we don't find this quickly, it might bring more danger.

_90.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_90.Summary: Research Material on South Dark Tower
_90.Description: We must now start collecting materials about the true Dark Tower! It might be long and arduous work! But you did decide to help me, so you will work with me until the end, right? Our first task is to collect research material on the south Dark Tower. You'll see the Dark Tower if you go south from here! Ah! Just so you know, you can only collect research material from the Digimon who are in the Dark Tower! Keep this in mind as you go about your work!! Go at once!! I'm busy with my other research!
_90.Objective: Research Material on South Dark Tower
_90.CompletionText: I will wait for you this time!!
_90.CompletionSummary: Well, this is good enough...but that doesn't mean you can relax! There is still a lot more research collection left to do!!

_91.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_91.Summary: Collecting Research on Southwest Dark Tower
_91.Description: So the primary research collection is finished, so shall we move to the next zone? Now, we'll...oh, that's right! Now go collect research material at the Central Dark Tower! Keep in mind that you have to collect within the Dark Tower area the same way you did before! Also, you'll have to contend with the Bakemon in the allies you go through while you complete your tasks!!
_91.Objective: Collecting Material on Southwest Dark Tower
_91.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Killing Bakemon in the Darkness%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Southwest Dark Tower DATA%qe %cc2/%mc2
_91.CompletionText: I told you that I will wait for you!!
_91.CompletionSummary: There is a slight difference in every piece of data.

_92.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_92.Summary: Collecting Materials on Northwest Dark Tower
_92.Description: Now, we shall move to the next zone. Now, we'll...oh, that's right! Now go collect research material at the Central Dark Tower! Keep in mind that you have to collect within the Dark Tower area the same way you did before! Also, you'll have to contend with the SkullGreymon in the alleys you go through while you complete your tasks!!
_92.Objective: Collecting Materials on Northwest Dark Tower
_92.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Killing Skull Greymon in Darkness%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Killing Skull Greymon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Northwest Dark Tower Data%qe %cc3/%mc3
_92.CompletionText: I told you that I would wait for you!
_92.CompletionSummary: Hmm..every time I see this it's incredible to me...

_93.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_93.Summary: Collecting Materials on Central Dark Tower
_93.Description: Now, we'll...oh, that's right! Now go collect research material at the Central Dark Tower! Keep in mind that you have to collect within the Dark Tower area the same way you did before! Also, you'll have to contend with the Dark SkullMeramon in the alleys you go through while you complete your tasks!!
_93.Objective: Collecting Materials on Central Dark Tower
_93.CompletionText: I told you that I would wait for you!
_93.CompletionSummary: Whew, I'm tired too!!! Don't complain!!

_94.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_94.Summary: Collecting Materials on Eastern Dark Tower
_94.Description: Now, this is the last stage in the research material collection Lastly, collect the data from East Dark Tower! Keep in mind that you have to collect within the Dark Tower area the same way you did before! Also, you'll have to contend with the WarGreymon in the alleys you go through while you complete your tasks!! Finally, we're almost done with the research! Hahahaha!
_94.Objective: Collecting Materials on Eastern Dark Tower
_94.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1V-mon in Darkness%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Killing WarGreymon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Eastern Dark Tower Data%qe %cc3/%mc3
_94.CompletionText: I told you that I would wait for you!
_94.CompletionSummary: Finally, we've collected all our materials on the Dark Towers. I don't know who made them, but I will definitely capture it for research... Hahaha!!

_95.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_95.Description: By collecting these research materials, we made it difficult for the Digimon living in the Dark Tower area to return to their original state...ha!... And, so, Dats has decided to handle those Digimon. Do a good job with this. Because I have to do research again. Hahahahahaha!!!
_95.Objective: Digimon in Darkness Which Cannot Be Restored
_95.CompletionText: Isn't it natural that this would happen?
_95.CompletionSummary: You've worked hard, no matter what happened during the course of your journey! Well, I've got to get to work now now, so you should get going.

_96.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_96.Description: The Digimon Kaiser does not recognize the Digimon as living beings, and seems to enjoy ordering them around as he pleases. We just have to stop his ambitions... The SkullGreymon that constantly accompanies him has made this a very difficult situation. I don't know how he was able to train it, but even though you'll have to fight the SkullGreymon, you'll be able to face him.
_96.CompletionText: The Digimon Kaiser has made this situation very difficult.
_96.CompletionSummary: Well done. We must find some way to stop the Digimon Kaiser, but I have no idea what his goals are.

_97.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_97.Description: I cannot forgive Wormmon.. If only I could evolve, I could bend him to my will easily...In the state I'm in now, I can't take my revenge on him... Can you guys help me out? Take revenge on the Wormmon for me.
_97.CompletionSummary: You even take revenge on my enemies for me. You certainly seem different from other humans.

_98.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_98.Description: I am curious about who the Digimon Kaiser who built the Dark Tower is.. I think his Partner Digimon is... Wormmon... I will find out when we catch Wormmon and ask!! Now, go and hunt Wormmon!!
_98.CompletionSummary: I caught his Partner Digimon but nothing happened? Vicious bastard... Or did I catch the wrong one?

_99.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_99.Summary: Data collection of Dark Tower Field
_99.Description: It looks like we collected all the basic data of Dark Tower... Now I want to know its operating mechanism... Go and fetch the data in the field! You can't refuse now that you've come this far. Here is the Dark Data Collector. Now, go fetch the data! It is a makeshift version, but it will work.
_99.Objective: Data collection of Dark Tower Field
_99.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1South Dark Tower Data%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Southwest Dark Tower Data%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Central Dark Tower Data%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Northwest Dark Tower Data%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5East Dark Tower Data%qe %cc5/%mc5
_99.CompletionText: It is mysterious machine the more I see it~
_99.CompletionSummary: Oh, here you are. You are a little bit late, but that's okay. We'd better delve into that sinister thing!

_100.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_100.Description: By collecting these research materials, we made it difficult for the Digimon living in the Dark Tower area to return to their original state...ha!... And, so, Dats has decided to handle those Digimon. Do a good job with this. Because I have to do research again. Hahahahahaha!!!
_100.Objective: Digimon in Darkness Which Cannot Be Restored
_100.CompletionText: Isn't it natural that this would happen?
_100.CompletionSummary: You've worked hard, no matter what happened during the course of your journey! Well, I've got to get to work now now, so you should get going.

_101.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_101.Description: Hmmm...anyway, it wasn't a Worrmmon. Anyway, there's nothing I can do, since I don't have enough information!!! Then, it was the SkullGreymon I saw at the entrance...but how could he have tamed such a violent creature!!?? I won't give up, though!! I'll show him that I can control violent creatures too!! But to do this, I'll need data on SkullGreymon!! Go at once, to get it for me!! I can start my project immediately, when you bring it back!!
_101.CompletionText: Oh... All this stuff with the Digimon Kaiser is giving me a headache...
_101.CompletionSummary: Good work! I have to begin my project at once!!

_102.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_102.Description: Finally, I've finished this... this is a Digimon brainwashing device of my own making!! And I didn't make this because I'm jealous of the Digimon Kaiser!! I'm only using it because I can obtain research information more easily by brainwashing the Digimon!! I don't know if it will work properly, but... Try using it!!
_102.CompletionText: Thanks to the Digimon Kaiser, I'm completely exhausted.
_102.CompletionSummary: Well, my whole brainwashing idea was nonsense..I have to think of another plan..Just wait a moment, while I think...Digimon Kaiser...

_103.Title: D-Terminal
_103.Description: The train to Snowstorm Village in Digital World just opened... As I expected, there have been many problems since it opened. Anyway, they seem to be related to the Strange Activities appearing all over the Digital World. Go to the Snowstorm Village and pay Dr. Akihiro Kurata a visit.
_103.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Dr. Akihiro Kurata of Snowstorm Village
_103.CompletionText: If you don't go at once, Dr. Akihiro Kurata will be annoyed
_103.CompletionSummary: You're so late! I'm tired of waiting for you!

_104.Title: Snowstorm Village
_104.Description: How on earth did it become so cold here? I have to warm up. Ohhh, it's so cold. Catching 8 Gabumon will warm me up. Don't you think so? Stop complaining!! I'm cold too!! Just do this, and you can warm up your body. Come back quick!
_104.CompletionSummary: I've warmed up enough, but have nothing to do now, so I'm still cold... I have to begin my research soon...Oh, it's cold.

_105.Title: Snowstorm Village
_105.Description: Ohh...it's so cold I can't stand it!!! I can't do my research properly!! I don't have any thick clothes... I will need that Fur Coat Gabumon wears draped over him.. Take and bring back the Fur Coat Gabumon wears around.. I'll handle the rest myself!
_105.CompletionText: Come back quick! I'm so cold I could die!
_105.CompletionSummary: Even at this stage of my career, I'm stuck doing stuff like this...But I can't quit doing my research...What a fix I'm in

_106.Title: Snowstorm Village
_106.Description: Whew, well, now it's somewhat bearable It doesn't look so strange from the outside... I wore it underneath my jacket, so don't look at me like that!! Anyway, I will now brief you on the strategy we'll be pursuing here...
_106.CompletionSummary: Anyway, this place seems to be a passage that Digimon are using to pass over! This is why I've come to do this research.Well, I do have some other goals, but don't worry, I'll tell you what they are, all in good time! Oh, right! You'll have to collect da

_107.Title: Snowstorm Village
_107.Description: Hello, I am known in the Digital World as a SuperStarmon detective. My pursuit of the strange activities brought me to the place....What's this tomb-like thing?? Tell me, if you know. Hm, from the look on your face,you don't know either. Well, that's that! The Guilmon are making it hard for me to do my investigations, so why not face off against the Guilmon? I'm a private detective, not a police detective, so I'm having some challenges... Please help me out with this.
_107.CompletionText: What could this bizarre tomb be?
_107.CompletionSummary: Well, despite the thorough job you did fighting them off, they keep popping up. I should just continue with my investigation anyway. Thanks anyway.

_108.Title: Snowstorm Village
_108.Description: Ah... Do you think I am easy to deal with!? Oh! I wasn't talking to you. I'm not mad at you.... It's those Guilmon.. Even their chief has turned up now and is impeding my investigation!! Now!! Be on your way, brave tamers! Like I told you, I am not a detective... Hahaha
_108.CompletionText: I want to dig up the tomb.......but the snow is making my hands cold.
_108.CompletionSummary: You've worked very hard, tamers. Have you guys considered becoming police investigators?? Hahaha

_109.Title: Snowstorm Village
_109.Description: Hm, well, I can only only be a true detective if I overcome these difficulties and do this research! I have to begin my research, so perhaps you should go have a cup of tea somewhere, and come back! Maybe if my cold hands move you to pity, you could bring me a shovel from somewhere?? Oh, never mind, I'll just dig with my hands. You will see what I dig up later.
_109.CompletionSummary: Finally I know what this grave is all about... Oops! Never mind what I said.. Well... Someone's footprints are clearly outlined on this grave... Just hold on a second... They're claws...

_110.Title: Snowstorm Village
_110.Description: Just because I investigated the tomb quickly doesn't mean I did a sloppy job. Judging from these claw patterns...it looks like a Guilmon is the most likely suspect... Considering how violent they are, it make sense. Would you capture Guilmon for me? Stop your complaining! Come back quick!
_110.CompletionText: Still not done?? Well, it's not urgent, but....
_110.CompletionSummary: Oh, you brought back the suspect! Now I will give it my interrogation.

_111.Title: Snowstorm Village
_111.Description: I am thinking of investigating Gabumon's Horn. What are you just standing there for!? You want me to tell you why?? Well, it's a secret! Get going and bring me those horns!
_111.CompletionText: I told you to bring them back!
_111.CompletionSummary: Oh, you're back...well, thanks for the hard work. Now I shall begin my research

_112.Title: Snowstorm Village
_112.Description: It seems like the Digimon don't feel the cold...Investigating their cold protection abilities will be helpful in my research. Does that sound good?! Bring me back data you collect on the Gabumon and Guilmon Cold Protection Properties!
_112.Objective: Investigation of Digimon Cold Protection Abilities
_112.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Data on Gabumon Cold Protection Abilities%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Data on Guilmon Cold Protection Abilities%qe %cc2/%mc2
_112.CompletionText: If I just apply these Cold Protection Abilities, it won't matter how cold it is.
_112.CompletionSummary: Great... This is it! Now I'll go apply it.

_113.Title: Snowstorm Village
_113.Description: Anyway, the Guilmon seems to be keeping its mouth shut. This leaves me no choice but to use force. You'll have to collect a claw sample from the Guilmon... That way, I'll be able to compare the evidence, you see. Please help me with this, brave tamers...
_113.Objective: Collection of Evidence on the Culprit
_113.CompletionText: When I get the evidence, the Digimon will be stuck! Hahaha!
_113.CompletionSummary: Good work! Now I will go compare the evidence!

_114.Title: Snowstorm Village
_114.Description: Finally, I have the results from the evidence...
_114.CompletionSummary: Anyway, Guilmon do not seem to be behind this. The claw prints do not match. On top of that, they appear to have been outlined artificially, and Digimon are incapable of making these artificial claw prints.

_115.Title: Snowstorm Village
_115.Description: Well, then who built this tomb? If it wasn't a Digimon, it must have been a human. It's great that someone has built this tomb, but I want to know who it was!!! Ay, being at this impasse is giving me a headache...
_115.Objective: The Mystery of the Builder of the Tomb
_115.CompletionSummary: First off, I need to pursue the investigation based on the hypothesis that humans built it...Hmm...

_116.Title: Frozen Ground
_116.Description: It looks like I'll have to stop my research here and go to Frozen Ground. Anyway, it seems certain that a human made it, from the situation, but it doesn't look like doing more research at Snowstorm Village will yield many results... First off, I'll go Frozen Ground, so you should come along to! It wouldn't be polite of you to desert me, now that you've already begun helping me in my investigation! See you at Frozen Ground!
_116.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with SuperStarmon at Frozen Ground
_116.CompletionSummary: Hmm... You're finally here I can see that there are a lot of odd things here. Let's do a little more research!

_117.Title: Snowstorm Village
_117.Summary: There Is no Material on Guilmon
_117.Description: This is funny. I have no material on Guilmon...could there perhaps be a Digimon I don't know about!? I'm a highly-educated Ph.D.! There's no way I could not know about this! Guilmon...
_117.Objective: There is nothing in Digimon Material on Guilmon
_117.CompletionSummary: No matter how hard I look, I can't find any material on Guilmon. How could this be? And it won't suddenly turn up either.

_118.Title: Snowstorm Village
_118.Description: Ack! I can't find any material on Guilmon!! This is humiliating... All right then. I will collect all the data on Guilmon that I can... I will put an end to it. Go quickly, to collect data on Guilmon!!
_118.CompletionSummary: You've brought back the data... I'm going to begin research with the data you collected, so be quiet now.

_119.Title: Snowstorm Village
_119.Description: This is so unfortunate... I've never seen this Digimon anywhere else before.... I'm completely perplexed, and fat lot of good my Ph.D. is doing! This is so infuriating!!! Well, I have to acknowledge there's something I am ignorant about. This is humiliating for me to do, but I'll have to send you to Yukidarumon to ask about Guilmon. Run along and come back quickly. I feel so dejected...
_119.CompletionText: I told you to get going!
_119.CompletionSummary: The Guilmon? The Guilmon is a Digimon which appeared all of a sudden recently. It seems to be artificially made. I've never seen it before either I don't know anything about it, except that it's very violent... I'm sorry.

_120.Title: Snowstorm Village
_120.Description: Ah! Would you help me out with something? I left this igloo empty for a long time, and then some annoying Digimon called a Bearmon popped up. It's been giving me some problems, because it looks like a bear and is as strong as one too. Would you help me look after this area? I have to take care of the igloo.
_120.CompletionSummary: Oh, you're back. Thank you. This is somebody's home actually. Someone built it and then left, so I have to guard it until that person comes back.

_121.Title: Snowstorm Village
_121.Description: So you're saying Yukidarumon doesn't know either! I'm dying to find out about it...First of all, I need more information, so would you mind capturing a Guilmon for me? I can't believe there's something I'm ignorant of. I feel pathetic.
_121.CompletionSummary: Oh...good work... I'll begin my research immediately.

_122.Title: Snowstorm Village
_122.Description: By the way, Keenan Krier still has not come back. I've been hearing rumors that he came across a human called the Digimon Kaiser, which would be very unfortunate. I hope nothing bad has happened to him, but if you hear any news about Keenan Krier, please tell me.
_122.CompletionSummary: It makes me very worried that Keenan Krier has not returned.

_123.Title: Snowstorm Village
_123.Description: When I was fixing up the igloo area, I saw the mailbox had disappeared. Someone seems to have taken the mailbox. Judging from the animal footprints, it is clear that Garurumon have taken it. I don't know if there are any letters in it, but please take the mailbox back from them. Perhaps there will be a letter from Keenan Krier
_123.CompletionText: I don't know if there will be a letter from Keenan Krier inside...
_123.CompletionSummary: Oh, my! There is a letter from him! Just a moment... Luckily, Keenan Krier seems to be doing fine... This is very good news... It says that he is in pursuit off something, so he can't come back a while... You're looking for Keenan Krier too, aren't you? I

_124.Title: Snowstorm Village
_124.Description: Well, first of all, I'm relieved to see a letter from Keenan Krier, but I am still angry with the Garurumon... It seems to have become violent because of the Strange Activities in the Digital World. Go defeat the violent Garurumon.
_124.CompletionText: If we don't do something about the violent Digimon, there might be damage to the Digital World.

_125.Title: Snowstorm Village
_125.Description: Hm, there is something else that is worrying me...Keenan Krier seems to have fallen into the Icemon's trap and no longer trusts humans, despite being a child of humans. This is horrible news.. We need to take care of Icemon, the mischief-maker first. We can look for Keenan Krier later. I will leave the matter in your hands.
_125.CompletionSummary: Good work. Now you have to find Keenan Krier, but he seems to be at a very remote distance...You're best off looking for him at Snowstorm Village. I will do my best to help too.

_126.Title: Snowstorm Village
_126.Description: Those horrid Guilmon! How violent they are! Sometimes I feel that all Digimon should be destroyed, but then I'd be out of a job! There's nothing I can do... There's no way I could like Digimon if there are Digimon that behave this violently!! Anyway... I'm done with all my research
_126.CompletionSummary: This data seems to be derived from data someone arbitrarily manufactured. To put it simply, this is an anomalous appearance. This is what I've learned so far. It would be worth it to pursue more research on it.

_127.Title: Snowstorm Village
_127.Description: Ah... My back is killing me... Huh, what bring you guys here?? What? I followed you, you say? What are you talking about? Don't be ridiculous. Why would I follow you? I came here because I have some business to take care of here!
_127.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I'm not in good condition now, so I don't have time to face you... I have to find and defeat a stronger opponent than you guys in order to evolve... Oh, I'm in such pain..

_128.Title: Snowstorm Village
_128.Summary: Let's Teach the Guilmon a Lesson
_128.Description: Those rotten Guilmon... The first time I came here, I left the grave area and was humiliated at the hands of Guilmon. I'm so angry. I have to find a way to avenge myself.. Oh!
