There are snowballs piled all around, so why don't you go teach those Guilmon a lesson!! II am asking you to take revenge on my enemies because I know how kind you are!! Hurry on!
_128.Objective: Let's Teach the Guilmon a Lesson
_128.CompletionSummary: Ha! Serves you right, you Guilmon! Good work. I feel much better now.

_129.Title: Snowstorm Village
_129.Description: Oh, thanks for the baseball cap... I'm saving it until the weather gets a little colder, so don't worry... Anyway, Icemon are currently running wild in this area... I could take care of this matter myself, but they're such an easy opponent for me, there is no need for me to interfere... You guys can go handle this matter.
_129.CompletionText: Aren't there any difficult opponents for me?
_129.CompletionSummary: Hmm, it seems your skills have greatly improved recently. Later I'll give you a test of your abilities.

_130.Title: Snowstorm Village
_130.Description: Oh...it's freezing here...and I have nothing to wear......... Bearmon wear hats though. Bring me back some Bearmon hats... If I just put on a hat, I'll be able to bear the cold more...
_130.CompletionSummary: Thanks, my human friend. But is the hat too big? No, it fits! Thank you.

_131.Title: Frozen Ground
_131.Description: You probably saw black wheels discarded all over the place on your way here, which likely means that the Strange Activities in the Digital World have spread here...
_131.CompletionSummary: Let's leave our other work aside and do research on these black saw-toothed wheels.

_132.Title: Frozen Ground
_132.Description: We have to start collecting the black wheels. That way we'll be able to do research on it. We don't need the gear discarded in the landscape, so you should get the gears from Digimon in the area. Obtain them from Tentomon
_132.CompletionText: Now I've brought the black wheels here.
_132.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Shall we investigate what this might be?

_133.Title: Frozen Ground
_133.Description:
Huh? This?!!!
I don't know either...although I can guess how it changes Digimon...
_133.CompletionSummary: Dang! This is frustrating! Being a detective is not an easy job...

_134.Title: Frozen Ground
_134.Description: Well, you'll have to ask Doctor Akihiro Kurata about this... I don't like having to do this... But we can't just ignore it. Go ask Doctor Akihiro Kurata and come back...
_134.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Akihiro Kurata at Snowstorm Village
_134.CompletionText: Come back soon. I don't have much time.
_134.CompletionSummary: What? What have you come to ask me?
_134.ReservedText: I'm busy now! What is it?

_135.Title: Frozen Ground
_135.Description: Oh, so the private detective is making a request to me... That's unexpected. Leave the gears to me, and you go back to the Fourth dimension SuperStarmon. Wait! Tell him that since I helped him this time, he owes me a favor later... Since he's a private detective, I can probably find many uses for it! Ha!
_135.CompletionText: Well, its certainly a surprise to see you.
_135.CompletionSummary: Ooh, I can't stand that person...Well, there's nothing I can do about this. Thank you for making the effort anyway.
_135.ReservedText: Well, you've never liked Akihiro Kurata.

_136.Title: D-Terminal
_136.Description: Something urgent has come up! Come see me quick!!
_136.CompletionSummary: You've come sooner than I thought! I thought you'd take longer!

_137.Title: Snowman Village
_137.Summary: The cold just won't go away.
_137.Description: I can't get used to the cold at all..... How could Digimon stand this freezing temperature of the Digital World... I think we need Mammothmon's data to overcome such a low temperature... Yes, we need the data... Ah... It's freezing cold here...
_137.Objective: The cold just won't go away.
_137.CompletionText: Oh, it's so cold...Why is it colder here when we're in the same zone?
_137.CompletionSummary: Goodness, thanks for your work. Now I must find a way to warm up using this...

_138.Title: Snowman Village
_138.Description: Now, I feel a lot better~ I haven't come here in a long time... What? I never told you that I've come here before, you say??
_138.CompletionSummary: I came by here when I joined the beginning Digital Expedition Remembering that time only bad memories back to me, so I don't want to talk about it!!

_139.Title: Snowman Village
_139.Description: I am receiving very detailed information about the suspect. This is very good news. First go see Yukidarumon and come back, as I have to investigate this area more. Also, don't neglect to fight off Digimon you encounter on the way there and back.
_139.CompletionText: Come back quick. The information the informant will give you is very important.
_139.CompletionSummary: Well, I had noticed that as well, but it doesn't interest me. You'll have to ask Keenan Krier.
_139.ReservedText: It is certain that the chain of events recently in the Digital World has something to do with the human tamers. But someone else seems to be involved as well...I don't know who it is yet, but perhaps Keenan Krier will know

_140.Title: Snowman Village
_140.Description: Go ask Keenan Krier about these events. It is likely that Keenan Krier might know what they are, but don't forget to fight Digimon you encounter on the way.
_140.CompletionText: Now, I can size it up...
_140.CompletionSummary: Hmm...Digimon Kaiser? I've never heard that name before. Well now that I know who's behind this, I have to capture that guy!
_140.ReservedText: So, a tamer called the Digimon Kaiser is behind all this Strange Activities..It's his fault the Digimon are becoming this violent.... If I don't take action fast, the Digital World will fall under his power.

_141.Title: Snowman Village
_141.Description: Falcomon will be worried... I want to give him some encouragement, but he looks so busy...Oh, I've got an idea... Since Falcomon will be worried about this situation, you can just deliver him my letter...
_141.CompletionText: I'm so worried that he was hurt.
_141.CompletionSummary: A letter from Keenan Krier!!! Ha, he seems fine... what a relief. Thank you for delivering the letter to me. I feel better now.

_142.Title: Snowman Village
_142.Description: You can listen to me reminisce later. Now you must fight off the Mammothmon in this area. They're preventing me for collecting these materials. Hurry back. Oh...It's so cold.
_142.CompletionText: Why are the Digimon making things so difficult?
_142.CompletionSummary: Good work. Now I can do my work more quickly.

_143.Title: Snowman Village
_143.Description: You can listen to me reminisce later. Now you must fight off the Mammothmon in this area. They're preventing me for collecting these materials. Hurry back. Oh...It's so cold.
_143.CompletionText: Why are the Digimon making things so difficult?
_143.CompletionSummary: Good work. Now I can do my work more quickly.

_144.Title: Snowman Village
_144.Description: Who on earth keeps doing these awful things to Digimon? If we don't stop this, they'll they will have to turn back into DigiEggs... I have to find the person causing this... Would you guys fight off the Digimon in this area, so I can find my target?
_144.CompletionSummary: Good job... But I feel sorry for them...

_145.Title: Snowman Village
_145.Description: How busy I am! But I'm happy that I'm busy! I But I can't be happy--I'm too busy!!! There's been a request from the Dats center.... You, as Dats members, should fulfill the request. It's very fortunate that you're here. The request asks for a road to be made to Snowman Village. You'll have to drill a road first, but violent Digimon will make it hard for you to pass through. Go handle the request
_145.CompletionText: You haven't left yet?? Go fulfill the request now, so we can have a break.
_145.CompletionSummary: Wow. Job well done, gentlemen. Now we can have peace of mind~

_146.Title: Distorted Data Village
_146.Description:
Oh, you're finally here.
Long time, no see. Have you been well?? Actually, we don't have time for greetings. There have been very strange occurrences here.
It wasn't like this the last time I came...
Would you mind going over to the Safe Zone?? Just go north from here to get there.
There might be Digitamamon over there.
_146.CompletionText: I have a funny feeling about something.
_146.CompletionSummary:
So, you're finally here??
Somebody has distorted the data here, which is a huge problem.

_147.Title: Distorted Data Village
_147.Description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves! We are members of the Glacier Defense Corps of the Glacier Region!! I am the leader, Penguin No.1!! As you can see, not all leaders are red!
Well, now that we have finished our introduction, on to business. We must find a solution for the strange activities in the Glacier Region.
_147.Objective: Strange Activities in Distorted Data Village
_147.CompletionSummary: I don't know who is responsible for this, but we will do our utmost to protect this place!!

_148.Title: Distorted Data Village
_148.Description: Our Glacier Defense Corps was about to begin independent research. Can you can help us out too? But don't misinterpret the request as an admission of poor abilities. Let's begin our research with an investigation of MetalGarurumon. ?
_148.CompletionText: Leaders are not all red, you know! Huh? Oh, sorry, I thought you were someone else.
_148.CompletionSummary: Well, you've worked very hard, but unfortunately, MetalGarurumon does not seem to be behind this...

_149.Title: Distorted Data Village
_149.Description: Well, let's eliminate MetalGarurumon from the list of possible suspects and inform Penguin No.2 of this.
_149.CompletionText: Quickly, quickly. No. 2 is waiting for you.
_149.CompletionSummary: Oh, you're telling me news from our leader. It's a little awkward meeting for the first time though!!! Anyway, even though it's awkward, thanks for the good news!

_150.Title: Distorted Data Village
_150.Description: It seems as if the data has been distorted by someone...
_150.CompletionSummary: We have to do something about this situation, and you guys look like you need some help.

_151.Title: Distorted Data Village
_151.Description: In order to understand the causes, you have to ask the Digimon here about why this has happened. Come back to find me after you ask Penguin No.1, Digitamamon, and Penguin No.2 about what has caused this situation.
_151.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speaking with Penguin No. 1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Speaking with Penguin No. 2%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Speaking with Digitamamon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_151.CompletionText: This problem will gradually get worse and worse...
_151.CompletionSummary: Nobody knows about this, but the same thing occurred long ago too. We seem to getting more and more lost in a labyrinth. We need to do more research on this.
_151.ReservedText: Hmm, I know that someone caused this to happen, but I don't know who it is!!

_152.Title: Distorted Data Village
_152.Description: Oh, you're finally here. Do you know what that thing you see in front of you is? Don't look at me like that. I don't know either... Because I have to investigate this here first, come back after you clear this area.
_152.CompletionSummary: It looks like you cleared this area. What...what on earth is this?

_153.Title: Distorted Data Village
_153.Description: Now I have to begin my investigations. I'm so curious about these things I can't take it!!! It looks like a DigiEgg, but....Hmm....
_153.CompletionSummary: How should I handle this? I have no idea...

_154.Title: Distorted Data Village
_154.Description: Ah!!! I have a headache!!! I don't have a clue what I'm doing!!! Let's just put a halt to all the research and investigations we've done!!
_154.Objective: Interruption of All Research and Investigation
_154.CompletionSummary: As long as I can't investigate this unknown egg in front of me, it seems that I can't touch any other work either!! It's time to begin new work!! What joy!

_155.Title: Distorted Data Village
_155.Description: How did this happen? Whatever I try to do, Digimon block my every move!! I can't work in peace at all! What are you guys doing, just standing here!? Go do something about the MetalEtemon around here!!
_155.Objective: King of Digimon! Metal Etemon's Obstruction!
_155.CompletionText: Don't talk to me!! Stop all this chattering.
_155.CompletionSummary: My head already hurts enough as it is......Huh??? You say the MetalEtemon seem peculiar to you??? Since they've come here, I'm up to my ears in work!!

_156.Title: Distorted Data Village
_156.Description: Hmm... This is the first news from him, so he doesn't say anything very special... He asks to investigate the Digimon in this area... Let's start the investigation first. Go investigate MetalEtemon for me. I'm leaving this in your hands.
_156.CompletionText: He's our leader, but, well....how should I put it? It's nothing. Forget about it.
_156.CompletionSummary:
You've done good work.
Anyway, we must eliminate the MetalEtemon from the list of possible suspects.

_157.Title: Distorted Data Village
_157.Description: It seems natural to have to immediately report the investigation results, so would you start off by making a report to Penguin No.1?
_157.CompletionText: The leader is so....bizarre..... Oh! It's a secret.
_157.CompletionSummary: Hmmm... That's what I thought as well, and it turns out I was right... Well, our last option is to put our expectations on our Penguin No. 3...

_158.Title: Distorted Data Village
_158.Description: Finally, I have a job to do.
_158.CompletionText: Penguin No. 3 is not blue....All of us are black...
_158.CompletionSummary: So they found nothing. I understand.

_159.Title: Distorted Data Village
_159.Description: We got swept up in some annoying issue....But we're members of the Glacier Defense Corps, so we can't just overlook it... Why don't we investigate all the members from scratch~ Our target is the Vikemon. Now, let's go!!
_159.CompletionText: I'm not forcing you to do this task I'm giving you. But please, help us out...
_159.CompletionSummary: There is nothing useful here... Why did I get involved in this... Dang...

_160.Title: Distorted Data Village
_160.Description: Anyway, the Digimon here don't seem to be responsible for this....we'll have to look for a new culprit. Is there any other place that comes to mind?? Why not share your information with some worthy people ? Oh, I see. You don't want to tell me because I'm not a human...ha!
_160.Objective: Search for a Solution to Strange Activities
_160.CompletionText: Please Share Your Information With Us.
_160.CompletionSummary: The Digimon Kaiser, you said? And who might that be??? Hahaha, being new members of the defense corps, we're susceptible to information... Anyway, thanks for the information!

_161.Title: Distorted Data Village
_161.Description: It seems like there are other effects of the strange activities here as well.. I have a feeling there might be another cause for this... Huh?? We'll have to find out what those causes are graduall. Let's first ask the Digimon in this area what they are! Co capture MegaKabuterimon in the area!!
_161.CompletionText: Is the Digimon Kaiser behind this? Or is it someone else?
_161.CompletionSummary: Good work. It doesn't look like it is the MegaKabuterimon that are causing this.

_162.Title: Distorted Data Village
_162.Description: Hmm... It seems that someone has intentionally distorted the data here...
_162.CompletionSummary: But why did this person do this...does he want something?? Or... Is there another reason..

_163.Title: Distorted Data Village
_163.Description: Let's deal with the problem here first... The distorted data seem to be having an effect on the Digimon.... It seems to be exactly like the strange activities in the Digital World... Go deal with the Digimon in the area...
_163.Objective: Finding Out the Reason for This Is the Top Priority
_163.CompletionText: I wish someone would give us a clue or something...

_164.Title: Distorted Data Village
_164.Description: Anyway, we don't have much information to go on... Go get Doctor Akihiro Kurata's advice on this situation..And don't forget to fight off Digimon you encounter on your way to see him.
_164.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speaking with Doctor Akihiro Kurata%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Killing HiAndromon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Killing HiAndromon (Leader)%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Killing Vikemon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Killing Vikemon (Leader)%qe %cc5/%mc5
_164.CompletionText: Akihiro Kurata will know something about this.
_164.CompletionSummary: Hmm...so a human did this. Well, then, maybe...
_164.ReservedText: Wait a minute! Why should I have to trouble myself with this now, of all times, when I don't even enough time to focus all my attention on this one DigiEgg. Fine, I'll give you one piece of information...this is a human's handiwork! That's all I'm saying

_165.Title: Distorted Data Village
_165.Description: Well, if the suspect is a human, that narrows our choices....And that means we can't eliminate Doctor Akihiro Kurata from the possible suspects...Go investigate Chief Homer Yushima and Doctor Akihiro Kurata and come back.
_165.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speaking with Doctor Akihiro Kurata%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Speaking with Chief Homer Yushima%qe %cc2/%mc2
_165.CompletionText: Remember that just because you're acquainted with a suspect doesn't mean you can let him off easy in the interrogation.
_165.CompletionSummary: So... It wasn't those two. Then there's just one other person left.
_165.ReservedText: What? You're interrogating me? I've been at your side all this time. You've got the wrong guy.

_166.Title: Distorted Data Village
_166.Description: Well, then our only final suspect is the Digimon Kaiser....And we haven't seen him here...How could this be I heard the Glacier Defense Corps was around these parts Why don't you ask Penguin No. 3 close by~ You'd better take care of Vikemon on the way there~
_166.Objective: Investigation of Connections with Digimon Kaiser
_166.CompletionText: Why is the Digimon Kaiser causing such violence here?
_166.CompletionSummary: Ack! It's not the Digimon Kaiser!!!!!!????
_166.ReservedText: The Digimon Kaiser??? Well, he's one possible suspect, but I don't believe it's him.

_167.Title: Distorted Data Village
_167.Description: Now what should I do? Well, then who on earth is causing all off this!? Hmm... Aha!!! Perhaps this isn't something that arose just recently?? That's it!!
_167.CompletionSummary: It's a pretty interesting deduction, isn't it!? Anyhow, one can see that the problem here started quite along time ago, perhaps even before the Glacial Defense Corps...Well, I can't be sure about this yet...We must investigate this further.

_168.Title: Distorted Data Village
_168.Summary: Who has done this to Village!?
_168.Description: Huh, what's this!!! How could everything have changed while I was just on a business trip to Snowstorm Village..... What? It didn't just happen? So this started a long time ago, huh? Who cares, though? Who was it? Who has done this to the village!!! Is it you!? It's not you? Then MetalEtemon is the only culprit!! You guys go teach MetalEtemon a lesson!! If you don't do that, I'll report you!!
_168.Objective: Who has done this to the Distorted Data Village!?
_168.CompletionText: Waaa!!! The Distorted Data Village has come to this...
_168.CompletionSummary: Well, thank you for doing this, but...now that I consider it, there never was anything at the Distorted Data Village... I'm sorry I put you through all that...

_169.Title: Distorted Data Village
_169.Description: I'm sorry about what happened earlier...That's life, isn't it? But something certainly is odd... The data have been severely distorted, which prevents me from making the things I need to run my business.
_169.Objective: I can't sell anything, now that the Distorted Data Village is in this state!!
_169.CompletionSummary: I don't know who is behind this, but he must be caught immediately. So please do your best...

_170.Title: Distorted Data Village
_170.Description: Ah, the penguin you just saw is our leader... He seems a little unfocused, but in the Digital World, that doesn't matter. On top of that, the fact that we're even talking shows how incredible the world is.
_170.CompletionSummary: I'm sorry our leader surprised you.

_171.Title: Distorted Data Village
_171.Description: So... What's the leader doing over there? Why is he over there... Isn't it hot?. If he just flaps his wings, he can get out from there... Maybe he's embarrassed... You should bring some water to cool Penguin No.2's.
_171.CompletionSummary: Our leader has harmed you again. Let me apologize for him.
_171.ReservedText: Oh, so the leader has again...

_172.Title: Distorted Data Village
_172.Description: I'm very sorry about the leader.. So you've come because you need water. But I don't have any water now, so I can't help you... You can obtain the water from the Digitamamon in the area and bring it back to Penguin No.3?
_172.CompletionText: Please do this for me, even if it's a nuisance.
_172.CompletionSummary: What? You want water?? I have some, but it's very precious, you know.

_173.Title: Distorted Data Village
_173.Description:
I do have water, but if I just give it to you... Just giving it to you would be an insane way to run a business... I can't help that I'm a salesperson, first and foremost If you don't need it, I won't care if you just go.
But if you really want it, you can go collect Dark Tower remnants from the MetalEtemon as payment. I don't know who made them, but they seem to have been made with rare minerals. If you are a merchant, you want to have anything valuable..
_173.CompletionText: I thought you needed this water! Why are you so late?
_173.CompletionSummary: Oh, good work. So you've finally obtained the remnants of the Dark Tower

_174.Title: Distorted Data Village
_174.Description:
Well, a promise is a promise, so here's the water. But what are you going to use all this water for?
Well, I'm not particularly interested in your reasons. Just take the water and be off! If you feel like it, buy something... Hahaha!!
_174.ObjectiveProgress: Giving the Water to Penguin No. 3
_174.CompletionSummary: Finally, you're back. I am sorry to have put you through this trouble.
_174.ReservedText: You brought water for the Penguin Leader... Thank you!

_175.Title: Distorted Data Village
_175.Description: Now could you sprinkle the water on the penguin leader to cool him down? He seems to have no plans of coming out of there.... Dang!! Here comes the troublemaker!!!
_175.ObjectiveProgress: Let's sprinkle water on the volcanic zone!
_175.CompletionSummary: I feel horrible for having caused you harm.

_176.Title: Distorted Data Village
_176.Description: I first have to investigate this.. There is force shield surrounding the DigiEgg... Someone must have deployed it on purpose... I am not so sure.... Since we couldn't pass through the shield, let's test it with the data collector.
_176.CompletionText: This is pulling me right along...
_176.CompletionSummary: I can't collect anything with this... I have to take it out myself but I have no way to penetrate the force field.

_177.Title: Distorted Data Village
_177.Description: This is embarrassing, but Digimon have stolen jump boosters, so the way back to the Real World is not clear... I'd like to tell Homer Yushima... MetalGarurumon have attacked and stolen from us for no reason...Please find our jump boosters.
_177.CompletionText: I'm so worried that we won't be able to go back. Shh! This is Homer Yushima's secret...
_177.CompletionSummary: Oh, thank you. Now, a weight has been lifted off my mind as I travel through the Digital World. What? No, I didn't say that I'm immediately returning to the Digital World... But please take these remaining jump boosters as a token of my appreciation.

_178.Title: Distorted Data Village
_178.Description: They must originally be basic Etemon, but they put on those strange metal exteriors... I want to know how that single thing gives them such strength!! Bring back the metal exteriors from the MetalEtemon. We need them for our experiments. Something is telling me we can't overlook this.
_178.CompletionText: They're far too strong to be steel.
_178.CompletionSummary: Good work... I have to investigate this now, so go somewhere and take a break.

_179.Title: Distorted Data Village
_179.Description: Due to their tenacity, Vikemon were leaders who led all the Digimon in the Glacier region. However, because of the Strange Activities these days in the Digital World, they have turned very violent. As a result, the penguin leader has given an order to take weapons from the Vikemon. Even inside the volcano, he's still giving orders left and right.. Because the Vikemon are too strong for us to collect the weapons from them ourselves...we want you, the tamers, to handle this.
_179.CompletionText: Please collect the weapons as fast as you can.
_179.CompletionSummary: You've worked very hard. Our awful leader has put you through the ringer.

_180.Title: Distorted Data Village
_180.Description: Due to their tenacity, Vikemon were leaders who led all the Digimon in the Glacier Area. However, because of the Strange Activities these days in the Digital World, they have turned very violent. As a result, the penguin leader has given an order to take weapons from the Vikemon. Even inside the volcano, he's still giving orders left and right.. Because the Vikemon are too strong for us to collect the weapons from them ourselves...we want you, the tamers, to handle this.
_180.CompletionText: Please collect the weapons as fast as you can.
_180.CompletionSummary: You've worked very hard. Our awful leader has put you through the ringer.

_181.Title: Distorted Data Village
_181.Description: Hmm, what's the leader doing over there? He seems to be behaving strangely because he's gotten weaker. We have to restore him to health. You hear so often these days that antlers are so good for the health.. but you know what are even better than deer antlers? MegaKabuterimon horns!!! Just one will make him strong as an ox. He carries a lot of weight around though, so he might need more than that...
_181.CompletionSummary: Thank you for doing this. I'll have to give this to him right away. Thanks.

_182.Title: Distorted Data Village
_182.Description: Hmm, what's the leader doing over there? He seems to be behaving strangely because he's gotten weaker. We have to restore him to health. You hear so often these days that antlers are so good for the health.. but you know what are even better than deer antlers? MegaKabuterimon horns!!! Just one will make him strong as an ox. He carries a lot of weight around though, so he might need more than that...
_182.CompletionSummary: Thank you for doing this. I'll have to give this to him right away. Thanks.

_183.Title: Distorted Data Village
_183.Description: I want you to collect Dark Tower remnants from MetalEtemon I don't know who built them, but they seem to have been made with rare minerals. If you are a merchant, you want to have anything valuable...
_183.CompletionText: This collection will bring me a tidy sum.
_183.CompletionSummary: Oh, good work. So you've finally obtained the remnants of the Dark Tower

_184.Title: Dats Center
_184.Description: I am dying to know what Akihiro Kurata has found through his research! Go get the report from Akihiro Kurata and give me a report on the outcome. Leave everything else aside. This is our priority now!
_184.CompletionSummary: Now what? Here I am, swamped in work, and you come asking me for a report? Fine. I'll write the report now, so sit tight!

_185.Title: Distorted Data Village
_185.Description: I'm done with the report.. I am sick and tired of that guy. He is not helping Minnie at all. Go deliver this to Hashiba now. Oh, yes! There's something else you have to do, so hurry back.
_185.CompletionSummary: What? He hasn't finished his research yet!!?? After all I've invested in him!!

_186.Title: Distorted Data Village
_186.Description: I can't let this go on any longer!! I'm going to have you deliver some instructions, so go back to Doctor Akihiro Kurata!! He can't continue on with his work like this if he wants my backing, and that's a fact. Go tell him what I've said!!
_186.Objective: Delivering Instructions to Doctor Akihiro Kurata
_186.CompletionText: Akihiro Kurata is acting very strange recently!!
_186.CompletionSummary: Huh? What's this? Instructions from Director Hashiba??? Humph....

_187.Title: Distorted Data Village
_187.Description:
Ha! How dare he send me these instructions...
(Akihiro Kurata tears up the instructions.) ? A genius like me doesn't need to take instructions from anyone!... (Akihiro Kurata to himself : That useless director...Now that this has happened, I won't have time to research the eggs here...)
Well, this isn't important, so we don't have to worry about it... Let's just continue with what we were doing. It looks that with the little time we have, we have to speed up our research..Can you bring me those spherical things attached to MegaKabuterimon's back? I think I'll be able to make some powerful weapons with those.... Hurry back!! There's very little time!!!
_187.CompletionText: (Akihiro Kurata is deeply engrossed in thought about something)
_187.CompletionSummary: Thank you for dong this. We have very time left...

_188.Title: Distorted Data Village
_188.Description: By cracking the code, Akihiro Kurata has found information for coming into contact with the Digimon Kaiser... The Digimon Kaiser is closely related to the strange activities in Digital World... It is more accurate to say he is the mastermind... But Akihiro Kurata has raised so many suspicions throughout this period that we have to keep an eye on the situation.. Go now to Chief Homer Yushima in the Distorted Data Village...he might need some help.
_188.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Homer Yushima at the Distorted Data Village
_188.CompletionSummary: Things are going pretty badly. It looks like it'll be impossible to stop Doctor Akihiro Kurata's preparations to leave. And all we can do is chase after the Digimon Kaiser and Akihiro Kurata..Anyway... I'll come up with some countermeasure too. And the f

_189.Title: Distorted Data Village
_189.Description: I understand what you've said, tamers...We're the Glacier Defense Corps, so there's nothing we don't know about this area!~ We think we can fix that situation ourselves, but maybe you'd like to help us too?? Hahah Hey,we're not asking too much! You know how strange the Vikemon have been lately. Fighting them off again will probably be good for this area. Why don't you come help? Of course, if you take care of this, I'll give you some information you want. Hahaha
_189.CompletionText: It's all about give and take!!
_189.CompletionSummary: Wow, you're certainly quick! Truly incredible.

_190.Title: Distorted Data Village
_190.Description: Well, now we'll give you some information. As you know, unlike in other places, there is a Digimon who controls all of the Glacier Area. This Digimon is called a Mercurimon, which is in its Mega stage. Since the Mercurimon manages and controls this zone, it finds solutions promptly for the strange activities that arise. I want you to find him and go to the Infinite Ice Wall. Oh, and...the Mercurimon will know Manager Homer Yushima, so you'd better go talk to Homer Yushima first.
_190.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Homer Yushima at the Infinite Ice Wall
_190.CompletionSummary: Hmm, the truth is that I also have come here to see Mercurimon... I wanted to meet him in secret, but I've been found out... Hahaha.
_190.ReservedText: How'd you know I was here?

_191.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_191.Description: Hmm, so this is the place called the Infinite Ice Wall....Boy, it certainly is cold! Are you guys doing alright in this cold?~ Well, you're in the vigor of youth.... Mercurimon? Looks like we still have long way to go...
_191.CompletionSummary: Mercurimon? Looks like we still have long way to go. Let's get moving.

_192.Title: Distorted Data Village
_192.Description: Hmm, the volcano and lava have increased the temperature here greatly. Because our bodies are accustomed to the cold, it is very difficult for us to be here. Maybe you can sprinkle water on the lava hereabouts and lower the temperature. Because all the Digimon have been altered by the strange activities in the lava area, you'll have to contend with them while you go about your task.
_192.Objective: High Temperatures in Distorted Data Village
_192.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Using Water from Northern Lava Area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Using Water from Central Lava Area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Fighting Mega Kabuterimon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeating HiAndromon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_192.CompletionText: Boy, it's hot...these temperatures might drive us to extinction.
_192.CompletionSummary: Whew, thanks. This seems more bearable.

_193.Title: Distorted Data Village
_193.Description: Hmm, the volcano and lava have increased the temperature here greatly. Because our bodies are accustomed to the cold, it is very difficult for us to be here. Maybe you can sprinkle water on the lava hereabouts and lower the temperature. Because all the Digimon have been altered by the strange activities in the lava area, you'll have to contend with them while you go about your task.
_193.Objective: High Temperatures at Distorted Data Village[Daily Quest]
_193.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Using Water from Northern Lava Area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Using Water from Central Lava Area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Fighting Mega Kabuterimon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeating HiAndromon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_193.CompletionText: Boy, it's hot...these temperatures might drive us to extinction.
_193.CompletionSummary: Whew, thanks. This seems more bearable.

_194.Title: Distorted Data Village
_194.Description: Haha...hello there....you might not remember me, but...well, even if you don't remember me, I don't much care because I'm more interested in Doctor Akihiro Kurata than in you guys. I'd like you to transmit the data I send you now to Doctor Akihiro Kurata. ? (Transmitting data.........) ? And you can ask Akihiro Kurata if you want to know learn about the data..Well, that's all for now...you Dats Center messengers.
_194.CompletionSummary: Hm, what's this? This is the first time I've seen this data. Hold on a second, while I decipher the code.

_195.Title: Distorted Data Village
_195.Description:
Hurray! I've cracked the code....
(As he reads through the decoded data, a smile plays around his lips.) ? Hm? Oh, there's nothing in here you need to know about.. . Finally, the day I've longed for has arrived... Hahaha!!! Now I'll have to bid farewell to you!! You've done so much to help me but it looks like I won't need you any more. In fact, I no longer have a need for the Dats Center or anything else!. Hahaha!!!
_195.Objective: Doctor Akihiro Kurata's Change of Heart
_195.CompletionSummary: Hm? Oh, there's nothing in here you need to know about.. ? Finally, the day I've longed for has arrived... Hahaha!!! Now I'll have to bid farewell to you!! You've done so much to help me but it looks like I won't need you any more. In fact, I no longer h

_196.Title: Dats Center
_196.Description: The situation has taken a turn for the worse. Akihiro Kurata has covered his tracks, and is not communicating with us at all, and we are now deciphering the data from the hacked Digivice. Come back to the Dats Center immediately.
_196.ObjectiveProgress: To Commander Richard Sampson at the Dats Center
_196.CompletionSummary: We are finishing all the investigations on the hacking. It's protected by a very difficult password.

_197.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_197.Description: The problems here do not seem very different... This problem has also occurred where Mercurimon lives, so something might have happened to him. Now we should work to take care of our work in this area.... Let's start our work with the HerculesKabuterimon And I will collect information on Mercurimon...
_197.CompletionSummary: Well done. I can see that your skills are improving by leaps and bounds these days.

_198.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_198.Description: It's Commander Richard Sampson. According to current information, Doctor Akihiro Kurata and the Digimon Kaiser appeared at the Infinite Ice Wall. Go help Doctor Homer Yushima, who has arrived already at that area, and try to find a solution to the problem.
_198.CompletionSummary: Can you believe Commander Richard Sampson? He makes all these excessive demands to an old man like me...hahaha

_199.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_199.Description: Mercurimon doesn't seem to be here... Well, to be more accurate, it is obvious he has been humiliated somehow.. I can just sense it in my old bones Because this has happened, we should find the best solution we can to the strange activities here...Anyway, this is the best way for you to make a good impression on Mercurimon! (Speaking to himself: But I have to do something somehow...)
_199.Objective: Do your utmost to find the best solution you can to the Strange Activities!
_199.CompletionSummary: The best way to handle this is to first clear this area and pursue their whereabouts.

_200.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_200.Description: Do you see Anubimon over the hill there? Let's go there to chase them out of that area. Don't complain. That's not an easy task to us.
_200.CompletionText: At least, we'll have something to speak about with Mercurimon
_200.CompletionSummary: Good work. You definitely have proven your skills.
_200.ReservedText: You don't need my help, I see.

_201.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_201.Summary: The matter of Infinite Ice Wall[D]
_201.Description: The problems here do not seem very different... This problem has also occurred where Mercurimon lives, so something might have happened to him. Now we should work to take care of our work in this area.... Let's start our work with the HerculesKabuterimon And I will collect information on Mercurimon...
_201.CompletionSummary: Well done. I can see that your skills are improving by leaps and bounds these days.

_202.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_202.Description: Do you see Anubimon over the hill there? Let's go there to chase them out of that area. Don't complain. That's not an easy task to us.
_202.Objective: That's not an easy task to us!
_202.CompletionText: At least, we'll have something to speak about with Mercurimon
_202.CompletionSummary: Good work. You definitely have proven your skills.
_202.ReservedText: You don't need my help, I see.

_203.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_203.Description: It's Commander Richard Sampson. A request from Yukidarumon has arrived, so go look for Yukidarumon at Snowman Village.
_203.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Yukidarumon at Snowman Village

_204.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_204.Description: Keenan Krier and Falcomon have not come back yet. Deliver my letter to Keenan Krier. The letter says that although they consider themselves Digimon, the truth is that they are humans, and it contains all the facts of how they came to the Digital World through an unexpected accident as well as my request.
_204.ObjectiveProgress: Deliver the letter to Keenan Krier at the Infinite Ice Wall.
_204.CompletionText: Please deliver the letter for me.
_204.CompletionSummary: What have you brought for me? A letter from Yukidarumon?? Give it to me, quick!

_205.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_205.Description:
(Keenan Krier, who has read the letter calmly, stares at the tamer.)
Hm, Yukidarumon's letter seems to be true.. I was also very curious about you guys, but I felt that everything would disappear if If found out about the reality, so I didn't want to acknowledge it. Now that Yukidarumon has told the truth... I have no more business with you. Good. Now that I know the whole situation, let's find a solution for the strange activities.
_205.CompletionSummary: First we should find Mercurimon and tell him about all the circumstances.

_206.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_206.Description: You would know if you saw him, but Falcomon withstood a lot of injuries to find me. He withstood especially severe injuries when he faced Hercules Kabuterimon. I'd like you to obtain a drug from Yukidarumon at Snowman Village. Please, I can't leave Falcomon like this.
_206.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Yukidarumon at Snowman Villlage
_206.CompletionText: Go ask for the drug... I'm sorry.
_206.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Would you like to hear the whole story??

_207.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_207.Description: Hmm... HerculesKabuterimon... It looks like I will need information on Digimon. As you know, because we are made up of digital DATA, if we are injured, a drug can be made easily for us as long as we have the information on the Digimon that gave the injury. If you obtain the HerculesKabuterimon horn, I can make the drug in a jiffy.
_207.CompletionText: I am preparing to make the medicine.
_207.CompletionSummary: Ah, you're here. I had just finished preparations.

_208.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_208.Description: Here, I'm done making Falcomon's medicine. I didn't take too long, did I? Hahaha You can take this medicine to Falcomon to use.~ Also, since you're going there already, don't forget to give him my regards.
_208.CompletionSummary: Oh, thank you, I feel much better than now. Yukidarumon's medicines are all excellent. You'll have to tell him how thankful I am.

_209.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_209.Description: Now it looks like we'll have to try in earnest to find a solution for the Strange Activities. The first thing we should deal with are the Anubimon. These Digimon distinguish between the good and evil that flow into the Dark areas. For some reason, they seem to have all gathered here... We'll have to eliminate them from here. It pains me to do this...but there's no other choice.
_209.Objective: Strategy to Solve Regular Strange Activities
_209.CompletionText: Isn't there a way to send them back again?
_209.CompletionSummary: Good work... I can't do anything because Falcomon was still weak.. Thanks anyway.

_210.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_210.Description: Ow, this hurts... I've been healed to some extent, but the injuries I got from HerculesKabuterimon still hurt.. You have to destroy them...those Digimon are very dangerous..If we don't do anything, the Digimon in other regions, not only at the Infinite Ice Wall, might become very dangerous....
_210.CompletionText: We must ignore our consciences and eradicate rampaging Digimon.
_210.CompletionSummary: (Dejected-Looking Falcomon) Good work. I hope you continue to do the same in the future.
_210.ReservedText: Back already? Your skills have improved greatly.

_211.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_211.Description: If we don't do anything about the Anubimon, the Dark area will be thrown into chaos... We have to send Anubimon back again...I don't know how well it will work, but I'm giving you a Digimon transmission device I received from Mercurimon... Mercurimon told me to use this when threatened by Digimon...but I don't think that will happen since I'm with you, so I'm going to give it to you... Please, I ask you!!
_211.CompletionText: The Digital World is gradually becoming stranger...
_211.CompletionSummary: Well... Is it impossible to defend with that equipment? This is happening because I am weak... If I were a little stronger, this would not have happened....

_212.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_212.Description: I don't think I need any introduction. You know who I am!~ Why did I have to come so far? I had a very hard time catching up with you, and on top of that, I was attacked by a Gryphonmon on the way, and my notebook was destroyed....my notebook!!! It had my daily log of all the events!!! Find my notebook for me! Perhaps the pages were scattered all over the place while I was being attacked...Find it !!
_212.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Page 1 of Daily Record of Events%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Page 2 of Daily Record of Events%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Page 3 of Daily Record of Events%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Page 4 of Daily Record of Events%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Page 5 of Daily Record of Events%qe %cc5:%
_212.CompletionSummary:
Phew...this is so frustrating...
Well, when will we be able to gather everything?

_213.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_213.Description:
I'll never forgive you for doing this to my daily record, Gryphonmon!!! But... I have to put the daily record of events together again... Maybe I won't be able to... Won't you guys please help me? This is so unfair I can't bear it!!!! I'll be here putting this back together, so maybe you can take revenge for me!!! Maybe you can help me out with other tasks, please.
Hahaha...you're becoming like assistants! Nice!
Since it looks like you plan to just abandon me here, why don't you bring a piece of the Gryphonmon's tail? Boy, it hurts to get bitten by one of those!...
_213.CompletionSummary: Ahhh, sweet revenge...Serves those suckers right! (Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon puts the daily record of events together again.)

_214.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_214.Description:
I'll never forgive you for doing this to my daily record, Gryphonmon!!! But... I have to put the daily record of events together again... Maybe I won't be able to... Won't you guys please help me? This is so unfair I can't bear it!!!! I'll be here putting this back together, so maybe you can take revenge for me!!! Maybe you can help me out with other tasks, please.
Hahaha...you're becoming like assistants! Nice!
Since it looks like you plan to just abandon me here, why don't you bring a piece of the Gryphonmon's tail? Boy, it hurts to get bitten by one of those!...
_214.Objective: I'll never forgive you Gryphonmon!!![Daily Quest]
_214.CompletionSummary: Ahhh, sweet revenge...Serves those suckers right! Ha!

_215.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_215.Description:
Finally, I've put the daily record of events back together. Let's see... There was something important in here
( Fourth dimension SuperStarmon skims through the daily record of events)
Ah! I found it!!! Here, here... Let me tell you what it says. It's very important. It says that Doctor Akihiro Kurata met with the Digimon Kaiser and arrived at the Infinite Ice Wall and immediately went straight to Mercurimon and didn't emerge for a while. That's what it says. Anyway, it is possible that this area has been thrown into chaos because something has happened to Mercurimon.
_215.Objective: Information in Daily Record of Events
_215.CompletionSummary: Well, that's the full extent of the daily record of events. When you travel to see Mercurimon, it would best for you to hurry.
_215.ReservedText: End of Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon's Daily Record of Events

_216.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_216.Description: Ahhh...how lovely the scenery is here. Can I ask you a favor? There is a frozen waterfall on the way to Infinite Ice Wall. Could you take a snapshot of it for me? I am asking you because I couldn't go there by myself. I want to keep the view. Hahaha... Please bring it to me, will you?
_216.CompletionSummary: Oh...what a beautiful picture. Thank you! I'll treasure this forever.

_217.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_217.Description: The Royal Knights are on their way. This situation is getting worse and worse. Go make a report to Commander Richard Sampson. If even the Royal Knights are here, the situation is very dire.
_217.Objective: The Arrival of the Royal Knight, Gallantmon
_217.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Commander Richard Sampson at the Dats Center
_217.CompletionText: Finish making the report immediately and come back.
_217.CompletionSummary: Apparently, the Royal Knights have arrived. This is very serious.
_217.ReservedText: A report from Manager Homer Yushima?

_218.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_218.Description: Oh, you don't know who the Royal Knights are.. You can think of the Royal Knights as patron saints that revere the creator of the Digital World, Yggdrasil, and protect the Digital World. . It's too complicated of a story to tell now, but I will tell you later...But you should go now to Manager Homer Yushima, because I have to get into touch with him myself.
_218.ObjectiveProgress: Speaking with Manager Homer Yushima of the Infinite Ice Wall
_218.CompletionSummary: I've received a message from Commander Richard Sampson. Speaking with Gallantmon is your top priority.

_219.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_219.Description: First off, go to Gallantmon and have a short conversation with him. Gallantmon also seems to believe that the Dats Center is not involved in this situation. Go see Gallantmon first, and you'll be able to speak to him if you give this to him.
_219.CompletionText: Go now to speak to him.
_219.CompletionSummary: So you are humans from the Real World. And what business do you have with me?

_220.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_220.Description:
This is Kudamon's necklace? Where did you get this, my human friend??
(Gallantmon listens to you say that you got it from Richard Sampson)
Hm... I see... so Kudamon accompanied Richard Sampson around... For some reason I never saw him. Then you guys have nothing to do with what's happening in here. Okay, I will trust you for now, because we need to deal with strange incident first.
I came here charged with the task of dealing with the Digimon who have been behaving strangely.
Now I want you to take charge of this task, so I can test your abilities.
_220.CompletionText: Hmm...maybe your skills aren't up to snuff.
_220.CompletionSummary: Hm...you're back, finally...Well, maybe your skills are good enough.

_221.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_221.Description:
Doctor Akihiro Kurata and the Digimon Kaiser are the source of all this. I can't forgive them.... However, I'm so exhausted I can't take revenge against them...
SaberLeomon has also changed a great deal... He's Mercurimon's friend, Although he was a violent Digimon, he was greatly valued by the Digital World...
(Keenan Krier has a resolute look on his face.)
This is our only option to resolve this situation. First we have to get past this hurdle, to prevent all Digimon from suffering. They don't really die, because they are reborn later, so this will help them out.
_221.CompletionText: Even if this pains me, I have no other choice.
_221.CompletionSummary: Thank you. You'll pay for this, Akihiro Kurata and Digimon Kaiser!

_222.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_222.Description: First, recover the Symbol of Domination from the SaberLeomon, who are dominating the Glacier Area. Although they were entrusted to be leaders, I want to deprive them permanently of their qualifications, as long as the strange activities continue.
_222.CompletionSummary: Good work. Although I am trusting Kudamon and accepting your help, I don't want to hear you talking nonsense.

_223.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_223.Description: You have unexpected abilities...now I know why Kudamon trusts you . But that doesn't mean you can relax now. You have to move immediately to the next task. We still have a long ways to go. The culprit at the source of all the Strange Activities invaded here, followed by his partner, SkullGreymon. I want you to go defeat them.
_223.CompletionText: I told you to stop goofing around.
_223.CompletionSummary: We haven't earned the right to relax yet.

_224.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_224.Description: First, recover the Symbol of Domination from the SaberLeomon, who are dominating the Glacier Area. Although they were entrusted to be leaders, I want to deprive them permanently of their qualifications, as long as the strange activities continue.
_224.CompletionSummary: Good work. Although I am trusting Kudamon and accepting your help, I don't want to hear you talking nonsense.

_225.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_225.Description: We're in dire need of Mercurimon's assistance in this situation. But now all his duties have been neglected and he has disappeared. Go to the castle and try to find Mercurimon Let me know immediately if something happens.
_225.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Search of Infinite Ice Wall%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Search of Infinite Ice Wall%qe %cc2/%mc2
_225.CompletionText: Hmm...maybe Mercurimon did something to bring us all this point.
_225.CompletionSummary: You're certainly entering some dangerous waters with that talk.
_225.ReservedText: How is the task I entrusted you with going?

_226.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_226.Description: So..Mercurimon isn't here... Well, that's that. Take this, so you can use it later in the Infinite Ice Cave. These are pyrotechnics built for signaling to one another during crises,and it's perfect for situations like this... Go on your way.
_226.CompletionText: We can't let anything go wrong.
_226.CompletionSummary: The pyrotechnics didn't work!? I can't take anymore bad news!This situation we're in is getting worse and worse...Ok. Now don't do anything unnecessary from now on.

_227.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_227.Description: Hm...we're certainly swamped in work... You've probably heard a good deal about the Eveling. However, since we have not analyzed it to understand what it is, I want you to recover the Eveling and bring it back to me.
_227.CompletionSummary: I never thought a human would be capable of making such a thing. That's extraordinary. We made a huge mistake!

_228.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_228.Description:
What strange... looking Digimon over there... It looks like a machine...
(Gallantmon, upon hearing the background story on Gizumon)
Oh, I see... So that's an artificially-made Digimon... How terrible that someone's out there playing God! !!! Destroy all those machine-like creatures, now!!
_228.CompletionSummary: That's a very dangerous Digimon. Where on Earth has Mercurimon gone?

_229.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_229.Description:
What strange... looking Digimon over there... It looks like a machine...
(Gallantmon, upon hearing the background story on Gizumon)
Oh, I see... So that's an artificially-made Digimon... How terrible that someone's out there playing God! !!! Destroy all those machine-like creatures, now!!
_229.CompletionSummary: That's a very dangerous Digimon. Where on Earth has Mercurimon gone?

_230.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_230.Summary: I have no need for weaklings!
_230.Description: Hmm? A human? It's been a while since I've seen one here. Humans are pathetic and need to take ages to defeat even the smallest Digimon. At this rate, we'll never get out of here. Focus more on your work.
_230.Objective: I have no need for weaklings!
_230.CompletionSummary: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Banchoreomon. I am taking care of bad Digimon in Digital World. And it looks like you're doing similar work, although I don't see how that is possible, if that's all your skills amount to.
_230.ReservedText: I, Banchoreomon, am a Digimon that travels around and have given up all creature comforts.

_231.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_231.Description:
You, again! Stop bothering me, you humans!
(with a face of resignation) Alright, alright, it looks like we're all in the same boat. Well, I can't give you my total trust right off the bat. To earn it, I'm going to put you to a test of skills...Your first task is to fight off Digimon in this area. Hurry back! I'll be here enjoying the scenery.
_231.CompletionSummary: Well, maybe you can be useful for a few tasks, but you still have a lot to prove.
_231.ReservedText: Oh! I forgot you were here.

_232.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_232.Description:
Well, you seem to be rising to the challenge... I'll give you my trust
What? You want to know what Bancho means?? What are they teaching you in the Digital World!!
If you want to know, ask someone with a good deal of knowledge about this place... Richard Sampson will know... Go ask him. I'm busy now.
_232.CompletionSummary: So...finally you've learned what Bancho means.
_232.ReservedText: What does Bancho mean? So, I guess you've met Banchoreomon... Bancho is a designation given to Digimon that have just barely defeated fierce opponents in fights... Banchoreon...this is...a surprise.

_233.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_233.Description: So... You found out what Bancho meant! And here's something else to do with this... I'm going to let you in on a little secret. You are not yet using 100% of your partner's true capabilities. If you only realize these abilities, you'll be a match for anybody.
_233.CompletionSummary: You think I just gave you that information for free? If I gave you access to skills before you could handle them, you'd only become more dangerous.
_233.ReservedText: You still have a long way to go.

_234.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_234.Description:
I'm not in a position to just hand you information about Mega power. Ah! Minnie has a suggestion. There are very dangerous Digimon all over the Digital World. I'll give you the information you need to achieve Mega strength, if you capture them. Hmm, where should I send you first... Ok...start with the Dark Tower Wasteland... Among the SkullMeramon is an evil one who plays the role of leader. Go capture that Digimon first.. .It will be a tough opponent for you.
SkullMeramon (Ruler of the Flame) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of SkullMeramon. Keep that in mind.
_234.CompletionText: You've still got a long way to go.
_234.CompletionSummary: Well, I will give you credit for your skill...You've done well.

_235.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_235.Description: Strangely, the Glacier Region has become a very dangerous place.... I never expected Skull Greymon would be here... Looks like someone did this. (Going his own way.) First, fight off the SkullGreymon... If you accomplish that, you'll have proven yourself to me...
_235.CompletionText: No, you're still not there yet.
_235.CompletionSummary: Well, you're capable of this much...Well, congratulations, you've gained some of my respect..

_236.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_236.Description: Hm, in in any case, there some Digimon here with unknown identities...although it's not your fault... Go chase them off. They are doing harm to Digimon living in the Glacier Region. That way you'll prove your skills to me.
_236.CompletionSummary: Hmm...you seem to be equal to the challenge.

_237.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_237.Description:
Now, this is just the beginning. Don't let your guard down. Now, capture Okuwamon which has appeared at Frozen Ground... That Digimon is known as a tyrant and is so violent that even I avoid facing him. You're not tired yet, are you? Don't you have to do this much, if you want to obtain Mega power?
Okuwamon (Tyrant of Darkness) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Digimon. Keep that in mind.
_237.CompletionSummary: So I see your skills are good enough to defeat the Tyrant. You just decided to show me them one by one, didn't you?

_238.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_238.Description: Now we'll get started with the real tasks... Next is Mammothmon, who has clairvoyance in darkness. He used to be a kind Digimon, but he turned evil, and is now being used by evil villains. You will be able to travel through the Digital World more easily if you just eliminate them. Because those creatures have clairvoyance about everything, they are very difficult to deal with.. ? Mammothmon (Clairvoyance of Darkness) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Mammothmon. Keep that in mind.
_238.CompletionSummary: I can read humans like a book! You don't perhaps have your eye on the title Bancho?

_239.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_239.Description: Next is the MetalEtemon, which calls itself the King of Digimon. This Digimon lives in the Distorted Data Village, and I'm warning you in advance that it is as strong as its name. Well, be on your way. ? MetalEtemon (King of Digimon) is that Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of MetEtemon. Keep that in mind.
_239.CompletionText: Looks like it won't be an easy job.
_239.CompletionSummary: Good work. From now on, there are only a few hurdles to go through.

_240.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_240.Description: Apparently, ,there's a deviant who has betrayed the righteous Digimon army corps at the Distorted Data Village... It's Vikemon, who used to be the manager of the Digimon army corps...However, he seems to have been affected somehow by the Strange Activities. I think it would be wise for him to be eliminated, since he has become this way. ? Vikemon (Army Defector) is the Boss Digimon that appears when a fixed number of Digimon is captured. Keep that in mind.
_240.CompletionText: I'm not saying this because of the strange activities in the Digital World...
_240.CompletionSummary: Good work. Worrying about even the Digimon Army Corps is making my head hurt.

_241.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_241.Description:
Where on Earth could Mercurimon be? What an awful state the Glacier Area is in.. . It's even more dangerous than before. Because the guardians who take care of the Digital World have increased in number, this place has been thrown into complete chaos...Also, the SkullGreymon is roaming around as if he's someone's subordinate.. Anyway, fighting the Digimon in this area looks more urgent than training.
Gryphonmon (Guardian of Ruin) and SkullGreymon (Outlaw Immortal) are the Boss Digimon which appear when you capture a fixed number of Gryphonmon and SkullGreymon. Keep that in mind.
_241.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Killing Gryphonmon (Guardian of Ruin)%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Killing Skull Greymon (Outlaw Immortal)%qe %cc2/%mc2
_241.CompletionText: It will not be an easy job.
_241.CompletionSummary: Good work. Just think of it as part of the work you have to do.
_241.ReservedText: Oh ho, what righteous tamers you are.

_242.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_242.Description:
The most important problem to deal with is Akihiro Kurata's Gizumon. They have destroyed Digimon all over the places, and I have no idea why. You have to stop the Gizumon... If we do nothing, all of the Digital World will be in danger.
Gizumon AT (Digimon Destroyer) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Gizumon AT. Keep that in mind.
_242.CompletionText: I have a favor to ask of you.
_242.CompletionSummary: As a Digimon, I don't think I can take Gizumon's attack.....

_243.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_243.Description: No... This is the last one! I've found out that there is a Gizumon one level above Gizumon...And this will be a huge challenge. If you take care of this, I'll give you Mega strength. Although you seem to have grown to some extent... I charge you with completing this final task. ? Gizumon XT (Digimon Destroyer) is the boss Digimon with appears when you capture a fixed number of Gizumon AT (Digimon Destroyer). Keep that in mind.
_243.Objective: Final Challenge to Reach Mega Mode!
_243.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on completing this long training. I hope you receive even more training and protect the Digital World.

_244.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_244.Description: So... You found out what Bancho meant! And here's something else to do with this... I'm going to let you in on a little secret. You are not yet using 100% of your partner's true capabilities. If you only realize these abilities, you'll be a match for anybody.
_244.CompletionSummary: You think I just gave you that information for free? If I gave you access to skills before you could handle them, you'd only become more dangerous.
_244.ReservedText: You still have a long way to go.

_245.Title: Infinite Ice Wall

Among the SkullMeramon is an evil one who plays the role of leader. Go capture that Digimon first...It will be a tough opponent for you.
SkullMeramon (Ruler of the Flame) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of SkullMeramon. Keep that in mind.
_247.CompletionText: You've still got a long way to go.
_247.CompletionSummary: Well, I will give you credit for your skill...You've done well.

_252.Description:
Now, this is just the beginning. Don't let your guard down. Now, capture Okuwamon which has appeared at Frozen Ground... That Digimon is known as a tyrant and is so violent that even I avoid facing him. You're not tired yet, are you? You have to do this much, if you want to obtain Mega power?
Okuwamon (Tyrant of Darkness) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed nunmber of Digimon. Keep that in mind.
_252.CompletionSummary: So I see your skills are good enough to defeat the Tyrant. You just decided to show me them one by one, didn't you?

_253.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_253.Description:
Now we'll get started with the real tasks... Next is Mammothmon, who has clairvoyance in darkness. He used to be a kind Digimon, but he turned evil, and is now being used by evil villains. We will be able to travel through the Digital World more easily if you just eliminate them. Because those creatures have clairvoyance about everything, they are very difficult to deal with.
Mammothmon (Clairvoyance of Darkness) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Mammothmon. Keep that in mind.
_253.CompletionSummary: I can read humans like a book! You don't perhaps have your eye on the title Bancho?

_256.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_256.Description: Next is the MetalEtemon, which calls itself the King of Digimon. This Digimon lives in the Distorted Data Village, and I'm warning you in advance that it is as strong as its name. Well, be on your way. ? MetalEtemon (King of Digimon) is that Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of MetEtemon. Keep that in mind.
_256.CompletionText: Looks like it won't be an easy job.
_256.CompletionSummary: Good work. From now on, there are only a few hurdles to go through.

_259.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_259.Description: Apparently,there's a deviant who has betrayed the righteous Digimon army corps at the Distorted Data Village... It's Vikemon, who used to be the manager of the Digimon army corps...However, he seems to have been affected somehow by the strange activities. I think it would be wise for him to be eliminated, as long as he has become this way. ? Vikemon (Army Defector) is the Boss Digimon that appears when a fixed number of Digimon is captured. Keep that in mind.
_259.CompletionText: I'm not saying this because of the Strange Activities in the Digital World...
_259.CompletionSummary: Good work. Worrying about even the Digimon Army Corps is making my head hurt.

_261.CompletionSummary: Good work. Worrying about even the Digimon Army Corps is making my head hurt.

_262.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_262.Description:
Where on Earth could Mercurimon be? What an awful state the Glacier Area is in... It's even more dangerous than before. Because the guardians who take care of the Digital World have increased in number, this place has been thrown into complete chaos...Also, the SkullGreymon is roaming around as if he's someone's subordinate Anyway, fighting the Digimon in this area looks more urgent than training.
Gryphonmon (Guardian of Ruin) and SkullGreymon (Outlaw Immortal) are the Boss Digimon which appear when you capture a fixed number of Gryphonmon and SkullGreymon. Keep that in mind.
_262.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Killing Gryphonmon (Guardian of Ruin)%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Killing Skull Greymon (Outlaw Immortal)%qe %cc2/%mc2
_262.CompletionText: It will not be an easy job.
_262.CompletionSummary: Good work. Just think of it as part of the work you have to do.
_262.ReservedText: Oh ho, what righteous tamers you are.

_265.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_265.Description: The most important problem to deal with is Akihiro Kurata's Gizumon. They have destroyed Digimon all over the places, and I have no idea why.. You have to stop the Gizumon... If we do nothing, all of the Digital World will be in danger. ? Gizumon AT (Digimon Destroyer) is the Boss Digimon that appears when you capture a fixed number of Gizumon AT. Keep that in mind.
_265.CompletionText: I have a favor to ask of you.
_265.CompletionSummary: As a Digimon, I don't think I can take Gizumon's attack.....

_266.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_266.Description:

_268.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_268.Description:
No... This is the last one! I've found out that there is a Gizumon that is stronger than normal Gizumon... And this will be a huge challenge. If you take care of this, I'll give you Mega strength. Although you seem to have grown to some extent... I charge you with completing this final task.
Gizumon XT (Digimon Destroyer) is the boss Digimon that appears when you capture a certain number of Gizumon AT (Digimon Destroyer). Keep that in mind.
_268.Objective: Final Challenge to Reach Mega Mode!
_268.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on completing this long training. I hope you receive even more training and protect the Digital World.

_271.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_271.Description: Hmm... I am sure you know how difficult it is too use Mega Power. So let me make one proposal to you. As you guys know, this place is in chaos because Mercurymon is not here. Some group of Digimon Leaders often invades this area. If you defeat them, I will let you have Mega strength. How about that? I think this is a good deal for both of us...

_275.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_275.Description: This is Richard Sampson from Dats Center. Do you copy? We require your assistance. Double-time to Dats Center. We will talk more in detail when you arrive.
_275.Objective: Find Richard Sampson at Dats Center.
_275.ObjectiveProgress: Find Richard Sampson at Dats Center.
_275.CompletionSummary: Finally, you are back. Well done.

_276.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_276.Description: The current situation looks grim with Dr. Akihiro Kurata and Digimon Kaiser alone. In the midst of all this, we have also received intel that a place has been discovered in the Western Area which seems to have been intentionally distorted by human hands. It will be a very dangerous mission. We don't know what kind of intention lies behind this, and this may be Digimon Kaiser's trap. A trustworthy partner in the Western Area of the Digital World has requested elite reinforcement. The partner will be waiting to the north of Dark Tower Wasteland. Go and assess the situation.
_276.Objective: Speak to Starmon in Dark Tower Wasteland.
_276.ObjectiveProgress: Speak to Starmon in Dark Tower Wasteland.
_276.CompletionText: Hmm... This is not looking good. You are the only agent who can take on this dangerous task.
_276.CompletionSummary: So, you are the agent Dats Center dispatched? Hmm... I asked for someone reliable...

_277.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_277.Description:
I'm familiar with your service records. I'm sure you will be of great assistance to me. Commander Sampson has briefed you on our situation, I assume? We can't have humans frequently causing such incidents in the Digital World. As it is, anti-human sentiment is spreading because of Digimon Kaiser and Akihiro Kurata. More and more digimons are rallying behind the ruler of the Western Area whose only mode of resolving conflicts is by force. If this incident involves humans, we will have to stop them first before the ruler interferes.
I will be there ahead of you. See you there soon.
_277.Objective: Find Starmon at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_277.ObjectiveProgress: Find Starmon at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_277.CompletionSummary: You're back. Too slow, don't you think?

_278.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_278.Description:
This place is hot. Phew... We have built a temporary base here for now. We have requested support from the Western Village, but no digimons are willing because of safety issues.
Unless this place is secured and safe first, no digimon will come to our aid.
Besides, if we are to receive reinforcement from Dats Center, this place will need to be safe.
Rockmons near the entrance pose a significant threat. Remove them first.
_278.CompletionText: Hmm... About 15 of them should do, don't you think?
_278.CompletionSummary: Not too shabby when it comes to taking care of digimons, huh?

_279.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_279.Description:
Rockmons look threatening because of their sheer size. Just because we have eliminated them doesn't mean this area is safe, but, at least, we have removed visible threat. This should help convince the digimons that this area is safe. I will give you an official document requesting reinforcements from Western Village. Take it to Chuchidarumons in Western Village.
Give me a minute.
_279.CompletionText: Those cowards... Chuchidarumons have no guts.
_279.CompletionSummary: Take the reinforcement request and the Jump Booster.
_279.ReservedText: I'm writing up the official document. Hang in there for a minute.

_280.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_280.Description: This is the official document requesting support. With this, Chuchidarumons from Western Village will have no choice but to help. I'll give you a Jump Booster to go with it, so hurry on.
_280.Objective: Speak with merchant Chuchidarumon in Western Village.
_280.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with merchant Chuchidarumon in Western Village.
_280.CompletionText: (Starmon keeps on grumbling out of some discontentment.)
_280.CompletionSummary: Hmm... This is irritating. We have no obligation to help you... But this is an official document from Starmon. We can't exactly turn it down, either... I'm sorry, but this alone is not enough.

_281.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_281.Description:
Oh, yeah. I forgot about that... Even if we have eliminated Rockmons, those coward Chuchidarumons won't move without the evidence. We need evidence that we have eliminated the threat in this area.
Hmm... We need something solid... Oh, I know! The leaders of Rockmons are superior to the regular Rockmons in size and in strength.
Destroy them and bring me 5 Stone Fragments as evidence.
_281.CompletionText: Those Chuchidarumons are a bunch of chickens... They don't seem to realize how they are keeping safe at Western Village.
_281.CompletionSummary: Ahem... I see why Dats Center places so much trust in you.

_282.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_282.Description:
Chuchidarumons are big cowards. Even with the official document along with the evidence of safety, they can choose not to help. They forget that they owe their safety in Western Village to us.
(He grumbles for a while...)
Among the Chuchidarumons in Western Village, there is a certain young one. He is very bold and curious. If you take the Rockmon Stone Fragments to him, he will be very curious where you got it from. If that kid insists on coming here, merchant Chuchidarumons will have no choice but to come as well. Take this Stone Fragment to the young Chuchidarumon.
_282.Objective: convey Rockmon Stone Fragments Speak with <Young> Chuchidarumon
_282.CompletionText: (He is grumbling in some unknown tongue.)
_282.CompletionSummary: Hmm? What is this? I've never seen such a thing before. Oh, my... There are things I don't know about in this world? What? You found this in the Digimon Maze? Hmm...

_283.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_283.Description: I would like to go and see the Digimon Maze myself... Hmm? merchant Chuchidarumons refuse to go there, you say? Tell them I said that no matter how dangerous that place may be, I will go there to satisfy my curiosity.
_283.CompletionText: Look at these Stone Fragments...!! Amazing. Simply amazing! They have the same formation as the crystal anomaly of Martensite as a type of external anomaly in its metallic state...
_283.CompletionSummary: See? What did I tell ya? When I say I will go, others are bound to follow.
_283.ReservedText: What? The Young Chuchidarumon wants to go where? That place is incredibly dangerous! *sigh* I suppose we will just have to accompany him...

_284.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_284.Description:
Now that we have secured reinforcements from Western Village, we need to investigate this place now. While you've been at Western Village, I've been looking around a bit, and I've discovered a few suspicious locations.
I would like you to go and look into these places more closely. As you patrol the area, watch out for the digimons in the area.
They won't be all that friendly towards you. Look out for Boltmons, especially.
_284.Objective: Patrol around the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_284.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Explore the Strange Altar%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Explore the Destroyed Holy Site%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Explore the Digimon Maze Entrance%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Explore the Ruins%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Explore the Ruined Castle Walls%qe %cc5/%mc5
_284.CompletionText: I would like you to investigate the Strange Altar, Destroyed Holy Site, Digimon Maze, Ruins, and the Ruined Castle Walls.
_284.CompletionSummary: Ruler SaberLeomon from the Western Area is here. Things are getting complicated. We need to find a way to enter the Maze before they do...

_285.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_285.Description: We will organize the supplies here first. You go on ahead of us and let Starmon of Passion know.
_285.Objective: Speak with Starmon of Passion at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_285.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Starmon of Passion at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_285.CompletionText: If I can just unlock the secret of these Stone Fragments...
_285.CompletionSummary: I was right. The Young Chuchidarumon is fearless, unlike the rest of the group.

_286.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_286.Description: The Stone Fragments you brought to Western Village were fascinating. I would like you to bring me more of those. Where in Digital World did you get such oddities? Bring me 10 more of those, would you?
_286.Objective: Collect 10 Stone Fragments from Rockmon leaders.
_286.CompletionText: Look at these Stone Fragments. It's as though they are alive!
_286.CompletionSummary: Oh... There are so many of them...

_287.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_287.Description:
What is this place? This is not at all what the official document said. Unless you do something about Cerberumons, we won't stay here another minute.
They are very aggressive, and we don't know when they will lay ambush on the base. It's not because I am a coward...
It's all for safety...
_287.CompletionText: I'm just a weak Chuchidarumon who doesn't know how to fight...
_287.CompletionSummary: We still can't let our guard down...

_288.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_288.Description:
The research can't continue if I'm just taking little bits and pieces of material from you. I will have to do something about this. Of course, I won't ask you to be my guide.
I will give you something I invented. Take it and use it where you found the Stone Fragments.
This invention is my work of art. Don't be too amazed.
All it does is record images on the photo-sensitive plate.
_288.Objective: Use Chuchidarumon's invention on Rockmon leaders.
_288.CompletionSummary: What is this? Rockmons?! You got these Stone Fragments from Rockmons?

_289.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_289.Description: The young Chuchidarumon seems to be taking interest in Rockmons... Rockmons are highly dangerous digimons. If we are not careful, we may get into trouble. You are an expert in that area. I would like you to destroy Rockmon leaders so they are not seen by the young Chuchidarumon.
_289.CompletionText: I think defeating about 10 Rockmon leaders would do.
_289.CompletionSummary: You have the responsibility for our safety.

_290.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_290.Description: I'm sure you've been working hard at it, but the number of Cerberumons is not diminishing. If you don't continue to keep this area safe, I'm going to leave this place.
_290.CompletionText: If we slay their leaders, the followers will naturally go away. Slay 5 of them for me.
_290.CompletionSummary: Sometimes, it looks as though you enjoy slaying digimons.

_291.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_291.Description:
Yikes! That's the self-styled ruler of the Western Area, the Ruler SaberLeomon. Why is he here?
