This is not good. If he is out and about, that means he realized something is up... He is not too fond towards you all since his failed invasion attempt into the Real World. It's probably for the best not to get involved with him.
Hurry back to the camp and we'll talk about this.
_291.Objective: Return to Starmon of Passion at Camp.
_291.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
_291.CompletionText: It's best not to confront them head-on...
_291.CompletionSummary: This has gotten complicated... They must be sending out scouts throughout the area to learn something. It would be good to find some clues from them, but, naturally, they won't tell us their findings that easily... What do we do...?

_292.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_292.Description: I suppose there's not much we can do... Ruler SaberLeomon may not be able to understand us, but Patrol Leomon probably know our intention well. The patrol must be wandering about in this area. Find them, and tell them what they are investigating.
_292.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speak with Scout A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Speak with Scout B%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Speak with Scout C%qe %cc3/%mc3
_292.CompletionText: Don't use force... We just might end up losing potential allies.
_292.CompletionSummary: Hmm... It's difficult to persuade them with words, as expected. There has to be some other way...
_292.ReservedText: Our intel says that humans are involved in this incident. You, too, are humans! We cannot give you any information.

_293.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_293.Description: This space has been distorted by humans... It looks a lot like the pyramids humans constructed ages ago. There must have been an error during data configuration, though, the structures are upside down. You should be able to see the entrance from there... See if you can open it.
_293.CompletionSummary: I knew it wouldn't be easy, but... Hmm... Now, what do we do?

_294.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_294.Description: Before coming here, I had asked the Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon to scout out the area first. He must be around here somewhere. He may be a little rough around the edges, but he's harmless. He'll be of great help to you as you explore the Digimon Maze. I'll give you a flare. Use it in a conspicuous area. Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon will show up soon enough.
_294.Objective: Use the flare at the Strange Altar.
_294.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use the flare at the Strange Altar%qe %cc1/%mc1
_294.CompletionText: Use the flare at the Strange Altar. It's a pretty conspicuous place.
_294.CompletionSummary: Hey, long time no see, suspect. You need my help again?

_295.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_295.Description:
As expected, there are plenty of digimons to watch out for in the area... If we don't secure camp safety, we may lose the hard-earned support from Western Village. Before those cowardly Chuchidarumons pick up and leave, let's take the initiative and destroy the raging digimons in the area.
Why don't we take care of Volcamons first? Defeat 15 Volcamons and take 5 helmets from the leaders.
_295.Objective: Defeat 15 Volcamons and collect 5 Volcamon Helmets.
_295.CompletionText: Volcamons, not Boltmon. Don't confuse the two...
_295.CompletionSummary: Well done. Now that we have seized their leaders' helmets, they will feel the threat.

_296.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_296.Description: CannonBeemons are awful creatures... They move about in groups wreaking havoc in the Western Area. No matter how many of them you defeat, they just keep coming. Defeat 20 of them for me, would you? Not only do they look intimidating, they are also powerful. You will have to use caution. Especially watch out for their poison needles.
_296.CompletionText: Be careful. Their attacks are immensely powerful. If you take them too lightly, you may end up on a stretcher.
_296.CompletionSummary: Good work. This will make Chuchidarumons happy.

_297.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_297.Description: In order for us to maintain the safety of our camp, we must defeat them continually. Bring us 10 helmets from their leaders.
_297.CompletionText: Volcamons, not Boltmon. Don't confuse the two…
_297.CompletionSummary: Well done. Now that we have seized their leaders' helmets, they will feel the threat.

_298.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_298.Description: As you defeat CannonBeemons and their leaders, you should be able to acquire their poison needles. Collect 8 of them and bring them to Chuchidarumons. If we show them that we are mindful of the camp's safety, they will have peace of mind, too.
_298.CompletionText: Be careful. Their attacks are immensely powerful. If you take them too lightly, you may end up on a stretcher.
_298.CompletionSummary: These are poison needle fragments from CannonBeemons? Astonishing. You are capable of slaying such monstrous creatures.

_299.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_299.Description: Since we defeated the Volcamons, multiple PileVolcamons have appeared at the Digimon Maze Entrance. If we don't take care of them, our investigation on the Maze Entrance will be stalled.
_299.CompletionText: Defeat 10 PileVolcamons and 5 of their leaders.
_299.CompletionSummary: Hmm... You took these things from them, did you?

_300.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_300.Description: Oh, dear! The Young Chuchidarumon has gone out of the camp... This region is filled with fearful digimons... How could he do such a thing? Please hurry and find the Young Chuchidarumon.
_300.CompletionSummary: What? He is gravely wounded and has lost consciousness?! This is terrible!
_300.ReservedText: ............. (He has lost consciousness. Judging by the wounds, he probably had a run-in with Rockmons.)

_301.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_301.Description: I knew this would happen! This is why we didn't want to come here in the first place! I will give you first aid supplies. Go, heal him and bring him back. This is all your fault. You lured the Young Chuchidarumon into coming here, so you'll have to take the responsibility on this matter.
_301.CompletionText: Hurry! Time is of the essence! Use the medicine on the young Chuchidarumon...
_301.CompletionSummary: He has survived, at least. That's good...

_302.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_302.Description: Fire... The Stone Fragments you brought me, they are no... ordinary stones. They can look like crystal anomaly of Martensite like a type of external anomaly in its metallic state, but... It's nothing like that at all... If we have powerful flame energy... we can... we can create life. Create life with my... hands... PileVolcamons carry immense flame energy hidden in their back. Bring me... 10 of those.
_302.CompletionText: Hur...ry... We don't have much time...

_303.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_303.Description: I feel sorry for Starmon of Passion, but... what with the accident that happened to the Young Chuchidarumon and all..., we can no longer lend our support to this area. This place isn't safe for us.
_303.Objective: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
_303.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
_303.CompletionText: It's no use trying to change our mind. We're sorry...
_303.CompletionSummary: Bah! I knew this was going to happen! Those cowards!!

_304.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_304.Description: Those cowardly Chuchidarumons have all returned to Western Village after all. Bah! This makes things complicated. Now, the only other option we have is to ask Dats Center for reinforcement...
_304.Objective: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
_304.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Starmon of Passion at Camp.
_304.CompletionSummary: I have written down our situation in detail. Take this with you.
_304.ReservedText: I'm sure Dats Center won't send us any cowards...

_305.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_305.Description: I've made a Reinforcement Request form for Dats Center. I need you to take it to Dats Center. Take the Jump Booster with you and hurry back.
_305.Objective: Speak with Richard Sampson at Dats Center.
_305.CompletionText: Hmm... Raging digimons are a headache, but working with those cowardly Chuchidarumons is just as bad...
_305.CompletionSummary: Mmm... I see what's going on over there. Well done. From now on, Dats Center will send out its reinforcements directly.

_306.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_306.Description: So, the chaos in this region is because of Digimon Kaisers, huh... Hmm... Take the Evil Ring to Chief Leomons. If we explain to them that we have a common enemy, they will realize that they have no reason to fight against us. We may not be able to communicate with Ruler SaberLeomons, but Leomons will listen to us.
_306.CompletionText: Chief Leomon is not all that fond of you all, so you'd best be careful.
_306.CompletionSummary:
You seem familiar... We are allies? How am I to trust your word?
(I show the Chief Leomon the Evil Ring. He seems conflicted.)
I see... You, too, are in pursuit of those causing the chaos in this area. I understand. We will cooperate.

_307.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_307.Description: We are paying attention to the strange devices installed here and there. These devices seem to be some kind of a power suppressor. We've sent out scouts to find out how to activate them. You should speak with the Elite Scout Leader. He and his scout unit are moving along the path in the middle of this region. Give him your full cooperation.
_307.CompletionSummary: I heard from the chief. Cooperating with humans, huh... We have sent out scouts to gather intel from this area, but the presence of raging digimons is making it difficult. If you help them, we will give this partnership a chance.

_308.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_308.Description: Oh, dear... I need to activate that strange device, but these raging digimons are getting in the way. I think I will investigate the device while you suppress the digimons. Think you could lend us a hand? It's simple. Defeat Cerberumons and Rockmons, 10 each, so that they can't approach me while I carry out the investigation.
_308.CompletionText: Their willpower is weak to begin with... Easy targets for manipulation.
_308.CompletionSummary: Excellent work. Now, we'll be able to investigate the device thoroughly.

_309.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_309.Description: One of our comrades has been attacked to CannonBeemons... Such awful poison. If we can't neutralize the poison, he is sure to die... In order to create an antidote, we need their poison. I need you to bring me 5 units of Venom from their leaders.
_309.CompletionText: If you are not careful, you will fall for it, too.
_309.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This should be more than enough for the research to create an antidote.

_310.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_310.Description: PileVolcamons in this area carry very strong armor. If we render their armor useless, they are not that tough to deal with... I will give you 5 Bombs. Use them on PileVolcamon leaders. Once the armor is destroyed by the bomb, it won't be that big of a threat for us. That'll give us some edge.
_310.Objective: Use the Bomb on PileVolcamon leaders.
_310.CompletionText: Regular PileVolcamons won't do. Make sure you use them on their leaders.
_310.CompletionSummary: Ha! PileVolcamons won't be bothering us anymore, I see.
_310.ReservedText: (There is a large explosion, but it doesn't seem to have any effect.)

_311.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_311.Description:
Hehe... Looks familiar, doesn't it?
(SuperStarmon shows me an Evil Ring.)
In the course of my investigation, I found out that raging digimons in the region are being controlled by this thing... That means the one responsible for the chaos in this area, and the one responsible for the rampage of digimons in the Western Area are one and the same.
You should be able to get this as you defeat digimons in this area. Bring 8 of them to Starmon of Passion. That should tell him what's going on here.
_311.CompletionText: You don't have to be so amazed... This is quite normal for a genius like me.
_311.CompletionSummary: This is an Evil Ring! So, you were instructed to deliver this to Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon, huh?

_312.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_312.Description:
Hmm... My investigation reveals that these digimons carry something strange other than the Evil Ring. It looks somewhat like the communicator commonly used by humans. Now, digimons wouldn't communicate with each other like that... This thing is rather suspicious.
You can find it on digimons in the area. I would like you to bring me 10 of them.
_312.CompletionText: Don't complain or anything... We helped you, so you should return the favor, don't you think?
_312.CompletionSummary:
Ah! Having collected these things stokes my curiosity even more.
(SuperStarmon starts touching this and that. Shortly, the device breaks down...)
What is this? It doesn't work?

_313.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_313.Description: (This is important information written before his death. I should take it to Leomon.)
_313.Objective: Deliver the memo to Elite Scout Leomon.
_313.CompletionSummary: The Leomon has fallen, has he? Hmm... He has left a very critical piece of information for us. It says here that we need to activate the mysterious devices in this area in order to open up the Digimon Maze. It looks like we need a special device if we

_314.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_314.Description:
What strange devices... They look like the communicator you humans use... It seems that someone attached these on the digimons for information. The culprit behind all the troubles here is no doubt gathering information about this area with these. We should destroy them as soon as we see them.
When you see one, bring it to me and I will destroy it.
_314.CompletionText: Bring 8 of each. No matter how many more you bring, the Deconstructor can only handle a limited number at a time.
_314.CompletionSummary: Even when I break something, I do it like a genius. Hehehe.

_315.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_315.Description: We have received the report that Evil Rings have been discovered in the area. Evil Rings are dangerous artifact that must be eliminated from the Digital World. If you acquire Evil Rings, please, bring them to me.
_315.CompletionText: If something like this exists in the Digital World, the anti-human sentiment will grow.
_315.CompletionSummary: Good work. I look forward to our continued partnership.

_316.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_316.Description: This area is a space created with the data gleaned from an ancient structure in the Real World. Perhaps because of that, precious research data is scattered here and there in the Real World, too. Digimons don't know how valuable these are. Dats Center has ordered the retrieval of those precious research data. As you take down digimons, you should be able to acquire Precious Research Data. Bring me 5 of them.
_316.CompletionText: Collecting such data is certainly within the scope of what Dats Center does.
_316.CompletionSummary: Thank you. These will be transported to Dats Center safely.

_317.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_317.Description: This is amazing... Not only have we avenged Leomons, we have also activated all the mysterious devices.
_317.CompletionText: We need to let Chief Leomon know...
_317.CompletionSummary: We have received reports of an unknown digimon at the Strange Altar. He appeared when the mysterious device was activated. I would like you to go and ask how to open the Digimon Maze Entrance…

_318.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_318.Description:
(There is faint writing.)
<Target CannonBeemon leaders. When the Overseer appears, seize the Power Core from him.>
_318.Objective: Retrieve the Power Source from Boltmon Overseers.
_318.CompletionText: (I will lure the Boltmon Overseer by slaying PileVolcamon leaders.)
_318.CompletionSummary: (Upon connecting the power source, the mysterious device begins to run.)

_319.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_319.Description:
(There is faint writing.)
<Target Rockmon leaders. When the Overseer appears, seize the Power Core from him.>
_319.Objective: Retrieve the Power Source from Boltmon Overseers.
_319.CompletionText: (I will lure the Boltmon Overseer by slaying Rockmon leaders.)
_319.CompletionSummary: (Upon connecting the power source, the mysterious device begins to run.)

_320.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_320.Description:
(There is faint writing.)
<Target Volcamon leaders. When the Overseer appears, seize the Power Core from him.>
_320.Objective: Retrieve the Power Source from Boltmon Overseers.
_320.CompletionText: (I will lure the Boltmon Overseer by slaying Volcamon leaders.)
_320.CompletionSummary: (Upon connecting the power source, the mysterious device begins to run.)

_321.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_321.Description:
(There is faint writing.)
<Target Cerberumon leaders. When the Overseer appears, seize the Power Core from him.>
_321.Objective: Retrieve the Power Source from Boltmon Overseers.
_321.CompletionText: (I will lure the Boltmon Overseer by slaying Cerberumon leaders.)
_321.CompletionSummary: (Upon connecting the power source, the mysterious device begins to run.)

_322.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_322.Description:
(There is faint writing.)
<Target PileVolcamon leaders. When the Overseer appears, seize the Power Core from him.>
_322.Objective: Retrieve the Power Source from Boltmon Overseers.
_322.CompletionText: (I will lure the Boltmon Overseer by slaying PileVolcamon leaders.)
_322.CompletionSummary: (Upon connecting the power source, the mysterious device begins to run.)

_323.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_323.Description: This is Starmon of Passion! The item that you gave to Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon...! It's probably a signal emitter of some sort. Get one of those from SuperStarmon and bring it to me. I will find out how to use it.
_323.CompletionText: Get one from SuperStarmon and bring it to me. I will figure out how to use it.
_323.CompletionSummary:
What? You want one of these?
(SuperStarmon grumbles.)

_324.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_324.Description:
This is Starmon!
I want you to bring that item to me. There may be some sort of a clue in there.
_324.CompletionSummary: Great work... I will examine this thing very carefully.

_325.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_325.Description: Scouts are supposed to report in even if nothing has happened... But, at some point, I stopped hearing from Leomon A scout... Find him and see what's happening.
_325.CompletionSummary: (There is a memo next to the Leomon. It looks like he wrote something on it for his friend moments before he died.)
_325.ReservedText: (This Leomon has sustained a grave wound. It is already too late...)

_326.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_326.Description: Are you the ones who have awakened me? I am Anubimon, a long-time guardian of this place... My title was revoked by humans, and I have been asleep since.
_326.CompletionText: What do you want from me?
_326.CompletionSummary: Activating all the devices alone doesn't solve all our problems in this place. There is an underlying evil in this place. If we don't take care of it, the Digimon Maze Entrance won't open. Lure out the source of evil and destroy it. You may have seen

_327.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_327.Description: Yipes!! Have you seen them? Have you? Those are Boltmons!! They have no emotions whatsoever. They only blindly obey their creator... They are cruel and fearsome creatures!!! Leomon was defeated by them a little while ago, too... So long as they are wandering about, this place is not safe!!! I beg of you. Please, destroy them!!
_327.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Boltmon of Rock%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Boltmon of Darkness%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Boltmon of Flame%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Boltmon of Poison%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Defeat Boltmon of Strength%qe %cc5/%mc5
_327.CompletionText:
(He seems frightened somehow.)
Don't do anything rash like taking him on by yourself!
_327.CompletionSummary: Th... thank you... But this is still not very assuring for us...

_328.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_328.Description:
Gather 10 devices and bring them to me. If you do so, I will create a device for you that will attract the source of evil in this place.
He has the key to the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_328.CompletionText: You can find Danger Sensors on raging digimons in this place.
_328.CompletionSummary: With this, we should be able to lure him out... Be careful. You just can't defeat him on your own.

_329.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_329.Summary: Root Out the Source of Evil [Party]
_329.Description: Take the Summoning Stone to the <Destroyed Holy Site>. That will cause the source of evil that has tainted this region show himself. Defeat him. That will open the way to the Digimon Maze.
_329.CompletionText: You can't do it on your own... Find some friends.
_329.CompletionSummary: This takes care of the source of evil. I will give you the key to the Digimon Maze. May eternal safety and peace be upon you...

_330.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_330.Description: This is Starmon of Passion! Do you copy? That device is the one that Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon thought suspicious before! So, my hunch was right, after all... Come and see me for a while, would you?
_330.CompletionSummary: What incredible intuition. Nothing less than Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon. This device is highly dangerous!

_331.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_331.Description: I learned from Anubimon how to use this thing. From now on, this dangerous device must be managed by Dats Center. If you find more of these in the future, bring them to me immediately. I will make <Summoning Stones> with them for you.
_331.CompletionText: Hmm... It turns out, this is a very dangerous thing.
_331.CompletionSummary: Good work. Let me give you a Summoning Stone. You know where to use it, right?

_332.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_332.Summary: Root Out the Source of Evil [D]
_332.Description: The source of evil is so deep-rooted that... it doesn't vanish easily... It's like poisonous mushrooms. Eliminate the hell hunters, Cerberumons, and I will give you the key to the Digimon Maze.
_332.CompletionText: Destroy the source of evil and restore peace in this place...
_332.CompletionSummary: I will give you the key to the Digimon Maze. May eternal safety and peace be upon you...

_333.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_333.Description: This is Starmon of Passion! You are amazing. You have finally opened the way to the Digimon Maze. Come back to camp. Let's discuss what we'll do from here on.
_333.Objective: Speak with Starmon at Camp Kidosin.
_333.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Starmon at Camp Kidosin.
_333.CompletionText: Hurry back to Camp, would you?
_333.CompletionSummary: Now, all we have to do is to enter the Digimon Maze. It's probably a good idea to stock up at Camp before we enter the Maze. Unlike here, you can't receive any supplies while you are in the Maze. Remember that. Oh, and we should let Leomons know, too,

_334.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_334.Description:
I would like you to take this news to Leomons... They are our partners, after all. If we maintain our partnership in the Maze, they are as good as military allies.
They make powerful allies, unlike those cowardly Chuchidarumons.
_334.CompletionText: Take the news to Elite Scout Leomon.
_334.CompletionSummary: I see... The way to the Digimon Maze is open!

_335.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_335.Description: Take the news to the Chief Leomons. Now, all we have left to do is to get into the Digimon Maze. Once we are inside, and if we can manage it, we should continue our partnership.
_335.CompletionText: If at all possible, we should work with each other inside as well.
_335.CompletionSummary: Fool! Humankind is our common enemy... Be gone! If we meet each other again, I will show no mercy even for you! Be prepared to die next time!
_335.ReservedText: I see... I understand what is happening now. Now, we can trust you somewhat.

_336.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_336.Description:
Dear, me... It looks like we fell into a trap right from the start. This is probably an underground level of the Digimon Maze. We have no idea what manner of traps Digimon Kaisers may have installed, so we will have to tread carefully.
I also see dangerous, raging digimons here and there. Hmm... Anyway, we will have to take care of those raging digimons first if we are to leave this place soon.
_336.CompletionText: This place is terrifying... Working alone is a foolish idea.
_336.CompletionSummary: Well done... Now, shall we move forward?

_337.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_337.Description:
I saw Giromons up head... They are highly dangerous creatures. They are vaccine digimons whose original duties were to protect specific areas. I can't believe even they are infected and being used... It looks like whoever created the Digimon Maze is a tough one to deal with.
I have an Evil Ring Deconstructor, so we can use that. If that doesn't work, well... I suppose we will just have to blast through this place...
Use the Evil Ring Deconstructor on Giromons. If we can restore them, we will have a great advantage.
_337.Objective: Use Evil Ring Deconstructor on Giromons.
_337.CompletionSummary: Oh, no... This doesn't work at all!!

_338.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_338.Description: Roachmons are simply disgusting... They don't seem to realize that about themselves, though... We will have to teach them just how disgusting they are. They carry strange pouches that smell absolutely foul. Seize them from them, and throw them at their leaders. If they smell it, they will realize just how foul of a thing they have been carrying all along...
_338.Objective: Seize Foul Pouches from Roachmons and throw them at their leaders.
_338.CompletionText: Take the foul-smelling pouches from Roachmons and throw them on their leaders!
_338.CompletionSummary: Ugh... What a stench! This is incredibly foul...

_339.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_339.Description: Ugh... Boltmons have pursued us here... This is not looking good... We are sandwiched between raging digimons up ahead and Boltmons behind us. Now, this is what I call a dilemma. We can't afford confronting them, so the only way is forward. I want you to defeat the Meramons that are blocking our way. Things are very hot around them, so be careful.
_339.Objective: Defeat 10 Meramons and 8 of their leaders.
_339.CompletionText: Defeat 10 Meramons and 8 of their leaders for us, would you?
_339.CompletionSummary: Phew... That gives us some room to breathe for now... When you see Boltmons, the best thing to do is flee.

_340.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_340.Description: This leave us with no choice... We break through! Defeat 5 of them!
_340.CompletionSummary: How sad... Their willpower is manipulated in such terrible ways...

_341.Title: Digimon Maze Entrance
_341.Description: I have sent out scouts throughout this area... I have to deliver orders, but I have no good way of reaching them right now. I want you to find them, deliver the orders, and see if they are experiencing any trouble carrying out their assignments...
_341.Objective: Deliver the Orders to the scouts.
_341.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver the Order to Scout A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver the Order to Scout B%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Deliver the Order to Scout C%qe %cc3/%mc3
_341.CompletionText: Are you not done yet? This is taking longer than I thought.
_341.ReservedText: Hmm... Alright. I have received the message.

_342.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_342.Description:
This is too embarrassing... We've had the order document sent by Elite ScoutLeomon seized by Gladimons.
I would like you to recover that order for me... I can't move right now, you see.
You should be able to recover the order from Gladimons.
_342.CompletionText: Would you mind collecting 5 Order Fragments?
_342.CompletionSummary: Many thanks... How unusual that I should receive help from a human. This place is more dangerous than what one would expect.

_343.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_343.Description:
Hmm... I see. The order document is torn to pieces, but, at least, we can decipher what it's meant to say. According to Elite ScoutLeomon's orders, we are to make it a priority to eliminate Gladimons. They are getting in the way of our dominating this place.
Still... The situation isn't looking good. We have already lost contact with other Leomons that have entered the Digimon Maze with me.
This place is more dangerous than we had expected. I need you to defeat Gladimons on my behalf.
_343.CompletionText: The raging digimons here are more powerful than us. How absurd!
_343.CompletionSummary: Thank you... But this is not the only order...

_344.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_344.Description:
This is Starmon of Passion!
I see that those ScoutLeomon are wasting their time and energy. We are having trouble making progress as it is! The best way to take them down is to eliminate their leaders.
If we don't take care of their leaders, they simply won't give up!!! I want you to defeat Gladimon leaders.
_344.CompletionText: If we just rely on them, nothing is going to get done.
_344.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Gladimons should remain quiet for a while.

_345.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_345.Description: Many Leomons other than myself have entered this place. I have lost contact with them. Contacting Elite Scout Leomon is not easy right now, either. It would be most appreciated if you could find other Leomons, recover their orders and assist them.
_345.CompletionSummary: .......... (He has sustained a great burn. It's already too late...)

_346.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_346.Description: (Judging from the wounds, this must be Meramons' doing. I will have to recover the order document from Meramons.)
_346.CompletionText: (I need to collect the order documents from Meramons.)
_346.CompletionSummary: (There is something written on the recovered order.)

_347.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_347.Description: (The contents of recovered orders are written in digimon script and cannot be verified. I will have to take this to Starmon of Passion.)
_347.Objective: Take the Order documents to Starmon of Passion.
_347.ObjectiveProgress: Take the Order documents to Starmon of Passion.
_347.CompletionText: (The contents of recovered orders are written in digimon script and cannot be verified. I will have to take this to Starmon of Passion.)
_347.CompletionSummary: An order left behind by Leomons? Hmm... I see.

_348.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_348.Description:
Tsk, tsk... It looks like he tried to use Aqua Crystal against Meramons to defeat them. He was probably defeated before he could even get to using it. Not to mention having the <Aqua Crystal> seized. It's really too bad, but his death was in vain. Tsk, tsk...
Recover the <Aqua Crystal> from the Meramons and use it on their leaders. Teach them a harsh lesson, would you?
_348.Objective: Use the Aqua Crystal on Meramon leaders.
_348.CompletionText: It's too bad, but his death has been in vain...
_348.CompletionSummary: Great!!! Hmph! Now, they will have learned that harsh lesson.

_349.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_349.Description:
This is Starmon of Passion!! Thanks to your work, we made some progress from the Digimon Maze Entrance! Move on a little more from where Meramons are, and you'll see us. Come this way!
We have plenty of things for you to do here, too...
_349.CompletionText: We have plenty of things for you to do around here...
_349.CompletionSummary: You are here... This place seems a little safer, but we still can't let our guard down.

_350.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_350.Description: This is not good... It looks like Boltmons have tracked us down here. If we don't take care of them, our six will be left wide open. Not to mention more ScoutLeomon casualty. I'd rather not confront them unless we absolutely have to, but... I guess extraordinary circumstances call for extraordinary measures. I need you to eliminate <Blood Boltmons> and <Fanatic Boltmons>. They should show themselves as you defeat <Giromons>...
_350.CompletionText: They will show themselves as you slay <Giromons>...
_350.CompletionSummary: We will have to move before they start pursuing us...

_351.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_351.Description:
You seem to be in one piece. Since we have entered this place, the only folks who have remained safe are you and Starmon of Passion. This is terrible...
I have lost contact with others that have come in here together, and I am isolated here, too. Right now, I can't even verify whether they are dead or alive.
I would like you to move on forward and see if they are alive. If they have sustained grave wounds, please treat them with the <Healing Medicine>.
I know this is a difficult task, but you are the only one I can rely on.
_351.Objective: Find Leomon survivors and treat them.
_351.CompletionText: I know it's a difficult ask, but you are the only one capable of doing this.

_352.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_352.Description: It would be good if the scouts are still alive, but... we should also be prepared for the worst case scenario. If they have been injured or even died, I would like you to recover the orders from them and bring them to me. If they fall into the hands of the enemy, this could turn really ugly. As soon as you find them, burn them.
_352.Objective: Recover Order documents from deceased scouts.
_352.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Recover Order document%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Recover Order document%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Recover Order document%qe %cc3/%mc3
_352.CompletionText: Retrieve the orders from the scouts.
_352.CompletionSummary: (I have incinerated all the recovered order documents.)
_352.ReservedText: ............ (It's already too late. I will just have to recover the order.)

_353.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_353.Description: It's really too bad, but most Leomons here seem to have been slain... Tsk, tsk... What a shame. As a digimon myself, this is a real tragedy. It would be abominable to abandon their bodies here. I will give you a Data Loader... I would like you to take care of their bodies.
_353.Objective: Load the DATA of Deceased Leomons.
_353.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Load Fallen Leomon DATA%qe %cc4/%mc4
_353.CompletionText: It may have been a short while, but they were our allies. It is not right for us to simply abandon their bodies here.
_353.CompletionSummary: The DATA you have collected from them will be recreated in DigiEggs. Well done.
_353.ReservedText: (The DATA is loaded from the Leomon.)

_354.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_354.Description: Those Boltmons will never give up their pursuit. Not before we stop the one controlling them, anyway... We need to continually slay them.
_354.CompletionText: Slay Blood Boltmons and Fanatic Boltmons.
_354.CompletionSummary: Excellent work. We should be able to relax for now.

_355.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_355.Description:
A little farther on from here are WaruMonzaemons. I sustained a grave wound from them. My partner didn't even make it when they attacked... I will probably spend the rest of my life in this sense of guilt. The guilt of failing to protect my partner...
I may be weak and incompetent, but you are different... You have power. The power to save a partner in the middle of a dangerous situation.
Please, I beg of you. I want him avenged... And I want you to ease this sense of guilt...
Slay WaruMonzaemons and bring me 5 capes from their leaders.
_355.CompletionText: I need you to defeat WaruMonzaemons...
_355.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This should put the souls of our fallen comrades at rest. I will present these capes as an offering.

_356.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_356.Description:
The information they tried to protect to their death has been lost. It's probably the doing of the raging digimons in the area. Recovering what they tried to protect with their life would be the last thing I could do for them.
I want you to retrieve the information they left behind from Giromons and WaruMonzaemons.
_356.Objective: Report Fragment from Giromons and WaruMonzaemons.
_356.CompletionText: Giromons and WaruMonzaemons are probably behind this...
_356.CompletionSummary: Great work. The final message they left behind... I will protect it with my life.

_357.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_357.Description: (This looks like a device that activates the Digimon Maze power source. I will have to find the power source and activate the device.)
_357.CompletionText: (There must be a digimon who is carrying the power source in the Maze.)
_357.CompletionSummary: (The device starts with a great roar.)
_357.ReservedText: (The device starts with a great roar.)

_358.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_358.Description: (This looks like a device that activates the Digimon Maze power source. I will have to find the power source and activate the device.)
_358.CompletionText: (There must be a digimon who is carrying the power source in the Maze.)
_358.CompletionSummary: (The device starts with a great roar.)
_358.ReservedText: (The device starts with a great roar.)

_359.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_359.Summary: Power Source for Device of Blood
_359.Description: (This device seems old and unstable. I should continue to secure power sources.)
_359.CompletionText: (I need to seize the power source from Blood Boltmons.)
_359.CompletionSummary: (The device starts with a great roar.)
_359.ReservedText: (The device starts with a great roar.)

_360.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_360.Description: (This device seems old and unstable. I should continue to secure power sources.)
_360.CompletionText: (I need to seize the power source from Fanatic Boltmons.)
_360.CompletionSummary: (The device starts with a great roar.)
_360.ReservedText: (The device starts with a great roar.)

_361.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_361.Description: We meet again, human... Thanks to your effort in securing the power source of the Maze, entry into the Maze is now possible.
_361.CompletionSummary: I will send you to B1. Once you activate the power sources throughout the Maze and restore the Maze to its original condition, we should be able to find my body as well. Please remember this - the only way to stop him is to recover my body.
_361.ReservedText:
Originally, I took care of the Maze. My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place.
But, since Digimon Kaiser robbed this place and sealed my body, the security of this place has been compromised.

_362.Title: Digimon Maze B1
_362.Description: Did... did you feel that!? What? Was it just me? Since I came in here, I feel some strange... resonance...
_362.CompletionSummary: We need to find a way to go up, quick. I will look for a way to go up there. Why don't you do the same?
_362.ReservedText: It is as though the entire Maze is moving. I have a bad feeling about this...

_363.Title: Digimon Maze B1
_363.Description:
Oh, no!! A battle has broken out at the dead-end path up ahead between Leomons and the pursuing Boltmons. Things are not looking good. I broke away from it to get help, but... with this wound, I won't be able to last too much longer, either... Ugh...
(Leomon spits out blood.)
You are our last hope. Hurry... Go and help the Leomons, or we will be annihilated.
_363.CompletionText: At this rate, we will all be annihilated!!!
_363.CompletionSummary: Hehehe... We have some powerful reinforcements now.

_364.Title: Digimon Maze B1
_364.Description: Now... Haha... All we have to do now is to use the power source to activate that device... *cough* But, be careful... He is not alone in this...
_364.Objective: Defeat Boltmons and activate the device.
_364.CompletionText: When they show themselves, slay every last of them... They must be eliminated before we can start the device.
_364.CompletionSummary: Great work. You have strength unlike anything I have seen. Thank you... Take this news to... *cough*
_364.ReservedText: (The device starts with a great roar.)

_365.Title: Digimon Maze B1
_365.Description: Argh... I got it pretty good... I will have to rest here for a while. Leomons that have entered the Digimon Maze are now all dead. Please take this news to Chief Leomon at the Digimon Maze Entrance...
_365.CompletionText: Uhn... The chief is probably at the Digimon Maze Entrance.
_365.CompletionSummary: Annihilated?! I have lost my digimons again...

_366.Title: Digimon Maze B2
_366.Description: *sigh* So, Leomons who entered this place have been annihilated. That's what happens when you are all passion and no caution. I will give you this Data Loader. Please, gather their bodies.
_366.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc5/%mc5 %qs6Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc6/%mc6 %qs7Load Leomon DATA%qe %cc7/%mc7
_366.CompletionSummary: Well done. The loaded DATA will be recreated in DigiEggs.
_366.ReservedText: (The Leomon's DATA is loaded with a bright light.)

_367.Title: Digimon Maze B1
_367.Description: I can feel their grief and bitterness... As their chief, I can't move on to something else unless I relieve them of their grief. Will you help?
_367.CompletionText: Help me avenge their deaths, will you? Destroy Berserker of Destruction. He will show as you destroy <Boltmons>.
_367.CompletionSummary: Pray for their souls to rest in peace.

_368.Title: Digimon Maze B1
_368.Description: Boltmons have stolen the <Power Source> we need to activate the device. It must be very important to the Digimon Maze. Recover the seized <Power Source>... That is our priority.
_368.Objective: Secure the power source to activate the device.
_368.CompletionText: Take the <Power Source> from Boltmons. They seem to be trying to protect that device.
_368.CompletionSummary: Yes. This is it. If we just use this <Power Source>...

_369.Title: Yokohama_Village
_369.Summary: Report the result to Akihiro Kurata
_369.Description:
I have read Akihiro Kurata's report and proposal.
But why do we have to spend
such an enormous amount of money
to proceed with the project...
Tell him that we need firm evidence
to proceed.
_369.Objective: Go back to Akihiro Kurata in Yokohama
_369.CompletionText: We need a firm evidence... Akihiro Kurata's proposal is good, but we need firm evidence to persuade opposing party...
_369.CompletionSummary: Huh...!! Do we need more evidence!? Shoot... What a coward. Do you think I would give up just because some of them are against my brilliant project?

_370.Title: Yokohama_Village
_370.Description:
We need more data in order to
execute my project!
I need your help.
I heard many Digimon have appeared at the Small Forest Trail. I should go there and investigate
those Digimon immediately.
Meet me there when you are ready!
We should hurry. The number of Digimon
coming to Real World
is increasing...!
Don't tell me that you don't know where Small Forest Trail is. It is at the end of Small Forest Park. Now follow me!!
_370.Objective: Find Akihiro Kurata at Small Forest Trail
_370.CompletionText: I will follow you as soon as I am ready...
_370.CompletionSummary: Look all those Digimon! Aren't they awful? Now. Let's begin if you are ready.

_371.Title: Small Forest Trail
_371.Description:
Kekekeke...
Now... Send this report to Director Hashima
at the Dats Center.
This is an indisputably perfect report
I can just see their reaction
now.
_371.Objective: Return to Director Hashima in Dats Center
_371.CompletionText: Hurry up. Move. Move! If you are expecting some kind of reward forget about it. Beside, you didn't do anything.
_371.CompletionSummary: Report from Akihiro Kurata? Hmm... Let's take a look?

_372.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_372.Description:
Why do I have to return to the
Digital World full of those awful Digimon?
Well, it's just matter of time.
You can't enter Digital World because you are not an official agent...
Why don't you ask Richard Sampson
to promote you to official agent?
Not a bad idea, don't you think? Kekekeke
Come and see me once you are in Digital World
At least I know you are good at
fighting with Digimon.
If you could be of help in my research
you should consider it an honor... Hahaha...
_372.Objective: Find Akihiro Kurata in Digital World
_372.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with Akihiro Kurata at Digital World Western Village
_372.CompletionText: So you work for Richard Sampson... Huh? What a pity.
_372.CompletionSummary: Are you an @<tc:800>official agent@</tc> now? Kekeke... That will certainly speed up my research. Shall we proceed as soon as you are ready?

_373.Title: Yokohama_Village
_373.Description:
Hmm...
Akihiro Kurata's report was very interesting.
But I feel that it is insufficient to research only the Digimon that have appeared in the Real world.
There must be all kinds of Digimon in Digital World.
If you could include them in your project, you will be able to come up with a better report...
Tell Akihiro Kurata that's what I think.
_373.Objective: Report to Akihiro Kurata in Yokohama
_373.CompletionText: That's a better idea than Richard Sampson's idea of doing nothing... Dr. Akihiro Kurata
_373.CompletionSummary: What!? That sly bastard... Does he still think my report is insufficient?

_374.Title: Dats Center
_374.Description:
Thank you for everything~
You are young. And you are doing your job well. You taught me a good lesson.
?
So you need a letter of recommendation to become an official agent?
I will write one for you.
Take it to Richard Sampson at the Dats Center.
_374.CompletionText: Now, off you go. I am sure you will be a good @<tc:800>official agent@</tc>.
_374.CompletionSummary: From the nurse? Hmm... I see. Since you have accomplished another task, I will give you @<tc:800>Dats Emblem@</tc>.

_375.Title: Dats Center
_375.Description: Thank you. Thank you for rescuing me from Digimon. I won't do such a foolish thing again. I will write a letter of recommendation to Richard Sampon at the Dats Center... ?
_375.Objective: Report to Richard Sampson at the Dats Center
_375.CompletionText: I hope you can become an @<tc:800>Official Agent of the Dats Center@</tc>.
_375.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I see. Now that you have solved all the problems, I will give you a @<tc:800>Dats Emblem@</tc> that proves that you are an official agent of Dats Center Keep your spirits up. And don't give up no matter how hard it gets. ?

_376.Title: Dats Center
_376.Description: You get a Cracked DigiEgg by defeating normal Digimon, as a type of trophy. All you have to do is send it back to Digital World safely. That's basic knowledge Dats agents must know. ? Now bring it to Miki Kurosaki who is in charge of collecting Cracked DigiEggs. Do it now. ?
_376.Objective: Conversation with Miki in Yokohama Village
_376.CompletionText: Miki should be around the @<tc:800>Dats Vehicles@</tc> in Yokohama Village.
_376.CompletionSummary: Wow... Good job. Is this my first mission as a @<tc:800>Dats agent@</tc>!? I will give you a @<tc:800>Cracked DigiEgg@</tc>. Why don't you @<tc:800>return@</tc> it all by yourself? To get a refund for DigiEgg, first talk to me and select @<tc:800>Return

_377.Title: Dats Center
_377.Description:
All I know is scannable DigiEgg consists of Dragon, Beast, Insectoid, Rock, Plant, Bird and Devil types.
Would you please return this to Miki Kurosaki?
_377.CompletionText: You should handle it carefully as it contains DATA. Don't be reckless!
_377.CompletionSummary: Wow... Good job. This is @<tc:800>DATA scannable@</tc> DigiEgg. Normally, you can get it from @<tc:800>Field Digimon@</tc>. You'd better study them as you can get different @<tc:800>scannable DigiEggs@</tc> depending on what kind of Field Digimon you dea

_378.Title: Yokohama_Village
_378.Description:
Still a long way to go. Once you become an official agent, you can enter the Digital World.
Keep on working... Megumi Shirakawa in Yokohama Village will give you the first task. Go and find her...

_379.Title: Dats Center
_379.Description:
You can acquire Mercenary Digimon by hatching a Mercenary DigiEgg. You have to register Mercenary DigiEgg to a NPC who is in charge of Mercenary hatching. You will also need appropriate DATA Items to hatch Mercenary DigiEggs. Don't forget that you can acquire DATA Item by scanning DigiEgg...
Well... That's all I have to tell you.
Go to Richard Sampson at the Dats Center...
_379.Objective: Report to Richard Sampson in Dats Center
_379.CompletionText: If you can successfully hatch @<tc:800>Mercenary DigiEggs@</tc>, you can raise other Digimon other than @<tc:800>Partner Digimon@</tc>. Isn't that great?
_379.CompletionSummary: Here you are. Did you get the gist of it? But, it is too early for you to become an @<tc:800>official Dats agent@</tc>.

_380.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_380.Description: You are always late. Unlike you, I am a very busy man. I know you are here for sightseeing, but don't forget that I came here to work... Hope you got the idea. Shall we proceed? This is Kiwimon. It is a very fast Digimon, but it's also weak like you. Weak as it may be, it also is invaluable data for my research. Bring 8 Beast samples from Kiwimon.
_380.CompletionText: What was it? Why are you glaring at me like that?
_380.CompletionSummary: Ha! It is none of your business what kind of research I use it for...

_381.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_381.Description:
I'm doing this work for the Real World. I hope you understand how I feel.
Get rid of the Digimon so I can concentrate on my research.
Get rid of 8 Leomon (Leader).
Watch out for Leomon (Leader)... They are stronger than normal Leomon...
_381.CompletionText: There are some Digimon like that. They are such a headache!!
_381.CompletionSummary: Hahahaha... Now we can continue our research.

_382.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_382.Description:
Looks like we stirred up a hornet's nest...
It is because you didn't do your job well.
Well. Well, it's the price we have to pay for taking you in.
Those Leomon are doing whatever they can to disrupt my research.
I didn't know were a fool like Richard Sampson... I am disappointed!!
I will show who they are dealing with.
Although my research is at its final stage, we still have more time. I need your help.
Get their daggers and bring them to their leader.
That will be our threat...
In case the leader doesn't get the idea, we will have to use my secret weapon although it is not yet completed...
_382.Objective: Get 8 daggers from Leomon and bring them to Leader of Leomon
_382.CompletionText: Frustrating... Really frustrating!! What is so frustrating!? The way you do your job makes me frustrated!!

_383.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_383.Description:
I don't think all humans are bad. I have met many humans.
But this guy is the worst I have encountered. Working for him must not be an easy job. I understand.
Tell him that.
I received his message...
But tell him that we will never give up as long as he stays there!!
_383.Objective: Return to Akihiro Kurata with Leomon's Message
_383.CompletionSummary: This getting to be more and more of a nuisance... Shoot!

_384.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_384.Description:
My research is about to be completed...
And things aren't going well. Well, that's okay. I can conduct research anywhere... I can't afford to have unnecessary interruption.
We are moving to new research facility!!
My job here is all done anyway...
By the way, those sticky Leomon are stubborn.
They must be relatives of Richard Sampson's. Kekekeke...
They're a very difficult type to deal with...
You are responsible for this.
We are moving to a new facility in Western Village: East of Western Area. I will meet you there.
_384.Objective: Find Akihiro Kurata in the Western Village East Area
_384.CompletionText: This place is full of stubborn bastards... Can't we be more productive than this?
_384.CompletionSummary: Shoot... Nothing is in its place...

_385.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_385.Description:
Shoot...
I can't believe Leomon followed me here...
They're stubborn bastards, just like Richard Sampson...
Get rid of them all!!
I can't afford to be interrupted by them when I'm about to finish my work!
Prove to me that you are a useful agent!!
Get rid of all the Leomon you can find!!
_385.CompletionText: Stubborn bastard... Just like Richard Sampson...
_385.CompletionSummary: I don't think I can stay here longer... We should move on to next stage...

_386.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_386.Description:
Every Digimon uses a unique weapon...
They even use parts of their body as weapons...
Some of them even transform body parts into specific objects.
I really want to know how they work!
Huh...? Don't you know who I am talking about!!
And you call yourself a Digimon expert?
It is Deputymon. Deputymon!! This one makes bullets inside its body.
It's very interesting... If only I could find out how it does it...
Hmm...
Bring me Deputymon's bullets in pristine condition.
_386.Objective: Bring me 8 bullets in pristine condition from Deputymon
_386.CompletionText: The bullet I want to have is... @<tc:800>bullet@</tc> in pristine condition!!
_386.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I don't see anything special about it... Shoot...Did I just do that for nothing!?

_387.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_387.Description:
There is nothing as fascinating as the Greymon's fang when it come to weapon research...
Kekeke... It's a very vicious Digimon. It will tear apart anything it bites...
Bring me Greymon's fang...
I wonder what it it's made of!
_387.CompletionText: It does not just look foolish... It looks like a complete idiot, don't you think? Hahahahaha!!
_387.CompletionSummary: Hmm... All this research material is useless! Shoot...

_388.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_388.Description: Kekekeke... There is a gigantic Digimon called Rockmon in this area. Normal attacks won't even leave a scratch on it as it is covered with rock. And that make it wonderful research material. I will give you this, my proud invention. Try using it on Rockmon to see if it works. You don't have to install it anywhere... So don't do anything stupid with it... And be careful with my precious invention!!
_388.Objective: Defeat 10 Rockmon with Akihiro Kurata's invention
_388.CompletionText: Don't play around with it! This is very delicate machine... That you better not break...
_388.CompletionSummary: What!? My invention didn't work on Rockmon!? I can't believe it... That's not possible!!! How could an invention by a genius like me fail...?? You have to be lying!!

_389.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_389.Description:
You liar!!
You're lying to me!!
There's no way my invention was ineffective against Rockmon!!
You came back unharmed. How can you explain that??
You are a liar...
All right! All right... I can't trust you any more.
This is the most up-to-date research report on Digital World so far. Bring it to the Director Hashima at Dats Center in the Real World...
I will bring this item to Wind Valley and test it. If Director Hashima asks about me, tell him that!!
_389.Objective: Report the research results to Director Hashima at Dats Center
_389.CompletionText: I hope you are not reporting false results to me. I will check the results by myself, so don't you dare lie to me!!
_389.CompletionSummary: It has been such a long time since I heard from Akihiro Kurata...

_390.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_390.Description: Humans are all look alike. It is difficult to tell them apart. I know a lots of human kids have come from Real World recently... But 15 years ago? How would I know?. Why don't you ask some other Digimon in the Western Village?
_390.Objective: Ask Digimon in Western Village for Keenan Krier's whereabouts.
_390.CompletionText: Sorry, I don't know anything about this... Why don't you ask another Digimon?
_390.CompletionSummary: Ah... Here you are... Richard Sampson sent you, right? Do you have information about Keenan Krier?

_391.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_391.Description:
PawnChessmonBlack and Richard Sampson sent me here. I was ordered to find Keenan Krier's whereabouts and collect information about the Digital World.
I saw a human kid in the Digital World recently. I approached him to see if he was Keenan Krier, but he began to attack us suddenly.
I got the impression that all Digimons surrounding him took orders from him.
I had no choice but to away from them.
And I lost contact with PawnChessmonBlack... Now that you are here to support us, I am going to look for PawnChessmonBlack again. Are you going to help me? I will wait for at Western Village Outer Area...
_391.Objective: Find PawnChessmonWhite in Western Village Outer Area
_391.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with PawnChessmonWhite in Western Village Outer Area
_391.CompletionText: Go to northeast of Western Village if you want to go Western Village Outer Area
_391.CompletionSummary: Here you are. We have no time to waste... ?

_392.Title: Dats Center
_392.Description: Now that you are an official agent you will be able to go to Digital World through the D-terminal. Megumi Shirakawa will brief you on the details. Look for Megumi Shirakawa in the Dats Center harbor area.
_392.Objective: Look for Megumi at the Dats Center
_392.CompletionText: Be careful because @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc> is a very dangerous place...
_392.CompletionSummary: Finally you're an @<tc:800>official agent@</tc>. Congratulations. I am in charge of D-terminal teleportation. Talk to me first, then select D-terminal to teleport. You can teleport to the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc> through the @<tc:800>D-terminal@</t

_393.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_393.Description:
That human kid busted the stupid looking Digimon...
If you want to save him... You must destroy this suspicious-looking hook on this Digimon... But you can't use usual methods.
Babamon knows about everything that happens in this area. . Babamon is in Wind Valley. Why don't you ask Babamon about this suspicious looking object..
What? You want me to go with you?
No way. I hate Babamon!!
_393.CompletionText: And don't tell Babamon that you are doing me a favor! Got it?
_393.CompletionSummary: What? Impmon, the menace? Shrewd bastard... How dare ask me a favor without showing his ass...

_394.Title: Digital World Wilderness Area
_394.Description: When I think of what Devil Impmon has done, I don't want to help you... But I guess this is a different case. Tell Devil Impmon that I need additional information in order to identify the object.
_394.Objective: Find Devil Impmon in the Wilderness Area
_394.CompletionText: Go now. There's not enough time.
_394.CompletionSummary: Hm... How did Babamon know that I sent you? I should never have trusted a @<tc:800>human@</tc> in the first place.

_395.Title: Digital World Wilderness Area
_395.Summary: Trying to identify the suspicious item...
_395.Description: The object Babamon told me should be around here. Babamon said we need to find the nucleus of the suspicious item. All Digimon in this area are rampaging ones... We'll probably find out if we ask them... ? Defeat Boarmon and Boarmon (Leader) and find out whether they have the suspicious item. ?
_395.Objective: Trying to identify the suspicious item...

_396.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_396.Description: Boarmon won't do... It must be Digimon close to the Virus type. Stingmon must be around here... That Digimon might have it. Take care of 5 Stingmon and 5 Stingmon (Leader)...
_396.CompletionText: Stingmon is a seasoned warrior. Not that I am scared of it... It's best to be careful..
_396.CompletionSummary: It was not Stingmon... Hmm... Well, this might be dangerous, but...

_397.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_397.Description: Now, only Devimon and Sabirdramon are left. They are vicious Digimon... I would usually avoid them... But we have no choice... I want you to bring anything suspicious items from them you find. What kind of suspicious item? I don't know exactly either... Just bring anything you can take from them... ?
_397.CompletionText: They are fallen Digimon... They are very dangerous Digimon. Well, this is to save your friend... so you must take care of it.
_397.CompletionSummary: That's right! This is it! This is it!!

_398.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_398.Description: Bring this to Babamon I hope this is what she is looking for. I hope it will solve the problem. I hope this will complete our task.
_398.CompletionSummary: I see... Devil Impmon found it...

_399.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_399.Description: This is a wicked object... Hmm... I see. This is what makes Digimon malicious. This object consists of a very powerful virus that will destroy the wearer's consciousness and consequently make the wearer obey its creator... What's it called? That's right... It has to be an Eveling. It was created by people with evil intentions. I have no idea why this ancient object is here. We need some ingredients to make something to destroy this. We need cold rocks and and sharp fangs capable of melting anything. Get 5 of each from Icemon and Doggymon.
_399.Objective: Let's get 5 cold rocks and sharp fangs
_399.CompletionText: @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> can't be destroyed using normal methods... We need something of equal strength to it to destroy it...
_399.CompletionSummary: Good job... We will be able to melt @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> with a @<tc:800>sharp fang@</tc> and @<tc:800>cold rock@</tc>.

_400.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_400.Summary: Things you need if you want to destroy Eveling
_400.Description: Hmm... Cold Rock can't withstand sharp fang... Sorry to ask you again, but can you bring one more thing? Garurumon's rake has the mysterious power to withstand any shock. It would allow Cold Rock to withstand Doggymon's sharp fang too. I want you to bring me 5 rakes of Garurumon.
_400.Objective: Things you need if you want to destroy Eveling
_400.CompletionText: I will make the necessary arrangements...
_400.CompletionSummary: I think this number will be enough... Well done.

_401.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_401.Description: Finally, we made a material as sturdy as Eveling... But physical force alone can't break Eveling as it is made of a powerful virus. In order to destroy Eveling's powerful virus, we need Virus DATA corresponding to it. As they say, an eye for an eye, or poison for poison. Let me see... What kind of Digimon around here has a powerful virus that is a match for Eveling? That's right. The IceDevimon will do! I want you to bring Virus DATA from IceDevimon to me...
_401.CompletionText: Be careful not to be infected by the @<tc:800>Virus@</tc>...
_401.CompletionSummary: I think @<tc:800>Virus DATA@</tc> as powerful as it will do. Well done.

_402.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_402.Description: Well, it's done. We can finally destroy Eveling. Bring this to the Devil Impmon in Wilderness Area...
_402.Objective: Return to Devil Impmon in Wilderness Area
_402.CompletionText: I hope we can destroy the @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> with this.
_402.CompletionSummary: You are too late! What took you so long...?

_403.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_403.Description: Here. Now, it's time to use this against that stupid Digimon... Don't expect it to destroy Eveling... Babamon makes some strange stuff sometimes... Pray...
_403.CompletionText: Now that you found the @<tc:800>Digimon @</tc> that smells like human... You can finally return to @<tc:800>Real World@</tc>...
_403.CompletionSummary: Oh!? What was I here for?

_404.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_404.Description: Oho... So, Babamon's creation did the job... What a surprise... Now we can get rid of the cause of the rampaging Digimon. Tell this to Starmon in Western Village.
_404.Objective: Talk to Starmon of Passion in Western Village
_404.CompletionText: You can go there if you use @<tc:800>Time Dimension Bomb@</tc>.
_404.CompletionSummary: What? Impmon, the menace? That's right... If I have it...

_405.Title: Dats Center
_405.Description: We found this while investigating the Digital World... I think it is one of the traces Keenan Krier left behind... He must be somewhere around here... That's right... The kid who attacked me wore a strange costume. Seeing that he has his own Partner Digimon... He must be a Tamer like you... I want you to report it to Richard Sampson.
_405.Objective: Report to Richard Sampson in Dats Center
_405.CompletionText: Wow... I still don't know what's going on...

_406.Title: Yokohama_Village
_406.Description: So you came back with traces that Keenan Krier may have left... Bring this news to Michelle Krier in Yokohama Village... She will be happy to hear that.
_406.CompletionText: Please tell her the happy news.
_406.CompletionSummary: Yes, this is! I know this is Keenan's...!! Thank God! Are you sure he is alive?

_407.Title: Yokohama_Village
_407.Description: Human kid who uses Eveling... If we overlook this matter, rage against human and Real World in Digital World will grow... You should report this to the commander. He will tell you what to do... He should be in Yokoham Village...
_407.Objective: Find Homer Yushima at DATA Center in Yokohama Village
_407.CompletionText: Cowards die many times before their deaths. The valiant never taste of death but once... Remember that...
_407.CompletionSummary: What? Richard Sampson sent you? Hahaha...

_408.Title: Dats Center
_408.Description: Eveling... A human kid? Haha... What a extraordinary kid he is... If the kid is capable of making this, he must be definitely be in league with Digimon... Ask Richard Sampson to search for someone suspicious among children registered as Tamers... We should notify other Digimon institutions...
_408.Objective: Report to Richard Sampson at Dats Center
_408.CompletionText: Wasting such talent for this evil purpose... That's truly a shame...
_408.CompletionSummary: Hmm. I got it. I will find out about this kid. Meanwhile, carry on the rest of your tasks...

_409.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_409.Description: Those Leomon, they are crazy!! It wouldn't be a problem if only I could complete this device!! Leomon followed me here... I am sure they want to interrupt my research.. I think they don't know my exact location... so I should attack them first. It will be hard to defend once they found out where we are... Defeat 3 Leomon (Tracker) in Wind Valley!! What this!! That was an order! Keep moving!!
_409.CompletionText: If my research was sabotaged in any way, it's all your fault!!
_409.CompletionSummary: Luckily they couldn't find out where we are... Those sticky bastards...Kekeke... If I'm given a little more time, they won't be a problem..Kekeke.

_410.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_410.Description: That's good news... It is comforting to hear the that number of rampaging Digimon at the Western Train Station is decreasing... We just received a request for backup forces from Digimon Farm because of several rampaging Digimon. We'd better go there because the human kid who initiated the rampage has been spotted. Look for me at Digimon Farm... I will wait for you there...
_410.Objective: Find Starmon of Passion at the Digimon Farm!
_410.CompletionText: If we could catch the @<tc:800>human kid@</tc>, the mastermind behind the rampaging incident, we can eliminate the cause of the rampaging Digimon.
_410.CompletionSummary: That was fast... Wow... It looks bad...

_411.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_411.Description: This place is full of dangerous Digimon... It is better to deal with easy ones first. Take care of 5 Blossomon... I am not saying that I don't trust Babamon's Eveling Destroyer, but it is safe to try it first. Let's try it against Blossomon...
_411.CompletionText: All Digimon around Digimon Farm are dangerous... Be careful...
_411.CompletionSummary: Great... Babamon is great. We can count on that Digimon's knowledge.

_412.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_412.Description: Now that we've tested it, we can move on. Collect Eveling from Digimon in this area. Collect 10 Evelings. I will destroy them with this machine.
_412.CompletionText: Our targets are Blossomon, Puppetmon and Bad Puppetmon!
_412.CompletionSummary: Phew... Looks like they are gone... Unless we catch the mastermind behind @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc>, it will be difficult to stop rampaging Digimon...

_413.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_413.Description: I think we need Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon. This Digimon is quite a famous detective in this area. We should ask Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon to find the human kid who caused this whole mess. Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon is in Mining Area up north. Ask the Digimon to take care of this task.
_413.CompletionText: For your reference... Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon is weird... If it asks for outrageous reward, just do it as it says...
_413.CompletionSummary: What is it? I am the one and only famous Digimon detective!! Hahahaha!! ?

_414.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_414.Description: Leomon!! It is Leomon!!! Those stupid Digimon never give up... I can't stand it!! They broke into my research center and stole every piece of data and materials! Without them, I am nothing in Digital World! They can't do this! Of course, we won't let them!! I am sure they are still around here. Go find them!! Hurry!! You should bring back 5 research materials, 1 experimental material, and 3 experimental equipment. Hurry!! Hurry up!!
_414.CompletionText: It is Leomon (Tracker)!! They stole all the research data!!
_414.CompletionSummary: Hahahaha..!! I found them. I found them!! Kekeke... No matter what I do, I'm the victor!!!

_415.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_415.Description: Oho... This is interesting... But we don't have enough information! Although I am a famous detective... Interrogation is a basic skill for detectives... Why don't you ask about the kid in the village? ?
_415.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I believe I've seen him. I am a wandering merchant. I think I saw a @<tc:800>human kid@</tc> with <tc:800>strange costume@</tc>... I am not so sure, bu maybe it was at the Ruined Historic.
_415.ReservedText: Hmm... Well? I am not sure...

_416.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_416.Description: That place is very dangerous... Don't go there. Fourth Dimension SuperStarmon might go there...
_416.CompletionText: Are you going to Ruined Historic?
_416.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I see. I got it. Why haven't I noticed the @<tc:800>strange costume@</tc> until now!? Mystery solved! @<tc:800>You are the culprit!@</tc> The clothes you have on! That is clear evidence!!

_417.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_417.Description: Ha! Don't deny it. It is you!! You are the prime suspect from now on. Don't do anything stupid. If I can't catch the real culprit, I have no choice but to mark you the culprit.. There is still another suspicious one. You go and check! There is old house to the north of Digimon Farm... Recently a human in a strange costume has been doing something there. ? ( Is it perhaps Akihiro Kurata? )
_417.CompletionText: You must find the real culprit if you want to be free... If there is real culprit...
_417.CompletionSummary: What!? You are losing your temper... You are hiding something from me... I have a feeling in my gut about it! But I don't have evidence! Well, we should go to Ruined Historic to procure evidence.
_417.ReservedText: What!? What? You came all the way up here to ask such a silly question? I knew you were a fool... But this is absurd. No way!!

_418.Title: Digital World Ruined Historic
_418.Description: I heard you brought evidence indicating my son Keenan Krier might be alive in Digital World. We hope to see our son. Thank you. But I've heard there is a human kid who causes problem in Digital World. I hope he is not my son... We are afraid he is our son, Keenan Krier... Thankfully, Homer Yushima volunteered to search for my son... I am really sorry to ask you this, but please help Homer Yushima to find out who that kid is... Homer Yushima said he will go to Ruined Historic.
_418.Objective: Find Homer Yushima in Ruined Historic.

_419.Title: Digital World Ruined Historic
_419.Description: We need to find out who the kid with the Eveling is first in order to find out Keenan Krier's whereabouts. Let's check whether the kid is Keenan Krier or not. The information we received indicates that the kid was seen in Ruined Historic. As I expected, all the Digimon around here seemed to be controlled by someone. First, let's find out where Eveling is. Bring 5 Evelings from the Digimon from around this area...
_419.CompletionText: You'd better be careful. The rage toward @<tc:800>humans@</tc> in the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc> is getting worse due to @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc>.
_419.CompletionSummary: I thought so... This @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> is identical to what has been discovered so far.

_420.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_420.Description: It is amazing to see an Eveling with my own eyes. If the kid is capable of using Eveling however he pleases, he must be a genius with extensive knowledge on Digimon. That's a shame. It is pity that he is using his genius for ill... Metal Greymon and Garudamon are righteous Digimon. They don't get along with rampaging Digimon. But some evil force drove them to rampage too... Hmm... Find any traces of Eveling and the kid from Metal Greymon and Garudamon.
_420.CompletionText: If you find anything, bring it to me...

_421.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_421.Description: Hmm... That won't do the job then. All we have to do is find Digimon who know the area well... I saw Devil Impmon wandering in this dangerous area. They were looking for something... I suspect that Digimon found something... Ask Devil Impmon in the Ruined Historic whether they found something...
_421.Objective: Find Devil Impmon in the Ruined Historic
_421.CompletionText: I can't wait till I find out who this kid is...
_421.CompletionSummary: So you've found me at last. Well, you @<tc:800>humans@</tc> can't do anything without the help of @<tc:800>Digimon@</tc> like us...

_422.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_422.Description: Indeed I found something... But I am not going to give it to you for free. I am not that big of a pushover... I will think about it if you do what I want. How about that? Well, you don't even have a choice anyway... I think that hateful looking human I saw at Ruined Historic in Western Village is here too. Was it Akihiro Kurata? I heard Leomon are having a hard time dealing with him. You should see how they run away in fright... What I am saying is this. Both Leomon and you ignored my warning. I want you to find Panjyamon and bring 5 pieces of ice from them.
_422.CompletionText: You must pay the price for valuable information...! Kekeke...
_422.CompletionSummary: Kekekeke... Imagine how that @<tc:800>human@</tc> will struggle.

_423.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_423.Description: This is not enough... Right! I have to use Metal Greymon...Kekeke... Vicious Metal Greymon will be right for this job!! Bring me 5 fangs of Metal Greymon.
_423.CompletionText: Do you think you can get such valuable information for free?

_424.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_424.Description: Kekeke... Here you go! All done! Give this to that ugly looking human. He would be happy to have it... Was his name Akihiro Kurata?
_424.CompletionSummary: Hahahaha... Now White Leomon and Skull Greymon will be public enemy No. 1!! Hahaha... You should have listened to my warning!! This is good!!
_424.ReservedText: Huh? What? What is this? Okay, leave it there!

_425.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_425.Summary: A promise is a promise! Important Evidence!
_425.Description: Well... Since I promised you... Here it is. To tell you the truth, I ended up here after chasing the kid with the Eveling. On the way here, he dropped this. Some human language was written on it... And I don't know human language...
_425.Objective: A promise is a promise! Important Evidence!
_425.CompletionText: How long are you going to wander in the @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc>!
_425.CompletionSummary: This pendant!! It says Digimon Kaiser...

_426.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_426.Description: Report this to Richard Sampson at the Dats Center... It seems the human kid who might be the mastermind behind the rampaging Digimon in Digital World is called the Digimon Kaiser...
_426.Objective: Find Richard Sampson at the Dats Center
_426.CompletionSummary: Digimon Kaiser? Hmm... I see. I will investigate it.

_427.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_427.Description: I just discovered an amazing truth after I analyzed the Eveling you gave me the other day...Kekeke You look curious. The person who made it has to be genius. It's incredible that I share this world with another genius. This object is called an Eveling. Huh? What? You already know what it is? What a liar you are! Well, who cares... I am fascinated by this Eveling. The stuff you brought me the other day was totally broken... We need more Digicore to use this again... The more we have, the better... Bring 10 Digicore from Monzaemon and WaruMonzaemon...
_427.CompletionText: Don't forget. The powerful @<tc:800>Digicore@</tc> will speed up my research.
_427.CompletionSummary: Excellent!! You are quite good except that you are a liar... Kekeke... Wait a second...

_428.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_428.Description: Kekeke... I am a genius. I fixed the delicate machine you brought me. Here it is. Go and defeat Cerberumon. Don't you dare break it. It is delicate machine. You're such a klutz... Use this Eveling to defeat 10 Cerberumon, 5 Cerberumon Leaders and report back to me.
_428.CompletionText: Be careful. Unlike you, it is an exquisite machine!
_428.CompletionSummary: Is that so? It didn't work on them? Or are you lying to me again?

_429.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_429.Description: It is not possible to extract accurate data from wild Digimon in the fields... Eveling controls people by destroying their consciousness and free will. Therefore, Eveling only works on targets with a certain intellectual level. If you go down to South, you will find the village. You can find Chuchidarumon there... Test it against them and report the results to me...
_429.CompletionText: Yeah, that's right... @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> must be ineffective to you... Kekeke...
_429.CompletionSummary: What...? It was useless against you... I see. I guess the @<tc:800>Digicore@</tc> I used to resurrect it was too weak...

_430.Title: Digital World_Digimon Farm
_430.Description: We have to go to Ruined Historic to acquire powerful Digicore. Kekeke... There are stronger Digimon. I will go there first... Meet me there when you are ready... Don't forgot what I told you Dats agent must follow orders.
_430.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with Akihiro Kurata in Ruined Historic
_430.CompletionText: It will be ready soon. Kekekeke...
_430.CompletionSummary: Oh, you are here... Take a look around... Horrifying, isn't it? Kekeke... Oh... Did you see Leomon on the way here?

_431.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_431.Description: I need Digicore composed of strong virus. It's urgent... We don't have enough time. The scout reported that Leomon's nest is around here... They will attack us soon... We should move on before they find us. Defeat Leomon (Elite) and bring 10 Digicore...!!
_431.Objective: Defeat Leomon (Elite) and bring 10 Digicore to Akihiro Kurata
_431.CompletionText: I need this quick! Hurry up!!

_432.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_432.Description: Kekeke... At last! Is it done!? I need to test it quickly. Aren't you happy?? Handle it cautiously. This is the only one we have... Use it to defeat Garudamon and Metal Greymon and bring me 5 DATA for my research !! Hurry up!! ?
