_432.Objective: Acquire 5 Eveling Research DATA and bring them to Akihiro Kurata
_432.CompletionText: What are you doing? Hurry up!
_432.CompletionSummary: What horrible handwriting... It's gibberish! Goodness... Even a four-year-old could write better than this...

_433.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_433.Description: Finally completed!! Kekeke... I'm a genius! I'm a genius!! Done. Now bring this Eveling to Leomon (Head). Leomon (Head) should be somewhere in Ruined Historic. This is their hideout...
_433.CompletionText: Kekeke... It is my turn to attack!!
_433.CompletionSummary: Long time no see. It's the human kid... What!! ( As soon as Leomon finished talking, @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> attacked Leomon)

_434.Title: Digital World_Ruined Historic
_434.Description: You silly humans... You humans are nothing in this Digital World... And you are foolish enough to come to the Digital World... Leomon was my best warrior. I will torture you twice as much as you tortured Leomon!! Tell your boss!! The world you live in won't be safe any more!!
_434.CompletionText: The world you live in won't be safe any more!!
_434.CompletionSummary: Kekeke... You heard me... loud and clear. This is @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc> I created!!

_435.Title: Dats Center
_435.Description: Kekeke... Farewell. I am sick and tired of Digital World! I've got all the data. Why don't you go back first to report this happy news to Director Hashima. Kekeke...
_435.Objective: Report to Director Hashima in Dats Center
_435.CompletionText: Kekekeke... Horrible @<tc:800>Digital World@</tc>! This is farewell then!
_435.CompletionSummary: This is Akihiro Kurata's report I have been waiting. Excellent! Impressive...!

_436.Title: Event
_436.Description: Hohoho. Are you doing well without catching a cold in this freezing winter? I bet you'll have many good events this winter if you are with Digimon Masters this winter. It is a fortune that we've met, so I'll give you a present!
_436.CompletionSummary: My presents for you is Christmas Cards! The more luck you'll gain as you have more cards! Are you willing to collect them?

_437.Title: Event
_437.Description: My request is quite simple. Pinocchimon is making clones of himself and spreading them all over the places. He seems to think it is a joke, but I personally don't like it. If you defeat his clones and return to me, I'll reward you.
_437.CompletionText: Have you taken care of Pinocchimon's clones?
_437.CompletionSummary: You've done well, haha. This is the reward as promised.

_438.Title: Event
_438.Description: Now this time, shall I propose a more difficult request? You may think it's annoying and difficult, but there is no glory without taking risk. At this time, defeat Gazimon from all over the area. A lot of them. It looks like someone is playing tricks on them and I wish to find out.
_438.CompletionText: It's not enough. Please take care of the rest of Gazimons.
_438.CompletionSummary: You've done well, haha. This is the reward as promised.

_439.Title: Event
_439.Description: What would you choose to be from good and evil? If you wish to choose the good side, you can do it by completing conversation with me. Then you can carry out mission with me during the event term. Once you choose the good side, Millenniummon on the other side will leave this area, so please make a wise decision.
_439.CompletionText: If you complete this quest, Millenniummon on the other side will leave.
_439.CompletionSummary: You've made a great choice. Now, you'll be able to receive missions from me daily.
_439.ReservedText: If you complete this quest, Millenniummon on the other side will leave.

_440.Title: Event
_440.Description: As you have joined the good side, you have the task to defeat the monsters of evil with us. Please take care of Dark Tyrannomons and Deltamons all over the areas.
_440.CompletionText: Have you done with dealing Dark Tyrannomons and Deltamons?
_440.CompletionSummary: You've done a good job. Please take the rewards now.

_441.Title: Event
_441.Description: What will you decide to be? The good or the evil? If you wish to be the evil, you will have to complete the conversation with me. Then you'll receive the mission from me during the event. As you choose to stay here, the Alphamon Burst Mode will be leaving this place, so choose wisely.
_441.CompletionText: Complete this quest and that Alphamon Burst Mode in the other side will vanish.
_441.CompletionSummary: Mwahaha. So you're more attracted to the dark side? From now, you'll take missions from me daily.
_441.ReservedText: Complete this quest and that Alphamon Burst Mode in the other side will vanish.

_442.Title: Event
_442.Description: As you have joined the evil side, you'll help us get rid of the hypocrites. Defeat Raptordramons and Ginryumons from all areas.
_442.CompletionText: Have you finished with the Raptordramons and Ginryumons?
_442.CompletionSummary: Mwahaha! You're better than I expected. Take the rewards.

_443.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_443.Description: It has been reported that frequent earthquakes on Wood Bench Trail of Yokohama are scaring the villagers. It also has been reported that Drimogemon caused the earthquake. The ground must have been softened due to Drimogemon who likes to dig underground. Hurry and prevent the ground from collapsing.
_443.CompletionText: Many houses around Wood Bench Trail will collapse at any moment.
_443.CompletionSummary: Good job... But it is too early to say it's okay.

_444.Title: Yokohama_Village
_444.Summary: We are ready for the match!!
_444.Description: Hahahaha... He shouldn't have to worry about it... Of course, I worry about Minnie, but I have to win this match for Minnie... Tell him that we are doing our training as scheduled..
_444.Objective: Deliver the message of Hayase Harris to the Village Chief in Yokohama Village
_444.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with the Village Chief in Yokohama Village
_444.CompletionText: This time, the enemy is strong. But we can't afford to lose!! even for Minnie...
_444.CompletionSummary: You are the future champion!! I shouldn't have been worried about you...

_445.Title: Yokohama Village
_445.Description: Can you hear me? It's Richard Sampson. From now on, I will give you orders through the Digivice whenever an emergency situation arises. The tasks you receive through the Digivice are very important. So be very careful not to miss them. Mutant Digimon are emerging in Yokohama Park. Mutant Digimon are very aggressive. They are stronger than normal Digimon. According to the report, those mutant Digimon consist of Koromon, Upamon and Tsunomon. Go to Yokohama Park immediately and suppress them. They are highly intelligent mutant. Finding them won't be easy. According to the report... Koromon (Mutant) was seen in the front yard of Small Forest Park, Upamon (Mutant) in Small Forest Park, and Tsunomon (Mutant) on Wood Bench Trail where Kunemon stays.
_445.CompletionText: They are highly intelligent mutants. Finding them won't be easy. Stay low. You will soon find them...
_445.CompletionSummary: You've successfully accomplished your first mission, suppressing @<tc:800>Mutant@</tc> Digimon. Well done.

_446.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_446.Description: I heard Director dispatched an agent to support my research. I am disappointed that it was you. Is this the best Dats Center could do? Or don't they understand how important my research is? Well...Forget about it! As my research is a far more important matter, I have no choice but to use you. As you can see, we have poor research conditions. It's hot during the day and freezing at night. Since we are located at quite a distance from Dats Center, their support is minimal. I wish we had something to strike up a fire. And I can't go fetch fire logs myself, can I? That's a job for a foolish guy like you. Go straight south, and you will find Woodmon. Take some bark from him. What?! That isn't cruel. They are not living beings... Don't forget that you are in the Digital World where everything is made with data. Even you are made with data for the duration of your stay. We just need some wood data in order to activate fire data. That's all.
_446.Objective: Get 5 pieces of bark from Woodmon
_446.CompletionText: Why are you standing there!!! Hurry up and fetch some bark!!!
_446.CompletionSummary: How slow you are. Now I understand why Richard Sampson is always in a sour mood.

_447.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_447.Description: Be aware of your duty to me as a Dats Agent. What?! Kekeke... I am not talking about all those bullshit. As a Dats Agent, all you have to do is obey me. Kekeke... Go straight south, and you will find Togemon. That Digimon makes needles inside its body and shoots them at its enemies. I need to analyze what is that made of. !? What are you waiting for!? That should be enough information by now!? Go and get Togemon's needle for me!!
_447.CompletionText: What a sluggish boy. Do I have to explain every single detail?
_447.CompletionSummary: Kekeke... Don't expect any congratulations from me. That word is not in my dictionary. Keke...

_448.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_448.Description: Wow... These substances are more delicate than I though. If I don't handle them properly, they will blow my hands off... I think I need an antidote. Starmon of Passion in Western Village is supposed to help us. Tell the Digimon that we need an antidote.
_448.CompletionText: I tell you all the time. Move, move!!
_448.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Antidote@</tc>? Well... We don't have an antidote now. I don't see it on the supplies list. You humans always ask for strange stuff... Shoot.

_449.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_449.Description: Why don't you ask the wandering merchant, Chuchidarumon. The Digimon might have what you need...But the recent rampage of Digimon has cut off supplies to the village... So I can't guarantee it.
_449.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with Chuchidarumon in Western Village
_449.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Antidote@</tc>? Another human asking for strange stuff... All the supplies have been cut off, so an antidote will be hard to find. If you stop the rampaging Digimon, I will get it for you.

_450.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_450.Description: I believe the order list of supplies from Western Village has not been delivered to the suppliers. I think rampaging Impmon and Digimon took the list. I want you to bring the list from them.
_450.CompletionText: The list of supplies is very important. If the suppliers don't receive the list, they won't send us supplies
_450.CompletionSummary: Good job. No wonder supplies were cut off because the list wasn't delivered to them...

_451.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_451.Description: We must find out what's going on. If you follow the road north of Western Village, you will see a shrine. The passage to Western Village Outer Area : is east of the shrine. Go and check what is happening there.
_451.Objective: Checking the passage to Western Village Outer Area
_451.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Checking the passage to Western Village Outer Area%qe %cc1/%mc1
_451.CompletionText: North of Western Village. It's east of the shrine!
_451.CompletionSummary: Good job. Now that we know what is happening there, I must ask you to deal with it...

_452.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_452.Description: I heard rampaging Digimon attacked the delivery trucks on the road. We are afraid that they might cut off our food supplies What is that look? What? Didn't you know Digimon need to eat? I will answer you by asking this. Does a human have to eat in order to survive? Digimon also need to eat for energy reserves. Whether that is DATA or anything else. The rampaging Digimon took our food baggage away. I want you to bring it back.
_452.CompletionText: We won't last more than couple days with our food stocks.
_452.CompletionSummary: Thank you. It's not that bad to be helped by humans.

_453.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_453.Description: Don't you look down on me because I am a young Chuchidarumon. I am as just as smart as Impmon around here. But recently I've had a problem. Well, I haven't received the machine the Uncle Chuchidarumon ordered. This machine tests stability of molecule conformation, energy difference between molecule conformations and potential energy that operates between atoms. You don't know what I am talking about... Simply put, it is a spring. I need that spring. Can you get it for me? Based on my quantitative measures and analysis, I think Impmon took it.
_453.CompletionText: If I had the @<tc:800>spring@</tc>, I would be testing all of it now.
_453.CompletionSummary: Wow, thank you... Was my calculation right? Impmon had it?

_454.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_454.Summary: Signal to update list of supplies
_454.Description: Finally we have found the entire supply list. I just updated the list of supplies. I added the antidote you asked... Now take these signal flares. Go to the Western Village Outer Area: and use it on the passage.
_454.Objective: Use signal flares at the passage to the Western Village Outer Area
_454.CompletionText: By the time you come back, the supplies will be here.
_454.CompletionSummary: Good job. The supplies are here. What is that suspicious look? It's okay. Everything is here now.

_455.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_455.Description: Here. The supplies are here. Is this what you want? Poison Antidote. Didn't you tell me the person who wanted this is a researcher on poisonous material? This will neutralize the poison...But what on earth could he be researching? Well, that's none of my business...
_455.Objective: Let's go back to Akihiro Kurata
_455.CompletionText: Don't you think we should go?
_455.CompletionSummary: You came later than I expected. Well, thanks for reminding me again of how useless you are... Shoot...

_456.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_456.Description: Didn't you learn anything from the incident!? Humans are the source of all problems. Yes, I am talking about you. Don't you think you are responsible for all this? You have to help us to fight them. I can't do this alone... Bring 5 of those mysterious objects from them.
_456.CompletionText: We have no time to waste.
_456.CompletionSummary: Ha! I don't want to say thank you... Well, it was an easy job...

_457.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_457.Description: We should start searching from here. I know a good spot. Sand fall Gloomy Area. Central Passage. I want you to search Leomon's Nest. I hope we find something.
_457.Objective: Thoroughly search the Western Village Outer Area
_457.CompletionSummary: You couldn't find a trace of it? That's no good... Are you are saying that it couldn't make it here after it was attacked?

_458.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_458.Summary: What does a strong weapon need?
_458.Description: What does a strong weapon need? High power? Resistance against any shock? Kekeke... I shouldn't have asked. What would you know!? Kekeke... I do silly stuff from time to time. Keke... Flymon might be the answer. Bring me 5 wings of Flymon...
_458.Objective: What does a strong weapon need?
_458.CompletionText: If I were you, I wouldn't still be standing there. Do you understand what I mean? Get out of here!
_458.CompletionSummary: Power and resistance... Yes, they are important.. But strong weapons must be easy to maneuver.

_459.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_459.Description: No... No.. Something is missing here. I have collected various experimental materials... Hmm... That's right!! Birdramon's body is made of flame. Isn't that strange? How could that be? There must be a secret. Huh? What are you doing? You have to move quickly!!! Bring me 8 samples of Birdramon! Quickly!!
_459.CompletionSummary: Ha! There's nothing special about these samples at all...

_460.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_460.Description: I am going to ask my old friend (Head) Leomon for help Would you deliver this letter to Leomon? You will find Leomon if you go South from here.
_460.CompletionText: (Head) Leomon is a very righteous Digimon. It will help me.

_461.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_461.Description: Hmm... I recently saw some Leomon wandering around here. I have a bad feeling about this for some reason. It is clear they are here to interrupt my research. Preemptive attack is basic principle the basic principle of battle.. Kekeke... Show them who you are, so that they won't come again!! Defeating 5 Leomon will do. ?
_461.CompletionText: Leomon is a highly intelligent and seasoned warrior. So you'd better be careful.
_461.CompletionSummary: Just follow my command. And don't do any thinking! That's my job!! Remember that!

_462.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_462.Description: Hi? Long time no see. Human children... I am wandering merchant, Chuchidarumon. I got stuck here on my way back home, to the Western Village because of the rampaging Digimon Could you check the central passage for me and come back with a report?
_462.Objective: Checking the central passage of Western Village Outer Area
_462.CompletionText: I got stuck like this with my hometown right in front of me...
_462.CompletionSummary: I see, things are not going so well. Do you think I can go through the passage by myself?

_463.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_463.Summary: Digimon That Have Lost All Reason...
_463.Description: As an old friend, I want to do this for you, but I can't help you now, as you can see. Because of ever-emerging Digimon, I can't leave this place. I want you to do it for me. Digimon Leaders are usually the ones who worsen the situation... If you can defeat the leader, this area will be peaceful again. ?
_463.Objective: Digimon That Have Lost All Reason...
_463.CompletionText: This area is not safe anymore...
_463.CompletionSummary: Impressive skills... Please use them for a good cause.

_464.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_464.Description: Bring me whatever traces you can find in order to find out where PawnChessmonBlack is. I want to learn something from Monster Digimon in Western Village Outer Area...
_464.CompletionText: I hope they find some traces...
_464.CompletionSummary: What's this? Emblem which proves that the bearer of it is @<tc:800>Dats Agent@</tc>?

_465.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_465.Description: My intuition told me that something happened to the Digimon during this whole period. As you can see, mutant Digimon only listen to their instincts as their consciousness has been totally destroyed. There is no way to turn them back to normal. It is sad that they have to live only with their instincts. Someone must rescue them from such madness. For the mutant Digimon and for those who were left behind... Take care of all the Digimon in front of you.
_465.CompletionText: I am counting on you. I know you can do it...
_465.CompletionSummary: It's sad... But please understand that we are doing it for their own good.

_466.Title: Yokohama Park
_466.Description: So you understood all the basics, right? If you discover a cracked DigiEgg while you're hunting, that is the DigiEgg for you to return and get refunded. You can get them from most Monster Digimon. If you bring them to Miki Kurosaki, Dats Agent, then she will pay you for returning it. Now, go to Yokohama Park and bring me 3 DigiEggs to return. Since it is your first attempt, you can get them from Koromon.
_466.CompletionSummary: Wow, amazing. Good job. I am going to give you back the @<tc:800>Cracked DigiEgg@</tc> you brought in... Try @<tc:800>returning@</tc> by yourself will be a good experience for you.

_467.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_467.Description: I just realized that certain Digimon are in mutant stage now. Very interesting. We should confirm whether they will evolve to another form or they are undergoing simple mutation. Bring me 5 mutant samples from Monster Digimon in Western Village Outer Area.
_467.CompletionText: I need more mutant samples. Move, move~!
_467.CompletionSummary: Keke... Very interesting samples. Well, shall we proceed!?

_468.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_468.Description: I was attacked by some strange stuff on the way to here. It is called RedVegiemon. That Plant type Digimon attacked me. They are useless even for my research. Get rid of them all!! 8 RedVegiemon! Got it?
_468.CompletionText: I hope I don't see them again in this area.
_468.CompletionSummary: They are useless even for my research!! Let them realize what happens if they attack me.

_469.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_469.Description: Lots of my colleagues were wounded by the rampaging Digimon. Unless we treat them soon, they could lose their lives. Looks like the leader also took their Healing Medicine. I want you to take 5 medicines from them. You can see them in Western Village Outer Area
_469.CompletionText: Healing Medicine for Digimon is unique. It is ineffective for humans.
_469.CompletionSummary: I thank you on behalf of my colleagues... I would like to give you Leomon's pants as a token of our gratitude... To cure your wound, you need to pull down your pants... Well... Take it anyway. Thank you.

_470.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_470.Summary: Comparing the traces! Akihiro Kurata is a suspect
_470.Description: I checked the mark you bought me and found out it was scratched with a sharp object. I will give you a copy that shows the traces so that you can compare it with others. Please use it to find out who did this. You can use it against anyone you suspect. Akihiro Kurata is right beside you. so you should compare them. ? Select Akihiro Kurata and compare the traces of sharp objects with him.
_470.Objective: Compare the traces of sharp objects with Akihiro Kurata
_470.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Comparison of Sharp Object Traces Akihiro Kurata%qe %cc1/%mc1
_470.CompletionText: Akihiro Kurata is a member of Dats Center, so he wouldn't be our guy. But as we all know, he hates Digimon...
_470.CompletionSummary: That make sense. It was not Akihiro Kurata.
_470.ReservedText: What are you doing?? Are you nuts? Human finger nails aren't that sharp!!

_471.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_471.Summary: Comparing the traces! Chuchidarumon is the culprit
_471.Description:
Chuchidarumon is basically a peaceful Digimon. But we need to compare everything to come up with evidence. I will compare the traces of sharp objects with Chuchidarumon...
Select Chuchidarumon then use the traces of sharp objects.
_471.Objective: Compare the trace of sharp object to the Chuchidarumon
_471.CompletionText: I hope we can find some evidence...
_471.ReservedText: What!? Hahaha... It's not me. I have nothing sharp with me.

_472.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_472.Description: We have to compare the traces with all the Digimon in this area. I will give you couple traces of sharp objects... Go and compare it with all Leader Digimon in this area. They are Kiwimon (Leader), RedVegiemon (Leader), Flymon (Leader). and Birdramon (Leader). This is very important... I am counting on you. ? You can't compare evidence during battle, so be careful.
_472.Objective: Compare the traces of sharp object to Digimon in the Western Village Outer Area
_472.CompletionText: If there is a Digimon who perfectly matches traces, it is likely to know PawnChessmonBlack's whereabouts.
_472.CompletionSummary: What!? There's no Digimon that matches the traces!?

_473.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_473.Description: I heard the chief of Western Area is Starmon of Passion. We should ask for his help. Please ask Starmon for help with this.
_473.CompletionText: Starmon of Passion in Western Area will know a lot.

_474.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_474.Description: This belongs to Leomon. I am positive. But based on what you told me, it sounds like your colleague was attacked by Leomon. From what i know, Leomon are not troublemakers. You'd better bring it to (Head) Leomon. There must be a reason.
_474.CompletionText: Rest assured. They don't attack humans without reason...
_474.CompletionSummary: That make sense. I remember this wound. I inflicted it...

_475.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_475.Description: Yes, I inflicted this wound. But I want to make myself clear. I didn't attack first. He attacked me first. He was just like the rampaging Digimon that recently emerged here. As you can see, Digimon have become very aggressive recently/ This place is no longer a peaceful area. I am investigating the incidents by myself. If humans are involved in the recent incidents, they must pay the penalty. And I don't know how this came to be here. It was East of the Western Area where he fought with it : not Western Village. If you are looking for him, you'd better go there. I am sure he is still alive...
_475.CompletionText: So you feel Digimon are your colleagues. Well, I think we can arrive at a good understanding.
_475.CompletionSummary: What!? Western Village: East!? You have to go North to go Western Village: East.

_476.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_476.Summary: The more research materials, the better...
_476.Description: Kekeke... What interesting samples. They will be very helpful in my research. If you have mutant samples, bring them anytime... Defeat any Digimon in Western Village Outer Area... I think they have samples...
_476.Objective: The more research materials I have, the better...
_476.CompletionText: Did you bring more mutant samples?

_477.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_477.Description: Thank you for helping my old friend for me. Please pass this message to my friend. But be careful. Defeating leaders only bring temporary peace. They are not permanent measures...
_477.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with Chuchidarumon in the Western Village Outer Area
_477.CompletionText: Please pass this message to my friend before the rampaging Digimon attack the central passage.
_477.CompletionSummary: I see... Thank you. It seems to be very strong despite its appearance. I'd better be ready to go.

_478.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_478.Description: I am going to go East of : the Western Village. As soon as you finish your job here, join me.
_478.CompletionText: At least it was good news. He may be alive. We can find him soon.

_479.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_479.Description: A Dobermon is covered with very sharp fangs all over the body. You must avoid the fangs at all costs, or you'll be torn apart. I need those fangs. They fascinate me greatly. Of course, you'll have to take some risks in order to get them. Well, I think you can do it. Because it doesn't matter if you die while getting them...Kekeke... Bring me 5 fangs from Dobermon. They will be good research materials.
_479.CompletionText: Be careful. Dobermon is very fast.

_480.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_480.Summary: This area is also a mess.
_480.Description: We are checking the area destroyed by rampaging Digimon. It looks like supply delivery trucks heading to Western Village were attacked. I think they were attacked quite recently. From the traces left on the trucks, I am sure it was done by Dobermon. The security of Western Village is in danger, if we let them attack the trucks. I want you to take care of 10 Dobermon...
_480.Objective: This area is also a mess.
_480.CompletionText: I hope there won't be any more attacks on supplies...
_480.CompletionSummary: Good job. I hope there won't be any more attacks on supplies...

_481.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_481.Description: I noticed something strange while recovering supplies... I don't think the trucks were attacked by the rampaging Digimon... If you notice anything strange while recovering supplies, let me know. ? I think I can find some evidence from the Digimon near the attacked Supply Box.
_481.CompletionText: Hmm... It was a deliberate attack.
_481.CompletionSummary: I was right. This what I thought... Someone deliberately broke the supply box and took everything inside!!

_482.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_482.Description: The trucks on the way to Western Village were attacked. All supplies were scattered around. I want you to recover lost supplies from Digimon around here. It would be great if you could recover as many as you can. Please recover 8 supplies...
_482.CompletionText: Recover as many as you can. This is for the security of Western Village.
_482.CompletionSummary: Wow, you recovered them all? Good job.

_483.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_483.Description: Now we don't have to worry about Dobermon anymore... But there are too many rampaging Digimon here. And we have to guard the delivery route to secure supplies. That's right. Greymon of Justice is here somewhere. One of the few Digimon who would cooperate with us. We should ask his help. You can find him if you follow the road south.
_483.CompletionText: Other Greymon are already rampaging. I hope he is okay...
_483.CompletionSummary: It has been such a long time since a human sought me out from the Digital World...

_484.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_484.Description: Those sticky Leomon keep threatening me. Who do you think is responsible for all this? It is you!! What are you looking at!! If you did your job properly, those Leomon wouldn't threaten us!! This is no good! I can't trust you anymore. Get me the items on that list from Chuchidarumon!
_484.CompletionText: I don't want to ask Digimon, but you are different...Kekeke...
_484.CompletionSummary: Huh? I don't want to help despicable humans, but since it is you that is asking, I will...

_485.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_485.Description: Strange humans are asking strange stuff. I carry almost everything, but even I never heard of it. On top of that, we don't get supplies very often now, so it would be faster for you to find it yourself. Go down to South and you will find the crime scene where the trucks were attacked. Look for Digimon around there. Starmon of Passion who is in charge of the crime scene will tell you details
_485.CompletionText: Due to rampaging Digimon, everything became scarce...
_485.CompletionSummary: Huh? You came to buy something??

_486.Title: Yokohama Village
_486.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Go to Yokohama Park and defeat DemiMeramon. DemiMeramon is in small residential area now. If it explode the gas tanks there will be a chaos Bring me 5 DemiMeramon and 5 indistinguishable flame before it become chaos! DemiMeramon must be in Small Forest Park.
_486.CompletionText: We have to prevent it before it gets worse. That's the responsibility of Dats Agent.
_486.CompletionSummary: Job well done. Well done. I will give you @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>. Use it wisely...

_487.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_487.Description: We need something that blow them away at once. Kekekeke... Something that stimulate them. That's it... Blood!! Blood will do. Get me some blood of Leomon now.
_487.CompletionText: We can stimulate them with blood...

_488.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_488.Description: Now that I see all the ingredients on the list, the doctor intends to make a bomb. But what for? Well. I want to help you, but I can't do it now. As you can see, I couldn't recover anything from the trucks. You can take some from Deputymon. I mean black powder...
_488.CompletionText: What is that strange doctor up to?
_488.CompletionSummary: You are late. I don't want to comment your work, but you are always late.

_489.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_489.Description: Kekeke... Good. It will do. Well, shall we install the trap!? Go to Leomon's invasion route and nest. Dig a deep hole on the ground. Spray some blood and come back. Go to West direction. You will find Leomon's invasion route. Leomon's nest is Southeast from here!
_489.Objective: Use shovel and Leomon's blood on Leomon's invasion route and their nest
_489.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Digging Leomon's Nest%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Installing Trap Leomon's Nest%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Digging Leomon's Invasion Route%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Installing Trap Leomon's Invasion Route%qe %cc4/%mc4
_489.CompletionSummary: Good. It's time to use black powder...Kekekeke What is that look? It was a perfect job for you, don't you think so? Digging!!

_490.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_490.Description: Kekeke... I will give you the bomb I built. It is much more powerful one than normal bomb. Install them in their invasion route and nest. We also need to get rid of any witnesses...
_490.Objective: Defeat 10 Leomon and Leomon (Leader) and install bombs in their invasion route and nest.
_490.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeated Leomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeated Leomon (Leader)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Installed Bomb in Leomon's Nest%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Installed Bomb in Leomon's Invasion Route%qe %cc4/%mc4
_490.CompletionText: Let's blow those sticky Leomon away!! Kekeke!
_490.CompletionSummary: Thanks to them, we can enjoy fancy fireworks. Now I can focus on my research...

_491.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_491.Description: This is PawnChessmonWhite! We found a trace of furious fight. I think it is the place Leomon referred to. Do you think there is any witness?
_491.CompletionText: Let's ask Devil Impmon around here.
_491.CompletionSummary: Huh? Did I see those @<tc:800>Digimon@</tc> who fought here? Of course I saw them. That one was brave enough to challenge Leomon. He flew away to Wilderness Area.

_492.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_492.Description: Do you hear me? This is PawnChessmonWhite! The connection of Digivice is not stable. According to Devil Impmon, PawnChessmonBlack went to Wilderness Area. We'd better search the area. You have to go further to reach : Western Area East Area. Please search the area for me. But be careful. The area has not been cleared yet.
_492.CompletionText: You have to further to reach Western Village East Area

_493.Title: Dats Center
_493.Description: This is Richard Sampson! Now you are doing your job properly. You became an official agent. Come and see me.
_493.CompletionSummary: From now on, you are an official agent of Dats Center. You can teleport to Digital World through D-terminal now. Do your job well. Ah! Here is present for you. It's Kunemon's DigiEgg. You can either raise it here or go to Digital World. That's all.

_494.Title: Yokohama_Village
_494.Summary: I will tell you about Digivice.
_494.Description: Hahaha... I am Homer Yushima... So you got the Digivice. Come to see me. I will explain what Digivice is. I am in Yokohama Village. You can easily find me...
_494.Objective: Find Homer Yushima in Yokohama Village
_494.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc> basically consists of @<tc:800>Mercenary Digimon Slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Tamer Skill Slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>ChipSet Slot@</tc>. You can bring Mercenary Digimon as many as your @<tc:800>Mercenary Digimon Slot@</tc> allows. @<tc:800>Tamer

_495.Title: Yokohama_Small Forest Park
_495.Description:
This is Richard Sampson. Go to Yokohama Park immediately and defeat DemiMeramon. DemiMeramon is in small residential area now. If it explode the gas tanks there will be a chaos. Bring me 5 DemiMeramon and 5 indistinguishable flame before it become chaos!
DemiMeramon must be in Small Forest Park.
_495.CompletionText: We have to prevent it before it gets worse. That's the responsibility of Dats Agent.
_495.CompletionSummary: Job well done. Well done. I will give you a @<tc:800>ChipSet@</tc>. Use it wisely...

_496.Title: Yokohama_Small Forest Park
_496.Description:
This is Richard Sampson. Go to Yokohama Park immediately and defeat DemiMeramon. DemiMeramon is in small residential area now. If it explode the gas tanks there will be a chaos. Bring me 5 DemiMeramon and 5 indistinguishable flame before it become chaos!
DemiMeramon must be in Small Forest Park.
_496.CompletionText: We have to prevent it before it gets worse. That's the responsibility of Dats Agent.
_496.CompletionSummary: Job well done. Well done. I will give you a @<tc:800>ChipSet@</tc>. Use it wisely...

_497.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_497.Description: We are investigating the source of risky factors. We still have to suppress the rampaging Digimon. As you all know, this is strategically very important point. If anything goes wrong, we can never return to Real World. Woodmon (Leader). Togemon (Leader). Impmon (Leader). Digimon (Leader). Defeat 5 of each to secure safety of this area.
_497.CompletionText: You have to push hard to continuing threats.
_497.CompletionSummary: Good job. I might need your help later...

_498.Title: Digital World_Western Village
_498.Description: We could receive supplies without being attacked by rampaging Digimon from now on. But it is equally important to recover what has been stolen. I want you to recover 3 supplies from Digimon in Western Village. How was it?
_498.Objective: Recover 3 supplies from Digimon in Western Village
_498.CompletionText: What a loss... I will be bankrupt sooner or later...
_498.CompletionSummary: Well... I see. Thank you. There are more to recover. I will ask your help again.

_499.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_499.Description: Investigation of mysterious hook is another matter. We can't neglect this incident. Defeat all rampaging Digimon around here and bring me 3 suspicious items.
_499.CompletionText: If we don't settle this incident, Western Village will be in danger.
_499.CompletionSummary: Good job. But I have piles of stuff to finish...

_500.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_500.Description: Sadly... some Leomon turned to mutant. Among all Digimon, we are a honorable race. Living disgraceful life is worse than dying honorably. Please rescue them for us. Take care of all mutant Leomon in front of you...
_500.CompletionText: They must not survive. They are disgraceful Leomon.
_500.CompletionSummary: Don't waste your sympathy on those who loses pride. They are loser of their own pride.

_501.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_501.Description: Those Leomon will never give up. They will do anything to interrupt my research... You should know how important my research is. Defeat any Leomon you can find!!
_501.Objective: They will never give up[Repeated Daily]
_501.CompletionText: Ha! They are just Digimon... Pride? No kidding!!
_501.CompletionSummary: Kekeke... You should be thankful that I've found the a way your pathetic talents can be of any use.

_502.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_502.Description: Although you recovered lots of supplies, we still have to recover more for Western Village. I want you to recover supplies to keep Western Village safe. Defeat enemy Digimon in Western Village and bring supplies!
_502.Objective: Recover 3 supplies from Digimon in Western Village
_502.CompletionText: Don't forget that your contribution is greatly improve security of Western Village.
_502.CompletionSummary: Thank you... If you recover more supplies from now on, please bring them to me.

_503.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_503.Description: I am sorry... As you can see, I can't help you now. Except me, all Greymon turned to rampaging Digimon. I want to suppress them, but it was not easy. I need your help to suppress them. Can you suppress them for me?
_503.CompletionText: Now this place became a mess.
_503.CompletionSummary: Thank you... I won't forget what you did for me.

_504.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_504.Description: I hear someone crying from distance... It must be Dobermon. I am not a coward, but I couldn't sleep because that crying is horrifying. What? Does Digimon sleep too? Are you kidding me...? If you think my request is sincere, please do me a favor. I want you to take care of 10 Dobermon.
_504.CompletionText: Do you hear that? That's the sound... It really annoys me...
_504.CompletionSummary: I think I can still hear the sound in my head. What? Don't you look at me like that. I am telling you again. I am not a coward...

_505.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_505.Description: There are very vicious Digimon in this area. Even before the outbreak of rampaging Digimon, it was well known for atrocity. That Digimon usually shows up in group and did all kinds of evildoing... You look quite strong. Can you take care of that Digimon? Please take care of 5 Deputymon and Deputymon (Leader)...
_505.CompletionText: Those Digimon had done evildoings so far...
_505.CompletionSummary: Wow, you are really strong. Even Starmon of Passion couldn't suppress them!!

_506.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_506.Description: If you keep going further, you will find a hideout where my friend stays. I hope he is okay. Can you check it for me?
_506.Objective: I hope my friend is fine.
_506.CompletionText: My friend lost his memory long time ago... Poor guy.
_506.CompletionSummary: What!? He was not there? Where did he go? Do you think he was attacked by the rampaging Digimon?

_507.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_507.Description: I wouldn't worry about this place only if it is peaceful as it had been... That worries me... Yukidarumon is my friend. I heard he lost his memory due to a tragic accident in the past. He goes to Wilderness Area to get some herbs from time to time. Can you look for my friend there?
_507.CompletionText: Wilderness Area is much more dangerous than here. You'd better be ready.
_507.CompletionSummary: Human? So you are human. Greymon of Justice asked you to do it? What a nice Digimon. Greymon of Justice is...

_508.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_508.Description: There is a troublemaker in here. Wanted Deputymon is the one. They usually come in groups and attacked supplies trucks. I think the Wanted Deputymon is responsible for this, not rampaging Digimon. There are Deputymon's nest around here. Why don't you go and check it.
_508.CompletionText: There must be Deputymon's nest around here.
_508.ReservedText: Ha! No kidding... Do you think I would let you arrest me!! Well, I did that. We help each other, doesn't it!?

_509.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_509.Description: As I expected, it was Deputymon How could they take advantage of this chaotic situation to commit crime? I can't let it happen! Please take care of them to ensure safety of Western Village... Defeat 5 Deputymon and Deputymon (Leader). Wanted Deputymon will be embarrassed if all of his subordinates were defeated.
_509.CompletionText: Teach them a bitter lesson so that they realized how stupid they were.
_509.CompletionSummary: Good job. And now, it's Wanted Deputymon's turn?

_510.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_510.Description: Keke... Are you going to make fun of Deputymon? I have perfect stuff for that purpose. Use this against Deputymon (Leader). Horrible stench will definitely last for a whole week. Kekeke...
_510.CompletionText: I never liked them. I am different! Those low class bastards should be punished... Kekeke...
_510.CompletionSummary: Kekekeke... That's bad. I should have seen Deputymon suffering with stench bomb. Kekeke...

_511.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_511.Description: What should I choose...? Right! Kekeke... That should do it... RedVegiemon is around here. As you know, they are smelly Digimon. I want you to bring some smelly stuff from them. Why do I need it? None of your business! You can find offensive looking leaf from RedVegiemon. Bring 5 of them to me.
_511.CompletionText: You can find @<tc:800>offensive looking leaf@</tc> from RedVegiemon. Bring 5 of them to me.
_511.CompletionSummary: It is indeed offensive looking stuff...Kekeke...

_512.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_512.Description: I think I just unnecessarily made Greymon of Justice worry. I am cultivating herbs which is good for healing wound. Unlike other areas, soils in Wilderness Area are very good... You know, recently Piyomon came to my fields and ruined my herbs... I don't want to harm any Piyomon, but if I let them do it again, my herbs are all ruined. Can you bring back my herbs from Piyomon?
_512.CompletionText: I lost my memory long time ago. Somehow humans are familiar to me. I wonder why?
_512.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I believe this herbs would cure the rampaging Digimon.

_513.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_513.Description: I lost lots of my colleagues : in Western Area East Area. I managed to escape to here, but I couldn't move anymore. I have to let (Head) Leomon and Ruler SaberLeomon in Western Area know I am here. (Head) Leomon will be in Wilderness Area now. I must let (Head) Leomon know that I am here...
_513.CompletionText: I wonder how many of them survived the battle...
_513.CompletionSummary: I see... They are all gone?

_514.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_514.Description: I think I just unnecessarily made Greymon of Justice worry. I am cultivating herbs which is good for healing wound. Unlike other areas, soils in Wilderness Area are very good... You know, recently Piyomon came to my fields and ruined my herbs... I don't want to harm any Piyomon, but if I let them do it again, my herbs are all ruined. Can you bring back my herbs from Piyomon?
_514.CompletionText: I lost my memory long time ago. Somehow humans are familiar to me. I wonder why?
_514.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I believe this herbs would cure the rampaging Digimon.

_515.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_515.Description: Cheep, cheep... Annoying!! I am talking about Piyomon. I don't like Piyomon. The way it pretend to be cute. If you need my help, do something about the noise!!
_515.CompletionText: Cheep, cheep... Showing off how cute it is... I don't like it!
_515.CompletionSummary: Me too... Huh? You don't like it too? You are first human I like...

_516.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_516.Description: Hmm... What a grief. It all happened because of me. I should warn him when he decided to attack the human doctor.. We lost so many colleagues... Please tell my colleagues, (Injured) LeomonA, (Injured) LeomonB, (Injured) LeomonC, (Injured) and LeomonD who came to find me in Wilderness Area that I am fine.
_516.CompletionText: You are not free as long as you are the one who are involved in this...
_516.CompletionSummary: Well done... We need to do something for them.
_516.ReservedText: Is that so? So the leader is okay... Good to hear that... Cough...

_517.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_517.Description: Water... I need water... I feel sorry for Piyomon, but could you get their feathers and soak them with lake water at Wilderness Area then bring them to me? You should use the feather at the lake in Wilderness Area.
_517.Objective: Use the feather at the lake in Wilderness Area
_517.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use the feather at the lake in Wilderness Area%qe %cc1/%mc1
_517.CompletionSummary: You got the feather of Piyomon.

_518.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_518.Description: The feathers are fully soaked with lake water at Wilderness Area. Let's bring it to (Injured) LeomonA before it dries up.
_518.CompletionText: The feathers are fully soaked with lake water at Wilderness Area. Let's bring it to (Injured) LeomonA before it dries up.
_518.CompletionSummary: Thank you... It was the most delicious water I have ever tasted...
_518.ReservedText: Thank you very much... I really appreciate your help. What a nice human...

_519.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_519.Description: Is Boarmon preying on me now? Ha... You look horrible. If I were not injured, I wouldn't let those Digimon to threaten me... Take care of them, if you want to help me...
_519.CompletionText: I should have listened to leader's warning...
_519.CompletionSummary: Injured by humans and cured by humans... How irony..

_520.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_520.Description: How foolish you are... Defeated by humans... You couldn't even protect our symbol of pride, our flag... I am already done for. I can't see my leader. But I can't give up my last pride. Although they are all torn apart, gather all 5 flags and bring them to the leader. Stingmon in front of you have them.
_520.CompletionText: This is all I can do for my @<tc:800>Leader@</tc>...
_520.CompletionSummary: You are the one who saved our honor.

_521.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_521.Description: A Tamer seems to have a business with me... Maybe he has nothing to do. How about that? If you help me, I will tell you what happened in Wilderness Area. I think it is a wonderful deal to you. Bring me research materials for me. Listen carefully. I don't want to repeat. 5 Piyomon! 5 Piyomon DigiEgg! Hurry up.
_521.CompletionText: I told you that I will not repeat.

_522.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_522.CompletionSummary: Why were you so late? All the data I have collected from Wilderness Area were stolen because of you! What are you gonna do about it! I don't feel like to tell you what happened in Wilderness Area! So hurry up!

_523.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_523.Description: You should pay the price since you were late!? I won't say a word about Wilderness Area until you recover what was stolen! 8 Boarmon 8 Excrements of Boarmon Don't complain!! You have to recover what was stolen! Get them now!
_523.CompletionText: If you are late again, you are fired!
_523.CompletionSummary: Hmm... At least you are not late this time! All right! Promise is promise. I will tell you what I know!

_524.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_524.Summary: Collecting Lost Data for Eccentric Doctor
_524.Description: Hmm! You still have to bring more than what you have brought so far! If you bring more, then I will give you reward! 5 Boarmon 5 Excrement of Boarmon Don't complain!! You have to recover what was stolen! Get them now!
_524.CompletionText: Aren't you going to collect data?
_524.CompletionSummary: All right! Promise is promise. I will tell you what I know!

_525.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_525.Description: Oh, you brought them. What a perfect timing! I feel much better!
_525.CompletionSummary: Promise is promise. I will tell you what I know!! It was a Tamer who attacked me! Dang! He stole all my research data! It was a new face. He was very strong. I tried to fight back based on the knowledge I learned from research, but I was defeated! Wretch

_526.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_526.Description: Again, you are too late! I could have been attacked again! Thanks to the Tamer who helped me the other day, I was okay. Without his help, all the data you guys have gathered so far could have been stolen again! Hmm... I heard the name, but I forgot! Not all doctors have brilliant memory! Looks like he was heading to Wind Valley. Why don't you ask someone else? I am busy now!
_526.CompletionText: Go away! I am busy now!

_527.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_527.Description: Hmm... You came on time! I finally figured out what the Dark Tower does! It doesn't matter here because Dark Tower is experimental model, but your Digimon would be unable to evolve in other area! I know how to avoid that, but it is not right time to tell you! How about that? What do you think about the result! Since you told me the information, I should reward you!? It is getting difficult to collect research data due to Digimon around here. Why don't you take care of them all? It would be easier this time! 10 Stingmon 10 Boarmon (Leader) 5 Sabirdramon 5 Devimon Hurry up!
_527.CompletionText: Not ready yet? Hurry up! I have to gather research data!

_528.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_528.Description: Hmm... A Tamer who keeps his own word! All right, I will give you other information as a reward.
_528.CompletionSummary: As I told you the other day, there was a Tamer who saved my life when I was attacked. Yes, there are great Tamers in this world. Compared to him, you are nothing! If you meet him, please let me know! That's all!

_529.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_529.Description: (Head) Leomon know where the Tamer you are looking for went to... But if you simply go and ask (Head) Leomon, he won't answer... If you can bring me medicine, I will help you. Please... Get the medicine and bring it to Yukidarumon...
_529.CompletionSummary: Are you telling me that Leomon was injured? I will get the medicine.

_530.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_530.Description: Ah... I am sorry. We don't have enough medicine now. I need to get the ingredients for medicine by myself, but I couldn't leave this place now. Can you get the medicine for me? As soon as you get the ingredients, I will make the medicine for you. I will tell you the ingredients. 3 Stingmon's herbs 3 Devimon's fangs. That's all we need. Hurry and bring them to me.
_530.CompletionText: Haven't you got them? We don't have enough time.
_530.CompletionSummary: Oh, did you get them all? I will make the medicine at once!

_531.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_531.Description: Use the medicine on (Injured) Leomon. Leomon will be cured.
_531.CompletionText: It is urgent. You should go now.
_531.CompletionSummary: Ah... I think I am getting better. Thank you.

_532.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_532.Description: Thank you very much. You saved him. (Head) Leomon knows the Tamer you are looking for. Bring the Leomon's flag I give you to him. Then he will answer your question. Once again, thank you very much. Now you can go to (Head) Leomon.
_532.CompletionSummary: Hmm... It's Leomon's flag. I already heard it. I thank you on behalf of all Leomon. I heard that you are looking for a Tamer. I saw the Tamer in Wind Valley. I think you have to collect information there. Good luck.

_533.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_533.Description: I came to Wilderness Area in search of a human kid who might be Keenan Krier. But I got injured by light column which blew me away to distant location. If you get me some medicine, I will be okay. Find Yukidarumon. It will make medicine for me.
_533.CompletionSummary: You came for the medicine. I will make it for you now.

_534.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_534.Description: The medicine is ready. Use it on PawnChessmonBlack. Take care of yourself.
_534.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Now I can go out and get some information about Keenan Krier.
_534.ReservedText: I feel a lot better now.

_535.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_535.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Akihiro Kurata disappeared without a word. Our investigation indicates that he is in Wilderness Area. Find Akihiro Kurata and ask why he had left. Then report back to me.
_535.CompletionText: I know he went there to collect some data, but I wonder what he is really up to.
_535.CompletionSummary: Wonder why I am here? I can't tell you anything until I finish my research! Get out of here now!

_536.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_536.Description: I know the kid you are looking for, but I can't tell you anything now. Because he hates humans. If you still want to meet him, please do me a favor. I am having a hard time finding ingredients for medicine. 5 Herb leaves from Stingmon 5 Devimon's fangs. That's all I need. If you bring them all, then I will tell you about the kid.
_536.CompletionSummary: Wow, you really got them all. Well... As I promised to you, I will tell you about him. But he really hates humans. You'd better be prepared well, because anything could happen. Go to Wind Valley. You will be able to find traces of him.

_537.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_537.Description: Digimon who are controlled by Eveling are rampaging in Wilderness Area. It is not a normal rampage we have seen so far. It is rampage by mutants. So eliminating Eveling alone won't solve the problem. I know it's not easy job. Take care of them all. 8 Sabirdramon 8 Devimon. Defeat them all. Here is Time Dimension Bomb. Return to me when you finish the job.
_537.Objective: Eveling Digimon Cleanup Operation in Wildness Area
_537.CompletionText: You haven't accomplished your mission yet.
_537.CompletionSummary: Good job. Keep on hard working.

_538.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_538.Description: At last I finished building Time Dimension Bomb! What? Are you asking me what it is? Hmm... You still don't understand? All right, I will explain! Time Dimension Bomb opens a time dimension gate through which you can teleport to other dimension. But you can only use it once. Even I can't make it reusable. But this is amazing stuff. That's important. I will give you this Time Dimension Bomb to you. I need lots of materials in order to build it. If you get me more materials, I will build another one! From Leomon 8 Suspicious Item 2 5 Ragged Emblem 2 Bring them to me now!
_538.CompletionText: I need some ingredients to build @<tc:800>Time Dimension Bomb@</tc>. Bring them now!
_538.CompletionSummary: Okay, I have everything I need now. Wait! Here is the @<tc:800>Time Dimension Bomb@</tc>! You can directly teleport to Dats Center with this. This is the only one I have, so use it wisely.

_539.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_539.Description: Hmm... It is difficult to harvest herbs in here due to the Digimon. Please take care of them all. 5 Black Birdramon (Leader) Defeat 5 Devimon (Leader)
_539.CompletionSummary: You've worked very hard. It is much better to harvest herbs now.

_540.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_540.Description: Oh, it has been such a long time. Digital World is wonderful place. It is not easy to take a look around because of annoying Digimon. Can you take care of Stingmon and Stingmon (Leader) in this area? 5 Stingmon Defeat 3 Stingmon (Leader)
_540.CompletionText: Well, it is much better now. Are you done?
_540.CompletionSummary: That's it. Now I can take a look around in peace. What? Why am I here for? I come to walk around.

_541.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_541.Description: You guys... Are you looking for a human in Digital World? What? How did I know it? Hmm... Not that I was interested in you guys!! Enough!! If you help me, then I will help you find the human!! I am starving............. Give me some food... I wish you have meat dumpling made with Boarmon...
_541.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use Boar Meat Dumpling to Devil Impmon
_541.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! Then I will help you find the human!! Go to Wind Valley!! What!? You already knew it? Well, that's all I know... At least I tried...

_542.Title: Dats Center
_542.Description: Congratulations. You are now an official agent. I have a present for you. There is a Equipment Merging Merchant named Doruphin in Yokohama Village. Doruphin said he have something to tell you. He also have a present for you. Off you go.
_542.ObjectiveProgress: Pay a visit to Doruphin in Yokohama Village.
_542.CompletionText: You will love the present you are about to get.
_542.CompletionSummary: Oh! Are you the new @<tc:800>Tamer@</tc> of @<tc:800>Dats Center@</tc>? Well, congratulations! When you are ready to accept your present, talk to me again.

_543.Title: Yokohama Village
_543.Description: At last, I could give you the present.
_543.CompletionSummary: Check your @<tc:800>Tamer@</tc> Item you have. You can see @<tc:800>Slot1 , Slot2@</tc> in the Equipment Item Window. You can equip certain items into the slots that allow you to have special capabilities... I am give you those slots to celebrate your p

_544.Title: Dats Center
_544.Description: I heard you found Akihiro Kurata. Report to me when you return.
_544.CompletionText: I heard you found Akihiro Kurata. Report to me when you return.
_544.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I don't know what he is thinking. I see. Pay close attention to Akihiro Kurata.

_545.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_545.Description: Hmm... Now that I think about it, Dark Tower is a great source to my research... But I need more data at the same time... I want to collect data by myself, but I am busy man as you know... Why don't you help me find data? I will give you handsome reward, so don't be grumpy! I believe all Digimon in Wilderness Area picked up the small pieces fell from Dark Tower. Bring me those small pieces! 5 Dark Tower Pieces 1. 5 Dark Tower Pieces 2. 5 Dark Tower Pieces 3. Each piece is different. Classify them carefully!
_545.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Dark Tower Piece 1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Dark Tower Piece 2%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Dark Tower Piece 3%qe %cc3/%mc3
_545.CompletionText: Have you gathered them all? You guys are not good.
_545.CompletionSummary: Well... You gathered them well... But still not enough.

_546.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_546.Description: Doing business in Wilderness Are is not easy due to those Digimon. Take care of Digimon around here.
_546.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Good luck on your business.

_547.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_547.Description: Haven't had a guest awhile~ I want to cook for you guys, but Doggymon stole my cookwares. Bring me 5 ladles and dishes from Doggymon~
_547.CompletionSummary: Well, thank you. With these cookwares, I can cook~

_548.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_548.Description: This is really boring place to be~ It would be quite exciting to see you to fight each other~ 8 Doggymon Will you fight with 5 Doggymon (Leader)? I will give you handsome reward~ I love to watch others fight each other~
_548.CompletionSummary: That was very exciting~ Thank you~

_549.Title: Dats Center
_549.Description: Hmm... This is Richard Sampson. You look tired to carry a task. You look exhausted. If you accomplish this mission successfully, I will give you energy drink. I heard the some Digimon Leaders are still emerging in Small Forest Trail and Wood Bench Trail. Go now and defeat 8 Bearmon (Leader) and 8 PicoDevimon (Leader).
_549.CompletionText: I think you like the energy drink.
_549.CompletionSummary: You've been through a lot. Rejuvenate yourself with @<tc:800>Energy Drink@</tc> when exhausted.

_550.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_550.Description: Young man, Jijimon and my extra weapons were gone. I fight with Jijimon to have some fun. I made an extra weapon, but Icemon stole it. Can you find my weapons, young man?~
_550.CompletionText: How could they stole from old lady like me, wretched bastards...
_550.CompletionSummary: Thank you, young man. Now I can enjoy fighting with Jijimon again~

_551.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_551.Description: Those sticky Leomon! They are keep coming back! Attack them until they give up! Don't let them interrupt my research!
_551.CompletionText: Take care of them! It's an order!

_552.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_552.Description: So many Digimon is still attacking Oil Refinery-3 area! Real World will be in danger! NeoDevimon, Vikaralamon and SaberLeomon are severe threats to Real World. Please stop them!
_552.CompletionSummary: Good job... But it is too early to be relieved.

_553.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_553.Description: I couldn't find Keenan Krier in here. I think we need more information in here. Why don't you go and meet PawnChessmonWhite who is collecting information in Wind Valley PawnChessmonWhite will help you. Good luck.
_553.CompletionSummary: You are the Tamers PawnChessmonBlack told me. Nice to meet you. I am PawnChessmonWhite. I am looking for Keenan Krier in Wind Valley.

_554.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_554.Description: Based on the collected information, I can tell you that Keenan Krier has passed Wind Valley Keenan Krier may still be in Wind Valley. If you find any information, come to see me. I know Keenan Krier is carrying a boomerang. But for some reason, it seemed to be broken. Please bring me the piece of boomerang from Icemon. We are Scientific Investigation Unit. We can find evidence.
_554.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1A Piece of Keenan Krier's Boomerang 1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2A Piece of Keenan Krier's Boomerang 2%qe %cc2/%mc2
_554.CompletionText: I can't tell anything without information.
_554.CompletionSummary: Good job. Trust my scientific investigation.

_555.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_555.Description: I couldn't collect enough data in Wilderness Area. So I have to try again in Wind Valley, but I am too busy! Why don't you collect research data from Doggymon! I think 5 is enough! Hurry up!!
_555.CompletionSummary: Good job!! It will greatly help... What!? What is this? This is not @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc>! Why did you bring such an useless... No... Wait... This resembles @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc>... I need to find out... Well, that all!!

_556.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_556.Description: I couldn't figure out what it is... I have to ask you a favor again. I need more research data! Bring me 8 research data from Doggymon! I need 8 of them! This time, I will definitely find out!
_556.CompletionText: Hurry up! I need them for my research!
_556.CompletionSummary: Good job! I will find out what it is this time!

_557.Title: Digital World Everywhere
_557.Description: I miss Piyomon~ I hope I didn't bother you too much. But I miss Piyomon... Yes! I saw a DigiEgg among the supplies you brought me. Wait a second~
_557.CompletionSummary: Ah~ I found it! Here it is~ Here you are. It is useless to me anyway~ Consider it a token of my gratitude. Take them all.

_558.Title: Digital World_Western Village Outer Area
_558.Description: We, Leomon are having same trouble like other Digimon. Please take care of Mutant Digimon for us. Please let those Mutant Digimon rest in peace.
_558.CompletionText: Pity. Let them rest in peace.
_558.CompletionSummary: Thank you. It is heartbreaking, but we had no choice. Yeah... I will give you @<tc:800>DigiEgg@</tc> I took away from them. Hope they are useful to you.

_559.Title: Yokohama_Village
_559.Description: Gotsumon was hard to fight off. Well thank you for your help~
_559.CompletionSummary: Ah! I found this @<tc:800>DigiEgg@</tc> from the infirmary. I will give it to you. I don't need it~

_560.Title: Digital World_Wilderness Area
_560.Description: Ah~ I am so full. I don't want to do anything~ Hey, human! Why are you still here? Looking for some reward? You sticky humans~
_560.CompletionSummary: All right, all right. Take this. It's not reward, I am just throwing it away. Now get out of my sight, human.

_561.Title: Digital World_Western Village East Area
_561.Description: They fought for us. We should give them some rewards.
_561.CompletionSummary: Yes, I happened to have a @<tc:800>DigiEgg@</tc>! I took it away when they degenerated. I will give it to you. Don't let it evolve to bad one~

_562.Title: Yokohama_Village
_562.Description: Wait a second! I didn't tell you how to go there. Oil Refinery is located between Small Fores Trail and Wood Bench Trail. But you can't simply pass through. Find Oil Refinery workers in East Village. He will help you pass through. Off you go~
_562.CompletionSummary: Oh, you want to go to Oil Refinery? I will guide to there.

_563.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_563.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Gabumon is rampaging in Wood Bench Trail now. Defeat Gabumon immediately After you defeated them, come and see me. I have a present for you.
_563.CompletionSummary: Well done. As I promised to you, there is the present Raise them well.

_564.Title: Dats Center
_564.Description: Could you pass this happy new to him? I mean Keven Krier. He is renowned researcher on Super Dimension in Dats Center. You can meet him in Dats Center.
_564.Objective: Find Kevin Krier in Dats Center
_564.CompletionText: You can meet him in Dats Center.
_564.CompletionSummary: Is that so? That means he is likely to be alive...

_565.Title: Western Village West Area
_565.Description: There won't be any more rampaging Digimon in here as we just defeated SaberLeomon. We just received another intelligence that there is another human Tamer in Western Village West Area. Investigate it now. Cerberumon of Hell can send you to Western Village West Area. Not everyone can go there. But now that I saw your skill and ability, I don't have to worry about you.
_565.CompletionText: Go and find the @<tc:800>human Tamer@</tc> immediately.
_565.CompletionSummary: Richard Sampson already informed me that you are coming. I will send you to Western Village West Area.
_565.ReservedText: How was your travel to here?

_566.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_566.Description: Hmm... My scientific investigation indicates that this is Keenan Krier's boomerang. It looked like he fought with someone. This broken boomerang proved that he fought with someone very strong. He could have been injured during the battle. I hope he is okay. Get me all the information about Keenan Krier. Here is photo of Keenan Krier.
_566.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Photo of Keenan Krier%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Conversation with Babamon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Conversation with Jijimon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_566.CompletionSummary: As I expected, he is not here anymore. I am worried... I see. In the meantime, I will keep searching for him.
_566.ReservedText: Well... I haven't seen him. I don't know...

_567.Title: Western Village West Area
_567.Description: Hmm... Looks like this area is full of research data. Don't look at me like that! It will eventually help you anyway. For now, bring me 5 hooks from Okuwamon! Don't ask me why! Just get them to me! I will explain you why later.
_567.CompletionText: Hurry up! We don't have enough time!
_567.CompletionSummary: Yes, yes... I could make a perfect weapon out of... What? Why are you still here? Go now!

_568.Title: Western Village West Area
_568.Description: You humans... I lost my friend because of you! What do you want from me? You humans made Digital World a mess! I don't know how you did it, but all good Digimon turned to evil one! Get out of my sight, you humans!
_568.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Falcomon still don't trust us. But we need to treat Falcomon first...

_569.Title: Western Village West Area
_569.Description: Before we treat his wound, we have to gain some trust from him. But we need to treat Falcomon first Get medicine from Pumpkinmon and give it to Falcomon. Then Falcomon might change his mind.
_569.ObjectiveProgress: Get medicine and use it on @<tc:800>Falcomon@</tc>
_569.CompletionText: If we don't hurry, it will be too late.
_569.CompletionSummary: Why did humans treat my wound? I really don't understand... Thanks to them I feel better now...

_570.Title: Western Village West Area
_570.Description: I never expected humans would take care of me. I think you are different than other humans. I guess I misunderstood you guys. Sorry. Ah! Let me ask you another favor. My friend got injured after he fought with a Partner Digimon of human and disappeared. Can you find him for me? I want to find him myself, but I couldn't move freely now. He fought with Okuwamon over there. I hope he is okay...
_570.CompletionSummary: This is... the necklace of my friend, Keenan Krier... Why is it here...

_571.Title: Western Village West Area
_571.Description: Hmm... I wonder how my research turns out... I want to know how powerful those Digimon are... Skull Greymon in this area have bombs in their back.. It is called Shark Bullet. Bring it to me! Get it at all cost. 8 Shark Bullets would help my research.
_571.CompletionSummary: I thought you could get them. Good job! Kekeke...

_572.Title: Western Village West Area
_572.Description: I don't know what is going on here, but recently Pumpkinmon became aggressive~ I don't know why they became aggressive, but if we let them rampaging, it will be a big problem. Take care of rampaging Pumpkinmon. 8 Pumpkinmon Please take care of 5 Pumpkinmon (Leader)
_572.CompletionText: That's strange... Pumpkinmon is not at all aggressive.
_572.CompletionSummary: Good job. It is heartbreaking, but we had no choice.

_573.Title: Western Village West Area
_573.Description: It looks like Digimon in this area are suddenly getting aggressive... I guess someone intentionally made them aggressive. But I don't have any proof. Take care of rampaging Digimon in this area anyway. 5 Pumpkinmon (Leader) Take care of 8 Okuwamon.
_573.CompletionText: As a Digimon, it is sad to see them dying.
_573.CompletionSummary: Good job. I think someone intentionally made Digimon in this ares aggressive.

_574.Title: Western Village West Area
_574.Description: What? How do you know Keenan Krier?
_574.Objective: Keenan Krier is missing![Toward Wilderness Area of Dark Tower!!]
_574.CompletionSummary: Keenan Krier was teleported to Digital World due to the tragic gate accident... I will tell you the details later. We need to find him first. Help me. I am sure he is injured... We must find him quickly.

_575.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_575.Description: Those sticky Leomon! How dare you challenge to me! I have ignored you so far because I was busy working, but not any more! Leomon, I will use you as research data.. Bring me 8 Leomon's fangs! You will regret what you did to me...
_575.CompletionText: Take your time. I will wait for you here.
_575.CompletionSummary: Finally, you got them!! Wait for me, Leomon... Enjoy my counterattack!

_576.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_576.Description: At last, I found out the truth of gears! It turned out to be another Eveling... Hmm... I don't know who made it, but he must be a brilliant guy.
_576.CompletionSummary: No! I am not saying that the guy who made it is a genius!

_577.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_577.Description: I think I need to collect data about new Eveling. I am sure it can speed up my research. Bring me 10 new Evelings! You can get them from any Digimon in this area!
_577.CompletionText: I am busy. Bring them quickly!
_577.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Let me see what you got. Good job! I will call you later whenever I need you guys!

_578.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_578.Description: I don't know who's responsible for this, but there's a lot of Gotsumons! Ugh, if this keeps happening, they'll all go up to the ground! We need to clean up before I figure out the cause! Defeat 10 of them and report to Richard Sampson!
_578.CompletionText: Hmm.. Why are there so many Gotsumons..
_578.CompletionSummary: Well done. Looks like Gotsumons are causing troubles here and there.

_579.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_579.Description: I am sure that something horrible happened to Keenan Krier in this spot. I think Keenan Krier disappeared right after he fought with Garurumon here. Please find more evidence of his whereabouts.
_579.CompletionText: We need evidence to find out his whereabouts.
_579.ReservedText: We must find Keenan Krier quickly.

_580.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_580.Description: It looks like he was attacked by someone and narrowly escaped from here Falcomon must be with him...
_580.CompletionSummary: Yes, it worries me a lot. We have to start searching for him. Thank you for bring me evidences.

_581.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_581.Description: Young man~ I need to repair my house as it is very windy area~ I need very strong support beam that could stand against strong wind~ Garurumon's claw is strongest one you can find in here~ Bring me 5 Garurumon's claws~ I am too old to fight wit them~
_581.CompletionText: Young man, have you gotten Garurumon's Claw?
_581.CompletionSummary: Hahaha~ Thank you for your offer, but I will repair by myself~

_582.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_582.Description: Hmm... I will merge my new Eveling with research result... I wonder what result I would get! Wanna know? If all goes well, I can control Digimon! First, use it against Leomon (Tracker)! I made specifically for them! Do your own experiment and report the result to me!
_582.CompletionSummary: Hmm... As I expected, it was useless! That doesn't matter! All I care is field data from the experiments! I should move on to experiment based on the research data from Digimon Farm. See you in Digimon Farm!!

_583.Title: Digital World_Wind Valley
_583.Description: Oh~ I am so sorry, young man~ I forgot to tell you another thing~ The most important thing for my repair is brown cloth... I have to ask you a favor again.. Bring me 1 brown cloth from Leomon (Tracker)~ I am sorry to make things complicated~
_583.CompletionSummary: Thank you, young man~ My forgetfulness made you do miscellaneous chores... Hahaha

_584.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_584.Description: They say IceDevimon is alluring Tamers in D-terminal-Dungeon-B1. Go to D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 immediately and take care of the malicious IceDevimon. You will need permit to enter to D-terminal-Dungeon-B1. I have already issued your permit. Use it to enter. If you don't have the permit, ask Kevin Krier to issue one for you.
_584.CompletionText: If we let it happen @<tc:800>Tamers@</tc> would be in trouble.

_585.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_585.Description: Gotsumon is destroying D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area now. If we let Gotsumon destroy D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area, there won't be anything left. Take care of Gotsumon.
_585.CompletionText: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 is very important area for us. Please take care of Gotsumon.
_585.CompletionSummary: You've worked very hard. I feel relieved now.

_586.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_586.Description: My investigation indicates that another Eveling emerged in D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area~ It's Wormmon! I don't know why Eveling emerged in here. I want you to collect 5 Evelings from Wormmon and bring them to Miki Kurosaki... I must investigate them because they might be something else.
_586.CompletionText: Emergence of @<tc:800>Eveling@</tc>... I am not surprised..
_586.CompletionSummary: Good job. Now it's our turn to investigate.

_587.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_587.Description: Ever since it was collapsed, so many Digimon had emerged in here sporadically. If we let them keep emerging here, security of Real World would be threatened. Take care of Digimon in D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area.
_587.CompletionSummary: Good job~ Thanks to you, Real World will be safe for a while.

_588.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_588.Description: At least I finished investigating it.
_588.CompletionSummary: My investigation suggests that someone filled Eveling in Wormmon on purpose.. I got a feeling that something is happening in here. We have no time to waste.. We need to investigate further... It make take long, but I must investigate!

_589.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_589.Description: Hmm... We found out the leader of Digimon! Gotsumon (Destroyer) is the leader. I think they brought Gotsumon here. Please take care of them~
_589.CompletionText: If you don't defeat them, you will be in trouble.
_589.CompletionSummary: What a swift move. Good job~

_590.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_590.Description: Hmm... We found out who is the leader of Digimon! Bearmon (Destroyer) is the leader. I think they brought Bearmon here. Please take care of them~
_590.CompletionText: If we don't defeat them quickly, they will be uncontrollable.
_590.CompletionSummary: What a swift move. Good job~

_591.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_591.Description: D-terminal is very dangerous area to enter. Entrance to D-terminal is restricted to once a day.
_591.CompletionSummary: You need to show permit to enter to D-terminal. Basically, one permit is issued to you, but you can also enter with other <tc:800>Tamer@</tc>'s permit. You can only enter to D-terminal once a day, because it is very dangerous place to be. Here is your @

_592.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_592.Description: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 has been sealed off due to malfunction of gate. I thought we lost all of our research data.
