Thanks to recent reopening of D-terminal-Dungeon-B1, we could recover the parts.. But it is still too dangerous for us to enter. #<my_tname>! Could you go there for us? Please recover all Gate Parts Box from Digimon in D-terminal-Dungeon-B1.
_592.CompletionText: I will do anything to take my son.
_592.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you I can continue to research on the @<tc:800>gate@</tc>.

_593.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_593.Description: Other Digimon is easy to deal with, but leaders are relatively difficult to defeat. They are making our breakthrough very difficult. Please take care of leader Digimon so that we could easily break through.
_593.CompletionText: We must clear the area, otherwise our backup unit couldn't come here.
_593.CompletionSummary: You guys are really good~ Good job~ We can finally move on.

_594.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_594.Description: Ever since it was collapsed, so many Digimon had emerged in here sporadically. If we let them keep emerging here, security of Real World would be threatened. Please take care of Digimon in D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area.
_594.CompletionText: Oh, I don't know what to do with it.
_594.CompletionSummary: Good job~ Thanks to you, Real World will be safe for a while.

_595.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_595.Description: What is going on? Digimon emerged out of nowhere are making a mess!!! There are dangerous equipments in here. They might be exploded! You! If you are a Tamer, get rid of those Digimon It's urgent!
_595.CompletionText: There will be countless casualties If you let them...
_595.CompletionSummary: Good job! Good to see you guys! But it is too early to feel safe... Digimon is keep emerging to here... What is going on...

_596.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_596.Description: Now it was settled down a little bit, but we can leave this place! What? Do you how difficult it is to be unemployed!!?? We have responsibility to keep this place!! There are other Employees around here, but I can't go anywhere right now! Please pass them my message~! that I have to keep this place! Go now!
_596.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Conversation with Oil Tank Repairman%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Conversation with Gas Tank Repairman%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Conversation with Guard%qe %cc3/%mc3
_596.CompletionSummary: Thank you for passing me the instruction! I had to go there by myself due to radio transmitter malfunction. Well, thank you!
_596.ReservedText: I got it! We will keep this area safe! I won't let them sweep my workplace!

_597.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_597.Description: Due to rampaging Vikaralamon, Oil Tank Area is in danger now. If we let them destroy this area... Then... There will be a Oil Shock... What? What was I talking about?? Well, forget what I just said!! I mean we will be in trouble if we don't have enough oil!! Take care of Vikaralamon immediately!
_597.CompletionText: We have no time to waste!! Please stop them from rampaging!!
_597.CompletionSummary: Good job!! Now we can be rest assured.

_598.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_598.Description: That's a big problem... SaberLeomon is aiming to attack the gas tank... If there is gas leaking from the gas tank, the environment is in danger.. Stop SaberLeomon!
_598.CompletionText: If there is a gas leaking... This is getting worse..
_598.CompletionSummary: Fortunately, there was no gas leaking... But it's not over yet!

_599.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_599.Description: I wanted to take a nap in my room... That wretched NeoDevimon ruined my day!!! We have to keep our house!! Otherwise we can't even take some sleep!
_599.CompletionText: I know you need to sleep, but can you stop NeoDevimon now!
_599.CompletionSummary: Wow~ That settles it... But it is too early to take some sleep... Keep working~

_600.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_600.Description: Hmm... I have collected many data so far, but SaberLeomon's data is hard to find... It is not easy to get some sample~ Bring me SaberLeomon Data. I thought you could do that.. Come back quick!
_600.CompletionText: Not yet? I thought you could do better than that.
_600.CompletionSummary: Good job!! Now I can finally complete my research! Hahaha!

_601.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_601.Description: Dang Digimon!! I should have cleaned them all in Digital World... If we have done it at the time, we wouldn't have to do this now!! We need to clean this place first!! Get rid of all Digimon in this area!!
_601.CompletionText: Why are you still here? Hurry up!
_601.CompletionSummary: We still have long way to go!! I don't believe it!!
_601.ReservedText: I am sick and tired of all this!!

_602.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_602.Description: Wretched SaberLeomon! Did they follow us to here? And he called himself the ruler of Western Area? You!! If you are from Dats Center, take care of that! Sorry, I got another business... Kekeke...
_602.CompletionText: What bring the @<tc:800>Ruler of Western Area@</tc> here... Hahaha!!!
_602.CompletionSummary: Wow, that's great! I never expected that it became stronger... Amazing!!

_603.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_603.Description: Dang Digimon!! I should have cleaned them all in Digital World... If we have done it at the time, we wouldn't have to do this now!! We need to clean this place first!! Get rid of all Digimon in this area!!
_603.CompletionText: Why are you still here? Hurry up!
_603.CompletionSummary: We still have long way to go!! I don't believe it!!
_603.ReservedText: I am sick and tired of all this!!

_604.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_604.Description: So many Digimon are attacking Oil Refinery -3 area now! Real World is in danger! NeoDevimon and Vikaralamon, SaberLeomon is severe threat to Real World. Please stop them!
_604.CompletionSummary: Good job... But it is too early to say it's okay.

_605.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_605.Description: Due to rampaging Vikaralamon, Oil Tank Area is in danger now. If we let them destroy this area... Then... There will be a Oil Shock... What? What was I talking about?? Well, forget what I just said!! I mean we will be in trouble if we don't have enough oil!! Take care of Vikaralamon immediately!
_605.CompletionText: We have no time to waste!! Please stop them from rampaging!!
_605.CompletionSummary: Good job!! Now we can be rest assured.

_606.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_606.Description: That's a big problem... SaberLeomon is aiming to attack the gas tank... If there is gas leaking from the gas tank, the environment is in danger.. Stop SaberLeomon!
_606.CompletionText: If there is a gas leaking... This is getting worse..
_606.CompletionSummary: Fortunately, there was no gas leaking... But it's not over yet!

_607.Title: Oil Refinery-3
_607.Description: I wanted to take a nap in my room... That wretched NeoDevimon ruined my day!!! We have to keep our house!! Otherwise we can't even take some sleep!!
_607.CompletionText: I know you need to sleep, but can you stop NeoDevimon now?
_607.CompletionSummary: Wow~ That settles it... But it is too early to take some sleep... Keep working~

_608.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_608.Description: I know that uniform!! So you're a Dats Agent... You've come at the right time... Do you see that container there!? It contains dangerous chemical substances. If it explodes, it'll be a disaster. We have to move the truck quickly to another location before it explodes... However, I've lost the key to the truck...Find two truck keys... You'll find them if you destroy any Digimon in this area...
_608.Objective: Destroy Digimon in the area and find two truck keys and give them to Repairman B.
_608.CompletionText: Ah... This is not good... If that explodes...
_608.CompletionSummary: Ah.! That's right...it's this one... Found it! What a relief!

_609.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_609.Description: This radio is not working... It looks like a powerful electricity current runs through here. Sinduramon must be the culprit. Because those Digimons use powerful electricity...we won't be able to communicate if the walkie talkies go dead, so the situation will deteriorate. Can you defeat 10 Sinduramon? I'm asking you for this favor because you're an employee of Dats.
_609.Objective: You defeat 10 Sinduramon and make a report to Repairman C.
_609.CompletionSummary: (Crackle...Crackle...) It's on! There's still a lot of static, but it's good enough.

_610.Title: Oil Refinery-2
_610.Description: Wow, you're just in time... As you can see, Volcamon and Cherrymon are threatening port facilities. You might be aware as well, but it take a long time to repair port facilities... You must do whatever it takes to protect the port facilities!! Please go after 10 each of Volcamon and Cherrymon.
_610.Objective: Defeat 10 each of Volcamon and Cherrymon and make a report to Repairman D
_610.CompletionText: I don't have anything against Digimon either...but I can't help this.
_610.CompletionSummary: Whew, thank you...would it be okay to relax for a little while, at least?

_611.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_611.Description: Other Digimon is easy to deal with, but leaders are relatively difficult to defeat. They are making our breakthrough very difficult. Please take care of leader Digimon so that we could easily break through.
_611.CompletionText: We must clear the area, otherwise our backup unit couldn't come here.
_611.CompletionSummary: You guys are really good~ Good job~ We can finally move on.

_612.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_612.Description: Without a permit, you can't enter to D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area. Since you helped me a lot, I will give you the permit of D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 area. You can't enter without the permit. Don't forget that.
_612.CompletionSummary: Be careful. D-terminal-Dungeon-B1 is dangerous area.

_613.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_613.Description: Hmm... Gotsumon is destroying everything in here! Looks like Gotsumon (Destroyer) is leading other Gotsumon.. Take care of them all!
_613.CompletionText: We will be in trouble if we don't defeat them quickly.
_613.CompletionSummary: What a swift move. Good job~

_614.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_614.Description: Hmm... Bearmon is destroying everything in this place! Looks like Bearmon (Destroyer) is leading other Bearmon. Take care of them all!
_614.CompletionText: We will be in trouble if we don't defeat them quickly.
_614.CompletionSummary: What a swift move. Good job~

_615.Title: D-terminal-Dungeon-B1
_615.Description: I have an intelligence suggesting that the rampaging IceDevimon contacted with a Tamer in D-terminal-Dungeon-B1. It looks like IceDevimon has made regular contact with the Tamer. We must investigate the matter. It has been confirmed that the Unknown Tamer is Wormmon's Tamer. Go there and defeat them!
_615.CompletionText: If we let it happen, @<tc:800>Tamers@</tc> would be in trouble.
_615.ReservedText: Hmm... IceDevimon won't give up easily... That's no good..

_616.Title: Snowman Village
_616.Description: I think IceDevimon is alluring Tamer in here~ What? How did I know it?? Richard Sampson and I help each other from time to time.. I will tell you the story later, but now we have to take care of IceDevimon first... Okay, let's go!!
_616.CompletionSummary: Oh~ Good job~ I know you could do it.

_617.Title: Snowman Village
_617.Description: What? IceDevimon is keep coming back... That's no good... I think you should go there again gentlemen~ Why don't we eradicate every single IceDevimon? Okay, let's go~!!
_617.CompletionText: We are busy enough investigating the matter. Why does IceDevimon keep coming back?
_617.CompletionSummary: Well done, gentlemen~ Now we can focus on investigation. Hahaha!

_618.Title: Snowman Village
_618.Description: How busy I am! But I'm happy that I'm busy! I But I can't be happy--I'm busy!!! There's been a request from the Dats center... You, as Dats members, should fulfill the request. It's very fortunate that you're here. The request asks for a road to be made to Snowman Village. You'll have to drill a road first, but violent Digimon will make it hard for you to pass through. Go handle the request.
_618.CompletionText: You haven't left yet?? Go fulfill the request now, so we can have a break.
_618.CompletionSummary: Wow, well done gentlemen~ Now I am relieved~

_619.Title: Snowman Village
_619.Description: Finally, I got it. Keenan Krier is in here~
_619.CompletionSummary: Keenan Krier is here, but it seems that he couldn't come back because of injury...

_620.Title: Snowman Village
_620.Description: I think something happened to Keenan Krier... I want you to find out what happened to him... And could you pass this message to him? Oh, you also have to deal with the rampaging Digimon on the way. Thank you.
_620.CompletionSummary: You humans!!! What do you want from me? What? Yukidarumon sent me a letter? It doesn't sound like a lie. Don't come near me~!!

_621.Title: Snowman Village
_621.Description: What? Is there a Digimon who assumes my name? They say it resembles me. Well, someone wanted my reputation badly~!!! Okay, gentlemen. Take care of the Digimon~!!
_621.CompletionSummary: Hmm... That Digimon really resembles me? That's strange... I will think about it later. I am busy now.

_622.Title: Snowman Village
_622.Description:
Well, it looks like the letter was sent by Yukidarumon... I will trust you. But I am not buying everything you tell me.
(...Yukidarumon... It seems that he worries about me..)
You... Deliver my letter to Yukidarumon... I can't go there by myself as I have a business I have to attend. I don't usually trust human, but I have no choice now... Don't you dare read my letter!
_622.CompletionText: Let's deliver the letter at once...!!
_622.CompletionSummary: Ah... You are here~ ................. I am happy to hear that he is fine... What? I see... Keenan Krier seems to believe all the incidents happening in Digital World are caused by humans. That's why he hates human so much. He thinks he is a Digimon...

_623.Title: Snowman Village
_623.Description: Hmm... I see... Keenan Krier must be busy due to all those incidents happened in Digital World... Hope he is okay.. I want you Tamers to help him. I know you have been looking for Keenan Krier for some time. Unfortunately, Keenan Krier despises humans. If you trust him, he may accept the truth. Please help us.
_623.CompletionSummary: What? Yukidarumon sent you to help me?? Okay... But don't think that I will trust you because of that!

_624.Title: Snowman Village
_624.Description: If you are here to help me, help me now. Because of all those humans, Digimon became vicious and aggressive. Since there is no way to turn them back to what they were, I am thinking about turning them back to DigiEgg. I feel very sorry for them, but could you turn them back to DigiEgg?
_624.CompletionText: I am sorry, but I have no choice. I will find out the real culprit

_625.Title: Snowman Village
_625.Description: Who on earth keeps doing these awful things to Digimon? Now we have no other choice but to turn them back to DigiEgg... I have to find the person causing this... Would you guys fight off the Digimon in this area, so I can find my target?

_626.Title: Infinite Ice Wall
_626.Description: Akihiro Kurata... You bastard... Didn't you forget how much have I supported your research? And now you betray me like this? I won't forgive what you have done to me. You! Go and find Akihiro Kurata!!
_626.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Confused Anubimon! Investigation%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Investigation of frozen waterfall%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Royal Knights Gallantmon! Investigation%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Emergence of Gizumon! Investigation%qe %cc4/%mc4
_626.CompletionSummary: Haha... Akihiro Kurata... I found it... Good job!! Such a useless man could be useful from time to time... I won't forgive you, Akihiro Kurata!!!

_627.Title: Yokohama_Small Forest Park
_627.Description:
This is Richard Sampson. Go to Yokohama Park and defeat DemiMeramon DemiMeramon is in small residential area now. If it explode the gas tanks there will be a chaos. Bring me 5 DemiMeramon and 5 indistinguishable flame before it become chaos!
DemiMeramon must be in Small Forest Park.
_627.CompletionText: We have to prevent it before it gets worse That's the responsibility of Dats Agent.
_627.CompletionSummary: Job well done. Well done. I will give you a @<tc:800>ChipSet@</tc>. Use it wisely...

_628.Title: Event
_628.Description: When the life borned in Spring is to radiate its mystic energy, the Digimons that have the energy of a hard earth still hiding in the shadows of the winter will only become an obstacle for the nature's order. Help the seed of life not to lose its mystic power from them.
_628.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Red Seed of Life%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Blue Seed of Life%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Yellow Seed of Life%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Green Seed of Life%qe %cc4/%mc4
_628.CompletionText: I can guide you to where they are. Get yourself ready.
_628.CompletionSummary: Nature's order exist in Digital World just like yours. I thank you sincerely for protecting it.

_629.Title: Event
_629.Description: When the life borned in Spring is to radiate its mystic energy, the Digimons that have the energy of a hard earth still hiding in the shadows of the winter will only become an obstacle for the nature's order. Help the seed of life not to lose its mystic power from them.
_629.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Red Seed of Life%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Blue Seed of Life%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Yellow Seed of Life%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Green Seed of Life%qe %cc4/%mc4
_629.CompletionText: I can guide you to where they are. Get yourself ready.
_629.CompletionSummary: Nature's order exist in Digital World just like yours. I thank you sincerely for protecting it.

_630.CompletionSummary: I see you have brought Halloween hat pieces! I will make you a Halloween hat in a jiffy!
_630.ReservedText: I don't think there are enough items required... I can't make you a hat with this. You can probably get Halloween hat pieces from monster Digimons.

_631.Title: Event
_631.Description: Congratulations! You've reached to the level 11 of your Partner Digimon. Complete a quest and receive items.
_631.Objective: You've reached to the level 11 of your Partner Digimon.
_631.CompletionSummary: Next distribution will be at the level 25 of your Partner Digimon.

_632.Title: Event
_632.Description: Congratulations! You've reached to the level 41 of your Partner Digimon. Complete a quest and receive items.
_632.Objective: You've reached to the level 41 of your Partner Digimon.
_632.CompletionSummary: Next distribution will be at the level 65 of your Partner Digimon.

_639.Title: Dats Center
_639.Description: You have solved those problems in Yokohama Village very well. I am impress at your talent. So you are now become Official Dats Agent.
_639.CompletionText: You will be met a big hardship.
_639.CompletionSummary:
This Cloth is a Symbol of Official Agent. It is yours.
And another item, this bomb make send you to D-Terminal.
Please try hard for peace of Real World and Digital World.

_640.Title: Wood Bench Trail
_640.Description: You must have become an official Dats agent already. That's amazing! Your reputation precedes you. Now, let's actually test your skills. Drimogemons have suddenly appeared on the Wood Bench Trail, and they are causing us trouble in managing riding digimons. I want you to take care of them. As you deal with them, you will see riding digimons' behavioral patterns. I'm sure it will be beneficial for someone like you who have no experience with riding. So, give it a shot yourself.
_640.Objective: Defeat Drimogemom and the Chief Drimogemon.
_640.CompletionText: On the Wood Bench Trail, you will find Drimogemons with the information that you need. Go see for yourself.
_640.CompletionSummary: Did that help you at all?

_641.Title: Dats Center
_641.Description: The situation is somewhat under control now. Be sure to remember the behavioral patterns of riding digimons that you learned today. You can go see Captain Richard Sampson at the Dats Center.
_641.CompletionText: Go meet with Captain Sampson at the Dats Center…
_641.CompletionSummary: So, everything has been taken care of, then?

_642.Title: Dats Center
_642.Description: It seems that you have gained some understanding of how riding digimons work. I will give you a riding DigiEgg. Hatch it, use the given riding item, and experience the riding yourself.
_642.CompletionText: Hatch a Drimogemon first, and then use the Standard Issue Rider Wing.
_642.CompletionSummary: Hatch a Drimogemon first, and then use the Standard Issue Rider Wing.

_643.Title: Yokohama_Village
_643.Description: It looks like Megumi Shirakawa, the agent in charge of riding, is having some trouble. Now that you are an official Dats agent, you can take this assignment. Head over to Yokohama Village and meet with the riding agent, Megumi Shirakawa.
_643.CompletionText: Go and speak with the riding agent, Megumi Shirakawa, at Yokohama Village.
_643.CompletionSummary: Hey, rookie. I've been waiting for you.

_655.CompletionSummary: I see you have brought Halloween hat pieces! I will make you a Halloween hat in a jiffy!
_655.ReservedText: I don't think there are enough items required... I can't make you a hat with this. You can probably get Halloween hat pieces from monster Digimons.

_656.CompletionSummary: Thanks for getting me a Jack-O-Lantern. Here is a gift for you in return.
_656.ReservedText: I don't think there are enough items required... You can probably get Jack-O'-Lanterns from monster Digimons.

_657.CompletionText: 유키다루몬에게 가봐. 그 녀석은 이맘때면 이것저것 잡동사니를 모아 닷트본부에서 파는거 같더군.

_658.Title: Event
_658.Description: I can sense that suspicious beings have appeared.. It doesn't feel like they are that powerful, however, I'm suspecting that this is somewhat foreshadowing our jeopardized future. Then all we can do is completely eradicate the origin of all possible harms. Take care of those Bakemons of the Real World, Chimeramons of Western areas, Yukidarumons of Glacier areas and Devimons of File Island areas right now. According to the reports, they appear to roam around in random places of the stated areas, so don't forget to search for them yourself before you can start doing whatever you must do.
_658.Objective: Defeat 'Bakemon', Real World Defeat 'Chimeramon', Western Defeat 'Yukidarumon', Glacier Defeat 'Devimon', File Island
_658.CompletionText: Did you successfully handle all of them?
_658.CompletionSummary: These guys seem like they appear every single day, so it looks like I might have to call you up again. Take this certificate for now.

_659.CompletionText: 유키다루몬에게 가봐. 녀석은 이상한거 모으게 취미라 그것과 교환하면 얻을 수 있을거야.

_660.CompletionText: 유키다루몬은 이 맘때 이것저것 상품을 모아 어린이날 기념 코인과 교환해 준다고 했어.

_661.CompletionText: 유키다루몬을 찾아가서 천체 망원경이 있는지 확인해 보라고!
