_673.Title: Event
_673.Description: Congratulations! You've reached to the level 65 of your Partner Digimon. Complete a quest and receive items.
_673.Objective: You've reached to the level 65 of your Partner Digimon.

_674.Title: Silver Lake
_674.Description:
Have you seen the <Mysterious Forest Dust>? You find it occasionally on the Digimons at Silver Lake. Please collect the Mysterious Forest Dust for me.
It may not be all that useful to you, Tamer, but it is essential to us. Very useful to those at Silver Lake.
If you happen to find any, please let me know!
_674.CompletionText: Have you ever seen the Forest Dust?
_674.CompletionSummary: You can turn in any Forest Dust you might have. Feel free to come by anytime!

_675.Title: Village of the Beginning
_675.Description:
You've come through D-Terminal, haven't you? You've come a long way.
The File Island is made up of [Silver Lake], the [Silent Forest], the [Forgotten Ruins], [File Shores], the [Infinity Mountain and dungeons].
Aren't you getting excited just to think about all the adventures ahead of you?
Your adventure will begin at Silver Lake! Go east from here and you will find the path that leads to the Lake.
The File Island is filled with exciting adventures, but there are many problems, too. It would be very nice of you to take care of them, Tamer.
I hope you make lots of friends with the Digimons here. Enjoy the incredible adventures here on the File Island!
_675.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Agumon at Silver Lake.
_675.CompletionText: Have you spoken with Agumon at Silver Lake yet?
_675.CompletionSummary: You are new to Silver Lake, aren't you?

_676.Title: Lost Historic site
_676.Summary: Reason why Palmon has became violent
_676.Description:
I heard that the Black Cogwheels makes Digimons violent from other explorers.
Palmon has become vicious recently, do you think it is related? Defeat Palmons and check whether Black Cogwheels are there.
_676.Objective: Collect 5 fragments of Black Cogwheels after eliminating Palmon
_676.CompletionText: I think the Black Cogwheels is related to the reason why Palmon became violent.
_676.CompletionSummary: Is this the Black Cogwheels…? It has crack on?!

_677.Title: Lost Historic site
_677.Description:
This small fragment can make Digimons violent?
Hmm… I think I cannot investigate more about this. Earlier explorers might have more information about this.
Take this fragment to Terriermon. I will contact him in advance
_677.Objective: Give Black Cogwheels of Palmon to Terriermon
_677.ObjectiveProgress: Give Black Cogwheels of Palmon to Terriermon
_677.CompletionText: Terriermon must know more about this.
_677.CompletionSummary: I got call from Hawkmon in advance. You brought a fragment of Black Cogwheels?

_678.Title: Lost Historic site
_678.Description:
Hmm… It seems like an investigation kit is necessary, but I have none.
Explorer Lopmon across the continent has Ruins Composition Analysis Kit. You may investigate with that.
Go find Lopmon first.
_678.Objective: Speak with Lopmon the explorer across the bridge
_678.CompletionText: Palmon is near the cliff. Palmon will send you to across continent. Ruins Composition Analysis Kit will find out the component of that piece.
_678.CompletionSummary: You need Ruins Composition Analysis Kit?

_679.Title: Lost Historic site
_679.Description: Oh… my god….. Gotsumons have stolen Ruins Composition Analysis Kit while I was away. They won't know how to use it! Please bring me Ruins Composition Analysis kit Gotsumons stole back to me.
_679.CompletionText: Gotsumons took the Ruins Composition Analysis Kit.
_679.CompletionSummary: Thanks! I will check whether Gotsumons touched it or not.

_680.Title: Lost Historic site
_680.Description: Fortunately, it looks fine. Here it is. Take it to Terreiermon.
_680.Objective: Give Ruins Composition Analysis Kit to Terriermon
_680.ObjectiveProgress: Give Ruins Composition Analysis Kit to Terriermon
_680.CompletionText: Give this to Terriermon. Terriermon will be waiting for you.
_680.CompletionSummary: You came! I was worrying since you took so long.

_681.Title: Lost Historic site
_681.Description: All right, then let’s exert analyst's instinct of explorer~ Wait a minute!
_681.CompletionSummary: I think this is not made naturally from File Island. This fragment is too small to analyze in detail, but certain Digimon's energy is in here.

_682.Title: Lost Historic site
_682.Description:
I heard from Lopmon that Gotsumons have stoles Ruins Composition Analysis kit. I knew they are prank but nowadays it became more serious.
Maybe Gotsumons too? Investigate Gotsumon and Gotsumon Leaders!
_682.CompletionText: Prank boys! There should not be such a thing!
_682.CompletionSummary: Nothing happened? Phew~ It's not affecting all Digimons yet. But we have another problem!

_683.Title: Lost Historic site
_683.Description: While you were gone to investigate, another explorer Starmon has contacted me. Digimons have also became violent in his area. I made a report with information you gave, take this to Starmon!
_683.CompletionText: What are you doing? Hurry up to speak with Starmon!
_683.CompletionSummary: Did Terriermon send you here? Our situation is bad here, too.

_684.Title: Lost Historic site
_684.Description: This is RedVegiemon's Village. I knew that they smell bad, but they did not attack first. One day, they became violent and spread disgusting smell all around! Stop RedVegiemon's violent behavior first!
_684.CompletionText: My head aches so badly because of RedVegiemon's smell…
_684.CompletionSummary: Phew… It seems a little better now. Wait a minute please. I will read the report.

_685.Title: Lost Historic site
_685.Description:
Let's start serious conversation now. So the reason why Digimons became violent is the Black Cogwheels? And some Digimon created this Black Cogwheels??
Hmm…. Right! I think I saw RedVegiemon with black energy! It must have the Black Cogwheels! Go and get me one.
_685.Objective: Collect 1 Black Cogwheels fragment of RedVegiemon
_685.CompletionText: Maybe this Digimon is affected by the Black Cogwheels.
_685.CompletionSummary: Did you get it? What? This is also a fragment of Black Cogwheels? Then there's nothing different from report….

_686.Title: Lost Historic site
_686.Description: Yes! SuperStarmon is near the river below. He is in corner but very bright about information. Get more fragments of Black Cogwheels and speak with SuperStarmon. He might know something.
_686.Objective: Collect 5 Black Cogwheels fragments and give to SuperStarmon
_686.CompletionText: SuperStarmon has good hearing. Go find him.
_686.CompletionSummary: Why did you come to see me?

_687.Title: Lost Historic site
_687.Summary: Master Investigator? Reclusive Digimon bright for Rumors?
_687.Description:
Have I heard about Digimons became violent? Yes, I already knew that. Why I did not tell anyone? Why should I? This area around me is so peaceful.
So, you came to see me for information? With nothing?
Huh, you are not aware of Give & Take. Recently Blossomons are increased and became loud. Go defeat some of them .
What are you doing? Hurry up!
_687.CompletionText: You don’t want information? Then just go.
_687.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. It's quiet now.
Then let's start to talk.

_688.Title: Lost Historic site
_688.Description:
Did you see while you are coming up to here? Digimons in File Island became violent. The phenomenon started not long ago. I believe that this started to happen after you humans came to File Island. I just assume like that…
Ah.. I don't blame or hate you humans, so no worries. I think your potential ability threatens the Digimon which created that Black Cogwheels.
There is a Ruins across the river. You can find out about ancient legend if you go there. It might tell about your potential ability in detail.
That's all I know. Return to Starmon and tell what I told you.
Right, Leomon just walked by. Leomon is a nice Digimon. If you have more questions, go ask Leomon.
_688.CompletionText: Return to SuperStarmon and tell this.
_688.CompletionSummary: Really?! Your appearance and Bad Digimons' behaviors…. I am sure that Bad Digimons are afraid of you!!

_689.Title: Lost Historic site
_689.Description: Emergency Contact! Yukidarumon is in danger! Yukidarumon is a Digimon collecting trees around here. I did not hear details yet. Go talk to Yukidarumon now!
_689.CompletionText: What are you doing? Hurry up!

_690.Title: Lost Historic site
_690.Description: I'm sorry… I can't talk right now because my heart is pita patting…. I think it will calm down if I listen to Gewappamon's song and smell Blossomon's flower. Will you get those for me…?
_690.Objective: 1 Headset of Gawappamon and 5 Flowers of Blossomon
_690.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Can you talk to me again after I calm down?

_691.Title: Lost Historic site
_691.Description:
Um… Now I feel calmed down… Have you seen Leomon while you walk here? Ah.. You didn't…
You already know that Leomons are nice Digimons, right? But the ones I saw a moment ago were different… They were running with mad eyes and mumbling something… Defeat children interfering our purpose....'
Something must happened to Leomon. I don't know the detail. Cherrymon might have seen Leomons too.
Go talk to Cherrymon. It will tell you about Leomon and more details.
_691.CompletionText: Go to Cherrymon. I need to calm down.
_691.CompletionSummary: Yes. I also saw Leomon. It has black energy around. Can you tell me what had happened on the way here?

_692.Title: Lost Historic site
_692.Description:
Cherrymons also became violent here. Black Cogwheels are the cause of their viciousness…
Remove Black Cogwheels from them and get 5 fragments for me.
_692.Objective: Collect 5 Black Cogwheels fragment of Cherrymon
_692.CompletionText: Bring me the Black Cogwheels embedded in Cherrymon.
_692.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This won't solve the problem, but it will get better.

_693.Title: Lost Historic site
_693.Description:
A legend tells that there is an ancient document containing ancient digimon's prophecy. We call is the Ancient Document of Legend, but never seen it before. According to the legend, Mammothmon, the digimon who was with the birth of Digital World, has the document.
Could you get the Ancient Document of Legend from Mammothmon Captain?
_693.CompletionText: The biggest Mammothmon lived for the longest time. That Digimon seems to have the most possibility…
_693.CompletionSummary:
Oh, this is it. I have never seen it before…
Wait a minute here. I will read it once….

_694.Title: Lost Historic site
_694.Description:
Damn…. The book is sealed itself. We can get the ancient document by ourselves, but not able to open….
I think it is out of my capability. Jijimon is over there. Go talk to him.
_694.Objective: Give sealed Ancient Documents of Legend to Jijimon
_694.ObjectiveProgress: Give sealed ancient documents of Legend to Jijimon
_694.CompletionText: Jijimon knows a lot of things. He must know how to open the ancient document.
_694.CompletionSummary: Ancient Documents? I see the ancient document I only heard about for the first time. But we can't see it because it is sealed?

_695.Title: Lost Historic site
_695.Description:
I am not sure if it can unseal the Ancient document, but I have a method.
I need some materials from Digimons… Firstly, get Crystal of Wisdom from Mammothmon and Magic Wand of Wizardmon.
_695.Objective: Collect 5 Crystal of Wisdom and 5 Magic Wand of Wizardmon
_695.CompletionText: I will prepare while you are gone to get materials.
_695.CompletionSummary: Nice work. Step aside, I need to use my spell.

_696.Title: Lost Historic site
_696.Description:
Done! The book is opened! Let's read for a while…
Oh….right… Hmm…..
I will summarize it for you, wait a second.
_696.CompletionText: I am organizing in my head. Wait a minute.
_696.CompletionSummary: The Ruins contains the secret to make you, Chosen Children, more powerful. The reason why the Ruins was separated into two continents is to prevent Bad Digimons from blocking your power. But then I think Bad Digimons are now trying to jump ahead of us.

_697.Title: Lost Historic site
_697.Description: Tell this to Babamon. Also tell her what had happened until now. File Island is facing a huge crisis!
_697.CompletionSummary: That's what happened… Now what happened here seems to fit each other…

_698.Title: Lost Historic site
_698.Description:
I kind of guessed that. Waspmons and Dokugumons in this area became vicious, too.
I have an ability to feel Digimon's energy.
Bring me Black Cogwheel fragments of Waspmon and Dokugumon. I believe that I am more accurate than explorer's Ruins Composition Analysis kit, I can figure out who's behind this.
_698.Objective: Collect 5 Black Cogwheel fragments of Arachnemon, 5 Black Cogwheel fragments of Waspmon
_698.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Arachnemon's Black Cogwheels Fragment%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Waspmon's Black Cogwheels Fragment%qe %cc2/%mc2
_698.CompletionText: Digimons are more violent closer to the Ruins.
_698.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. I feel bad mind raises just by holding the fragment of Black Cogwheels…
Could you give me a little time? I need to concentrate…

_699.Title: Lost Historic site
_699.Description:
Devimon? This is Devimon's energy! I can't be sure but I felt Devimon's energy. A champion Digimon could show this much power….
We need to stop this right now!! Let remaining explorer around the Ruins about this! They are in danger!
_699.CompletionText: We have no time to spare! Go on!
_699.CompletionSummary: What? Is that true? I saw Leomons moving towards the Ruins… But they were controlled by Devimon's power…

_700.Title: Lost Historic site
_700.Description:
Tentomon is out to Entrance of Ruins for investigation! But I can approach because Digmons are raving around…
It will be quite if we can defeat Digmons. Please defeat Digmons and tell Tentomon to evacuate!
_700.CompletionSummary: Evacuate to a safe place? Digmon s are behind and Leomons are in front. I can't move at all~

_701.Title: Lost Historic site
_701.Description:
Leomon is wandering around the Entrance of Ruins. I can't see well here, so I am not sure what they are doing.
Do you see a huge tree over there? Can you check Leomon's movement on the tree with telescope?
_701.Objective: Use telescope where Leomon can be seen
_701.CompletionSummary: They are not able to enter the Ruins? That might be the reason why they are waiting for you so desperately.

_702.Title: Lost Historic site
_702.Description: There must be a reason why Leomon cannot enter the Ruins. Babamon might know about it. Speak with Babamon!
_702.CompletionText: Babamon knows a lot of things~
_702.CompletionSummary: Leomon cannot go into the entrance of Ruins? Some power must block them….

_703.Title: Lost Historic site
_703.Description:
Now is the chance! Leomons are wandering around, show your power! Once Leomon recovers its spirit back, Leomon will be your great supporter.
Did you knot that Leomon is Fire Attribute? If you attack Leomon with Water Attribute Digimon, it will be much easier to win.
It might be hard if you go alone, take other Chosen Children with you!
_703.CompletionText: Remember. Fire Attribute Leomon is weak at Water Attribute Digimons.
_703.CompletionSummary: Leomon ran away? Anyways, good job.

_704.Title: Lost Historic site
_704.Description:
Have you been to shore? Not the shore in Real World. Shore of File Island is very famous for resting place.
However, Black Cogwheels energy is affecting Digimons of the shore. Speak with Gawappamon at the shore to solve problems they have.
_704.CompletionText: Black Cogwheels are affecting all over the File Island…
_704.CompletionSummary: Welcome. You are new to the shore, right?

_705.Title: Lost Historic site
_705.Description:
Well… Could you do me a favor?
I love….no..like my senior explorer Lopmon. Collect flowers on Palmon's head and give to Lopmon!
_705.CompletionSummary: What is this? Terriermon sent it?

_706.Title: Lost Historic site
_706.Description:
I understand Terriermon's mind. But we are just good friends.
Unless Terriermon become more mature explorer.
For that reason, I will give some work. Gotsumon's rock skin is deeply related to stonecomposition from the Ruins. Collect 5 rock pieces of Gotsumon and give to Terriermon.
_706.CompletionText: Just a good junior colleague yet.
_706.CompletionSummary: Is this the answer of Lopmon? Yeah! I will become a great explorer as he expected! +ㅅ+

_707.Title: Lost Historic site
_707.Description:
Palmons became violent, so we are short of fruits. Residents of Lost Historic Site are having hard time since they don't have enough food.
Give 5 delicious fruits to Chuchidarumon. Palmon has the fruits.

_708.Title: Lost Historic site
_708.Description:
Did you see the size of Chuchidarumons? It will only survive one day with 5 delicious fruits.
If you pass here everyday, give 5 delicious fruits to Chuchidarumon.
Palmon has the fruits.

_709.Title: Lost Historic site
_709.Description:
Thanks to you, I had a good meal! Ah, I also have a favor to ask.
I don’t look like but I am really good at flower arranging. Palmons became violent and Gotsumons became more prank, so I can't do flower arranging nowadays.
Scold Palmon Leader and Gotsumon Leader!
_709.Objective: Defeat 5 Palmon Leaders Defeat 5 Gotsumon Leaders
_709.CompletionText: It will be better when leaders become quiet.
_709.CompletionSummary: Now I can do flower arranging peacefully. Flower arranging needs quiet circumstance and calm mind!

_710.Title: Lost Historic site
_710.Description:
I am trying to concentrate on flower arranging, but Palmon and Gotsumon are getting loud again!
Indeed… they won't stay one day quiet!
Give a scolding once again!
_710.Objective: Defeat 5 Palmon Leaders Defeat 5 Gotsumon Leaders
_710.CompletionText: It will be better when leaders become quiet.
_710.CompletionSummary: Now I can do flower arranging peacefully. Flower arranging needs quiet circumstance and calm mind!

_711.Title: Lost Historic site
_711.Description:
Smell of RedVegiemon won't go away….
Defeat 10 RedVegiemons and 5 RedVegiemon Leaders.
_711.CompletionText: My head aches so badly because of RedVegiemon's smell…
_711.CompletionSummary: Thank you! If you have time, keep helping me.

_712.Title: Lost Historic site
_712.Summary: Go round the Lost Historic Site 1
_712.Description:
I've collected some information.. A lot of Digimons are affected by the Black Cogwheels all around Lost Historic Site. I need you to defeat them.
Firstly, left continent where I am. Here we have Palmon, RedVegiemon and Cherrymon.
Defeat them first.
_712.Objective: Defeat Palmon fruit Predator Defeat RedVegiemon Disgusting Smell Defeat Cherrymon Rotten tree
_712.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Palmon Predator of Fruit%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2RedVegiemon Disgusting Smell%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Cherrymon Rotten Tree%qe %cc3/%mc3
_712.CompletionText: I am asking you because I trust you guys.
_712.CompletionSummary:
Thank you! But you already feel that this is not the end, huh? These ones will appear constantly and tease Digimons until the Black Cogwheels is banished.
I need your constant help. See you tomorrow.

_713.Title: Lost Historic site
_713.Description:
Leomons are wandering around, show your power! Once Leomon recovers its spirit back, Leomon will be your great supporter.
Did you knot that Leomon is Fire Attribute? If you attack Leomon with Water Attribute Digimon, it will be much easier to win.
It might be hard if you go alone, take other Chosen Children with you!
_713.CompletionText: Remember. Fire Attribute Leomon is weak at Water Attribute Digimon.
_713.CompletionSummary: Leomon ran away? Anyways, good job.

_714.Title: Lost Historic site
_714.Description:
I've been thinking…. If I want to keep studying here, I need to find a way to remove the smell of RedVegiemon!
Get me Blossomon's petals first. Blossomon smells good, so it should ease the smell of RedVegiemon.
_714.CompletionSummary: Good. Let's grind these petals to make concentrated liquid…

_715.Title: Lost Historic site
_715.Description:
Here it is! Use this where RedVegiemons are.
They will fall into good smell and they will smell good too!
_715.Objective: Use Blossomon's petal concentrate in Stinky Forest
_715.ObjectiveProgress: Use Blossomon's petal concentrate in Stinky Forest

_716.Title: Lost Historic site
_716.Description:
What!! My plan was perfect….! There must be another way!
Chuchidarumon's hobby is flower arranging, he must know well about flowers. Then he must know the solution!
Ask Chuchidarumon!
_716.CompletionSummary: Do you want to know how to remove smell of RedVegiemon?

_717.Title: Lost Historic site
_717.Description:
Palmon has flower on its head, so it is very good at photosynthesis. It smells good, too.
I think Palmon's petal would work. Get 3 petals of Palmon and go to Starmon.
_717.CompletionText: Palmon's petal is wide. 3 will be enough.
_717.CompletionSummary: Oh! Is that so? Then I will make concentrate with this.

_718.Title: Lost Historic site
_718.Description:
Okay! Take this and use it where RedVegiemons are gathered!
This time I am sure!
_718.Objective: Use Palmon's petal concentrate in Stinky Forest
_718.ObjectiveProgress: Use Palmon's petal concentrate in Stinky Forest
_718.CompletionSummary:
RedVegiemons are gathered on the area where concentrate is spread? Hmm.. It's not perfect, but still successful. Why? At lease RedVegiemons are not spreading it smell around!
All right! I can now investigate the Ruins comfortably.

_719.Title: Lost Historic site
_719.Description:
I will be bored after you leave. What can I do if I am bored? Fighting with Babamon!
I wrote a duel request, give it to Babamon.
_719.CompletionText: Huhuhu! I am not going to lose this time!
_719.CompletionSummary: Duel request~?! I need to prepare, then!

_720.Title: Lost Historic site
_720.Description: My broomstick is old and need to fix. Can you get me 3 wooden fragment of Cherrymon and 5 hairs of Mammothmon?
_720.Objective: Collect 3 wooden fragments of Cherrymon and 5 hairs of Mammothmon
_720.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Attack has been increased because of you… Jijimon would never know how much I prepared. Hohoho!

_721.Title: Lost Historic site
_721.Description: Give this box to Jijimon. He will be surprised!! Hohohoho~
_721.CompletionText: You are curious about the box. Jijimon will be surprised hohoho~
_721.CompletionSummary:
Babamon gave me this? Let's open it… What!!
My wand! Babamon is the best! She still loves me so much haha!

_722.Title: Lost Historic site
_722.Description:
The continent where Lost Historic Site is located was the huge Ruins in the past. There are lots of traces of Ruins behind me.
I'm done with collecting samples, but I need to move stone fragment from the Ruins for thorough investigation…
Is there any method to move them? Can you ask Jijimon?
_722.CompletionText: I can't think of good methods.
_722.CompletionSummary: You need to move stone pieces of the Ruins? Hmm… I need to think.

_723.Title: Lost Historic site
_723.Description: Right! Use spiderweb of Dokugumon! Spiderweb of Dokugumon is very durable, it is better than normal net. Take 5 Spiderwebs of Dokugumon to Babamon. Babamon will make a net for you.
_723.CompletionSummary: Do you want me to make a net? Wait a minute.

_724.Title: Lost Historic site
_724.Description: Here you are. Take it. It would hold any kind of things sufficiently since I made it huge.
_724.CompletionSummary:
A net made from spider web of Arachnemon! Why I haven't thought about it! Jijimon and Babamon are so great!
Thank you! I will put stone pieces of the Ruins here.

_725.Title: Lost Historic site
_725.Description:
Uh… so heavy! Okay! Take this to Starmon in front of Babamon.
Is it too heavy to carry? I heard humans are strong, you are not weak one, aren't you? I do believe in you~
_725.Objective: Give Stone Fragment from the Ruins to Starmon
_725.ObjectiveProgress: Give Stone Fragment from the Ruins to Starmon
_725.CompletionSummary: Oh! Thanks! It must be hard, good job~!

_726.Title: Lost Historic site
_726.Description:
Uh… so heavy! Okay! Take this to Starmon in front of Babamon.
Is it too heavy to carry? I heard humans are strong, you are not weak one, aren't you? I do believe in you~
_726.Objective: Give Stone Fragment from the Ruins to Starmon
_726.ObjectiveProgress: Give Stone Fragment from the Ruins to Starmon
_726.CompletionSummary: Oh! Thanks! It must be hard, good job~!

_727.Title: Lost Historic site
_727.Description:
I've learned how to make a net from Babamon! Hahaha!! But I am short of materials...
Could you get me 7 spider webs of Dokugumons? I am not skilled, so I might need more…
_727.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I will make a net and put stone pieces of the Ruins in.

_728.Title: Lost Historic site
_728.Description: You see here? These are flowers and trees I am growing. But Waspmons are coming after good smell of flowers! I want to kick them out but I am too short and small to do that. Will you get rid of Waspmons for me?
_728.CompletionSummary: Now it's quiet here~ I need to make an alternative to stop them from teasing.

_729.Title: Lost Historic site
_729.Description:
I got an idea! Make a scarecrow!! Hahaha! I am a genius!
I need some materials~ Hat of Wizardmon, hair of Mammothmon, and wooden fragment of Cherrymon. Get me materials, then I will make it!
_729.Objective: Collect 1 Wizardmon's hat, 5 Mammothmon's Fur, and 5 Cherrymon's Wooden fragments
_729.CompletionText: Get me 1 hat of Wizardmon, 5 Furs of Mammothmon, and 5 wooden fragments of Cherrymon.
_729.CompletionSummary: Now, Waspmons will not gather around the flowers, right?

_730.Title: Lost Historic site
_730.Description:
It's good to make scarecrows…. But scarecrows are breaking by flying Waspmons…
I need more scarecrow materials! Get me 3 hat of Wizardmon, 10 hair of Mammothmon, and 10 wooden fragment of Cherrymon.
_730.Objective: Collect 3 Wizardmon's hat, 10 Mammothmon's Fur, and 10 Cherrymon's Wooden fragments
_730.CompletionText: I need more materials to prepare in advance.
_730.CompletionSummary: I feel relieved by having enough materials.

_731.Title: Lost Historic site
_731.Summary: [Daily] Go round the Lost Historic Site 2
_731.Description: Digimons affected by Black Cogwheels are all around Lost Historic Site. Much more numbers are located in Lost Historic Site . There are Mammothmon, Wizardmon, Dokugumon,Waspmon.
_731.Objective: Defeat Mammothmon Defeat Wizardmon Defeat Dokugumon Defeat Waspmon
_731.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mammothmon Trace of Legend%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Wizardmon the Star Chaser%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3 Arachnemon the Spoiled Spider%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Waspmon Guards of Queen bee%qe %cc4/%mc4
_731.CompletionText: There are Digimons with special energy. Defeat them.
_731.CompletionSummary: Nice job. But this is not the end. They will appear constantly until the Black Cogwheels is banished.

_732.Title: Lost Historic site
_732.Description:
As you know, flowers and stones always go together. But some do not understand this. Palmon and Gotsumon.
These two fights everyday. Will they recover if they get scolding? Scold Palmon and Gotsumon.
_732.CompletionText: Will you wake up after beaten?

_733.Title: Lost Historic site
_733.Description: Hmm… maybe leaders should be scolded? Scold 3 Palmon Leaders and 3 Gotsumon Leaders.
_733.Objective: Defeat 3 Palmon Leaders Defeat 3 Gotsumon Leaders
_733.CompletionText: Will you wake up after beaten?
_733.CompletionSummary: What? Is rather gathering around more?

_734.Title: Lost Historic site
_734.Description:
I think the source of problem is Captains.
Try to talk with Captains to reconcile. If talking doesn't work, fight them.
_734.Objective: Defeat Palmon Captain Defeat Gotsumon Captain
_734.CompletionText: If you do not listen, I need to use force to make you listen.
_734.CompletionSummary: Now it's calmed down? That's good. But still we don’t understand. This Digimon we can't do anything about it.

_735.Title: Lost Historic site
_735.Description:
I can't let them like this anymore. Keep persuading Captains.
You know already that you can use physical force.
_735.Objective: Defeat Palmon Captain Defeat Gotsumon Captain
_735.CompletionText: If you do not listen, I need to use force to make you listen.
_735.CompletionSummary: We need to persuade everyday… You got to work on this.

_736.Title: Lost Historic site
_736.Description:
I know Starmon will feel this, but this place smells really bad smell! But I don't see any method to fix this except getting rid of RedVegiemon.
Ah! I think if we defeat larger ones, then bad smell would go away! Defeat RedVegiemon Captains!!
_736.CompletionText: Large RedVegiemons must have large smell pocket, right?

_737.Title: Lost Historic site
_737.Description:
I think rather than Captain, the Black Cogwheels are the major culprit!
Defeat the biggest RedVegiemon, RedVegiemon Disgusting smell having the Black Cogwheels!
_737.CompletionText: It will be hard if you go alone. Prepare well!
_737.CompletionSummary:
It does seem to have a little effect…. I think I should be satisfied just for this..
I want to go back to the Explorer camp as soon as possible~

_738.Title: Lost Historic site
_738.Summary: [Daily] In Search of the Source of Smell
_738.Description:
When huge RedVegiemons were gone, less smell occurred.
I need to eliminate those huge RedVegiemons constantly. Will you help?
_738.Objective: Defeat RedVegiemon Captain Defeat RedVegiemon's disgusting smell
_738.CompletionText: Smell fades away when large RedVegiemons disappear.
_738.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I need to be satisfied with this..

_739.Title: Lost Historic site
_739.Description:
I was fishing here. I often handed out fish to Gawappomon near the lake.
One day, Gawappamons became violent and occupied the lake. Let them know the lake is everyone's!
_739.CompletionText: Gawappamon and Gawappamon Leaders! Really bad!
_739.CompletionSummary: Made fun of you while dancing? What a jerks!

_740.Title: Lost Historic site
_740.Description:
Um…. I think the one pushed me away and took over the lake and is huge Captain.
Scold the Captain and tell him to return the lake!
_740.CompletionSummary: Is it okay now? Can I fish?

_741.Title: Lost Historic site
_741.Description:
Gawappamons calmed down a bit, but they still covet the lake.
Beat Gawappamons down to give up!
_741.CompletionText: Gawappamon and Gawappamon Leaders! Really bad!
_741.CompletionSummary: Thank you. They must be regretting a little, don’t they?

_742.Title: Lost Historic site
_742.Description:
We, Cherrymons, grow bigger with digitalized nutrient of ground. However, those huge Mammothmons are trampling on grounds making us impossible to get nutrients and interfering trees to grow.
Can you reduce the number of Mammothmons?
_742.CompletionText: Trampling around with those huge feet…
_742.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Now new Cherrymons with no Black Cogwheels will grow.

_743.Title: Lost Historic site
_743.Description:
It is good to have ne Cherrymons grow, but I believe the Black Cogwheels energy is passing to other Digimons.
It seems to go thru by rotten trees.
Will you defeat Rotten trees?
_743.CompletionText: We need to stop Rotten trees from spreading.
_743.CompletionSummary: I hope peaces comes soon for the Ruins…

_744.Title: Lost Historic site
_744.Description:
I am studying about the reason why the Ruins are built here. Among them, I am analyzing the movement of sky and stars.
I need to study about the movement of stars, but Wizardmon is interfering my research.
Will you negotiate with Wizardmons? I think there is nothing we can do about wizards since their spirit and will is stubborn.
_744.CompletionText: Giving physical impact is a good method when talking does not work.
_744.CompletionSummary: What? Wizardmon was also a researcher of the stars?

_745.Title: Lost Historic site
_745.Description:
Fortunately, we've got a little bit of earning. But information explorers have is not enough.
Will you ask Jijimon? Jijimon keeps asking me to fight when he sees me~
_745.CompletionText: Ask Jijimon who knows a lot.
_745.CompletionSummary:
Wizardmons?
They were once a researchers studying stars with magic. But one day, they occupied the place where stars can be seen leaving all researches behind.

_746.Title: Lost Historic site
_746.Description:
I guess bad energy has merged into Wizardmons.
Wizardmon Captain was very calm. We always talked and played. Well…. I sometimes fight with him for no reason. HuhHuh!
Hmmhmm.. Anyways! Go for Wizardmon Captain.
Take care of yourself if Wizardmon Captain is also violent!
_746.CompletionText: Take care of yourself if Wizardmon Captain is also violent!
_746.CompletionSummary: Captains got violent, too? Huh…. Too bad….

_747.Title: Lost Historic site
_747.Description:
I need to let Starmon know about this.
Return to Starmon.
_747.CompletionText: Where are you going? Its beside me.
_747.CompletionSummary: Bad energy is also affecting Wizardmons…

_748.Title: Lost Historic site
_748.Description:
I can't wait! I should move to where I can see the stars!
There is a big Ruins in the middle of vacant lot where Wizardmons are. That's where stars were seen really clearly in the past.
Could you find out what's happening over there?
_748.Objective: Explore where stars can be seen
_748.CompletionText: It is where trees and huge Ruins are.
_748.CompletionSummary: What? There is a Wizardmon covered with Black energy?

_749.Title: Lost Historic site
_749.Description:
I think we should defeat Wizardmons with black energy to prevent other Wizardmons from being affected.
More and more Digimons are affected by black energy… I'm concerned…
Anyways, I'm asking you!
_749.CompletionText: Defeat Wizardmon the Star chaser with the black energy.
_749.CompletionSummary: When will peace come to the Ruins…. Is there any other method except letting everything on your hand…….?

_750.Title: Lost Historic site
_750.Description:
Wizardmons with black energy keeps showing up. This is really dangerous…
I need your help!
_750.CompletionText: Defeat Wizardmon the Star chaser with the black energy.
_750.CompletionSummary: When will peace come to the Ruins…. Is there any other method except letting everything on your hand…….?

_751.Title: Lost Historic site
_751.Description:
You guys! You didn't get tired already while you come up here, did you? If you are already, you have weak mind!!
Musyamon is well-known for will!
Firstly, would you like to spar with Musyamon to feel how strong they are?
_751.CompletionText: Musyamon has a strong will. Sure~ he is~
_751.CompletionSummary:
Musyamons call their captain as Lord. They are willing to sacrifice their lives for their Lord.
Are you willing to do the same for the peace of File Island?

_752.Title: Lost Historic site
_752.Description: When Lord is in danger, Musyamons near will rush towards you. Defeat all of them!
_752.Objective: Defeat 10 Musyamon Leaders Defeat 1 Musyamon Captain
_752.CompletionText: Defeat all of them, and you will grow one step further.
_752.CompletionSummary:
What about this! Did you see will of warriors? Do not forget this mind and will and go forward!
And bring peace back to the File Island!

_753.Title: Lost Historic site
_753.Description:
What's wrong? Your will is weakened and need practice?
Then spar with Musyamon Captain and Musyamon Leaders. Musyamons are always ready.
_753.Objective: Defeat 10 Musyamon Leaders Defeat 1 Musyamon Captain
_753.CompletionText: Defeat all of them, and you will grow one step further.
_753.CompletionSummary:
What about this! Did you see will of warriors? Do not forget this mind and will and go forward!
And bring peace back to the File Island!

_754.Title: Lost Historic site
_754.Description:
Oh my waist…. Could you please help me out? My waist hurt a lot since I am analyzing components of ground near the Ruins by bending my waist…
Waspmon's sting works really good for waist, can you get me some?
_754.CompletionText: Wasp's sting is know for its good effect on File Island.
_754.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. Put this on waist~!
Ha~ Cool~ Much better~

_755.Title: Lost Historic site
_755.Description:
Well, I asked for Waspmon's sting not just because of my health. There is a secret reason for!
Do you see that? That huge Waspmon with black energy! That Waspmon is occupying the Ruins, so I can't investigate!!
I want to give a scold to him, but I can't do anything with my power. Then I thought of one way!
That is to give sting shot on Waspmon! Do you want to use sting on Waspmon Captain to test?
_755.Objective: Use Waspmon's Stinger on Waspmon Captain
_755.ObjectiveProgress: Use Waspmon's Stinger on Waspmon Captain
_755.CompletionSummary: What? They are really pissed and flying around?

_756.Title: Lost Historic site
_756.Description:
This seems hard….. I thought it might work a little bit at least, but no effect…….
Then! Let's just beat them! What? Too stupid?
Attack is the best defense. You heard of it. Attack ahead when Waspmons are relieved after settlement!
_756.Objective: Defeat Guards of Waspmon's queen bee
_756.CompletionText: I cannot help but this seems to be the answer. Cheer up!
_756.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I think I can go over there and concentrate on my research!

_757.Title: Lost Historic site
_757.Description:
Oh my god! This irritating Waspmon larvae! It drives me crazy!
Can you remove these larvae first?
_757.CompletionText: I can’t concentrate since it is whirling around in front of my eyes!
_757.CompletionSummary:
Phew~ I feel relieved now…
Why do Waspmons gather around me? Because it's the season for me to have fruits~ Sweet smell of fruits is attracting Waspmons, I guess.

_758.Title: Lost Historic site
_758.Description:
I guess the reason why Waspmon's larvae are running around because grown-up Waspmons do not take care of them.
Well, they are not educating children properly!
Give Waspmons a scolding!
_758.CompletionSummary: It is not because of Waspmon and Waspmon Leaders?

_759.Title: Lost Historic site
_759.Description:
What? You saw young Waspmons flying around Waspmon with black energy?
Right! It's all because of that! I need to scold it!
Hey you! Go blow them over!
_759.Objective: Defeat Guards of Waspmon's queen bee
_759.CompletionText: Guards of Waspmon's Queen bee were taking care of Waspmons larvae!
_759.CompletionSummary: Thank you! It should be quiet now, right?

_760.Title: Lost Historic site
_760.Description:
Number of Waspmon's larvae around me has reduced, but still, I see some having eye on fruits.
I can see that control is not perfect yet! More scolding!
_760.Objective: Defeat Guards of Waspmon's queen bee
_760.CompletionText: There's a saying that what's learned in the cradle is carried to the grave...Tut Tut!
_760.CompletionSummary: Guards of Waspmon Queen bee! How much scolding do they need to wake up~!

_761.Title: Lost Historic site
_761.Description:
Other explorers will come here since Leomon became quiet, but we have bigger problem.
Digmons are digging up and overturning the ground. Give them a scolding not to overturn the ground!
_761.CompletionText: It's covering the ground and damaging historical Ruins~!
_761.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Damage on the Ruins gives me a lot of tears..

_762.Title: Lost Historic site
_762.Description:
Woo~ Why is there so many Digmons here?
I was going to return to report what had happened here, but I can't move a step forward because of Digmons!
I can't take it anymore! Eliminate all of them so that I won’t see them!
_762.CompletionText: It's covering the ground and damaging historical Ruins~!
_762.CompletionSummary: I really appreciate it! Sample of Ruins and report are too heavy. I can’t fly with those….

_763.Title: Lost Historic site
_763.Description:
In this Lost Historic Site, Guardian Mystimon was here to protect this Ruins from long time ago.
But it not a guardian anymore! As you felt, it tries to attack first!
We will become true guardians of the Ruins. Defeat Mystimons!
_763.Objective: Defeat 10 Mystimon the Guard of Ruins
_763.CompletionText: Mystimon has become an abuser wearing a mask of Guardian.
_763.CompletionSummary: We will become true guardians protecting and preserving the Ruins!

_764.Title: Lost Historic site
_764.Description:
I am SuperStarmon. I heard you are learning about Attribute. Do you know about Earth Attribute? Earth Digimon in this Ruins is Gotsumon. You can earn Earth Attribute point when you defeat them, and create Element Crystal Data when point is full.
Collect Attribute point after defeating 15 Gotsumons.
One more thing! Earth Attribute is weak at Wood Attribute. If you fight with Wood Digimon, battle will be easier. Remember that!
_764.CompletionText: In order to create crystal data of Earth Attribute, you need to defeat Earth Attribute Digimons first.
_764.CompletionSummary: Good job. You are following more than I thought.

_765.Title: Lost Historic site
_765.Description:
I am SuperStarmon. Do you know about Wood Attribute? Wood Digimon in this Ruins are Palmon, RedVegiemon, Blossomon and Cherrymon. You can earn Wood Attribute point when you defeat them, and create Element Crystal Data when point is full.
RedVegiemon is the easy one, so collect Attribute point from RedVegiemons!
One more thing! Wood Attribute is weak at Wind Attribute. If you fight with Wood Digimon, battle will be easier. Remember that!
_765.CompletionText: In order to create crystal data of Wood Attribute, you need to defeat Wood Attribute Digimons first.
_765.CompletionSummary: Good job. You are following more than I thought.

_766.Title: Lost Historic site
_766.Summary: [Attribute] Your name is Wind, Wind, Wind
_766.Description:
I am SuperStarmon. Do you know about Wind Attribute? Wind Digimon in this Ruins is Waspmon. You can earn Wind Attribute point when you defeat them, and create Element Crystal Data when point is full.
Collect Attribute point after defeating 15 Waspmons.
One more thing! Wind Attribute is weak at Earth Attribute. If you fight with Earth Digimon, battle will be easier. Remember that!
_766.CompletionText: In order to create crystal data of Wind Attribute, you need to defeat Earth Attribute Digimons first.
_766.CompletionSummary:
Good. Now you've learned everything about elemental attribute.
If you realize relation between Attribute, you will be able to give more damage to stronger Digimons.
My teaching ends here. Please keep the peace of File Island.

_767.Title: Infinite Mountain
_767.Description:
Digimons on Infinite Mountain are ones thrown away after final Black Cogwheels experiment of Devimon failed.
Devimon…! It is a truly brutal Digimon!
Remove all imperfect Black Cogwheels embedded on Digimons at the Infinite Mountain.
_767.CompletionSummary: Poor Digimons… I will make an item to defeat Devimon with imperfect Black Cogwheels you gathered!

_768.Title: Infinite Mountain
_768.Description:
You're finally here. If you go in there, there's a dungeon that Devimon is waiting.
If you give me Infinite Mountain Gateway and I'll open a gate to enter the dungeon.
There are Kuwagamon, Meramon, Ogremon, Leomon, and Monochromon inside the dungeon.
Be careful and tell me when you're ready!
_768.CompletionText: Protect the peace of File Island
_768.CompletionSummary: It's time to restore peace to File Island!

_769.Title: Infinite Mountain
_769.Description: Infinite Mountain is where you can look every scenery of File Island. But as you see now, it is devastated….
_769.CompletionSummary: I can never forgive Devimon! I cannot show dark future to young Digimons at Village of the Beginning!

_770.Title: Infinite Mountain
_770.Description:
Did you get Devimon Summon Card by defeating Ogremon?
If you use the card in the central hall magic circle, Devimon will appear.
Devimon is strong.. I don't want to admit it! So we need the power of Angemon..! Bring me Angemon's Feather! Go to Angemon on the left and get Angemon's feather I'm sure it will help you to defeat Devimon.
_770.CompletionText: Keep the peace of File Island!
_770.CompletionSummary:
It's the final battle now!
All Digimons in File Island wish you a victory!!

_771.Title: Infinite Mountain
_771.Description:
There are so many Digimons that become Devimon's minions..
There are Kuwagamon, Meramon, Ogremon, Leomon, and Monochromon inside the dungeon.
It'll be difficult to get to Devimon if you don't get rid of them!
_771.Objective: Defeat Kuwagamon (Raid) Defeat Monochromon (Raid) Defeat Spoiled Leomon (Raid) Defeat Meramon (Raid) Defeat Ogremon (Raid)
_771.CompletionText: Keep the peace of File Island!

_772.Title: Infinite Mountain
_772.Description:
Did you get Devimon Summon Card by defeating Ogremon?
If you use the card in the central hall magic circle, Devimon will appear.
Thanks to you bringing Angemon's Feather, we'll be able to fight more easily!
Defeat Devimon!
_772.CompletionText: Keep the peace of File Island!
_772.CompletionSummary:
Finally, Peace came back to File Island.
We might be playing on Devimon's hands if you Chosen Children 's effort was not here.
Thank you!

_773.Title: <Event>
_773.Description:
Hm..Hm.. ..I.. prepared these.
White Day shall be full of love. And the expressions of love are gifts.
This might look similar with the clothing I gave you last time, but it has different effect. So use it well. Hm Hm.. I feel shy somehow.. Lastly
♥♥Happy White Day♥♥ (gesturing a heart with arms♥)
. .. ... .... Are you laughing right now? Keep your dignity or I will summon all the Dats agents in Digital World.. Hm.
You may leave.
_773.CompletionSummary: You are still here? Now leave. It's not easy to keep the peace of Digital World and the Real World.

_774.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_774.Description:
My, my. That Digimon you have! Why in the world are you taming such an evil Digimon, Culu?
TERRIBLE things will happen because of that Digimon and its extreme evilness! What's even scarier is the fact that your Digimon can (and might) evolve to a massive form.
Huh? You want to know how? I can't tell you, Culu!
_774.Objective: Talk to Akihiro Kurata in Snowman Village
_774.CompletionText: Don't you dare think I will let you know how, Culu.
_774.CompletionSummary: You, you… Did you know that your Digimon could evolve to an incredibly massive creature? I could tell you how…

_775.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_775.Description:
Let's take a look at your Digimon. Hmm. To evolve, we need some information.
Not just any info like other Digimons, I mean the very special information that allows it to 'merge' with another form.
You think you can defeat those SkullGreymons in Inifinite Ice Wall? The more, the better...
_775.CompletionText: Won't you just go to Frozen Grounds already and get me those SkullGreymon research data?
_775.CompletionSummary: Great! You've got a lot of them! Since SkullGreymon is part of Chimeramon's data, something 'good' will happen if I merged this with your Digimon…

_776.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_776.Description:
Hold on a sec. There is no reaction! Nothing happened after injecting Chimeramon's data! What is happening? Hmm, I think it's more serious than I thought. M..Millenniummon… might appear in Infinite Mountain...
I… I will stop helping you from here. You can do what the heck ever you want now!
_776.CompletionText: Is Millenniummon really making its appearance in the Digital World?
_776.CompletionSummary: Oh, my! It really happaned, Culu! Wait, what? You… already defeated… Millenniummon?

_777.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_777.Description:
Well, it seems like it's out of hands now. As you would know as well, there will be a massive chaos - literally, a MASSIVE chaos if Millenniummon appeared in the Digital World.
But, now that you have defeated Millenniummon, you are now officially qualified to gain my trust, Culu!
_777.CompletionText: Millenniummon is a very dangerous being! Make sure to handle it with care!
_777.CompletionSummary: I'm not sure if this is a good thing that I'm doing…

_778.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_778.Description:
What the heck is that weird-looking Digimon? I've never seen one like this. Seems like it can evolve, too, just like many other Digimons.
What? I can't tell you how to evolve this Digimon, Culu! It's certain nothing 'good' will come out as the result even if it evolves.
_778.Objective: Talk to Digimon Kaiser in Dark Tower Wasteland
_778.CompletionText: Don't you dare think I will let you know how, Culu.
_778.CompletionSummary: Heh… You're a lucky useless being to have that Digimon that I made. How are they? Are you feeling the powers yet?

_779.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_779.Description:
What? Chimeramon can evolve in a different way? Well, that bugs my curiosity. I will do some researches on Chimeramon's Digivolutions.
However, the only thing is that Chimeramon possesses relatively low power despite all its merged data. That being said, I am in need of some 'information' just for this Chimeramon. Go defeat Megadramons in Ruined Historic, do some research on their abilities, then report them back to me.
_779.CompletionText: What in the world do you think you're doing here, you useless being? Move your darn feet to Ruined Historc! … Now!
_779.CompletionSummary: Great, great… Seems like increasing Chimeramon's power abilities just as much as Megadramon's value will get the evolution going. Nice work, but you're still useless.

_780.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_780.Description:
Yikes! How could this even happen…? Oh, wait. You're still here - good, good. Let me tell you what happened. I injected Mugendramon's power data into your Chimeramon because Megadramon's data weren't enough.
The result? Well… It successfully evolved, but that pathetic creature just ran off without even noticing me, the mighty Digimon Kaiser. It seemed like it ran off into Infinite Mountain areas... but that's none of my business now!
_780.CompletionText: A Digimon that doesn't listen… It sickens me just by thinking of it. What it does is none of my interest, anyways.
_780.CompletionSummary: I sensed great evilness in Infinite Mountain. Was that you who defeated it, Culu??

_781.Title: Jogress [Millenniummon]
_781.Description:
Huh? It was 'Millenniummon' that appeared in Infinite Mountain? I was worried if it was, but it REALLY had to be Millenniummon.
There's no choice, Culu! I will teach you how to evolve, Culu!
_781.CompletionText: Millenniummon is a very dangerous being! Make sure to handle it with care!
_781.CompletionSummary: I'm not sure if this is a good thing that I'm doing…

_782.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_782.Description: Oh my god.' Mimi got mad at Izzy, who was only looking at the computer, so she chased Leomon and went into the secret ancient ruins! Tentomon tried to placate Mimi, but he followed her inside... I can't get inside to the historical site all alone, so please help me!
_782.Objective: Talk to Palmon at Lost Historic Site
_782.CompletionSummary: I nevere been to the Secret Ancient Ruins but I will tell you as much as I can.

_783.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_783.Description: Huh? Where did Mimi and Tentomon gone? And… what is this Huge black cogwheels ?
_783.Objective: Talk to Palmon at Ancient Ruins of Secret
_783.CompletionText: The secret ancient ruins are in the same digital world but in different dimensions. This could be your own space, or it could be a space with other friends connected to you. There are many unknown dangers …

_784.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_784.Description: Izzy find out where Mimi and Tentomon are located! But… Monsters are heading to that place right now! Tentamon is in danger! Go and help them quickly!!!
_784.CompletionText: Hope Tentomon and Mimi are safe…
_784.CompletionSummary: Oh, you finally found it! Thank you. I couldn't win by myself. But ... there's another problem. This ruin is also taken by Devimons.

_785.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_785.Description: Oh, and the friend you're looking for, it looks like she went into that maze. I saw Centalmon and the others chasing her. Follow the path of Digimon and you'll find your friend.
_785.Objective: Talk to Mimi at Lost Historic Site
_785.CompletionText: Roachmons made a room full of mess.
_785.CompletionSummary: Ah! Finally! You are here! What keep you so long~!!

_786.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_786.Description: This ruin was originally protected by Centalmon and Mystimon. Devimon made this place full of monsters by using Black cogwheels ... So... Centalmon came after us, and Mystimon tried to protect us, but he was forced by the black cogwheels and became a Monster. Meanwhile, I was separated from Mimi. Mystimon said Devimon would use his men to destroy the Ruins. Please defeat the Parasimon in the Dark Attribute Room for the revenge of Mystimon and the peace of Ancient Ruins.
_786.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. I found the Digicode while you were in fight. This will help to wake.

_787.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_787.Description:
There's Meramon here, too!
I guess there's Meramon here who hasn't woken up yet!
And, Izzy said that a DigiCode is in here also.
Please help them! I'll quickly investigate where the DigiCode is!
_787.CompletionSummary: I found it! Meramon seems okay now Now, let's find Mimi!

_788.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_788.Description: Hey! Yes, it's you! Come here. I'm in trouble now! I'll tell you what, I am the Digimon who lived here for a long time! Last time, PicoDevimon came and made my room mess up, but this time, the Roachmons suddenly stormed in and smashed my room and these ruins. Besides, he hides under a jar that where I go to sleep in, because you were you coming? It's all your fault, right? Right? I won't say anything else. There's a Roachmon over there right now do the Night watcher duty, and he's got a lever to hold the pot, so get them out of here!
_788.Objective: Obtain Lever by defeating Roachmon(Night Watcher). Summon Roachmon(Hidden Leader) and defeat at Lost Historic Site
_788.CompletionText: I only wanted to live quietly…
_788.CompletionSummary: Good! Now everything solved. Ah, of course, I will reward you. That I am the noble one. Here. Take this.

_789.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_789.Description: There's a Centalmon in the room... He became just as violent as any other Monsters! I tried to go back because I was scared, but I can't because it's a maze. So how did I get here? I don't know! I've been wandering around and I've come all the way here. Are you going to keep asking me questions? Scold Centalmon~ Hurry up!
_789.CompletionText: So Scared~ Hungrey~ Want to go Home~
_789.CompletionSummary:
I think Centalmon is awake now! Look over there. Waiting for you over there?
Thanks! I can get out of here comfortably now!

_790.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_790.Description: Why was I doing this? I remember meeting Leomon. What? Black cogwheels that make Digimon violent? So did you get rid of them by yourself? Thank you very much. But I don't think it's over yet. Leomon is going to the Holy Digivice Altar. Go ahead and stop him!
_790.CompletionText: To reach the Digivice Altar, you need to across this Portal.
_790.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Leomon escape but at least the Ancient Ruins is safe.

_791.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_791.Description: I remember that Ms.Mimi went this way. We need to be hurry before Mimi is dangerous! Hum…? I hear some strange sounds inside! Shall we go and check!?
_791.Objective: Move to The strange sound Place
_791.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to The strange sound place%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to the Owner of sound%qe %cc2/%mc2

_792.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_792.Description: Looks like you came for me as your Digimon has approached the path of evolution? But Digimon without good heart does not deserve my guidance, culu! If you still need my help, you should lead your Digimon to change his heart to a good heart, culu!
_792.CompletionText: Digimon without a good heart? I won't help, culu.
_792.CompletionSummary: Ha! I think I know why you came to me just by looking at your Digimon partner.

_793.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_793.Description: You must be finding clues to evolution? I'm capable to help you find the clue, but for a price of course, as always. This time, I'd like you to extract data out of Dokugumon in Lost Historic and bring it to me. Once you do that, I'll make sure you find that clue.
_793.CompletionSummary: Hey, you… wait a second! Do you know who I am? Or where I'm from?

_794.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_794.Description: I lost all my memory of the past and only the will to fight remains. But strangely, you don't make me want to fight you. So I'd like to ask you a favor to fight the Crowmon for me. I assume it will help me control my violence desire inside of me. To make it easier, I'll spare you a little of my spirit.
_794.Objective: Defeat Crowmon in File Island Waterfront
_794.CompletionText: Now, go and fight the Crowmons for me.
_794.CompletionSummary: So you've managed to defeat Dokugumon? But what is this? How did your Digimon change like that?

_795.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_795.Description: What is happening? Your Digimon's Virus energy is jumping to an enourmous stage! What have you done lately? He may become out-of-control! (Suddenly I hear someone calling for me)
_795.CompletionText: Wha…what are you doing here alone? (Someone is calling me)
_795.CompletionSummary: So is it really a Digimon affected by Black Digitron? (chuckles) If that is true, I have an advice to give you.
_795.ReservedText: What now? Should you become a nuisance?

_796.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_796.Description: Looks like you came for me as your Digimon has approached the path of evolution? But Digimon without good heart does not deserve my guidance, culu! If you still need my help, you should lead your Digimon to change his heart to a good heart, culu!
_796.Objective: Talk with Digimon Kaiser in Dark Tower Wasteland
_796.CompletionText: Digimon without a good heart? I won't help, culu.
_796.CompletionSummary: Why are you fools keep on asking me for help?

_797.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_797.Description: That Digimon can't be evolved with an ordinary mechanism you fool! However, you may begin to figure it out if you defeat some of the Rockmons… hmmph!
_797.Objective: Defeat Rockmon in Digimon Maze Enterance
_797.CompletionText: What are you waiting for? I told you what to do already.
_797.CompletionSummary: Stop right there! I can sence energy from you which is very similar to mine.

_798.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_798.Description: By looking at it carefully, seems to be slightly different. You look like you're looking for the path of evolution. Then will you receive some of my energy? To fully activate that energy, you should defeat Psychemon and complete it.
_798.Objective: Defeat Psychemon in Server Continent Canyon
_798.CompletionText: There's nothing much more I can do for you.
_798.CompletionSummary: What took you so long for just taking care of those Rockmons. As useless as I expected…

_799.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_799.Description: What? The spirit that flows out of your Digimon… Is this really the Black Digitron that we only believed as a rumor? Great! I'll kindly conduct an investigation myself. (Suddenly I hear someone calling for me) Hey! Where do you think you're going all of a sudden?
_799.CompletionText: (Someone is calling me) I told you I'll investigate it for you. Why are you trying to leave?
_799.CompletionSummary: So is it really a Digimon affected by Black Digitron? (chuckles) If that is true, I have an advice to give you.

_800.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_800.Description: So how's the strength of Black Digitron? (chuckles) Isn't it amazing how just a little part can make power of Virus overflows? To become a true warrior of evil, you must defeat Omegamon. I'll give you this summon scroll, so you go ahead and summon Omegamon in the Summon Square to trample over what call himself apostle of justice!
_800.CompletionSummary: Have you become conscious again? Fortunately, you could stop your friend from corruption. The rest relies on Calumon.

_801.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_801.Description:
This is the message from Calumon. Please read it.
(Letter that Omegamon gave you was written as follows)
- Dear, tamer -
Royal Knights as I expected! Omegamon has made you wake up, culu! This should be enough condition to open new path of evolution. Bring the crystal of extreme Vaccine attribute and crystal of extreme Light attribute, culu!
- From, Calumon.
_801.Objective: Collect Vaccine Attribute Data Collect Light Attribute Data
_801.CompletionText: Bring me the crystal of extreme Vaccine attribute and crystal of extreme Light attribute, culu!
_801.CompletionSummary: The good-hearted energy seems to be enough to prevent your Digimon from falling into the path of D. Now, it's time for rebirth, culu!

_802.Title: Jogress [Omegamon Zwart]
_802.Description:
This is the message from Calumon. Please read it.
(Letter that Omegamon gave you was written as follows)
- Dear, tamer -
Royal Knights as I expected! Omegamon has made you wake up, culu! This should be enough condition to open new path of evolution. Bring the crystal of extreme Data attribute and crstyal of extreme Light attribute, culu!
- From, Calumon.
_802.Objective: Collect Data Attribute Data Collect Light Attribute Data
_802.CompletionText: Bring me the crystal of extreme Data attribute and crystal of extreme Light attribute, culu!
_802.CompletionSummary: The good-hearted energy seems to be enough to prevent your Digimon from falling into the path of D. Now, it's time for rebirth, culu!

_803.Title: Infinite Mountain
_803.Description: There is a crisis in other continents before the battle in Infinite Mountain.. I think you should go there. I'll be on File Island. Can you come to the place I tell you?
_803.CompletionText: There are so many things that threathen Digital World.
_803.CompletionSummary: I'll explain it to you as I know you're ready.

_804.Title: Crack of Devimon
_804.Description: Ouch! My back... Do you see me? ....
_804.CompletionText: Ahem... Do you want to know who I am?
_804.CompletionSummary: Now there will be peace in Crack on New Dimension?

_805.Title: Crack of Devimon
_805.Description: My back still hurts.. Let me see.. Crack on New Dimension is different from other zones. It is remote from general zones. I can be dangerous if you go alone. So be careful!
_805.CompletionText: Now I have the last thing to tell you.. Talk to me again..
_805.CompletionSummary: Now there will be peace in Crack on New Dimension?

_806.Title: Crack of Devimon
_806.Description: Ouch! I'm tired of talking.. It's only me talking.. Ahem.. Devimon, Leomon, and Ogremon are there in the Crack on Dimension . Cough! Cough.. Ah.. I'm tired.. Talk with Elecmon at the entrance of Infinite Mountain..
_806.Objective: Speak with Elecmon(Nanny) at the entrance of Infinite Mountain
_806.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Elecmon(Nanny) at the entrance of Infinite Mountain
_806.CompletionText: You haven't left? Go to the entrance of Infinite Mountain..
_806.CompletionSummary: Crack on Dimension has been a headache.. It's good for you to come here.

_807.Title: Crack of Devimon
_807.Description: You are here… Crack of Devimon…. It seems different from existing moving methods. … Does it make you more curious?
_807.CompletionText: We can move to the crack of new dimension if we know more.
_807.CompletionSummary: All right… Only a bit left..! Learn a bit more and depart…

_808.Title: Crack of Devimon
_808.Summary: Location of Crack on New Dimension?
_808.Description: Okay… firstly..! You need to enter into the Crack of Devimon thru me. Do you know what you have to prepare? … Go straight towards 12 o'clock after you enter.. You will see the Crack of Devimon.
_808.CompletionSummary: Devimon and its group is vicious.. But there is a prophecy that Chosen Children will gather power and seal Devimon… We believe you…!

_809.Title: Crack of Devimon
_809.Description: You will face Ogremons first when you enter the Crack of Devimon!! Ogremons(Crack of Devimon)' wicked energy became stronger after Devimon's experiments. Please stop the wicked energy of File Island from spreading by defeating Ogremons!
_809.CompletionSummary: Wow! Incredible! I think you guys can defeat Devimons!!!

_810.Title: Crack of Devimon
_810.Description: Ogremons(Crack of Devimon) with stronger wicked power thru Devimon's experiment are stopping invaders coming into the Crack of Devimon with Underling. In order to defeat Devimon, it will be easier to defeat Ogremon's Underling.
_810.CompletionText: Cheer up! You will be able to defeat Gotsumon's Underlings!
_810.CompletionSummary: I knew you guys can defeat Devimon's Underlings!!

_811.Title: Crack of Devimon
_811.Description: You can get Club of Ogremons after defeating Ogremons(Crack of Devimon). White-bearded Guru told me that data to destroy Black Cogwheels from the Club of Ogremons. So collect the Club of Ogremons and bring it to me!
_811.CompletionText: Yet the crack of Devimon cannot be prevented…
_811.CompletionSummary: You defeated Ogremon (Crack of Devimon)…. You guys are really strong!!

_812.CompletionText: Cheer up! You will be able to defeat Gotsumon's Underlings!
_812.CompletionSummary: I knew you guys can do it!!

_817.Description: While you were moving more deeply into the Crack to meet Devimon, you will be able to meet Leomons whose minds are dominated by Devimon. Please save those dominated Leomons..
_817.CompletionSummary: Leomons will also thank you guys…

_818.Description: I would like you to persuade Leomon's Underlings dominated by Black Cogwheels of Devimon…!!

_819.Summary: Collect Leomon's Tail feathers (Crack of Devimon)
_819.Description: If you fail to persuade and can't bring them back, please bring one item to remind Leomon.
_819.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I will keep memory with Leomon with this tail feather..

_825.Description: When you reach the deepest point of the Crack, Devimon you will face will use magic with wicked energy!! Especially that unknown wicked magic is trying to imbrue whole File Island with dark energy!! I believe you guys can defeat Devimon(Crack of Devimon) and bring peace to File Island!!
_825.CompletionText: Cheer up!! Do not give up!
_825.CompletionSummary: You guys are so great…. Thank you… File Island will get its old shape back..!!
