_834.Title: <Event>
_834.Description: Collect 30 candies. I will exchange them for Chicken Combo. Hurry up!
_834.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_835.Title: <Event>
_835.Description: Collect 50 candies. I will exchange them for the nice gift that will make you faster. Hurry up!
_835.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_836.Title: <Event>
_836.Description: Collect 50 candies. I will exchange them for the nice gift that will make you faster. Hurry up!
_836.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_837.Title: <Event>
_837.Summary: White Candy x100 = White Day Gift box
_837.Description: Collect 100 candies. I will exchange them for 2014 White Day Giftbox. Hurry up!
_837.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_838.Title: <Event>
_838.Summary: White Candy x100 = White Day Gift box
_838.Description: Collect 100 candies. I will exchange them for 2014 White Day Giftbox. Hurry up!
_838.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_839.Title: <Event>
_839.Summary: White Candy x250 = Mystery Mercenary DigiEgg(Unit)
_839.Description: Collect 250 candies. I will exchange them for Mystery Reinforced Mercenary DigiEgg(Unit). Hurry up!
_839.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_840.Title: <Event>
_840.Summary: White Candy x250 = Mystery Mercenary DigiEgg(Unit)
_840.Description: Collect 250 candies. I will exchange them for Mystery Reinforced Mercenary DigiEgg(Unit). Hurry up!
_840.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_841.Title: <Event>
_841.Summary: White Candy x500 = Reinforced Mercenary DigiEgg
_841.Description: Collect 500 candies. I will exchange them for Mystery Reinforced Mercenary DigiEgg. Hurry up!
_841.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well. Now I can give digimons these candies!

_842.Title: <Jogress-Patamon>
_842.Description:
Patamon! I heard that Arachnemon and Mummymon are trying to destroy Digimon world using Digimon Kaiser's Black Tower, Calu.
We must remove all Dark Towers quickly. Please purify the Digimons who are already infected by Evil Ring, Calu. Go to the Western Dark tower Wasteland, Calu!
_842.Objective: Use Evil Ring Scanner to Dark SkullGreymon Defeat Dark SkullGreymon
_842.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use Evil Ring Scanner to Dark SkullGreymon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Dark SkullGreymon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_842.CompletionText: Even just one second is precious now, Calu!
_842.CompletionSummary: We shall remove the cause, Calu. Let's find Arachnemon, Calu!

_843.Title: <Jogress-Patamon>
_843.Description:
Before you fight with Arachnemon, I think you'd better fight with its temporary data to prepare the real battle, Calu.
Defeat Dokugumon at Silver Lake in File Island, and bring me 10 Spider Webs, then I will make you the card with which you can summon the Phantom of Arachnemon, Calu.
_843.CompletionText: 10 Spider Webs. You can get Spider Webs from Dokugumon, Calu.
_843.CompletionSummary: You did well, Calu! I can make it with these materials. Wait a moment.

_844.Title: <Jogress-Patamon>
_844.Description:
This is the card summons the Phantom of Arachnemon.
You can summon the illusion of Arachnemon anyplace, Calu. Find Arachnemon's Weakness Data, Calu.
_844.CompletionText: I heard Arachnemon drops irregularly weak point data when defeated. If you need the card, you can buy from me; I will make it for you, Calu.
_844.CompletionSummary: Arachnemon's Spider Web seems to be generated from these gloves.

_845.Title: <Jogress-Armadimon>
_845.Description:
Armadimon! While Patamon is purifying the infected Digimons, please remove Dark Towers.
Dark Tower A is located at the Ruined Historic Site in Western Area. I will give you the spatial temporal bomb that will let you return! Come back safely, Calu!
_845.Objective: Remove Dark Tower A and collect Dark Tower A's broken piece
_845.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Remove Dark Tower A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2 and collect Dark Tower A's broken piece%qe %cc2/%mc2
_845.CompletionText: I heard the evolution is canceled when you get near to a Dark Tower, Calu!
_845.CompletionSummary: I will let you know where the next tower is. Wait a moment, Calu!

_846.Title: <Jogress-Armadimon>
_846.Description:
I got new information, Calu! Dark Tower B is located at Frozen Ground in Glacial Area, Calu!
Use this spatial temporal bomb this time as well! Be careful, Calu!
_846.Objective: Remove Dark Tower B and collect Dark Tower B's broken piece
_846.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Remove Dark Tower B%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2collect Dark Tower B's broken piece%qe %cc2/%mc2
_846.CompletionSummary: Now we have only one. Keep it up, Calu!

_847.Title: <Jogress-Armadimon>
_847.Description:
I got the information about the last Dark Tower, Calu!
Dark Tower C is in the Silent Forest, File Island, Calu! You won't know what kind of Digimon will appear; do not surprise and collect the piece.
You can't use Jump Booster in File Island! Be careful, Calu!
_847.Objective: Remove Dark Tower C and collect Dark Tower C's broken piece
_847.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Remove Dark Tower C%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2collect Dark Tower C's broken pieceC%qe %cc2/%mc2
_847.CompletionText: Don't forget to collect the pieces, Calu!
_847.CompletionSummary: A Digimon appears whenever you destroy a Dark Tower? Wait a moment, Calu.

_848.Title: <Jogress-Armadimon>
_848.Description:
It must be Arachnemon, Calu!
This is the Dark Tower mutant summon card made of the broken piece. Defeat the Digimon appearing at the tower and get Arachnemon's hair to have more detailed information, Calu.
_848.CompletionText: I heard the information that a Dark Tower becomes a Digimon by using Arachnemon's Hair, Calu.
_848.CompletionSummary: I have found another Arachnemon's weak point again, Calu!

_849.Title: <Jogress-Armadimon>
_849.Description:
The information I heard is not wrong, Calu!
It seems that Arachnemon is using its hair to transform Black Towers into bad Digimons, Calu.
_849.CompletionSummary: We've got all the data, Calu. Now, let's go to stop Arachnemon, Calu!

_850.Title: <Jogress-Shakkoumon>
_850.Description: We have Arachnemon's hair and gloves. Now defeat it, Calu!
_850.CompletionSummary: It's terrible, Calu! Arachnemon did something big, Calu!

_851.Title: <Jogress-Shakkoumon>
_851.Description:
Arachnemon is now transforming 100 Dark Towers at once to summon BlackWarGreymon, Calu!
BlackWarGreymon is not under Arachnemon's control and trying to destroy the Digital World.
_851.CompletionSummary: I have to find a method, Calu! While I think about how to take care of it, please prepare for battle, Calu!

_852.Title: <Jogress-Armadimon>
_852.Description: Armadimon! I want you to go to Digimon kaiser and ask him for help. As he is the one who installed the Black Tower, he must know a weak point. Find Digimon kaiser, Calu! You can meet him at Infinite Ice Wall in Glacial Area.
_852.CompletionSummary: Please jogress with Patamon and defeat BlackWarGreymon again.

_853.Title: <Jogress-Patamon>
_853.Description:
Patamon! While Armadimon is gone to ask for help, stop BlackWarGreymon, Calu!
BlackWarGreymon is making troubles at the center of Dark Tower Wasteland.
_853.CompletionText: Now go to Dark Tower Wasteland, Calu!
_853.CompletionSummary:
Please jogress with Armadimon and defeat BlackWarGreymon again, Calu.
Use this card at Dark Tower Wasteland to make it!

_854.Title: <Jogress-Shakkoumon>
_854.Description: When you have a new Jogress form, try to challenge BlackWarGreymon using <BlackWarGreymon summon card>, Calu!
_854.CompletionSummary: Though you didn't win, it's great you found a new jogress form, Calu! Keep it up, Calu Calu.

_855.Title: D-Terminal
_855.Description:
So, you are the General with a Xros loader?
Now Shoutmon and the Digimons are waiting in the GreenZone.
I think they need your help.
Talk to me again when you're ready.
_855.CompletionSummary: Did Jijimon allowed you to come all the way here?

_856.Title: D-Terminal
_856.Description:
I have a favor to ask of you, General... If you go to the GreenZone,
Would you send my regards to my friend there, Jijimon?
_856.CompletionText:
Do me a favor!
My friend looks just like me!
_856.CompletionSummary: Is he alive? This is a small gift of gratitude for delivering the letter.

_857.Title: D-Terminal
_857.Description: Um, General! I've heard that there's a guy in the Green Zone called Madleomon(Illusion Digimon). I'd like you to defeat him and bring me some saw blades.
_857.CompletionText:
I think it's going to be good research...
I have a lot of questions about Crossche Digimon!
_857.CompletionSummary: Thank you. If there is anything, can I ask you a favor again?

_858.Title: GreenZone
_858.Description:
Get up! Get up!
Thank you for putting my melody into the Xros loader!
This is the Green Zone where we live in the Digital World.
Madleomon, one of the Bagramon's Minion, is controlling this zone.
I almost died, but you saved my life!
Oh, Who am I?
_858.Objective: Welcome~ first time of GreenZone, right?
_858.CompletionText: Do you really want to know?

_859.Title: GreenZone
_859.Summary: Who will become a King of Digimon
_859.Description:
Do you want to hear it?
You want to hear the name of this body!
My name is Shoutmon! One day I will be the King of Digimon!
I don't think it's time to have a casual conversation.
He brought his men down this cliff.
If we don't stop them now, our town will be attacked!
First, Defeat four Mammothmon at the below the cliff.
After that, check out the Xros loader!
_859.Objective: Will become a King of Digimon
_859.CompletionText:
Mammothmon is Madleomon's minions.
I can't get enough of them!
_859.CompletionSummary:
All right! That's enough to move forward.
There's a Madleomon on the right side of the low hill. Be careful!

_860.Title: GreenZone
_860.Description:
Our brothers are always shining! Thank God you came back alive!
I heard you're going to help us defeat the Bagramon's Army for a while!
Shoutmon says he's okay, but he is not fully recovered yet, i guess.
Inside the Green Zone, there's a Food called Diginoir Don! Collect 10 of Diginoir by defeating Digimons in GreenZone.
_860.CompletionText: Diginoir Don is a low drop probability for Digimon in the Green Zone, so you won't be able to collect all of it all at once.
_860.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I'll take care of Brother's health!

_861.Title: GreenZone
_861.Description:
I have to go to the Starmons Brother!
I'm lost here!
There are too many CommanDramon's in front of me to move forward.
So I want General to help me!
Can you open the way for me?!
_861.CompletionText: What are you doing? I have to go to Brother!
_861.CompletionSummary:
I thought a Pickmon wasn't enough, so it was.
I'm sorry, brother!

_862.Title: GreenZone
_862.Description:
I heard there's a hidden area in this Green Zone.
Through a thick patch of bushes,
They're selling items that could weaken the 매드Leomon...
First of all, Please defeat the chaotic SunFlowmon. They're not always bad guys!
_862.CompletionText: SunFlowmon is originally a resident of our village.
_862.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!
To continue with the story… I heard that you should go through a wooded area.

_863.Title: GreenZone
_863.Description:
Madleomon absorbed his men and split the ground!
We need the Pickmon to move on.
I feel like They are playing in the front yard because I'm out of military discipline!
Can you scold them and bring them to me?
I'll keep you in line so I can get through this road!
_863.CompletionText: What a lacked in the discipline.
_863.CompletionSummary: Pickmon will make you a string. You can ride them over! Take care!

_864.Description:
I think if you turn right at the crossroad, you might able to do the trial-match with Madleomon.
I heard that from Jijimon, so it should be right! Why don't you try the challenge?
_864.CompletionSummary: Don't let down your guard! It's only a Illusion! Even though, you did a great job!

_865.Title: GreenZone
_865.Description:
The Mammothmons are big.
I can't just pass by because they blocking the way!
All the Bagramon's Army should be punished!
So General.
Please help me...yes?
Let's defeat Mammothmon and move on!
_865.CompletionSummary: Now! The road is open, so charge!

_866.Title: GreenZone
_866.Description:
General! If you go down this cliff, there will be a Mikemon not far away.
They're waiting for help.
Let's help on the way!
First find me a Mikemon.
They will be in a little higher where the terrain that went down.
_866.CompletionText: Are you still out there? Are you scared, General?
_866.CompletionSummary:
Shoutmon worried about me?
Well, you came just in time!

_867.Title: GreenZone
_867.Description:
Please here me first!
There's a Tricky Digimon called Phantomon in front of us. I came out with my friends, "Gatomon" and "Black Gatomon." He took my friends somewhere else!
Can you defeat them and find my friends?
I'm begging you.
I want to go there myself, but actually I don't like the type that looks like a ghost...

_868.Title: GreenZone
_868.Description:
My friends were dragged by the Phantomon!
I need your help, General.

_869.Description: Thank you, General! I think Mammothmon and Mikemon have been settled. But it seems like some of Pickmon has left the Starmons line at the left side of the pass the hill of trials I really hope that if you can help on the way?!

_870.Title: GreenZone
_870.Description:
In front of this is a very powerful Madleomon : Armed mode.
He's the current ruler of the Green Zone.
He's one of the member of the Bagramon's Army, but he's at the bottom position.
But be careful! He's very powerful.
If he cut the ground with his saw, there will be critical damage you'll wear it.
I've heard that if we defeat the summoner he summons,
They are going to drop an item that you can directly damage him.
Keep that in mind!
_870.CompletionText:
I can't go in anymore!
I'm scared!
Please defeat them and bring peace in this Green Zone!
_870.CompletionSummary:
Good work, General!
Even though I ran away, you defeat the Madleomon. I can't let my guard down until he comes back!

_871.Title: GreenZone
_871.Description:
How did you find this place?
I'm a friend of Ballistamon, Shoutmon.
And I don't like Fighting.
I want to get out of here, but I'm worried about that "MechaNorimon" in front of me. I don't want to fight first.
I'm sorry, but can you help me?
_871.CompletionText: If you defeat him, I will give you an important information about Madleomon and items.
_871.CompletionSummary:
If you're on your way to fight the Madleomon,
Take this item!
This will be works to a summoner.

_872.Title: Yokohama Village
_872.Description:
Who are you? I am Dats member Yoshino Fujieda.
Next to me is my partner digimon Lalamon.
First, I will tell you simple instructions and the information you need.
_872.CompletionText:
You can do basic moves by clicking the mouse.
Right click the mouse to move vision,
and use the mouse wheel to control the camera zoom.
_872.CompletionSummary: Welcome. But I don't recognize you. Are you rookie?

_873.Title: Yokohama Village
_873.Description:
You know the simple instructions now, right? What? Wait.. Wait.. I have a call from the Dats Center.
Yes! Yes… Okay!
Umm… It's last minute, but I have a favor.
Rapter-1 is running away from the lab and causing damage.
If you go down the stairs behind me you will see the sky park. They say he is there, so find the monster and keep him down.
_873.CompletionText: Have you found Rapter-1? Rapter-1 is in the sky park down the stairs behind me… It is the worst situation right now, so hurry!
_873.CompletionSummary:
You took care of Rapter-1. You must be pretty good?
I will tell you one instructions I didn't tell you earlier..
You can register skills in the shortcut slots and use them. F1-F2 are basically registered so try them!

_874.Title: Yokohama Village
_874.Description:
Hi~ As I introduced before, I'm Dats member @<tc:171>Yoshino Fujieda@</tc>. The Digimon next to me is @<tc:171>Lalamon@</tc> of my partner.
Ah! Richard Sampson said me, bring you to Dats Center.
At first, visit Mrs. @<tc:171>Sara Damon@</tc> befor you go to there.
You can meet her if follow the road!
_874.CompletionText: I thought there were stairs down to the park… Have you still not found Marcus Damon's house?
_874.ReservedText: I'm just cooking for a breakfast, could you eat Rolled Omelet together?

_875.Title: Yokohama Village
_875.Summary: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_875.Description: Ha, ha, ha. You have worked hard to become an Official Dats Agent . I will give you this @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>. It will help you a lot in your travels.
_875.Objective: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_875.CompletionText: The Digivice is needed to raise the digimon's abilities.
_875.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>are divided into @<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Skill slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Chipset Slot@</tc>. @<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc> can carry as many mercenary digimons as the slots. @<tc:800>TamerSkill@</tc> include @<tc:800>Skil

_876.Title: Yokohama Village
_876.Summary: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_876.Description: Ha, ha, ha. You have worked hard to become an Official Dats Agent . I will give you this @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>. It will help you a lot in your travels.
_876.Objective: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_876.CompletionText: The Digivice is needed to raise the digimon's abilities.
_876.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>are divided into @<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>,@<tc:800>Tamer Skill slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Chipset Slot@</tc>.@<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>can carry as many mercenary digimons as the number of slots.@<tc:800>Tamer Skill@</tc>include@<

_877.Title: Yokohama Village
_877.Summary: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_877.Description: Ha, ha, ha. You have worked hard to become an Official Dats Agent . I will give you this @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>. It will help you a lot in your travels.
_877.Objective: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_877.CompletionText: The Digivice is needed to raise the digimon's abilities.
_877.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>are divided into @<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>,@<tc:800>Tamer Skill slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Chipset Slot@</tc>.@<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>can carry as many mercenary digimons as the number of slots.@<tc:800>Tamer Skill@</tc>include@<

_878.Title: Yokohama Village
_878.Summary: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_878.Description: Ha, ha, ha. You have worked hard to become an Official Dats Agent . I will give you this @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>. It will help you a lot in your travels.
_878.Objective: I will tell you about the Digivice.
_878.CompletionText: The Digivice is needed to raise the digimon's abilities.
_878.CompletionSummary: @<tc:800>Digivice@</tc>are divided into @<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Tamer Skill slot@</tc>, @<tc:800>Chipset Slot@</tc>. @<tc:800>Mercenary Slot@</tc>can carry as many mercenary digimons as the number of slots.@<tc:800>Tamer Skill@</tc>includ

_879.Title: Yokohama Village
_879.Description:
Oh, are you the one who's trying to become the rookie of Dats?
I'm glad you came..
Doctor Homer Yushima over there asked me to show him anyone who looked like a Dats member..
Go and meet Doctor Homer Yushima.
_879.CompletionText: Go to Doctor Yoo Homer Yushima in front of you.
_879.CompletionSummary: Oh, you must be the Rookie of Dats!

_880.Title: Yokohama Village
_880.Description:
There are 3 types of DigiEggs.
@<tc:800>Retrieval DigiEggs which can only be retrieved@</tc>, @<tc:800>DATA Scan DigiEggs@</tc> which contain DATA that can be scanned, @<tc:800>Mercenary DigiEggs@</tc> from which you can gain mercenary digimons.
DigiEggs with DATA can be scanned for items.
But you need to pay for the scanning, so keep that in mind.
Shall we bring the DATA Scan DigiEggs? Sarah Damon from Yokohama Village found DATA Scan DigiEggs by chance.
Go and retrieve the DATA Scan DigiEggs from Sarah Damon.
_880.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Miki Kurosaki in Yokohama Village
_880.CompletionText: @<tc:800>DATA Scan DigiEgg@</tc>still has data left so you can get various items…
_880.CompletionSummary: Oh… good job. Are you the new Dats member? I found this egg in the house as I was cleaning.

_881.Title: Yokohama Village
_881.Description:
DATA Scan DigiEggs are divided into digimon types such as dragon type, beast type, insect type, ore type, plant type, bird type, devil type, etc.
Will you get this back to Miki Kurosaki?
You will find Miki Kurosaki by going down this steep road, at the parking lot on your left.
There are vicious Drimogemon on the way, so be careful..
_881.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Relay Dragon Mercenary DigiEgg to Miki Kurosaki%qe %cc1/%mc1
_881.CompletionText: You must handle with care because it still has data in it. Don't be too rough!
_881.CompletionSummary: Wow… Well done. This is the @<tc:800>DATA Scan@</tc>DigiEggs. You can normally get it from the @<tc:800>Field Digimon@</tc>. The @<tc:800>DATA Scan DigiEggs@</tc>you can get according to field digimon are different so study them when you can.

_882.Title: Yokohama Village
_882.Description: All right! Let's scan this DigiEgg. I'll give you a practice DigiEgg. Try scanning it yourself. To scan DigiEggs, come and speak with me first. Then, select Scan DigiEgg. You can click "Auto-Assign" or drag the DigiEgg in the inventory that needs scanning. Once you scan the DigiEgg, bring me whatever item you gain from it.... Curious what you will find? Well, scan it and find out. Heh.
_882.CompletionText: What is in it?? Aren't you curious?
_882.CompletionSummary: Ha, ha, ha… This DigiEgg was for practice so the item I entered came out… but if you scan a general DATA Scan DigiEgg, you may not acquire diverse items. Now you understand @<tc:800>Scanning DigiEgg@</tc>to a certain extent, right?

_883.Title: Yokohama Village
_883.Description:
Huh? What? You are going to meet Richard Sampson to become a Dats member? There is a problem with how Richard Sampson handles digimon matters.
He's far too soft. We can't handle the growth of digimons. We need to take drastic measures and preemptively eliminate potential problems... On this point, Director Hashima, the one in charge of Dats, agrees.
If you are a Dats member, it will be in your own best interest to assist me. *snickers*. Get out there and bring me Dragon Digimon Research Data from Koromon.
_883.CompletionText: Get the Koromon and collect dragon type data…!!
_883.CompletionSummary: Ah… okay, okay… That is great data.

_884.Title: Yokohama Village
_884.Description:
There is a set chance of acquiring the data you just scanned when scanning DigiEggs.
If you happen to obtain a mercenary DigiEgg, you can hatch it for a mercenary digimon.
To hatch mercenary DigiEgg, you have to take it to the mercenary hatcher NPC and register it. You will also need the correct ingredient DATA. You can get ingredient DATA items from scanning DigiEggs. Don't you forget...
_884.CompletionText: If the@<tc:800>Mercenary DigiEgg@</tc>is hatched you can raise not just the @<tc:800>Partner Digimon@</tc>but also other digimons. Isn't that great?
_884.CompletionSummary: But it's too early to become an @<tc:800>Official Dats Agent@</tc>. How about starting with helping those who are in trouble because of the recent appearance of digimons?

_885.Description: We sincerely apologize for causing inconvenience for game users with this quest since the last maintenance on October 10.
_885.CompletionSummary:
This is a small reward I give with a sorry heart.
Thank you.

_886.Title: Wood bench Park
_886.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Can you hear me? Now, you are the member of Dats Center. However, only the partner digimon can't make you great Tamer. You have to hatch mercenary digimon and nurture it as a strong digimon. It is also the condition for great Tamer. I will let you know the method to hatch mercenary digimon. Acquire 1 mercenary DigiEgg from Kunemon in front of you... Size and shape of mercenary DigiEgg are different from those of other DigiEgg so you will identify it easily.
_886.CompletionText: You need other Mercenary DigiEggs and data to hatch mercenary digimons.
_886.CompletionSummary: This is great… What you just acquired is a Kunemon Mercenary DigiEgg.

_887.Title: Yokohama Village
_887.Description:
I have received information that a pair of bank robbers
have used a Drimogemon to steal a safe and ATM machine.
You are the closest, so take care of it.
_887.CompletionSummary:
When you fight digimons don't forget to use the surrounding topography well.
I will give you a Dats Badge as a reward.

_888.Title: Yokohama Village
_888.Description:
Can you hear me? This is Richard Sampson.
You will see a school ahead.
If you see a digimon reaction at the school, it means there is someone in need. Please check it out.

_889.Title: Yokohama Village
_889.Description:
I am responsible for retrieving and scanning DigiEggs. You will see PawnChessmon more than me most times.
Retrieving DigiEggs is a basic task that a Dats member must carry out often.
While we are at it, let's scan Retrieval DigiEggs.
_889.CompletionText: What are you doing? Scan the DigiEgg I gave you, quickly.
_889.CompletionSummary:
Wow… Well done. Does this complete your first mission as a @<tc:800>Dats Agent@</tc>!?
I will give you a @<tc:800>Retrieval DigiEggs@</tc>. Try @<tc:800>Retrieve@</tc>it yourself. To retrieve, talk to me and select @<tc:800>Retrieve DigiEgg@</tc>.

_890.Title: Yokohama Village
_890.Description:
The rabbits I take care of died during the night. I… took care of them well… but…
Please find out who killed my rabbits!
My friend Kristy Damon says she saw someone who looks like a caterpillar do it!
Please get him! (Is the culprit Kunemon? You need to investigate the small forest park.)
_890.CompletionText: It was a digimon that looks like a caterpillar. I think it was a Kunemon.
_890.CompletionSummary:
Whew- Thank you.. The bad digimons need to be taught a lesson! Hee hee…
I will give you a Dats Badge as a gift.

_891.Title: Yokohama Village
_891.Description: This is Richard Sampson. A digimon has come to the Real World and is causing traffic signal problems. It has been confirmed as an Elecmon so find it and take care of it immediately!
_891.CompletionSummary: It seems like you are getting used to your work. Here is a Dats Badge for you.

_892.Title: Yokohama Village
_892.Description:
Hmm… Oh no… That small spark-like thing is strutting around the streets and lighting fires. We cannot do anything about it. Can you help us?
Fires are hard to put out even with wind once they start to grow big.
_892.CompletionText:
Fire is interesting. Don't forget that.
Fires are hard to put out even with wind once they start to grow big.
_892.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Take the Dats Badge you need.

_893.Title: Yokohama Village
_893.Description: Ah, do you recognize me, too? I am the young star of this age, G. Neon. What is the secret of my popularity? I… Only I must know it!!
_893.CompletionText: I am going to work on it alone in my room.
_893.CompletionSummary: Are you still hanging out over there?

_894.Title: Yokohama Village
_894.Description:
I have information that there are signs of a digimon near G. Neon.
It seems like Keramon is helping G. Neon.
He uses an information network, but he is stronger than he looks so be careful.
_894.CompletionSummary:
Sorry. I will try to make it to the top on my own from now on.
This is the Dats Badge you are looking for.

_895.Title: Yokohama Village
_895.Description:
We have sufficient material on the dragon type now…
Now we need research data on the animal type digimon.
Seeing you collect data, it seems as if you are qualified to be my subordinate..
Catch the Upamon and Tsunomon to get research data on the animal type digimon...
This should not be difficult for you, with your skills? Isn't that right?
_895.CompletionText: Get the Kormon and collect dragon type data…!!
_895.CompletionSummary: Ah… okay, okay… That is great data.

_896.Title: Yokohama Village
_896.Description:
Ha, ha, ha, ha… Now… Get this report to Director Hashima at the Dats Center.
Umm… It is a perfect report without any room for objections, so I can tell what the reaction will be like.
_896.CompletionText:
Move quickly.
If you think that something is going to fall, it's best that you don't hope for it. You have done nothing, after all.
_896.CompletionSummary: The report by Doctor Akihiro Kurata? Hmm… Shall I have a look?

_897.Title: Dats Center
_897.Description: If you solve the case of the Yokohama village people who are experiencing troubles with digimons, I will give you a Dats Badge. Collect 5 of these…
_897.CompletionText: Have you collected all the Dats Badges?
_897.CompletionSummary: Hmm… This is definitely a @<tc:800>Dats Badge@</tc>. Well done.

_898.Title: Dats Center
_898.Description:
You have collected 5 Dats Badges. I now have to acknowledge you as an Official Dats Agent. Come to the Dats Center to see me…
You can come quickly if you use the @<tc:800>Spatial Temporal Bomb-Dats Center@</tc> I gave you earlier.
_898.CompletionSummary: You took care of it so quickly…

_899.Title: Yokohama Village
_899.Description:
This is Richard Sampson of the Dats Center. I heard you were helping Doctor Akihiro Kurata's work.
Doctor Akihiro Kurata is working for the Real World, but his methods only worsen emotions in the Real World and Digital World.
_899.CompletionText: He works for Real World, too, but his methods are wrong.
_899.CompletionSummary:
I will recognize you as an Official Dats Agent if you bring 5@<tc:800>Dats Badges@</tc>to me.
I hope you will find a way to effectively solve the problems between the Real World and Digital World on your own when you become an official agent.
@<tc:800>D

_900.Title: <생일 이벤트>
_900.Description: 가을을 맞이하여 14일간 사용할 수 있는 코스튬을 준비했다. 남자는 타오르는 주먹이지 ! 여자라면 미안하군.
_900.CompletionSummary: 추가경험치 40% 공격력 40 친화력 40 이동속도 40% 를 마음것 누리길 바란다!

_901.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (현무몬)>
_901.Description: 나의 이름은 현무몬. 북쪽을 수호하는 디지몬이다. 데 리퍼들이 최근 보이는 것 같아. 이 녀석들은 디지몬이 아닌 '삭제'프로그램으로 일종의 백업 프로그램이지.
_901.CompletionText: 자네가 선택받은 테이머라면 그것을 증명할 수 있는 "무언가"를 보여주길 바라네

_902.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (현무몬)>
_902.Description: 사성수 중 서쪽을 지키는 백호몬의 안부가 궁금하네- 데 리퍼 녀석들과 엮인 것이 아닌가 걱정도 되고. 백호몬의 종인 신드라몬을 찾아가보는게 좋을거야.
_902.CompletionText: 아직 안갔나 ? 신드라몬 녀석은 서부마을 어딘가에 있을거라 생각되는데 말이지...

_903.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (현무몬)>
_903.Description: 역시나 백호몬은 데 리퍼녀석들과 싸우고 있단 말이군. 내가 바로 서쪽으로 가야겠네. 부탁하나를 하지. 이 북쪽의 안전을 보장해주면 마음편히 갈 수 있을 것 같은데... 눈보라마을에서 보이고 있는 메가드라몬을 처리해줬으면 좋겠어.
_903.CompletionText: 디지털월드에서 현재 상대 디지몬을 처치하고 로드할 경우 리얼월드로 갈 수 있는 힘을 얻을 수 있다는 소문이 돌고 있다더군.
_903.CompletionSummary: 고맙네 작은 선물로 나의 디지코어의 일부를 주겠네. 이 후 크게 도움이 될 물건이니 잃어버리지 않도록 하게.

_904.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (현무몬)>
_904.Description: 나의 디지코어가 더 필요하다는 말인가 ? 그럼 네가 갖고 있는 디-아크와 교환해주도록 하지.
_904.CompletionText: 꼭 필요할 수 있으니 조급해하지 말게.
_904.CompletionSummary: 내 디지코어가 남아나질 않겠군. 여기 있네.

_905.Title: Yokohama Village
_905.Description: This is Richard Sampson... The DATA of mercenary DigiEgg you acquired are not perfect so hatching is not possible. If you take the mercenary DigiEgg to <Incubator> of Yokohama Village, you will get Kunemon mercenary DigiEgg and material DATA required for hatching. You can get mercenary digimon by putting mercenary DigiEgg you received to <Incubator> and add the material required for mercenary DigiEgg hatching. Go to Yokohama Village and try it...
_905.CompletionText: Now you are seeing a mercenary DigiEgg hatching NPC Incubator. If you obtain mercenary DigiEgg, you can hatch it in Incubator. Of course you have to prepare material DATA required for hatching…
_905.CompletionSummary: I will give you three DATA that is a material DATA required for hatching Kunemon mercenary DigiEgg and insectoid digimon. Try hatching by using Incubator that is mercenary DigiEgg hatching NPC …

_906.Title: Yokohama Village
_906.Description:
It seems that you hatched Kunemon successfully. Then, you have to train a new mercenary digimon. When it comes to digimon, actual battle is the best training method
It can get XP by fighting against monster digimon and its level will be upgraded by meeting requested XP. All digimons can evolve into Champion at level 11 with Ultimate at level 25 and Mega existence at level 41.
_906.CompletionText: Some type of digimon can evolve into evolved existence beyond Mega existence.
_906.CompletionSummary: I will test your ability as a Tamer. Train hatched Kunemon mercenary digimon until it becomes level 6...

_907.Title: Yokohama Village
_907.Description: This is Richard Sampson of Dats Center. You nurtured the hatched Kunemon greatly. Good job. If digimons become your side, they will be very helpful in the future. I mentioned your story to Megumi Shirakawa at Yokohama village so visit her to get reward...I will keep an eye on how you will grow as a member of Dats. That is all.
_907.Objective: Go to Megumi Shirakawa at Yokohama village.
_907.ObjectiveProgress: Go to Megumi Shirakawa at Yokohama village.
_907.CompletionText: I heard the news from Richard Sampson…
_907.CompletionSummary: I heard about you from Richard Sampson...Size and power of mercenary digimon depend on hatching step. You can't hatch mercenary digimon in the 1st or 2nd step but you can get mercenary digimon from the 3rd step. If you hatch mercenary digimon in the 4th o

_908.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (주작몬)>
_908.Description:
디지몬에게 인간따위는 필요없다. 인간에 의지하여 진화하다니, 있을 수 없는 일이야. 이 세계를 무너지게 하려는 인간을 지키는 디지몬따위를 난 용서할 수 없다! 디지엔텔케이어는 이곳에 있어야만 한다!
난 네녀석을을 인정할 수 없다. 만약 너희들의 진화가 옳은 진화라면 나를 쓰러뜨려보아라
_908.CompletionText: 이 정도로는 아무것도 되지 못한다. 내가 옳다는걸 알려주지. 소환카드는 "뒤틀린 데이터 마을" 중앙용암에서 사용할 수 있다.
_908.CompletionSummary: 인간과 함께 진화하는 디지몬들이여, 나는 아직 너희들을 받아들인게 아니다. 하지만, 그게 너희들이정한 길이라면 나는 아무런 말도 안하겠다.

_909.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (주작몬)>
_909.Description: 디지엔탈케이어가 무엇인줄 알고있느냐 ? 디지몬에게 진화를 전해준다. 그 것이 바로 디지엔탈케이어. 그것은 디지몬에게 필요불가결한 것이었지만 진정한 적을 가라앉히기 위해선 숨길 수 밖에 없었다.
_909.CompletionSummary: 하지만 디지몬으로 만들 필요까지는 없었단 말이지. 이야기는 여기까지다. 네녀석들이 마음에 들지는 않지만, 이걸 가져가라. 나의 디지코어다. 이 후 크게 도움이 될 물건이니 잃어버리지 않도록

_910.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (주작몬)>
_910.Description: 내 이름은 주작몬. 이 디지몬세계를 수호하는 성수다. 디지엔탈케이어를 찾으러 왔는가 ?
_910.CompletionText: 자네가 선택받은 테이머라면 그것을 증명할 수 있는 "무언가"를 보여주길 바라네

_911.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (주작몬)>
_911.Description: 나의 디지코어가 더 필요하다는 말인가 ? 그럼 네가 갖고 있는 디-아크와 교환해주도록 하지.
_911.CompletionText: 꼭 필요할 수 있으니 조급해하지 말게.
_911.CompletionSummary: 내 디지코어가 남아나질 않겠군. 여기 있네.

_912.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (백호몬)>
_912.Description: 나의 이름은 백호몬. 서방을 수호하는 디지몬이다. 현재 데-리퍼 들이 다시 날뛰는 바람에 디지엔탈 케이어의 도움이 필요한 상황이지.
_912.CompletionText: 자네가 선택받은 테이머라면 그것을 증명할 수 있는 "무언가"를 보여주길 바라네
_912.CompletionSummary: '디-아크' 군. 너희는 디지몬과 인간의 진화를 이용하는건가 ?

_913.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (백호몬)>
_913.Description: 데-리퍼와 혼자싸우고 있었다 나는. 디지털월드의 보안을 위해 중립의 입장에서 그대들을 보호하고 있을 뿐.
_913.CompletionText: 현무몬이 나를 대신하여 땅을 수호해 주었지. 연장자임에도 불구하고 고맙게 생각하고 있네.

_914.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (백호몬)>
_914.Description: 내가 그대에게 부탁할 것이 있네. 나를 제외한 다른 사성수들에게 디지엔탈케이어의 도움을 요청해야한다는걸 전해주지 않겠나?
_914.CompletionText: 다른 성수들도 이 마을 어딘가에 있을걸세
_914.CompletionSummary: 모두 이야기 했는가 ? 이제 디지엔탈케이어를 찾으러 가게나.

_915.Title: <4성수 이벤트 퀘스트 (백호몬)>
_915.Description: 나의 디지코어가 더 필요하다는 말인가 ? 그럼 네가 갖고 있는 디-아크와 교환해주도록 하지.
_915.CompletionText: 꼭 필요할 수 있으니 조급해하지 말게.
_915.CompletionSummary: 내 디지코어가 남아나질 않겠군. 여기 있네.

_916.Title: Yokohama Village
_916.Description: Hmm… Now I get to give you a gift..
_916.CompletionText: Aren't you curious what the gift is?
_916.CompletionSummary:
Look at the @<tc:800>Tamer@</tc>item you have installed.
You will see @<tc:800>Slot1 , Slot2@</tc>on the installed item. You can install items with various effects there.. This time, I will especially give you a gift for become an official agent of @<tc:

_917.Title: Dats Center
_917.Description: Will you let him know the good news? I mean Doctor Kevin Krier. He is a Dats Center member and the pioneer of surreal time and space research. You can meet him at the Dats Center.
_917.Objective: Find Kevin Krier at the Dats Center.
_917.CompletionText: You will be able to see it at the Dats Center.
_917.CompletionSummary: Is that so? So there is a chance he is still alive…

_918.Title: oil refinery-2
_918.Description:
It is Kristy Damon's birthday soon so I bought a present for her, but a digimon stole it.
Oh no! I went to great pains to get the present. What shall I do?
Will you find it? The digimon looked like a chicken… I heard many digimons are appearing near the oil refinery these days. Perhaps you could find it there?
_918.Objective: Give Kristy Damon's birthday present to Sarah Damon.
_918.CompletionText: Not many days left until her birthday. What shall I do? Kristy Damon will be disappointed if I don't have that present…
_918.CompletionSummary: Thanks so much. Kristy Damon's birthday will be the best this year!

_919.Title: oil refinery-1
_919.Description:
You probably know this but many digimons have been realized near the oil refinery. This has not been confirmed yet, but they say there are even Ultimate form digimons.
The situation has become very urgent.
I think you should quickly move to the oil refinery-1 and solve the problem of rising digimons.
I will go ahead of you.
Come and find me when you come to the oil refinery area.
_919.CompletionText: This is an urgent situation! I don't have time for this!
_919.CompletionSummary: You are always late… I will have to report this to Richard Sampson!!

_920.Title: Yokohama Village
_920.Description: Ah! Wait! I forgot to tell you the way! The oil refinery is past the small forest trail and wooden bench trail… but you can't just get in! There is an oil refinery employee in the village to the east, and if you speak to him he will let you go to the oil refinery. Go on then~
_920.CompletionSummary: Hmm.. You came to go to the oil refinery. I will send you to the oil refinery.

_921.Title: Dats Center
_921.Description: Evil Ring… The child of a human? Ha… A piece of work… Anyone able to make this kind of object must have something to do with digimons… Go to Richard Sampson and tell him… to look for anyone suspicious out of those registered as digimon tamers.. It would be best to find out through another organization related to digimons...
_921.CompletionText: Using good abilities for something bad… What a waste…
_921.CompletionSummary: Hmm.. Okay. I will look for information on him. Stick to your duties in the meantime...

_922.Title: Yokohama Park
_922.Description:
After I left my dear daughter, Minnie...
alone and came here to train, I heard that strange monsters appeared at my village.
If I did not have this match to prepare for, I would be at her side in a second..
What? You saw my daughter Minnie, you say?
Then, can you tell Minnie that I'm doing well, and to stay put there until I get there?
_922.Objective: You give Minnie news of her father.
_922.CompletionText: How scared Is Minnie by herself?
_922.CompletionSummary: I'm doing fine... And I even met a new friend.

_923.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_923.Summary: To get into the Miso Village 2
_923.Description: This is Miso Village, the pride of the Green Zone. But I can't even go home because the Bagra army is blocking the way... Defeat Troopmon so I can get into town, General!
_923.Objective: Please help us get Into the Village
_923.CompletionText: We need to get into the Village!

_924.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_924.Description: Thank you for helping me get into town, but they're not moving...Help me a little more.
_924.Objective: Please help us get Into the Village

_925.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_925.Description: You look a little tired. If you can help me find Cutemon, I'll cooperate.

_926.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_926.Description: I must leave this zone soon. I can't believe bamboo shoots are coming up this high. I take care of all those who get in the way.
_926.CompletionSummary: Such a good General you are.

_927.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_927.Description: The village is full of Bagra Army, too. The villagers are in panic, so let's go help them, General
_927.CompletionText: Please keep our village safe General!
_927.CompletionSummary: Is this make us a little safer?

_928.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_928.Description: I think there's a Mad Lomon in this bamboo shoot. Let's defeat the Apemons in front of us and get in!

_929.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_929.Description: It's a Digimon of Blue Xrosloader Can I fight General?
_929.CompletionText: He doesn't look like a good guy!
_929.CompletionSummary: Well, we lost it, but can't help it. Mad Leomon comes first, General!

_930.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_930.Description: I want General to work a little bit harder to keep our town safe!
_930.CompletionSummary: Good, good! Tomorrow also, please, General!

_931.Title: D-Terminal
_931.Summary: To get into the Miso Village 1
_931.Description: Do you want to go into Miso Village? In the green zone, defeat the Mad Leomon: Final Mode.
_931.Objective: To get into the Miso Village 1
_931.CompletionSummary: All right, I'll be on my way.

_932.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_932.Description: "It's the day of the Bamboo Shoots in the Natural Disaster Area from the Village!" According to legend, there is an active fault of bamboo shoots in the basement of this town, and they swallow the neighborhood once every few decades!
_932.CompletionText: Curious. Too many of them at the wrong timing.
_932.CompletionSummary: Please do the research for this weird situation.

_933.Title: GreenZone Miso Village
_933.Description:
The Bagra Army must have stirred up the ground by releasing Digimon underground.
Let's get defeat the Digimon in front of us.

_934.Title: <Event>
_934.Description: If you are lonely, please take this costume I prepared~
_934.CompletionSummary: If you wear this solo avatar when you have a girlfriend or wife, you could soon be alone. So watch out~

_935.Title: File Island Waterfront
_935.Summary: Sail out! To the New World! 1
_935.Description:
Information about the new continent is gathered.
Its name is Server Continent.
In Server Continent, there are other digimons aside from Devimon who want to harm the Digital World.
Our digimon friends are making a ship so that you can go to Server Continent.
You chosen children, go to the new continent and defeat the enemies.
_935.CompletionSummary: Wait while the ship is being constructed.

_936.Title: File Island Waterfront
_936.Summary: Sail out! To the New World! 2
_936.Description:
The ship is complete.
I shall let you know one thing before you leave.
There are many stronger digimons in Server Continent than those in File Island.
However, you don't need to worry.
There you will find necklaces and emblems with which you can get stronger.
I do not know their detailed locations.
Find the necklaces and emblems around Server Continent.
Now, board the ship.
_936.CompletionText: Is there anyone who feel seasick?

_937.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_937.Description: This is Server Continent... Now all we need to find are the Necklace and the Crests. That Durimon over there seems to know something.
_937.CompletionText: Lord Devimon’s order to guard the Necklace must never! Be told! To anyone!
_937.CompletionSummary: This is the Necklace! Now, when the Necklace and Crest unite, we can become even stronger!

_938.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_938.Description: 뭐? 데블몬이 두리몬에게 목걸이를 지키라는 명령을 내렸다고? 그렇다면 두리몬이 목걸이를 가지고 있을거야! 먼저 우리가 두리몬들을 혼내줘서 위협을 해야할 것 같아.

_939.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_939.Description:
Why..why are you doing this to my friends!
I won't tell you that the Drimogemon(Leader) and Drimogemon(Captain) have the necklaces even if you threaten me!
_939.CompletionSummary:
This is the necklace!
Now we will be stronger as the necklace and the emblem meet!

_940.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_940.Description: 미나 누나가 너무 지쳐보여요... 혹시 팔몬에게 미나 누나의 상태를 확인할 수 있을까요?
_940.CompletionSummary: 그렇지 않아도 미나가 목이 마르다고 해서 물을 찾고 있는 중이야.

_941.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_941.Description: 혹시 저기 넵튠몬들 보여? 넵튠몬은 바다를 헤엄치지만 몸 속엔 깨끗한 물이 있대. 그 물 모아와줘.
_941.CompletionText: 나도 물이 필요하지만 미나도 물이 필요해.

_942.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_942.Description:
Oh! Why are you so late to bring the water!
By the way, brother Tai and Agumon went to find a town...
Ask brother Tai if he has found a town.
_942.CompletionText: I want to take a shower quickly!!
_942.CompletionSummary:
Mimi is tired?
However, I am too in trouble...

_943.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_943.Description:
FanBeemon flying around took my spyglass.
These imps!
Please find my spyglass!
_943.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now let's locate the town!

_944.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_944.Description:
Ooh..If I were more tall, I could see better...
Please look around with the spyglass since you're taller than me.
_944.CompletionSummary:
Oh, the town is there?
I shall tell Agumon!

_945.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_945.Description:
Tell Agumon to come back as we have found a town.
He is looking around too much today...
_945.CompletionText: Is this because of sand dust...?
_945.CompletionSummary:
You found a town?
Sniff sniff..but smell tells differently...

_946.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_946.Description:
Sniff sniff...It's strange...
If Tai saw correctly, Koromon town should be there...
Then but why Koromon's smell comes from other place?
Tsk, I don't know! children must be hungry and tired!
_946.Objective: Go to the town and speak with town resident
_946.ObjectiveProgress:
%qs1Enter the town%qe %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Talk with a town resident%qe %cc2/%mc2

_947.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_947.Description:
이거 어쩌죠? 과일들은 준비되어 있지만 고기를 구할 수 없었어요... 죄송하지만 고기를 좀 구해다주실 수 있나요? 맛있~는! 요리로 보답하겠습니다!
마을 근처에 멧돼지몬이 있으니까 고녀석들을 잡아서 고기를 구해다주세요.
_947.CompletionText: 이 지역 멧돼지몬은 정말 육질이 좋답니다!
_947.CompletionSummary: 정말 고생많으셨습니다. 덕분에 맛있는 요리를 할 수 있게 됐어요. 목욕이라도 하시면서 기다리세요. 맛있는 요리를 준비해드릴게요.

_948.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_948.Description:
Now! Delicious dishes are all prepared!
Eat as much as you want and get rest!
_948.Objective:
Speak with Agumon
Speak with Tentomon
Speak with Gomamon
_948.ObjectiveProgress:
%qs1Speak with Agumon%qe %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Speak with Tentomon%qe %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Speak with Gomamon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_948.CompletionText: Make yourself at home! Take a rest!
_948.CompletionSummary: I was worried as Tentomon said Gazimons were bad; they are good digimons!

_949.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_949.Description:
Kkkk...It's lucky that the chosen children have come to us!
I shall lock up Patamon where Koromons are imprisoned!
I must send this news to Etemon.
Telegram deliverer Gazimon shall do the job!
_949.CompletionText: Kikiki...Etemon will give me a higher position!
_949.CompletionSummary: Oh-ho! I shall tell Etemon about this!

_950.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_950.Description:
Oh-ho! The chosen children have come to us themselves?
Hahaha... Etemon will be very glad if he hear this news!
_950.Objective:
Discovery of Etemon's hideout
Speak with Etemon
_950.CompletionText: Hahaha! You, the chosen children! You're rats in the trap! Kikikik!
_950.CompletionSummary:
What?!
The chosen children have already arrived here?!

_951.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_951.Description:
The chosen children arrived too soon!
My plan is wasted!
I won't forgive them. They'd better be prepared!
_951.CompletionText: I alone can take care of the chosen children!
_951.CompletionSummary:
What?!
This is what Gazimon and Etemon have done?!

_952.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_952.Description:
*Sobbing* Patamon!
Please ask Tai how to find Patamon...
*Sobbing*

_953.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_953.Description:
Gazimon and Etemon! They deceived us!
Agumon tracked Gazimon's smell.
Agumon must be at the hill in front of the town.
_953.CompletionText: Gazimon and Etemon... I won't forgive you@

_954.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_954.Description:
I can smell the group of Gazimons up there.
Patamon should be held behind them.
Let's defeat Gazimons and find Patamon!
If you find Gazimon, talk to Patamon!
_954.CompletionSummary:
*Sobbing* I was scared...
I'm sorry to make you worry..

_955.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_955.Description: 이 철창을 열려면 열쇠가 필요한데... 아! 아까 가지몬 대장 녀석이 열쇠를 가지고 있는 걸 봤어! 가지몬 대장에게서 열쇠를 찾아줘! 나랑 코로몬들 철창 열쇠까지 세개가 필요해!
_955.CompletionSummary: 좋았어! 이제 그 열쇠로 철창을 열면 되겠다!

_956.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_956.Description: 맞아! 바로 이 열쇠야! 이 열쇠로 나와 코로몬의 철창을 열어줘~
_956.Objective: 코로몬에게 열쇠 사용 코로몬에게 열쇠 사용 파닥몬에게 열쇠 사용
_956.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1코로몬에게 열쇠 사용%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2코로몬에게 열쇠 사용%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3파닥몬에게 열쇠 사용%qe %cc3/%mc3
_956.CompletionSummary: 고마워 고마워! 덕분에 마을로 돌아갈 수 있게 됐어!

_957.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_957.Description:
Etemon did all these troubles!
Interrogate the Gazimon there and locate Etemon!
_957.CompletionText: Gazimon and Etemon! I won't forgive you!
_957.CompletionSummary:
Oh!
Why..why are you doing this to me?

_958.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_958.Description:
Even if you threaten me and locate Etemon, you won't be able to defeat Etemon!
Hahaha! Etemon is in the open space there!
_958.CompletionText: Kikiki, you are not good enough to win against Etemon!
_958.CompletionSummary:
Oh-ho! You walk into my trap all by yourselves!
The chosen children!

_959.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_959.Description:
You'd better be prepared to fight against me!
My music block evolution!
I will let you hear the music of despair!
_959.CompletionText: I will let you hear the music of despair!
_959.CompletionSummary:
It's amazing that you win against me!
However, don't think it's the end!
Hahaha!

_960.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_960.Description:
Wow! Awesome!
It wasn't a perfect victory, but with your help we find peace again!
_960.CompletionSummary:
The chosen children! Thank you very much!
Because of you, we regained peace!

_961.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_961.Description:
As a reward, I will give you an age-old legendary object.
The chosen children, you will find what it is.
_961.Objective: Speak with a town resident Koromon

_962.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_962.Description:
Bring it to Tai.
He must know what it is.
_962.Objective: Deliver Emblem of Bravery to Tai

_963.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_963.Description:
Emblem of Bravery that makes Agumon's power stronger...
Good!!
Agumon, we can be stronger!
Now, let's go! To the broader world!
Now I'm not afraid of anything!

_964.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_964.Description:
You'd better be prepared to fight against me!
My music block evolution!
I will let you hear the music of despair!
_964.CompletionText: I will let you hear the music of despair!
_964.CompletionSummary:
It's amazing that you win against me!
However, don't think it's the end!
Hahaha!

_965.Title: 이벤트
_965.Description: 허허허~ 추운 겨울 감기 걸리지 않고 잘 지내고 있는가? 이번 겨울도 디지몬 마스터즈와 함께 보낸다면 좋은 일들이 많이 있을 걸세. 이렇게 만난 것도 인연이니 내가 선물을 주도록 하지!
_965.CompletionSummary: 나의 선물은 크리스마스 카드라네! 카드를 모으면 모을수록 행운이 깃든다고 하지! 열심히 카드를 모아보겠나?

_966.Title: 이벤트
_966.Description: 이번 겨울은 유난히 추워서 따듯하게 입은 나도 왠지 으스스한 느낌이 드는구먼. 추울 때는 녹용이 참으로 좋다고 하던데…. 그렇다고 루돌프의 뿔을 빼앗아 사용하기는 무척 난감하구먼. 그러니 나에게 녹용을 구해주는 것이 어떻겠나? 어떤 지역에서든 볼 수 있는 일반적인 디지몬들로부터 구할 수 있다네.
_966.CompletionText: 몬스터를 사냥하다보면 녹용을 획득할 수 있을 것이네. 허허허

_967.Title: 이벤트
_967.Description: 난 눈을 아주 좋아해! 눈덩이를 가지고 놀 수 있는 방법이 없을까? 아 맞다! 유키다루몬이 눈덩이를 갖고 있다고 하는 데 나에게 가져다줄 수 있겠어? D 터미널 B2, 눈사람 마을, 디지몬 미궁필드, 황야지역, 잃어버린 유적지, 사막 협곡에서 유키다루몬이 나타난다고 하니 참고해!
_967.CompletionText: 눈사람을 빨리 만들고 싶어. D 터미널 B2, 눈사람 마을, 디지몬 미궁필드, 황야지역, 잃어버린 유적지, 사막 협곡에서 유키다루몬이 나타난다고 하니 참고해!
_967.CompletionSummary: 우와! 고마워! 오늘 하루는 이걸로 신나게 놀 수 있겠군!

_968.Title: 이벤트
_968.Description:
안녕! 디지몬 마스터즈 7주년을 기념해서 너희들에게 멋진 업적을 줄께 물론 그냥은 줄 수 없고 7주년 메달 10개를 가져오는 조건으로!
이벤트를 진행하다보면 7주년 메달을 획득할 수 있으니 10개를 가져온다면 꼭 나에게 말을 걸라구!

_969.Title: 이벤트
_969.Description:
안녕! 지금은 디지몬 마스터즈 7주년 행사가 진행 중이야! 그런데...넌 굉장하군...? 십이신장의 가호를 받는 테이머였구나!
그렇다면 나 역시 너에게 그에 걸맞는 보상을 제공해주겠어! 앞으로 디지몬 마스터즈의 영웅이 되어줘!

_970.Title: 이벤트
_970.Description: 허허허~ 추운 겨울 감기 걸리지 않고 잘 지내고 있는가? 이번 겨울도 디지몬 마스터즈와 함께 보낸다면 좋은 일들이 많이 있을 걸세. 이렇게 만난 것도 인연이니 내가 선물을 주도록 하지!
_970.CompletionSummary: 나의 선물은 크리스마스 카드라네! 카드를 모으면 모을수록 행운이 깃든다고 하지! 열심히 카드를 모아보겠나?

_971.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_971.Description:
Oh... Till when shall we continue to walk? I'm so tired... I'm Gomamon! I live in the water! At this rate, my moist and glossy hair will dry...
There is an oasis nearby. Please find it. Comfort Mimi; she looked very exhausted.
_971.CompletionText: Shore? There is an oasis in a desert! I said Oasis. Oasis!

_972.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_972.Description:
As Tentomon said, it needs vast energy to evolve. We need to eat to replenish energy!
It's fortunate there are many FanBeemons who carry the fruits Agumon can eat.
Don’t be too hard on them; just scare them and get the fruits. It's bad but we need it for Agumon's evolution!
_972.CompletionText: Where is the fruits? We don't know when will Etemon attack us.!

_973.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_973.Description: Agumon shall eat to evolve! Now, let's have Agumon eat the fruits!
_973.CompletionText: Have you given all the fruits??
_973.CompletionSummary:
Okay. Have you eaten enough? Agumon, it's time for evolution!
Let's start quickly! Now Agumon, evolve!
_973.ReservedText: Oh... I'm too full to eat..

_974.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_974.Description:
Huh? Nothing happens... Why?
Aha! Let him fight with other digimons?
Yes! He eats fully to get strength. Now, let Agumon evolve. Agumon will evolve much faster if it fights with other digimons.
We need to fight with strong digimons to try the new evolution. Agumon! Let's fight with Rockmon there!
_974.CompletionText: Have you defeated all the Rockmons?
_974.CompletionSummary:
You can't evolve?
Why not?
Izzy, why does it not work?

_975.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_975.Description:
Tai
I feel like I somewhat changed after I got the emblem..
We are trying too much even if it's for Agumon and us...
_975.CompletionSummary:
Tai...
Agumon...
Are you two okay?
Is it okay?

_976.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_976.Description:
Oh... Look at this.
Kido Jou's emblem is shining.
There must be a nearby emblem!
Why don't you watch the surroundings with the spyglass I gave you?
You might find a good spyglass.
_976.CompletionText:
Use the spyglass sent to the bag.
(If you lost a spyglass, give up the quest and retake it.)

_977.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_977.Summary: To the Colosseum in the desert!
_977.Description:
I find a building there with the spyglass!! Let's go!
There might be a Kido Jou's emblem that we can find!
_977.CompletionText:
Have you checked which direction to Colosseum?
We might get lost.

_978.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_978.Description:
There are bad Gazimons nearby.
I think those digimons interrupt our evolution.
We have no choice. Let's defeat those dirty digimons!
_978.CompletionSummary: Disturbers... I will not let you do this again!

_979.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_979.Description:
That fake... No, that Greymon is controlled by Etemon!
That black aura shows that Greymon is being controlled. Defeat the Greymon being controlled.
_979.CompletionText: Have you defeated all the bad Greymons?

_980.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_980.Description:
A... Agumon... It's my fault.
No way. If we don't take care of that brutal SkullGreymon.
Please fight against SkullGreymon with us... It might be the faster way to restore our good Agumon.
_980.CompletionSummary:
We stopped SkullGreymon, but...
...
...
I'm sorry, Agumon...

_981.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_981.Description:
A... Agumon... It's my fault.
No way. If we don't take care of that brutal SkullGreymon.
Please fight against SkullGreymon with us... It might be the faster way to restore our good Agumon.
_981.CompletionSummary:
We stopped SkullGreymon, but...
...
...
I'm sorry, Agumon...

_982.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_982.Description:
Because of me, Agumon degraded into Koromon...
I should find the Koromon who must be sad.
Let's go to the Koromon at the rock in the six o'clock position in the desert.
_982.CompletionSummary: I'm not sad about it... I'm sad because I can't fulfil my friends' expectation..

_983.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_983.Description:
Phew.. I used up all the energy.
Will I be able to evolve into Agumon again?
Where should I go?
Oh?? Giant Cactus. Wait, Togemon! Let's go together... Don't leave me here!
There are a crowd of people near the cactus; he must be White-bearded Guru? Gennai... He may be able to help me!
_983.CompletionText:
Let's go to White-bearded Guru first.
He seems to be beside the giant cactus there.
_983.CompletionSummary: Hoho. You've come to see me?

_984.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_984.Description:
Oh... I want to be gigantic Togemon so that I want to protect Mimi and other friends from heat.. Sigh.
Oh? Hah? What is that? Everyone, do you see that? A giant cactus is there; let's go and see!
_984.CompletionText: It must be cool if we're near the giant cactus.
_984.CompletionSummary:
It's good as everyone was sick of the heat!
Togemon, it's cool for you too, right?

_985.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_985.Description:
It seems Tai's greed caused dark evolution...
Even with a necklace and an emblem, you need care for digimons.
Digimons grow according to your mind.
If you don't care for them, your parner digimons do not evolve.
Learn how to raise digimons well.
_985.CompletionText:
If you do whatever you want, you will see another SkullGreymon.
Don't tell me you want this pretty Patamon do dark evolution?
_985.CompletionSummary:
Keep think about it.
About what you should do to raise your parner digimon.

_986.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_986.Description:
Hah? Hah? Hah?
Look, my emblem is shining!
Do you see?
I didn't want it... However, it's pretty to see it shining...
Will I be able to have Palmon grow well?
What form would I take after evolving into a Togemon?
I want to take an angel or a fairy form! If I take one of those forms, I will give a accessory gift made with pretty feathers. Now, you will defeat Aquilamon and get some feathers!
_986.CompletionText: I don't want to have ... an emblem. However, Palmon will like it.
_986.CompletionSummary:
Palmon. I will try hard from now on!
I will make a pretty accessory with these feathers to congratulate the evolution!

_987.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_987.Description:
Will you be able to do for Palmon?
Palmon shall like it if we have it to drink and photosynthesize?
Yes! I shall find water and give Palmon some!
This is too dry and tough. We shall give Palmon some water before it withers. I can almost see Palmon smiles due to coldness.
Who has water? I saw Flymons had buckets of water!
Now get some water from Flymon.
_987.Objective: Get buckets of water from Flymon
_987.CompletionText: Have you got all the water?
_987.CompletionSummary:
Shrieking! Thank you.
Palmon will be very glad.

_988.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_988.Description:
Tai, welcome! We are doing very important meeting about digimons!
Hah? Oh?? By the way.
Kuwagamon is chasing us from there!
I think it's dangerous.
_988.CompletionText: Hurry. We have no time for this.
_988.CompletionSummary: Phew. Tai, with your help, I got it. Thank you!

_989.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_989.Description:
Even Kuwagamon threatens so much, Agumon couldn't evolve.
No... It's not Agumon's problem. It seems like my problem. I don't want it to become another SkullGreymon..
What does Agumon think?
_989.CompletionText: I have to tell Agumon that I have a heavy heart about it.
_989.CompletionSummary:
I am too afraid.. However, Tai...
If I do nothing due to fear, I will remain as Greymon forever.
I must stand up even if I fear!

_990.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_990.Description:
Where have Izzy gone to?
I saw two of them were leaving but didn't know where they are since then.
It's like Matt is also missing; why don't you ask Gabumon about Matt's and Izzy's whereabouts?
_990.CompletionSummary:
I was looking for Matthew..
Where Matt and Izzy have gone?
Oh... Suddenly my power is disappearing; what is the cause?

_991.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_991.Description:
Suddenly I lost strength. Tentomon looks it also lost some strength. It seems something happened to Matt and Izzy. Arkadimon must have done it.
Defeat nearby ferocious Arkadimon. I have lost strength now so that I can't fight with the digimons.
_991.CompletionText: Have you defeated all the Arkadimons?
_991.CompletionSummary: Wow... I think Matt and Izzy are out of danger as my power is back. Thank you!

_992.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_992.Description:
Agumon and I lack something. What is the problem...?
Does White-bearded Guru knows the problem correctly?
_992.CompletionText: I think White-bearded Guru may be able to help us.

_993.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_993.Description:
Each emblem helps each character.
Its power works when you understand some values
To know what you need most, you must fight together with Agumon.
Devidramon is bullying weak digimons around here. Defeat him.
Have you found what Tai and Agumon need?
_993.CompletionText: Have you found everything you need?
_993.CompletionSummary:
Courage...
You two need courage to move forward.
Well, I don't know.. That might be true as well..

_994.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_994.Description:
Big danger seems like to shows up.
That sand storm is the most mischievous and violent Etemon.
The conclusion you two have found. Now is the time to test your courage to step forward!
Go to Etemon and defeat him to restore the peace to the desert.
_994.CompletionText: Etemon is very strong. He will lose his power if Love serenade is sung.
_994.CompletionSummary:
You did it!
I'm proud of you! I knew you would do it.

_995.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_995.Description:
Big danger seems like to shows up.
That sand storm is the most mischievous and violent Etemon.
The conclusion you two have found. Now is the time to test your courage to step forward!
Go to Etemon and defeat him to restore the peace to the desert.
_995.CompletionText: Etemon is very strong. He will lose his power if Love serenade is sung.
_995.CompletionSummary:
You did it!
I'm proud of you! I knew you would do it.

_996.Title: Server Continent-Desert
_996.Description:
Agumon, what you and I need is the courage to go one step forward.
Thank you. I alone could never go forward. It has been possible only because I have been with you.
Thank you very much. Agumon. And... friends
_996.CompletionSummary: What kind of stories will our emblems tell us?

_997.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_997.Description: Calu? Gatomon, it's time to find your Holy Ring, Calu! You can restore your true power when you get back the lost Holy Ring, calu! Let's go to Silver Lake in File Island, calu!
_997.CompletionText: Go now! Be careful. I heard there's Distorted World there, calu!
_997.CompletionSummary: It was just about here, I think this is the place!

_998.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_998.Description: Hawkmon! I want you to help Gatomon to find Holy Ring, calu! Gatomon went to Silver Lake, calu!
_998.CompletionText: Many digimons live in the forest- So,they might know, calu!
_998.CompletionSummary: I think I lost my Holy Ring around here...

_999.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_999.Description: It must be around here… Local digimons may have taken it. Do you know any digimon here? Why don't you talk with Elecmon? He must be near! Let's find him! Only one might tell you what happened!
_999.CompletionText: Many digimons live in the forest- So, they might know.

_1000.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1000.Description: I heard Digimon kaiser's scream while you got Elecmon's statement! I don't know what is happening! Let's go! There might be clue to Holy Ring!
_1000.CompletionSummary: Recently Digimon kaiser has regular headache. I don't know what is happening…

_1001.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1001.Description: How can you be here? Calumon told you? I lost Holy Ring while fighting against Digimon Kaiser here. Without Holy Ring, I can hardly evolve- It would be nice to find it together. Ask Elecmon for clue! Only one of them knows what happened!
_1001.CompletionText: Without Holy Ring, I can hardly evolve- It would be nice to find it together.
_1001.CompletionSummary: He said he haven't seen Holy Ring… Oh! I heard Digimon kaiser's scream. Let's move to the place first!

_1002.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1002.Description: .You are looking for Holy Ring? I will help you as you helped me. Let's go to Silent Forest. Ask others for help .
_1002.CompletionText: If we keep going forward, we will face Silent Forest.

_1003.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1003.Description: That's weird. As V-mon cannot find us, this must be the Distorted World Calumon warned about. How can we escape from here? There must be Holy Ring here! Let's gather information about this place. Hawkmon seems to have found something. Let's go to the Lost Historic Site to talk to Hawkmon.
_1003.CompletionText: Hawkmon seems to have found something. Let's go to the Lost Historic Site to talk to Hawkmon.
_1003.CompletionSummary: There is something shiny at the cliff!!

_1004.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1004.Summary: That Shiny Thing Is a Ring?
_1004.Description: There is something shiny at the cliff! I need to check it, can you help me? That shiny thing must be Holy Ring! How can we check it? Let's go back to Calumon for now.
_1004.Objective: That Shiny Thing Is a Ring?
_1004.CompletionText: That shiny thing must be Holy Ring! How can we check it? Let's go back to Calumon for now.
_1004.CompletionSummary: Shiny ring? It's Evil Ring, calu! We heard it's violet, right!

_1005.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1005.Summary: To Escape From the Distorted World...
_1005.Description: Oh no! The shiny thing was Evil Ring! Calu! That's Blossomon sent by Arachnemon, calu! That made this space distorted. Let's defeat Blossomon and go back home! Calu! Defeat Blossomon and get its 'Leaf' to me, calu! Blossomon is somewhere in the "Lost Historic Site"!

_1006.Title: Jogress Quest(Silphymon)
_1006.Description: Arachnemon, I won't forgive you! You made digimons with Dark Tower…! I will teach you a lesson! Calu! Bring back Arachnemon's hair, calu! Arachnemon is somewhere in the "File Island Waterfront"!

_1007.Title: <Event>
_1007.Description: Collect 50 Essence of Desert. I will exchange them for <Miracle Fruit>. Hurry up!
_1007.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well.

_1008.Title: <Event>
_1008.Description: Collect 50 Essence of Desert. I will exchange them for <Miracle Fruit>. Hurry up!
_1008.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well.

_1009.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well.

_1010.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well.

_1017.Description: Collect 650 Essence of Desert. I will exchange them for <Mystery Reinforced Mercenary Digiegg>. Hurry up!
_1017.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've collected them very soon! You did well.

_1018.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1018.Description:
At some point, Digital World time base has been distorted. I can’t recognize accurate reason for the matter, anyway azimuth is affected by the time base distorted. So azimuth of Four holy beasts may also affected.
Azimuth of Four holy beasts cannot be changed absolutely. Entire Digimon World will be in danger if it is changed. Calu~
We must check azimuth of Four holy beasts first. Go to @<tc:900> Snowman Village @</tc> and check azimuth of Qinglongmon. @</tc> Calu~
_1018.CompletionText:
Hurry up Calu~
The time base has been distorting more and more.
_1018.CompletionSummary:
I’m Qinglongmon who protect the east of Digital World.
Why are you standing in front of me?

_1019.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1019.Description:
At some point, Digital World time base has been distorted. I can’t recognize accurate reason for the matter, anyway azimuth is affected by the time base distorted. So azimuth of Four holy beasts may also affected.
Azimuth of Four holy beast cannot be changed absolutely. Entire Digimon World will be in danger if it is changed. Calu~
We must check azimuth of Four holy beasts first.
Go to @<tc:900> Western Village ? West @</tc> and check azimuth of Baihumon. @</tc> Calu~
_1019.Objective: @<tc:090>Talk with Baihumon in Western Village - West@</tc>
_1019.CompletionText:
Hurry up Calu~
The time base has been distorting more and more.
_1019.CompletionSummary:
I’m Baihumon who protect the west of Digital World.
Why are you standing in front of me?

_1020.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1020.Description:
At some point, Digital World time base has been distorted. I can’t recognize accurate reason for the matter, anyway azimuth is affected by the time base distorted. So azimuth of Four holy beasts may also affected.
Azimuth of Four holy beast cannot be changed absolutely. Entire Digimon World will be in danger if it is changed. Calu~
We must check azimuth of Four holy beast first.
Go to @<tc:900> Oil Refinery-3 @</tc> and check azimuth of Zhuqiaomon. @</tc> Calu~
_1020.CompletionText:
Hurry up Calu~
The time base has been distorting more and more.
_1020.CompletionSummary:
I’m Zhuqiaomon who protect the south of Digital World.
Why just human likes you are finding me?!

_1021.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1021.Description:
At some point, Digital World time base has been distorted. I can’t recognize accurate reason for the matter, anyway azimuth is affected by the time base distorted. So azimuth of Four holy beasts may also affected.
Azimuth of Four holy beast cannot be changed absolutely. Entire Digimon World will be in danger if it is changed. Calu~
We must check azimuth of Four holy beast first. Go to @<tc:900> Silver Lake @</tc> and check azimuth of Xuanwumon. @</tc> Calu~
_1021.CompletionText:
Hurry up Calu~
The time base has been distorting more and more.
_1021.CompletionSummary:
I’m Xuanwumon who protect the south of Digital World.
Why are you standing in front of me?

_1022.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1022.Description:
My name is @<tc:900> Qinglongmon @</tc>, who protect the east of Digimon World.
I’m standing here to look true enemies squarely and to protect useless blood shedding. And it is my work that I have changed Digi-Entelechy into Digimon to conceal against enemies. If you are chosen child, prove it to me. Retrieve @<tc:900>my Digicore@</tc> from Wendimon.
_1022.CompletionText: If you are chosen child, prove it to me.
_1022.CompletionSummary: Chosen Child! I think the Digimon Evolution with human is also a decision which has been made by this World.

_1023.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1023.Description:
My name is @<tc:900> Baihumon@</tc>, who protect the west of Digimon World.
I have been fighting against D-Reaper alone.
If you are chosen child, prove it to me. Retrieve @<tc:900>my Digicore@</tc> from Okuwamon.
_1023.CompletionText: If you are chosen child, prove it to me.
_1023.CompletionSummary: Chosen Child! I just try to protect you neutrality for security of Digimon World.

_1024.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1024.Description:
My name is @<tc:900> Zhuqiaomon@</tc>, who protect the south of Digimon World.
Digimon doesn’t need any human.
To evolve relying on Human, It isn’t existed.
I cannot forgive Digimon which has tried to protect the human!
If you are chosen child, prove it to me. Retrieve @<tc:900>my Digicore@</tc> from Neo Devimon.
_1024.CompletionSummary:
Human, I don’t still accept you.
But, it is a way to be decided by you… I won’t say anything about it.

_1025.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1025.Description:
My name is @<tc:900> Xuanwumon@</tc>, who protect the north of Digimon World.
D-Reaper is in activation! I didn’t know really that I can see human in this place.
Human! You have a reason for finding me, right?
If you are chosen child, prove it to me. And then I may hear your voice.
Retrieve @<tc:900>my Digicore@</tc> from Elecmon (Leader).
_1025.CompletionText: If you are chosen child, prove it to me.
_1025.CompletionSummary:
Leave D-Reaper to us.
The enemy cannot be handled by you.

_1026.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1026.Description: You worry about distorted time base! But it can’t give us chaos. The chaos has been only caused by someone who sealed our core. I don’t know exactly who it is, but there is someone I eye with suspicion. You must check it for revival Huanglongmon. @<tc:900> Go to Lava Area that middle of Distorted Data Village</tc> @<tc:900> Defeat Seraphimon@</tc> and@<tc:900> find a trace of Huanglongmon@</tc> @<tc:900>bring it @</tc>to Calumon. He may able to revive Huanglongmon.
_1026.Objective: ‘@<tc:090>Defeat Seraphimon and collect Trace of Huanglongmon@</tc>
_1026.CompletionText: Huanglongmon has been sealed in deepest place of earth by an angel type Digimon who descended from Ancient era. Find the Digimon of angel type!
_1026.CompletionSummary:
This is Trace of Huanglongmon!
At last, I can find the way to revive Huanglongmon. Calu~

_1027.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1027.Description: I think you don’t know a reason for this chaos. The chaos has been caused by disappeared core. So, we must find the angel who sealed Huanglongmon to calm down the chaos. I don’t know exactly who it is, but there is someone I eye with suspicion. @<tc:900> Go to Dark Tower Wasteland</tc> @<tc:900> I can feel his power nearby three way intersection in North @</tc> Defeat him @<tc:900> and find a trace of Huanglongmon@<tc:900> bring it @</tc>to Calumon. He may able to revive Huanglongmon.
_1027.Objective: ‘@<tc:090>Defeat Cherubimon(Virtue) and collect Trace of Huanglongmon@</tc>
_1027.CompletionText: Huanglongmon has been sealed in deepest place of earth by an angel type Digimon who descended from Ancient era. Find the Digimon of angel type!
_1027.CompletionSummary:
This is Trace of Huanglongmon!
At last, I can find the way to revive Huanglongmon. Calu~

_1028.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1028.Description: Evolution relies on human? I can’t accept it still. Do you think the evolution is really right!? We will protect Digital World with our own way. You have to do a thing Above all. Maybe another 4 holy beasts also start to find sealed trace of Huanglongmon. @<tc:900>Go to Abandoned historic excavation area @</tc>of @<tc:900>Desolate Historic Site @</tc> , defeat the angel @<tc:900> Ofanimon@</tc> @<tc:900> and find a trace of Huanglongmon@</tc> @<tc:900>bring it @</tc>to Calumon. He may able to revive Huanglongmon. After you finish it, I will make a decision for the way of evolution is right or not.
_1028.Objective: ‘@<tc:090>Defeat Ofanimon and collect Trace of Huanglongmon@</tc>
_1028.CompletionText: Revival of Huanglongmon is the power & way to protect this world.
_1028.CompletionSummary:
This is Trace of Huanglongmon!
At last, I can find the way to revive Huanglongmon. Calu~

_1029.Title: Jogress Quest (Huanglongmon)
_1029.Description: The enemy that we are in fighting cannot be handled by you. Moreover we must find & revive Huanglongmon. But 4 holy beasts also have to protect their azimuth. Here is a thing you have to do instead of us to revive Huanglongmon. Find the angel who sealed Huanglongmon, and find a trace of Huanglongmon. I don’t know exactly who it is, but there is someone I eye with suspicion. @<tc:900>Go to Lost Historic Site@</tc> and find Lucemon nearby @<tc:900> Stinky Forest @</tc> I assure Lucemon sealed Huanglongmon. @<tc:900> Defeat Lucemon @</tc> @<tc:900> bring a trace of Huanglongmon @</tc>to Calumon.
_1029.Objective: ‘@<tc:090>Defeat Lucemon and collect Trace of Huanglongmon@</tc>
_1029.CompletionText: Hurry to revive Huanglongmon who has been sealed in deepest place of earth.
_1029.CompletionSummary:
This is Trace of Huanglongmon!
At last, I can find the way to revive Huanglongmon. Calu~

_1030.Title: <Event>
_1030.Description:
Digimon Ka... No, Digimon Kaiser used to say he will make his original digimon!
However, Kaiser failed evolution experiment, and it ended up SkullGreymon going wild in the digital world.
Go to defeat SkullGreymon going wild.
When SkullGreymon appears, I will let you know by a message.
SkullGreymon appears randomly at one of @<tc:900>Oil Refinery Area 1, Western Town Suburb, and Blizzard Town@</tc>!
If there are more than 50 players who deal more damage to SkullGreymon than you do, you may not receive the bone piece; so do your best!
_1030.Objective: @<tc:090>※Messages will show up when SkullGreymon appears and get defeated.@</tc>
_1030.CompletionSummary: Wow! I was worried because SkullGreymon moved around. Thank you for defeating it!

_1031.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_1031.Description: Digimon Kaiser is beginning to raise a dark tower in the region we live. We tried to stop it but we couldn't evolve due to the dark tower's evil power. Still my friends are suffering there. Go to Dark Tower Wasteland and help Falcomon.
_1031.CompletionText: My friends are in danger because of the dark tower and evil ring.
_1031.CompletionSummary: The chosen children! You have come. Please help.

_1032.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_1032.Description: Digimon Kaiser is experimenting evil spiral, which is a more powerful brainwashing device than evil ring, here to control the strong evolved digimons. Help my friends suffering because of evil spiral. Take evil spirals from all the digimons in the dark tower area.
_1032.Objective: @<tc:090>You defeated a digimon in the dark tower and obtained an evil spiral@</tc>
_1032.CompletionText: There are still many friends who need your help.
_1032.CompletionSummary: Thank you. With your help, my friends are free again now.

_1033.Title: Dark Tower Wasteland
_1033.Description:
Hahaha.. Stupid kids.
You never remove my original 'Chimairamon' who was made by my genius brain and desire.
Hahaha.. Try it. Haha.. Do it now! Haha!
Well, if you remove my Chimairamon in my laboratory hard stage, I will give you a fabulous title!
There is one digimon bothering me.. Magnamon. But I don't care. My experiment is more important. Haha..
Let's see your funny fight. Hahaha!!
_1033.CompletionText: Did you think you can make it?
_1033.CompletionSummary: Damm.. I should make my Chimairamon more powerful.. Get this title that I promised.

_1034.Title: Yokohama Village
_1034.Description:
"I heared about you. Many people say you are an exceptional Dats Agent. Let's see is that true.
Now we have a small problem in Management of Digimon Riding because of Drimogemon. They suddenly shown up infront of Yokohama Elementary School. So i want you to defeat them. Addition, you can learn about a habit of Riding Digimons.
This mission will be helpful to you. You never tried Riding, aren't you? So take it, and try it."
_1034.CompletionText: You can find Drimogemon that has infromation about rindg from infront of Yokohama Elementary School. Go and check it.
_1034.CompletionSummary: How was it? Is it helpness to you?

_1035.Title: Yokohama Village
_1035.Description: I think problem has been solved. Don't forget that you learn and always remember the Riding Digimon's habit.

_1036.Title: Yokohama Village
_1036.Description:
Let's start a lesson about Riding Digimon! We have 3 steps to ride Digimon. 1. Regist Drimogemon Digi-Egg (Incubator) 2. Input a Beast Data 3. Use [Rider Wing] after hatch Drimogemon
Do you understand the steps? Easy, right?
_1036.CompletionText: Now you can ride Drimogemon! Aren't you excited?
_1036.CompletionSummary:
I will explain the steps one more time!
1. Regist Drimogemon Digi-Egg (Incubator) 2. Input a Beast Data 3. Use [Rider Wing] after hatch Drimogemon
Don't forget!
