_1037.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1037.Description:
We have to go somewhere to escape Etemon. Where is a good place to hide?
I think we should get away from here and go to a different place.
_1037.Objective: Server Continent - moving to the desert canyon
_1037.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Server Continent - moving to the desert canyon%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1037.CompletionText: Let's get out of this place.
_1037.CompletionSummary: It is fortunate that we somehow escaped Etemon.

_1038.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1038.Description:
This place is very complicated. We should enter the geography of the region into the laptop and complete the map of this place but as you can see, the laptop is not powering on.
Fortunately, Psychemon below the southwest side has materials for recharging. Please obtain the recharging materials from them.
_1038.CompletionText: Hurry up and find the materials for recharging.
_1038.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I can use the laptop with this.

_1039.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1039.Description:
It is necessary to restore the laptop network for good communication with Gennai. We will need advice for the way.
Please find the wireless transceiver from Psychemon, who is southwest from here.
_1039.CompletionText: We have to quickly restore the network…
_1039.CompletionSummary: Done. It will be easier to connect to the network with this.

_1040.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1040.Description:
What? I turned the laptop on and there is one mail. Let me see…
The mail says they will tell us where the Emblem is if we save them.
_1040.CompletionSummary: Is it the guy who will tell us the whereabouts of the Emblem?

_1041.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1041.Description:
We do not know who they are but it does not feel right to ignore their plea for help.
Let's help the people who sent the mail.
_1041.CompletionText: Do all of you agree with me?
_1041.CompletionSummary: Yes, I agree with you Tai.

_1042.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1042.Summary: A Emblem buried in the canyon
_1042.Description:
It says that the necklace will shine faintly as we go in the direction the sender told us.
The light is becoming brighter as we move to the place of hope in the southeast. That means that the Emblem is there?
Let's move.
_1042.Objective: Talking with Izzy at the place of hope
_1042.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1talking with Izzy at the place of hope%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1042.CompletionText: Quickly follow the light. I think we should go to the southeast, to the place of hope.
_1042.CompletionSummary: It's here! T.K.'s necklace is glowing here!

_1043.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1043.Description: Because T.K.'s Emblem is glowing, we know for certain that we have to move southeast. But Monochromons are blocking the road to the southeast. Please block them so T.K. can concentrate on finding the Emblem. I will go to the place of hope first. Tell me after you have defeated Monochromons.
_1043.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Because of you, T.K. was able to come here safely.

_1044.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1044.Description: Why can't we find the Emblem even though the necklace is glowing? It seems as if PicoDevimon took the Emblem. I think Izzy can help us move to the place where you can't walk to. Let's ask him to help find to Emblem.
_1044.CompletionText: If we talk to Izzy, he will move us to the blocked place.
_1044.CompletionSummary: It is here! The Emblem of Hope!

_1045.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1045.Summary: Realizing the identity of the sender of the mail
_1045.Description:
We found the Emblem. It seems as if the sender of the mail was not lying. But I am curious who it is…
Looking through the binoculars, it looks like Vegiemon tortured Gazimon in the west. Let's punish Vegiemon and talk to Gazimon.
_1045.CompletionText: Let's defeat Vegiemon, who tortured Gazimon.

_1046.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1046.Description:
Finding the Emblem is important but we should first accomplish the orders of the sender is important too.
The order is finding the key that will open the shackles and free the sender. It looks like Vegiemons in the west down this road have the key. Finding the key is first.
I will wait in the lost place. Report to me there.
_1046.CompletionText: What do you think the key is?
_1046.CompletionSummary: Oh, this looks like a switch to operate a machine.

_1047.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1047.Description:
I am Etemon's follower but now, I do not want to fight. I was tortured by Vegiemons and ShogunGekomons on the left took Etemon's snack!
If you find Etemon's snack, I will tell you what you want to know.
_1047.CompletionSummary:
Thank, thank you.
Huh! Nanomon is the one managing the network. It looks like he is the sender who sent you the mail.

_1048.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1048.Description: We know who sent the mail so let's get out of here. Izzy is making the canyon map so he will know how to quickly move to another place.
_1048.Objective: Moving to another place after talking with Izzy
_1048.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1moving to another place after talking with Izzy%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1048.CompletionText: Talk to Izzy to move to another place.
_1048.CompletionSummary: This place looks like there is no data built yet. I think we have to find another way out of the canyon here.

_1049.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1049.Description:
Welcome, the Digidestined. I will train you here so you can fight Etemon!
First, fight with Roachmon in the west region so I can see your skills. Beep!
_1049.CompletionText: Fighting Etemon is not easy. That is why you have to train. Beep!
_1049.CompletionSummary:
Good job. Beep! I think that is enough.
Now, only Tai will receive special training with me. Beep!

_1050.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1050.Description:
Piximon instructed me to go on a special training. I don't know why he is making only me do it but I must do what he told me to do.
The special training is fighting and defeating Strikedramon.
I think Strikedramon is in the southwest direction.
_1050.CompletionText: To be honest, I am not confident. Do you think we will be OK? Agumon?
_1050.CompletionSummary: Tai is becoming confident again. Beep! The purpose of this special training was to help Tai be confident again. Beep!

_1051.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1051.Description:
It is weird… My necklace started glowing. Does it mean my Emblem is around here somewhere?
It looks like the light becomes brighter when I go towards the south where Strikedramon live.
_1051.CompletionText: Let's go to find the Emblem of Friendship.
_1051.CompletionSummary: Great, it is my Emblem of Friendship!

_1052.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1052.Description:
There is no need to stay here anymore because Tai is confident again and we found the Emblem. Beep!
Move to the 'Beginning of the Canyon,' the first place of the desert canyon. Beep!
Move to the east and you will easily find the place. Beep!
_1052.Objective: Talking with Izzy at the 'Beginning of the Canyon' of the desert canyon
_1052.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1talking with Izzy at the 'Beginning of the Canyon' of the desert canyon%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1052.CompletionText: You can find the road to the exit from the 'Beginning of the Canyon.' Beep!
_1052.CompletionSummary: Ah, this place is… I see.

_1053.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1053.Summary: A question about the Digital World
_1053.Description:
Go down the road and you can get out of the desert canyon. We can now get out of this complicated place.
But there are still unsolved puzzles. It is a good idea to move to the south and fight Gazimon.
I will wait for you on the road towards the pyramid.
_1053.CompletionText: We have to catch Gazimon to collect information.
_1053.CompletionSummary: The sentence information they had is similar to the information in the ruins.

_1054.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1054.Description:
You can operate the program just by using sentences and can make the Digital World using electricity.
Now, we understand the surrounding region. We only need to collect information for the whole map now. We have to obtain the pieces of the Digital World Map from Gazimon.
_1054.Objective: Collecting the pieces of the Digital World map
_1054.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1collecting the pieces of the Digital World map%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1054.CompletionText: It feels like I have seen the map of this place somewhere.

_1055.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1055.Description:
The Digital World map is very similar to the world we live in. That means this place is a world that looks similar to the model of the world made of data.
It is like we are in this world as data.
_1055.CompletionText: Let's try to figure out the place from where Nanomon sent the mail.
_1055.CompletionSummary: What? That means we are not real but our existence is digital!

_1056.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1056.Description:
That means our real selves are someplace else and we are here digitally. That means we cannot die even under any danger.
Excellent! Let's fight Etemon and save Nanomon! Let's defeat Cherrymon, who is blocking our way, and go forward!
_1056.CompletionSummary: Excellent. Just wait Etemon! I will show you the results of the training!

_1057.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1057.Description:
It seems like the children are placed in so much danger while finding my Emblem. I am so sorry…But I am very thankful that all of you do not show it.
I want to do something helpful for the children. What do you think of finding kindling for Cherrymon at the bottom? I want them to have fire so they will be warm tonight.
_1057.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I will never forget your help.

_1058.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1058.Description:
To destroy the mobility of Etemon, we have to stop Monochromon, who pulls the train, at least a little bit.
That is why I want you to defeat Monochromon in the southeast so Etemon cannot use the train. Can you help us a little?
I will be at the place of hope. Tell me when it is completed.
_1058.CompletionText: I am nervous because I think Etemon might follow us all the way here.
_1058.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Do you think we can relax a little?

_1059.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1059.Summary: Digimon tries to break them apart
_1059.Description:
It looks like that evil Digimon is trying to break T.K. and I apart. What is it trying to do, luring T.K.?
Let's show PicoDevimon a piece of our minds.
_1059.CompletionText: T.K. must not fall for PicoDevimon's trap!
_1059.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Because of you, T.K. and I are not drifting apart.

_1060.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1060.Description:
I like Izzy. He is always searching for knowledge. However, his necklace is glowing faintly but he is not thinking of finding the Emblem at all.
He is completely focused in researching the Digital World. So, what do you think about searching Roachmon in the west for Izzy's Emblem?
_1060.CompletionText: Oh no. Izzy is still so busy.
_1060.CompletionSummary: There really is the Emblem of Knowledge. With this, I have the ability to evolve into an Ultimate!

_1061.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1061.Description:
I really want photosynthesis. I think the place to the west receives the most sunlight.
But as you can see, Cherrymon is down there. Can we chase them away? If we defeat the Leader, I think we can somewhat take the place.
_1061.CompletionText: There is not much sunlight here.
_1061.CompletionSummary: With this, I can receive some sunlight!

_1062.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1062.Description:
There is a hidden place in the canyon. Beep. Digimons called the rulers of the canyon are in the hidden place. Beep.
The reason I am here is to observe them. Beep. If they come out, the Digital World will surely fall into chaos. Beep.
Can you fight them?
_1062.CompletionSummary:
OK. If you are that sure, I will tell you how to fight them. Beep.
Receive orders from me, located in the south from here. Beep.

_1063.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1063.Description:
The most dangerous Digimon among the rulers of the canyon is the Devil of the canyon. Beep.
To meet the Devil of the canyon, you have to defeat and collect the data of the followers of the Devil. Beep.
I will move you so you can meet the observers of the canyon. Beep. Defeat them and collect the data. Beep.
_1063.CompletionText: The observers of the canyon are not easy. Beep.
_1063.CompletionSummary: You completely defeated the observers. Beep. Hold on to the data for now. Beep.

_1064.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1064.Description:
The most dangerous Digimon among the rulers of the canyon is the Devil of the canyon. Beep. You have to defeat the Devil of the canyon to truly defeat the threat of the canyon. Beep.
To meet the Devil of the canyon, you have to defeat and collect the data of the followers of the Devil. Beep.
I will move you so you can meet the guards of the canyon. Beep. Defeat them and collect the data. Beep.
_1064.CompletionText: The guards of the canyon are not easy. Beep.
_1064.CompletionSummary: You completely defeated the guards. Beep. Hold on to the data for now. Beep.

_1065.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1065.Description:
The most dangerous Digimon among the rulers of the canyon is the Devil of the canyon. Beep. You have to defeat the Devil of the canyon to truly defeat the threat of the canyon. Beep.
To meet the Devil of the canyon, you have to defeat and collect the data of the followers of the Devil. Beep.
I will move you so you can meet the commanders of the canyon. Beep. Defeat them and collect the data. Beep.
_1065.CompletionText: The commanders of the canyon are not easy. Beep.
_1065.CompletionSummary: You completely defeated the commanders. Beep. Hold on to the data for now. Beep.

_1066.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1066.Summary: Summoning the Devil of the canyon
_1066.Description:
You have to defeat and collect the data of the observers, guards, and commanders of the canyon to create the data to summon the Devil of the canyon. Beep.
You cannot summon the Devil of the canyon if you do not have them. Beep.
_1066.Objective: Collecting the data of HiAndromon Collecting the data of Murmukusmon Collecting the data of Slayerdramon
_1066.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1collecting the data of HiAndromon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2collecting the data of Murmukusmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3collecting the data of Slayerdramon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1066.CompletionText: I need the data from defeating the observers, guards, and commanders of the canyon. Beep.
_1066.CompletionSummary: You collected all the data. Beep. Now, combine them together and it is complete. Beep!

_1067.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1067.Summary: [Raid] Defeating the Devil of the canyon
_1067.Description:
I will move you to the base of the Devil of the canyon. Beep. The Devil of the canyon is summoned if you use the essence item of the data there. Beep.
Good luck. Beep. He is a very strong and dangerous Digimon. Beep.
_1067.Objective: Defeating Diaboromon, the Devil of the canyon
_1067.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1defeating Diaboromon, the Devil of the canyon%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1067.CompletionText: The Devil of the canyon needs the essence item of the data. Beep. If you do not win the fight, don't forget to go on the quest again to collect the data from the Devil's followers. Beep.
_1067.CompletionSummary: You finally did it! Beep! I am so proud of you. Beep!

_1068.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1068.Summary: Collecting the data of the followers of the canyon.
_1068.Description:
There are still threats in the canyon. Beep. Collect the data of the observers, guards, and commanders of the canyon. Beep.
I will make you the item to summon the Devil of the canyon if you bring the data. Beep. If you collect all the data, report to me in the middle. Beep.
_1068.Objective: Collecting the data of HiAndromon Collecting the data of Murmukusmon Collecting the data of Slayerdramon
_1068.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1collecting the data of HiAndromon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2collecting the data of Murmukusmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3collecting the data of Slayerdramon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1068.CompletionText: They are the observers of the canyon, guards of the canyon, and commanders of the canyon. Beep.
_1068.CompletionSummary: Great, I will make you the item to summon the Devil of the canyon. Beep.

_1069.Title: Server Continent - Canyon
_1069.Summary: [Raid] Defeating the Devil of the canyon
_1069.Description:
I will move you to the base of the Devil of the canyon. Beep. The Devil of the canyon is summoned if you use the essence item of the data there. Beep.
Good luck. Beep. He is a very strong and dangerous Digimon. Beep.
_1069.Objective: Defeating Diaboromon, the Devil of the canyon
_1069.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1defeating Diaboromon, the Devil of the canyon%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1069.CompletionText: The Devil of the canyon needs the essence item of the data. Beep. If you do not win the fight, don't forget to go on the quest again to collect the data from the Devil's followers. Beep.
_1069.CompletionSummary: You finally did it! Beep! I am so proud of you. Beep!

_1070.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1070.Description:
I discovered that the base of Etemon is in the pyramid region. You can say that the time to battle Etemon is now.
Move to the pyramid region and talk to me.
_1070.Objective: talking with Izzy after moving to the pyramid region
_1070.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1talking with Izzy after moving to the pyramid region%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1070.CompletionText: Quickly move to the pyramid region.
_1070.CompletionSummary: This is the pyramid region. You have to face Etemon to save Nanomon.

_1071.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1071.Description:
This… looks like one of the servers creating Etemon's network. We can neutralize the network if we can hack it.
But we need to code name to access it. We have to defeat the Gazimons in the east and find the code name.
_1071.CompletionText: There surely will be a Gazimon with the code name.
_1071.CompletionSummary: Argh! You are the Digidestined fron the canyon! I give up! You say you want Etemon's access code? I will tell you. Just don't hit me.

_1072.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1072.Description:
It is not easy to access it, even with the code name. The code name depends on the connecting cable.
We need the red cable to use the code name I told you. Orgemons in the west have the red cable. Take it from them.
_1072.CompletionText: Dang, I will eat all of Etemon's bananas because of the betrayal.
_1072.CompletionSummary: You successfully accessed Etemon's network. Now Etemon can never find us.

_1073.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1073.Description:
Great. While Izzy neutralizes Etemon's network, let's think of ways to rescue Nanomon.
Listen to everyone's opinions and tell me.
_1073.Objective: talking with Matt talking with T.K. talking with Mimi talking with Sora talking with Jou
_1073.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1talking with Matt%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2 talking with T.K.%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3 talking with Mimi%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4 talking with Sora%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5 talking with Joe%qe %cc5/%mc5
_1073.CompletionText: Now now, tell me all the good methods.
_1073.CompletionSummary: After listening to everyone's opinions, it seems making a small infiltration group to secretly rescue Nanomon is the best plan.

_1074.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1074.Description:
While Tai's group rescues Nanomon, we should take care of the dangers here.
It will be good to secure an escape route to quickly get away from this place.
Can you defeat the Rapidmons at the south?
_1074.CompletionText: Let's secure the escape route beforehand.
_1074.CompletionSummary: Great, we just have to wait for Tai's group.

_1075.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1075.Description:
I… I wanted to participate in the rescue of Nanomon. But Matt stopped me so I am here.
I thought I was doing my part as one of the Digidestined... Will you defeat the leader of Rapidmon and take the token to Matt?
I want to tell Matt that I am strong.
_1075.Objective: collecting the token of the leader of Rapidmon
_1075.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1collecting the Sign of the leader of Monocromon%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1075.CompletionText: Sigh… When will Matt acknowledge me?
_1075.CompletionSummary: T.K. worries about that? It is no use. I am his brother and have a duty to protect him!

_1076.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1076.Description:
If we go straight in, Etemon will see us so we must first find a secret passage to the pyramid.
I have a basic idea of the route but it is better to be sure, right?
There is a doore with an electric current in the middle of the secret passage. Find an electricity insulator from CyberDramon in the north to prevent danger.
_1076.CompletionText: There is a strong current in places that are not paths.
_1076.CompletionSummary: Now, shall we enter the secret passage?

_1077.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1077.Description:
I am sending mails to and receiving mails from Nanomon. We have to combine the lever pieces from the Canyon and form a level shape.
Get high-strength adhesive from CyberDramon to make the lever to free Nanomon.
_1077.CompletionText: A high-strength adhesive is required to make a complete lever.
_1077.CompletionSummary: Success. One level is complete. But it is so unstable it can only be used once.

_1078.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1078.Description: You! Why did you just bring me? Nanomon took Sora!
_1078.CompletionText: I cannot understand it at all!
_1078.CompletionSummary: I think Tai misunderstood it! It is not true that you cannot die in the Digital World! If you die here, you die forever!

_1079.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1079.Description: N… no… Then if I tried to save Sora, I might have fallen into the trap and died. But Sora… Sora…
_1079.CompletionSummary: Let's leave Tai like that. We have something we must do.

_1080.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1080.Description:
At this moment, we can only wait for the opportunity. The Digimons must recover if they are to help later on. Help them.
Can you find food for the Digimons? The Monochromon in the northwest will have food.
_1080.CompletionSummary: Thank you. We were able to conserve the health of our Digimons.

_1081.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1081.Description:
Now the problem to solve is where Nanomon took Sora. If Nanomon disappears, the route connected to him is completely lost.
I will search for him with the previous information. Can you find the green cable to connect to a new network? The Volcamon in the west seems to have the green cable.
_1081.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I was able to discover the whereabouts of Nanomon because a new network route was opened.

_1082.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1082.Description:
Now, Tai and Izzy are waiting near the pyramid. Let's begin to lure Etemon.
Defeat the Monochromon in the northwest.
_1082.CompletionSummary: Great. Now we just have to wait for Etemon to come out.

_1083.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1083.Description:
This is the flare Izzy left behind.
Let's use the monkey firework at the place for provoking Etemon in the north and provoke him. Then Etemon will come out and fight with us.
Let's call Etemon.
_1083.CompletionText: Let's call Etemon with the monkey fireworks.
_1083.CompletionSummary: Whew. I don't know if Tai made it in.

_1084.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1084.Description: Now, we saw that Etemon is out. We have to hurry and go into the Nanomon Maze. Talk to me in the Nanomon Maze.
_1084.Objective: talking with Izzy of the Nanomon Maze[E]
_1084.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1talking with Izzy of the Nanomon Maze[E]%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1084.CompletionSummary: This is the place where Nanomon is.

_1085.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1085.Description:
This is a very complicated region. It wil not be easy looking for Nanomon.
Past this place, remember that we have to move through the hidden wall and not on the path.
Now, let's go and face Nanomon!
_1085.CompletionText: Let's quickly defeat Nanomon and save Sora.
_1085.CompletionSummary: We did it! We saved Sora!

_1086.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1086.Description: Thank you for saving me. I want to get out of this tiring place.
_1086.CompletionSummary: Oh no. Etemon followed us all the way here!

_1087.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1087.Description: I have no worries anymore. I don't feel any fear even when I see Etemon! Because I have courage! Let's being the final battle with Etemon!
_1087.CompletionSummary: Tai's courage. I can feel it too!

_1088.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1088.Description: Wow! We finally escaped the threat of Etemon! Wh…what? Gennai is here! Let's tell Gennai of our victory of Etemon.
_1088.CompletionSummary: Huh, the Digidestined. You did a great job defeating Etemon. But I must tell you one bad news.

_1089.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1089.Description:
I hear that Myotismon, the other evil that exists in the Server Continent, is heading towards Odaiba of the real world with a huge army.
Perhaps, it is the find the eighth Digidestined. I am telling you this now but there are not seven but eight Digidestined.
You will find the eighth Digidestined and head towards Odaiba.
_1089.CompletionText: Myotismon is afraid of the eighth Digidestined.
_1089.CompletionSummary:
But it is too much for you to face Myotismon. I will search for routes to Odaiba from many directions.
During that time, increase your strength and prepare for the upcoming battle.

_1090.Title: Dats Center
_1090.Description: I think you came to me because you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from Palmon [Woodmon] Calu? @<tc:970>If you complete Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution@</tc> of the other Four Dark Masters, I will give you @<tc:970>a very special achievement@</tc> and @<tc:970>title@</tc> Calu.
_1090.CompletionText: Make sure if you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from <tc:090>Betamon</tc> and <tc:090>Hagurumon [MechaNorimon]</tc> and <tc:090>PicoDevimon [Soulmon]</tc> Calu.
_1090.CompletionSummary: I hope you can achieve Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from the remaining Four Dark Masters.

_1091.Title: Dats Center
_1091.Description: I think you came to me because you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from Betamon Calu? @<tc:970>If you complete Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution@</tc> of the other Four Dark Masters, I will give you @<tc:970>a very special achievement@</tc> and @<tc:970>title@</tc> Calu.
_1091.CompletionText: Make sure if you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from <tc:090>Palmon [Woodmon]</tc> and <tc:090>Hagurumon [MechaNorimon]</tc> and <tc:090>PicoDevimon [Soulmon]</tc> Calu.
_1091.CompletionSummary: I hope you can achieve Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from the remaining Four Dark Masters.

_1092.Title: Dats Center
_1092.Description: I think you came to me because you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from Hagurumon [MechaNorimon] Calu? @<tc:970>If you complete Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution@</tc> of the other Four Dark Masters, I will give you @<tc:970>a very special achievement@</tc> and @<tc:970>title@</tc> Calu.
_1092.CompletionText: Make sure if you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from <tc:090>Betamon</tc> and <tc:090>Palmon [Woodmon]</tc> and <tc:090>PicoDevimon [Soulmon]</tc> Calu.
_1092.CompletionSummary: I hope you can achieve Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from the remaining Four Dark Masters.

_1093.Title: Dats Center
_1093.Description: I think you came to me because you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from PicoDevimon [Soulmon] Calu? @<tc:970>If you complete Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution@</tc> of the other Four Dark Masters, I will give you @<tc:970>a very special achievement@</tc> and @<tc:970>title@</tc> Calu.
_1093.CompletionText: Make sure if you achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from @<tc:090>Betamon@</tc> and @<tc:090>Hagurumon [MechaNorimon]@</tc> and @<tc:090>Palmon [Woodmon]@</tc> Calu.
_1093.CompletionSummary: I hope you can achieve Apocalymon Ultimate Evolution from the remaining Four Dark Masters.

_1094.Title: Dats Center
_1094.Description: You achieved Apocalymon Ultimate Evoluton from Palmon [Woodmon], Betamon, Hagurumon [MechaNorimon],and PicoDevimon [Soulmon] Calu?
_1094.CompletionText: As promised, I will give you a very special achievement and title. Wait a moment Calu~
_1094.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on the achievement. Here is an item. When you use it, you can receive the gift I prepared.

_1095.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1095.Description:
What to do? I think I lost the Emblem of Reliability. I know I had it. I am in trouble…
The Orgemons in the south look suspicious. Can you catch them and see if they have the Emblem?
_1095.CompletionSummary: Th… Thank you! We will not forget what you did for us!

_1096.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1096.Description:
This is not the time for this… Let's compose ourselves and save Sora.
We need an opportunity. So, can you defeat the leader of CyberDramon?
After the battle, he might be more open.
_1096.CompletionText: Let's catch the leader of CyberDramon.

_1097.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1097.Description:
I want to let others know that I can be of help in these dangerous situations.
So, can you defeat the leader of Volcamon in the east? I think I can let them know that I exist.
_1097.CompletionSummary: Thank you. The way you look at me changed.

_1098.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1098.Summary: Location of the Emblem of Love
_1098.Description:
I do not think a Digimon has the Emblem of Love. It seems like Gazimon in the Nanomon Maze has the Emblem of Love.
Can you defeat Gazimon and recover the Emblem of Love?
_1098.CompletionText: I need the Emblem of Love.
_1098.CompletionSummary: Thank you for finding my Emblem of Love!

_1099.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_1099.Summary: searching for the Emblem of Sincerity
_1099.Description:
Uhm… Actually, I threw away the Emblem of Reliability. Of course I am regretting it now.
I had to have courage. That is why, can we recover the Emblem of Reliability?
I threw it away around here so the Meteormon in the north will have it.
_1099.CompletionText: I am sure that Meteormon took my Emblem of Sincerity.
_1099.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I will not throw it away anymore.

_1100.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1100.Description:
Haha. The Digidestined. You might think the threat of Nanomon is completely gone but there is another dimension in the Nanomon Maze.
The Nanomon in the Maze has power completely different from what you have seen before. You have to defeat them to say that the Server Continent really found peace.
_1100.CompletionSummary: Finally peace is here at the Server Continent.

_1101.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1101.Description:
Haha. The Digidestined. You might think the threat of Nanomon is completely gone but there is another dimension in the Nanomon Maze.
The Nanomon in the Maze has power completely different from what you have seen before. You have to defeat them to say that the Server Continent really found peace.
_1101.CompletionSummary: Finally peace is here at the Server Continent.

_1102.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1102.Description: They say you need a special entrance ticket to enter the Nanomon Maze [N] dungeon. This is a pass card based on the data of Nanomon so you can use it to enter the Nanomon Maze [N].
_1102.CompletionText: Please waith. I will make it for you.
_1102.CompletionSummary: Here is the Nanomon Maze pass card. You can only use it once so if you need more, I will make them every day.

_1103.Title: Event
_1103.Summary: The Great Twelve on the Move [Reward]
_1103.Description: You must know more about the Great Twelve than me now! They are the mouse, the ox, the tiger, the rabbit, the dragon, the snake, the horse, the sheep, the monkey, the chicken, the dog, and the boar. There is a Digimon for each animal: <Mouse / Kumbhiramon>, <Ox / Vajramon>, <Tiger / Mihiramon>, <Rabbit / Antylamon>, <Dragon / Majiramon>, <Snake / Sandiramon>, <Horse / Indramon>, <Sheep / Pajiramon>, <Monkey / Makuramon>, <Rooster / Sinduramon>, <Dog / Caturamon>, and <Boar / Vikaralamon> The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated. Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
_1103.Objective: The Great Twelve on the Move [Reward]
_1103.CompletionText: The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated. Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
_1103.CompletionSummary: The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated. Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.

_1104.Title: <Jogress Quest - Examon>
_1104.Description:
Ah?? You are Dracomon Calu! I heard about you like gathering and ingest twinkle jewels.
Blue and Green way…. You may walk on your way according to what jewels you will gather.
_1104.CompletionSummary:
You are able to have different experiences according to what way you choose.
Of course you can walk other way also regardless of you have done one way Calu.

_1105.Title: <Jogress Quest - Coredramon(Blue)1>
_1105.Summary: Way of justice with blue color
_1105.Description:
You choose Blue way Calu. Blue Diamante means 'Justice'. I wonder how it goes with your stong will for Justice Calu!
The blue diamante which is a rare jewel you would like to can be got if you defeat Guilmon in Snowstorm Village. But Guilmon is a wild nature, please be careful Calu.
_1105.Objective: Defeat Guilmon in Snowstorm Village to get Blue Diamante
_1105.CompletionText: Guilmon in Snowstorm Village has Blue Diamante.
_1105.CompletionSummary: Wow! It is Blue Diamante. Twinkle twingle, it is really beautiful Calu.

_1106.Title: <Jogress Quest - Coredramon(Blue)2>
_1106.Description:
Have you heard about Ordeal of the four dragons which is challengeable only for dragon type Digimon?
I have heard about if this ordeal is got through, scale ammor which is made with Chrome Digizoid can be equipped.
To get through Ordeal of the four dragons, you must travel Major areas in Digital World.
First,
You must travel Located on 5 o'clock direction of Western Village : East - <Hideout>,
and 7 o'clock direction of Western Village : West - <Unknown Ruins>
And <Digimon Grave> of south Snowstorm Village,
<Freezing Area> located on the end of Frozen Ground
<Frozen Waterfalls> in the middle of Infinite Ice Wall.
Travel of ordeal consists of total 5 places. Get through it and fulfill your justice.
_1106.Objective:
Location for Travel of ordeal
<Hideout> <Unknown Ruins> <Digimon Grave> <Freezing Area> <Frozen Waterfalls>
_1106.CompletionText:
Have you done your Travel of Ordeal Calu?
Destinations are
Western Village : East-Hideout Western Village : West-Unknown Ruins Snowstorm Village-Digimon Grave Frozen Ground-Freezing Area Infinite Ice Wall-Frozen Waterfalls
Total 5 places is where you
_1106.CompletionSummary: You have done great travel Calu. Amazing Calu!

_1107.Title: <Jogress Quest - Coredramon(Blue)3>
_1107.Description:
When you are on Travel of ordeal, Breakdramon said like below Calu!
- - -
"Regardless of who is on Travel of ordeal, nobody can get as same as my strongest power.
Slayerdramon! Use Green jewel which has been undertaked by Calumon. Time has come to untie Endless knot."
_1107.CompletionSummary: It is not over with just talking… I don't know so well Calu.

_1108.Title: <Jogress Quest - Examon>
_1108.Description:
Ah?? You are Dracomon Calu! I heard about you like gathering and ingest twinkle jewels.
Blue and Green way…. You may walk on your way according to what jewels you will gather.
_1108.CompletionSummary:
You are able to have different experiences according to what way you choose.
Of course you can walk other way also regardless of you have done one way Calu.

_1109.Title: <Jogress Quest - Coredramon(Green)1>
_1109.Summary: Way of destory with green color
_1109.Description:
You choose Green way Calu. Green Margarite means 'Power'. I wonder how it goes with your end of determination for Power Calu!
The Green Margarite which is a rare jewel you would like to can be got if you defeat Skull Greymon in Western Village : West. But Skull Greymon is a wild nature, please be careful Calu.
_1109.Objective: Defeat rageful Skull Greymon of Western Village : West to get Green Margarite
_1109.CompletionText: Rageful Skull Greymon in Western Village : West has Green Margarite.
_1109.CompletionSummary: Wow! It is Green Margarite. Twinkle twingle, it is really beautiful Calu.

_1110.Title: <Jogress Quest - Coredramon(Green)2>
_1110.Summary: Ready to destory: Data hacking for heavy machine
_1110.Description:
You ingest many Green Margarite Calu. Here is a mail for someone choose Green way. Please read it Calu.
-<Dear someone choose Green way>
You have an ecxellent choice with 'Power'.
This is an opportunity to walk until end of way for power regardless of useless method and purpose.
Get strongest power. And I'm about to tell you how to get it with this mail.
Do hacking heavy construction machine's plan data. You will get more power as hack the plan data which has Heaviest weight and strongest power. Of course your body part is decreased until zero, and your emotion is disappeared as a Digimon.
Use <Data Extraction Coil> which has been put in this mail to some Digimon and do hacking the data. More power will be waited for you.
Digimons that need to be hacked data are <Guardromon> & <Volcamon> in Oil Refinery-2 and <Metal Garurumon> & <Vikemon> in Distorted Data Village. Success it to grab more power.
_1110.Objective:
Oil Refinery-2
Guardromon, Volcamon
Distorted Data Village
Metal Garurumon, Vikemon
Use Data hacking item
_1110.CompletionText:
-Among contents of mail…-
Digimons that need to be Hacked are
In Oil Refinery-2 area
<Guardromon> and <Volcamon>
In Distorted Data Village
<Metal Garurumon> and <Vikemon>
_1110.CompletionSummary: Get more scared and more Calu. Are you alright Breakdramon?

_1111.Title: <Jogress Quest - Coredramon(Green)3>
_1111.Description:
When you are on Travel for more power, Slayerdramon said like below Calu!
- - -
"You want to get more power with hacking another Digimon after all? It's ridiculous...
Breakdramon! Use Blue jewel which has been undertaked by Calumon. Time has come to untie Endless knot."
_1111.CompletionText: Slayerdramon is on own's way also after got through Ordeal of the four dragons.
_1111.CompletionSummary: It is not over with just talking… I don't know so well Calu.

_1113.Title: <Jogress Quest - Examon2>
_1113.Summary: Examon formation - The top of dragon type
_1113.Description:
Huh? What was…Calu? Ah… Yggdrasil… It is… Did you hear of specfic?
You must defeat Digimon in Oil Refinery-1, 2 areas to get Data Access Coil. And you can summon a Digimon which has huge volume with Data Access Coil. Also you must defeat the summoned Digimon.
Please keep in mind there is False Data Access Coil, so Digimon may not be summoned with it.
Please do your best to gather Data Access Coil, and fulfill Examon formation.
_1113.Objective: Get <Data Access Coil> which is for summon Mugendramon from Digimon on Oil Refinery-1, 2 area. And use to defeat it.
_1113.CompletionText: Examon is needed really huge data mass.

_1114.Title: <Jogress Quest - Examon3>
_1114.Description:
These are all Yggdrasil's plan…Such a vain… I'll forget hatred against Breakdramon. No…it's wrong… It has to be expressed an integration.
I'm just called as Examon which is a holy knight belong to Royal knights. I will accept if becoming Sentient wings Caledfwlch is my destiny.
_1114.CompletionSummary: A Holy knight Examon in Royal knights

_1115.Title: <Jogress Quest - Examon4>
_1115.Description:
It's ridiculous. My effort to get more power is all Yggdrasil's part of plan.
It might has been found a purpose. Because the power I want to get doesn't have a direction. Do I accept with Slayerdramon at this point?
I will just live as a holy knight belong to Royal knights. I will live as a the gigantic lance "Ambrosius".
_1115.CompletionSummary: A Holy knight Examon in Royal knights

_1116.Title: <Examon Achievement Quest>
_1116.Summary: [Achievement] The top of dragon type Digimon
_1116.Description:
You have experienced many thing until reaching here Calu! Here is a gift to you who makes a effort for Examon formation.
Gather <Proof of ordeal> x100 from Mugendramon Calu. And then I will give you <Examon. The top of dragon type Digimon> title which is proved as a top of dragon type Digimon.
_1116.CompletionText: Have you gathered all Proof of ordeal Calu?
_1116.CompletionSummary: Amazing! Fly in the sky with Examon Calu~!

_1117.Title: <Event>
_1117.Description: You feel loneliness, please receive the costume I prepared~ If you already have a Gir/Boy friend or Wife/Husband, you may become a single. Be careful!
_1117.CompletionSummary: You feel loneliness, please receive the costume I prepared~ If you already have a Gir/Boy friend or Wife/Husband, you may become a single. Be careful!

_1118.Title: <Event>
_1118.Description: Hi? I'm little busy now….. Do you want to go a date with me?
_1118.CompletionSummary: You don't have any charming point for me. I don't think you are my lover. Good bye~!

_1119.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1119.Description:
It is too sad...
The guardian of Digital world is very angry.
What did human do really.
Why is this happening for <Xuanwumon> of all Digimons....
As I remembered, he was very gentle.
There is no choice. We must do something.
You may talk with Xuanwumon, please go to <Scar of water crystal> where Xuanwumon stay a moment before coming back to real world.
I guess we can't talk with Xuanwumon normally because Xuanwumon is so angry now.
Moreover, Mega Seadramon and Marin Devimon are on the path to protect Xuanwumon. .
But I assure that you can do it! If you success this mission, I may give a nice achievement as a reward for you!
_1119.Objective:
<Scar of Water Crystal>
Defeat Mega Seadramon
Defeat Marin Devimon
Defeat Xuanwumon
_1119.CompletionText: Wasn't that easy to meet Xuanwumon?
_1119.CompletionSummary:
Phew… At last, we can feel relieved.
The real world is safe now, but it may be just a this moment.
Thank you anyway! And you are so great!

_1120.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1120.Description:
I will give @<tc:900>2 Scar of water crystal pass cards per a day@</tc> Please use it to protect real world.
When you need the pass card more,
Gather 100 <Scar Essence> from @<tc:900>monsters of <Glacier Area>@</tc>. I will exchange them with the pass card.
Take care of yourself.
_1120.CompletionSummary: Cheer up. Nobody can finish it except you.

_1121.Title: <Tutorial>
_1121.Description:
Huh? A human came all this way with a Digimon? I see… you must have brought Digimon friend with you and escaped from DATS Center.
But it seems like you're lost in the middle, aren't you?
_1121.Objective: @<tc:990> 1. Talk to <DATS Center Underground Passage> Agumon. @</tc>
_1121.CompletionText: Looks like you need a hand. I'll help you.
_1121.CompletionSummary: This is just the first step from your journey.

_1122.Title: <Tutorial>
_1122.Description:
I'll teach you how to move first. If you're a true tamer, making your partner Digimon following you should be a simple task.
Can you show me?
_1122.Objective: Follow the instructions in the Tool Tip
_1122.CompletionText: Following the instructions without a problem, are you?
_1122.CompletionSummary: Good. It looks like you've already earned respect from your Digimon friend.

_1123.Title: <Tutorial>
_1123.Description:
DATS Center should be tracking you down by now, so let's speed up~
Now I'll teach you how to search an NPC.
_1123.Objective: Follow the instructions in the Tool Tip
_1123.CompletionText: Just follow the instructions and you'll be fine~
_1123.CompletionSummary:
Great! You're doing better than I expected! Well done! Now you can get out of here! I have a company who I'm waiting, so I can't leave here with you.
Wish you luck~

_1124.Title: <Tutorial>
_1124.Description:
I'm Yoshino~ Were you expecting me to contact you? You can receive quests with your Digivice like this.
You don't have to report to me by coming all the way back. You can take quests and complete with your Digivice, so keep that in mind!
_1124.Objective: Follow the instructions in the Tool Tip
_1124.CompletionText: Now, do as what I told you. Go on~
_1124.CompletionSummary: You're following the instructions very well~ Very good!

_1125.Title: <Tutorial>
_1125.Description:
Do you hear me? Hi, this is Yoshino Fujieda. Did I surprise you? As you can probably see, quests are also acceptable on your Digivice.
You don't have to always come and see me directly - just accept & complete quests on your Digivice!
So, shall we start training again?
First of all, could you please deal with an Agumon (Raptor-1) nearby?
They must be returned back to the Digital World as they don't have any Tamers with them.
_1125.Objective: Follow the instructions on the left of your screen.
_1125.CompletionText: Follow the instructions on the window to the left of your screen!
_1125.CompletionSummary: Seems like you're catching up pretty well. Good work!

_1126.Title: <Tutorial>
_1126.Description: Now, let's try scanning and returning the items. Follow the instructions displayed in the tool tip and then report to me~
_1126.Objective: Follow the instructions in the Tool Tip
_1126.CompletionText: You need to focus on what you're doing now~
_1126.CompletionSummary: You're beginning to look like a new DATS agent now.

_1127.Title: <Tutorial>
_1127.Description:
This time, I'll teach you about hatching a Digimon. It's not difficult.
Just follow the instructions in your guide and it will be done~!
_1127.Objective: Follow the instructions in the Tool Tip
_1127.CompletionText: You aren't lost in the middle of a tutorial, are you?
_1127.CompletionSummary: Good! That is your another Digimon!

_1128.Title: <Tutorial>
_1128.Description:
I will be explaining the last part of your tutorial.
It is quite obvious that you must train your Digimon to grow stronger than others.
A Digimon's ability can be enhanced through several stages of reinforcement.
Wanna give it a try?
_1128.Objective: Follow the instructions on the left of your screen.
_1128.CompletionSummary: Good work. You've earned yourself a title of a probationary member.

_1129.Title: <Tutorial>
_1129.Description:
You've done good job so far. I'll give you some rewards for the completion of tutorial.
I'll look forward to you become a legendary tamer,
_1129.CompletionText: Good job on finishing the tutorial!
_1129.CompletionSummary: Now, the true journey of a tamer is about to begin!

_1130.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1130.Description:
We have no time. Zhuqiaomon is going to make his mind.
No one can stop Clash of the Two Worlds, once he is in fury. Hurry… Move on before it is too late.
_1130.Objective:
<Uprising Flame>
Beat Birdramon Beat Garudamon Beat Phoenixmon Beat Zhuqiaomon
_1130.CompletionSummary: Thank heaven. But do not let your guard down…

_1131.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1131.Description:
This will help you on the way to Zhuqioamon. Two for one day only.
If you think this is not enough, Go to @<tc:900><File Island> and collect 100 x <Piece [Uprising Flame]>@</tc> Then I will exchange them to the pass.
Never give up!
_1131.CompletionSummary: Digial World and Real World shall not be collided…

_1132.Title: Event
_1132.Description: I've fell into a trap during an investigation! Who could have imagined that someone set a trap in this place? The someone who got me into trap are a group of Giromons! Can you find the key from them and bring it here for me?
_1132.CompletionText: Do you think I can get out of here?
_1132.CompletionSummary: Oh! That's it! That's the key! With the key, I can get out of this jail. Take this as my reward for your favor.

_1133.Title: Event
_1133.Description: About my investigation? Sure, I'll tell you all. Mainly the investigation starts from a conspiracy going on in Digital World. I haven't discovered everything yet, but there is some kind of a distorted area in the part of Digital World. Even though the exact location and purpose of distorted area are not clarified... And there are some kind of a group that does not want me to discover the truth. I think we can find clues from the monsters around. Will you help me?
_1133.CompletionSummary: Oh! This is! I have a feeling that this clue is related with the truth I'm seeking. Only if we can get more of them… Even though I don't mean to push you. Anyway, thanks for helping!

_1134.Title: Event
_1134.Description: Thunder to the Light~ Water to the Light~ Darkness to the Light~ Steel to the Light~ Congraturation! You have done once again to Hyper Spirit Evolusion!
_1134.CompletionSummary: Here is my present for you~ You can make MagnaGarurumon more stronger!

_1135.Title: Event
_1135.Description: Digimons of Digital World are getting scared at the Icedevimon. I don't know why Icedevimon is not in the Prison. He has life imprisonment from Altar of Digimon because he prepetrate on destroy Digimon's Town and consume the other Digimon's Data.
_1135.CompletionText: I have information that some Digimons witness the Icedevimon. I think Icedevimon go around place to place for hide himself.
_1135.CompletionSummary: You have done to defeat all of the icedevimon? Thank you so much! You save Digital World again!

_1136.Title: Event
_1136.Description:
I understood that Cherubimon has different mind with me and Seraphimon. Cherubimon now become corrupt because of the desire to make the whole world under to him.
Cherubimon is now consume the power of the Digital World for Destroy and We have to Stop him. So could you help us? We need your Spirit to stop Cherubimon.
Cherubimon show up any field randomly and I have say sorry that i can not guess the place where Cherubimon will show up.
_1136.CompletionText: We have to stop Cherubimon before Cherubimon become more powerful. And when you defeat him, don't forget to abosorb Cherubimon's DigiCore.
_1136.CompletionSummary: Thank you for the Stop Cherubimon. Digital World has been peaceful again.

_1137.Title: Event
_1137.Description: Congraturation! You have succeeded Max Level of MagnaGarurumon! And this is the Present for you!
_1137.Objective: Congraturation for Max Level of MagnaGarurumon!
_1137.CompletionText: It is impossible! Already Max Level!
_1137.CompletionSummary: Please protect the peace of Digital World by Power of MagnaGarurumon!

_1138.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1138.Description:
I won't believe but now some bad situation has kept on happening. I think Lucemon is coming..
I think we need some help from 3 Archangel Digimon. They now what is going on because they managed Digital World until now. Go to Silver Lake 2 o'clock Side to meet Ophanimon.

_1139.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1139.Description:
The 10 Legendary Worriors seal Lucemon in deepest side of Digital World. And Our 3 Archangel Digimons were manage Digital world for them. But one of the Beast type Archangel Digimon, Cherubimon suffer from a persecution complex and finally he becomes fallen Archangel Digimon. Now he is a underling Lucemon and following his directions.
You have to stop Cherubimon and find out what was a directions about.
Cherubimon is now stay in a load of tree in Central Silver Lake
_1139.CompletionText: Kerubimon is here, in Silver Lake.
_1139.CompletionSummary: Cherubimon will regret for his own guilty that he does before.

_1140.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1140.Description:
Dynasmon is going to collect DigiCode with LordKnightmon by Lucemon's order. Lucemon planning to destroy Digital World and First step is a collecting Digicode. If they finish to collect Digicode, it is a big hazard to Digital World! So please stop Dynasmon!
I know it is hard to make it. But you have to do for peace of Digital World!
Dynasmon is in Central of [Lost Historic Site] that Star has rising up. Hurry!
_1140.CompletionText: Don't look down on the Royal Knight.
_1140.CompletionSummary: I can't believe.. You did it! You stop Dynasmon!

_1141.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1141.Summary: God of Destruction! The Legendary Digimon!
_1141.Description:
You did stop Dynasmon but Lucemon already collect enough digicode and power. And it means Lucemon has resurrect already. Lucemon is a dangerous Digimon ever. He think Digital World is so counfused and need New rules. He will destroy Digital World to make his own World.
And Lucemon consumed LordKightmon and Dynasmon's power.
You need more stronger power than before to stop Lucemon.
_1141.CompletionText: I wonder you get on adversity by your wisdom
_1141.CompletionSummary: Ok, Peace of Digital World is on your hand now.

_1142.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1142.Description:
Digicode is disappearing!! Big threat is coming Now!
Until now we were under protection of 3 Archangel, but again we need their help. Let's go to Disorted Data Village to meet Seraphimon. He knows what is going on to Digital World. Seraphimon is in 1 o'clock side of Disorted Data Village.
_1142.CompletionText: Seraphimon is in Distorted Data Village.
_1142.CompletionSummary: Human Child.. Why are you looking for me?

_1143.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1143.Description:
Digicode… Lucemon.. Finally the day has come.
I was sealed until few times because of Cherubimon's betray. And one of the subordinate Digimon get my Data to do something Bad work.
i think subordinate of Cherubimon make a fallen angel by my Data. it is very dangerous thing. We have to stop fallen angel fist, and Cherubimon will be a next target for us. BalckSeraphimon is in North side of Data Magma Filed in Disorted Data Village.
_1143.CompletionText: Go to North side, North Data Magma field. Maybe BlackSeraphimon is in there.
_1143.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Thank you for the punishing him.

_1144.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1144.Description:
LordKnightmon is going to collect Digicode with Dynasmon to follow Lucemon's Order. Lucemon never cares Peace of Digital World. He just alwasy mind about how to destroy Digital World and make a New World for him.
We can not just look at them to collect the all the Digicode to destroy Digital World. Let's stop LordKnightmon to safe the Digital World!
Go to Load of Ordeal in [Ruined Historic], LordKnightmon is in there!
_1144.CompletionText: Don't look down on the Royal Knight.
_1144.CompletionSummary: I doesn't matter but Now I see. You already proove your strong by stopping LordKinghtmon.

_1145.Title: Jogress Quest [Susanoomon]
_1145.Description:
You did very well. Now LordKnightmon can't collect Digicode anymore and it will be damage to Lucemon. But saddly, we failed to stop Lucemon's resurrection and Lucemon counsumed LordKnight power. I think now he is stronger than before. Presently, You can not stop him now. But i believe you as much as like 10 Legendary Worriors did. Until you have new power, i will help you.
Pleas save Digital World.
_1145.CompletionText: If you failed to stop Lucemon, It will be a disaster for Digital World and evern your World.
_1145.CompletionSummary: You need more power than 10 Legendary Worriors. And remember. You have to develop on yourselves to use this power.

_1146.Title: Event
_1146.Description:
New Legendary Champion! Amaizing! Why Susanoomon has unlimited power!?
I think no ones can defeat you!
_1146.CompletionText: I think Susanoomon is a most Amazing Digimon ever. Even I can't still believe that I can see Susanoomon aright ahead.
_1146.CompletionSummary: Please obey Digital World for us.

_1147.Title: Event
_1147.Description:
You make it! You make Maximum Level of Susanoomon!
This is for you! Now, No one can't stop you!
_1147.CompletionText: Maximum Level? Now I can guess why your Digimon looks so Strong.
_1147.CompletionSummary: Please, My storngest Digimo! Keep us from Enemy Digimon!

_1148.Title: Event
_1148.Summary: [Repeat] Something that will bring my attention
_1148.Description: I'm Omegamon of the Royal Knights. What made you come to me? I apologize if you just came here for a chat. But if you have a purpose, you don't have to hide it from me.
_1148.CompletionText: Do you have something to show me?
_1148.CompletionSummary: What's this? It seems like some kind of virus data, but I haven't seen this type yet. Can you bring me more of these, tamer? If you do, I'll reward you this emblem.

_1149.Title: Event
_1149.Description: These warp fragments are unstable, but I still appreciate your cooperation to my investigation. I'll exchange you my detective badge even for the destructible warp fragments. So please bring me the warp fragments to me.
_1149.CompletionSummary: Crap… trying to make these fragments into one piece failed as it destroyed… But promise is promise. Take my badge as I promised.

_1150.Title: Event
_1150.Description: As a celebration of the new year, 2017, DATS Center has decided to issue extra official licenses for Tamers. First things first, I will see if you qualify as a Tamer who deserves the license. Move to Frozen Grounds and defeat '1' [Panjyamon]. Wanna give it a try?
_1150.CompletionText: Don't tell me you're scared of those Panjyamons.
_1150.CompletionSummary: It seems like you've fulfilled the qualification. As promised, I will issue your 'Tamer Certificate [Epic]'. Take this and go visit Jijimon!

_1151.Title: Event
_1151.Description: I'm exchanging posts with my acquaintances all over the world regularly. However, it seems that 4 of the sent posts are missing. I assume that the mischievous have snatched the posts in the middle. Can you retrieve them back for me? Once you do, please deliver them to Digimon Kaiser in Silent Forest, Kamemon in Frozen Ground, Jijimon in Wind Valley, and Gas Tank Repairman in Oil Refinery-3.
_1151.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Postal Package%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Gas Tank Repairman%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk to Digimon Kaiser%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Talk to Kamemon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc5/%mc5
_1151.CompletionText: Looks like you're still in the middle of my request. Please let me know when you're done.
_1151.CompletionSummary: Good job on taking the postman duty. Please take this as a reward.
_1151.ReservedText: Message from doctor Yushima just arrived. Thanks for your help.

_1152.Title: Event
_1152.Description: I've heard that it is White Day season now. What do you think about tasting these sweets? Please share some of those Candy with me, for a price. I'll look forward to it then. There's one more thing to tell you. If you gather some of the candy crumbs and bring them to me, I can make you a new one.
_1152.CompletionText: So, can I have some of the sweets too?
_1152.CompletionSummary: Oh, you've really got the Candy for me. Great! Take this. It's the White Day Coin which I promised.

_1153.Title: Event
_1153.Summary: [Daily] Mysterious papers spread out all over the area
_1153.Description: We have a situation here! The document paper which contains top secrets of the digital world and the real word has been lost! The contents are encoded so not anyone can understand it, but still it's not safe! I heard that some Mysterious group has made copies of the paper as they may have thought it is a treasure map and spread them out all over the area, so we have a big job to do. Please help me by getting those papers back! If you cooperate, I'll give you a ticket which you can use to go to forbidden areas.
_1153.CompletionText: So how are we doing on finding those papers?
_1153.CompletionSummary: Gladly, thanks to you that I can catch my breath now. I'll give you the ticket that I promised. You can use this to go to the forbidden area through Yoshino in Yokohama Village, or Gatomon in File Island Waterfront. They're seperate places, so make your o

_1154.Title: Event
_1154.Description: I'm one of the Royal Knights guarding the Digital World and I'm now here in the Real World to prevent potential threats. Recently, there is some news that come from Digital World. Can you pass it to Dorphin in Yokohama Village? I know you guys are looking for those secret boxes now. So if you do me a favor, I'll provide you the key to open it.
_1154.CompletionSummary: So you have told him all. Thanks. Take this with you.
_1154.ReservedText: Oh, is it something from the Digital World? I'll take a look.

_1155.Title: Event
_1155.Summary: [Daily] Who is the king of Digital World?
_1155.Description: There is a rumor that the king of Digital World is returning… Do you think it's true? I really want to know who the Digital World king is. Can you give me the answer?
_1155.CompletionText: Are you going to show me the king of Digital World?
_1155.CompletionSummary: What? Is he really the king of Digital World? I can see he's wearing a crown, but I can't erase this awkward feeling. Anyway, I didn't expect you to really show him to me. Take this as my appreciation.

_1156.Title: Event
_1156.Summary: [Daily] To be a member of Lanamon's fan club
_1156.Description: Ahem! Are you interested in Lanamon's fan club? I'm Toucanmon, the president of the fan club. I know that you came here because you wish to join the fan club, but you must first prove that you're in fond of Lanamon. Lanamon is Digimon of water attribute. Do you know what this means?
_1156.Objective: Collect Spirit of Water H Collect Spirit of Water B
_1156.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Spirit of Water H%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Spirit of Water B%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1156.CompletionText: You should figure it out soon if you really wish to join the fan club.
_1156.CompletionSummary: That's right! Lanamon represents the spirit of water! I guess that enough for proving yourself. Take this fan card with you!

_1157.Title: Event
_1157.Description: SkullSatamon is rampaging through the Digital World recently… it must be stopped. He's a wanted criminal with a bounty. Are you interested in it? It is reported that he's found from Western Village Outskirts, Frozen Ground, and Silver Lake. Go get him and the bounty will be yours. I've heard that there is a summon card that summons him. Take a look from the event window if you want.
_1157.CompletionSummary: So, you've got him! Impressive! Here's your bounty.

_1158.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1158.Summary: Break through the Trace of Black Steel
_1158.Description:
Baihumon thought there has other forces that threating the Digital World and human is not related this case. Therefore, i got some news that Baihumon went to Place named 'Trace of Black Steel'
I think we have to move on to Trace of Black Steel. to know what Baihumon figure out in Trace of Black Steel.
So find out Baihumon! what are you waiting for? Time is running out!
_1158.Objective:
<Trace of Black Steel>
Break through the Exterior Zone Break through the Interior Zone Break through the Central Zone
_1158.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Break through the Exterior Zone%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Break through the Interior Zone%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Win the battle with Baihumon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1158.CompletionSummary: Oh! I got message from Baihumon. Baihumon says he will help us anytime! Now we have great ally!

_1159.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1159.Description:
This is the Pass that make you able to enter Trace of Black Steel. I can give you only 2 piece of pass every day.
If you need more pass, go to @<tc:900><Server Continent Desert> or <Server Continent Canyon> and obtain <Energy of Steel> x 100pec.@</tc> When you bring those <Energy of Steel>, i will change it to pass[Trace of Black Steel].
So you can do it! Don't give up!
_1159.CompletionText: I hope Baihumon helps us as soon as possible.
_1159.CompletionSummary: Let's find out more what we can do now.

_1160.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1160.Description:
I'm going to give you @<tc:900>2 Pass Cards for Scar of Water Crystal [Easy] a day@</tc>. I hope you can use it to protect the Real World.
In case 2 pass cards a day is insufficient, bring me @<tc:900>50 of <Scar Essence> which you can find from <Ice Area> monsters@</tc>, then I'll exchange extra pass cards for you.
Take good care of yourself at all times.
_1160.CompletionSummary: Keep up the good work. If you give up now, there's no one who can replace you.

_1161.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_1161.Description:
This pass will lead you to Zhuqiaomon. Please keep in mind that I can give you only two of these a day for free.
But if you need more than that, bring @<tc:900>50 of <Uprising Flame> which you can obtain from <File Island Area> monsters@</tc> to me, and I can exchange more passes with them.
And just remember that I'm on your side Tamer! Don't give up!
_1161.CompletionSummary: The Digital World and the Real World must not conflict..

_1184.Summary: Completed the evolution of WarGreymon into Mega existence

_1574.Title: D-Reaper
_1574.Description: Did you get a good rest? Sounds Good. I guess there's more work to do. Overwork again.. Anyway, come to Shinjuku Western(D-Reaper). I'll be waiting.
_1574.CompletionSummary: I was thinking of wrapping-up, but... I think things got bigger.

_1575.Title: D-Reaper
_1575.Description: Do you see it over there? I don't know why, buy D-Reaper invaded the real world. In addition, we have an uncooperative army, so it is not easy to move. So we have to find kids first. We should join them and discuss how to defeat that monster. I'll go to Takato's house, so you go to school. Call me as soon as you find him.

_1576.Title: D-Reaper
_1576.Description: Thanks god! Tell Pawnchessmon W, I will be right there!

_1577.Title: D-Reaper
_1577.Description: Well.. There's not enough space for us to go in and make bread, and it seems that we have enough members to make bread, so let's look around to see if there's anything dangerous. If you see a strange guy, I think it would be great to defeat them.
_1577.Objective: Investigate Residential area Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02

_1578.Title: D-Reaper
_1578.Description: Well, Still too many around. It's going to be a little bit of a problem starting out like this. Can you defeat the weird guys around a bit more?

_1579.Title: D-Reaper
_1579.Description: I'm glad to see you while I was looking for kids. Can you take me to them?
_1579.CompletionText: I'm glad I found you right away. This area is very dangerous..

_1580.Title: D-Reaper
_1580.Description: I was looking for you guys. I guess you might know something about that.. Can you tell me something?

_1581.Title: D-Reaper
_1581.Description: I told you so..! It's impossible to win with military strength only! It looks like it's near the park, so let's move there! This might cause huge damage!
_1581.Objective: Move to Park Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03
_1581.CompletionSummary: The army doesn't work at all!

_1582.Title: D-Reaper
_1582.Description: huff.. There are still so many! We can't win with military strength alone! It seems that it's near the park, so let's move there! This might cause huge damage!
_1582.CompletionSummary: The army doesn't work at all!

_1583.Title: D-Reaper
_1583.Description: There are still a few more.. The children's enemy is also persistent! Let's clean up a bit more!
_1583.CompletionText: I'm glad you guys are here.

_1584.Title: D-Reaper
_1584.Description: There are still a few more.. The children's enemy is also persistent! Let's clean up a bit more!
_1584.CompletionText: I'm glad you guys are here.

_1585.Title: D-Reaper
_1585.Description: Heh, did you waste time with those guys? If you cut something that looks like a cable, they won't be able to move!

_1586.Title: D-Reaper
_1586.Description: .. It's serious that we can't compete as Ultimate. It's good news that the weakness seems clear.. But.. The appearance that can't target the weakness itself, or an overwhelmingly strong guy may appear. The information we have is too lacking.. Let's talk to Yamaki Mitsuo first.
_1586.CompletionSummary: D-Reaper TF team.. Should be worth meeting.
_1586.ReservedText: Hmm.. I was thinking of asking you guys to cooperate. We currently established D-Reaper TF team. The Wild Bunch team you know well is with us. If you don't mind, I'd like you to join us.

_1587.Title: D-Reaper
_1587.Description: They must have been tired from big battle, they're already back to school. Well, I know you want to take a rest, but can you do it something more? Well, we decided to cooperate with Yamaki Mitsuo, but I think we need to prepare our own information. We can check what they don't know.. So, let's start by collecting battle data. It's dangerous, but necessary. Let's fight the D-Reaper ADR-03 we saw earlier.
_1587.CompletionSummary: This might be not bad.. But we need a little more.

_1588.Title: D-Reaper
_1588.Description: They must have been tired from big battle, they're already back to school. Well, I know you want to take a rest, but can you do it something more? Well, we decided to cooperate with Yamaki Mitsuo, but I think we need to prepare our own information. We can check what they don't know.. So, let's start by collecting battle data. It's dangerous, but necessary. Let's fight the D-Reaper ADR-03 we saw earlier.
_1588.CompletionSummary: This might be not bad.. But we need a little more.

_1589.Title: D-Reaper
_1589.Description: Hmm, We got enough battle data, but I'm just worried about how useful this battle data will be… Is there anything I can collect? What? If you defeat it, it just disappeared..? Hmm.. Well. Let's go to Yamaki Mitsuo's team first. I want to get some more but there is no way.

_1590.Title: D-Reaper
_1590.Description: Gorou Mizuno just came and was about to deliver the information about D-Reaper. I hope you guys listen to it together.
_1590.CompletionSummary: Well.. First of all, since D-Reaper is also data, it's clear that Digimon's power is important.

_1591.Title: D-Reaper
_1591.Description: We need to investigate. As for the battle data, I think the ones you brought will be helpful, but I'm guessing that there will definitely be guys with different appearances depending on the purpose. After all, D-Reaper is also a program. That's why I want you to look around the places I designate and use what I'm giving you to them.
_1591.Objective: West Shinjuku(D-Reaper) Park Use item to D-Reaper ADR-03
_1591.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1West Shinjuku(D-Reaper) Park%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use item to D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1591.CompletionText: Hmm.. It's interesting no matter how much I look at it.

_1592.Title: D-Reaper
_1592.Description: Hmm~ I think I need a little more data.. Could you go to the park on the west side of Shinjuku and check it again?
_1592.Objective: West Shinjuku(D-Reaper) Park Use item to D-Reaper ADR-03
_1592.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1West Shinjuku(D-Reaper) Park%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use item to D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1592.CompletionText: Hmm.. It's interesting no matter how much I look at it.
_1592.CompletionSummary: Oh! Thank you. It's not bad?

_1593.Title: D-Reaper
_1593.Description: I think this amount of data should be enough. The analysis will take some time, so could you wait? You can sit anywhere and relax.

_1594.Title: D-Reaper
_1594.Description: For now, we'd better leave the investigation to the Wild Bunch team, who know exactly what D-Reapers are. But even so, we cannot just completely let go? Looks like a new type of D-Reaper has been discovered on the east side this time and it might be helpful to sort them out.
_1594.CompletionText: There's still a lot we can do
_1594.CompletionSummary: Hmm.. Is there any way? Let's go back to the office for now.

_1595.Title: D-Reaper
_1595.Description: For now, we'd better leave the investigation to the Wild Bunch team, who know exactly what D-Reapers are. But even so, we cannot just completely let go? Looks like a new type of D-Reaper has been discovered on the east side this time and it might be helpful to sort them out.
_1595.CompletionText: There's still a lot we can do

_1596.Title: D-Reaper
_1596.Description: I think it's a TV interview. Shall we take a look?
_1596.CompletionSummary: Well.. The evolution of primitive programs..

_1597.Title: D-Reaper
_1597.Description: Hey! I think you guys should also hear together! We've got some more accurate information about the D-Reaper!
_1597.CompletionSummary: A colleague had past research materials. I'll interpret it from now on.

_1599.Title: D-Reaper
_1599.Description: Oh no..! It's happening all over the place at the same time! The mysterious D-Reaper that suddenly appeared at Shinjuku Station is now in charge of the children! You go west and take on the D-Reapers who suddenly appear in great numbers!
_1599.Objective:
Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02
Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03
Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04
_1599.ObjectiveProgress:
%qs1Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02%qe %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1599.CompletionSummary: I'm glad you defeated it safely..! But something else happened! Can you help me?

_1600.Description: Please! Help the children and defeat that mysterious D-Reaper!!
_1600.CompletionSummary: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Hurry up and go to Shinjuku station! I'll prepare the ride!

_1603.Title: D-Reaper
_1603.Description: You're back! Right now, the children are fighting with the unknown D-Reapers at Shinjuku Station! But the charter is unfavorable..! It's dangerous to stay like this! Go and help the children!

_1604.Title: D-Reaper
_1604.Description: You're back! Right now, the children are fighting with the unknown D-Reapers at Shinjuku Station! But the charter is unfavorable..! It's dangerous to stay like this! Go and help the children!

_1605.Description: You're back! Right now, the children are fighting with the unknown D-Reapers at Shinjuku Station! But the charter is unfavorable..! It's dangerous to stay like this! Go and help the children!

_1606.Description: There is a risk of engagement. Meet Takato and if there is a threat to Takato, please defeat it!
_1606.CompletionSummary: I'm glad eveyone is safe! Good work!

_1607.Title: D-Reaper
_1607.Description: It seems we've got the situation under control.. But I can't find Takato. It seems that he was dragged into the D-Reaper. We're not ready to go there yet. Can you go find Takato?
_1607.CompletionSummary: Please! You are the only one who can find Takato!

_1610.Description: There is a risk of engagement. Meet Takato and if there is someone who is threatening to Takato, I hope you defeat them!
_1610.CompletionSummary: I'm glad eveyone is safe! Good work!

_1611.Description: There is a risk of engagement. Meet Takato and if there is someone who is threatening to Takato, I hope you defeat them!
_1611.CompletionSummary: I'm glad eveyone is safe! Good work!

_1612.Description: There is a risk of engagement. Meet Takato and if there is someone who is threatening to Takato, I hope you defeat them!
_1612.CompletionSummary: I'm glad eveyone is safe! Good work!

_1613.Title: D-Reaper
_1613.Description: Good job. @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, do you and PawnChessmon W have time for a conversation with us?
_1613.CompletionSummary: The conversation suddenly got longer.. but there is something I want to discuss with you guys.

_1614.Title: D-Reaper
_1614.Description: Ark designed by Daisy is still alive... I've made contact with my communicator. I intend to bring Ark back to life. could you possibly help me? I heard that you have the technology to go to the Digital World. Gather a substance called Digizoid from Digimons in the Digital World.
_1614.Objective: Collect Digizoid in the Digital World
_1614.CompletionSummary: Thanks! This will help enough to save Ark!

_1615.Title: D-Reaper
_1615.Description: I think we need more materials to revive the Ark.. Can you help me one more time? Collect the Digizoid owned by Digimons in Digital World.
_1615.Objective: Collect Digizoid in the Digital World
_1615.CompletionSummary: Thanks! This will help enough to save Ark!

_1616.Title: D-Reaper
_1616.Description: I’ll keep an eye on the situation here, so take a look around and take a look around and get some rest. If you go to the Road, there will be a place to rest.

_1617.Title: D-Reaper
_1617.Description: Thank god! You come over here and help me! This weak guy isn't listening to me and is trying to go over there?! I'll try to stop this guy, so defeat the dangerous guys roaming around!
_1617.Objective: Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04
_1617.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04%qe %cc3/%mc3

_1618.Title: D-Reaper
_1618.Description: Damn it! I can't stand it! Help me one more time please! This guys trying to go over there one more time?! I'll try to stop this guy, so defeat the dangerous guys roaming around!
_1618.Objective: Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04
