_1620.Title: D-Reaper
_1620.Description: Aren’t you taking a break?! What's happening?
_1620.CompletionSummary: What? You are here to see it too? We were just talking about it.

_1621.Title: D-Reaper
_1621.Description: Suzie said that she saw Beelzebumon and Culumon enter the sphere above the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building. We saw it too, and were doing some analysis on it. Professor Dolphin is analyzing, so let's talk about it.

_1622.Title: D-Reaper
_1622.Description: I had a favor to ask you. I'm going to upgrade the Ark soon. It's all thanks to the Digizoid you collected. It can give great power to kids fighting the D-Reaper. The only concern is that there are D-Reapers hanging around. Researchers helping to upgrade Ark are trembling with anxiety because of it, so their work is slowing down. Can you defeat the D-Reapers?
_1622.Objective: Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04
_1622.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1622.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Researchers will be a little relieved

_1623.Title: D-Reaper
_1623.Description: Where did Rika go? I can't find.. Can you find her? I think she might out. Go to West Shinjuku(D-Reaper) Road.

_1624.Title: D-Reaper
_1624.Description: Oh.. You worried, Henry. Well… Jeri was always bright so I thought she grew up without much difficulty.. But her mother passed away before. After hearing that, I thought of many things… so I wanted to get some fresh air.
_1624.CompletionSummary: .. Yeah, let's go back and find Jeri.

_1625.Title: D-Reaper
_1625.Description: A new entity has now appeared in East Shinjuku(D-Reaper). Everyone went there except Henry who was left to realize the Ark! Head there and help the kids defeat the new entity!

_1626.Title: D-Reaper
_1626.Description: First of all, let's defeat that guy who just appeared. He's much bigger than the others and looks dangerous! Let's join our powers!

_1627.Title: D-Reaper
_1627.Description: First of all, let's defeat that guy who just appeared. He's much bigger than the others and looks dangerous! Let's join our powers!

_1628.Title: D-Reaper
_1628.Description: An incredibly huge.. Guy..! In addition, a lot of D-Reapers are coming out of the body..! Ugh! Let's defeat them all first!
_1628.CompletionText: Ugh.. It's too big I can't reach it.
_1628.CompletionSummary: Is there a way to fly..

_1629.Title: D-Reaper
_1629.Description: An incredibly huge.. Guy..! In addition, a lot of D-Reapers are coming out of the body..! Ugh! Let's defeat them all first!
_1629.CompletionText: Ugh.. It's too big I can't reach it.
_1629.CompletionSummary: Is there a way to fly..

_1630.Title: D-Reaper
_1630.Description: .. Jeri.. will be over there. But right now there are a lot of people who are hurt and tired, so let's go back..

_1631.Title: D-Reaper
_1631.Description: Because of the fight earlier, the D-Reaper's territory suddenly began to expand. The speed is extraordinary. Furthermore..
_1631.CompletionSummary: .. Yeah. It's soon to give up.

_1632.Title: D-Reaper
_1632.Description: It's full of emergencies.. Fortunately, it's over somehow, but first of all, you need to rest. The kids said they had already met their parents and rested, so go to DATS Center and take a break.
_1632.CompletionSummary: Um.. yes, You might not like taking a break. Are you interested in the newly developed digivice?
_1632.ReservedText: Good job. Were there any difficult parts of the mission? It's good to work hard, but it's also important to take a break.

_1633.Title: D-Reaper
_1633.Description: This is a Digivice called D-Ark. It's differentiated design from other Digivices. If you like it, I recommend you to try it once. This Digivice was also produced in an upgradeable form. PawnChessmon B, who is dispatched to Shinjuku, will help you.

_1634.Title: D-Reaper
_1634.Description: We need to evacuate here too.. eh?
_1634.CompletionSummary: Yeah, at least we can't give up.

_1635.Title: D-Reaper
_1635.Description: Unfortunately, there's not much we can do, so I guess we should ask you. The number of people who can fight against the D-Reaper is small, so it is time to use more efficient personnel. The children are probably preoccupied with saving Jeri. If so, wouldn't the full support that adults can give open the way to go there? So, please follow the children and open the way.
_1635.Objective: Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04
_1635.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04%qe %cc3/%mc3

_1636.Title: D-Reaper
_1636.Description: Did Mr. Dolphin say that? That's right.. We should conserve our strength to reach Jeri. The little D-Reapers are still in the way..! Help us as Mr. Dolphin says!
_1636.Objective: Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03 Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04
_1636.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat D-Reaper ADR-02%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat D-Reaper ADR-03%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat D-Reaper ADR-04%qe %cc3/%mc3

_1637.Title: D-Reaper
_1637.Description: Thanks for saving our strength! I'll be sure to save Jeri!

_1638.Title: D-Reaper
_1638.Description: Beelzebumon was injured while saving Jeri! It must have fallen somewhere around here..! Can you save Beelzebumon?! We'll take care of saving Jeri! Please look around all the East Shinjuku(D-Reaper) areas!
_1638.Objective: Investigate near Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building High Street Overpass near West Shinjuku Main Road
_1638.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Investigate near Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Investigate High Street%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Investigate Overpass near West Shinjuku%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Investigate Main Road%qe %cc4/%mc4

_1639.Title: D-Reaper
_1639.Description: I've heard that Beelzebumon was seriously injured. I also looked around but the results are not good. Let's find another way. It's urgent situation, so let's use the machine. Take a look around the area you investigated earlier with the explorer, and come back.
_1639.Objective: Use items near Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building High Street Overpass near West Shinjuku Main Road
_1639.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use item on near Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use item on High Street%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Use item on Overpass near West Shinjuku%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Use item on Main Road%qe %cc4/%mc4

_1640.Title: D-Reaper
_1640.Description: We need get out of here quickly. I just heard information about dropping a bomb here. Children are going to avoid it after hearing that, so let's hurry up and move.

_1641.Title: D-Reaper
_1641.Description: You are all right..! That's a relief. You don't have to worry about the bomb, but.. I think we need some time to analyze whether the D-Reaper is suddenly starting to change.. Can you help me? Your ability will be of great help. Once the area of D-Reaper has been expanded, I want to know if there are any changes in D-Reapers as well. So, it would be nice to collect data that can be obtained by defeating D-Reaper ADR05 to ADR07 active in the East.

_1642.Title: D-Reaper
_1642.Description: It's hard to get a clear sense of what kind of changes have occurred with the data you've obtained now.. Once again, please collect data that can be obtained by defeating D-Reaper ADR05 to ADR07 active in East.

_1643.Title: D-Reaper
_1643.Description: We're going to have a meeting based on the data sent by researchers from all over the world. It would be good for you to participate too.

_1644.Title: D-Reaper
_1644.Description: As well as analyzing D-Reaper's data in-depth, I intend to use the Digimon's construction to interpret the D-Reaper. That's how we believe we can turn the D-Reaper back to primitive programming as intended. However, the formation of Digimon can be done with Terriermon's help, but I think I'll have to ask you for D-Reaper's data. Gorou Mizuno used all the data he received from you.

_1645.Title: D-Reaper
_1645.Description: Gorou Mizuno recently used the data again... Ugh.. Then there are not enough samples to compare, so I should ask you again. Please collect the data.

_1646.Title: D-Reaper
_1646.Description: Thank to you and Terriermon's help, I can now put my plan into action..

_1647.Title: D-Reaper
_1647.Description: I just broke the news to the others with D-Ark. Let's go to the safe area prepared by others. It starts from there.

_1648.Title: D-Reaper
_1648.Description: With this.. We can go to D-Reaper's area.

_1649.Title: D-Reaper
_1649.Description: With this.. We can go to D-Reaper's area.

_1650.Title: D-Reaper
_1650.Description: With this.. We can go to D-Reaper's area.

_1651.Title: D-Reaper
_1651.Description: Okay, let's defeat the D-Reaper, and save Jeri and the real world!

_1652.Title: D-Reaper
_1652.Description: Okay, let's defeat the D-Reaper, and save Jeri and the real world!

_1653.Title: D-Reaper
_1653.Description: Okay, let's defeat the D-Reaper, and save Jeri and the real world!

_1654.Title: D-Reaper
_1654.Description: Okay, let's defeat the D-Reaper, and save Jeri and the real world!

_1657.Title: Gankoomon
_1657.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>... You've passed all the tests I've prepared.
That means the Dats is a group of talented people like you…
_1657.CompletionSummary:
Good! I'm Gankoomon, the Digimon who keeps what I said once!
I'll go into the Dats and solve the cases that happen with you! So, please take good care of me from now on! Partner!!

_1658.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_1658.Description:
Oh... this is the data of the ZeedMillenniumon! You brought this by yourself!? So what is your main concern?
(Explaining distress...)
Well... I see... The story is simple. We just need to have a ZeedMillenniumon. It is only a matter of time before the Dats Center will have the ZeedMillenniumon since you have brought the ZeedMillenniumon's Data.
_1658.CompletionSummary:
Completed.
This data I'm giving you now is the data that can evolve into a ZeedMillenniumon. If this data is used for a particular digimon, it can evolve into a ZeedMillenniumon.
'You want me to tell you what Digimon can evolve into a ZeedMillenniumon?
Try to find the Digimon while you travel. I don't think I'm obliged to tell you that, so now, I'm busy studying this work data.

_1659.Title: Mastemon
_1659.Description:
You've collected all three Stamps! I believed it. You could be recognized by our three angels...!
Phew~ I'm sorry, but it's not over yet. We still have to wrap it up.
Could you give me three stamps for a moment?
_1659.CompletionSummary:
The three Stamps have been combined into one. There's a little bit of power in us little by little. Well, I think it's like a Amulet. It can prevent the situation from happening, or it can boost Holy power. Please give it to your partner, Angewomon.
Now the warrior of light from the ancient legend is perfectly ready. All we have to do is find LadyDevimon, who has the same opinion as us.
It's going to be hard. But I think you can do it.
May good luck be with you...

_1660.Title: Boltboutamon
_1660.Description:
You want to cleanse this mask? culu? Ok~ If I leave this mask alone, I'm sure something bad will happen, so I'll clean it right away~ culu~
Purified~ The bad evil energy in this mask is now gone~ Then, goodbye~ culu~
_1660.CompletionSummary:
Well… It's definitely purified... If you create evolutionary data with this mask, you can evolve into the Digimon you met. Wait, I will make it right away...!
Now, it's done. Using this evolutionary data I made, It can evolve to Boltboutamon. It will not do anything ugly because the culumon has purged the thoughts, but it still doesn't know if you should watch it well or not.
Then go, because I want to do a little more analysis... !

_1661.Title: Ogudomon
_1661.Description:
Um... Um... Well… Got it. The content was definitely entered in my head.
If the Culumon had been purified it, most of the evil power would have disappeared. Of course, not all of them were removed. Culumon did not lie.
As a result of my analysis, the power of Ogudomon has been reduced by 80% by Culumon. It is very unfortunate.
It's ridiculous that the Digimon called the Evil King is so weak. So I'll give you something.
_1661.CompletionSummary:
It is a data code that strengthens the power of Ogudomon, which is the Ogudomon enhancement data.
Don't worry, I made this object. No function exists to revive the evil powers of the lost Ogudomon.
However, the story is different if the remaining 20% ??of the evil power and the strengthened power of Ogudomon are synergistic.
So you need to take good control of it. How do you control it?
That is your homework. Don't ask me. Now please go. I have to analyze the data...!

_1662.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_1662.Description:
What's going on?
What? You need Keramon's backup data? You do really bothering Digimon...
Okay, I will give it to you...!
But! You should bring the Keramon's Data to me.
Find me the Keramon Data at Digimon Maze F1. Then, I will work on it right away.
_1662.CompletionText: Keramon is in Digimon Maze F1. Bring me the Data of Keramon.
_1662.CompletionSummary:
Oh, you did it faster than I expected. I will backup the Keramon Data right away.
And… Done.
Now go. I am a very busy Digimon.

_1663.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_1663.Description:
What's going on?
What? You need Chrysalimon's backup data? You do really bothering Digimon...
Okay, I will give it to you...!
But! You should bring the Chrysalimon's Data to me.
Find me the Chrysalimon Data at Digimon Maze F2. Then, I will work on it right away.
_1663.CompletionText: Chrysalimon is in Digimon Maze F2. Bring me the Data of Chrysalimon.
_1663.CompletionSummary:
Oh, you did it faster than I expected. I will backup the Chrysalimon Data right away.
And… Done.
Now go. I am a very busy Digimon.

Find me the Infermon Data at Digimon Maze F3. Then, I will work on it right away.

_1664.CompletionSummary:
Oh, you did it faster than I expected. I will backup the Infermon Data right away.
And… Done.
Now go. I am a very busy Digimon.

What's going on?
What? You need Diablomon's backup data? You do really bothering Digimon...
Okay, I will give it to you...!
But! You should bring the Diablomon's Data to me.
Find me the Diablomon Data at D-terminal-Dungeon-B1. Then, I will work on it right away.

_1665.CompletionSummary:
Oh, you did it faster than I expected. I will backup the Diablomon Data right away.
And… Done.
Now go. I am a very busy Digimon.

_1666.CompletionSummary:
Oh, you did it faster than I expected. I will backup the Armagemon Data right away.
And… Done.
Now go. I am a very busy Digimon.

_1667.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_1667.Description:
Mmm… This must be the Black Digitron. I've heard of it many times but it's first time seeing this stuff and it's pretty amazing. I sincerely appreciate for the great gift to me.
Now, back to the point, when this stuff gets into Digimon, it becomes difficult to separate it again. However, if we can only nullify its weaknesses, it can become a blessing instead.
_1667.CompletionSummary:
It can be a tough task, but possible for me who could even duplicate Digivice.
Here, I'll give you a sample. This sample of Black Digitron is extracted from Omegamon Alter-B, so it can only be used on Omegamon Alter-S.
So if you get a chance to face Omegamon Alter-S, you can try it.
It'd definitely work, because I've tested it many times myself already.

_1668.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_1668.Summary: Re- result of the experiment : BanchouLEomon
_1668.Description: This is... this seems like the things that Digimon Kaiser did some crap on BanchouLeomon. Culumon might know something. Go find Culumon.
_1668.CompletionSummary: Here, spoiled Digicore of BanchouLeomon, Culu! You know you should be careful with this, Culu!
_1668.ReservedText: This is…. It seems like it was BanchouLeomon's DigiCore, Culu! BanchouLeomon's DigiCore is twisted into chaos. I don't know what Digimon Kaiser did this for! Culu!

_1669.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_1669.Summary: Re- result of the experiment : DarkDramon
_1669.Description: Show this to Culumon. To be honest… I'm not even sure that the Culumon knows about this.
_1669.CompletionSummary: From the stories I've heard so far, it seems that Digimon Kaiser tried to merge BanchouLeomon and DarkDramon's DigiCore through experiments, Culu! Luckily, the experiment wasn't fully done thanks to Tamer, Culu! Please be careful with this DarkDramon's DigiCore, Culu!"
_1669.ReservedText: Culu? Is this the Digicore of DarkDramon…?

_1670.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_1670.Description:
Is this the Rafflesimon's Digicore? How can this precious thing...
What?? Can I bring Rafflesimon back to life with this Digicore?
No matter how many times I try, I cannot bring back the dead Digimon... But I can use this Digicore to create data that can evolve into Rafflesimon...!
Okay, let me shine my equipment! I am ready!
_1670.CompletionSummary:
Okay, done. Rafflesimon's Digicore was processed to create data that could evolve into Rafflesimon.
There is a caveat in using this data. In short, this data should only be used for plant-type Digimon.
If you keep this in mind and use it well You will be able to meet Rafflesimon, who can be active longer than the existing Rafflesimon.
Then, leave me alone. I want to analyze more about Rafflesimon...!

_1671.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_1671.Description:
What? Culumon sent you? Culumon said I could make your Alphamon stronger?
Well, Of course! I can do Everything and knows Everything!
When I checked Alphamon, he absorbed several Digimon X-Antibody. But...It was not 100% fused with Alphamon.
However, if I touch it a little, it can be used with other Digimon X-Antibody and Alphamon will be 100% fully fused.
Then I'll start the work right away.
_1671.CompletionSummary:
All done. Now your Alphamon is a completely different digimon.
If you see Alphamon's strength, you will know his physical ability, and My mighty skills!
Then go ahead... I want to take this opportunity to analyze more of the Alphamon data…!

_1672.Title: Fanglongmon(Shin)
_1672.Description:
Fanglongmon is a Digimon that has both Negative and Positive powers.
But your Fanglongmon has only positive power... That means that the negative power is still sealed by ancient angels, It is asleep in the depths of the digital world.
Don't you want your partner, Fanglongmon to be perfect? Then, go to Fanglongmon Dungeon!
There, you will find the negative power of Fanglongmon, sealed by an ancient angel!
_1672.CompletionSummary:
However, Fanglongmon's negative power is not unique to Fanglongmon. His subordinate 4 Holy Beasts also has the negative power of Fanglongmon. You must also recover the power of negative from them.
If you gather all the negative power from them I will blend the power well and give it to you.
Ah! I haven't told anything important yet! Ah! The kind of power to be fused can be found through my production list. Keep this in mind!
If your Fanglongmon gets the fused negative power he will be reborn in full shape.
Then go ahead! I will be preparing to fuse the negative powers!

_1673.Title: [Jogress Alphamon Ouryuken(X-Antibody)]
_1673.Description: Take this and go back to Culumon. My work is done.
_1673.Objective: Take [Collected X-Antibody] and talk with Culumon at Dats Center
_1673.CompletionSummary:
Take this to Digitamamon, Culu! This won't be enough,
Check what else you need from Digitamamon, and if you bring those to him and ask him, he will help, Culu!
_1673.ReservedText:
Culu!
Gallantmon X helped a lot, Culu.

_1674.Title: Ordinemon
_1674.Description:
Of course I have successfully developed the vaccine and cure. Take it, your partner is in danger. It's amazing that there are no signs of infection so far.
What? You have something for me? Give it to me. I’ll take a look.
Hm… this is Raguelmon’s digicore fragment… It even contains information from Jogress evolution… Strange…
Wait a moment, I’ll give you a gift.
_1674.CompletionText: I knew it, you are so good at bringing fun data~
_1674.CompletionSummary:
All done. Take it. I processed some of the Digicore fragments of Raguelmon you brought.
If you give this data to Raguelmon, it will be able to evolve into Digimon you saw before. Of course, since the madness data has been removed, it will not lose its mind, so rest assured.
Why? Of course, I kept the evolution information intact.
There is nothing to be amazed. Because it is natural to do so!
Well, go ahead. I still have some data to analyze!

_1675.Title: GreenZone
_1675.Description:
Get up! Get up!
Thank you for putting my melody into the Xros loader!
This is the Green Zone where we live in the Digital World.
Madleomon, one of the Bagramon's Minion, is controlling this zone.
I almost died, but you saved my life!
Oh, Who am I?
_1675.Objective: Welcome~ first time of GreenZone, right?
_1675.CompletionText: Do you really want to know?

_1676.Title: GreenZone
_1676.Summary: Who will become a King of Digimon
_1676.Description:
Do you want to hear it?
You want to hear the name of this body!
My name is Shoutmon! One day I will be the King of Digimon!
I don't think it's time to have a casual conversation.
He brought his men down this cliff.
If we don't stop them now, our town will be attacked!
First, Defeat four Mammothmon at the below the cliff.
After that, check out the Xros loader!
_1676.Objective: Will become a King of Digimon
_1676.CompletionText:
Mammothmon is Madleomon's minions.
I can't get enough of them!
_1676.CompletionSummary:
All right! That's enough to move forward.
There's a Madleomon on the right side of the low hill. Be careful!

_1677.Title: GreenZone
_1677.Description:
Our brothers are always shining! Thank God you came back alive!
I heard you're going to help us defeat the Bagramon's Army for a while!
Shoutmon says he's okay, but he is not fully recovered yet, i guess.
Inside the Green Zone, there's a Food called Diginoir Don! Collect 10 of Diginoir by defeating Digimons in GreenZone.
_1677.CompletionText: Diginoir Don is a low drop probability for Digimon in the Green Zone, so you won't be able to collect all of it all at once.
_1677.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I'll take care of Brother's health!

_1678.Title: GreenZone
_1678.Description:
I have to go to the Starmons Brother!
I'm lost here!
There are too many CommanDramon's in front of me to move forward.
So I want General to help me!
Can you open the way for me?!
_1678.CompletionText: What are you doing? I have to go to Brother!
_1678.CompletionSummary:
I thought a Pickmon wasn't enough, so it was.
I'm sorry, brother!

_1679.Title: GreenZone
_1679.Description:
I heard there's a hidden area in this Green Zone.
Through a thick patch of bushes,
They're selling items that could weaken the 매드Leomon...
First of all, Please defeat the chaotic SunFlowmon. They're not always bad guys!
_1679.CompletionText: SunFlowmon is originally a resident of our village.
_1679.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!
To continue with the story… I heard that you should go through a wooded area.

_1680.Title: GreenZone
_1680.Description:
Madleomon absorbed his men and split the ground!
We need the Pickmon to move on.
I feel like They are playing in the front yard because I'm out of military discipline!
Can you scold them and bring them to me?
I'll keep you in line so I can get through this road!
_1680.CompletionText: What a lacked in the discipline.
_1680.CompletionSummary: Pickmon will make you a string. You can ride them over! Take care!

_1681.Title: GreenZone
_1681.Description:
The Mammothmons are big.
I can't just pass by because they blocking the way!
All the Bagramon's Army should be punished!
So General.
Please help me...yes?
Let's defeat Mammothmon and move on!
_1681.CompletionSummary: Now! The road is open, so charge!

_1682.Title: GreenZone
_1682.Description:
General! If you go down this cliff, there will be a Mikemon not far away.
They're waiting for help.
Let's help on the way!
First find me a Mikemon.
They will be in a little higher where the terrain that went down.
_1682.CompletionText: Are you still out there? Are you scared, General?
_1682.CompletionSummary:
Shoutmon worried about me?
Well, you came just in time!

_1683.Title: GreenZone
_1683.Description:
Please here me first!
There's a Tricky Digimon called Phantomon in front of us. I came out with my friends, "Gatomon" and "Black Gatomon." He took my friends somewhere else!
Can you defeat them and find my friends?
I'm begging you.
I want to go there myself, but actually I don't like the type that looks like a ghost...

_1684.Title: GreenZone
_1684.Description:
My friends were dragged by the Phantomon!
I need your help, General.

_1685.Title: GreenZone
_1685.Description:
In front of this is a very powerful Madleomon : Armed mode.
He's the current ruler of the Green Zone.
He's one of the member of the Bagramon's Army, but he's at the bottom position.
But be careful! He's very powerful.
If he cut the ground with his saw, there will be critical damage you'll wear it.
I've heard that if we defeat the summoner he summons,
They are going to drop an item that you can directly damage him.
Keep that in mind!
_1685.CompletionText:
I can't go in anymore!
I'm scared!
Please defeat them and bring peace in this Green Zone!
_1685.CompletionSummary:
Good work, General!
Even though I ran away, you defeat the Madleomon. I can't let my guard down until he comes back!

_1686.Title: GreenZone
_1686.Description:
How did you find this place?
I'm a friend of Ballistamon, Shoutmon.
And I don't like Fighting.
I want to get out of here, but I'm worried about that "MechaNorimon" in front of me. I don't want to fight first.
I'm sorry, but can you help me?
_1686.CompletionText: If you defeat him, I will give you an important information about Madleomon and items.
_1686.CompletionSummary:
If you're on your way to fight the Madleomon,
Take this item!
This will be works to a summoner.

_1687.Title: XrosWars
_1687.Description: Hey Bro~ You will need those symbols of proof to get into the Greenzone! But... It's a really rare Item though. Only 5 per day. If you give this Item to Jijimon, he will send you to Greenzone. Talk to me whenever you are ready, I will give you the Code Crown.
_1687.CompletionSummary: Here! Please take care of my friends! Bro!

_1688.Title: XrosWars
_1688.Description: Hey Bro~ You will need those symbols of proof to get into the Miso Village! But... It's a really rare Item though. Only 5 per day. If you give this Item to Jijimon, he will send you to Miso Village. Talk to me whenever you are ready, I will give you the Code Crown.
_1688.CompletionSummary: Here! Please take care of my friends! Bro!

_1689.Title: XrosWars
_1689.Description: Hey Bro~ You will need those symbols of proof to get into the Greenzone! But... It's a really rare Item though. Only 5 per day. If you give this Item to Jijimon, he will send you to Greenzone. Talk to me whenever you are ready, I will give you the Code Crown.
_1689.CompletionSummary: Here! Please take care of my friends! Bro!

_1690.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1690.Description:
Haha. The Digidestined. You might think the threat of Nanomon is completely gone but there is another dimension in the Nanomon Maze.
The Nanomon in the Maze has power completely different from what you have seen before. You have to defeat them to say that the Server Continent really found peace.
_1690.CompletionSummary: Finally peace is here at the Server Continent.

_1691.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1691.Description:
Haha. The Digidestined. You might think the threat of Nanomon is completely gone but there is another dimension in the Nanomon Maze.
The Nanomon in the Maze has power completely different from what you have seen before. You have to defeat them to say that the Server Continent really found peace.
_1691.CompletionSummary: Finally peace is here at the Server Continent.

_1692.Title: Digimon Farm
_1692.Description: Welcome to Digimon Farm in the hot weather. Do you know cool Welcome Milk? It's a shame that you don't know the famous Welcome Milk in Digimon Farm. Tut, tut... Do you want to try it, huh? But you can't drink it although you want. Glutton Monzaemon took all ingredients. If you find it, you may get the ingredients of cool Welcome Milk. Find Monzaemon.
_1692.CompletionText: Go and capture Monzaemon. I need the ingredients for cool Welcome Milk.
_1692.CompletionSummary: Thanks, you are very responsible than I expected. I can assign various works to you. HaHa

_1693.Title: Digimon Farm
_1693.Description: I will give you 4 glasses of Welcome Milk. It is not good to drink them by ourselves. Distribute one glass to each Chuchidarumon around you respectively. They will like it very much.
_1693.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Welcome Milk : Chuchidarumon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Welcome Milk : Chuchidarumon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Welcome Milk : Chuchidarumon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Welcome Milk : Chuchidarumon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_1693.CompletionText: Distribute all 4 glasses. Click Chuchidarumon and then right click Welcome Milk item.
_1693.CompletionSummary: Thanks. It seems that we are building up trust gradually. If we develop trust more, I will let you know my secret. Of course, I won't let you know now but later on...

_1694.Title: Digimon Farm
_1694.Description: Actually, it is a secret. But I'm only telling you. I have not liked Starmon from the past. Although I can't still tell its reason, it is true that I mind it... Anyway, I heard from someone that Gatomon makes an effort to have friendly relationship with Starmon... I don't like all monsters that want to have friendly relationship with Starmon. Therefore, I may trust you only after you hunt it at least. Go and hunt Gatomon!
_1694.CompletionText: Hunt them now. Capture Gatomons and Gatomon leader
_1694.CompletionSummary: We are building up trust gradually.

_1695.Title: Digimon Farm
_1695.Description: I will give you another assignment. Remember that it is a very important mission. There is a guy called Leomon tracer somewhere in Digimon Farm. Rumor has it that he has Starmon's weak point document. Go and bring me a Starmon's weak point document from Leomon chaser.
_1695.CompletionText: Hush! do it without letting Starmon know
_1695.CompletionSummary: It is enough to grasp Starmon's weak point.

_1696.Title: Digimon Farm
_1696.Description: You have improved your ability by fulfilling my several assignments, haven't you? Now, it is time to grasp the geography of Digimon Farm. When considering your ability you have shown to me, I think you can handle the assignment easily. It is the mission to explore whole area of the farm so it will be a piece of cake.
_1696.Objective: Explore whole area of Digimon Farm
_1696.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1the Way to Wilderness1 Area of Farm%qe %qs2the Way to Wilderness2 Area of Farm%qe %qs3Canyon Entrace of Farm%qe %qs4Grassland Area of Farm%qe %qs5Mining Village of Farm%qe
_1696.CompletionText: Didn't you start yet? Explore whole area of Digimon Farm right now!!
_1696.CompletionSummary: I will give you the last assignment! The last assignment will be very difficult. Of course, I think you can handle it well.

_1697.Title: Digimon Farm
_1697.Summary: I will give you a final test.
_1697.Description: If you go to the northern area of Digimon Farm, you can find Mining Village Area. Use the <Token of Trust> I gave to you there. I won't explain in detail. Summon and defeat it. Be sure to use it in Mining Village Area!! It might be a difficult battle. After summoning, you have to search the northern <Mining Village Area> It may hide somewhere. Prepare yourself thoroughly!
_1697.Objective: I will give you a final test.
_1697.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Mining Village Area of farm%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Hunting of Deputymon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1697.CompletionText: Use <Token of Trust> item in Mining Village Area located in the north of Digimon Farm.
_1697.CompletionSummary:
I think we develped tremendous trust!
The monster that you summoned is my phantom that is made to test you. I knew that you would make it.
If I have to fight against Starmon I dislike in the future, I wish you to help. I don't know when it will be.. F

_1698.Title: Digimon Farm
_1698.Description: Hey! Do you know that my favorite game in the world is playing card? Of course I like to play card with girls Ha Ha Ha. Actually, I can't play recently although I want to... Why? Cerberumon stole pieces of cards. So if you find them, I wish you to hunt them and bring me pieces of Trump back. If you go to the center of the Farm, you will find Cerberumon.
_1698.CompletionText: Bring me pieces of cards now. You can get them by hunting Cerberumon.
_1698.CompletionSummary: I could get pieces of cards thanks to you. Now, I will gather members for playing card.

_1699.Title: Digimon Farm
_1699.Description: I found cards now so I have to gather members to play card. Chuchidarumon of this village like cards very much. You can gather members by clicking Chuchidarumon and using cards I distributed. Go and gather members for playing card.
_1699.CompletionText: What is my favorite game?? Playing card~~
_1699.CompletionSummary: I could gather members because of you. Thanks.

_1700.Title: Digimon Farm
_1700.Description: I am furious now. I don't how it could happen. This was a very peaceful place... Now, we can't go out of village because of violent digimons. I wish you to sweep violent digimons, researching its cause. Can you do this for me? First of all, let's hunt Blossomon as a test.
_1700.CompletionText: You did a great job for me. Thank!

_1701.Title: Digimon Farm
_1701.Description: I will give you the first digimon sweeping assignment. Hunt Monzaemons and their leader. Isn't it very simple? I think you can make it. If you go up a little from this village, you will find a narrow valley in the west. I know that Monzaemons are gathered there.
_1701.CompletionText: Go to the western valley and sweep Monzaemons.
_1701.CompletionSummary: Succeeded in the first sweeping challenge!!

_1702.Title: Digimon Farm
_1702.Description: Go to sweep violent digimons again! Hunt Strikedramons. Thank you for sweeping violent digimons for me. I look forward to good news again. Strikedramons are distributed in the north of map.
_1702.CompletionText: Get rid of violent Strikedramons distributed in the north of map.
_1702.CompletionSummary: Succeeded in the second sweeping challenge!!

_1703.Title: Digimon Farm
_1703.Description: You are handling violent digimons well. I wish you to hunt Gatomons and their leader this time. If you come back safely, I will give the last mission. If you go to the north from Digimon Farm, you will find Gatomons.
_1703.CompletionText: Go and get rid of violent Gatomons.
_1703.CompletionSummary: You succeeded in the third sweeping challenge. I will give you the last mission. If you complete the last mission, it can be soothed me.

_1704.Title: Digimon Farm
_1704.Description: It is my last request to you. Find Blossomon leader and WaruMonzaemon leader in the north of Digimon Village. You have to take care of yourself because it is a leader hunting. They are different from average monsters. Anyway, this is the last request to you. Go for it!!
_1704.CompletionText: If they disappear, it will be peaceful again. Hurry up. When you go straight up to the north from Digimon Village, you will find them.
_1704.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I really appreciate it. Now, Digimon Village will be peaceful. It is stabilized now. Visit this village at any time. I will prepare delicious food for you.

_1705.Title: Digimon Farm
_1705.Description: First of all, you should grasp violent digimons. Which one do you have to start? Ummm..... Please grasp Monzaemon residing around here first. Monzaemon looks like a yellow rag doll. It is very big. Eyes are red and plaster is stuck to navel. Go there and take a picture of Monzaemon leader.
_1705.CompletionText: The abbreviation of digital camera is "Dica". It is Digital Camera in English.
_1705.CompletionSummary: Take pictures over 3 times for grasping digimons. The first target is Monzaemon leader. The second target is Cerberumon leader. The last target will be Gatomon leader.

_1706.Title: Digimon Farm
_1706.Summary: Dog to Guard House of Hell
_1706.Description: Now, take a picture of Cerberumon leader. Cerberumon looks like ferocious dog that its nickname is the dog to guard house of hell. Its body is covered by hard black skin. The armors of both shoulders have consciousnesses respectively. They detect the attacks of all directions and give notice to main body of Cerberumon. Take a picture of Cerberumon leader.
_1706.Objective: Dog to Guard House of Hell
_1706.CompletionText: Go and take a picture of Cerberumon leader.
_1706.CompletionSummary: You completed the second shooting. You need to take pictures over 3 times for grasping digimons. The first target is Monzaemon leader. The second target is Cerberumon leader. The last target will be Gatomon leader.

_1707.Title: Digimon Farm
_1707.Description: Gatomon looks like a white cat. It became violent suddenly. I want to know how it has changed. May I request you to take a picture of violent digimon? Go and take pictures of 3 Gatomon leaderes.
_1707.CompletionText: I was a great photographer in the past. HaHaHa
_1707.CompletionSummary: Completed the grasping with this. Thanks. I'll keep the data well.

_1708.Title: Ruined Historic
_1708.Description: Hello... I am Hawkmon. I came back from travel just now so I am very tired... I'd appreciate if you bring me a Recovery Disk. I heard that merchant Chuchidarumon of the northwest area has it... Anyway hurry up... Bring me a special <Recovery Disk> ... Please...
_1708.CompletionText: Bring me a Recovery Disk. I heard that merchant Chuchidarumon is in the northwest area.
_1708.CompletionSummary: (Tamer gave notice that Hawkmon was tired.) Really? It happened... Does Hawkmon lose his energy?

_1709.Title: Ruined Historic
_1709.Description: Really? It seems that Hawkmon is in trouble. What can I do? I am in more urgent situation now. If you handle my problem, I will give the product you want. I have started business in this area recently. But the business was not good. It seems that commercial area is not secured in the region ... I wish you to grasp nearby area. I think the business will be better if I can secure 2 Ways. I wish you to secure <Way to Wind Valley>and <Way to Digimon Farm> Hurry up.
_1709.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Secure the way to valley%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Secure the way to farm%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1709.CompletionText: Secure 2 areas, <Way to Wind Valley>and <Way to Digimon Farm> of Ruined Historic
_1709.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. But I worry about another thing..

_1710.Title: Ruined Historic
_1710.Description: Thank you... It seems that we secured area... Ummm..... Since I am a beginner in this business, I am afraid of that guys. I can know only through their eyes. Look at the peaked eyes. Nine tails make me more fearful of them. (Ummm... This is about Kyubimon?) I have no information about them. I wish you to research them with <Digital Camera> Go and take pictures of them.
_1710.CompletionText: Their position? Ummm..... They are in front of you over there. Click them first and then right click <Digital Camera> item in inventory. You can press shutter and complete research in that way.
_1710.CompletionSummary: Oh~ Thank you very much. Now, I know that they are Kyubimons. HaHaHa

_1711.Title: Ruined Historic
_1711.Description: Ah~ they are Kyubimons. The monsters similar to them aimed at my disk in the past. They must aim at my disk too. I wish you to kick their asses. If you hunt 10 Kyubimons I will give what you want. I believe that you will handle them well~
_1711.CompletionText: Go and hunt 10 Kyubimons. (It seems that you are very urgent...)
_1711.CompletionSummary: HaHaHa. Did you hunt 10 Kyubimons? Now I can do business safely.

_1712.Title: Ruined Historic
_1712.Description: HaHaHa. Did you hunt 10 Kyubimons? Now I can do business safely. As I promised with you at the beginning, I will give you special <Recovery Disk>. As you know by reading in detail this Recovery Disk is exclusively used for bird digimon~ Take it to Hawkmon, and tell him to use my store frequently.
_1712.CompletionText: <Recovery Disk> I gave to you is exclusively used for bird digimon. Click Hawkmon first, and then right click <Recovery Disk> item in inventory.
_1712.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. Now, I can feel better because of <Recovery Disk> that you obtained hard. Now I will tell you my story.

_1713.Title: Ruined Historic
_1713.Description: Thank you very much. Tamer~ I introduce myself officially. I am Hawkmon. Nice to meet you. I came back to <Ruined Historic> alone from the travel with my partner, Inoue Papa. Because it was a long travel, I felt low. Just in time, you found me, passing here and gave me <Recovery Disk>. Thank you very much. I think nearby digimons are strange. I am sorry for abrupt request but may I request you to research white Leomon around here? I will give you <Digital Pen> that I received from Inoue Papa. <Digital Pen> is the device to research and record digimon at the same time. You can use it by clicking enemy digimon and right click <Digital Pen>. Please research them swiftly.
_1713.CompletionText:
<Digital Pen> is the device to research and record digimon at the same time.
It is a Minnie among various digital devices I received from Inoue Papa. Please use it properly.
_1713.CompletionSummary: You completed the research about white Leomon by using <Digital Pen>. Thank you very much.

_1714.Title: Ruined Historic
_1714.Description: It is suspicious that the white Leomon is the phenomenon of digimon rampage. It is also described in <Digital Pen>. It seems that I heard it from Inoue Papa before. For the detail research I wish you to hunt several <white Leomons>and <white Leomon leader> It is very painful because they are digimons like me. However, we have no choice for the peace of Ruined Historic. While hunting white Leomon if you find <Crystal of Lion>, be sure to bring it to me. I will transmit <DATA> and <Crystals> that you collect during hunting to Inoue Papa via network. Please hunt white Leomon.
_1714.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Hunt white Leomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Hunt leader%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Crystal of Lion%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1714.CompletionText: Please bring me <Crystal of Lion> from white Leomon. I will transmit <Data> and <Crystals> you collected to Inoue Papa via network.
_1714.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. I could collect many data because of you Tamer.
I transmitted data and <Crystal of Lion> you collected to Inoue Papa via network.

_1715.Title: Ruined Historic
_1715.Description: I am the descendant of special tribe that was abundant in ancient period. I can't tell you detail now. I have to research about the phenomenon of digimon rampage in earnest First of all, I will research Aquilamon. Aquilamon has 2 big horns on head, and has very huge wings. You can think that it is an eagle of Real World. I will give you <Digital Pen> that you used previously. But this <Digital Pen> is exclusively used for Aquilamon . Aquilamon resides in <Occupied Excavation Area> located in the northeast of <Ruined Historic> map. This area was obtained by rampaging digimons. Please research them rapidly.
_1715.CompletionText:
Aquilamon resides in <Occupied Excavation Area> located in the northeast of <Ruined Historic> map.
You can find Garudamon in the way to <Occupied Excavation Area> after passing through < Street of Trial> located in the east of <Ruined Historic> map.
_1715.CompletionSummary: Thank you. You completed general research about Aquilamon. Now we should start detailed research.

_1716.Title: Ruined Historic
_1716.Description: How do you think about my hair decoration.. I received it from Garudamon, who I respect very much. It is very precious to me. (You say that the hair decoration of Hawkmon is not a genuine article as a joke.) Really? Do you think my hair decoration is not a genuine article? What are you talking about. I am very disappointed. I received it from Garudamon, who I most respect, directly. If you can't still believe me... Check it with my <Digital Pen>.
_1716.CompletionText:
Aquilamon resides in <Occupied Excavation Area> located in the northeast of <Ruined Historic> map.
You can find Garudamon in the way to <Occupied Excavation Area> after passing through < Street of Trial> located in the east of <Ruined Historic> map.
_1716.CompletionSummary: Now, it is found that my hair decoration is a genuine article. It is very precious to me. Anyway, you completed general research about Garudamon. Now, it's time to start detailed research.

_1717.Title: Ruined Historic
_1717.Summary: Convince the phenomenon of digimon rampage
_1717.Description: In relation with the data you have collected until now I requested analysis to Inoue Papa. After analysis, he convinced that it is <Phenomenon of digimon rampage>. The digimons that I love and respect are in painful situation. I have to make an effort to release them from the pain. For the detail research You have to hunt several <Aquilamons> and <Aquilamon leader> While hunting Aquilamon if you find <Crystal of Eagle>, be sure to bring it to me. As I mentioned previously, I have transmitted <Data> and <Crystals> to Inoue Papa via network.
_1717.Objective: Convince the phenomenon of digimon rampage
_1717.CompletionText: Aquilamon resides in <Occupied Excavation Area> by rampaging digimons, which is located in the northeast of <Ruined Historic> map.
_1717.CompletionSummary: Thank you. We collected plenty of data. I transmitted data and <Crystal of Eagle> you collected to Inoue Papa via network.

_1718.Title: Ruined Historic
_1718.Description: I respect Garudamon deeply. Originally, Garudamon is a nice person. But he is insane now. Maybe, its cause is <phenomenon of digimon rampage. For research You have to hunt several <Garudamons> and <Garudamon leader> While hunting Garudamon if you find <Crystal of Golden Eagle>, be sure to bring it to me. I have transmitted <Data> and <Crystals> that you collected during battle to Inoue Papa via network..
_1718.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Hunt Garudamon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Hunt leader%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Crystal of Golden Eagle%qe %cc3/%mc3
_1718.CompletionText: My honorable Garudamon... (It seems that he is angry about the phenomenon of digimon rampage.)
_1718.CompletionSummary: Thank you. We collected plenty of data. I transmitted data and <Crystal of Golden Eagle> you collected to Inoue Papa via network.

_1719.Title: Ruined Historic
_1719.Description: I have transmitted various data that you have collected to Inoue Papa. Now, I request you to perform the research about MetalGreymon. MetalGreymons are distributed in the center of <Occupied Excavation Area> located in the north. I wish you to research them by using <Digital Pen> too. Of course, this <Digital Pen> is only applicable to MetalGreymon.
_1719.CompletionText:
<Digital Pen> is the device to research and record digimon at the same time. I received it from Inoue Papa. Isn't it wonderful?
I am still not familiar with its use... Now, you can use <Digital Pen> better than me after using it over several times.
_1719.CompletionSummary: I appreciate your support all the time.

_1720.Title: Ruined Historic
_1720.Description: We have a problem. Inoue Papa contacted me. He said that among the data we have transmitted, the data about white Leomon boss is not sufficient Therefore.... I request you to kill white Leomon leaders, whose data are not sufficient. He said that 10 white Leomon leaders would be enough. Now, you may know that I transmit the data you collected to Inoue Papa. Come back safely.
_1720.CompletionText:
I request you to hunt white Leomon leader.
I wish you to bring me the data of <white Leomon leader> rather than the data of <white Leomon>
_1720.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. You collected plenty of data. It will be very helpful for data analysis.

_1721.Title: Ruined Historic
_1721.Description: Now we collected most of data about <phenomenon of digimon rampage> In addition, we have new information that Eveling exist in <Ruined Historic> too. I think you can get <Historic Map Eveling> from <MetalGreymon leader> residing in the north of Historic. Please bring me <Historic Map Eveling> It is for research. I will wait for you here.
_1721.CompletionText: I wish you to collect <Historic Map Eveling> from <MetalGreymon leader>
_1721.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for precious data.
All people that have met me have said that I am polite and courtesy person.
I also think that I am cool and calm person.

_1722.Title: Ruined Historic
_1722.Description: I heard that <Historic Excavation Area> is divided into <Occupied Excavation Area> of rampaging digimons and <Abandoned Excavation Area> where dark tower is built. I wish you to research both divided historic excavation areas. When I looked around, I could find several humans in the area. (Tamer reminds of Major general Homer Yushima and Doctor Akihiro Kurata.) It is to research nearby humans and digimons. I think it is not a difficult mission.
_1722.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Explore Occupied Excavation Area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Explore Abandoned Excavation Area%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1722.CompletionText: I heard that <Historic Excavation Area> is divided into <Occupied Excavation Area> of rampaging digimons and <Abandoned Excavation Area> where dark tower is built.
_1722.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. I could get all geographical information of <Ruined Historic>.
Inoue Papa will be pleased with the result too.

_1723.Title: Ruined Historic
_1723.Description: I wish you to notify this fact to nearby people while distributing the data collected until now. Go to <Historic Excavation Area> and notify this fact to <Boss Leomon > <Ruler SaberLeomon> <Major general Homer Yushima> and <Devil Impmon> respectively. While notifying the fact, If they have good data, you may receive the data from them. Come back safely.
_1723.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk with Boss Leomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk with Ruler SaberLeomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk with Major general Homer Yushima%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Talk with Devil Impmon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_1723.CompletionText: Talk with <Boss Leomon> <Ruler SaberLeomon> <Major general Homer Yushima> and <Devil Impmon> respectively.
_1723.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. I am Hawkmon.
Now you may know the seriousness of <phenomenon of digimon rampage>
Ah~ Did you deliver the secret letter to Kamemon?
When you detect Kamemon, you can deliver item to Kamemon by clicking Kamemon and right clicking secret letter

_1724.Title: Ruined Historic
_1724.Description: Oh.. It is another request that is not related with previous one. Please deliver the letter to Kamemon that has given me a lot of assistances. (You think that you will see the letter without letting Hawkmon know.) You have to deliver the secret letter to Kamemon. You must not see the letter while delivering it. It is a secret letter... (You opened it again secretly but it is described with digimon language that you can't understand.) When you detect Kamemon, you can deliver item to Kamemon by clicking Kamemon and right clicking secret letter item
_1724.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver secret letter to Kamemon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk with Dats member Kamemon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1724.CompletionText: Deliver this letter to Kamemon. Hurry.
_1724.CompletionSummary: Thank you for delivering secret letter.

_1725.Title: Ruined Historic
_1725.Description: Thank you for Hawkmon's <Secret Letter>. I can't tell you detail now. HaHa Ah... I obtained <Unidentified Data> in this area I wish you to deliver it to Hawkmon. If Hawkmon receives it, he can analyze it with Inoue Papa. Please deliver it to him now.
_1725.CompletionText: Deliver <Unidentified Data> to Hawkmon. If Hawkmon receives it, he can analyze it with Inoue Papa.
_1725.CompletionSummary:
Now, we collected all data completely. In addition, we notified the fact to all people around here.
I will transmit data to Inoue Papa again. We can get final analysis result.

_1726.Title: Ruined Historic
_1726.Description: Inoue Papa sent one item with final analysis result. It is the item called <Hope of Inoue Papa>. The item contains hopes of all digimons around here including me as well as hope of Inoue Papa. You can use it only in <Street of Trial> area of <Ruined Historic> map. If you use this item, <Garudamon of Trial> will appear. You must defeat it to get necessary information and plenty of vaccine data. Before leaving for Street of Trial, prepare everything. Cheer up Tamer!
_1726.CompletionText:
It is the item called <Hope of Inoue Papa>.
The item contains important compressed data, including hope of everybody. You can use it only in <Street of Trial> area of <Ruined Historic> map.
_1726.CompletionSummary:
<Garudamon of Trial> You overcame trial.
I knew you would make it.
Because of the trial you overcame now, we collected all vaccine data related with <phenomenon of digimon rampage>.
Thank you again. You did good job.

_1727.Title: Ruined Historic
_1727.Description: Because of the trial you overcame now, we collected all vaccine data related with <phenomenon of digimon rampage>. Thank you again and you did really good job. Inoue Papa analyzed all data and sent the vaccine that was made on the basis of collected data. He made it as a portable type for your convenience. It is the portable vaccine <Portable Vaccine Player>. With <Portable Vaccine Player>, go to Occupied Excavation Area and begin the purification of that area. Although it takes long time, I, Hawkmon, will also make an effort to purify <Ruined Historic> It will be my last appreciation to you Tamer. Thank you.
_1727.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Explore Occupied Excavation Area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use Portable Vaccine Player%qe %cc2/%mc2
_1727.CompletionText:
<Portable Vaccine Player> contains the vaccine data that are required to purify <Ruined Historic>.
It takes long time
to purify this area completely.
Use this item in <Occupied Excavation Area>
_1727.CompletionSummary:
Although it takes long time, I will also make an effort to purify <Ruined Historic>. Good job.
I have no more request for you Tamer. Thank you very much.

_1728.Title: Nanomon Maze
_1728.Description: They say you need a special entrance ticket to enter the Nanomon Maze [H] dungeon. This is a pass card based on the data of Nanomon so you can use it to enter the Nanomon Maze [H].
_1728.CompletionText: Please waith. I will make it for you.
_1728.CompletionSummary: Here is the Nanomon Maze pass card. You can only use it once so if you need more, I will make them every day.

_1730.Title: Christmas
_1730.Description:
Hi... Tylomons attacked our villages again this year. It's not fish this time... They took all the gifts for the Christmas festival...
Help us!! If we do this, Christmas will be a mess!!
_1730.CompletionText: Did you get the gifts back??
_1730.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much!!! Now, collect these and give them to Agumon and he will give you a nice gift.

_1731.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1731.Description:
The one you saw just now is called Devimon. I'd been looking for him all along. Too bad I lost him again. (They look similar, but he's a different digimon from Leomon as I know him.)
Devimon, how dare you do such a thing to me...?! I will show no mercy! (I did hear that Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis) was once brainwashed by Devimon.)
The evil must be purged! I will find him and destroy him!
Stay alive, tamer, at all cost! Before you go on any further, you should explore the surrounding area.
I hear D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2 is divided into many areas. To start, explore the surrounding three areas.
Stay alive at all cost!
_1731.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Explore: Leomon's Roar%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Explore: Devimon's Trace%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Explore: Brainwashed Digimons%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1731.CompletionText: I hear that this area is divided into many sections. You must first explore three areas. First, move onward, tamer.
_1731.CompletionSummary: Well done. This should take care of exploring the surrounding areas.

_1732.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1732.Description:
Well done. I suppose this concludes the exploration of the surrounding areas.
While you were out and about, I found a device in this area used by humans .
I would like you to take this to its owner. (I took Miki Kurosaki's Communicator from Leomon.)
Go on, tamer!
_1732.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speak with Miki Kurosaki <D-Terminal-Dungeon-2F>%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Deliver Miki Kurosaki's Communicator%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1732.CompletionText:
Hmm? You are not sure where to find Miki Kurosaki? I heard that she is somewhere in B2.
Keep moving on, and you should be able to find the one you seek.
_1732.CompletionSummary: Oh, this is the Communicator that I lost a long time ago. Thank you for finding it.

_1733.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1733.Description:
Thank you for finding this Communicator. With this Communicator, I will be able to communicate with Dats Center without a glitch.
As a Dats agent, I've been examining the digimons in this area. They are showing unusual behavior.
They have all become very ferocious and aggressive. Sure, there are digimons that were aggressive in the first place, but the digimons that used to be docile have now turned aggressive.
A Devimon appeared here and there, and I can only speculate that this is his doing.
Anyway, we will have to begin by investigating Monodramons in the area first.
_1733.CompletionText:
You are not sure where to find Monodramons? As you come to B2, you will see many pathways.
Enter these pathways and you will see small rooms. You will find Monodramons there.
_1733.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This is a Black Cogwheel, as I had suspected...

_1734.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1734.Description:
Thank you for bringing me the Black Cogwheel before. It really helped with the investigation.
Now that we have found the cogwheel, it is almost certain the Devimon's doing, the one that has been showing up around here.
Still, this is not 100% conclusive. Can I ask you to investigate a little more for me Thank you so much.
If you keep going ahead here, you will come to a large open space.
There, you will see digimons called Keramons.
Keramons are rather mischievous, but I don't think they realize that their mischief is putting the Digital World in danger.
Investigate them for me, would you? Go on, then.
_1734.CompletionText:
You will find Keramons if you go straight from the pathways.
They are purple. If you see mischievous faces,
you have found them.
_1734.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Your help is making our investigation much smoother.

_1735.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1735.Description:
Thank you so much. With your help, the investigation has become so much easier.
But I can't keep asking you to do things for me, so I'll ask one final thing of you.
Have you heard of the Great Twelve?
Of these twelve, there is one called Sinduramon. It's in the shape of a bird.
I would like you to investigate the Sinduramon. It flies around like a bird.
You should be able to recognize it right away when it shows. Now, move along and investigate Sinduramon for me, will you?
When you are done, go and speak with Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis).
_1735.CompletionText:
Sinduramon, one of the Great Twelve, is a bird-like digimon.
It flies in the sky, so you should have no trouble spotting it.
Please, hurry with the investigation with Sinduramon. When you are finished, go and speak with Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis)
_1735.CompletionSummary: This concludes the preliminary investigation in B2.

_1736.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1736.Description:
I see. So you have finished the investigation of this area, then? You are not sure where this Black Cogwheel comes from?
It is the doing of none other than Devimon himself.
Long ago, I met Devimon on the <File Island>.
He once used the <Black Cogwheel> and controlled my body.
I have never forgotten that piece of my past. Now we know that it is Devimon's doing...
We must secure a wider perimeter, and then close in on him.
Go and secure a wider perimeter for us. You will have to travel far, so be sure to be prepared.
Stay alive at all cost, tamer!
_1736.CompletionText:
Go deep into the B2 area, and you will discover two new areas.
Stay alive at all cost, tamer!
_1736.CompletionSummary: Well done, tamer. Thank you for your hard work.

_1737.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1737.Description:
Well done, tamer. I regret to see you so hard at work because of the enmity between me and Devimon.
Anyway,
while you were out and about, I did some work of my own.
I found another device. (Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis) handed over the device to me.)
I would like you to take this to its rightful owner as well. (What looks like a Communicator has the name <Megumi Shirakawa> written on it.)
Go on, then, tamer!
_1737.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speak with Megumi Shirakawa <D-Terminal-Dungeon-2F>%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Deliver Megumi Shirakawa's Communicator%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1737.CompletionText:
That cursed Devimon... He has been using the so-called Black Cogwheels to cause pain and suffering for digimons.
This is unacceptable!

_1738.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1738.Description:
Oh, this is my Communicator! I had lost it as I came deeper into B2. I've been using a different Communicator since. Thank you for finding it for me.
My name is Megumi Shirakawa. I'm from Dats Center.
I just heard from <Miki Kurosaki> over the Communicator regarding the Black Cogwheel.
<Miki Kurosaki> has told you about the digimons in the area having turned violent, I assume?
It seems that an evil digimon called <Devimon> has brainwashed the digimons in the area with his <Black Cogwheel>.
I would greatly appreciate any assistance you can offer in this investigation.
Have you heard of a digimon called <Hagurumon>?
There are <Hagurumons> in the area, and they know how to fly.
I need them for my investigation. Please, help.
_1738.CompletionText:
Hagurumons attack from the air.
They look like saw blades. They may look rather cute, but you will feel differently when they start attacking.
We need to get this done for the investigation. Please, hurry.
_1738.CompletionSummary: Thank you for bringing me the Black Cogwheel.

_1739.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1739.Description:
You have the Black Cogwheel. Thank you. The data you have collected is helping us greatly in our investigation of this region.
This time, I would like you to investigate Wendigomons.
When you see a Wendigomon, you will be pretty shocked at just how ferocious it looks.
They are sometimes also called Chocomons, probably because their color is like that of chocolate.
Anyway, please, go out and find Wendigomons, and help us with our investigation.
_1739.CompletionText: I'd like you to do some investigation on Wendigomons in the area.
_1739.CompletionSummary: Thank you, tamer. Your assistance is greatly appreciated at Dats Center.

_1740.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1740.Description:
Thank you, tamer. Thanks to you, Dats Center is seeing great progress in its investigation.
We have learned a lot of things from the data you collected for us.
As you have no doubt discovered in collecting the data for us, digimons in this area have been under the control of one called Devimon, the self-titled <Messenger of Darkness>.
It has been using something called <Black Cogwheels>. It puts the cogwheels in the body of the digimons in the region to control them at his will.
Now that we have found this out, please extract <Black Cogwheels> from the digimons to save them from their pain.
I would appreciate it if you would extract <Black Cogwheels> from <CyberDramons>.
Oh, and you should also meet with <Pajiramon> on your way.
In passing, it told me that it had something to say to you, tamer.
_1740.CompletionText: Go through this pathway and go deeper in. You will find CyberDramons there.
_1740.CompletionSummary: I am Pajiramon. You have come seeking me?

_1741.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1741.Description:
I am Pajiramon. You have sought me out.
You do understand that I am one of the Great Twelve, do you not? The Great Twelve are the twelve zodiac digimons.
Sinduramon whom you saw in this area is one of the Great Twelve. I, too, am one of the Great Twelve.
I know not whether you know this yet, but the enemy digimons in this area are suffering because of the <Black Cogwheels>.
I would ask that you go and liberate the many digimons who are suffering.
First, go and liberate Monodramon Keramon and Sinduramon from their pain and suffering.
I big you good luck! (I felt that there was something strange about the way Pajiramon looked at me.)
_1741.CompletionText:
You probably have discovered this as you walked around in this area, but as you search the areas that you have come through so far, you will be able to find these digimons.
Find Monodramon, Keramon, and Sinduramon.
Good luck! (There's something o
_1741.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Yes... You have done well, tamer. (I still feel that there is something off about the way Pajiramon looks.)

_1742.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1742.Description:
Ahem... Yes... You have done well. (I still feel there is something odd about the way Pajiramon looks at me.)
I did not expect you to carry out the task so well. I am very grateful to you.
Now, then, I shall tarry no longer, and give you another assignment. (The way Pajiramon speaks to me is overly kind and gentle.)
I would like you to liberate Hagurumon Wendigomon and Cyberdramon from the <Black Cogwheel>.
If you complete this assignment, I will give you a fine gift. (I felt that there was something sinister about the way Pajiramon talked.)
_1742.CompletionText: I would like you to liberate Hagurumon Wendigomon and Sinduramon from the <Black Cogwheel>. (I felt that Pajiramon's facial expression was rather sinister.)

_1743.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1743.Description:
I will give to you your final assignment. I will give you an item.
It is called the <Mark of Summoning>. Use it in the <Unexpected Trap> area of <D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2>, and you will see something good happen.
Go on. Go use it. (Pajiramon is still making that sinister smile.>
_1743.CompletionText:
This is what is called a <Mark of Summoning>.
Use this in <Unexpected Trap> of (D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2> and you will see great things take place.
(Pajiramon is still making that sinister smile. ) (I will have to let Megumi Shirakawa know about this
_1743.CompletionSummary:
Ah... We got this intel just now.
It seems that Pajiramon had already been brainwashed by Devimon even before you met with him.
If you go see Leomon, he will tell you more about it in detail.
The enemy digimon summoned with the <Mark of Summ

_1744.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1744.Description:
What? Pajiramon has been brainwashed by Devimon? Devimon, you will have it coming to you!!
I was once brainwashed by Devimon myself... Since then, I have been carrying this stabilizer data with me wherever I may be.
(Leomon (Devimon's Nemesis) handed the <Stabilizer Data> to me.)
We need to stop Devimon from doing this ever again. Tamer, hear my plea.
This world has summoned you as its only hope. You must stay alive at all cost!
_1744.CompletionText:
Take the <Stabilizer Data> and use it on Pajiramon.
Please.
_1744.CompletionSummary:
Many thanks, tamer. Thanks to your effort, I was able to be freed from Devimon's influence.
Devimon has come through here and gone to B3. I would like you to go and punish him.
I would like to see this never happen again from now on. Again, I tha

_1745.Title: D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2
_1745.Description:
Digimons in this area are suffering from the Black Cogwheel. We must work diligently to set the digimons free from being brainwashed by the Black Cogwheel.
As an agent of Dats, I will do my best. I would appreciate your assistance. A little bit everyday.
Today, I would like you to set <Monodramons> free.
_1745.CompletionText:
Places around here are dark and the pathways are narrow. It will make fighting difficult.
But we could use your help with <Monodramon> again today.
_1745.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. As expected, you can do daily quests only once a day.
I hope to see you again tomorrow to fight for the cleansing of D-Terminal-Dungeon-B2.

_1751.Title: Event
_1751.Description: Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon? Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Boar. The explanation above explains the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon. This month of [July] is the month of the <Rooster/Sinduramon>. If you handle the enemy digimons that are spread out all over the map for a month... you will get a <Crystalloid of Twelve Heavenly Generals>. If you collect all of them... You will reach your goal and good things will happen.
_1751.CompletionText:
Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?
If you collect medals from the enemy digimons I will exchange them for something good!
_1751.CompletionSummary:
Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?
If you collect medals from the enemy digimons I will exchange them for something good!

_1752.Title: Dats Center
_1752.Description:
This is Richard Sampson of Dats Center. I need you immediately for an assignment to D-Terminal-Dungeon 2F.
Double-time to me at Dats Center. While you are at it, I want you to deliver the news to Dr. Kevin Krier, as well!
_1752.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Speak with Richard Sampson at Dats Center%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Kevin Krier at Dats Center%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1752.CompletionText:
I have summoned you urgently to investigate D-Terminal-Dungeon 2F.
You are over level 50 as a tamer, and there is something we need your skills for.
Notify Dr. Kevin Krier about this as well!
_1752.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for responding to my urgent summon so quickly. I will give you the pass to the D-Terminal-Dungeon.
Take it, and present it to Dr. Kevin Krier. Hurry!

_1753.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1753.Description: We have finally arrived to the first floor of the Maze. Well done coming here. We will need to identify the topology of the surrounding areas first. Take a look around and report back.
_1753.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Begin the Search%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Area: Mini Tower of Mystery%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Area: Invisible Wall%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1753.CompletionText: What are you still doing here? Start searching Digimon Maze 1F already!
_1753.CompletionSummary: Well done, tamer! You finished exploring this area. Let me tell you what needs to be done next.

_1754.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1754.Description:
All right! Now that we have completed the preliminary exploration... We will begin our search proper.
First, take this Search Order and deliver it to one of the Leomon scouts on the first floor.
This document also contains vital information regarding this region, so don't lose it on the way.
_1754.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver the Search Order%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Scout Leomon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Area: Mini Tower of Mystery%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1754.CompletionText: Are you still here? Go on.
_1754.CompletionSummary: Oh, it's you. I am currently exploring Digimon Maze 1F under the orders of the Chief Leomon.

_1755.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1755.Description:
We found this structure while we were exploring this area under the Chief Leomon's orders.
It's a beautiful one. It looks like a tower of some sort.
As you can see, that Mini Tower is quite beautiful and mysterious.
We are investigating the Wormmons nearby. Something seems a little off about them.
They seem rather violent... I need someone to examine them more closely...
How about it? Could you lend us a hand?
_1755.CompletionText: Examine Wormmons near the Mini Tower.
_1755.CompletionSummary: Yes! This concludes our investigation of nearby areas.

_1756.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1756.Description:
Hmm... Mini Tower Fragment Alpha? It looks like a fragment from the tower, but I'm not sure how to use this...
Anyway, now that we have finished the preliminary examination of Wormmons, we will need to investigate further.
They seem to be carrying something with them. I would like you to look into it.
_1756.CompletionText:
This region is divided into three areas:
<Mini Tower of Mystery> <Begin the Search> and <Invisible Wall>.
_1756.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… Putting these pieces together, I see that this picture is of someone…
Do you recognize who this might be? (This photo is certainly of Digimon Kaiser.)
I am not sure why Wormmons would be carrying the fragments of a photo like this,
but that, at l

_1757.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1757.Description:
Yes... Our investigation seems to be going smoothly.
I have another search assignment for you. I have lost contact with the Leomon I sent on a search and scout assignment.
I will give you this <Old Search Order>. Take this and look for him.
I hope he's not just lost somewhere. It worries me.
_1757.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver Old Search Order%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Speak with Wounded Leomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Area: Begin the Search%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Area: Invisible Wall%qe %cc4/%mc4
_1757.CompletionText: Take the <Old Search Order> and find him.

_1758.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1758.Description:
I can't believe that our Scout Leomon has fallen...
I will show no mercy to the monsters in this area. I need you to help...
First, I want you to take care of those Goblimons and Gotsumons over there.
Eliminate them and bring me Goblimon's Clubs and Gotsumons Stone Fragments as evidence.
_1758.CompletionSummary:
Yes… That should help me calm down a bit. I thank you, tamer.
I believe there is a digimon around here by the name of Starmon. You should go and pay him a visit.

_1759.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1759.Description:
Hmm... The area ahead of us seems to be blocked by something. We can progress further with the wall there.
From what I have investigated, we need an item related to the Mini Tower in order for us to proceed.
(I rummaged through my things and pulled out the Mini Tower Fragment Alpha.)
Yes... The Alpha fragment. This takes care of one.
Now, all we have to do is find the Beta and the Gamma fragments.
You should be able to find them on Goblimons and Gotsumons.
_1759.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Goblimon Leader%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Gotsumon Leader%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Beta%qe %cc3 /%mc3 %qs4Mini Tower Fragment Gamma%qe %cc4 /%mc4
_1759.CompletionText: We don't have quite enough… Go on and find the rest of the Fragments.
_1759.CompletionSummary: We now have the Alpha, Beta, and Gamma pieces of the Mini Tower Fragments.

_1760.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1760.Description:
Now we have all three Mini Tower Fragments, Alpha, Beta, and Gamma.
We have one last thing we need.
It's called the <Hexagon Crystal>.
I need to integrate the gathered Mini Tower Fragments onto the Hexagon Crystal, if we are to proceed through this area.
The <Hexagon Crystal> is carried by a Goblimon. Now, I'm not sure which Goblimon has it. It might be the leader. But, then, it might be not.
I would think that the chances of you finding the <Hexagon Crystal> from so many Goblimons are pretty slim.
It will take a lot of effort to find it. Anyway, good luck.
_1760.CompletionText:
Goblimons took the <Hexagon Crystal>. I'm not sure if the leaders took it or not.
I figure your chances of finding the <Hexagon Crystal> among so many Goblimons are quite slim
It will be a difficult search. Good luck!
_1760.CompletionSummary: You have the Hexagon Crystal. This should enable us to go through this area freely.

_1761.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1761.Description:
Huh? It's you again. Is this chance of fate? Haha!
Anyway, you get to be in the presence of the Master Investigator again. It makes your heart pound, doesn't it? Hmm? You've come here struggle after struggle, so you are wondering how I came here, you say?
What's it to you? I'm busy right now. Well... I suppose it would be a different story if you are willing to help.
Take care of those Bakemons over there. And, while you are at it, bring me the Hell Teeth, too.
_1761.CompletionText: How goes the assignment given by the extremely gifted Master Investigator?
_1761.CompletionSummary: Excellent work, but we are not done yet. Inquiry is never that simple.

_1762.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1762.Description:
You have Bakemons' Hell Teeth. Fantastic! But this is not over yet.
The nature of inquiry is never that simple. I, the Master Investigator, have never once been wrong in my reasoning. Hahaha!
I will give you another assignment.
This time, eliminate the Bearmons over there and bring me their fur.
It will be a critical clue for my investigation. Go on, then. (I think there's something fishy about SuperStarmon's strange demands. I will have to speak with Starmon when I complete this assignment.)
_1762.CompletionText:
Hurry up and bring me the Bearmon Fur. It will be a very important clue in my investigation.
(Hmm… How strange… I will have to speak with Starmon once the task is finished.)

_1763.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1763.Summary: In Search of the Ancient Pages
_1763.Description:
Hmm... I see... I suppose we have wasted our time here, then...
Anyway, Maze 1F is more complex than I had thought. Its structure seems to be so that, if we don't find an exit to the upper levels, we will continue to walk around down the same route.
In order for us to get to the upper levels, we will need to find some kind of a clue.
Candlemons in the surrounding areas seem to carry some kind of a clue to a book, like an Ancient Page.
I want you to find something that will serve as a clue.
_1763.Objective: In Search of the Ancient Pages
_1763.CompletionText:
Candlemons in the surrounding areas seem to carry some kind of a clue to a book, like an Ancient Page.
I want you to find something that will serve as a clue.
_1763.CompletionSummary:
Ah, the Ancient Pages. You have gathered them all.
Hmm… Their content is more important than what I expected.

_1764.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1764.Description:
Ah, yes... The Ancient Pages... You have collected them all.
Hmm... These pages contain information much more valuable than I had originally thought. I've translated the contents.
According to these pages, on Maze 1F here, there are 4 types of digitalized hidden treasure.
I scoured through this area, but I don't recall ever seeing such treasure.
Oh, right! The Ancient Pages said that these treasures have been digitalized.
I heard that Keramons in the area consume data.
If you start slaying them, we might be able to find the ancient treasure we are looking for.
Slay <101 Megabyte Eater> Keramons and find the treasures.
It will be difficult, but I need you to do it. It will be very hard to find it.
_1764.CompletionText:
It is said that there are 4 digitalized treasures on the first floor of the Digimon Maze.
Defeat <101 Megabyte Eater> Keramons and bring me the treasure.
It will be no walk in the park. Good luck!
_1764.CompletionSummary:
I knew it… This is <Anubis Bronze Bracelet>.
That is, this is one of the 4 treasures on Digimon Maze 1F.

_1765.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1765.Description:
Hmm... Just as I thought... This is <Anubis Bronze Bracelet>.
This is one of the 4 treasures on Maze 1F. Its bronze hue is beautiful...
We need to find the remaining 3 treasures quickly if we are to move up to the upper levels...
This time, I need you to bring me the Bronze Armband.
You should be able to find Anubis Bronze Armband, one of the 4 treasures, on <102 Megabyte Eater> Keramons.
Those cursed Keramons... Eating up data... I'm not sure if it's a good thing or a bad thing that ancient artifacts are digitalized.
Anyway, hurry on and bring me <Anubis Bronze Armband>.
This task will be very difficult yet again. Don't give up!
