_1765.CompletionText:
It is said that there are 4 digitalized treasures on the first floor of the Digimon Maze.
This time, bring me the second treasure, the <Anubis Bronze Armband>.
You should be able to find it on <102 Megabyte Eater> Keramons.
It will be no walk in the pa
_1765.CompletionSummary:
<Anubis Bronze Bracelet> <Anubis Bronze Armband>
Now, we have 2 of the ancient treasures. We will need 2 more.

_1766.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1766.Description:
<Anubis Bronze Bracelet>, and <Anubis Bronze Armband>.
With these, we have 2 of the ancient treasures. We just need 2 more.
Once we have all 4 of them, we should be able to move up to the upper levels...
This time, I would like you to bring me the Bronze Necklace.
The Anubis Bronze Necklace is one of the 4 ancient treasures. You should be able to find it on <103 Megabyte Eater> Keramons.
Anyway hurry on out and bring me the <Anubis Bronze Necklace>.
This search will be a difficult one, as well. Don't give up but keep pushing for it.
After all, we only need 2 more. Haha!
_1766.CompletionText:
It is said that there are 4 digitalized treasures on the first floor of the Digimon Maze.
This time, bring me the third treasure, the <Anubis Bronze Necklace>.
You should be able to find it on <103 Megabyte Eater> Keramons.
It will be no walk in the pa
_1766.CompletionSummary:
<Anubis Bronze Bracelet> <Anubis Bronze Armband> <Anubis Bronze Necklace>
Now, we have 3 of the ancient treasures. We will need 1 more.

_1767.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1767.Description:
<Anubis Bronze Bracelet>, <Anubis Bronze Armband>,. and <Anubis Bronze Necklace>.
With these, we have 3 of the ancient treasures. We just need 1 more.
Once we have all 4 of them, we should be able to move up to the upper levels...
This time, I would like you to bring me the Bronze Shoes.
The Anubis Bronze Shoes are one of the 4 ancient treasures. You should be able to find it on <104 Megabyte Eater> Keramons.
Anyway hurry on out and bring me the <Anubis Bronze Shoes>.
This search will be a difficult one, as well. Don't give up but keep pushing for it.
After all, this is the last one...
_1767.CompletionText:
It is said that there are 4 digitalized treasures on the first floor of the Digimon Maze.
This time, bring me the fourth and the final treasure, the <Anubis Bronze Shoes>.
You should be able to find it on <104 Megabyte Eater> Keramons.
It will be no wa
_1767.CompletionSummary:
<Anubis Bronze Bracelet> <Anubis Bronze Armband> <Anubis Bronze Necklace> <Anubis Bronze Shoes>
Now, we have all 4 of the treasures. What's going to happen now?

_1768.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1768.Description:
<Anubis Bronze Bracelet>, <Anubis Bronze Armband>, <Anubis Bronze Necklace>, and <Anubis Bronze Shoes>.
Now, we have all 4 of the ancient treasures. What will happen now?
The 4 treasures came together and formed the <Bronze Anubimon Statue>.
Hmm...
I will give you this <Bronze Anubimon Statue>. Try using it over at <Anubimon's Traces>.
You should be able to find a clue to get to the next region.
Something might pop out at you, so be careful out there.
_1768.CompletionText:
Take the <Bronze Anubimon Statue> and use it in the <Anubimon's Traces> area.
You never know what may happen, so make sure you are amply prepared.
_1768.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… I didn't realize a boss monster like that would pop out of the <Bronze Anubimon Statue>.
Anyway, now that this is done, you should go speak with Anubimon and we'll be able to move on to the next floor.
Go to <Anubimon's Traces> and speak with Anubi

_1769.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1769.Description:
Ah... It is you.
You have discovered all of the hidden treasures on Digimon Maze 1F. Do me one favor, and I will grant you passage to 2F.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
In the first place, the Maze was mine to protect. My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place. However, Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away. Since then, the safety of this place has been compromised.
This is my final favor that I will ask of you. Slay some Candlemons and Bearmons, and I will grant you passage to Digimon Maze 2F. Thank you.
_1769.CompletionText: This is my final request. Take care of a few Candlemons and Bearmons in the area, and I will let you move on to the second floor of the Maze. Thank you in advance.
_1769.CompletionSummary:
Thank you.
If we restore the Maze to its original condition, I will be able to recover my body as well.
Please remember that recovering my body is the only way for us to stop hm.
Let me grant you passage to Digimon Maze 2F.

_1770.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1770.Description:
Hmm... It is fascinating to me that Wormmons should carry such pictures.
I want to know if they carry other things on them, and I would greatly appreciate it if you could look into it for me.
How about it? Do you think you could lend a hand?
_1770.CompletionText:
This region is divided into three areas:
<Mini Tower of Mystery> <Begin the Search> and <Invisible Wall>.
_1770.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… Just as I suspected - identical photos.
I will need your help again.

_1771.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1771.Description: Furious about scouts being attacked, asks for tamer's assistance in dealing with monsters nearby.

_1772.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1772.Description: Furious about scouts being attacked, asks for tamer's assistance in dealing with monsters nearby.

_1773.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1773.Description:
Inquiry is an ongoing process. I, the Master Investigator, am relentless in my inquiry. Hahaha!
I shall grant you the honor of taking an assignment for me yet again.
This time, take care of those Bakemons over there, and bring me the Hell Teeth.
They will be a vital clue to my investigation. Hurry on, then.
(I had to sigh at SuperStarmon's ludicrous request.)
_1773.CompletionText: Hurry up and bring me the Hell Teeth. It will be a very important clue in my investigation.
_1773.CompletionSummary:
What? Hell Teeth? What did you bring such useless items to me for?
What? I told you to bring them to me? What are you on? I, the Master Investigator, would never make someone do something so senseless.
Oh, well. You worked, so I suppose I should pay

_1774.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1774.Description:
Inquiry is an ongoing process. I, the Master Investigator, am relentless in my inquiry. Hahaha!
I shall grant you the honor of taking an assignment for me yet again.
This time, take care of those Bearmons over there, and bring me their fur.
It will be a vital clue to my investigation. Hurry on, then.
(I had to sigh at SuperStarmon's ludicrous request, wondering if he was really a Master Investigator.)
_1774.CompletionText: Hurry up and bring me the Bearmon Fur. It will be a very important clue in my investigation.
_1774.CompletionSummary:
What? Bearmon Fur? What did you bring such useless items to me for?
What? I told you to bring them to me? What are you on? I, the Master Investigator, would never make someone do something so senseless.
Oh, well. You worked, so I suppose I should pa

_1775.Title: Digimon Maze 1F
_1775.Description:
As I said before, the Ancient Pages contain information much more vital than I had thought before.
I thought I saw Candlemons in the area carrying something of a clue to the book - the Ancient Pages...
Find the Ancient Pages on Candlemons. I have a feeling that we will find out more.
_1775.CompletionText:
Candlemons in the surrounding areas seem to carry some kind of a clue to a book, like an Ancient Page.
I want you to find something that will serve as a clue.
_1775.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… You sure put in a lot of effort in recovering these Ancient Pages, but there is nothing else new in these pages.
Thank you. I look forward to working with you further.

_1776.Title: Tutorial
_1776.Description: Welcome. To begin with, I will briefly explain to you rookies the basic controls and in-game features. As a warm-up exercise, we will first work on @<tc:800>Camera Movement@</tc>.
_1776.CompletionText: Move according to the @<tc:800>image@</tc> to the left.
_1776.CompletionSummary: Completing all the tutorials is essential for a Dats agent.

_1777.Title: Tutorial
_1777.Description: Next, we will works on @<tc:800>Character Movement@</tc>. Try moving your character according to the @<tc:800>image@</tc> to the left of the screen.
_1777.CompletionText: Move according to the @<tc:800>image@</tc> to the left.
_1777.CompletionSummary: Completing all the tutorials is essential for a Dats agent.

_1778.Title: Tutorial
_1778.Description: I trust that you now understand how the basic movement works? Now, let's learn about @<tc:800>locating NPCs@</tc> using the area map. You can view the area map by pressing @<tc:800>M@</tc>. Be sure to master this handy shortcut. It will be used frequently in the future.
_1778.ObjectiveProgress:
%qs1open the area map.%qe %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Click the NPC button.%qe %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Select Yukidarumon.%qe %cc3/%mc3
%qs4close the area map.%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Move to Yukidarumon.%qe %cc5/%mc5
_1778.CompletionText: Press @<tc:800>M@</tc> and look at the area map carefully.
_1778.CompletionSummary: Completing all the tutorials is essential for a Dats agent.

_1779.Title: Tutorial
_1779.Description: If you use the area map proficiently, you will be able to move more quickly than other agents. Now, let's learn about @<tc:800>combat@</tc>. Take down the enemy Digimon before you. (Press @<tc:800>TAB@</tc> to auto-select the nearest enemy and @<tc:800>1@</tc> for basic attacks.)
_1779.CompletionText: Focus on the combat!! (Press @<tc:800>TAB@</tc> to select the nearest enemy and press @<tc:800>1@</tc> to use normal attacks.)
_1779.CompletionSummary: Completing all the tutorials is essential for a Dats agent.

_1780.Title: Tutorial
_1780.Description: I knew you'd be able to defeat it handily. Now, then, let's look at using @<tc:800>skills@</tc> to prepare for when you will face a more challenging Digimon. Take down the enemy Digimon in front of you using skills. (Select the enemy Digimon and use skills by pressing @<tc:800>F1@</tc>.)
_1780.CompletionText: Try using your skills with precision. (Select the enemy digimon and press @<tc:800>F1@</tc> to use the skill.)
_1780.CompletionSummary: Completing all the tutorials is essential for a Dats agent.

_1781.Title: Tutorial
_1781.Description: We are almost done. Keep up the good work. This time, we will look at locating enemy Digimons using the Quest window. You are just beginning, so @<tc:800>Upamons@</tc> at the Small Forest Park should do. (Press L to open the Quest window.)
_1781.ObjectiveProgress:
%qs1open the Quest List.%qe %cc1/%mc1
%qs2Select the quest%qe %cc2/%mc2
%qs3Select the name of the Digimon.%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Click Locate.%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Close the Quest List.%qe %cc5/%mc5
_1781.CompletionText: @<tc:800>Select the enemy Digimon@</tc> to fight against during your quest.
_1781.CompletionSummary: Completing all the tutorials is essential for a Dats agent.

_1782.Title: Tutorial
_1782.Description: Did you manage to find the Upamons? This feature will be very helpful for you in the future. Now, this is our final exercise. I trust that you will finish strong. I will show you how to @<tc:800>remove the enemy Digimon indicator arrow@</tc>, which was created in the previous tutorial. (Click the search target icon in the top right corner of the screen.)
_1782.CompletionText: Click the icon of your search target in the top right corner.
_1782.CompletionSummary: You have completed all the tutorials. We look forward to seeing you in action.

_1783.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1783.Description:
A new place calls for a new attitude.
All right! We are on the second floor, now. Now that we are in a new area, let's come back at it fresh and begin our search again.
First, let's explore the surrounding area. Begin with <New Attitude> and, <Path of Tranquility>.
These areas are not too far away from here, so hurry it up!!
_1783.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: A Brand New Day%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Area: Path of Tranquility%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1783.CompletionText: Why are you still here? The search begins.
_1783.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for starting in a new place with a new attitude.
Now, let me tell you about the <2F Scout> Leomon.

_1784.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1784.Description:
There is a Leomon scout on the second floor of the Maze, too.
I sent him out to search the surrounding area.
Go on, then. Get started on your search.
_1784.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: A Brand New Day%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Scout Leomon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Deliver Search Order%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1784.CompletionText:
Huh? Have you not left yet?
The scout is not too far away from here. Double-time!
_1784.CompletionSummary:
We meet again!
I am diligently searching this area per Chief Leomon's orders.

_1785.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1785.Description:
Good to see you again!
I am diligently searching this area per Chief Leomon's orders.
Do you know what the word "search" means literally? It comes from an ancient word that means to "go around" looking for something.
Let me give you this <Mini Device>. I would like you to explore the surrounding area and examine the digimons.
We will need to pay close attention to Ogremons. Something is fishy about them.
Before we begin our search proper, of course, we will need to do some preliminary investigations first. Slay Ogremons and bring me their <Ogremon's Bone Clubs>.
_1785.CompletionText: I need you to defeat Ogremons and bring me <Ogremon's Bone Clubs>.
_1785.CompletionSummary:
Good work.
This takes care of most of the search operation on 2F. What? You've discovered other digimons in the area, you say?

_1786.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1786.Description:
Great work!
This takes care of our search on the second floor somewhat. Pardon? You saw other digimons in the area, you say?
Hmm... Those are Icemons you mention.
They may look similar to the Gotsumons on the first floor, but they are slightly different. Cold energy runs through their body.
We will need to examine Icemons this time. Take it one step at a time, shall we?
As you slay them, you will find <Icemon's Ice Fragments>. Be sure to bring them to me.
When you are done, go and speak with the Chief Leomon.
_1786.CompletionText:
This time, we will need to examine Icemons. Take it one step at a time, eh?
As you defeat Icemons, you will be able to pick up <Icemon's Ice Fragments>, too. Be sure to bring those to me.
When you are done with your investigation, go and speak with Chie
_1786.CompletionSummary: Ah… This is no doubt <Icemon's Ice Fragments>.

_1787.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1787.Description:
Hmm...
With the various material you brought me, I have completed a report on the second floor, tamer.
Take this <2F Report> to Starmon in the <Path of Tranquility> area.
This report is on the basic investigation of the second floor. Make sure that Starmon gets it. (Right-click the item in the inventory to use it.)
Once you have delivered it, come back to me.
_1787.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Path of Tranquility%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Starmon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Deliver Report%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1787.CompletionText:
Take the <2F Report> to Starmon in <Path of Tranquility>.
Be sure to speak with Starmon and pass the <2F Report> to him. (Right-click the Report in the inventory to use it.)
When you are done, come back to me!
_1787.CompletionSummary:
Starmon ran various kinds of analyses from the report, I see.
Hmm… Mini Tower Fragments, huh…?

_1788.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1788.Description:
Hmm...
If Starmon is correct, we need to gather some material if we are to pass through the <Invisible Wall> area.
First, I will tell you what we need immediately.
Get <Mini Tower Fragment Delta> from Ogremons, <Mini Tower Fragment Epsilon> from Icemons, and <Mini Tower Fragment Zeta> from Chrysalimons.
I would really appreciate it if you could go gather those Mini Tower Fragments as Starmon suggested.
Once you have gathered all the fragments, I will let you know what we need next...
_1788.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mini Tower Fragment Delta%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Mini Tower Fragment Epsilon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Zeta%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1788.CompletionText: Go and find <Mini Tower Fragment Delta> from Ogremons, <Mini Tower Fragment Epsilon> from Icemons, and <Mini Tower Fragment Zeta> from Chrysalimons in the area.
_1788.CompletionSummary:
Yes… Now, we have all the Mini Tower Fragments.
The last item that we need is <Garnet Crystal>.

_1789.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1789.Summary: In Search of the Garnet Crystal
_1789.Description:
Ah, yes. We now have all the Mini Tower Fragments we need.
Now, finally, we need the <Garnet Crystal>.
The Garnet Crystal is a beautiful red gem.
If we integrate the material you gathered before, <Mini Tower Fragment Delta>, <Mini Tower Fragment Epsilon>, and <Mini Tower Fragment Zeta>, onto the Garnet Crystal, we can pass through this area anytime.
You should be able to collect the final material, the <Garnet Crystal>, from <(Data Crasher) Chrysalimons> in the area.
It may take a long time before you actually find one, so prepare yourself.
_1789.Objective: In Search of the Garnet Crystal
_1789.CompletionText:
You should be able to collect the final material, the <Garnet Crystal>, from <(Data Crasher) Chrysalimons> in the area.
It may take a long time before you actually find one, so prepare yourself.
_1789.CompletionSummary:
With this, we have all the material that we need to get through this area.
We can now pass through the <Invisible Wall> anytime, now.
Speak with Starmon to pass through this area. He is at the end of the <Path of Tranquility>.

_1790.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1790.Summary: What Is This Place And Where?
_1790.Description:
Yeah, baby! I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
What? Why am I in a place like this, you ask? Shut yer cakehole! It ain't none of your business.
I like to be noticed by others, and I'm violent to boot. Mwahahahaha!
Anyway, you, tamer, must also obey my every whim.
What? I'm being rude to a stranger, you say? You still don't get it, do you?
No matter. I have my reasons for being here, so don't go on prying.
Bah! Maze 2F is way too complex.
You work for me now, so I command you to scout for me.
Scout out the <Self-Titled Etemon the Most Powerful> area as well as the <Path of Stillness> area.
Oh, shut up and just do it!
_1790.Objective: What Is This Place And Where?
_1790.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Self-Titled Etemon the Most Powerful%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Area: Path of Stillness%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1790.CompletionText:
Yeah, baby!
Go and pay a visit to <Self-Titled Etemon the Most Powerful> and <Path of Stillness>.
_1790.CompletionSummary: What? You expected my gratitude on a simple recon mission like this?

_1791.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1791.Description:
That takes care of the exploration of nearby areas somewhat. The Digimon Maze is more complex than one might think.
Tamer, you work for me, and, now, listen to my commands.
Oh, quit your grumbling!
Stingmons in the area are getting on my nerves. I don't like their attitude. They are too cocky.
I will give you this <Search Device>. Use it on them and report back to me.
The Search Device, as its name implies, is a device used to search enemies.
Approach an enemy, click him, and then right-click the device in your inventory to use it.
I also want you to slay a few of them. How dare they try to be cool in my presence! I don't like 'em one bit.
I look forward to your obedience, my beloved subordinate tamer!
_1791.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Self-Titled Etemon the Most Powerful%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Use Search Device%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Stingmon%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1791.CompletionText: Examine Stingmons in <Self-Titled Etemon the Most Powerful> with the <Search Device>, and slay a few of them while you're at it.
_1791.CompletionSummary: Hmm… I like you. Work a little harder, and I will give you a promotion. Mwahaha!

_1792.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1792.Description:
You know, I really like you. Work a little harder, and I will promote you, baby!
Stingmons are pretty quiet now.
But <Stingmon Leader> is far too loud for my liking.
Shut the cakeholes of <Stingmon Leaders>, so they can't cause more ruckus. Bring me their <Stingmon Antennae> as evidence.
You do as I say, ya hear? Go, go, go!
_1792.CompletionText:
Shut the cakeholes of <Stingmon Leaders>, and bring me their <Stingmon Antennae> as evidence.
Go, baby!
_1792.CompletionSummary:
Ah, it's a little quieter now… I just want everyone - except me, of course - to shut their cakehole.
I am, after all, so magnificently powerful that no one can be a match to me.

_1793.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1793.Description:
Ah, the peace and quiet... Everyone should just keep their cakeholes shut... except me, of course.
After all, I am so powerful that no one can be a match for me.
*sniff sniff* What is this stench?! Ugh...!
Where is this stench coming from? Ah, it's those guys over there. Those Vegiemons are creating the horrible stench.
Slay those foul Vegiemons!
Get rid of <Vegiemons> and bring me their <Vegiemon Insectivorous Fruit>.
Rock 'n Roll, baby!
_1793.CompletionText:
Get rid of <Vegiemons> and bring me their <Vegiemon Insectivorous Fruit>.
Rock 'n Roll, baby!
_1793.CompletionSummary:
Ah, that clears the air!
Well done, tamer. Thank you!

_1794.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1794.Description:
Ah, it's much better without the stench! Well done, pal.
Now... These so-called Chrysalimons are wandering about in the area. I want you to eradicate them...
I could easily dispatch them myself, but they seem rather gross and I don't even want to get close...
I hate anything that gives me the creeps! Waving those tentacles about... Ugh! Disgusting!
Take care of <Chrysalimons> in the surrounding area, and bring me <Chrysalimon's Data>.
_1794.CompletionText: Take care of <Chrysalimons> in the surrounding area, and bring me <Chrysalimon's Data>.
_1794.CompletionSummary:
Actually, I can easily take on a tentacle monster myself…
But, thanks anyway, tamer…

_1795.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1795.Description:
Actually, I could handle tentacle monsters myself…
But, well done, anyway… Thank you!
It is a great honor indeed to receive my gratitude.
Anyway, there are some things I would like to ask Starmon. I've written it down in this document.
Take this <Etemon's Document> and deliver it to Starmon.
It has all my questions about our surroundings.
Don't forget - you have to click the NPC and right-click the item to deliver the document.
Have fun!
_1795.CompletionText:
Take this <Etemon's Document> and deliver it to Starmon.
It has all my questions about our surroundings.
Don't forget - you have to click the NPC and right-click the item to deliver the document.
Have fun!

_1796.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1796.Description:
Mmm… That takes care of all my curiosity.
That Starmon… He's smarter than one might expect. Not like I know him super-well, though. Mwahaha!
Anyway, just as I thought, we need the Mini Tower Fragments to pass through this area that's blocked off.
As it turns out, this place is more complex than I had thought in the first place... They don't call it a Maze for nothing.
According to Starmon, we need <Mini Tower Fragment Eta> <Mini Tower Fragment Theta> and <Mini Tower Fragment Iota>.
What are eta, theta, and iota, you ask? I'm not sure, either. According to Starmon, though, it's ancient Greek.
Now, hurry on and bring me those Fragments.
_1796.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mini Tower Fragment Eta%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Mini Tower Fragment Theta%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Iota%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1796.CompletionText:
What are eta, theta, and iota, you ask? I'm not sure, either. According to Starmon, though, it's ancient Greek.
Now, hurry on and bring me those Fragments.
_1796.CompletionSummary:
Look at all those Mini Tower Fragments. We should be able to pass through this area, then.
But, before we do that, there is something you must do for me.

_1797.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1797.Description:
Look at all those Fragments. We should be able to pass through this area soon.
Before that happens, though, there is something we need to do.
See those stinky Vegiemons over there? I'm itching for a vendetta.
First, go give them a good thwack, and then get their stinky <Whatchamacallits>...
Then, chuck those <Whatchamacallits> in their faces.
That is your priority as a tamer.
Go and take care of those foul creatures, got it?
_1797.CompletionText:
First, go give them a good thwack, and then get their stinky <Whatchamacallits>...
Then, chuck those <Whatchamacallits> in their faces.
That is your priority as a tamer.
Go and take care of those foul creatures, got it?
_1797.CompletionSummary:
This is SO satisfying!
Ahem… Now, if we just get our hands on the Amethyst Crystal, we should be able to pass through the area.

_1798.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1798.Summary: In Search of the Amethyst Crystal
_1798.Description:
Ah, that is SO satisfying!
Now, once we have the Amethyst Crystal, we'll be able to get out of this place.
An Amethyst is a purple crystal. It's a variety of quartz, tectosilicate mineral. Iron oxide creates the purple hue. The more iron oxide it has, the deeper its color. Those with deep color and those deemed beautiful are used as jewelry.
... so says Starmon's memo.
I may be the most powerful digimon in the world, but I ain't that smart, you see.
All that is to say, I want you to get the final material, <Amethyst Crystal> from <(Misconnecter) Chrysalimons>!
Go and get that! It will be very difficult to actually find one, so make sure you are prepared when you leave.
_1798.Objective: In Search of the Amethyst Crystal
_1798.CompletionText:
All that is to say, I want you to get the final material, <Amethyst Crystal> from <(Misconnecter) Chrysalimons>!
Go and get that! It will be very difficult to actually find one, so make sure you are prepared when you leave.
_1798.CompletionSummary:
Ah-ha! You have the <Amethyst Crystal>. Item integration is now complete!
Now, we can come and go in this area as we please.
Go and speak with Starmon at the end of the <Path of Stillness> and we can move on to the next area. Go, baby!

_1799.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1799.Description:
You again? Are you stalking me or something?
We just happen to run into each other on the first floor, and, now, on the second floor, too?
Well, enough of that. I don't know who created the Digimon Maze, but that's the one you should be chasing after. Not me.
Still, there must be a purpose behind our encounter. On that note, would you do me a favor?
What do you think are the basics of being an investigator? I think it's area search.
That is to say, this area needs to be searched.
I would like you to explore <Lost in the Maze> and <Path of Silence> for me.
So, go and explore these areas, and come back to moi! The Master Investigator!
I will graciously welcome you back anytime!
_1799.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Lost in the Maze%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Area: Path of Silence%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1799.CompletionText:
What do you think are the basics of being an investigator? I think it's area search.
That is to say, this area needs to be searched.
I would like you to explore <Lost in the Maze> and <Path of Silence> for me.
_1799.CompletionSummary:
So, you want to become a master investigator like myself, do you?
Exploring the area is the bare minimum for a master investigator. Don’t ya forget it!

_1800.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1800.Description:
Hmm..
I, SuperStarmon the Master Investigator of irresistible charm with black sunglasses, have a favor to ask of you.
And you will do it for me. In this area, you will find Soulmons. They look rather like Bakemons.
They both look like ghosts, but Soulmons wear black hats.
I need you to go and slay them. I may be the seasoned Master Investigator, but I still don't like ghosts, you know.
So, I want you to go and eradicate them.
Don't forget to examine them with this <Search Device> before you slay them, though!
_1800.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Area: Lost in the Maze%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Use Search Device%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Soulmon%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1800.CompletionText:
Take the <Search Device> and examine the Soulmons. After that, slay them.
To use the Device, right-click it on the target enemy.
_1800.CompletionSummary:
Yes, that's it! That's how you deal with Soulmons!
Now, let's find our suspect, shall we?

_1801.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1801.Description:
Now, we are talkin'! That takes care of those Soulmons.
Now, let's start looking for the culprit, shall we?
The culprit is in here somewhere. We have narrowed down the suspects to two: Soulmons or Grizzmons.
Those ghostly Soulmons look like the kind of digimons that would create a place like the Digimon Maze. Those hats look rather suspicious, too.
The other suspects are Grizzmons. Their bear-like appearance must be a fake... It is my tentative conclusion that they may look slow, but they are actually quite quick.
So, that brings us to the conclusion that either <Soulmons> or <Grizzmons> are the culprits behind creating the Digimon Maze.
We need to slay them and find our clues. Go on, then. Just go and do it!
_1801.CompletionText:
So, that brings us to the conclusion that either <Soulmons> or <Grizzmons> are the culprits behind creating the Digimon Maze.
We need to slay them and find our clues. Go on, then. Just go and do it!
_1801.CompletionSummary:
What? You took care of them but found no viable clues?
Hmm… Were they not the culprits? Was my deduction completely wrong? No! It can't be!

_1802.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1802.Description:
What? You defeated them but found no clues?
Hmm… So, they are not the culprits, then? Was my deduction wrong? No, it can't be! I'm never wrong!
They have been targeted by me, and I will get to the bottom of this.
I want you to defeat their leaders this time.
First, take care of Soulmon leaders and bring me their <Cursed Black Hats> as evidence.
There is no way that the perfect reasoning of this Master Investigator can crumble like this.
_1802.CompletionText:
I want you to defeat their leaders this time.
First, take care of Soulmon leaders and bring me their <Cursed Black Hats> as evidence.
There is no way that the perfect reasoning of this Master Investigator can crumble like this.
_1802.CompletionSummary:
They are not it, either, huh?
Oh, well. We still have our next suspect. Grizzmons are next!

_1803.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1803.Description:
So, they were not the culprits, then?
Oh, well… We still have the another suspect. It's Grizzmons' turn this time!
I'm going to dig deeper with these Grizzmons. Once I suspect something, I always get to the bottom of it.
I want you to defeat their leaders this time.
First, slay Grizzmon Leaders and bring me <Grizzmon Claws> as evidence.
The Master Investigator's perfect deduction never crumbles so easily!
_1803.CompletionText:
First, slay Grizzmon Leaders and bring me <Grizzmon Claws> as evidence.
The Master Investigator's perfect deduction never crumbles so easily!
_1803.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… So, they are not it, either, eh? Then, Starmon is next!
There's something fishy about this guy…

_1804.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1804.Description:
Hmm… They really weren't the culprits, huh? Then, Starmon is our next suspect!
Something is… fishy about him. Anyway, I am suspicious of him, so I wrote down a few questions on this document…
I want you to take it to him. You will find Starmon in a nearby area.
Go and give it to him.
_1804.CompletionText:
Anyway, I am suspicious of him, so I wrote down a few questions on this document…
I want you to take it to him. You will find Starmon in a nearby area.
Go and give it to him.
_1804.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… He's not it, either, I see… But this trip was not in vain.
Seeing Starmon was productive in its own way.

_1805.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1805.Description:
Hmm… He's not it, either, I see… But this trip was not in vain.
Seeing Starmon was productive in its own way.
According to Starmon, we need certain items in order for us to get through areas in this Maze that are blocked off.
By certain items, he means Mini Tower Fragments and Crystals. This Starmon kid is smarter than I thought. Hahaha!
Anyway, this place is more complex and annoying than I had expected.
I need you to take care of this problem for me.
First, go and collect <Mini Tower Fragment Kappa> from Soulmons, <Mini Tower Fragment Lambda> from Grizzmons, and <Mini Tower Fragment Mu> from Chrysalimons in the area.
Bring me those Fragments.
_1805.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mini Tower Fragment Kappa%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Mini Tower Fragment Lambda%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Mu%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1805.CompletionText:
First, go and collect <Mini Tower Fragment Kappa> from Soulmons, <Mini Tower Fragment Lambda> from Grizzmons, and <Mini Tower Fragment Mu> from Chrysalimons in the area.
Bring me those Fragments. The structure of this place is rather annoying.
_1805.CompletionSummary:
If Starmon is right, we should be able to leave this area soon!
The jurisdiction of this Master Investigator will get larger and larger…

_1806.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1806.Description:
Ah, yes. We now have all the Mini Tower Fragments we need. According to Starmon, we need the <Aquamarine Crystal> next.
The Aquamarine Crystal is a beautiful gem with a turquoise hue.
When I first laid my eyes on aquamarine outside of this Maze, I was quite shocked by its clear, turquoise color.
Sure, its properties are probably somewhat different from those of this region.
As a matter of fact, aquamarine may not be as expensive as its cousin, emerald, but it is still used as jewelry
If we integrate the material you gathered before <Mini Tower Fragment Kappa> <Mini Tower Fragment Lambda> and <Mini Tower Fragment Mu> onto the Aquamarine Crystal we can pass through this area anytime.
According to Starmon, yes.
You should be able to collect the final material, the <Aquamarine Crystal>, from <(Tentacles) Chrysalimons> in the area.
It may take a long time before you actually find one, so prepare yourself.
_1806.CompletionText:
You should be able to collect the final material, the <Aquamarine Crystal>, from <(Tentacles) Chrysalimons> in the area.
It may take a long time before you actually find one, so prepare yourself.
Getting lost in this maze makes me feel like my soul it
_1806.CompletionSummary:
With this, we have all the material that we need to get through this area.
We can now pass through the <Invisible Wall> anytime, now.
Speak with Starmon to pass through this area. He is at the end of the <Path of Silence>.

_1807.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1807.Summary: In Search of the Artifact Map
_1807.Description:
After all that trouble, we have finally arrived at the end of the second floor of the Maze. What a journey…
If we are to pass through the second floor and move on to the third, we need some clues.
First, we will need to collect fragments of the <Ancient Artifact Map> from <Seadramons> in the area.
Once we have all the fragments, we will be able to find clues to the <Anubimon Artifacts> of <Digimon Maze 2F>.
Huh? My explanation is too difficult to understand? Let me summarize it for you: Defeat <Seadramons> and bring me the <Ancient Artifact Map>.
_1807.Objective: In Search of the Artifact Map
_1807.CompletionText:
We will need to collect fragments of the <Ancient Artifact Map> from <Seadramons> in the area.
Once we have all the fragments, we will be able to find clues to the <Anubimon Artifacts> of <Digimon Maze 2F>.
_1807.CompletionSummary:
We have all the Artifact Map fragments…
Let's start translating this map. This is a critical moment.

_1808.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1808.Description:
Ah, yes... The Ancient Artifact Map... You have collected all the pieces.
Hmm... These pages contain information much more valuable than I had originally thought. I've translated the contents.
On Maze 2F here, there are 4 types of digitalized hidden artifacts.
As with the first floor, I scoured through this area, but I don't recall ever seeing such artifacts.
Oh, right! The Ancient Artifact Map said that these treasures have been digitalized.
I heard that Chrysalimons in the area consume data.
If you start slaying them, we might be able to find the ancient artifacts we are looking for.
Slay <Hand-to-Hand Chrysalimons> and find 1 of the 4 treasures.
It will be difficult, but I need you to do it. It will be very hard to find it.
_1808.CompletionText:
Slay <Hand-to-Hand Chrysalimons> and find 1 of the 4 treasures.
It will be difficult, but I need you to do it. It will be very hard to find it.
_1808.CompletionSummary:
There it is. <Anubis Silver Bracelet>.
That is, we have one of the 4 treasures on Digimon Maze 2F.
1 down, 3 to go.

_1809.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1809.Description:
Hmm... Just as I thought... This is <Anubis Silver Bracelet>.
That means we have acquired one of the 4 treasures on Maze 2F. Its silver hue is beautiful...
We need to find the remaining 3 treasures quickly if we are to move up to the upper levels...
This time, I need you to bring me the Silver Armband.
You should be able to find Anubis Silver Armband, one of the 4 treasures, on <Tentacle Chrysalimons>.
Hurry on and bring me <Anubis Silver Armband>.
This task will be very difficult yet again. Don't give up!
Remember the place where you first ran into SuperStarmon on the second floor? The Chrysalimons are there. Don't confuse them with other Chrysalimons.
_1809.CompletionText:
Slay <Tentacle Chrysalimons>,
and find the second of the 4 digitalized ancient artifacts, the <Anubis Silver Armband>.
_1809.CompletionSummary:
There it is. <Anubis Silver Armband>.
That is, we have 2 of the 4 treasures on Digimon Maze 2F.
2 down, 2 to go.

_1810.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1810.Description:
Hmm... Just as I thought... This is <Anubis Silver Bracelet>.
That means we have acquired 2 of the 4 treasures on Maze 2F.
We have 2 left, then...
Let me give the run-down on the treasures again. The 4 treasures are: <Anubis Silver Bracelet> , <Anubis Silver Armband>, <Anubis Silver Necklace>, and <Anubis Silver Shoes>.
We have the Silver Bracelet and Armband. We just need the Necklace and the Shoes.
Defeat <Misconnecting Chrysalimons> and bring me the <Anubis Silver Necklace>.
I'm not sure if you remember, but you will find <Misconnecting Chrysalimons> in the place where you first met <Etemon> on the second floor.
You need to go back there and take the ancient treasure from them.
_1810.CompletionText:
Slay <Misconnecting Chrysalimons>,
and find the third of the 4 digitalized ancient artifacts, the <Anubis Silver Necklace>.
_1810.CompletionSummary:
There it is. <Anubis Silver Necklace>.
That is, we have 3 of the 4 treasures on Digimon Maze 2F.
We have just one more to go. Keep at it, tamer!

_1811.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1811.Description:
<Anubis Silver Bracelet>, <Anubis Silver Armband>,. and <Anubis Bronze Necklace>.
With these, we have 3 of the ancient treasures on the second floor of this Maze. We just need 1 more.
Once we have all 4 of them, we should be able to move up to the upper levels...
This time, I would like you to bring me the Silver Shoes.
The Anubis Silver Shoes are one of the 4 ancient treasures. You should be able to find them on <Destroyer Chrysalimons>.
Go on out and bring me the <Anubis Silver Shoes>.
This search will be a difficult one, as well. Don't give up but keep pushing for it.
After all, this is the last one... I don't need to tell you where to find those Chrysalimons, do I?
_1811.CompletionText:
On Maze 2F here, there are 4 types of digitalized hidden artifacts.
This time, I would like you to bring me the fourth and the final treasure, <Anubis Silver Shoes>.
You should be able to find them on <Destroyer Chrysalimons>.
It will be difficult, but
_1811.CompletionSummary:
<Anubis Silver Bracelet> <Anubis Silver Armband> <Anubis Silver Necklace> <Anubis Silver Shoes>
Now, we have all 4 of the treasures. What's going to happen now?
Hint - think back to what happened on the first floor.

_1812.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1812.Description:
<Anubis Silver Bracelet>, <Anubis Silver Armband>, <Anubis Silver Necklace>, and <Anubis Silver Shoes>.
Now, we have all 4 of the ancient treasures. What will happen now?
The same thing happened like on the first floor as expected.
The 4 treasures came together and formed the <Silver Anubimon Statue>.
Hmm...
I will give you this <Silver Anubimon Statue>. Try using it over at <Memories of Anubimon>.
You should be able to find a clue to get to the next region.
Something might pop out at you, so be careful out there.
_1812.CompletionText:
I will give you this <Silver Anubimon Statue>. Try using it over at <Memories of Anubimon>.
Something might pop out at you like on the first floor, so be careful out there.
_1812.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… I didn't realize a boss monster like that would pop out of the <Silver Anubimon Statue>.
Anyway, now that this is done, you should go speak with Anubimon and we'll be able to move on to the next floor.
Go to <Memories of Anubimon> and speak with An

_1813.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1813.Description:
Ah... It is you.
Let me first tell you what your final task here.
Please, slay some <Seadramons>, <Seadramon Leaders>, and <(Fighter) Chrysalimons>.
I will explain everything to… you… la…ter…
_1813.CompletionText:
Let me first tell you what your final task here.
Please, slay some <Seadramons>, <Seadramon Leaders>, and <(Fighter) Chrysalimons>.
I will explain everything to… you… la…ter…
_1813.CompletionSummary:
Ah… It is you.
We need to restore the Digimon Maze to the way it once was.

_1814.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1814.Description:
Do me one last favor, and I will grant you passage to 3F.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
In the first place, the Maze was mine to protect. My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place. However, Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away. Since then, the safety of this place has been compromised.
This is my final favor that I will ask of you. Please tell Starmon what just happened.
I will soon grant you passage to Digimon Maze 3F. Thank you.
_1814.CompletionText:
Ah… It is you.
This is my final favor that I will ask of you. Please tell Starmon what just happened.
I will soon grant you passage to Digimon Maze 3F. Thank you.
_1814.CompletionSummary:
Thank you.
If we restore the Maze to its original condition, I will be able to recover my body as well.
Please remember that recovering my body is the only way for us to stop hm.
Let me grant you passage to Digimon Maze 3F.

_1815.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1815.Description:
Today, I need to investigate Ogremons thoroughly.
I will spare you all the details. Slay <Ogremon Leaders> and <Ogremons>, and bring me <Ogremon's Bone Clubs>.
This is necessary for a thorough investigation of this area, and I need your assistance, tamer.
_1815.CompletionText:
I will spare you all the details. Slay <Ogremon Leaders> and <Ogremons>, and bring me <Ogremon's Bone Clubs>.
This is necessary for a thorough investigation of this area, and I need your assistance, tamer.
_1815.CompletionSummary:
Yes, well done. Let's call it a day. No more Ogremons today.
I look forward to working with you again.

_1816.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1816.Description:
Today, I need to investigate Icemons thoroughly.
I will spare you all the details. Slay <Icemon Leaders> and <Icemons>, and bring me <Icemon's Ice Fragments>.
This is necessary for a thorough investigation of this area, and I need your assistance, tamer.
_1816.CompletionText:
I will spare you all the details. Slay <Icemon Leaders> and <Icemons>, and bring me <Icemon's Ice Fragments>.
This is necessary for a thorough investigation of this area, and I need your assistance, tamer.
_1816.CompletionSummary:
Yes, well done. Let's call it a day. No more Icemons today.
I look forward to working with you again.

_1817.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1817.Description:
Ah, dang it…
Now, they are being noisy in stereo… They are far too loud!
It bothers me that <Stingmons> and <Stingmon Leaders> are so noisy.
Shut the cakeholes of <Stingmons> and <Stingmon Leaders>, so they can't cause more ruckus. Bring me their <Stingmon Antennae> as evidence.
You need to keep at it, ya hear?
_1817.CompletionText:
Shut the cakeholes of <Stingmons> and <Stingmon Leaders>, so they can't cause more ruckus. Bring me their <Stingmon Antennae> as evidence.
You need to keep at it, ya hear?
_1817.CompletionSummary:
Ah, the peace and quiet... Everyone should just keep their cakeholes shut... except me, of course.
After all, I am so powerful that no one can be a match for me.
You need to keep at it, ya hear?

_1818.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1818.Description:
Slay those foul Vegiemons, too!
Get rid of <Vegiemons> and <Vegiemon Leaders>, and bring me their <Vegiemon Insectivorous Fruit>.
Rock 'n Roll, baby! You need to keep at it, ya hear?
_1818.CompletionText:
Get rid of <Vegiemons> and <Vegiemon Leaders>, and bring me their <Vegiemon Insectivorous Fruit>.
Rock 'n Roll, baby!
_1818.CompletionSummary:
Ah, the stench is gone, and I can breathe now! Well done, buddy!
You need to keep at it, ya hear?

_1819.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1819.Description:
I just don't care. They got me suspicious of 'em, and I will get to the bottom of this.
First, slay Soulmons and Soulmon Leaders, and bring me <Cursed Black Hats> as evidence.
There is no way that the perfect reasoning of this Master Investigator can crumble like this. (Hmm... This SuperStarmon just doesn't come off as reliable...)
_1819.CompletionText:
First, slay Soulmons and Soulmon Leaders, and bring me <Cursed Black Hats> as evidence.
There is no way that the perfect reasoning of this Master Investigator can crumble like this.
_1819.CompletionSummary:
My perfect reasoning cannot crumble like this! This is not over!
You just wait and see, Soulmons…

_1820.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1820.Description:
I just don't care. They got me suspicious of 'em, and I will get to the bottom of this.
First, slay Grizzmons and Grizzmon Leaders, and bring me <Grizzmon Claws> as evidence.
There is no way that the perfect reasoning of this Master Investigator can crumble like this. (Hmm... This SuperStarmon just doesn't come off as reliable...)
_1820.CompletionText:
First, slay Grizzmons and Grizzmon Leaders, and bring me <Grizzmon Claws> as evidence.
There is no way that the perfect reasoning of this Master Investigator can crumble like this.
_1820.CompletionSummary:
My perfect reasoning cannot crumble like this! This is not over!
You just wait and see, Grizzmons…

_1821.Title: Digimon Maze 2F
_1821.Description:
As the name suggests, Seadramons are dragons of the sea. <Sea + Dragon>.
Hmm…
We will need to gather more <Ancient Artifact Map> fragments, from <Seadramons> in the area.
Having all the pieces may help us gain further clues to <Anubimon Ancient Artifacts> on <Digimon Maze 2F>, you see.
Huh? My explanation is too difficult to understand? Let me summarize it for you: Defeat <Seadramons> and bring me the <Ancient Artifact Map>.
_1821.CompletionText:
As the name suggests, Seadramons are dragons of the sea. <Sea + Dragon>.
We will need to gather more <Ancient Artifact Map> fragments, from <Seadramons> in the area.
Defeat <Seadramons> and bring me the <Ancient Artifact Map>.
_1821.CompletionSummary:
There's nothing more we can learn from the Artifact Map. The content of this Map is identical to that of the previous one.
We will have to try to collect them again tomorrow…

_1822.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1822.Description:
Finally, we are on the third floor of the Digimon Maze. As with the first and the second floor, topographical research is a must.
On the first and the second floor, you will have encountered rather weak digimons. Of course, you may have found them challenging to deal with.
Whereas we encountered Rookie digimons on the first floor, we encountered Champions on the second floor, and we will probably encounter Ultimates on the third.
Be careful when you fight them... Now, let's scout out this place first, shall we?
We need to lay the foundation of our investigation first. A Maze is... well... complex.
Oh, yeah! Take this 3F Search Order to the Scout Leomon. It contains search-related information.
_1822.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver Search Order%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with ScoutLeomon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Area: One Step at a Time%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1822.CompletionText:
Whereas we encountered Rookie digimons on the first floor, we encountered Champions on the second floor, and we will probably encounter Ultimates on the third.
Oh, yeah! Take this 3F Search Order to the ScoutLeomon. It contains search-related informatio
_1822.CompletionSummary: Hmm… Searching the third floor, huh?

_1823.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1823.Description:
Ah, thank you for coming all this way.
As you know, we are encountering Rookie digimons on the first floor, Champion digimons on the second, and Ultimate digimons on the third.
There are lots of Ultimate digimons on the third floor. We will need to examine Pumpkinmons first.
Take this Mini Device and examine a few Pumpkinmons. Then, hunt some of them and bring me a few Pumpkinmon's Pumpkins to me.
This is a necessary step to investigate the third floor. I need you to do this without fail.
_1823.CompletionText: You don't have all of them yet, do you? Go on and examine those Pumpkinmons. We will need more Pumpkinmon's Pumpkins than one might expect.
_1823.CompletionSummary:
Thanks for your help. It's not easy collecting Pumpkinmon's Pumpkins, huh?
Anyway, this is a big help to my investigation of the area. And you did a fabulous job with the Mini Device, too.

_1824.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1824.Description:
You've done quite well thus far, but I will explain to you once again how to use the Mini Device.
To use the Mini Device, click the enemy to examine, and right-click the Device.
I'm sure you know all of this already. After all, you've made it to the third floor. But this is just in case.
Use this Mini Device and examine Meteormons in the area.
Meteormons on the third floor are the Ultimate form of the Gotsumons on the first floor and the Icemons on the second.
They look rather similar at the first glance, but they are quite different in color and material.
I must be boring you with all this detail.
Go and examine Meteormons, hunt them, and bring me Meteormon's Ore.
Ah, yes! Before I forget... Bring me more Pumpkinmon's Axes. I need them for our investigation.
When you are done, go and speak with Chief Leomon. He was looking for you.
_1824.CompletionText:
Go and examine Meteormons, hunt them, and bring me Meteormon's Ore.
Ah, yes! Before I forget... Bring me more Pumpkinmon's Axes. I need them for our investigation.
When you are done, go and speak with Chief Leomon. He was looking for you.
_1824.CompletionSummary:
Ah, yes. You've met with the scout on the fourth floor, have you?
I see… With this search, we were able to gather lots of information. You are always so helpful.

_1825.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1825.Description:
That takes care of the preliminary search. Take this report to Starmon.
It's a report on the preliminary search of the third floor. Be sure Starmon gets it.
I need Starmon to run some precise analysis. Let's hope for the best.
_1825.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: One Step at a Time%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Starmon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Deliver Report%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1825.CompletionText: Hurry and take this document to Starmon.
_1825.CompletionSummary:
I see you have delivered <3F Report> safely to Starmon. He is pretty smart, that Starmon…
Anyway, with this analysis, we have learned much.
Just like the second floor, we need certain Fragments and Crystals to get through the third floor on to the next.

_1826.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1826.Description:
I see you have delivered <3F Report> safely to Starmon. He is pretty smart, that Starmon…
Anyway, with this analysis, we have learned much.
Just like the second floor, we need certain Fragments and Crystals to get through the third floor on to the next.
Your priority is to obtain Mini Tower Fragments Nu, Xi, and Omicron.
These are Mini Tower Fragments composed of an ancient language.
You should be able to find Mini Tower Fragment Nu on Pumpkinmons, Mini Tower Fragment Xi on Meteormons, and Mini Tower Fragment Omicron on Infermons (Hell).
Hurry and bring me the Fragments.
_1826.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mini Tower Fragment Nu%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Mini Tower Fragment Xi%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Omicron%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1826.CompletionText:
As you know already, Starmon said that we need Mini Tower Fragments before we can exit this floor.
You should be able to find Mini Tower Fragment Nu on Pumpkinmons, Mini Tower Fragment Xi on Meteormons, and Mini Tower Fragment Omicron on Infermons (Hell)
_1826.CompletionSummary:
You have the Mini Tower Fragments Nu, Xi, and Omicron.
Now, let me explain to you about one of the materials we need to get through here - the Diamond Crystal.

_1827.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1827.Description:
You have the Mini Tower Fragments Nu, Xi, and Omicron.
Now, let me explain to you about one of the materials we need to get through here - the Diamond Crystal.
From what Starmon said, we need 2 of the key material, the Diamond Crystals, to get through this floor.
We needed only 1 crystal on the second floor, but, apparently, the third floor requires more.
I hear they are very difficult to come by. I'm not sure if you will be able to manage finding 2 of them. But, then, you, of all people, just might pull it off.
I hear you can find it on Infermons (Hell). Go on, then, and good luck. I wonder which ones from the throng could possibly be carrying the crystals.
_1827.CompletionText:
we need 2 of the key material, the Diamond Crystals, to get through this floor.
I hear you can find it on Infermons (Hell). Go on, then, and good luck. I wonder which ones from the throng could possibly be carrying the crystals.
_1827.CompletionSummary:
We now have all the material we need to pass through the area. Take these and speak with Starmon.
We can exit this floor anytime, now. Again, speak with Starmon.

_1828.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1828.Description:
Hey, come here! You there! Yeah, you!
What a pleasant surprise to run into you in this desolate place! Hahaha! You see that Mini Tower behind me?
It's been a long time, but that's a place of many memories for me with a certain Nanomon I used to see. Ahem... That's not what's important, though. Huh? You want to know more about the Nanomon? Maybe I'll tell you later...
Anyway, if I were to summarize into one sentence what I want to tell you, it would be: Search here!
I need you to investigate this area for me. I suppose I, the coolest and most awesome digimon, could do it.
But these menial tasks are for lackeys, y'know? Investigate the area and defeat some JewelBeemons. They are just pesky like there's no tomorrow.
Hmm? My instructions were too long, so you don't really understand what I want you to do? Well, let me summarize it for you:
Search the area, examine JewelBeemons, and defeat some of them.
_1828.CompletionText:
Investigate the Ruined Mini Tower area.
Examine JewelBeemons with the Search Device, and slay some of them.
_1828.CompletionSummary:
Yes, well done. As expected of my lackey, you have completed a simple search.
What? You want me to tell you about my past with the Nanomon? I said I would tell you later.
Anyway, I'll tell you what you need to do one at a time.

_1829.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1829.Description:
Yes, well done. As expected of my lackey, you have completed a simple search.
What? You want me to tell you about my past with the Nanomon? I said I would tell you later.
Anyway, I'll tell you what you need to do one at a time.
Huh? JewelBeemons put up a harsh fight during your hunt?
Those cursed bugs have the same spirit as JewelBeemons below... That really ticks me off...
That's enough! Slay some JewelBeemon leaders, and tear out the Silk Wings from their backs.
This is an order! Double-time! Git 'r dun!
_1829.CompletionText:
I HATE bugs. I hate those digimons that look like grasshoppers. I hate the way they look at me.
Hurry! Slay JewelBeemon Leaders, and tear the Silk Wings off of their backs.
This is an order! Double-time! Git 'r dun!
_1829.CompletionSummary:
Why are there so many idiots around here who think they are so important?
They all think they are the most important thing in the world. Fine. I will wipe them all out and prove to them that I am the most important one.

_1830.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1830.Description:
Why are there so many idiots around here who think they are so important?
They all think they are the most important thing in the world. Fine. I will wipe them all out and prove to them that I am the most important one.
I hear Andromons are very smart. Defeat them and bring me their Digital Brain.
I remember the Nanomon that I used to see... She thought of herself oh-so-highly with that brain of hers.
Those idiots with Digital Brains must be purged. Go take care of it! Make me the most important one of all! Hahaha!
Oh, yeah. I almost forgot. Let me give you this Search Device. Be sure to use it on Andromon Leaders!
_1830.CompletionText:
Those idiots with Digital Brains must be purged. Go take care of it! Make me the most important one of all!
Oh, yeah. I almost forgot. Let me give you this Search Device. Be sure to use it on Andromon Leaders!
_1830.CompletionSummary:
Ah, the Digital Brains. This takes care of them for now.
See? I'm the most important one around here! Ta-da!

_1831.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1831.Description:
Ah! Digital Brains… That settles that problem for now…
So! Guess what I hate the most.
As you know already, I hate, hate, HATE insects!!! Earlier I looked around a bit, and I saw what looked like spiders.
It gives me the creeps! Slay Infermons and bring me their data.
You are my lackey, and the only response you need to give me is "Yes, sir!"
That way, I won't hate you. If not, I'm gonna start hating you, and you won't like it. Go on!
_1831.CompletionText:
Slay Infermons and bring me their data.
You are my lackey, and the only response you need to give me is "Yes, sir!"
That way, I won't hate you. If not, I'm gonna start hating you, and you won't like it. Go on!
_1831.CompletionSummary:
Hahaha! You've finished the job! Good job! This must really suit your personality.
Hmm? You think I seem rather smart? Hahaha! You've noticed that, have you?

_1832.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1832.Description:
Hmm? You think I seem rather smart? Hahaha! You've noticed that, have you?
Now, there is one other digimon around here whose intelligence, I admit, is rather high.
As you may have guessed, it's Starmon. I hate to admit it, but he is smart in a subtle way.
We need his help again, and I need you to deliver this document to him.
Find Starmon in the area and give this document to him.
Make sure he gets it, and then report back to me.
_1832.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Ruined Mini Tower%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Starmon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Deliver Etemon's Document%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1832.CompletionText:
We need his help again, and I need you to deliver this document to him.
Find Starmon in the area and give this document to him.
Make sure he gets it, and then report back to me.
_1832.CompletionSummary:
You are back.
And you gain lots of information from Starmon, too.
Hmm… Yes, I see…
Now, let me tell you step-by-step what it is you need to do for me.

_1833.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1833.Description:
Now, let me tell you step-by-step what it is you need to do for me.
To pass through the area blocked off by the Invisible Wall, we need - as expected - Mini Tower Fragments. So says Starmon's note.
First, we need Mini Tower Fragments Pi, Rho, and Sigma.
Hmm? What are Pi, Rho, and Sigma, you ask? I don't know the details, either. My guess is as good as yours.
Anyway! Go on and bring me the Mini Tower Fragments.
You should be able to find Mini Tower Fragment Pi on JewelBeemons, Mini Tower Fragment Rho on Andromons, and Mini Tower Fragment Sigma on Infermons (Destroyer).
Chances of finding them are slim, but you will eventually get them.
_1833.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mini Tower Fragment Pi%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Mini Tower Fragment Rho%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Sigma%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1833.CompletionText:
You should be able to find Mini Tower Fragment Pi on JewelBeemons, Mini Tower Fragment Rho on Andromons, and Mini Tower Fragment Sigma on Infermons (Destroyer).
Chances of finding them are slim, but you will eventually get them.
_1833.CompletionSummary:
Now, we should be able to exit this place. Before we do that, though, I will ask a favor of you.
It is…rather personal.

_1834.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1834.Description:
Now, we should be able to exit this place. Before we do that, though, I will ask a favor of you.
It is…rather personal.
I want you to take JewelBeemons' spears and pierce the belly of Andromon Leaders.
Huh? It's cruel, you say? Hahaha! You haven't seen anything yet.
Anyway, I'd like you to help me with my hobby.
_1834.CompletionSummary: I'm cruel, you say? Hahaha! That was nothing!

_1835.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1835.Description:
I'm cruel, you say? Hahaha! That was nothing! Anyway, moving on…
Now, we should get that final material Starmon mentioned. That way, we'll be able to exit this place.
He said we needed 2 Emerald Crystals.
According to him, we should be able to find Emerald Crystals on Infermons (Destroyer). Very few of them carry it, he said.
Shall we begin our hunt?
_1835.CompletionText:
To pass through this area,
we need to get 2 Emerald Crystals from Infermons (Destroyer), Starmon said.
Go git 'r dun!
_1835.CompletionSummary:
Done!
Now, we can pass through here freely. See ya later!!!
You can go to Starmon, now.

_1836.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1836.Description:
Oh, hey, it's you again. We just keep running into each other, don't we?
Huh? You saw whom? I'm not sure whom you're talking about.
What? I don't understand what you're talking about… Anyway, my suspect should be somewhere in the area.
Area search is a master investigator's foundation! How many times do I need to tell you this?
Go on. Ask Starmon.
_1836.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Digimon Maze of Death%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Starmon%qe %cc2 /%mc2
_1836.CompletionText:
What? Are you being suspicious of me right now? (I'm not sure what he's talking about, but he seems to be acting. Poorly, at that.)
What are you talking about? Hurry over to Starmon and tell him what's going on.
_1836.CompletionSummary:
Well done.
No matter what happens, searching the area is the very foundation of becoming a master investigator.

_1837.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1837.Description:
Well done.
No matter what happens, searching the area is the very foundation of becoming a master investigator.
By the way… err… have you looked around? It's rather creepy here.
It makes me feel like I'm facing an unknowable foe. This has got to be a conspiracy. This is not fair!!!
Here. Take this Search Device, and examine those ghostly-looking things nearby.
What was their name again? Phan... phan... something or other. (He must be talking about Phantomons.)
I, the Master Investigator, am a very busy person!
_1837.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Digimon Maze of Death%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Use Search Device%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Phantomon%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1837.CompletionText:
Stop bothering me, and begin the search.
Examine those… Phan… Phan… something or other. (He must be talking about Phantomons.)
_1837.CompletionSummary:
Pha… Phantomons, are they?
Any… way… Thanks for a job well done.

_1838.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1838.Description:
What do you make of your life? Do you believe that you have lived a worthy life so far? (Here he goes again…)
Life… It is what people live. It refers to both the person and the way he lives…
Now, how will you live your life? Huh? You don't understand what I'm talking about?
Look, don't interrupt me while I'm talking. It will be all to your benefit.
What? What about my attitude? You don't like it, do ya? *snickers*
Hmph! No matter. I will give you a task. This may teach you a thing or two about life.
Go and defeat MegaDramons and their Leaders.
Go on, you un-enlightened worm. (*sigh* What the heck was he going on about? Anyway, I should just finish my task and leave this place.)
_1838.CompletionText:
I will give you a task. This may teach you a thing or two about life.
Go and defeat MegaDramons and their Leaders.
_1838.CompletionSummary:
What is that mysterious look you have going on there on your face? Is that a look of unquestioning trust in me? *snickers*
Anyway, it's fun playing here. You may not know anything about life, but I do, you see. (Hmm… I'll need to choose wisely here…)

_1839.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1839.Description:
What is that mysterious look you have going on there on your face? Is that a look of unquestioning trust in me? *snickers*
Anyway, it's fun playing here. Hey, look, kid. I need you to do something for me.
Those digimons from earlier… What are their names again? Pha... Right! Phantomon!
I like their necklace. The bead has beautiful and shiny frosting on it! I want it!
I want you to bring some to me. They will be core items in my investigation. (Core item my bottom... He probably wants it for his greed's sake.)
_1839.CompletionText: Just go and do it. Bring me Phantomon's Necklaces!
_1839.CompletionSummary:
Ah, yes! They are really pretty! Ahem…
This is strictly for my investigation and has nothing to do my personal greed.

_1840.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1840.Description:
You, there! All this investigation takes a lot of mental energy.
Have you heard of Nail Art before? It is my hobby to collect nails. Hmm? Strange, you say? What's so strange about it? Hahaha!
It's very popular among women in the human world.
Just as you collected Grizzmon Claws on the second floor, I want you to collect the Machine Claws from those MegaDramons over there.
And, while you're at it, I want you to bring me some Phantomon's Scythes, too. This is the least you can do for me, don't you think?
_1840.CompletionText:
I want you to collect the Machine Claws from MegaDramons.
And, while you're at it, I want you to bring me some Phantomon's Scythes.
_1840.CompletionSummary:
Hahaha! You have the Machine Claws and the Scythes!
Very well done. Just remember that this is all for the sake of the investigation.

_1841.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1841.Description:
Hey, listen…
I came across some questions during my investigation. I wrote them all down in this document…
I want you to take it to Starmon… I know you helped me out on the second floor…
But I need your help again. Take this to Starmon, would you?
_1841.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Area: Digimon Maze of Death%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Speak with Starmon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Deliver SuperStarmon's Document%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1841.CompletionText: Go do it. It's not that difficult of a task.
_1841.CompletionSummary:
As always, speaking with him is beneficial.
Thanks for the footwork.

_1842.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1842.Description:
According to Starmon, in order for us to exit this floor,
we need Mini Tower Fragments, as expected.
You should be able to find Mini Tower Fragment Tau from Phantomons, Mini Tower Fragment Upsilon from MegaDramons, and Mini Tower Fragment Phi from Infermons (Cocoon).
So says Starmon's note.
Go and find those Fragments. My intuition as the Master Investigator says that they won't be easy to come by.
_1842.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mini Tower Fragment Tau%qe %cc1 /%mc1 %qs2Mini Tower Fragment Upsilon%qe %cc2 /%mc2 %qs3Mini Tower Fragment Phi%qe %cc3 /%mc3
_1842.CompletionText:
The structure of this place is quite annoying.
You should be able to find Mini Tower Fragment Tau from Phantomons, Mini Tower Fragment Upsilon from MegaDramons, and Mini Tower Fragment Phi from Infermons (Cocoon).
So says Starmon's note.
_1842.CompletionSummary:
Hard to find those Mini Tower Fragments, huh?
We should be able to exit this floor soon. If Starmon is right, of course…
Now, bring me the final material, the Pearl Crystal. Apparently, we need 2 of them.

_1843.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1843.Description:
Hard to find those Mini Tower Fragments, huh?
We should be able to exit this floor soon. If Starmon is right, of course…
Now, bring me the final material, the Pearl Crystal. Apparently, we need 2 of them.
Starmon's note says that you should be able to find some as you go through numerous Infermons (Cocoon).
Even I, the Master Investigator, won't be able to tell you which ones might carry Pearl Crystals. It will be a difficult hunt.
Go on, then. Find 2 Pearl Crystals on Infermons (Cocoon).
_1843.CompletionText:
Starmon's note says that you should be able to find some as you go through numerous Infermons (Cocoon).
Go do it. Find 2 Pearl Crystals from Infermons (Cocoon).
_1843.CompletionSummary:
There! 'Tis done! This is all thanks to the incredible deduction of moi - the Master Investigator!
From now on, we can pass through this area freely.
Go on to the next area, then.

_1844.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1844.Description:
Ah, we have finally arrived at the end of the third floor.
Now, we will need the Final Artifact Map to find a clue.
See those MegaSeadramons over there? You should be able to find fragments of the Artifact Map.
We need a lot of fragments - more than you might expect. And I need you to collect them all. I know it's a huge task, and I'm sorry to be asking you this.
But these are essential pieces if we are to get up to the upper level.
So, collect the Final Artifact Map from MegaSeadramons.
_1844.CompletionText:
We need a lot of fragments - more than you might expect. And I need you to collect them all. I know it's a huge task, and I'm sorry to be asking you this.
So, collect the Final Artifact Map from MegaSeadramons.
_1844.CompletionSummary: Ah… You have the Final Artifact Map fragments. Now, let's translate the map!

_1845.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1845.Description:
Thank you for finding the Final Artifact Map for me…
I've translated the Artifact Map. According to it, we need to find the 4 hidden treasures of Anubis on the third floor.
This map contains some very valuable information.
The 4 treasures on the second floor was of the Silver series.
It seems that the 4 hidden treasures on the third floor is of the Gold series.
First, find the first treasure, Anubis Gold Bracelet, on Infermons (Inferno).
I don't need to explain to you where to find Infermons (Inferno), do I? They are in this area.
Go on and bring me 2 Anubis Gold Bracelets off of Infermons (Inferno).
They will be harder to come by than you might think. Once you have them, I'll tell you what to do next.
_1845.CompletionText:
Go on and bring me 2 Anubis Gold Bracelets off of Infermons (Inferno).
They will be harder to come by than you might think. Once you have them, I'll tell you what to do next.
_1845.CompletionSummary:
Well done bringing me those Gold bracelets.
1 down, 3 more to go.

_1846.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1846.Description:
Well done bringing me those Gold bracelets.
1 down 3 more to go.
Now that we have the bracelets, we need to find the Armband, Necklace, and Shoes.
You understand that the items we need for the third floor are of the Gold series, right?
According to the Artifact Map, Anubis Gold Armband is carried by Infermons (Cocoon).
Go on and bring me the Anubis Gold Armband. Somebody has to be carrying it among the Infermons.
_1846.CompletionText:
Infermons have the treasure data for the third floor.
According to the Artifact Map, Anubis Gold Armband is carried by Infermons (Cocoon).
Go on and bring me the Anubis Gold Armband. Somebody has to be carrying it among the Infermons.
_1846.CompletionSummary:
Now, we have 2 of the Gold artifacts - the Gold Bracelets and the Gold Armband.
We have 2 more to go. We need the Necklace and the Shoes.

_1847.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1847.Description:
Thanks for all the work you put into securing the Gold Armband.
2 down and 2 to go.
We now have the Necklace and the Shoes left.
You do know that you need the Gold artifacts on the third floor, don't you?
According to the Artifact Map, Anubis Gold Necklace is carried by Infermons (Destroyer).
Go on and bring me the Anubis Gold Necklace. Somebody has to be carrying it among the Infermons.
_1847.CompletionText:
We now have the Necklace and the Shoes left.
According to the Artifact Map, Anubis Gold Necklace is carried by Infermons (Destroyer).
Go on and bring me the Anubis Gold Necklace. Somebody has to be carrying it among the Infermons.
_1847.CompletionSummary:
Now, we have 2 of the Gold artifacts - the Gold Bracelets, Armband, and Necklace.
We have 1 more to go. We need the Shoes.

_1848.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1848.Description:
Thanks for all the work you put into securing the Gold Necklace.
That's three: Gold Bracelet, Armband, and Necklace...
We only have the Anubis Gold Shoes left.
You should be able to find the Gold Shoes on the Infermons (Hell) that you saw when you first entered the third floor.
It will be a long fight. Be careful out there.
Now, bring me the final ancient artifact, the Gold Shoes.
This is the last artifact! You can do it!
_1848.CompletionText:
We now have the Necklace and the Shoes left.
According to the Artifact Map, Anubis Gold Shoes is carried by Infermons (Hell).
Go on and bring me the Anubis Gold Shoes. Somebody has to be carrying it among the Infermons.
_1848.CompletionSummary:
Finally! We have all 4!
Now, we can go ahead and take the next step!

_1849.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1849.Description:
<Anubis Gold Bracelet>, <Anubis Gold Armband>, <Anubis Gold Necklace>, and <Anubis Gold Shoes>.
Now, we have all 4 of the ancient treasures. What will happen now?
Probably the same thing that happened on the first and the second floors.
The 4 treasures came together and formed the <Gold Anubimon Statue>.
Hmm...
I will give you this <Gold Anubimon Statue>. Try using it over at <Anubimon's Final Memories> here on the third floor.
You should be able to find a clue to get to the next region.
Something might pop out at you like it happened on the first and the second floors, so be careful out there.
_1849.CompletionText:
I will give you this <Gold Anubimon Statue>. Try using it over at <Anubimon's Final Memories> here on the third floor.
Be careful out there.
_1849.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… Anubimon has appeared. I suppose my work here is done now.
Go and speak with Anubimon, and he'll send you to the next floor. Keep up the good work!

_1850.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1850.Summary: What Is This Next to Me?
_1850.Description:
Ah, it is you. I am not certain what these things are next to me… Suddenly, I find myself between these machines guarding me.
Let me first tell you what you need to do here. Please, slay some <MegaSeadramons>, and bring me some <MegaSeadramon's Horns>.
I will explain everything to… you… la…ter…
_1850.Objective: What Is This Next to Me?
_1850.CompletionText:
Suddenly, I find myself between these machines guarding me.
Let me first tell you what you need to do here. Please, slay some <MegaSeadramons>, and bring me some <MegaSeadramon's Horns>.

_1851.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1851.Description:
Do me one last favor, and I will grant you passage to 4F.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
In the first place, the Maze was mine to protect. My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place. However, Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away. Since then, the safety of this place has been compromised.
This is my final favor that I will ask of you. Please tell Starmon what just happened.
I will soon grant you passage to Digimon Maze 4F. Thank you.
_1851.CompletionText:
Ah… It is you.
This is my final favor that I will ask of you. Please tell Starmon what just happened.
I will soon grant you passage to Digimon Maze 4F. Thank you.
_1851.CompletionSummary:
Thank you.
If we restore the Maze to its original condition, I will be able to recover my body as well.
Please remember that recovering my body is the only way for us to stop hm.
Let me grant you passage to Digimon Maze 4F.

_1852.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1852.Description:
I need your help. I need more Pumpkinmon's Pumpkins.
Hunt some Pumpkinmons and their Leaders in the area, and gather some Pumpkinmon's Pumpkin.
This is a very simple yet difficult assignment. I desperately need your help.
_1852.CompletionText:
This assignment is simple.
Hunt some Pumpkinmons and their Leaders in the area, and gather some Pumpkinmon's Pumpkin.
_1852.CompletionSummary: Oh, thank you. I will call you again when the time comes. This will do for today.

_1853.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1853.Description:
I need your help. I need more of Meteormon's Ore.
Hunt some Meteormons and their Leaders in the area, and gather some Meteormon's Ore.
This is a very simple yet difficult assignment. I desperately need your help.
_1853.CompletionText:
This assignment won't be easy.
Hunt some Meteormons and their Leaders in the area, and gather some Meteormon's Ore.
_1853.CompletionSummary: Oh, thank you. I will call you again when the time comes. This will do for today.

_1854.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1854.Description:
Bah! Those JewelBeemons really get on my nerves!
And those grasshopper masks they wear! As I said before, the likes of them must not be allowed in my presence. I totally detest them.
Go. Slay JewelBeemons and their Leaders, and rip the Silk Wings off of their backs.
Such beautiful things must not be on such ugly beasts.
_1854.CompletionText:
Slay JewelBeemons and their Leaders, and rip the Silk Wings off of their backs.
Such beautiful things must not be on such ugly beasts.
_1854.CompletionSummary:
Very good! This is very satisfying.
That's it for today. I will call on you again tomorrow.

_1855.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1855.Description:
Andromons…
You know… The ones that looks half-human and half-robot. Ring a bell?
Andromons have Digital Brains.
Remember what I told you before? Anyone smarter than me must be eliminated.
… although… I doubt there are people with digital brains in the human world.
I want you to eliminate them, so I can be the smartest one in the Digimon World.
Go on, then. Bring me their Digital Brains. It goes without saying that this is an order, not a request.
_1855.CompletionText:
Slay Andromons and their Leaders, and bring me Andromon's Digital Brains.
It goes without saying that this is an order, not a request.
_1855.CompletionSummary:
There! That takes care of it for today. Bring me Digital Brains again tomorrow.
Dismissed!

_1856.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1856.Description:
Umm… You know… Remember that thing from before…?
You know… The necklaces with the fantastic glitter. The ones carried by Phantomons…
They were really pretty, you know! Ahem… Would you bring me a few more?
This is strictly for my investigation and has nothing to do my personal greed.
I would like you to bring me some. How about it? Easy job, huh?
_1856.CompletionText: Go and bring me those beautiful necklaces from Phantomons.
_1856.CompletionSummary:
Hmm… This is it, huh? I want to get a few more, but I will just have to wait.
Until tomorrow, then. Well done.

_1857.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1857.Description:
Remember my hobby I told you about before?
You do? Then, get a move on! Bring me some MegaDramon's Machine Claws.
You should be able to find them on MegaDramons or their Leaders.
What? Are you still here? Get a move on! This process is critically important for the investigation!
_1857.CompletionText:
Go on.
