You just need to bring me MegaDramon's Machine Claws from MegaDramons or their Leaders.
_1857.CompletionSummary:
Wow. That's a lot more than I had expected.
This will do for today. Let's do it again tomorrow.

_1858.Title: Digimon Maze 3F
_1858.Description:
Collect the Final Artifact Map from MegaSeadramons, would you? I just might be able to find some other clues in it. I know it's a difficult task, but I need your help.
You should be able to find the Final Artifact Map as you defeat MegaSeadramons and their Leaders.
_1858.CompletionText:
Collect the Final Artifact Map from MegaSeadramons, would you? I just might be able to find some other clues in it. I know it's a difficult task, but I need your help.
You should be able to find the Final Artifact Map as you defeat MegaSeadramons and the
_1858.CompletionSummary:
Well done! You have the Artifact Map.
Unfortunately, today's Artifact Map didn't reveal any new clues. Let's do this again tomorrow…
Thanks for a good day of work.

_1859.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1859.Description:
* huff huff* Finally… after all that trouble, we've made it to the fourth and the final floor.
I can't believe it was Digimon Kaiser that we've been chasing after all this time… I will show him no mercy!
To think of all those who were sacrificed because of him... Grrrr! Tamer, I'm counting on you. I know you can do it.
First, please tell Chief Leomon what is going on.
_1859.CompletionText:
I can't believe it was Digimon Kaiser that we've been chasing after all this time… I will show him no mercy!
To think of all those who were sacrificed because of him... Grrrr!
First, please tell Chief Leomon what is going on.
_1859.CompletionSummary:
All gathered here today are counting on you, tamer!
Now that we have spoken to the scout, we will begin our talk with Etemon.

_1860.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1860.Description:
Yeah, baby! I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
What? That's Digimon Kaiser? And you've been chasing after him all along? Well… It really has nothing to do with me, but...
You work for me, Etemon the Great, "The Most Powerful Digimon in Existence" and the "King of Digimons".
Go and get Kaiser. Make a bun out of him.
You just need to follow after me! But once we are there, you're pretty much on your own. Hahaha!
Now, go and speak with Chief Leomon.
_1860.CompletionText:
Go and get Kaiser. Make a bun out of him.
You just need to follow after me! But once we are there, you're pretty much on your own. Ha!
Now, go and speak with Chief Leomon.
_1860.CompletionSummary:
So, you have spoken to Chief Leomon. Let's talk with all digimons in this area.
This time, have a chat with SuperStarmon.

_1861.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1861.Description:
See? I knew it! I just knew it! Digimon Kaiser was the culprit!
My deduction was 100% right! So accurate that it gives me the chill!
Now that I have successfully found out the culprits with my fantastically brilliant brain, I will give you the honor of wrapping this up.
See how generous I am?
Chief Leomon is looking for you, so go on.
_1861.CompletionText:
Now that I have successfully found out the culprits with my fantastically brilliant brain, I will give you the honor of wrapping this up.
Chief Leomon is looking for you, so go on.
_1861.CompletionSummary:
So, you have spoken to Chief Leomon. Let's talk with all digimons in this area.
Next on the line is Starmon!

_1862.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1862.Description:
Ah, finally, we are at the end of the Digimon Maze.
We have solved many challenging puzzles, and finally came to where we are today. A lot has happened since we first began.
It seems that my role here is done. The rest is up to you.
I'm sure Chief Leomon has something to say to you.
_1862.CompletionText:
We have solved many challenging puzzles, and finally came to where we are today. A lot has happened since we first began.
I'm sure Chief Leomon has something to say to you.
_1862.CompletionSummary:
Great. You've spoken with everyone.
Now, go and put an end to this miserable story with Digimon Kaiser!

_1863.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1863.Description:
*snickers* At last, you are here. Welcome. Shall we begin this party? *snickers*
Let me get right to the point. Let's see if you can endure my first trial. Mwahahahahaha!
To endure this trial, you need this wonderful virtue called patience.
_1863.CompletionText:
*snickers* At last, you are here. Welcome. Shall we begin this party? *snickers*
Let me get right to the point. Let's see if you can endure my first trial. Mwahahahahaha!

_1864.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1864.Description:
Grrrr! You are not too bad, kid.
But there is another trial. Mwahaha! Let's see if you can handle the second trial! Mwahahahahahaha!
To endure this trial, you need this wonderful virtue called patience.
_1864.CompletionText:
Grrrr! You are not too bad, kid.
But there is another trial. Mwahaha! Let's see if you can handle the second trial! Mwahahahahahaha!

_1865.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1865.Description:
You…! You!!!! This is unacceptable!
I, the Digimon Kaiser, shall bestow upon you the final trial.
This is not the sort of trial that an inferior being like you can endure. Mwahahaha!
I will make you cry in fear of me all the days of the rest of your life! Mwahahahahaha!
I assure you! You will NOT be able to triumph in Kaiser's final trial!
To endure this trial, you need this wonderful virtue called patience.
_1865.CompletionText:
This is not the sort of trial that an inferior being like you can endure. Mwaha!
I will make you cry in fear of me all the days of the rest of your life! Mwahaha!
I assure you! You will NOT be able to triumph in Kaiser's final trial!
_1865.CompletionSummary:
Ugh…! What on earth…?
How can this be?! Everything was perfect!
This… this is a nightmare! What a terrible ending…
Now that it has come to this…, I will start everything all over again! Everything!! I will reset the Digital World.
I will… I will re

_1866.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1866.Description:
Digmons and humans should never have met in the first place.
But, I changed my mind after witnessing the love between that human from before and a digimon. (He seems to be talking about Keenan Krier and Yukidarumon.)
Right now, he doesn't understand what it is that he should truly hate...
SaberLeomon! Unless you change your mind, the world of digimons will have no future!
_1866.CompletionText:
Right now, he doesn't understand what it is that he should truly hate...
SaberLeomon! Unless he changes his mind, the world of digimons will have no future!
_1866.CompletionSummary: So… he is not willing to talk, is he?

_1867.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1867.Description:
What do you know, human? How dare you speak to me! I never speak with humans.
Every terrible thing that is happening in the Digital World is because of you humans.
You claim to protect the Digital World… Hrmph! What a joke!
Take this message to Mercurymon, too, that I will never ever listen to him!
_1867.CompletionText:
You claim to protect the Digital World… Hrmph! What a joke!
Take this message to Mercurymon, too, that I will never ever listen to you!
_1867.CompletionSummary:
For the peace of the Digital World, you humans must leave this place.
And that Mercurymon, too…

_1868.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1868.Description:
Once upon a time, the Primeval Digital Era comes to an end, and the Ancient Digital Era began. Yet, peace never came. Humanoid digimons and beast digimons began their fight.
The cause of this fight traces back to the Three Great Angels. Seraphimon and Ophanimon loved humanoid digimons.
However, Cherubimon, an angel digimon in the form of a beast, loved beast digimons. The will of the Three Great Angels was divided, and Cherubimon declared war on humanoid digimons. The war raged on.
Then, a digimon by the name of Lucemon suddenly appeared. He stopped the war and restored peace. But, before long, Lucemon became corrupt. He went into the Fallen Mode and began to threaten the entire Digital World, until the Ten Warriors appeared, sealed Lucemon, and disappeared leaving their spirits behind.
However, this was all in the past..
Still, Mercurymon and SaberLeomon open a new chapter, and a new story is about to begin. A new story of war between humanoid digimons and beast digimons.
_1868.CompletionText:
However, this was all in the past..
Still, Mercurymon and SaberLeomon open a new chapter, and a new story is about to begin. A new story of war between humanoid digimons and beast digimons.
_1868.CompletionSummary:
Do you think this story is over?
(Just then, my Digivice displayed a message: Play again?)

_1869.Title: Baihumon's Pleasant Worries Event
_1869.Description:
Welcome, human… perfect timing. Nothing serious, but… Even an Holy Beast like myself have concerns… I'm kind of ashamed to ask… but.. Umm… What should I eat today?
There are so many things to eat, and I just don't know what I should eat today!
_1869.CompletionText: There are so many things to eat, and I don't know what I should eat!
_1869.CompletionSummary: I'll show you the menu. Can you pick one for me?

_1870.Title: Baihumon's Pleasant Worries Event
_1870.Summary: Should I eat inferno fire noodle?
_1870.Description:
Inferno fire noodle? It has to be something spicy, right?
Go to the Silver Lake, defeat the Sabirdramon and bring me some bird meat!
I'll prepare extra spicy sauce in the meantime!
_1870.Objective: Go to the Silver Lake, defeat the Sabirdramon and obtain bird meat
_1870.CompletionText: Inferno fire noodle… I'm already drooling…
_1870.CompletionSummary:
Is that bird meat? Nice work! While you were out there collecting the ingredients, I've prepared the seasoning!
Wait for just a little! I'll cook it in no time!
It's all done~! Take a bite! It'll be really HOT! Hahaha!

_1871.Title: Baihumon's Pleasant Worries Event
_1871.Description:
Fish stew? I should eat fish stew so I can taste the ocean flavor, right?
Go to Minato City, defeat the Gesomon and bring me the legs of Gesomon!
I'll get ready to cook the stew in the meantime!
_1871.Objective: Go to Minato City, defeat the Gesomon and obtain legs of Gesomon
_1871.CompletionSummary:
Is that Gesomon's leg? Nice work! While you were out there collecting the ingredients, I got ready to cook the stew!
Wait for just a little! I'll cook it in no time!
It's all done~! Give it a try! You'll taste the deep ocean flavor! Hahaha!

_1942.Title: Digimon Maze 4F
_1942.Description:
First Story of Almighty Diablomon
He has no clue. What does he really hate...
As long as you don't change your mind SaberLeomon... There is no future in Digimon World!
What? Around here? Digimon which absorbs and destroys data on the network?
Um... Tamer!
I think you need to get rid of Diablomon who thinks almighty. Please.
_1942.CompletionText:

_1945.Title: <Jogress>
_1945.Description: You have to complete various missions to evolve into a Jogress. Culu! Some strange things are happening at Yokohama Village. We did some investigating, and it looks like Keramons are playing around at D-terminal-Dungeon-B2. Culu! Find the Keramon leader, and go to Yokohama Village and find Dr. Akihiro Kurata to check if the problem has been solved. Culu!
_1945.CompletionText: I think something is wrong at Yokohama Village. Culu!
_1945.CompletionSummary: Thank you, but I think there is still a problem. The phones are not working properly at the village. Could you check it for me?

_1946.Title: <Jogress>
_1946.Description: I found out why the phones are not working in the village. Culu! I think some of the Keramons stayed and escaped to the Maze. Culu! They have evolved into Infermons, so be careful, Culu! Go to Digimon Maze 3F and catch the Infermons (Inferno), Culu!
_1946.CompletionText: We have to solve it before something bigger happens, Culu!
_1946.CompletionSummary: It looks like the phones are working properly now, thanks to you, Culu! Why does something not feel right? I feel like we missed something. Culu…

_1947.Title: <Jogress>
_1947.Description: I checked and found that something big has happened, Culu!! Diablomon is trying to blow up the Real World. If the bomb goes off, the Real World could be in danger. Culu.. We can find Diablomon if we go to the Unlimited Ice Bow. The problem is, I don’t know who has the bomb. Find out who has the bomb, get it and bring it to me. Please solve the problem, Culu!!!
_1947.CompletionText: You are the only one who can solve this problem. Culu!
_1947.CompletionSummary: Whew, we almost had a huge problem at Real World, Culu… We just need to complete the final mission now. Remember, you have to have a tamer level of 70 or above to complete the last mission. Come back to see me when you reach level 70.

_1948.Title: <Jogress>
_1948.Description:
Now, let me tell you how to get new strength. Culu!!
It looks like some of the Keramons that caused a problem at Yokohama Village have been hiding and they have evolved strangely into Armagemons. Catch the Armagemons at Digital World with your fellow Digimons. Culu!! If you use this item at the Digimon Maze Entrance, you will be able to call the Armagemons. Culu!!
_1948.CompletionText: Hang in there. You might be able to get new strength. Culu!!
_1948.CompletionSummary: Now I will give you the strength of the royal knights that only the chosen can get, Culu! However, you have to have a heart of justice at all times as long as you are going to be the Royal Knights. The strength of Royal Knights is the strength of light,

_1949.Title: <Jogress>
_1949.Description: You have to complete various missions to evolve into a Jogress. Culu! First, solve the problem at Snowman Village, Culu! There is a problem right now at Snowman Village. Seadramons are tormenting the nice Digimons. Catch the Seadramon Leader, Culu!!
_1949.CompletionText: I think something is wrong at Yokohama Village. Culu!
_1949.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Snowman Village has become calmer now thanks to you. I think there is a problem at Yokohama Village, too… Culu.

_1950.CompletionText: We have to solve it before something bigger happens, Culu!

_1957.Description: Hmmm… why are the phones not working… Ask Donglemon at the Dats Center. Culuemon will know what the problem is.
_1957.CompletionText: Go to the Culumon at the Dats Center and find out how to solve the problem.
_1957.CompletionSummary: The phones are not working at Yokohama Village… Culu … This is terrible. Ah, we just got some news.

_1958.Title: Event
_1958.Description: Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon? Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Boar. The explanation above explains the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon. This month of [December] is the month of the <Ox /Vajramon >. If you handle the enemy digimons that are spread out all over the map for a month... you will get a <Crystalloid of Twelve Heavenly Generals>. If you collect all of them... You will reach your goal and good things will happen.
_1958.CompletionText: Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?
_1958.CompletionSummary: Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon?

_1959.Title: Event
_1959.Summary: The Great Twelve on the Move
_1959.Description: Have you heard of... the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon? Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Boar. The explanation above explains the Twelve Heavenly Generals of Digimon. This month of [December] is the month of the <Ox /Vajramon >. If you handle the enemy digimons that are spread out all over the map for a month... you will get a <Crystalloid of Twelve Heavenly Generals>. If you collect all of them... You will reach your goal and good things will happen.
_1959.Objective: The Great Twelve on the Move
_1959.CompletionText: The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated. Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.
_1959.CompletionSummary: The power of the <Great Twelve> will be activated. Now that you have gathered them all, something good will happen, not to mention the achievement of it all.

_1960.Title: Event
_1960.Description: With Pumpkin Bomb I give, hunt pumpkin monsters and collect 30 candies.
_1960.CompletionText: I don't have enough candies. Bring me more!
_1960.CompletionSummary: Here. I will give you this item as I promised.

_1961.Title: <Jogress Quest - Alphamon1>
_1961.Description:
You want to know about Project Ark culu?
Gallantmon, one of the Royal Knights would know for sure culu.
I think I saw Gallantmon somewhere up the hill, at Infinite Ice Wall. Go to Infinite Ice Wall and ask Gallantmon there culu culu!
_1961.Objective: Conversation with Gallantmon of the Infinite Ice Wall
_1961.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with Gallantmon in the Middle of the Infinite Ice Wall
_1961.CompletionSummary: It is the plan of Yggdrasil, huh…

_1962.Title: <Jogress Quest -Alphamon1>
_1962.Description: I will give you items if you bring me candies.
_1962.Objective: Get Rid of Arkadimon and Find Gallantmon's Records

_1963.Title: <Jogress Quest - Alphamon2>
_1963.Description: The X antibodies brought with them survival of the fittest among Digimons. I think Leomon, who failed the competition for survival, is around here. Help him.
_1963.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1%qe Speaking with X Antibodies Predator Leomon %cc1/%mc1

_1964.Title: <Jogress Quest - Alphamon2>
_1964.Description:
I seized all the X antibodies I could get to stay alive... To survive. Digimons' survival of the fittest? Huh... Is it too much to think that this might be part of Yggdrasil's plan?
Is it time for my X antibodies to become prey...?
I do not have much longer to live, but I am getting angry... I have no strength in my body...
_1964.CompletionText: We... Do not... Have... Much time left now...
_1964.CompletionSummary: You have done something useless. I do not have much time left now. Take this. These are my X antibodies. I do not need it anymore.............. You must ...... Survive....

_1965.Title: <Jogress Quest - Alphamon2>
_1965.Description:
Your hidden strength will have awakened with the X antibodies I gave you. I have hurt other Digimons and taken their X antibodies to stay alive, but I always thought about whether it was right.
Go! Go to the Culumon at the Dats Center and find your way. You have made me feel a little bit more comfortable...
... Thank you
_1965.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1%qe Speaking with Culumon at the Dats Center %cc1/%mc1
_1965.CompletionText: There is not much time left...
_1965.CompletionSummary: That happened to Leomon, I see...

_1966.Title: <Jogress Quest - Alphamon3>
_1966.Description: Death-X-DORUgoramons will appear through the Terminal Gate I provided. The Terminal Gate can be used in <Gloomy outer Area> of the North-western Outskirts Terminal GateA-Death X antibodies A Terminal GateB-Death X antibodies B Terminal GateC-Death X antibodies C Terminal GateD-Death X antibodies D You can buy Transfer Terminal Gate A from Death-X-DORUgoramon. By defeating it, you can obtain the Gate B and the Death X antibodies A for certain amounts of rate. If you couldn't receive the Death X antibodies A, you will again have to face the Death-X-DORUgoramon to receive it. After receive the Death X antibodies A, you will have chance to fight against the another Death-X-DORUgoramon from the Gate B and by defeating the monster from Gate B, you can obtain the Gate C and the Death X antibodies B for certain amounts of rate. This process continues until the Death X antibodies C and D which you will have to collect 4 different types of Death X antibodies A, B, C, D and bring it to me.
_1966.Objective: Collect Death X antibodies A, B, C, D
_1966.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Death X antibodies A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Death X antibodies B%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Death X antibodies C%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Death X antibodies D%qe %cc4/%mc4
_1966.CompletionText: Death-X-DORUgoramons are dangerous... They might destroy Digimon World... Get rid of the Death-X-DORUgoramons...
_1966.CompletionSummary: You have defeated the Death-X-DORUgoramons, Culu! Digimon World has been relieved for the moment from the danger of Death X evolution. Thanks, Culu!

_1967.Title: <Jogress Quest -Ouryuumon1>
_1967.Summary: The Legend of the Savior Dragon
_1967.Description:
Have you heard of the legend of the Dragon King, Culu?
It is a new legend on the dragon type Digimons that did not exist in the old Digital World... However, it is just a legend...
Legend has it that the Dragon King saves the world.. That is all I know. Ask the Culumon at the Snowman Village for more information, Culu.
_1967.Objective: Conversation with Culumon of the Snowman Village
_1967.ObjectiveProgress: Conversation with Culumon in front of the hill in the middle of Snowman Village
_1967.CompletionText: Is the Dragon King legend nothing more than a legend?
_1967.CompletionSummary: They are researching the Dragon King legend?

_1968.Title: <Jogress Quset - Ouryuumon1>
_1968.Summary: The Legend of the Dragon King.
_1968.Description:
You want to know more about the new dragon type Digimons, Culu?
The dragon of the legend is known to be awakened from a jewel called the Aqua Orb. However, I do not know the location of the jewel... I have to check the records on the Dragon King legend to find out the location of the Aqua Orb.
I have Detection Stone of Aqua Orb, but... Detection Stone must be used in the place written in the records, Culu!!
They say the records about the legend are in water that does not make things wet, Culu. However, I heard you can sometimes find it on the Seadramon that goes in and out of the water as it pleases.
Get rid of the Seadramon and find the records on the legend of the Dragon King, Culu!
_1968.Objective: Get rid of the Seadramon and look for records on the legend of the Dragon King.
_1968.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1 Records on the legend of the Dragon King%qe %cc1/%mc1
_1968.CompletionText: I can't get rid of the Seadramon because I am too weak... I could not read the records.
_1968.CompletionSummary: Wow!! These are the records. I will read it and tell you what it says. Wait, Culu!

_1969.Title: <Jogress Quest - Ouryuumon2>
_1969.Summary: The Legend became reality.. Aqua orb
_1969.Description:
Ah.. I see, Culu. The records show that it is a place close to hear, Culu, Culu.
It says the Aqua Orb is near the water, Culu! It says it is where the penguins are. Hmm... The penguins are to the northwest of here.
And if you find the <The Place Where the Aqua Orb Is at Rest>, use this Detection Stone. The Detection Stone the Aqua Orb will react and the power will transfer to you, Culu!
_1969.Objective: Find <The Place Where the Aqua Orb Is at Rest> near where the penguins are and use the Detection Stone.
_1969.ObjectiveProgress: Use the Detection Stone at the place where the Aqua Orb rests.
_1969.CompletionText: Have the powers of the Aqua Orb transferred to you?
_1969.CompletionSummary: You have found the Aqua Orb! I saw the powers of the Aqua Orb transfer to you with the light. The legend... Has become reality!!

_1970.Title: <Jogress Quest - Ouryuumon2>
_1970.Summary: Who will this sword fight for?
_1970.Description:
The legend of the Dragon King has become reality! But who should this sword be used for?
What is Yggdrasil's idea of justice, which is trying to use the X-program to purify Digimon World and open a new world?
Or Digimons that are trying to change Digicore themselves and survive?
I do not know the answer... What choice should be made at the Road of the Sword?... I do not know, so talk to Culumon at the Dats Center.
_1970.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1%qe Speaking with Calumon at the Dats %cc1/%mc1
_1970.CompletionText: Have you met Culumon at the Dats Center, Culu?
_1970.CompletionSummary: The road of the sword... I do not know... However, I have a favor. Solve the problem and think about it more.

_1971.Title: <Jogress Quest - Ouryuumon3>
_1971.Description:
You came, Culu! Death-X-DORUgoramons produced at oil refinery-3 are invading to eat all the remaining Digimons, Culu!!
Go to oil refinery-3 and get rid of the Death-X-DORUgoramons. Collect the 'Spoiled X antibodies' they ate and spoiled, too.
If the spoiled X antibodies are purified, it will be possible to hand out the X antibodies to more Digimons. And then, think about...the Road of the Sword.
_1971.CompletionText: Purify spoiled X antibodies so no more Digimons are attacked by the X-program.

_1972.Title: Alphamon Jogress Quest
_1972.Description: This interrupts the plan of Yggdrasil....
_1972.CompletionSummary: Stop the evolution of Death X!

_1973.Title: Alphamon Jogress Quest
_1973.Description: I do not know if the road you chose is the right one. The evolution of Death X is continuing to interrupt the plan of Yggdrasil. Combining strength with Alphamon... It is a relief for me.
_1973.CompletionSummary: Do you have your answer? I will not think too hard. Gallantmon and I are different. I hope you do not regret the road you chose...

_1974.Title: <Jogress Quest - Alphamon3>
_1974.Description: You have collected 4 types of Death X antibodies, Culu! It is almost over now, Culu. Talk to Omnimon and try to get new power! Save Digital World, Culu!!
_1974.CompletionSummary:
This is the last road to Jogress. Did you develop enough strength to get the power of Jogress?? Remember, you need to be at least tamer level 70 to complete the last mission..
If you have enough strength, talk to me.

_1975.Title: <Jogress Quest - Ouryumon3>
_1975.Description: You have defeated all the Death-X-DORUgoramons, Culu! It is almost over now, Culu. Talk to the Omnimon and try to get new strength! Save Digital World, Culu!!
_1975.CompletionSummary:
This is the last road to Jogress. Did you develop enough strength to get the power of Jogress?? Remember, you need to be at least tamer level 70 to complete the last mission..
If you have enough strength, talk to me.

_1985.Title: Silver Lake
_1985.Description: Welcome to the Digital World. I hope I didn't startle you. As for this place, you will gradually come to know this place piece by piece.
_1985.CompletionSummary: I'm excited for our adventures together in the Digital World!

_1986.Title: Silver Lake
_1986.Description: It looks like your friend is in danger! This place is not just full of cute and well-behaved Digimons like me. There are plenty of nasty and intimidating Digimons around here. We gotta be careful!
_1986.CompletionSummary: A Tsunomon? Hmm... Tsunomons are not aggressive. Maybe they were just playing? Anyway, your friend is safe now, thanks to my excellent hearing.

_1987.Title: Silver Lake
_1987.Description:
Want to know what this place is? Now that your friend, Izzy, is here, maybe I'll explain it again.
Like I said before, this is the Digital World. This is where Digimons like me live. You were sent here from your world by some strange force.
_1987.CompletionSummary: Frankly, I don't really know much more about that. We will find out bit by bit, so don't worry! I will help you.

_1988.Title: Silver Lake
_1988.Description:
I like flowers. That's why I like this forest. It feels kinda bad to pick them, but... whatever. Of course, I don't pick them to eat them.
Would you bring me some blossoms off of Upamons?

_1989.Title: Silver Lake
_1989.Description:
I would like to tell you more like this world, but I'm starving... Give me something to eat, would you?
I saw Tsunomons carrying something around.
_1989.CompletionText: Do you have any food yet?
_1989.CompletionSummary: *crunch crunch* Wow, this is good! You humans have such delicious things in your world.

_1990.Title: Silver Lake
_1990.Description:
I have a friend who likes flowers like me. Why don't you go and teach those Tsunomons and Upamons a lesson for harassing the flowers? You can then tell my friend about it.
I'm going to go on a flower picnic with him! Don't go by the water. You need to go right from here.
_1990.CompletionText: Are you done already? You need to tell my friend!
_1990.CompletionSummary: Thank you. You must be the one Agumon mentioned. Agumon's friends are my friends.

_1991.Title: Silver Lake
_1991.Summary: Tell Me More, Tell Me More.
_1991.Description: You want to know more about this world, don't you? Well, let me introduce you to a friend who knows far more than I do.
_1991.CompletionText: Go on. He is a good friend of mine.
_1991.CompletionSummary: If you want to learn more about this world, you have come to the right Digimon. I don't mean to brag, but I do know more than Agumon.

_1992.Title: Silver Lake
_1992.Description:
Digital World was a peaceful place. It's not like we need to eat. (Agumon likes to eat, though...)
There was no need to fight, you see, even if there were aggressive Digimons among us.
_1992.CompletionText: I'm not sure when things changed...
_1992.CompletionSummary: Something is different these days. And there are scary-looking black Digimons appearing, too. When will peace be restored to the Digital world again, I wonder?

_1993.Title: Silver Lake
_1993.Description: I think this is all because of the Black Cogwheels... I only know what they are called. I don't know any details.
_1993.CompletionText: I hear someone left a record of those Black Cogwheels.
_1993.CompletionSummary: Well, let's look for the clues together.

_1994.Title: Silver Lake
_1994.Description:
I used to have notes on the Black Cogwheels.
I took brief notes of what the White-bearded Guru told me, but I must have lost them when I was picking some flowers.
We should be able to learn a lot from those notes.
I'm pretty sure the Palmons near the flowers have them. Go get those notes from them.
_1994.CompletionSummary: This should tell us something about the Black Cogwheels.

_1995.Title: Silver Lake
_1995.Description:
Have you seen Koromons on your way back, by any chance?
I want to build a flower garden, but they keep interfering. Would you help me?
_1995.CompletionText: Are you finished already? You are quick!
_1995.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I should be able to build my flower garden now!

_1996.Title: Silver Lake
_1996.Description:
I'm sorry to impose, but I'm not giving up on my flower garden!
Bring me some Floral Bines from the Koromons nearby. They do nothing but interfere with my work. Hrmph!
_1996.Objective: Find Red Floral Bine to koromon
_1996.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. The flower garden will be finished soon!
As long as Koromons don't harass me, I should be able to finish it quickly!

_1997.Title: Silver Lake
_1997.Description:
Pretty stones are a must for a garden! I saw Tanemons playing with them. Teach them... not-so-harsh a lesson and bring me the stones, would you?
I will invite the Tanemons to my garden later and cheer them up!
_1997.CompletionText: Do you have the pretty stones?
_1997.CompletionSummary: Thank you! With your help, I have now finished a pretty flower garden!

_1998.Title: Silver Lake
_1998.Description:
You haven't been explore to the whole area yet, have you? If you go farther to the right, you will see a high ground.
Talk to the Terriermon there, and he'll show you how to get to the top where you will be able to look down at the whole region.
_1998.CompletionText: Go on, then. Fly away like me!
_1998.CompletionSummary: There's nothing like the view from the top! If you have to get to a higher ground, you have come to the right Digimon!

_1999.Title: Silver Lake
_1999.Description:
You are looking for the highest ground around here, you say? Just follow this path up the hill. Before you go, though, can you give me a hand?
I've made a Two-Way Wooded Path, but Kunemons are gnawing away at the trees and ruining the path. I would like you to teach them a lesson.
_1999.CompletionText: I need to protect the Two-Way Wooded Path.
_1999.CompletionSummary: Wow! Thanks for your help! Don't take the Two-Way Wooded Path yet. Wait until the trees grow. It'll be so pretty!

_2000.Title: Silver Lake
_2000.Description:
There's one thing I forgot.
I need equipment to maintain the forest, you see. But Kunemons have stolen a precious garden trowel from me.
Find the garden trowel those Kunemons stole.
_2000.CompletionText: Do you have the trowel yet?
_2000.CompletionSummary: Thank you. With this, I should be able to make the wooded path even prettier.

_2001.Title: Silver Lake
_2001.Description: To make the wooded path more... well... wooded, I will have to scatter more seeds. Bring back the Sapling Seeds that Dokunemons stole away for their snacks.
_2001.CompletionSummary: Thank you. The wooded path will be so nice!

_2002.Title: Silver Lake
_2002.Description:
You want to take a look around the File Island?
Oh, dear... I have lost my telescope, you see.
I think I might have lost it where Patamons are not too far from here.
_2002.CompletionSummary: You found the telescope. Now we can look around this place.

_2003.Title: Silver Lake
_2003.Description:
What's wrong with you? Why are you so out of breath?
Something flew at you and almost hurt you?
It was probably a Kuwagamon. It's a very aggressive Digimon. I'm scared... *trembles*
_2003.CompletionText: Kuwagamon is perhaps the most aggressive Digimon in this region.
_2003.CompletionSummary: Kuwagamon is scary. *trembles* Be careful not to run into him.

_2004.Title: Silver Lake
_2004.Description:
It know he's a scary one, but go and defeat Kuwagamon (Terror of High Hills) for me. Go up farther from here and you will see him a top the hill.
He is an evil Digimon that ruins the forest and, most importantly, threatens other good Digimons with his own power.
But I can't go. I'm scared of him.
_2004.CompletionText: Did you manage to defeat Kuwagamon (Terror of High Hills)?
_2004.CompletionSummary:
Kuwagamon (Terror of High Hills) fled, you say?
You must be really powerful. But you'd best be careful from now on. Kuwagamon will threaten you even more aggressively in the future.

_2005.Title: Silver Lake
_2005.Description:
I bet the reason Kuwagamons have turned violent is the Black Cogwheels. They might have been aggressive in the past, but they never hurt one another. Somewhere along the way, though, everyone began to threaten everyone else.
I'm not even sure what the Black Cogwheels are. If you want to know more about it, talk to Armadimon.
_2005.CompletionText: Ask Armadimon about the Black Cogwheels. I'm not sure whether he knows anything about it, but it's worth a try...
_2005.CompletionSummary: I'm a smart Digimon! You can see it in my eyes, you know?

_2006.Title: Silver Lake
_2006.Description:
Why am I here, you ask? Well, it's a long story...
There is something that you can only see from here...
Curious?
_2006.CompletionText: It's something hidden deep inside the forest.

_2007.Title: Silver Lake
_2007.Description:
I keep my eyes fixed on the Unknown Forest, but Salamon doesn't get it. He keeps hassling me.
He wants me to come down now. Would you ask him for me why he hassles me like that? If I talk to him, we'll just end up quarreling.
_2007.CompletionText: Have you talked with him yet?
_2007.CompletionSummary: It is no easy task to understand each other.

_2008.Title: Silver Lake
_2008.Description:
In this forest, there is a hidden area called the Unknown Forest.
It's hard to find. It's even invisible. But the one place where I can see it is right here. From time to time, I see the Digimon that I long to see.
That is the happiest moment of my life. The Digimon I'm talking about is Lillymon. If you happen to see her, would you give this to her for me?
_2008.CompletionText:
The moment is brief but filled with joy.
Please, please get this to her. It doesn't have to be right away.
The Unknown Forest is quite far from here. Just keep the note with you until you run into Lillymon. Then give it to her!
_2008.CompletionSummary: And who might you be? You have something Terriermon for me, do you?

_2009.Title: Silver Lake
_2009.Description:
Ah, you must have me Terriermon on the High Tree Hills...
It's not that I don't understand Terriermon. I'm simply worried that he is so fixated on the Unknown Forest.
We need to protect Terriermon, and he probably doesn't know what's going on.
_2009.CompletionText: There is something Terriermon does not realize.
_2009.CompletionSummary: Please, help me. I can't do this alone...

_2010.Title: Silver Lake
_2010.Description:
Since Terriermon went up to the hill, Betamons appeared.
I think they want to occupy a hill with a good view and drive out all Digimons who live there. Please help me and fight the Betamons!
_2010.CompletionSummary: It's not over yet, but this gives us some room to breathe...

_2011.Title: Silver Lake
_2011.Description:
Betamons are not the only Digimons targeting the High Tree Hills.
Elecmons also want this hill. Help me defeat them, too!
_2011.CompletionText: Let's protect Terriermon together! Help me!
_2011.CompletionSummary: The battle will continue, but we are safe for now. Thank you.

_2012.Title: Silver Lake
_2012.Description:
I would like to cheer up Terriermon with a gift.
I want to give him a necklace, and I need you to find the material for it. I want to make it a really pretty one.
Bring me White Necklace Material from Elecmons and Betamons.
_2012.CompletionSummary:
Thank you very much. This will do nicely.
If you see a necklace you like, please, take one.
Anyway, how long is Terriermon going to be up there? I hope he comes down soon.

_2013.Title: Silver Lake
_2013.Description:
Oh, where did you get this? This is a floral bine that I made with Salamon.
Ah, that brings back memories. I think I might have seen Elecmons carrying White Floral Bines...
_2013.Objective: Find White Floral Bine to Elecmon
_2013.CompletionText: Thank you for bringing these to me.
_2013.CompletionSummary: Thanks a lot for bringing these to me.

_2014.Title: Silver Lake
_2014.Description:
Now that you've fought Kuwagamon, you want to become more powerful, do you? You've come to the right place, then. Let me tell you about the basic attributes of Digimons.
Basic attributes of Digimons can be largely divided into three categories: Data, Vaccine and Virus.
These three attributes are correlated. If you understand their relationship to one another, it will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.
_2014.CompletionText: If you understand the attributes thoroughly, it will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.
_2014.CompletionSummary: Data, virus and vaccine are also the foundations of the Digital World.

_2015.Title: Silver Lake
_2015.Description:
First, let me tell you about the Virus attribute. Virus is powerful against Data.
Virus penetrates Data and distorts it. This is commonly called an infection. Infected Data, that is, Data that have been distorted by Virus don't function properly. In severe cases, they are even damaged.
Data is weak against Virus. Go and fight some Data Digimons. If you pit Virus Digimons against them like I told you, you should be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
_2015.CompletionText: Have you fought Data Digimons yet?
_2015.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2016.Title: Silver Lake
_2016.Description:
Secondly, let me tell you about the Vaccine attribute. Vaccine is powerful against Virus.
Vaccine finds any Virus hidden in Data, removes it, and fixes the distorted Data. So, the greatest enemy against a Virus Digimon is a Vaccine Digimon.
To summarize, Virus is weak against Vaccine. Go and fight some Virus Digimons. If you pit Vaccine Digimons against them like I told you, you should be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
_2016.CompletionText: Have you fought Virus Digimons yet?
_2016.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2017.Title: Silver Lake
_2017.Description:
Thirdly, let me tell you about the Data attribute. Data is powerful against Vaccine.
While Vaccine is greatly effective against Data distorted by Virus, Vaccine is powerful in and of itself. That's why Vaccine Digimons are weak against Data Digimons.
To summarize, Vaccine is weak against Data. Go and fight some Vaccine Digimons. If you pit Data Digimons against them like I told you, you should be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
_2017.CompletionText: Have you fought Vaccine Digimons yet?
_2017.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2018.Title: Silver Lake
_2018.Description:
Aside from the three attributes of Data, Virus and Vaccine, there is another, special attribute. It is the Unknown attribute, marked by "Un".
Digimons with the Unknown attribute are powerful against all three attributes of Data, Virus and Vaccine, because Digimons of these three attributes have no data on Digimons with the Unknown attribute.
Digimons with the Unknown attribute are few and far between. If you happen to come across a Digimon with the Unknown attribute, it will be a great boon in your adventure in the Digital World.
_2018.CompletionText: I hope you come across lots of Digimons of Unknown attribute.
_2018.CompletionSummary: I have rarely ever seen Digimons with the Unknown attribute. If you happen to run into one, make sure to talk to him.

_2019.Title: Silver Lake
_2019.Description:
Do you see why you need to become stronger?
Digimons that are influenced by the Black Cogwheels become violent. So, we need to train ourselves and become much stronger.
Defeat Kiwimons, RedVegiemons and Tentomons. You will find Heavy Stones on them. Bring me 15 of them.
_2019.CompletionText: Too many, you say? I don't think you understand the gravity of our situation here with the Black Cogwheels!
_2019.CompletionSummary: Ah. It was no easy task but you've done well.

_2020.Title: Silver Lake
_2020.Description:
The Black Cogwheels symbolize the power of darkness.
When one of these stick to or enter a Digimon, the Digimon becomes larger or vicious.
_2020.CompletionText: I hope that gives you some general ideas about the Black Cogwheels. Do you need me to explain anything further?
_2020.CompletionSummary: There is something more I need to tell you.

_2021.Title: Silver Lake
_2021.Description:
When a Black Cogwheel gets lodged in the body of a Digimon, the Digimon becomes larger and its skills can sometimes mutate.
That is to say, Black Cogwheels are an instrument that twists Digimons to become evil and cruel. You have to be careful!
_2021.CompletionText: So, do you need more training?
_2021.CompletionSummary: It is important to know about the Black Cogwheels, but becoming stronger is even more important!

_2022.Title: Silver Lake
_2022.Description:
I have a friend who has been attacked by Kuwagamon.
I need to train other adventurers, so I can't leave.
Would you go and check in on Gabumon? You will find Gabumon half-way between here and the Three-Way Lake.
_2022.CompletionSummary: I'm doing well. No need to worry!

_2023.Title: Silver Lake
_2023.Summary: What in the Digital World Happened?
_2023.Description:
Kuwagamon has been cutting down the trees in the center of the forest.
Thankfully, I wasn't hurt as Armadimon thought.
If you see him later, tell him I am doing okay.
_2023.CompletionSummary: I'm doing all right, but there is something I could use your help with.

_2024.Title: Silver Lake
_2024.Description:
I am more worried about Piyomon.
While he was running away from Kuwagamon, he dropped a necklace in the lake. Since then, he has been staring into the lake all day and doesn't want to leave.
Would you go and check in on him?

_2025.Title: Silver Lake
_2025.Description:
With Kuwagamons flying around and creating great winds, the apple seeds that I have been preparing all vanished.
I think Birdramons picked up the seeds. Please find them.
_2025.CompletionText: Have you found the apple seeds?
_2025.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much! I put in a lot of effort into preparing these, you know.

_2026.Title: Silver Lake
_2026.Description:
I lost grape seeds along with the apple seeds.
I believe Sabirdramon took them away. Please find them for me.
_2026.CompletionText: Do you have the grape seeds?
_2026.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much! I put in a lot of effort into preparing these, you know.

_2027.Title: Silver Lake
_2027.Description:
Oh, Gabumon sent you to check in on me? I am doing just fine.
A necklace? Oh, that necklace.
I forgot about that a long time ago.
I found something - someone - more beautiful. Who is she that is gazing upon me from that lake?
Isn't she beautiful?

_2028.Title: Silver Lake
_2028.Description:
Who is that beautiful Digimon?
By the way, whenever Seadramons move nearby, the water is disturbed and that beautiful Digimon's visage becomes obscure.
I need to continue to gaze upon her. Go and drive out the Seadramons.
And tell Gabumon that I am doing well.
_2028.CompletionText: Hurry! Her visage keeps getting obscured!

_2029.Title: Silver Lake
_2029.Summary: Piyomon Is Okay... In a Sense
_2029.Description:
So, he's doing better than we expected, is he?
I will have to go see him myself.
Hmm? He really seems okay?
Well, then... I guess I won't have to pay him a visit after all. Thank you checking in on him. It makes me feel much better!
_2029.CompletionText: I'm glad to know that he's okay.

_2030.Title: Silver Lake
_2030.Description:
Simply gazing upon her will not do.
I will send her a sincere gift to let her know just how much I love her. Sorry, did you say something?
I can't take my eyes off of her, so you will have to get that gift for me. Move, move!
You will find Mushroomons in a dark and dank corner not too far from here. Go! Quickly!
_2030.CompletionSummary: Well done. Now give me some room and go away, will you?

_2031.Title: Silver Lake
_2031.Description:
You want to defeat Kuwagamons, you say?
It will be difficult on your own. Go and speak with Cherrymon. He is known as a guru because he has lived in this forest the longest.
I'm sure he can help.
_2031.CompletionSummary: Ahem. I am Cherrymon the Wise.

_2032.Title: Silver Lake
_2032.Description:
You want to know about Kuwagamons, do you? This place is filled with troublemakers, I see. Well, let me speak from my fantastic wisdom.
Before you came here, you probably heard a lot about the basic attributes.
If you knew Kuwagamons' attributes and had a Digimon that is powerful against it, it would help you greatly, right?
Kuwagamons' basic attribute is Virus and elemental attribute Darkness.
Now, what do you think you will need to face these attributes?
That's right. The basic attribute must be Vaccine and elemental attribute Light.
Don't be discouraged because your Digimons don't match those attributes. If you keep at it, you will be able to defeat Kuwagamons eventually.
_2032.CompletionText: Kuwagamons' attributes are Virus and Darkness. Remember that as you fight.
_2032.CompletionSummary: Kuwagamons have the Virus and Darkness attributes. Don't ever forget!

_2033.Title: Silver Lake
_2033.Description:
Defeat Kuwagamon (Raid) and restore peace to Silver Lake.
You can find Kuwagamon (Raid) over the hill where the trees have been cut down.
_2033.CompletionText: Kuwagamon (Raid) is strong, but I trust in you!
_2033.CompletionSummary: Great work! You are a lot more powerful than you look. Finally, peace will be restored to Silver Lake. Woo hoo!

_2034.Title: Silver Lake
_2034.Description:
Hmm... You want to return home, do you? I've lived a long time but I've never heard anyone say that before.
Maybe, if you explore the deeper part of the File Island, you just might be able to find a way home.
Oh, wait! Maybe you should talk to Babamon. She has lived longer than I have and is wise. You will find her in the Silent Forest.
To get there, go east from here a little ways and you will be able to teleport there.
_2034.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Babamon in the Silent Forest.
_2034.CompletionText: To get to the Silent Forest, go east from here. When you get there, talk to Babamon.

_2035.Title: Silver Lake
_2035.Description:
Those cursed rocks...
One day, those arrogant stones just began to claim that they are the most powerful and coolest Digimons in the forest.
We will have to teach those pebbles a harsh lesson.
Defeat Gotsumons and Rockmons in the forest and then speak with the captain Rockmon. I would be dying to see his reaction.
_2035.CompletionText: Have you taken care of Gotsumons and Rockmons?
_2035.CompletionSummary: Who the devil are you? Why are you wreaking havoc here?

_2036.Title: Silver Lake
_2036.Description:
Oh, is THAT what those trees said? Those sticks have a big mouth!
You owe us for hurting Gotsumons and Rockmons. You will need to do something for us. If you don't listen to us, you are in trouble.
I think it's time that we taught them a lesson of our own.
Defeat Woodmons and Cherrymons and then speak with the captain Cherrymon. I can just see the expression on his face. Hehehehe.
_2036.CompletionText: Have you taken care of Woodmons and Cherrymons?
_2036.CompletionSummary: Whose side are you on, anyway?

_2037.Title: Silver Lake
_2037.Description:
Stop fighting? Our pride and dignity are at stake here. You can just buzz off. Hmm? How long are we going to keep this up?
Who knows? Be quiet and just begone.
Fighting sometimes brings people together, but now right now. Those stupid pebbles!
_2037.CompletionSummary:
You still have something to ask about? I have nothing else to tell you. Ahem. To win this battle, we will have to use the Crane Formation.
Listen up, Woodmons! Team 1 will take the Crane Formation and Team 2 the Snake Formation.

_2038.Title: Silver Lake
_2038.Description:
Unknown Forest? I have heard of it before, but I don't know any details.
The Digimons who have explored the forest the most extensively are Terriermon, whom you've met already, and Tanemon.
Go and speak with Tanemon.
_2038.CompletionText: Have you met with Tanemon yet?
_2038.CompletionSummary: This forest is truly awe-inspiring. There are lots of secret places of beauty. I highly encourage you to explore it all.

_2039.Title: Silver Lake
_2039.Description: Ah, I was hoping you'd come by. You have something to ask me? Can I ask you to do something for me first? DemiMeramons are out to burn up the entire forest. Take this bucket of water and use it on them to put out the fire.
_2039.CompletionText:
Please, hurry.
If you delay, the whole forest will get consumed by fire.
You didn't throw away the bucket of water or anything, did you? If you don't have it anymore, abandon the quest and try it again.
_2039.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I'm glad the forest is intact.

_2040.Title: Silver Lake
_2040.Description:
Unknown Forest? That place is hidden in the deepest regions of Silver Lake.
Still, it's not that difficult to find it.
I hear that, before someone created a trail, the place was hidden.
_2040.CompletionText: Is it that far from here?
_2040.CompletionSummary: Why are you looking for the Unknown Forest?

_2041.Title: Silver Lake
_2041.Description:
I take my vocation to be the protection of this forest.
The recent increase in the number of vicious Digimons in the area concerns me.
Please help me. Help me before you leave for the Unknown Forest.
Along with DemiMeramons, Candlemons are also out to set the forest ablaze. Candlemons sometimes set things on fire by accident because the fire on their heads get onto other things.
Defeat Candlemons and protect this forest.
_2041.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Although there are still many enemies about, the forest will be a little safer.

_2042.Title: Silver Lake
_2042.Description:
We need fences to protect the forest, but I can't leave this place.
But you can help me. Find some fence material for me, would you?
With the fences up, the forest will be safer. Bring me the material off of Candlemons and DemiMeramons in the area.
_2042.CompletionText: The fences will slow down our enemies, right?
_2042.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. You have been very, very helpful.
Oh, no! Come to think of it, fences can burn down, too. Well, I guess it's better than trees burning down.

_2043.Title: Silver Lake
_2043.Description:
If you happen to find the Unknown Forest, try planting this White Four-Leaf Clover in the ground.
That will energize the Unknown Forest and make it glitter. I hope that the entire forest will be energized like that.
_2043.ObjectiveProgress: Unknown Forest - Use White Four-Leaf Clover
_2043.CompletionText: Have you tried planting the White Four-Leaf Clover?

_2044.Title: Silver Lake
_2044.Description:
Terriermon? I didn't know he thought of me in that way. I would love to leave the Unknown Forest and fly around Silver Lake freely. But, it's easier said than done.
I have Lillymon friends here that won't let me leave. I can't even talk to them anymore.
Would you mind intimidating them just a little? I would like to fly even for a little while during the commotion.
_2044.CompletionText: Don't be too harsh with my friends.
_2044.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I will take this opportunity and see the outside world even for a little while...

_2045.Title: Silver Lake
_2045.Description:
That boulder at the entrance is one of the reasons why this Unknown Forest is so hidden.
The largest and the strongest of all Lillymons in this area blocked the entrance with that boulder.
She says that she did that to protect the fireflies in the area, but I don't know...
In order for the Unknown Forest to be open to the rest of the world, we must first defeat the Lillymon.
She's strong, so be careful. If it's too difficult, you can come back later when you are stronger.
_2045.CompletionText: Be careful. It doesn't have to be done right now.
_2045.CompletionSummary:
Wow! You are so powerful. With that Lillymon defeated, I'm sure more Digimons will visit the Unknown Forest now.
... including Terriermon, of course.

_2046.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2046.Description:
Hmm?? You must have crossed over from the Lost Historic Site. We have lots of dangerous Digimons here. We haven't had any visitors from the Lost Historic Site to the File Island Waterfront for a while.
Did you have any trouble while you were at the Lost Historic Site? We have plenty here... This is all because of Devimons, their underlings and the Black Cogwheels.
There is much you can do to help, Tamer. But, first, go and speak with Gawappamon. He will tell you all about the troubles over at the Beach.
_2046.CompletionText: Have you spoken with Gawappamon yet? You should be able to see him from here.
_2046.CompletionSummary: You have come from the Lost Historic Site, have you? I suppose danger abounds there as much as here.

_2047.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2047.Description:
Welcome to the File Island Waterfront. You must have had quite an adventure to get here.
When you hear the word "Waterfront", you may think of rest and leisure, but things are not so comfortable on the File Island Waterfront.
You are looking for a place where you can look at the entire region, you say?
Beyond the beach and the forest, go up the rock mountain. From there, you can get to the Infinite Mountain, the highest point on this island.
_2047.CompletionText: Welcome to the File Island Waterfront!
_2047.CompletionSummary: The highest point on this island is a rock mountain. It was once a green forest, though...

_2048.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2048.Summary: The Story behind the File Island Waterfront 1
_2048.Description:
This is your first time an the File Island Waterfront, so there must be a lot that you want to know. I'm glad you came when you did. There is a lot you can do to help us.
If you help me, and I will tell you many things about the File Island Waterfront and what you need to watch out for.
Lately, Zudomons have been far too noisy. Drive them out for me, will you?
_2048.CompletionText: Did you drive out the Zudomons?
_2048.CompletionSummary: Ah! Thanks to you, some peace and quiet.

_2049.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2049.Description:
The File Island Waterfront was a peaceful place at first. But, at some point, it turned into a desolate place of strife and territorial rivalry.
This all happened when Monochromon changed. He loved the mountains more than anyone else. Monochromon changed when that evil Digimon appeared.
_2049.CompletionText: He loved the mountains more than anyone else...
_2049.CompletionSummary: The File Island Waterfront will become gradually more desolate...

_2050.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2050.Description:
If Monochromon loves the mountains, I love this beach.
But we've been seeing evil Digimons around here, too, and they are defiling the beach!
Lopmon has sent me here to take care of it, but I can't do it alone. Take care of Silphymons and tell Lopmon what's been happening here.
_2050.Objective: Defeat 12 Silphymons and speak with Lopmon.
_2050.CompletionText: Look at this fine sand on this beach.
_2050.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I am going to protect this beach to my dying breath.

_2051.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2051.Description:
We need you to stop the rift on the File Island Waterfront. The File Island Waterfront is made up of the beach, the forest and the rock mountain. Although, that rock mountain wasn't so rocky to begin with...
Visit Lopmon. He'll be able to tell you more about the File Island Waterfront.
_2051.CompletionText: Have you spoken to Lopmon yet?
_2051.CompletionSummary: Thank you. We need to do something about the File Island Waterfront!

_2052.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2052.Description:
Who goes there?!
Oh, Gawappamon sent you? I'm sorry for the yelling.
I'm rather edgy what with all the evil Digimons on the beach lately.
_2052.CompletionText: You are not a bad person, are you?
_2052.CompletionSummary: The beach used to be a really beautiful place...

_2053.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2053.Summary: The Story behind the File Island Waterfront 2
_2053.Description:
As I said before, there are more and more Digimons who seek to destroy the File Island Waterfront.
When the situation on the beach is stable, we'll talk more. Remove Rapidmons for me.
_2053.CompletionText: Did you take care of Rapidmons?

_2054.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2054.Description:
It's not just Rapidmons that are out to destroy the beach. I need you to take care of Arcadimons (Ultimate), too.
What's with all these Digimons out to ruin the beach?
_2054.CompletionText: Sorry about dumping all these requests on you. But I need your help. I can't do it alone.
_2054.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much. I can just feel the beach getting better already!

_2055.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2055.Description:
There used to be lots of pretty pebbles around here. You couldn't find those on the beach, so we used to get them as gifts from the mountains.
But, since Rapidmons and Arcadimons appeared on the beach, those pebbles just vanished.
Defeat Rapidmons and Arcadimons. Recover the Lost Pebbles for us.
_2055.CompletionSummary: Thank you. These make the beach so much more beautiful, you know!

_2056.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2056.Description:
Since *that* Digimon appeared on the File Island Waterfront, Monochromon began to become vicious.
Monochromon used to love the mountains and the trees. Yet, when the Black Cogwheels got stuck on him, he started to demolish the mountains and the trees that he spend all his life building with his friends.
_2056.CompletionText: He used to love the forest more than anyone else...
_2056.CompletionSummary: Will you go to the mountains and help Monochromon? Just remove the Black Cogwheels, and he'll come back to his old self.

_2057.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2057.Description:
We are waiting for the 'Children of the Rumor'.
I've only heard Gatomon mention it briefly. Talk to him for more details, but I know this one thing:
The Children of the Rumor are on our side.
_2057.CompletionSummary: The Children of the Rumor, huh?

_2058.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2058.Description:
What in the Digital World is that Digimon?
That rectangular Digimon over there! Do you know who he is? Pay... phone? That's not a Digimon? Oh, I see. What's that for?
It said something to me, so I approached it. But then it just repeated itself over and over again.
Oh, and I found this round thing while I was playing in this area. Do I need this?
Examine that strange contraption, and then tell Gatomon your findings. Gatomon and I are very, very curious about that piece of machinery.
_2058.ObjectiveProgress: Examine Payphone and speak with Gatomon
_2058.CompletionText: Coins? Phones? You humans use strange words.
_2058.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Things didn't quite work out as you'd hoped, did they? You know, Palmon is the smartest Digimon on the Waterfront. Speak with him and he may tell you something important.

_2059.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2059.Description:
You want to know about the Children of the Rumor? Well, I would be happy to tell you more about them. But, first, you have probably seen how desperate we are on the beach. You spoke with Gawappamon and Lopmon, right?
If we take care of business around these parts, the beach should be stabilized somewhat.
Help me defeat the Digimons on the beach. Those are evil Digimons that ruin the beach.
_2059.CompletionText: Did you take care of them?
_2059.CompletionSummary: Thank you. But we still have a long way to go...

_2060.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2060.Description:
You defeated MegaSeadramon?
You must be really powerful, Tamer. But, here, we have something more fearful - Arachnemons. They look the part, too. Will you defeat them for me?
_2060.CompletionText: Did you take care of them?
_2060.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I hope this gets all settled soon.

_2061.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2061.Description:
On this side of the beach, MegaSeadramons crawl around.
In order to discover their weakness, we need two kinds of scale, MegaSeadramon scale. Could you get some for me?
Some MegaSeadramon scale is also venomous. They are all very useful for the research.
Find me those two types of scale. It will be no easy task. Good luck!
_2061.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I will do my best to drive out the MegaSeadramons!

_2062.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2062.Description:
So, you have heard about the Children of the Rumor, have you? Yes, there is a rumor that is going around in the Digital World.
The rumor speaks of the Chosen Children from another world who will come in our darkest hour to rescue the Digital World.
We don't know when this will be. All we can do is wait for their arrival.
_2062.CompletionText: When will they come, I wonder?

_2063.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2063.Description:
I am told that the Chosen Children have the power to evolve Digimons.
Apparently, you can evolve Digimons beyond the Ultimate stage by using a certain crest and necklace.
_2063.CompletionSummary: Seeing that you have suddenly crossed over into the Digital World from another world, it is likely that you are a 'Chosen Child'.

_2064.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2064.Description:
There was a time when nasty Digimons called Giromons (Forest Destroyer) went on cutting down the trees in the forest indiscriminately.
They carried electric saws, you see.
This angered Monochromon. He fought the Giromons (Forest Destroyer) and eventually defeated them, but he, too, sustained grave wounds.
Those Giromons remained quiet for a while, but...
Now that Monochromon has changed, they are here again, mowing down the trees. Will you stop them for us?
They are powerful. Be careful out there!
_2064.CompletionText: They are so vicious that I can't even get close... Those fearsome eyes and the horns... They are scary...
_2064.CompletionSummary:
Thank you so much. You are keeping the forest safe. You are successful where we have failed.
Who cares if you are not a 'Chosen Child'?!

_2065.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2065.Description:
It is probably best for you to go to the rock mountain yourself. From there, you will be able to view the entire File Island.
While you're at it, tell my friend, Hawkmon, the good of news of Giromons defeated.
_2065.CompletionSummary: I've heard a lot about you. From here, you can get to the rock mountain.

_2066.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2066.Description:
What? You defeated Giromons (Forest Destroyer)? You must be really powerful.
As you can see, we have problems of our own here. Cherubimons (Good) and Cherubimons are blocking the way. Defeat them and open the way to the mountain.
Once you do that, speak with Greymon and he will tell you about the mountain.
_2066.Objective: Defeat Cherubimons (Good) and Cherubimons and speak with Greymon.
_2066.CompletionText: The way to the mountain is full of danger.
_2066.CompletionSummary: So, how do you like the rock mountain?

_2067.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2067.Description:
So, Gatomon thinks you are the Children of the Rumor?
Hmm... He could be right. But, then, he could be wrong. I'm not sure.
But, if you all have something in common in relation to the Digital World, it's possible that you really are the Chosen Children.
I don't mean whether you all went to the same school. We need something more than that. By the way, I remember seeing a diary written in a language that is not from the Digital World.
I have a feeling that this diary will be very helpful to you, if you can read it.
Cherubimons (Good) in the area must have it. I couldn't take it from them - I'm not that strong. But you should be able to.
_2067.Objective: Retrieve File Island Waterfront Diary from Cherubimons and Cherubimons (Good).
_2067.CompletionSummary: Hmm... As expected... I can't read this, so you try it.

_2068.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2068.Description:
It's you. I knew you would come here...
You are all witnesses to the incident on the Hill of Light..
All of you also met Digimons four years ago. Yes. You are the 8th Chosen Children.
The Digimon that helped you back then was Greymon. That's me.
_2068.CompletionText: Good to see you. You seem rather familiar...
_2068.CompletionSummary: That you are all here means that the time is nigh when we will put an end to this chaos.

_2069.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2069.Description:
The incident on the Hill of Light, the Chosen Children, the Black Cogwheels... Has it "clicked" yet?
To put an end to all of this, you have no choice but to face Devimon.
You must defeat Devimon in order for you to become unnecessary beings in this world. That is to say, you can return home.
_2069.CompletionText: Are you starting to understand why you are in the Digital World now?
_2069.CompletionSummary: Now, prepare yourselves to go up to the Infinite Mountain.

_2070.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2070.Description: Devimon has many underlings we need to take care of, still. Defeat SkullSatamons and CyberDramons to weaken Devimon's influence.
_2070.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Your showdown with Devimon is approaching.

_2071.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2071.Description:
Devimon is the greatest threat to the File Island right now.
But the Waterfront is also fraught with problems. As you probably saw along the way, Monochromon is causing lots of trouble here.
I would like you to help me remove the Black Cogwheels from Monochromon.
But, first, this area is filled with Devimon's underlings because this area leads up to the Infinite Mountain. Slay his underlings for me.
_2071.CompletionSummary: Thank you. With this, Devimon's influence will gradually shrink.

_2072.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2072.Description:
Devimon's underlings carry a special mark.
This mark has the image of Devimon's horn. The rumor has it that this amplifies their evil powers.
Bring me these marks and I will examine them. I will reverse the process to weaken Devimon's power. That will help you greatly as you fight his underlings in the future.
_2072.CompletionText: Have you found the Black Marks of Devimon?
_2072.CompletionSummary: Well done, Tamer. I will put them to good use.

_2073.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2073.Description:
You will find Devimon in the Infinite Mountain Dungeon on the Infinite Mountain through the gate next to me. Please, slay him and restore peace to the File Island.
You have other things you must do in the meantime, like removing Black Cogwheels from Monochromon.
You need to do this for us. Ask Resolute Leomon about how to get to Monochromon. Follow this path up a little farther and you will find Resolute Leomon.
_2073.CompletionSummary: You are doing many good things for the File Island Waterfront, Tamer.

_2074.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2074.Description:
I will help you in your fight against Monochromon. In exchange, why don't you help me restore this desolate mountain?
PileVolcamons are interrupting our restoration work on the mountain. Defeat them.
_2074.CompletionSummary: Great work, Tamer. PileVolcamons were hard to deal with because of their rocky body.

_2075.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2075.Description:
I haven't given up hope of speaking with Monochromon yet. I want to see him return to his old, kind self.
But he is not willing to talk. Is there really no other way but to use force? The root of this problem lies in the Black Cogwheels on him, so the best way to go about this is to pull them out.
Pull out the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon and help the File Island Waterfront return to its former glory!
_2075.CompletionText: Did you remove the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon?
_2075.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. Thank you so much. You really removed the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon.
The File Island Waterfront will be restored now. With Monochromon's love for the mountains and the forest, I am sure we can make the Waterfront even more beautifu

_2076.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2076.Description:
There is nothing like White Feathers for bedding!
Crowmon's feather is especially comfortable. Sand doesn't even come close!
I'm going to make a clean and soft bed. Will you gather the feathers for me?
If you do that, I will let you lie down on the bed for a little while.
_2076.CompletionText: Crowmons can be mean to us, but... their feathers are good!
_2076.CompletionSummary:
Great! I'm going to make bedding for my friends who are fighting throughout this region.
No more fatigue!

_2077.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2077.Description:
Before Devimon showed up, Black Feathers were a symbol of good fortune on the File Island Waterfront.
I hear that you can sometimes find Black Feathers off of Waspmons and CannonBeemons.
They are mechanical, and yet they carry Black Feathers for good luck. Isn't that kinda ridiculous?
Find those Black Feathers for me, would you? I'm sure good fortune will come to you, too, for finding them.
_2077.CompletionText: Did you find Black Feathers? I'll let you keep one, if you'd like.
_2077.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I bid you excellent fortune in the future, Tamer!

_2078.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2078.Description:
Since Monochromon's change, strange Digimons began to rage out of nowhere.
I would like to go drive them out, but they look... rather scary. Would you go beat up those CannonBeemons for me?
_2078.CompletionSummary: Yowza! You did it! Thank you so much!

_2079.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2079.Description:
When will Monochromon come back to his old self, I wonder?
Now that you have defeated CannonBeemons, could you also beat up Waspmons?
_2079.CompletionSummary: Ah, this area will be a little safer thanks to you.

_2080.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2080.Description:
I hear that the forest is not the only place crowded with Digimons. The beach and the rock mountain are both crowded, too.
Lots of things are happening here. Drive out Crowmons for me. When will peace be restored to the File Island Waterfront?
_2080.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Thank you so much. I couldn't have done this on my own.

_2081.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2081.Description:
Where did those mechanical Digimons come from? They don't really fit in here in the forest.
They are pesky, for sure, but it's not all bad! I've been building a vehicle that will fly over the peak of the rock mountain.
Will you collect some Waspmon Wings for the vehicle? It'll be so exciting to fly to the sky over the shiny sand on that beach!
_2081.CompletionText: Have you found all the wings? Please, help me with my research.
_2081.CompletionSummary: Thank you. If I just analyze this mechanical part, I'm sure I can discover something.

_2082.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2082.Description:
I should be able to make the wings for the contraption with the CannonBeemon wings. As with any research, I need some material to extract data from it.
Will you defeat CannonBeemons and bring me their wings? If I just have those wings, I should be able to finish the 'vehicle'.
_2082.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. When it's done, I will let you take a ride on it. Hehe.
Hopefully, those bees won't attack me during my research.

_2083.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2083.Description:
There many fabulous female Digimons. I would LOVE to declare my love to them, but...!
I, the SuperStarmon of Love, am way too good for them. I can't give in first. Hmm? You think I'm just afraid of rejection? No, no, no! Never! They do look rather strong and somewhat vicious, but that's not why!
*Ahem* Let that Lillymon know of my love, would you? Those beautiful colors... Ah, how beautiful you are, Lillymon!
_2083.Objective: Target Lillymon and use the Red Heart from the inventory.
_2083.CompletionSummary: What? Lillymon almost beat you up for it? How dare she! Hmph! She was just an ugly Digimon to begin with, anyway. This is unforgivable!

_2084.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2084.Description:
Why would I want to fall in love with someone nasty like Lillymon when QueenChessmon is so full of grace and elegance? The beautiful copper-tone skin and the contrast of the golden outfit. Ah, how beautiful you are!
What? You think I change my mind too quickly? Sh... shut up! Just... just tell QueenChessmon how much I love her!
Heh. The moment she lays her eyes on my sunglasses and the charming, star-shaped face, QueenChessmon won't be able to help falling in love with me.
You should be honored to be the messenger of my love. Hahahaha!
_2084.Objective: Target QueenChessmon and use the Red Heart from the inventory.
_2084.CompletionSummary: What? QueenChessmon actually managed to beat you up? How badly??? This... this is preposterous!

_2085.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2085.Description:
It's all over for me... Hmm? You think I'm giving up too easily after only two tries? Wh... what would YOU know?!
What? How about LadyDevimon, you say?
.....................................................
You know, LadyDevimon is just too.... Ah, forget it. It's all over for me.
_2085.CompletionSummary: This can never be! How dare they mock my love? They will regret this!

_2086.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2086.Description:
Teach them a lesson! A nasty, harsh lesson! Teach them the consequence of rejecting my love!!!
Why should you do this? Well, you played the messenger, didn't you? You gotta finish what you started. It doesn't make sense, you say? Shut up!
Now that it has come to this, you are just as responsible for my emotional suffering. You need to make me feel better. What? You don't want to...?
....................................
Please, help me. I'm not strong enough to do this. Please!
Hmm? Really? You will help me? Thank you, thank you, thank you! First, teach QueenChessmon and Lillymon a lesson. They rejected my love.
_2086.CompletionText: This will make them realize what they have done..
_2086.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Thank you. This makes me feel a little better.

_2087.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2087.Description:
LadyDevimon needs to learn a lesson, too.
What? You didn't deliver my message of love to her? It doesn't matter! They are all the same! Teach that LadyDevimon a lesson, too!
_2087.CompletionText: They think they've got it all just because they're pretty.
_2087.CompletionSummary:
Ah, this makes me feel much better. Thank you. Maybe... maybe I can love again.
Hmm? You think I need to make up my mind, do ya? Shush! I'm not going down that easy.

_2088.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2088.Summary: A Heart of Love Part Deux
_2088.Description:
The Red Hearts of Love that you delivered to QueenChessmon and Lillymon should have turned black. I... need to restore them. This is rather different, you say? Of course! My love is unique! Yup!
Anywho...
Bring me the Black Hearts. I will need to make them red again.
_2088.Objective: Retrieve Black Hearts of Deep Love from QueenChessmon and Lillymon.
_2088.CompletionText: Come back to life, my heart of burning love!
_2088.CompletionSummary: Thank you. My love begins once again!

_2089.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2089.Description:
To be frank, the reason I avoided LadyDevimon is because... well... she stole my Red Hearts.
She has too many Red Hearts. If I'm not careful, she may get too clingy to me. That's a frightening prospect.
Why am I so cowardly all of a sudden, you ask? You don't know how fearsome LadyDevimon is, do you? Those red eyes... Just the thought of them chills my bones.
To squelch her interest in me, we need to retrieve those hearts. Please, help me! This is the most important thing!
_2089.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. Hopefully, LadyDevimon won't be so interested in me anymore. I'm going to go find someone else to love. Good luck to you, too.
If you keep trying, you will be able to live a life so full of passion. Just like mine!

_2090.Title: [Attribute]
_2090.Description:
I'm sure you've learned a lot of attributes by now.
Now, there is one last type of attribute I need to teach you about.
This time, you're going to learn about the relationship between four attributes of Light, Darkness, Steel and Electricity.
_2090.CompletionText: How are you doing with elemental attributes?
_2090.CompletionSummary: Knowing about the elemental attributes will help you great as you journey through the Digital World!

_2091.Title: [Attribute]
_2091.Description:
The first elemental relationship you will learn is Light against Darkness.
Light is powerful against Darkness. What makes the night retreat is the bright ray of the sun.
Go and fight some LadyDevimons in the area. They have the Darkness attribute.
If you pit a Light Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
_2091.CompletionText: Have you fought against LadyDevimons, the Darkness Digimons?
_2091.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2092.Title: [Attribute]
_2092.Description:
The third elemental relationship you will learn is Electricity against Steel.
Electricity is powerful against Steel. Even the most powerful steel in the world that can destroy anything is nothing more than a conductor against electricity.
Go and fight some QueenChessmons in the area. They have the Steel attribute.
If you pit an Electricity Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
_2092.CompletionText: Have you fought against QueenChessmons, the Steel Digimons?
_2092.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2093.Title: [Attribute]
_2093.Description:
The fourth elemental relationship you will learn is Steel against Light.
Steel is powerful against Light. All that light can be against steel is to be reflected. It can't do anything to it. A well-crafted steel sword can cut light.
Go and fight some Cherubimons (Good) in the area. They have the Light attribute.
If you pit a Steel Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
