_2093.CompletionText: Have you fought against Cherubimons (White), the Light Digimons?
_2093.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2094.Title: Silent Forest
_2094.Description:
Ugh, this is way too hot! You are a strong one to brave this hot weather, kid! Do you want to know why it's so hot here? The weather suddenly began to turn hot one day. My guess is that the once-tame Meramons began to go mad.
Hurry! Go and find out why Meramons are raging!
_2094.CompletionText: Is this your first time in the Unknown Forest?

_2095.Title: Silent Forest
_2095.Description:
Over here... Keep your footsteps light! If she finds us, we are done for... That Babamon over there - it's her birthday in a few days and I don't have a birthday gift for her yet...
There is a rumor that Meramons carry the most precious treasure of Hope Forest.
Get that treasure for me, will you?
_2095.Objective: Find Treasure of Hope Forest from meramon
_2095.CompletionText: Is this your first time in the Unknown Forest?
_2095.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I'm going to win some brownie points from Babamon. Hehe.

_2096.Title: [Atrribute Quest]
_2096.Description:
*ring ring* Ah! You are here. It looks like there is an incredible Fire Seed here.
What better attribute to learn than Fire in a tropical paradise? Fight Meramons and find some Fire Attribute Items.
_2096.Objective: Get Fire Attribute Item from Meramon
_2096.CompletionText: Have you fought Fire Digimons yet?
_2096.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2097.Title: Wanted
_2097.CompletionText: Have you ever fought a captain-class Meramon?
_2097.CompletionSummary: I can see hope for the Digital World.

_2098.Title: Silent Forest
_2098.Description:
The Hope Forest region of the Silent Forest began to get hot one day. Meramons - they were probably docile once - began to rage.
Go and find out what they are doing. Take pictures of them!
_2098.CompletionSummary: Is THAT what they've been doing?

_2099.Title: Silent Forest
_2099.Description: We have discovered that Meramons are carrying unknown objects on them. Let me give you this suspicious-looking thing. Use it in the Hope Forest and tell Babamon what happens.
_2099.CompletionText: Don't you know where Hope Forest is?
_2099.CompletionSummary: There is terrible energy in Hope Forest, but it has gotten much better with your help.

_2100.Title: Silent Forest
_2100.Description:
I know what this is! This is a Black Cogwheel! This is what turned Meramons evil...
The cause has been identified. Go and defeat Meramon (Captain)!

_2101.Title: Silent Forest
_2101.Description:
Hmm... There are still things left unresolved. But there is only so much I can do...
Take this Black Cogwheel sample and tell Elecmons in the Dark Forest what's been going on!
_2101.CompletionSummary: Oh, no...! I didn't know such terrible things were happening in Hope Forest!

_2102.Title: Silent Forest
_2102.Description: Listen, friend. Elecmons are a suspicious folk. Before you get to the Dark Isle, use this flare to let them know that you are on their side.
_2102.Objective: Use Item to front door Dark Forest
_2102.CompletionSummary: Hmm... I don't completely trust you yet. Did Babamon send you?

_2103.Title: Silent Forest
_2103.Description:
Hmm... We are having trouble with Goblimons. They appeared out of nowhere swinging their clubs!
Go and find out what they are up to.
_2103.CompletionText: Did you figure out what they are up to yet?

_2104.Title: Silent Forest
_2104.Description:
So, that's what's been happening in Hope Forest.
I think I might have seen something similar to this object before. I can't remember the details, but I think I saw them on Sharmamons.
Well, they are tainting the Black Shadow Forest anyway. Go and defeat them. See if you can find something similar to this object.
_2104.CompletionSummary: As expected... It was the Sharmamons. Well, excellent work, friend.

_2105.Title: Silent Forest
_2105.Description:
Goblimons barged in and took over my home, the Shadow Forest. I had no choice but to run.
Those Goblimons are tainting the Shadow Forest all black.
Go and teach them a lesson.
_2105.CompletionText: Did you beat up those Goblimons already?
_2105.CompletionSummary: Hahaha... Did you really? Did you beat the living daylight out of them?

_2106.Title: Silent Forest
_2106.Description:
Sharmamons barged in and took over my home, the Shadow Forest. I had no choice but to run.
Those Sharmamons are tainting the Shadow Forest all black.
Go and teach them a lesson.
_2106.CompletionText: Did you beat up those Sharmamons already?
_2106.CompletionSummary: Hahaha... Did you really? Did you beat the living daylight out of them?

_2107.Title: Silent Forest
_2107.Description:
I have no idea. None whatsoever! I haven't a clue what's going on...
Take some pictures of Goblimons and Sharmamons to figure out why they are doing what they are doing. We need data!
_2107.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use item on Goblimon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use item on Sharmamon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2107.CompletionText: You know how to use the item, right?

_2108.Title: Silent Forest
_2108.Description: Now... Let's see... We'll analyze the data you gathered from Hope Forest and the Black Shadow Forest. ... Hmm... I will continue the analysis. You go south and see if you can find more clues.
_2108.Objective: There is Cemetery Forest to south
_2108.CompletionSummary: Another clue from the south, huh? The Silent Forest is in trouble, I see...

_2109.Title: Silent Forest
_2109.Description:
Hey, you. I hear you are heading south to investigate this crisis. A while ago, a Tamer lost his wood block in the southern region... I was supposed to find it for him, but I'd like you to do it instead.
From what I gathered, there is a rumor that ghosts are appearing there. Defeat anything that looks like a ghost.
_2109.CompletionSummary: So, it was Bakemons tainting the Cemetery Forest.

_2110.Title: Wanted
_2110.CompletionText: Have you ever fought a captain-class Bakemon?
_2110.CompletionSummary: I can see hope for the Digital World.

_2111.Title: Silent Forest
_2111.Description: Let me give you this wood block. Go to the southern region and defeat the top boss of Bakemons - Soulmon (Gravekeeper)!
_2111.CompletionSummary: Ah, peace will finally return to the Cemetery Forest...

_2112.Title: Silent Forest
_2112.Description: I have the results from the analysis of Meramons, Goblimons and Soulmon. The culprit is the Ogremons. I am told that the Ogremon Hideout is to the northeast. Ogremon... Ogremon...
_2112.Objective: Ogremon's base is located east from here
_2112.CompletionText: Have you found the hideout yet?
_2112.CompletionSummary: So? What were the Ogremons doing? What? You are not sure? Did you just glance at them or something?

_2113.Title: Silent Forest
_2113.Description:
So, we have our culprit, then! The reasons that Meramons, Goblimons, Sharmamons and Soulmon have been enraged is all because of Ogremons.
Go! Make sure they can never do this ever again!
_2113.CompletionSummary: There's a lot more of them than we thought, I see...

_2114.Title: Wanted
_2114.CompletionText: Have you ever fought a captain-class Ogremon?
_2114.CompletionSummary: I can see hope for the Digital World.

_2115.Title: [Atrribute Quest]
_2115.Description: *ring ring* Ah, you're here! At the southernmost edges of the Silent Forest, there is a small beach. There are Digimons that protect the area, but go fight them and bring me some water you will need in this container. We are looking for water this time! Go and collect some water items.
_2115.CompletionText: Have you fought Water Digimons yet?
_2115.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2116.Title: Silent Forest
_2116.Description: Yes, yes, yes. Well done. A comrade of mine is patrolling Battle Forest to the southeast. Tell him about our situation here and see how he's doing over there.
_2116.CompletionText: Haven't you found Leomon yet? He is patrolling Battle Forest.
_2116.CompletionSummary: I see. That's what's been happening in the Dark Forest.

_2117.Title: Silent Forest
_2117.Description:
Yes, yes, yes. Well done. We have real Black Cogwheels from Ogremons. We will have use for them later, so keep them safe.
I will write a letter. Take it to the Leomon who's on a patrol duty to the southeast.
_2117.Objective: Speak with Leomon at Battle Forest
_2117.ObjectiveProgress: Speak with Leomon at Battle Forest
_2117.CompletionText: Go southeast. You will see a path that leads to Battle Forest.

_2118.Title: Silent Forest
_2118.Description:
Yes. I am Leomon. I'm patrolling these woods. Monzaemons are wreaking havoc, blocking the way to the Ruins. If we don't suppress them, we have no access to the Ruins.
Go and suppress those Monzaemons!
_2118.CompletionSummary: The path is opening up. The way to the Ruins is opening up!

_2119.Title: Silent Forest
_2119.Description: Yes, I really AM Leomon. Quick clicking me, already! Now, a new chapter is beginning. Onward to the Ruins! When you get to the Ruins, check out the Fruit Forest. Someone will be welcoming you with arms wide open.
_2119.CompletionText: Don't you know how to get there?
_2119.CompletionSummary: Welcome to the Ruins - where you can encounter the living history of the Digital World. I would like to throw you a big welcome party, but we have trouble brewing here. You probably know this already, but I think what they call 'Black Cogwheels' are cau

_2120.Title: Silent Forest
_2120.Description:
Go to the Silent forest and defeat Meramon (Raid) the Lord of Fire!
Until then, peace will not be restored to the Silent Forest.
_2120.CompletionText: Meramon (Raid) is incredibly powerful, isn't he?

_2121.Title: Silent Forest
_2121.Description: Slay Ogremon (Raid). He is scheming something at the Ogremon Hideout. Slay him and I will give you a gift!
_2121.CompletionSummary: Great work. This will come in handy someday... Keep it safe until then.

_2122.Title: Silent Forest
_2122.Description: It's hot... I can't pass through here. It's too hot with Meramons around. Create a pathway for me, would you? Pretty please?
_2122.CompletionText: I said get rid of those fiery Meramons!
_2122.CompletionSummary: Thank you ever so much! Gotsumon! Hey, Gotsumon!! Where are you?!

_2123.Title: Silent Forest
_2123.Description:
I am looking for a friend of mine. A while ago, there was an earthquake on the File Island. The ground split, separating me and my friend, Gotsumon.
I haven't been able to find him since. Could you find my friend for me? If you do find him, give him this letter. He will know that I am well.

_2124.Title: Silent Forest
_2124.Description:
Let's see.. Gotsumon... Ah! I think I saw him north of here.
It looks like Sharmamons have taken over the pathway, though. Anyway, my guess is that Gotsumon is near the Shadow Forest to the north.
_2124.Objective: Speak with Gotsumon in Dark Shadow Forest

_2125.Title: Silent Forest
_2125.Description: I can't leave the Black Shadow Forest because Sharmamons and Goblimons are blocking the way. Get rid of them so I can get out of here.
_2125.CompletionText: Are you afraid of them, too?
_2125.CompletionSummary: Wow, thank you! Shall we leave this place, then?

_2126.Title: Silent Forest
_2126.Description: I'm doing well. I was investigating the strange energy in the Silent Forest. I plan on heading over to the Ogremon Hideout. Now, would you do me a favor and give this letter to my friend, Pumpkinmon?
_2126.CompletionSummary:
So, Gotsumon is safe...
But... the Ogremon Hideout is just around here.

_2127.Title: Silent Forest
_2127.Description:
Why would Gotsumon want to go to the Ogremon Hideout? What in the Digital World is happening in the Silent Forest?
I will have to do some investigative work of my own, then. Let's look around near the Ogremon Hideout.
_2127.CompletionSummary: Ah-ha! Now I see what's happening here.

_2128.Title: Silent Forest
_2128.Description:
I found Gotsumon's tracks while I was exploring the Ogremon region. It is clear that Gotsumon is in the Ogremon Hideout!
Go and find Gotsumon for me!
_2128.CompletionText: You will probably find him near the Ogremon Hideout.
_2128.CompletionSummary: All this time, he was not too far away... Thank you, friend.

_2129.Title: Silent Forest
_2129.CompletionSummary: Awesome! Let me give you something amazing as a reward!

_2130.Title: Wanted
_2130.CompletionText: Have you ever fought a captain-class Goblimon?
_2130.CompletionSummary: I can see hope for the Digital World.

_2131.Title: Wanted
_2131.CompletionText: Have you ever fought a captain-class Sharmamon?
_2131.CompletionSummary: I can see hope for the Digital World.

_2132.Title: [Atrribute Quest]
_2132.Description:
*ring ring* Ah, you're here! I can feel the chill from Bakemons...
We are looking for Ice this time! Go and collect Ice attribute items from Bakemons. Hehe.
_2132.Objective: Collect Ice Attribute Item from Gothmon
_2132.CompletionText: Have you fought Ice Digimons yet?
_2132.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2133.Title: Wanted
_2133.CompletionText: Have you ever fought a captain-class Monzaemon?
_2133.CompletionSummary: I can see hope for the Digital World.

_2134.Title: Silent Forest
_2134.Description:
Meramons are growing too quickly in their number. We need to slow down the growth of DemiMeramons. Slay DemiMeramons and bring me their Growth Plates.
They are hard to get, so take your time with this quest.

_2135.Title: Silent Forest
_2135.Description:
Is it just me or are we seeing visions of Devimon?
If you can see the vision, too, go and slay that phantom!
_2135.CompletionText: I said get rid of those Devimons (Phantom)!

_2136.Title: Silent Forest
_2136.Description: Soulmons have appeared at the Cemetery Forest pretending to be the gravekeepers. Go and slay those fakes.
_2136.CompletionText: I said get rid of those Soulmons (Gravekeeper)!

_2137.Title: Silent Forest
_2137.Description:
WaruMonzaemons have appeared in the Battle Forest and are causing trouble.
The Battle Forest is a sacred place. Go and take care of the WaruMonzaemons.
_2137.CompletionText: I said get rid of those WaruMonzaemons (Troublemaker)!

_2138.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2138.Description:
Yes. Since he gained power with the Black Cogwheels, Monochromon has been gathering evil friends.
One of them is Argomon (Ultimate). He's more of an underling than a friend, though.
We're almost there. Please, finish strong as we strive to restore peace to the File Island Waterfront.
_2138.CompletionSummary: Hmm... You just might be able to take on Monochromon...

_2139.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2139.Description:
There is another Digimon that is ruining this place - GrandisKuwagamons...
Only a select few GrandKuwagamons can evolve into them. I'm not sure how they came to take on such a form, though.
No matter. They are enemies right now. Slay them and let's work to undo Devimon's evil schemes.
_2139.CompletionText: They are not that easy to take on, are they?
_2139.CompletionSummary: You are very powerful. I guess they weren't kidding when they said that you took care of problems on the beach and the forest.

_2140.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2140.Description:
You probably heard about the Mark of Devimon from Greymon on the way here.
The Digimons close to the cliff here on the rock mountain carry the White Mark of Devimon. I hear it is more powerful than the black counterpart.
You can't hope to prevail against Devimon without any preparation. You need to analyze him thoroughly before you take him on.
If you come across the White Mark of Devimon on <Argomons (Ultimate)>, <PileVolcamons> and <GrandisKuwagamons>, will you bring it to me?
_2140.CompletionText: Do you have the White Mark of Devimon?
_2140.CompletionSummary: So, these are the marks. The showdown is not too far away.

_2141.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2141.Description:
How are you enjoying your travels on the File Island Waterfront? This is a beautiful place, but we've been having lots of problems lately.
The File Island Waterfront used to be a place where White Five-Leaf Clovers grew.
Do you have White Five-Leaf Clovers where you are from, Tamer?
When the evil Digimons arrived here, they began to pick the clovers one by one.
As you fight the Digimons on the Waterfront, you will find <White Five-Leaf Clovers>. They are rare, though.
Collect them and bring them to me. I will give you my cherished <Green Clover of Luck>.
_2141.CompletionText: Did you find any White Five-Leaf Clovers?
_2141.CompletionSummary: Wow. It's been so long since I last saw one. You can turn them in again and again, so feel free to stop by anytime!

_2142.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2142.Description:
This place is called the <Scattered Memory>.
I don't know the details, but, from what I know, Monochromon fought Devimon on top of that cliff over there. There, he was brainwashed with the Black Cogwheels.
Monochromon resisted as hard as he could.
In that chaos, Monochromon fell to the bottom of the cliff.
When he fell, he became unconscious and eventually succumbed to the Black Cogwheel.
...............................................
Since then, Leomon who lives at the top of the rock mountain has turned this place into training grounds.
He hopes to use this place to recover the scattered memory.
Use these Shining Pebble at the <Scattered Memory>. Three Monochromons will appear.
They will each have different health and attack power. Defeat them all and return to me. I will give you a big gift.
If you want to join the training, you will need <White Five-Leaf Clovers>.
Monochromons that appear here are very powerful. You will need the help of other Tamers.
_2142.Objective: Turn in 5 <White Five-Leaf Clover> for a <Shining Pebble - Monochromon>.
_2142.CompletionText: Did you take care of them? If it's too much on your own, be sure to bring other Tamers with you.
_2142.CompletionSummary:
Wow. You are so powerful! I didn't think you would actually make it.
Continue your training, Tamer, and protect the peace on the File Island.
You can keep training, but you can only receive the rewards once a day. You can receive the reward through t

_2143.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2143.Description:
I trust that you've heard about this place?
The fight against Monochromons will be difficult, but don't give up!
You can receive the rewards from the fight only once a day.
Of course, you can find a variety of precious items on the Monochromons themselves.
It will be a very difficult fight on your own, so be sure to bring friends with you.
--------------------------- Now, let me tell you how to enter the fight.
Use a <Shining Pebble - Monochromon> at the 'Scattered Memory' and three Monochromons will appear.
Top 15 Tamers will receive 'Green', 'Red', and 'White' Four-Leaf Clovers when you defeat them.
Bring me the mark of the fight, Three-Leaf Clovers, and I will give you the promised reward.
Each Monochromon will give you clovers of different colors depending on his name.
Sharp Horn - Green Four-Leaf Clover Thick Tail - Red Four-Leaf Clover Giant Paw - White Four-Leaf Clover
You have to collect all three. Good luck!
_2143.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Green Four-Leaf Clover%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Red Four-Leaf Clover%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3White Four-Leaf Clover%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2143.CompletionSummary:
You are amazing, Tamer.
At this rate, it will be a matter of time before you defeat Devimon and restore peace to the File Island. Well done!

_2144.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2144.Description:
Around the Giromon (Forest Destroyer), you will find the smaller Giromons (Dismantler).
Giromons (Dismantler) have dismantled the small wooden houses nearby.
They should have the remains on them. Will you find them for me? We have a rather talented Palmon around here. He might be able to do something with it.
There are three types of remains - <Cloth Fragments>, <Wooden Pieces> and <Broken Bolts>. Bring them to me.
_2144.Objective: Collect Cloth Fragments, Wooden Pieces and Broken Bolts from Giromons (Defuser).
_2144.CompletionText: They don't carry those saws just for show.
_2144.CompletionSummary: Ah, the remains... I am grateful and yet... sad. I will bring these to Palmon. I look forward to seeing you again.

_2145.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2145.Description:
Thank you for the material you gathered.
I'm not sure what he is creating exactly, but I think Palmon is making something that will cheer up all the Digimons who are depressed around here.
But Giromons (Dismantler) may appear at any time to destroy it. Will you go take care of those Giromons (Dismantler) and protect Palmon's plans?
_2145.CompletionText: Palmon is working really hard on whatever it is he is making.
_2145.CompletionSummary: Wow! With this, Palmon should be able to carry on with his research in peace. Thank you so much! Whenever it is done, I will be sure to invite you to come and see it! Thanks again!

_2146.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2146.Description:
Read the diary. And Greymon is waiting for you on top of that boulder over there.
----------------------------------- xx, xx, xxxx / Weather: clear / Place: File Island Waterfront
I get it now. I think I saw that Digimon when I saw the light. We were drawn to the light and came to this place. We had an amazing adventure.
Those eyes were piercing yet kind. That Digimon, he protected us then and he is protecting us now.
I'm not looking forward to leaving my friends that I made here. I will never be able to forget them. When I return home, is it at all possible to take my friends with me?
... How did the 'Chosen Ones' who came before me deal with this? ------------------------------------
_2146.CompletionSummary:
We meet again... ...............
I missed you.

_2147.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2147.Description:
Shh! Careful!
*looks around*
Okay, I think we are clear.
I saw him. I saw the Phantomon standing there on the Waterfront and then just vanishing.
You see him ever so seldom, but I definitely saw him.
He'll vanish one moment, and then just appear again the next.
If you happen to come across Phantomons, be careful. If you see them, please drive them out. They are making other Digimons nervous.
Also, tell me later how often you see one, and how many of them there are on the Waterfront.
Shh! Careful!
_2147.CompletionSummary:
Hmm... So, you are saying there there are about three Phantomons in total on the File Island Waterfront, and one appears every hour or so, right?
Where do they appear? .......... ..........
The place of their appearance is the most important thing!
..

_2148.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2148.Description: My heart pounds... And the world is a beautiful place once again. Love has come to life again at last. The moment I laid my eyes on her, I knew it. Wait... Where are you going? Hear me out. Don't you think it's rude to just take off without asking who it is or what makes her so charming? It is none other than her royal majesty, the QueenChessmon (Royal). Is she different from the other QueenChessmons? Of course! Listen. The aura that gently rises from the bottom. The way she doesn't even cast a glance on the Cherubimons surrounding her. And the sheer size - she could embrace the entire world! She is my life! But she is too difficult to approach... Call it a royal charm. But I have a plan. Go and beat her up just a little bit. When she's feeling down, I will come and comfort her. That is your assignment! Go and be my Cupid. Don't go too hard on her. But keep her pride intact - get beaten up every now and then. If you leave a scar, though, you are a dead human, ya hear me?!
_2148.CompletionSummary: Great work! You didn't leave a scar anywhere, did you? All right. It's my turn now. Fantastic job, my friend. I hope love finds you soon, too!

_2149.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2149.Description:
...
Thank you.
I can't thank you enough.
I won't say much.
Defeat Devimon.
Keep this 'Monochromon's Mark'. You will need it when you enter the Infinite Mountain Dungeon.
_2149.CompletionSummary:
Devimon is powerful. You will need to be prepared.
You have come across many enemies on your travels. Silver Lake, the Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, the Waterfront...
But Devimon is more powerful than any of them. But don't lose your courage.

_2150.Title: File Island Waterfront
_2150.Description:
I haven't given up hope of speaking with Monochromon yet. I want to see him return to his old, kind self.
But he is not willing to talk. Is there really no other way but to use force? The root of this problem lies in the Black Cogwheels on him, so the best way to go about this is to pull them out.
Pull out the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon and help the File Island Waterfront return to its former glory!
_2150.CompletionText: Did you remove the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon?
_2150.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. Thank you so much. You really removed the Black Cogwheels off of Monochromon.
The File Island Waterfront will be restored now. With Monochromon's love for the mountains and the forest, I am sure we can make the Waterfront even more beautifu

_2151.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2151.Description:
This is a certificate that allows you to visit Qinglongmon's place, bu all I can give you for free is two a day.
If you need more of them, bring me @<tc:900>100 <Energy of Thunder God> which you can find from the monsters of <Digimon Maze>@</tc>. Once you do that, I'll exchange extra pass for those materials.
Keep up the good work then!
_2151.CompletionText: Let's go to Qinglongmon and get this problem solved!
_2151.CompletionSummary: What else could we do now?

_2152.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2152.Description: Qinglongmon may have been watching us from the first trial we've went through. This may be a chance…! Qinglongmon should be aware of your faith and courage! There was a request from Qinglongmon for you to visit him, so would you like to pay a visit?
_2152.Objective:
<Descending Thunder God>
Defeat Antylamon Defeat Mihiramon Defeat Majiramon Defeat Qinglongmon
_2152.CompletionSummary: Qinglongmon told me that he was impressed with your skills. He also said that he has confirmed your faith and courage, so he could rely on you for the peace of Digital World and Real World!! This is such a good news..! You're truly worth becoming a hero!

_2153.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2153.Description:
This is a certificate that allows you to visit Baihumon's place, but all I can give you for free is two a day.
If you think you need more of them, bring me @<tc:900>50 <Energy of Steel> which you can find from the monsters of <Server Continent Desert> or <Server Continent Canyon>@</tc>. If you do that, I'll exchange them to an extra pass.
Keep up the good work then!
_2153.CompletionText: I hope Baihumon can help us soon.
_2153.CompletionSummary: What else is there for us to help?

_2154.Title: [Atrribute Quest]
_2154.Description:
The second elemental relationship you will learn is Darkness against Electricity.
Darkness is powerful against Electricity. Inside the emptiness of darkness, there is nothing electricity can do.
Go and fight some SkullSatamons in the area. They have the Electricity attribute.
If you pit a Darkness Digimon against them like I told you, you will be able to defeat them more quickly and with greater ease.
_2154.Objective: Defeat nearby SkullSatamons, the Electricity Digimons.
_2154.CompletionText: Have you fought against SkullSatamons, the Electricity Digimons?
_2154.CompletionSummary: Wow! You are a quick learner. This will help you greatly in your adventure throughout the Digital World.

_2155.Title: <Christmas Event>
_2155.Summary: Blue Hat x100=Mystery Reinforced Mercenary DigiEgg
_2155.Description:
Hahaha! Merry Christmas! This year's Christmas has come near!!
Why don't you exchange your precious 100 Blue Hats with 2012 Christmas Mercenary DigiEgg?
Scan <Merry Christmas Box> that monsters drop to collect the hats!
Check 2012 Christmas Mercenary DigiEgg Item List!
Impmon DigiEgg-Level 4[Ultimate] Impmon DigiEgg-Level 5[Champion]
Ryudamon DigiEgg-Level 4[Ultimate] Ryudamon DigiEgg-Level 5[Champion]

Dracomon DigiEgg-Level 4[Ultimate](Green) Dracomon DigiEgg-Level 5[Champion](Green)

Arkadimon DigiEgg-Level 4[Ultimate] Arkadimon DigiEgg-Level 5[Champion]
Seedmon DigiEgg-Level 4 Seedmon DigiEgg-Level 5
_2155.CompletionSummary: Thank you for bringing such precious hats! Wish all your works succeed and have very nice Christmas! Hahaha!

_2158.Description:
Hahaha! Merry Christmas! This year's Christmas has come near!!

_2162.Title: Event
_2162.Description: So you want to hear about the story? Hear me out, this is what happened. There's a place which resembles village of the beginning, but of another dimension over a wall of fire. By investigating that place, I came to conclusion that Apocalymon is behind. I couldn't stop the path from opening, but fortunately I managed to relocate the fire wall before Apocalymon arrive. However, now there is another problem. Apocalymon's mind has been embodied, went through the fire wall, splited in to pieces and scattered all over that place, blocking me from approaching. I'm upset that I can't continue by investigation, but I think this is my dead end, so I'll just stop it and report to DATS Center. Since you've helped me so far, I'll give you this teleporter. But I want you to be extremely careful with it.
_2162.CompletionText: Even though Apocalymon couldn't get through, his mind has created evil beings that got in and they're quite horrifying! I've managed to arrange the fire wall to stop Apocalymon himself, so you don't have to worry about him though.
_2162.CompletionSummary: I really don't recommend you to go there, since I know how danger the place is. I don't want to put someone who helped me into great risk! And there are still lots of other cases to investigate!
_2162.ReservedText: Even though Apocalymon couldn't get through, his mind has created evil beings that got in and they're quite horrifying! I've managed to arrange the fire wall to stop Apocalymon himself, so you don't have to worry about him though.

_2163.Title: Event
_2163.Summary: [Repeat] Something that will bring my attention
_2163.Description: I'm Omegamon of the Royal Knights. What made you come to me? I apologize if you just came here for a chat. But if you have a purpose, you don't have to hide it from me.
_2163.CompletionText: Do you have something to show me?
_2163.CompletionSummary: What's this? It seems like some kind of virus data, but I haven't seen this type yet. Can you bring me more of these, tamer? If you do, I'll reward you this emblem.

_2164.Title: Event
_2164.Description: Hehehe. Can you say hello to my good old pals for me? Please say hello to them and tell them I'm fine.
_2164.Objective: Wind Valley Jijimon Silent Forest Jijimon Lost Historic Jijimon
_2164.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2164.CompletionText: Do you remember all the locations?
_2164.CompletionSummary: Great, I guess you've done very well on delivering my message to them. Take this gift as my appreciation.
_2164.ReservedText: Oh, you've came a long way to say hello. How impressive! I'm doing just fine, and please say hi to him too.

_2165.Title: Event
_2165.Description: Valentine's Day is getting very close… But I haven't finished making all the chocolates I need. Can you help me with preparing the ingredients? If you do, I'll give you some of the already made chocolates!
_2165.CompletionText: I just need cacao and milk, don't worry about the others.
_2165.CompletionSummary: Thanks for getting me the ingredients! Look! Here's the completed chocolate. I hope you like it.

_2166.Title: Event
_2166.Description: Greetings! Are you planning for a hopeful new year today? If you do, what about trying some fireworks? It is believed that fireworks can bring you a great fortune for the whole year. I can give you these for free now and some more when you visit again tomorrow~!
_2166.CompletionText: Don't you get curious of how the fireworks will look like?
_2166.CompletionSummary: Don't forget to come by again tomorrow and take the fireworks!!
_2166.ReservedText: Don't you get curious of how the fireworks will look like?

_2167.Title: Event
_2167.Description: You seem to be questioning why is it so freezing cold than usual? The temperature has dropped down because Yukidarumon has taken away the Red Flower of Warmth. It's the only thing to keep us warm in winter, so it must be returned. If you happen to find Yukidarumon, please take the flower back for us.
_2167.CompletionText: This flower is like a bonfire.
_2167.CompletionSummary: Finally, we have the Red Flower of Warmth again. This flower will fade away the coldness. Thank you!

_2168.Title: Event
_2168.Summary: [Daily] Challenge against the Lord of Pride
_2168.Description: I think it's time for your next challenge. The next opponent will be the Lord of Pride, Paradise of Loss, Lucemon. It should be your last opponent among the Seven Great Demon Lords. The true aspects of Lucemon is Lucemon Falldown Mode. If you succeed on defeating his first form, I'll give you the challenge scroll.
_2168.CompletionText: Consider this mission as your training.
_2168.CompletionSummary: Good. I'll give you the challenge scroll. When you wish to see stronger Lucemon Falldown Mode, go to Digitamamon and exchange it for higher level challenge scroll.

_2169.Title: Event
_2169.Summary: [Daily] Challenge against the Lord of Envy
_2169.Description: Welcome back, tamer. I've been expecting you. This time, your opponent will be the lord of envy, also known as the Abyss of Despair among the Seven Great Demon Lords. Syakomons are the minions of Leviamon. When you succeed on defeating them, I'll give you the challenge scroll.
_2169.CompletionText: Syakomon is in form of a giant clam, so it won't be so difficult to spot them.
_2169.CompletionSummary: Good. I'll give you the challenge scroll. When you wish to see stronger Leviamon, go to Digitamamon and exchange it for higher level challenge scroll.

_2170.Title: Event
_2170.Description: I can sense that suspicious beings have appeared.. It doesn't feel like they are that powerful, however, I'm suspecting that this is somewhat foreshadowing our jeopardized future. Then all we can do is completely eradicate the origin of all possible harms. Take care of those Bakemons of the Real World, Chimeramons of Western areas, Yukidarumons of Glacier areas and Devimons of File Island areas right now. According to the reports, they appear to roam around in random places of the stated areas, so don't forget to search for them yourself before you can start doing whatever you must do.
_2170.Objective: Defeat 'Bakemon', Real World Defeat 'Chimeramon', Western Defeat 'Yukidarumon', Glacier Defeat 'Devimon', File Island
_2170.CompletionText: Did you successfully handle all of them?
_2170.CompletionSummary: These guys seem like they appear every single day, so it looks like I might have to call you up again. Take this certificate for now.

_2171.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2171.Description: Ah, that ugly looking Digimon again? I don't really feel like looking his face anymore culu~ By the way, not only his looks are bizarre, but he may be able to mentally evolute in an unordinary way.
_2171.CompletionText: What? I don't feel like telling you an advice now, culu!
_2171.CompletionSummary: Haha, still hanging around with that worthless looking Digimon?
_2171.ReservedText: Are you asking me about evoultion? Never! I’m not going to tell you culu~! This Digimon will turn into a terrifying creature when he evolves!

_2172.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2172.Description:
Did you say that Chimairamon can evolute into a total different form? That's an interesting story.
Chimairamon is a creation of various data mixture, so fusing with another Digimon's soul should be possible.
So why don't you do a favor on researching the Digimon's soul? Bakemon in the graveyard of Silent Forest should be a good subject.
_2172.CompletionText: Why don't you make yourself useful? Bakemons won't donate their data to you by themselves, so you know what to do now, don't you?
_2172.CompletionSummary: I can see that its rebirth is near… You've done well… for your level.

_2173.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2173.Summary: Collecting Enormous and Evil Mind Data
_2173.Description:
Huh… I've already tried with injecting Bakemon's data, but the result wasn't so satisfying, because that Digimon is weak!
Which means it requires data from a larger and more psychic subject.
How about Monodramon wandering in the Silent Forest? Collect Monodramon's Mind Data and bring it to me. I think the result will be more interesting this time.
_2173.CompletionText: Go and collect some data. What's so difficult about that?
_2173.CompletionSummary: Good. It's getting more closer now… Impressive!

_2174.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2174.Description:
Ha! So you were… still remaining here? Injecting the mind data to Chimairamon succeeded this time and it created an enormous psychic Digimon.
But unfortunately, this worthless creature did not obey to me and left this place!! It seem to be heading Distorted Data Village, but a creature who cannot obey to its master is still worthless!
_2174.CompletionText: Digimon who does not obey to its master? How worthless! I don't really care about worthless beings!
_2174.CompletionSummary: I've sensed energy of great evil from the direction of Distorted Data Village. It disappeared soon though.

_2175.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2175.Description: What? You're telling me that the creature that appeared in Distorted Data Village was a substantiation of Millenniumon?
_2175.CompletionText: MoonMillenniumon is known to be extremely dangerous, so you should better watch out!
_2175.CompletionSummary: Ah, I'm not sure if this is the right thing I'm doing…
_2175.ReservedText: I was expecting from the beginning that it will turn out be MoonMillenniumon after the evolution from that weird psychic Digimon... Looks like I cannot stop it, culu! So I'll tell you about the evolution, culu!

_2176.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2176.Description: Are you still hanging around with that evil Digimon? I can't understand… culu!
_2176.CompletionText: No, I'm not going to tell you how he evolutes, culu!
_2176.CompletionSummary: The Digimon beside you… It can be reborn into an enormous Digimon by an extraordinary method.
_2176.ReservedText: It's unusual that you're out of trouble with that Digimon. Are you asking me about his new method of evolution? I don't think I'm going to tell you that, culu!

_2177.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2177.Description:
The Digimon beside you… It can be reborn into an enormous Digimon by an extraordinary method.
So, you should be eager to discover that method by now?
If you want to figure it out, you should collect some more information to complete this evolution.
Cerberumon from the Digimon Maze Enterance has the key to this information, so go and get it!
_2177.CompletionText: I'd be more careful if I were you. Not to be driven to hell if that's the case… (chuckles)
_2177.CompletionSummary: Good! That'll be enough of Cerberumon's Data.

_2178.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2178.Description:
Hahaha… finally, the invisible psychic data will complete this experiment. It is certain that Cherubimon (evil) possess this data.
Go and extract psychic data from Cherubimon (evil), as much as you can!
_2178.CompletionText: I'm sure that Cherubimon (evil) has the required data. Any better ideas? If not, you should be listening to me.
_2178.CompletionSummary: Hahaha… that's very nice… and satisfying indeed… Fusing the psychic data of Cherubimon (evil) and that Digimon will make a very interesting result! Haha…

_2179.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2179.Description:
Oh my gosh!! Did I just made a mistake? Unbelievable! Wha... What are you still doing here? I thougth you were leaving.
Are you asking what I'm doing now? I'm glad you asked. The numeric value of result made by Digimon and mind data fusion was much greater than I first expected.
However, that result has already gone to Distorted Data Village.
_2179.CompletionText: It's gone to Distorted Data Village. Isn't that enough information for you? You're on your own now!
_2179.CompletionSummary: Gees! So you've done it… that creature… What? You defeated him already, culu?

_2180.Title: Jogress [MoonMillenniumon]
_2180.Description: What? You're telling me that the creature that appeared in Distorted Data Village was a substantiation of Millenniumon?
_2180.CompletionText: MoonMillenniumon is known to be extremely dangerous, so you should better watch out!
_2180.CompletionSummary: Ah, I'm not sure if this is the right thing I'm doing…
_2180.ReservedText: I was expecting from the beginning that it will turn out be MoonMillenniumon after the evolution from that weird psychic Digimon... Looks like I cannot stop it, culu! So I'll tell you about the evolution, culu!

_2181.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2181.Description:
This is a certificate that allows you to visit Qinglongmon's place, bu all I can give you for free is two a day.
If you need more of them, bring me @<tc:900>50 <Energy of Thunder God> which you can find from the monsters of <Digimon Maze>@</tc>. Once you do that, I'll exchange extra pass for those materials.
Keep up the good work then!
_2181.CompletionText: Let's go to Qinglongmon and get this problem solved!
_2181.CompletionSummary: What else could we do now?

_2182.Title: <Shadow Labyrinth Dungeon>
_2182.Description: This is the map that can guide you to the Shadow Labyrinth. I can give you 2 of them a day. It will be vanished whether you use it or not, so make your decisions quick.
_2182.CompletionSummary: The evil energy is known to be strong enough to destroy the balance of Real World.

_2183.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2183.Description: We have a serious situation here. Fanglongmon has been sealed and isolated underground in the Descending Thunder God area. We sence a wave of force flowing out of that place and it seems to be growing. I hope it's not too late.
_2183.CompletionText: Fanglongmon must have broke free from the seal.
_2183.CompletionSummary: With the help of Four Holy Beasts, Fanglongmon is no more angry now. He said he will not interfere now, giving us a chance. Thanks. And you've done a great job of getting over all the trials. You're truly a hero after all!

_2184.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2184.Description:
You'll need the pass to go through the boundaries of Fanglongmon. I can give you only 2 of them per day.
If you need more, bring me @<tc:900>100 Yin and Yang Spirits from monsters of <Verdandi Terminal>@</tc>. Once you do that, I'll make you extra passes.
Do your best and never give up!
_2184.CompletionSummary: Is there anything else we could do?

_2185.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2185.Description:
I'll give you @<tc:900>3 Scar of Water Crystal [Hard] pass cards a day.@</tc> Please use it to protect the Real World.
This place is overwhelmed by the powers of Xuanwumon. For protection, you'll need @<tc:900>30 Scar Essence from monsters of <Ice Area>@</tc>. Bring them to me
_2185.CompletionSummary: Cheer up. Nobody can finish it except you.

_2186.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2186.Description:
I can give you @<tc:900>3 Passes [Uprising Flame] [Hard] a day@</tc>. Please help us save the Real World.
This place is overwhelmed by power of Zhuqiaomon who became much stronger than before. You'll need protection, so bring me @<tc:900>30 Pieces [Uprising Flame] that can be found from monsters of <File Island>@</tc> area.
_2186.CompletionSummary: Great! You'll be able to get in there now. Be safe!

_2187.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2187.Description:
I'll give you @<tc:900>3 passes for Trace of Black Steel [Hard] a day@</tc>. Please use them to protect the Real World.
This place became overwhelmed by Baihumon's massive power and it is much stronger than before. Please bring me @<tc:900>30 Energy of Steel which can be found from monsters in <Server Continent> area@</tc> and I'll make you a proper protection.
_2187.CompletionSummary: Here are the passes. Take care.

_2188.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2188.Description:
I can give you @<tc:900>3 Passes [Descending Thunder God] [Hard]@</tc> a day. Please use it for the purpose of saving the Real World.
The place is overwhelmed by Qinglongmon's power, so you'll need a proper protection when you get in there. Please bring me @<tc:900>30 <Energy of Thunder God> which you cand find from the monsters of <Digimon Maze>@</tc>, and I'll make you the protection.
_2188.CompletionSummary: Here you have it now. Take good care of yourself.

_2189.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_2189.Description:
You'll need the pass to go through the boundaries of Fanglongmon. I can give you only 2 of them per day.
If you need more, bring me @<tc:900>50 Yin and Yang Spirits from monsters of <Verdandi Terminal>@</tc>. Once you do that, I'll make you extra passes.
Do your best and never give up!
_2189.CompletionSummary: Is there anything else we could do?

_2190.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2190.Description: It's been a while for you to be here, since your last mission. Anyway, now I want you to investigate a place. It's about a new area we recently discovered. Agent Miki has been sent there earlier, but she told us that the wild Digimons there are too tough to deal with alone. This is why I'm asking you to continue the investigation. Further instructions will be delivered by Digivice.
_2190.CompletionText: Unfortunately, there's not much information about the new area yet. You'll be able to reach Verdandi Terminal from the D-Terminal.

_2191.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2191.Description: It's good to see you again here, as I was needing some serious backup. The wild Digimons in this place are too strong, so I couldn't make any progress. We should find a safe zone, to send research data to DATS Center without any mistake. First, please defeat Leomons in the path, so we can move on.
_2191.CompletionText: Did you face Leomons? They seemed to be insane.
_2191.CompletionSummary: Good…! You're the most reliable member of DATS.

_2192.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2192.Description: Both of them needs treatment. Dorumon doesn't seem to be injured badly, but stressed out. So please calm him down first, and cure him with the first-aid kit. I'll take care of Leomon.
_2192.CompletionText: It's not me who needs healing. Talk to Dorumon.

_2193.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2193.Description: Are you a companion of the human who healed me? I appreciate your help, but you don't have to worry about me now. Please take care of Dorumon first.
_2193.CompletionSummary: I have a bad feeling about this…
_2193.ReservedText: Looks like he just drew his last breath.

_2194.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2194.Description: I've heard about overall circumstances of the area from agent Miki. The Dorumon which you're protecting now will be very helpful in our investigation. So keep it away from danger surrounding you, and defeat any hostile Digimons that can become a threat.
_2194.CompletionText: Are you strong enough to resist and continue the mission?
_2194.CompletionSummary: Wow! You came back safely! I was worried. Commander always assign difficult duties!

_2195.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2195.Description: I can see that there are many incidents happening in this area. We have a lot of information to research. This place seems quite dangerous so we should be more careful when moving. Can you talk to Dorumon and see if there's anything we should be aware of?
_2195.CompletionSummary: I don't know much about this place.
_2195.ReservedText: This place? I really don't know. I don't even remember how I got here. All I know is that the Digimons here tries to steal each other's core and survive. I don't know what exactly they are after, but some of them were chasing and attacking me.

_2196.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2196.Description: Seems like he's not a native of this place! Then I guess we should patrol the place ourselves. I'll take Dorumon with me to a safer place. Please continue the investigation meanwhile.
_2196.Objective: Take picture Leomon Attach Transmitter to Leomon Take picture Kunemon Attach Transmitter to Kunemon
_2196.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Take picture Leomon(Insane)%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Attach Mini Transmitter to Leomon(Insane)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Take picture Kunemon(Evolved)%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Attach Mini Transmitter to Kunemon(Evolved)%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2196.CompletionText: Do not hesitate! We don't have much time.

_2197.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2197.Description: I think this is very strange. Leomons here seems to be much stronger than we know. Leomon is a Champion form Digimon, but Leomon's in this place are strong and fights like a Mega form Digimon. It needs more research! Take this scanner with you and use it on any one of them. Take them down when necessary.
_2197.Objective: Defeat Leomon(Insane) Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
_2197.CompletionText: I know you're working hard. Just keep it up!
_2197.CompletionSummary: Information sending is successfully completed. Great!

_2198.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2198.Description: The headquarters is analysing the research data sent through the scanner, but there seems to be not much progress yet. If we send more data, it should be helpful.
_2198.Objective: Defeat Leomon(Insane) Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
_2198.CompletionText: This is a Commander's request, so it must be something important.

_2199.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2199.Description: I've been searching all over the area but this whole place is packed with danger! So I decided to change my mind. Let's clear a spot. Can you take care of Leomons and Kunemons nearby? When you drive some of them out here, this spot will become a safe zone.
_2199.CompletionText: I don't think I'll get used to this place!

_2200.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2200.Description: Nooooo!! It's still not over yet! I wonder where these guys are coming from, regardless of how many we've driven them out. It's really getting into my nerves! Please keep these Leomons and Kunemons out of this area.
_2200.CompletionText: I really hope to see the end of this madness!
_2200.CompletionSummary: Oh… yeah this should be good enough for now. Even though they may return again soon. Thanks!

_2201.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2201.Description: Dorumon was here but he disappeared all of a sudden! He's not fully recovered from the injury, so I'm worried. He was attacked before I met him, and this place is too dangerous for a Digimon to run around alone! Please help me find him! Please search the forest, while I search the other side.
_2201.Objective: Enter to Forest of Jungle Law
_2201.CompletionText: Damn it, where did he go to?

_2202.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2202.Description: Have you found Dorumon? What? He's being harassed by Mushmons? Oh my god! You don't have to ask me what to do! Just go help the poor guy!

_2203.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2203.Description:
Why are the Mushroomons being such nuisance? It's quite annoying!
Anyway, first thing's first! Please tell me when you find somewhere we can take rest.
_2203.CompletionText: Hmm… I couldn't find it… have you?
_2203.CompletionSummary: Great… that place is also dangerous as I thought! But it's same here, so we should keep moving!

_2204.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2204.Description:
Good News! I found a spot we can stay safe for a while! Can you bring Dorumon with you?
Just be careful on the way!
_2204.CompletionText: Don't forget to check your current location!

_2205.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2205.Description:
I've done nothing harm to others, but all these guys here are hostile against me. It's really painful to resist.
Is there a way out?
_2205.CompletionText: Sorry, but please leave me alone for a while.
_2205.CompletionSummary: All right, if you insist… I'll think about it.

_2206.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2206.Description:
Mushroomons here are much stronger than I used to know… It is really a mystery…
I think we should also investigate on them. How? Just like we did with Leomon!
I know it's a hard work for you, but please do me a favor. Thanks again!
_2206.Objective: Defeat Mushroomon(Violent) Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
_2206.CompletionText: This is getting really weird… First, it was Leomon, and now Mushroomon looks the same…
_2206.CompletionSummary: Excellent~! Now shall we start the analysis? Don't worry, I'll handle this!

_2207.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2207.Description:
As I was expecting, DATS Center requested me for more data.
So I think I should ask you for favor again. The data we need is from the Mushroomons.
_2207.Objective: Defeat Mushroomon(Violent) Use Digimon Scanner to Leomon(Insane)
_2207.CompletionText: You're doing great so far! Keep it up!
_2207.CompletionSummary: Great! I just sent the recent data and received a positive feedback from the headquarters! Thanks to you!

_2208.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2208.Description:
Data research is successfully completed as planned! So we can take some rest now. What? Are you asking me some more things to do?
Oh well… then how about a duty of bringing justice? Do you remember the Mushroomons that were harassing Dorumon? Use this condiment to teach them a lesson.
_2208.Objective: Use Strange Condiment to Mushroomon(Ill-tempered) Defeat Mushroomon(Ill-tempered)
_2208.CompletionText: How would the harassers feel when they are harassed themselves?
_2208.CompletionSummary: Have you seen the expressions on their faces? I feel much better now.

_2209.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2209.Description: There was a contact from the headquarters.
_2209.CompletionSummary: Hmm… what should I do? I was told that they're mutants.
_2209.ReservedText: I've heard from the headquarters of the research results. The Digicore is larger than normal and it means the Leomons here are not the Leomon we know, but mutants. Some kind of an unknown antibody is included in the core, which makes it larger than normal

_2210.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2210.Description:
Information we can get from scanning isn't much enough. So we should find some alternatives.
I think we should start collecting datas directly.
Please collect data from the Digimons in this forest regardless of their type!
_2210.CompletionText: This place is really weird… but let's bring peace here together!

_2211.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2211.Description:
There was another request from the headquarters. They are asking us again for more research data. I wonder why they don't ask us for correct amount at the first time (sighs).
Anyway, duty is duty, so let's get it done fast.
_2211.CompletionText: Have you collected the fragments enough already? Wow!
_2211.CompletionSummary: You're the best agent indeed, just as Mary told me. Great job!

_2212.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2212.Description: Since we've become used to this place, I think we should expand our research area. I'll be moving with Dorumon, so meanwhile, you can go ahead and patrol by your own pace. By any chance if you meet any human or Digimon possible to communicate, get all the information you can!
_2212.Objective: Enter to Waterfalls and forest Talk to ???
_2212.CompletionText: Look for the big waterfall ahead. It should be easy to find.

_2213.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2213.Description: I asked who you are first, and you are asking who am I? You're truly a weird human. I'm WarGreymon X, leader of Resistance, a group of wanderers in Verdandi Terminal.
_2213.CompletionText: I told you who I am. Now, it's your turn to introduce yourself.
_2213.CompletionSummary: Is that so? You've came long way just to investigate this place? All right, I get it now.

_2214.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2214.Description: This entire place is Verdandi Terminal. It's part of New Digital World that got ruined by X-Program. We have came so far escaping from the effect of X-Program, but still struggling to survive. Recently, there are some evil Digimons who are loitering and attacking younger generations that come from the Digital World, so we were having a hard time. Can you give me a hand on this? Kuwagamon will appear when you attack Kunemons.
_2214.CompletionText: I'm asking you a favor, human. You look strong enough to do this.
_2214.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! You've done it really fast! I can trust you now!

_2215.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2215.Description: Hello, human friend! If you have some time, can I ask you for another favor? I know you helped me last time, but there are still those evil Digimons doing the same thing! Please show them no mercy!
_2215.CompletionText: You're doing good job so far! Please continue to save the innoncent Digimons!
_2215.CompletionSummary: I appreciate your effort!! Your abilities are very impressive!

_2216.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2216.Summary: The Land of Jungle Law, Verdandi Terminal
_2216.Description: I guess you need some explanation of this place. This whole place Verdandi Terminal, is cursed by X-Program that spread to entire New Digital World by Yggdrasil. Only chosen Digimons could survive this hell-like place, but we Resistance are a group of unchosen Digimons who survived from this hell. All of us Resistance members are very desperate to survive, and still having a hard time. Will you listen to me for more stories?
_2216.CompletionSummary: I have one more favor to ask you.

_2217.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2217.Description: As I told you, we're group of Digimons that immigrated from Digital World. So we're unwelcomed guests in this world. This is why the chosen ones are aggressive against us, and try to get rid of us. What's worse is that, the Royal Knights is with the chosen ones and they're causing a lot of damage, even deaths. So we're trying to negotiate with the chosen ones recently. It'd be much better if you can help us with it. If we fail to negotiate, we may have to fight the Royal Knights. To be honest, we're risking our lives here.
_2217.CompletionSummary: You have no hesitation on my request! I greatly appreciate it!

_2218.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2218.Description: I really feel confident as you've become our reliable ally! However, the rest of my group don't seem to trust you. Regardless of my explanation, they still aren't changing. So I've thought of you earning their trust right away. It may be a tough task, but I'm certain that it's effective. There is GranKuwagamon in this forest, that appears in this forest. If you beat him and return, all of us must gain faith in you! GranKuwagamon will appear when you attack Kunemon, Kuwagamon, and Okuwamon in the forest.
_2218.Objective: Defeat Grandkuwagamon Collect Grandis kuwagamon's Horn
_2218.CompletionText: I know it's a very tough task. But at least I have faith in you that you can succeed!
_2218.CompletionSummary: I was totally right about this! You're truly astonishing!

_2219.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2219.Description:
Thank you! As you've proven yourself by bringing evidence showing your strength, everyone of us has expressed their trust on you and agreed to assign you as our representitive.
Now, it's time for us to go and negotiate with the chosen Digimons. We may find peace if it succeeds, but we should also consider fighting them when it fails.
We don't know what will happen, so get prepared. I'll lead you to the place.
_2219.Objective: Enter to Hidden forest between cliffs
_2219.CompletionText: You'll get to find the area in the way. I'll meet you there.

_2220.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2220.Description: When we arrive at the meeting place, there may be a lot of risks, and even chance to have difficulties on moving. So get prepared as much as you can before you leave. If you wish, you can go up ahead and check the situation first. I and the rest of Resistance will be there as all of us are completely ready. If you're ready, talk to me and tell me to send you to the meeting place.
_2220.CompletionSummary: Welcome. Are you ready to join us with the meeting?

_2221.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2221.Description:
We arrived here as planned, but the situation is not good.
The chosen Digimons don't seem to wanting to listen to us, but only getting in position to fight us. I guess we have no other choices than to fight back.
Let's show them that we can resist.
_2221.Objective: Defeat Apemon Defeat Blossomon Defeat Andromon
_2221.CompletionSummary: I wonder if they change their mind now.

_2222.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2222.Description: Now, shall we start the real negotiation with their real representatives?
_2222.CompletionText: Let's see how they would react.
_2222.CompletionSummary: Is there no way to persuade them?
_2222.ReservedText:
You're totally under a delusion. We have no intension to coexist with you, nor let you stay in this place! Because you're just a bunch of intruders that trespass our territory and broke the peace!
Get out of here! We have no intention to negotiate with y

_2223.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2223.Description:
Oh… so this is what happens now! Andromon declared war against us. This place is dangerous now!
Royal Knights will be here in any minute! Please buy us some time, so our members who cannot fight will escape.
_2223.CompletionText: Damn… the Royal Knights should be coming!
_2223.CompletionSummary: Here! Get yourself to somewhere safe! I'll take care of the Royal Knights now.

_2224.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2224.Description:
Did you leave the place? We're having combat nearby, so please take off at once.
I'll send you the coordinates, so please come! Hurry!

_2225.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2225.Description:
Oh… that's what happened so far? WarGreymon X, not only different from the looks but is much stronger than WarGreymon that we know of.
I could see that he can face Omegamon evenly! What is this place and how could this happen? A Mega form Digimon fighting a Jogress Digimon doesn't seem to make sence at all... Anyway, this isn't the issue now.
Dorumon was looking for you. He said that he has something important to discuss.
_2225.CompletionSummary: I have something to ask you.
_2225.ReservedText: Are you ok? You didn't hurt yourself?

_2226.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2226.Description:
I've made a friend through WarGreymon X. This friend has relied on me much, and is pretty young. By the time I first met him, was seriously injured.
I expect that he should be recovered by now, but I'm still curious of his current status!
_2226.CompletionText: I hope my friend is fine.
_2226.ReservedText: Oh, you must be the human WarGreymon X was talking about. You look strong as he told me.

_2227.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2227.Description:
WarGreymon X is safe. Tell him not to worry. The reason why he's not showing up is because he's still taking rest in the secret base.
By the way, I have something to ask you. As WarGreymon being injured badly and due to his vacancy, the tasks he's been doing were left out.
So if you don't mind, can you help with the tasks, before WarGreymon X is fully recovered?
_2227.CompletionText: I know it's not easy, but I beg you!
_2227.CompletionSummary: Thanks a lot! You're really strong as WarGreymon X told me.

_2228.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2228.Description: If you don't mind, there's a little more of unfinished duties. There are more ferocious Digimons in another area.
_2228.CompletionText: I look forward for your success!

_2229.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2229.Description:
These ferocious Digimons never stop appearing.
Can I ask you once more to keep them out? Good luck!
_2229.CompletionText: I wonder when this will end.

_2230.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2230.Description: Ah, WarGreymon X isn't in a very good condition yet. Even though he's one of the strongest member of Resistance, he's not invincible. That also proves how much strong Royal Knights are. Anyway, we need more treatment for WarGreymon X to fully recover, but we ran out of cure, so it became impossible. Hopefully, I'm aware of the materials to make new cure. So can you help us by collecting them?
_2230.Objective: Collect Crude Remedy Collect Empty Capsule
_2230.CompletionText: Have you collected all the materials for the cure?
_2230.CompletionSummary: I guess this is enough to make a cure. Thank you!

_2231.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2231.Description: Not only we need cure for WarGreymon X, but we also need cure for the rest of the members. We usually are hiding ourselves in the base, so cure run out easily. Can you help us making new cures for our members? I'd greatly appreciate it if you can continue to help us.
_2231.Objective: Collect Crude Remedy Collect Empty Capsule
_2231.CompletionText: Did you get all the materials?
_2231.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've got the materials so fast. I can't even imagine the situation without you now.

_2232.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2232.Description: I really don't understand why is this miserable incidents keep happening!! Dorumon is not returning, and I'm sure something has happened. He went out to play with a child by request from WarGreymon X while ago, but there's no sign of him until now. Please search Dorumon for us! I've heard that Omegamon is loitering the areas nearby. He'll be in deep trouble if he gets to face Omegamon in his path! Please find him and return to Historic Site immediately!
_2232.CompletionSummary: You've finally arrived. Now, let's take off!
_2232.ReservedText: Owww… This whole thing is giving me a headache!

_2233.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2233.Description: First, we should find Dorumon as soon as we can! It will take too much time for just two of us to do this, so we need to call Resistance for reinforcements!!
_2233.ReservedText: What is it? What has happened?

_2234.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2234.Description: Me and my friends here will continue to patrol and find Dorumon all seperately. So if you happen to find Dorumon, please use this to give us a signal!
_2234.Objective: Use Flare Gun in Desperate Struggle
_2234.CompletionText: Don't forget to signal when you find him!
_2234.CompletionSummary: What is wrong with you? We didn't harm anyone!!

_2235.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2235.Description:
Did you really find him? I'll send a message to WarGreymon X about this, so hold on! Let's make sure Dorumon is safe and settled down. He even challenges Omegamon when he's gone mad.
Let's get Dorumon into a safer spot!
_2235.CompletionSummary: Run away? Can that be possible?
_2235.ReservedText: We just don't want to die, that's all!

_2236.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2236.Description: Good! We've just arrived!! Let's get together to fight back the arrogant Royal Knights!

_2238.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2238.Summary: Project Arc, Real Intention of Yggdrasil
_2238.Description:
It's been a while, but can you allow me a moment for me to say farewell to my old friend?
Thank you.
_2238.CompletionSummary: Leave this place to me and you guys escape. I'll remain here to save the diginity of my old friend and have a rough conversations with the one who's responsible for all this. Don't worry about me and just focus on escaping at this moment.
_2238.ReservedText: It's good to have you safe.

_2239.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2239.Description:
Let's retreat as Gallantmon suggested. Power of Royal Knights is tremendous as we first expected. Even though we joined our forces together, we couldn't stand this battle…
After retrating, we should take some rest and healing.
Meanwhile, you can return to where you're from. We'll be at our secret base.
_2239.CompletionSummary: We had a hard time. Let's take some rest now.
_2239.ReservedText: Welcome. You've worked hard for us.

_2240.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2240.Description: We thought this place is safe, but it actually wasn't. This area is known to be Omegamon's active territory. Right now, we can't face Omegamon directly, so to clear us an escape route, we need to clean up the surroundings! Please take care of the Digimons around this area!
_2240.CompletionSummary: I hope this will make us safer.

_2241.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2241.Description:
The conclusion made from the headquarters is to support the Resistance. As we help them, they can help us to continue our investigation. And also, they are not hostile against us like the other chosen ones such as Royal Knights.
Go and ask WarGreymon X to see if he and his members have made a decision.
_2241.CompletionText: I've kept in touch with Resistance while you were away, so it'll be easy for you to ask.
_2241.CompletionSummary: I agree with some of your opinions.

_2242.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2242.Description:
I think this is an obvious result, but we Resistance are very positive on cooperating with your group of force.
However, I'd like to ask you for a favor as allies. As MetalGarurumon X has been killed in battle, Resistance force became weaker than before. So I want you to help us until we regain our full force.
First, please get rid of the Digimons nearby, that becoming threat to us Resistance.
_2242.CompletionText: I'm aware that this is a troublesome task. But you're the only hope for us now.
_2242.CompletionSummary: I won't have to regret making allies with you humans.

_2243.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2243.Description:
You helped us clear the surroundings so we can have an escape route. But somehow the ferocious Digimons have brought their reinforcements and the place became occupied again. So I have to ask you this favor again.
Please clear us a path, like you did before~!
_2243.CompletionText: I wonder what's making them so strong.
_2243.CompletionSummary: This area became a little more safe! So it should help us proceed our investigation!

_2244.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2244.Description:
It would be grateful if you can help us a little more. It seems like death of MetalGarurumon X is a great loss in our force. It is not easy for Resistance to regain his vacance.
Please help us like youj've done before.
_2244.CompletionText: I feel sorry to ask you for something difficult everytime.
_2244.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you that it became much easier for our members to secure our borders!

_2245.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2245.Description: Since we've became allies now, I think I should inform you about the X-Antibody, which evolved us.
_2245.CompletionSummary: I can say that the evolution is found from the will to survive. We call it X-Evolution.

_2246.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2246.Description:
Dorugamon has been kidnapped by Magnamon!
I don't know for what purpose Dorugamon is kidnapped, but first thing's first! Use the tracking device from the location where Magnamon has vanished and we may get a clue!
_2246.CompletionText: Please let me know as soon as you find any clue!
_2246.CompletionSummary: For what has Magnamon taken away Dorugamon with him?

_2247.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2247.Description:
Good! You found the trace, so let's continue using the tracker from a distance now! I hope Dorugamon is safe.
I hope we can find a clue to track down Magnamon.
_2247.Objective: Use Tracker in Exterior Site Ruins
_2247.CompletionText: So this is what Royal Knights have done?

_2248.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2248.Description:
What a shame! We were really close! We've almost reached the objective, but it wasn't successful.
How about getting help from the Resistance?
_2248.CompletionText: I could use some help, definitely.
_2248.CompletionSummary: That's it. That's how it was done.

_2249.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2249.Description:
I'm sorry to hear that you've lost tracking Magnamon. We Resistance, will help you with the search. Since this place is very wide and risky, it may take some time.
While we search this area, I think it's good for you to search other areas.
_2249.CompletionSummary: I see. He's already heading to Royal Base.

_2250.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2250.Description:
I found a signal from the Tracker. Even though I don't know if this is Magnamon or something else, I assume that we need to investigate.
Please go to the location and check what's there!
_2250.CompletionSummary: Are you the human who's after him?

_2251.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2251.Description:
Dorugamon is unconscious, but he's not hurt. I'm just taking care of him to fully recover consciousness.
By the way, we could use some hand now. Can you help us? We are members of Resistance and we're finding stuffs we could use. I'll give you a shovel, so you can find anything useful buried in the grounds.
_2251.CompletionText: Hmm… The place is messy, so it won't be easy to find stuffs.
_2251.CompletionSummary: Oh, you've returned sooner than I expected. But there was nothing useful? Maybe it's because of them…

_2252.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2252.Description:
Hmm… To keep us safe from the Royal Knights, we need various items. Of course we're short of these things now… and always was.
I've thought of the reason why this place became so empty is probably because of the Nanomons and Dracmons around. Go and see if they have any stuffs in their pockets!
_2252.CompletionText: Just make a few good hits on them, and you'll see if they drop some stuffs or not.
_2252.CompletionSummary: Great! These stuffs will be helpful.

_2253.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2253.Description:
I really appreciate your help last time. Anyway, we still need more stuffs.
I might keep asking you for help, for a price of course. Are you willing to help?
_2253.CompletionText: I know it's not a easy job. I really appreciate your help.
_2253.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This will help us to protect ourselves from Royal Knights.

_2254.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2254.Description:
Roachmons are showing up in this area recently, and this means the ferocious Digimons here are becoming threat because of X-Antibody, or willing to survive.
As you see, this area is an essential place to find things we need, so we should get rid of the trouble makers. If you don't mind, can you help us with this?
_2254.CompletionText: I hope the Dumpsite doesn't get messed up by them.
_2254.CompletionSummary: I can't thank you enough. You've saved our day.

_2255.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2255.Description:
I've found the trouble makers making trouble again in the Dumpsite.
Can you kick them out like you did before?
_2255.CompletionText: They are such a pain in the butt.
_2255.CompletionSummary: Thanks, but this thing may happen again tomorrow. Will be you able to continue helping us?

_2256.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2256.Description:
Today's target quantity has been filled up. So I'll be able to distribute all the items to my friends.
By the way, your friend Dorugamon has not awaken yet, so I'm trying to take him to our headquarters. I'll send you the coordinates of our base, so you can stop by later.
_2256.CompletionText: We will carry Dorugamon safe and sound, so don't worry about your friend.
_2256.CompletionSummary: Come in. It's much safer inside.
_2256.ReservedText: Good to see you. Wizardmon has told about you before.

_2257.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2257.Description:
Welcome to the headquarters of Resistance. Wizardmon told me that your friend Dorugamon is not in such a good condition. But unforunately, we do not have enough medication to cure him.
Recently, Dracmons are loitering around our base and constantly stealing our supplies. I bet they also have the Digimon Cure.
_2257.CompletionText: We'll take good care of your friend until you get the cure.
_2257.CompletionSummary: Oh! I think this is more than enough.

_2258.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2258.Description: We have enough medication to heal your friend Dorugamon now. He'll be fully restored in no time. Meanwhile, you can visit Wizardmon. I've heard that he's looking for you.
_2258.CompletionText: Wizardmon is in the place you first met. Don't worry about your friend Dorugamon.
_2258.CompletionSummary: You should be the human WarGreymon X was talking about.

_2259.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2259.Description:
WarGreymon X told me that you helped him too, just like you helped me before. We Resistance owe you a great debt.
However, there is a situation. It's about Dorugamon.
_2259.ReservedText: Because Dorugamon came from another place, our companions seem to put a distance against him. Even though I told them that he's not a member of Royal Knights, some of us seem to be afraid of him.

_2260.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2260.Description:
I know that you won't like this situation. I really appreciate your help. But to make all the members understand is not very easy. So I've thought of a way of solving the problem.
Recently, a group of DexDoruGreymons is confronting us and being a threat to our members. If you can chase away from our sight, our members should gain more trust in you and not be afraid of your friend Dorugamon anymore.
_2260.CompletionText: Meanwhile, I'll make the members to calm down.
_2260.CompletionSummary: Excellent! As you've driven out DexDoruGreymons, our members seem to be relieved.

_2261.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2261.Description:
Regardless of your friend Dorugamon, the members are still uncomfortable because of the DexDoruGreymon loitering outside.
If you don't mind, please chase them away like you did before.
_2261.CompletionText: Feeling insecured even in home is not such a joyful thing.
_2261.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much for enlightening the mood!

_2262.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2262.Description:
This is Miki! I've spot a pack of DexDoruGreymon heading to Resistance headquarters!!
Me and WarGreymon X is heading the way to the headquarters to stop them, but I'm not sure if we can make it before it's too late.
Are you and the Resistance members safe there? If you are, please notify Silphymon about this right now.
_2262.CompletionText: We're still on the way. Please keep the base safe!
_2262.CompletionSummary: Worse things happen in such bad times! Right when WarGreymon X is not in the place!

_2263.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2263.Description:
WarGreymon X is on the way of returning. Meanwhile, MetalGarurumon X who we thought to be dead has returned all of a sudden and is defending the headquarters from DexDoruGreymons!
I'll get our injured members to evacuate from the base for just in case, so please buy me some time!
_2263.CompletionText: The evacuation is just for the worst case. I'll return with them when defense succeeds.

_2264.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2264.Description:
With your help, we could defend our headquarters. However, MetalGarurumon X is still against the hostile DexDoruGreymons.
Can you help him in the battle? If you defeat the DexDoruGreymons around the base, it will be a big help!
_2264.CompletionText: I'll do my best to keep the base safe!
_2264.CompletionSummary: With your great support, our injured members could return safely. Thanks to you that we're safe now!

_2265.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2265.Description:
Their attack is still lasting! MetalGarurumon X is still guarding the behind of our base.
At the meantime, we can go inside and warn the rest of our members.
We also need members that can fight back with us! And if we can clear the path in the way, it would be much better!
_2265.Objective: Defeat DexDoruGreymon Enter to Resistance secret base Talk to Wizarmon
_2265.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat DexDoruGreymon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Enter to Resistance secret base%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk to Wizarmon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2265.CompletionText: There's not much time, we should be leaving!
_2265.CompletionSummary: The situation here isn't very good.
_2265.ReservedText: Royal Knights… What are they thinking?
