_2266.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2266.Description:
MetalGarurumon X is guarding us from one side. But there are a lot of injured members inside, and not many of us can join the fight.
We have to find a solution, at least to resist until WarGreymon X arrives.
Human, you're the only hope we can rely on now. Please keep the DexDoruGreymon away from the base. I trust you!
_2266.CompletionText: WarGreymon X should be arriving in any minute!
_2266.CompletionSummary: What a hectic day we're having!

_2267.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2267.Description:
Your friend Dorugamon is still not fully recovered yet and the recent attack of DexDoruGreymons is only making it worse.
And the number of casualties are increasing as the fight is lasting longer, so we're running out of medication again.
By looking at their habits, devouring anything in their sight, I'm sure that some of them should have our medical supplies swalled.
When you defeat them, please look for the stolen medical supplies.
_2267.CompletionText: I'll take good care of the injured members, along with your friend Dorugamon!

_2268.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2268.Description:
By the attack of DexDoruGreymon, number of casualties are still increasing.
So we are still running short of medication again. I'm trying my best to find the lost medical supplies, but getting into a limit.
If you are capable, please help me retrieve the medical supplies from DexDoruGreymons. Thanks!
_2268.CompletionText: We are getting new injuries before the already injured members fully recover. This is such a madness!
_2268.CompletionSummary: Thank you as always! I think you've brought enough supplies for today.

_2269.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2269.Description:
Not even a single moment for the injured members to recover! The attack of DexDoruGreymone is insane!
I just need to buy some time! Yes, it was always about the time, but especially now I'm more desperate!
Please get those greedy bastards out of this place!
_2269.CompletionText: The injured members are in recovery without any problem. I just hope there'll be no more injuries.
_2269.CompletionSummary: Great! With your help, the number of injuries are decreasing.

_2270.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2270.Description:
The recovery of your friend is completed, but for some reason, he's not fully conscious. It doesn't look like it's a cause by a physical injury.
So we've decided to take him to the Lake. We'll be carrying him to the Lake, so me up there.
_2270.Objective: Enter to Lake Talk to Wizarmon
_2270.CompletionText: Once we get to the Lake, we'll find a way to make him conscious.
_2270.ReservedText: It doesn't make sence. This place wasn't exposed to anyone!

_2271.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2271.Description:
It's like we are facing monsters from hell, devouring everything in their sight, as if today's the end of the world.
How can this be happening?
_2271.CompletionSummary: We have to find a way to stop this madness! We are survivors!
_2271.ReservedText: This secret base was never exposed to the Royal Knights. And there is no way that it can be exposed. So how can this situation be explained? Can it be the influence of Yggdrasil?

_2272.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2272.Description:
We have companions! And we have you, who we can rely on.
I and other members will resist to survive! When WarGreymon X arrives here, we may be able to turn the table!
_2272.ReservedText: You've waited for a long time!

_2273.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2273.Description:
We're still fighting back on DexDoruGreymons to defend the base!
MetalGarurumon X is still guarding one side of our base, but we could use a hand. If you can, please get rid of more DexDoruGreymons!
_2273.CompletionText: We must keep our companions safe!
_2273.CompletionSummary: I hope we can take some rest soon!

_2274.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2274.Description: Thanks to you that we could evacuate the injured members during the attack!
_2274.CompletionSummary: I will never give up! I'll put all my efforts in…
_2274.ReservedText: The situation is not getting any better. Even with your help, we can't stop all the members from getting injuries.

_2275.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2275.Description:
Don't get confused! We have a trial to overcome!
We're in emergency situation now. Please help us by stopping the DexDoruGreymon!
We can't leave our injured companions into danger again.
_2275.CompletionText: Hurry! We don't have much time!
_2275.CompletionSummary: Calm down everyone! Being nervous won't help the situation!

_2276.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2276.Description: This is a confusing situation! For what reason is Dorugamon in the same form of the bad guys over there? Is this the worst scenario that we can imagine?
_2276.ReservedText: How come Dorugamon evolves into a form same as the one who's attacking us? This is chaos.

_2277.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2277.CompletionSummary: He's become one of us now! Don't doubt a friend! Just trust him!
_2277.ReservedText: Regardless of how he looks now, doesn't matter with this situation now. Dorugamon… or DoruGreymon is still our ally and will help us fight back no matter what!

_2278.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2278.Description: WarGreymon X is right! It's just his looks that is similar to DexDoruGreymon, but that has nothing to do with the fight! Because he's on our side now and fighting for us! Right now, I'll request our headquarters for reinforcements. So we can secure our base and keep our companions safe. At the meantime, please protect me and the signal device from the enemies!!
_2278.CompletionText: Getting the signal device ready is not a problem, but it should be kept safe from any attacks.
_2278.CompletionSummary: Good job! I'll now send the reinforcement request, so hold tight!

_2279.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2279.Description:
This is Richard Sampson from DATS Center. I just received backup request from agent Miki. We'll be preparing for the backup soon, so hold on until then.
As the result of data I received, the DexDoruGreymon seems to be coming out from the Royal Base.
_2279.CompletionSummary: We'll have someone reliable other than DATS Center!
_2279.ReservedText: Really? I have a good news for us too!

_2280.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2280.Description:
Hopefully, we have a new reinforcement arriving soon.
WarGreymon X and MetalGarurumon X are becoming exhausted by their continuous attacks, and the headquarters can be invaded in any minute when the defense line collapses.
But if our new reinforcement arrives, I'm pretty sure we can reverse the situation!
Please tell this to WarGreymon X!
_2280.CompletionText: You need to tell this to WarGreymon X fast!
_2280.ReservedText: Just a little more time!... The members of Resistance must be safe!

_2281.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2281.Description: I see! A new reinforcement is arriving? That's a good news. It can be awakward to say in this situation now, but I really appreciate your help. Without your help, we probably couldn't have come this far.
_2281.ReservedText: There's nothing better than a reinforcement joining us in this situation! The members will be happy to hear this!

_2282.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2282.Description: Reinforcements seems to be on the way now, but we have a situation. DexDoruGreymons are continuing to attack us! We'll not hold out if unless we make a breakthrough. Can you help DoruGreymon to barricade enemies in the frontline?
_2282.CompletionText: We don't have much time left now!
_2282.CompletionSummary: Damn! We need reinforcements right now!
_2282.ReservedText: We don't have much time left now!

_2283.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2283.Description: The battle is being extended. Our members aer getting exhausted and injured. But we can't give up now. If we lose, we'll all be dead. So we must get through this trial. Please keep up the good work. I appreciate your help.
_2283.CompletionSummary: Who is the Digimon in front of me? I have to keep my position, so please check for me.

_2284.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2284.Description: I Gallantmon, has returned from the Data Universe to retrieve justice in this place. Thank you human. I came back with MetalGarurumon, but the situation here seems worse than I expected. Please help our injured members to escape. WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon will be joining you.
_2284.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to WarGreymon X%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to MetalGarurumon X%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2284.CompletionSummary: That's good. Perhaps we can talk now.
_2284.ReservedText: All right. I'll start moving now.

_2285.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2285.Description: I've been questioning Yggdrasil's will all the time I was wandering in the Data Universe, but could not reach to a conclusion. Instead, I've been convinced by Dorumon's shout. I believe that DoruGreymon has a proper motivation. I'll open the path for you, so you can go and talk to DoruGreymon.
_2285.CompletionSummary: Is that what Gallantmon has said?

_2286.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2286.Description:
My existance… The enemies ahead… And Yggdrasil…
Finally, I've made up my mind.
_2286.CompletionText: It's the only choice I can make.
_2286.CompletionSummary: I'll head to Royal Base. It's time I can ask a question of myself.
_2286.ReservedText: It's the only choice I can make.

_2287.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2287.Description: So that's how DoruGreymon determined. Then let's clear a path in front of him. There's another swarm of DexDoruGreymon coming towards us now.

_2288.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2288.Summary: Need Backup? I Don't Think So.
_2288.Description: Dorugreymon is the key to resolve this situation, so I've sent him to the Royal Base. But Royal Base is not an easy place to enter and I'm out of energy ever since DoruGreymon has left. Right now, we need the Royal Knight's approval. To be thorough, you need to be certain to be prepared to stand against the power of Yggdrasil. I know the way, but I want to ask if you're really ready.
_2288.CompletionText: We'll have to make a conclusion to this incident.
_2288.CompletionSummary: So, have you made your decision?
_2288.ReservedText: We'll have to make a conclusion to this incident.

_2289.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2289.Description:
Well, if that's what you want.. Okay. We'll have to defeat pesky guys in order to make a space to create the gate.
First, get rid of DexDoruGreymon.
And come back here!
_2289.CompletionSummary: Good. We can buy some time.

_2290.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2290.Description:
The next thing to check is your strength.
All the remaining Digimons here are survivors of extreme jungle law environment.
When you can beat the Digimons on battle, I'll trust you.
_2290.Objective: Defeat GranDracmon Defeat TigerVespamon Defeat GrandisKuwagamon Defeat Dorugoramon

_2291.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2291.Description:
That was actually impressive. You've managed to beat all of them.
So you have done this before? I see. Now I begin to understand all the situation.
It'd be a joke if I still can't trust you.
_2291.CompletionText: A relationship between a human and Digimon. Interesting...
_2291.ReservedText: A relationship between a human and Digimon. Interesting…

_2292.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2292.Summary: Too Early For a Happy Ending
_2292.Description:
Getting through the enterance of Royal Base requires massive energy consumption.
Fortunately, there are energy sources that can be used. They are spreaded widely in this area.
When you collect enough energy sources, bring them to me.
_2292.CompletionText: Be careful when you collect the energy sources.
_2292.CompletionSummary: The energy sources may already have been fused by Digimons nearby.

_2293.Title: Royal Base
_2293.Description: I've located several DexDoruGreymons' main rally points. Miki told me that she has the tracking device. Get the tracking device first.
_2293.CompletionSummary: It's good to see you're safe!
_2293.ReservedText: When do we get out of here?

_2294.Title: Royal Base
_2294.Description:
Here's the tracking device. It's a precious supply from DATS Center, so please hand it carefully.
You can go talk to Gallantmon now.

_2295.Title: Royal Base
_2295.Description: Gateways were destroyed many times so I had a hard time locating the enterance, but this device will make it a lot easier. Now, we can continue whenver you're ready.

_2296.Title: Royal Base
_2296.Description: After condensing the energy sources for the gateway, with the support of the device you brought, I'll be able to create new gateway that allow us to enter the Royal Base. Just give me a moment.
_2296.CompletionSummary:
I managed to open a gateway to Royal Base from the Historic Site.
Meet me there when you make up your mind.

_2297.Title: Royal Base
_2297.Description:
Getting through the enterance of Royal Base requires massive energy consumption.
I can make the gateway again for you if you request. But to do that requires more energy sources.
Bring enough energy sources and I'll create the gateway once more.
_2297.CompletionSummary: The gateway to Royal Base is ready. Go and show Yggdrasil our will!

_2298.Title: Royal Base
_2298.Description: It seems that the Royal Knights have detected our intrusion. When you defeat them, you'll be able to move into the center of the base. Deal with the Royal Knights in Royal Base and you'll be able to obtain their vouchers. But be careful while you're in there.
_2298.CompletionSummary: You returned safely as I expected.

_2299.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2299.Description: X-Antibody… I think that's a suitable name of calling it. It's the decisive matter to allow our partner Digimons to stand against the X-Program. I wish to research further about it, so what do you think?
_2299.CompletionSummary: Just a little more help. I'm sure it will be a great aid to us.

_2300.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2300.Description:
You should be aware of it already. But anyway, Kunemons here are stronger than we expected. Don't you agree with it?
I think this needs to be investigated also! Can you take this Precision Camera with you and take some pictures?
_2300.CompletionText: Why? Is the camera not comfortable for you?
_2300.CompletionSummary: Great! The picture looks good enough!

_2301.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2301.Description: I sent the pictures of Kunemon to headquarters and requested for data comparison with the Kunemon of Digital World. After a while, I've been told that the Kunemons in this world has another singularity. An instinct to fight and kill their same race, who's weaker than itself... To prove this, we require the battle data of Kunemon. Can you fight the Kunemons?
_2301.CompletionText: See? How do they look? Can you also see the differences between them and the Kunemons we already know?
_2301.CompletionSummary: Hmm… hahaha… it's a little funny to think like this.

_2302.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2302.Description: Pleased to see you. I'm Gallantmon, a member of the Royal Knights. We serve Yggdrasil. The reason why I'm visiting is because you seem to be searching for something in common, which I also want to know. The will of survival that Digimons have in this place, is still a mystery. But as these Digimons are defined as our enemies, I had to come to you for cooperation.
_2302.CompletionText: I know it's a difficult task. But it is necessary.
_2302.CompletionSummary: The reason why the Digimons become ferocious?
_2302.ReservedText: Oh! My human friend, did you just arrive?

_2303.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2303.Description: Aha… that's what happened. Explaining you the fact, we are not the native Digimons of 'New Digital World', but immigrants from the existing Digital World. In the Digital World, something called 'X-Program' is keep spreading and causing many Digimons suffer and even to die. Some of the Digimons that survived from 'X-Program' has evacuated and that lead to this place. I guess that's how the 'will of survival' got stronger.
_2303.CompletionSummary: A law that allows anything if it's related with survival? That's a little horrible. It's frightening.
_2303.ReservedText: Is that so? I never knew the place had such a story.

_2304.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2304.Description: That's understandable. Even though the so called 'X-Program' seems to have no effect to humans, it's critical to our Digimons in the other hand. The Kunemons here seems to be evolved by the purpose of surviving. I think we should collect the data of Kunemon in this world. I'll give you a scanner, so use it to collect data, and if possible, get the cores from them too.
_2304.Objective: Use scanner to kunemon Collect Digimon's Core
_2304.CompletionText: I'm busy right now. I'll do the analysis, so just get me the stuffs that I asked.
_2304.CompletionSummary: Very good~! Now take some rest, while I do the rest!

_2305.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2305.Description:
As we expected, headquarters is requesting us for more data. It looks like the data has never been seen before, so it's taking a lot of time and effort, and they need more samples because of that.
So let's collect more research data.
_2305.Objective: Use scanner to kunemon Collect Digimon's Core
_2305.CompletionText: I'm getting tired of this repetitive tasks sometimes.
_2305.CompletionSummary: You've done well~. I'll be sending them to headquarters. So meanwhile, you can take some rest.

_2306.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2306.Description:
Please take this to Gallantmon. The research result is pretty absolute.
It's been translated to Digimon font, so you won't be able to read it. Or you can ask Gallantmon to read if for you, if you're curious.
_2306.Objective: Deliver Research Report to Gallantmon Talk to Gallantmon
_2306.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver Research Report to Gallantmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Gallantmon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2306.CompletionText: All Royal Knights seem to be arrogant and it's annoying.
_2306.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. I've found some answeres to my questions now.
I've been questioning on the other aspects of ferocious Digimon when it evolved, rather that the ferocious Digimon itself.
If you were questioning the same thing, take a look on the Digimons who evolved into new form.
_2306.ReservedText: Yes? Have you completed with the research already?

_2307.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2307.Description:
We gave Gallantmon information he asked, so now we should get information that we need.
Refering to Gallantmon's information, there are not only Digimons of unknown forms, but ones that changed forms influenced by the environment.
This need to be investigated further. I've found that there were some Kuwagamons that are evolved from Kunemons, and become a threat to us. Please deal with them first.
_2307.CompletionText: The Digimon in a shape of red insect, called Kuwagamon. He seems to be too violent.

_2308.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2308.Description:
I found something strange. At first, I could only see Kunemons in that area, but now I begin to see Kuwagamons.
How could this be explained, unless they can't just suddenly appear like magic or dropped from the sky?
From the opposite direction, Okuwamons are approaching and they look very aggressive. Please defeat them, and collect their cores!
_2308.Objective: Defeat Okuwamon Collect Kernel Antibody Core
_2308.CompletionText: This is weird, but not just weird… It's tooooo weird.
_2308.CompletionSummary: First the analysis! Result comes afterwards!

_2309.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2309.Description: I heard that the scientists of DATS Center are amazed by the research data extracted from Okuwamon. The data is very different from the other existing Digimons, is what they said… So the next request is to attach transmitter on Okuwamons and get their action data and movement pattern results.
_2309.Objective: Attach Transmitter to Okuwamon Defeat Okuwamon
_2309.CompletionText: It's painful just thinking about it.

_2310.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2310.Description: During the investigation, I've heard a loud noise coming out of the forest. I recorded and analyzed this noise and it came out to be GranKuwagamon's roar. If we don't do anything about this, we may lose Okuwamon in track. So please deal with GranKuwagamon first!
_2310.CompletionText: I hope the scientists of DATS Center learn some manners!
_2310.CompletionSummary: You've done a great work so far. Well done!

_2311.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2311.Description: The GranKuwagamons have appeared again. They're disturbing our task to extract data from Okuwamons. Then the solution is simple. Let's get rid of the disruptors!
_2311.CompletionText: This place is full of mystery. I wonder when I'll get used to it.

_2312.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2312.Description:
Research results have arrived, and there is something very unique. One of the GranKuwagamon was grabbing the transmitter we attached on Okuwamon. That means… they didn't just appear from nowhere, but have evolved by themselves.
Well… this is just a theory yet, so we need to look further. WarGreymon X may know the answer to this.
_2312.CompletionText: Save all questions for the experts!
_2312.CompletionSummary: I see. So you've found such a strange being?

_2313.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2313.Description: We are the finders of X-Antibody. We have earned it to resist and survive from the effect of X-Program. As we gained X-Antibody, we became stronger than usual, and there were some remarkable changes into our bodies. Evolving or changing in shape is just one of the ways of survival. You'll be able to see that from the forest, because there's a perfect example to explain all this. Look for GrandisKuwagamon in the forest.
_2313.CompletionText: You haven't found it yet? I'll give you a hint. It's stronger than GranKuwagamon.
_2313.CompletionSummary: So the evolution was for survival…

_2314.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2314.Description: If your objective of research is about the X-Antibody and evolution, GrandisKuwagamon can be a good example and research target. These Digimons are known to be more ferocious and violent compared to other Digimons.
_2314.CompletionText: I know it's a tough target, but at least it's not invincible. You'll make it kneel before you.
_2314.CompletionSummary: See? I knew you could do it. Great!

_2315.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2315.Description: As a result of your efforts and hard word, we could reach to a conclusion in a short time. Yggdrasil's will, and the will of Digimons we predicted to be extinct had the same main purpose. It was to 'Survive'. X-Evolution is just a process for the objective. Everything there has the purpose of survival. Thanks to you that now I have my doubts cleared now.
_2315.CompletionSummary:
I've managed to send all our data, including the ones received from Gallantmon to our headquarters.
They told me that the overall research data results we sent so far looks positive.
_2315.ReservedText: Gallantmon seem to be leaving somewhere, wasn't he?

_2316.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2316.Description: You've done well. I hope you can come back to headquarters and drop by. Is that ok?
_2316.CompletionText: It should be a good news for you. I'll be awaiting.
_2316.CompletionSummary: We always need to adjust into new environments. Our research of the X-Antibody has been succeeded. So X-Evolution became enabled.
_2316.ReservedText: Welcome. By your devotional support, the scientists of DATS Center could successfully develop

_2317.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2317.Description:
Hmm… these are…? Looks like we got more objects to research on.
These things seem to be somehow connected with the essential parts of Digital World.
_2317.Objective: Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam A Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam B Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam C Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam D
_2317.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam B%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam C%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Collect Data Ocean's Flotsam D%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2317.CompletionText: Those stuffs may be valuable, who knows?
_2317.CompletionSummary: Good! You brought the flotsams. I'll take a closer look now.

_2318.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2318.Description:
As we are collecting these flotsams from the Data Ocean, I sometimes get weird messages or voice files through my digivice. It's little… very creepy… All the message includes the word 'Survive' in common.
Due to the experinces we had here, I presume that it's deeply related with this area. I think it's worth for more investigation.

_2319.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2319.Description: Since this is also a digital signal, I need more trackers installed around this area. These trackers I have are not very expensive, but they'll do the job fine. Please install them as many as you can in this area.
_2319.Objective: Use traker in Exterior Site Ruins
_2319.CompletionText: It's kinda creepy, but I'm still curious!

_2320.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2320.Description: I… want… survival… and to… learn… You… want… to know… survival… help… required…
_2320.CompletionSummary: I don't know what to do with it.
_2320.ReservedText: Was it a request for us to help? From an existence we don't even know?

_2321.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2321.Description:
Some support request came from nowhere… or from unknown existence in an unknown place… I have no idea what will happen afterwards regardless of what this request is about.
I just know that the sender seems to be deeply related with the Digimons we can easily see from "Verdandi Terminal".
_2321.CompletionSummary: I guess it's meaningless to hesitate now. Let's find out who this may be. At least we know that the existence needs help.

_2322.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2322.Description:
If this guy give a lot of meaning to survival, why not make him realize by the battles we have went through so far? There are a lot of Digimons nearby… I found Dorumons or a similar species hanging around this area.
Fight and defeat them one by one!
_2322.Objective: Defeat Dorumon Defeat Dolgamon Defeat Dorugreymon
_2322.CompletionText: Surive to survive… I think I've heard it somewhere?

_2323.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2323.Description:
We seem to have some changes, but as nothing very impressive is found yet, message is looking awkward.
I'm not saying that it is meaningless, so the main concept remains the same. Just focus on showing the will to survive with more attention!
_2323.Objective: Defeat Dorumon Defeat Dolgamon Defeat Dorugreymon
_2323.CompletionText: No matter how many times I try… Battle doesn't seem to fit me.
_2323.CompletionSummary: It's starting to talk better than before!

_2324.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2324.Description:
I… was… killing… Digimons… by… orders… However… I… did not… like… the idea… And why… were they… struggling… so desperately… just to… live…
I… want to… know… What… is… the purpose… of… this will… I… need… your… help…
_2324.ReservedText: Hmm… Is it recalling its memory?

_2325.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2325.Description:
This message of unknown being is really mysterious. I mean… this guy don't seem to be nice. But neither so evil too…
This is a rare chance of getting new information, but in the otherside, I feel like it's opening a Pandora's Box we should not be opening.
_2325.CompletionSummary: But still, I think we should be cooperating. Even for the purpose of continuing our investigation.

_2326.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2326.Description: I… have faced… a lot… of Dragon type… Digimons… I… may had… some… advantages… against… them… many… Dragon type Digimons… engaged… retaliation… no doubt… memories… lost… impact… on the… contrary...
_2326.Objective: Defeat Monochromon Defeat Darktyranomon Defeat Reptiledramon Defeat Allomon
_2326.CompletionSummary: Having some progress? What's with Dragon type Digimons? Is this unknown guy being rough?

_2327.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2327.Summary: Digimon Achieving Evolution of Endless Potential
_2327.Description:
We have to take care of the remaining tasks. There still are dangerous looking Digimons loitering around.
Especially, some guys like GrandisKuwagamons are on rampage. Because of the impact, the area is messed up and supplies we find from there are running short.
Please get those Dorugoramon out of the area.
_2327.CompletionSummary: Awesome! This place will be more quiet now. So, what could this be?

_2328.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2328.Summary: [Daily] Digimon Achieving Evolution of Endless Potential
_2328.Description:
Despite of your effort last time, these trouble makers are occupying the area continuously.
Can you drive them out like you did last time? Thanks!
_2328.CompletionText: You can handle this like last time, can't you?

_2329.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2329.Description: The… that… that shield… there! That's it… I… I am…!!
_2329.CompletionSummary: What? It suddenly screamed and it's not talking anymore? It's not dead, is it?

_2330.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2330.Description:
As the unknown being gets to see Gallantmon's Shield, it started to react intensely? Wait a moment… Why is Dorugoramon's holding this shield? Have Gallantmon abandoned his shield?
I think we need to investigate this too… Let's question this to WarGreymonX first, as he may know something about it.
_2330.CompletionText: Gallantmon? I never though a strong being like him would be defeated like that.
_2330.CompletionSummary: But this surely looks like Gallantmon has been defeated.

_2331.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2331.Description:
Because of the possible risks in this investigation, we couldn't go any further. Instead, I found out something else that caught my sight.
Royal Knights seem to have an internal conflict. It's happening between Omegamon and Gallantmon, and this isn't just an ordinary conflict, because they used to be close friends.
I think it needs to be investigated definitely. The area is one of Omegamon's territory, so it's a bit risky, but since I trust you, we can...
_2331.ReservedText: Think there was a fierce battle going on?

_2332.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2332.Description:
This is just one of my predictions. Can the unknown existence be deeply related with Gallantmon? A companion, or subordinate of him, perhaps?
We found the shield from this location, so could there be a chance to find his spear? Let's continue this investigation and find out!
_2332.CompletionSummary: We should be stronger, not only from here.

_2333.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2333.Description:
I think we should fight the Digimons who are related with Gallantmon. Dorugoramon was holding the trace of Gallantmon, so we may find a clue!
We may be able to find spear from the Dorumons, or Dracmons loitering around this area!
_2333.CompletionText: I've observed with tracking device. It should be near us now!
_2333.CompletionSummary: See? I told you it was near.

_2334.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2334.Description: I'll send these shield and spear to unknown presence by the form of data. If this guy has anything to do with Gallantmon, there must be any kind of reaction.
_2334.CompletionSummary: Data transmission is completed! You're on your own now! Don't forget to be responsible for what you do next!

_2335.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2335.Summary: I'm Gallantmon, a Royal Knight with Pride
_2335.Description:
First of all, thank you humans. It's been a while. You've done a hard work because of me. It's such a shame that I've lost my memory, even after surviving from the Data Ocean.
I came all this way to find out the 'Will of Survival', so I've been hit by Omegamon and dragged myself down here. Now it's time for me to regain my power. Can you help me find the Digizoids from my companions?
_2335.Objective: Collect Data Chrome Digizoid Collect Data Red Digizoid Collect Data Blue Digizoid Collect Data Gold Digizoid
_2335.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Chrome Digizoid%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Red Digizoid%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Blue Digizoid%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Collect Gold Digizoid%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2335.CompletionText: I know that it's a tough task. But I'm sure you can handle it.
_2335.CompletionSummary: Thanks a lot! Now it's time for a change!

_2336.Title: Verdandi Terminal
_2336.Description:
Through your support, I and the Digimon beside me is able to return to the Digital World.
But it's not right now. There is an exit, and we should find it to escape. Don't worry about it though, as I'll take care of it myself.
I've earned much information, and learned alot from you guys. I appereciate all the support you've done for us.
_2336.CompletionSummary: Huh? For what did he leave so much data behind? Gallantmon has sent us massive amoount of data! Can you choose one of these? Thanks!

_2337.Title: Royal Base
_2337.Description:
You succeeded on getting the vouchers. Good job.
I'll persuade the rest, so you can go further inside.
Go and find out the real intention of Yggdrasil.
_2337.CompletionSummary: The human and Digimon together. Thanks for coming all the way to here.

_2338.Title: Royal Base
_2338.Description:
The situation now is not very nice.
Dexmon is defending Yggdrasil from inside.
We need your help. You and I, Omegamon. Three of us will make a good team enough to defeat Dexmon.
Let's fight and survive!

_2339.Title: Royal Base
_2339.Description:
The digital world has retrieved peace again with your help. Our comrades who struggled just to survive can now take some rest. Thank you dearly.
By the way, Omegamon should be waiting for you. You might want to talk to him too.
_2339.CompletionText: Omegamon should have something to talk with you.

_2340.Title: Royal Base
_2340.Description: The aspects of me? Yes, as you can see I've accepted X-antibody. My friend Gallantmon has said that the will to survive is X-antibody itself, but I still don't know about that. But anyway, I believe that the peace we have now is the result of true justice. Yggdrasil must have believed in another justice apart from us, but the result we have now is more important. Thank you human. I look forward to see you again next time.
_2340.CompletionText: Gallantmon seems to have something to tell.
_2340.CompletionSummary: Have you had conversation with Omegamon?

_2341.Title: Royal Base
_2341.Description:
Another human that came with you is waiting for you at Historic Site.
I think you should go there now.
Thanks for all the support so far.
_2341.CompletionSummary: Finally, you're back again! You didn't get hurt?

_2342.Title: Royal Base
_2342.Description:
Afer the last fight , Dorumon disappeared.
But I found him!
Now, keep going!
_2342.CompletionText: What are you waiting for? You should go now.

_2343.Title: Royal Base
_2343.Description: I've found this item from the Data Universe. It seems to possess DigiSoul in it, but it doesn't fit to me. It should fit for you instead. How about we making a deal? If you get the Royal Knight's vouchers and bring them to me, I'll give you this as an exchange.
_2343.CompletionText: A equipment fit to human, which possess DigiSoul? It's very unusual to me. Do you guys evolve too?
_2343.CompletionSummary: That's the voucher I was talking about. Here, take this item.

_2344.Title: Royal Base
_2344.Description:
Getting through the enterance of Royal Base requires massive energy consumption.
I can make the gateway again for you if you request. But to do that requires more energy sources.
Bring enough energy sources and I'll create the gateway once more.
_2344.CompletionSummary: The gateway to Royal Base is ready. Go and show Yggdrasil our will!

_2345.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2345.Description:
Culu~
Do you hear that too, Culu~?
The sound of depressed Digimon voice? The sound of the wounds?
It was a tragic to hear these voices, Culu… But strangely, now the voices are fading…
_2345.CompletionSummary: Something must be going on… Culu!

_2346.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2346.Description:
That's not all of what so strange. Along the fading voices, there was a voice of anger~ Culu!
The voice was in rage, but any kind of evil. It was more like a shouting of justice, Culu!
And the voices were coming from the cold Ice Area! I think it's best to go there at once to find out the situation there Culu~!
And please check what caused the Digimon voice of rage, Culu!
_2346.CompletionSummary: Human child? What's your business here? Sorry, but I'm not in such a mood for chit-chat now.

_2347.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2347.Description:
What?
Calumon has sent you for an investigation of this Ice Area? Hmm… I see that Calumon still has an incredible sence…
As a response to Calumon, I can tell you that Ice Area is in a middle of war. Many Digimon became the victims of war and many died.
_2347.CompletionSummary:
Leomon who fell down here has also became a victim of this war.
It's such a pity…

_2348.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2348.Description:
I'm restoring the data of war casualties who didn't make it. Their data will reborn as new DigiEgg after being restored. That's why I came to this place, which is frequently at war now.
I've first thought that what I do is a contribution to peace. Granting new life to Digimon that'd live longer without war was what I've been doing so far. I prayed for them to reborn in the place where there is no war, so they can live their second life happily.
However, as I kept repeating this procedure, my thoughts have been changed. I started to think that what I do is just extending the war.
_2348.CompletionSummary: Because I began to think the ones I helped may have reborned, evoluted, and return to war for their revenge. That'll never end the war.

_2349.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2349.Description:
Therefore, I've changed my mind!
Consequentially, to end this meaningless war once and for all!
Ending the war to reclaim peace, and everyone forgets about war to live their new lives in peace!
_2349.CompletionSummary: If you agree and willing to stop the war, can you help?

_2350.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2350.Description:
Cause of the war? Pardon me. I guess I've skipped the most important part. The cause of this war…
It is told that Human type Digimon and Beast type Digimon weren't in such a good relationship. They were maintaining balance with careful understanding and tolerance, but suddenly it broke and lead to a war.
I don't know what flamed this war and who's responsible for it.
_2350.CompletionSummary: But I'm sure of one thing! That this meaningless war must be stopped!

_2351.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2351.Description:
I know it's too difficult to restrain both sides at once, so we should help one side to win and end this war.
So which side of Digimon force do you want to help?
I'm in a position to ask for your help, so I'll respect your choice no matter what. And I'll actively support you to make the side you choose to win from the war!
_2351.CompletionSummary: So, have you made up your mind? Which side are you going to help?

_2352.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2352.Description: You want to help the Human Type Digimon? Well, I suppose that you feel more fellowship to them as you're a human yourself?
_2352.CompletionSummary: Aha… Human, you also have a good sence of judgment.

_2353.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2353.Description:
Need some explanation for that?
Valkyrimon may not explained this part to you, but I think you should know.
The supreme leader of Beast Type Digimon turns out to be Cherubimon. Cherubimon is one of the 3 Angel Digimon and put a lot of effort for maintaining peace. But unfortunately, Cherubimon has fallen and became evil.
They say that Cherubimon fell to darkness and started this war.
_2353.CompletionSummary:
So the target becomes clear now.
Main target will be Cherubimon, and the objective is to defeat him!

_2354.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2354.Description:
Before taking down Cherubimon, taking down his minions will help!
To the information I've received, army is being trained from Digimon Maze F2. And Grizzlymon are making the core troops among them.
If the troops of Grizzlymon are defeated, the force of Beast Type Digimon will be weaken!
Please go there and take down those Grizzlymon armies! We'll guard this area from the Beast Type Digimon intruders!
_2354.CompletionSummary: I see that you completed defeating Grizzlymon! The force of Beast Type Digimon became weaker.

_2355.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2355.Description:
Since the armies have been defeated, now let's get rid of their leaders!
Cherubimon has 3 co-leaders… They're Antylamon(Deva), MetalTyrannomon, and Mephismon. These co-leaders have an enormous amount of armies, so it should be a tough task…
But to end the war for good, all of them must be taken down!
_2355.Objective: Defeat Antylamon (Deva) Defeat Sangloupmon Defeat Gazimon
_2355.CompletionSummary: You're greater than I thought! I didn't expect you to take down Antylamon(Deva) so soon…

_2356.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2356.Description:
Our next target is MetalTyrannomon!
This guy is very vicious as he looks like! Even his armies are vicious just like him. They're known to inflicted most of the damage to Human Type Digimon…
So it may become more tough than when you fought against Antylamon(Deva)...
We're in desperate need of your help now! Please encounter MetalTyrannomon, his armies and take all of them down to bring peace!
_2356.Objective: Defeat MetalTyrannomon Defeat DarkTyrannomon Defeat Greymon(Black)
_2356.CompletionSummary: I had a faith in you to defeat MetalTyrannomon and his armies, but it really is amazing to see it myself. You're really a one big miracle!

_2357.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2357.Description:
Now, it's just one co-leader what's left of Cherubimon! When Mephismon is taken down, Cherubimon will no longer has control over his minions!
Mephismon is a very cunning type of leader. Even Omegamon of Royal Knights has once falllen into Mephismon's plan.
But if you stay focused, you won't have any problem on defeating Mephismon!
I start to see the light of hopes from Digital World's future that was covered only with darkness! So please keep it up until it ends!
_2357.Objective: Defeat Mephismon Defeat Devidramon Defeat BlackGatomon
_2357.CompletionSummary:
I knew it! I had confidence that you'll succeed it as well!
Thanks to you that the war has come near to the end!

_2358.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2358.Description:
Hopefully, this will be the final task. It's eliminating the source of this war.
When Cherubimon is finally defeated, our world will retrieve peace, and I won't have to restore data of Digimon who lost their lives in war…
I hope it will be my last request! Please take down Cherubimon and retrieve the peace of Digital World!
_2358.CompletionSummary:
Thank you so much my friend!
I'm pretty sure that you're a true hero of this world! It's not much, but I want to reward you for the peace you retrieved for us.
Please take it!

_2359.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2359.Description:
The thing I gave you is a type of amulet I've have been treasuring.
It's currently sealed, but Calumon may break the seal for you…
When you keep the amulet with you, the powers of amulet may enable your partner Silphymon's evolution.
It's my little reward for you my friend. I hope you like it.
_2359.Objective: Talk to Calumon Deliver Sealed Aurvandil
_2359.CompletionSummary:
I've noticed that the voice of sadness and rage has turned to voice of joy, Culu~! You must have succeeded your mission!
Wait, what is that stuff? A gift from Valkyrimon, Culu? That should probably mean Valkyrimon greatly appreciate you for what you've done, Culu~!

_2360.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2360.Description:
Aurvandil is a bow that has been treasured by Valkyrimon and it even possess some of the powers of Valkyrimon, Culu~!
Giving the most treasured bow to someone… that must mean Valkyrimon has been deeply impressed by your help~ Culu~!
To the sincerity of Valkyrimon, I shall break the seal of this item~ Culu!
_2360.CompletionSummary:
The item has been successfully unsealed now, Culu~! When you use it on your partner Silphymon, she'll be able to evolve into Valkyrimon, Culu~!
I hope you can have the warm heart just like Valkyrimon you've met earlier, who mourn for death of the innocent and seek for peace.

_2361.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2361.Description: You want to help the Beast Type Digimon? Well, I expected you would probably choose Human Type Digimon, but it seems like I was wrong.
_2361.CompletionSummary: Aha… Human, you also have a good sence of judgment.

_2362.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2362.Description:
Need some explanation for that?
Valkyrimon may not explained this part to you, but I think you should know.
The supreme leader of Human Type Digimon turns out to be ShadowSeraphimon. ShadowSeraphimon is one of the 3 Angel Digimon and put a lot of effort for maintaining peace. But unfortunately, ShadowSeraphimon has fallen and became evil.
They say that ShadowSeraphimon fell to darkness and started this war.
_2362.CompletionSummary:
So the target becomes clear now.
Main target will be ShadowSeraphimon, and the objective is to defeat him!

_2363.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2363.Description:
Before taking down ShadowSeraphimon, taking down his minions will help!
To the information I've received, army is being trained from Digimon Maze F2. And Ogremon are making the core troops among them.
If the troops of Ogremon are defeated, the force of Human Type Digimon will be weaken!
Please go there and take down those Ogremon armies! We'll guard this area from the Human Type Digimon intruders!
_2363.CompletionSummary: I see that you completed defeating Ogremon! The force of Human Type Digimon became weaker.

_2364.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2364.Description:
Since the armies have been defeated, now let's get rid of their leaders!
ShadowSeraphimon has 3 co-leaders… They're Asuramon, MarinDevimon, and Astamon. These co-leaders have an enormous amount of armies, so it should be a tough task…
But to end the war for good, all of them must be taken down!
_2364.Objective: Defeat Asuramon Defeat Musyamon Defeat Yashamon
_2364.CompletionSummary: You're greater than I thought! I didn't expect you to take down Asuramon so quickly…

_2365.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2365.Description:
Our next target is Panjyamon!
This guy is very vicious as he looks like! Even his armies are vicious just like him. They're known to inflicted most of the damage to Beast Type Digimon…
So it may become more tough than when you fought against Asuramon...
We're in desperate need of your help now! Please encounter Panjyamon, his armies and take all of them down to bring peace!
_2365.Objective: Defeat Panjyamon Defeat Sawujinmon Defeat Bastemon
_2365.CompletionSummary: I had a faith in you to defeat Panjyamon and his armies, but it really is amazing to see it myself. You're really a one big miracle!

_2366.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2366.Description:
Now, it's just one co-leader what's left of ShadowSeraphimon! When Astamon is taken down, ShadowSeraphimon will no longer has control over his minions!
Astamon is a very tactful type of leader.
But if you stay focused, you won't have any problem on defeating Astamon!
I start to see the light of hopes from Digital World's future that was covered only with darkness! So please keep it up until it ends!
_2366.Objective: Defeat Astamon Defeat WereGarurumon(Black) Defeat Wendigomon
_2366.CompletionSummary:
I knew it! I had confidence that you'll succeed it as well!
Thanks to you that the war has come near to the end!

_2367.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2367.Description:
Hopefully, this will be the final task. It's eliminating the source of this war.
When ShadowSeraphimon is finally defeated, our world will retrieve peace, and I won't have to restore data of Digimon who lost their lives in war…
I hope it will be my last request! Please take down ShadowSeraphimon and retrieve the peace of Digital World!
_2367.CompletionSummary:
Thank you so much my friend!
I'm pretty sure that you're a true hero of this world! It's not much, but I want to reward you for the peace you retrieved for us.
Please take it!

_2368.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2368.Description:
The thing I gave you is a type of amulet I've have been treasuring.
It's currently sealed, but Calumon may break the seal for you…
When you keep the amulet with you, the powers of amulet may enable your partner Silphymon's evolution.
It's my little reward for you my friend. I hope you like it.
_2368.Objective: Talk to Calumon Deliver Sealed Aurvandil
_2368.CompletionSummary:
I've noticed that the voice of sadness and rage has turned to voice of joy, Culu~! You must have succeeded your mission!
Wait, what is that stuff? A gift from Valkyrimon, Culu? That should probably mean Valkyrimon greatly appreciate you for what you've done, Culu~!

_2369.Title: Jogress[Valkyrimon]
_2369.Description:
Aurvandil is a bow that has been treasured by Valkyrimon and it even possess some of the powers of Valkyrimon, Culu~!
Giving the most treasured bow to someone… that must mean Valkyrimon has been deeply impressed by your help~ Culu~!
To the sincerity of Valkyrimon, I shall break the seal of this item~ Culu!
_2369.CompletionSummary:
The item has been successfully unsealed now, Culu~! When you use it on your partner Silphymon, she'll be able to evolve into Valkyrimon, Culu~!
I hope you can have the warm heart just like Valkyrimon you've met earlier, who mourn for death of the innocent and seek for peace.

_2370.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2370.Description:
What brings you here, Culu~? Have you talked to chief Sampson already? No?
Sampson has just recalled all DATS agents, Culu~.
I've sensed something bad is happening, and I guess it may be involved, Culu~!
Go and talk to Sampson to find what's going on, Culu~.
_2370.CompletionText: Sampson has a serious face when I saw him. That may mean whatever happening is not just and average accident, Culu~.
_2370.CompletionSummary:
Mmm… I thought you'd come earlier… Well, we're on an emergency state now, so I just want you to focus on my briefing.
Please pay attention to what I say.

_2371.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2371.Description: I want you to go to Tokyo-Odaiba area. First, search the whole area and report to headquarters right away when you find anything remarkable. Over!
_2371.Objective: Go to Minato City Investigate Minato City

_2372.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2372.Description:
There's an organization called the D.A.A(Dark-Above-All) in Digital World… It totally makes sence as their members are all formed up by Digimon of darkness.
Some of them weren't dark from the first time, but began to change after joining that organization.
Even if the new member has nothing to do with darkness, the boss of organization can easily turn him into darkness by injecting someting inside the body.
_2372.CompletionSummary: That injection not only turns Digimon into dark color, but pulls strength upto their limit boundaries. And for the price, they'll lose their mind and become very violent.

_2373.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2373.Description: Ah… Hello? Can you hear me clearly? @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>? We have a situation! We've received report of 3 dangerous Digimon re-arised in Minato City! 2 of them are showing destructive behaviors. @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, you're the one who can stop them. Please stop the 2 Digimon before they destroy anything! Good luck to you! Over!
_2373.CompletionSummary: Have you defeated them already? I see. That's nice work! But the whole situation isn't over yet.

_2374.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2374.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, have you visited Big Sight before? Even if you haven't visited there yet, you'd probably heard of it before. We detected a very dangerous Digimon from that area!
Agent Thomas was dispatched to Big Sight, so you'll be able to get a briefing from him! Over!
_2374.Objective: Go to Big Sight Talk to Thomas
_2374.CompletionSummary: Are you the backup agent? I'm glad you came! You may have heard already, but the situation here is not good…

_2375.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2375.Description:
One of the very dangerous Digimon has re-arised here! However, this one is not comparable to the others.
The appearance of it was Omegamon, but it was black. The force of this Digimon was so strong that I couldn't bear moving a step once it came into my sight. It's impossible for me to stop it alone.
But if you help, maybe we can stand a chance against that Black Omegamon! It must be a very tough opponent, but at least we can try!

_2376.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2376.Description:
I've received report from Thomas that you successfully defeated the re-arised Digimon, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Good job!
But stay sharp though, because the whole situation isn't over yet. I want you to head to Odaiba now.
We've received in report that Digimon with huge data is about to re-arise in Odaiba soon! So be there quickly!
And also take good care of your partner Digimon. Calumon has told me that something not good may happen to your Digimon friend.
So now, I want you to focus on the current duty! Over!
_2376.Objective: Go to Hideout of Odaiba Talk to Omegamon Alter-S
_2376.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Hideout of Odaiba%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Omegamon Alter-S%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2376.CompletionSummary: Is this it? As I thought… something is not right…

_2377.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2377.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Be careful! It's the one that I warned you! It's coming towards you!

_2378.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2378.Description:
This is Richard. How's the situation?
Hmm… so that's what happened? Well, I guess we can't turn that back now. We have to focus on things that we can do. That is to minimize the damage we take!
First thing is first, we should stop Omegamon Zwart D! I know it's a big burden for you, but try your best to block Omegamon Zwart D!
I'll contact other agents to send them there soon! Over!
_2378.CompletionSummary:
Have you defeated Defeat Omegamon Zwart D? That's outstanding work!
How's the status of Omegamon Alter-S?

_2379.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2379.Description:
Turned black being affected by darkness? Then Calumon was right about this.
I asked White-bearded Guru about the legend you once mentioned. And he told me that it's not just a made-up story. Then we have only one thing to do!
This time, we should stop Omegamon Alter-S who truned into darkness before the city takes any damage! Our agents are heading to Odaiba in a haste! Meanwhile, I hope you can buy some time! I wish you luck! Over!
_2379.CompletionSummary: Have you defeated him by yourself alone? Incredible!

_2380.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2380.Description:
Oh, is that so? You haven't defeated him, but made him unconscious instead?
I understood. Bring him to DATS Center with you.
We'll discuss what to do next. Over!
_2380.CompletionSummary: Excellent! We're still in middle of an urgent situation, so we shall discuss about your reward later!

_2381.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2381.Description:
White-bearded Guru told me that the variation of Omegamon Alter-S who turned dark is called by the name of Omegamon Alter-B. Anyway, the issue now is what to do with Omegamon Alter-B. I asked Nanomon in DATS Center to check the conditions of Omegamon Alter-B.
So if you go and ask Nanomon, you'll be able to check Omegamon Alter-B's condition. Over!
_2381.CompletionSummary: Hmm… have you come for the results? It's taking a while, but almost finished. Just wait for a moment.

_2382.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-B]
_2382.Description:
Mmm… This must be the Black Digitron. I've heard of it many times but it's first time seeing this stuff and it's pretty amazing. I sincerely appreciate for the great gift to me.
Now, back to the point, when this stuff gets into Digimon, it becomes difficult to separate it again. However, if we can only nullify its weaknesses, it can become a blessing instead.
_2382.CompletionSummary:
It can be a tough task, but possible for me who could even duplicate Digivice.
Here, I'll give you a sample. This sample of Black Digitron is extracted from Omegamon Alter-B, so it can only be used on Omegamon Alter-S.
So if you get a chance to face Omegamon Alter-S, you can try it.
It'd definitely work, because I've tested it many times myself already.

_2383.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2383.Description: An enormous force is moving towards us, Culu! Rumors say that Yggdrasil started to carry out its plan. There's a survivor from that place, Culu. The survivor is Dorumon in D-Terminal, so pay him a visit sometime, Culu.

_2384.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2384.Description:
So… you must be a human guardian of this place. I can tell you that Yggdrasil is threatning all the Digimons with X-Program. We need stronger power, something new…
You're looking very strong. Can you help my friend Wiardmon, who saved me before?
_2384.CompletionText: Wiardmon is somewhere deep in the forest.

_2385.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2385.Description:
You're the one who Dorumon called. Then you came the right way. To survive in this environment requires X-Antibody. This is my personal thinking, but I don't believe that only the chosen one gets it.
I need more research. Please help me get the Digicores from the outrageous FanBeemons.
_2385.CompletionText: Once you get the FanBeemon's Digicores, I'll tell you the results of my research.
_2385.CompletionSummary: As I thought, X-Antibody isn't just given to the chosen ones. It isn't related with type of Digimon.

_2386.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2386.Description:
I've heard that GranDracmon has appeared in this area.
His companions are immune to X-Program and they are attacking the innocent and weak Digimons.
It's not something tolerable! Please show them no mercy!
_2386.CompletionText: It's getting more and more confusing.
_2386.CompletionSummary: What? Dracmons are looking for something? What could that be?

_2387.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2387.Description:
This is very suspicious. I want to investigate this further.
They are subordinates of GranDracmon, so I guess they should have something like document written with their master's instructions. If you find it, please collect them as many as you can and bring them to me.
_2387.Objective: Obtain each Low, Mid, High Class Instructions of Dracmon, Sangloupmon and Matadormon.
_2387.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1GranDracmon's Low Class Instructions%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2GranDracmon's Mid Class Instructions%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3GranDracmon's High Class Instructions%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2387.CompletionText: Be careful. They are strong Digimons.
_2387.CompletionSummary: Great! I'll take a close look to these documents now!

_2388.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2388.Description:
It's ordering them to retrieve X-Antibody before it spreads to all the rest of Digimons.
I wonder what GranDracmon is upto. I think we should encounter GranDracomon. But before that, I'll call for reinforcements, so please hold on!
_2388.CompletionText: I have no idea on his power limits. I'll contact Resistance now.

_2389.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2389.Description: They are just my data pieces, but you've taken them down. You're an interesting human. X-Antibody is a blessing to bring evolution and power of curse at the same time. You should be aware of the source well. So let me tell you a secret. Do you remember DexDoruGreymon that you've encountered? You'll find out what the source really is when you look into its Digicore.
_2389.CompletionText: The secrets will be revealed one day.
_2389.CompletionSummary: Evolution of risking death? So where is this X-Antibody coming from?

_2390.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2390.Description: Damn, the Royal Knights has found this place. Our patrols told me that they already started to appear from area nearby. Examon is one of them and it started to attack Resistance. Please save our companions. I can't leave them to die!
_2390.CompletionText: Is Yggdrasil trying to eliminate all the possibilities.
_2390.CompletionSummary: We have another problem right after a problem! Gees!

_2391.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2391.Description:
The leader and the strongest member of Royal Knights has finally revealed himself. It's Omegamon, and he's very dangerous. Magnamon was a big threat to us before, but now a bigger threat has approached.
I'll help the members to evacuate. Please stop Omegamon at the meantime!
_2391.CompletionText: Do you think Yggdrasil also knows the secret of X-Antibody?
_2391.CompletionSummary: Have you felt something strange in the battle against Omegamon?

_2392.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2392.Description:
Magnamon, Omegamon, and the evolution of death. X-Antibody is chaos itself. And it's a one big data that contains a lot of secrets.
However, I believe that you are capable of taking control over its power.
Now, my human friend. Please become the hope of Digimon. Please become the balance of true justice and power.
_2392.CompletionText: Ask Calumon about the Antibody. He's the one who's responsible for all evolutions, so he should be aware.
_2392.CompletionSummary: Huh? What did you say that you saw?
_2392.ReservedText: You've came back safely, Culu! You didn't get hurt, did you?

_2393.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2393.Description:
That's what happened Culu… and the truth of Omegamon was like that Culu.
The power seems to be unleashed from the potential of Omegamon Culu. And the potential has grew inside you, so I'll help you grow it, Culu.
The answer is inside yourself, Culu.
_2393.CompletionSummary: It's all done Culu!! To get used to this power, your level and Digimon level should reach 99 Culu. Visit Omegamon when you're fully prepared.

_2394.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2394.Description: Now, go and talk to Omegamon Culu. I know that you've faced him in battle, so it can be a little awkward, but it's important to find out his intention Culu.
_2394.CompletionSummary: I see, that the power has been revealed. Talk to me again when ready.

_2395.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2395.Description:
새로운 싸움이 또 다시 펼쳐지려고 해 동글.
D-터미널에 있는 동글몬이 널 기다리고 있어 동글.
한번 가봐 동글!

_2396.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2396.Description:
지금도 이그드라실이 X-프로그램으로 디지몬들을 위협하고 있어.
오메가몬이 네게 힘을 줬지만.. 아직 그와 로얄나이츠의 정의는 이그드라실이 있는 것 같아.
정의가 무엇인지 보여줄 때야. 일단 위자몬을 찾아가볼래?

_2397.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2397.Description:
알고 있겠지만.. 이곳은 매우 혼란스러워.
디지몬들이 서로 살기 위해서 서로 죽이고 디지코어에 있는 항체들을 흡수하고 있어.
그런데 중엔 폭주를 하거나 악행을 일삼는 디지몬들도 있어서 머리가 아플 지경이야.
다시 우리의 동료가 되서 그들을 막아줘!

_2398.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2398.Description:
X-항체가 없는 디지몬들은 필사적일 수 밖에 없어.
그 결과는..응, 네가 보는대로야.
힘을 합쳐야될 때..이러고 있다니 젠장.
이번엔 다크티라노몬들을 진정시켜줘. 부탁한다.

_2399.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2399.Description:
싸움이 점점 더 격해지고 있어.
그랜쿠가몬들과 그 부하들이 무차별적으로 동료들을 공격하고 있고 X-항체를 수집하고 있다고 해.
원흉은... X-프로그램과 그걸 만든 이그드라실인데..
그 녀석들은 쿠네몬들을 잡으면 나타나는데 하나씩 계속 처치하다보면 그랜쿠가몬도 모습을 드러낼거야.
어서 그 녀석들을 막아줘.
_2399.Objective:
쿠와가몬(진화한) 처치 오쿠와몬(진화한) 처치 그랜쿠가몬(진화한) 처치
쿠네몬(진화한)을 처치시 그랑디스쿠가몬들과 그 부하들이 출현

_2400.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2400.Description:
예전에 그란드라큐몬을 만난 적이 있지?
최근에 그의 데이터 조각들이 눈에 띄게 늘어났다고해. 여러 일들 때문에 대충 넘어갔었지만 수상한 게 한둘이 아니야.
그 녀석한테 죽음의 진화와 X-항체에 대해 물어볼 때가 됐어. 또 그 녀석의 부하들이 방해하겠지만..돌파할 수 밖엔 없어. 갈 준비 됐지?
_2400.Objective:
그란드라큐몬(진화한) 처치
드라큐몬(진화한) 처치시
상굴몬,마타돌몬,그란드라큐몬 순으로 출현

_2401.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2401.Description:
일을 방해하다니 귀찮게 하는구나 인간.
데크스돌그레몬으로 봐서 깨달았을텐데? X-항체는 죽음을 막지만 죽음을 부르는 데이터다.
내게 답을 구한다고 한들 의미가 없다. 직접 격어봐야 알지. 다시한번 그 녀석들을 만나보거라. 깨달음은 매우 쉬울 것이다.
_2401.Objective: 데크스돌그레몬 처치 후 불안정한 X-항체 수집
_2401.CompletionText: 진화의 끝엔 무엇이 있을 것이라고 생각하나?
_2401.CompletionSummary: 그랬군.. 죽음의 진화. 그것은 생존을 위한 욕망이었어. 그것이 데크스를 만든 거야.

_2402.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2402.Description:
엑자몬이 다시 나타났어.
이번엔 제대로 할 생각인가봐. 여유가 보이지 않는다고 해.
부탁한다. 힘겹겠지만 그를 막아줘.
_2402.CompletionText: 대체 언제까지 우리들을 없앨 생각인 거지..?

_2403.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2403.Description:
이번에도 오메가몬이 다시 나타났어.
아무래도.. 그의 정의가 이그드라실의 정의인 이상
여전히 이그드라실의 명령을 듣고 있는 것 같아.
이대로 지켜볼 수는 없어. 동료들을 부탁할게.

_2404.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2404.Description:
겨우 하나의 시련을 넘겼어.
동료들은 지금 은신처에 숨어서 몸을 추스리는 중이야.
시련과 시련.. 살아남기 위해 죽음을 각오하고 싸워야한다니 그란드라큐몬의 말이 생각나는군.
…그 힘은 나로선 알 수가 없어. 일단 동글몬을 찾아가봐. 그 친구라면 뭔가 알고 있을 거야.
_2404.CompletionText: 고생했어. 네 세계로 돌아가서 정비하도록 해.
_2404.CompletionSummary: 아, 다시 돌아왔구나 동글!! 음? 뭘 봤다고 동글?

_2405.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2405.Description:
그건.. 특별한 X-항체의 힘이 피어난 것 같다 동글.
아마 오메가몬 안에 있었던 잠재력이 싸움에서 나온 것 같다 동글.
아무래도 오메가몬이랑 싸우면 그 힘의 근원이 나올 것 같아 동글.
최근에 수수께끼 X-항체 인자이란 걸 스캔하면 여러 인자들이 나온다고 하니까
그걸로도 찾아봐 동글!
_2405.CompletionText: 구하기 힘들겠지만... 새로운 힘을 위해서 힘내 동글!
_2405.CompletionSummary: 다 됐어 동글!! 새로운 힘에 적하려면 너의 레벨이 99이어야 하고 디지몬의 레벨은 99이어야만 해 동글. 레벨이 준비되면 오메가몬을 찾아가봐 동글

_2406.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2406.Description:
자 이제 오메가몬을 찾아가봐 동글.
오메가몬의 뜻은 아까와 같은 걸까 동글?
_2406.CompletionSummary:
그 항체를 다시 찾아냈나보군.
내게 다시 말을 걸도록.

_2407.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2407.Summary: Master Sitting on an Empty Seat
_2407.Description:
The empty seat… was that Digimon indeed.
Yggdrasil is justice. But through my old friend Gallantmon, I was doubtful to my thoughts. Willing to survive is an instinct. However, Yggdrasil is denying all these facts.
So I began to question myself. What it another justice? Is there answere to this question?
Now, please show me. The true justice you were talking about.
_2407.CompletionText: Gallantmon, what have you been thinking?
_2407.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on becoming the master of the empty throne.

_2408.Title: Jogress[Alphamon Ouryuken X]
_2408.Description:
The empty seat… was that Digimon indeed.
Yggdrasil created absolute power to prevent Royal Knights from getting crazy. And the justice was put under the absolute power.
I began to wonder as I heard what Gallantmon said.
_2408.CompletionText: Alphamon, and Ouryuken. Where will your sword point at now?
_2408.CompletionSummary:
Congratulations on becoming the master of the empty throne.
Use 'X-Antibody Factor: Alphamon Ouryuken Beta' to expand the evolution slot.

_2409.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2409.Description: I can sence dark towers radiating strong negative energy from everywhere of Digital World, culu! And the energy seems to be especially fierce from the Western Areas of Digital World, culu! My friend Patamon left to investigate the area, so if you go there, you'll be able to meet Patamon, culu!
_2409.CompletionText: Patamon should be at somewhere in the Dark Tower Wastelands, culu! Ask Patamon about the situation and you'll hear something helpful, culu!
_2409.CompletionSummary: Welcome, my friends! I'll tell you what's going on here!

_2410.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2410.Description: I found a spider army constructing the Dark Towers. There are lots of them, and the red spider Archnemon is their leader. Please stop Archnemon and her minions before they become a big threat to the entire Digital World!
_2410.CompletionText: Archnemon and her spider army are heading for Western Area: Outskirts.
_2410.CompletionSummary: Thanks, my friend! The world is one step closer to peace now!

_2411.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2411.Description: Breaking news, my friend! The spider army that you confront was not the only suspect responsible for the evil plan! A swarm of Flymons and Okuwamons are in rage to avenge for their leader Archnemon in the Wilderness Area! Please go to the Wilderness Area and save our friendly Digimons from the risk!
_2411.CompletionText: The swarm of Okuwamons are found from the center of Wilderness Area.
_2411.CompletionSummary: Thanks, my friend! Western Area became much safer now!

_2412.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2412.Description: With your help, Digital World is free from potential threats, culu! Thank you!
_2412.CompletionSummary: This Jogress is new and powerful, culu!

_2413.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2413.Description: Good to see you again, culu. Your old master, that mad kid has caused lots of trouble and Digital World is in risk now. Not to blame you, but if you can help the situation, head to the Ice Area and meet Hawkmon there, culu! My friend Hawkmon left to investigate the area, so if you go there, you'll be able to meet Hawkmon, culu!
_2413.CompletionText: Hawkmon should be at somewhere in the Frozen Ground, culu! Ask Hawkmon about the situation and you'll hear something helpful, culu!
_2413.CompletionSummary: Oh, a reinforcement has arrived? Then, I'll brief you the situation first!

_2414.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2414.Description: I saw IceDevimon and Mojyamons constructing Dark Towers in this area. I see that you've come a far distance to help us. Then I'll guide you what to do from now. IceDevimon is the leader in the group. So when you strike him down, the Dark Towers won't be increased anymore.
_2414.CompletionText: IceDevimon is found from Snowstorm Village!
_2414.CompletionSummary: Thanks, my friend! Your passion is warm enough to let us stand in this cold place!

_2415.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2415.Description: There's a bad news! It seems Apemons and Mojyamons that already contaminated by the Dark Towers are rampaging in Distorted Data Village! I guess we need your help one more time! Please go to Distorted Data Village and stop the rampaging Apemons and Mojyamons!
_2415.CompletionText: Apemons and Mojyamons are rampaging from Distorted Data Village!
_2415.CompletionSummary: Thanks, my friend! Ice Area became much safer now!

_2416.Title: Jogress [Paildramon]
_2416.Description: With your help, Digital World is free from potential threats, culu! Thank you!
_2416.CompletionSummary: This Jogress is new and powerful, culu!

_2417.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2417.Description:
Culu! I sence the energy of Dark Towers in the Real World now clearly, culu!
This means the Real World is in a risk, so go to Sampson immediately!
_2417.CompletionText: Dark Towers in Real World is a very big disaster, culu!
_2417.CompletionSummary: I was expecting you to come. We have a situation now!

_2418.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2418.Description: We have an emergency situation! Dark Towers have created a monster in the Real World. This creation of Dark Towers possess power transcending our presumptions! We don't have a chance to face that monster directly. Please ask Calumon if there are any countermeasures.
_2418.CompletionSummary: Creation of the Dark Towers? That's horrible… culu.

_2419.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2419.Description: So master Sampson does not have any plans? That's a pity, culu. However, we can't just give up and leave the Real World into danger. I've been saving Qinglongmon's Digicore until now, and it seems to possess unmeasurably enormous energy inside it, culu! Now is the time to use this to face the evil, culu!
_2419.CompletionSummary: Qinglongmon's Digicore has the ability to maximize your power, culu!

_2420.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2420.Description: Good enough, culu! With this power, you'll be able to face and defeat the incarnation of Dark Towers, culu! Please get rid of the horrible monster from this world, culu!
_2420.CompletionText: I sence Dark Tower energy from the Oil Refinery, culu!
_2420.CompletionSummary: Thank you, culu! The world regains peace once again! Culu!

_2421.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2421.Description:
Culu! I sence the energy of Dark Towers in the Real World now clearly, culu!
This means the Real World is in a risk, so go to Sampson immediately!
_2421.CompletionText: Dark Towers in Real World is a very big disaster, culu!
_2421.CompletionSummary: I was expecting you to come. We have a situation now!

_2422.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2422.Description: We have an emergency situation! Dark Towers have created a monster in the Real World. This creation of Dark Towers possess power transcending our presumptions! We don't have a chance to face that monster directly. Please ask Calumon if there are any countermeasures.
_2422.CompletionSummary: Creation of the Dark Towers? That's horrible… culu.

_2423.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2423.Description: So master Sampson does not have any plans? That's a pity, culu. However, we can't just give up and leave the Real World into danger. I've been saving Qinglongmon's Digicore until now, and it seems to possess unmeasurably enormous energy inside it, culu! Now is the time to use this to face the evil, culu!
_2423.CompletionSummary: Qinglongmon's Digicore has the ability to maximize your power, culu!

_2424.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon]
_2424.Description: Good enough, culu! With this power, you'll be able to face and defeat the incarnation of Dark Towers, culu! Please get rid of the horrible monster from this world, culu!
_2424.CompletionText: I sence Dark Tower energy from the Oil Refinery, culu!
_2424.CompletionSummary: Thank you, culu! The world regains peace once again! Culu!

_2425.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon - Fighter Mode]
_2425.Description:
Culu! I sence a great evil Digimon in the Real World again, culu!
Go and talk to master Sampson, Culu!
_2425.CompletionSummary: You must have heard from Calumon. Good to have you here.

_2426.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon - Fighter Mode]
_2426.Description: The evil Digimon identified as SkullSatamon is found in the middle of Yokohama Village. It is much stronger than the common SkullSatamon we know. Much likely to be affected by Dark Towers. Go to Yokohama Village right now and save the people out there!
_2426.CompletionText: SkullSatamon doesn't seem to have reached deep inside the village yet. But there isn't much time, so you'd better hurry!
_2426.CompletionSummary: The energy is truly incredible. Is this the true aspect of Dark Towers? Anyway, you've done an excellent job!

_2427.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon - Fighter Mode]
_2427.Description:
Culu! I sence a great evil Digimon in the Real World again, culu!
Go and talk to master Sampson, Culu!
_2427.CompletionSummary: You must have heard from Calumon. Good to have you here.

_2428.Title: Jogress [ImperialDramon - Fighter Mode]
_2428.Description: The evil Digimon identified as SkullSatamon is found in the middle of the Oil Refinery. It is much stronger than the common SkullSatamon we know. Much likely to be affected by Dark Towers. Go to Oil Refinery right now and save the people out there!
_2428.CompletionText: SkullSatamon was found in the middle of Oil Refinery. The place is still quiet, but you'd better not waste time!
_2428.CompletionSummary: The energy is truly incredible. Is this the true aspect of Dark Towers? Anyway, you've done an excellent job!

_2429.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2429.Description: Project Ark has been resumed and New Digital World is being stabilized. But the intruders from old Digital World is creating chaos to New Digital World and it's becoming a mess. I'm a messenger of Yggdrasil, and you're partner of Omegamon. So you should do your part with responsibility, human. Did you make up your mind?

_2430.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2430.Description: You should get rid of the intruders. It's time for an execution!
_2430.Objective: Defeat Dorumon Defeat Dracmon Defeat FanBeemon Defeat Kunemon
_2430.CompletionText: When you're done with the task, return to me.
_2430.CompletionSummary: You've done well. Here's the data with the voucher.

_2431.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2431.Description: You should get rid of the intruders who oppose to Yggdrasil's plan. Now stick to the plan!
_2431.CompletionText: When you're done with the task, return to me.
_2431.CompletionSummary: Good job. Now I can move on.

_2432.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2432.Description:
Gallantmon denied to join us. He is questioning on Yggdrasil's decisions.
But our will is strong. Please tell him that.
_2432.CompletionText: So you know where Gallantmon is at?
_2432.CompletionSummary: You must be the partner of Omegamon?

_2433.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2433.Summary: A Friend on the Other Side
_2433.Description:
Is that really the will of rest of the Royal Knights? Human, what do you think about that? About why this massacre has to be occurred. They're even trying to execute the ones who are about to die by X-Program.
I see. If that is your choice, you'll have to go through me first. Find me in another place.
_2433.CompletionText: This is not the place to fight. I'll be moving to another area.

_2434.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2434.Description: A friend has left us… But we can't lose the Digital World. I've heard that there are intruders we had never seen before. To deal with them, we need more information about them. Please defeat Okuwamon and colllect some data.
_2434.CompletionText: Okuwamon will reveal itself when you defeat Kunemon and their evovled ones.
_2434.CompletionSummary: You've brought the data of Okuwamon. Good! I'll start the examination.

_2435.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2435.Description: X-evolution… Gallantmon has once said that. The recent strangers must be related with it. They are known to evolve by forms that are much stronger than the normal forms. Please investigate them.
_2435.Objective: Defeat Dorumon Defeat Dorugamon Defeat DoruGreymon
_2435.CompletionText: They exist on Verdandi Terminal Desert.
_2435.CompletionSummary: How was the investigation? Did you find a clue?

_2436.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2436.Description:
This investigation starts from just a theory, so we need more information.
Please collect the data from those Digimons and hand them over to me. I think I can find a clue.
_2436.CompletionText: The collecting of data is necessary for investigation.
_2436.CompletionSummary: I think this will be enough. Thanks.

_2437.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2437.Description: I've been examining on the data you brought me. Meanwhile, there is a possible threat found from somewhere. A strong Digimon is found from the place where we found Dorumon last time. It may become an obstacle for Project Ark, so we should deal with it.
_2437.CompletionText: It will show itself when you defeat the Dorumons.
_2437.CompletionSummary: Have it been eliminated? Then we should have no problem on proceeding Project Ark.

_2438.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2438.Description:
X-evolution isn't part of Yggdrasil's plans. The Digimon is just a mere experiment of Yggdrasil.
A Digimon to bring new order to the Digital World.
But how did it evolve into something that oppose Yggdrasil's will?

_2439.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2439.Description: Yggdrasil has executed a new Project Ark. But it's not natural. Destroying the world, that seems to be too impatient as a decision Yggdrasil would make.
_2439.CompletionText: I've never heard of such plan!!
_2439.CompletionSummary: What? You mean you're going there?

_2440.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2440.Description: Wait. The gate has been damaged by them, so you may not return when you go throught it now. I think we should reduce their number first to prevent the gate being destroyed. Please go and get them.
_2440.CompletionText: Hurry! There is no time to waste!
_2440.CompletionSummary: Thanks. With your help, the gate is maintaining.

_2441.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2441.Description: DexDoruGreymons left suspicious traces of data. We need to find out where they come from. Please collect the data and stop them from destroying the gate.
_2441.CompletionText: I can find out where they come from when you bring the data.
_2441.CompletionSummary: This will be enough data. I'll start examining.

_2442.Title: Jogress [Omegamon X]
_2442.Description: Are you ready? It's almost time. Time to go to Yggdrasil… [Condition: X-evolution quest [Ready to Risk Lives] completed]
_2442.CompletionSummary: You've came. Omegamon, and his partner.

_2443.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2443.Description:
Yggdrasil has summoned Dexmon.
It seems Yggdrasil does not want to communicate with us.
Are you prepared to fight back?
_2443.CompletionSummary: It's good to see you safe, human.

_2444.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
