_2444.Description: X-evolution… it is the will of life itself. A will confronting death. A form of hope in middle of darkness that fear and despair gave birth to. I bet Yggdrasil is aware of it too. Even though the incarnation of it was just Dexmon. Do you want to understand the whole thing? First you need the proof of it.
_2444.CompletionText: The proof is with Dexmon now.
_2444.CompletionSummary: So Yggdrasil also had it too. Life that confronts death is more desperate. I bet no one wants to die, for whatever the reason is. So is the will of survival before death. The records that you brought seems to speak for Yggdrasil.

_2445.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2445.Description: This is the strength to survive.
_2445.CompletionSummary: I hope you found the true means of survival.

_2446.Title: Jogress [Omegamon-X]
_2446.Description:
Someone has called the Royal Knights, culu!
You're Omegamon's partner, so you should be there too!
Go on now to Verdandi Terminal, culu!
_2446.CompletionText: I don't feel good about this, culu…
_2446.CompletionSummary: Omegamon, and human. I was expecting.

_2447.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2447.Description: Welcome. Meanwhile, I was about to find you, and you came to me. So, do you know about Diablomon? In the past, Diablomon has planned to destroy the Real World by distorting the data of Nuclear Missiles to launch them and strike the entire World. I have a request for you to do dealing with this dangerous monster. Would you like to hear more?
_2447.CompletionText: I have a feeling that this request may be very intense.
_2447.CompletionSummary: As I've expected! I knew you would accept my request.

_2448.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2448.Description: Then I shall continue my speech. Diablomon was once defeated by the chosen ones, brave children long time ago. I was thinking Diablomon had vanished… but that was just a delusion. Diablomon had backup data of itself, and it revived in current Digital World. So what do you think of this story? Do you still think you can handle a request with such great risk?
_2448.CompletionText: The task may be very risky, but at least I can trust you on it.
_2448.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I had confidence that you would listen to my request. Hohoho…

_2449.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2449.Description: I'll end my speech shortly. Diablomon has been acting suspicious ever since it was revived. Witness has said that it seem to transfer data to someone in Real World. But there is no clue who it may be, and Diablomon was trying to hide the identity of whomever it was contacting. Go and ask chief Sampson, as he knows Real World better than me.
_2449.CompletionText: Thanks for listening to my request.
_2449.CompletionSummary: Here you are. I'll explain shortly and clearly. So I want you to focus.

_2450.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2450.Description: From what White-bearded Guru, Diablomon seem to be contacting someone in the Real World. We have no information what the data is, and what their purpose is. However, I have a strong feeling that the cooperater of Diablomon is Akihiro Kurata. There could be no one else to do something insane like this. But we can't suspect him without any evidences. Go talk to director Hashima for now, as he may have a clue about Kurata.
_2450.CompletionSummary: Location of Akihiro Kurata? Why would you want to know that? Has the man caused trouble again?

_2451.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2451.Description: That is absolutely right. Only a man like Kurata would think of such madness. However, he seems to wake up and live quietly these days. Could he be planning something stupid again from behind us? I know it's not good to doubt other people, but it's obvious he's been doing so many stupid things so far. I've recently heard that Kurata is researching something in Dark Tower Wastelands. You may be able to find the answer from there.
_2451.CompletionText: I don't want anymore trouble caused by Akihiro Kurata.
_2451.CompletionSummary: Huh?? What brings you all the way here, young agent of DATS?

_2452.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2452.Description: Diablomon? Yes, I've heard that name before. That creature seems to be totally nuts. Launching all nuclear missiles from all over the world simultaneously? That could have created a very spectacle view! Haha… it was just a lame joke, don't make a serious face. I know what you think of me, but I'm not that kind of a freak. And I haven't even seen this monster, so called Diablomon. So I want you to get out of my face when you have no more business.
_2452.CompletionText: What's holding you up? I thought you have no more business on me.
_2452.CompletionSummary: Did you realize that you're wrong to judge me?

_2453.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2453.Description:
If you really do, then let's talk about some business.
There's a Digimon I was researching personally, but the research data about it was taken by a green bug. Bugs are bugs after all. They're disgusting.
You get the data back to me. Get rid of those green bugs too so they don't bug me anymore.
_2453.Objective: Defeat Dark Wormmon Collect Akihiro Kurata's Research Data
_2453.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Dark Wormmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Akihiro Kurata's Research Data%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2453.CompletionText: They should be around this place. Many legs, but not very fast…
_2453.CompletionSummary: I appreciate your help. I hope you got rid of those bugs definitely. And you haven't peeked on my research data?

_2454.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2454.Description: What? Who told you that you can look into my research data? If I didn't say it, you shouldn't have looked at it. Haven't you been taught in school not to touch things that don't belong to you? It is common sense. Armagemon is a Digimon which everything is obscure. And I'm a scientist. What do scientists do? They study about the unknown domains, don't they? So my research is for the knowledge of mankind! Stop looking at me like if I'm a mad scientist! Seems like our businss is done now, so why don't you leave?
_2454.CompletionSummary: What? Did you just say Armagemon?

_2455.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2455.Summary: Getting a Clue from Doctor Kurata
_2455.Description: Armagemon? That name came out of Akihiro Kurata's mouth? That is something frightening. It's a Digimon that we only know it's name. Everything else are under veil. I wouldn't worry if it was another scientist who do the research, but it is Akihiro Kurata. I'm worried that this creature may appear in the Real World just like Belphemon did last time. From now, you can stay near him and watch over him to see if he's doing anything suspicious. If you find out, report to me at once.
_2455.CompletionText: Akihiro will certainly have doubts in you when he sees you again, but in other hand, he won't deny your help on his research. He'll try to use you. It's not something very pleasant, but right now, that's the only way to find out what he's at. So go and help him to find out what he's planning to do!
_2455.CompletionSummary: Why did you come back here again?

_2456.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2456.Description: By the looks of you, I can tell you've been ordered to watch me. Right? Haha… I'm a scientist, not an idiot. But that's fine with me. You're not going to stare me all day here, so why don't you do me a favor? I'm sure your chief don't want you to just keep staring at me like that. I suppose you figured out Armagemon is a Digimon of unknown attribute? There are more Digimons with the same attribute. They're Keramon, Chrysalimon, Infermon and all of them are in the Digimon Maze. What you can do now is to collect Keramon's data for me. So I can restart with my research again.
_2456.CompletionText: You can find Keramon from Digimon Maze F1. I look forward to take a look of that data.
_2456.CompletionSummary: Finished so quickly? Good. Let's see what you've got.

_2457.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2457.Description: Keramon, they devour massive amount of data. They seem to enhance and evolute themselves out of it. So if I research its data, I expect to find some interesting results. Haha… to be honest, I appreciate your effort for bringing me such precious data.
_2457.CompletionSummary: That's good. Now, I want you to carry the backup data for just in case. I may lose the data when research fails, but I don't want that to happen.

_2458.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2458.Description: Now, it's time to continue research on Chrysalimon. It's a evoluted form of Keramon. Get me its data for me so I can go on. Meanwhile, I have to look more deeply into current data.
_2458.CompletionText: Chrysalimons can be found from Digimon Maze F2. I wonder how the data will look like.
_2458.CompletionSummary: It took you more time than before. Did you get into trouble or something? Ah… nevermind.

_2459.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2459.Description: Chrysalimon can evolute into next form when a lot of them are gathered together. So if we could amplify its feature, something magnificent may happen. For example, if I inject some kind of a vector to help the evolution, it may exceed the standard evolutionary stage. It's just a theory yet, but who knows?
_2459.CompletionSummary: That's good. Now, I want you to carry the backup data for just in case. I may lose the data when research fails, but I don't want that to happen.

_2460.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2460.Description:
Now, I'm eager to research on Mega Digimon Infermon which is evoluted from Chrysalimon!
So what are you hesitating for? Isn't it obvious that I need Infermon's data now? Go and bring me the data of Infermon, immediatey. We must not waste time on such a important moment!
_2460.CompletionText: Infermons are in Digimon Maze F3. Value your time and be quick!
_2460.CompletionSummary: What took you so long? I thought you lost in the maze. Now, hand me the data.

_2461.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2461.Description:
Infermon hides its face and legs to its body and can greatly be enhanced on durability.
It becomes dull when it's hiding its face and leg into body, but when I research its data, I think I can extract the secret of durability only.
Thanks to you for bringing me such precious data.
_2461.CompletionSummary: That's good. Now, I want you to carry the backup data for just in case. I may lose the data when research fails, but I don't want that to happen.

_2462.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2462.Description:
You're doing great on watching over Akihiro Kurata.
Now you can return to headquarters and report of his actions, over.

_2463.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2463.Description: The data he asked you to bring are of Keramon, Chrysalimon, and Infermon? They have one in common, that they are all subordinates of Diablomon. Then the assumption that Akihiro Kurata being connected with Diablomon should be true. I'm not sure, but I think I'll have to interrogate after having him arrested. Hopefully, he didn't get Diablomon's data yet, so we must have him arrested at stop the risk immediately. Go to Dark Tower Wasteland and bring Akihiro Kurata at once!
_2463.CompletionText: Akihiro Kurata is about to call a disaster again.
_2463.CompletionSummary: Hey, there! Just a second! We have a situation here!

_2464.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2464.Description: We're in an emergency state! A Digimon with huge data has realized in D-Terminal B1! Chief Sampson isn't aware of it yet, so please make a report to him as soon as possible!
_2464.CompletionText: This is not good at all. I hope for no more trouble now.
_2464.CompletionSummary: What brings you back so early? Have you forgot something?

_2465.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2465.Description:
What? A Digimon with huge data has realized in D-Terminal B1?
A realize of huge data in a time when there is a great risk… that is awkward…
But the situation here must be taken care sooner. Go to D-Terminal B1 and deal with the crisis there first.
_2465.CompletionText: If the cause is Akihiro Kurata, the whole incidents probably won't end so easily.
_2465.CompletionSummary: It's you again? What took you so long? I almost fell asleep while waiting.

_2466.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2466.Description:
Welcome back, my faithful cooperator.
I successfully precede my research with your support. You seem to be surprised? Since you haven't brought me the data of Diablomon, but I manged to complete the research. But from the beginning, Diablomon's data wasn't necessary at all. Didn't you notice it? Have you had no idea who I was collaborating with?
Anyway, the incarnation of Armagemon is near! Meanwhile, shall we play along with Diablomon?
_2466.CompletionSummary: Hmm… that was faster than I thought. Diablomon gets weaker once it starts splitting. But I guess that was enough to buy some time. Look now my friend, the time is over.

_2467.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2467.Description: So Akihiro Kurata has caused another disaster. I'm really sorry to give you tough tasks to you only, but in the other hand, there is no one else reliable. I'll have to ask you to stop Armagemon and the ambitions of Akihiro Kurata!
_2467.CompletionSummary: Don't you ever get tired of chasing me? Is it because you're also eager to see Armagemon? (chuckles)

_2468.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2468.Description:
As an expression of gratitude for my loyal supporter, I'll show you the most splendid and glorious moment! Open your eyes wide, and take a look at the masterpiece, Armagemon!!
It's Show Time~!!
_2468.CompletionSummary: Aaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!! No way! This can't be true! It doesn't add up!! You've tormented me by giving me a hope and then smashing it into pieces!! But I never give up! At least before I see the true aspects of this world! You'll never stop me!!

_2469.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2469.Description:
Did you defeat Armagemon?
I'm impressed again. You've done such a great job. Now you can return to headquarters!
_2469.CompletionSummary: You've done great. There is something you should do to put this to an end.

_2470.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2470.Description:
Akihiro Kurata never leaves us in peace. Now we should think of what to do with the remaining data after Diablomon and Armagemon are defeated.
This isn't something for me to decide, so go and ask White-bearded Guru.
_2470.CompletionText: Treat the old man with manners when you ask him a question. I'm confident that he'll give you the right answer.
_2470.CompletionSummary: Welcome back. I've heard what you did from chief Sampson.

_2471.Title: Extra Evo [Armagemon]
_2471.Description:
Diablomon and Armagemon's remaining data? Of course, it could be a headache.
It splits and multiplies itself, so we can't be relieved even though it's just a file of data. Then there is just one answer to it.
We should keep an eye on it. You are capable of defeating Armagemon, so it should be easy for you to take care of Armagemon. I'll help you with it too, of course.
Use this vaccine program to surppress the destructive instincts. Then you'll be able to handle it.
_2471.CompletionSummary: Please take care of it well. I hope the burden isn't too much for you to carry on.

_2472.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2472.Description: Have you heard of the news? File Island was under attack by a single Digimon, culu! As you may know, File Island is packed with lots of strong monsters, but they seem to be defeated by that Digimon. I really wonder who that'd be, culu! Don't you want to know who it is too? If you get to know the answer, can you tell me to, culu? From what I've heard, it's a name called BlitzGreymon, culu!
_2472.CompletionText: I really eager to know who it is~
_2472.CompletionSummary: I do not have time to play with little kids like you. So don't try to waste my time.
_2472.ReservedText: You look too weak to be considered as a challenger. Did you just come here to see who I am?

_2473.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2473.Description: Listen to me kid. I don't have time for jokes nor play with you. I don't even feel the needs to continue this conversation. But if you're here to challenge me, it'd be a whole different story. Even though you don't look to be so strong, I'll give you a chance if that is your will. I'm going to move on, so if you really want to challenge me, you'll confront me there.
_2473.CompletionText: If you change your mind, that's fine. Because that's nature's fate.
_2473.CompletionSummary: Impressive! You're much stronger than I first expected. So what brought you here?

_2474.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2474.Description: Calumon? The one who wants to see me? I've heard the name before. If I remember it correctly, it must be the one who knows the secret of evolution. I thought it was just a made up story or a myth, but you're telling me it's real? That draws my attention. Because if it's true, it can be very useful. So far, I was seeking for more power. If this guy reveals the secrets of evolution, I may be able to find a path to new evolultion. Can you guide me to this guy? I'd like to meet and have a conversation myself.
_2474.CompletionSummary: Culu~? Who is this… oh wait! You must be the dominator of…!

_2475.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2475.Description: You came all the way to me for something, culu? Why? Do you want to know the secrets of evolution? I can understand. But I'm not going to help someone who is not qualified, culu! So what is the standard of qualify? That is not an easy matter, but if you still want to prove yourself, show it to me, culu! Engage GrandisKuwagamon in File Island, defeat at least 5 of them and come back! If you succeed, I'll think positively.
_2475.CompletionText: But you're already strong enough, culu. Why seek for more?
_2475.CompletionSummary: Wow, you're strong and stubborn indeed! I thought you might give up, culu!

_2476.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2476.Description: But promise is a promise, culu. BlitzGreymon, you've reached Mega form all by yourself, and that is very remarkable. However, you've reached a limit and cannot evolve further by yourself, since you've evolved in a different form compared to WarGreymon. But hopefully, you may still be able to evolve further by Jogress evolution. To make this possible, you need to find MetalGarurumon that made a different type of evolution. If you wish to continue, find and bring that MetalGarurumon of different evolution form. Luckily, I have a good news for you. People said that MetalGarurumon of a different form had been found from Infinite Ice Wall. But that's all I know now, so I guess the rest is up to you.
_2476.Objective: Find Another Type of MetalGarurumon and Talk
_2476.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Find Another Type of MetalGarurumon and Talk%qe %cc1/%mc1
_2476.CompletionText: It won't be easy to find though, culu.
_2476.CompletionSummary: I wasn't expecting to see you here.

_2477.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2477.Description: So we meet again in an unexpected place, BlitzGreymon. But first thing is first. I was in middle of conflict between me and a group of SaberLeomon. I can see that you've not come all the way here to fight me again. If so, why don't you help me first? Help me to chase away SaberLeomon, about 20 of them. After it's done, we can talk.
_2477.CompletionText: Such a mess, huh? I'm sorry to drag you into a fuss even though you came from a long distance.

_2478.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2478.Description:
The last aspects of you I remember was a berserker who's only crazy about battle, but you look different now. Have you found enlightenment or something? The day I encountered you in File Island seems clear like yesterday, yet you've changed a lot. So what brought you here? Oh, a new type evolution Digimon? Shall I call this a fate or a coincidence? I'm CresGarurumon, another type of evolution from MetalGarurumon.
So you came to me without noticing? I see. But I haven't heard that further evolution is possible. I want to reveal the truth. All right, I'll follow you this time to find the answer. Please guide me to Calumon now.
_2478.CompletionText: Haha… I have high hopes now.

_2479.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2479.Description: Oh, you came earlier than I expected, culu. Anyway, regarding to my knowledge, you two can unite together and evolve into a complete new form, culu. It's called Jogress evolution, and the basic concept of it is equal to WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon's. Because you guys come from the same root. As it has been said, there is a Jogress form of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon near us, culu. How about having a little conversation with Omegamon?
_2479.CompletionText: What I told you is just a theory, but with high possibility. You may bring a surprising result if it succeeds, culu.
_2479.CompletionSummary: Good to see you, brave warriors. I'm Omegamon.

_2480.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2480.Description:
I'm Omegamon, Jogress form of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon, as you may already know. Straight to the point, I can tell you that you also have the possibility to evolve into Jogress form. However, great power of Omegamon comes with great responsibility in the Digital World. If you need my assistance, let me test you to see if you're fully prepared for your Jogress evolution.
I'm looking forward for a positive result, as you have a good chance to become Omegamon yourself.
_2480.CompletionText: There's plenty of time, so you don't need to rush.
_2480.CompletionSummary: I've checked your probabilities. You're ready for your next form, Omegamon.

_2481.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2481.Description: From now on, Calumon who knows the secret of evolution will guide you the path to Omegamon. I hope you'll contribute to achieving peace and glory in Digital World. I wonder what you'll look like.
_2481.CompletionText: Go and talk to Calumon now.
_2481.CompletionSummary: A new type of Omega? It makes me curious too, culu!
_2481.ReservedText: You should have passed the test I guess!

_2482.Title: Jogress[Omegamon Alter-S]
_2482.Description: Great! You must have faced a long and harsh journey, culu! New type of Omegamon! Let's call you Omegamon Alter-S, culu!
_2482.CompletionSummary: Congratulations to become one of OMEGA! Omegamon Alter-S, culu!!

_2483.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2483.Description:
It's an urgent situation so I'll just tell you the point… First of all, you should stop Myotismon to go to Real World! If Myotismon finds the 8th chosen child in Real World, Digital World and Real World will be in disaster…
We must stop it….!
_2483.CompletionSummary: Okay, Grandpa! We will take care of it!

_2484.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2484.Description: Let's go to stop Myotismon! Guys! We have to move quick to save our world!
_2484.Objective: Go to Link of Real World
_2484.CompletionSummary: You finally made it here…. Foolish chosen children….

_2485.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2485.Description:
You foolish chosen children…You've got lucky to make it here, but it's too late… I am leaving Digital World and going to Real World to find and kill the 8th chosen child to achieve my ambition.
You are just going to watch both Digital World and Real World collapse... HAHAHAHAHA!!!!!!!

_2486.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2486.Description:
Gosh…! We missed Myotismon!!! What should we do??
Does our wolrd really collapse? Because we couldn't stop Myotismon??
_2486.CompletionSummary: Hahaha! It's too early to give up on it, guys….

_2487.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2487.Description: It's too early to give up on it , guys… There's one way to follow Myotismon…
_2487.CompletionText: Eh…today's children give up on things too fast…

_2488.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2488.Summary: Way to Go Back to Real World
_2488.Description: Is there a way back to Real World like Myotismon did? White-beard Guru?
_2488.CompletionSummary: yes, there's one way to go back to Real World…. So, don't give up…..

_2489.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2489.Description:
Way to go to Real World….is that you have to collect digimon cards and open the gate to Real World. There are 10 cards….but I don't have those cards, but Myotismon's minions have them.. I had it once….But Gatomon, Devidramon, and Dokugumon which are Myotismon's minions took them away from me.... Those who are very fast Gatomon and its minions...
Anyway we can open the gate to Real World by taking Digimon cards back from them. One thing you should be careful is that there's one card that leads to somewhere dangerous instead of Real World.. But I don't know which one is the card.... But I believe you can find the card without trouble. Good luck.
_2489.Objective: Collect Elecmon Card, Gazimon Card, Junimon Card, Drimogemon Card from Devidramon's Cards
_2489.CompletionText: I heard Gatmon and its minions are still around here…

_2490.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2490.Description:
According to White-bearded Guru, there are 9 Digimon Cards total.
We have 4 cards so we need 5 more cards!
Let's collect more Digimon cards like we just did!!
_2490.Objective: Collect Kuwagamon Card, Andromon Card, Digitamamon Card, TonosamaGekomon Card from Dokugumon's Cards
_2490.CompletionSummary: Sigh*…. We've collected 4 cards so far and one more to go!

_2491.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2491.Description:
Taichi, we have one more card to collect!
Let's go find the last one!
The last one must be imoportant so there's possibility that Gatomon has it!
Let's defeat Gatomon and get it!
_2491.Objective: Collect the Last Card by defeating Gatomon
_2491.CompletionSummary: Eh? Taichi, Gatomon has two Digimon cards!

_2492.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2492.Description: Ah…so there is a fake card between these two! Taichi, which one is the fake one?
_2492.CompletionSummary: Well… Hmm….Could it be this one with this portrait on?

_2493.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2493.Description:
White-bearded Guru~ We have all 9 cards!
We also thought of the fake card too! We think the fake card is Agumon Card….
Please open the gate with these cards except Agumon Card!
_2493.CompletionSummary: Agumon Card… Okay…I will try to open the gate to Real World with using the cards except for Agumon Card….

_2494.Title: Server Continent - Pyramid
_2494.Description:
Ohhhh! The gate is opened! So, Agumon Card is the fake card… You've done it well….
So the gate is opened so please stop Myotismon … The fate of Digital World and Real World is on your hands!
Good luck on you~ guys~

_2495.Title: Camp Site
_2495.Description: I guess we arrived safely… The atmosphere is quite different from the last place but it still feels like part of the Real World.
_2495.CompletionSummary: Tai seems to have lost consciousness for a bit…

_2496.Title: Camp Site
_2496.Description: The children are still unconscious. What shall we do?
_2496.CompletionSummary: Let’s prepare something before our children wake up~

_2497.Title: Camp Site
_2497.Description:
When the children wakes up, they should be starving. We don't know for how long we should stay at this place. So let's find something to eat first.
Look around if there are anything like fruits.
_2497.Objective: Find Delicious Fruit from the Fruit Tree
_2497.CompletionSummary: It seems like more than plenty. Maybe I can eat one of them… they should not notice.

_2498.Title: Camp Site
_2498.Description:
It is bearable now, but it may be freezing cold at night.
We need something to make a bonfire.
Let's collect some twigs to make one.
_2498.Objective: Collect Twigs from the Fruit Tree
_2498.CompletionSummary: That's enough of twigs we have. Now, it must be my turn? Look at me! Petit~~ Fire~!!

_2499.Title: Camp Site
_2499.Description: Ouch… such a headache… I.. Is this place Real World? How's everyone else?
_2499.CompletionSummary: This place… is this the temple from the campground? We’ve… we’ve arrived!!

_2500.Title: Camp Site
_2500.Description: Anyway… How do we get to the Valley of Light? The place has quite long distance from here.
_2500.CompletionSummary: Leave it to me! I’ve come up with a brilliant idea!

_2501.Title: Camp Site
_2501.Description:
Let's ask our teacher for a ride.
We can ask him to drop us off on the Valley of Light on the way back to Odaiba. Trust me, he shall listen to us.
_2501.Objective: Go to Front of the Bus
_2501.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to the Front of the Bus%qe %cc1/%mc1
_2501.CompletionSummary: What… what is this? Brother… there’s no one here!

_2502.Title: Camp Site
_2502.Description: Matt! I don't see anyone in this camp site. It's so strange. There're no teachers and no friends here…
_2502.CompletionSummary: What the…? Why is no one here? This is so creepy!!

_2503.Title: Camp Site
_2503.Description:
Why isn't anyone in this place? Is this really the Real World? The place where we used to live? How could it be so empty?
All right! I'm going to find my friends! Don't stop me!
_2503.Objective: Go to Corners of the Camp
_2503.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to the Secluded Area of the Campground%qe %cc1/%mc1

_2504.Title: Camp Site
_2504.Description: Whoa… it's a person?? T… T.K! Where have you been? So… haven't you seen? That… thing was so scary!! Something white…. like ghosts have suddenly appeared and ambushed us! All the teachers and students have flee away from this area. I was staying here admiring the view but it was too late to get out when I realized I was alone. Now, since you came here, what shall we do? I'm still scared.
_2504.CompletionSummary: Hmm… It seems Myotismon’s minions have also arrived here. I hope the teacher and friends are safe…

_2505.Title: Camp Site
_2505.Description: We have to reach the Valley of Light as soon as possible… Myotismon's minions not in this place means they're heading to the Valley of Light by now. If they are so violent like now, it means the rest of people in the Real World is put out to danger.
_2505.CompletionSummary: Yeah! We have to move quickly!

_2506.Title: Camp Site
_2506.Summary: Let's Go! To the Valley of Lights!
_2506.Description: Since we can't ask our class teacher for help… There's no other way than having it resolved by ourselves! Let's go to the Valley of Light!
_2506.Objective: Talk to Sora in Valley of Light

_2507.Title: Camp Site
_2507.Description: Do you think the Valley of Light is far away from here? I'm still hungry after eating the fruits from the camp. Can we find something more to eat? What do you thing about that Taichi?
_2507.CompletionSummary: It's not much… Taichi… I'm still hungry. Can we find for more food?

_2508.Title: Valley of Light
_2508.Description: At last we're here. It's been such a long time, so the memories of past are flashing in my head.
_2508.CompletionSummary: Yeah~ How long has it been since we last came here?

_2509.Title: Valley of Light
_2509.Summary: The Sneaky Shadow You Have Missed
_2509.Description: It doesn't seem like the place is in trouble or anything worse than we first expected. Maybe Myotismon and his minions didn't reach this place yet.
_2509.CompletionSummary: Well, isn’t it a good thing? If we find the eighth Chosen Child before Myotismon does, that’s great!

_2510.Title: Valley of Light
_2510.Description: I also hope so. But I still feel something not so good from here. Like something bad is going on in this place.
_2510.Objective: Investigation Area A Observe Area A with Telescope Investigation Area B Observe Area B with Telescope
_2510.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Investigation Area A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2AObserve Area A with Telescope%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Investigation Area B%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Observe Area B with Telescope%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2510.CompletionSummary: I think Taichi is right about this. Myotismon's army has left before we did, so they must have reached Valley of Light before us. They should be somewhere close preparing for the next step.

_2511.Title: Valley of Light
_2511.Description: If what Taichi and Izzy have guessed is true, it's truly a disaster. If we don't see any Digimon because they already found the 8th chosen child already, they must have moved to somewhere else already.
_2511.CompletionSummary: Brother, what’s going to happen to us now?

_2512.Title: Valley of Light
_2512.Description: I found it! That white cloth must be… Bakemon! Are we at the place? This is it. This is where the monsters appeared! The number of them is enourmous!
_2512.CompletionSummary: That’s an incredible number… On the other hand, it’s somewhat reassuring. Having that many Digimon in this city means the eighth Chosen Child hasn’t been found yet.

_2513.Title: Valley of Light
_2513.Description: Even though they haven't found yet, I'm still worried! Too many of them are still looking for the 8th chosen child! If this continues, don't they have higher chance to find 8th chosen child sooner than us?

_2514.Title: Valley of Light
_2514.Description: I agree to Joe's opinion. Myotismon's army should have higher chance to find 8th chosen child than us because they have more number. So if we can disturb them by defeating their minions, we can slow them down.
_2514.CompletionSummary: Alright! As Izzy said, let’s defeat Myotismon’s minions and find the eighth Chosen Child!

_2515.Title: Valley of Light
_2515.Description: Let's not hesitate here. We should go and find 8th chosen child ourselves! Of course, we should defeat Myotismon's army in the way to slow them down. Let's keep moving!
_2515.CompletionSummary: Looking closer, there are so many minions…

_2516.Title: Valley of Light
_2516.Description: Group of Bakemon gave us a hard time in File Island. I never imagined to see them again. We've had enough trouble at that time…
_2516.CompletionSummary: Yes, yes, back then it was so terrifying, dreadful, and tough… Seeing the Ghostmon here again… It’s like a nightmare~~~

_2517.Title: Valley of Light
_2517.Description: Guys, stop complaining and be more constructive. Let's defeat the Bakemon horde! Defeating them will slow down Myotismon's plan too!
_2517.CompletionText: Izzy, will you look for their weakness while you're encountering the group of Bakemon?
_2517.CompletionSummary: I found something that may be a little interesting.

_2518.Title: Valley of Light
_2518.Description: Just a simple fact! The group of Bakemon seem to move as if they are ordered by one commander. If we can find their commander and get rid of it, we may able to dissolve them and we can move onto next area.
_2518.CompletionText: It's quite surprising that they have such an organized system.
_2518.CompletionSummary: Is that it? Good job, Izzy! It's a great discovery!

_2519.Title: Valley of Light
_2519.Description: Then we have an agreement now. Let's find and defeat their leader who give orders to them. We can reduce their numbers on the way.
_2519.Objective: Defeat Bakemon Army Captain Defeat Bakemon
_2519.CompletionSummary: Oh, well? Something strange is going on? Look at Bakemon!

_2520.Title: Valley of Light
_2520.Description: Wait? We defeated their leader, but the group of Bakemon don't seem to react on it. Taichi, have we missed something?
_2520.CompletionSummary: Maybe it wasn't the true leader who we've defeated.

_2521.Title: Valley of Light
_2521.Description: Their organization may be more complicated then I thought. If they have more complicated system, there may be another position that leads more larger group. When we find and defeat it, they must react differently.
_2521.CompletionSummary: (As I've expected. It wasn't a wrong target.)

_2522.Title: Valley of Light
_2522.Summary: Now, Let's Continue the Real Plan!
_2522.Description: Izzy, don't worry about it! We're going as we've planned anyway. Now, let's find the real leader of them and stop them for good.
_2522.CompletionSummary: The group of Bakemon seems to react now! They seem to be confused, as if they've lost their head leader!

_2523.Title: Valley of Light
_2523.Summary: We Won't Let You Disturb Anymore!
_2523.Description: What is this interruption! Oh? Just a few cheeky little human younglings and the traitors who's tailing them? How arrogant! I cannot tolerate this situation! Be prepared for the judgment!
_2523.Objective: Defeat Bakemon Captain Defeat Bakemon Army Captain Defeat Bakemon
_2523.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Bakemon Captain%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Bakemon Army Captain%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Bakemon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2523.CompletionText: You've came here to disturb lord Myotismon's plans? You arrogant humans and traitors! You'll fail here!
_2523.CompletionSummary: Ouch… I didn't expect them to attack all at once like this. I thought we were in big trouble…

_2524.Title: Valley of Light
_2524.Description: We've got over with it though. Bakemon army gave us a hard time again. By the way, do you have any idea what that is? There's something that looks like Bakemon, but it's wearing a black hat.
_2524.CompletionSummary: Truly, it was another moment of trouble. Hmm… Where are we now?

_2525.Title: Valley of Light
_2525.Summary: T.K has an Idea that Works??
_2525.Description: I've been thinking… whether it is a good or bad… What if we disguise ourselves as Bakemon by covering us with white cloth? Won't we be unseen and pass them safely?
_2525.CompletionText: What do you think about that? Isn't it a good idea? At least we can try!

_2526.Title: Valley of Light
_2526.Description: Wow, wait a second! Are you telling me that I should wear these unidentified fabrics? This is a little ridiculous. These fabrics aren't made for us and I can say we'll definitely get caught. Unless we wear the hats of Soulmon, the disguise won't be perfect. I and Palmon refuse to wear these pieces of fabric. I advice you to do the same Sora!
_2526.CompletionText: Be careful not to get your hat crumpled!
_2526.CompletionSummary: Uh… I should think again now. Wearing this hat doesn't make me feel like I'm disguised. Maybe it's better to fight the Bakemons.

_2527.Title: Valley of Light
_2527.Summary: Joe is Not Feeling So Good
_2527.Description: I had enough suffering when we were in File Island because of Bakemon! But now we have an expansion of this suffering in Real World now! What a coincidence!
_2527.CompletionText: Oh please!! I've had enough of this stupid ghost jokes!!
_2527.CompletionSummary: So how did we overcome this trouble at that time?

_2528.Title: Valley of Light
_2528.Summary: Bakemon Hates the Sound of Chants
_2528.Description: Oh… that remind me of the past. When you started reading the scripts of an old book, Bakemon was . Do you think you can do that one more time?
_2528.CompletionSummary: There was just 1 Bakemon at that time, but here we have a lot more. We should think of something else.

_2529.Title: Valley of Light
_2529.Description: If we can only amplify your voice, I'm sure it'd be effective! Do you think we can find a Sound Amplifier? Although we're in middle of these rampaging monsters around here.
_2529.CompletionSummary: I think some of Bakemon or Soulmon may have them. If there is a machine that works, they'll definitely try to keep it themselves.

_2530.Title: Valley of Light
_2530.Description: That makes sence! Even though it's just a rough theory, may worth a try. Let's look if they have one! At least one of them must possess a recorder or something!
_2530.Objective: Collect Recordable MP3 from Bakemon or Soulmon
_2530.CompletionText: After all the trouble we went through…
_2530.CompletionSummary: I found it! A Recordable MP3!!

_2531.Title: Valley of Light
_2531.Description: Good! Now we need a Sound Amplifier that can amplify the recorded voice! Once we start to spread the sound, these Bakemon army will be freaked out! I think I've minutely heard noise of Sound Amplifier from Soulmon and their leader in the way!
_2531.Objective: Collect Sound Amplifier from Soulmon or Soulmon Army Captain)
_2531.CompletionText: I think I've minutely heard noise of Sound Amplifier from Soulmon and their leader in the way!
_2531.CompletionSummary: Now I found the Sound Amplifier too! Time to say goodbye to all the ghost jokes!!

_2532.Title: Valley of Light
_2532.Description: Joe, we have a problem. The Sound Amplifier can't be played alone. It needs to be connected to the Recordable MP3. To make that possible, we also need a cable.
_2532.CompletionSummary: Ah… yeah. That's right… Sorry, I'm not an expert in this subject.

_2533.Title: Valley of Light
_2533.Description:
Wonderful!! Now let's look for the cable! Keep up the pace! (what a shame)
We need a cable that connects the sound to sound amplifier (writes it down on a note)
I remember seeing one of the Bakemon leader carrying electric wires with it! Do you think there may be an usable cable among them?
_2533.CompletionText: I remember seeing one of the Bakemon leader carrying electric wires with it! Do you think there may be an usable cable among them?
_2533.CompletionSummary: Just as expected! You found the cable! Now we can proceed as we planned?

_2534.Title: Valley of Light
_2534.Summary: Amplified Chant Echoes through the Town
_2534.Description: Joe, we connected the Recordable MP3 to the Sound Amplifier. Now all we have to do is to press the play button! Let's play your voice of reading the ancient scripts and chase away those ghosts!
_2534.Objective: Play Ancient Script Reading.mp3 from Valley of Light
_2534.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Play Ancient Script Reading.mp3 from Valley of Light%qe %cc1/%mc1
_2534.CompletionText: The Bakemon army seem to be losing consciousness! This is our chance to fight back!
_2534.CompletionSummary: Look! I was right on this! They're collapsing!

_2535.Title: Valley of Light
_2535.Description:
The Bakemon army seem to be losing consciousness! This is our chance to fight back!
Uh… wait! The battery on this machine is low! We don't have other choices. Let's end this quickly!
_2535.Objective: Defeat Bakemon Army Captain Defeat Soulmon Army Captain Defeat Bakemon Captain Defeat Soulmon Captain
_2535.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Bakemon Army Captain%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Soulmon Army Captain%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Bakemon Captain%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Soulmon Captain%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2535.CompletionText: The battery is low, we must hurry!!
_2535.CompletionSummary: The battery just ran out… Now, what shall we do?

_2536.Title: Valley of Light
_2536.Description: Matt! I remember this place a little. We used to play a lot here! Didn't we?
_2536.CompletionSummary: That's right. You were very young at that time, but you still seem to remember.

_2537.Title: Valley of Light
_2537.Description: I guess we don't even have time to remind of our memories. These monsters don't let us. By the way, they're trying to ruin the place that we have memories of our youth. It should be stopped for whatever cost!
_2537.CompletionSummary: That should keep them away from this place, doesn't it?

_2538.Title: Valley of Light
_2538.Description: Matt, I feel strange. I was feeling all right until I came here, but now I'm losing strength. My head seems to be in a daze.
_2538.CompletionSummary: T.K! What's the matter with you? Are you all right?

_2539.Title: Valley of Light
_2539.Description:
It should be caused by Soulmon. Soulmon has the ability to drain out vitality from others! The symptoms of T.K tells that he's become the victim!
To make T.K recover, we need to find Soulmon that drained his vitality and defeat it!
_2539.CompletionSummary: Did you say Soulmon drained energy from my brother? I'll make it pay the price, with some interests!!

_2540.Title: Valley of Light
_2540.Description: Soulmon, you bastards! I won't let you run!! How dare you harm my brother!! I'll make you pay the price and you'll regret for attacking someone you shouldn't!!
_2540.Objective: Defeat Soulmon Defeat Soulmon Army Captain
_2540.CompletionText: Let's go, Gabumon! Show them that victory is on the side of justice!
_2540.CompletionSummary: I still don't feel very good. It's annoying…

_2541.Title: Valley of Light
_2541.Summary: T.K is Not Feeling So Good
_2541.Description: Matt, your brother don't seem to feel better yet! That means the Soulmon that stole vitality from him is still out there! You should keep looking for the real suspect!
_2541.CompletionSummary: That's not good. Where in the world is that suspect??

_2542.Title: Valley of Light
_2542.Description:
Matt, you may find this a little strange, but I think it's time. You should not let your anger control you. Maybe you can learn it from Taichi. He doesn't lose his pace regardless of whatever situation he's on. Don't lose your pace by letting your anger control you. Keep up the pace and focus only on the target, and I'm sure you'll find your right target!
Oh, by the way, Taichi. This is a compliment for you but not criticism.
_2542.CompletionSummary: Izzy. I sometimes forget your age. Are you really younger than me?

_2543.Title: Valley of Light
_2543.Description: Ok, that was a good point, Izzy. I can't just give up here. Since it's one of them, keep defeating the Soulmon army should resolve the problem. I have to do it fast though, or else my brother may get worse!
_2543.Objective: Defeat Soulmon Defeat Soulmon Army Captain Defeat Soulmon Captain
_2543.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Soulmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Soulmon Army Captain%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Soulmon Captain%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2543.CompletionText: Hold on, T.K! It won't take so long!
_2543.CompletionSummary: Matt, your brother is recovering! He's recovering his strength slowly! What a relief!

_2544.Title: Valley of Light
_2544.Description:
Cocky little humans are attacking us who serve lord Myotismon! You do not recognize your own place!! If you become our energy, you'll at least become more useful then now. (chuckles)
You little humans! You dared to attack us, so be prepared for the price you pay!
_2544.Objective: Defeat Soulmon Army Captain Defeat Soulmon Captain
_2544.CompletionSummary: Huh? You've been so nosy so far with this much power?

_2545.Title: Valley of Light
_2545.Description:
Honestly, it was quite impressive that you've sustained until now.
But if you have thought this is the end, your suffering will begin from now! Feel the gap between your weakness and our true power!!
_2545.Objective: Soulmon(Colossal) emerges when you defeat 20 Soulmon(Captain) Defeat Soulmon(Colossal)
_2545.CompletionSummary: Oh my goodness…!! Who could have imagined it to grow so big?

_2546.Title: Valley of Light
_2546.Description: Who would ever imagined it to grow into such an unbelievable size! It almost freaked me out… (gasp)
_2546.CompletionSummary: Yeah… you’re right… I never imagined we’d get this tired so soon…

_2547.Title: Valley of Light
_2547.Description: It's completely different from my expectations too. What is this? We came to the Real World after all the trouble fighting with monsters in Digital World, but now what? This is just an extension of endless battle. And if our enemies we confront are so tough, how much stronger could Myotismon be? Do you think we can beat Myotismon? What if we lose? I'm actually worried. I just want to go home. I miss my mom and dad!
_2547.CompletionSummary: Hmm… everyone seems exhausted… This is bad…

_2548.Title: Valley of Light
_2548.Description: Guys, I know you're tired and you miss your family. But we have to keep up, or else our family will be in danger. That's not it. The whole Real World will be put into the threat of Myotismon! Let's keep going!
_2548.CompletionSummary: Got it, Tai… (sniff) I’ll try to hang in there a bit longer… (sniff)

_2549.Title: Valley of Light
_2549.Description: Huh?? Do you smell something weird? Something really stinky seems to be here somewhere?? Why don't we check what's there?

_2550.Title: Valley of Light
_2550.Description: Ugghhh!! What in the world is this smell!! It's much worse than I thought!! Gross! I feel like I'm going to puke.
_2550.CompletionSummary: It seems the source of that awful stench is over there!

_2551.Title: Valley of Light
_2551.Description: The nauseating smell is from the RedVegiemon. It spreads out very strong odor, breathing out venomous gas from its mouth, so try to hold your breath!
_2551.CompletionSummary: So now I can’t even breathe freely?!

_2552.Title: Valley of Light
_2552.Description: What if we defeat that red rotten pineapple-like monster? Then this stinky smell would be gone? Let's get rid of them! It's such a tragedy to have this stinky smell permeate into my hat and dress!
_2552.Objective: Defeat RedVegiemon Collect Disgusting Soil from RedVegiemon(Army Captain)
_2552.CompletionSummary: This must be what’s causing this place to be filled with such a terrible stench…

_2553.Title: Valley of Light
_2553.Description: We should defeat these RedVegiemon… Also we must collect these disgusting soil on one spot and discard it, or everyone here may be put into danger. Such as getting poisoned…
_2553.CompletionSummary: Why? Why are you telling me such ominous things?

_2554.Title: Valley of Light
_2554.Description:
In fact, I seem to be paralyzed because of this poison. It's becoming more and more difficult to move. Joe, Sora, T.K are already exhausted, me, Taichi and Matt are barely standing, it is not strange if we fall out…
But Mimi you don't seem to be effected much from the poison. Maybe because you're with Palmon everytime, you may have grown immunity against plant's poison. Now you're our only hope.
_2554.CompletionSummary: Oh my God! Why is something unpleasant like this keep happening to me? But all right! If I'm the only one standing here, I can't let you down, so I'll try my best now!

_2555.Title: Valley of Light
_2555.Description: 이젠 옷 같은 건 중요하지 않아. 모두의 생명이 걸린 일이 되어버렸으니까… 우선 이 근처에 있는 레드베지몬들부터 하나씩 처치하자!
_2555.CompletionSummary: 후~ 다 처치했다! 나도 이제 좀 모두에게 도움이 되는 것 같아!

_2556.Title: Valley of Light
_2556.Description: 아! 맞다! 오물을 폐기해야 한다고 했었지! 깜빡하고 잊어버렸네… 레드베지몬을 처치하고 오물을 모아서 폐기해 버리자!
_2556.CompletionSummary: 으으윽…머리야…. 휴….이제야 좀 살 것 같아요..

_2557.Title: Valley of Light
_2557.Description:
Thank you, Mimi. You have helped us all.
I'll tell you a tip how to defeat RedVegiemon in an easier way.
They are plant type Digimon. They are weak against fire, but that may take risk to burn the city. If using fire isn't easy, you can think of using salty water which can damage the plants. They'll probably not notice before they fully absorb the water.
_2557.CompletionSummary: Salty water? How do I suppose to get salty water from this place?

_2558.Title: Valley of Light
_2558.Description: I understand the whole idea, but where can I get the salt from? This place is too far away from the seas! Any better ideas?
_2558.CompletionSummary: Look into Sora's backpack. It's in her backpack.

_2559.Title: Valley of Light
_2559.Description:
If you look into Sora's bag, there will be a first-aid kit. In the first-aid kit, there is a saline solution inside. I remember seeing it from last time. You can use that.
I'm not fully recovered from the poison yet, so it's difficult for me to follow now. Please search for saline solution from the first-aid kit in Sora's bag.
_2559.Objective: Find Saline Solution from First-aid Kit
_2559.CompletionSummary: So you've found the Saline Solution! It's lucky that I'd remembered it correctly.
_2559.ReservedText: (There is saline in the emergency box.)

_2560.Title: Valley of Light
_2560.Description: So you've found it! I know that it's not enough to use against all the army of RedVegiemon. But if you use it to their leader to take it out, we should have a chance to encounter them. Please use the saline solution against the leader of RedVegiemon!
_2560.CompletionSummary: I wonder how that feels like!

_2561.Title: Valley of Light
_2561.Description: 식염수를 뿌린 지금이야! 레드베지몬들이 허둥지둥하고 있을 때가 기회야! 이 기회를 놓치지 말고 레드베지몬들을 해치우자!
_2561.Objective: 레드베지몬 대장 처치 레드베지몬 행동대장 처치 레드베지몬 처치

_2562.Title: Valley of Light
_2562.Description: Thanks to Mimi, we could recover and be safe now. We owe you a debt.
_2562.CompletionSummary: Waaah~ That was so exhausting and terrifying…! But I’m so glad everyone is safe… Waaah~

_2563.Title: Valley of Light
_2563.Description: Guys~ are you all right? Since everyone is in good condition, how about a visit to the convenient store? We should eat while we can. I hope the convenient store we used to go when we were young is still there.
_2563.Objective: Go to the Place of Memory 4 Years Ago
_2563.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to the Place of Memory 4 Years Ago%qe %cc1/%mc1

_2564.Title: Valley of Light
_2564.CompletionSummary: What was that just now? I felt like I remembered something, but I’m not sure…

_2565.Title: Valley of Light
_2565.Description: What are you waiting for? Aren't you coming with us to the convenient store?
_2565.CompletionSummary: Huh? Let’s go! Come on, let’s go together!

_2566.Title: Valley of Light
_2566.Description: I hope so too. It was one of my favorite place to visit when I was young!
_2566.CompletionSummary: There it is! The convenience store where I used to buy snacks when I lived here!

_2567.Title: Valley of Light
_2567.Description: What shall we do now? We were stuck here longer than I first expected, because of Myotismon's army here. We can't let rest of the Myotismon's army find 8th chosen child before us though.
_2567.CompletionSummary: Yeah, really… What if that actually happens?

_2568.Title: Valley of Light
_2568.Description: I kept thinking, that if the 8th chosen child is somewhere around us nearby, won't we be able to see from the Digivice?
_2568.CompletionSummary: No, I’ve been watching closely, and there hasn’t been any reaction.

_2569.Title: Valley of Light
_2569.Description: I know that we must find the 8th chosen child, but we should at least take a rest once a while. I'm very tired and hungry! Since we arrived to convenient store, let's grab something to eat. We can't starve to death before we find the 8th chosen child, can we?
_2569.CompletionSummary: Chocolate ice cream~ Strawberry milk~ Vanilla cookies~ I want to eat those~~

_2570.Title: Valley of Light
_2570.Description: Looks like Mimi is very tired… Let's look for stuffs to eat. Oh darn… The convenient store seems to be attacked by Myotismon's army too. It seems like they were after the foods too. Let's see if those group of Wendimon have any snacks from the convenient store!
_2570.CompletionText: I hope the snacks are still in good shape.
_2570.CompletionSummary: Good grief, there were snacks that are still in good shape. I hope Mimi's favorite snack is included here.

_2571.Title: Valley of Light
_2571.Description: I'm thirsty now! I need some water! Or anything I can drink!
_2571.CompletionText: Hope they're not all ruined by Myotismon's minions…
_2571.CompletionSummary: Oops… I forgot about the drinks…

_2572.Title: Valley of Light
_2572.Summary: Sora Takes Care of One to Ten
_2572.Description: I missed to think about the drinks. Let's find for the drinks now. There must be a vending machine nearby.
_2572.Objective: Deliver Cold Beverage from <Valley of Light >
_2572.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Cold Beverage %qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2 <1st in Valley of Light >Vending Machine%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2572.CompletionText: I wish that Myotismon's army haven't damaged the vending machines.
_2572.CompletionSummary: At last… this drink is so refreshing! I feel alive again!

_2573.Title: Valley of Light
_2573.Description: Sorry, I guess I asked you for favors too much. I didn't mean to bother you, but I was losing faith myself because of thirst and hunger.
_2573.CompletionText: I wish that Myotismon's army haven't damaged the vending machines.
_2573.CompletionSummary: Sorry guys. I won't ask you for many things again.

_2574.Title: Valley of Light
_2574.Description: Did everyone have enough rest? If so, let's continue searching for the 8th chosen child!
_2574.CompletionSummary: What are you doing? Guys? We need to find the eighth Chosen Child~

_2575.Title: Valley of Light
_2575.Description: What if the 8th chosen child already left Valley of Light? The Myotismon's army couldn't find from here and Digivice is not locating the 8th chosen child.
_2575.CompletionSummary: I agree with that. If I was 8th chosen child, I would not stay in one place. So I don't think 8th chosen child is here. Let's move on to Odaiba.

_2576.Title: Valley of Light
_2576.Description: 아닛! 디지몬이 나타났습니다! 처음 보는 디지몬인데…확인해 보겠습니다! 웬디몬이라는 디지몬입니다! 조심하세요! 그레이몬이 암흑 진화를 해서 스컬그레이몬이 된 것처럼 저 디지몬도 암흑진화를 했습니다. 비록 성숙기이지만 상당히 강할 것이라 생각됩니다! 저 디지몬을 처치해야 이곳에서 벗어날 수 있을 것 같아요!
_2576.CompletionText: 어떻게 하면 이곳에서 좀 더 쉽게 벗어날 수 있을까?
_2576.CompletionSummary: 겨우겨우 해결한 것 같습니다만… 모두들 괜찮으신가요?

_2577.Title: Valley of Light
_2577.Description:
왜 다들 대답이 없으시죠? 안 괜찮은….?
엇! 다들 어디에…?

_2578.Title: Valley of Light
_2578.Description:
아!! 그렇구나... 웬디몬…시간과 공간을 조종할 수 있는 디지몬… 굉장히 성가신 녀석이군요..
시공간을 조종해서 모두를 다른 공간으로 데려간 거구나!
_2578.CompletionSummary: 어떻게 하면 모두를 다시 이곳으로 데려오고 웬디몬을 처치할 수 있을까?

_2579.Title: Valley of Light
_2579.Description: 맞다! 흰수염도사님께서 주신 프로그램! 분명 흰수염도사님께서 디지몬 위치를 보여주는 프로그램을 설치해 주셨다고 하셨어! 이 프로그램을 실행해보자! 이 프로그램이 다른 차원의 공간 속에 숨어있는 웬디몬의 위치를 알려줄 거야!
_2579.Objective: 프로그램 발동 지역에서 탐지 프로그램 사용
_2579.CompletionSummary: 웬디몬이 어디에 있는지 알게 됐어! 이제 모두를 구할 수 있겠어!

_2580.Title: Valley of Light
_2580.Description:
Oh my… that Digimon is? It must be Devidramon! It must have followed Myotismon all the way through here!
The situation is worse as I have to face Wendigomon and Devidramon at the same time…!
But let's get rid of Devidramon in front first!
_2580.CompletionText: How shall I deal with all these…
_2580.CompletionSummary: Somehow I managed to deal with them. But I still have to find Wendigomon that moved to another dimension…

_2581.Title: Valley of Light
_2581.Description:
아까 데블드라몬과 싸울 때 데블드라몬과 눈이 잠시 마주쳤었는데… 그 순간 몸이 경직되는 것을 느꼈어… 흰수염도사님이 주신 프로그램에서 데블드라몬의 설명을 본 것과 비슷한 현상을 경험한 것 같아… ‘데블드라몬의 눈은 상대방의 움직임을 제한한다…’무서운 능력이야…
웬디몬은 나를 공격 또는 다른 공간으로 데려가기 위해 다른 공간에서 나를 주시하고 있을 거야… 그런데 이 상황에!! 만약에!! 혹시라도!! 웬디몬이 데블드라몬의 눈을 보게 된다면 어떻게 될까..?? 움직일 수 없어서 공간을 만드는 능력도 사라지게 되지 않을까?
밑져야 본전이다! 일단 데블드라몬의 눈을 모아보자!
_2581.CompletionSummary: 좋아, 이거를 이제 이렇게 저렇게 뚝딱뚝딱 만들면~!

_2582.Title: Valley of Light
_2582.Description:
좋아, 내가 만든 이 물건을 사용하면 웬디몬은 어쩔 수 없이 데블드라몬의 눈을 바라보게 되는 현상을 겪게 될 거야!
제발 내 예측이 맞아야 할 텐데…
긴급상황이니까 어서 사용해보자!
_2582.Objective: 프로그램 발동 지역에서 장한솔의 발명품 사용
_2582.CompletionSummary: 좋았어! 내 예상이 맞았어! 웬디몬이 모습을 드러냈어!

_2583.Title: Valley of Light
_2583.Description: 지금이야! 웬디몬들을 처치하고 모두를 다시 이곳으로 탈출 시키는 거야!
_2583.Objective: 웬디몬 행동대장 처치 웬디몬 대장 처치

_2584.Title: Valley of Light
_2584.Description:
엇…? 이곳은??? 돌아온 것인가??
모두들 괜찮니? 다친 사람은 없지? 휴~ 다행이다~
하마터면 큰일 날 뻔했네… 도대체 거기는 어디였던 거야?
_2584.CompletionSummary: 으~~아~~앙~~~ 너무 무서웠어!! 너무 고독하고 춥고 무서운 곳이었다고!!

_2585.Title: Valley of Light
_2585.Description:
모두들!! 돌아왔군요! 다행이에요! 모두 무사하셔서! 그런데 아직 너무 기뻐하긴 일러요!
아직 우리 주위에 디지몬들이 많이 남아 있다구요…!
_2585.CompletionSummary: 한솔아, 구해줘서 고마워!! 그..그렇네…아직 디지몬들이 남아있구나…!

_2586.Title: Valley of Light
_2586.Description: We have to stay focused! So we don't get highjacked by Wendigomon again! We should also watch out for Devidramon and try not to stare them in the eyes directly!
_2586.CompletionSummary: Leave that to me! They owe us a debt, so it's fair to let them pay! Including some interests makes it perfect!

_2587.Title: Valley of Light
_2587.Description:
우리를 이상한 곳에 가둬놨겠다! 그리고 저 녀석들은 우리를 이곳 현실 세계로 가는 것을 막았었지!
이번 기회에 한꺼번에 다 갚아 주겠어!
_2587.Objective: 데블드라몬 행동대장 처치 웬디몬 행동대장 처치 플라이몬 처치
_2587.CompletionSummary: 후~ 이제 속이 좀 후련하신가요? 태일이 형? 음? 어디선가 이상한 소리가 들리지 않나요?

_2588.Title: Valley of Light
_2588.Description: That is definitely a buzzing sound… but not from ordinary bees. It comes from the swarm of Flymon! The sound of them are so loud it makes me dizzy! By the way, we have to be careful not to get stung!
_2588.CompletionSummary: Gees…! The sound they make is so loud, it's tormenting my ears! Is this another way of disturbing from Myotismon's army?

_2589.Title: Valley of Light
_2589.Description:
It's a torment to the ears! I'm pretty sure we may become deaf if we stay here all day!
Let's get them out of our way first!
_2589.CompletionText: I feel like I'm hit by a big hammer on my head…
_2589.CompletionSummary: I feel a lot better now. I never imagined that loud noises can be so deadly!

_2590.Title: Valley of Light
_2590.Description:
플라이몬을 처치한 건 매우 좋은 소식이지만… 더 안 좋은 소식을 알려드리자면…
웬디몬, 데블드라몬, 플라이몬이 동시에 공격을 해온다는 안 좋은 소식을 알려드릴게요…
각오를 단단히 해야 할 것 같습니다..!
_2590.Objective: 웬디몬 행동대장 처치 데블드라몬 행동대장 처치 플라이몬 행동대장 처치
_2590.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1웬디몬 행동대장 처치%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2데블드라몬 행동대장 처치%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3플라이몬 행동대장 처치%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2590.CompletionSummary: 하핫! 어떠냐! 너네들 한 트럭이 덤벼와도 하나도 겁 안 난다고!! 응??? 뭔가 내 몸이 좀 이상한 것 같은데?

_2591.Title: Valley of Light
_2591.Description: 윽…! 한솔아! 나 갑자기 모…몸…몸이 안 움직이는데? 뭐…뭐지? 왜 안 움직여지는 거야?
_2591.CompletionSummary: 휴…태일이 형…말씀드리지 않았나요? 데블드라몬의 눈을 보게 되면 몸을 움직일 수 없게 된다 구요… (음…태일이 형한테는 말 안 한 것 같기도…??)

_2592.Title: Valley of Light
_2592.Description:
태일이 형이 어느 데블드라몬의 눈을 바라봤는지 알 수 없으니 지금 태일이 형의 증상을 낫게 하기 위한 가장 빠른 방법은 벌침이겠네요!
벌침의 효능에는 다양하게 있는데 그중에 신경 부활 작용이라는 효과가 있거든요~
플라이몬을 해치운 후에 독침을 모아서 태일이 형에게 써보는 거에요!
_2592.CompletionSummary: 지금 저 녀석의 독침을 나에게 놓겠다고? 한솔아!! 너 지금 제정신인 거야???

_2593.Title: Valley of Light
_2593.Description: 플라이몬의 침은 독침이라며! 독은? 어떻게 한 건데? 내가 좀 건강한 편이긴 하지만, 나도 사람이라고! 평범한 사람! 독침 맞으면 죽는 거 아니야? 시퍼렇게 변해서 죽는 거 아니냐고!!!???
_2593.CompletionSummary: 괜찮아요, 태일이 형! 몸을 움직이고 싶으시다면 저를 전적으로 믿으셔야 합니다!

_2594.Title: Valley of Light
_2594.Description: 플라이몬의 침에 있는 독은 싹 뺐습니다~ 이제 태일이 형에게 놓는 일만 남았어요~ 뭐 움직일 수 없겠지만, 혹시나 해서 말씀드릴게요~ 움직이시면 안 됩니다! 혹시라도 다른 곳에 놔버리면 진짜 죽을 지도 모른다구요!!
_2594.CompletionText: 꾸우울꺽… 부…부탁할게…제발 아프게 놓지는 말아... 아아아아아악!!!
_2594.CompletionSummary: 한솔아!! 살살 좀 놓으면 안 되겠니?

_2595.Title: Valley of Light
_2595.Description:
오~ 움직여진다~ 대단한데? 한솔아?!! 고마워!
좋았어! 이제 끝을 내자! 다 쓸어버리고 이곳을 떠나보자고!!
_2595.Objective: 웬디몬 대장 처치 데블드라몬 대장 처치 플라이몬 대장 처치
_2595.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1웬디몬 대장 처치%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2데블드라몬 대장 처치%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3플라이몬 대장 처치%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2595.CompletionSummary: 모두 정리된 것 같습니다! 흰수염도사님이 주신 프로그램에도 주위에 디지몬 반응이 나타나지 않고 있어요!

_2596.Title: Valley of Light
_2596.Description: White-bearded Guru has once told us that all Digimon have their own attributes. So if we can analyze the attributes of our opponents we're fighting, we can easily win the battle.
_2596.CompletionSummary: Yeah! You're totally right! We used the attribute information to solve the card riddle and we came all the way through!

_2597.Title: Valley of Light
_2597.Summary: Researching for Data of the Enemies
_2597.Description: So what are the attributes of Myotismon's minions? According to that theory, we should know what their attributes are, I guess?
_2597.CompletionSummary: Yes. Which is why we need to gather some information from the result of battles. So I'd like to ask for your cooperation. We need to collect their data from now on.

_2598.Title: Valley of Light
_2598.Description: What to do isn't so complicated. As you fight and defeat Myotismon's army, your Digivice will accumulate according data. When you get enough of the data collected, please lend me your Digivice. Once you do that, I'll do the data analysis with my laptop.
_2598.CompletionText: I know it's not such a pleasant work to do, but we need this.
_2598.CompletionSummary: Ok, I understood! You can rely on us, Izzy.

_2599.Title: Valley of Light
_2599.Description: So whenever we defeat them, data will be collected automatically? That's a piece of cake! Now, shall we get started?
_2599.CompletionSummary: Good job! Now, I shall start the analysis with the program received from White-bearded Guru.

_2600.Title: Valley of Light
_2600.Description: Sorry to disappoint you, but we're a little short of required data! I guess it has been miscalculated. Can you get me some more data? With just a little more of them should bring us an interesting result.
_2600.CompletionText: Just a little more will definitely bring the result! I rely on you now!
_2600.CompletionSummary: Thanks a lot! I'm pretty sure that we'll have a result which make your efforts worthy this time!

_2601.Title: Valley of Light
_2601.Description: The analysis result show that both Wendigomon and Flymon are Virus attribute Digimon. If we use this data to update the program provided by White-bearded Guru, we may be able to find tactics to encounter Myotismon's army more easily.
_2601.CompletionSummary: That's a good news! Let's get out of here using that program!

_2602.Title: Valley of Light
_2602.Description: Ok, let's leave this place by using the program!
_2602.Objective: Use White-bearded Guru Program Operation Area Defeat Wendigomon Defeat Flymon
_2602.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use White-bearded Guru Program Operation Area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Wendigomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Flymon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2602.CompletionSummary: Thanks to your cooperation we finally escaped from the place!

_2603.Title: Valley of Light
_2603.Description: Ah~ at last it's over… There is no sign of Myotismon's minions nearby. We don't have to worry!
_2603.CompletionSummary: Joe, amidst all these battles, you seem to have forgotten something… Defeating Myotismon’s minions is important, but so is finding the eighth Chosen Child.

_2604.Title: Valley of Light
_2604.Description: As we stay here longer, my presumption that 8th chosen child is not here, in the Valley of Light is growing bigger. It is rather strange to think that 8th chosen child did not evacuate from this place.
_2604.CompletionSummary: This is the issue. It’s possible they moved to Odaiba like us, or somewhere in Japan, or even emigrated abroad… We have so few clues about the eighth Chosen Child.

_2605.Title: Valley of Light
_2605.Description: Oh… wait! What is this? Suddenly, the signal is jammed. Someone, or something must be disrupting our signal.
_2605.CompletionSummary: I have a bad feeling that a Digimon as powerful as Myotismon might be nearby…

_2606.Title: Valley of Light
_2606.Description: Like what Izzy said, the suspect may be Myotismon, so let's stay focused and search our surroundings. By a worst scenario, we may encounter Myotismon before finding the 8th chosen child here.
_2606.CompletionSummary: Everyone! Look over there! It’s a massive Mammothmon!

_2607.Title: Valley of Light
_2607.Description: That is truly Mammothmon indeed. An ultimate form Digimon just like Etemon, Nanomon, or Myotismon. We may lose if we try to fight it unprepared! Everyone stay alert!
_2607.CompletionSummary: To cause such havoc in the middle of a city with that massive body… If we leave it alone, the damage will only grow!

_2608.Title: Valley of Light
_2608.Summary: Rampage of Mammothmon in the City
_2608.Description: If we let Mammothmon rampage around the city, it sure will be a disaster! We have to stop it before it becomes too late!
_2608.CompletionSummary: That was such a tough opponent to beat…

_2609.Title: Valley of Light
_2609.Description: Because of Mammothmon's rampage just happened here, the crowds may be gathered here at any time… Let's get out of this place.
_2609.CompletionSummary: This should be enough for now.

_2610.Title: Valley of Light
_2610.Description: The battle against Mammothmon reminded me of the past. The accident that happened in the past known to be bomb terror was not actually a bomb terror, but it was a collision between two huge Digimon… Greymon and Parrotmon. We were all there when it happened and it was 4 years ago. The 8th chosen child must have saw it too.
_2610.CompletionSummary: Oh yeah! Like the kid who saw Greymon four years ago! Let’s find someone like that!

_2611.Title: Valley of Light
_2611.Description: Regarding to what Izzy said about the incident happened 4 years ago, the chance of 8th chosen child leaving this place is higher. At least Valley of Light is not the place we should look for. Let's move on to another place!
_2611.CompletionSummary: Hmm… this place is so flashy~ Brightly lit signs everywhere~

_2612.Title: Shibuya
_2612.Description: Izzy~ Aren’t you hungry? You must be tired after all the work at Light Hill... Why didn’t you go eat with the others?
_2612.CompletionSummary: Um~ Tentomon I’m not that hungry, and I’d like to investigate here a bit more~

_2613.Title: Shibuya
_2613.Description: This place is crowded, so you’re hoping to find the eighth Chosen Child here. It seems Myotismon’s minions haven’t arrived yet. But how do you plan to find the eighth Chosen Child?
_2613.CompletionSummary: Don’t we have a Digivice, Tentomon? We should look for it using the Digivice~

_2614.Title: Shibuya
_2614.Description: We have the Digivice and the program given to us by Whitebearded Guru. I think the eighth Chosen Child, like us, will be with a Digimon. Even if the Digivice doesn’t react, if the program detects a Digimon signal, it could be the Digimon of the eighth Chosen Child.
_2614.CompletionSummary: Wow~ As expected, Izzy is amazing~

_2615.Title: Shibuya
_2615.Description: Then, while the others are eating, why don’t we search a bit more for the eighth Chosen Child? Let’s head this way, Izzy!
_2615.CompletionSummary: Izzy, shouldn’t we check it once now?

_2616.Title: Shibuya
_2616.Description: Izzy, we traveled some distance. Can we check if we have the target around us? Try with the program. I hope we have a result.
_2616.Objective: Run the Detection Program in middle of Scramble Intersection
_2616.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Run the Detection Program in middle of Scramble Intersection%qe %cc1/%mc1
_2616.CompletionText: I hope we get a positive response.
_2616.CompletionSummary: Yes!! We have a response signal!

_2617.Title: Shibuya
_2617.Description: Tentomon! We’ve got a reaction! But it’s not just one signal?! Seeing multiple signals must mean Myotismon’s forces are nearby!
_2617.CompletionSummary: Fortunately, the reaction is not far from where we are!

_2618.Title: Shibuya
_2618.Description: Izzy, let's go there and check where the response came from. If those responses are really from Myotismon's army, we should defeat them before citizens here get into trouble.
_2618.CompletionSummary: Oh? Something black, and very fast just passed so fast! What can it be?

_2619.Title: Shibuya
_2619.Description: Black Gatomon? By the way, I see that the group of Black Gatomon are aggressive and harassing the people who live here! Kabuterimon, let's defeat them and save other people!
_2619.CompletionText: This Digimon is very swift and ill-tempered
_2619.CompletionSummary: We defeated them successfully! Izzy, do we have more responses on your laptop?

_2620.Title: Shibuya
_2620.Description:
응! 캅테리몬! 계속 반응이 나타나고 있어! 캅테리몬! 검은색 가트몬과 싸워보니까 들은 생각인데, 검은색 가트몬은 가트몬과 생김새도 비슷하고 공격 패턴이나 움직임이 비슷한 것 같아. 검은색 가트몬의 데이터를 모으면 지금 이 검은색 가트몬과 싸울 때나 나중에 가트몬과 대결할 때 좀 수월해지지 않을까?
이 검은색 가트몬들의 데이터를 모아와 줘! 데이터를 모아오면 내가 분석을 해볼게!
_2620.CompletionSummary: 데이터를 모와 왔어, 한솔아! 이 정도면 충분하지 않을까?

_2621.Title: Shibuya
_2621.Description:
Izzy, will this be enough data for analysis? I hope it can help us when we encounter Gatomon in the future.
I remember that we were helpless at the last battle in Myotismon's Castle, so this data better be useful.
_2621.CompletionSummary: Of course, Tentomon. We'll reverse the results this time, don’t worry!

_2622.Title: Shibuya
_2622.Summary: Not Just an Ordinary Black Cat
_2622.Description:
So they must be BlackGatomon you talked about? Do you think they have been effected by the dark powers? It's not just because their looks, but I can sense it.
Anyway, I wonder if they're also minions of Myotismon. What do you think about that, Izzy?
_2622.CompletionSummary: I think so too. If not, why would they even be here?

_2623.Title: Shibuya
_2623.Description: Besides the fact whether these BlackGatomon are Myotismon's army or not, there is a subject we need to take a look. Look at the gloves they are wearing! Aren't they so adorable? They don't seem to fit on me, but should fit on you though. What do you think about that, Izzy?
_2623.ReservedText: Izzy! I got the gloves! Take it once!

_2624.Title: Shibuya
_2624.Description:
Wow, Izzy! You look so cute with that gloves on your hand!
How about wearing cat ears over your head next? You sure would look like a cute human cat then.
Can you wait until I get you the ears of BlackGatomon?
_2624.CompletionSummary: Uh, well…? I've tried them because you asked for me to, but they're still not my type!
_2624.ReservedText: Now, I got the ear of Black Gatomon ~ Take it once ~

_2625.Title: Shibuya
_2625.Description:
Izzy, can you check if there are anymore signs of monsters around?
Oh, wait! It should be difficult for you to use your laptop with the gloves on… (chuckles)
What a pity…
_2625.CompletionSummary:
The ears should be fine since it won't bother you using your laptop, isn't it?
They fit so well for you. I like them!

_2626.Title: Shibuya
_2626.Description:
Huh? Wait a second! Where’s my Digivice?
Tentomon, have you seen my Digivice?
_2626.Objective: Talk to Tentomon Defeat Black Gatomon to obtain Izzy's Digivice
_2626.CompletionSummary:
What? The Digivice is gone? Where did you lose it?
Could it be that BlackGatomon stole it?
No matter how much I think about it, BlackGatomon seems to be the culprit! Let’s ask BlackGatomon!

_2627.Title: Shibuya
_2627.Description:
Izzy?
They don't seem to tell the truth or be friendly to us. I guess we should find it by the hard way! When they realize who's stronger, they may change their mind!
_2627.CompletionSummary: One of BlackGatomon confessed about where your Digivice is!

_2628.Title: Shibuya
_2628.Description: It told me that their captain took your Digivice! Let's teach it a lesson and retrieve yourself the Digivice!
_2628.CompletionText: One of BlackGatomon confessed that their captain has the Digivice, so let's find their captain!
_2628.CompletionSummary: There it is! You found your Digivice.

_2629.Title: Shibuya
_2629.Summary: If You Commited a Crime, You Should be Punished!
_2629.Description: Let's teach the whole group of BlackGatomon a good lesson! So they do not attempt to steal Digivice from any of us!
_2629.Objective: Defeat BlackGatomon Defeat BlackGatomon Army Captain Defeat BlackGatomon Captain
_2629.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat BlackGatomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat BlackGatomon Army Captain%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat BlackGatomon Captain%qe %cc3/%mc3
_2629.CompletionSummary: I guess that'd be enough punishiment for them. It should be more effective than a mere lecture!

_2630.Title: Shibuya
_2630.Description: Izzy~ Are cats really this sneaky? Stealing things and scratching people without them noticing…

_2631.Title: Shibuya
_2631.Description: Tentomon! Now the tracking program is showing only one signal! This could be the eighth Chosen Child! Let’s head to where the signal is coming from!

_2632.Title: Shibuya
_2632.Description: It’s you, isn’t it?! The ones who defeated the BlackGatomon! How dare you interfere with Lord Myotismon’s plans?! You always know how to ruin my day!
_2632.CompletionSummary: It’s PicoDevimon! Why is he here?

_2633.Title: Shibuya
_2633.Description: Izzy~ Doesn’t the fact that PicoDevimon is here mean we’re getting closer to the eighth Chosen Child? Let’s capture him and find out about Myotismon’s plans!
_2633.CompletionSummary: You guys! What are you whispering about?

_2634.Title: Shibuya
_2634.Description: Looks like you’re all alone, huh? Heh, did you think the BlackGatomon you defeated were all there were? Think again! Come forth, Ghostmon! Take them down!
_2634.CompletionSummary: Hey! PicoDevimon! These few Soulmon won’t stop us!

_2635.Title: Shibuya
_2635.Description:
오호~ 혼자인데도 제법 하는데? 하지만, 방금 나온 고스몬들이 전부라고 생각하면 큰 오산이야~
얘들아 다 나와~! 저 벌레 녀석이 아직 덜 혼난 것 같아~
너네들이 힘 좀 써줘야겠어!
_2635.Objective: 고스몬 대장 처치 고스몬 행동대장 처치
_2635.CompletionText: 건방진 인간 녀석! 눈이 퉁퉁 부을 때까지 울게 해주마!
_2635.CompletionSummary: 엇! 피코데블몬이 어디 갔지? 방금까지 여기 있었는데?

_2636.Title: Shibuya
_2636.Description: Izzy! PicoDevimon is escaping! Let’s chase him! This is our best chance to capture him!
_2636.CompletionSummary: Kekekeke… Welcome~ I’ve prepared something for you~

_2637.Title: Shibuya
_2637.Description: My ally, Raremon! Just being near him is a headache with his awful stench... He’s your opponent now.
_2637.CompletionSummary: So the reason you lured us here was Raremon…!

_2638.Title: Shibuya
_2638.Description: Kabuterimon! Quickly take down Raremon so we can capture PicoDevimon! If Raremon runs rampant here, it’ll cause massive damage to the city! And PicoDevimon might escape again!
_2638.Objective: (Raremon Summon Card Pre-issued) Defeat Raremon Talk to PicoDevimon
_2638.CompletionSummary: Ah! PicoDevimon is running away again!!
_2638.ReservedText:
Until Raremon ...
I have to run away ~ !!

_2639.Title: Shibuya
_2639.Description: PicoDevimon… he’s incredibly fast... Sorry, Izzy… we lost him… So frustrating…
_2639.CompletionSummary: It’s okay, Tentomon~ It’s disappointing, but we can’t help it, huh~ Oh! What’s this reaction?

_2641.Title: Shibuya
_2641.Description: The reaction on the Digivice suddenly disappeared…
_2641.CompletionSummary: It’s a pity we couldn’t find the 8th Digidestined child, but still! We’ve confirmed that the 8th Digidestined is somewhere around here, not on the Hill of Light, so that’s a big find, Tentomon!

_2642.Title: Shibuya
_2642.Description: I’ve discovered something very important, Tentomon~ Skipping lunch was worth it! The eighth Chosen Child is somewhere nearby! Let’s inform everyone!
_2642.CompletionSummary: That seems like a good idea, Izzy~!

_2643.Title: Shibuya
_2643.Description: Izzy~ Have you contacted everyone? Let’s move out quickly too!

_2644.Title: Shibuya
_2644.Description: Izzy? Is it true? The eighth Chosen Child is nearby?
_2644.CompletionSummary: Yes, that’s right. We just encountered PicoDevimon and Raremon, servants of Myotismon, and fought them. During the battle, my Digivice briefly reacted.

_2645.Title: Shibuya
_2645.Description:
So our presumption may be true? 8th chosen child must have left the Valley of Light in the past.
Let's search from near Shibuya. Myotismon's minions have already occupied this area, so lets hurry!
_2645.CompletionSummary: I agree to that. Let's make haste and search the surrounding area!

_2646.Title: Shibuya
_2646.Description: Let's split up and continue searching! The streets of Shibuya are in pretty complex structure, so moving in one group will take too much time. I think it will be better for us to split into groups of 2 or 3 of us.

_2647.Title: Shibuya
_2647.Description: As you know, I'm going to middle school this year, and I have to prepare for it. For that, I need to start taking classes from the middle school institute. So I have to go home now. If you're still here after my class, I'll come back and continue to help you!
_2647.CompletionSummary: Oh, well~ ok then~! Joe, good luck on your class! Now, it's up to rest of us then~!!

_2648.Title: Shibuya
_2648.Description: Alright, let’s find the eighth Chosen Child. I’ll search with T.K., and Sora can search with Mimi.
_2648.CompletionSummary: Alright, I’ll go with Izzy to search. Everyone, be careful!

_2649.Title: Shibuya
_2649.Description: We are going to look for the 8th chosen child and meet up back in Odaiba! You should all miss your family, and also need some rest. We can't fall down before we find the 8th chosen child, can we?
_2649.CompletionSummary: All right, guys! Let's meet up again in Odaiba~!

_2650.Title: Shibuya
_2650.Description:
Tai~ Are we searching for the eighth Chosen Child here? This place seems even more complex and full of buildings compared to the last one~ It feels so exciting to be in such an interesting place! My heart’s racing!
Wait? My Digivice is gone!!!
_2650.CompletionSummary:
Huh, Tai! Did you lose your Digivice?
I knew it… That kind of thing would be done by Mikemon! I was also attacked once on my way here! It wasn’t Mikemon, but it was a similar cat Digimon!
Anyway, I’m sure it’s Mikemon’s doing!!

_2651.Title: Shibuya
_2651.Description:
Taichi! Watch out! I see monsters nearby! They look like the white cat we confront from Myotismon's castle, but it has different colored furs. If they are alike, must be tough enemies to deal with!
Do you think they're Myotismon's minions too? Where are those cats from?
