_2651.CompletionText: By the way, Taichi~ Are we going to eat after the fight?
_2651.CompletionSummary: I'll check what they really are! Please wait for a minute!

_2652.Title: Shibuya
_2652.Description:
Identified! Taichi, listen to this. The cat-like Digimon is called Mikemon. It is very fast and fierce type Digimon. So we should be careful encountering them.
Taichi, they are Champion form, so we need to digivolve too!

_2653.Title: Shibuya
_2653.Objective: Defeat Mikemon, Defeat Mikemon(Army Captain), Defeat Mikemon(Captain)
_2653.CompletionSummary: Greymon! There are more of them coming from the street ahead! Watch out!

_2654.Title: Shibuya
_2654.Description: 한솔아, 내가 좀 생각을 해봤는데 미케몬의 강력한 펀치의 힘은 혹시 저 장갑에서 나오는 게 아닐까? 그럴싸하지? 우리 한 번, 미케몬의 장갑을 뺏어볼까?!
_2654.CompletionSummary: 흠…크게 변화는 없는 것 같은데요…태일이 형… 그냥 저 고양이 장갑이 귀여워서 뺏자고 한 것은 아니겠죠?

_2655.Title: Shibuya
_2655.Description: 태일이 형! 아직 싸움이 끝난 게 아닙니다. 흰수염도사님이 주신 프로그램으로 이 지역을 살펴보니 엄청난 속도로 많은 수의 디지몬들이 이곳으로 달려오고 있어요!
_2655.CompletionSummary: 아까 그 고양이들인데? 그런데 아까 봤던 고양이들 보다 발톱이…유독…굉장히 날카로워 보이는 건 내 기분 탓이냐?

_2656.Title: Shibuya
_2656.Description:
8번째 선택받은 아이를 찾는 것은 아직 시작도 못했는데 계속 디지몬들이 몰려오네…
그레이몬! 힘들겠지만 좀 더 힘을 내줘! 어서 미케몬과 미케몬(행동대장)들을 처치하고 8번째 선택받은 아이를 찾으러 가자!
_2656.CompletionSummary: 미케몬들…수도 많고 강한데… 어떻게 손쉽게 처치할 수 있는 방법이 없을까?

_2657.Title: Shibuya
_2657.Description:
그러고 보니, 태일이 형 집에서 고양이 키우지 않나요? 저번에 형이 고양이는 강아지풀을 굉장히 좋아한다고 했었는데
저 미케몬 대장에게 한 번 강아지풀이 먹히는지 실험을 해볼까요?
_2657.CompletionSummary: 효과가 있는 것 같습니다. 미케몬 대장이 강아지풀에 눈을 떼질 못하는 것 같아요!

_2658.Title: Shibuya
_2658.Description:
지금이 기회인 것 같습니다!
미케몬들이 강아지풀에 정신이 팔렸을 때 미케몬들을 후다닥 처치해 버리죠!!
_2658.Objective: 미케몬 행동대장 처치 미케몬 대장 처치
_2658.CompletionSummary: 후~ 이 근처에 있는 미케몬은 모두 처치한 것 같습니다. 이제 8번째 선택받은 아이를 찾으러 갈 수 있겠군요!

_2659.Title: Shibuya
_2659.Description:
Woosh! (*sound of wind) Yikes!! (Taichi falls down)
What was that? Did someone push me? Agumon, did you see that?
_2659.CompletionSummary: No, I didn't see anything, Taichi. I was close to you! But I did feel something passing by. Like a sudden breeze…

_2660.Title: Shibuya
_2660.Description:
Taichi, check if you haven't lost anything! Is your Digivice missing?
(after Taichi reacts) I knew it… It's probably stolen! It happened to me too while I was on the way. It was BlackGatomon, same cat type Digimon!
If they have habits in common, then the suspect who stole your Digivice must be one of Mikemon!
_2660.CompletionText: I never expected to have my Digivice stolen like this…
_2660.CompletionSummary: I see. I guess that's why me and Agumon couldn't even see who did it. Shall we find the suspect now? Agumon! Digivolve!

_2661.Title: Shibuya
_2661.Description:
Is it one of them? The thief who stole my Digivice? Let's find the suspect!
Greymon, don't let them get away!!
_2661.CompletionText: I never expected to have my Digivice stolen like this…
_2661.CompletionSummary: Taichi, I couldn't find Digivice from them…

_2662.Title: Shibuya
_2662.Description: They should be hiding the suspect who stole your Digivice. Then we can make them talk. Let's make them confess who the suspect is!
_2662.CompletionSummary: I knew it!! They confess after getting a few good hits…! Now I know who the suspect is!

_2663.Title: Shibuya
_2663.Description: Taichi! Your Digivice is stolen by their active leader! Since we've located the suspect, It's time to retrieve your Digivice now.
_2663.Objective: Collect Taichi's Digivice from Mikemon(Army Captain)
_2663.CompletionSummary: There it is! My Digivice! Thank you Agumon! I could retrieve my Digivice with your help!

_2664.Title: Shibuya
_2664.Description:
내 디지바이스를 훔친 미케몬들을 그냥 보내줄 수는 없지! 아주 혼쭐을 내줘서 다시는 디지바이스 훔칠 생각을 못 하게 해주자!
그레이몬! 미케몬들을 마구마구 혼내줘 버렷!!
_2664.CompletionSummary: 태일아, 이 녀석들 눈빛을 보아하니 아직 덜 혼난 것 같은데?!?

_2665.Title: Shibuya
_2665.Description:
그럼! 진화하자! 그레이몬! 진화를 해서 미케몬에게 본때를 보여주자!!
이번엔 미케몬들의 대장을 혼내주는 거야! 그래서 다시는 우리 근처에 얼씬도 못하게 만들어 버리자!!
_2665.CompletionSummary: 미케몬들이 도망가고 있어! 이렇게까지 했으니 다신 우리의 디지바이스를 훔치러 오지 못 할 거야!

_2666.Title: Shibuya
_2666.Description:
From now on, I should keep the Digivice in my pocket or bag… Leaving it out in the open led to this.
We need to be more cautious… We never know what other Digimon might target us.
_2666.CompletionSummary: Izzy’s right~ Tai, you’re so clumsy~ (shaking head) Still a long way to go~

_2667.Title: Shibuya
_2667.Summary: Is This a City or a Zoo?
_2667.Description:
Tai… Another Digimon has appeared…
It seems like a really strong one… Be careful…
_2667.CompletionSummary: That Digimon is Sangloupmon, a wolf-type Digimon… A wolf after a cat, huh? This place doesn’t feel like a city… It feels like a zoo… Tai! Sangloupmon is a Champion-level Digimon, so let’s Digivolve and fight!

_2668.Title: Shibuya
_2668.Description:
Greymon! Let’s take down all the wolves here! We’ve wasted too much time!
We need to hurry!
_2668.CompletionSummary: Tai! These wolf guys keep trying to bite me rather than scratch me??

_2669.Title: Shibuya
_2669.Description:
아! 그 이유는 상굴몬은 디지몬의 피를 빨아먹는 디지몬이기 때문이에요! 상굴몬에게 피를 빨리게 되면 죽게 되니…조심하셔야 합니다! 그레이몬!
굉장히 위험하고 힘들 것 같지만… 제가 생각한 한 가지 아이디어는 상굴몬의 송곳니 부러뜨려서 피를 못 빨아먹게 하는 겁니다!
그레이몬이라면 이 일을 해낼 거라고 생각해요! 그레이몬! 상굴몬의 송곳니를 부러뜨려서 피를 못 빨게 하죠!
_2669.CompletionSummary: 상굴몬의 송곳니를 이렇게 부러뜨렸으니 좀 더 수월하게 상굴몬을 처치할 수 있을 거라 생각합니다!

_2670.Title: Shibuya
_2670.Description:
상굴몬이 피를 빨게 되면 상대방의 디지코어의 정보를 모두 뽑아간다고 합니다. 그렇다는 건 상굴몬의 디지코어를 얻게 되면 상굴몬이 피를 빤 모든 디지몬의 정보를 알 수 있게 되지 않을까요?
왠지 제 예상이 맞을 것 같은 예감이 듭니다. 많은 정보를 얻을 수 있으면…매우 행복하겠군요… 어서 상굴몬을 잡으러 가보죠!
_2670.CompletionSummary:
(한솔이…뭔가 좀 흥분한 것 같은데….)
한솔아…괜찮아? 어디 아픈 건 아니지?

_2671.Title: Shibuya
_2671.Description:
태일이 형, 무슨 생각을 하신 거예요? 전 아무렇지도 않아요! 완전 멀쩡하다구요!
아무튼! 상굴몬을 잡아 디지코어를 얻어보도록 하죠! 피를 빤 디지몬들의 정보를 자신의 디지코어에 저장하고 있다면 엄청난 데이터를 얻을 수 있을 거예요! 예를 들면, 그중에 묘티스몬의 부하의 정보가 있다면!! 우린 묘티스몬의 부하들이 공격을 해 왔을 때 완전무결한 대비를 할 수 있을 거예요!
태일이 형! 어서, 상굴몬의 디지코어를 얻으러 가보죠!
_2671.CompletionSummary: 이게 그 정보의 바다일 수도 있는 상굴몬의 디지코어인가요?? 분석하려면 시간이 꽤나 걸리겠지만 분석할 맛이 나는 데이터인 것 같습니다.

_2672.Title: Shibuya
_2672.Description:
태일이 형… 상굴몬들…자신들의 동료가 다치니 단단히 열을 받은 것 같습니다… 무리 지어서 덤비려고 하고 있어요!
당황하지 말고 차근차근히 대응하도록 하죠!
_2672.CompletionSummary: 태일아! 조심해…뭔가 심상치 않은 기운이 느껴져…

_2673.Title: Shibuya
_2673.Description:
Taichi…I think it is an uncommon Sangloupmon….it must be the king of Sangloupmons…. I feel huge power on him…!
I don't think we can defeat it without evolution! Let me Digivolve, Taichi!!!!!!
_2673.CompletionSummary: Okay! Got it! Greymon! Let's fight with evolution!

_2674.Title: Shibuya
_2674.Description:
You are the brutal humans that killed my fellows…. You've done very wrong thing…. Since I've witnessed this situation, I won't let you alive!
Better to be ready! You Humans!!
_2674.Objective: Defeat 20 Sangloupmon Captain, then Sangloupmon King of the Wolves appears Defeat Sangloupmon King of the Wolves
_2674.CompletionSummary: Gasp*…. He was very powerful one…. Gasp*…

_2675.Title: Shibuya
_2675.Description:
Tai! It’s the Crest of Light Pendant! Sangloupmon had it!
We’ve made an incredible discovery!
_2675.CompletionSummary: The Crest of Light Pendant? Is it food?

_2676.Title: Shibuya
_2676.Description: Tai~ It looks just like the Necklace you have, but the image inside is different, isn’t it? Is this the Crest of Light Pendant, Tai?

_2677.Title: Shibuya
_2677.Description:
That’s right! Koromon! This is the Crest of Light Pendant that the eighth Chosen Child must have!
Tai! Finding this means we’ve accomplished something huge!
We’ve stolen the Crest of Light from Myotismon’s forces! This means we’ve partially thwarted Myotismon’s ambitions!
_2677.CompletionSummary: Did we do something amazing, Tai?

_2678.Title: Shibuya
_2678.Description: Yeah, Koromon! We’ve done something incredible! Plus, having the Crest of Light will make it easier to find the eighth Chosen Child!
_2678.CompletionSummary: Really… (indifferent…) Tai, I’m hungry~ When are we eating?

_2679.Title: Shibuya
_2679.Description:
Taichi~I'm hungry~ I'm so starving that I can't Digivolve anymore~
Sniff*~ I can smell something good~
_2679.CompletionSummary:
I'm hungry too….Agumon… Stop whining~~~
Wait~it's true? Should we go there?

_2680.Title: Shibuya
_2680.Description:
Agumon~ Aren't those wolf digimons eat something?
Wait! It's meat! They are having really delicous looking meat~
Agumon~ Should we steal their meat from them? I will give them all to you~
_2680.CompletionSummary: Wow~Looks good~ Taichi~ Why don't you eat it?

_2681.Title: Shibuya
_2681.Description:
Taichi~ I'm thirsty…? Where can I find water~?
But I want something else, not woater~
_2681.CompletionSummary: Really? Then we should get some beverage from Vending Machine…… Wait a second Agumon~

_2682.Title: Shibuya
_2682.Description:
I'm going to get something from Vending Machine Agumon~ Wait here for me~
Soda should be enough I should drink something too~
Let's go get some beverage from Vending Machine~
_2682.Objective: Deliver Soda from Vending Mahcine<2nd in Shibuya> Use Vending Machine
_2682.CompletionSummary: I'm so full, Taichi~ I feel much better now~ Taichi~ You always eat these things all the time?

_2683.Title: Shibuya
_2683.Description: Taichi~ Didn't you say your sister is weak? How about make some warm clothes for her? Unfortunately I'm not Gabumon… I don't have warm leather….
_2683.CompletionSummary: Oh~Agumon~Admirable? Thank you for your consideration~

_2684.Title: Shibuya
_2684.Description:
Taichi~ what about make clothes with Mikemon and Sangloupmon's leather? Cat and wolf leather clothes will be super warm~
Let's get Mikemon and Sangloupmon and take their leather Taichi~
_2684.Objective: Collect Mikemon's Leather from Mikemons Collect Sangloupmon's Leather from Sangloupsmon
_2684.CompletionSummary: All the material is ready! Taichi!

_2685.Title: Shibuya
_2685.Description:
Anyway Agumon~ Do you know how to make clothes?
Knitting? Sewing? Do you know what those are?
_2685.CompletionSummary:
Knitting? Sewing? What is it? Can I eat?
What if I don't know…? Then…. We don't need these leather?

_2686.Title: Shibuya
_2686.Summary: Search with the Crest of Light
_2686.Description: Let’s use the Crest of Light to locate the eighth Chosen Child, Tai! If the eighth Chosen Child’s Digivice is nearby, it’ll react! Let’s move quickly!

_2687.Title: Shibuya
_2687.Description:
It’s Musyamon, Tai! Be careful of that sword! It’s a cruel weapon that drains life energy…
Agumon, especially, be cautious!

_2688.Title: Shibuya
_2688.Description: Tai~ So we just need to take down these Musyamons, right? I’ll handle them, so stay safe in the meantime!
_2688.Objective: Defeat Musyamon Obtain a suspicious item from Musyamon
_2688.CompletionSummary: What’s this? This… Crest of Light? Why is there another one of these?

_2689.Title: Shibuya
_2689.Description: Two Crests of Light? What’s going on here, Izzy?
_2689.CompletionSummary: I’m not sure… I have a guess, but… I hope that guess never comes true…

_2690.Title: Shibuya
_2690.Description:
Well, I do have a suspicion… It’s that… One or both of them are fake. But the important part is figuring out how to tell the fake apart.
Unfortunately, I haven’t come up with that method yet…

_2691.Title: Shibuya
_2691.Description:
I’ll bite the Pendant! If it breaks, it’s fake, and if it doesn’t, it’s real!
I can’t imagine the real Pendant breaking, so if it does, it must be fake!
Let me take a bite!
_2691.CompletionSummary: Greymon!! If Greymon bites this pendant, even if it’s a real one, it could actually break! Aaaah!!!!! Whew~ Anyway, unless we meet the 8th Digidestined, we won’t be able to determine whether this pendant is real or fake.

_2692.Title: Shibuya
_2692.Description:
Let’s check if other Musyamons have Crest of Light Pendants too. We might find more if we look inside their armor!
Of course, that’s assuming the Pendants we currently have are fake. Tai, let’s go search for more!
_2692.CompletionText: "If they don't have it…… I want to believe that one of the two is really just a toy….."
_2692.CompletionSummary: The Crest of Light doesn’t appear anymore….

_2693.Title: Shibuya
_2693.Description:
I think that's all tags that Musyamons were hiding. Then Shall we check Musyamon Army Captains and Captains to find out more evidence? Only way to get evidence is from Musyamon!
Let's go get Musyamon Army Captain and Captain! Taichi!
_2693.Objective: Collect Evidence from Musyamon(Army Captain) and Musyamon(Captain)
_2693.CompletionText: Greymon! Keep the steam up a bit more!
_2693.CompletionSummary: I think Musyamon dropped something? Let's go find out!

_2694.Title: Shibuya
_2694.Description: The third Emblem of Light… Taichi….I think all the Emblem of Light we got are fake. Maybe they are all duplicates… I think Myotismon has the real one… I've never thought that Myotismon has such ability that can copy the emblem.
_2694.CompletionSummary: Gosh…Myotismon…. Never imagined you could be this caution…!

_2695.Title: Shibuya
_2695.Description:
There are no other ways except we defeat them and take their Emblem of Light away, Taichi! Even though it's duplicated one, it still can detect the 8th chosen child and that's why Myotismon duplicated it.
If we take their duplicated Emblem of Light away, we can delay the speed of their searching!
_2695.Objective: Collect Duplicated Emblem of Light from Musyamon(Army Captain) and Musyamon(Captain)
_2695.CompletionSummary: Izzy, I think we take them down enough and get Emblem too Shall we Go to the other area?

_2696.Title: Shibuya
_2696.Description: 태일이 형! 무사몬들이 또 나타났습니다! 이렇게까지 우리 앞에 또 나타난 것을 보니 우리가 뺏은 복사된 빛의 문장들을 되찾으러 온 것 같습니다. 수가 상당히 많아요! 조심해야 할 것 같습니다!
_2696.CompletionText: 성숙기 디지몬으로는 이 수를 상대하는 것은 무리일 것 같습니다!

_2697.Title: Shibuya
_2697.Description:
메탈그레이몬! 무사몬들을 해치우고 어서 이곳을 벗어나자! 복사된 펜던트가 이렇게 많다고 한다면 8번째 선택받은 아이가 위험한 상황에 있을 수도 있어!
어서 이 무사몬 대장들을 처치해버리자!
_2697.CompletionSummary: 디지몬들이 더 오고 있어! 조심해, 태일아!

_2698.Title: Shibuya
_2698.Description:
네 녀석들이 내 부하들에게 무사의 자긍심에 금을 가게 한 녀석들이냐? 인간과 이런 디지몬에게 졌다면 금이 가도 뭐 어쩔 수 없다만…
그래도 자신의 부하의 수치를 갚지 않는다면 이것 또한 무사가 아닐지니…
너희의 목! 내가 가져가겠다! 각오해라!
_2698.Objective: 무사몬(대장) 20마리 처치 시 무사몬(진정한 무사) 출현 무사몬(진정한 무사) 처치

_2699.Title: Shibuya
_2699.Description:
Musyamon was quite a strong Digimon… You’ve worked hard, Koromon!
There are likely two reasons why they’re trying to recover these Crests of Light. One, there’s a real one among them. Two, there aren’t many copies of the Crest of Light. I believe the latter is more likely.
_2699.CompletionSummary: Why do you think so, Izzy?

_2700.Title: Shibuya
_2700.Description: The reason is that Myotismon is a cunning Digimon who doesn’t trust others easily. He seems to trust only himself and is deeply suspicious of his subordinates. The real Crest of Light Pendant is probably in Myotismon’s possession.
_2700.CompletionSummary: Really? Tai, did you think so too?

_2701.Title: Shibuya
_2701.Description: This place seems wrapped up. Shall we move on? We should also inform the others about what happened here.
_2701.Objective: Move to Shibuya East Talk to PicoDevimon
_2701.CompletionSummary: What! You! Pico Devimon!! What’s that guy doing here?
_2701.ReservedText: Hey ~ you had a little accident ~

_2702.Title: Shibuya
_2702.Description: PicoDevimon! What scheme are you plotting this time?!
_2702.CompletionSummary: Pico Devimon must have been watching us all along...
_2702.ReservedText: You don't need to know that. Anyway, you!! I see that you've already figured out the existence of duplicated Emblem of Light. Of course I was expecting that, but it's a bit earlier than I first thought. But you arrogant human children and the traitors who

_2703.Title: Shibuya
_2703.Description: Are these the ones you were talking about?
_2703.CompletionSummary: No!! Who's that guy?! He looks really strong...
_2703.ReservedText: That's right, sir Phantomon! These fools dare to disturb lord Myotismon's plan!

_2704.Title: Shibuya
_2704.Description: Lord Phantomon… I wonder if I could humbly ask how you plan to deal with them…
_2704.CompletionSummary: Grr! It's coming! Everyone, you better get ready!!
_2704.ReservedText: Fine… Even thought it wasn't very pleasant to listen to a kid like you, I still agree to the fact I don't feel happy about them trying to disturb lord Myotismon's plans. Now shall I do some exercise lightly?

_2705.Title: Shibuya
_2705.Description: Let’s go, MetalGreymon!! Take down that Phantomon!!
_2705.Objective: (Phantommon Summon Card Issued) Defeat Phantommon (Summon Card Replacement)
_2705.CompletionText: 메탈그레이몬!! 조심해야 해! 무척 강한 녀석인 것 같아!

_2706.Title: Shibuya
_2706.Description:
Don’t make a fuss, PicoDevimon! I was just playing around…
Well, they’re not bad, but… Their attacks won’t even scratch Lord Myotismon…
Let’s go, PicoDevimon. We must report to Lord Myotismon. Tell him there’s nothing to worry about even if these humans find the eighth Chosen Child.
_2706.CompletionSummary: Phantomon and Pico Devimon are on the move! Tai!!

_2707.Title: Shibuya
_2707.Description: Phantomon is an Ultimate-level Digimon. His level is the same as MetalGreymon’s… But we couldn’t deal much damage. If that’s the case, just how powerful must the Myotismon he serves be? It’s hard to imagine…

_2708.Title: Shibuya
_2708.Description:
By the way, Tai… Sorry to bring this up out of nowhere, but… Doesn’t it feel warmer suddenly?
Is it just me…? Am I imagining things…?

_2709.Title: Shibuya
_2709.Description: Tai! Tokyo Tower is wobbling! It looks like it’s melting and bending… Something must be happening at Tokyo Tower.
_2709.CompletionSummary: Seems like it, wait a second! There's a Digimon at Tokyo Tower! It's Birdramon! Is Sora there?

_2710.Title: Shibuya
_2710.Description:
Everyone~ We need to head to Tokyo Tower quickly! Something’s happened to Sora…!
Let’s go to Tokyo Tower! Sora is in danger!
_2710.CompletionSummary: Ah~ I’m tired~ Sora~ let's take a break while searching~

_2711.Title: Shibuya
_2711.Description: *Beep beep* (The Digivice points towards a specific location.)
_2711.Objective: Move to Digivice Reaction Area A
_2711.CompletionSummary: Tai, what's wrong? You look so serious… Do you need to poop?

_2712.Title: Shibuya
_2712.Description: What are you staring at so intently? Hungry?
_2712.CompletionSummary: No, that's not it, Agumon… My Digivice just reacted a moment ago!

_2713.Title: Shibuya
_2713.Description: *Beep beep* (The Digivice points towards a specific location.)
_2713.Objective: Move to Digivice Reaction Area B
_2713.CompletionSummary: The Crest of Light is also glowing, Tai~ But the Digivice keeps reacting? That’s fascinating~

_2714.Title: Shibuya
_2714.Description: Agumon, look! The light from the Crest has disappeared! And now, the Digivice isn’t making any sound either!
_2714.CompletionSummary: What could have caused it to react suddenly? Could the eighth chosen child be nearby?

_2715.Title: Shibuya
_2715.Description:
I have no idea, Agumon… But that eighth Chosen Child sure is fast…
Is it really a child? It moves like it’s driving a car or riding a motorcycle…

_2716.Title: Shibuya
_2716.Description:
Could it have wings? … … …
Ah! I got it, Tai! What if the eighth Chosen Child is like Centarumon? A human upper body and a horse lower body! That would explain the speed! How’s that for a theory? Pretty smart, right? Like Izzy?
_2716.CompletionSummary: Tai~ why are you making that face? Hmph…

_2717.Title: Shibuya
_2717.Description:
Oh, right~ How about making a blanket with Soulmon's cloth for Taichi's sister? Taichi? Wouldn't it be possible to make a warm blanket with many cloth?
I will get some cloth by defeating Soulmons~ Taichi~ Wait for a moment!
_2717.CompletionSummary: I collected them all~ Taichi~ Let's make a blanket now~

_2718.Title: Shibuya
_2718.Description:
Agumon…You said you don't know how to sew….
And if you sleep in this dirty cloth Your cold can get worse….
_2718.CompletionSummary: Taichi….all the cloth I collected are useless? Are these cloth that dirty? Okay…these cloth are for digimons like me ….. Okay…Taichi…. If you say so…it's alright….

_2719.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2719.Description: Sora~ let's take a short break here~ It's hot~ and my legs hurt too~
_2719.CompletionSummary: Ha~It's so cool~ I feel relieved now~
_2719.ReservedText: Again? We just took a break... Hmm… I guess there’s no choice...

_2720.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2720.Description: Sora~ I have a good idea It's the place where very cool and helpful to find the 8the chosen child Do you want to go with me?

_2721.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2721.Description: Over~~~~~there~~~ Tokyo Tower Observatory~ Isn't it possible to find some places where the 8th chosen child can be if we go up to Tokyo Tower Observatory? Sora~~~Let's go~
_2721.Objective: Go to the Park in front of Tokyo Tower
_2721.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to the Park in front of Tokyo Tower%qe %cc1/%mc1
_2721.CompletionSummary: Sora~Don't you think it's hotter than before? Is it just me?

_2722.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2722.Description: Really…It's getting hotter….MiMi… Is something really happening around the Tower?
_2722.CompletionSummary: What on earth happens there and makes us dying under heat?

_2723.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2723.Description:
Sora! It's a digimon!
They are DemiMeramons and very violent! Be careful!
They can possbily burn this area, so it's better to defeat them, MiMi!
_2723.CompletionSummary: Sora, DemiMeramon keeps coming! We have to keep preparing!

_2724.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2724.Description: 소라야~ 아직 페티메라몬들이 아직 저곳에 남아있어! 쟤네들이 일을 내기 전에 해치워버리자!
_2724.CompletionSummary: 소라야~ 이곳에 디지몬들이 더 남아있는지 확인해볼게~ 조금만 기다려~

_2725.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2725.Description:
소라야~! 미나야~! 큰일 났어! 날아서 이 주위를 확인해 봤는데 도쿄타워 주위에 디지몬들이 엄청 많아…
어떻게 하면 좋지? 소라야?
_2725.CompletionSummary: 큰일이네…피요몬에게 들은 걸로 생각해 봤을 때 우리 둘로는 역부족일 것 같은데…

_2726.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2726.Description:
그냥 지나쳤다간 이곳에 더 큰일이 벌어지게 될 거야… 그러니 우리끼리 디지몬들을 해치우고 있자.
우리가 디지몬들을 해치우고 있으면 소란을 눈치채고 태일이나 다른 애들이 와줄 거야! 우리는 그때까지만 버티고 있으면 돼!
_2726.CompletionSummary: 알았어, 소라 언니… 또 이런 일에 휘말려서 기분이 좀 그렇긴 한데 어쩔 수 없지 뭐~ 소라 언니 의견을 따르도록 할게~!

_2727.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2727.Description: 아니! 미나야! 결국엔 쟤네들이 이곳에 불을 질러 버렸어! 미나야 나는 불을 끌 물을 구해볼게! 미나는 저 디지몬들을 해치워줘! 부탁할게!
_2727.Objective: 페티메라몬(행동대장) 25마리 처치 시 페티메라몬(거대화) 출현 페티메라몬(거대화) 처치

_2728.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2728.Description: 물을 구해왔어! 미나는 저쪽에 난 불을 꺼줘! 나는 반대편에 난 불을 끄도록 할게!
_2728.Objective: 화재 지역으로 이동해서 양동이로 화재 진압하기
_2728.CompletionSummary: 소라 언니~ 소라 언니 말대로 이쪽 불은 다 껐어~

_2729.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2729.Description:
잘 했어~미나야~ 그런데 아직 물이 조금 남아 있거든~
이 물을 사용해서 디지몬들을 약하게 만든 다음에 해치우도록 하자! 그러는 편이 우리가 좀 더 수월하게 디지몬들을 해치울 수 있을 거야!
바가지에 물을 떠서 페티메라몬 행동대장에게 뿌려보자! 분명 효과가 있을 거야!
_2729.CompletionSummary: 좋았어~! 미나야! 디지몬들이 괴로워하면서 몸부림을 치고 있어!

_2730.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2730.Description: 기회는 지금이야, 미나야! 다시는 불을 지르지 못하게 어서 저 디지몬들을 해치워버리자!
_2730.CompletionSummary: 휴~ 이제야 한고비 넘었네… 지쳤다, 지쳤어~

_2731.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2731.Description: Hing…Mina… The trees and flowers are all burnt to ashes… This place used to be so beautiful… It’s such a shame… If only we’d found the Digimon sooner…
_2731.CompletionSummary: Exactly… From now on, let’s stop other Digimon from causing more trouble like this! Palmon!

_2732.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2732.Description: Mina… the flowerbed is completely charred… It’s so sad… How can we restore it to how it was before?
_2732.CompletionSummary: Palmon… It’s unfortunate, but you know as well as I do… Plants don’t grow quickly. We’ll just have to wait patiently for them to grow strong again over time.

_2733.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2733.Description:
Palmon~ Next time we come here, let’s plant some seeds to make the flowerbed as beautiful as it was.
Sora, what do you think? Isn’t that a good idea?
_2733.CompletionSummary: I like that~ That would be great~

_2734.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2734.Description:
I saw Candlemons hurt flowers and trees earlier! Candlemons might have the seeds of plants!
If they have them, we can get those by defeating Candlemons! Let's check if they have it!
_2734.Objective: Collect Seeds of Plant from Candlemons
_2734.CompletionSummary: It's nice that Candlemons have seeds~

_2735.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2735.Description:
Candlemons have seeds~ Maybe they have seedlings too!
Let's figure out if they have seedlings too!
_2735.CompletionSummary: You also have seedlings~ good~ How come Candlemons bring those seedlings?

_2736.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2736.Description: We have seeds and seedlings now so let's plant on the garden~ Make sure you won't hurt them~
_2736.Objective: Plant Seeds on Dream Garden Plant Seedlings on Hope Garden
_2736.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Plant Seeds on Dream Garden%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Plant Seedlings on Hope Garden%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2736.CompletionSummary: We are done~ Now we have to wait untill they grow up~ I hope they grow up without any trouble~ right, MiMi?

_2737.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2737.Description:
My parents told me that we use ash as fertilizer to help plants to grow well….
I saw Demimeramon took ash after they burned!
Let's take them down and spread ash on the garden that we plant seeds~
_2737.CompletionSummary: I think you have enough ash fertilizer~

_2738.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2738.Description:
We have enough ash fertilizer so let's spread them on the garden~ You have to spread wide and equal~
Don't dump it on one side because it's annoying, Mimi~!
_2738.Objective: Spread Ash Fertilizer(Seeds) on Dream Garden Spread Ash Fertilizer(Seedling) on Hope Garden
_2738.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Spread Ash Fertilizer(Seeds) on Dream Garden%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Spread Ash Fertilizer(Plants) on Hope Garden%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2738.CompletionSummary: MiMi, Piyomon, Palmon~ Everybody well done~ Now we have to wait till they grow~

_2739.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2739.Description:
I hope the flowerbed will be as pretty as it was…
When we come back, it’ll be as beautiful as me, right, Mina?
_2739.CompletionSummary: Right~ Palmon~ When we come back later, it’ll be a beautiful garden, just like me~ and Palmon~

_2740.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2740.Description: Hmm? I think I just heard a huge explosion somewhere. Where could it be? Let’s check it out!
_2740.CompletionSummary: Ah! It’s Boarmon! Be careful, Sora!

_2741.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2741.Description: Boarmon is rampaging, crashing into everything around Tokyo Tower… How do we stop it? Is there a way to resolve this without fighting?
_2741.CompletionSummary: I have a good idea~ Piyomon~

_2742.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2742.Description: I’ve got it—‘scare tactics’! If there’s a sudden loud noise, it’ll spook them, right? We’ll tie empty cans to a string and loop it around Boarmon. When it walks over the string, the cans will rattle and make noise. The sudden noise will scare Boarmon back to where it came from! If we keep doing this, it’ll stay put, thinking there’s something weird going on!
_2742.CompletionSummary: Wow~ Sora, that’s amazing~ I think it’s a great idea~

_2743.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2743.Description: First, we need many empty cans so get as many cans as we can from Vending Machine~ There should be Vending Machine around here~ Let's go to Vending Machine and get some beverages~
_2743.Objective: Get Fruit Juice from Vending Machine Get Sports Drink from Vending Machine Get Soda from Vending Machine Use Vending Machine
_2743.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Get Fruit Juice from Vending Machine%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Get Sports Drink from Vending Machine%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Get Soda from Vending Machine%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Use Vending Machine%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2743.CompletionSummary: I think it was a good idea that we get juice and sports drink because soda is hard to swallow~

_2744.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2744.Description:
okay~ Let's drink~ It's wasting if we don't drink all~! MiMi~Didn't you say you were thirsty earlier~? Let's drink~
You have to drink it all even if you are full~? MiMi?
_2744.Objective: Pass Fruit Juice to Palmon Pass Sports Drink to Piyomon Pass Sports Drink to MiMi Pass Soda to Sora
_2744.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Pass Fruit Juice to Palmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Pass Sports Drink to Piyomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Pass Sports Drink to MiMi%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Pass Soda to Sora%qe %cc4/%mc4
_2744.CompletionText: Piyomon, pass me sports drink Palmon, pass me fruit juice And MiMi, just give me the rest of your drink after you finish~

_2745.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2745.Description: Sora…Is it going to work on Boaromn? It looks brilliant at first…but my anxiety gets bigger and bigger while working on this..
_2745.CompletionSummary: It's okay~it will be all good~ If it doesn't work…then we should fight harder….

_2746.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2746.Description:
Okay~It's all done~
Let's install them now~ Boarmon must not know about this devices~ Okay? MiMi~?
_2746.Objective: Install Silencer A at Spot A Install Silencer B at Spot B Install Silencer C at Spot C Install Silencer D at Spot D
_2746.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Install Silencer A at Silencer Spot A%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Install Silencer B at Silencer Spot B%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Install Silencer C at Silencer Spot C%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Install Silencer D at Silencer Spot C%qe %cc4/%mc4

_2747.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2747.Description:
Oh! Sora! Boarmon goes back after they hear those noise of cans~ It works~!!
It is so surprising that we don't have to fight with Boarmon!
_2747.CompletionSummary: Right? If we met them in Digital World, we didn't have to fight with them at all and could get along with each other… Couldn't it be so good if we don’t fight and get along each other?

_2748.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2748.Description:
Careful, Mina! These guys charge at their target once they lock on! It seems like they’ve already marked us, so we’ve got no choice but to fight!
Don’t worry, I’ll protect you, Mina!
_2748.CompletionSummary: Looks like we’ve barely managed to calm it down…?

_2749.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2749.Description:
Ugh! These guys! They start spitting fire! Careful, MiMi! Get behind me!
I think it's going to be difficult because it's fire attack but I will protect MiMi no matter what! Wait for a moment!

_2750.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2750.Description:
Ahh!! Boarmon is running wild around Tokyo Tower, smashing into everything!
The buildings and tower are taking serious damage! If this keeps up, the whole area will be a wreck!
How can they ram into steel and not even flinch? Boarmon doesn’t seem bothered at all, but the metal is getting crushed!

_2751.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2751.Description:
Boarmon has a headband made of Chrome Digizoid, a super-tough metal that only exists in the Digital World!
That’s why they can headbutt things without getting hurt! And that metal is so strong, even real-world steel can’t withstand it!
_2751.CompletionSummary: So that’s it, it’s a really dangerous Digimon, Boarmon!

_2752.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2752.Description:
Then, we should take their headbands away! Their power will be reduced if we take their headbands off! And there will be no more ramming into the builing or Tokyo Tower!
So~Shall we go get Boarmon's headband?
_2752.CompletionSummary: Oh~MiMi~! I've got an good idea!

_2753.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2753.Description:
What do you think if I put the headband on my gloves? Wouldn't it increase the power of my punch?
Also, protecting my fists? What do you think? Isn't it a good idea?
Shall we try?
_2753.CompletionSummary: Umm~ It makes my fists heavy but also feels something powerful~

_2754.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2754.Description:
Shall we test my modified gloves? Boarmon's head! My fist! Competing to see which one is stronger!
Let's go MiMi! I will show you my new feature!
_2754.CompletionSummary: It seems there's no difference…. Did we just do something meaningless?

_2755.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2755.Description: And the reason I don’t coat my gloves with Chrome Digizoid is because my fists are already strong enough as they are! Mwahaha!
_2755.CompletionSummary: Togemon… Stop fooling around and let’s go already~ We’ve still got a long way to go~

_2756.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2756.Description: Piyomon~!! It’s getting even hotter around here…! Something must be happening at Tokyo Tower! Piyomon, head over there and check out the situation! Mina, Palmon, and I will catch up with you!
_2756.CompletionSummary: Sora~ Sora~ I’ve found out what’s going on!

_2757.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2757.Description: Look, it’s Meramon! They’re trying to set fire to everything here, just like they did on File Island!
_2757.CompletionSummary: Calm down, Piyomon~ The Meramon over there haven’t done anything yet~

_2758.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2758.Description: Hey, you! Can we talk for a moment?
_2758.CompletionSummary: Meramon spoke to us first… What’s going on here?

_2759.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2759.Description: What’s going on, Meramon? Aren’t you one of Myotismon’s subordinates?
_2759.CompletionSummary: I only follow Lord DeadMeramon; I do not obey Myotismon. The reason I stopped you is that I have a favor to ask.

_2760.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2760.Description:
A long time ago, we Meramon used our flames for justice and peace. But now, under Myotismon’s control, we’ve been forced to use them for evil. I’ve tried to stop it, but my kin are like they’re in a frenzy, focused only on burning everything in sight.
Our flames should protect, not destroy! Please, I beg you… Help free my kin from this madness without harming them…

_2761.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2761.Description:
We’ll try calming Meramon with a soothing scent~ Like flowers or certain plant aromas to help them relax.
Let’s find something like scented candles!
I think I noticed a pleasant scent near Candlemon earlier~ Maybe we can get some candles from Candlemon?
_2761.CompletionSummary:
Mmm~ This subtle aroma scent~ It’s so nice~
Mimi~ You should smell it too~ It’s amazing~

_2762.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2762.Description:
Some Meramons might not like this aroma scent~ Let's find lavendar candle this time~
That reminds me that there was also lavendar scent around Candlemons~
_2762.CompletionSummary: hmm~ this lavendar scent~ How is it? MiMi? Don't you feel comfortable when you smell this scent?

_2763.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2763.Description:
Let's burn these candles and make Meramons smell them! It should work!
Aroma candles for Meramon Army Captain~ And Lavendar candles for Meramon Captain~
_2763.Objective: Deliver Aroma Scent to Meramon (Army Captain) Deliver Lavendar Scent to Meramon (Captain)
_2763.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver Aroma Scent to Meramon (Army Captain)%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Lavendar Scent to Meramon (Captain)%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2763.CompletionSummary: Oh! It looks like your fellows are calming down! Good job! Guys! And also want to say thank you!

_2764.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2764.Description:
Hmm… but it seems the leaders of these Meramon aren’t affected by the scent…
I’m sorry to ask, but there’s one more thing… I can’t bring myself to hurt my kin… Could you take care of the Meramon that the candles don’t work on?
_2764.CompletionText: Thank you...all of you… I will never forget this debt for the rest of my life...
_2764.CompletionSummary: 고맙다..너희들… 이 은혜는 평생 잊지 않도록 하겠다..

_2765.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2765.Description:
No need to thank us so much, Meramon!
If you use your flames only against evil, it’ll save the flowers and trees I love so much!
It’s a win-win for all of us, don’t you think, Mina?
_2765.CompletionText: It's reassuring to hear you say that...thank you… I'll be on my way now, taking my comrades with me… I hope you resolve things with Myotismon. Good luck.
_2765.CompletionSummary: "I just thank you for thinking like that…. I have to leave with my fellows now… Good luck on defeating Myotismon"

_2766.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2766.Description:
I feel hotter heat when we get closer to the buliding and it is because of that digimon…
Meramon…..you are burning as blast furnace! That heat kills all the flowers around there!
_2766.CompletionSummary: Ugh…it's too hot Feels like I'm going to dry to death

_2767.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2767.Description:
Meramons in File Island only use their flames to protect the island… The ones in here aren't like that… They try to burn everything!
We have to stop them! Let's kill them all and protect the area from fire!
_2767.CompletionSummary: Ugh~Hot~ I thought my fists are going to burn…!

_2768.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2768.Description:
What are you doing? You cactus!
You only cactus comes at the minions of the greatest Myotismon? You wish to become ash like other weeds around here!
_2768.CompletionSummary: What? Who burn who? I will make you regret what you said!

_2769.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2769.Description:
They must be very angry because we killed their fellows! It feels like it's gets hotter than before!
I think there's one that have more heat than any others! I think it can burn all of my hair but I have to stand against it and kill Meramon!
Let's kill Meramon first and run away from this heat!
_2769.CompletionSummary: Haha…you are persistent… You are standing against this heat….instead of being ash….

_2770.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2770.Description:
You pets of humans and weak humans! How dare you act up on us!
I'm really angry…I will show you the real flame… I will make to regret to stop us!
I will burn you completely so that even ash won't exist in this world!
_2770.CompletionSummary: You really think we aren't going to resist? I'm the cactus that survives in desert! Don't look down on me!

_2771.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2771.Description:
They can be more hotter that this…. It's hard to breathe now…
And water in my body left a little bit… I want to breathe fresh air and drink fresh water after kill these guys…
Let's go kill Meramon Captain! We have to end this!
_2771.CompletionSummary: Hahaha….I admit it you humans… Very persistent…. I will make you regret that you have those persistent life…. We will incinerate you with our overwhelming power!!

_2772.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2772.Description:
What!! They get so huge with becoming one! It's outrageous heat!!
It looks very strong!! But there's nothing I can do! There's nothing but we have to stop them!
If we let this one like this, the entire city is going to be burned!!!
_2772.Objective: Defeat 25 Meramon(Captain), then Meramon(Gigantic) appears Defeat Meramon(Gigantic)
_2772.CompletionSummary: …. Several parts of the area is burned…. But I think we stopped them well….. Good job! Guys~!

_2773.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2773.Description:
Big trouble! There are more Digimon up on the observatory!
I couldn’t get a good look, but they seem dangerous!
We need to head toward Tokyo Tower now!
_2773.CompletionSummary: We’re so exhausted... what should we do, Sora?

_2774.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2774.Description:
Let’s head up there! We’ll hold our ground as best as we can!
By now, everyone should be done with their searches in Shibuya. If we fight up there, they’ll spot us and come to help!
Let’s go, everyone!
_2774.Objective: Talk to Mimi at the Tokyo Tower Observation Deck
_2774.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Mimi at Tokyo Tower Observatory%qe %cc1/%mc1
_2774.CompletionSummary: Ahh~ It's hot~!! What is that? That Digimon is surrounded by blue flames...!!

_2775.Title: Shibuya
_2775.Description: Matt! What do we do now?
_2775.CompletionSummary: We'll walk through Shibuya streets to see if the Digivice reacts, Piyomon. If the Digivice reacts, it means the eighth chosen child is nearby.

_2776.Title: Shibuya
_2776.Description: Matt~! Let’s find the eighth Chosen Child! Keep an eye on the Digivice for any reactions!
_2776.CompletionSummary: Shall we start checking from here? Matt?

_2777.Title: Shibuya
_2777.Description: Huh? Who’s that running toward us? Is that… a human? Wait, it doesn’t look like one…

_2778.Title: Shibuya
_2778.Description: Pumpmon and Gotsumon! They must be Myotismon’s henchmen! Be careful, Matt!

_2779.Title: Shibuya
_2779.Description: Hey, do we look like we’re working right now? Playing is what we do best! Why don’t you join us for some fun?

_2780.Title: Shibuya
_2780.Description: If you love playing so much, why are you working for Myotismon?

_2781.Title: Shibuya
_2781.Description: Myotismon is incredibly strong and merciless… If we disobey him, he’ll eliminate us without a second thought… We’re only under his command to survive, not because we want to be…

_2782.Title: Shibuya
_2782.Description:
Look, you guys! You want to find the eighth Chosen Child, right? You don’t want Myotismon to capture them.
We can help you with that! Let’s play a little game—messing with Myotismon!

_2783.Title: Shibuya
_2783.Description:
Hmm… You still don’t trust us, huh? Fine, we’ll prove we’re on your side. See that Vegiemon over there? He’s a sneaky, nasty piece of work.
Let’s take him down together!
_2783.CompletionSummary: How about this~? Can we trust them?

_2784.Title: Shibuya
_2784.Description: 뭐야…아직도 못 믿겠다는 눈초리는? 우리의 진심을 알아주지 못하는구나… 좋아, 좀 더 보여주지, 우리의 진심을!

_2785.Title: Shibuya
_2785.Description: Okay, right! We are going to trust you now, okay? Matt?
_2785.CompletionSummary: Yea, right, Gabumon. I think we can trust Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon now!

_2786.Title: Shibuya
_2786.Description:
Thank you for trusting us! Now let's go defeat Vegiemon Captain all together! Defeat Vegiemon, it's time to end this!!
Let's go! Guys!
_2786.CompletionSummary: HaHa~ We killed all Vegiemons~ We might disturb Myotismon's plan which is finding the 8th chosen child~

_2787.Title: Shibuya
_2787.Description: Did you know? That looking Vegiemon also can be used as medicine~~
_2787.CompletionSummary: What? Really? No way….. Don't you think so, Matt?

_2788.Title: Shibuya
_2788.Description:
Hey, you guys have been deceived all your life? How come you don't trust digimon's word….
If you don't trust me, get some Vegiemon's stems. I will show you their effects~! Hoot!
_2788.CompletionSummary: We collect them anyway…show me how you make it!

_2789.Title: Shibuya
_2789.Description: Hurry and make some medicine! I get hurt while getting Vegiemon…
_2789.CompletionSummary: Don't be hurry~friend~ I will make it quick!

_2790.Title: Shibuya
_2790.Description:
How is it? Isn't is working well?
This time, collect Vegiemon's Leaves! I will make other types of medicine~
I'm not going to tell you what kinds of medicine~ I will tell you when you get them~
_2790.CompletionText: Also this leaf~ You can find leaves from any Vegimon~
_2790.CompletionSummary: Here it is~ What kind of medicine are you going to make this time?

_2791.Title: Shibuya
_2791.Description: Matt~ I'm so excited what kinds of medicine Pumpkinmon is going to give me! The one before was very helpful~!
_2791.CompletionSummary: This one is an Energy Drink! Pumpkinmon's Energy Drink is perfect! You will get power when you take it!

_2792.Title: Shibuya
_2792.Description:
This time, I will cook with Vegiemon~!
I need some ingredients but get some salt water first! Can't there be some water in Vending Machine around here?
Doggymon might have some salt~ Because Doggymon likes to eat salty~
_2792.Objective: Collect Salt from Doggymons Get Water from Vending Machine Use Vending Machine
_2792.CompletionSummary: Good~ We get one of the ingredients~

_2793.Title: Shibuya
_2793.Description:
Guys~ Do you know that? Well grown up Vegiemon has fruit… Take Vegimons down and get fruits!
I will let you taste the greatest recipe!
_2793.CompletionSummary: Pumpmon! Here they are! Matt! I want to have this supper so bad!

_2794.Title: Shibuya
_2794.Description:
Alright, guys! The dish is ready!
It’s Veggie Fruit Brine! Take a bite, and you’ll feel like you’re in heaven!
_2794.CompletionSummary: Matt~ It's so delicious~ let's go catch more Vegiemon!

_2795.Title: Shibuya
_2795.Description:
Taking down Vegiemon to mess with Myotismon was a great success! Well done, friends!
Gotsumon and I had a blast! It felt so good to mess with Myotismon!
_2795.CompletionSummary: What are you guys thinking…? I just can’t understand… So, what’s the next plan?

_2796.Title: Shibuya
_2796.Description:
Of course! There’s more! Our next target is Soulmon!
They’re Phantommon’s subordinates, fiercely loyal to Myotismon. Taking them down will severely hinder Myotismon’s operations! Soulmon are like Myotismon’s hands and feet.
_2796.CompletionSummary: I see… Matt, what will you do? Will you trust them again this time?

_2797.Title: Shibuya
_2797.Description:
Don’t be like that, kiddo! We’re on your side, I swear! Didn’t we just help take down Vegiemon together?
Trust us! If we take down Soulmon, Myotismon’s plans will fall apart!
Let’s do it together! Come on!
_2797.CompletionSummary: Great~ Since we’ve defeated Soulmon, Myotismon has lost his hands and feet!

_2798.Title: Shibuya
_2798.Description:
Here’s a crucial piece of information, everyone!
Soulmon’s leader sometimes receives direct orders from Myotismon!
If we capture the leader, we can learn what Myotismon is planning! Let’s go, everyone!
_2798.CompletionSummary: Pumpmon! There seems to be some paper here!?

_2799.Title: Shibuya
_2799.Description:
Looks like there’s something written here, but I can’t read it…
Pumpmon, can you take a look? What does it say?
_2799.CompletionSummary: Hmm~ let’s see~ This is definitely an order! It says everyone should gather at Odaiba!

_2800.Title: Shibuya
_2800.Description:
Odaiba?!
That means our home is in danger! Matt, we need to get back home, now!
Our family is in danger!!
_2800.CompletionSummary: Hmm~ little friend… Sorry, but it seems we’re already a bit late. Myotismon has already settled in Odaiba…

_2801.Title: Shibuya
_2801.Description:
Myotismon is already settled down in Odaiba So just think Odaiba is taken by Myotismon~
So I think killing all minions of Myotismon first and then fighting with Myotismon alone in Odaiba is the best scenario~
So stop worrying and kill Soulmons~!
_2801.CompletionSummary: Nice job~guys~ We should reduce the number of minions of Myotismon So it is easier to fight with Myotismon~

_2802.Title: Shibuya
_2802.Description:
It’ll be alright, Matt and T.K. Don’t worry!
Your parents will be fine. If anything happens, Palmon and I will step up to take down Myotismon and protect your family.
You have my word, T.K.!
_2802.CompletionSummary: Yeah! Thanks! Gabumon! You’re a big help!

_2803.Title: Shibuya
_2803.Description: There’s a thing called Halloween in the real world, right? Where people dress up as ghosts and monsters to scare and prank each other? What a cool tradition! The real world is such a fascinating place!
_2803.CompletionSummary: Well… What are you going to do with that information?

_2804.Title: Shibuya
_2804.Description:
Why don't we all disguise like Soulmon? Soulmon looks like a ghost~ People will be sooooo surprised if we disguise like Soulmon~
Let's get Soulmon and collect their cloth~
_2804.CompletionSummary: Well, we give some food and medicine… We, digimons, are already enough to surprise them….

_2805.Title: Shibuya
_2805.Description:
Oh~let's try Soulmon's hat~ Witches or magicians wear those hats in Real World~
Definitely! We will look good on it~
Let's go~!
_2805.CompletionSummary: okay, we finally collect their cloth But we don't need to disguise….

_2806.Title: Shibuya
_2806.Description: Gotsumon~! Do you think this will scare them? Haha, I can’t wait! If we walk around with these sheets and hats on, we’ll look like ghosts!
_2806.CompletionSummary: Oh, come on! We don’t need to disguise ourselves! Especially you guys; you’re scary just by looking!

_2807.Title: Shibuya
_2807.Description: Tsk tsk tsk… You don’t get it, do you, Gabumon? When in Rome, do as the Romans do! If it’s a human festival, you’ve got to join in human-style! Heh heh~ What do you think, Gotsumon?
_2807.CompletionSummary: Fine, do whatever you want… Sigh...

_2808.Title: Shibuya
_2808.Description: How about this, guys? Fun, right? While Myotismon’s busy waiting for news that’ll never come from his base, we’re out here messing with him! It’s thrilling just to think about it!
_2808.CompletionSummary: I see… Thinking about Myotismon being flustered doesn’t feel too bad…

_2809.Title: Shibuya
_2809.Description:
Alright, alright~ This time, let’s target Roachmon! He’s a cockroach Digimon assigned to search Shibuya. He’s got to be scuttling around somewhere nearby.
Let’s go find Roachmon!

_2810.Title: Shibuya
_2810.Description:
Exactly, Gabumon~ Roachmon’s got six legs, so he’s super fast! He’s really helpful to Myotismon when it comes to finding things.
If we take him out, it’ll drastically slow Myotismon down in his search for the eighth Chosen Child!
Let’s get rid of Roachmon!
_2810.CompletionSummary: Pumpmon! We took care of it easily! It won’t be hard this time, will it?

_2811.Title: Shibuya
_2811.Description:
방심했구나, 파피몬! 로오치몬은 굉장히 끈질긴 녀석이라고! 쉽게 죽지 않는 것이 그 녀석의 챠밍 포인트라 할 수 있지!
아마 죽은 줄 알았던 녀석들, 대부분 아직 살아있을 거야~ 죽은 척하는 것이 그 녀석들의 특기라 할 수 있지…
다시 가서 확실하게 로오치몬을 해치워버리자!
_2811.CompletionSummary: 진짜 살아있었네… 하지만 이번엔 진짜! 확실히 해치운 것 같아, 펌프몬!

_2812.Title: Shibuya
_2812.Description:
그런 것 같네, 파피몬!
내가 하나 고급 정보를 알려주자면 로오치몬에게도 현실 세계의 해충약이 효과가 있다는 사실이지~
아까 울퉁몬과 시부야에서 놀면서 해충약을 파는 것을 확인했지!
거기서 해충약을 사서 로오치몬에게 써보자! 우선 해충약을 사와 봐~
_2812.CompletionSummary: 오~! 사 왔군! 이제 로오치몬에게 해충약을 뿌릴 일만 남았네~

_2813.Title: Shibuya
_2813.Description:
이제 로오치몬들에게 해충약을 뿌리러 가보자! 효과 만점일 거라고! 이제 로오치몬들에게 해충약을 뿌리러 가보자! 효과만점일 거라고! 로오치몬에게 1번! 로오치몬 행동대장에게 2번! 로오치몬 대장에게 2번!
이렇게 뿌려보자!
_2813.Objective: 로오치몬에게 해충약 뿌리기 로오치몬 행동대장에게 해충약 뿌리기 로오치몬대장에게 해충약 뿌리기
_2813.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1로오치몬에게 해충약 뿌리기%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2로오치몬 행동대장에게 해충약 뿌리기%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3로오치몬 대장에게 해충약 뿌리기%qe %cc3/%mc3

_2814.Title: Shibuya
_2814.Description:
지금인 것 같아! 파피몬! 저 징그러운 바퀴벌레들을 어서 해치우자!
더 이상 눈뜨고 못 봐주겠어!!
_2814.Objective: 로오치몬 처치 로오치몬 행동대장 처치 로오치몬 대장 처치
_2814.CompletionSummary: 휴~ 형~ 이제야 살 것 같아~ 나도 저 바퀴벌레 너무 징그러웠어…

_2815.Title: Shibuya
_2815.Description:
Matt, How could Roachmon can run so fast? I can run fast when I Digivolve, but I want to run faster….
Then, I must be more helpful to Matt…
_2815.CompletionSummary: I think I can resolve those curiosity!

_2816.Title: Shibuya
_2816.Description:
You must not see Roachmon because of your hatred…. But I checked right! You guys probably didn't know! But Roachmon wears shoes!
Those are definitely air shoes! They are comfortable and increase momentum because there are air soles!
Gabumon! You can run faster if you wear their shoes! Hoot!
Let's take Roachmon's shoes!
_2816.CompletionSummary: Pumpkinmon…Thanks for collection shoes….But….. First, it's not my size…and those were Roachmon's …I think I can't wear them….

_2817.Title: Shibuya
_2817.Description:
Matt…I have goose bumps when Roachmon wings fluttering…. It's disgusting…
I don't want to see Roachmon anymore! Roachmon have terrible appearance~!

_2818.Title: Shibuya
_2818.Description: Matt~! What can be the source of Roachmon's vital power? Don't you think we don't have to worry when we fight with Myotismon if we have the Roachmon's vital power?
_2818.CompletionSummary: Gabumon! I have the same curiosity as you!

_2819.Title: Shibuya
_2819.Description: Let's kill Roachmon once again! At the same time we should observe them! If we look closer, we can figure their source of life energy out!
_2819.CompletionSummary: Umm..maybe we can figure something out…

_2820.Title: Shibuya
_2820.Description:
I have thoroughly observed Roachmon And the reason of Roachmon's long life is from its antenna!
Usually people think the power of devil contains in devil's horn! So! Roachmon's vital power must be in their antenna!
Let's collect their antenna!
_2820.CompletionSummary: So this is the resource of Roachmon's vital power? But how this antenna works to transfer Roachmon's vital power to us?

_2821.Title: Shibuya
_2821.Description: I don’t know… What should we do? Do you have any ideas, Gabumon?
_2821.CompletionSummary: How would I know! Phew… this remains a mystery after all…

_2822.Title: Shibuya
_2822.Description:
Since we’ve dealt with Roachmon, next up is Dogmon… Dogmon has an incredibly good nose, making him excellent at tracking Digimon.
But there’s one problem…
_2822.CompletionSummary: There it is! The yellow dog Digimon!

_2823.Title: Shibuya
_2823.Description:
Yeah, Doggymon’s nose is super sharp. If we take him down, Myotismon will have a much harder time tracking the eighth Chosen Child.
But, uh… there’s still that one issue…

_2824.Title: Shibuya
_2824.Description: Doggymon’s super strong, right? But he doesn’t really look it… He just seems like a goofy, mischievous dog.
_2824.CompletionSummary: Actually… Dogmon is a best friend of mine and Monochromon… We became very close playing pranks on each other...

_2825.Title: Shibuya
_2825.Description:
Doggymon is a dog type digimon, so he is loayl to his master… So Doggymon is finding the 8th chosen child for Myotismon and I'm interupting him….
I don't want to hurt or kill Doggymon so I'm annoying Myotismon… So help Doggymon to get out of Myotismon by giving him some treats!
What do you think? Good? So let's find some treats that Doggymon would like!
_2825.Objective: Buy Delicious Pet Treat from Vending Machine<2nd in Shibuya>
_2825.CompletionSummary: Is this the treat that the dogs in Real World have? This? I'm not sure if Doggymon likes it!

_2826.Title: Shibuya
_2826.Description:
Okay! We bought the dog treat from Real World So let's give it to Doggymon!
Hope he likes it And turn to our side….
_2826.CompletionSummary: hum! It seems to have interest… Confusing though~

_2827.Title: Shibuya
_2827.Description:
Hey, you’re… Pumpmon? What are you doing here with these humans?
Don’t tell me, Pumpmon! You’ve betrayed Myotismon, haven’t you? I knew it! You were always grumbling about him, and now you’ve turned traitor!
But I, Doggymon, am loyal to Myotismon! I can’t walk the same path as you!

_2828.Title: Shibuya
_2828.Description:
We don’t have a choice… It’s heartbreaking and difficult, but we must take Doggymon down.
Myotismon is evil… If he’s allowed to continue, both the Digital and Real Worlds will be destroyed!
We can’t let that happen… Doggymon… must be stopped!
_2828.Objective: Defeat Dogmon, Defeat Dogmon(Army Captain), Defeat Dogmon(Observers)
_2828.CompletionSummary:
Dogmon! Please, just reconsider one more time!!
I don’t want to hurt your comrades...! I don’t want to do this either...!

_2829.Title: Shibuya
_2829.Description:
Pumpkinmon! I'm telling you once again that I'm a Myotismon's man! If you do this to me, I have no other ways too! I have to kill you if you keep interupt Myotismon's plan!
I'm going to get you! Woof!
_2829.Objective: Doggymon(Pumpkinmon's Friend) appears after defeating 25 Doggymon(Leader) Defeat Doggymon(Pumpkinmon's Friend)
_2829.CompletionSummary: S….sorry Doggymon…. I didn't want to let you go like this…. ….I'm really sorry….Doggymon….

_2830.Title: Shibuya
_2830.CompletionSummary: Cheer up…Pumpmon… It must be very painful for you…

_2831.Title: Shibuya
_2831.Description: What’s going on here? Pumpmon? Gotsumon?

_2832.Title: Shibuya
_2832.Description:
I was just about to take care of them, Myotismon! I’ll deliver their Crests and Digivices to you right away!
Prepare yourselves, humans!
_2832.CompletionSummary: What?! Suddenly their eyes changed…! What should we do?

_2833.Title: Shibuya
_2833.Description:
Darn it… Myotismon’s here… and with Pumpmon and Gotsumon, we’re outnumbered…
Matt! We have to run!
_2833.CompletionSummary: Grr… we're at a dead end…

_2834.Title: Shibuya
_2834.Description:
Matt… Pumpmon and Gotsumon look terrifying…
Pumpmon! Gotsumon! Aren’t we friends? Why are you doing this?

_2835.Title: Shibuya
_2835.Description: Playing is more fun than following Myotismon’s orders~
_2835.CompletionSummary: Fine, fine! Let’s just play together~ guys~!

_2836.Title: Shibuya
_2836.Description: Myotismon is coming! Quick, hide! Everyone!

_2837.Title: Shibuya
_2837.Description:
My… Myotismon! We almost captured the Chosen Children, but… they escaped…
I’ll catch them next time, I swear!
_2837.CompletionSummary: Did you think Myotismon would fall for such a lie? Creatures like you are no longer needed! Disappear!

_2838.Title: Shibuya
_2838.Description:
Sniff… Even though we didn’t know them for long, they were our friends! They were my friends, Gotsumon’s friends, and T.K.’s friends!
How could they kill our friends? I won’t forgive them!
_2838.CompletionSummary: Hah! Pathetic fools! Come at me! I’ll show you the difference between you and me!

_2839.Title: Shibuya
_2839.Description: That’s right! We’ll make them pay! Let’s go, Gotsumon! We’ll take down Myotismon and avenge Pumpmon and Gotsumon!
_2839.Objective: Move to Showdown! Myotismon! (Myotismon Summon Card)
_2839.CompletionSummary: Got it, Matt! Let’s take down Myotismon!

_2840.Title: Shibuya
_2840.Description: We’re going after Myotismon, Matt! We’ll avenge Pumpmon and Gotsumon!

_2841.Title: Shibuya
_2841.Description:
Heh heh heh… how pitiful… We’ll continue this fight another time…
It was dull, but mildly amusing…

_2842.Title: Shibuya
_2842.Description: Sob… Pumpmon… Gotsumon… Our time together was short, but I felt they were truly great Digimon friends…
_2842.CompletionSummary:
They were good guys… Don’t cry…T.K.…
Matt…

_2843.Title: Shibuya
_2843.Description:
Matt… Let’s go.
They wouldn’t want to see us moping around like this…

_2844.Title: Shibuya
_2844.Summary: Leaving Behind the Memories of Shibuya…
_2844.Description:
You’re right… Gotsumon, we can’t stay down forever… We’ll muster our strength…
And when we’re ready, we’ll make Myotismon pay for Pumpmon and Gotsumon!
Anyway, it seems like the eighth Chosen Child isn’t here…
And Myotismon hasn’t found them yet, either.
Let’s head to Odaiba.
That’s where everyone agreed to meet!
Let’s go, Gotsumon! T.K.!

_2845.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2845.Description:
The investigation in Shibuya should be done by now.
They will come and help us if we keep resisting at the observatory!
Let's go, guys!
_2845.CompletionSummary: Hmmm~ Shall we look for the 8th Chosen Child from here?

_2846.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2846.Description: Sora and Mina look like they’re in danger… Ugh!! It’s so hot!! Is it because of that Digimon?
_2846.CompletionSummary: So, this was the one who bent the Tokyo Tower!

_2847.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2847.Description: Grr…! It’s unbearably hot! If this Digimon keeps going, Tokyo Tower will melt down completely! We have to stop it before the tower takes any more damage! Let’s go, MetalGreymon!
_2847.Objective: (DeadMeramon Summon Card Issued) Defeat DeadMeramon (Summon Card Replacement)
_2847.CompletionSummary: Ugh~ What a tough opponent… Well done! MetalGreymon! Let's leave this place on Kabuterimon before more people gather!

_2848.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2848.Description: Sora and MiMi seem in danger…ugh! It's hot!!! Is this heat from that digimon?
_2848.CompletionSummary: That's the reason Tokyo Tower bent!

_2849.Title: Valley of Light
_2849.Description:
I tried to pretend as Bakemon with Bakemon's costume….
Well I tried to take this costume away from Bakemon but it tore….
I was going to stitch it… With needle, but I don't have thread…
I have a favor…. Can you get some thread for me?
_2849.Objective: Collect a Ball of Thread from Bakemons
_2849.CompletionText: You got some threads!! Thank you!! But…I'm not good at sewing…so I might ask you frequetly to get some threads….! I'm looking forward to your cooperation~(Wink*)

_2850.Title: Valley of Light
_2850.Description:
I think T.K. tries to help us with making clothes with Bakemon's Cloth…
Did you know that effort makes me proud of him?
So. I would like to give some help for T.K… Can you help me?
It's not a difficult one… Let's defeat Soulmon first and then take their cloth and hat to T.K....
Can I ask you this favor? I can do that....But It feels awkward to help T.K. like this... Please!!
_2850.Objective: Collect Soulmon's Cloth from Soulmons Collect Soulmon's Hat from Soulmons
_2850.CompletionText:
That's what Matt said? Thanks for delivering it~ But could you take my word to Matt that this amount isn't enough to sew the costume?
I'm not that good at sewing…..

_2851.Title: Valley of Light
_2851.Description:
It's such a good timing~!! I have a favor, and I want you to take it
I hold some trumps to defeat these tiresome ghost Digimons at a time, but I can't use it because it's running out of battery!
I'm trying to find the battery, but they took it and hide it somewhere in their body...
Can you get the battery by defeating those Bakemons and Soulmons?
If you take the battery, I can defeat all these ghost digimons!!
_2851.Objective: Collect Battery from Bakemons Collect Battery from Soulmons
_2851.CompletionText: Thanks! If I use up all these battery… Can I ask you again to collect some batteries?

_2852.Title: Valley of Light
_2852.Description:
Whaaaaaa~~~t is that~!!
You've just make it on time!
I'm so sure that I've defeated those rotten-red pineapple looking Red Vegiemon before?!?!?
But some of them must hide in grassland pretending as honey!
So~I have~a favor~ Can you defeat those Red Vegiemons~~?
I'm so sick of fighting with them! Please~do~me~a favor~~
_2852.Objective: Defeat RedVegiemon Defeat RedVegiemon(Army Captain) Defeat RedVegiemon(Captain)
_2852.CompletionText: Sigh*~ It feels better because I don't see RedVegiemons anymore~ If RedVegiemons hide and show up again~ Please defeat them again~(Wink~)

_2853.Title: Valley of Light
_2853.Description:
Ah! Good timing! I was working on analyzing data… I kept thinking..But…we need more data to figure out the result value…
If I have a bit of more data, I can draw the result…
Can you get some more data so that I can get the answer?
If you can, please get data of Wendigomon, Flymon, Devidramon.
You can collect those data when you defeat Wedigomon, Flymon. and Devidramon!
_2853.Objective: Collect Data from Wendigomon Collect Data from Flymon Collect Data from Devidramon
_2853.CompletionText:
Thank you! I will make this one count and do my best to find the answer..
But…If…I need more data…Can I ask you another favor?

_2854.Title: Valley of Light
_2854.Description:
I came to CVS because I'm hungry…but did you know that Myotismon's minions, Wendigomons, took all food in CVS?
So I'm really angry!!
So I have a favor…Can you teach a lesson to those digimons!
And take all those food back!! Especially!! Snacks and bread!!
Please I'm begging you~!!
_2854.Objective: Defeat Wendigomon Defeat Wendigomon(Army Captain) Collect Kebap from Wendigomons
_2854.CompletionText: Wow~Thanks~it looks yummy~~ But~ if~ I get hungry again, can I ask you one more time? (Wink~)

_2857.Title: Valley of Light
_2857.Description:
Ah! Good timing~! I have a favor to ask! I'm into Rock genre recently….
I need some awesome looking accessory in order to play rock music, but I don't have such things…
So….
Can you collect some Bakemon's teeth by defeating Bakemons around here?
If you do so, I can make a bracelet with those teeth~
Sorry, but please~
_2857.CompletionText: Thanks! I think I can make awesome accessory, thanks to you! If I need more, I will ask you once more~

_2858.Title: Shibuya
_2858.Description: If we let Raremon out of the city, it can destroy city massively! Let's defeat him!
_2858.CompletionText: It was hard… Nice work, Tentomon!

_2859.Title: Shibuya
_2859.Description:
Tentomon… Data that we just collected are damaged…
We can't analyze Black Gatomon because there's lack of data…
We have to collecct Black Gatomon's data again in order to find out Black Gatomon's information…
Let's cheer up and collect their data again!
_2859.Objective: Collect Black Gatomon's Data from Black Gatomons
_2859.CompletionText: Sigh*~ finally we finished collecting all~ I will check the data~ There's a possibility…that some data are damaged… There's nothing we can do, but collect them again~!

_2860.Title: Shibuya
_2860.Description:
Taichi…
I've been feeling some glancing around us…
Hmmm~~~
They are Bastemon that we've fought before! I think they are trying to revenge!
We can't be defeated by them!!
Let's defeat them again!
_2860.Objective: Defeat Bastemon Defeat Bastemon(Army Captain) Defeat Bastemon(Captain)
_2860.CompletionText: You just tought them a lesson, so they won't try to fight with us again, right? If they try to fight again! I will teach them another lesson!

_2861.Title: Shibuya
_2861.Description:
Taichi~ I finallly found a gift to give your sister when we visit her hospital!
It's a decoration made by cats' tail! I've been looking Bastemon's tail very carefully…
It seems like it will be a good material to make decoration!
Let's defeat Bastemons and collect their tails!
_2861.CompletionText:
We have Bastemon's tails now~ But Taichi~ Why don't we eat these tails instead of making decorations? I heard there's an eel in Real World and it is good for your health…
Shall we collect more Bastemon's tails?

_2862.Title: Shibuya
_2862.Description:
Taichi… I've been feeling some glancing around us….
I heard some growling sound too… Is it just my feeling? Hmm~
Ah! There's Sangloupmons that we've fought before!
They are grinding their teeth and claws to revenge us…
I can't lose the one I fought before!
Let's defeat Sangloupmons once more!
_2862.Objective: Defeat Sangloupmon Defeat Sangloupmon(Army Captain) Defeat Sangloupmon(Captain)
_2862.CompletionText: I've tought them a less, so they won't try to fight with us again, right? If they try to fight again, I will give them another lesson!!

_2863.Title: Shibuya
_2863.Description:
!!!! I'm sure we already defeated you….
You are trying to fight again…
You are a king that never collapse and lose…
You are awesome….
But! I can't lose because you are a king! Let's go! Agumon! Let's fight with this Sangloupmon(King) with our best effort!
_2863.Objective: Sangloupmon(King of the Wolves) emerges when you Defeat 20 Sangloupmon(Captain) Defeat Sangloupmon(King of the Wolves)
_2863.CompletionText: Sangloupmon!! It was amazing win! If you try to fight again, I will do my best to win again!!

_2864.Title: Shibuya
_2864.Description:
Taichi~
Actually…I have a distant relation and he likes to collect sword
Unlike me, he fights with a sword!
His birthday is coming and I'd like to give him a sowrd as a gift!
That Musyamon's sword, it looks very nice…
I want to give it to him as a gift!
Let's take the sword away from Musyamon!
_2864.CompletionText:
Hmm…This one is brokend… Hmm… The handle of this sword is not stable….
I will take a look more thoroughly, Taichi! I will collect more if there are better swords!

_2865.Title: Shibuya
_2865.Description:
Taichi…
I really want that Musyamon's helmet and armor~ Taichi, don't you feel the same?
Like..you want to wear helmet and armor when I see it? I have that kind of idea~
Taichi~ I want to try Musyamon's helmet and armor~
I want to take them away from Musyamon~
Let's go get a helmet and armor from Musyamon
_2865.Objective: Collect Musyamon's Helmet from Musyamons Collect Musyamon's Armor from Musyamons
_2865.CompletionText: I'll try it~ Ugh…I don't think it fits me… I'm going to defeat Musyamons until I find the right size!

_2866.Title: Shibuya
_2866.Description:
What! We've already defeated you….
You are trying to fight again… You have no intention of giving up…. So this is what true warrior is…
It's so awesome….
But I can't lose because you are awesome!
Come and fight me! Musyamon! I will fight you with all my effort!
_2866.Objective: Musyamon (True Warrior) Emerges when you Defeat 20 Musyamon(Captain) Defeat Musyamon(True Warrior)
_2866.CompletionText: Musyamon!! It was amazing win! If you try to fight again, I will do my best to win again!!

_2868.Title: Shibuya
_2868.Description:
Pumpkinmon~ The food you've cooked with Vegiemon's fruit last time was so delicious!
So, I want to have it again. Would you make it once more if I get the ingredients?
I really want to eat it again~!
I will get fruits from Vegiemons this time too~! please? Can you cook it for me once~~~more?
_2868.CompletionText: I collected all fruits~ I'll give it to Pumpkinmon now~ I'm so happy that I can have that food again~ I feel so exicted~

_2869.Title: Shibuya
_2869.Description:
Gosh! Soumons…They tear the Myotismon's order for hiding the information from us…
Well..We can't do anything about it~!! Let's take back the Myotismon's Order by defeating Soulmons!
If we collect all the torn parts and put them together, we can know about the Myotismon's order~
Let's defeat Soulmons and collect the Myotismon's order!
Everybody, Cheer up~
_2869.Objective: Collect Torn Myotismon's Order from Soulmons
_2869.CompletionText:
Hmm…I think I collected enough. I have to try these ones first and look for more if I need more~
Should I try it?

_2870.Title: Shibuya
_2870.Description:
(Yelling) C….ock..roach!!!!!!! It's so disgusting~ These Roachmons never die?
We've defeated them before, right? They come out again!! Their lookings are so disgusting!
Please defeat them ASAP!!!
_2870.Objective: Defeat Roachmon Defeat Roachmon(Army Captain) Defeat Roachmon(Captain)
_2870.CompletionText: Thanks~ I feel much better~ But can you help me out once again if they come again? Cockroaches…I really…hate them~

_2871.Title: Shibuya
_2871.Description:
I think I have to try Roachmon's shoes at least once…
It looks really nasty…. But it seems I can run fast if I wear their shoes….
Their shoes might not fit my feet, but it's possible that they have big feet Roachmon!
So, let's defeat Roachmons and get their shoes!
I really hope to get the right one~
_2871.CompletionText:
These shoes are small…these ones are too…. These ones….these…..
No…they must be here!! There must be shoes that fit my feet….!!!
If there's not…I will look for it again!

_2872.Title: Shibuya
_2872.Description:
Wait! Where is the pesticide?
The one I prepared for Roachmon is gone!
Roachmons must be done this!
They took it before I spray to them!
Please!
Please take back the pesticide from Roachmons!
I will anxious without that pesticide~ Please~I'm begging you~!
_2872.CompletionText: Thanks! I can fall asleep without worrying now!!! If Roachmon steals my pesticide again, I will ask you to take it back again!

_2873.Title: Shibuya
_2873.Description:
Doggymons…they must like the treat we've given to them before…
Well I heard they took all the treat in Shibuya…
There must be no crime in Shibuya, my beloved city!
Let's defeat Doggymon and take them back!
_2873.CompletionText:
Hmm~ Don't you think the amount they stole and we've collected are different? They ate them already?
Let's search a bit more and if we don't find them all, we have to take a look on Doggymons again…

_2874.Title: Shibuya
_2874.Description:
Doggymon…Do you really have to loyal to Myotismon?
Are you really trying to keep fighting with that hurt body because of Myotismon?
Is this your way?
If so, I will be the one who blocks your way!
Come one! Doggymon! I will fight with you!
_2874.Objective: Doggymon(Pumpkinmon's Friend) appears after defeating 25 Doggymon(Leader) Defeat Doggymon(Pumpkinmon's Friend)
_2874.CompletionText: Doggymon…It hurts me to hurt you like this… But there's nothing I can do…it's for peace of world…. If you attack us like this again, I have to fight with you and defeat you!

_2876.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2876.Description:
MiMi! DemiMeramons are still waiting for burning the area!
If they burn here again, the damage will be so massive!
Let's defeat DemiMeramon and prevent the situation!
_2876.CompletionText:
Ugh~ I feel relieved~ Because there's no fire!
It's possible that DemiMeramon might come again So we have to look around carefully!

_2877.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2877.Summary: [Daily] Many a Mickle Makes a Muckle
_2877.Description:
Gosh! DemiMeramons must be really angry!
They gather together and get bigger!
If that sized digimon burns this area, everything is going to become ashes!
Let's defeat that digimon!!!
_2877.Objective: DemiMeramon (Gigantic) Emerges after defeating 25 DemiMeramon(Army Captain) Defeat DemiMermon(Gigantic)
_2877.CompletionText: Fine~ We succeeded blocking DemiMeramon~ We have to be careful not to face this situation again! If this thing happens again, we have to take care of it right away!

_2878.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2878.Description:
Well~ I always light up candles when I go to bed~
But I'm out of candles now~ But in a good timing~ I came up to the idea while helping Meramon!
I have to gather some candles by defeating Candlemons~
Let's get some candles by defeating Candlemons~
_2878.Objective: Collect Aroma Candle from Candlemons Collect Lavendar Candle from Candlemons
_2878.CompletionText: Good~I've collected all the candles I wanted I will collect again if I use them all~

_2879.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2879.Description:
MiMi~ we've failed to modify our gloves with Boarmon's head band~
So, This time, I would like to try with Boarmon's tusk~
What do you think?
So, let's defeat Boarmons and collect their tusks and modifying my gloves~
Let's go~ MiMi~ To defeat Boarmons and collect Boarmon's tusks~
_2879.CompletionText: Should I modify my gloves now? It's possible to damage some of tusks while modifying so let's collect more when I need more~

_2880.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2880.Description:
Look at the hair of Boarmon. What do you think? Isn't it awesome?
I bet it can make a fancy muffler or fur coat that can make me look elegant.
Let's collect their hair after defeating them.
_2880.Objective: Collect Boarmon's Hair after defeating them

_2881.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2881.Description:
Sora~! Meramons are trying to burn around this area!
We have to hurry and block them~!
We must be hurry! Let's defeat Meramons and prevent the fire
_2881.Objective: Defeat Meramon Defeat Meramon(Army Captain) Defeat Meramon(Captain)
_2881.CompletionText: I feel much relieved that we've stopped Meramons just like we've done in File Island! Meramons are troublemakers so we have to keep our eyes on them!

_2882.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2882.Description:
We have to fight them and make them tired before they make a trouble~
First, we teach them a lesson and then steal Meramon's Flame~ Then, their power will get a bit weaker~
Let's go~ Sora~
Let's defeat Meramons and take Meramon's Flame~!
_2882.CompletionText: Okay~ Sora~ Now Meramons' power get a bit weaker~

_2883.Title: Tokyo Tower
_2883.Description:
Sora~ Meramon are the same as DemiMeramon! They gather together and get bigger!
If they make a trouble like that, the entire Tokyo Tower will be burned!
Let's defeat Meramon!
_2883.CompletionText: Really~ we did a good job~ we blocked very big Meramon~ I hope this thing won't happen again…but if this happens again, we have to take care of it!

_2884.Title: Shibuya
_2884.Description: T.K… be safe on your way back home.
_2884.CompletionText: Don't go anywhere else and go straight home, T.K.
_2884.CompletionSummary: All right, T.K. Be safe on your way. And make a call when you arrive!
_2884.ReservedText: Ok, Matt. You go safely too~!

_2885.Title: Shibuya
_2885.Description: Ah… I'm so tired. Shall we return home now?
_2885.CompletionText: I'd just take a bath and go to bed.
_2885.CompletionSummary: Hmm… Now we shall investigate this area.

_2886.Title: Minato City
_2886.Description: It's so peaceful here... There's no way the eighth Digidestined child would be in a place like this…
_2886.CompletionText: Where on earth is the 8th Digidestined child?

_2887.Title: Minato City
_2887.Description: Something feels... suspicious. How do they know who we are? It's just too suspicious…

_2888.Title: Minato City
_2888.Description: Hmm~ They've left~ Too bad... They seemed like they could've been great friends for Agumon…
_2888.CompletionSummary: This is too strange... How could they recognize the existence of our Digimon? We need to observe a bit more...

_2889.Title: Minato City
_2889.Description: I have a feeling that child might be the eighth Digidestined... But... why don't I want to attack them...? Why is that?
_2889.ReservedText: So, you were here... Why do you think that way?

_2890.Title: Minato City
_2890.Description: No matter how I think about it, that child is too suspicious... Wizardmon, I'll keep an eye on that child. You go and search the area for any other humans who might be the eighth. Got it?
_2890.ReservedText: Understood. I will follow your orders accordingly…

_2891.Title: Minato City
_2891.CompletionText: Let’s start by checking the Odaiba beach up ahead…

_2892.Title: Minato City
_2892.Description: The Crest of Light is glowing, which means the eighth child must be nearby... I need to confirm it…
_2892.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Oh no... The Shakomon have found the eighth Digidestined's Digivice first...
_2892.ReservedText: Hehehe… Hey, guys! Look at this! A Digivice~! That cat was holding it~! If we take this Digivice to Lord Myotismon, he’ll be pleased with us, hehe~!

_2893.Title: Minato City
_2893.Description: No choice... We'll have to deal with the Syakomon and take their Digivice... Let's get rid of the Syakomon...!
_2893.CompletionSummary: Oh no... Who has the Digivice?

_2894.Title: Minato City
_2894.Description: What are you doing, Wizardmon? Why are you attacking us? Are you betraying Lord Myotismon?
_2894.CompletionSummary: I have never followed Myotismon… I only follow Gatomon...

_2895.Title: Minato City
_2895.Description: 샤코몬…너희들에겐 악감정은 없어…다만…가트몬의 방해물이 될 것 같거든… 미안하지만 사라져 줘야겠어…
_2895.CompletionSummary: 그보다…도대체 8번째 선택받은 아이의 디지바이스는 누가 갖고 있는 거야?

_2896.Title: Minato City
_2896.Description: Kehehe… Did you think we'd give up so easily, traitor? We'll hold out until reinforcements arrive, then teach you a lesson! After that, we’ll take you to Lord Myotismon!! Now, you!!! Kehehehe~
_2896.Objective: Talk to Wizardmon to obtain the Chosen Child's Digivice
_2896.CompletionSummary: Hmm... These Shakomon... All they do is waste their strength… So this is the eighth Digidestined's Digivice… I'll give this to Gatomon… But before that... Myotismon's minions could come here after that battle... We'd better leave quickly.
_2896.ReservedText: What do you think you’re going to do, Shakomon… You’d better return it quietly if you don’t want to see things get ugly… I’ll wipe you all out…

_2897.Title: Minato City
_2897.Description: Capture that traitor!! Hurry, before they escape!!
_2897.Objective: Talk to Wizardmon Move to Odaiba Beach Plaza
_2897.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Wizardmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Odaiba Beach Plaza%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2897.CompletionSummary: Darn!! We avoided Shakomon only to encounter Gesomon… This has gotten annoying...
_2897.ReservedText: Damn… I thought I’d dealt with them all… I’ll have to escape to the other side…

_2898.Title: Minato City
_2898.Description: 이런…둘려싸여 버렸군… 할 수 없지…실력 행사를 해야겠네… 우선 약한 녀석부터 처리하자
_2898.CompletionText: 하나하나 해결해 나가면 이 위기를 벗어날 수 있을거야…

_2899.Title: Minato City
_2899.Description: It’s Gesomon... If we get caught by them, we’re in danger. Be careful... Let’s deal with Gesomon quickly and return to Gatomon...!
_2899.CompletionSummary: It seems we've taken care of everything...and no pursuers in sight. Shall we head back?

_2900.Title: Minato City
_2900.Description: Oh no... The Gesomon are coming... Did they hear about what happened to their comrade? They’re faster than I thought...
_2900.CompletionSummary: Hmm... It seems so, my squid friend... Let me turn you into squid cuisine with the arrogant lightning magic of this third-rate wizard...!
_2900.ReservedText: Ah, it’s that wizard who was always trailing after Gatomon… I heard he attacked Shakomon and one of our allies… As expected of someone brought in by Gatomon, always doing the most insolent things…

_2901.Title: Minato City
_2901.Description: 그러고보니…연체몬의 다리로 만든 요리는 체력 회복에 좋다는 얘기를 들었던 것 같아… 앞으로 힘든 여정이 될 것 같으니 연체몬의 다리를 미리미리 모아두는 게 좋을 것 같군… 연체몬들을 해치워서 연체몬의 다리를 모으도록 하자…!
_2901.CompletionText: 가트몬이 오징어로 만든 요리를 좋아해야 할텐데…
_2901.CompletionSummary: 연체몬의 다리가 통통하니 맛있어 보이는군…벌써부터 군침이 돌아… 그나저나…가트몬이 오징어 요리를 좋아해야 한텐데 말이야…

_2902.Title: Minato City
_2902.Description: 아~맞다…바보같이 그것을 깜빡해버렸군… 연체몬의 머리로 만든 요리는 피로 회복에 탁월하다고 들었는데… 연체몬의 다리를 구할 때 같이 구했어야 하는데…깜빡하다니… 연체몬들을 해치워서 연체몬의 머리도 모아야겠어…! 가트몬이 8번째 선택받은 아이를 찾느라 많이 피곤할테니 말이야…
_2902.CompletionSummary:
흠…보기에는 맛도 없어 보이고 그렇긴 한데… 몸에는 좋으니, 가트몬에게 적극적으로 권유를 해야겠어…
가트몬에게 돌아가면서 오징어 요리법을 좀 찾아봐야 겠군…

_2903.Title: Minato City
