_2903.Description: Wizardmon you traitor! Not only you've turn your back on Myotismon, you've attacking our group. You must be mad! Out of mind! The rage of our defeated souls are big enough to take your soul in return, so don't expect to run back to Digital World alive!
_2903.Objective: Gesomon(White Demon of Abyss) Emerges When You Defeat 20 Gesomon(Captain) Defeat Gesomon(White Demon of Abyss)
_2903.CompletionText: Wizardmon you fool! You're in big trouble now!!
_2903.CompletionSummary: Being so tenacious huh, Gesomon? I do feel a bit of remorse, but it can't be turned back. Because this is for Gatomon.

_2904.Title: Minato City
_2904.Description: Hmm… Based on what’s happened so far, it seems like most of Myotismon’s forces have gathered here… Before long, news will spread that I’ve taken down Myotismon’s minions… If I return to Gatomon now, she’ll be suspected too… So, I’ll have to eliminate all of Myotismon’s minions in this area before going back to ensure Gatomon’s safety…
_2904.CompletionText: I can’t let Gatomon get hurt…
_2904.CompletionSummary: First, let's head toward the park...

_2905.Title: Minato City
_2905.Description: First, let’s head to the eerie beach park… There must be some of Myotismon’s minions there…
_2905.CompletionSummary:
Hmm... Strange… Is there really no one here?
Urgh...! No way...!!??

_2906.Title: Minato City
_2906.Description: Welcome, Wizardmon~ Is this your first time experiencing an ambush like this?? We figured you’d come here after defeating Gesomon~ As expected of you~
_2906.CompletionText: Heheh~ Look at that panicked face~ Hehe
_2906.CompletionSummary: Darn... We've been surrounded… To think they were capable of devising a plan like this...!

_2907.Title: Minato City
_2907.Description: Impressive, Flybeemon… Coming up with a strategy like this…
_2907.CompletionSummary: Oh no... Have we been found out?
_2907.ReservedText: You underestimated us, Wizarmon! You arrogant fool!! You’ll regret looking down on us…

_2908.Title: Minato City
_2908.Description: Earlier, we managed to escape by defeating the relatively weaker Shellmon… But now, they’re all Flybeemon… How are we going to get out of this… Hmm…
_2908.CompletionText: Stay calm… Wizardmon… There must be a way to get out of this situation…!

_2909.Title: Minato City
_2909.Description: There should be weak ones along with the tough ones among them. We can start with eliminating the weak ones fast and reduce their number. What do you say?
_2909.CompletionText: I'm sure there's something we can do to get out of this risk!
_2909.CompletionSummary: It was harsh, but I see their numbers have been reduced…

_2910.Title: Minato City
_2910.Description: This guy… Wizardmon…! You’re putting up quite a fight…! How dare you attack our comrades!!
_2910.CompletionSummary: Sorry, Flybeemon… But for Gatomon, I will do whatever it takes...! So be prepared!

_2911.Title: Minato City
_2911.Description: 플라이비몬의 수도 어느 정도 줄었고, 녀석들도 지금 머리에 열로 가득해져, 이성을 잃어서 정상적인 판단을 못 하고 있는 지금이 기회로군… 플라이비몬(행동 대장)과 플라이비몬(대장)을 쓰러뜨리고 이 지역을 벗어나자…!
_2911.Objective: 플라이비몬 행동대장 처치 플라이비몬 대장 처치
_2911.CompletionSummary: 후~~~힘들다….힘들어…. 그래도 플라이비몬들을 많이 해치운 것 같군…

_2912.Title: Minato City
_2912.Description: Phew… I’ve scouted this area enough and reduced the number of Myotismon’s minions… Time to return to Gatomon. Huh...? Something feels off. Wait!! Where’s the Digivice??
_2912.CompletionText: I can’t believe I made such a mistake…
_2912.CompletionSummary: Ugh... I've been outsmarted.... I never thought they'd target the Digivice… I can't keep up with their tricks...
_2912.ReservedText: Hahaha~ Serves you right, Wizarmon~ We’ve got the Digivice you’re looking for~~ hahaha~ Did you enjoy taking down our comrades?? But what’s truly important is this Digivice~ hahaha!!!

_2913.Title: Minato City
_2913.Description: I thought we dealt with them all... but I guess not… Did I let my guard down...? I can’t let the Digivice reach Myotismon...! We need to recover it here...!
_2913.Objective: Defeat Flybeemon, Flybeemon(Army Captain), Flybeemon(Captain), obtain Chosen Child's Digivice
_2913.CompletionSummary: Phew~ Finally found it... That's a relief… Now, all that's left is to get it to Gatomon...

_2914.Title: Minato City
_2914.Description:
We’ve recovered the Digivice, and it seems there are no more of Myotismon’s minions or the eighth Digidestined child in this area… I think it’s time to return to Gatomon…
But this forest feels incredibly suspicious… There might be something in here that could harm Gatomon… I need to check it out…
_2914.Objective: Explore the Suspicious Forest Head to the Suspicious Forest and encounter the mysterious Digimon
_2914.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Explore the Suspicious Forest%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Encounter the Mysterious Digimon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2914.ReservedText: What are you doing here…? Wizardmon…?

_2915.Title: Minato City
_2915.Description: Oh...no...? You... you're...? Witchmon...? Why are you here...?
_2915.CompletionText: I’ve run into the one I least wanted to meet…
_2915.ReservedText: You’re only saying what you want to say… Wizardmon… I should be the one asking... What are you doing here? Wizardmon?

_2916.Title: Minato City
_2916.Description: Never mind that... Witchmon! Have you also joined Myotismon's subordinates?
_2916.CompletionSummary: I’ve never followed Myotismon, Witchmon… I only listened to Gatomon, who saved my life… Witchmon...if you came under Myotismon following me… Why not start following Gatomon instead from now on?
_2916.ReservedText: Yeah, Wizardmon… After hearing that you had joined Myotismon, I followed you and became one of Myotismon’s subordinates too… But… I saw everything, Wizardmon… I saw you defeating Myotismon’s subordinates, my comrades… Did you betray Myotismon? Wizardmon??

_2917.Title: Minato City
_2917.Description: What are you talking about? Wizardmon?? The reason I joined Lord Myotismon as a subordinate is to rise as a grand sorcerer… I need Lord Myotismon's power for that. But to work under Gatomon? That's so absurd it makes me laugh~! I thought you also became a subordinate to become a grand sorcerer… I was wrong about you... Wizardmon...
_2917.CompletionText: I thought you dreamed of becoming a great wizard like me…
_2917.CompletionSummary: In the past, I would have done anything, no matter the cost, to become a great wizard… But now, it’s different... Now, I live for Gatomon, my savior… My life belongs to Gatomon now… If...Witchmon...you ever get in Gatomon’s way… I’ll have no choice but to consider you an enemy.

_2918.Title: Minato City
_2918.Description: Is that so?? Then there's no choice but to fight you...But... even if you're Wizardmon… Do you think you can take on all of us Witchmon alone?? Don’t take it personally… I know how strong you are…
_2918.CompletionSummary: Phew~~.... Is this all you've got, Witchmon?? Was this weak attempt really meant to stop me?? (Huff... Huff... As expected, Witchmon is a formidable opponent...)

_2919.Title: Minato City
_2919.Description: 역시…위자몬…어느 정도 반항은 할 줄 알았는데…이 정도일 줄이야… 하지만 아직 끝난 건 아니야!! 위자몬!! 너를 위해 준비한 게 아직 많다구~! 방금 너가 쓰러뜨린 동료들 보다 더 강한 위치몬(행동대장)과 위치몬(대장)이 너를 기다리고 있으니 말이야!!
_2919.Objective: 위치몬 행동대장 처치 위치몬 대장 처치
_2919.CompletionSummary: 아쉽게 됐네…위치몬… 난 아직 이렇게 멀쩡한데 말이야… (후…온몸이 너덜너덜 해졌군…)

_2920.Title: Minato City
_2920.Description: Well, why don't we put an end to this meaningless quarrel, Witchmon? You should have realized that you can never stop me. I don't want to make more casualties. And I'm sure you don't want that either.
_2920.CompletionSummary: If you're so persistant to fight, I have no other choices than to defeat you.
_2920.ReservedText: What do you know about me, Wizardmon? I'm not weak-minded like you and I'm not a traitor! I'm going to be the greatest mage and it isn't going to be changed! I've grown ever since we've last met. Wizardmon, you'll be beneath me in no time!

_2921.Title: Minato City
_2921.Description: If you don't change your mind, I'm sure you'll become a threat to Gatomon. Then I must make up my mind and defeat you. Well, I still don't want to make you as an enemy though.
_2921.Objective: Witchmon(Wizardmon's Rival) Emerges When You Defeat 20 Witchmon(Captain) Defeat Witchmon(Wizardmon's Rival)
_2921.CompletionSummary: Must you have made this choice, Witchmon?

_2922.Title: Minato City
_2922.Description: This isn't how I wanted it... but I've always wanted to settle things with you… I don't want to see you leading ahead of me anymore… Wizardmon... since you’ve defeated me, here’s a gift… I’ll give you information… Aside from the ones you've defeated, there are three more of Myotismon's subordinates in this place... And Myotismon is currently on his way here… Lastly... as you probably know... the true Pendant of the Crest of Light is in Myotismon’s possession... I've told you everything I know... Good luck from here on out...
_2922.CompletionSummary: Thank you for everything... Witchmon... Next time we meet, I hope we can get along better... and have fun... Go ahead first... Witchmon... I'll follow soon...

_2923.Title: Minato City
_2923.Description: I've obtained the Digivice of the eighth Chosen Child… And gained valuable information about Myotismon from Witchmon… Now I can head back to Gatomon with great news... Shall we hurry?
_2923.ReservedText: Hey~~ Wizardmon~~~ What are you doing here??

_2924.Title: Minato City
_2924.Description: With that pesky PicoDevimon gone… It’s time to find Gatomon… Seeing PicoDevimon here means we need to move faster...
_2924.CompletionSummary: Were you here, Gatomon...? Are you that concerned about that girl...?

_2925.Title: Minato City
_2925.Description: Wizardmon, huh? What's the status? Have you found the eighth?
_2925.CompletionSummary: No... I haven't found the eighth Digidestined yet... But...

_2926.Title: Minato City
_2926.Description: Gatomon… here… is the Digivice of the eighth Chosen Child.
_2926.CompletionSummary: Gatomon... Take this Digivice to that girl... I think... You might find the one you've been longing to know...

_2927.Title: Minato City
_2927.Description: Understood, Wizardmon… As you said, I’ll meet that girl...
_2927.CompletionSummary: Ah, you're... from before?? You're back~ As expected, you're Agumon's friend, right?

_2928.Title: Minato City
_2928.Description: That doesn’t matter right now… Place your hand on this device.

_2929.Title: Minato City
_2929.Description: From now on, you will hold onto Hikari’s Digivice… Take this…!

_2930.Title: Minato City
_2930.Description: Why are you giving Hikari's Digivice to Tai?!
_2930.CompletionSummary: Ah... got it... Then I'll hold onto Hikari's Digivice... But... what should we do next??
_2930.ReservedText: If Myotismon finds out that Hikari is the 8th DigiDestined and that Gatomon is her partner Digimon, their lives will be in danger… If you keep this, both Hikari and Gatomon will be safe…

_2931.Title: Minato City
_2931.Summary: The True Crest of Light Pendant
_2931.Description: We need Hikari's Crest… The true Crest...
_2931.CompletionSummary: You knew, didn't you? The real Pendant of the Crest of Light is with Myotismon! We have to get it back!
_2931.ReservedText: That’s right… Myotismon’s subordinates had the copied Pendant of Light Crest…

_2932.Title: Minato City
_2932.Description: Gatomon and I are heading to Myotismon’s lair to find the true Pendant of the Crest of Light… You all stay here…!
_2932.CompletionSummary: No, it's too dangerous! Wizarmon and I will go alone! You stay here! Hikari, don't worry~ I'll make sure to return to your side safely~!!

_2933.Title: Minato City
_2933.Description: The true Pendant of the Crest of Light is hidden somewhere in Myotismon’s room…! So we must get to his lair as quickly as possible! Let’s hurry, Wizardmon!!
_2933.CompletionSummary: Gatomon... Something seems off... The information I received seems quite different...

_2934.Title: Minato City
_2934.Description: Information? What kind of information? Who told you this?
_2934.Objective: Talk to Wizardmon at Odaiba Beach Plaza
_2934.CompletionSummary: No, Wizarmon... your information is 100% reliable... Even though we can't see them, my instincts and nose are telling me... There are many Digimon around, and they seem to be targeting us...
_2934.ReservedText: There’s information that Myotismon’s subordinates are in this area. It’s information we got from Witchmon… But the information doesn’t match the current situation… She’s not the type to lie, though…

_2935.Title: Minato City
_2935.Description: Oh my… You traitors have sharp senses… I thought I hid well… I was waiting for the perfect moment to strike... but you found me...
_2935.CompletionSummary: The fishy smell is just too much... I couldn't ignore it~

_2936.Title: Minato City
_2936.Description: Wizardmon! We don’t have time to waste here! Let’s defeat these Swimmon and head to the lair! First, we’ll take down these sentinels!
_2936.Objective: Defeat Swimmon, Defeat Swimmon(Army Captain), Defeat Swimmon(Observers)
_2936.CompletionSummary: If these kinds of Digimon are guarding this place, we should be able to reach the hideout soon...!

_2937.Title: Minato City
_2937.Description: 그럴 것 같네, 위자몬.. 그런데 아직 방심할 때는 아닌 것 같아! 계속해서 스윔몬들이 오고 있어! 여기서 시간을 더 이상 뺏길 수 없으니 서둘러서 스윔몬들을 해치우자!
_2937.CompletionText: 위자몬의 번개 기술로 스윔몬을 구운다면…? 안 돼, 안 돼…이런 생각을 할 때가 아니야…
_2937.CompletionSummary: 가트몬…어느 정도 스윔몬들을 해치운 것 같군요…

_2938.Title: Minato City
_2938.Description: Gatomon… it seems we’ve missed something… These are sentries, meaning one of them must have the key to the lair…
_2938.CompletionSummary: I'll see if I can hypnotize Swimmon... And that Myotismon, being such a shady one, might have more than one lock... I'll investigate that as well.
_2938.ReservedText: That makes sense… I can’t believe I forgot something like this… I’ve been rushing so much that I overlooked the basics… By the way, Wizardmon, can you tell which of these Swimmon has the key?

_2939.Title: Minato City
_2939.Description:
Now, I'll try the hypnosis agasint Swimmon.
Hey, Swimmon… listen and answer to me carefully. First question, who has the key to Myotismon's Hideout? Second question, what else is needed to open the Hideout's locked door? Finally, where is Myotismon right now?
_2939.CompletionSummary: Gatomon, I've discovered everything we need. Apartment key can be found from Swimmon(Guard), and there are 3 keys in total.
_2939.ReservedText: The key… is held by one of the Swimmon guards… And to enter… Hideout… requires… total three… three keys… Myotismon… has left… to have… a proper meal…

_2940.Title: Minato City
_2940.Description: Well done, Wizardmon! Let's find Swimon(Guard) and claim the Hideout's Key!
_2940.Objective: Defeat Swimmon(Guard) and collect First Hideout's Key
_2940.CompletionSummary: Gatomon!! I've found the Hideout's key!!

_2941.Title: Minato City
_2941.Description: Well done! Wizardmon!! We’ve accomplished what we came for, now let’s move on! Wizardmon, as we move, make sure to keep an eye out for more sentries! We need to find the second lair key!
_2941.CompletionSummary: Gatomon...! It seems like there's someone ahead...!

_2942.Title: Minato City
_2942.Description: I’ve been waiting… You’re quite late, aren’t you…?
_2942.CompletionSummary:
Looks like it...
Hey, Tylomon... How did you know we were coming?
_2942.ReservedText: The second guard is a shark… Looks like a pretty strong one…

_2943.Title: Minato City
_2943.Description: That’s because… of your scent… Your smell… And I know you defeated our allies… I could sense the disappearance of the Digimon’s presence~
_2943.CompletionSummary: Myotismon must know... That we betrayed him...

_2944.Title: Minato City
_2944.Description: Well, do you think Myotismon is aware of your betrayal, or not? In fact, that isn't really the point. Because your miserable journey is going to end here, soon. Just give up your hopes and don't try to resist!
_2944.Objective: Defeat Tylomon, Defeat Tylomon(Army Captain), Defeat Tylomon(Captain)
_2944.CompletionSummary: It doesn't sound like a lie, Gatomon. I've managed to deal with the ones who approached. But it looks like we're going to spend more time here.

_2945.Title: Minato City
_2945.Description: 약한 소리하면 안 돼! 위자몬! 서둘러야 한다고!! 묘티스몬이 아지트에 없는 지금이 기회란 말이야!! 이곳에 있는 이 상어 녀석들을 해치우고 아지트로 가야한단 말이야!! 어느 정도 잔챙이 같은 녀석들들은 해치운 것 같으니까 나머지 성가신 티로몬(행동대장)과 티로몬(대장)들을 해치우고 여기를 벗어나자!
_2945.CompletionSummary: 거의 다 해치운 것 같군요, 어서 이곳에서 벗아나죠! 가트몬!

_2946.Title: Minato City
_2946.Description: You arrogant traitors! We've not finished our business yet, so where are you trying to go now? What you saw from us is not the real us! Let me show you what real terror is!!
_2946.Objective: Tylomon(Megalodon) Emerges When You Defeat 25 Tylomon(Captain) Defeat Tylomon(Megalodon)
_2946.CompletionSummary:
What in the world!? What made the sharks so big?
Well…! But we've managed to defeat them though. Wizardmon, are you ok?

_2947.Title: Minato City
_2947.Description: Yes, fortunately, no one is injured. However, we have yet to find the second lair key… We’ve taken down most of the Tylomon, but… Perhaps we missed it, or one of the Tylomon still holds it… I’ll search their bodies for the key.
_2947.CompletionSummary: We’ve found the key to the second hideout…! Only one more to go…!
_2947.ReservedText: I found it…! It’s the second hideout key…!

_2948.Title: Minato City
_2948.Description:
Gatomon… we just need to find the third key now. There are still Tylomon we haven’t defeated, so… They might have information about the third key.
It seems we should interrogate the Tylomon while dealing with them. Shall we head off to gather information about the third key?
_2948.Objective: Search Tylomon's body to find the second key
_2948.CompletionSummary: Gatomon…! Tylomon provided information about the third key…! It seems the third key is held by Ghostmon… We’ll need to go find Ghostmon…!

_2949.Title: Minato City
_2949.Description:
Gatomon… judging by your expression… you seem worried about Hikari…
But… you don’t need to be overly concerned… So far, I haven’t sensed any Digimon moving towards Hikari’s house…
For Gatomon’s peace of mind, we must hurry to Myotismon’s lair… Our goal is the true Pendant of the Crest of Light… Once we secure it and return to Hikari, Gatomon will have nothing to worry about anymore…
_2949.Objective: Defeat Tyrannomons to obtain information on the third key
_2949.ReservedText:
I know, Wizardmon… Hikari will be fine… Her brother and Agumon are with her… No… Honestly, I’m worried… Hikari’s brother and Agumon… they’re just so unreliable…
Wizardmon!! Let’s go find Ghostmon quickly!! I’m really worried about Kari…!

_2950.Title: Minato City
_2950.Description:
What?! A flash of light!! They’re fighting now, aren’t they?! They can’t handle it alone! We need to help them!
Let’s go!! Agumon!! We’re going to help them!
_2950.CompletionSummary: No, it’s too dangerous! Hikari! You stay at home!! Got it? It’s too dangerous outside, so you must stay home!!
_2950.ReservedText: Brother!! I want to go too!!

_2951.Title: Minato City
_2951.Description: Got it… Brother… Be careful and come back safe~! Agumon too~!! Please take care of Gatomon~
_2951.CompletionSummary: Alright, shall we go? Agumon!? The direction is that way, right?
_2951.ReservedText: Alright! Kari!! Leave it to us~!!

_2952.Title: Minato City
_2952.Description: Yes, Tai! It was in the direction of that big bridge~!! It seems Gatomon and Wizardmon are fighting there~
_2952.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Tai%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Odaiba Rainbow Park%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2952.ReservedText: That’s right!! I think so too! Let’s go, Agumon!! We need to hurry! I’ve got a bad feeling about this…!

_2953.Title: Minato City
_2953.Description: Who are you?! Why is a Digimon with a human?!
_2953.CompletionSummary: Don’t you think, Tai? There’s no way such delicious... uh, I mean, cute birds could be Myotismon’s minions!!
_2953.ReservedText: What’s this?? Are these guys Myotismon’s subordinates too?

_2954.Title: Minato City
_2954.Description: What’s with the whispering?! To talk amongst yourselves in front of us… the great subordinates of Lord Myotismon!! How insolent!!
_2954.CompletionSummary: You’re right... Tai... but even if they’re cute, if they’re Myotismon’s minions, we can’t let them go!! Digivolve them, Tai!!
_2954.ReservedText: No, Agumon~ They were Myotismon’s subordinates~ Despite their appearance, they were bad guys… (grumble grumble~)

_2955.Title: Minato City
_2955.Description:
I’ve warned you so many times And yet~!! You still talk only among yourselves~!!
I won’t let this slide!! Come at me, you insolent brats~! This Toucanmon will teach you proper manners~!!
_2955.Objective: Defeat Toucanmon, Defeat Toucanmon(Army Captain), Defeat Toucanmon(Observers)
_2955.CompletionSummary: Despite their appearance… they’re fierce… Their pecking with beaks really hurts…

_2956.Title: Minato City
_2956.Description: 그래? 상당히 귀찮게 됐네… 이런 곳에서 이 녀석들에게 발목이 잡히다니… 이렇게 되리라고는 생각지도 못했어…얼른 가트몬에게로 가야 하는데 말이야.. 조금만 더 힘내도록 하자! 그레이몬! 어서 이 새 녀석들을 해치우고 여기를 벗어나자고!!
_2956.Objective: 통카몬 행동대장 처치 통카몬 대장 처치
_2956.CompletionSummary: 고생했어! 그레이몬! 다 처리한 것 같지? 이제 가트몬에게로 가자!

_2957.Title: Minato City
_2957.Summary: Rage of the Big Bill Bird
_2957.Description: What's making you in such a hurry? Our business isn't done yet! Because we still have our leader 'Tonka'! Leader 'Tonka' will be here any minute to give you a punishment for your sins! Don't even think of running away!
_2957.CompletionSummary: Stronger enemies are blocking us now? Gees… I thought we could leave this place soon. Prepare to evovle, Greymon! Like I said, I have a bad feeling! I think we should return to Gatomon.

_2958.Title: Minato City
_2958.Description: Let's go Greymon! Tofu or Token or whatever that is, let's just finish it off and get out of this area!
_2958.Objective: Toucanmon(Tonka) Emerges When You Defeat 25 Toucanmon(Captain) Defeat Toucanmon(Tonka)
_2958.CompletionSummary: That was nice, Greymon! Now let's go back to Gatomon!

_2959.Title: Minato City
_2959.Description: We’ve wasted too much time here… I hope Gatomon and Wizardmon are alright… They need to be safe until we get there… Let’s go! Agumon!
_2959.CompletionSummary: Gatomon… I see Ghostmon… That must be the one holding the final hideout key…

_2960.Title: Minato City
_2960.Description: Yeah, that’s right… that guy must have the key…! Wizardmon! Just like with Swimmon, use your hypnosis on Gesomon! From here on, we must move cautiously and swiftly…!
_2960.CompletionSummary: Understood… Gatomon…! I also think it’s best to follow your advice. I’ll try to hypnotize the Ghostmon guarding the hideout door…!

_2961.Title: Minato City
_2961.Description: Hey, Bakemon buddy! Look at me.
_2961.ReservedText: Oh, wow? This is? Wizardmon? What are you doing here? Myotismon went out for a proper meal. No one can enter unless… Just, what was I going to do??

_2962.Title: Minato City
_2962.Description: Now we don't have Bakemon around…! Let's go find the real Crest of Light, Gatomon!
_2962.Objective: Use Hideout's Second Key Search Myotismon's Coffin
_2962.CompletionSummary: Oh, lord! This must be? Gatomon! I found this!
_2962.ReservedText: (shuffling) Something has been caught in my hand.

_2963.Title: Minato City
_2963.Description: What are you doing here…? Instead of searching for the eighth Chosen Child… Why are you rummaging through my lair…?
_2963.CompletionSummary: What…! Myotismon…!? How… how did Myotismon get here so quickly… Is this all because of Tylomon…?

_2964.Title: Minato City
_2964.Description: Looking for something? Shall I help? What do you plan to do by stealing the true Crest? Traitors won’t be forgiven…

_2965.Title: Minato City
_2965.Description: Coming to me directly… I’m honored… Since you’ve saved me the trouble, here’s a ticket to the underworld… Darkness Whip!

_2966.Title: Minato City
_2966.Description: Let’s go, MetalGreymon! This is our chance to defeat Myotismon!
_2966.CompletionSummary: MetalGreymon can’t fight properly… He’s still not recovered from the fatigue of the last battle… Pull yourself together! Agumon!

_2967.Title: Minato City
_2967.Description:
Did you really think such an attack would work on me? How foolish…
Chosen Child! You’ve come to rescue Gatomon… It seems Gatomon is the eighth Digimon, after all…
_2967.CompletionSummary: What are you talking about, Myotismon? I’m not the eighth Digimon!

_2968.Title: Minato City
_2968.Description: You’ll soon find out… I’ll use Gatomon as bait to lure out the eighth Chosen Child… They won’t ignore their Digimon in danger… By using this one, I’ll easily find the eighth Chosen Child…
_2968.CompletionSummary:
That’s cowardly! Myotismon!! Stop right there!!
Gatomon!!! I’ll come save you for sure! Just wait a bit longer!!

_2969.Title: Minato City
_2969.Description:
No!! Gatomon was captured by Myotismon…! What do I tell Hikari…? And where did Wizardmon go?!
Argh!! Too much is happening at once, I can’t keep up!! We need to head back home for now…! Agumon! Let’s go home! I need to sort things out there…!
_2969.Objective: Talk to Agumon Move to Tai's house
_2969.CompletionSummary: What’s this? Digimon in front of our house!!?? Is Hikari okay??
_2969.ReservedText: Yeah, Tai! Let’s head home and think about it carefully!

_2970.Title: Minato City
_2970.Description: Tai!!! Suddenly, Digimon started appearing!! They're not only targeting our house but also kidnapping people from the neighborhood!! What should we do?!
_2970.CompletionSummary:
Damn! They’re Myotismon’s minions!
Agumon!! Digivolve!! Defeat those guys and protect the people here!
_2970.ReservedText: Capture all the people… Especially the children!! They must be taken! This is Myotismon’s order…!

_2971.Title: Minato City
_2971.Description: Uhuhuhu... You insolent fool... I've been lenient until now, but it seems you've forgotten your place...
_2971.CompletionSummary: Alright, got it! Let’s get out of here!
_2971.ReservedText: I’m sorry… Tai… In my current state, I can’t take on that guy… I promise, I’ll save the people here later. For now, let’s retreat…!

_2972.Title: Minato City
_2972.Description: This... doesn't feel like an ordinary situation. I should take Matt and find a safe place to hide... This area is way too dangerous... We need to get out of here quickly...
_2972.CompletionSummary: Wait, Father!! Why did you suddenly show up and bring me here?

_2973.Title: Odaiba
_2973.Description: What in the world is going on? Father? Please, explain to us!
_2973.CompletionSummary: I’m not sure… It’s hard to explain… One thing is certain: Odaiba is completely locked down...

_2974.Title: Odaiba
_2974.Description: It must have started when this dense fog appeared... Since then, all means of communication and transport have been cut off, completely isolating us from the world outside the fog. And... your friend next to you, you said their name was Gabumon. I'm sorry, but these monsters, ones I've never seen even in the Digital World, are roaming the streets and abducting the residents of Odaiba...
_2974.CompletionSummary: That... I see... (This is more serious than I thought… I need to meet up with the others and deal with Myotismon…)

_2975.Title: Odaiba
_2975.Description: Follow me for now. I’ve found a safe place where you and your friend can hide. We’ll talk more there...
_2975.CompletionSummary: This is the place... You and your friends can stay here for now, hidden from the monsters...

_2976.Title: Odaiba
_2976.Description: What?? But what about you, Father? Aren’t you staying with us?
_2976.ReservedText: I’m heading to the TV station… I have to find a way to contact the outside world and tell them what’s happening here… Even though Fuji TV is currently occupied by those monsters, I can use a secret passage to get inside… Was it Gabumon? Please take care of Matt…

_2977.Title: Odaiba
_2977.CompletionSummary: Alright, got it… Don’t worry about me, just stay put here! I’ll resolve the situation and come back right away...!

_2978.Title: Odaiba
_2978.Description: Matt... What’s your plan from now on? Are you going to stay here? If we don’t act, the people of this area might face even greater danger...
_2978.CompletionSummary: I know… But the two of us alone aren’t enough… If only Tai were here... we could’ve managed somehow…

_2979.Title: Odaiba
_2979.CompletionSummary: Huh? Tai? Why are you here…?

_2980.Title: Odaiba
_2980.Description: Agumon! Let’s head to Big Sight! Hikari is with Matt, so she’ll be fine! We need to hurry and rescue Gatomon!
_2980.Objective: Talk to Agumon Move to Parking Lot Zone 1
_2980.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Agumon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Parking Lot Zone 1%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2980.CompletionSummary: Of course… This area is also under Myotismon’s control… There’s an overwhelming number of Digimon...

_2981.Title: Odaiba
_2981.Description: Huh?? Agumon, it looks like someone’s over there. Wait, isn’t that WereGarurumon? But... his fur is black?
_2981.CompletionSummary: I see! No choice then! Evolve, Agumon!
_2981.ReservedText: Tai! That Digimon is WereGarurumon (Black)… He’s just as strong as WereGarurumon, but unlike him, he’s extremely ferocious… We need to be careful in this fight! Otherwise, we’ll be in trouble!

_2982.Title: Odaiba
_2982.Description: I can smell something delicious from somewhere... The scent of humans... and the Digivice of the 8th Digidestined...
_2982.CompletionSummary: How about this!! This is the power of our bond!
_2982.ReservedText: Oh no! That fake Pendant of the Crest of Light is reacting to Hikari’s Digivice! We need to defeat that WereGarurumon (Black) before more of Myotismon’s minions notice!

_2983.Title: Odaiba
_2983.Description:
Human child… such a shame that your wishes won't come true. We all know that you're holding the 8th Chosen Child's Digivice.
Let's not waste our time and energy. Hand over the Digivice and run away as fast as you can if you value your lives!
_2983.CompletionSummary: You should have not underestimated us, boys. And I'll return your words back to you. Give up the Digivice and run away as fast as you can if you value your lives! The place you occupied doesn't belong to you.
_2983.ReservedText: What kind of nonsence is that? Do you really think I'd give up this thing so easily? MetalGreymon, show them no mercy!

_2984.Title: Odaiba
_2984.Description: We're sorry! We were wrong!! Please, spare us…!! Huh?? We didn’t want to do this!! The truth is... we’re victims too! That wicked Myotismon... he’s holding our leader hostage, and we had no choice but to follow his orders... We love peace too! We hate fighting...!
_2984.CompletionSummary: I see… So that’s what happened… Poor souls… though I’d like to believe you, I can’t just trust your words, you know?

_2985.Title: Odaiba
_2985.Description: Yeah, I get it! We were enemies just moments ago, so trusting us won’t be easy. I’d feel the same if I were you!! But please, give me a chance. Let me prove that what I’m saying is true!!
_2985.CompletionSummary: Really?? I’ll play along with your tune for now. So how are you going to prove it?

_2986.Title: Odaiba
_2986.Description:
Thank you!! You’re such a kind soul!! I thought so from the moment I first saw you... there was a radiant glow behind you!
Ah, sorry~ I’ve been rambling~! Follow me for now! I’ll show you how I’ll prove my words!
_2986.Objective: Move to Parking Lot Zone 2 Talk to Tai
_2986.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Parking Lot Zone 2%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Tai%qe %cc2/%mc2
_2986.CompletionSummary: That’s a good question! I’ll show you right now!
_2986.ReservedText: What’s with those tattered teddy bears? Why did they bring them here?

_2987.Title: Odaiba
_2987.Description: Those guys are BadPuppetmon... Just like you said, they look like ragged teddy bear Digimon, but they’re incredibly strong... If you defeat them, it’ll deal a major blow to Myotismon! So, go and take down the BadPuppetmon! How about it? With this kind of information, you can trust that I’m telling the truth, right?
_2987.CompletionSummary: Phew, just as you said, they’re strong ones, huh? Is this enough for now?
_2987.ReservedText: So, those are definitely Myotismon’s minions? Let’s go! MetalGreymon!!

_2988.Title: Odaiba
_2988.Description:
무슨 말도 안 되는 소리를 하고 있는거야??!! 네가 해치운 건 배드퍼펫몬 중에서 가장 약한 녀석들이란 말이야~!! 그 녀석들을 해치운 것만으로는 묘티스몬에게 큰 타격을 줄 수 없어! 방금 해치운 배드퍼펫몬 녀석들에게는 '행동대장'이라는 간부급 배드퍼펫몬들이 있는데 그 녀석들을 해치워야 확실하게 묘티스몬에게 타격을 줄 수 있다고!!
뭐하고 있어? 얼른 가지 않고? 내가 이렇게 고급 정보까지 줬는데 느릿느릿하게 있을 거야? 얼른 가서 배드퍼펫몬(행동대장)을 쓰러뜨리고 와!
_2988.CompletionSummary:
헉…헉…진짜 간부 맞나보네… 엄청 강하잖아…
이봐…워가루몬(흑)!! 이제 됐겠지??

_2989.Title: Odaiba
_2989.Description: 응?? 뭐?? 뭐 했어?? 아~ 미안~ 잠시 뭐 좀 하느라 못 봤어~ '행동대장'들을 해치웠다고? 난 못 믿겠는데~ 그렇게 강한 녀석들을 너네가 해치웠을리 없잖아~

_2990.Title: Odaiba
_2990.Description:
워워~ 화내지 마~ 알았어~ 믿어줄게~~ 뭐 보니까 배드퍼펫몬 숫자들이 좀 줄은 것 같긴 하네~ 잘했어~ 잘했어~
너네들이 '행동대장'들을 해치웠다고 하니까, 이제 마지막 단계에 도달한거야~ 기뻐하라고~!!!
이제 너네는 배드퍼펫몬(대장)을 쓰러뜨려리면 돼~!! 그 녀석이 배드퍼펫몬의 핵이거든! 만약 너네들이 그 녀석을 해치운다면 묘티스몬은 엉엉 울게 될거야~!!
난 잠시 뭘 해야해서 너네들이 해치우는 것을 못 볼 수도 있으니까 '배드퍼펫몬 대장의 증표'를 모아오도록 해! 그것을 모아오면 너네들이 '대장'을 쓰러뜨렸다는 것을 믿을 수 있으니까~~

_2991.Title: Odaiba
_2991.Description: Alright!! We've defeated all the Bad Puppetmon!!
_2991.CompletionSummary: Hey... you… Are you showing your true colors?!
_2991.ReservedText: (Hehehe… impressive, huh? Defeating all those guys...) (You’ve worked hard~ Hehe… but you’ve used up a lot of strength, haven’t you?) (Now it’s my turn to finish you off easily!)

_2992.Title: Odaiba
_2992.Description:
Now it’s time to cook you exhausted fools~ I tricked you to drain your power and also to get rid of those annoying Bad Puppetmon! How foolish of you to fall for such a simple trick!
Now, if I finish you off, Myotismon’s favor will be all mine! Khehehehe, now how should I cook you up?
_2992.Objective: Talk to Tai After defeating 20 Bad Puppetmon Leaders, Wicked Wolf WereGarurumon will appear Defeat Wicked Wolf WereGarurumon
_2992.CompletionSummary: Hah~ You insignificant thing, acting tough! You’re only good at scheming, aren’t you~!! You coward!!
_2992.ReservedText:
Damn… I knew it… Something felt off, but… it’s exactly as I suspected… Not that it matters! We’ll take them all down anyway! Let’s go, MetalGreymon!!
Let’s punish that cowardly, despicable villain!

_2993.Title: Odaiba
_2993.Description: Ugh… Tai… I’m exhausted… I can’t fight anymore…. Let’s take a short break~ I’m also starving~~
_2993.CompletionSummary: That’s true... You’ve worked hard, Agumon… Let’s look around here for some food...

_2994.Title: Odaiba
_2994.Description: Tai~~ What are you doing here? Tai?
_2994.CompletionSummary: What!!!! Why are Sora and Birdramon here?

_2995.Title: Odaiba
_2995.Description: I see~ You’ve been through a lot too… But that aside… Agumon looks really tired!! Tai, you don’t have any money on you right now, do you? Here, take this~ It’s emergency money my mom gave me. Use it to buy some food for you and Agumon~
_2995.CompletionSummary: Don’t be shy… I’m leaving now~ Tai, take good care of Agumon~
_2995.ReservedText: Thank you, Sora… You’re the best…

_2996.Title: Odaiba
_2996.Description:
Shall we look for place to find enough food? I don't think the parking lots are good place for it, but… It's too far to return to the city.
Agumon, stay put for just a little more. For we're going to find something to eat!
_2996.Objective: Talk to Agumon Use Vending Machine Delicious Food
_2996.CompletionSummary: Whoa!! Taichi! Can I eat all of them for real?
_2996.ReservedText: Good! I don't mind for anything if it's for food, delicious food!

_2997.Title: Odaiba
_2997.Description:
Ahh~ I’m full~ Now I feel alive again~ Tai~!! From now on, I feel like I can fight Myotismon’s minions without worry!!
Huh?? Tai~ Don’t you hear a buzzing sound coming from somewhere?
_2997.CompletionSummary:
What!! What’s that Digimon?? It’s holding a chainsaw… Looks terrifyingly strong…
Agumon, evolve! Time to clean up Myotismon’s minions!
_2997.ReservedText:
Yeah… what’s that sound?? It sounds like a chainsaw…
Agumon! Let’s check out where that sound is coming from! I have a bad feeling about this…

_2998.Title: Odaiba
_2998.Description: MetalGreymon! Quickly take down that Digimon with the buzzsaw over there!
_2998.CompletionSummary: Great job, MetalGreymon! Looks like we’ve almost cleared them all!
_2998.ReservedText: Hmm? This reaction? Is it… the eighth Digidestined? Heh heh heh… Lucky me… You’ve come to me on your own… Could that be the eighth Digidestined? Guys! Capture them! Let’s offer them to Lord Myotismon!

_2999.Title: Odaiba
_2999.Description:
좋아! 이러면 되겠다! 메탈그레이몬! 저 녀석들의 전기톱을 빼았자! 그래야 좀 더 안전하게 저 녀석들을 해치울 수 있을거야!
누구든 좋으니까 닥치는대로 잡아서 전기톱을 빼았는거야! 할 수 있겠지?
_2999.CompletionSummary: 태일아…저 녀석들의 전기톱을 빼앗았더니 전투 의욕이 떨어진 것 같아!! 지금 저 녀석들을 모두 처치할 기회인 것 같아!

_3000.Title: Odaiba
_3000.Description: 나도 그렇게 생각해! 메탈그레이몬! 이곳에 있는 저 디지몬들을 모두 해치워버리자!
_3000.Objective: 폭탄몬 처치 폭탄몬 행동대장 처치 폭탄몬 대장 처치
_3000.CompletionSummary: 좋아! 잘했어! 메탈그레이몬! 거의 다 해치운 것 같은데?!

_3001.Title: Odaiba
_3001.Description:
You’re strong… you guys… I admit it… you’re stronger than us… But this isn’t over! I won’t let you pass through here!!
Myotismon! Forgive us! It seems this is as far as we go!! I’m so sorry we couldn’t serve you to the end! But!! We won’t let these brats reach you!! I’ll take them down with me with this bomb!
You fools! Let’s go to hell together!!
_3001.CompletionSummary: Well done, MetalGreymon! It seems we’ve stopped all the bombs!
_3001.ReservedText: Tai! Those guys are planning to self-destruct along with us!! We have to stop them before they blow up!!!

_3002.Title: Odaiba
_3002.Description:
MetalGreymon! We have to take away their bombs for whatever causes! The bombs can't blow up here! If the bombs go off, not only this city will be ruined, but we can't survive through!
Did you get it? MetalGreymon! Let's get them disarmed before they detonate the bombs!
_3002.CompletionSummary: Excellent! MetalGreymon! I guess we took away all bombs from them!

_3003.Title: Odaiba
_3003.Description:
폭탄은 다 뺏었지만 혹시라도 우리가 뺏은 폭탄을 터뜨리려고 할 수도 있어… 그래서는 안 되니까 저 디지몬들을 전부 해치워버리자!
메탈그레이몬! 가자!
_3003.Objective: 폭탄몬 처치 폭탄몬 행동대장 처치 폭탄몬 대장 처치
_3003.CompletionSummary: 태일아! 이제 이 주위에 묘티스몬 부하들은 없는 것 같아!

_3004.Title: Odaiba
_3004.Description: Good job, Agumon! Let’s head to Big Sight now!
_3004.Objective: Talk to Agumon Move to Parking Lot Zone 3
_3004.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Agumon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Parking Lot Zone 3%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3004.CompletionSummary: Darn… So there are Myotismon’s minions here as well...

_3005.Title: Odaiba
_3005.Description: We’ve detected the signal of the 8th Digidestined’s Digivice. Under Myotismon’s orders, we must find the 8th Digidestined’s Digivice and bring it to him.
_3005.CompletionSummary: Alright, Agumon! Evolve!! Let’s break through in one go!
_3005.ReservedText: Tai! Be careful! Enemies are coming!

_3006.Title: Odaiba
_3006.Description: Let’s go! MetalGreymon! Sweep away those Knightmon and break through in one go!
_3006.Objective: Defeat Knightmon, Defeat Knightmon(Army Captain), Defeat Knightmon(Captain)
_3006.CompletionSummary: Well done, MetalGreymon!! Looks like we’ve dealt with them all!! Let’s get out of here!

_3007.Title: Odaiba
_3007.Description: 뭐…뭐지?? 분명히 제대로 타격을 준 것 같았는데?? 어떻게 나이트몬들이 일어날 수 있는 거지? 안 되겠어! 메탈그레이몬! 다시 한번 더 저 나이트몬들을 쓸어버리자!
_3007.CompletionSummary: 이런…! 투구랑 갑옷 때문에 저 녀석들에게 타격을 줬는지 못 줬는지 도저히 알 수가 없네…

_3008.Title: Odaiba
_3008.Description:
이런! 아무리 우리가 공격을 해도 투구랑 갑옷 때문에 저 나이트몬들에게 타격을 줬는지 도저히 모르겠어!
무식한 방법이긴 하지만…저 녀석들의 투구랑 갑옷을 뺏어서 저 녀석들에게 확실하게 타격을 줘야 겠어! 메탈그레이몬! 저 나이트몬들의 투구와 갑옷을 빼앗자! 빼앗아서 저 녀석들에게 확실하게 타격을 줘야 겠어!
_3008.Objective: 나이트몬을 처치하여 나이트몬의 투구 획득 나이트몬을 처치하여 나이트몬의 갑옷 획득
_3008.CompletionSummary: 좋았어! 녀석들의 방어구를 모조리 빼앗았다! 이제 우리가 할 일은 하나밖에 남지 않았어!

_3009.Title: Odaiba
_3009.Description: 좋아~ 메탈그레이몬~ 녀석들을 보호해주던 투구와 갑옷을 빼앗았으니 이제 녀석들을 모두 해치워버리는 일만 남았어! 싹 다 해치워 버리자! 메탈그레이몬!
_3009.Objective: 나이트몬 처치 나이트몬 행동대장 처치 나이트몬 대장 처치
_3009.CompletionSummary: 잘했어! 메탈그레이몬!! 이제 남은 녀석은 저 녀석뿐이야! 그런데 화가 엄청 난 것 같아 보이는데...…조심해야 겠어…

_3010.Title: Odaiba
_3010.Description: This humiliation of having our proud helmets and armor taken from us!! We won’t forgive the Digidestined who insulted us! For Myotismon!!! As the Knight Commander, I will defeat you all!
_3010.Objective: After defeating 20 Knightmon Leaders,KnightmonCavalry Lord will appear Defeat Knightmon Cavalry Lord
_3010.CompletionSummary: We... we defeated them, right…? Phew~ We barely made it… MetalGreymon… you did well… That was a really strong one… wasn’t it?

_3011.Title: Odaiba
_3011.Description: Tai… I think it’s too early to relax… I can feel countless eyes staring at us through the thick fog… I sense a strong presence from over there. Should we check it out? Or should we focus on rescuing Gatomon? What do you think, Tai?
_3011.CompletionSummary: Tai! It’s those guys…! Be careful...!
_3011.ReservedText: I wish I could go save Gatomon and Mimi, but MetalGreymon, it’s probably best to deal with those ones you sensed… If they follow us to Big Sight, it’ll be a huge hassle… MetalGreymon! Let’s find those guys you sensed!

_3012.Title: Odaiba
_3012.Description: That… that creature…? It’s Cerberus, just like in the books!!! It looks terrifying!!
_3012.CompletionSummary: Ahhh! They’re coming! Prepare yourself, MetalGreymon!

_3013.Title: Odaiba
_3013.Description: Hmph! Even if it looks like that, it’s just a pet Myotismon keeps around! MetalGreymon! Don’t be scared and take down Cerberumon! But stay alert! It does seem strong, as you said!
_3013.CompletionSummary: Good! Haha. They may look scary but they’re nothing special!

_3014.Title: Odaiba
_3014.Description:
메탈그레이몬의 단단한 기계손 부분에 상처가 났어… 아마도 케르베로스몬의 발톱이 메탈그레이몬에게 상처를 냈을 거야… 저 발톱이 가장 단단해 보이고 날카로워 보이니까 말이야…
메탈그레이몬! 케르베로스몬의 발톱을 부러뜨려서 더 이상 강한 공격을 하지 못하게 만들어 버리자! 그렇게 한다면 좀 더 수월하게 저 녀석들을 해치울 수 있을 거야!!
_3014.CompletionSummary: 좋아! 이제 좀 더 안전하게 케르베로스몬을 해치울 수 있겠어!

_3015.Title: Odaiba
_3015.Description: 저 녀석들의 날카로운 발톱이 없다면 더 이상 무서워할 것이 없지! 메탈그레이몬! 단숨에 케르베로스몬들을 해치워 버리자!
_3015.Objective: 케르베로스몬 행동대장 처치 케르베로스몬 대장 처치
_3015.CompletionSummary: 뭐…뭐지?? 발톱이 없으니 해치우기 수월할텐데… 왜 이렇게 해치우는 속도가 느린 걸까?

_3016.Title: Odaiba
_3016.Description:
Hmm… Something’s suspicious about those dog heads on its shoulders… It seems to anticipate and dodge our attacks quickly… In that case!! Let’s use bait! Give it a bone to distract it, and then take it down in one swift move!
Surely, since they’re dogs, they’ll love bones!!
_3016.CompletionSummary: Hmm… Does this work? Or not??

_3017.Title: Odaiba
_3017.Description: Unbelievable… treating us like pampered house pets… It’s quite offensive… My comrades, let’s show these Digidestined brats what we’re made of!
_3017.Objective: Talk to Tai Defeat Cerberumon Leader
_3017.CompletionSummary: Ha ha!! Great job, MetalGreymon!! Didn’t I say we’d win? Ha ha ha!!
_3017.ReservedText: Ah!!! Now it’s attacking us even more furiously? Even so, with its anger blinding it, it won’t fight properly! MetalGreymon! Stay calm and fight back!

_3018.Title: Odaiba
_3018.CompletionSummary: Of course~ Agumon! I knew all along that giving a bone to such scary-looking guys would just make them angry! Hmph!
_3018.ReservedText: Really? Tai? You knew giving Cerberusmon bones would make it angry?

_3019.Title: Odaiba
_3019.Description: Phew~ Anyway, it seems we’ve taken care of all of Myotismon’s minions in this area! There’s no time to waste! Let’s go, Agumon! We need to rescue Gatomon! And also Mina!
_3019.Objective: Talk to Agumon Move to Big Sight
_3019.CompletionSummary: Mimi~!! You were dragged here too...?

_3020.Title: Big Sight
_3020.Description: Sora? It’s really you~ You’ve been kidnapped too~
_3020.CompletionSummary: Mimi? It’s you~ Mimi, were you captured as well?

_3021.Title: Big Sight
_3021.Description: Yeah… that’s what happened… Sora, what should we do now?
_3021.CompletionSummary: Yeah… What should we do? Shall we think it over together a bit more?

_3022.Title: Big Sight
_3022.Description:
First, let’s check on the situation with the townspeople. They’re probably scared out of their minds seeing Digimon for the first time…
I think it’s best to calm them down~
_3022.CompletionSummary: I agree, sis~ Let’s find the frightened people and lift their spirits!

_3023.Title: Big Sight
_3023.Description: There are a lot of people gathered in front of Big Sight Plaza… Let’s find out what they’re thinking right now.
_3023.Objective: Investigate the condition of the residents
_3023.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Investigate the Condition of the Residents%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Investigate the Condition of the Residents%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Investigate the Condition of the Residents%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3023.CompletionSummary: Sis, as expected, everyone’s trembling in fear…!

_3024.Title: Big Sight
_3024.Description:
This is a big problem… What should we do…? Without Piyomon, and with only Palmon, fighting Myotismon’s minions might be too dangerous… At times like this, it’s best to get help from the adults!
Let’s find townspeople willing to fight against Myotismon’s minions! They could be a great help to us!
_3024.Objective: Move to Big Sight - Outer Park Find residents willing to resist Myotismon’s minions
_3024.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Big Sight - Outer Park%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Search for Residents%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3024.CompletionSummary: Who are you kids? It’s dangerous for children to be here! Go to your parents right away!

_3025.Title: Big Sight
_3025.Description:
I was kidnapped along with those Digimon… but we got separated… So, I want to help you find my parents! Please, let me help you!
We’ll definitely be of help to you!
_3025.CompletionSummary: Yes, you’re right! That’s why we think we can be of help to you!
_3025.ReservedText: Digimon? You just called those monsters Digimon? Do you know something about those creatures?

_3026.Title: Big Sight
_3026.Description:
Alright, I understand! I’m not too keen on relying on kids, but it seems your friend’s strength will be a great help to us.
First, let’s rescue the townspeople who were kidnapped by that gun-wielding monster!
_3026.CompletionSummary: What!! Something suddenly flew in and exploded! What’s going on here?!

_3027.Title: Big Sight
_3027.Description:
그런 것 같구나…역시 쉽게 되지는 않는 구나…! 그래도 네 친구는 강한 것 같으니까 납치된 주민들을 구할 수 있을 거라고 생각한다!
숫자가 많으니 게릴라 작전으로 적들의 숫자를 줄이는 것이 좋겠구나… 기습해서 총을 든 디지몬들의 숫자를 줄이자꾸나!
_3027.CompletionSummary: 아닛!! 갑자기 어디서 뭔가가 날라와서 폭발했어요! 도대체 무슨 일이 일어난거죠?

_3028.Title: Big Sight
_3028.Description:
It’s really dangerous to have something like that attacking us… We should scout the area before proceeding with the next rescue.
Luckily, I have a camera with me. Let’s use the zoom lens to take a closer look…
_3028.Objective: Use the camera to identify Tankdramon
_3028.CompletionSummary: This is unbelievable… Can Digimon even look like this…?

_3029.Title: Big Sight
_3029.Description:
이정도로 생긴 것은 귀여운 편에 속한다고 생각해요…하하하 이 디지몬이 쏘는 포탄이 위험하다면 이 포탄을 뺏으면 괜찮겠네요! 그렇겠죠?
저희가 저 디지몬이 쏘는 포탄을 뺏어올게요! 그동안 아저씨는 이 다음 작전을 생각하고 계세요!
_3029.CompletionSummary:
너희들 정말 대단하구나! 그 괴물들한테서 이렇게 많은 양의 포탄을 빼앗아오다니 말이야…
이전에 너희들을 무시한 내 자신이 부끄러워지기 시작했구나…

_3030.Title: Big Sight
_3030.Description:
너희들이 이렇게 포탄을 빼앗아 왔다면 답은 간단하다! 저들을 해치워야지! 내버려둔다면 언젠가 우리를 방해할 수 있으니 말이야!
저 탱크 모습을 한 괴물들을 해치우고 주민들을 구하도록 하자꾸나!
_3030.Objective: 탱크드라몬 행동대장 처치 탱크드라몬 대장 처치
_3030.CompletionSummary: 애들아! 고생했구나! 괴물들을 모두 처치했으니 이제 주민들을 구하자꾸나!

_3031.Title: Big Sight
_3031.Description:
Oh, darn!! Where in Earth are those monsters coming from? It looks like more of them came after we defeated them. The monsters with gun have emerged once more!
Kids, I'm really hate myself to say this, but I must count on you now. Please help saving the rest of civilians. Defeat the monsters so the captured civilians can be set free!
_3031.Objective: Defeat CommanDramon Defeat CommanDramon(Army Captain) Defeat TankDramon(Army Captain) Defeat TankDramon(Captain)
_3031.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat CommanDramon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat CommanDramon(Army Captain)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat TankDramon(Army Captain)%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat TankDramon(Captain)%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3031.CompletionSummary: Thank you, children! Thanks to your help that now e can save the innocent civilians!

_3032.Title: Big Sight
_3032.Description: Now, let’s go rescue the residents! While you were busy fighting those monsters, I managed to steal the key to the prison lock. Let’s use this key to unlock the prison and free the residents!
_3032.CompletionSummary: Thank you…! Really, thank you…! I thought it was all over when those monsters kidnapped me…!

_3033.Title: Big Sight
_3033.Description: Jin! I’m so glad you’re safe! Are you hurt anywhere? More importantly, did you see where the other Odaiba residents were taken?
_3033.Objective: Talk to Jin, the kidnapped resident
_3033.ReservedText: Yeah, luckily, I'm not hurt...! Oh, did you see it? It must be around here somewhere! We all went down those stairs together, but they headed in the opposite direction... The monsters that kidnapped us felt completely different, like they were on another level... Demons... They looked just like demons... Ugh... Just thinking about it again, they looked absolutely horrifying...

_3034.Title: Big Sight
_3034.Description:
(A demon…? Does it look like Devimon…? If so… it could be as strong as Devimon…)
Excuse me… If you remember, could you guide us to that place?
_3034.CompletionSummary:
I... see… You saved me, so of course, I must tell you!
I’ll guide you to that place!
_3034.ReservedText: Ah~ Let me introduce them. These guys worked hard to save you... The monsters you saw? Ah~ These ones are called Digimon, and they have their own Digimon with them~

_3035.Title: Big Sight
_3035.Description: Alright, follow me…! That demon-like monster is really scary, but having these friends with us gives me courage!
_3035.CompletionSummary: That... that monster!! That devilish creature! Look!!! Isn’t it terrifying?

_3036.Title: Big Sight
_3036.Description:
Wow… it really does look like a demon….
Ah! Look over there!! People are trapped inside that prison!! It’s terrifying, but if we don’t rescue them soon, it’ll be dangerous…!
It’s going to be tough, but let’s defeat that demon-like Digimon and rescue the residents!
_3036.CompletionSummary: It’s... it’s defeated!! Well done, everyone!! Can we save the residents now??

_3037.Title: Big Sight
_3037.Description:
Oh no!! Something just suddenly appeared around the cell! Some kind of barricade that double-locks the cell I guess!
The demons seem to protect the barricades, so what if we take them down too?
Let's defeat the ones who guard the barricades and see what happens then!
_3037.Objective: Summon NeoDevimon(Absence) by Defeating 10 NeoDevimon Defeat NeoDevimon(Absence) and Obtain Sealing Key of NeoDevimon(Absence)
_3037.CompletionSummary: We've found something strange from the demon monster. Do you have any idea what this is?

_3038.Title: Big Sight
_3038.Description: Mmm… Since the thing came out from monster that guards the device, it can be related with the barricades. Maybe it can be the key to unlock it. Shall we give it a try?
_3038.Objective: Use Sealing Key of NeoDevimon(Absence) to Open Seal of Absence

_3039.Title: Big Sight
_3039.Description:
오~! 이상한 장치가 사라졌어! 방금 너희들이 주운 물건이 이상한 장치를 사라지게 해서 감옥 주위에 쳐져 있는 결계를 없애주는 열쇠같은 역할을 하는 것 같아!
좋아! 이제 우리가 할 일은 정해졌어! 이상한 장치 주위에 있는 악마를 해치우는 거야! 그다음에 장치를 사라지게 하는 물건을 찾도록 하자!
방금 전에 사라진 장치를 지키는 악마 디지몬을 해치우니까 다른 악마 디지몬이 나타났어! 흠…앞으로 이런 식으로 이상한 장치를 없애야 할 것 같아...!
그럼 애들아! 방금 새로 나타난 악마 디지몬을 해치우도록 할까?
_3039.Objective: 네오데블몬(결여) 5마리를 처치하여 네오데블몬(망상) 소환 네오데블몬(망상)을 처치하여 네오데블몬(망상) 봉인 열쇠 획득하기
_3039.CompletionSummary: 아저씨! 찾았어요! 전에 찾은 것과 동일한 모양의 물건이에요!

_3040.Title: Big Sight
_3040.Description:
역시! 우리의 예상대로 장치 옆에 있는 악마 디지몬은 각 장치를 맡아서 지키고 관리하는 역할을 갖고 있는 거야!
그리고, 역시…너희들은 대단해! 저 무섭게 생긴 녀석들을 해치우다니 말이야…!
좋아! 너희들이 고생해서 찾은 그 물건을 장치에 갖다 놓도록 하자!
_3040.Objective: 네오데블몬(망상) 봉인 열쇠를 사용하여 망상의 봉인 해제
_3040.CompletionSummary: 아저씨! 아까 일어난 반응과 똑같은 반응이 나타나고 있어요!

_3041.Title: Big Sight
_3041.Description:
좋아! 예상대로 장치가 사라졌어! 너희들이 찾은 물건은 역시 장치를 해제하는 열쇠였던 거야!
앞으로 3개가 남았네… 힘들겠지만 좀 더 버텨주길 바라…부탁한다…
힘내서 세 번째 장치 주위에 있는 악마를 해치워서 장치를 해제할 물건을 찾아줬으면 해! 파이팅!
_3041.Objective: 네오데블몬(망상) 5마리를 처치하여 네오데블몬(허영) 소환 네오데블몬(허영)을 처치하여 네오데블몬(허영) 봉인 열쇠 획득하기
_3041.CompletionSummary: 아저씨! 열쇠를 찾았어요! 어서 장치를 해제하도록 해요!

_3042.Title: Big Sight
_3042.Description: 고생했어! 세 번째 장치를 해제할 열쇠를 찾았구나! 그래! 어서 장치를 해제하자!
_3042.Objective: 네오데블몬(허영) 봉인 열쇠를 사용하여 허영의 봉인 해제

_3043.Title: Big Sight
_3043.Description:
앞으로 2개라… 네 친구…매우 지쳐보이는구나…
이런 말을 하는 내 자신이 너무 작고 초라해 보이지만…조금만 더 힘내서 네 번째 장치에 있는 악마를 해치워 줘…!
_3043.Objective: 네오데블몬(허영) 5마리를 처치하여 네오데블몬(우둔) 소환 네오데블몬(우둔)을 처치하여 네오데블몬(우둔) 봉인 열쇠 획득하기
_3043.CompletionSummary: 아저씨! 4번째 열쇠를 찾았어요! 어서 장치를 해제하도록 해요!

_3044.Title: Big Sight
_3044.Description: 대단해! 많이 지친 것 같은데 네 번째 열쇠를 찾다니 말이야!! 그래그래! 빠르게 장치를 해제하도록 하자!
_3044.Objective: 네오데블몬(우둔) 봉인 열쇠를 사용하여 우둔의 봉인 해제

_3045.Title: Big Sight
_3045.Description:
애들아! 정말 고생했어! 이제 마지막이야! 저 장치만 해제한다면 오다이바 주민들을 구할 수 있어!
그러니 조금만 더 힘을 내도록 하자!
저 악마 디지몬을 해치우고 마지막 장치의 열쇠를 찾는 거야! 애들아! 부탁할게!
_3045.Objective: 네오데블몬(우둔) 5마리를 처치하여 네오데블몬(망각) 소환 네오데블몬(망각)을 처치하여 네오데블몬(망각) 봉인 열쇠 획득하기
_3045.CompletionSummary: 드디어 마지막 열쇠를 찾았어요! 아저씨! 어서 장치를 해제하고 갇힌 주민들을 구하도록 해요!

_3046.Title: Big Sight
_3046.Description:
좋아! 드디어 마지막 열쇠를 찾아냈구나! 너희들은 정말이지…진짜 대단한 아이들이구나!
너희들이 열심히 노력해준 덕분에 이제 주민들을 구할 수 있게 됐어!
_3046.Objective: 네오데블몬(망각) 봉인 열쇠를 사용하여 망각의 봉인 해제
_3046.CompletionSummary: 아니…뭐지?? 왜 결계가 사라지지 않는 거지??

_3047.Title: Big Sight
_3047.Description:
건방진 인간 녀석들… 감히 묘티스몬님의 간식 거리에 손을 데려고 하다니… 분수도 모르고 기어오르는 구나… 거기에 우리 동족까지 해치우고…선을 넘어도 단단히 넘었구나…
같잖은 인간 녀석들…너희에겐 벌이 필요하겠구나… 이 몸께서 직접 벌을 내려줄테니 감사해하며 달게 받도록 해라!
_3047.Objective: 네오데블몬(망각) 5마리를 처치하여 네오데블몬(악마) 소환 네오데블몬(악마) 처치
_3047.CompletionSummary:
으아…지금까지 봤던 악마 디지몬이랑 차원이 다른 것 같은데…? 모습은 똑같은데 이렇게 세도 되는 거야?
그..그보다 애들아? 괜찮니? 어디 다치진 않았지?
너희들도 참 대단하다…그 강한 악마 디지몬을 지친 몸으로 이기다니 말이야… 너희들이 참 존경스러워…

_3048.Title: Big Sight
_3048.Description:
Haha, not at all~ This is Palmon, and it’s all thanks to her~ Palmon, you did an amazing job~!
Ah~ but now’s not the time for this! Let’s hurry and rescue the Odaiba residents!
_3048.CompletionSummary: Thank you…! Really, thank you!! I thought I was going to die because of those scary monsters…!!! Sob...!

_3049.Title: Big Sight
_3049.Description: I’m so glad you’re safe! Are you hurt anywhere?
_3049.Objective: Talk to Mino, the kidnapped resident
_3049.CompletionSummary:
No, no! While it’s true this creature is different from us, it’s a kind friend. It worked hard to save you.
Don’t be afraid. It’s on our side! Rest assured!
Ah! Do you know where the other residents of Odaiba were taken?
_3049.ReservedText: No, there isn’t. You don’t need to worry… But what’s that green monster behind you...? Are you by any chance allied with those demon-like monsters...? I thought you saved us, but… are we being taken somewhere else...?

_3050.Title: Big Sight
_3050.Description:
I see… Since you saved us, we’ll trust you…!
We’re not entirely sure. All we know is that we came down those stairs with the others and ended up locked in here… I’m afraid I don’t know where the other residents are either…
_3050.CompletionSummary:
I see… Understood… You must’ve been terrified being kidnapped… but it’s such a relief that you’re safe.
We’ll protect you from now on. Don’t worry!

_3051.Title: Big Sight
_3051.Description: What should we do now? Should we head back up to the plaza?
_3051.Objective: Move to Big Sight - Plaza Talk to Jake
_3051.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Big Sight - Plaza%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Jake%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3051.CompletionSummary: There are Gotsumon and Soulmon here… It feels like there are more of them now than when we came earlier… Must be my imagination, right?
_3051.ReservedText:
Yeah, that sounds like a good idea… We’ve rescued everyone who was brought here, after all.
Plus, there are still many people to save in the plaza…
Shall we head to the plaza?

_3052.Title: Big Sight
_3052.Description: Gotsumon? Soulmon? Are you talking about those ghost-like Digimon?
_3052.CompletionSummary: I see… So they’re not that strong? Then we should be able to buy some time…!
_3052.ReservedText:
Yes, that’s right! The ghost-like one is Ghostmon, and the ghost-like one wearing a hat is Soulmon!
They’re not particularly strong, but there are a lot of them, so they’re tricky Digimon to deal with.

_3053.Title: Big Sight
_3053.Description:
We’ll buy you some time so your friend can recover… If they’re not too strong, we’ll take on those ghost creatures ourselves!
It’d be tough barehanded, but if we use tools from around here, we should be able to handle them to some extent! You’ve done so much to help us, so we should return the favor a little…!
Now, let’s search for some tools to fight those ghost Digimon! There should be something useful around here!
_3053.CompletionSummary: Alright! This should do! Looks like we’ve found some useful tools!

_3054.Title: Big Sight
_3054.Description:
Residents! These kids saved us from danger! As adults, we must repay them properly!
These kids and their friend are exhausted. They can’t keep fighting like this… Now is the time for us to help them!
Those who have received their help, grab these tools and let’s take down those ghost monsters! Let’s go, everyone!
_3054.CompletionSummary: Seems like we’ve defeated quite a few ghost-type Digimon! Maybe we can even aim to escape from this Big Sight?

_3055.Title: Big Sight
_3055.Description:
좋아! 계획대로 되고 있어! 하지만 아직 피로를 풀기에는 시간이 턱없이 부족해! 좀 더 시간을 벌어야겠어!
여러분! 저희의 공격이 통하는 것 같습니다! 저희가 저 아이들에게 도움이 될 수 있게 조금만 더 힘을 내서 좀 더 많이 저 유령 괴물들을 해치우도록 하죠!
_3055.CompletionSummary: 제법 유령 디지몬들을 많이 해치운 것 같아! 잘하면 이 빅사이트에서 탈출까지도 노려볼 수 있을 것 같은데?

_3056.Title: Big Sight
_3056.Description: Excuse me! Over there, people are trapped in that prison! It looks very dangerous! Please, save them!!!
_3056.Objective: Talk to Jake Move to Big Sight - Saw Ornament
_3056.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Jake%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Big Sight - Saw Ornament%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3056.CompletionSummary: W-what…? That huge black dinosaur…? A tank, a demon, and a dinosaur… Am I dreaming right now…?
_3056.ReservedText: What did you say? This is serious! Guys! There are people trapped over there, let’s go quickly!

_3057.Title: Big Sight
_3057.Description: Kids! We can’t keep fighting any longer! I’ll draw their attention! In the meantime, you take the residents and escape! Hurry! Quickly! Don’t dawdle!
_3057.ReservedText: This guy… what’s he scheming? DarkTyrannomon! Take care of that man, get rid of him!

_3058.Title: Big Sight
_3058.Description: Lilymon! Protect the old man from that ugly black dinosaur!
_3058.CompletionSummary: We’ve purified the evil virus that was controlling DarkTyrannomon with the power of flowers! It’s no longer our enemy~

_3059.Title: Big Sight
_3059.Summary: One Hour Ago - Battle with Myotismon
_3059.Description: Mina! Stay with Sora and the old man for a while! I’ll hold off Myotismon!!
_3059.Objective: Move to Big Sight Hall (Receive Summoning Card) Defeat Myotismon (Replace Summoning Card)

_3060.Title: Big Sight
_3060.Description: Myotismon… I’ve found the 8th Digidestined child… I’ve captured them and they’re currently held at our base… Wouldn’t it be a good time to return now…?
_3060.CompletionSummary: Yes! Understood! Lord Myotismon! I will follow your orders!
_3060.ReservedText:
Really? Well done… As expected, you’re the only one I can count on… Good… Let’s head back now… Heh heh heh…
PicoDevimon! I’ll deal with the people here slowly after I return. In the meantime, put them all to sleep...

_3061.Title: Big Sight
_3061.Summary: One Hour Ago - Power of the Crests
_3061.Description: What… what’s this…? I’m suddenly feeling so sleepy… falling… asleep… Zzz…

_3062.Title: Big Sight
_3062.Description: What’s going on? Why is everyone lying down, asleep? And wasn’t Myotismon supposed to be here? But there’s no sign of him or his minions.
_3062.CompletionSummary: Mimi! You’re safe! You’re not hurt, right?

_3063.Title: Big Sight
_3063.Description:
Hikari being captured must mean something’s happened to Matt and Sora as well! The kids are in serious danger!
We need to hurry! Mina, you come too! Agumon! Digivolve! We need to rush to Fuji TV!
_3063.Objective: Move to Path to Big Sight

_3064.Title: Odaiba
_3064.Description: Where are you going on your own, Matt? Tai and Mina will be here soon! Why aren’t you waiting for them? Where exactly are you going?
_3064.CompletionSummary: Don’t blame yourself too much… Matt…
_3064.ReservedText: Ahhh!! I couldn’t keep my promise to Tai! I promised him I’d protect Hikari... But I failed! And yet, how can I just sit here waiting so calmly? At this rate, I won’t be able to face Tai!

_3065.Title: Odaiba
_3065.Description: Huff… I can’t wait anymore! I’ll go find Nari by myself if I have to! I can’t just leave her alone like that!
_3065.CompletionSummary: I... I see… Thank you for offering to help…
_3065.ReservedText: Then I’ll go too! Matt, don’t try to take responsibility for everything on your own! I also failed to protect Hikari…

_3066.Title: Odaiba
_3066.Description: Alright, Matt, calm down now, and let’s go rescue Hikari!
_3066.Objective: Move to Odaiba Square Talk to Gabumon
_3066.CompletionSummary: Yeah! Sora! We’d better be careful! Someone’s here in this place!
_3066.ReservedText: Matt! Be careful! I’ve got a bad feeling about this!

_3067.Title: Odaiba
_3067.Description: Y-Yeah… I feel like someone’s watching us… It’s… scary… something’s not right…
_3067.CompletionSummary: Let’s evolve first! There’s definitely something here! If we don’t evolve and stay like this, we’ll just get taken down! Gabumon, evolve!
_3067.ReservedText: Don’t worry, Sora! I’ll make sure to protect you no matter what!

_3068.Title: Odaiba
_3068.Description:
It’s a Digimon, as expected! That Digimon is called Sealsdramon! It moves at an incredible speed, so stay sharp!
Garudamon! I’ll handle Sealsdramon, so take care of Matt, Sora, and Lilymon!
_3068.CompletionSummary:
Alright! Seems like we've defeated them all! Good job, WereGarurumon!
Let's go rescue Kari again!

_3069.Title: Odaiba
_3069.Description:
워가루몬! 조심해! 그 녀석들뿐만 아니라 뒤에 실즈드라몬이 더 나타났으니까 말이야!
가루다몬! 우리는 릴리몬을 데리고 알아서 잘 숨어있을테니까 워가루몬을 도와줘! 워가루몬 혼자서는 추가로 더 나타난 실즈드라몬까지 상대하기는 힘들 것 같아! 가루다몬이 워가루몬을 도와서 실즈드라몬들을 해치워 줘!
_3069.CompletionSummary:
좋았어! 모두 해치운 것 같은데? 잘했어! 워가루몬!
다시 나리를 구하러 가자!

_3070.Title: Odaiba
_3070.Description:
Matt! Not yet! Another Digimon has appeared!
It’s Yaksamon! Just like Sealsdramon, Yaksamon is incredibly fast, so be careful!
I’ll take care of Yaksamon, so stay hidden near Garudamon!
_3070.CompletionSummary: Good! We got them all! Now let's move!

_3071.Title: Odaiba
_3071.Description:
아까 다 해치운 줄 알았던 실즈드라몬들이 다시 몰려오고 있어! 저 녀석들 도대체 몇 마리나 있는 거야?
아무튼! 방심하지 말고 저 디지몬들이랑 싸워서 해치워버리자! 가루다몬 숫자가 너무 많으니까 워가루몬을 도와줘! 이번엔 안전하게 숨어있을테니까!
_3071.Objective: 실즈드라몬 행동대장 처치 야차몬 행동대장 처치
_3071.CompletionSummary: 이런…팬텀몬이나 묘티스몬과 싸우기도 전에 상처가 많이 생기겠어…어떻게 하면 좋지…?

_3072.Title: Odaiba
_3072.Description:
이러면 될 것 같아! 매튜! 저 디지몬들이 가지고 있는 무기들을 모조리 빼앗는거야! 그러면 공격할 수단이 없으니까 가루다몬과 워가루몬이 다칠 일이 없을 거야!!
그렇지?? 좋아! 가루다몬! 워가루몬! 실즈드라몬과 야차몬의 무기를 전부 빼앗아 버리자!
_3072.Objective: 실즈드라몬들을 처치하여 실즈드라몬의 단검 획득 야차몬들을 처치하여 야차몬의 목검 획득
_3072.CompletionSummary: 좋아~ 무기 수거 끝~! 이제 안전하게 싸울 수 있게 됐어!

_3073.Title: Odaiba
_3073.Description: How was it? An idea not so bad? I think WereGarurumon and Garudamon will not be injured anymore fighting this way~!
_3073.CompletionSummary: I see it, Sora. I guess it's working!

_3074.Title: Odaiba
_3074.Description:
WereGarurumon! Garudamon! The remaining armies of SealsDramon and Yashamon must be eliminated! They can call their reinforcements again if we keep them alive!
Let's finish them all and go save Hikari!
_3074.Objective: Defeat SealsDramon(Army Captain) Defeat Yashamon(Army Captain) Defeat SealsDramon(Captain) Defeat Yashamon(Captain)
_3074.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat SealsDramon(Army Captain)%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Yashamon(Army Captain)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat SealsDramon(Captain)%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Yashamon(Captain)%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3074.CompletionSummary:
You've done well, WereGarurumon! Garudamon, you too!
Now, let's move on to next area!

_3075.Title: Odaiba
_3075.Description:
Let’s head to Fuji TV! Phantomon was headed toward Fuji TV and… I’m also worried about my dad…
Actually, my dad is at Fuji TV right now… But of all places, Phantomon…
_3075.Objective: Talk to Sora Move to Fuji TV Front Gate
_3075.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Sora%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Fuji TV Front Gate%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3075.CompletionSummary: Matt? What are you doing here? Why didn't you stay hidden there…!
_3075.ReservedText: Really? Then we need to hurry! Let’s move quickly!

_3076.Title: Odaiba
_3076.Description: Dad… it’s a long story, but… I ended up here because of some unforeseen events…!
_3076.CompletionSummary: Matt and Sora! You're both here!
_3076.ReservedText: Well… you’re someone who usually handles things well on your own, so there must have been no other choice…

_3077.Title: Odaiba
_3077.Description: But who is that Digimon? It’s my first time seeing it. Is it one of Myotismon’s minions?
_3077.CompletionSummary: So, what are you going to do?
_3077.ReservedText: You’ve been hit by Myotismon’s Chains of Darkness… You’ve lost control!

_3078.Title: Odaiba
_3078.Description: Kids… take care of those Digidestined brats interfering with us!
_3078.Objective: Defeat Okuwamon (Replace Summoning Card) Defeat Groundramon (Replace Summoning Card)
_3078.CompletionSummary: This is payback for getting in our way earlier!! You evil Digimon!

_3079.Title: Odaiba
_3079.Objective: Talk to Matt's Dad Move to Fuji TV Rooftop
_3079.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Matt's Dad%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Fuji TV Rooftop%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3079.ReservedText: I’ll lead the way! Everyone, follow me!

_3080.Title: Odaiba
_3080.Description:
Myotismon! You’ve obstructed the mission of the Digidestined, invaded the real world, tormented countless people, and even took Wizardmon’s life… Do you realize the gravity of your sins?
Prepare yourself, Myotismon! We’ll shatter your evil ambitions!
_3080.ObjectiveProgress: Summoning Item for Myotismon Given %qs1Defeat Myotismon%qe %cc1/%mc1

_3081.Title: Odaiba
_3081.Description: Yes!! We’ve finally defeated Myotismon!! Wait, what’s happening??
_3081.Objective: Talk to Sora Move to Fuji TV Front Gate
_3081.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Sora%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Fuji TV Front Gate%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3081.CompletionSummary: Now that we’ve defeated him, there shouldn’t be any more danger, right? But what are you guys doing? Is something wrong?
_3081.ReservedText: This place looks like it’s going to collapse! Let’s get down quickly!

_3082.Title: Odaiba
_3082.Description: Look up, Matt! The fog is still there…! It’s not clearing!!
_3082.CompletionSummary: Defeating Myotismon alone won’t resolve this situation?? Do we need another plan?
_3082.ReservedText: What? It really is! What’s going on here?

_3083.Title: Odaiba
_3083.Description:
Hold on! We’ve got an email from the Whitebearded Guru! I’ll read it!
‘Kids! Rejoice! I’ve discovered an ancient prophecy that can help defeat Myotismon! The prophecy goes like this:
“First, a swarm of bats covered the sky. Then, countless people chanted the name of the Zombie Digimon King. When the clock struck the devil’s number, the Zombie Digimon King revealed its terrifying true form! And when angels shot arrows of light and hope at the most precious person of the one they protect, a miracle occurred.”
That’s the prophecy. Good luck to you all.’
But honestly, I have no idea what this prophecy means…
_3083.CompletionSummary: Brother, let’s hurry to where Mom and Dad are… I’m worried…
_3083.ReservedText: What on earth are you talking about?? I have no idea…

_3084.Title: Odaiba
_3084.Description: Alright, Hikari! Let’s head straight to Big Sight!
_3084.Objective: Talk to Hikari Move to Big Sight Plaza
_3084.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Hikari%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Big Sight Plaza%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3084.CompletionSummary: What’s this?? Everyone is still asleep…!?

_3085.Title: Big Sight
_3085.Description: Tai~! You’re already here! Izzy and Mimi are here too~!
_3085.CompletionSummary: Ah, it's my brother! Ahhh~! What’s going on? Why is everyone lying down here?
_3085.ReservedText: Huh? Who’s the person next to you?

_3086.Title: Big Sight
_3086.Description: It’s because of Myotismon’s spell… Even though we’ve defeated Myotismon, his power still lingers… Why aren’t they waking up yet? What if something’s gone wrong…
_3086.CompletionSummary: Alright, got it… Let me take a look.
_3086.ReservedText: Shin! You’re a med student, right? Can you check on the people?

_3087.Title: Big Sight
_3087.Description: Stop it, Mom! Don’t say Myotismon’s name!!
_3087.CompletionSummary: Is this the prophecy Whitebearded Guru mentioned…?
_3087.ReservedText: Why are people acting so scary??

_3088.Title: Big Sight
_3088.Description: What on earth is going on right now?
_3088.ReservedText: Everyone’s physically asleep. So you could say this is just sleep-talking…

_3089.Title: Big Sight
_3089.Description: Let’s use my car! I’ll get you to Fuji TV as fast as possible!
_3089.ReservedText: Ah! What’s that? Is it Myotismon?

_3090.Title: Big Sight
_3090.Description: We have to hurry! There’s no time to waste standing around! Get in quickly!
_3090.Objective: Move to Path to Big Sight Talk to Matt's Dad
_3090.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Path to Big Sight%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Matt's Dad%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3090.CompletionSummary: Seeing it up close… it’s utterly horrifying…

_3091.Title: Odaiba
_3091.Description: Let’s go, Gabumon! It’s our time to shine!

_3092.Title: Odaiba
_3092.Description: Tai! Matt! We’ll handle things here with WereGarurumon! You head back to Big Sight and plan your next move!
_3092.CompletionSummary: Alright! Got it! Let’s do it! MetalGreymon! WereGarurumon!

_3093.Title: Odaiba
_3093.CompletionSummary: Think about it! Tai! There are tens of thousands of Odaiba residents at Big Sight! How are we supposed to move all those people?
_3093.ReservedText: Izzy?? Why are you saying it’s not possible?

_3094.Title: Odaiba
_3094.Description: Hikari! T.K.! Tell Angemon and Angewomon to shoot their arrows at me and Matt!
_3094.CompletionSummary:
We’ll never die! Don’t worry about us!
The prophecy has been right so far, so this one will be too! So, Angemon’s Arrow of Hope and Angewomon’s Arrow of Light, shoot them at us!!
_3094.ReservedText: No! Brother!! That’s too dangerous!! You could die!!

_3095.Title: Odaiba
_3095.Description: Got it! Shoot, Angemon! Angewomon! Shoot the Arrows of Light and Hope at our brothers!
_3095.Objective: Use Arrow of Light on Tai Use Arrow of Hope on Matt
_3095.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use Arrow of Light on Tai%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use Arrow of Hope on Matt%qe %cc2/%mc2

_3096.Title: Odaiba
_3096.Description: Agumon… Gabumon… they’ve both digivolved…! With this power, we might just be able to stop VenomMyotismon! WarGreymon! MetalGarurumon! This is the final battle! Let’s defeat VenomMyotismon!!
_3096.CompletionSummary: Finally!! We finally defeated VenomMyotismon!! Now the real world should be safe!!

_3098.Title: Odaiba
_3098.Description: Guys~! The fog is finally clearing~! Look~! Wait, what’s that in the sky?
_3098.CompletionSummary: We’re… going to save the Digital World again!

_3099.Title: Odaiba
_3099.Description: Myotismon! You've not only disturbed the mission of DigiDestine, but invaded Real World, attack more than thousands of innocent people, and now you've even attacked Wiardmon. You should be aware of your sins?
_3099.CompletionSummary:
Give up, Myotismon!
Your errant ambition will be shattered completely!

_3100.Title: Odaiba
_3100.Description: Agumon and Gabumon has newly evolved! This can bring us the possibility to stop VenomMyotismon!
_3100.CompletionSummary: WarGreymon! MetalGarurumon! This will be the final move! Let's put a period to VenomMyotismon and make him history!

_3101.Title: Odaiba
_3101.Description: Myotismon! You've not only disturbed the mission of DigiDestine, but invaded Real World, attack more than thousands of innocent people, and now you've even attacked Wiardmon. You should be aware of your sins?
_3101.CompletionSummary:
Give up, Myotismon!
Your errant ambition will be shattered completely!

_3102.Title: Odaiba
_3102.Description: Agumon and Gabumon has newly evolved! This can bring us the possibility to stop VenomMyotismon!
_3102.CompletionSummary: WarGreymon! MetalGarurumon! This will be the final move! Let's put a period to VenomMyotismon and make him history!

_3103.Title: <Tutorial>
_3103.Description: What's going on? Are you okay? You scared me! Oh, you think you saw the strong-looking Digimons? Huh... Pull yourself together! Do you even remember what I just said? I will tell you one last time, listen carefully! Our Dats Center is tasked with protecting citizens from realized Digimons and returning the Digimons to the digital world. It sounds simple and easy, but every time you do a mission, you'll be filled with all sorts of hardships and hardships. And from now on, you're going to take a test to become a Dats Agent. But before that, we can't take a test without any preparation, right? I prepared something for you, who probably didn't prepare anything!
_3103.CompletionSummary: PawnChessmonB, the one that I asked earlier. is the thing ready?

_3104.Title: <Tutorial>
_3104.Summary: As a Dats Agent - Item Scan
_3104.Description: Our Dats Agent is on various and deadly missions. And Dats Center never stop researching for better methods for complete the mission. You can expect something spectacular from the high-quality technique. Now, talk to PawnChesspmonB with this item for [Scan].
_3104.CompletionText: All the Dats Agent must know about this. Please memorise this and do not forget it. If you able to do same as tool tip, there will be no problem.
_3104.CompletionSummary: You'll need a variety of items because you sometimes have to go to Digital World when you're on a mission. Most of these items are made by analyzing data from the DATS Center by scan and research. So many Tamers tried hard to achieve this. I'm sure this [Item Scan] will be a great help during your mission.

_3105.Title: <Tutorial>
_3105.Summary: As a Dats Agent - Hatch Digimon
_3105.Description: Not only the item but also select the partner digimon well is contribute to successful way to complete the mission. Every digimon have different status to other side. Therefore, agent need to be very careful to choose the right digimon as a partner. How to find partner digimon? not that hard. now, you see this item? bring that to the inqubater and try to [Hatch] the digimon.
_3105.CompletionText: meeting new partner always exciting. If there is any difficulties, try follow the tool tip.
_3105.CompletionSummary: Hows your new Partner? Do you like it?

_3106.Title: <Tutorial>
_3106.Description: Now, that's all I can tell you, but there's still one more thing you need to learn. I just think it would be better to hear it from the person who made it than me. Go see Dr.Yushima who made this. He has been watching how you do it, so you'll find him soon.
_3106.CompletionText: Dr.Yushima knows the best. He also very important person in Dats Center.
_3106.CompletionSummary: How do you like the present? Hope you like it! With this Digivice, we people lean on to you and your partner Digimon for Peace in this world. I will give you information about Digivice. The Digivice is one of my masterpieces that the equipment which helps Tamer and Partner Digimon's Friendship deeper and stronger. Furthermore, Tamer can register the special skills to help the Partner Digimon, and finally, the mission can be delivered. Don't you think this is magnificent?
_3106.ReservedText: Welcome! Asking for Digivice? Ok, I was about to see you, with the gift! This is the tool that helps Tamer and Partner's Friendship deeper. With this, Tamer can train them to be stronger, and to register the skills, and to carry many Digimon at once.

_3107.Title: <Tutorial>
_3107.Description: To become a Dats Agent, you have to go through a period of apprenticeship and pass the Dats Centers Test. Of course, the test is not for anyone to take, and the acceptance rate is very low, so don't let go of the tension and concentration! Well, there's not much time left before the test starts. Mary's waiting for you for the exam on the way. Go see Mary.
_3107.CompletionText: All the Best. Hope you can do well in the test.
_3107.CompletionSummary: Hum, Hum! Now we are going to start the Dats Agent Test. Examiners, please prepare!
_3107.ReservedText: Welcome! Are you ready for the test?

_3108.Title: <Tutorial>
_3108.Description: This test is aimed at finding out and defeating Digimon, which is messing up Yokohama Elementary School's breeding grounds. Dats Center already analyzed what Digimon is, but as a rookie, you don't know what kind of Digimon it is. Dats Agent needs to be able to make quick and accurate judgments about the targets. From now on, it is your duty to collect information of Digimons that appear near Yokohama Elementary School. It is a very important task for the Dats Agent and for the Dats Centers. So take it seriously.
_3108.CompletionText: The test itself is dangerous. So, you gonna be careful!
_3108.CompletionSummary: It was surprisingly fast, wasn't it?

_3109.Title: <Tutorial>
_3109.Description: Digimon found near Yokohama Elementary School is Kunemon, Rookie Digimon. However, the Dats Centers concluded that there is a possibility of evolution due to the energy gained from the attack on the Yokohama elementary school breeding ground. Digimon is dangerous in itself, but the risks of evolution are beyond description! Now, your test and mission are to get rid of the Kunemon that appeared at Yokohama Elementary School as well as the Digimon that evolved from Kunemon.
_3109.CompletionText: I'm sure you will do it well.

_3110.Title: <Tutorial>
_3110.Description: I didn't expect to solve the case at Yokohama Elementary School this soon. I thought you were Dats Agent. Well, I was surprised! Anyway, I think you can look forward to having a good point! All right, let's get ready for the next test. Miki will brief you on the next exam. You know how to find Miki, right?
_3110.CompletionText: Gool luck for the next test!
_3110.CompletionSummary: Welcome back, but don't lose your tension. My mission make you feel Kunemon's a pretty tricky digimon.

_3111.Title: <Tutorial>
_3111.Description: There are Digimons that are openly attacking like Kunemon, and Digimons that hide and secretly influence others like the ones involved in this case. This is an incident in which an older boxer is continuing his winning streak in a row, apparently due to Digimon's involvement. There's nothing clear about it, so we need to gather information to solve the case, right? I've confirmed there's someone connected to that boxer nearby. Try to collect information from him.
_3111.CompletionText: Don't act like a baby. You are on a test.
_3111.CompletionSummary: Why would a kid like you know that? Get out of here!

_3112.Title: <Tutorial>
_3112.Description: What? Well, if your fan of ours, then it is a different story. But I can not tell you everything to a stranger. What if you are a spy!? Hmm... I will think about it if you do me a favor. Can you buy Cold Water for our boxing club? my old whole body aches all the time. others very busy with training... I will answer you after you bring me Cold Water. Use these coins for exchange Cold Water at the Vending Machine. Bring me 10 Cold Water.
_3112.Objective: Buy Cold Water from Vending Machine Talk to Vending Machine
_3112.CompletionText: Hmm. what a hassle... Ah! What are you doing?
_3112.CompletionSummary: Good. You've done this much for me, you do deserve the answer. Well, our player is a little old. But he has enough experience. So he can win most games.
