Recently, however, his opponents' boxers either failed to maintain their physical condition or lost the game for no reason. There were problems with colds, inability to concentrate on the game and almost illness. Well, we're happy because we're lucky. Even if we want the other person to be in bad shape, yet we actually can't make him feel sick. It's just luck.

_3113.Title: <Tutorial>
_3113.Description: Maybe our player is a little old, but also he has experience. So he can win most games. Recently, however, his opponents' boxers either failed to maintain their physical condition or lost the game for no reason. There were problems with colds, inability to concentrate on the game and almost illness. Well, we're happy because we're lucky. Even if we want the other person to be in bad shape, yet we actually can't make him feel sick. It's just luck. Do you satisfied with my answer?
_3113.CompletionSummary: Great! You've collected quite an information!?
_3113.ReservedText: So What kind of Information did you get?

_3114.Title: <Tutorial>
_3114.Description: All right. I've got some rough information, so I'll let you know. The target is a Digimon called Togemon. The needles in Togemon's body contain poison that causes all kinds of illnesses. But the real problem is the types of venom are hard to make an antidote! And also Togemon never missed the target! This kind of case is usually helped by humans. But whether we know we're digging up information like this, there's been an increase in the presence of Togemon around here. First, we need to get rid of Togemon, reduce the number, and make an antidote, so we need you to collect Togemon's Needle.
_3114.Objective: Defeat Togemon Collect the Niddle of Togemon
_3114.CompletionText: First, try reduce the number of Togemon.
_3114.CompletionSummary: Very good. I'm very surprised that your not a skilled Dats Agent! I think I can trust you for sure.

_3115.Title: <Tutorial>
_3115.Description: I've already sent the needles to the Dats Center for an Antidote. And this case is clearly caused by Minnie, the daughter of Hayase Harris, and her partner Togemon. During the research, we found out that Minnie's clothes ripped a bit. For now, most of Togemon is defeated, now all we need to do is erase the memory about this case with relevant people. Don't forget! Citizens must not know about the Digimon. It could cause a chaotic situation. Use this Memory Erasing Device to Hayase Harris and Minnie. Go talk to Harris about the situation, and delete the memory of Digimon.
_3115.Objective: Bring Memory Control Device to Hayase Harris
_3115.ReservedText: May I help you? What is wrong with my daughter?

_3116.Title: <Tutorial>
_3116.Description: So by the way. Why are you asking this to me?
_3116.CompletionSummary: Well done! Info is not enough to solve the problem, but you remarkably done your job. So based on what we've shown so far, u will easily complete.. Huh? Wait! Newbie! Wait a second!

_3117.Title: <Tutorial>
_3117.Description: As a DAT Member, the most important mission is to prevent embodied Digimon from causing damage to reality! Would like to show us what talents you have? Defeat Elecmon and Gabumon(Black) that appears on the Road!
_3117.CompletionSummary: What? Have you ever trained before? You are very skillful. Great job!

_3118.Title: <Tutorial>
_3118.Description: Phew, thanks to the newcomer coming in on time, I'm pretty sure the situation has settled, but... Oh, it's really bad. The Elecmon here is almost done, but the real problem is that the early Elecmon which got away. Plus, this Digimon, he's been eating a lot of electric power from the telephone pole and evolving it. Thanks to you, this place is now organized, but the problem is the evolved Garurumon(Black). First, I'm gonna clean this place up and I'm gonna go after you. Can you get rid of Garurumon(Black) first?
_3118.CompletionText: I hope there are no damages!

_3119.Title: <Tutorial>
_3119.Description: You handled this situation really well. It's not easy for a rookie to be this good at battle! I was really impressed. Well, enough of the small talk, are you ready for the next test? If you are alright, go to Miki! She will kindly explain.
_3119.CompletionText: Why these things happen during the test day…
_3119.ReservedText: I heard that you did a great job!?

_3120.Title: <Tutorial>
_3120.Description: The next case is to defeat the Drimogemon which helped the Bank robbers. Cooperating with the bank was a bit sensitive matter... I didn't realize that only half of the plan completed. Enough nagging. from now on, you need to defeat Drimogemon. be careful, they are very strong!

_3121.Title: <Tutorial>
_3121.Description: Well... we didn't expect this... But, I guess some of Drimogemon here seems to be evaluated very soon. we need to return them to the digital world by defeating them before too late. Other Agents are busy to support now... Oh! Can you help me with this? Beware! It will be very strong compared to other Drimogemons!
_3121.CompletionSummary: Great!! I really surprised this time!

_3122.Title: <Tutorial>
_3122.Description: Hugh... I'm sick and tired of thinking that so many Drimogemon could have evolved. But I'm glad it ended well. We were supposed to get rid of Drimogemon like this and prepare the bank robbers to erase their memories and hand them over to the police, but we couldn't help it because we weren't so prepared. There's a lot of events going on in this test. Anyway, good job! We are almost at the end of the exam, so try your best! You can go ahead with the next test by Mary, who is waiting near the building in the harbor.
_3122.CompletionSummary: But I hope this doesn't make you so proud! We still have a lot of tests left!
_3122.ReservedText: There are lots of rumor of you that you are doing great!

_3123.Title: <Tutorial>
_3123.Description: Digimons always appear in dangerous places that can cause great casualties. Just like DemiMeramon, a Digimon that's lit by a gas plant. Especially, DemiMeramon has the characteristics of proliferating if there is any remaining fire, so you need to defeat them as soon as possible. Now, all you have to do from now on is defeat the DemiMeramon and let them get away from the gas plant little by little. Can you do it?
_3123.CompletionText: This could cause critical damage to people. Be careful.

_3124.Title: <Tutorial>
_3124.Description: Oh, no! The DemiMeramon felt threatened and combined to evolve into Meramon! DemiMeramon is much stronger than Meramon! You really have to be careful about that strength. And also, Meramons are near the factory, so we should hurry up and defeat them before they get too close to the factory! What are you doing? Please go get rid of him! As a Dats Agent, you have a duty to respond when Digimon shows up at any critical moment, so come on! Get them out of here!
_3124.CompletionText: I'm not very happy to see such a fussy Digimon's realize.
_3124.CompletionSummary: There are too many DigiEggs to send back to the digital world.

_3125.Title: <Tutorial>
_3125.Description: Anyway, the case closed! well done! but we must respond immediately whenever Digimon realized into the real world. Even if you are having a break time. I wish you keep this in mind and become a great Dats Agent. Anyhow... wow so many DigiEgg of DemiMeramon...When are we able to return this massive quantity... in this case, Dats Agent's duty to clean the mess up, yet you are on the test. But you don't need to worry. 'Actual Dats Agent' will do what they need to do. Please go to Miki, she's preparing the next test for you.
_3125.CompletionText: That's great. If it stays like this…
_3125.CompletionSummary: I've been nagging you, but I'm embarrassed because you're so good.
_3125.ReservedText: I can't even nag about your work!

_3126.Title: <Tutorial>
_3126.Description: The paranormal activities can sometimes be caused by Digimon. Just like now. This was done by Soulmon, who turned a ship into a ghost ship. However, we don't have much information about Soulmon, so we also need to collect information. Even if it's a little spooky and scary, try scanning the Soulmon with the item I'm giving it now! Are you asking me to do it? Well, I'm not scared, but I don't have anything to do with the test. Seriously!
_3126.CompletionText: A Ghost… I am not afriad!

_3127.Title: <Tutorial>
_3127.Description: Now that we've got some information, why don't we take care of the realized Soulmon now? Anyway, this is how it looks, and people think it's a ghost, so this ship is nicknamed a ghost ship. It's a bit different, but somehow, Soulmon analyzed data showed that the Digimon is the Champion Digimon. It's a very strong and dangerous Digimon, so we have to defeat them. First of all, it's obvious that it could be a threat to people, so take care of it as soon as possible.

_3128.Title: <Tutorial>
_3128.Description: You seem taking this pretty easy. It looks small, but the Dats Agent has to deal with it without considering the importance of the mission. Even the smallest and the weakest-looking Digimon has enough power to damage people. Well, shall we go to the next test? Mary prepared for the next exam. This test may be the final one, but it's probably a pretty big one at Dats Center. The difficulty is, well, maybe you can look forward to it. Anyway, you should go to see Mary.
_3128.CompletionText: Phew… Ah! I'm not afraid of ghost! Really!
_3128.ReservedText: Hey! I just heard that the test is over. And you are here already? Don't you think you are too passionate about this?

_3129.Title: <Tutorial>
_3129.Description:
Now, this test is to catch people who have a negative influence on the real world through Digimon. The suspect in this test is G.Neon! First, we need to investigate whether there are any suspicious circumstances about G.Neon. If you approach blindly, you may be suspicious, so buy a drink from the vending machine next to you and go talk to him! Here's the money to buy drinks!
A good DAT Member must be good at battle, but also good at research! Cheer up!
_3129.Objective: Find a Vending Machine Buy Drink Find G.Neon
_3129.CompletionText: G.Neon! Suspicious, but he is awusome!
_3129.CompletionSummary:
Huh? Drinks? My fan? So surprised. How did you know I was taking a walk at this hour?
Because I'm a bit popular. If I don't go for a walk secretly like this, I won't be able to move properly because of the crowds of paparazzi and fans. So, I only sneak out every now and then to get some fresh air, but you caught me.
You are very doubtful. And my partner is telling me you're not my fan. So, thank you for the drinks, but this is where the conversation ends. Just disappear now.

_3130.Title: <Tutorial>
_3130.Description: G.Neon's partners have good sense, but seems impatient. A lot of Keramon and Chrysalimon have appeared near the fountain! It's lucky that these friends who were suspected of being G.Neon's partners showed up like this! So! Let's start a mission! Please stop these two from causing harm to the real world!
_3130.CompletionSummary: Wow~ you have a great fighting skills? I didn't believe it when I heard it, but..

_3131.Title: <Tutorial>
_3131.Description: G. Neon's running away. That's a deduction! Anyway, as G. Neon ran away, lots of Keramon realized at once. Maybe he didn't want to hide it, or does he think his plan has gone to some extent already? Don't you think he is too confident? Anyone who abuses Digimon in this way may be punished severely, but first, we need to arrest G.Neon. You should defeat the realized Keramon first. It's too many Digimon to pass. Chasing? Your seniors will take care of that.

_3132.Title: <Tutorial>
_3132.Description: The Keramon that was attached to G.Neon evolved into a Chrysalimon. They seem to have collected enough data while manipulating the music charts. G.Neon has already been pursued and arrested by your seniors, so you must first defeat the evolved Chrysalimon here.
_3132.CompletionSummary: Hum, Hum! We now announce that the Final Exam has finished!

_3133.Title: <Tutorial>
_3133.Description: Tell you the truth, G.Neon accepted our request for cooperation and helped us with this test. How was it? Was it real? Anyway, I think the test ended well. I'm looking forward to it personally because I think it's a great achievement for a rookie, but I think it's possible for a higher person to be negative. But I'm sure you can be a Dats Agent. Now, go see Dr.Yushima. He will let you know the final result.
_3133.CompletionSummary: Good Job. I've been watching you afar. It was great.

_3134.Title: <Tutorial>
_3134.Description: You did a good job. Our judges watched from afar the calmness of not being embarrassed by the sudden incident, the courage to approach an object that cannot be clarified, and, above all, to keep citizens safe. The result was unanimous! Congratulations! You've finally become a real Dats Agent. Now that you've become a Dats Agent, you need to see the captain who picked you up, right? Go to Dats Center and visit Captain Richard Sampson.
_3134.CompletionText: Huhuhu. You must be very happy! Well, what are you waiting for~ Go on~

_3135.Title: <Tutorial>
_3135.Description: I have a gift for you who's become a Dats Agent with excellent grades. Please accept this and continue for hard work to ensure peace between the Real-world and the Digital world. I look forward to working with you.
_3135.CompletionSummary: I hope you like the gift. Well, If your not busy, shall we talk about the mission?

_3136.Title: <Tutorial>
_3136.Description: I feel sorry for the fact that I'm assigned you a difficult task as soon as you become a Dats Agent, but I hear that the cause of the incident continues to happen in the digital world. However, it takes a really long time to investigate, and we can't put in a lot of people, and sometimes Digimon has become a realize more often, so I think you need to go to the Digital World and do some research that has proven your ability through tests. I'm asking you because the risks of the digital world can affect the real world enough. Now, this is a Time Dimension Bomb which will drag you to a place called Lake Silver in the Digital World, and you can use it to go to Silverlake and meet Agumon. According to our research, it's Agumon that's closest to the threat that's taking place in the digital world right now. Go and collaborate with the Digimon to conduct the investigation.
_3136.CompletionText: I'm sorry to give you this kind of situation, but I'm sure you'll do well.

_3137.Title: <Tutorial>
_3137.Summary: As a Dats Agent - Crafting Item
_3137.Description: DATS agents are carrying out really diverse and dangerous missions. One of the essential part for DATS agent is crafting. Now, from now on, you will learn how to make essential items for agent. Talk to Digitamamon with the item obtained from scanning and ask him to [craft] this item.
_3137.CompletionText: This crafting training is also for you! So, you need to train more meticulously!
_3137.CompletionSummary: Like scanning, Crafting is a great help when performing missions. Most of these items can be crafted at DATS Center to keep missions running smoothly. Digitamamon helped a lot, and others put in a effort to create this technology. [Craft Item] will help you complete your mission perfectly.

_3138.Title: Minato City
_3138.Description:
Damn! Those Syakomon just do not quit! When did Myotismon gather so many followers? Does he have some connections that I am not aware of?
For Gatomon's sake, we need to reduce the number of Myotismon's underlings! Let us take care of Syakomon gathered there!
_3138.CompletionText: These Syakomon… are really coming after us in waves…!
_3138.CompletionSummary: Did we get them all at last..? I hope they do not pop up anymore…!

_3139.Title: Minato City
_3139.Description:
There are Gesomon still remaining...? I honestly have no idea where that huge number of Gesomon came from… If we do not get rid of them now, they will get in Gatomon's way…
Let us finish them off fast!
_3139.Objective: Defeat Gesomon Defeat Gesomon (Army Captain) Defeat Gesomon (Captain)
_3139.CompletionSummary: Have we defeated them all…? I do not wish to see more of Gesomon…!

_3140.Title: Minato City
_3140.Description:
For Myotismon to have so many underlings… I was not expecting this…
Gesomon's legs and heads we gathered just now would not be enough…
Looks like we need to gather more of those. Gatomon's share as well…!
_3140.Objective: Defeat Gesomon to obtain Gesomon's Leg Defeat Gesomon to obtain Gesomon's Head
_3140.CompletionText: Gonna take some effort to cook with this amount.
_3140.CompletionSummary: I guess this is enough? Hope Gatomon likes it…

_3141.Title: Minato City
_3141.Description:
Damn… was our final touch not good…? It is back again… Its size matches its regenerative capability, I see…
Fine, I will finish it off for good this time!
_3141.Objective: Defeat Gesomon (Captain) 20ea to cause Gesomon (White Demon of Deep Sea) to spawn Defeat Gesomon (White Demon of Deep Sea)
_3141.CompletionText: I will finish it off for good this time…!
_3141.CompletionSummary: Huff…Huff… is it over now?? Do not ever get back up again… Please…!

_3142.Title: Minato City
_3142.Description:
Came back to steal Digivice from me again? How persistent…
I need to get rid of them and leave this place soon…! Sticking around longer would only bring more trouble…!
_3142.Objective: Defeat Flybeemon Defeat Flybeemon (Army Captain) Defeat Flybeemon (Captain)
_3142.CompletionText: That is a large number of Flybeemon…
_3142.CompletionSummary: Did I get them all..? Gotta get moving then…

_3143.Title: Minato City
_3143.Description:
Are they here to take revenge on me, for defeating Witchmon...? If it were just my problem, I would have let them take me, but since this concerns Gatomon as well, I can't do that.
I need to defeat all of Witchmon and return to Gatomon…!
_3143.Objective: Defeat Witchmon Deafeat Witchmon (Army Captain) Defeat Witchmon (Captain)
_3143.CompletionText: Such a great number of Witchmon…!
_3143.CompletionSummary: I am sorry Witchmon… I will make sure to pay for this later…

_3144.Title: Minato City
_3144.Description:
Oh! Now that I remember, I heard Witchmon uses magical tools that enhance her magical prowess…
Hmm… perhaps I could use those tools in preparation for battle against Myotismon…?
I should get those magical tools from Witchmon..
_3144.CompletionText: I hope the magical tools are effective…
_3144.CompletionSummary: Hmph… they don't seem too useful to me…

_3145.Title: Minato City
_3145.Description: Gatomon! Swimmon are chasing us to retrieve the key..! There is an alarming number of them…!
_3145.Objective: Talk to Gatomon Defeat Swimmon Defeat Swimmon (Army Captain)
_3145.CompletionText: Gatomon, if it is with you..!
_3145.CompletionSummary: Seems like we got them all, Gatomon..! Let us move on from this place…!
_3145.ReservedText: They might be a lot, but they are just Rookie Digimon! Let's beat them quickly, Wizardmon!

_3146.Title: Minato City
_3146.Description: Gatomon…! How about we fill our stomach before we move on? Full stomach will make everything easier… I heard dish made of Swimmon can fill you up pretty well…
_3146.Objective: Talk to Gatomon Defeat Swimmon to obtain Fresh Fish
_3146.CompletionText: Gatomon, if it is for you..!
_3146.CompletionSummary: We got quite a good number of them. Please wait awhile, Gatomon. I will cook and serve in a moment..!
_3146.ReservedText: It is an urgent situation indeed, but you make a good point, Wizardmon..! Very well, let us hurry!

_3147.Title: Minato City
_3147.Description: Gatomon! Watch out..! It's Tylomon…! They are still around… They are all that remain but still in a large number… Seems like the only option is to fight our way through…
_3147.Objective: Talk to Gatomon Defeat Tylomon Defeat Tylomon (Army Captain) Defeat Tylomon (Captain)

_3147.ReservedText: Guess you are right… No other way around it, Wizardmon! Let's beat those Tylomon, and don't let your guard down!

_3148.Title: Minato City
_3148.Description: Gatomon…! It's the huge Tylomon we saw just now…. I guess our final touch was not good enough.. It seems to have recovered while we were fighting against the leftovers..!

_3148.CompletionText: Gatomon, if it is with you..!
_3148.CompletionSummary: Such a persistent fellow… Gatomon…! We managed to defeat it somehow… Are you hurt anywhere…? If you are ok, let us leave this place at once…!
_3148.ReservedText: That seems to be the case, Wizardmon…! It's the same creature we beat just now! Let's combine our efforts and defeat that Tylomon once again…!

_3149.Title: Minato City
_3149.Description:
Agumon! It's the Toucanmon bunch! They seem to be really pissed off. Looks like they have no intention of letting us get to Gatomon!
So let's kick their butt and find Gatomon!
_3149.Objective: Talk to Agumon Defeat Toucanmon Defeat Toucanmon (Army Captain) Defeat Toucanmon (Captain)
_3149.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Agumon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Toucanmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Toucanmon (Army Captain)%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Toucanmon (Captain)%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3149.CompletionText: Gatomon! Wizardmon! Hold on just a little bit more!
_3149.CompletionSummary: Good job, Agumon! Looks like we got them all!
_3149.ReservedText: I got it, Taichi! Leave it to me!

_3150.Title: Minato City
_3150.Description:
Taichi! I got this idea while I was fighting against Toucanmon: Toucanmon's bill is sharp enough to hurt me, and its shell was hard enough to withstand my attack!
So, what if I use Toucanmon's beaks and shells? Pretty good idea, huh?
_3150.Objective: Talk to Taichi Defeat Toucanmon to obtain Toucanmon's Bill Defeat Toucanmon to obtain Toucanmon's Shell
_3150.CompletionText: Is this right? Gatomon! Wizardmon! Hold on just a little bit more!
_3150.CompletionSummary: Hmm… This doesn't seem right, Taichi…
_3150.ReservedText: That is a pretty good idea, Agumon!! Shall we collect their bill and shell?

_3151.Title: Minato City
_3151.Description: Agumon! It's the big Toucanmon we saw just now!! We didn't finish it off well! Did it get back up while we were fighting against the other Toucanmon??

_3151.CompletionText: Gatomon! Wizardmon! Hold on just a little bit more!
_3151.CompletionSummary: Good job, Agumon! Looks like we finished it off for good!
_3151.ReservedText: That is so! Taichi! Let me Digivolve! I make sure to finish it off for good!

It is tiring but for Gatomon's sake, we need to reduce the number of Myotismon's underlings!

_3165.Title: Minato City
_3165.Description: Let's go, MetalGreymon! Let's take this opportunity to beat Myotismon once and for all!
_3165.CompletionSummary: MetalGreymon seems unable to exert himself… He must not have recovered from his last fight yet… Pull yourself together, Agumon!

_3166.Title: Big Sight
_3166.Description:
Guys! Those gun-toting monsters are back again! Are there supposed to be this many of such monsters? I honestly can't figure out where those monsters come from!
In any case, let us quickly deal with those mosters to save the kidnapped people!
_3166.CompletionText: Where in the world did those fearsome creatures come from…
_3166.CompletionSummary: Great job, everyone! How impressive! I hope no more of those monsters appear again…

_3167.Title: Big Sight
_3167.Description:
Guys! It's the tank-like monsters again! Thought we got rid of all of them, but looks like I was wrong!
Now this time, let us quickly deal with those mosnters to save the kidnapped people!
_3167.Objective: Defeat TankDramon Defeaet TankDramon (Army Captain) Defeat TankDramon (Captain)
_3167.CompletionText: Where in the world did those fearsome creatures come from…
_3167.CompletionSummary: Great job, everyone! You guys are really amazing! You defeated all those frightening tank-like monsters! You guys seen worn out… I hope no more of such monsters appear again…

_3168.Title: Big Sight
_3168.Description:
Oh no! Breaking one barrier has caused a massive outbreak of those demonic Digimon! They must be here to interfere with our attempt to break the barriers!
Everyone! It seems like we need to defeat all those monsters if we were to save the kidnapped people! So please, defeat those demonic Digimon!
_3168.CompletionText: Where in the world did those demonic creatures come from…
_3168.CompletionSummary: You have defeated all those hideous Digimon… You have done well, children! I hope no more of such monsters appear to interfere with our work to break the barriers…

_3169.Title: Big Sight
_3169.Description:
Oh no! Ghost-like Digimon are back again! You guys can rest for a while more! We willl handle this!
Everyone! Let us chase away those ghostly creatures so that these children can rest more!
_3169.CompletionSummary: Phew~ Looks like we chased away a lot of those ghostly Digimon!

Oh no! They just do not know when to quit! Stupid ghosts… you guys can just sit back! We willl handle this!
