_3174.Title: Big Sight
_3174.Description: Lilymon! Protect him from that ugly, dark dinosaur!
_3174.CompletionSummary: I eliminated the evil virus that was controlling DarkTyrannomon with the power of flowers! It is no longer our enemy~

_3175.Title: Big Sight
_3175.Description: Mimi! Go somewhere safe with Sora and mister! I will handle Myotismon!

_3176.Title: Odaiba
_3176.Description:
Ah! Look over there, MetalGreymon! WereGarurumon(Black) are coming back again!
There are still more of them remaining? We gotta get to Big Sight asap… We don't have a choice!
MetalGreymon! Let's take care of these guys at once!
_3176.CompletionText: Arhh…. Gotta get to Big Sight soon…
_3176.CompletionSummary: Good job, MetalGreymon!! Let's get to Big Sight now!

_3177.Title: Odaiba
_3177.Description:
Ah! More WereGarurumon(Black)!! Just how many of them are out there?
We have to get to Big Sight now, but Myotismon's lackeys are…!
MetalGreymon! We can't lose any more time here! Let's take care of those guys and move onto Big Sight!
_3177.CompletionText: Stop showing up to bother us, WereGarurumon(Black)!! We don't have time for you!
_3177.CompletionSummary: Good, MetalGreymon!! Let's hurry to Big Sight!

_3178.Title: Odaiba
_3178.Description:
You guys, did you really take care of WaruMonzaemon? Look over there~ There are still so many of them~
Didn't ya say you're gonna stop Myotismon? Isn't this more like helping him, not stopping him?
Go and get those WaruMonzaemon now!
_3178.CompletionText: Good… It's going as I planned…
_3178.CompletionSummary: Hmm…You got all those WaruMonzaemon as I told you to? Okayyy… Good job~

_3179.Title: Odaiba
_3179.Description:
Hold on! You guys, why so sloppy? Look over there~
WaruMonzaemon are still loitering around! I told ya, didn't I, that if you get all those guys, you can stop Myotismon's plan?!
What are you standing around for? Go and beat those guys up!
_3179.CompletionText: A little bit… Just a little bit.. More..!
_3179.CompletionSummary: Hmm… Ya sure ya got all WaruMonzaemon like I told you to? (Giggles) Good kids~ We are doing great~

_3180.Title: Odaiba
_3180.Description:
Hey, you guys… Do you not know how to count? Look here, ya didn't get them all!! 3 are missing!!
3 of them are missing and ya told me ya got them all? Liars! Disgraceful!
The badges ya got just now are NOT counted anymore! So go and get them all again!
_3180.Objective: Defeat WaruMonzaemon (Captain) to obtain WaruMonzaemon Captain's Badge
_3180.CompletionText: Giggles… 3 are actually in my pocket of course~
_3180.CompletionSummary: Huh? Ya really got them all~ Didn't expect you guys to actually do it~ Well, gotta hand it to you guys this time I guess~

_3181.Title: Odaiba
_3181.Description:
Did you think I'd give up? I get you guys, and it's a special promotion for me!!
You better be ready! I will make sure to destroy you guys and earn Myotismon's approval!
_3181.Objective: Defeat WaruMonzaemon(Captain) to spawn WereGarurumon(Black) (Despicable Wolf) Defeat WereGarurumon(Black) (Despicable Wolf)
_3181.CompletionSummary: Think we would let ourselves be beaten by a despicable guy like you? Not a chance!

_3182.Title: Odaiba
_3182.Description:
Look! MetalGreymon! It's Giromons again!
There must have been more of them around! We need to hurry to Big Sight but Myotismon's minions keep getting in our way..!
No other choice then! MetalGreymon!! We'll go through them!
_3182.CompletionSummary:
Great work, MetalGreymon!! Looks like we them all around here!
Now, let's go to Big Sight!

_3183.Title: Odaiba
_3183.Description:
Oh no! There is a huge group of Giromons blocking our way to Big Sight!! Just how many of his underlings did Myotismon bring to the Real World?
Ugh… MetalGreymon, I know it's tough but please stay storng for a bit more! We gotta beat them and get to Big Sight!
Let's go, MetalGreymon!!
_3183.CompletionText: MetalGreymon!! Let's go through them fast!
_3183.CompletionSummary:
Very good, MetalGreymon!! No more Giromons to bother us anymore!
Let's hurry to Big Sight!

_3184.Title: Odaiba
_3184.Description:
MetalGreymon! Seems like the easy way to beat these Giromon, is by stealing their chainsaws like we did just now!
Let's take away their chainsaws to make it hard for them to fight us!
_3184.Objective: Defeat Giromon to obtain Giromon's Chainsaw
_3184.CompletionSummary: Good job, MetalGreymon!! Without their chainsaws, Giromons won't be able to do anything!

_3185.Title: Odaiba
_3185.Description: I am not giving up now! With this bomb, I will bring you guys along with me to hell! You will NEVER! Reach lord Myotismon!
_3185.Objective: Talk to Taichi Defeat Giromon to obtain Bomb
_3185.CompletionSummary:
Great job, MetalGreymon! I really thought we were about to blow up…
You saved us, MetalGreymon!! Let's get to Big Sight now!
_3185.ReservedText: Giromons are trying to blow themselves up with us because they don't have their chainsaws! MetalGreymon! Let's take away their bombs to stop this suicide bombing!

_3186.Title: Odaiba
_3186.Description:
Ah! Look over there, MetalGreymon! Knightmon are coming back again!
There are still more of them remaining? We gotta get to Big Sight asap… We don't have a choice!
MetalGreymon! Let's take care of these guys at once!
_3186.Objective: Defeat Knightmon Defeat Knightmon (Army Captain) Defeat Knightmon (Captain)
_3186.CompletionText: Stop showing up to bother us, Knightmon!! We don't have time for you!
_3186.CompletionSummary: Knightmons are stronger than expected so it's taking a lot of time, Taichi. What can we do to beat them easily?

_3187.Title: Odaiba
_3187.Description:
I have a good idea, MetalGreymon! To easily deal with these endless waves of Knightmons, I think it's best to take away their armors like we did just now!
Let's take away their helmets and armor to make them more vulnerable!
_3187.Objective: Defeat Knightmon to obtain Knightmon's Helm Defeat Knightmon to obtain Knightmon's Armor
_3187.CompletionText: MetalGreymon! Let's be stronger for a bit more!
_3187.CompletionSummary: Good job, MetalGreymon! Now that we took away their helmets and armor, we should be able to beat them easily!

_3188.Title: Odaiba
_3188.Summary: A Knight Does Not Die With Empty Hands.
_3188.Description:
You have taken our pride; our helmet and armor… Unforgivable!
As a knight who serves Myotismon, I cannot allow myself to retun to him empty-handed! I WILL return to him, with your lives and Digivices in my hands!
Prepare yourself!
_3188.Objective: Defeat Knightmon (Captain) 20ea to cause Knightmon (Cavalry Lord) to spawn Defeat Knightmon (Cavalry Lord)
_3188.CompletionText: My life for my lord Myotismon..!

_3189.Title: Odaiba
_3189.Description:
The guy we took down just now must have been the boss of Knightmons! Once he fell, their whole army seems to be in disarray! Now is our chance to defeat them altogether!
MetalGreymon! Let's beat those guys once and for all!
_3189.Objective: Defeat Knightmon Defeat Knightmon (Army Captain) Defeat Knightmon (Captain)
_3189.CompletionText: Let's beat these Knightmon quick and get to Big Sight, MetalGreymon!
_3189.CompletionSummary:
Great job, MetalGreymon! Looks like we got them all around this area!
Now, to Big Sight!

_3190.Title: Odaiba
_3190.Description:
Ah! More Cerberumon!! Just how many of them are out there?
We have to get to Big Sight now, but Myotismon's lackeys are…!
MetalGreymon! We can't lose any more time here! Let's take care of those guys and move on to Big Sight!
_3190.CompletionText: We don't have time to waste here…
_3190.CompletionSummary: Dang it..! If we get out of here, we could get to Big Sight right away,,, But those Cerberusmon caught up with us..!

_3191.Title: Odaiba
_3191.Description:
With this kind of persistence, they will chase us all the way to Big Sight for sure… That will mean putting the residents in Big Sight area in danger!
We can't let that happen so we gotta take care of these Cerberusmon here! Let's break a leg, MetalGreymon!
Let's get them all and move on to Big Sight
_3191.CompletionSummary:
Good job, MetalGreymon!! Seems like all the Cerberusmon around here are taken care of!
Now, to Big Sight!

_3192.Title: Odaiba
_3192.Description:
Oh no… More SealsDramon are on the way!
They must be the stragglers! We have to go and save Hikari fast…
WereGarurumon! Garudamon! Let's take their daggers away like we did just now!
_3192.Objective: Defeat SealsDramon to obtain SealsDramon's Dagger
_3192.CompletionText: Hikari…! Just hold on a little longer…! I will save you!
_3192.CompletionSummary: Matt! We took all of their daggers!

_3193.Title: Odaiba
_3193.Description: Good, WereGarurumon! We took them by surprise by stealing their daggers. Now is our chance! Let's defeat those guys once and for all!
_3193.Objective: Defeat SealsDramon Defeat SealsDramon (Army Captain) Defeat SealsDramon (Captain)
_3193.CompletionSummary:
Great work, WereGarurumon!! Seems like we got all SealsDramon around here!
Let's go to save Hikari now!

_3194.Title: Odaiba
_3194.Description:
Matt! Yaksamons are back again! There must have been more of them around! We have to go and save Hikari but Myotismon's minions continue to show up to stop us…
No choice then! We have to beat them all and get going! Garudamon! Let's take their weapons as we did just now!
_3194.Objective: Defeat Yaksamon to obtain Yaksamon's Wooden Sword
_3194.CompletionText: Hikari, we will be right there! Hold on a little more!
_3194.CompletionSummary: Sora! We took all of their wooden swords! What do we do now?

_3195.Title: Odaiba
_3195.Description:
Good job, Garudamon! Now we can take them down!
Garudamon! Let's defeat all Yaksamon around here!
_3195.Objective: Defeat Yaksamon Defeat Yaksamon (Army Captain) Defeat Yaksamon (Captain)
_3195.CompletionSummary:
Well done, Garudamon!! Seems like we defeated all of Yaksamon that popped up!
Let's go and save Hikari now!

_3196.Title: Odaiba
_3196.Description:
Ah! Look over there, MetalGreymon! WereGarurumon(Black) are coming back again!
There are still more of them remaining? We gotta get to Big Sight asap… We don't have a choice!
MetalGreymon! Let's take care of these guys at once!
_3196.CompletionText: Arhh…. Gotta get to Big Sight soon…
_3196.CompletionSummary:
Are we done with them at last..? Good job, MetalGreymon!! Let's get to Big Sight now!
Hope those WereGarurumon(Black) don't pop up anymore..!

_3197.Title: Odaiba
_3197.Description:
Ah! More WereGarurumon(Black)!! Just how many of them are out there?
We have to get to Big Sight now, but Myotismon's lackeys are…!
MetalGreymon! We can't lose any more time here! Let's take care of those guys and move onto Big Sight!
_3197.CompletionText: Stop showing up to bother us, WereGarurumon(Black)!! We don't have time for you!
_3197.CompletionSummary:
Are we done with them at last..? Good job, MetalGreymon!! Let's hurry to Big Sight now!
Hope those WereGarurumon(Black) don't pop up anymore..!

_3198.Title: Odaiba
_3198.Description:
You guys, slacking off, aren't ya? Look over there~ There are still so many of WaruMonzaemon~
How are ya gonna stop Myotismon's plan like this? Ya sure you want to stop him?
Go and get those WaruMonzaemon now!
_3198.CompletionText: Good… It's going as I planned…
_3198.CompletionSummary: Hmm…You got all those WaruMonzaemon as I told you to? Okayyy… Good job~

_3199.Title: Odaiba
_3199.Description:
Hold on! You guys really want to disappoint me like this? Look over there~
WaruMonzaemon are still loitering around! I told ya, didn't I, that if you get all those guys, you can stop Myotismon's plan?!
What are you standing around for? Go and beat those guys up!
_3199.CompletionText: A little bit… Just a little bit.. More..!
_3199.CompletionSummary: Hmm… Ya sure ya got all WaruMonzaemon like I told you to? (Giggles) Good kids~ We are doing great~

_3200.Title: Odaiba
_3200.Description:
Huh? Weird… The numbers don't add up again!! 3 of them are missing again!
You guys lied to me again so the badges ya got so far are NOT counted anymore! So go and get them all again!
_3200.Objective: Defeat WaruMonzaemon (Captain) to obtain WaruMonzaemon Captain's Badge
_3200.CompletionText: Giggles… 3 are actually in my pocket of course~
_3200.CompletionSummary: Huh? Ya really got them all~ Didn't expect you guys to actually do it~

_3201.Title: Odaiba
_3201.Description:
Did you think I'd give up? I get you guys, and it's a special promotion for me!!
You better be ready! I will make sure to destroy you guys and earn Myotismon's approval!
_3201.Objective: Defeat WaruMonzaemon(Captain) to spawn WereGarurumon(Black) (Despicable Wolf) Defeat WereGarurumon(Black) (Despicable Wolf)
_3201.CompletionSummary: Think we would let ourselves be beaten by a despicable guy like you? Not a chance!

_3202.Title: Odaiba
_3202.Description:
Look! MetalGreymon! It's Giromons again!
There must have been more of them around! We need to hurry to Big Sight but Myotismon's minions keep getting in our way..!
No other choice then! MetalGreymon!! We'll go through them!
_3202.CompletionSummary:
Great work, MetalGreymon!! Looks like we them all around here!
Now, let's go to Big Sight!

_3203.Title: Odaiba
_3203.Description:
Oh no! There is no end to these Giromons!! Just how many of his underlings did Myotismon bring to the Real World?
Ugh… MetalGreymon, I know it's tough but please stay storng for a bit more! We gotta beat them and get to Big Sight!
Let's go, MetalGreymon!!
_3203.CompletionText: MetalGreymon!! Let's go through them fast!
_3203.CompletionSummary:
Very good, MetalGreymon!! No more Giromons to bother us anymore!
Let's hurry to Big Sight!

_3204.Title: Odaiba
_3204.Description:
MetalGreymon! Seems like the easy way to beat these Giromon, is by stealing their chainsaws like we did just now!
Let's take away their chainsaws to make it hard for them to fight us!
_3204.Objective: Defeat Giromon to obtain Giromon's Chainsaw
_3204.CompletionSummary: Good job, MetalGreymon!! Without their chainsaws, Giromons won't be able to do anything!

_3205.Title: Odaiba
_3205.Description: I am not giving up now! With this bomb, I will bring you guys along with me to hell! You will NEVER! Reach lord Myotismon!
_3205.Objective: Talk to Taichi Defeat Giromon to obtain Bomb
_3205.CompletionSummary:
Great job, MetalGreymon! I really thought we were about to blow up…
You saved us, MetalGreymon!! Let's get to Big Sight now!
_3205.ReservedText: Giromons are trying to blow themselves up with us because they don't have their chainsaws! MetalGreymon! Let's take away their bombs to stop this suicide bombing!

_3206.Title: Odaiba
_3206.Description:
Ah! Look over there, MetalGreymon! Knightmon are coming back again!
There are still more of them remaining? We gotta get to Big Sight asap… We don't have a choice!
MetalGreymon! Let's take care of these guys at once!
_3206.Objective: Defeat Knightmon Defeat Knightmon (Army Captain) Defeat Knightmon (Captain)
_3206.CompletionText: Stop showing up to bother us, Knightmon!! We don't have time for you!
_3206.CompletionSummary: Knightmons are stronger than expected so it's taking a lot of time, Taichi. What can we do to beat them easily?

_3207.Title: Odaiba
_3207.Description:
I have a good idea, MetalGreymon! To easily deal with these endless waves of Knightmons, I think it's best to take away their armors like we did just now!
Let's take away their helmets and armor to make them more vulnerable!
_3207.Objective: Defeat Knightmon to obtain Knightmon's Helm Defeat Knightmon to obtain Knightmon's Armor
_3207.CompletionText: MetalGreymon! Let's be stronger for a bit more!
_3207.CompletionSummary: Good job, MetalGreymon! Now that we took away their helmets and armor, we should be able to beat them easily!

_3208.Title: Odaiba
_3208.Summary: [Daily] A Knight Does Not Die With Empty Hands.
_3208.Description:
You have taken our pride; our helmet and armor… Unforgivable!
As a knight who serves Myotismon, I cannot allow myself to retun to him empty-handed! I WILL return to him, with your lives and Digivices in my hands!
Prepare yourself!
_3208.Objective: Defeat Knightmon (Captain) 20ea to cause Knightmon (Cavalry Lord) to spawn Defeat Knightmon (Cavalry Lord)
_3208.CompletionText: My life for my lord Myotismon..!

_3209.Title: Odaiba
_3209.Description:
The guy we took down just now must have been the boss of Knightmons! Once he fell, their whole army seems to be in disarray! Now is our chance to defeat them altogether!
MetalGreymon! Let's beat those guys once and for all!
_3209.Objective: Defeat Knightmon Defeat Knightmon (Army Captain) Defeat Knightmon (Captain)
_3209.CompletionText: Let's beat these Knightmon quick and get to Big Sight, MetalGreymon!
_3209.CompletionSummary:
Great job, MetalGreymon! Looks like we got them all around this area!
Now, to Big Sight!

_3210.Title: Odaiba
_3210.Description:
Ah! More Cerberumon!! Just how many of them are out there?
We have to get to Big Sight now, but Myotismon's lackeys are…!
MetalGreymon! We can't lose any more time here! Let's take care of those guys and move on to Big Sight!
_3210.CompletionText: We don't have time to waste here…
_3210.CompletionSummary: Dang it..! If we get out of here, we could get to Big Sight right away,,, But those Cerberusmon caught up with us..!

_3211.Title: Odaiba
_3211.Description:
With this kind of persistence, they will chase us all the way to Big Sight for sure… That will mean putting the residents in Big Sight area in danger!
We can't let that happen so we gotta take care of these Cerberusmon here! Let's break a leg, MetalGreymon!
Let's get them all and move on to Big Sight
_3211.CompletionSummary:
Good job, MetalGreymon!! Seems like all the Cerberusmon around here are taken care of!
Now, to Big Sight!

_3212.Title: Odaiba
_3212.Description:
Oh no… More SealsDramon are on the way!
They must be the stragglers! We have to go and save Hikari fast…
WereGarurumon! Garudamon! Let's take their daggers away like we did just now!
_3212.Objective: Defeat SealsDramon to obtain SealsDramon's Dagger
_3212.CompletionText: Hikari…! Just hold on a little longer…! I will save you!
_3212.CompletionSummary: Matt! We took all of their daggers!

_3213.Title: Odaiba
_3213.Description: Good, WereGarurumon! We took them by surprise by stealing their daggers. Now is our chance! Let's defeat those guys once and for all!
_3213.Objective: Defeat SealsDramon Defeat SealsDramon (Army Captain) Defeat SealsDramon (Captain)
_3213.CompletionSummary:
Great work, WereGarurumon!! Seems like we got all SealsDramon around here!
Let's go to save Hikari now!

_3214.Title: Odaiba
_3214.Description:
Matt! Yaksamons are back again! There must have been more of them around! We have to go and save Hikari but Myotismon's minions continue to show up to stop us…
No choice then! We have to beat them all and get going! Garudamon! Let's take their weapons as we did just now!
_3214.Objective: Defeat Yaksamon to obtain Yaksamon's Wooden Sword
_3214.CompletionText: Hikari, we will be right there! Hold on a little more!
_3214.CompletionSummary: Sora! We took all of their wooden swords! What do we do now?

_3215.Title: Odaiba
_3215.Description:
Good job, Garudamon! Now we can take them down!
Garudamon! Let's defeat all Yaksamon around here!
_3215.Objective: Defeat Yaksamon Defeat Yaksamon (Army Captain) Defeat Yaksamon (Captain)
_3215.CompletionSummary:
Well done, Garudamon!! Seems like we defeated all of Yaksamon that popped up!
Let's go and save Hikari now!

_3216.Title: Odaiba
_3216.Description: My servants, take care of those meddlesome children!

_3217.Title: Odaiba
_3217.Description:
Myotismon! You have interfered with the mission of the DigiDestined, invaded the Real World, casued great amount of pain to countless people, and even took Wizardmon's life… You are aware of the gravity of your sins, aren't you?
Prepare yourself, Myotismon! We shall destroy that vile ambition of yours!

_3218.Title: Odaiba
_3218.Description: Agumon… Gabumon… they have evolved anew! With these powers, they might be able to stop VenomMyotismon! WarGreymon! MetalGarurumon! This is our last chance! Let's get VenomMyotismon!!
_3218.CompletionSummary: At last!! We beat VenomMyotismon at last!! Our world will be safe now!

_3219.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3219.Description:
The situation seems to be getting more serious… I don't have good feelings about this.
There are too many people too… How do we get to Odaiba??
_3219.CompletionText: Uhh… Need to meet up with the others quick..
_3219.ReservedText: Don't worry, Joe! We can cross this ocean if I Digivolve and carry you guys!

_3220.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3220.Description: T.K.! What are you doing here? Weren't you with Matt?
_3220.CompletionText: Being with T.K. puts me at ease a bit…
_3220.CompletionSummary: I think so too. We gotta meet up with the others and do something…
_3220.ReservedText:
No, I was with my mom, but not with Matt.
By the way, I've seen the news and it looks like things have gotten worse. What do you think, Joe?

_3221.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3221.Description: We need to go to Odaiba but we are stuck here because of the fog and Myotismon's minions…
_3221.CompletionText: If nothing else, Gomamon's idea will have to do…
_3221.CompletionSummary:
Right. As Gomamon said, him becoming Ikkakumon and carrying us on his back to Odaiba seems to be our only option…
Ah! Is that?? Myotismon's minions? Oh no! Gomamon, Digivolve!
_3221.ReservedText: I see… Matt, Taichi and others must have gotten to Odiba already! Joe, how do we get there?

_3222.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3222.Description:
There are so many of Myotismon's minions! Where are they all coming from??
Could it be that they're trying to stop us from crossing this ocean and reaching Odaiba?
I hope not… In any case, let's get those guys!
_3222.Objective: Defeat Syakomon Defeat Syakomon (Army Captain) Defeat Gesomon Defeat Gesomon (Army Captain)
_3222.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Syakomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Syakomon (Army Captain)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Gesomon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Gesomon (Army Captain)%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3222.CompletionText: How did they know that we are here??
_3222.CompletionSummary: Phew… Looks like we are done with them… Did anybody get hurt?

_3223.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3223.Description:
Joe! It's no time to relax yet!! Myotismon's minions are coming again!
We have to meet up with Matt and the others as quickly as possible, so we need to beat them fast!
_3223.Objective: Defeat Gesomon (Army Captain) Defeat Gesomon (Captain) Defeat Gesomon (White Demon of Abyss)
_3223.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Gesomon (Army Captain)%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Gesomon (Captain)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Gesomon (White Demon of Abyss)%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3223.CompletionSummary: Joe! Are you ok? It looks like Myotismon's minions are no longer around!

_3224.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3224.Description:
T.K.! Watch out! Myotismon's minions are flying towards us now!
There is a large number of them but It's not too bad. If we met them while we were on the ocean, it would have been very dangerous!
Let's take them down here and get to Odaiba, T.K.!
_3224.Objective: Defeat FlyBeemon Defeat FlyBeemon (Army Captain) Defeat FlyBeemon (Captain)
_3224.CompletionSummary:
Good! Now, for REAL! We got them all!
Let's hurry, T.K.!

_3225.Title: Rainbow Bridge
_3225.Description: Now that Myotismon's minions are all gone… (Gulp) Shall we go to Odaiba?

_3227.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3227.Description: Everybody… Came back… You really are Mimi…
_3227.ReservedText: Chuumon! What happened? And what about Sukamon?

_3228.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3228.Description: That must be one of the Dark Masters! Everybody! Let's Digivolve to defeat that guy, and save the Digital World!
_3228.CompletionSummary: Oh no! MetalSeadramon is a Mega-level Digimon! We outnumber him 8 to 1 but we don't stand a chance in Champion-level!

_3229.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3229.Description: At this rate we migth los… Argh!
_3229.CompletionSummary: How could this be… All of us…

_3230.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3230.Description: Glad I made it in time, pi! Listen carefully now, pi! You children are not prepared to fight the Dark Masters yet, pi! There are 8 of you gathered but that's not enough, pi! Unfortunately, there is no time to explain in detail, pi! I will buy you some time so quickly escape, pi!
_3230.CompletionText: You guys are our last hope, pi! You HAVE TO survive, pi!
_3230.CompletionSummary: Piximon is right… The only ones who can save the Digital World, are us.

_3231.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3231.Description: Piximon is holding them back but there will be pursuit. According to my data-based calculations, there is a group of Dokugumon nearby. Snimon is a very aggressive and vicious Digimon. There is possibility that Dokugumon might be working for the Dark Masters so we have to defeat them.
_3231.CompletionSummary: Digimons that were not visible are suddenly starting to reveal themselves. As expected, the Dark Masters must have sent them after us!

_3232.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3232.Description: The group of Dokugumon does not seem to be diminishing at all. We need to defeat more of them.
_3232.CompletionText: Is there any other way? We can't let Piximon's sacrifice be in vain.
_3232.CompletionSummary: Whew… This is a difficult situation.

_3233.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3233.Description: There are just too many of Dokugumon here. We need to get out of here fast. Everyone, let's continue into the forest!
_3233.CompletionSummary: Seems like the Dark Masters beat us to it… So many Digimons here…

_3234.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3234.Description: Not just Snimon, but now, Kuwagamon and Okuwamon are starting to appear as well… They are not fighting Dokugumon so it's safe to assume that they are all working for the Dark Masters… To make it out of here safely, we have to beat them. Okuwamon seems to be giving the orders to the rest, so we havae defeat Okuwamon first. Okuwamon will appear when 10 of Kuwagamon are defeated so defeat Kuwagamon first.
_3234.CompletionText: There are too many of them…
_3234.CompletionSummary: This doesn't bode well. We have to move.

_3235.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3235.Description: Their number is not getting smaller at all. To ensure our safe escape, we have to defeat more of them. Okuwamon will appear when 10 of Kuwagamon are defeated so defeat Kuwagamon first.
_3235.CompletionText: There are too many of them…
_3235.CompletionSummary: Whew… Wish we could move from here safely.

_3236.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3236.Description: There are simply too many Digimons around here. Trying to deal with them might attract unnecessary attention to us. For now, since there are many trees around, camouflaging ourselves in the woods is a better idea. Defeat Woodmon around here and please gather some branches!
_3236.CompletionText: The Dark Masters are worryingly powerful…

_3237.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3237.Description: There are not enough tree branches to cover all of us… We need to gather more!
_3237.CompletionText: The Dark Masters are worryingly powerful…
_3237.CompletionSummary: Good… I hope we can pass through here undetected.

_3238.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3238.Description: As Izzy said, we are in a tight spot. But we can't let Piximon's sacrifice be in vain.

_3239.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3239.Description: We can't just stay here. For now, let's try to go through the path with many trees!
_3239.CompletionText: It's difficult, but let's focus on one thing at a time.
_3239.CompletionSummary: Whew… We have to move in deeper from here.

_3240.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3240.Description: Ready? Let's be careful not to split up.
_3240.CompletionSummary: Desert? … No. It smells like the ocean. There must be an ocean nearby.

_3241.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3241.Description: Seems like the Dark Masters have sent their minions here too. Let's talk to Izzy first.
_3241.CompletionText: To overcome this challenge, we have no choice but to become stronger.
_3241.CompletionSummary: We might have to force our way through here.
_3241.ReservedText: There are many dangerous elements around here as well.

_3242.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3242.Description: First, let's deal with this group of Betamon. They seem to be minions of the Dark Masters so we have to prevent them from gathering intelligence about us.
_3242.CompletionText: Betamon is… Rookie-level Digimon before eventually becoming MetalSeadramon…

_3243.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3243.Description: There are still many Betamon remaining. We don't have much time but to ensure our safety, we have to clean up the rest!
_3243.CompletionText: Betamon is… Rookie-level Digimon before eventually becoming MetalSeadramon…
_3243.CompletionSummary: It will be a bit safer now.

_3244.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3244.Description: We dealt with that bunch of Betamon so we have to hurry now. Since we are all tired and hungry, we have to find somewhere safe. Let's continue to move into the forest!
_3244.CompletionText: I'm anxious. The Dark Masters might come up behind us any moment.

_3245.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3245.Description: Guys, don't be fooled! That's Shellmon!! And since he attempted to trick us from the beginning, he must have gotten an order from the Dark Masters! We have to deal with him quick!
_3245.CompletionSummary: Hm… Is this what Piximon talked about?

_3246.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3246.Description: Shellmon is back again! If we don't deal with him quick, we might get in trouble.
_3246.CompletionText: I want to rest for awhile…. What do we do if hostile Digimons continue to attack us?
_3246.CompletionSummary: Looks like all minions of the Dark Masters are dangerous Digimons.

_3247.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3247.Description: Our Digimon friends are tired, but…
_3247.CompletionSummary: Hey, hasn't it suddenly become hot here?

_3248.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3248.Description: Let's talk to Izzy first. We might all collapse under this weather.
_3248.CompletionText: Whew… The hot weather is draining me too.
_3248.CompletionSummary: Dark Masters… I wonder when they'd stop chasing us…

_3249.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3249.Description: Let me give you the details. I was looking around and found some Digimons who looked like minions of the Dark Masters. They seemed to be searching for something; I assume they are looking for us. It will do us no good if they spot us so let's take them out one by one. First, let's defeat Syakomon to secure some space to move about.
_3249.CompletionText: So many aquatic-type Digimons… They all might be MetalSeadramon's minions…

_3250.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3250.Description: More and more Syakomon are coming so we have to beat them back. Let's try to be sneaky, and take them out without causing a ruckus.
_3250.CompletionText: So many aquatic-type Digimons… They all might be MetalSeadramon's minions…

_3251.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3251.Description: Next up, it's Seadramon. All these aquatic-type Digimons are likely to be working for MetalSeadramon… For improved mobility, we have to defeat them!
_3251.CompletionText: He's got tons of minions following him.
_3251.CompletionSummary: Now, shall we move to find somewhere we could rest?

_3252.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3252.Description: The number of Seadramon is even greater than that of Syakomon… There is just no end to them. Looks like we have to defeat more of them to ensure our safety. And please, please, make it neat and quiet.
_3252.CompletionText: He's got tons of minions following him.
_3252.CompletionSummary: Now for real, shall we move to find somewhere we could rest?

_3253.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3253.Description: The area seems clear now. Before their reinforcements arrive, let's hurry and move forward.
_3253.CompletionSummary: Look there! Somewhere we could take a break!

_3254.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3254.Description: We might not be able to Digivolve now, but we still need to prepare for fights anywa.. Huh? Scorpiomon is gone?

_3255.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3255.Description: While he is gone, why don't we search for some food? There were tons of clam shells and seagrass scattered around so Scorpiomon must have been feeding on them. Perhaps we can get some if we defeat Syakomon?
_3255.CompletionText: Hope we can feed them quickly so that they can get their strength back.

_3256.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3256.Description: Palmon and Gomamon are back on their feet but they cannot Digivolve yet… Shall we get more food? We already know we can get some from Syakomon so let's go!
_3256.CompletionText: Hope we can feed them quickly so that they can get their strength back.

_3257.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3257.Description: They seem to have recovered somewhat… Now we have to take care of the rest… But Scorpiomon is back. What do we do?
_3257.CompletionSummary: Hey guys! Scorpiomon is here! Get ready!

_3258.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3258.Description: For now, we have to beat Scorpiomon to save the others! We have to fight!

_3259.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3259.Description: At this rate, we are all goners! We need to distract Scorpiomon… Ah! That's right! MetalSeadramon rewarded him with clams! The fact that he wanted clams as a reward means he loves them so much! Could we perhaps use them as a distraction?! Well, for Gomamon and Palmon to Digivolve to their Ultimate forms, they need more energy! No time to hesitate! Let's collect more clams now!
_3259.CompletionText: Need some time until they can Digivolve to Ultimate forms!
_3259.CompletionSummary: Great! We have gathered a bunch!

_3260.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3260.Description: Here! We put all the clams we gathered in this net! Throw this at Scorpiomon to distract him, and buy some time!

_3261.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3261.Description: Great! All Digivolved to their Ultimate forms! We stand a good chance of winning now! No, we WILL win this time! Let's fight again and defeat Scorpiomon for good!
_3261.CompletionSummary: Terrific! Let's go save our friends!

_3262.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3262.Description: Ugh… Scorpiomon is awake again! It might be difficult but our Digimons are still in their Ultimate forms, so we still have a good chance of winning! Let's beat him for good!
_3262.CompletionSummary: Terrific! Let's go save our friends!

_3263.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3263.Description: Let's put this dude in the store! MetalSeadramon will have to deal with him first! Hurry now!
_3263.Objective: Use Captured Scorpiomon at Beachside Store

_3264.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3264.Description: They almost got us… Whew. If it weren't for Joe and Mimi, we might have been in big trouble. For now, we should move before MetalSeadramon notices that we have escaped.
_3264.Objective: Move to Path to the Deeper Forest
_3264.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Path to the Deeper Forest%qe %cc1/%mc1

_3265.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3265.Description: It's MetalSeadramon… We are at a big disadvantage here! Ugh! But we've got to fight now!!
_3265.CompletionSummary: Ugh… He's one powerful enemy but… Agumon! Digivolve!

_3266.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3266.Description: To fight MetalSeadramon, we need to Digivolve to Mega form… Damn! Is there anything around that we can eat quickly? Oh right! This is ocean! Ocean has something like… fishes? That Agumon can eat? We can buy some time in Ultimate form so we gotta find something he can eat. Seadramon might have something!

_3267.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3267.Description: Now! We have Digivolved and we can fight again! This time, let's combine our power and defeat MetalSeadramon!
_3267.CompletionText: He's a really tough enemy but… We can do this!

_3268.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3268.Summary: [Daily] Preparation for Battle against the Ruler of the Ocean
_3268.Description: Agumon Digivolved to WarGreymon… But we still need more power! Everyone, let's combine our power and defeat MetalSeadramon!
_3268.CompletionSummary: We can defeat him for sure!

_3269.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3269.Description: He is extremely strong by himself, and now his minions are here too! But we can't give up now! We have to fight on, to save the Digital World! Now! Let's put all of our strength together to defeat MetalSeadramon!
_3269.CompletionText: He's a really tough enemy but… We can do this!
_3269.CompletionSummary: Awesome! We defeated one of the Dark Masters!

_3270.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3270.Description: He is extremely strong by himself, and now his minions are here too! But we can't give up now! We have to fight on, to save the Digital World! Now! Let's put all of our strength together to defeat MetalSeadramon!
_3270.CompletionText: He's a really tough enemy but… We can do this!
_3270.CompletionSummary: Awesome! We defeated one of the Dark Masters!

_3271.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3271.Description: He is extremely strong by himself, and now his minions are here too! But we can't give up now! We have to fight on, to save the Digital World! Now! Let's put all of our strength together to defeat MetalSeadramon!
_3271.CompletionText: He's a really tough enemy but… We can do this!
_3271.CompletionSummary: Awesome! We defeated one of the Dark Masters!

_3273.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3273.Description: …. Mimi is making graves for those Digimons who sacrificed themselves for us. Help us. Please get us some tree branches that we can use to mark the graves. You can get them from Woodmon.
_3273.CompletionSummary: For their sake, we have to be strong.

_3274.Title: Forest of the Beginning
_3274.Summary: To the forest, to the deeper forest
_3274.Description: The emotions got too intense. I'm sure everyone's tired. But it's still like this, we might get caught by enemies. First, let's go into deeper forest and hide.

_3275.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3275.Description: ..Everyone's tired and their emotions are intense. But an enermy appears again. I don't know whose subordinate he is… We need to fight him off. Let's go and defeat Flymon.
_3275.CompletionText: So many.. I'm tired of it now.
_3275.CompletionSummary: Fortunately, we can still move without being detected.

_3276.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3276.Description: I think there are digimon who ran away after fighting in a tired state. If those digimon let dark masters know, something big may happen. Let's go and defeat Flymon.
_3276.CompletionText: So many.. I'm tired of it now.

_3277.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3277.Description: Hikari, what are you doing there? It's dangerous, so hurry... What is this all of a sudden?
_3277.CompletionSummary: What's going on.. Oh my, it hurts..

_3278.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3278.CompletionSummary: So... Shall we go home then?

_3279.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3279.Description: Shall we start the war game now?
_3279.CompletionSummary: Now, wait a minute! I'll bring a friend soon!

_3280.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3280.Description: I'm glad you're okay! I found objects that teleported us at Puppetmon's Mansion and remote control that moved forest! But I think Puppetmon's took a few! Let's take those items from Mushroomon and Blossomon!
_3280.Objective: Collect a toy doll Collect a toy map Collect a toy remote control
_3280.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect a toy doll%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect a toy map%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect a toy remote control%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3280.CompletionSummary: Good! Found! Tear up this map here and let's go!

_3281.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3281.Description: Um... Looking at these things I brought, I think there are more things that we still deprive. We need to take some more!
_3281.Objective: Collect a toy doll Collect a toy map Collect a toy remote control
_3281.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect a toy doll%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect a toy map%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect a toy remote control%qe %cc3/%mc3

_3282.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3282.Description: Then let's break the map and remote control and go! So that Puppetmon can see it well... We're going to break it in front of Puppetmon's Mansion!
_3282.Objective:
Use a toy map in house of Puppetmon
Use a toy remote control in house of Puppetmon
_3282.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use a toy map%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use a toy remote control%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3282.CompletionText: You suffer as much as you suffer!

_3284.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3284.Description: I think we need to defeat him first! Like Matt said, I don't think he's going to open his mouth, so let's defeat him first and go find T.K.!
_3284.CompletionText: It looks weaker than I thought.

_3285.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3285.Description: Matt disappeared. There's no Gabumon either. It's dangerous if he is alone. The threat of dark masters is not over yet! Let's look around!
_3285.Objective:
Move to Somewhere in the forest -1
Move to Somewhere in the forest -2
Move to Somewhere in the forest -3
_3285.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Somewhere in the forest -1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Somewhere in the forest -2%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Move to Somewhere in the forest -3%qe %cc3/%mc3

_3286.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3286.Description: First... Let's move. Let's go find Matt.

_3287.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3287.Description: We don't have to listen to that! Let's fight!
_3287.CompletionText: I can't lose... I have to be strong.

_3288.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3288.Description: Ugh... It's not over yet! We can win! Let's fight again!
_3288.CompletionText: I can't lose... I have to be strong.

_3289.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3289.Description: Please stop this meaningless fight. I'm not here to fight. I'm here to say something quite tempting.

_3290.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3290.Description: We have to hurry up and find Matt.

_3291.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3291.Description: Those guys... Gerbemon? They shoot poop?! But we can't be beaten by Puppetmon's subordinates! Let's fight!
_3291.CompletionSummary: Ugh... It's dirty, but it's even strong.

_3292.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3292.Description: Those dirty guys... I don't want to fight, but we can't be fooled by Puppetmon's subordinates! Let's fight!
_3292.CompletionSummary: Ugh... It's dirty, but it's even strong.

_3293.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3293.Description: We have so many enemies that we'll get poop all over our body. And if we're attacked byPuppetmon while fighting, it's more dangerous, so let's move somewhere else!

_3294.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3294.Description: .. I'm getting angry. I don't even know why I'm doing this! If you want to fight that much, let's fight!

_3295.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3295.Description: .. You're not tired yet! Are you going to be like this all day? Okay! I'll match you!

_3296.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3296.Description: Are you finally willing to fight?

_3297.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3297.Description: Does he still have no intention of stopping the fight between WarGreymon and MetalGarumon? If you're going to keep fighting, I'm not going to hold it in anymore! Do you want to see the end of the fight?

_3298.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3298.Description: Let's borrow some of your time.

_3299.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3299.Description: Hikari, are you okay? How do you feel? Are you sick or anything?

_3300.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3300.Description: ..So what you was curious about was solved, right?
_3300.CompletionSummary: It's not an easy way, but we have to do it anyway.

_3302.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3302.Description: Something like a meteorite falls over there. Let's go check!

_3303.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3303.Description: ..Ogremon. Is it the Ogremon we know? I think you got hurt a lot. First, let's get herbs and water. Herbs... There's nothing we can do. Woodmon seems to have it, so let's bring some herbs and water from them.

_3304.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3304.Description: But Ogremon is a bit big... Can you help me a little bit? I'll give you a bandage, so if I apply herbs, put it on top.
_3304.CompletionText: If this is the case, I can do it too.

_3305.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3305.CompletionSummary: It's going to be a tough fight.. But!

_3306.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3306.Description: I didn't know Puppetmon would appear here. Let's try our best to do as much as we can! I'm fighting with Puppetmon!

_3307.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3307.Description: They're fighting. Let's run away! You can go into that forest! Let's run away!
_3307.CompletionSummary: That's... You're saying it's Puppetmon's base, right?

_3308.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3308.Description: There are two sentries... There may be more Puppetmon's other men nearby. Let's look around because we can't be surrounded and attacked.
_3308.Objective: Move to Puppetmon's Mansion - Outside Move to Path to Puppetmon's Mansion Move to RedVegimon's Ground
_3308.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Puppetmon's Mansion - Outside%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Path to Puppetmon's Mansion%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Move to RedVegimon's Ground%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3308.CompletionText: It can't be like this. Sometimes we need to attack first.
_3308.CompletionSummary: Hmm... It seems like there's no one around me, right?

_3309.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3309.Description: Then... Let's go attack those guys! We have to take over the base before Puppetmon shows up!
_3309.CompletionText: Ummm... I'm a little worried, though.

_3310.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3310.Description: It's dangerous to go Puppetmon's mansion like that! Because there are other digimon who protect this mansion! If you don't get rid of them, Puppetmon will come soon.
_3310.Objective: Defeat RedVegimon Defeat Mushroomon Defeat Blossomon
_3310.CompletionText: Those guys are the bad guys. Pputti
_3310.CompletionSummary: If I can get revenge on Puppetmon! I like it as much as I want. Pputti!

_3311.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3311.Description: There are more digimon who listen to Puppetmon's orders than you think. This isn't enough! You have to defeat RedVegimon, Mushroomon and Blossomon more to be safe!
_3311.Objective: Defeat RedVegimon Defeat Mushroomon Defeat Blossomon
_3311.CompletionText: Those guys are the bad guys. Pputti
_3311.CompletionSummary: If I can get revenge on Puppetmon! I like it as much as I want. Pputti!

_3312.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3312.Description: Well, I'm sure Puppetmon will come back here. Is there anything to counterattack?
_3312.CompletionSummary: There are a lot of things like that!

_3313.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3313.Description: If you look in the box over there, there will be various toys and shells. It could explode if you mess with it, so be careful! Get me 10 Cannonball from there.

_3314.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3314.Description: You've collected enough... But I'm still nervous! Puppetmon is so strong, so this amount might not be enough! Bring more shells from the box!

_3316.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3316.Description: This guy... RedVegimon is blocking the way. Let's defeat them and chase Puppetmon!

_3317.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3317.Description: Why are there so many RedBegimon? If we continue like this, we might miss Puppetmon! Let's defeat them and chase them!
_3317.CompletionSummary: Good! Let's hurry up and chase him!

_3318.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3318.Description: We found Puppetmon! I won't miss him this time!
_3318.CompletionSummary: Now! Puppetmon! You won't be able to run away anymore!

_3319.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3319.Description: Now! Let's end the bad relationship with Puppetmon.
_3319.CompletionSummary: Oh no! Did he disappear in the meantime?

_3320.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3320.Description: Now! Let's end the bad relationship with Puppetmon.
_3320.CompletionSummary: Oh no! Did he disappear in the meantime?

_3321.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3321.Description: Now! Let's end the bad relationship with Puppetmon.
_3321.CompletionSummary: Oh no! Did he disappear in the meantime?

_3322.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3322.Description: Wow, really. He sacrificed his minions and ran away. He's such a terrible guy.
_3322.CompletionSummary: First, let's find the traces of Puppetmon and follow him. We must defeat him.

_3323.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3323.Description: If it's here... It'll be safe, right?

_3324.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3324.Description: Oh no! Let's hurry up and run away! I think we can go over there!
_3324.CompletionSummary: Gasp... I'm sure we'll get caught if it's like this.

_3325.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3325.Description: We might get caught like this! Ah! Let's gather leaves! We cover our bodies with that so that he don't notice that we're here! There are usable tropical plants around, so bring several leaves from there! In various ways!
_3325.CompletionText: We need to collect it quickly!
_3325.CompletionSummary: Let's hurry up and lie down and put this on top of our body!

_3326.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3326.Description: Um... I can hear your voice from far away. It's gone now... Huh? That's... What Digimon is it? Enemy? Oh, my. Get ready to fight...
_3326.CompletionSummary: Wait a minute and calm down first. The story is later, and now follow me quickly.

_3327.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3327.CompletionSummary: ..It seems that the MetalEtemon has arrived here.

_3328.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3328.Summary: A duel of revenge and justice
_3328.Description: MetalEtemon… He's a very strong opponent. But that doesn't mean we can back down. I will definitely defeat you!

_3329.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3329.Summary: [Daily] A duel of revenge and justice
_3329.Description: SaberLeomon is being pushed back. SaberLeomon told me not to interrupt... My colleague is fighting, but I can't stay still! Let's fight with MetalEtemon together!

_3331.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3331.Description: No! Don't die! I don't want others to die again!
_3331.CompletionSummary: ..So that Digimon who sacrificed for us can come back... Let's go!

_3332.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3332.Description: Hehe~ I'm going to run away.
_3332.CompletionSummary: I can never just let you go.

_3333.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3333.Description: Don't think about running away or hurting your colleagues anymore. Because you're going to die here!

_3334.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3334.Description: Is he still struggling? He lost your weapon, too. But the opponent is the ultimate level, don't let our guard down.

_3335.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3335.CompletionSummary: There's nothing we can do. Matt or the others haven't joined us yet.. But we still have to keep going.

_3336.Title: Forest of Marionette
_3336.Description: Let's get moving. Even though we are separated, we'll get together again soon.

_3337.Title: Metal Empire
_3337.Description: Everyone's tired and sick person.. At times like this, we need to be strong! Let's hurry up and find a place where Hikari can rest. We'll look the other way, so look around the road leading through the forest and the mansion and meet here again.
_3337.Objective: Search Road Leading Through the Forest Search the Mansion
_3337.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Road Leading Through the Forest%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Search the Mansion%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3337.CompletionSummary: You're safe! This place.. I think it's a region controlled by MugenDramon.

_3338.Title: Metal Empire
_3338.Description: This place would be good for Hikari to rest. But this place…
_3338.CompletionSummary: This place still seems to be on the safe side, so let's get inside.

_3339.Title: Metal Empire
_3339.Description: Actually, I'm not relieved. I see Digimons haging around. At this rate, they might find out where we are before Hikari wakes up. It would be good to get rid of at least 10 Digimons carefully.

_3340.Title: Metal Empire
_3340.Description: It still looks like there are some Digimons hanging around. Don't let them know where we are before Hikari wakes up. So once again, let's be careful and get rid of at least 10 Digimons.

_3341.Title: Metal Empire
_3341.Description: It's right to think about the patient first. She need to get better soon and be easier to move.. But..
_3341.CompletionSummary: Let's go to the city first. There might be a medicine!

_3342.Title: Metal Empire
_3342.Description: I wish we could get a map somewhere.. I'll have to find a suitable place. Let's take a look around the silent city center first!
_3342.CompletionText: It's a bit of a rush but..

_3343.Title: Metal Empire
_3343.Description: I think it's a waste of time to just go around looking for it. It could be more dangerous if we move without any information. Fortunately, I found a phone booth with access to the network. But.. We don't have enough cables to connect to the network. I believe Kokuwamon must have it. About 5.. I think we need it.
_3343.CompletionSummary: Good.. It's close but I think this is enough.

_3344.Title: Metal Empire
_3344.Description: Oh, no.. I failed to analyze the network and broke the cable. I don't know why, but the laptop is safe. I'll figure out which part I made a mistake, and I don't think I'll make a mistake this time, so could you bring 15 more? I believe Kokuwamon must have it.
_3344.CompletionSummary: Good.. It's close but I think this is enough.

_3346.Title: Metal Empire
_3346.Description: I think we need to go to the hospital first! It says on the map that there's a hospital near there! Let's hurry!
_3346.CompletionText: Let's find it before we get caught.

_3347.Title: Metal Empire
_3347.Description: I don't know why, but Taichi is in a hurry. He might get sick like Hikari. Since he doesn't seem like going to rest, can you get some water or drinks? I think it will be enough for four of us.. I saw a vending machine on the way here. Let's see if we can buy it there!
_3347.CompletionSummary: Thank you~! This will cheer Taichi up!

_3348.Title: Metal Empire
_3348.Description: First, please find as many medicines as possible from enemy Digimons around the hospital. I'll be able to find out by comparing the cold medicine with the data in the hospital! The more, the better, but I think it'd be better to bring at least 3 medicines.

_3349.Title: Metal Empire
_3349.Description: We already have the cold medicine you found, but this might not be enough. I think we need more, so you'd better bring at least 5 more.

_3350.Title: Metal Empire
_3350.Description: What's the sound.. Maybe you should go find out. Well, I'm glad I found the medicine. The direction of the sound is the direction of the park. Let's go over there.

_3351.Title: Metal Empire
_3351.Description: Oh, my God?! How can so many Digimons..! Even MechaNorimon we saw before! And the dangerous-looking Tankmon?! Let's fight first! Get 7 each of MechaNorimon and Tankmon! Also defeat 3 each leaders!
_3351.Objective: Defeat MechaNorimon Defeat MechaNorimon(Leader) Defeat Tankmon Defeat Tankmon(Leader)

_3352.Title: Metal Empire
_3352.Description: I can't believe it's still that many..! If we just go like this, Hikari and the others might be in danger! Let's fight again! Get 7 each of MechaNorimon and Tankmon! Also defeat 3 each leaders!
_3352.Objective: Defeat MechaNorimon Defeat MechaNorimon(Leader) Defeat Tankmon Defeat Tankmon(Leader)

_3353.Title: Metal Empire
_3353.Description: Oh, no! We might be surrounded by any moment! There are so many that we won't be able to overcome it with our own strength! Let's go to the forest of buildings first! Buildings are dense, so it'll be good to hide!
_3353.CompletionSummary: I don't think it's safe here but..

_3354.Title: Metal Empire
_3354.Description: First of all, I saw CommanDramon walking around here holding somethings that could be used as cables. If possible, please collect about 3 cables and bring it to me!
_3354.CompletionSummary: Good.. It's close but I think this is enough.

_3355.Title: Metal Empire
_3355.Description: Oh no..! It wasn't enough this time either. Ugh.. There's nothing I can do. Can you get me about 15 more?
_3355.CompletionSummary: Good.. It's close but I think this is enough.

_3356.Title: Metal Empire
_3356.Description: Oh, my God?! Enemies are coming! We need to get out of here! We need to move to B1-2-9, which looks like there has the least enemy!
_3356.CompletionSummary: We have to fight like this! Agumon! Let's evolve!

_3357.Title: Metal Empire
_3357.Description: They're.. Ultimate?! But we're ultimate as well! We won't lose! Let's go! Defeat MegaDramon and GigaDramon!
_3357.CompletionSummary: But I can't back down like this!

_3358.Title: Metal Empire
_3358.Description: They're... I can't believe they still haven't fallen yet! But we're not down yet! We won't lose! Let's go! Defeat MegaDramon and GigaDramon!
_3358.CompletionSummary: But I can't back down like this!

_3359.Title: Metal Empire
_3359.Description: How.. how are they keep finding us? Is there...? There's one thing I want to check! I'm sure there's a communicator that SealsDramons have! Please bring it to me about 5 of them!

_3360.Title: Metal Empire
_3360.Description: We've found out how they find us! We'll be able to hide ourselves this time! Let's hurry up and move to the catholic church!
_3360.CompletionSummary: It's.. It's my fault. I'm sorry

_3361.Title: Metal Empire
_3361.Description: Because of the incident.. I want to protect Hikari even more. I'm sorry I got mad earlier, Izzy. But we still have to find a way to get to Hikari..!
_3361.CompletionSummary: It's okay.. I understand. It's not like there's no way to go. I have a good idea.

_3362.Title: Metal Empire
_3362.Description: We've figured out how the find us, so if we confuse them, there's a possibility. I need time! I slightly modified the communication device that you've collected earlier. Please use this to enemies around here!
_3362.CompletionText: Good! Now it's time for the counterattack!

_3363.Title: Metal Empire
_3363.Description: We succeeded confused them! Let's move to the mansion in the meantime!
_3363.CompletionSummary: What's this all of a sudden..!

_3364.Title: Metal Empire
_3364.Description: Oh no! The enemies are moving to where Nari is! We have to go quickly, too. Let's move to the mansion!

_3366.Title: Metal Empire
_3366.CompletionSummary: I'll cheer up as your sister as much as you did for me.

_3367.Title: Metal Empire
_3367.Description: This.. Is the underground of the city where we were. Sora said that there are things that look like they're in other countries.. Huh? There's the sound. I think it's coming from the city power plant zone 1! Let's go there!
_3367.Objective: Move to City Power Plant Zone 1
_3367.CompletionText: I hope both Taichi and Izzy are safe.

_3368.Title: Metal Empire
_3368.Description: Oh, my God.. Look over there. WaruMonzaemon is.. hitting Numemons all over the place.. I want to save it.. Is there any way to help?

_3369.Title: Metal Empire
_3369.Description: Numemons.. They need our help.. Defeat WaruMonzaemon's minion, Commandramon, you see around..

_3370.Title: Metal Empire
_3370.Description: They are still hitting Numemons.. They need our help.. Defeat WaruMonzaemon's minion, Commandramon, you see around..

_3372.Title: Metal Empire
