_3493.Title: Shinjuku
_3493.Description: Your Mission from now on is Research of Shinjuku Area. Recently, there has been Digimon Realize phenomenon very often. I've already sent some of the Agents for basic information research but… Agents not able to get enter the Area except Only a few because of Unkwon Gang. And, even agents who already in Shinjuku never know when they gonna kicked out. Well, it is good news that you are here. You've active most of the Digital world so, your face is kinda not well known to others. Your Mission is to hide your identity, meet up with PawnChessmon White at Shinjuku, and research for any phenomenon related to Digimon. Can you do it?
_3493.Objective: Talk to Richard Sampson of Dats Center and notify him that you are ready
_3493.CompletionSummary: As expected of you. I thought you'd accept this mission. Now, I'll send you to the location @<tc:900>where PawsnChessmon is located@</tc>, please come back after successfully completing your mission.
_3493.ReservedText: I guess you are now ready.

_3494.Title: Shinjuku
_3494.Description:
Welcome, I heard the story from the captain. I'm glad you came. I'll let you know the current situation first. Because of the unidentified organization, it was difficult to investigate because other agent members were not able to access Shinjuku, but thanks to the fact that some crew members were undetected, some information was available. First of all, the unidentified organization was not aware of the exact identity of Digimon.
Somebody call them as Wild one. They think it's just a simple chunk of data.
Digimon seems to have the ability to figure out where it appears, but since I know very little, I don't know how to deal with it. Rather, it's a girl with Digimon who is more dangerous than an unidentified organization.
I don't know how to figure it out, but I'm hunting and realizing Digimons.
I, of course, and other crews were almost hunted by the child.
_3494.Objective: Talk to <Hiding>PawnChessmon W and hearing rest of the story
_3494.CompletionSummary: Based on the findings, it's more likely to cause friction with the child than with Hypnos. Investigating an unidentified organization is important, but I think we need to keep an eye on him now.

_3495.Title: Shinjuku
_3495.Summary: Check the Eastern area of Shinjuku
_3495.Description: First of all, you need to know about the terrain to perform smooth missions, right? Seems like you visit Shinjuku for the first time. I'll tell you the coordinates, so take a look and come. Then, let's meet on the eastern side of Shinjuku.
_3495.Objective: Check Tokyo Metropolitan Government Check Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square Check Downtown Go to Boulevard
_3495.CompletionText: Shinjuku is a wide area. This place is only a part of Shinjuku.
_3495.CompletionSummary: Speak of the Devil! Good to see you @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!!

_3496.Title: Shinjuku
_3496.Description: It is the girl who said that you need to be careful. It seems quite aggressive. He attacked me before he even said anything. Let's create a room for conversation. That kid can know information that even unknown organizations don't know. First of all, let's take over the child's partner Digimon and talk!
_3496.CompletionSummary: Good. Now we may able to talk

_3497.Title: Shinjuku
_3497.Description: … Renamon, why? You are the strongest Digimon, so you can win. Come on fight.
_3497.CompletionSummary: ... Such a single-minded person. It's so difficult to communicate... Let's get out of here for now. An unidentified organization will move because of the disturbance and let's make sure that conversation with that child for the next time. @<tc:900>Now, then let's move to the hideout where I'm staying.@</tc>

_3498.Title: Shinjuku
_3498.Summary: Check the Western Area of Shinjuku
_3498.Description: The organization has also arrived. We should avoid friction with unidentified organizations if possible. I hope the girl can help us if she can. Once the night is too late, let's take a rest and look around the west of Shinjuku tomorrow. I told you, Shinjuku is huge. After you look around, come to Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square. See you there tomorrow. @<tc:900>Let's see, I think you can start here.
_3498.Objective: Check Shinjuku Elementary School Check Residential area Check Shinjuku Park-Center Go to Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square
_3498.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Shinjuku Elementary School%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Residential area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Shinjuku Park-Center%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3498.CompletionText: It's late. Go and take a rest.
_3498.CompletionSummary: Did you get a good rest? Let's hope that today will be okay

_3499.Title: Shinjuku
_3499.Description:
A sign of realization was observed near the construction site near the park. First of all, the investigation mission is important, but the mission of our Dats Center is also important.
Because Digimon is realizing, we shouldn't be doing damage around. First, let's go there and specify the realization position. Maybe the girl I met yesterday might be there again. Let's meet there.
_3499.CompletionText: For realize phenomenon in Shinjuku, the fog-like Digimon field appears first, so it's easy to specify.
_3499.CompletionSummary: Oh, you guys? ... in my dream last night ...? If so, you! You guys are real Digimon?!

_3500.Title: Shinjuku
_3500.Description: That guy... It might be dangerous, but he already got into that place without plans. You can't leave it to cause human injury. First, let's go after it.
_3500.CompletionText: So different from the guy I met yesterday.

_3501.Title: Shinjuku
_3501.Description: Digimon name is Guilmon! This is my Digimon! I am the one! How can this be?! Me, I can be a Tamer... I might be!!
_3501.CompletionSummary: .. made up Digimon?... Honestly, it's a bit hard to believe…

_3502.Title: Shinjuku
_3502.Description: I think I need to take Guilmon to my house. This is a Digimon I made, no matter what, I have to take care of it! However, it's a little uneasy to leave Guilmon, who has just been born, like this. Can you get some boxes near the trash for me?
_3502.Objective: Look for Trash Can Get Box from Trash Can
_3502.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Look for Trash Can%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Get Box from Trash Can%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3502.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I can go home safely thanks to you!

_3503.Title: Shinjuku
_3503.Description: Oh, I'm glad I had a relationship with Takato who can be considered as a new Tamer in a situation where there is not enough information. I've checked which school he's attending, and I'll probably increase my coverage little by little while observing spending time with Digimon for the time being. I think it's better to do it because it seems like a lot of accidents will happen because he is a beginner. And while you were looking for the box, signs of realization were observed on the side of Shinjuku Park-Playground. First, Takato will return, so go ahead and respond. @<tc:990>Start as soon as you are ready.@</tc>
_3503.CompletionText: An unidentified organization is quieter than I thought. Is there a lack of technology to observe Digimon appearing?
_3503.CompletionSummary: You here? The unidentified tissue is still quite. Let's take care of the Digimons first before the damage gets worse.

_3504.Title: Shinjuku
_3504.Description: Realized Digimon is Goblimon. You haven't seen any unidentified organizations? We should have sent people to deal with it by now. Hmm... I can't wait for them to deal with it. Let's get rid of all the realized Goblimons. If we leave them alone, it could do a lot of damage to our surroundings.
_3504.CompletionText: If you can't handle it like this, I hope you don't bother me.
_3504.CompletionSummary: Okay! This should be enough. Huh? Who is that kid?

_3505.Title: Shinjuku
_3505.Description: We finally met. I was worried that we didn't finish the game properly last time, but let's make it this time! I'm not going to let you run away. What? You don't want to fight me? Aren't you Tamer? I don't know why you avoid fighting. All right, then, let's change the way we fight. A realized Goblimon has just evolved into an Ogremon. It's my game, but I can't help it if it's for the competition. Let's see who defeat of Ogremon first! If you don't accept it, I'll force you to fight.
_3505.CompletionText: You're a Tamer, but you're not fighting, but you're taking this fight. You're weird.
_3505.CompletionSummary: Tsu, you've defeated Orgamon before we did. I don't know why you're hesitating to fight, but you'll see next time! I'll make you fight.

_3506.Title: Shinjuku
_3506.Description: The fight has lengthened, so an unidentified organization has detected a disturbance. If you stay here any longer, they'll find you. Since it's late at night, let's take a good rest and see each other tomorrow. We'll meet in front of Shinjuku Elementary School tomorrow, so keep that in mind. Let's move on to @<tc:900>. Get ready.@</tc>
_3506.CompletionText: What a pro group. They move like a snail. It's only a matter of time.
_3506.CompletionSummary: Hey~ As expected. There's been an accident. Listen to the details from Takato. I'm gonna have to hide.

_3507.Title: Shinjuku
_3507.Description: Oh, you're here. PawnChessmon W told me that you'd help. It's Guilmon... Guilmon! He came to school...! I hid Guilmon near the construction site where I found him on my way to school, but he was young and naive, so he just followed him without thinking...! You know, he played a joke with the vice principal, or he ate all the bread prepared for our lunch. I don't think he'd caught yet, but I'm so worried that he might be dragged somewhere or in an accident! I finally met the Digimon. I'm going to go around after school too, so help me find Guilmon! Please!!
_3507.Objective: Check Playground Check Residential area Talk to Guilmon

_3508.Title: Shinjuku
_3508.Description: Did you find Guilmon? That's a relief. I'll be there in a minute with Takato. Keep him safe so he doesn't go anywhere.

_3509.Title: Shinjuku
_3509.Description: I'm glad I found you. You worried me so much…
_3509.CompletionSummary: Let's find the hideout where Guilmon can stay!

_3510.Title: Shinjuku
_3510.Description: I need a place where Guilmon can stay. I've taken him to my place, but my parents are against it. It's hard, to be honest with my parents. So I think it would be better to build a secret base near Shinjuku Park where I often go and play. There are so many trees that it's perfect for hiding. Can you guys take a look around Shinjuku Park? Then we'll meet at Shinjuku Park-South.
_3510.Objective: Check Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square Check Shinjuku Park-Center Move to Shinjuku Park-South
_3510.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Check Park-Waterfall Square%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Check Park-Center%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Go to Shinjuku Park-Forest%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3510.CompletionSummary: Hurry up! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! I can't help but run into him.!

_3511.Title: Shinjuku
_3511.Description: If this is the case, I'll have to grant his wish. Let's get over Renamon first so Guilmon and Takato don't get hurt.
_3511.CompletionSummary: You're...! Why are you everywhere I go?

_3512.Title: Shinjuku
_3512.Description: Tsk... I'm gonna back up for now.
_3512.CompletionSummary: Are you all right? I'm glad that the kid just stepped back. Oh, I didn't introduce myself. My name is Henry who goes to the same school with Takato.

_3513.Title: Shinjuku
_3513.Description: I found out that Takato was a Tamer when Guilmon made a scene at our school. I think you're upset because Terriermon said something bad, but I'm glad that Takato thinks Guilmon is precious. Oh, I heard you're looking for a place for Guilmon to stay. I'll help you. First of all, there are more trees over there in the waterfall square than here. I think it'd be a better place for Guilmon to hide. Why don't you go there first?
_3513.CompletionText: You also a Tamer, right? Nice to meet you.
_3513.CompletionSummary: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! I found a good place! How do you like this?

_3514.Title: Shinjuku
_3514.Description: There's been a lot of accidents today, but they're not without income. I think it would be good to see Henry as a positive person when it comes to being friendly to us. Plus, we've found a place for Guilmon to stay, so you can rest assured for a while. Digimon doesn't even show any signs of real life, so let's take a break for today and see tomorrow. I'll talk to them. Oh, let's meet in front of the Tokyo building in eastern Shinjuku tomorrow.
_3514.Objective: Move to Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square
_3514.CompletionText: …Hope there would be progress in the investigation…
_3514.CompletionSummary: I was about to investigate the Eastern area of Shinjuku but screwed. It appeared again.

_3515.Title: Shinjuku
_3515.Description: I don't know what's wrong with you. I don't know why we always run into each other, but that's not the problem. Let's subdue Guilmon and Renamon.
_3515.CompletionText: What makes that kid to be like this…
_3515.CompletionSummary: Finally, the backup arrived on time!

_3516.Title: Shinjuku
_3516.Summary: The reason why we need to fight
_3516.Description: Why do you keep trying to fight?

_3517.Title: Shinjuku
_3517.Description: When Terriermon evolves, he can't control his power and go crazy! We have to stop it before anything bigger happens! Can you help me?! Overpower the Galgomon who's walking around excitedly!
_3517.CompletionSummary: Phew... What a relief. He finally calms down.

_3518.Title: Shinjuku
_3518.Description: First of all, in order to get back to Terriermon, we need to use up our strength. It's going to be noisy here, so let's go to @<tc:990>Shinjuku Park first. You have to hurry to get home.@</tc>
_3518.CompletionText: This is the reason why I didn't want to evolve you…
_3518.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for helping me to calm Galgomon down. Thanks to you guys, the time shortened.
Thank you for helping me calm down Galgomon today. It might have taken longer to calm down and it would have happened, all thanks to you guys…

_3519.Title: Shinjuku
_3519.Description: Henry had a hard day today, and I have to wait until Galgomon gets back to normal, so it would be nice if you could give him dinner. My house happens to be a bakery! @<tc:990>Come with me to my house, I'll get you some bread.@</tc>
_3519.CompletionText: this bread from my place but it's tasty!!
_3519.CompletionSummary: Errrr, my mom scolded me because I came in late. Wait a moment and I'll bring it out soon, thank you for today!

_3520.Title: Shinjuku
_3520.Description: Did you get the bread for the Henry? @<tc:990>All right then! Tell me when you're ready, I'll get you right over here.@</tc> Let's summarize what happened today and decide the direction of the investigation.
_3520.CompletionSummary: Hm? What is this bread? Ah.. It's Takato. Thanks for delivering the bread for me. I should say thank you to Takato tomorrow. Oh right. I'm going to meet Takato and play after school tomorrow. Will you come? I think we'll meet at the downtown area in west Shinjuku. If you are interested, come after school.

_3521.Title: Shinjuku
_3521.Description: You did a great job. I had a lot of work, but thanks to you, everything went well. But I'm worried about the lack of progress in the investigation. Aside from the unidentified organization, I think we should think about how to deal with the disruption of the investigation because of her. We're going to run into each other every time we investigate the realized phenomenon, and then we're going to start a fight and interrupt the investigation, but we can't just let it go. I'm glad that there are Henry and Takato. Let's do our best with them to investigate the realize phenomenon. Take a rest now, and I'll be waiting here, so you can go and @<tc:990>join Henry and Takato@</tc> as soon as you're ready.
_3521.CompletionSummary: Hey~ you finally here! Hmm? What happened, Terriermon?

_3522.Title: Shinjuku
_3522.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Can you hear me?! That's good! Now Digimon has seen a realized phenomenon in Eastern Shinjuku! I think it's Champion Digimon, and spilling the information! An unidentified organization might even notice and go where it's realized! Time is ticking! Bring them straight to the Accident scene east of Shinjuku!
_3522.CompletionSummary: It's not too late! That's a relief! I don't know if you've noticed yet, but the unidentified organization is still there!

_3524.Title: Shinjuku
_3524.Description: He's strong, but he doesn't have much skill. There's a card that can suppress that power! But it's hard to give him a decisive blow, so I'll hold him down with a card! In the meantime, get rid of the Apemon!!
_3524.CompletionSummary: ... All right! Oh, and let's not load the data. It's enough to keep them from fighting.

_3525.Title: Shinjuku
_3525.Description: It's a great combination. Henry and Terriermon. I'd like to recruit him to Dats Center if I can get him. Huu, anyway, I'm glad you solved the realize phenomenon well. I haven't run into her, but I'm concerned about an unidentified organization. It bothers me that there is no movement even though the realize phenomenon has been discovered. I don't know what they want, so let's be as careful as we can until we know the purpose. Take care not to get caught. Let's meet tomorrow at @<tc:990>Guilmon's house@</tc>. Now, let's go if you're ready.
_3525.CompletionSummary: I don't know what this is about. I think it's Digimon's work. It's hard to say.

_3526.Title: Shinjuku
_3526.Description: For more information, I think I can listen to Takato. @<tc:990>When you're ready, leave right there. I will be waiting here.@</tc>
_3526.CompletionText: This is the same thing. There's a lot of strange events.
_3526.CompletionSummary: Oh, I think I should tell you something about this one.

_3527.Title: Shinjuku
_3527.Description: There was a commotion at my school. There's this guy who messed up the schoolyard with his Line Machine overnight. Turns out he's the one. Aside from the fact that he's a Digimon, I wish we could send him back to the digital world, but we don't know how to. I was wondering what to do, but I was talking to Henry because I thought it would better to find a partner like Guilmon or Terriermon. First, I have a few candidates in mind, but I can't take Guilmon and Culumon with me, so I'm going to leave them to PawnChessmonW. Well Guilmon's home, too! We will take care of Culumon for now, so can you call PawnChessmonW?
_3527.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Then we'll leave Culumon to PawnChessmonW and find someone to partner with Culumon!

_3528.Title: Shinjuku
_3528.Description: If you've been asked such a favor by Takato, I think it's a perfect time. I will keep my eyes on to Guilmon and Culumon, so please investigate the realize phenomenon here in Shinjuku. The realize phenomenon that occurs here is strange, so we need to investigate more. It doesn't matter which Digimon it is, so I think it'd be good to get 30 samples of data after defeating the realized Digimon. The ones that show up in the western part of Shinjuku should be enough.
_3528.CompletionText: They're so pure, so it's harder to deal with them.
_3528.CompletionSummary: Okay, I think this should be enough. Huh? Where are the Guilmon and Culumon? Of course, they must be ho......

_3529.Title: Shinjuku
_3529.Description: .. Culumon and Guilmon are gone...! Let's find it in scatter! Day going to be over soon, so take a look around Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square, Shinjuku Park-Central Park, Shinjuku Park-South Park in Western Area (Night)! I'll come around looking elsewhere too! And let's meet at Shinjuku Park-Playground!
_3529.Objective: Check Park(Night) - Waterfall Square Check Park(Night) - Center Check Park(Night) - South Go to Park(Night) - Sports field
_3529.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Park(Night) - Waterfall Square%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Park(Night) - Center%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Park(Night) - South%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Park(Night) - Sports field%qe %cc4/%mc4

_3530.Title: Shinjuku
_3530.Description: ..A realize phenomenon was observed from the school. I think the demonic Digimons are realizing. If not, Digimon's impact on the real world is immense, but even devil-like guys may do damage to the city. Once I find Guilmon and Culumon, I'll do it. You go with the kids and go to school to defeat the realized Digimon.
_3530.Objective: Realized Devil Type Digimon-1 Defeat Realized Devil Type Digimon-2 Defeat
_3530.CompletionText: I have no idea that where they are.
_3530.CompletionSummary: I heard from them and I came here too! It's a relief to find Guilmon and Culumon after solving the realize phenomenon!

_3531.Title: Shinjuku
_3531.CompletionSummary: I don't know what the purpose is.

_3532.Title: Shinjuku
_3532.Description: An unidentified organization is quiet, so I'm worried. Investigations are all done before in the afternoon. Now that it is like this, whether it is a girl or an unidentified organization, I need to solve something. The unidentified organization has no movement, so let's solve it first. Today is late, so take a rest, @<tc:990>Tomorrow, let's meet in front of Guilmon's house.@</tc>

_3533.Title: Shinjuku
_3533.Description: I was just about to contact you, and it worked. A realize phenomenon was observed just before you came. I don't know Henry and Takato, but the girl will definitely appear. As you become more obsessed with being stronger, you will not miss the chance to kill Digimon and absorb the data. Once she loads all Digimons first, let's move before they disappear. The location is this place.
_3533.CompletionText: Hope that we could have positive conversation.
_3533.CompletionSummary: She looks like she didn't arrive yet. All right.

_3534.Title: Shinjuku
_3534.Description: It was confirmed that the realized Digimon was Allomon. I need to clean up before destroying the surroundings and making a riot, so I think it would be good to defeat 10 Allomons and install the device I give to the residential area. If not, I haven't made any progress in the investigation, so I want to collect data. With this device, we'll figure out why the realize phenomenon is happening around here.
_3534.Objective: Defeat Allomon Set the Device to Residential Area
_3534.CompletionText: …Hope there would be progress in the investigation…
_3534.CompletionSummary: Good. Now I just wait until that girl appeared

_3535.Title: Shinjuku
_3535.Description: .. speak of the devil! It's here! And already fighting! Let's go!
_3535.CompletionSummary: No need any help, cause Renamon is enough for now.

_3536.Title: Shinjuku
_3536.Description: I was worried about seeing the evolution of Terriermon. I also feel like I can't afford something when I see there is no room for conversation. In that state, friction will occur every time you encounter it. Hmm.. I have no choice but to count the information one by one while continuing to encounter friction. I can't help it. I have already installed a survey device in the Shinjuku Park area. It's not certain, but I've been told by the headquarters that there is a sign of realize in Shinjuku Park-Central Park.
_3536.CompletionText: The obsession with evolution... Maybe we can take advantage of evolution.
_3536.CompletionSummary: So… Now what should we do now.

_3537.Title: Shinjuku
_3537.Description: Phew! Are you a Digimon raised by humans like that fox Digimon? Can't you do anything without a human?
_3537.CompletionSummary: It's weird Digimon, but if what he said last is true, it's a big deal.

_3538.Title: Shinjuku
_3538.Description: If that Digimon is right, Renamon and her girl may be having a hard time-fighting Dokugumon around here. Let's hurry up for now. I'll go this way and you'll go to Shinjuku Park-Center.

_3539.Title: Shinjuku
_3539.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Chat with her later! We need to focus on Dokugumon first!
_3539.CompletionText: That's great. It's Champion, but so powerful.

_3540.Title: Shinjuku
_3540.Description: I'm sorry it's breaking the mood, but I'd like you to take a moment.
_3540.CompletionSummary: I knew you were at least different from those fools, but as long as you guys are Digimon and you have Digimon, you're an enemy to fight. I've got help today, so let's just let it go, but this won't happen the next time we meet.

_3541.Title: Shinjuku
_3541.Description: You haven't even had a good conversation with them. But that doesn't seem to be the case. First of all, it's too late, so let's go back. @<tc:990>When ready, let's start immediately. Go back to rest and see you in front of Guilmon's house tomorrow morning.@</tc>

_3542.Title: Shinjuku
_3542.Description: I like what Takato said while stopping by before school today. There's a place near Shinjuku Park where Guilmon's body gets blurred. I don't know if the other Digimons did it, or if it's only for Guilmon, but we do need to investigate. Let's look into it since it could be a clue while there's no progress. I'll be reporting the data you've collected and what you've been through so far, so I'd like you to install this machine in Shinjuku Park to check and investigate the abnormalities you just mentioned.
_3542.Objective: Check Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square Check Shinjuku Park-Center Check Shinjuku Park-South Check Shinjuku Park-sports field
_3542.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Check Park-Waterfall Square%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Check Park-Center%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Check Park-South%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Check Park-sports field%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3542.CompletionText: Let's see. So this is what happened. Huh? Why are you still here?
_3542.CompletionSummary: Oh, you're here? I think the installation went well. The data is coming in well.

_3543.Title: Shinjuku
_3543.Description: Let's see. There's nothing special about it while the data is being stacked. But you can't just play, can you? Why don't we do some digging around? Maybe we can get unexpected information. Go around the Shinjuku Park - central park and have a survey with the person you see.
_3543.CompletionText: Hmm… Hope you gather the informations.
_3543.CompletionSummary: I don't have to tell you whether I know or not. I guess I'll ask. Why are you disturbing in Shinjuku? I think you're one of the crews from that Dats Center or whatever where you're doing something, so don't poke Shinjuku around for no reason.
_3543.ReservedText: 'Like a monster? Oh, the animal from the animation? Why would you ask that?

_3544.Title: Shinjuku
_3544.Description: I don't know what you're trying to do with Shinjuku, but we'll deal with Wild One in our own way.
_3544.CompletionSummary: Did the investigation go well? Hmm? Head of an unidentified organization?

_3545.Title: Shinjuku
_3545.Description: Hypnos... calling Digimon Wild One... Well, it's highly likely that Hypnos isn't well aware of Digimon. Maybe they have a technology that can influence Digimon with their own technology. Well, it's an unexpected harvest. I wouldn't have been prepared if they just walked past us and tried to rule us out, but thanks to your identity, I can handle it somehow. Let's be more careful. First of all, the information keeps coming in from the place I installed earlier, but it's not satisfactory. I thought I'd need more, but I think it'd be good to install a research machine where the realize phenomenon occurred and defeat the Digimons that appeared there. I'll assign you the coordinates, so be careful when you get back.
_3545.Objective: Set the divice at Residential area(Day) Defeat Allomon Set the divice at Park(Night)-Sports field Defeat Goblimon,Ogremon
_3545.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Set the device-Residential area%qe%cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Allomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Set the device-Sports field%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Goblimon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Defeat Ogremon%qe %cc5/%mc5
_3545.CompletionText: I can't give up like this. I have pride in being a Dats Agent...!

_3546.Title: Shinjuku
_3546.Description: Oh, really, why would I listen to Digimon being raised by humans? Stop fooling around? No! If you prove you're a cool, strong Digimon like me. Get rid of the Dokugumon wandering around! He's stronger than me, but he's stronger than I am?
_3546.CompletionText: Well, there's no way that Digimons raised by humans can be strong. Dokugumon is a tough opponent for me, too.
_3546.CompletionSummary: What?! Don't lie to me! Anyway, I'm going to bed! It's hard for me to hang out with you little liars like you!

_3547.Title: Shinjuku
_3547.Description: ... it's a weird Digimon. First of all, you had a hard time keeping up with that guy. It's late, so let's take a good rest and see each other here tomorrow. Oh, no. You go to Takato right away in the morning and tell her what happened to Guilmon. When Guilmon came back earlier, something must have happened because of what Takato told him this morning. When I heard it from Guilmon, he was so sleepy that he kept saying weird things. Well, you were tied up or something. But it seems obvious that you've been through an abnormal phenomenon, so you need to find out. It takes time to analyze the information collected from the machine installed today, so @<tc:990>meet with Takato first and hear the whole story.

_3549.Title: Shinjuku
_3549.Description: Besides what happened to Guilmon, the teacher told me today... I think there's a bad kid who plays with fire in Shinjuku Park and surprises people... No way, Guilmon lives in Shinjuku Park. Guilmon was just born, and... I'm worried if it's Guilmon. @<tc:990> So can you go check on Guilmon instead of me?

_3550.Title: Shinjuku
_3550.Description: Guilmon? Well, I've been doing fine while I was here. Nothing special happened. But it was hard for me to move easily because the surveillance seemed to have become more strict. It seems that Hypnos has played a trick, but it seems to be bigger because of the one who plays pranks during the night that Takato told me. I think the Impmon we met last time was the culprit. It seems like it only appears at night, so let's go and wait where we expect it to be. @<tc:990>Let's start as soon as we're ready.

_3551.Title: Shinjuku
_3551.Description: We need to stop him playing for now. Let's defeat 10 of pranky Impmon.
_3551.CompletionText: This is the end of the prank. I won't let you get in the way anymore.

_3552.Title: Shinjuku
_3552.Description: He's... It's different from the guy I've been doing realize. It's a Devidramon. I think you were trapped in a digital field, but did you break it because of the impulse of the Impmon? We have to stop it! Let's defeat the monsters that show up!
_3552.CompletionText: I don't know what's going to happen if that big guy goes out there.
_3552.CompletionSummary: Oh, some of these are gone.

_3553.Title: Shinjuku
_3553.Description: I saw a guy flying towards the Tokyo Metropolitan Government. He was a big guy, but I think I'll go after him and defeat him. Here! We need to head to the Tokyo metropolitan government!
_3553.CompletionText: Devidramon is the powerful Champion Digimon. If Devidramon move the body in the city will cause a big commotion.

_3554.Title: Shinjuku
_3554.Description: First of all, we're backing down, but that doesn't mean we can leave the others alone. Let's find someone else and get rid of him other than Guilmon's. I think we can get rid of the monsters around and come back.
_3554.CompletionSummary: You did a great job tonight in many things.

_3555.Title: Shinjuku
_3555.Description: .. Growmon.. It's the Digimon I came up with.

_3556.Title: Shinjuku
_3556.Summary: What should I do with the bigger Growmon?
_3556.Description: Growmon so big that he can't stay here.@<tc:990>Let's go back to Guilmon's House for now.@</tc>

_3557.Title: Shinjuku
_3557.Description: I've been looking for ways to get back from Growmon to Guilmon, but... It didn't work well even if I surprised and exercised. So, by any chance, can you fight Growmon? Henry says it comes back in time, but... We don't know what's going to happen if we leave it like this.
_3557.CompletionSummary: Oh, no, I can't do this. I can't help it today. Stay hidden, Growmon. I'm sorry.

_3558.Title: Shinjuku
_3558.Description: ..I'm glad that everything had sorted. You've done a good job. @<tc:990>Let's meet again here tomorrow
_3558.CompletionSummary: Ah, you here. I don't think there's a break in this place.

_3559.Title: Shinjuku
_3559.Description: I originally had Growmon stay on the woody side of this area, but he moved it to a sheltered tunnel in the village at night. But when I got back this morning... They say it's gone. I don't know where he went with that big body size. By the way, they're going to school, and I and Terriermon are forced to look for Growmon and investigate Growmon. You should also go around and look for it as much as you can.

_3560.Title: Shinjuku
_3560.Description: I guess he got picked on by the Impmon and came all the way here. So I talked to Henry, and he's trying to put some protective color on Growmon! Don't you think it's a good idea? Growmon will be watching us, so get the paint green and brown! You can buy it from an old man near the construction site!
_3560.Objective: Talk to a Construction Worker Buy Paint
_3560.CompletionSummary: Thank you! This should be enough! We'll paint it!

_3561.Title: Shinjuku
_3561.Description: Growmon is hiding and it's so perfect I can't find him! All right! This will do!
_3561.CompletionSummary: .. You know, you need to be patient.

_3562.Title: Shinjuku
_3562.Description: Growmon finally be back to Guilmon. Rika. I think we need to find out more about her. Since Dokugumon, I don't think she's aware of it, but she seems to have a change of heart. She said she helped Guilmon the other day when he disappeared. I don't think she's the kind of girl she used to be. I think we'd better have a little more conversation. I'll track your location, and @<tc:990>depart as soon as you're ready.

_3563.Title: Shinjuku
_3563.Description: .. What is Evolution? Do you have any idea?

_3564.Title: Shinjuku
_3564.Description: Have you talked to Rika? Hmm... Evolution. You thought there was a difference in how to be stronger than you thought. Having seen Terriermon and Guilmon evolve, who have little experience in defeating Digimon and loading data so far, did you wonder if they were really doing it to be strong? Whatever it is, it seems to be going in a different direction from what you wanted. Let's think about this a little bit more. I don't think we're going to get any sharp numbers right now. First of all, it's not a realize phenomenon right now, but Digimon's reaction was found in Downtown, near where you are. The targets are Gazimon and Gekomon. Eliminate the two before they do damage to the surrounding area and come to the construction site east of Shinjuku.

_3565.Title: Shinjuku
_3565.Description: ..everyone's scared. I had frost on my body. I was suspicious because Digimon's reaction was found without a realize phenomenon, but I think there's something we don't know. I'll have to check what's going on. Could you go downtown again and collect the data of Gekomon and Gazimon wandering around?
_3565.Objective: Collect Gazimon Data Collect Gekomon Data

_3566.Title: Shinjuku
_3566.Description: .. Research shows traces of IceDevimon in each data. It looks like the data's been compromised, so we've been able to absorb the data and freeze it to maintain its appearance, and then a few of them have been released around the city. IceDevimon's a tricky, naughty guy. Huh? Renamon?
_3566.CompletionSummary: Rika has disappeared. Please help me.

_3567.Title: Shinjuku
_3567.Description: Rika is gone. I assume that she kidnapped by Digimon. I only can chase the track. what? IceDevimon recently realized near here?..If that is true, there may be IceDevimon in the cause of Rika's disappearance. He must have come to this world to save his partner to be stronger. At this rate, Rika is in danger. @<tc:990>Can you go with me to the place where the Ice Devil is? As soon as possible.

_3568.Title: Shinjuku
_3568.CompletionSummary: Fie! I can't stay like this.

_3569.Title: Shinjuku
_3569.Description: Rika's taken hostage, but once we deal with IceDevimon, we'll settle it! Never let him run away. You don't know what else you're gonna do if you run away! While Kyubimon draws attention, we'll defeat one IceDevimon and the Mushroomon and Gotsumon around it!
_3569.Objective: Defeat IceDevimon Defeat Mushroomon Defeat Gotsumon
_3569.CompletionSummary: The atmosphere is a little bit fishy…

_3570.Title: Shinjuku
_3570.Description: You seem to have a bigger change of heart than you thought. Maybe it's because they're young, but they're very emotional. Kyubimon didn't look very well either. I don't know what to do because it's my first time in a situation like this. I'm in trouble because I don't know how to organize Rika's parts. I wish I could be like Henry or Takato. Let's think about it slowly first. You did a great job today. See you in front of Guilmon's house tomorrow. @<tc:990>Let's leave as soon as we're ready.
_3570.CompletionSummary: Had a good rest? I've just about to get in touch..

_3571.Title: Shinjuku
_3571.Description: Hypnos must have done something. I don't know how you checked Digimon, but I think you stopped him once. But they didn't handle it completely, and it just irritated Digimon. They laid out Digimon fields in the middle of the city for realize. The children are there first, but the children alone won't be easy! @<tc:990>I'll tell you in coordinates and you'll join the kids there as soon as you're ready!

_3572.Title: Shinjuku
_3572.Description: Now I'll do what I can without further hesitation. So help us. Give me the strength to defeat the realized Musyamon!
_3572.CompletionSummary: @<tc:990>Let's move to Guilmon's House before people come!!@</tc>

_3573.Title: Shinjuku
_3573.Description: Oh, welcome. I'm sure there was a big fuss, but there wasn't much damage, so I think you can relax a little bit. By the way, Hypnos seems to be getting bolder. I don't know if the last meeting was a catalyst, but since he failed to stop the realize, he's probably trying to figure out the cause by now. I think it's going to be quiet for a while, and now that I have time like this, I'm going to decide what to do about Renamon and Rika. Just in time to find out where Renamon is, so @<tc:990>let's head towards the playground. Let's leave as soon as we're ready.

_3574.Title: Shinjuku
_3574.Summary: Still we need to do what we can do
_3574.Description: ..are they both gone? It's amazing that you're growing up and defeat Armor Type Digimon by yourself, but I thought you were hurt a lot, so I tried to treat you, but you disappeared again in the meantime. Like Rika, the cool-looking girls get sulky. Anyway, we can't leave the Flybeemons that show up. I'll be back with Henry first, so you defeat the Flybeemon and come back to Guillmon's house.
_3574.CompletionSummary: I met Yamaki Mitsuo on my way back home.

_3575.Title: Shinjuku
_3575.Description: It's a dangerous joke. There seems to be something else going on, but I'm not sure about that. The aftertaste is bitter, but I can't help it. Let's think about Rika and Renamon first. You can pretend you don't know it, but with the help of a combat-savvy Tamer like Rika and Renamon, the investigation will be as easy. And... personally, I don't want their relationship to end like this. So let's find out if there's anything we can do. First, Rika seems to be home, so let's find out where Renamon is. I'll give you a location, so look around, and if you find Renamon, you can talk to her. @<tc:990>Let's go when you're ready.
_3575.Objective: Check Eastern Shinjuku Boulevard Check Eastern Shinjuku Downtown Check Eastern Shinjuku Accident scene Talk to Renamon
_3575.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Eastern Boulevard%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Eastern Downtown%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Eastern Accident scene%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Talk to Renamon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3575.CompletionSummary: .. Ah, Yes. You also have a partner

_3576.Title: Shinjuku
_3576.Description: What is your partner Digimon mean to you?
_3576.CompletionSummary: ..is that so? Thank you for letting me know.

_3577.Title: Shinjuku
_3577.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Realize response from the Shinjuku Park-forest! Renamon's gone too, right? Oh no! I think Renamon is going near there! @<tc:990>Tell me when you're ready. Because we have to leave right away!@</tc>
_3577.CompletionSummary: Gargomon... At this rate, Renamon is disadvantageous.

_3578.Title: Shinjuku
_3578.Description: Renamon recklessly tries to figure out what he's thinking, and Gargomon is a strong Champion! We can't do this without the power of a partner! First of all, we need to take care of the Gargomon wandering around and save Renamon and save him! Defeat the Gargomon wandering around!

_3579.Title: Shinjuku
_3579.Description: ..I didn't know this was gonna happen, but it's not bad. Of course, it didn't help at all with the investigation. I can't help it. Let's just pretend we did volunteer work today. Thank you for responding to my urgent call. Anyway, let's move now. Hypnos might come after hearing the commotion.
_3579.CompletionSummary: .. First time to see face to face.

_3580.Title: Shinjuku
_3580.Description: I'd like to ask you if you know how dangerous they are.
_3580.CompletionSummary: 'Cooperation is dead and conversation is not working. It feels like when I first met Rika.

_3581.Title: Shinjuku
_3581.Description: Now I don't have to hide my identity anymore. I'm bold. It's clear now. Hypnos must be our enemy. I'm glad I don't care much about Rika anymore. If even he was an enemy, he might have been a little tired. Anyway, you did a great job today. See you in front of Guilmon's house tomorrow. @<tc:990>Make sure you start as soon as you're ready.@</tc>

_3582.Title: Shinjuku
_3582.Description: Maybe it's a little bad news this time. I'm not sure that what Hypnos is trying to do, but they kidnapped Digimon. Takato was going to school, so I couldn't listen to him the details. I can't move around as easily as before, so you should meet Takato and listen to him instead of me.

_3583.Title: Shinjuku
_3583.Description: I see. they subdued Digimon with some smog... If Takato were to say so, there would be traces left. And given that Digimon's reaction is still around, it's obviously not done. Move to Eastern Overpass near Nishi-Shinjuku, where Takato told you the location. Check what happened there, and let's defeat the remaining Digimons there. I'll go there, too, so I'll see you there.
_3583.Objective: Go to Eastern Shinjuku Overpass near Nishi Defeat Birdramon
_3583.CompletionText: I'll make you regret looking down on us.
_3583.CompletionSummary: .. Hm. Is it an EMP-type bomb that temporarily paralyzes data?

_3584.Title: Shinjuku
_3584.Description: ... something happens. The sixth sense as Digimon knows. It's creepy and I feel like I'm being sucked in. I can feel a strong reaction from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government. What did you do, Hypnos...! Let's move! I'll contact the children. @<tc:990>Let's go to Tokyo Metropolitan Government as soon as we're ready!
_3584.CompletionSummary: This..! What the heck did you do, Yamaki Mitsuo ?

_3585.Title: Shinjuku
_3585.Description: Something in the digital world... it crossed. A very dangerous one. It making me shiver with nothing. It's... it's like a one who's at least more than an Ultimate. It'll be different from the ones we've ever met. I think the realize place is Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square. Let's move over there.
_3585.Objective: Go to Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square
_3585.CompletionText: Hypnos... You made a Big mistake.
_3585.CompletionSummary: Disappear!! In the name of God!

_3586.Title: Shinjuku
_3586.Description: This is your chance! It's hard, but you can do it! We need to help WarGrowlmon to defeat the Mihiramon!
_3586.CompletionSummary: It doesn't make sense. How did you... to Digimon made by a human being?

_3587.Title: Shinjuku
_3587.Description: ..we've got the Ultimate Digimon down. That's a lot of power. Hypnos, I don't know why they did to make this happen, but... We need to be more proactive. We're all tired now, so @<tc:990>let's just back off. The children will gather again at the playground tomorrow. Let's leave as soon as we're ready.@</tc>
_3587.CompletionSummary: I've been waiting for you. Now, let's talk about it.

_3588.Title: Shinjuku
_3588.Description: Digimon Tamers... I don't think it's bad. Anyway, I'm glad to have such a good relationship with Rika. Now I can really focus on Hypnos. Let's make sure we're right about Hypnos, and Digimon and Deva, who realized, let the kids cope. We have to do what we can. Speaking of which, we need to install a research device at the construction site in Downtown, east of Shinjuku. Set up a research device of Digimon's realize areas so far, and defeat the Digimons that appear there. When you're done, come to Guilmon's house.
_3588.Objective: Set the Divice at Downtown Defeat Gazimon Defeat Gekomon Set the Divice at Accident Scene Defeat Apemon
_3588.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Set the Divice-Downtown%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Gazimon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Gekomon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Set the Digivice-Accident Scene%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Defeat Apemon%qe %cc5/%mc5

_3589.Title: Shinjuku
_3589.Description: While you were investigating, Digimon, Sandiramon, appeared at Shinjuku Station. Did what happened yesterday become a catalyst? I didn't expect the Champion Digimon to come over frequently. This isn't good. Even if there are children who can help, there will be no end to responding to Digimon, who is a realized figure. We need to use our time efficiently. I'll give you this first, so go back to Dats Center and report to Captain Richard Sampson. @<tc:990>Tell me when you're ready, I'll send it to you right away.@</tc>
_3589.CompletionText: Why don't you go out for mood change?
_3589.CompletionSummary: Hypnos. I see. The organization removed all the Digimons that were hidden through unknown power, but it rather strengthened its connection to the digital world. It's worse than I expected.
_3589.ReservedText: 'Oh, you here. I was worried about the lack of regular reports because an unidentified organization interfered. Good to see you.

_3590.Title: Shinjuku
_3590.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, good news and bad news. I found out that Digimon, which has huge data, has realized signs on the research device installed in eastern Shinjuku. I'm not sure, but it's highly likely that Deva appeared, so come back as soon as you finish your report to Captain Richard Sampson!
_3590.CompletionSummary: Alright. that is enough for the report. Please go back to the site.@<tc:990>talk to me when you are ready. I will send you there right away.@</tc>

_3591.Title: Shinjuku
_3591.Description: You're here! Did you report it well? All right. First of all, you're the only one who can do this job. Henry and Takato are going to summer camp today at school. And Rika also told me not to call Renamon because she's exhausted. I think we'll have to deal with it! Now, it's time for you to show your skills as a Dats Agent! First of all, some Digimons have appeared in the eastern part of Shinjuku. Looks like Deva's minions, according to the research, it's Kiwimon and Elecmon. We need to solve this before these guys get into a trouble!
_3591.CompletionText: Deva…. Where the heck are you!

_3592.Title: Shinjuku
_3592.Description: We don't... remember since IceDevimon got us... I remember being stuck in the ice, but I haven't remembered anything since...! Come to think of it, it was in the middle of Real World with strange buildings! I was really hungry, so I walked around a little bit, but I didn't cause any damage to my surroundings! I'm going to take the price of persecuting us for our sins! Bring us food to fill our stomachs! Then I'll pretend it never happened!
_3592.Objective: Talk to a Shopkeeper Buy Food
_3592.CompletionSummary: Wow! so you actually a good guy!

_3593.Title: Shinjuku
_3593.Description: Oh, well, I was just walking around because I needed something. What are these guys? What? Digimon was caught by IceDevimon and released? Hmm. But Digimon also eats too. Then, is the nourishing drink that people eat also helpful to Digimon? If you know anything, I think it'd be good to get it. I don't mean to give it to Renamon.
_3593.Objective: Talk to a Shopkeeper Buy Nutrition Drink
_3593.CompletionSummary: So this is what your partner eats? well, thank you. I learned things.

_3594.Title: Shinjuku
_3594.Description: The girl I saw before... It's really scary. I'm sure it's okay because she's gone! Anyway, I want to go back to the Digital World. Do you have any idea how? What? There's a Digimon you know? Then take me home! I'm scared here for some reason.
_3594.Objective: Move to Shinjuku Park-Guilmon's House Talk to PawnChessmon W
_3594.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Park-Guilmon's House%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to PawnChessmon W%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3594.CompletionText: Everyone keep mentions Real world but nothing much, you know…!
_3594.CompletionSummary: Ah..so, You brought them home to buy them a meal and send them back home?
_3594.ReservedText: Who are the Digimons near you?

_3595.Title: Shinjuku
_3595.Description: That's right. @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> I can help you get back to the Digital World. But you have to pay for that. From now on, you'll have to answer my questions well.

_3596.Title: Shinjuku
_3596.Description: Lately, there's been a shortage of electric current all over Shinjuku, and it's Sinduramon's fault. Probably couldn't have gone far. @<tc:990> I'll send you to the expected location, so respond as soon as you meet Sinduramon. Let's leave as soon as we're ready.@</tc>
_3596.CompletionText: While you are there, I will prepare to send these guys back to Digital World.
_3596.CompletionSummary: Arrogant human! Are you against God!

_3597.Title: Shinjuku
_3597.Description: Oh…! I think they've eaten up all the electricity in the city. There's nothing we can do. Let's return to Guilmon's house. We won't be able to chase them now, but they'll reappear in front of us as long as they have a purpose.
_3597.CompletionSummary: Hypnos has moved. Maybe they will do the finishing touches.

_3598.Title: Shinjuku
_3598.Description: We've missed Deva, but... Maybe they'll show up in front of us somehow because we'll get in the way. We just need to be prepared for that time. And Henry and Takato are coming back tomorrow, so let's wait calmly. Speaking of which, why don't you pick them up? @<tc:990>Tell me when you're ready, let's get going.@</tc>

_3599.Title: Shinjuku
_3599.Description: Oh? Sinduramon showed up in the city? And you defeat him yesterday? That's a relief. He has done more damage to the city than I thought. Oh, what was I doing? I was just looking into this blue card. Henry got this by accident yesterday, and there was some hidden data. So I was going to the electronics store where Henry found this card. Would you like to come with me if you don't mind?
_3599.Objective: Move to Eastern Shinjuku E-shopping Center
_3599.CompletionText: This blue card, it was there every time we were in a crisis. But I think there's someone who made this.
_3599.CompletionSummary: Wow! There are so many computers and TVs... uh... but why is it all broken?

_3600.Title: Shinjuku
_3600.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, a strong signal is now in eastern Shinjuku... what? You're already on that side? Deva? That's great. Let's show them what we got. Let's help the kids first and take care of the Digimons that seem to be Vajramon's minions! Leave Deva to the children, and we're the residuals!!

_3601.Title: Shinjuku
_3601.Description: I couldn't find the person who made the blue card...but I'm glad that we found Deva in advance. Hoo, what should I do? Actually, my dad caught Terriermon on the way here today. Impmon attacked my dad, so... I have a headache on how to talk about it, but first of all, people will be coming soon after hearing the commotion. @<tc:990>Let's get out of the way where PawnChessmonW is.@</tc>
_3601.CompletionSummary: Welcome. Eliminating two Devas is a huge harvest. You've done a good job.

_3602.Title: Shinjuku
_3602.Description: Blue card. You've been getting help with this all this time? Obviously, kids in Shinjuku were a little different from the way they fought. Wouldn't it be a bit of a reference at Dats Center? A new combat aid program might be ready... You can use the cards on the market as they are. I'm getting a little interested in this. Let's collect some cards for better data analysis. Defeat Digimon whos wandering east of Shinjuku and you'll probably get it. Let's give it a try.
_3602.CompletionText: I wish they be the power to Tamer.
_3602.CompletionSummary: Too bad... I can't see any difference. Shall we stop here? It's late at night. I'm going to send the card to the headquarters and ask for an analysis. I hope the headquarters get better results than I thought. @<tc:990>Let's get some rest anyway, and see you tomorrow in front of Guilmon's house.@</tc>

_3603.Title: Shinjuku
_3603.Description: Henry and Takato gave me the sad news. I've got some sad news. Vajramon, I thought it was dataized as it is, but it's still there. I heard Vajramon showed great interest in Renamon during the fight. He showed up again in the middle of the night and took Renamon somewhere. Renamon didn't have any particular resistance, he just followed. He's strong and intelligent, so he's good at it, but... I can't help being worried. Terriermon says it's okay, but I can't stay still. In addition, since Deva started to come over, the connection with the digital world has become stronger, and the reality phenomenon has begun to increase as well. First of all, what we need to deal with right now is... It's Vegiemon and Mammothmon. Let's defeat the Digimons and see if they have anything to do with Deva.
_3603.CompletionText: I'm afraid I can't help it with the card case.
_3603.CompletionSummary: Did you find any connection with Deva?

_3604.Title: Shinjuku
_3604.Description: ..I'll be here, so let's either join Rika and wait until Renamon gets here, or check Rika's Digivice if there's any way to find out. Probably the place where they usually hang around is east of Shinjuku, so wouldn't it be somewhere? Go find it.

_3605.Title: Shinjuku
_3605.Description: I'm a little worried about Renamon, to be honest. I'm afraid she won't come back. I tried to check with Digivice, but I couldn't find out. I keep trying to think that it'll be okay. Vajramon seemed to want to talk to Renamon.
_3605.CompletionSummary: We'll just wait anyway. If Renamon is with me, I would have fought with you. That's too bad.

_3606.Title: Shinjuku
_3606.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, can you hear me? Vajramon just showed up. Henry and Takato are also moving to where the realize response is now. You're with Rika? Good. Take Rika and come straight to Shinjuku Station! I'll see you there!

_3607.Title: Shinjuku
_3607.Description: Now, we need to be focused on. Vajramon is now near the stadium near Shinjuku. Seriously, let's send him back to the data this time! Now! Let's go to the stadium and defeat Vajramon!
_3607.CompletionText: Devaaa..! Let's show them our true power!
_3607.CompletionSummary: Taomon, aye? What a girl. Rika now becomes a great Tamer.

_3608.Title: Shinjuku
_3608.Description: I'm glad the kids are growing up amazingly. If it were just the two of us, maybe we couldn't have done this. Now, let's sort out the information we've collected so far. First of all, the Digimons appeared phenomenon was caused by the connection to the Digital World, and we need to investigate more about why it was connected. But what bothers me is that Deva, who seems to have a big presence in the Digital World, is quite hostile to humans. Should I say that he is more hostile than necessary? And so did the things that Mihiramon mentioned. First of all, our goal is to prevent Deva from making a fuss in Real World as much as possible. Getting as much information as you can. @<tc:990>Let's get back. I'll see you in front of Guillmon's house tomorrow.@</tc>
_3608.CompletionSummary: I don't know how many Deva is there, but it is definite that we detect reacts.

_3609.Title: Shinjuku
_3609.Description: It's the parking lot near the Playground. Hurry up and come back!
_3609.CompletionText: Seems like Digimon appears almost everyday.
_3609.CompletionSummary: Impmon, that will be impossible to you.

_3610.Title: Shinjuku
_3610.Description: ... Vajramon, the one that showed up earlier, said it was wrong to evolve with humans. I think... Deva's purpose seems to be with us, but something's wrong. Every Deva shows up talk that a human error or a false evolution. Honestly, I don't know why they hated us. But, as Renamon said, it's a fight they've walked into, so we're gonna have to accept it, right?
_3610.CompletionSummary: 'Anyway, a guy called Impmon... What do you think he will do?

_3611.Title: Shinjuku
_3611.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Impmon eventually made a trouble. They're attacking people in eastern Shinjuku. There's a lot of commotion going on! I'll send you right to the location, so stop the Impmon!
_3611.CompletionSummary: Let me go!! Why are you bother me in every case!

_3612.Title: Shinjuku
_3612.Summary: A reliable colleague and an emergency.
_3612.Description: ..@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I don't think it's time to pay attention to Impmon. Some Dangerous Digimon is trying to across the world. It seems like the other Deva! Leave this with me and Rika, and you go that way. You're stronger than us, you can do it on your own. I'm sure PawnChessmon W is running over, too. That's how dangerous...
_3612.CompletionSummary: How! I was just trying to reach you, but how did you know this place!?

_3613.Title: Shinjuku
_3613.Summary: in order to fulfill one's duties
_3613.Description: Renamon noticed first and sent you here? It's not easy on this side either, but it's not going to be easy on that side either...! I think we can overcome this crisis only if we do what we each do! Once Deva shows up over there, let's trust the kids, and let's do what we can! Now, appeared one is called Majiramon. I think that's Deva, too, but I think it's a feign an attack. Like they're looking for something. And I feel like they will take any risks until they find something. They're already destroying the perimeter. Let's defeat him before he does any more damage around here!

_3614.Title: Shinjuku
_3614.Description: ..ran... away? I don't think so... Those guys are... No way! It must be Hypnos...! let's go back to Guilmon's house for now. I think it's better to go back since the other side is in a lull.
_3614.CompletionSummary: Alright. Calm down and organize the things.

_3615.Title: Shinjuku
_3615.Description: If Rika's just trying to target the kids, it's weird that Majiramon's realize is somewhere else. I think he has a purpose other than children, considering that he's bringing in his men and Sinduramon. And I don't think they're the ones who're going to step down, but they' Maybe Hypnos used the one that Mihiramon used for realize again. And that's what makes Deva even more motivated. Hypnos may have some responsibility for the stronger connection with the digital world.
_3615.CompletionSummary: As long as Hypnos aims to exclude Digimon from the real world, it would be fair to say that he has the same purpose as us. Of course, it's a problem because the way they do is so different, but... But I can't just interrupt. @<tc:990>It's too late for now, so let's rest and get back here tomorrow.@</tc>

_3616.Title: Shinjuku
_3616.Description: ... let's not miss it this time. The Indaramon of Deva will be taken care of by children. We'll take care of Majiramon. Let's be strong. @<tc:990>Let's go as soon as we're ready. @</tc>

_3617.Title: Shinjuku
_3617.Description: ... the Hypnos. I think they've even brought in the army now. They've already got the kids on the side, and we also about to have a military helicopter on our side. @<tc:990>Let's go to Guilmon's house first. There might be children.
_3617.CompletionSummary: They say they've succeeded to defeat the indaramon. I wish we could've defeated Majiramon.

_3618.Title: Shinjuku
_3618.Description: I heard it from my master.

_3619.Title: Shinjuku
_3619.Description: ..I'll stay with them and finish talking. I just found a realize phenomenon. It's right around here, so would you go take care of it first? The location is Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square.
_3619.Objective: Move to Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square Defeat Digimon at Waterfall Square
_3619.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Park-Waterfall Square%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Digimon at Square%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3619.CompletionSummary: You are strong. But why me... huh? no. I have no intention of harming this place.

_3620.Title: Shinjuku
_3620.Description: I came here after a weirdo. A strange human girl has been following me for a while ago. I'm going to stay out of the way, so let's stop talking. Anyway, I don't mean to hurt this world. Rather, I intend to deal with those who are doing bad things. If we bump into each other, let's help each other.
_3620.CompletionSummary: …Leomon... and a suspicious guy. Now it's not surprising.

_3621.Title: Shinjuku
_3621.Description: Deva's probably right about the suspicious guy that Leomon mentioned. I was actually analyzing the data after the kids left. The data is not that big, but we've checked for traces of Deva's appearance. How many Devas are there? There's no end to it. I don't think he's as big as Majiramon, but... Would you like to look around first? Start from Shinjuku Park-waterfall square to the playground. Oh, and please installs this research device.
_3621.Objective: Shinjuku Park-Waterfall Square, Item Use Park-Center, Item Use Park-South, Item Use Park-sports field, Item Use
_3621.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Park-Waterfall, Item Use%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Park-Center, Item Use%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Park-South, Item Use%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Park-sports field, Item Use%qe %cc4/%mc4

_3622.Title: Shinjuku
_3622.Description: I just heard from Guilmon. A guy named Leomon became Takato's friend and partner Digimon, and then Leomon, who became his friend's partner, got rid of Kumbhiramon. Well, it's good to see fewer Deva, so you'd better take a positive view of this. Maybe it's because of a series of nervous events, I'm losing steam for no reason. @<tc:990>First of all, you did a great job today. See you here tomorrow.
_3622.CompletionSummary: Oh, you here? Finally, they brought a clue to find out about Deva's identity.

_3623.Title: Shinjuku
_3623.Description: It has all the characteristics of Devas that we've dealt with so far. If the child's reasoning is correct, there are now five Devas left. I don't know what the kids think, but it will be finished soon. I'm glad we're getting to know Deva step by step. I'm just a little worried about Hypnos. It's so quiet. Of course, they seem to have poured everything they could, but they're hiding something. They're not gonna end up like this. so I'd like you to look around the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square, which is expected to be Hypnos' home base. There's a risk of getting caught by the Hypnos crew, but if you don't want to be embarrassed when you might have to deal with Deva soon, you'd better check on Hypnos' movements. @<tc:990>So tell me when you're ready, I'll send you to the designated location right away
_3623.Objective: Check Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square Check Tokyo Metropolitan Government

_3624.Title: Shinjuku
_3624.Description: Now it's over that artificial intelligence made by old people is running wild.
_3624.CompletionSummary: You can look forward to it. Soon all the Wild one will disappear from this world.

_3625.Title: Shinjuku
_3625.Description: Hypnos's promise to stop Digimon has rather expanded its connection with the digital world. That's why all kinds of Digimons are about to come over. One of the Deva, Vikaralamon, is already realizing the city, and the others have come over! The biggest problem among them is MetalSeadramon! The ultimate Digimon! The damage will be uncontrollable once the ultimate begins to leap! I will be blocking Vikaralamon, so if you defeat the MetalSeadramon, come to the west side of Shinjuku!
_3625.CompletionSummary: Good thing you're here! Now let's fight back!

_3626.Title: Shinjuku
_3626.Description: The kids are blocking the Vikaralamon right now, but they're weak. You can say he's the strongest Deva you've ever fought. We can't back down like this! Let's help the children defeat the Vikaralamon!!
_3626.CompletionSummary: I've stopped the Vikaralamon, but... This is...

_3627.Title: Shinjuku
_3627.Description: ... What Deva chase after was a Culumon. By the time the battle with Vikaralamon intensified and was about to end, a monkey-like Digimon appeared and kidnapped and fled... Beyond the digital world that opened with the emergence of the Vikaralamon. Damn, the city was damaged beyond a turn, and the Culumon was kidnapped by the enemy. There's nothing that's going to be done right!
_3627.CompletionSummary: ... people are coming. @<tc:990>Let's move to Guilmon's house first.@</tc>

_3628.Title: Shinjuku
_3628.CompletionSummary: ..I need time for the kids to talk to their parents and get things organized before deciding on heading to the digital world. Digimon's identity has spread all over the Real world, and children need to be fully explained to their families as they are deeply involved in it. Anyway, until then, let's defeat the Digimon.

_3629.Title: Shinjuku
_3629.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimons are Goblimon and Ogremon. Before these guys make a scene, we need to stop them! Move to Shinjuku Western(Night) Park-Sports field!
_3629.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3630.Title: Shinjuku
_3630.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Apemon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Shinjuku Eastern(Day) Accident scene!
_3630.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3631.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimons are PicoDevimon and Bakemon. Before these guys makes a scene, we need to stop them! Move to Shinjuku Western(Night) Elementary School!
_3631.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3632.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3633.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3634.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3636.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3637.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Gargomon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to move to Shinjuku Western(Night) - Forest and stop him!
_3637.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3641.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3643.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3644.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3646.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3647.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Mihiramon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Shinjuku Eastern(Night) Tokyo Metropolitan Government Square!
_3647.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3648.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3649.Title: Shinjuku
_3649.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Majiramon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Shinjuku Eastern(Day) - Boulevard!
_3649.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3650.Title: Shinjuku
_3650.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is MetalSeadramon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Shinjuku Western(Day) - Road!
_3650.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3651.Title: Shinjuku
_3651.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Vajramon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Stadium!
_3651.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3652.Title: Shinjuku
_3652.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Vikaralamon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Stadium!
_3652.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work.

_3653.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3653.Description: ...The Digital World. I don't know how to get there from this part of Shinjuku yet, but there should be a way. The children are also preparing themselves to go to the Digital World. Let's decide too. We can't both follow them into the Digital World. Someone has to monitor the Shinjuku area. I'll take care of that so, you take the children and go to the Digital World. And once you are there, it will be hard to communicate so gain permission from Commander Sampson first.
_3653.CompletionSummary: I see. Digital World you say…
_3653.ReservedText: So you came. We watched everything that was happening in Shinjuku. It's a relief you and P:awnChessmonW are alright.

_3654.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3654.Description: Hmm definitely we need to go to the digital world and investigate why this is happening. But on the contrary, don't you know what will happen in Shinjuku? First, leave PawnChessmon W in Shinjuku, so you can follow the kids and investigate what's going on in Digital World. Since you are a competent agent, I think you can work wisely without PawnChessmon W and our instructions. Share this with PawnChessmon W and start with your kids right into Digital World.
_3654.CompletionSummary: I see.. I understand the leader's position. Alright. Please take good care of the children. The children are probably going to start out from this Guilmon's house, so join them there.

_3655.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3655.Description: Hi! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Good morning! Are you ready to go to the Digital World?

_3656.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3656.Description: ...We are okay.. even though we fell off from that height..

_3657.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3657.Description: All the food we brought to the Digital World is gone.. Let's seArkh around the area just incase? I'll take a look at this communication device.
_3657.CompletionText: Um.. is this how it's done? What should I do?
_3657.CompletionSummary: As expected.. All the food is gone.

_3658.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3658.Description: I don't know what to do about the food.. We have to look for a way somehow. It's odd.. maybe because it's the Digital World and seeing only machines left behind. I think I have to talk to Henry.
_3658.CompletionSummary: .. I'm not sure either. From what I heard from dad, the Digital World evolves by itself so there will be many things that we do not understand. We have to be careful.

_3659.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3659.Description: ..I heard about it form dad, but this was not what I anticipated.. I think we have to ask Renamon and Leomon who lived here once before. If we move like this we may get caught up in something bigger. Let's first ask Leomon who stayed in the Digital World most recently.
_3659.CompletionSummary: Well.. It's my first time here. I have nothing much to say. Also the Digital World is huge. It's a more barren and dangerous place than you may think. No matter how much you are being careful, it may not be enough, but do take caution.
_3659.ReservedText: How's the Digital World? Is it alright?

_3660.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3660.Description: Let's think about that later! Let's take a commemorative picture first! We have to capture the moment of our first step in the Digital World! Here, I'll give you the camera, could you take a picture of us?
_3660.Objective: Take a picture of Takato Matsuki
_3660.CompletionText: Wow~ I'm so excited about the Digital World!

_3661.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3661.Summary: Photos that cannot be taken, missing food
_3661.Description: All the photos.. it's blurry or some people are missing. It's the Digital World.., but some machines are not working properly. We should talk to the guys first.
_3661.CompletionSummary: By the way... where should we go now?

_3662.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3662.Description: Would you mind for a second? Anyway, I don't know where to go or where to go, so I think it would be better to go to a unique place that stands out. When I finally looked around with a telescope, there are peculiar stones in that direction. Let's go there.
_3662.CompletionText: .. We must go rescue Culumon! We have no time to waste.
_3662.CompletionSummary: Oh no... The situation is not good.

_3663.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3663.Description: First of all, I think everyone is too tired. The heat is also a problem, but the digital world wider than we expected also seems to play a part. And..

_3664.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3664.Summary: A sudden change of the environment
_3664.Description: It's okay if you don't run away. You don't have to be a fuss. This is the dastopaketo, it should be a cup of simple data. The real thing is after this... get ready.

_3665.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3665.Description: Let's get rid of that guy first! There is no need to think differently from Realized Digimon! Let's respond as we did!
_3665.CompletionText: Where all these guys live... Digital World..!
_3665.CompletionSummary: Why, Why are strong guys like here..!

_3666.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3666.Description: Ah... you were the humans. I also want to meet Tamer and become stronger! But maybe because they're not strong enough like Renamon or Leomon over there, they're not being chosen by the Tamer. So, can you train me to meet Tamer too?!
_3666.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! I feel like I've become a bit stronger!

_3667.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3667.Description: Ah... you were the humans. I also want to meet Tamer and become stronger! But maybe because they're not strong enough like Renamon or Leomon over there, they're not being chosen by the Tamer. So, can you train me to meet Tamer too?!
_3667.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! I feel like I've become a bit stronger!

_3668.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3668.Summary: Wishing for Each Other's Wishes to Come True
_3668.Description: I think I can achieve my dreams thanks to your help! Of course, it's a pity that you don't know the Digimon you're looking for, but thanks for your help! I hope you guys can find that Digimon by all means. There's nothing like this, but there's a place for you to rest over there. You can spend tonight there.
_3668.CompletionText: Thank you! Hope you find the Digimon you are looking for!!
_3668.CompletionSummary: This place.. It's not bad at all? I think it'll be more than enough to rest up a day here.

_3669.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3669.Description: It looks like a plant type Digimon called Jagamon! It looks small, but it's Ultimate! It is small, but it is very dangerous because it is in a group! Let's avoid everyone so we don't get swept over there!
_3669.CompletionSummary: ... Let's get some sleep first and search the area when there's light.. We need to find if there are any other risks nearby.

_3670.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3670.Description: Good morning..? Yesterday I was talking with them about Meramon. Maybe... because everyone didn't know that Meramon would disappear so vainly... First, let's make Meramon's tomb. Could you get some stones so we can build a tomb?
_3670.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Now, let's make Meramon's grave.

_3671.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3671.Description: Like Meramon's yesterday, we don't know what will happen to us. And as we have to find Culumon, it would be better to look around more closely to see if there is anything dangerous or if there is any trace of Culumon and then start. Me and the kids will go to the other side, so you look over there and come. And let's meet again around here.
_3671.CompletionSummary: It's the guys from yesterday! Let's get them!

_3672.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3672.Description: Yesterday you made Meramon like that... it put us in danger! we have to get revenge! So let's join forces and defeat the Jagamons around!

_3673.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3673.Description: The Jagamons are making noise and mess around again! Join forces to defeat Jagamon!
_3673.CompletionSummary: It keeps coming back to me... Meramon.. Wish you are now at the real world that you have always wanted.

_3674.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3674.Description: Let's go in the direction Jagamon gave us. Something is trivial, but I'm glad I could get a clue. Let's meet there.
_3674.CompletionSummary: Hm... Makuramon's trace doesn't seem to be here.

_3675.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3675.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! We have to save those idiots! Come on!

_3676.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3676.Description: The wind is starting to get stronger... Once these fools have awakened, let's find a place to hide. Look around and come.

_3677.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3677.Description: It's very dangerous because the wind blows a lot, but there are some crazy guys who don't always listen. You look stronger than those kids, so punish Deputymon, who wreaks havoc on this canyon without thinking even if the wind blows.
_3677.CompletionText: It'll be trouble if the house is destroyed by their commotion.

_3678.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3678.Description: It's very dangerous because the wind blows a lot, but there are some crazy guys who don't always listen. You look stronger than those kids, so punish Deputymon, who wreaks havoc on this canyon without thinking even if the wind blows.
_3678.CompletionText: It'll be trouble if the house is destroyed by their commotion.
_3678.CompletionSummary: Good job! I prepared this for a job well done. I hope you like it.

_3679.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3679.Description: While I went home to look at the children for a while, the Deputy mons robbed the food warehouse..! These guys just playing around! Bring back the items they stole! I will not make you disappointed in return!

_3680.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3680.Description: I need to get some firewood anyway. Can you see Woodmon over there? It would be nice if you could get dry branches from those Woodmons. Somehow, the trees that are there are easily dataized. Once this is done, we can all go home. Wouldn't it be all good to each other?
_3680.CompletionSummary: Oooooh! You gathered a lot. This should be more than enough.

_3681.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3681.Description: Ah! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Falling out of the sky! What's happening!! What about Rika and the others?! Are you okay?!
_3681.CompletionSummary: Oh, sorry..! I'm too excited. Anyways, I'm relieved you guys were able to get through the crisis after meeting Jijimon. Well done.

_3682.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3682.Description: This is the village where the Chuchidarumon lives. But they say they are suffering from some strange motorcycle... I was thinking about what to do. If you don't know, go to Chuchidarumon Chef and ask if you can help.
_3682.CompletionSummary: Oh, I see. He's those children's friend..

_3683.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3683.Description: Helping the village.. But there are some things that are a little overwhelming with our own strength. It would be nice if you could do the requests of Chuchidarumon all over the place.

_3684.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3684.Summary: A Toy for the Children to Play With
_3684.Description: Hello! Do you have any toys or something? We mean... I lost my toy for some weird motorcycle! Could you find something like a toy around you?
_3684.CompletionText: Is our toy not ready yet?
