_3684.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now we have something to play with too. Hehe.

_3685.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3685.Summary: [Daily] A Toy for the Children to Play With
_3685.Description: Hello! Could you ever get me a toy again? I lost my toy while playing with it! Could you find something like a toy around you?
_3685.CompletionText: Is our toy not ready yet?
_3685.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now we have something to play with too. Hehe.

_3686.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3686.Summary: Materials Needed to Repair the House
_3686.Description: Ah! Are you the humans who came to our village? Nice to meet you. Oh, if Chef did that, we have something to ask. Because my house is broken now. Could you give me some materials to repair the house? please!
_3686.Objective: Gather Repair Material stolen by Starmon
_3686.CompletionText: Wonder how long the motorcycle guys will keep showing up.
_3686.CompletionSummary: Oh! Thank you! This is should be enough to fix it!

_3687.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3687.Summary: [Daily] Materials Needed to Repair the House
_3687.Description: Oh, because the wind broke my house again. Could you give me some materials to repair the house? please!
_3687.Objective: Gather Repair Material stolen by Starmon
_3687.CompletionText: Wonder how long the motorcycle guys will keep showing up.
_3687.CompletionSummary: Oh! Thank you! This is should be enough to fix it!

_3688.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3688.Description: Whoa... I'm worried about the food. Huh? Are you human? Oh, is this what the Chef was talking about? I'm glad. If not, the house was destroyed and the food was so damaged that it was impossible to eat. I'll tell you the ingredients you need to make food, so can you get it?
_3688.Objective: Gather Food Ingredients taken by Starmon
_3688.CompletionText: Hmmm do you need anything else?
_3688.CompletionSummary: This should be enough. Thank you!

_3689.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3689.Description: Whoa... I'm worried about the food. Huh? Are you human? Oh, is this what the Chef was talking about? I'm glad. If not, the house was destroyed and the food was so damaged that it was impossible to eat. I'll tell you the ingredients you need to make food, so can you get it?
_3689.Objective: Gather Food Ingredients taken by Starmon
_3689.CompletionText: Hmmm do you need anything else?
_3689.CompletionSummary: This should be enough. Thank you!

_3690.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3690.Summary: Defeat the Digimon Who's Threatening the Village
_3690.Description: You! You look strong! Can I ask for help? Besides motorcycles, there are Digimons that threaten the town. I want you to get rid of those guys so they can't get to town
_3690.CompletionText: They! They damaged our village so intensely even though they call themselves the Apostles of Justice!
_3690.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now it should be calmer!

_3691.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3691.Summary: [Daily] Defeat the Digimon Who's Threatening the Village
_3691.Description: Can I ask you for help once again? Besides motorcycles, there are Digimons that threaten the town. I want you to get rid of those guys so they can't get to town
_3691.CompletionText: They! They damaged our village so intensely even though they call themselves the Apostles of Justice!
_3691.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now it should be calmer!

_3692.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3692.Summary: Chuchidarumon Who Wants to Become Stronger
_3692.Description: The way you showed is really great! I wonder how I can be strong like you! Rockmon, who lives with us, seems to want to see you and be strong. Fight Rockmon and train our friends!
_3692.CompletionSummary: So strong.. Will Rockmon be able to become as strong as you?

_3693.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3693.Summary: [Daily] Chuchidarumon Who Wants to Become Stronger
_3693.Description: The way you showed is really great! I wonder how I can be strong like you! Rockmon, who lives with us, seems to want to see you and be strong. Fight Rockmon and train our friends!
_3693.CompletionSummary: So strong.. Will Rockmon be able to become as strong as you?

_3694.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3694.Description: Thanks to you, the town is more stable.. Thank you. But... hoo, although this is not the only problem with motorcycles that cause damage here and there. For now, this is enough.
_3694.CompletionSummary: .. To be wielding such a thing..

_3695.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3695.Description: .. A Digimon that can control that motorcycle like that. It must be a very strong Digimon... Oh! Guys, be careful!! A ray of light came... @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!!
_3695.CompletionSummary: Are you okay?! Where have you been!

_3696.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3696.Description: I'm glad Takato was okay... It was a really stuffy situation, but I'm glad you came here too.

_3697.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3697.Summary: To the Place Where the Odd Sound is Heard
_3697.Description: I keep hearing weird clock noises from before... I'm going to calm Rika down and go with them, so can you go first and check what it is?
_3697.Objective: Enter Where Sound of a Broken Clock is Heard
_3697.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Enter Where Sound of a Broken Clock is Heard%qe %cc1/%mc1

_3699.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3699.Description: MegaDramon is an extremely dangerous Digimon! We're done now! What? Can you stop it?! Then please! Stop that guy!
_3699.CompletionText: Ryo helped us last time.. Please! Save us!!
_3699.CompletionSummary: Too strong! This might become too dangerous!

_3700.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3700.Description: MegaDramon is an extremely dangerous Digimon! We're done now! What? Can you stop it?! Then please! Stop that guy!
_3700.CompletionText: You guys are strong too! Please! Save me!!
_3700.CompletionSummary: As expected.. You are as strong as Ryo!

_3701.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3701.Description: I wasn't too late! You held out well! I'll take care of the rest!

_3702.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3702.Description: Tanned skin, shiny white teeth, fresh smile... What the hell is it? This unpleasant refreshing ray is...! Ah~ so irritated..! Could you talk to them instead of me? I really want to hit him, so I can't speak.
_3702.CompletionSummary: You are the one from the legend! It's an honour!! Oh and that's Rika Nonoka who has been the constant rank 1 since you disappeared! She's referred to as the Digimon Queen! 야! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Don't stay still like that and go talk to him!
_3702.ReservedText: You are!! The legendary Tamer Ryo Akiyama!!

_3703.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3703.Description: Ah~ I see. haha. I think I will meet people like this. I knew we'd meet someday, but I didn't know we would meet so soon. I heard your friends are in other places as well. Thanks to what Hirokazu and Kenta told me, I've heard the situation, so I'm going to actively help.. By the way.. The girl over there seems to be a little unhappy, but she seems to be a bit alert to me. Can you ask me how you feel for me?
_3703.ReservedText: Uh... They saying as if I'm weaker than him! Say that when you get stronger too!!

_3704.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3704.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Those idiots are too fascinated by that fresh light ray. I think it'll be better for us to travel ourselves. Let's ignore them go this way.
_3704.Objective: Enter Somewhere in the Cloud Area
_3704.CompletionSummary: Let's get swept in the light ray and move somewhere else.

_3705.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3705.Description: .. this is a forest. It's different from where we've been..! Let's look around to see if there is anything dangerous around.

_3706.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3706.Description: Rika is in the river! Culu! Come bring me something that can save Rika!
_3706.CompletionSummary: Culu! Now! Throw it like this!

_3707.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3707.Description: Uh... Thanks for saving me Rena-.. Culumon?

_3708.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3708.Description: What are you... don't disturb, get out of the way. I'm trying to test my strength, are you going to run too? Don't think about touching my prey. What? The guy running at you? Do it your way.
_3708.CompletionSummary: Don't kid yourself by defeating some weak Digimons. At any other time, I would destroy you, but right now I'm in a good mood so I'll let you live. But if you appear in front of me again, you will not survive.

_3709.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3709.Description: (We can't connect with the Digivice.. There's a route there so let's go over there.)
_3709.CompletionSummary: You are... the human that was with all those kids?! Darn it! Majiramon was tamed by some weird Digimon tamed by a human and now it's you?!

_3710.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3710.Description: I cannot forgive you humans! I lost when I was caught off-guard as Majiramon, but I'll show you my true strength here!
_3710.CompletionText: Darn it.. I remember the Digimon tamed by this guy was pretty strong..
_3710.CompletionSummary: Argh!! Human pest.. You are stronger than I thought! But I cannot disappear here! Hehehehehe! Follow me if you can! Hm?! NOO!! If I get swept by the light ray..!

_3711.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3711.Description: I cannot forgive you humans! I lost when I was caught off-guard as Majiramon, but I'll show you my true strength here!
_3711.CompletionText: Darn it.. I remember the Digimon tamed by this guy was pretty strong..

_3712.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3712.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! You are safe!.. Takato and Henry? Unfortuantely this is everyone. I think those two were swept somewhere else. We got here after being swept away by the light ray.
_3712.CompletionSummary: Anyways, we can't just stay still.

_3713.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3713.Description: Let's investigate around to see what Digimons there are and what area this is.

_3714.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3714.Description: Andromon got seriously injured while fighting Orochimon. First I open the road and let the rest of the kids take Andromon away! Orochimon's men are so strong! Join forces with me and take them down!
_3714.CompletionSummary: Okay! Now, let's escape as well!

_3715.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3715.Description: Seadramon is still harming the surroundings, Gekomon said! It's strong and burdensome, but let's get rid of it!
_3715.CompletionSummary: Okay! Now, let's escape as well!

_3716.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3716.CompletionSummary: I'm glad Gekomon granted our favor.

_3717.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3717.Description: Once we got everything we basically needed, we sent the children to Andromon first, but when you think about Andromon's physical condition, there may be more needs. You have to look for things that can help you heal your wounds. So, could you get some juice from the Vegimons wandering over there?

_3718.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3718.Description: First, I'll show you where Andromon and the kids are, so go there. I will go first and deliver this tree juice to my children, which can be helpful for healing. So let's see it there.
_3718.CompletionText: The true Digimon.. I hope he survives.

_3719.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3719.Description: Data is a very good medicine for Digimon. You can heal dangerous wounds right away if you use alcohol or some kind of tree juice you've been looking for. However, in the battle with Orochimon, he used too much power and degenerates into Gardromon. Still, I'm glad I can get the ceremony right away.

_3720.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3720.Description: No matter how much Jeri lives in a restaurant and is used to drunkards, Orochimon isn't just a drunkard. You have to save Jeri anyway. Let's talk to Gardromon, who has faced Orochimon the most.
_3720.ReservedText: I can't see someone who has taken care of me so intensively be kidnapped.

_3721.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3721.Description: To rescue Jeri, you have to collaborate with Gekomons. By now, the Gekomon will probably prepare a drink and bring it to Orochimon. Let's convince the Gekomon in the middle.

_3722.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3722.Description: The plan is to empty the keg to the Gekomons and attack them when we go in there and try to hide and drink. So I needed help from Gekomon. Now, are you ready to go? Let's start right away.

_3723.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3723.Description: Now! Let's take control of the Lake Area and defeat Orochimon, which prevents Gekomon from singing peacefully!!!

_3724.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3724.Description: Now! Let's take control of the Lake Area and defeat Orochimon, which prevents Gekomon from singing peacefully!!!

_3725.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3725.Description: We recovered peace.. it's all thanks to you guys!
_3725.CompletionSummary: Hehe... This is nothing. Let's go watch Gekomon sing! We have to congratu-.. huh?! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!!

_3726.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3726.Description: Ah! Finally you woke up! Is your body okay? Suddenly I was surprised to see it, but it was like that last time... Where is this place? Ah... it's a strange cave, but I was looking for how to get out. As you can see, the machine is still talking...

_3727.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3727.Description: This is not reality. The hypothesis we have shared is quite possible. Let's try it. It'll be fine if you think we won't get wet, won't choke. So let's look under the sea.
_3727.CompletionText: I'm nervous, but it should be possible.
_3727.CompletionSummary: As expected... Our theory was right.

_3728.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3728.Description: Ugh..! Pukumon and Otamamon ambushed us! Help!
_3728.CompletionText: We are underwater, but don't think about it and just fight!

_3729.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3729.Description: It's a bit to say from the raid standpoint, but I had no intention of doing anything to you! Sorry!! I've just been sensitive to some kind of nasty Digimon these days, but I misunderstood you for that Digimon.
_3729.CompletionSummary: Well.. it's fate that we met. We'll help you figure out some solution. But in exchange could you tell us the information we want too?

_3730.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3730.Description: That, then! Sure! If so, defeat the wandering Gesomon! They're coveting them, Otamamon! For the Otamamons to grow up, they have to drive out some Gesomons.
_3730.CompletionSummary: Wow.. You guys are really strong!

_3731.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3731.Description: Could you possibly defeat Gesomon wandering around again? They're coveting them, Otamamon! For the Otamamons to grow up, they have to drive out the Gesomons.
_3731.CompletionSummary: Wow.. You guys are really strong!

_3732.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3732.Description: Um.. can you just ask for one more request? Because the Gesomons took all the toys the Otamamons would play with. I hope you get it back.
_3732.CompletionSummary: Th, thanks! Otamamons will be able to grow a lot thanks to you guys!

_3733.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3733.Description: Um.. can you just ask for one more request? Because the Gesomons took all the toys the Otamamons would play with. I hope you get it back.
_3733.CompletionSummary: Th, thanks! Otamamons will be able to grow a lot thanks to you guys!

_3734.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3734.Description: We are looking for an exit. Do you know where it is?
_3734.CompletionSummary: Can you tell me where that would be?!

_3735.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3735.Description: It's not too far! Keep following us!
_3735.CompletionSummary: There's an exit across from this pipe?

_3736.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3736.Description: But why are you thinking that this is the exit?
_3736.CompletionSummary: Thank you for making the water bubble! Take care!

_3737.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3737.Description: Why is there a house in such a place..

_3738.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3738.CompletionSummary: You can sleep if you desire to... you can sit if you desire to... So good luck.

_3739.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3739.Description: (Ugh... where is this place. How did I fall off while riding the ark.. The light ray too.. My luck is not good lately. Let's.. first walk over to that crystal.)

_3740.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3740.Description: Wow! It's a relief there's a human here! I thought I would be alone..! Who are you? Me? I was asking my older brother that I wanted to see Terriermon and I suddenly landed here! This place is dangerous? No! I already made a friend! Look! Talk to this guy beside me!
_3740.CompletionSummary: ... It's an infant. Never seen a human before either.
_3740.ReservedText: Ah.. Yes. I know it looks weird to you.. Okay. I'm Antylamon, a Deva.

_3741.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3741.Description: I am Deva, responsible for protecting this place.. But it's hard to move anywhere because of this guy. Could you look around for me?
_3741.Objective: Where Four Holy Beasts' Nest is Seen
_3741.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Where Four Holy Beasts' Nest is Seen%qe %cc1/%mc1

_3742.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3742.Description: Those guys over there were playing with that child so I was just watching.. But that's not playing..? Uh.. I don't know what to do. I'll help out as well so can you help me chase those guys off?

_3743.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3743.CompletionSummary: You are okay. You fell off mid-way so I was shocked. And Suzie too.. The situation is becoming worse than I thought.

_3744.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3744.Description: Suzie being in the Digital World.. Parents must be worried.. We have to go back quickly after finding Culumon.. I think we are forgetting sometihng important.. Ah! Lopmon!
_3744.CompletionSummary: Let's prepare ourselves! This will be a stronger fight than ever before..!

_3745.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3745.Description: Beelzebumon.. But we have to fight in order to protect! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Please. Fight with us!!
_3745.CompletionText: Powerful..! Even Rapidmon in Ultimate form can't match up...

_3746.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3746.CompletionSummary: ... I.. He became this because.. I wanted it?

_3747.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3747.Description: That's Guilmon's Mega form.. Megidramon.. I know it's a Mega form.. but even as a virus this type of Digimon.. I think Guilmon and Takato are still connected!! We have to talk to Takato!
_3747.CompletionSummary: The Digimon I came up with... I told him to get rid of him..to.. get rid of him...

_3748.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3748.Description: Beelzebumon absorbed Makuramon's powers and is trying to steal Rapidmon and Taomon's powers! We have to stop him! Let's combine our efforts!!

_3749.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3749.Description: Beelzebumon... absorbed Taomon's and Rapidmon's powers...
_3749.CompletionSummary: That is... the true Mega evolution?

_3750.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3750.Description: This is our chance! We have to stop that devil. Let's combine our efforts!!
_3750.CompletionSummary: The fight is still not over..!

_3751.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3751.Description: Human, I need your help. If Caturamon intervenes in that fight, the situation could be at a disadvantage. Can you help me?

_3752.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3752.Description: Human, I need your help. If Caturamon intervenes in that fight, the situation could be at a disadvantage. Can you help me?

_3753.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3753.Description: Guys listen..! I think Gallantmon... is Takato!! I can feel it..! I can't explain it.. but I know I'm right. Gallantmon appeared as Takato disappeared.. It has to be him!
_3753.CompletionSummary: Then.. We have to help Takato even more!

_3754.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3754.Description: Beelzebumon powered up a lot. We have to create a chance for Gallantmon to defeat Beelzebumon! Let's work together guys!

_3755.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3755.Description: .. I don't know how we fought as a single entity.. but we won! We won..! But we haven't saved Culumon yet.. The God called Zhuqiaomon.. it's time to go meet him. Let's ask Lopmon on how to meet him.

_3756.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3756.Description: No, it's too dangerous for you Suzie.

_3757.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3757.Description: Now's the real thing. Let's save Culumon from Zhuqiaomon. It's not too far. Let's meet at Zhuqiaomon's Resting Area.
_3757.Objective: Talk to Renamon at Zhuqiaomon's Resting Area
_3757.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Renamon at Zhuqiaomon's Resting Area%qe %cc1/%mc1

_3758.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3758.Summary: In Order to Go Back Together
_3758.Description: Incredible. A new evolution! Henry did what we did!! Now! We can't stop here either! Let's fight together and defeat Zhuqiamon!

_3759.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3759.Description: Wait! Not yet!! The fights not over!!
_3759.CompletionSummary: Stay still, all of you! If you get wrapped around this, you will not be able to handle it!

_3760.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3760.Description: .. Also Zhuqiaomon kept saying something about the true enemy.. who is that? Lopmon, do you know anything about it?

_3761.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3761.Description: We have to show our power! Let's show that Qinglongmon is correct! It should be possible if we combine our efforts!!
_3761.CompletionSummary: I see.. Evolving with a human... Now I see why Deva could not win against this..

_3762.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3762.Description: But.. I will never recognize it!! If you want me to, defeat me!!
_3762.CompletionSummary: ..Now then. I'll that you to the place where 'D-Reaper' can be seen according to that human.

_3763.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3763.CompletionSummary: ..A red bubble.. that seems to erase the existence itself..

_3764.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3764.Description: It's already become this much here too.. I saw Baihumon and Xuanwumon combine their efforts to block it. Zhuqiaomon seemed injured too.. At this rate something bigger and badder may happen to the Digital World. If Culumon is indeed deep within this cave, we better be prepared. It's a little far, but if we gain essence after defeating the Deva.. Maybe it's possible?

_3765.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3765.Description: Even if Rika evolved to the Mega form, the Four Holy Beasts are burdned. We have to help! Go! I'll give you this card, so let's go to each area and drop the rocks. We'll try our best to block it!
_3765.Objective: Use at Where D-Reaper is Seen Use at D-Reaper Danger Area 1 Use at D-Reaper Danger Area 2 Use at D-Reaper Danger Area 3
_3765.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use at Where D-Reaper is Seen%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use at D-Reaper Danger Area 1%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Use at D-Reaper Danger Area 2%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Use at D-Reaper Danger Area 3%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3765.CompletionSummary: That's good! This should be enough help!

_3766.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3766.Description: Finally.. we saved everyone. That's a relief. We can return home now.
_3766.CompletionSummary: Ah! A mail from Mister Yamaki!

_3767.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3767.Description: The Ark is completed..? Return on that? I think we can return guys! Guys .. eh?.. Jeri... Where's Jeri? We have to find her!
_3767.Objective: Find and talk to Jeri Kato
_3767.CompletionSummary: Ah.. Well that can happen. Haha, let's all calm down.

_3768.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3768.Description: First, the pillar of light will come down from the real world side! I think I can go where the light is! But... there is a time limit... If you don't go there quickly, it might be a big deal! But what to do? It would be very far from here...
_3768.CompletionSummary: Even withour you guys, I'll show you that we can protect the Digital World ourselves.

_3769.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3769.Description: The wind... it's too much! And I can't see the light pillar.. We only have 30 minutes left!
_3769.CompletionSummary: Then let's find the light pillar until Rika and Renamon return.

_3770.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3770.Description: Well.. we'll take a look over there, so take a look around and come back. Let's meet somewhere here!
_3770.Objective: Move to the path to home
_3770.CompletionSummary: Found it! It's the Light Pillar!!

_3772.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3772.Description: Finally.. Home.. we are home!! Mom!! Dad!!
_3772.CompletionSummary: You are safe. I'm glad. I heard what's been going on from Yamaki. The children's parents are happy too. You can rest until the next mission. Take some alone time too. The children are probably too busy catching up with their parents. I'll call you once this place is all about organized.

_3773.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3773.Description: I have something to tell you before you fight D-Reaper.
_3773.CompletionSummary: I want to test your strength one more time.

_3774.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3774.Description: I have recreated your feeble battle as an illusion. Let’s see how long you will last in the place I have prepared. Shall we begin? I will enjoy watching you despaired, discouraged and see your justice denied.
_3774.CompletionText: I will show you strength you won't even be able to imagine.
_3774.CompletionSummary: Huh… well… this may work agains D-Reaper.

_3775.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3775.Description: You have failed so miserably, yet you want to try again? I will give you credit for your spirit. I accept your challenge.
_3775.CompletionText: I will show you strength you won't even be able to imagine.

_3776.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3776.Description: But you are too weak to fight against D-Reaper. D-Reaper is as strong as us the Four Holy Beats. If you pass this test, I may acknowledge your strength.
_3776.CompletionText: Fear before the strength of the Four Holy Beasts.

_3777.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3777.Description: It’s funny you try to challenge again when you barely survived this battle. I accept your challenge.
_3777.CompletionText: Fear before the strength of the Four Holy Beasts.
_3777.CompletionSummary: … you may be able to help stop D-Reaper.

_3778.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3778.Description: Oh, are you here? Let's just talk to me before we leave. Hmm… Among the anomalies we observed were goggles with strange powers. I'll pay you, so would you like to try it? It's not harmful to you.
_3778.CompletionText: If I hadn't rushed back and missed it… I wouldn't have made it this hard.
_3778.CompletionSummary: I haven't check it out completely, but it's pretty good thing. It has the ability to increase Tamer's overall ability. It doesn't have any effect right now, but if you bring me some materials, I think I can craft better pair of goggles. Check and bring the necessary materials.

_3779.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3779.Description: Oh, you're here? Let's talk before we leave. Well, we observe an odd phenomenon about a headset with strange power. I want to investigate that… Can you get it? It seems… You can get it by defeating powerful digimons sometimes appears in the field.
_3779.CompletionText: If I hadn't missed it because I was coming back in a hurry... Sorry I wouldn't have made you suffer like this.
_3779.CompletionSummary: Ah… This is pretty cool stuff. It has the ability to increase Digimon's growth. And if you bring some ingredients, I can make it better. Check the materials you need and bring them. I'll make it better

_3780.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3780.Description: Are you seriously going to challenge my trial? Good..I'll give you permission to enter the trial.
_3780.CompletionText: I'll show you an unimaginalbe strength.

_3781.Title: Digimon Tamers
_3781.Description: Are you really going to try it again? How energetic. Good. I'll allow you to enter.
_3781.CompletionText: Experience the power of Four Holy Beasts and feel the terror.
_3781.CompletionSummary: .. I wonder if you can satisfy my expectations.

_3782.Title: Shinjuku
_3782.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I've checked rearise phenomenon. Rearised Digimon is Vajramon. We need to move to the stadium and stop Vajramon before he makes a mess!

_3783.Title: Shinjuku
_3783.Description: If you're on your way to defeat Vajramon, you'll need this!

_3784.Title: Jogress [Omegamon X]
_3784.Description:
The data has been examined.
Those Digimons were coming from the very center of Royal Base.
…You have no choice but to ask him
Are you really going to the center?
_3784.CompletionSummary:
I can't...
If that's your will... Take it.
If you use this, you can go to Yggdrasil.
But there's only one, so be careful.

_3785.Title: Shinjuku
_3785.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I check ReArise phenomenon. ReArised Digimon is Vikaralamon. We need to get to the road and stop Vikaralamon before it makes a scene!

_3786.Title: Crack and Monster
_3786.Summary: [Daily] in the midst of a crisis
_3786.Description:
(Kaboom!!)
(People are screaming somewhere)
phew… What's going on? The arena collapsed due to a massive clashes between servers. But it's not a just simple matter of the level of collapse…
Maybe it's because of strange crack, the monsters are going crazy…
It seems the [Mana Stone] possessed by the monsters is the problem... I think, we need to investigate it.
We need them, Can you help us?
_3786.CompletionText: Take this. Come back to me when you're ready.

_3787.Title: Crack and Monster
_3787.Description:
If it's your skills, lower floors won't be a problem! But you'd better be careful though.
*Powerful enemies appear in the Lower floor. Party play is recommended*
_3787.Objective: Bring Seal of Upper floor to Miki

_3788.Title: Crack and Monster
_3788.Description:
You want to go to the abyss? It's too dangerous there… Are you sure you're gonna be okay?
*Powerful enemies appear in the Abyss. Party play is recommended*
_3788.Objective: Bring Seal of Lower floor to Miki

_3789.Title: Shinjuku
_3789.Description: You'll need this if you are on your way to defeat Vajiramon

_3790.Title: Shinjuku
_3790.Description: You'll need this if you are on your way to defeat Vajiramon

_3791.Title: Shinjuku
_3791.Description: You'll need this if you are on your way to defeat Vajiramon

_3792.Title: Serious Environmental Pollution
_3792.Description: I found the main culprits of the serious environmental pollution. If we stop them, the contamination won't progress any further.
_3792.Objective: Defeat <Culprit of Pollution>Raremon in Lost Historic Site and <Culprit of Pollution>Gerbemon in File Island Water Front
_3792.CompletionText: They appeared in Lost Historic Site and File Island Water Front, respectively.
_3792.CompletionSummary: There will be no more destruction of the environment of the Digital World

_3793.Title: Serious Environmental Pollution
_3793.Description: I need Gerbemon's trash can to purify the Digital World, which has become seriously polluted. Could you please help me?
_3793.Objective: Obtain [Sealed Trash can] 10ea by defeating Gerbemon in File Island Water Front.
_3793.CompletionText: If you do it wrong, it may get sucked into the trash, so be careful~
_3793.CompletionSummary: What a mysterious trash can. I really wonder how these things are made!

_3794.Title: Serious Environmental Pollution
_3794.Description: I need Purifying Light for an invention to purify the Digital World, which has become seriously polluted? Could you please help me? Purifying Light can be obtained by defeating the boss Digimon in the Shadow Labyrinth.
_3794.Objective: Obtain [Purifying Light] by defeating boss of Shadow Labyrinth.
_3794.CompletionText: You can enter the Shadow Labyrinth by Anubismon in D-Terminal .
_3794.CompletionSummary: Good job. The preparations are almost finished now.

_3795.Title: Serious Environmental Pollution
_3795.Description: Currently, there are reports that contamination is spreading rapidly in the Lost Ruins and Silver Lake. We must go and stop it!
_3795.Objective: Defeat Raremon in Lost Historic Site, and Vikaralamon 20ea in Silver Lake
_3795.CompletionSummary: I think we solve the most urgent problem..However, if we do not solve the underlying cause, they'll show up again.

_3796.Title: 테이블 동기화 - 남미
_3796.Description: 적의 본거지를 찾기위해 정찰병을 보냈습니다. 조마간 소식이 올겁니다.

_3797.Title: 테이블 동기화 - 남미
_3797.Description: 적의 본거지를 찾기위해 정찰병을 보냈습니다. 조마간 소식이 올겁니다.

_3798.Title: 테이블 동기화 - 남미
_3798.Description: 적의 본거지를 찾기위해 정찰병을 보냈습니다. 조마간 소식이 올겁니다.

_3799.Title: 테이블 동기화 - 남미
_3799.Description: 적의 본거지를 찾기위해 정찰병을 보냈습니다. 조마간 소식이 올겁니다.

_3800.Title: [Important letter delivery]
_3800.Description: I accidentally picked this up on the street. I'm wondering if I should deliver this... Could you please deliver it for me?
_3800.Objective: Defeat <Chasing Impmon>Leomon near Impmon in the Server Continent Dessert

_3801.Title: [Important letter delivery]
_3801.Description: Anyway, you're the guy who claims to have been the victim of me too!? Never mind!! I don't want to talk with you!!
_3801.Objective: Defeat <Angry at Impmon>Gerbemon near Impmon in Server Continent Canyon
_3801.CompletionText: Why do you keep following me?!

_3802.Title: [Important letter delivery]
_3802.Description: You are so persistent~! If you come after me, one more time, I will really beat you up!!!
_3802.Objective: Use Letter to <Running away>Impmon in Server Continent Pyramid
_3802.CompletionSummary: Huh...!! You should have said the main thing sooner!

_3803.Title: [Learn training methods!]
_3803.Description: I'll especially reveal Master's training methods to you.
_3803.CompletionText: If you don't believe me, you don’t have to~!
_3803.CompletionSummary: How is it?!?! Awesome, isn't it?!

_3804.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_3804.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_3804.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_3804.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_3805.Title: Advent of Greatest emperor of evil
_3805.Summary: [Sub] Advent of Greatest emperor of evil
_3805.Description: Greatest emperor of evil, DarknessBagramon, has finally appeared in this world. I really want to see it
_3805.CompletionSummary: I never thought the day would come when I could see DarknessBagramon with my own eyes!!

_3806.Title: Greatest emperor of evil
_3806.Description: If you use Data Chip, you can summon its alter ego. Check out what kind of guy it is.
_3806.Objective: Defeat DarknessBagramon in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3806.CompletionSummary: How do you think Bagramon's power? It's an alter ego, but it's powerful, right?

_3807.Title: For Kidults
_3807.Description: It's time to return to childhood~! Memories of drawing lots in my childhood~! Let's go back to our memories~!
_3807.CompletionText: Oh~! You can pick it up too~!
_3807.CompletionSummary:
Oh~! New~~~ Challenger~!
You can get my footprints again by defeating enemy Digimon in all areas except Yokohama~

_3808.Title: Happy Data Summon
_3808.Description: Data summon.... I think this is so much fun . But... How can they ignore this funny thing..??? I won't let them get away with it!!! Please scold Gazimon, Gekomon, and Puppetmon!! They will be on the Server Continent Desert, Lost Historic Site, and File Island Water Front!
_3808.Objective: Defeat Gazimon 30ea in Server Continent Dessert Defeat Gekomon 30ea in Lost Historic Site Defeat Puppetmon in File Island Water Front
_3808.CompletionText: Ugh..... How Dare you....!! I can't stand it!!!!
_3808.CompletionSummary: Huh... I'm feeling a little better~ Thank you Tamer, I'll share some of my fun in return! Take it and go to Babel!

_3809.Title: Repaying favor
_3809.Description: Everyone seems to be expressing their gratitude to parents, teachers and some more... I am going to convey my heart, too~! Tamer!! I need your help, right now!! Please collect Big flowers in Silver Lake!
_3809.Objective: Collect Big flower 30ea by defeating enemy Digimons in Silver Lake
_3809.CompletionText: Hurry!! Up!! As!! Big!! As possible!!!
_3809.CompletionSummary: Thank you!!! But..... I feel like I'm still lacking something...

_3810.Title: Grateful heart
_3810.Description: My friends have been asking me to deliver this for them Can you help me?? I think it's letter to their parents.. It would be nice if they do this themselves
_3810.Objective: Use Appreication Letter to Yokohama Village - Inoue Papa Yokohama East Village - Inoue mama Oil Refinery-1 - Matt Papa
_3810.CompletionText: But it's a letter of thanks, let's send it quickly
_3810.ReservedText:
Thank you...
The letter is commendable, but it would have been better if he came in person and showed his face once.
I feel sad..

_3811.Title: Follow the law
_3811.Description: Tamer, <Outlaw>Myotismon you defeated before has reappeared. This time, it appeared as Venom Vamdemon, a more powerful evolved form. If you use the Communication Machine at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you can find <Outlaw>Venom Vamdemon. Communication Machine was made by Izzy, so it should work well. Defeat Venom Vamdemon please.
_3811.Objective: Summon and defeat the <Outlaw>Venom Vamdemon usingg the communication Machine in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.
_3811.CompletionText: Haven't you defeated Venom Vamdemon yet?
_3811.CompletionSummary: Thank you. You've defeated Venom Vamdemon that reappeared. Now the outlaw is gone, it should be peaceful for a while. Thanks again.

_3812.Title: Day of Earth
_3812.Description: MarineDevimon which appeared before and polluted the environment, has reappeared. This time, it appeared in Silver Lake and is polluting the environment. Defeat MarineDevimon Please.
_3812.CompletionSummary: Thank you for punishing MarineDevimon. Unlike MarineDevimon, you don't pollute the environment and protect the Earth.

_3813.Title: Find Communication parts
_3813.Description: Hello. I've been taken away from the Communication Parts to repair Communication Machine. I need to repair Communication Machine, so can you find Communication Parts? The enemy Digimon is in the File Island Waterfront.
_3813.Objective: Collect Communication Parts 20ea by defeating enemy Digimon in File Island Waterfront
_3813.CompletionText: Haven't you found the Communication Parts yet?
_3813.CompletionSummary: You've found the Communication Parts. Thank you so much. Now, I'll try reparing the Communication Machine.

_3814.Title: Arena Challenge
_3814.Description: Hello. A new season of Arena has opened. Would you like to challenge the Arena and bring the Challenge certificate? You can obtain Challenge certificate by defeating the enemy Digimon in Arena.
_3814.Objective: Collect Challenge certificate 5ea by defeating enemy Digimon in Arena(regardless of difficulty)
_3814.CompletionText: Haven't you tried the Arena yet?
_3814.CompletionSummary: You came with a Challenge certificate. Please continue to challenge the Arena.

_3815.Title: Our bond!
_3815.Description: Finally!! Our bond paved the way for a new evolution

_3816.Title: Bond of Bravery - Last Evolution
_3816.Description: Use the Voucher of bravery to check the new evolution of bond.
_3816.Objective: Defeat Agumon - Bond of bravery in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3816.CompletionSummary: What do you think about the new evolution Agumon - Bond of Bravery?

_3817.Title: Introducing the new exchange
_3817.Description: I want to promote the newly entered Exchange to other regions. Can you help me?
_3817.Objective: Talk to Elecmon in Village of Beginning, Starmon of Passion in Western Village, and Miki in Snowstorm Village.
_3817.CompletionText: I hope many people use it a lot.
_3817.CompletionSummary: Thanks to this, many people have become interested.
_3817.ReservedText: Oh! There's a new function like that? Thank you. I'll try it right away

_3818.Title: Introducing the new exchange
_3818.Description: Hello. Tamer! <Community Manager>Director Hasima wants to introduce you to a new Exchange at the DATS Center. Shall we go together to hear the explanation?
_3818.CompletionText: What do you think??? So expected.
_3818.CompletionSummary: Oh! Tamer, you come to hear the explanation too? Then I'll tell you briefly. First of all, there is a new consignment management in the character menu at the bottom right. And if you click on consignment management, consignment shop will appear. Please note that the exchange is only available at the DATS Center. If you have other questions, click the question mark in the upper right corner of the consignment shop to get more detailed information.

_3819.Title: Contest Wrap-up
_3819.Description: The contest is over, but it seems that there are still Digimon wandering around the Digital World that have not returned. Go and stop them.
_3819.Objective: Defeat <Interfere with clean-up>Devimon 30ea appearing in Yokohama Village
_3819.CompletionText: They have to go back quickly when it's over, but what are they doing?

_3820.Title: Identity of Mastermind
_3820.Description: I think we need to deal with Culumon's subordinates first to catch him. So stop them first.
_3820.Objective: Defeat <Culumon's subordinate>Renamon, <Culumon's henchman>WarGrowlmon, and <Culumon's right-hand man>MegaGalgomon

_3821.Title: Identity of Mastermind
_3821.Description: Good! Let's go to Culumon. Why should I suffer this because of him. I'll beat him!!
_3821.Objective: Talk to <Mastermind>Culumon after defeating Renamon, WarGrowlmon, and MegaGalgomon.
_3821.CompletionSummary: You guys are bad!! How can you proceed without me in such a contest? No matter what anyone says, I'm the cutest Digimon in the Digital World!!

_3822.Title: Identity of Mastermind
_3822.Description: Finally I found the Culumon's hideout. Talk to me when you are ready.
_3822.CompletionSummary: This is the map of where he is hiding

_3823.Title: Who's the real Mastermind?
_3823.Description: Huh?? I've seen this handwriting somewhere. I lost my magnifying glass for handwriting appraisal right now. Could you bring me my magnifying glass?
_3823.Objective: Collect Magnifying glass 20ea by defeating enemy digimons in Digimon Maze Entrance
_3823.CompletionText: I cant' work without that magnifying glass
_3823.CompletionSummary: As I thought, I've seen this before! It's Culumon's handwriting.

_3824.Title: Who's the real Mastermind?
_3824.Description: When I hear Lilithmon's story about trying to interrupt this contest, she is also upset that she was deceived. Just in case, I should talk to Lilithmon.
_3824.CompletionText: I think there's something we don't know.
_3824.CompletionSummary: The letter I received this time said that you guys held the tournament without me because I didn't deserve it, so I just interfered!

_3825.Title: Mysterious Box
_3825.Description: Oh~! Would you like to receive a box?
_3825.Objective: Talk to Impmon (Impmon want to eat Cream Bread.)
_3825.CompletionSummary: Ohh~! It's hot?? But... Do you have some Cream Bread??

_3826.Title: Mysterious Box
_3826.Description: I want bread so much, do you have any??
_3826.CompletionSummary: Oh~! Cream Bread? How do you know I like Cream Bread?

_3827.Title: The best Digimon is!
_3827.Description: Finally! The winner has been decided. The winner is <The best cutie in File Island>Patamon!!!! Tamer, go to Patamon and congratulate him on his victory.
_3827.Objective: Talk to <The best cutie in File Island>Patamon
_3827.CompletionSummary: Finally, the contest is over. Thank you for helping me so much

_3828.Title: The best Digimon is!
_3828.Description: Finally! The winner has been decided. The winner is <The best cutie in Shinjuku>Terriermon!!!! Tamer, go to Terriermon and congratulate him on his victory.
_3828.Objective: Talk to <The best cutie in Shinjuku>Terriermon
_3828.CompletionSummary: Finally, the contest is over. Thank you for helping me so much

_3829.Title: Who's the best?
_3829.Summary: [Daily] Who do you think is number 1?
_3829.Description: Which one is more popular, Patamon vs. Terriermon? Could you please check out other people's opinion?
_3829.Objective: Talk to T.K in Infinite Mountain, Devimon in Dark tower Wasteland, and Magnamon in Verdandi Terminal
_3829.CompletionText: I wonder who will be more popular.
_3829.CompletionSummary: It's amazing. It's so close, I really don't know who will win if this happens

_3830.Title: Who is the mastermind?!
_3830.Description: I found the mastermind who sent them. Lilithmon, who couldn't participate in this tournament, sent them to seek revenge. Please stop Lilithmon from intefering with the contest any more.
_3830.Objective: Defeat <The best cutie?>Lilithmon appears in Western Village
_3830.CompletionText: Well….Is it right that Lilithmon is trying to participate in a Cute Digimon Contest…?
_3830.CompletionSummary: Thank you for stopping Lilithmon It's the final selection, I'll definitely win.

_3831.Title: Who is the mastermind?!
_3831.Description: I found the mastermind who sent them. Lilithmon, who couldn't participate in this tournament, sent them to seek revenge. Please stop Lilithmon from intefering with the contest any more.
_3831.Objective: Defeat <The best cutie?>Lilithmon appears in Western Village
_3831.CompletionText: Why does Lilithmon want to participate in this contest?
_3831.CompletionSummary: You stopped Lilithmon! Thank you. I will definitely repay you by winning

_3832.Title: Contest Interrupters
_3832.Description: Tamer!! Guys trying to sabotage the contest have appeared on File Island Water Front? Can you stop them?
_3832.Objective: Defeat <Servant of ???>Puppetmon 30ea apperas in File Island Water Front
_3832.CompletionText: Who is trying to ruin the contest?
_3832.CompletionSummary: You've worked hard, Tamer. Who did this…

_3833.Title: Contest Interrupters
_3833.Description: Tamer!! Guys trying to sabotage the contest have appeared on File Island Water Front? Can you stop them?
_3833.Objective: Defeat <Servant of ???>Mercuremon 30ea apperas in File Island Water Front
_3833.CompletionText: Who is trying to ruin the contest?
_3833.CompletionSummary: You've worked hard, Tamer. Who did this…

_3834.Title: Contest preparation
_3834.Description: I'm looking for pollen to use in the contest, and I heard that the pollen from the Digimon Farm in the Western Area is so beautiful… Can you get me some of that pollen?
_3834.Objective: Collect Pollen 20ea by defeating enemy Digimons in Digimon Farm
_3834.CompletionText: Flower… It will be really pretty! Right?
_3834.CompletionSummary: So pretty!! Thank you very much, I will definitely win

_3835.Title: Contest preparation
_3835.Description: I need a nice firecracker to set off in the contest, and the Digimons in the Wind Valley in Western Area have it. Can you get me some firecrackers?
_3835.Objective: Collect Firecracker 20ea by defeating enemy Digimons in Wind Valley
_3835.CompletionText: What a great firecracker! Looking forward to it
_3835.CompletionSummary: Wow!! So cool! Thank you Tamer.

_3836.Title: I'm the best!
_3836.Description: Tamer!! You're here to cheer me on? Thank you so much!
_3836.Objective: Talk to <The best cutie in File Island>Patamon
_3836.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much! I will definitely defeat Terriermon and win the contest

_3837.Title: I'm the best!
_3837.Description: As expected!! I thought you would come to cheer me on, Tamer.
_3837.Objective: Talk to <The best cutie in Shinjuku>Terriermon
_3837.CompletionText: Patamon is a piece of cake. I'll win
_3837.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much! I will definitely defeat Patamon and win the contest

_3838.Title: Who is the cutest digimon?
_3838.Description: From now on, we're going to hold a contest to select the cutest Digimon in the Digital World. The contestants are Patamon and Terriermon. Tamer, take a quest from Digimon you think is cute But! Please note that if you accept a quest from that contestant, you cannot receive another contestant's quest.
_3838.CompletionText: Think carefully about who to choose~
_3838.CompletionSummary: Once you've decided which Digimon to support, go to the Digimon and get the quest.

_3839.Title: Sweet Candy
_3839.Description: I made candy myself. Actually, I also wanted to give candy to Sora in return for receiving chocolate. I can't deliver it myself, so could you deliver it to Sora instead? She is across from me.
_3839.Objective: Use Taichi's Candy to NPC <Wanting to get candy>Sora in DATS Center.
_3839.CompletionText: Haven't you delivered the candy to Sora yet?
_3839.CompletionSummary: Thanks for giving me the candy instead.

_3840.Title: Sweet Candy
_3840.Description: I'm going to try making candy myself. So could you get some sparks from the ingredients I need to make candy? You can get it by defeating Meramon and Meramon(Leader) in Silent Forest. Bring it to me.
_3840.Objective: Collect Sparks 15ea by defeating Meramon and Meramon(Leader) in Silent Forest
_3840.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much for bringing the Sparks.

_3841.Title: Sweet Candy
_3841.Description: I'm going to try making candy myself. So could you get me some sugarcane among the ingredients needed to make candy? You can get it by defeating Woodmon in Western Village and Silver Lake. Bring it to me please
_3841.Objective: Collect Sugarcane 20ea by defeating Woodmon in Western Village and Silver Lake
_3841.CompletionText: Haven't you collected less Sugarcane yet?
_3841.CompletionSummary: Thanks for bringing me the Sugarcane.

_3842.Title: Still Cold Weather
_3842.Description: It gets quiet for a bit, then starts to get noisy again. There was a leader left of the guys I defeated. Take this and use it at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square. Then thier leader <Loud Voice>Tonosama Gekomon will appear. Quiet the <Loud Voice>Tonosama Gekomon that has appeared.
_3842.Objective: Summon <Loud Voice>Tonosama Gekomon from the D-Terminal Underground Summon Sqaure and defeat it.
_3842.CompletionText: Hurry up and silence their boss.
_3842.CompletionSummary: Thank you. It's completely quiet now. I think I'll ve able to sllep comfortably again.

_3843.Title: Still Cold Weather
_3843.Description: It's still cold, so I think I need to hibernate more, but there are guys making noise around me. Could you please quiet them down? I think I still need to hibernate more. Those guys are the <Wakened from hibernation>Gekomon in Silver Lake.
_3843.CompletionText: It's still noisy, can you please quiet them down quickly?
_3843.CompletionSummary: It's kind of quiet now. Thank you.

_3844.Title: Goddess Appears! JetMervamon!
_3844.Description: Tamer, Did you hear the news?? JetMervamon is visiting DATS Center!!
_3844.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, I was able to see JetMervamon.

_3845.Title: Goddess' Trials
_3845.Description: Hello, Tamer I'm BlackGatomon who servers Mervamon. Will you pass Mervamon's trial and get the reward?
_3845.Objective: Defeat JetMervamon from D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3845.CompletionText: If you go to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you can proceed with the trials.

_3846.Title: Western Area Expedition
_3846.Description: It's been a long time! How are you? This time, I'm going to organize an expedition and investigate the mysterious ruins of the Western Area. If you have time, how about exploring the Western Area with me?
_3846.Objective: Exploration of 3 specific areas(Western Village, Wilderness Area, and Ruined Historic)
_3846.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1[Western Village]Shrine of Dupetemon Royal Knights%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2[Wilderness Area]Wasteland Lake%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3[Ruined Historic]Street of Trial%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3846.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we found a good place

_3847.Title: Western Area Expedition
_3847.Description: Thanks to you, we've been able to find three decent base camps. I think we can set up camp there now.
_3847.Objective: Use Camping Equipment in Western Vil[Shrine of Dupetemon], Wilderness Area[Wasteland Lake], Ruined Historic[Street of Trial]
_3847.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Western Village in [Shrine of Dupetemon Royal Knights]%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Wilderness Area in [Wasteland Lake]%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Ruined Historic in [Street of Trial]%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3847.CompletionSummary: I think the camp is well positioned.

_3848.Title: Western Area Expedition
_3848.Description: Please help. A violent Digimon in the ruins is interfering with setting up the camp
_3848.CompletionText: Sorry. He's strong, so I can't hanle him alone.
_3848.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, We were able to finish setting up the camp safely! oh and the expedition leader is looking for you.

_3849.Title: Western Area Expedition
_3849.Description: Oh…We're in trouble. While I was careless for a while, they stole our expedition equipment. Could you please bring it back?
_3849.Objective: Collect [Camping Equipment] 20ea by defeating enemy Digimons in Wilderness Area
_3849.CompletionText: Please! We can't go any further without it
_3849.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, We were able to finish setting up the camp safely! oh and the expedition leader is looking for you.

_3850.Title: Western Area Expedition
_3850.Description: Oh, Come on! While you were fighting the Digimon in the ruins, I discovered something strange. I think you can use this to summon the guardian of the ruins.
_3850.Objective: Defeat the Guardian of ruins at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3850.CompletionText: I wonder what kinds of Digimon is the guardian of the ruins. Hurry up and summon it.
_3850.CompletionSummary: It's pity that the guardian of the ruins is hostile toward us, but it was an opportunity to learn a lot.

_3851.Title: Gankoomon's Training Ground
_3851.Description: Hi. A new Gankoomon's Training Ground has begun. I'll give you a reward when you collect the seal by defeating <Opponent for Training>Gankoomon. Try it now.
_3851.Objective: Collet seal 1ea by defeating <Opponent for Training>Gankoomon in Gankoomon's Training Ground
_3851.CompletionSummary: Take it. It's a reward of success in a challenge. Try again tomorrow.

_3852.Title: Valentine's Day
_3852.Description: Would you like to deliver the Dark Chocolate you got back to Taichi? Taichi is across from me at DATS Center.
_3852.Objective: Deliver Dark Chocolate to Taichi in DATS Center
_3852.CompletionText: Haven't you delivered the Dark Chocolate to Taichi yet?
_3852.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This is my token of appreciation.

_3853.Title: Valentine's Day
_3853.Description: Hey. I've been robbed of my Dark Chocolate. Can you find some? It's been stolen from the Western Area : Outskirts! I think it was <I like Chocolate!>Lopmon. Find it, beat it up, and get back my Dark Chocolate.
_3853.Objective: Collect Stolen Dark Chocolate 25ea by defeating <I Like Chocolate!>Lopmon in Western Area: Outskirts
_3853.CompletionText: Are you still looking for my Dark Chocolate yet?
_3853.CompletionSummary: Thanks for finding my dark chocolate.

_3854.Title: Valentine's Day
_3854.Description: Would you like to deliver the White Chocolate you got back to Matt? Matt is across from me at DATS Center.
_3854.Objective: Deliver White Chocolate to Matt in DATS Center
_3854.CompletionText: Haven't you delivered the White Chocolate to Matt yet?
_3854.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This is my token of appreciation.

_3855.Title: Valentine's Day
_3855.Description: Hey. I've been robbed of my White Chocolate. Can you find some? It's been stolen from the Frozen Ground! I think it was <I like Chocolate!>Terriermon. Find it, beat it up, and get back my White Chocolate.
_3855.Objective: Collect Stolen White Chocolate 25ea by defeating <I Like Chocolate!>Terriermon in Frozen Ground
_3855.CompletionText: Are you still looking for my White Chocolate yet?
_3855.CompletionSummary: Thanks for finding my white chocolate.

_3856.Title: Full moon photo
_3856.Description: Hi. I want to lend my camera to the kids who love full moon so they can take the photo of full moon. Won't you pass my 3 cameras to the kids? You just have to deliver my camera to T.K in Yokohama East Village, Hikari in Silver Lake, and Izzy in Lost Historic Site.
_3856.Objective: Deliver Cameras to T.K in Yokohama East Village, Hikari in Silver Lake, and Izzy in Lost Historic Site
_3856.CompletionText: Haven't you delivered all the cameras yet?
_3856.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This is my present for you.

_3857.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_3857.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_3857.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_3857.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_3858.Title: Emperor's Energy - Accessories
_3858.Description: The energy of harmony is needed to prevent the exploing energy from exploding in accessories All you have to do is collect 4 pieces according to the accessories.
_3858.Objective: Summon 4 Holy Beasts Digimon from the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square to obtain 4 Energy of Harmony
_3858.CompletionText: If you don't want to lose everything, you'd better get going
_3858.CompletionSummary: Good job. In this way, you can adjust the energy of all accessories.

_3859.Title: Emperor's Energy - Accessories
_3859.Description: Various energies are gathered in accessories made with the energy of the 4 Holy Beasts. If you do not control it properly, this energy will run out of control and become an accessory with no power.
_3859.CompletionText: When you are ready, please talk to me.
_3859.CompletionSummary: You must completely trust me. I will guide you.

_3860.Title: True Emperor's Power
_3860.Description: Can you lead the True Emperor by combining the energy of 4 Holy Beasts and the energy of Emperor? This is my last request.
_3860.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Shin - Emperor's Energy%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Shin - 4 Holy Beasts' Energy%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Emperor's Seal%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3860.CompletionText: When everything is ready, please talk to me again.
_3860.ReservedText: Thank you Tamer Thanks to you, the Emperor is able to bring out the true power.

_3861.Title: True Emperor's Power
_3861.Description: You are here. May I begin the test to awaken the True Power?
_3861.Objective: Collect Emperor's Energy 50ea by defeating all enemy Digimons except Yokohama
_3861.CompletionText: "It's Simple. Please collect 50 Emperor's Energy. You can get it from all regions except Yokohama."
_3861.CompletionSummary: You did great. I will exchange the collected energy for jewels.

_3862.Title: True Emperor's Power
_3862.Description: Emperor told me to deliver the seal to person who bears his plaque.
_3862.ReservedText: Here it is. There was an order to take a test only for those who had the seal. Participation in the test is free. All you have to do is come to me every day and get it.

_3863.Title: [Ticket Exchange]
_3863.Description:
(<Exclusive Ticket Exchange for STEAM>
[Exchangeable List] - Tough Training Box Exchange Ticket 1ea - Level-up Spike Package Exchange Ticket 1ea

_3864.Title: <4 Holy Beasts Dungeon>
_3864.Description: I'll give you @<tc:900>3 Passes [Fanglongmon Dungeon] [Hard]@</tc>per day. Please use it to protect the real world. First of all, since this is where Fanglongmon's mighty power rages @<tc:900>I need <Yin and Yang Spirit> 30ea that can be obtained from monsters in <Verdandi Terminal>@</tc>. Bring it please.
_3864.CompletionText: We have to stop Fanglongmon's runaway

_3865.Title: Uninvited Guest
_3865.Description:
Well, take this to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
and you will find bullying Etemon
_3865.Objective: Defeat Etemon in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3865.CompletionText: What are you doing without leaving?
_3865.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, the party ended without any problems. Thanks!! Tamer

_3866.Title: Uninvited Guest
_3866.Description: Hmm... Somone bullying here... He's making a fuss about not being able to join the party. How about listening the story?

_3867.Title: Cake Delivery
_3867.Description: It's a cake leftover from house party. Can you deliver this to my friend?
_3867.Objective: Use Cake for <Cake Delivery>NPCs in each region DATS Center, Vill of Beginning, Server Dessert, Snowman Vill
_3867.CompletionText: You can't open it even if you want it! There's even a letter!

_3868.Title: Rabbit King's Call
_3868.Description: Let's go and meet the king of black rabbit! I will guide for you!
_3868.Objective: Degeat BlackSaintGalgomon by entering event dungeion Black Rabbit Hole
_3868.CompletionSummary: Such a violent King.... I didn't expect him to rush in as soon as I saw....

_3869.Title: Rabbit King's Call
_3869.Description: The violent king of the rabbit hole wants to meet you
_3869.CompletionText: Talk to me when you are ready
_3869.CompletionSummary: You made up your mind...! Here's the royal letter from the king

_3870.Title: Awakening! Crimson Knight!
_3870.Description: It is the power fight aginst great evil .... I'm gonna follow Gallantmon...
_3870.CompletionSummary: Fight against devil. Gallantmon has become stronger, so it will be easier in the future

_3871.Title: Ordeal of Awakening - Crimson Knight
_3871.Description: A strong powerful is rising. Can you help me fully handle this power??
_3871.Objective: Defeat Gallantmon(Shin) in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3871.CompletionText: More.. More.. I have to become more stronger..!!
_3871.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, I feel a little more stable. Thank you.

_3872.Title: 23 year fortune
_3872.Description:
Do you like…. Fortune??
I learn how to tell someone's fourtne with a card game
Aren't you curious..??
_3872.CompletionText: I'll do it specially for free!

_3873.Title: Missing New Year's resolution journal
_3873.Description: It's a New Year's resolution that I always make... If it disappears like this, the motivation will be lost right now... The guy who stole my resolution journal must be Impmon
_3873.Objective: Defeat <Playful from New Year>Impmon in File Island Water Front
_3873.CompletionText: I heard they're roaming the File Island Water Front
_3873.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I don't know if I will do as resolution Still I can do it!

_3874.Title: House party preparation
_3874.Description: I want to throw a house party! Will everyone come??? Tamer~! Could you please help me? I need to clear out some boxes and get ready to welcome my friends! See you in the Village of Beginning!
_3874.Objective: Defeat Gerbemon in Village of Beginning Gerbemon appears after defeating Broken box 10ea and defeating Scattered box 3ea
_3874.CompletionText: See you in the Village of Beginning!!
_3874.CompletionSummary: I didn't know there was a Gerbemon.....

_3875.Title: House party preparation
_3875.Description: For house party…I can't leave out that!!! Tamer!! It's kind of weird for me to take it. Can you get me some?? Ch…ch..Champagne…you know I heard that it can be obtained from Server Continent~~
_3875.Objective: Collect Champagne 30ea by defeating enemy Digimon in Server Continent
_3875.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! Now we can have a proper house party!

_3876.Title: Black rabbit hole
_3876.Description: Tamer~~!!! I think my friends are mad in the rabbit hole!!! Please calm down my friedns!! I will reward you!!
_3876.Objective: Defeat all enemy Digimons in dungeon that can be entered through Terriermon

_3877.Title: Black rabbit hole
_3877.Description: Tamer~~!!! Could you please help me? When you are ready, talk to me agian!

_3878.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3878.Description: Everything is ready Will you give me the combined energy of the Four Holy Beasts ?
_3878.CompletionText: I will give you a plaque for an audience with the emperor
_3878.CompletionSummary: Here it is. I'll come back when preparation is complete.

_3879.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3879.Summary: Miraculous energy of Four Holy Beasts
_3879.Description:
There is a place I want you to check with the Four Holy Beasts.
I'd like you to think of it as preparation for an audience with the emperor.
_3879.Objective: Visit 4 specific areas(Infinite Ice Wall, Western Village,Ruined Historic, Silver Lake)
_3879.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1[Infinite Ice Wall]Frozen Waterfalls%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2[Western Village]House of Resurrection%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3[Ruined Historic]Street of Trial%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4[Silver Lake]Three-Way Lake%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3879.CompletionSummary: It must have been difficult, but I will not forget the grace of the Tamer who helped me until the end

_3880.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3880.Description:
Qinglong's energy has stabilized surprisingly.
Now all the Four Holy Beasts are resurrected… Thank you.
Well, I guess you'll be able to have an audience with the true emperor with the blessing of the Four Holy Beasts on your back.

_3881.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3881.Description:
Whoa... Lastly, it's not a strong energy, but I think you need Qinglong's energy that I have.
We can't fight here, so I'll wait for you at the Server Continent Pyramid.
_3881.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Antylamon in Server Continent Pyramid
_3881.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3882.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3882.Description:
Qinglong's energy is not scattered
You have to defeat Majiramon in the Server Continent Canyon this time.
You will be recognized enough.
_3882.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Majiramon in Server Continent Canyon
_3882.CompletionText: Qinglong's energy has been restored a lot..
_3882.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3883.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3883.Description:
Qinglong's energy is not scattered
It's probably kept by the other 12 Devas.
You have to fight them and get their recognition.
First of all, you have to defeat Mihiramon in Server Continent Dessert.
_3883.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Mihiramon in Server Continent Dessert.
_3883.CompletionText: Not long left. The resurrection of all the Four Holy Beasts....
_3883.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3884.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3884.Description: It's bead containing Qinglong's energy. If you bring Qinglong's energy, you can condense it into a bead.
_3884.CompletionSummary: Thank you Well, here is the bead containing Qinglong's energy.

_3885.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3885.Description: Baihu's energy has stabilized surprisingly. Now it seems it's time to wake up the last Four Holy Beasts, Qinglong. Tamer, Please.

_3886.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3886.Description:
The powerful energy of Baihu has been captured.
I can feel the Powerful energy of Baihu in the Shadow Labyrinth
Can you go to check?
_3886.Objective: Collect [Stiff fur of Baihu] by clearing Shadow Labyrinth once
_3886.CompletionText: It's Shadow Labyrinth that can be reached from the D-Terminal
_3886.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3887.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3887.Description:
Baihu's energy is scattered among many Digimons.
I'd like to you to defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon in Lost Historic Site.
_3887.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon 30ea in Lost Historic Site.
_3887.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3888.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3888.Description:
Baihu's energy is scattered among many Digimons.
I'd like to you to defeat <Energy of Baihu>SaberLeomon in Silver Lake.
_3888.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>SaberLeomon 30ea in Silver Lake
_3888.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3889.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3889.Description: It's bead containing Baihu's energy. If you bring Baihu's energy, you can condense it into a bead.
_3889.CompletionSummary: Thank you Well, here is the bead containing Baihu's energy.

_3890.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3890.Description: Zhuqiao's energy has stabilized surprisingly. Now it seems it's time to wake up the other Four Holy Beasts, Baihu. Tamer, Please.

_3891.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3891.Description:
The powerful energy of Zhuqiao has been captured.
Can you go to the arena and bring me [Burning feather of Zhuqiao]?
_3891.Objective: Collect [Burning feather of Zhuqiao] by clearing Arena Round 10
_3891.CompletionText: It is said to be in the arena
_3891.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3892.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3892.Description:
Zhuqiao's energy is scattered among many Digimons.
I'd like to you to defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon in Western Village West.
_3892.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon 30ea in Western Village West.
_3892.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3893.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3893.Description:
Zhuqiao's energy is scattered among many Digimons.
First of all, I'd like you to defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Birdramon in Western Village.
_3893.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Birdramon 30ea in Western Village.
_3893.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3894.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3894.Description: It's bead containing Zhuqiao's energy. If you bring Zhuqiao's energy, you can condense it into a bead.
_3894.CompletionSummary: Thank you Well, here is the bead containing Zhuqiao's energy.

_3895.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3895.Description: Xuanwu's energy has stabilized surprisingly. Now it seems it's time to wake up the other Four Holy Beasts, Zhuqiao. Tamer, Please.

_3896.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3896.Description:
The powerful energy of Xuanwu has been captured.
I'd like you to defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Vajiramon in Frozen Ground.
_3896.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Vajiramon in Frozen Ground.
_3896.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3897.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3897.Description:
Xuanwu's energy is scattered among many Digimons.
I'd like to you to defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon in Snowman Village.
_3897.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon 30ea in Snowman Village.
_3897.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3898.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3898.Description:
Xuanwu's energy is scattered among many Digimons.
First of all, I'd like to you to defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Icemon in Snowstorm Village.
_3898.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Icemon 30ea in Snowstorm Village.
_3898.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work. You can amplify the power of bead by collecting the pieces I give you.

_3899.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_3899.Description: It's bead containing Xuanwu's energy. If you bring Xuanwu's energy, you can condense it into a bead.
_3899.CompletionSummary: Thank you Well, here is the bead containing Xuanwu's energy.

_3900.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3900.Description:
This is the last mission. You worked hard to get here.
There's nothing special about the last one. After completing the quest [Fake Card is!], come to Camp Site.
_3900.Objective: After completing the quest [Fake Card is!], talk to Antylamon in Camp Site
_3900.CompletionText: You can't be relieved because it's the last one.
_3900.CompletionSummary: Now, let's take care of Xuanwu's energy and please wake up the other Four Holy Beasts.... Please..Tamer..
_3900.ReservedText: Thank you for following me this far. This is a gift for Tamer.

_3901.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3901.Description:
It will be over soon. Xuanwumon's energy has become very powerful!
After comleting the quest [Feeling sorry], come to Server Continent Pyramid.
_3901.Objective: After comleting the quest [Feeling sorry], talk to Antylamon in Server Continent Pyramid.
_3901.CompletionText: It's not long. Tamer Please cheer up a little more.
_3901.CompletionSummary: Great. Now there's only one left
_3901.ReservedText: If you..... You will see the true emperor....

_3902.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3902.Description:
I prepared it as a mission on the Server Continent. The method is the same. Clear the main quest and come to the Server Continent - Canyon.
After completing the quest [Power to move forward], come to Server Continent Canyon.
I'll wating for you.
_3902.Objective: After completing the quest [Power to move forward], talk to Antylamon in Server Continent Canyon.
_3902.CompletionText: There is plenty of time. It's okay to go little by little.
_3902.CompletionSummary: That is not much left now. Thank you for doing so well…

_3903.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3903.Description:
Well... This is the last mission in the File Island. Let's proceed with the main quest of Infinite Mountain and meet again on the Server Continent.
After completing the quest [Final Battle!!], someone will be waiting for you on the Water Front. Talk to him and come to the Server Continent.
_3903.Objective: After completing the quest [Final Battle!!], talk to Antylamon in Server Continent Dessert.
_3903.CompletionText: I believe you will succeed this time too
_3903.CompletionSummary: Xuanwu's energy is almost back. Thank you Tamer
_3903.ReservedText: Growth on File Island is over. From now on, you will continue to grow here on the Sever Continent.

_3904.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3904.Description:
More and more powerful enemies will appear. I'll be waiting for you at Infinite Mountain.
The way to get there is the same.
_3904.Objective: After completing the quest [Showdown Monochromon], talk to Antylamon in Infinite Mountain
_3904.CompletionText: Are you tired? You've come so far at a great speed, so it's okay to take a break for a while
_3904.CompletionSummary: There is only one growth left in File Island.

_3905.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3905.Description:
It's going to be a little tougher now. Come to the File Island Water Front.
You probably know by now that you have to complete the main quest(purple exclamation mark) in the Lost Historic Site to get to the File Island Water Front I'll be waiting for you there.
_3905.Objective: After completing the quest [Wake Spirit Up!], talk to Antylamon in File Island Water Front
_3905.CompletionText: You can miss a lot if you move too fast. Go fast but seek perfection
_3905.ReservedText: It's great speed. If you keep going like this, Xuanwumon's energy will come back soon.

_3906.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3906.Description: Good. I'll be waiting for you at Lost Historic Site. You can come to Lost Historic Site by proceeding with the main quest(purple exlamation mark) in the Silent Forest. Cheer up I'll be waiting for you at the Lost Historic Site.
_3906.Objective: After completing the quest [Outta My Way!], talk to Antylamon in Lost Historic Site
_3906.CompletionText: Umm… If you're tired, you can go slowly.
_3906.ReservedText: As expected, you are the tamer chosen by the Four Holy Beasts. It's great ability.

_3907.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3907.Description:
I'll wait for you in the Silent Forest.
You can come to Silent Forest by completing the main quest(purple exclamation mark) in Silver Lake
Then I'll see you later.
_3907.Objective: After completing the quest [Deeper into the File Island], talk to Antylamon in Silent Forest.
_3907.CompletionText: I believe you will come soon
_3907.CompletionSummary: Great. Sorry for the rush, but please move on to the next step

_3908.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3908.Description:
Then I will be waiting for you at Silver Lake.
To come to Silver Lake, you can come by completing the Yokohama main quest(purple exclamation mark) and then accepting the quest [To the Digial World!] from Richard Sampson in DATS Center.
I will go first and wait for you.
_3908.Objective: After completing the quest [Dats Agent Ceremony], talk to Antylamon in Silver Lake
_3908.CompletionSummary: Now let's move on to the second one.

_3909.Title: Antylamon's guide
_3909.Description: I'll check one more time. Would you like to help me?
_3909.CompletionText: If you've made your decision, Let's move on.
_3909.CompletionSummary: Let's get started right away. If you talk to me, you can proceed from the first mission.

_3910.Title: Antylamon's growth support
_3910.Description: Thank you. All preparation for the growth of Tamer are ready . Talk to me again when you are ready.
_3910.CompletionSummary: I'll see you often for a while, so please take care.

_3911.Title: Antylamon's growth support
_3911.Description:
I'm Antylamon, one of the 12 Devas serving Qinglongmon. I have a favor. Tamer
It's not bad for you either.
_3911.Objective: Talk to Antylamon in Yokohama Village
_3911.CompletionText: Think about it and tell me
_3911.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I will help you grow, so please help the Four Holy Beasts recover.

_3912.Title: Sweep leftovers!
_3912.Description: We've sent scouts to find the enemy's stronghold. There will be news soon.
_3912.Objective: Talk to <Bodyguard>Leomon to complete the quest

_3913.Title: True Crown of Seven Deadly Sins
_3913.Description:
That figure... Is this Lucemon's true form?
....No. Useless doubts cannot exert sufficient force. I just follow my own justice.
_3913.ReservedText: I'm a member of the Royal Knights, but I follow my own justice, even if it's 'evil'

_3914.Title: True Demon
_3914.Description:
Lucemon's aura is felt nearby. I feel pure evil unlike before
It's urgent. Take this. This is the data obtained from the battle with Lucemon in the past.
If you use this, it will be useful in the fight against Lucemon.
_3914.Objective: Go to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, use Evil Data and defeat the summoned Digimon.
_3914.CompletionSummary: If I fail, you're the only one who can stop him.

_3915.Title: Black Rabbit Horoscope in 2023
_3915.Description: [Best Luck]! Congratulations. You'll be solid this year too.
_3915.CompletionSummary: Cheers to your bright and solid future!

_3916.Title: Black Rabbit Horoscope in 2023
_3916.Description:
[Good Luck]! Good fortune.
Your horoscope for this year will be very .auspicious
So I have a favor for you.
I'm running out of materials for the stuff I'll make for you!
Could you get me a memory chip from the vending machine at DATS Center?
_3916.Objective: Obtain Memory chip 5ea from the <Beverage>Vending Machine
_3916.CompletionText: Memory chip can be obtained from the Vending Machine in DATS Center

_3917.Title: Black Rabbit Horoscope in 2023
_3917.Description:
Fine. [Common Luck]
I don't know about humans, but it is said that many Digimons are born with neither good nor bad fortune.
This is what our liar teacher said, so you can ignore it!
To celebrate the new year, how about looking at the sun and setting goals for the year?
The cliff on File Island is the best place to see the sun.
_3917.Objective: Move to cliff of File Island Waterfront
_3917.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Cliff of File Island Waterfront%qe %cc1/%mc1
_3917.CompletionText: The Cliff of File Island Water Front is a place that I often go to contemplate
_3917.CompletionSummary:
Of course, I also set a goal
Evolving to the next level!

_3918.Title: Black Rabbit Horoscope in 2023
_3918.Description:
