[Bad Luck]?! Well That's not good, you can prevent bad fortune by eliminating disaster.
Defeat Ogremon in Silent Forest!
_3918.CompletionText: Ogremon is the Digimon that holds the most misfortune
_3918.CompletionSummary: No matter how bad your luck is, there is always a way out.

_3919.Title: Black Rabbit Horoscope in 2023
_3919.Description:
.....[Worst Luck]? Hmm.... Usually this kind of divination is just for fun, so don't take it seriously.....
If you are too anxious, it is said that the floral energy of Blossomon will ward off misfortune.....
_3919.Objective: Defeat Blossomon appearing in Lost Historic Site
_3919.CompletionText: (I've never seen this, oh my god....)
_3919.CompletionSummary:
Maybe….. I think I've driven out a lot of misfortunes…
I feel sorry for the Blossomon

_3920.Title: Injured Leomon
_3920.Description:
After tracing the traces in various directions, we have found the place where our king, Delumon, is
The king has been attacked by rebellious Digimon, and the information is that king's bodyguard Leomon is injured!
Please help the king
_3920.Objective: Talked injured Leomon in Frozen Ground
_3920.CompletionText: The last checked trace was the Frozen Ground. King is most likely there.
_3920.CompletionSummary: Ugh.... Who's that...! You can't touch king...!

_3921.Title: Injured Leomon
_3921.Description:
Did the penguins send you? Thank you human! But now I can't move. Leomon protects me and is seriously wounded.
The monsters you see around here must have Medicine kit for treatment.
Bring it to me!
_3921.Objective: Collect Medicine kit by defeating monsters in Frozen Ground
_3921.CompletionSummary:
Hurry up and give Leomon some medicine
Human! Put a bandage on that side!

_3922.Title: Rescue King of Penguin, Delumon
_3922.Description:
ugh... Thank you. I can move my body to some extent.
I'll explain in detail later. First of all, Let's escape to safe place.
Fortunately, the enemy's troops are divided to find us, so I think we can break through.
I'll take the lead.
_3922.Objective: Defeat Birdramon and Sabirdramon appearing in Frozen Ground
_3922.CompletionSummary: Ok..... Now! Let's run to the DATS Center!

_3923.Title: Sweep leftovers!
_3923.Description:
This is call from the scouts.
They say that they've discovered the rebel base
eh? You go with me due to my wound? Such care.....
_3923.Objective: Defeat enemy monsters after entering the event dungeon Villain's Hideout
_3923.CompletionSummary: Thank you for fighting with us. This is a gold coin used in our kingdom Please accept it.

_3924.Title: Penguin's Request
_3924.Description:
It seems that a group of impure people are aiming for this place.
Please scold them so they don't even come close
_3924.Objective: Defeat <Suspicious>Devimon and PicoDevimon in Silver Lake
_3924.CompletionText: Please scold them so they don't even come close
_3924.CompletionSummary: .....I just heard from Penguin No.2 that they are innocent…. I feel sorry...

_3925.Title: Penguin's Request
_3925.Description:
The king is all right, but the danger remains around him.
Please patrol the glacier area where the king and Lemon were attacked.
_3925.Objective: Visit specific areeas on the Snowstorm Village, Snowman Village and Frozen Ground
_3925.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Search Digimon Grave%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Search Freezing Area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Search The Place Where the Aqua Orb Is at Rest%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3925.CompletionText: King, please stop wandering around recklessly

_3926.Title: Penguin's Request
_3926.Description:
I heard that Leomon was injured while protecting the king.
I want to give him his favorite fruit for his struggle.
If you use this seed in a cold region, a tree will grow. Please pick the fruit from that tree.
_3926.Objective: Go to Infinite Ice Wall and use Antarctic Fruit Seed. Use [Cold Fruit] to <Bodyguard> Leomon by defeating summoned monsters
_3926.CompletionSummary: ah... It's my favortie fruit. Penguin No.3 asked for it? Thank you for your kindness....

_3927.Title: Black Rabbit Horoscope in 2023
_3927.Description:
The past year is gone and a new year is coming. Maybe it's already a new year!
Let's take a look at this year's fortune!
_3927.Objective: Talk to <Black Rabbit>Antylamon to complete the quest
_3927.CompletionSummary: Interested in participating? Get your fortune cookie here!

_3928.Title: Collecting Christmas Socks
_3928.Description:
Bad Digimons stole the gifts for the children...
I don’t want to disappoint the children who are waiting for gifts....
Won't you help me get the gift back?
_3928.Objective: Collect [Christmas Socks] by defeating all enemy Digimons except in Yokohama Village
_3928.CompletionText: I'll prepare to pull the sled
_3928.CompletionSummary: I can see the children's smiling faces! Thank God.

_3929.Title: Penguins from Antarctica
_3929.Summary: [Sub] Penguins came to find the king
_3929.Description:
We're from the far and far south.
The king we serve heard that the environment here was similar to our kingdom, so he set off with an escort for the purpose of exploration...
Contact has been lost since then.
My colleague who came with me will be in another area. It's probably in a place called Village of Beginning Please meet him.
Please help us find our king.
_3929.Objective: Meet <Antarctica>Penguin No.2 in Village of Beginning
_3929.CompletionSummary: Did you come all this way after hearing the story from No.1?

_3930.Title: Penguins from Antarctica
_3930.Summary: [Sub] Penguins came to find the king-2
_3930.Description:
It's just as you heard from No.1.
Our king lost contact acter leaving to visit this area.
I tried to stop him, but this happened.
Thanks for your help.
Our colleague will be in another area. I remember that he was going to Snowstorm Village.
Please meet him.

_3931.Title: Penguins from Antarctica
_3931.Summary: [Sub] Penguins came to find the king-3
_3931.Description:
It's same as you heard from No.1 and No.2.
I'm looking for my king.
But I can't find him.
In fact, there are traitors in our kingdom.
They tried to expel the king.
I think they might be related to this situation.
I'll always stay here .
Tell this story to No.1.
_3931.CompletionText: I'm not cold. It is similar to my hometown here.
_3931.CompletionSummary: Everyone is looking for a king according to their own discreation. I'm relieved.

_3932.Title: The Missing King
_3932.Description:
I've searched several places, but there are places I haven't explored yet.
I'm sorry, but I'd like to ask you to explore this area.
_3932.Objective: Visit specific areas on Yokohama Village, Silver Lake, Western Village and Yokoham Village : East
_3932.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Search The Ghost of the ship area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Search Three-way Lake area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Search Passage of Western Village : Outskirts%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Search Clock Tower in Yokohama Village : East%qe %cc4/%mc4
_3932.CompletionText: I will keep looking for other places, too.
_3932.CompletionSummary: Is that so.... You didn't get much....

_3933.Title: Where is our King?
_3933.Description:
After spending some time here, I found a suspicious Digimon.
Its behaviors and actions do not seem to be the Digimon the live here.
I kept trying to talk, but they just ignored.
The only way left is forced dialogue.
_3933.Objective: Defeat <Suspicious>Devimon and PicoDevimon appearing in Silver lake
_3933.CompletionText: Let's catch them and tell them what they know
_3933.CompletionSummary: You couldn't find anything suspicious? Well… It's their fault….for acting strangely!

_3934.Title: Let's find the traces
_3934.Summary: [Daily] Let's find the trace of king
_3934.Description:
You are here.
I recently found out that there are footprints similar to ours here.
Please collect footprints from around here as I will go through them one by one.
Footprints can be obtained from all enemy Digimons in Snowstorm Village.
And please look for these two areas.
It is a place that the king often visited in our kingdom. He often went to hot springs and tombs of our ancestors.
_3934.Objective: Collect [Trace of footprints] by defeating all enemy Digimons in Snowstorm Village and visit specific area
_3934.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Trace of Footprints%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Search Digimon Grave area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Search Hot Springs Area%qe %cc3/%mc3
_3934.CompletionText: I haven't slept for 5 days, but I'm not sleepy. When I'm too sleepy, I sllep with one eye closed. I am sleeping and living at the same time.
_3934.CompletionSummary: There are a lot of footprints. From now on, I'll compare them one by one.

_3935.Title: Hot Card Game
_3935.Description:
Cold? You should play a hot card game with me to warm up your body.
But not for free.
Well, I'm just looking for a new mask....
If you bring me a decent mask, I'll give you a chance to play a hot card game!
Hercules Kabuterimon, SkullGreymon and GizumonAT in Infinite Ice Wall...... These Digimons must have a mask.
_3935.Objective: Collect Skull Mask by defeating Hercules Kabuterimon, SkullGreymon and GizumonAT appearing in Infinite Ice Wall
_3935.CompletionText: If your body and mind freeze, come to me
_3935.CompletionSummary: Hmm, great masks. Good! Now you can play a hot card game with me

_3936.Title: I hate the cold so much
_3936.Description: Ugh..It's cold!! I really hate the cold
_3936.CompletionSummary: Need to get ready before it gets colder

_3937.Title: I hate the cold so much
_3937.Description: I will make a bonfire to warm up. Could you go to Taichi and Matt and get some bonfires and firewood?
_3937.CompletionText: You can get the firewood from Matt and bonfire from Taichi
_3937.CompletionSummary: You saved me!!! I'll finally be free from this cold

_3938.Title: Let's get some firewood
_3938.Description:
You came to get firewood?
I was on my way to get new firewood because I had almost used up all the firewood I had gathered. Can you help me?
_3938.Objective: Collect [Firewood] 15ea by defeating Woodmon and Cherrymon in Silver Lake
_3938.CompletionText: Get it before it gets colder
_3938.CompletionSummary: I think this amount is enough

_3939.Title: Let's make a bonfire
_3939.Description:
I'm in trouble. The fire was extinguished while I was sleeping!
I need the fire of Meramon to light a fire in this weather. Could you go to Meramon and get some fire?
_3939.Objective: Talk to <Melting the Glacier>Meramon in Snowman Village Talk to <Blazing>Meramon in Western Village
_3939.CompletionSummary: It's easy to light a fire

_3940.Title: Let's get some fur
_3940.Description:
Before it gets colder, I need to make some warm fur clothes
Could you get me some materials to make warm fur clothes from Mammothmon?
_3940.Objective: Defeat Mammothmon appearing in Snowman Village, Lost Historic Site
_3940.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mammothmon in Sonwman Village%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Mammothmon in Lost Historic Site%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3940.CompletionText: Defeat Mammothmon in Snowman Village and Lost Historic Site
_3940.CompletionSummary: Thank you, I think I can spend warmly this winter

_3941.Title: Mammothmon became violent
_3941.Description:
I'm in trouble!!
Guess I have been torturing Mammothmon too much to make fur clothes Let's go calm Mammothmon
_3941.CompletionSummary: What a relief! Mammothmon seems to have calm down

_3942.Title: Cleaning the Warehouse
_3942.Description:
All items in the warehouse were sent to the Festival site.
I'm trying to clean up messy warehouse. Can you help me?
_3942.Objective: Defeat <Trash>Box monster after moving to Festival Warehouse through Astamon
_3942.CompletionSummary: It's neat. Thanks for your help

_3943.Title: Digitamamon Brings Snacks
_3943.Description:
I baked this cake for everyone who couldn't attend this fun festival to keep their place.
Can you give them this cake?
_3943.Objective: Use the received Cake from Digitamamon to Astamon, Elecmon, Impmon, G.Neon, and Akihiro Kurata scattered all over the Worlds
_3943.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use Cake to Astamon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use Cake to Elecmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Use Cake to Impmon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Use Cake to G.Neon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Use Cake to Akihiro Kurata%qe %cc5/%mc5
_3943.CompletionSummary: They told that it was good? Thank god

_3944.Title: Piedmon with Makeup
_3944.Description:
Is it weird that I wear makeup? I have bare-faced, but this white face is makeup.
I'm researching new makeup for the festival…
I ran out of makeup supplies during the conversation, could you get me some?
_3944.Objective: Collect [Makeup Supplies] 15ea from Lost Historic Site

_3945.Title: Suffering Doggymon
_3945.Description: I thought the smell had improved after you dorve out Garbagemon, but recently, it's starting to smell more and more disgusting. Help me please~!

_3946.CompletionSummary: As expected…!! What a perfect preparation!!

_3948.CompletionSummary: Oh… Can I become a knight if I collect this!?

_3963.Title: Enforcement of Justice SlashAngemon
_3963.Description: It is the birth of a new angel to fight against evil.
_3963.CompletionSummary: Until the day when complete justice is realized….

_3964.Title: Enforcement of Justice SlashAngemon
_3964.Description:
The Angelic Digimon has its own hierarchy. Among them, the class that fights fiercely with evil on the front line is called the "Potestas" class
Would you like to take the test of our Potestas?
_3964.Objective: Defeat Summoned Digimon by using Angel's Flute after moving to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3964.CompletionSummary: Today, justice is executed according to God's will.

_3965.Title: Behind the fun Festival….
_3965.Description:
I'm sorry while enjoying the Festival.
The Festival is going smoothly, but there is a shortage of manpower Help me as a Festival Assistant.
It's not that much difficult.
_3965.CompletionSummary: Okay, It's a pass. You can even enter the no-entry area.

_3966.Title: Behind the fun Festival….
_3966.Description:
ah? Assistant? I've been busy, and that's a big help!
Bring the material tools from the box in front of you.
I'll be packing stuff for the Festival
_3966.CompletionSummary: Yeah…. I don't think there's any defect Astamon! I think we can use this as it is!

_3967.Title: Behind the fun Festival….
_3967.Description:
There are a lot of thieves who sneak things because due to lack of manpower.
Please teach them by your overwhelming power not to hang around here again!
_3967.CompletionText: It's still short on stuff, but why do they keep taking it?
_3967.CompletionSummary: It serves you right. If you steal something, you should be punished

_3968.Title: Birthday Cake Ingredients Collection
_3968.Description: I'm in charge of making the food for the Festival snacks. I can't leave the space, Can you get the ingredients instead of me?
_3968.Objective: Collect [Flour] and [Egg] by defeating all Digimons except in Yokohama Village
_3968.CompletionSummary: Timing is Great? I just ran out of existing ingredients

_3969.Title: Birthday Cake Ingredients Collection
_3969.Description:
The cake is finished, and I just need to put the rest of ingredietns on top.
Bring me the necessary fruits to complete it.
_3969.Objective: Collect [Strawberry] and [Banana] by defeating all Digimons except in Yokohama Village
_3969.CompletionText: I need to clean the dishes.
_3969.CompletionSummary: The fruit looks fresh. It looks sweet too!

_3970.Title: Birthday Cake Ingredients Collection
_3970.Description:
Thank you so much for helping me.
In return, I made a delicious cake, please enjoy.
_3970.CompletionSummary: Whoa... Then I'll go back to work

_3971.Title: What's this smell!?
_3971.Description:
Huh….? Sniff Sniff….? What does this smell like? It's so terrible! My nose is so sensitive than other Digimon, it hurts more!
Where does this stink comes from?
_3971.Objective: Defeat <Serious Stench>Gerbemon appearing at specific area in Yokohama Village
_3971.CompletionText: ugh….. I think I'm going to pass out
_3971.CompletionSummary: Gerbemon was the cause of the smell? The stench must have flown this way by the wind, Anyway, Thank you saved my life. Sniff Sniff

_3972.Title: [Jogress]SlashAngemon
_3972.Description: Culu! Culu! I can feel the new evolution power from Shakkoumon Culu!
_3972.CompletionSummary: Thank you for helping Shoutmon Culu!

_3973.Title: [Jogress]SlashAngemon
_3973.Description: Hi Culu~! It's Tamer and Shakkoumon! Nice to meet you~ Culu Shoutmon is looking for an Angel Digimon in the Village of the Beginning Culu~ Go to Shoutmon with Shakkoumon~!
_3973.Objective: Talk to Shoutmon in Village of the Beginning

_3974.Title: [Jogress]SlashAngemon
_3974.Description: Did Culumon say I'm looking for an Angel Digimon? Right! I'm looking for a strong Digimon that can become Xros Heart. Among them, I'm looking for the stongest SlashAngemon! The data that can be called to SlashAngemon will be hidden in Silver Lake! Can you bring it to me?
_3974.Objective: Collect Blade data 30ea by defeating Digimons in Silver Lake
_3974.CompletionText: If you have Blade data, you can call SlashAngemon!
_3974.CompletionSummary: Great Thank you! Now I can call SlashAngemon by using this!

_3975.Title: [Jogress]SlashAngemon
_3975.Description: It doesn’t seem possible to call with the current Blade Data I think someone manipulated it. Is it Mystimon from Lost Historic Site? If you defeat them, you will definitely be able to use!
_3975.Objective: Defeat 10 Mystimon in Lost Historic Site
_3975.CompletionText: Defeat Mystimons and find me again!

_3976.Title: [Jogress]SlashAngemon
_3976.Description: Great! Take this completed Blade data! Let's use it to defeat the summoned SlashAngemon!
_3976.Objective: Defeat the summoned SlashAngemon in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_3976.CompletionText: Go to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and Use it!
_3976.CompletionSummary: You helped Shoutmon Culu! Great job Culu!

_3977.Description: Hey Tamer Why don't you try making a pumpkin doll? Since it's Halloween I'll give you Pumpkin Box Exchange Ticket when you're done
_3977.Objective: Gather materials and make [Complete Pumpkin Doll]
_3977.CompletionSummary: Oh… you've completed Pumpkin Doll…. That's amazing This is an exchange ticket for Pumpkin Box You'll get a better item if you collect a lot of tickets

_3978.Title: Pumpkin Art Expert
_3978.Description: I just need to complete the head, but I don't like it… Is this the master's grievance..??? Hey Tamer, would you get me some Pumpkin Doll's head and carving knife??? Where do you get it? You'll get [Pumpkin Doll Box] by defeating enemy Digimons in all areas except Yokohama. Try to scan it.
_3978.Objective: Collect 5ea of [Pumpkin Doll's Head] and [Carving Knife] by scanning [Pumpkin Doll Box]
_3978.CompletionSummary: Good~! With these ingredients, I can give you the heart of Pumpkin Doll

_3979.Title: Pumpkin Art Expert
_3979.Description: Hmm… What if I make a broom into a hand shape...?? What's the point of thinking?? Would you help me??? I think it'd be good to get left and right arms Where do you get it? You'll get [Pumpkin Doll Box] by defeating enemy Digimons in all areas except Yokohama. Try to scan it.
_3979.Objective: Collect 5ea of [Pumpkin Doll's Left Arm] and [Pumpkin Doll's Right Arm] by scanning [Pumpkin Doll Box]
_3979.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Pumpkin Doll's Left Arm%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Pumpkin Doll's Right Arm%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3979.CompletionText: Bring me good ingredients like last time~!
_3979.CompletionSummary: Good~! With these ingredients, I can give you the heart of Pumpkin Doll

I'll make a trendy feet scratcher, so bring both legs of Pumpkin Doll Where do you get it? You'll get [Pumpkin Doll Box] by defeating enemy Digimons in all areas except Yokohama. Try to scan it.
_3980.Objective: Collect 5ea of [Pumpkin Doll's Left Leg] and [Pumpkin Doll's Right Leg] by scanning [Pumpkin Doll Box]
_3980.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Pumpkin Doll's Left Leg%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Pumpkin Doll's Right Leg%qe %cc2/%mc2
_3980.CompletionSummary: Good~! With these ingredients, I can give you the heart of Pumpkin Doll

_4030.Title: Another Dimension's Crisis
_4030.Description:
My colleagues and I came from an another dimension of Digital World.
The peaceful world was suddenly damaged by monsters.
My colleagues and I are wandering around dimensions looking for a partner to help us. Strong Tamer, will you help us?
_4030.CompletionSummary: Strong Tamer, I salute you for your courage.

_4031.Title: Another Dimension's Crisis
_4031.Description:
Tamer, everything is ready. By collecting enough energy, we activate the gate which is located at the enemy's center.
I'd like to ask for your help, who is the most powerful, but is that okay?
…. Thank you.
_4031.CompletionSummary: This is Grace of Yggdrasil in our dimension. The risk is too high for your body for dimension warp, so this item works as a protective shield.

_4032.Title: Another Dimension's Crisis
_4032.Description:
That's a relief. I think we both moved to another dimension without any problems.
This is our DATS Center, and the leader of the enemy was the first to invade this area and neutralize the power of the headquarters.
Apparently, all the troops are dispatched on to other dimension, and there aren't many troops left. Let's attack.
_4032.CompletionText: I'll be here to prevent distortion, so please take care of them.
_4032.CompletionSummary: You're strong. I'm glad I came with you.

_4033.Title: Another Dimension's Crisis
_4033.Description:
I can't see the leader, he's probably hibernating using a lot of energy to invade.
If you use the flashbang, they'll react to the light and the leader will show up.
_4033.CompletionText: The distortion of dimension is getting stronger…. At this rate....!
_4033.CompletionSummary: I salute you, strong Tamer. I'm glad I'm with you out of all Tamers.

_4034.Title: Scattered Dimension of Energy
_4034.Description:
I'm glad I came to this world with Medibalducmon, but... .
I lost the energy I was saving during the dimension warp.
Maybe it's scattered around this world.... Can I ask for your help?
_4034.Objective: Talk to Red Stone Monument in Oil refinery-3, Ruined Historic, and Infinite Ice Wall
_4034.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Red Stone Monument%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Red Stone Monument%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk to Red Stone Monument%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4034.CompletionText: The air here is clear and clean
_4034.CompletionSummary: I found my energy! How should I repay you?

_4035.Title: Invader of Second Dimension
_4035.Description:
The monsters are invading this world, too! I can't do this by myself. Please lend me your strength!
The enemy's troops are appearing at File Island Waterfront!
_4035.Objective: Defeat <Invading Troop>Arkadimon at File Island Waterfront. Defeat Arkadimon (Ultimate)
_4035.CompletionSummary: You did it. But more troops will come soon. Let's take a break.

_4036.Title: Invader of Second Dimension
_4036.Description:
The monsters are invading this world, too! I can't do this by myself. Please lend me your strength!
The enemy's troops are appearing at Digimon Maze Entrance!
_4036.Objective: Defeat <Main Troop>Infermon at Digimon Maze Entrance. Defeat Diablomon
_4036.CompletionSummary: Lot of enemy troops has been defeated. But more troops will come soon. Let's take a break.

_4037.Title: Appearance of Second Dimension Commander
_4037.Description:
The enemy's commander, Armagemon, has appeared.
But I joined forces with Digimons here in Digital World to defeat all troops and weaken him.
I'd like to you to finish it.
_4037.CompletionSummary: We defeated the commander! But his regeneration is tremendous. When he's done recovering, he'll show up again.

_4038.Title: Lost Medal
_4038.Summary: The One Who Stole the Medal
_4038.Description: The medal I got from this cooking competition… There's a rumor going around that Impmon took it Would you check it out!?
_4038.Objective: Defeat Impmon in File Island Waterfront

_4039.Title: Hunt the Moon Rabbit
_4039.Description: There's a rumor that a rabbit that lived on the moon came down here!! I'm so curious!! Why don't you come with me and catch it?!
_4039.Objective: Defeat <Moon Rabbit?>MegaGalgomon in Forest of the Beginning, Forest of Marionette, and Metal Empire
_4039.CompletionText: Let's go!! Before it runs away!!
_4039.CompletionSummary: Is it because the creature that lives on the moon? It was very powerful… Should I go too…??

_4040.Title: Fruits of Fall
_4040.Description: Persimmon…I ate..too much…. My stomach hurts….. I need to eat pear which is good for digestion.. Help me..Tamer…

_4041.Title: Fruits of Fall
_4041.Description: I want to eat some persimmons!! Tamer!! Please get persimmons for me!!
_4041.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! You don't know how much I wanted to eat this~

_4042.Description: Would you get me some ingredients~?
_4042.Objective: Collect 10 [File Island]-[Drumstick] [Western Area]-[Leaf] [Ice Area]-[Unknown Liquid] [All Areas]-[Foot Candy]
_4042.CompletionSummary: We need to get started quickly!

_4064.Description: It's Digivice made of unknown power If it's oaky with you, can you take care of it?
_4064.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Here you go I think I can help you enhance if you bring me some enhancement materials I'll look forward to your kind cooperation~!

_4065.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4065.Description: This is the last mission The final battle of File Island!!! Complete the main quest of Infinite Mountain and meet again in File Island Waterfront if you finish the quest [Final Battle!!] then someone will be waiting for you in File Island Waterfront I'll be waiting with him!
_4065.Objective: Talk to Taichi in File Island Waterfront after completing the quest [Final Battle!!] in Infinite Mountain
_4065.CompletionText: Fighting! It's going to be difficult, but you can do it!
_4065.CompletionSummary: Congratulations~! You've completed all rapid growth missions, haven't you? Here's a gift for you, Tamer, who's cleared all of rapid growth missions I hope you use it well

_4066.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4066.Description: More powerful enemies will emerge This time, I'll be waiting for you at Infinite Mountain The way to get here is to complete the main quest You know that right?
_4066.Objective: Talk to Taichi in Infinite Mountain after completing the quest [Showdown! Monochromon!]
_4066.CompletionText: Are you okay?? It's okay to take a break

_4067.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4067.Description: It's going to be a little difficult now I'll be waiting in File Island Waterfront To come to File Island Waterfront, You have to complete the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in Lost Historic Site I'll be waiting for you!
_4067.Objective: Talk to Taichi in File Island Waterfront after completing the quest [Wake Spirit Up!]
_4067.CompletionText: If you go fast, you might miss something Speed is important but being perfect is as much important as speed
_4067.CompletionSummary: There's not much left~! Shall we move on?

_4068.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4068.Description: Good~! Shall we go to Lost Historic Site? To get there, You have to complete the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in Silent Forest~! Cheer up~! I'll be waiting for you!
_4068.Objective: Talk to Taichi in Lost Historic Site after completing the quest [Outta My Way!]
_4068.CompletionText: It's okay to do it slowly No rush~

_4069.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4069.Description: This itme, I'll be waiting for you in Silent Forest To come to Silent Forest, You have to complete the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in Silver Lake~! See you soon~!
_4069.Objective: Talk to Taichi in Silent Forest after completing the quest [Deeper into the File Island]
_4069.CompletionSummary: Great!! There's not much time to rest now is there? Let's start right away to the third mission~!

_4070.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4070.Description: Then I'll be waiting in Silver Lake To come to Silver Lake, You have to complete the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in Yokohama Village You can get here by accepting the quest [To the Digital World!] from Richard Sampson See you soon~!
_4070.Objective: Talk to Taichi in Silver Lake after completing the quest [Dats Agent Ceremony]
_4070.CompletionSummary: Shall we move on to the second mission?

_4071.Title: Extreme Jumping
_4071.Description: Hello~! Are you a new agent?? Don't you get a ticket from Agumon?
_4071.CompletionText: If you give me a ticket, I'll show you the way of rapid growth!

_4072.Title: Preparation for the Final Battle!
_4072.Description: Beyond Dark Masters, there is only one enemy left. Come back to me before you confront true darkness.
_4072.CompletionText: I can feel the strong dark energy all the way here
_4072.CompletionSummary: There's only one last fight left, good luck.

_4073.Title: Aura of Fear
_4073.Description:
Now that MetalSeadramon, One of Dark Masters, has disappeared. The uncontrolled Digimons are running wild.
Especially, please stop the dangerous-looking Dokugumon and Mammothmon.
_4073.Objective: Defeat Dokugumon and Mammothmon in Forest of the Beginning
_4073.CompletionSummary: Digimons have calmed down a bit. I'll call you back if there's any problems.

_4074.Title: Aura of Fear
_4074.Description:
Now that Puppetmon, One of Dark Masters, has disappeared. The uncontrolled Digimons are running wild.
Especially, please stop the dangerous-looking Goblimon and Flymon.
_4074.Objective: Defeat Goblimon and Flymon in Forest of Marionette
_4074.CompletionSummary: Digimons have calmed down a bit. I'll call you back if there's any problems.

_4075.Title: Aura of Fear
_4075.Description:
Now that MugenDramon, One of Dark Masters, has disappeared. The uncontrolled Digimons are running wild.
Especially, please stop the dangerous-looking Thunderballmon and SealsDramon.
_4075.Objective: Defeat Thunderballmon and SealsDramon in Metal Empire
_4075.CompletionSummary: Digimons have calmed down a bit. I'll call you back if there's any problems.

_4076.Title: Aura of Fear
_4076.Description:
Now that Piedmon, One of Dark Masters, has disappeared. The uncontrolled Digimons are running wild.
Especially, please stop the dangerous-looking PicoDevimon and Devidramon.
_4076.Objective: Defeat PicoDevimon and Devidramon in Top of a Nightmare
_4076.CompletionSummary: Digimons have calmed down a bit. I'll call you back if there's any problems.

_4077.Title: Rest at the lake
_4077.Description:
It's been a while since I've tried to enjoy a rest on Silver Lake. But there are a lot of people who threw away trash.
If you're free, would you help me?
_4077.CompletionText: You can't throw away trash whether you are on the vacation
_4077.CompletionSummary: Dirty guys…. Hey, help me to clean this up

_4078.Title: Squid occupying the beach
_4078.Description:
Squids showed up on the beach, drove out Digimons, and they settled down.
I need to teach those guys some manners.
Of course you have to. I'm on vacation, so I don't want to move.
_4078.CompletionSummary: It's a bad idea to believe in numbers

_4079.Title: Shall we get some rest now?
_4079.Summary: [Daily] Shall We Get Some Rest Now?
_4079.Description:
Since the lake and squids have been cleaned, shall we take a rest now?
While you're at it, help me with one more thing. Bring me materials to hang the hammock on the tree. What's a hammock? If I say a net bed then you would understand?
_4079.Objective: Collect <Hammock Material> by defeating enemy Digimons in File Island
_4079.CompletionText: It's tough to take a break
_4079.CompletionSummary: Is it over now? You worked hard to help me. It's not much, but it's my reward. Would you like to enjoy a vacation with me?

_4080.Title: Air conditioner is not working
_4080.Description:
The heat is rising…. If I get any more heat, I'll explode
I've heard there's someone in the air conditioner who's disrupting the facility to operate
Go ahead and detonate this bomb underground. It's going to respond to electromagnetic waves and the culprit will come out!
_4080.Objective: Use Electronic Bomb in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and defeat the enemy Digimon
_4080.CompletionText: Come on… Hurry up, before I explode
_4080.CompletionSummary: Whew…. the temperature's going down. I'm not going to explode

_4081.Title: Card Game
_4081.Summary: Do You Want to Play the Card Game?
_4081.Description: Do you want to play with me~~?
_4081.Objective: Talk to Pumpmon in DATS Center
_4081.CompletionText: It's simple~! It's just fliping the card~
_4081.CompletionSummary: Let's start the game with this~
_4081.ReservedText: Oh~~ Thank you~! We can have a more fun time~~

_4082.Title: Reckless Courage Training
_4082.Description: So mean!!! I was afraid that you guys would be scared, so I hid as much as possible so that you guys couldn't see!!! I can't believe you guys found and hit it!! Apologize!!!!!
_4082.Objective: Collect [Pencil] that can be found from Glacier Area, and [Paper] that can be found from Western Area and give it to Joe
_4082.CompletionSummary: Hu…Have to write a letter… Okay…I'll write it with an apology…

_4083.Title: Reckless Courage Training
_4083.Description: Good!! I think my heart is ready..!! Shall we start now??
_4083.Objective: Defeat <Hiding>Bakemon, which is summoned by using [Certificate Of Courage] in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_4083.CompletionText: Hu….I'm still scared, so can you take the lead, Tamer??

_4084.Title: Reckless Courage Training
_4084.Description: Tamer I've been thinking a lot I think I need to raise my courage Would you do it together?
_4084.Objective: Talk to Joe again to complete the quest
_4084.CompletionSummary: Hu… Hu… Good!! Would you talk to me again?
_4084.ReservedText: It's very scary, but it has to be done!!

_4085.Title: Source Of Rumor
_4085.Description: I think we need to check it out!! Let's find the cause, not the one we're afraid of!!

_4086.Title: Source Of Rumor
_4086.Description: Umm… there is a rumor that Anubimon is catching all ghost Digimons… Maybe….Phantomon in Lost Historic Site might be the problem..
_4086.Objective: Talk to Soulmon again to complete the quest
_4086.CompletionText: Can you check it together?? Tamer??
_4086.CompletionSummary: Thank you, then, I'll think about it a little more. Could you talk to me again later?
_4086.ReservedText: Maybe he's here to catch Phantomon who's doing bad things….

_4087.Title: Scary Rumor
_4087.Description: Uh?!!? Wouldn't Anubimon also return if we deal with escaped Soulmons instead of Anubimon? Tamer!! Can you defeat <Escaped>Soulmons in Silent Forest!? They'll be hiding among <Playing>Soulmons!
_4087.CompletionSummary: Hu… Now Anubimon will leave, right…??

_4091.CompletionSummary: How's Shoutmon's neww look? Isn't it cool?

_4092.Title: Messenger Of Peace, Xros 7!
_4092.Description: Yes…. You did it, the hot hearts that come together to make a bright golden light!
_4092.CompletionSummary: Bring true peace to me by winning over and over again.

_4093.Title: X7's Test
_4093.Description:
Ah! Tamer, I finally found you! My friend Shoutmon is looking for you.
I guess he want to show a new look. I'll give you the pager that he gave me.
_4093.CompletionSummary: Here! It's a pager to call Shoutmon

_4094.Description: Only one day! Only once! Usable machine. Please complete the mission on the note and receive the prize.
_4094.CompletionSummary: This is today's coupon. Please use the machine tomorrow as well.

_4095.CompletionText: Ice… I'll take some of them when Tamer brings it.
_4095.CompletionSummary: I reward you for completing the mission! What? Why do I put 2 block of ice in a different place? …hmm!

_4096.Description: Hmm! This mission note is…. It's a mission to visit the area! Find a phone booth in Wind Valley.

_4096.CompletionText: What's the number of the phone booth?
_4096.CompletionSummary: I reward you for completing the mission! Huh? Isn't it Wizardmon's voice? Who is that?

_4097.Title: Rare Machine Of Destiney
_4097.Description: Hmm! This mission note is…. It's a mission to defeat enemy Digimons! Please defeat Seadramon in Silent Forest!
_4097.CompletionText: They poured water at me before. Take this
_4097.CompletionSummary: I reward you for completing the mission! What? I look happy? Nah!

_4098.Title: Rare Machine Of Destiney
_4098.Description: Hmm! This mission note is…. It's a mission to collect certain items! Please get a memory chip.
_4098.Objective: Collect 10 Memory Chip that sells in <Beverage>Vending Machine
_4098.CompletionText: Well…. If Tamer brings me memory chips, I'll have about 80….. Whoa?! How long were you there?
_4098.CompletionSummary: I reward you for completing the mission! Huh? What am I going to do with memory chips? It's a secret.

_4099.Title: Rare Machine Of Destiney
_4099.Description: Hmm! This mission note is…. Congratulations! The mission is to carry this note!
_4099.Objective: Collect a special mission note item
_4099.CompletionSummary: I reward you for completing the mission! ….You think I'm disappointed that I didn't get something out of you? W..what!

_4100.Title: Legless Ones
_4100.Description:
Ghosts! Ghost Digimons! They were floating without legs! I can't go outside because I'm scared of them
Please get rid of them!
_4100.Objective: Defeat <Stealing The Soul>Phantomon which appears by defeating 10 <Ghost>Bakemon in Silent Forest
_4100.CompletionSummary: Will I be able to go outside again?

_4101.Title: For Information Security!
_4101.Description: Information security is important but there are attempts to hack the information of DATS Center. Hackers are in Distorted Data Village. Defeat 30 <Hacker>Andromon and <Hacker>HiAndromon each so that they can never hack into DATS Center again.
_4101.CompletionText: Haven't you defeated them all yet?
_4101.ReservedText: Thank you for defeating all the hackers. Thanks to you, they won't be able to hack for a while.

_4102.Title: Summer Nourishing Food
_4102.Description: I was able to complete the nourishing food using the ingredients you've collected. I appreciate that. But can you do me a favor again? There are 2 children who are struggling with the heat these days and I want to refresh them up by feeding them the nourishing food I made. I want to go myself, but if I go, it will take a long time and I'm asking because the nourishing food will become cold. There are 2 children: <Hot>T.K. in Western Village and <Tired>Hikari in Snowstorm Village. I'll reward you generously. Thank you.
_4102.Objective: Deliver Babamon's Nourishing Food to <Hot>T.K. in Western Village and <Tired>Hikari in Snowstorm Village
_4102.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver Babamon's Nourishing Food to T.K.%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Babamon's Nourishing Food to Hikari%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4102.CompletionText: Haven't you brought the nourishing food to the children yet?
_4102.ReservedText: Thank you for bringing nourishing food to the children. I got a call saying that they had a good meal and were refreshed. Thank you so much. Here is the reward.

_4103.Title: Summer Nourishing Food
_4103.Description: Lastly, I need ginseng as an ingredient for the nourishing food. Ginseng can be obtained by defeating <Ginseng?>Vegiemon and <Ginseng?>RedVegiemon in Western Area: East. Would you bring me 30 ginsengs? I'll give you a reward if you bring it to me.
_4103.Objective: Collect 30 ginseng by defeating <Ginseng?>Vegiemon and <Ginseng?>RedVegiemon in Western Area: East
_4103.CompletionSummary: Ah.. It's a little hard. I'm a little tired from walking a lot and I'm hungry.
_4103.ReservedText: Thank you for collecting ginseng. Now I can make the nourishing food. Here is the reward.

_4104.Title: Summer Nourishing Food
_4104.Description: Hey. I'm trying to make the nourishing food to prepare for the summer heat. Can you help me? I'm running out of 2 ingredients. I need the chicken first. You can get it if you defeat <Chicken?>Birdramon and <Chicken?>Sabirdramon in Lost Historic Site. Would you bring me 30 chickens? I'll give you a reward if you bring it to me.
_4104.Objective: Collect 30 chicken by defeating <Chicken?>Birdramon and <Chicken?>Sabirdramon in Lost Historic Site
_4104.ReservedText: Thank you for collecting chicken. In return, I'll give you a reward. I'll ask you to bring the next ingredient.

_4105.Title: Arena
_4105.Description: Hi. The new season of Arena has begun. To commemorate that, if you defeat Digimon in Arena, you can get Arena Seal with a high chance. Please collect 10 Arena Seal while experiencing the new season of Arena. You can enter Arena through DATS Center NPC <Digimon Arena Admission>Miki.
_4105.Objective: Collect 10 Arena Seal by defeating enemy Digimons in Arena
_4105.CompletionText: Are you still collecting 10 Arena Seal?
_4105.ReservedText: You've experienced a new season of Arena. In return, I'll give you a gift. Please continue to challenge Arena.

_4106.Title: Law-Abiding Spirit
_4106.Description: If you use Outlaw Summoning Stone that I gave you at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you'll be able to summon the hidden outlaw <Outlaw>Myotismon. Defeat the summoned <Outlaw>Myotismon.
_4106.Objective: Use Outlaw Summoning Stone and defeat <Outlaw>Myotismon in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_4106.ReservedText: Thank you for defeating Myotismon. I look forward to your support. I want you to obey the law, too.

_4107.Title: Law-Abiding Spirit
_4107.Description: Hi. Are you good at following the law? There is a Digimon who ignores the law and acts as he pleases. That's why I'm worried so much.
_4107.ReservedText: I've investigated and found that Digimon is now hiding in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square

_4108.Title: How To Celebrate The Anniversary
_4108.Summary: Let's Get Permission For The Festival!
_4108.Description: There's something you need to do to enjoy the festival! What's that? Oh, my god! Of course to get a permission for the festival? I want to have a festival at DATS Center, so please get a permission from Richard Sampson
_4108.CompletionText: We need to hurry before it's too late! At this rate, preparations for the fetival will be delayed~
_4108.CompletionSummary: Oh! Thank you! Shall we get started?

_4109.Title: How To Celebrate The Anniversary
_4109.Summary: Shall We Get Ready For The Festival?
_4109.Description: Let's officially get ready~ What can't be left out of the festival? That's right! It's fireworks~ Pop pop pop! I need some ingredients to make fireworks Get me some flames from DemiMeramon and gunpowders from Giromon from all regions!
_4109.Objective: Collect Flame 15ea from DemiMeramon in all regions Collect Gunpowder 15ea from Giromon in all regions
_4109.CompletionText: We're going to be late at this rate!! 15 flames, 15 gunpowders! Don't forget!
_4109.CompletionSummary: Did you bring everything? Ugh~ Wait a little bit! I'll make it soon

_4110.Title: How To Celebrate The Anniversary
_4110.Description: Hmm… Fireworks are small, so it doesn't create festival mood… I think we can make a bigger fireworks… Tamer! After using fireworks, don't throw away remains nad bring them to me! Maybe I can make a bigger firework!
_4110.Objective: Craft Parade Firework 1ea by using Remains Of Firework from <Firework Festival>Candlemon
_4110.CompletionText: Please collect 7 Remains Of Firework and bring them to me Maybe I can make a bigger firework!
_4110.CompletionSummary: Look! What a firework!! Thank you for making the best festival, Tamer~ Have a good day!

_4111.Title: Gankoomon X
_4111.Description: You look strong Tamer?? Would you help my teacher's training?? It will help my teacher to train Mega Tekken!
_4111.CompletionText: Can I ask you a favor?
_4111.ReservedText: You're helping me, right??? Thank you!! Take this and use it in Underground Summon Square, and my teacher will show up!

_4112.Title: Gankoomon X
_4112.Description: Go to Underground Summon Square and use the item You'll be able to fight with my teacher!
_4112.Objective: Move to Underground Summon Square and use [Tekken Fragment] to defeat Gankoomon X
_4112.CompletionSummary: Oh..you're really strong, Tamer, aren't you? Thanks to you, my teacher's Tekken training is going well~!

_4113.Title: Operation Diet

_4113.CompletionText: Let's go to the training ground

_4114.CompletionText: Let's go to the training ground
_4114.CompletionSummary: Whew~! I achieved my goal today!

_4115.CompletionText: Let's go to the training ground
_4115.CompletionSummary: Whew~! I achieved my goal today!

_4116.CompletionText: Let's go to the training ground
_4116.CompletionSummary: Whew~! I achieved my goal today!

_4117.CompletionText: Let's go to the training ground
_4117.CompletionSummary: Whew~! I achieved my goal today!

_4118.Title: Operation Diet
_4118.Description: I want to rest…because it's the weekend….. But if I rest….. I won't succeed on a diet…. Ugh…. It's difficult but let's do it~!Let's go!!!
_4118.Objective: Obtain [Saturday Training Stamp] 3ea at Gankoomon's Training Ground

_4118.CompletionSummary: Whew~! I achieved my goal today!

_4119.Title: Operation Diet
_4119.Description: It feels like I've become healthier... Feels tired…. It's a fascinating feeling whenever I go on a diet

_4119.CompletionText: Let's go to the training ground
_4119.CompletionSummary: Whew~! I achieved my goal today!

_4120.Title: Diet Challenge
_4120.Description: I'm going to the beach with Palmon I need to lose some weight now if I want to eat a lot Diet challenge begins!!!!! You'll join me, right!? Tamer?!
_4120.Objective: Collect Drop Of Sweat 30ea in File Island Waterfront
_4120.CompletionText: Piyomon and Palmon are helping me I can't fail!!
_4120.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! Being together makes me feel less tired!

_4121.CompletionText: Hikari and T.K. are working on something, too~ Let's prepare things to help Mimi
_4121.CompletionSummary: Oh~! You collected it faster than I thought There will be no problem with Mimi's diet!

_4122.Title: Preparing For A Trip Is Annoying
_4122.Description: The preparation is so annoying~~ Can you do it for me~? I'll definitely give you a reward!
_4122.CompletionText: I'm going to go on a trip with my friends~~ The preparation is so annoying….
_4122.CompletionSummary: Thank you~! You're a nice Tamer!!

_4123.Objective: Collect Ice 60ea in Infinite Ice Wall
_4123.CompletionText: I think Patamon and Gatomon are also looking forward to it~ Let's get ready!
_4123.CompletionSummary: Thank you~! You worked hard collecting all this from the cold~ I'll give you more reward for your hard work~!

_4124.Title: Preparing For A Trip Is Annoying
_4124.Description: Everything I need will be written on that paper If you get it, I'll give you a present~ Please~~~ I wonder what Gabumon and Matt are doing~
_4124.Objective: Collect Fresh Fruit 40ea in Silver Lake
_4124.CompletionSummary: Fruits can't be left out!, right?! Thank you so much for collecting them!!

_4125.Title: Preparing For A Trip Is Annoying

_4125.Objective: Defeat 50 <Travel Disrupter>Ogremon in File Island Waterfront
_4125.CompletionText: I think Piyomon and Gomamon are ready
_4125.CompletionSummary: Gomamon's happy since the waterfront became clean~ Thank you Tamer

_4126.Title: Preparing For A Trip Is Annoying
_4126.Description: Actually, I'm all ready to go~~ I waited for you to come Everyone waited for you to come! Agumon, Gabumon, and Gatomon have all been waiting for you~!
_4126.CompletionText: What are you doing? Why don't you get ready?! Let's go to the waterfront~!

_4127.Title: Don't Like Buying Clothes?
_4127.Description: I don't like plain clothes anymore I'm on a diet I'll make my own new clothes! I heard there's a machine with fancy cloth Can you get it for me~?
_4127.Objective: Get Piece Of Fancy Cloth in Cloth Box from <Cloth Coupon>Rare Machine
_4127.CompletionText: I want to look amazing and cool among Chosen Children!! We're going to travel to the waterfront soon!
_4127.CompletionSummary: Wow~!! What a fancy cloth!! Thank you so much!!! I think I can make nice clothes thanks to you!

_4128.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_4128.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_4128.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_4128.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_4129.Title: How to Fight the Heat
_4129.Description:
Be careful not to break the bottle you just received! There's a small wind inside.
If you open the lid in a windy area, It will turn into a huge storm.
Catch the storm and bring it to me
_4129.Objective: Use Bottle of Small Wind in Wind Valley to summon Storm Whirl and collect [Bottle of Strom] by defeating Storm Whirl.
_4129.CompletionText: There's a lot of strong wind in Wind Valley right?
_4129.CompletionSummary: Good! If you release this storm into Silent Forest, the heat will be gone!

_4130.Title: Into the Cool Sea!
_4130.Description:
Nice to meet you, Tamer! I'm the maritime inspector, Tylomon!
Recently, there have been many reports of Digimons disturbing order in the sea!
Would you help me to set the order straight in the bottom of the sea?
_4130.CompletionText: Isn't it tough? It's okay because I'm used to it!
_4130.CompletionSummary: Take this ticket. You can enter the sea by using this ticket

_4131.Title: Unfair Meramon
_4131.Description:
Ah! This is unfair! They always blame me when the weather gets hot!
I try to control the heat as much as I can!
The cause of this heat must be Asuramon
I can't stand the fact that I'm being accused of a hot weather because of him!
Go defeat Asuramon. Then everyone will know that I'm innocent.
_4131.Objective: Defeat <Hot>Asuramon in Wilderness Area, Western Area: Outskirts, and Western Area: East.
_4131.CompletionText: I have to concentrate to keep the heat under control, so please don't interrupt.
_4131.CompletionSummary: Now, the weather is getting cooler right?

_4132.Title: Prepare for the Heat Wave
_4132.Description:
The weather is getting hot~ It's going to be really hot real soon.
Would you get some cool water for me in advance?
_4132.Objective: Collect [Cool Water] by defeating enemy Digimons except in Yokohama Village
_4132.CompletionSummary: It's cool~ This should be enough

_4133.Title: How to Fight the Heat
_4133.Description:
Our hideout in Silent Forest has been taken away by Birdramons.
We've tried to resist, but Zhuqiaomon is behind all this! We can't defeat them….
Go to our hideout in Silent Forest and defeat them!
If you continue to defeat Birdramons, Zhuquiamon will appear.
_4133.Objective: Defeat <Rage>Zhuqiaomon at Ogremon Hideout in Silent Forest which appears after defeating 10 Birdramons
_4133.CompletionText: If you keep defeating Birdramon, Zhuqiaomon will show up
_4133.CompletionSummary: Don't ever come again, you basterds!

_4134.Title: How to Fight the Heat
_4134.Description:
It's good that Birdramons and Zhuquiamon is gone….
But the forest became very hot because of their heat.
Help me to cool down the heat in the forest.

_4135.Title: Conquest of Spiral Mountain
_4135.Description:
Dark Masters are very strong Digimons.
Also minions of Dark Masters have powers that can't be ignored.
You'd better defeat minions of Dark Masters before the fight.
_4135.Objective: Defeat <Dragon of the Deep Sea>MegaSeadramon in Forest of the Beginning
_4135.CompletionSummary: You've defeated [Dragon of the Deep Sea]

_4136.Title: Conquest of Spiral Mountain
_4136.Description:
Dark Masters are very strong Digimons.
Also minions of Dark Masters have powers that can't be ignored.
You'd better defeat minions of Dark Masters before the fight.
_4136.Objective: Defeat <Peak of Dirty>Gerbemon in Forest of Marionette

_4137.Title: Conquest of Spiral Mountain
_4137.Description:
Dark Masters are very strong Digimons.
Also minions of Dark Masters have powers that can't be ignored.
You'd better defeat minions of Dark Masters before the fight.

_4138.Title: Jogress[ZekeGreymon]
_4138.Summary: Find the Evolution of the Legend-0
_4138.Description:
Hello~ Culu! Looks strong and first time seeing MetalGreaymon Culu~! Come to think of it, I saw Starmons in Western Village West, and looked so sick Culu...
I'm worried. Would you go over there and check it out? Culu!
_4138.Objective: Talk to Starmons in Western Village West

_4139.Title: Jogress[ZekeGreymon]
_4139.Summary: Find the Evolution of the Legend-1
_4139.Description:
We're Starmons of Xros Heart! Ugh... We're avoiding Dorbickmon for a while because Dorbickmons has damages us so much! You're with Christopher and MetalGreymon(C)! I think we need to evolve of the legend like Shoutmon to win! Would you help me?
There's a lot of Coredramon around here. Collect Trail of Evolution of Legend from Coredramon! I'm sure it'll help!
_4139.Objective: Collect 30 Evolutionary Trail of Legend in Western Village West
_4139.CompletionText: Does everyone alright... Okay let's not worry!
_4139.CompletionSummary: Thanks! Thanks to you, we can rest now!

_4140.Title: Jogress[ZekeGreymon]
_4140.Summary: Find the Evolution of the Legend-2
_4140.Description:
Why! Why! Why can't we evolve!
Okay! Let's give up!
This feeling?! It's him! Fanglongmon!
He's Dorbickmons' Minion!
I can't deal with him right now!
Please, help me!
_4140.CompletionText: What? It's weird that Fanglongmons is Dorbickmons' Minion?

_4141.Title: Jogress[ZekeGreymon]
_4141.Summary: Find the Evolution of the Legend-3
_4141.Description:
You've defeated Fanglongmon that's great~!
We're going to find new crew now
Thank you for everything!
Fanglongmon comes back stronger. That's a problem. Last favor!
Defeat Fanglongmon!
_4141.CompletionText: I believe in you and MetalGreymon(C) who have not defeated!
_4141.CompletionSummary: I felt pride and faith in you. It didn't respond to me, but It will respond to you. Take it.

_4142.Title: Mina's Warm-heart
_4142.Description: Would you give my mugwort rice cakes to Joe and Izzy, who are far away from here? Mugwort rice cakes are delicious during this period so I wan to share it with my friends
_4142.Objective: Give Mugwort Rice Cake Made by Mina to <Responsible>Joe in Wilderness Area and <Curious>Izzy in Western Village West
_4142.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Give Mugwort Rice Cake Made by Mina to Joe%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Give Mugwort Rice Cake Made by Mina to Izzy%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4142.CompletionText: You need to go Wilderness Area and Western Village West.
_4142.CompletionSummary: Thank you for finding mugwort rice cake. This is the reward for return.

_4143.Title: Mina's Warm-heart
_4143.Summary: Mugwort Rice Cake, Mugwort Rice Cake
_4143.Description: Mugwort rice cakes that I made keep disappearing. The traces of mugwort powder are being found on File Island, would you get mugwort rice cakes back from Digimons on File Island?
_4143.Objective: Collect 30 Mugwort Rice Cake by defeating enemy Digimons in File Island
_4143.CompletionText: Find mugwort rice cake in File Island.
_4143.CompletionSummary: Thank you for finding mugwort rice cake. This is the reward for return.

_4144.Title: The Environment is Now…
_4144.Description: This time, selfish MarineDevimon is melting Frozen Ground by making a fire because he wanted to be comfortable. Hurry up and go to Frozen Ground and defeat MarineDevimon before all glaciers get melted.
_4144.CompletionSummary: Once again, thank you for keeping glaciers from melting. We all have to protect the environment!

_4145.Title: The Environment is Now…
_4145.Description: Digimons, who don't know the importance of the environment, are making fires in Ice Area thus glaciers are melting. Hurry up and go to Ice Area before all glaciers get melted and stop the fire.
_4145.Objective: Collect 20 Matches by defeating enemy Digimons in Ica Area
_4145.CompletionSummary: Thank you for keeping glaciers from melting. We all have to protect the environment!

_4146.Title: The Sea is Now…
_4146.Description: This time, Gerbemon is polluting the sea on File Island Water Front. We have to protect the sea. Please defeat Gerbemon.
_4146.Objective: Defeat <Polluted>Gerbemon in File Island Water Front
_4146.CompletionText: Go to File Island Water Front and defeat Gerbemon.
_4146.CompletionSummary: Thanks. Thanks to you, We can keep protecting the sea.

_4147.Title: The Sea is Now…
_4147.Description: Roachmons are polluting the sea near Yokohama Village Port. We have to portect the sea. Please defeat Roachmons.
_4147.CompletionText: Go to Yokohama Village Port and defeat Roachmon.
_4147.CompletionSummary: Thanks. Thanks to you, We can keep protecting the sea.

_4148.Title: ShoutmonDX
_4148.Description: ShoutmonDX is looking for someone who can pass his test. Summon ShoutmonDX's alter ego at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and defeat him. If you're confident you can defeat him, try it.

_4148.CompletionText: Haven't you tried ShoutmonDX's test yet?
_4148.CompletionSummary: Congratulations. You passed the test of ShoutmonDX. Now, I hope you can use your abilities in a good way like ShoutmonDX. And this is a gift from ShoutmonDX. Use it well.

_4149.Title: ShoutmonDX
_4149.Description: Hi. I'm Agumon, deputy of ShoutmonDX. ShoutmonDX is calling you.
_4149.CompletionSummary: Thank you for accepting ShoutmonDX's call. Now, let's start the test.

_4150.Title: Gift for the Teacher

_4150.Objective: Defeat <The One Who Stole Flowers>Palmon in Lost Historic Site
_4150.CompletionText: I heard it's at Lost Historic Site!
_4150.CompletionSummary: Thank you~! Thanks to you, I can give flowers to the teacher safely

_4151.Title: How Married Couple Loves

_4151.CompletionSummary: Thank you~ Thanks to you, I can give a present to Babamon

_4152.Title: How Married Couple Loves
_4152.Summary: Secret of Married Couple is a Gift! -1

_4152.CompletionSummary: Thank you~ I think we get closer thanks to you~

_4153.Title: Worried Sora
_4153.Description: Give this to Taichi He'll come back when he's rested He'll feel much better if he take the medicine.
_4153.CompletionText: Please give this to Taichi. Hurry.
_4153.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I'm feeling a lot better

_4154.Title: Worried Sora
_4154.Description: Give this to Matt It'll help Matt to get over the cold quickly.
_4154.CompletionSummary: Thank you Thanks to you, I feel better now

_4155.Title: Worried Sora
_4155.Description: Those two… They need some medicines…. I don't think I'll be enough to take care of two Tamers… Can you help me??
_4155.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimons in Odaiba, collect Medicine, and bring it to Sora
_4155.CompletionText: Please do it as soon as possible~
_4155.CompletionSummary: Now we can give it to them!

_4156.Title: Matt Caught a Cold
_4156.Description: Ugh.. This isn't just a cold.. It's the power of IceDevimon… Defeat IceDevimon!
_4156.Objective: Defeat IceDevimon in Infinite Ice Wall
_4156.CompletionText: Defeat IceDevimon and he'll be better.
_4156.CompletionSummary: You defeat IceDevimon...?? I guess it's just a cold…..

_4157.Title: Matt Caught a Cold
_4157.Description: Ahchoo!!! Ugh…I'm shivering because of a cold.... I need something like a hot pack…. Can you find something like that for me??
_4157.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimons in Server Continent Desert and collect Warm Sand

_4158.Title: Taichi is Suffering from the Heat
_4158.Description: Ugh…. It's so hot….I'm about to fall down…. This must be because of Meramon….. We need to defeat Meramon….
_4158.Objective: Defeat Meramon in Server Continent Desert
_4158.CompletionSummary: Hmm???You defeat Meramon…??? But why is it stilil hot??? S…..so…something's wrong……

_4159.Title: Taichi is Suffering from the Heat
_4159.Description: Ugh…It's so hot~~~~ I need to drink some ice water…. Can you get me some ice??
_4159.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimons in Infinite Ice Wall and collect Ice Chunk
_4159.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Thanks to you, I can drink cool ice water.

_4160.Title: [Daemon X Event]
_4160.Description:
I was waiting for you! Daemon X!
Seeing your partner Digimon, I want to give you a present…

_4161.Title: The Appearance of Rage
_4161.Description:
I'm Ulforce V-dramon, a member of Royal Knights. I'm on the trail of Demon King of Rage.
Will you help me, strong Tamer?
_4161.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for your decision, Tamer. The power of rage is quite strong. It's too dangerous to fight without preparation.
I'll give you the fragment of rage. It's weak but you'll get used to his power.

_4162.Title: The Appearance of Rage
_4162.Description:
Use the fragment of rage you just gave me to get used to the power of Demon King.
Even though the power is weak, don't let your guard down.
_4162.Objective: Move to D-Terminal Underground Summon and defeat summoned Digimon from using fragment of rage
_4162.CompletionSummary: Remember that feeling. Please join us when Demon King of Rage destroys everything.

_4163.Title: Grow Well
_4163.Description: Recently, children are getting scared because of the sudden increase of Devimon. Defeat them and get them out of this area! They mainly appear in Silver Lake, Silent Forest, and Lost Historical Site.
_4163.Objective: Defeat <Villain>Devimon which appears in Silver Lake, Silent Forest, and Lost Historical Site
_4163.CompletionSummary: I'm glad they're relieved. Thank you so much

_4164.Title: Terriermon's Card Game
_4164.Description:
If you bring me the card game coupon, We can play the game once.
Defeat WaruMonzaemon who recently interferes card games, and I'll give you more coupons!
_4164.Objective: Defeat <Mean>WaruMonzaemon which appears in Silver Lake, Distorted Data Village, and Digimon Farm
_4164.CompletionSummary: You defeated WaruMonzaemon! I'll give you a card game coupon as promised!

_4165.Title: Mother's Day
_4165.Description:
What was I doing?
I'm trimming flowers for my mother. Why don't you make flowers for your mother, too, Tamer?
If you bring flower Data from Digimons' in Silver Lake and Silent Forest, I'll help you make it.
_4165.Objective: Collect [Damaged Flower Data] from Digimons in Silver Lake and Silent Forest
_4165.CompletionSummary: I recovered damaged data on flowers. Bring it to Digitamamon and exchange good items.

_4166.Title: Jeri Kato's Request
_4166.Description:
Hello, Tamer? I'm Jeri Kato. This is my partner Leomon!
I wanted to go to new Digital World, so I asked Leomon to bring me here.
If you don't mind, can you take a picture of me and Leomon? I want to make unforgettable memories with Leomon.
Where should we start?
_4166.Objective: Move to <Wind Valley> and use a camera on Jeri Kato
_4166.CompletionSummary: So this place is Wind Valley!

_4167.Title: Jeri Kato's Request
_4167.Summary: [Daily]Shall We Go to a Cold Place?
_4167.Description:
It's so cool. There's a place like this in Digital World
Leomon, Where should we go next?
_4167.Objective: Move to <Distorted Data Village> and use a camera on Leomon
_4167.CompletionText: Let's go to the next region~!
_4167.CompletionSummary: It's a nice landscape but quite cold….

_4168.Title: Jeri Kato's Request
_4168.Description:
Well…. It's a beautiful place covered with snow.
But if we stay too long, Jeri might catch a cold. Let's go to the next region.
_4168.Objective: Move to <Yokohama Village: East> and use a camera on Jeri Kato and Leomon
_4168.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use a camera on Jeri Kato%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Use a camera on Leomon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4168.CompletionSummary: Such a quiet village. It's like time has stopped.

_4169.Title: Jeri Kato's Request
_4169.Description: Okay, let's go back. I'm sorry for the trouble Tamer I had a lot of fun thanks to you!
_4169.Objective: Move to <DATS Center> and talk to Leomon
_4169.CompletionSummary: I'm sorry to have put you through all this for us. And thank you, Tamer. Thanks to you, I was able to give Jeri a good memory.

_4170.Title: Jumping Follow-up Support
_4170.Description: I'll appoint you as a temporary support staff to get jumping support I'll give you a coupon to exchange supplies if you finish the corresponding work~
_4170.CompletionText: Talk to me when you're ready
_4170.CompletionSummary: Good. You said you are ready, let's move on right away~!

_4171.Title: Jumping Follow-up Support
_4171.Description: There are Digimons who stole accessory supplies We have to defeat them and get back those supplies They're upset about accessory supplies are not for them...
_4171.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimons in Ice Area and get back supplies
_4171.CompletionText: You need to hurry. You can't find it if you use it early~!
_4171.CompletionSummary: Good, that's the supplies we've lost The exchange staff will arrang and exchange supplies thet you've collected when the staff is ready~!

_4172.Title: Jumping Follow-up Support
_4172.Description: Hmm you're going to help us not only for accessory supplies but also for reinforcement supplies?? Well..... Okay~! I'll raise your authority. Instead, there will be more work to do!
_4172.CompletionText: Talk to me when you're ready~
_4172.CompletionSummary: From now on, you'll have more work as a support staff!

_4173.Title: Jumping Follow-up Support
_4173.Description: I think there are a few Digimons who stole the reinforcement supplies from the headquarters By my investigation, they are hiding in the arena I need you to go find them, defeat them, and get back the supplies
_4173.CompletionSummary: Thanks Tamer. Once it's organized, you'll be able to exchange coupons for the supply you want~!

_4174.Title: Jumping Follow-up Support
_4174.Description: I think it would be nice to raise the authority of the support staff.... I'll talk to the captain~! Talk to me again later!
_4174.CompletionSummary: Congratulations, Tamer~! But... The captain would like to see you... Be careful....

_4175.Title: Jumping Follow-up Support
_4175.Description: It's not like some Digimons stole it this time because the captain is in charge.... The captain wants to test you out... Go talk to him
_4175.Objective: Defeat <Support Captain>BanchoLeomon in File Island area
_4175.CompletionText: The support captain will be somewhere on File Island
_4175.CompletionSummary: Oh~! You're even acknowledged by the captain?! That's amazing?!

_4176.Title: Treasure Thief
_4176.Description: Some Digimon stole my precious treasure... I need you to teach that Digimon a lesson
_4176.Objective: Defeat Impmon for stealing Terriermon's treasure
_4176.CompletionText: I heard it appears in Shinjuku!!!

_4177.Title: Spring Festival that Couldn't go to
_4177.Description: I'm upset.... I couldn't participate in this spring festival.... I should enjoy looking at the fallen cherry blossom petals....
_4177.Objective: Collect cherry blossom petals by defeating enemy Digimons except Yokohama
_4177.CompletionSummary: Thank you~ I'll definitely participate in the next spring festival!

_4178.Title: Create a Vaccine
_4178.Description: Hey Tamer!! If you are not busy, would you help me?
_4178.CompletionText: Talk to me again when you're ready
_4178.CompletionSummary: Thank you~! I feel reassured because you said you'd help me

_4179.Title: Create a Vaccine
_4179.Description: The resistance of the captured Keramon is too strong I need you to calm Keramon down by the force!
_4179.Objective: Go to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and defeat <Virus>Keramon
_4179.CompletionText: Use the item in Underground Summon Square
_4179.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, it will be much easier for me to research

_4180.Title: Cleaning Mission
_4180.Description: Ha.... Gerbemon is throwing garbages everywhere... It doesn't seem to end even if I clean up the garbage... Tamer~ Would you help me?
_4180.Objective: Defeat <Throwing Garbage>Gerbemon in File Island area
_4180.CompletionText: I'm counting on you to defeat Gerbemon so we don't get any more garbages
_4180.CompletionSummary: Thank you~! At least there will be less garbage

_4181.Title: Good Day to Plant Trees
_4181.Description:
My duty is to protect the forest and keep it healthy. That's why I'm going to plant trees today.
Petaldramon is also trying to plant various trees.
If you help me, I'll give you a seed it can repay you. How's that sound?
_4181.CompletionSummary:
That's a good idea.
Bring the tree Data accoring to the mission from this box to me

_4182.Title: Mission: Pine
_4182.Description:
You've got the pine mission!
Then bring me the pine Data. I'll turn the data into seeds.
The pine Data is distributed at Silver Lake.
_4182.Objective: Collect [Pine Data] by defeating enemy Digimons in Silver Lake
_4182.CompletionText: A lot of tree Data is found in Silver Lake
_4182.CompletionSummary: You brought the Data. I'll make you a seed in no time.

_4183.Title: Mission: Wisteria
_4183.Description:
You've got the wisteria mission!
Then bring me the wisteria Data. I'll turn the data into seeds.
The wisteria Data is distributed at Silent Forest.
_4183.Objective: Collect [Wisteria Data] by defeating enemy Digimons in Silent Forest
_4183.CompletionText: A lot of tree Data is found in Silent Forest
_4183.CompletionSummary: You brought the Data. I'll make you a seed in no time.

_4184.Title: Mission: Oak
_4184.Description:
You've got the oak mission!
Then bring me the oak Data. I'll turn the data into seeds.
The oak Data is distributed at Lost Historic Site.
_4184.Objective: Collect [Oak Data] by defeating enemy Digimons in Lost Historic Site
_4184.CompletionText: A lot of tree Data is found in Lost Historic Site
_4184.CompletionSummary: You brought the Data. I'll make you a seed in no time.

_4185.Title: Mission: Silver Vine
_4185.Description:
You've got the silver vine mission!
Then bring me the silver vine Data. I'll turn the data into seeds.
The silver vine Data is distributed at File Island Waterfront.
_4185.Objective: Collect [Silver Vine Data] by defeating enemy Digimons in File Island Waterfront
_4185.CompletionText: A lot of tree Data is found in File Island Waterfront
_4185.CompletionSummary: You brought the Data. I'll make you a seed in no time.

_4186.Title: Plant Trees in Different Regions
_4186.Summary: [Daily] Tree to Plant in the Forest
_4186.Description:
What do you think, Tamer. The wonderful forest on my back? I'm trying to take care of it everyday.
But I want to plant rare species and make it stand out even more...
I'll pay you back if you bring me rare seeds that I don't have. What do you think?
_4186.Objective: Collect [Mysterious Rare Seed] by defeating enemy Digimons except in Yokohama Village
_4186.CompletionText: I'm excited by thinking of planting new seeds.
_4186.CompletionSummary:
There are a lot of seeds I've never seen before. Thank you very much.
I'll hand out some rare seeds I've analyzed.
Petaldramon would be happy to exchange it for something good.

_4187.Title: Plant Flowers too
_4187.Description:
It's good to plant a lot of trees, but I think the forest looks more attractive when there are flowers....
But these days, there are mean Digimons who are plucking those flowers....
Would you bring back flowers that mean Digimons have plucked....?
If you help me, I'll give you beautiful flowers....
_4187.Objective: Collect [Small Flower] by defeating enemy Digimons in File Island region
_4187.CompletionText: If you pluck flowers, my heart breaks too…
_4187.CompletionSummary:
Flowers are fine… That's a relief…
I'll give you this flower in return…
Thank you…

_4188.Title: Plant Flowers too 2
_4188.Description:
It's good to plant a lot of trees, but I think the forest looks more attractive when there are flowers....
But these days, there are mean Digimons who are plucking those flowers....
Would you bring back flowers that mean Digimons have plucked....?
If you help me, I'll give you beautiful flowers....
_4188.Objective: Collect [Large Flower] by defeating enemy Digimons in Shinjuku region
_4188.CompletionText: If you pluck flowers, my heart breaks too…
_4188.CompletionSummary:
Flowers are fine… That's a relief…
I'll give you this flower in return…
Thank you…

_4189.Title: Violent Digimon
_4189.Description:
Colleting eggs were my hobby.
A Digimon, who appeared recently, hit me out of the blue
Since then, I've been afraid to collect eggs.
Would you get rid of that bad Digimon for me?
_4189.Objective: Defeat Chimairamon in Silver Lake, Silent Forest, and Lost Historic Site
_4189.CompletionText: You want me to follow? You're strong but I'm not… I'm scared…,
_4189.CompletionSummary: Take that bad Digimon! Now I can freely collect eggs!

_4190.Title: Eradicating bugs - Mountain
_4190.Description: The beautiful mountain is occupied by violent bugs. Would you help me to get rid of bugs in the mountain?
_4190.CompletionSummary: Thank you for the decision. You can use this ticket to move to the mountain.

_4191.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Center]
_4191.Description:
Hmm... You're an interesting person...
getting trained by my teacher, Gankoomon, to become stronger.
Who am I? If you get trained by Gankoomonn, It's Huckmon, who will be your brother!
If my teacher will train you, I'll give you a special gift!
_4191.CompletionText: Hmm… Will you be able to withstand the teacher's training?
_4191.CompletionSummary:
Wow! You must be determined! Seeing that You're getting trained from the teacher who is known to be given out tough trainings!
Good! I'll give you a present! If you endure the teacher's training until the end, My gift will definitely help you!
I will be watching you from the side to see if you receive the teacher's training well.

_4192.Title: Eradicating Bugs - Huge
_4192.Description:
Because of the violent bugs, I ran out of the Silent Forest~ I can't handle it because they are too strong~
Would you kick them out instead of me~? In addition to the quiet forest, I think it appears often on Infinite Ice Wall and Digimon Farm~
_4192.Objective: Defeat <Pest> Okuwamon from the Silent Forest, Infinite Ice Wall, and Digimon Farm
_4192.CompletionText: I want to take a nap in a quiet place~
_4192.CompletionSummary: I can go back to the Silent Forest~

_4193.Title: Eradicating Bugs - Forest
_4193.Description:
Sizzling, It's so annoying! It's annoying to see disgusting things here and there!
Hey! You don't like disgusting things, too right? Please help me for the hygiene
What are we going to do? Pest control….!
_4193.Objective: Defeat 10 Kunemonand and FanBeemon each in the Verdandi Terminal
_4193.CompletionText: Just looking at them makes my body itchy.

_4194.Title: Eradicating Bugs - Forest
_4194.Description:
It keeps coming out, so I'll have to use another way. You know the pesticide I just gave you?
There must be a habitat for bugs in the place marked here. Use this for those bugs.
The problem will be solve when the bugs that took the pesticide return to the herd.
_4194.Objective: Use the pesticied that Impmon gave it to <Pest>Kunemon in the Silent Forest
_4194.CompletionSummary: I hope it calms down a bit….

_4195.Title: Eradicating Bugs - Underground
_4195.Description: I had something to do, so I went down to the underground… Um… Don't ask me. It's creeping me out.
_4195.CompletionSummary: What did I see? Don't ask me more!

_4196.Title: Eradicating Bugs - Underground
_4196.Description:
You have a lot of curiosity. If you're really curious, you know the sweet honey I just have you?
Go to the D-Terminal and use it. It'll come out by a sweet smell.
_4196.Objective: Go to the D-Terminal Summon Square, use the sweet honey, and defeat the summoned Digimon.
_4196.CompletionSummary: You're very courageous, aren't you? Is it okay to go back to the underground?

_4197.Title: Warning from the Lord of Greed.
_4197.Description:
I am Dunasmon, memer of Royal Knights.
Now, I'm tracing the Lord of Greed after I received the damage report about his deed.
Would you help me to stop further damage?
_4197.CompletionText: Balbamon…As long as we stand against you, you will never get what you want.
_4197.CompletionSummary: I appreciate for your resolution. Take this.

_4198.Title: Warning from the Lord of Greed.
_4198.Description:
I gave you "the shard of Greed". It contains the part of Balbamon's power.
Once you experience that power, you can also feel his energe. I'm tracing him by sensing his power.
Tamer…Use the shard and feel his power.
_4198.Objective: Use <Shard of Greed> to defeat the summoned digimon at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.
_4198.CompletionText: Balbamon…As long as we stand against you, you will never get what you want.
_4198.CompletionSummary:
Now you can feel the energe of greed? I ask you to inform me if you find him.
Very well then. I'll keep tracing him. So long.

_4199.Title: Preperation for Blooming flower
_4199.Description:
Now, the season of cold is gone. And the warmth is turning back.
It's time to blooming flower. Would you help me?
But tricky part is flame digimons appearing at Silver Lake. They made my collegues difficult to bloom flowers.
Would you drive them out for us?
_4199.Objective: Defeat the digimon that appears in Silver Lake.
_4199.CompletionSummary: Oh, I really appreciate you. Now we can safely bloom the flowers.

_4200.Title: Preperation for Blooming flowers
_4200.Description:
Now, no more threat from Flame digimons. But if you don't mind, would you help us again?
Because of gloomy weather in these days, flowers couldn't get enough sunshine. And the worse thing is evil digimons took our energy away.
Pelase, would you take back what we lost?
_4200.Objective: Collecet [Sunshine] from digimons in all maps except Yokohama Village.
_4200.CompletionText: Is it possible to bloom the flowers safely?
_4200.CompletionSummary: You took the energy back! Thank you!

_4201.Title: [Masters Match]
_4201.Description:
Masters Match Mission : R-3 is a mission to defeat the digimon calling himself "Great Lord".
If you come back after defeating KingEthemon, I will pay you a reward.
He will appear at Lost Historic Site and File Island Waterfront.
_4201.Objective:
Defeat <Masters Match>KingEthemon that appears in Lost Historic Site and File Island Waterfront.
KingEthemon Spawn : 1H
_4201.CompletionSummary: You defeated the KingEtemon? Well done, indeed. Take this.

_4202.Title: [Masters Match]
_4202.Description:
Masters Match Mission : R-2 is a mission to defeat a powerful enemy.
If you come back after defeating GranKuwagamon, I will pay you a reward.
He will appear at Silver Lake and A Silent Forest.
_4202.Objective:
Defeat <Masters Match>GranKuwagamon that appears in Silver Lake and A Silent Forest.
GranKuwagamon Spawn : 1H
_4202.CompletionSummary: You defeated the GranKuwagamon? Well done, indeed. Take this.

_4203.Title: [Masters Match]
_4203.Description:
Masters Match Mission : R-1 is a mission for dangerous area activities.
An object called [R: Certificate of Activity] has been distributed to the evil digimon appearing near the wilderness hills of Verdandi Terminal and in the desert area.
If you collect [R: Certificate of Activity] from them, we will pay you the appropriate reward.
_4203.Objective: Defeat evil digimon appearing near the wilderness hills of Verdandi Terminal and collect [R: Certificate of Activity] 50ea.
_4203.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect [R: Certificate of Activity]%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Get Masters Match Mission : R-1%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4204.Title: [Masters Match]
_4204.Description:
Masters Match Mission : F is a mission for basic activities.
To most evil digimon, an object called "F: Certificate of Activity" was distributed.
If you collect [Master's Match: F] from them, we will pay you the appropriate reward.
_4204.Objective: Collecet [F: Certificate of Activity] 50ea from evil digimons in all maps except Yokohama Village.
_4204.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect [F: Certificate of Activity]%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Get Masters Match Mission : F%qe %cc2/%mc2
