_4205.Title: It appears! Black Tiger!
_4205.Description:
(Tamer! It is said that white tiger, that had been tested by Akihiro Kurata, was eventually corrupted by dark energy and became a black tiger and is appearing everywhere.)
(In order to calm the black tiger, we need the power to purify him.)
(Please get the ingredients we need.)
(Defeat evil digiomons to get [Data of Purification] 40ea at Shinjuku East area(Day), Shinjuku Western area(Day), Shinjuku East area(Night), Shinjuku Western area(Night).)
_4205.Objective: Defeat evil digiomons to get [Data of Purification] 40ea at Shinjuku East(Day), Shinjuku Western(Day), Shinjuku East(Night), Shinjuku Western(Night).
_4205.CompletionSummary: (Thank you. We can't turn back the already changed white tiger, but we will be able to purify the energy of darkness.)

_4206.Title: It is just my afterimage
_4206.Description:
Tamer! Where are you looking at? I'm here!
You're surprised, right? That's an illusion I made.
My body got so cold that I try to let out the heat, a mirage like that appeared. ......
Yes! I have a funny idea! Why don't you look for me?
_4206.CompletionSummary: You catch me easily. Thank you for hanging out with me. This is a gift from me!

_4207.Title: Wizardmon failed at magic
_4207.Description:
Tamer, help me! I used a magic of miniaturizing to Mammothmon….
But I failed to cast and the Mammothmon became huge….
Please let the Mammothmon calm down! As time goes by, the magic will unravel. Until then, please.
_4207.Objective: Defeat <Mad>Mammothmon at Snowman Village, Snowstorm Village.
_4207.CompletionSummary: You have defeated Mammothmon! Thank you! The magic will unravel over time.

_4208.Title: Akihiro Kurata who aims for the new year's energy
_4208.Description:
Hmm? What's wrong? Baihumon's data is exploding!
Hey! What are you doing now? Go to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and stop The Mad Baihumon by using 'The Mad Baihumon's Data', right now!
_4208.Objective: Use 'The Mad Baihumon's Data' to defeat the summoned digimon.
_4208.CompletionSummary:
That's a relief. Good job. Energy of steel has been changed to the energy of the black tiger. It's no longer useful for experiment, so you take it and deal with it.
How do I take care of it? It's up to you!

_4209.Title: Akihiro Kurata who aims for the new year's energy
_4209.Description:
The new data will be completed. More powerful digimon…
Huh? Just in time. Bring me 'Energy of steel', you can get from Server Continent, right now.
You said why? Because it's necessary for the experiment. Even if I explain more, you don't understand.
Now, move.
_4209.Objective: Collect Energy of steel (50ea) that digimons drop in Server Continent.
_4209.CompletionText: Energy of steel can be obtained from digimon in Server Continent.
_4209.CompletionSummary: This is the energy of steel… It's definitely as I thought it'd be.

_4210.Title: The Sunrise of The Digital World!
_4210.Description:
I heard that in real world they set goals by looking at the rising sun in the new year!
So I also wanna make new year's resolutions, but NeoDevimon keeps disturbing me.
Can you kick him out of here?
_4210.Objective: Defeat NeoDevimon appearing in Western Village.
_4210.CompletionSummary: Thank you for chasing the bad guy! I will make a new plan while looking at the rising sun!

_4211.Title: This Year's Star is me!
_4211.Description:
'What are you doing here, Baihumon?' Nope! In this time, I'm not white tiger, but black tiger!
I heard that this year is the year of the black tiger. So, this year is the time for me!
There is someone that claims to be a tiger, but he is actually not.
He is BanchouLeomon! If you punish him, I'll pay you back.
_4211.Objective: Defeat BanchouLeomon appearing in Oil refinery.
_4211.CompletionSummary: Great job, Tamer! He can't impersonate me anymore!

_4212.Title: Wizardmon's Card Game
_4212.Description:
Do you wanna play cards? I'm sorry, now we can't.
Some digimons that like to joke around stole my cards. If you find the cards for them, we can play cards.
_4212.Objective: Defeat Meicoomon and Impmon appearing in Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront.
_4212.CompletionText: Meicoomon and Impmon stole my cards. They ran away to Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront.
_4212.CompletionSummary: Thank you for finding my cards. Then, let's play cards!

_4213.Title: Pouring Fuel on the Fire
_4213.Description: Kukuku… What's so funny, you ask? Well, you could totally play both sides in this conflict, between Team Rice Cake Soup and Team Wonton Soup. Join one team, do their biddings, only to join the other team secretly to do their biddings, sabotaging both of them… Hehehe so much fun! What, you wanna try as well?
_4213.CompletionSummary: It's so fun! In case you got some rice cake or wonton you don't need, bring them to me. Of course, I'll give you something good in exchange as well. Why do I need them? Kukuku I've got another plan on my mind!

_4214.Title: Will I Become Dilligent?
_4214.Summary: [Daily] Next Year, I'll Be Dilligent No Matter What!
_4214.Description: Starting next year, I'll be dilligent no matter what! My laziness stops at the end of this year. I'm confident I can change! You don't trust me? Why don't you go and get the paper with my new year resolution written on? You'll be convinced too!
_4214.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at all areas except Yokohama Vilalge to obtain New Year Resolution 30ea
_4214.CompletionSummary: How is it? You believe me now? I shall stay strong on my resolutions! So you can have that.

_4215.Title: Customizing Rice Cake Soup!
_4215.Description: Team Rice Cake Soup, Team Wonton Soup, whatever… What's the point of fighting over them? I'll cook and eat whatever I want! But recently, I noticed that some food ingredients are missing from my warehouse! I've been seeing Gotsumon and Pumpkinmon at Infinite Mountain a lot... They are suspicious! Help me out with those guys, and I'll help you make tasty rice cake soup!
_4215.CompletionSummary: You are here! Thanks! This is a token of my gratitude. If you ever want to customize your rice cake soup, come find me!

_4216.Title: Team Rice Cake Soup VS Team Wonton Soup
_4216.Summary: [Daily] Tastes Better with Wonton, Of Course!
_4216.Description: Whose idea was it that we have to eat rice cake soup for the new year? So old-fashioned. Hey you there! Judging by your look, you prefer wonton soup too, right? In that case, help me beat up those guys from Rice Cake Team at Western Area : West.
_4216.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Western Area : West to obtain Mark of Team Rice Cake Soup 20ea
_4216.CompletionSummary: Impressive. You did well! This is my gift for you.

_4217.Title: Team Rice Cake Soup VS Team Wonton Soup
_4217.Summary: [Daily] Tastes Better with Rice Cake, Of Course!
_4217.Description: Of course you have to eat the rice cake soup for the new year! What do you mean wonton soup? That's nonsense. You there, Tamer! You agree that rice cake soup is the way, right? Well, help me out then. Go and beat up those guys from Team Wonton Soup at Western Area : East.
_4217.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Western Area : East to obtain Mark of Team Wonton Soup 20ea
_4217.CompletionSummary: Such speed! I could rely on you next time too! Here, take it.

_4218.Title: My Fortune Next Year?
_4218.Description: You would like me to know about your fortune next year, huh! You've come to the right place. Let's see… hmm… Wait! I'm out of ingredients? No need to say more. Defeat Rockmon at Digimon Maze Entrance, Western Area : East, or Server Continent Desert to get Hard Rock 20ea, and defeat RedVegiemon at Western Area : Outskirts, or Lost Historic Site to get Red Liquid 20ea. Bring them all to me, and I'll tell you your fortune!
_4218.Objective: Defeat Rockmon to obtain Solid Stone 20ea, and defeat RedVegiemon to obtain Red Liquid 20ea
_4218.CompletionSummary: Ohh, yes yes. Bring them in. Take this. It will tell you your fortune.

_4219.Title: Christmas Hooligan
_4219.Description: I thought I could spend Christmas peacefully with my love… But guess what?! That Meramon is going berserk so I can't even step outside! Is there a solution to this? That's it! You could make him stand down! Help me out here, Tamer.
_4219.Objective: Defeat <Shivering>Meramon at Silver Lake, and File Isalnd Waterfront
_4219.CompletionSummary: What? You actually beat him? I… I knew you could do it!

_4220.Title: Merry Christmas!
_4220.Description: Have you, by any chance, seen some Christmas Cards on the ground? No? Hmm… I see. Ah! Now that I think about it, seems like I dropped the cards somewhere snowy. Would you help me get them back? I'm really busy right now giving out presents hohoho!
_4220.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Glacier Area to collect Christmas Card 20ea
_4220.CompletionText: If my guess is correct, the Digimons at Glacier Area would have picked them up!
_4220.CompletionSummary: Ohh, I knew you could find them. It's the exact number that I dropped! Thank you very much.

_4221.Title: Merry Christmas!
_4221.Description: Um… Hey Tamer! You just helped out Mr Claus, right? Recently, IceDevimon and MetalEtemon have been causing trouble at Snowman Village with all their snowball fights. They are causing delays in our attempts to give out presents… Could you help us out?
_4221.Objective: Defeat IceDevimon and MetalEtemon to collect Snowball 15ea
_4221.CompletionText: Remember! It's IceDevimon and MetalEtemon with Snowball that's causing this problem!
_4221.CompletionSummary: Wow! Thanks! Now we can give out presents with nobody bothering us!

_4222.Title: Merry Christmas!
_4222.Description: This is is not good… Naughty Digimon, ToyAgumon and WaruMonzaemon are loitering around our warehouse, plotting to steal the presents. If you have the time, would you please go and teach them a lesson, that stealing is bad?
_4222.CompletionSummary: I knew I could count on you! Please, take care of this matter.

_4223.Title: Holiday Sheriff!
_4223.Description:
We are short-handed for this holiday season… What? You want to help?
Well then, head over to the Western Area, and patrol the Ruined Historic please.
_4223.Objective: Move to Ruined Historic and defeat the evil Digimon to obtain the quest item
_4223.CompletionSummary: How was it? Any problem at the West?

_4224.Title: Holiday Sheriff!
_4224.Description:
Next up is Glacier Area. It will be really cold so you better bundle up.
You ready? Head over to Distorted Data Village and patrol the area please.
_4224.Objective: Move to Distorted Data Village and defeat the evil Digimon to obtain the quest item
_4224.CompletionText: Take care of Distorted Data Village.
_4224.CompletionSummary: Cold huh? Any problem at the Glacier Area?

_4225.Title: Holiday Sheriff!
_4225.Description:
Last stop is File Island. There are some tough Digimons there, could be quite dangerous. Make sure to bring your gears for it.
You ready? Head over to Lost Historic Site for the final patrol.
_4225.Objective: Move to Lost Historic Site and defeat the evil Digimon to obtain the quest item
_4225.CompletionText: Take care of Lost Historic Site.
_4225.CompletionSummary: Are you injured? You've done well! That's all for patrolling today. If there is a chance, I might ask you for your help again next year! Happy holidays!

_4226.Title: To Have Warm Holiday Season 1
_4226.Description:
Ahh choo! Holiday season sure is nice but it's too cold! The air is freezing and the wind blows strong!
Hey! You! Good that you're here! I, the great Etemon, will give you my concert ticket, so bring some tinder to start a fire!
DemiMeramon at Ruined Historic, Birdramon at Digimon Maze Entrance, and Agnimon at Verdandi Terminal.
These guys will have the tinder! Any of them will do so go wherever you please!
_4226.Objective: Defeat DemiMeramon at Ruined Historic, Birdramon at Digimon Maze Entrance, Agnimon at Verdandi Terminal to obtain Warm Tinder
_4226.CompletionSummary:
Whoo.. Starting a fire, eh? You are pretty resourceful, after all!
Here is the concert ticket I promised!
… Hey! Where are you going?!

_4227.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4227.Description: Hello~ Culu! Great. Great power, and great size, it's a great Digimon culu! Examon is already strong but can become even stronger culu! Examon seems to have contacted us culu! Go to Anubismon at D-Terminal culu!
_4227.CompletionText: Go find Anubismon now culu! Looks like it's urgent culu!
_4227.CompletionSummary: You are here. Examon of Royal Knights, and the Tamer.

_4228.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4228.Description: I know it might be sudden but let me explain the situation first. Dark Ocean, in other words, Shadow Labyrinth connected to the Dark Area, is exhibiting signs of problem.
_4228.CompletionText: Something is off with the Digimons at the Labyrinth; some kind of evil omen. I know we are always receiving your help but it seems like this is something out of our hands.
_4228.CompletionSummary: Hence, we would like to ask you, a powerful Digimon and the Tamer, to help us check on this situation.

_4229.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4229.Description: As I mentioned earlier, the Digimons at the Labyrinth are exhibiting something evil. Please collect Symbol of Calamity from the Digimons in Labyrinith (Hard).
_4229.CompletionText: Please collect Symbol of Calamity from the Digimons at Shadow Labyrinth (Hard).
_4229.CompletionSummary: You have collected the Symbol of Calamity. Such an evil, ominous symbol…

_4230.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4230.Description: If you bring me enough Symbol of Calamity, I will make a box to contain them as Omen of Calamity. Omen of Calamity is evil but it fades easily so please take note when acquiring it.
_4230.CompletionText: Please collect Omen of Calamity from the boxes.
_4230.CompletionSummary: You have collected all the Omen of Calamity. Thank you. Investigation is complete so I shall return this to you.

_4231.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4231.Description: Omen of Calamity continue to be found from the Digimons at the Labyrinth but they do not seem to be the source of the it.
_4231.CompletionText: The root of it must be the Dark Ocean that the Labyrinth is containing.
_4231.CompletionSummary: Dark Ocean is a dangerous place to investigate. It is worrisome indeed.

_4232.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4232.Description: You and Examon are full of fighting spirit. Understood. I know we do not have much time but a test is deemed necessary. Defeat DexDorugreymon that are taking whatever DigiCore that come their way at Versandi Terminal, and defeat DexDorugraymon of evil omen to bring back the Spirit of Awakening and Fighting.
_4232.CompletionText: I have faith in you, and Examon!
_4232.CompletionSummary: This is Spirit of Awakening and Fighting. I can sense a great strength from it. Take it.

_4233.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4233.Description: Your Examon possesses great strength. I would like to trust in that strength but I still worry. Battle powerful enemies, collect Data of Awakening and Fighting from them and hand them over to me, and I will help you face the evil forces of Dark Ocean.
_4233.CompletionText: I believe it. Examon's fighting spirit of potential!
_4233.CompletionSummary: You have them all! Excellent. I return this to you. You will need it for sure.

_4234.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4234.Description: Now, you the Tamer, and Examon have proven your great strength. I can testify it. Find Phoenixmon at Digimon Maze F4, who started investigating Dark Ocean ahead of you.
_4234.CompletionText: You are here. The powerful Tamer and the dragon emperor.
_4234.CompletionSummary: Thank you for coming. And I ask for your help.

_4235.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4235.Description: Just the two of you heading over to Dark Area now is a suicide. I have suffered a severe injury so I cannot move from here… Take this opener from me. It can open the gate to Dark Area for a moment. Use that item, and take down the Digimon from Dark Area, one by one. They are powerful, of course... Be careful.
_4235.CompletionSummary: Here it is. It will be safe to use it at the underground summon squre.

_4236.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4236.Description: Evil Digimon from Dark Area are trying to invade not only the Digital World, but also the Real World. I tried my best but I could not stop them with my power. I apologize. I beg of you, please defeat the evil forces, and figure out the cause of this strange phenomenon!
_4236.CompletionSummary: You did it. And this is…!

_4237.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4237.Description: So that was it. The one behind this strange phenomenon was Lilithmon, one of the Seven Great Demon Lords. She is hailed as the goddess of darkness; an evil Digimon indeed. I will accompany you to where Lilithmon is located. Steel your resolve and nerve, Tamer.
_4237.CompletionSummary: This is the final battle. I have faith in you, Tamer.

_4238.Title: Jogress [Examon X]
_4238.Description: Defeat Lilithmon, and restore peace to the Digital World and the Real World!
_4238.CompletionText: Resolve, fighting spirit, as well as your inner strength. I believe you two, Tamer and dragon emperor.
_4238.CompletionSummary: You did it! Wonderful. Great evil was vanquished by you two. Thank you.

_4239.Title: Myotismon's Walk
_4239.Description:
[YIKES!]Who is it? Don't scare me!
Why am I so surprised? My master, Myotismon, he just woke up.
He always uses violence when he's awake. This is why I ran away from him.
Can you punish that bad guy?
Myotismon appears in Silver Lake, File Island Waterfront, and Venom vamdemon appers in A Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site.
_4239.Objective: Defeat Myotismon in Silver Lake, File Island Waterfront and Venom vamdemon in A Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site.
_4239.CompletionText: Myotismon appears in Silver Lake, File Island Waterfront, and Venom vamdemon appers in A Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site.
_4239.CompletionSummary: You are so great! I'm free now!

_4240.Title: Demon of the Deep Sea
_4240.Description:
Sob sob that jerk! Where am I supposed to live now…
Why am I crying? MarineDevimon suddenly showed up and chased me out of where I was living: the deep sea.
It took me a lot of effort to find that place and I lost it so easily sob sob… You'd help me? Are you strong?
_4240.Objective: Defeat <Dirty Fighter>MarineDevimon at Snowstorm Village and Snowman Village
_4240.CompletionText: I feel like my body is shrinking since I'm out of the water.
_4240.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much for chasing that jerk away! This isn't much but it's a token of my gratitude.

_4241.Title: No Prank Calling
_4241.Description:
(It's a telephone installed by DATS Center for missions.) (Recently, this telephone has been getting prank calls.)
(Fed up with the calls, Commander Sampson declared that the calls interfere with our missions, and as such, ordered punishment of Digimons who are behind the prank calls.)
(The list here shows that the culprits are: Impmon, Candlemon, Digmon, and Woodmon)
_4241.Objective: Defeat <Prank Caller>Impmon, Candlemon, Digmon, and Woodmon at Western Area
_4241.CompletionText: The telephone is not ringing yet.
_4241.CompletionSummary: (We taught them a lesson so they won't be pulling any prank calls again.)

_4242.Title: No Prank Calling
_4242.Description:
(We thought for sure that there won't be any more prank calls after what happened. However, prank calls did not stop and the noise was getting increasingly intolerable.)
(Exasperated Commander Sampson traced the pranks calls, and figured out that they were coming from Glacier Area.)
(Let's head over to Glacier Area and "educate" them with our warm hearts.)
_4242.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Glacier Area and obtain Letter of Reflection
_4242.CompletionText: The telephone is not ringing yet.
_4242.CompletionSummary: We even made them write letter of reflection so they won't be pulling any pranks again.

_4243.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4243.Description: Thank you for attending 10th birthday party of Digimon Masters Online!
_4243.CompletionText: Thank you for attending 10th birthday party of Digimon Masters Online!
_4243.CompletionSummary: Thank you for celebrating 10th birthday of Digimon Masters Online!

_4244.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4244.Description: Please prepare the ingredient to be used in making of the cake, that will be shared amongst everyone.
_4244.Objective: Obtain Egg, Flour, and Sugar for Cake, 20ea each in all regions except Yokohama Village
_4244.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Obtain Egg for Cake%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Obtain Flour for Cake%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Obtain Sugar for Cake%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4244.CompletionText: Gather Egg, Flour, and Sugar for Cake from all regions except Yokohama Village
_4244.CompletionSummary: The ingredient looks really fresh. The cake will be completed soon.

_4245.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4245.Description:
It's already been 10 years since we began our adventure! There were hardships and sad times as well but we got over them. I'd like to continue to be with you, from here and onwards!
To commemorate that, I'll give you a 10th Year Anniversary Seal. You can participate in various events to get more of them.
Remaining seals can be exchanged for cake slices so take note!
_4245.CompletionSummary: This is a very meaningful day. I'll always appreciate you!

_4246.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4246.Description:
Momantai~ Fireworks are a must for a celebration!
Are you interested in them too by any chance? Well, it's a good day today so I shall share some with you as well!
_4246.CompletionText: Boom boom boom, even brighter than the…
_4246.CompletionSummary:
Fireworks are bundled up according to their types! Just in case you aren't sure, it's free the first time only.
What if you want more?
Hmm… Do me a favor or bring me some material for exchange.

_4247.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4247.Description:
Just in time! You need some fireworks, right? Do me a little favor and I will give you a bundle of them.
Some Giromon popped up in Western Village and Western Area: West.
Problem is, they did something to the gunpowder inside the fireworks, causing them to not explode.
I will stay here to identify which ones do not explode. You go and teach them a lesson!
_4247.Objective: Defeat <Unexploded>Giromon at Western Village and Wetern Area: West
_4247.CompletionText: Ha… This one is not working… that one too…
_4247.CompletionSummary:
Thanks for your work!
But those guys might come back for more mischief so please come back again tomorrow.
This is the fireworks bundle I promised!

_4248.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4248.Description:
The party vibe is so energetic, and lively.
Hm? Do you have something to say to me?
I came here today as a clown, for the celebration.
…. I am not kidding.
_4248.CompletionSummary: A clown is not supposed to cause conflict. It is a good day today so why don't you just believe me?

_4249.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4249.Description:
How many times do I have to say; I did not come here as a bad guy today, but as a clown.
I am not here to ruin the celebration.
You still don't believe me? In that case, find the paper with my sworn statement on it!
My minions at File Island Waterfront have it.
_4249.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at File Island Waterfront to obtain Oath Paper
_4249.CompletionText: I seriously do not have credit around here, huh.
_4249.CompletionSummary:
Do you believe me now? That is fine then. It is a celebration after all so you can have this.
Now that we cleared our misunderstanding, so let us go and enjoy ourselves.

_4250.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4250.Description:
Phew, such a mess. To have this many people disregarding the safety rules.
Hm?! Tamer over there! Since it's an emergency, your helping hand is needed!
MetalSeadramon and MugenDramon have appeared nearby and are wreaking havoc!
They are on the wanted list, but we lack the manpower to go after them now!
Could you please go and take care of this?
_4250.Objective: Defeat MetalSeadramon at Silver Lake and File Isalnd Waterfront, and MugenDramon at Silent Forest and Lost Historic Site
_4250.CompletionText: Heard MetalSeadramon was seen at Silver Lake and File Isalnd Waterfront, and MugenDramon at Silent Forest and Lost Historic Site.
_4250.CompletionSummary: Awesome! You got them nice and clean! Thanks to you, we can focus on maintaining the security here.

_4251.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4251.Description:
Did you just say I am here by myself? What nonsense! I have a lot of… friends….
No… You are actually right. I do have a group that I hang out with but we had some petty squabbles, so we are not talking now.
Make up with them? I do want that but will they really forgive me that easily?
You're gonna help? Well then, could you bring this to them on my behalf?
_4251.Objective: Use <Puppetmon's Present> on Puppetmon at Dark Tower Wasterland
_4251.CompletionText: My friends are at Dark Tower Wasteland.
_4251.CompletionSummary:
I guess true feelings do reach others. I just made up with my friends and enjoyed the celebration.
It's thanks to you. I'm really grateful to you.
This is a present to you from us Puppetmons. If you collect many of this and bring them to me, I am willing to exchange some good presents for them.

_4252.Title: 10th Year Anniversary Event
_4252.Description:
You must be that famous Tamer people have been talking about. Would you like to make your name known amongst the strongest beings?
Do you not want your name to reach further, and your fame higher?
If you have decided, come back and talk to me again.
_4252.CompletionText: I am looking forward to your answer.
_4252.CompletionSummary:
You have made up your mind. Take this item. It will allow you to summon the Royal Knights.
Of course, what you will summon are not their actual bodies, but their minds are connected nonetheless. In other words, they would be aware of you as you face them in battle.
If you bring me their insignia, which symbolizes their acknowledgement of you, I will give you appropriate reward in return.

_4253.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_4253.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_4253.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_4253.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_4254.Title: Call of God of Destruction
_4254.Description:
I have heard so much about you!
A human who displays great power together with a partner Digimon, huh?
My lord would like to meet you!
_4254.CompletionSummary:
Looks like you have decided!
Here! Take this card.
You will be able to meet my lord!

_4255.Title: Test of God of Destruction
_4255.Description:
Looks like you have determination!
Go on and meet my lord then.
I warn you though, don't expect a friendly banter.
Prepare yourself fully and go.
_4255.Objective: Use <Storm Calling Card> at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_4255.CompletionSummary:
You… You are as great as they say.
My lord has bestowed compliments on you.
And instructed me to deliver this to you.
If the fate wills it, won't we meet again?
Gya!

_4256.Title: Season of Harvest
_4256.Summary: [Daily] Would You Pick Some Persimmons for Me?
_4256.Description:
It's about time persimmons are ripe.
I heard Cherrymon with persimmons on their branches are appearing.
Could you get some persimmons for me?
_4256.Objective: Defeat <Persimmon Tree>Cherrymon in File Island regions
_4256.CompletionText: Persimmon after a long day of hard work is extraordinary indeed.
_4256.CompletionSummary:
Oooh you got them.
Let us eat together.

_4257.Title: Season of Harvest
_4257.Description:
Persimmons are still tasty if you ripen them even further, or dry them.
If you bring me some unripened persimmons, I will make them for you.
_4257.Objective: Defeat Woodmon, and Cherrymon at Silver Lake to obtain [Unripened Persimmon]
_4257.CompletionText: I will turn those unripened ones into something real good. You can look forward to them.
_4257.CompletionSummary:
You brought many.
Here, well-ripened persimmons, and dried ones too.
Enjoy.

_4258.Title: Season of Reading
_4258.Description:
Some pages are ripped off from the books that were returned!
Must be the act of mischievous Digimon.
Help me find the missing pages!
_4258.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Frozen Ground to obtain [Missing Page]
_4258.CompletionText: Too many things to tidy up…
_4258.CompletionSummary: Thank you for finding the missing pages!

_4259.Title: Season of Reading
_4259.Summary: [Daily] Bit by Bit, Page by Page
_4259.Description:
I have to reattach the ripped pages to the books…
I'm sorry but could you get me some [Adhesive Tape]?
_4259.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Versandi Terminal to obtain [Adhesive Tape]
_4259.CompletionSummary:
Thanks! I was able to fix the pages with the tape.
This is for helping me out.

_4260.Title: Season of Reading
_4260.Description:
These Digimons, who borrowed the books but not returning them, they are giving me a headache…
Would you please go and retrieve the books they borrowed?
_4260.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon in all regions except Yokohama Village to obtain [Borrowed Book]
_4260.CompletionText: Why don't they return what they borrowed?
_4260.CompletionSummary: Thanks for getting the books back!

_4261.Title: 데이터 복구 코드를 찾아라
_4261.Description: .....? (아무런 말이 없다. 소통이 가능하게 할 수 있는 방법이 없을까? 인스톨 프로그램과 <음료수>자판기에서 판매하는 메모리 칩을 가져와 보자.)
_4261.Objective: 접속유지 보상인 [인스톨 프로그램 : 언어]와 <음료수>자판기에서 판매하는 메모리 칩 5개를 수집

_4262.Title: 데이터 복구 코드를 찾아라
_4262.Description: .....? (시간이 지나면 간단한 대화는 가능 할 것 같다. 원활한 소통을 위해 스스로 생각하며 계산할 수 있는 프로그램을 구해다 주자.)
_4262.Objective: 은빛 호수에 등장하는 몬스터에게 [인스톨 프로그램 : 연산]을 획득

_4263.Title: 데이터 복구 코드를 찾아라
_4263.Description: .....? (디지몬의 제 성능을 발휘하게 하기 위해 스탯 프로그램을 인스톨해주자.)
_4263.Objective: 정유 공장 3에 등장하는 몬스터에게 [인스톨 프로그램 : 스탯]을 획득

_4264.Title: 운동을 하자! 헬스!(Hells)
_4264.Description:
거기 너! 몸매가 형편없군! 이번 기회에 나와 함께 노력의 땀을 흘리지 않겠나?
사양할 거 없어. 이리로 와
음... 음... 제일 기본적인 달리기부터 해볼까? 체력을 늘리기 좋은 방법이지.
자! 뒤틀린 데이터 마을로 가서 내 동료를 만나봐. 방해하는 몬스터 몇 마리 정도 처치하면 더 좋겠군!
중간에 힘들다고 걸어선 안돼! 내가 지켜보겠어.
_4264.Objective: 뒤틀린 데이터 마을로 이동하여 바이킹몬 3마리를 처치 후 <Hells>레오몬을 만난다.
_4264.CompletionText: 아직 출발 안 했나? 운동의 적은 게으름이야!
_4264.CompletionSummary: 하하하! 여기까지 오느라 수고 많았네! 많이 힘들지? 하지만 숨을 턱 끝까지 차오르게 해야 효과가 있는법!

_4265.Title: 운동을 하자! 헬스!(Hells)
_4265.Description:
하하하! 여기까지 오느라 수고 많았네. 많이 힘들지?
하지만 숨을 턱 끝까지 차오르게 해야 효과가 있지!
쉴 틈이 없어, 이제 정유공장 2로 달려가서 내 동료를 만나봐.
방해하는 몬스터 몇 마리 정도 처치하면 더 좋겠군.
_4265.Objective: 정유공장 2로 이동하여 가드로몬 3마리를 처치 후 <땀흘리는>레오몬을 만난다.
_4265.CompletionText: 아직 출발 안 했나? 운동의 적은 게으름이야.
_4265.CompletionSummary:
후우...후우... 이런 운동을 하느라 온 줄 몰랐군 실례했네.
자네도 엄청나게 땀을 흘리고 있군.

_4266.Title: 운동을 하자! 헬스!(Hells)
_4266.Description:
후우... 후우... 이런 운동을 하느라 온 줄 몰랐군 실례했네.
자네도 엄청나게 땀을 흘리고 있군.
지금이 가장 격렬하게 운동해야 할 타이밍인 거지!
마지막으로 무한빙벽에 있는 내 친구에게 찾아가봐 방해하는 몬스터 몇 마리 정도 처치하면 더 좋겠군.
_4266.Objective: 무한빙벽 으로 이동하여 스컬그레이몬 3마리를 처치 후 <휴식>레오몬을 만난다.
_4266.CompletionText: 아직 출발 안 했나? 운동의 적은 게으름이야.
_4266.CompletionSummary:
수고 많았네.
격렬한 운동 후 휴식은 필수지.
이건 내가 주는 수고의 보답이야.
적당한 운동을 하여 건강을 유지하게.

_4267.Title: 운동을 하자! 헬스!(Hells)
_4267.Description:
근력 트레이닝이다!
몬스터와 격렬한 싸움을 하는 거지!
상대는.... 디지몬 미궁 진입로에 있는 볼케몬과 파일볼케몬이 좋겠군.
둘 다 멋진 육체를 가진 디지몬 들이지!
_4267.Objective: 디지몬 미궁 진입로에서 볼케몬, 파일볼케몬 처치
_4267.CompletionText: 아직 출발 안 했나? 운동의 적은 게으름이야!
_4267.CompletionSummary: 격렬하게 한판 붙었군! 말하지 않아도 너의 얼굴을 보면 알 수 있지!

_4268.Title: 운동을 하자! 헬스!(Hells)
_4268.Description:
운동 후 식사는 단백질이 풍부한 고기가 좋지! 말 나온김에 함께 먹자구!
물론 고기는 지금 없어!
왜 그렇게 처다보나? 당연히 자네가 구해와야지!
_4268.Objective: 황야지역에서 멧돼지몬 처치 후 단백질 고기 획득
_4268.CompletionText: 아직 출발 안 했나? 운동의 적은 게으름이야!
_4268.CompletionSummary:
잘 구해왔군!
이건 고생 해준 보답으로 자네에게 주겠네. 방금 손질을 마친 고기야.

_4269.Title: 옆구리가 시린 계절
_4269.Description:
저기... 시간 있으면 내 부탁 좀 들어줄래? 빛의 언덕에는 시들지 않는 꽃이 핀다는 이야기를 들었어.
괜찮다면 대신 구해다 줄 수 있을까?
꼭 선물하고 싶은 상대가 있어서.
누구냐고? 비.. 비밀이야!
_4269.Objective: 빛의 언덕 맵에서 악역 몬스터를 처치 후 시들지 않는 꽃 수집
_4269.CompletionText: 빛의 언덕에 시들지 않는 꽃이야. 잘 부탁해~
_4269.CompletionSummary:
정말 있었구나! 이걸 받고 좋아해 주면 좋을 텐데.
뭐... 뭐야! 바쁜 거 아냐? 어서 가봐! 네가 갈 때까지 안 움직일 꺼야!

_4270.Title: 옆구리가 시린 계절
_4270.Description:
안녕! 브이몬의 부탁을 들어 주던데 혹시 나도 부탁 하나 해도 될까?
나도 친구들에게 의미 있는 선물을 하고 싶어!
시부야에는 반짝반짝 빛나는 돌이 있다고 해. 나에게 그걸 구해다 줄래?
_4270.Objective: 시부야 맵에서 악역 몬스터를 처치 후 빛나는 돌 수집
_4270.CompletionText: 빛나는 돌은 시부야에서 얻을 수 있어,
_4270.CompletionSummary:
정말 고마워! 힘들었지?
정말 반짝반짝 빛이나네 돌이 맞는 걸까?

_4271.Title: Season of Gluttony
_4271.Description:
Hey, you there. Yes, the one who's going around with a Digimon.
Do you feel the season changing? I heard that in your world, now is the season of harvest and food.
I devour tons of data usually, but around this time, my hunger pang gets even stronger, so...
Go and get some Data of Gluttony at Digimon Maze Entrance. I don't want some weaklings' data so get me some good ones.
_4271.Objective: Obtain <Data of Gluttony> at Digimon Maze Entrance
_4271.CompletionText:
As I said before, I don't want a weakling's data.
You know what I mean, right?
_4271.CompletionSummary:
Not too bad.
You… despite how dumb you look, you are pretty resourceful, aren't you?
It's your reward. Take it.
You can use it like it is, or bring it back to me with <Evidence of Hunger>. If I feel like it, I might make something for you out of them.

_4272.Title: Indigenous Peoples' Day
_4272.Description:
This is not good!
We were gonna honor Indigenous Peoples' Day by releasing some balloons…
But Monzaemon stole those balloons for himself!
We've got to stop him!
_4272.Objective: Defeat <Balloon Stealer>Monzaemon that randomly spawns at Village of Beginning
_4272.CompletionText: We've got to stop him before it’s too late!
_4272.CompletionSummary:
We got the balloons back! Thank you so much.
Here, you take this balloon… You deserve it.
Bring me many of these balloons you just got and I will give you some neat items in return.

_4273.Title: Rare Machine Covered with Leaves
_4273.Description:
Wanna spin the Rare Machine?
If you bring me traces of each season at Silver Lake, Silent Forest, and Lost Historic Site, I will give you coins that can be used with Rare Machine!
_4273.Objective: Collect traces of season by defeating the evil Digimon at Silver Lake, Silent Forest, and Lost Historic Site.
_4273.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Trace of Wind 20ea%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Trace of Summer 20ea%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Trace of Fall 20ea%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4273.CompletionSummary:
You got the traces of season.
I'll give you these coins. Try them with the Rare Machine.

_4274.Title: Approaching Fall
_4274.Description:
Cooling wind that blows the leaves around has come to us.
That means lots of fallen leaves and litter on the ground.
I'm trying to gather some supplies to use for cleaning… But I think it'll be hard by myself. Would you help me?
Go to Versandi Terminal and get some Pail, Stick, and Cloth.
You can get Pail from Leomon (Insane) and Kunemon (Evolved), Stick from Monochromon (Violent) and Rockmon (Violent), and Cloth from DexDoruGreymon (X-Program).
Help me out!
_4274.Objective: Collect Pail, Stick, and Cloth at Versandi Terminal
_4274.CompletionText: I am making a broomstick now. I wonder how much longer this will take?
_4274.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, I could save a lot of time! Here is your reward!

_4275.Title: Approaching Winter
_4275.Summary: [Daily] Full Course Meal Even During Winter!
_4275.Description:
Smells good, right? I may look like this, but I'm a pretty good cook, if I do say so myself!
Wanna try? Not for free though. It just so happens that my cooking utensils have worn out recently…
Get me some new utensils from Silver Lake.
_4275.Objective: Collect Cooking Utensils at Silver Lake
_4275.CompletionText: I might need to up the firepower here. Where is Meramon when I need him?
_4275.CompletionSummary:
You got them! My new tools! Can't wait to put them to use.
Here, take this, it's a set of tools that humans use when eating. And as promised, have some of this as well.

_4276.Title: Guardian of Full Moon
_4276.Description: To be unable to gaze upon the full moon, in the fall season when every family should gather to mingle and watch the night sky together… This is not right. Please, my dear Tamer, defeat the darkness that will descend upon File Island, and claim its aura. We have to take its power to clear the night sky for the full moon.
_4276.CompletionText: Fall season must have its full moon, rightfully so…
_4276.CompletionSummary: At last, full moon for the fall night sky. It is nothing great but something for you, dear Tamer.

_4277.Title: You Call This Fall? FALL my ***!
_4277.Summary: [Daily] The Heater, the Hater, and the Taker
_4277.Description: This heat is craaaaaazy, I am sure I can cook a freakin' EGG if I put it on my palm!! ARGHHHHH!! WHY IS IT JUST GETTING HOTTER AND HOTTER! For real tho, it's already hot enough, and some Digimon who like the heat have popped up, getting on my nerves! Damn it! Hey you there! Work with me! There are some punks here in our town who aren't supposed to be here. Let 'em know that they are at a wrong place, at a wrong time! Take all of their aura, and we will claim the reward on them!
_4277.CompletionSummary: What? You want this thing? You can handle the heat with this thing?

_4278.Title: You Call This Fall? FALL my ***!
_4278.Summary: [Daily] If You're Hot, You Know What to Do…
_4278.Description: This is insane… Is this really fall weather? Not even where I came from was this hot! Damn it! Hey you there! Work with me! There are some hotheads in my town who have no qualms about the weather, and are shooting up the temperature. Let's go and make them 'chill'! Come on!
_4278.Objective: Defeaet Candlemon Defeat Birdramon Defeat Boarmon

_4279.Title: Want to Play a Game?
_4279.Description:
Hello there.
I am Piedmon. If you are bored, would you like to play a game with me?
This object that I would like to know more about, they are some kind of a letter, and are found everywhere except in certain regions.
You will be able to collect them as you go on your adventure.
If you bring those to me, I will reward you well.
_4279.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon from anywhere except the Yokohama Village region to collect [Enigmatic Letter] 50ea
_4279.CompletionText: I am expecting much from you. Fufufu…
_4279.CompletionSummary:
Thank you.
Would you like to play a little card game I prepared for you?

_4280.Title: Leave Summer Fashion to Me!
_4280.Description:
All the fabric I prepared so that I can make summer clothes are gone! Would you help me find them?
If you defeat evil Digimon anywhere, except in Yokohama Village region, you will find clues to whereabouts of the missing fabric.
Please take care of this!
_4280.CompletionText: I was just trying to make cool clothes…
_4280.CompletionSummary:
The clues revealed Etemon's data. He must be the culprit who stole all my fabric!
I will give you this data. Teach Etemon a good lesson, and the remaining fabric is yours.

_4281.Title: The Last Roaring Flame
_4281.Description:
Summer is almost over but it's still hot!
Find out what's causing the hot weather and take care of it!!
_4281.Objective: Defeat<Burning Up>Chimairamon that randomly spawns at Silver Lake, Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, File Isalnd Waterfront.
_4281.CompletionSummary:
Thanks. I feel better already.
Here is my token of gratitude. Take it.

_4282.Title: The Last Roaring Flame
_4282.Description:
Summer is almost over but it's still hot!
Find out what's causing the hot weather and take care of it!!
_4282.Objective: Defeat<Burning Up>SkullMeramon that randomly spawns at Silver Lake, Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, File Isalnd Waterfront.
_4282.CompletionSummary:
Thanks. I feel better already.
Here is my token of gratitude. Take it.

_4283.Title: High Discomfort Index
_4283.Description:
The weather is hot and everything is annoying me.
I'm gonna play some pranks to get some steam off.
Hey yo, won't you do something for me?
_4283.Objective: Defeat WereGarurumon(Black), WaruMonzaemon, Giromon, and Knightmon at Odaiba
_4283.CompletionSummary:
Now, that's a stress reliever! Good job!
You did well, so you deserve a praise.
'Till next time!

_4284.Title: [Preparing For Fall]
_4284.Description:
This is not good! I prepared some moisturizer to prepare for Fall weather, but RedVegiemon used it up behind my back and ran off!
I will give you the card that summons RedVegiemon. Summon that punk at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, and kick his butt for me!
_4284.Objective: Defeat RedVegiemon summoned at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_4284.CompletionSummary: Thanks for doing this for me! This is my token of gratitude. Take it!

_4285.Title: [Preparing For Fall]
_4285.Description: MetalEtemon is holding a concert every night at File Island Waterfront, making so much noise that I can't even sleep! Would you get rid of him? I will pay you back for sure!
_4285.Objective: Defeat <Nightly Concert>MetalEtemon that spawns at File Island Waterfront
_4285.CompletionSummary:
Thanks! Now we will not have to hear the noisy music every night!
Here you go!

_4286.Title: [Still Hot DATS Center]
_4286.Description:
The Summer here is too hot!!
I think I might melt at this rate…
Help me please!
Bring me Chunk of Snow from File Island Waterfront, Cooling Ice from Frozen Ground, and Dew from Silver Lake, please!
_4286.Objective: Obtain "Chunk of Snow" at File Island Waterfront, "Cooling Ice" at Frozen Ground, and "Dew" from Silver Lake
_4286.CompletionSummary:
This is very cooling, all thanks to you!
Here is something in return. 'Til next time, then!

_4287.Title: [Still Hot DATS Center]
_4287.Summary: [Daily] The Digimon That Went on a Summer Vacation to Somewhere Cold
_4287.Description:
Hey human, have you seen my master?
He disappeared after showing me a vacation paper… I still have a lot of training to do!
You have to find the master. This is my order as your senior!
If you find him, I will give you a reward!
_4287.Objective: Defate Gankoomon that spawns at Infinite Ice Wall, Frozen Ground, and Snowstorm Village
_4287.CompletionText: Where could have master gone to?
_4287.CompletionSummary:
Can't believe my master went on a vacation by himself!
This is shocking indeed, but since you found him, I will keep my promise. As your senior, I give you this present that I got from the master!

_4288.Title: [Still Hot DATS Center]
_4288.Description:
Hello. Some Meramon have appeared around Guilmon's House all of a sudden…
Guilmon is feeling really hot so could you please chase away those Meramon?
_4288.Objective: Defeat <Responsible for Heat>Meramon 30ea at Shinjuku Western Area (Day)
_4288.CompletionText: Hold on a little longer, Guilmon…
_4288.CompletionSummary:
Meramon are all gone thanks to you!
Guilmon shouldn't be feeling too hot now. This is for you. Thank you.

_4289.Title: [Scary Test of Guts!]
_4289.Description:
When the weahter is hot like this, testing your guts is the thing to do! If you want to test your guts, head over to Silent Forest!
You know that there are Goblimons there, right? They have Chilling Aura so you will feel it for sure.
Go get your chills! Also, if you get their aura, bring them to me!
_4289.Objective: Obtain Chilling Aura from Goblimon from Silent Forest
_4289.CompletionText: Let's beat this heat with chills!
_4289.CompletionSummary:
How was it? Cool enough? Heard Goblimons are known as some kind of fairies or demons in the Real World!
This is for your hard work! Open it when there's no one around~

_4290.Title: [Scary Test of Guts!]
_4290.Description:
What bettere place is there to test one's guts, other than a graveyard? Ghosts will be popping up too. Are you a chicken?
If you aren't, head to Silent Forest. And bring me the proof that ghosts exist.
_4290.Objective: Collect Proof of Ghosts from Bakemon from Silent Forest
_4290.CompletionText: Let's beat this heat with chills!
_4290.CompletionSummary:
Real proof of ghosts, huh? Take this token; it's for your effort!
You can use it to exchange for an item you want. But what's that thing that's been standing behind your back?

_4291.Title: [In Search of Somewhere Cool]
_4291.Description:
Sigh… What is this!? What kind of weather is this? I know it's summer but isn't this a bit too much?
Hey kid! You there! Nice to meet you here. You are feeling hot too, aren't ya? Go to Infinite Ice Wall now and find some stuff to cool me down. I will pay you back!
What are you standing around for?
_4291.Objective: Collect Iciness Aura at Infinite Ice Wall
_4291.CompletionText: It's too hot, even singing is annoying!
_4291.CompletionSummary:
Ah~ So cool. Now that's what I'm talking about. I promised you a reward, didn't I?
I will give you the honor of listening to my song for 10 hours straight, right here! Here we go..? Hey! Where are you going?!

_4292.Title: [In Search of Somewhere Cool]
_4292.Description:
Hey! Rude of you to turn down my gratitude like that! You got me all worked up so now I'm hot again!
Remember that Monster Card I gave you just now? Use it at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square!
Why? It's because "that guy" absorbed all the cold things. That's why it is not cool here at all!
I will reward you well so get going!
_4292.Objective: Defeat IceDevimon summoned at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_4292.CompletionText: It's too hot, even singing is annoying!
_4292.CompletionSummary: Since that guy is gone, the air conditioning is finally cooling me down~ Here, take this. Bring it to the dude next to me wearing a pelt and he will give you a good deal.

_4293.Title: [There's No Such Thing As A Bad Demon Beast Digimon]
_4293.Description:
Krrr… I am out of things to chew on so my teeth are itchy…
The bones around here are simply not good enough!
From what I heard, there are many kinds of tough bones in Versandi Terminal. Could you get me some bones that will satisfy my teething urges?
Hard Bone from Leomon, and Kunemon. Soft Bone from Mushroomon, and FanBeemon. Huge Bone from Monochromon, DarkTyrannomon, and Raptordramon. Chewy Bone from Datamon, Megadramon, and Allomon. These are the bones you can get from there.
I will repay you handsomely for this.
Krrr....
_4293.Objective: Obtain Hard Bone, Soft Bone, Huge Bone, Chewy Bone from Versandi Terminal
_4293.CompletionSummary:
Yes this is it! It's tough enough to withstand my bites.
I could chew on this until I am satisfied. This is for your hard work.
Take it. (Scronch! Scronch!)

_4294.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_4294.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_4294.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_4294.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_4295.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_4295.Description:
I am Gankoomon, one of the Royal Knights.
What? You want to receive training from me? Hahaha! You have come to the right place!
If you receive training from me, you will become strong no matter what!
However, it will be extremely difficult… Are you up for it? If you are, come back to me!
_4295.CompletionText: Hahaha! That reminds me of my Jesmon!
_4295.CompletionSummary:
Good! Looks like you have prepared yourself.
Everyday, different Digimon will appear to help you with your training.
Of course, none other than I, will be the last one to test your mettle!
If you endure, and complete this training, I shall give you an appropriate reward.
So, are you ready for this?

_4296.Title: [Blistering Hot Weather]
_4296.Description: Fire Digimons have caused weather anomalies which made the weather even hotter… At this rate, nobody will be able to adapt to the weather. Go teach those hot-heads a lesson.
_4296.Objective: Defeat DemiMeramon at S. Vill Defeat Meramon at File Island Defeat Candlemon at Server Desert Defeat Birdramon at Forest Area
_4296.CompletionText: The hot weather has gotten even hotter…
_4296.CompletionSummary: Thank you! With your help, the weather will become normal again!

_4297.Title: RustTyranomon
_4297.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Long time no see, culu~!
Are you going to Richard Sampson by any chance? Culu~? No, you say? Culu?
I've been getting bad vibes from the Digital World, starting from 2~3 days ago, culu… And as if to show that my bad feelings were right, Royal Knights came to visit Richard Sampson, culu…
So go to him quick and see what's up! Culu~!
_4297.CompletionText: I really hope it's nothing culu…
_4297.CompletionSummary:
What a good timing. I was just about to call you!
Gallantmon and Craniummon of Royal Knights are here so let us get started now.

_4298.Title: RustTyranomon
_4298.Description:
Understood. @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Go with Gallantmon and Craniummon to the Digital World right now to help with their investigation of current phenomenon!
From what I have heard so far, I have a feeling that something bad is going to happen.
Thoroughly investigate the matter to prevent such a thing! Dismissed!
_4298.Objective: Talk to Gallantmon Move to Forest Area Talk to Craniummon
_4298.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Gallantmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Forest Area%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk to Craniummon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4298.CompletionSummary: You have arrived… This is the place, where the incident took place..!
_4298.ReservedText:
Thank you for your help, Commander Sampson. I shall repay this someday.
Let us move to Digital World, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>.

_4299.Title: RustTyranomon
_4299.Description:
Almost every Digimon in the Digital World know that Craniummon, Gankoomon and I are Royal Knights. Considering their hostility towards us, it will be nearly impossible for us to gather more information.
As such, I hope you can find out what happened on previous days from the Digimons of Forest Area.
I hope you could bring back some good results…!
_4299.Objective: Talk to Forest Area Resident 1 Talk to Forest Area Resident 2
_4299.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Forest Area Resident 1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Forest Area Resident 2%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4299.CompletionText: Hope this brings back good results..!
_4299.CompletionSummary:
No… no more q..questions!! STOP ASKING! I don't wanna remember!!
ARGHHHH!!!
_4299.ReservedText: What? You asking what happened here? Why is a human asking that?

_4300.Title: RustTyranomon
_4300.Description:
My friends that I was hanging out and having fun together just a few days ago are all gone!
Pretentious Royal Knights who pop up only now to tell me that they will take care of everything, And you human who has no business with us whatsoever!
I am sick of you all! So get out of my sight now! If you don't, I WILL move you!
_4300.CompletionText: You are still here? Get lost! Get out of my sight!
_4300.CompletionSummary:
You are here. How is it?
Hmm…that is how badly it was hurt.. I have mixed feelings about this..

_4301.Title: RustTyranomon
_4301.Description:
Looks like we do not have a choice… We have to subdue them with force… If we just stand by just because they refuse to tell us more, something worse will happen…
I want you to find out what happened here a few days ago from Floramon and Vegiemon who live here. We Royal Knights will gather information from other Digimons as well.
_4301.Objective: Subdue Floramon to obtain Testimony Subdue Vegiemon to obtain Testimony
_4301.CompletionSummary: How was it? Any good news?

_4302.Title: RustTyranomon
_4302.Description: You have acquired important information…! Good. Let us go to the Wasteland Area and find out who is responsible for this!
_4302.Objective: Move to Crater of Wasteland Area Talk to Gankoomon
_4302.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Crater of Wasteland Area%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Gankoomon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4302.CompletionText: Well, let's go to the Wasteland Area!
_4302.CompletionSummary: This is where the terrible incident that they mentioned took place...!

_4303.Title: RustTyranomon
_4303.Description:
Just as Gallantmon mentioned before, we should not be wasting any more time. We have to get moving fast!
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Investigate the Wasteland Area. Find anything that could potentially serve as a clue!
We will be going around the Wasteland Area to check on our own. I will be counting on you…!
_4303.Objective: Move to Antenna Region Move to Stormy Hill Move to Chuchidarumon Village Move to Rocky Mountain Move to Remote Wilderness
_4303.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Antenna Region%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Move to Stormy Hill%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Move to Chuchidarumon Village%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Move to Rocky Mountain%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Move to Remote Wilderness%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4303.CompletionText: We should get going too! Gallantmon! Craniummon!

_4304.Title: RustTyranomon
_4304.Description:
This area too seems to be hostile to us Royal Knights… As such, we hope you could gather information from the Digimons here in our stead…
We will be counting on you. Hope you bring some good news…
_4304.Objective: Talk to Wasteland Area Resident 1 Talk to Wasteland Area Resident 2
_4304.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Wasteland Area Resident 1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Wasteland Area Resident 2%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4304.CompletionText: Hope this brings back good results..!
_4304.CompletionSummary:
D..don't ask!! Don't ASK anymore!! I don't want to remember anymore!!
ARGHHHH!!!
_4304.ReservedText:
What? You asking what happened here? Why do you want to know that?
Get lost!

_4305.Title: RustTyranomon
_4305.Description: We got nothing to tell you so scram! If you bother us with more questions, you WILL be sorry!
_4305.Objective: Talk to Deputymon Subdue Deputymon Subdue Starmon
_4305.CompletionText: I don't even wanna think about that day!
_4305.ReservedText:
Do we seem like a joke to you, human? We told you we don't wanna talk about it! You just don't know when to quit, think we are some joke, huh?
We aren't gonna take that! Prepare to get your human-butt kicked!

_4306.Title: RustTyranomon
_4306.Description:
Oh! Just one more thing!
On the night of that incident…I saw them…! Shadows of a gigantic dinosaur-like Digimon with a human, through the sandstorm that occurs in this wasteland…
I also heard these words from those shadows… 'Tomorrow night, we will be back…'
The tomorrow night that the shadowy figure mentioned is tonight… That's why my friends and I are getting out of this place today!
You should skedaddle too if you want to live!
_4306.CompletionText: Let's get out of this place now! Deputymon!
_4306.CompletionSummary: You are here. Found anything good?

_4307.Title: RustTyranomon
_4307.Description:
Well done, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! You have discovered a critical piece of clue!
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!, Craniummon! Gankoomon! Let us set up an ambush here!
If the tip is right, those guys will be here for sure!
_4307.Objective: Talk to Craniummon Talk to Gankoomon
_4307.CompletionText: I am starting to see the end of this…
_4307.CompletionSummary:
Agreed. We have nothing to lose!
This will be a battle of patience… Then, let us go somewhere appropriate for hiding!

_4308.Title: RustTyranomon
_4308.Description: Hmm…How boring… It is already night and nobody seems to be showing up…
_4308.CompletionSummary: I see… No sign of it at all… Could it be wrong information?

_4309.Title: RustTyranomon
_4309.Description:
Well, it's fine I guess! I will take this as a good opportunity to test RustTyranomon's increased power from eating those Digimons!
Go, RustTyranomon! Let those puny Royal Knights have a taste of your power!
And that pesky little DATS Agent too!
_4309.CompletionSummary:
Grr… not strong enough to take on 3 Royal Knights at the same time yet, I see…
Hmph, Fine… We shall fall back now for further progress later!
Let's go, RustTyranomon! I, Akihiro Kurata, shall prepare a stage for you again!
Well bye then, my dear Royal Knights... and pesky little DATS Agent...

_4310.Title: RustTyranomon
_4310.Description:
It is me. There is a large Realization taking place at Big Sight currently. How is the situation over there? If you have taken care of it, you should come provide support over here…
What? Akihiro Kurata? That Akihiro Kurata again?
What? He went to the Real World together with a Digimon named RustTyranomon? Hmph, that means Akihiro Kurata is responsible for the Realization occurring at Big Sight now.
Understood. Wrap up your task there and depart for Big Sight! Over!
_4310.Objective: Talk to Gallantmon Move to Big Sight
_4310.CompletionSummary: Kekeke… You've come all the way here, DATS Agent??
_4310.ReservedText:
You are going?
Go and teach that guy a lesson.
Do not be afraid. You have shown great courage in the battle against him back then. Have confidence and face him straight on.
You are strong..!

_4311.Title: RustTyranomon
_4311.Description:
It was difficult just now because of Royal Knights but they aren't around anymore…
So I will destroy you right here right now…!
_4311.CompletionSummary:
What! RustTyranomon!!
Getting in my way until the very end, you stupid DATS guys!!! I WILL find even more powerful Digimon and tear you guys to pieces!! DATS!!! THIS IS NOT OVER!!!!

_4312.Title: RustTyranomon
_4312.Description:
It is me. The Realization seems to have stopped. Did you take care of it?
Well done. What about Akihiro Kurata?
Escaped, huh… As quick as ever, I see…
Right. Return to DATS Center…Over!
_4312.CompletionSummary:
You are back. Well done. We just received a message from Royal Knights. Thanks to your efforts, Digital World has regained its stability.
You have done well, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>.
Go and get some rest… Dismissed!

_4313.Title: RustTyranomon
_4313.Description:
Wait, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>. What is that in your hand?
The Digicore you picked up from defeating RustTyranomon and Akihiro Kurata's research data?
Hmm…Nanomon will appreciate such material… Hand those over to Nanomon. If it is Nanonmon, it just might be possible to figure out what he is thinking…!
_4313.CompletionText: What kind of problem will he cause next time… Akihiro Kurata…!

_4314.Title: RustTyranomon
_4314.Description:
Hmmm~ This, this is RustTyranomon's Digicore… Hmm..hmm..You got your hands on something like this somehow!
Hm? Is that? That Akihiro Kurata guy's research data? Ohh~ That fellow…This is how he created RustTyranomon…
If only he were mentally stable, we could have made something great together… What a shame… What's with that look on your face?
_4314.Objective: Talk to Nanomon RustTyranomon's Digicore Akihiro Kurata's Research Data
_4314.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Nanomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2RustTyranomon's Digicore%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Akihiro Kurata's Research Data%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4314.CompletionSummary:
Well, this Akihiro Kurata guy seems to have created RustTyranomon by applying Jogress on Aegisdramon and Machinedramon. Since we have RustTyranomon's Digicore, I too, can create data that can make evolution to RustTyranomon possible.
Wait just a bit, I will make it in a moment!
Now, it is complete. This is the data that can make evolution to RustTyranomon possible. Give this to Machinedramon, and it will be able to evolve and become RustTyranomon.
Well, get going. I want to analyze this Kurata guy's data further!

_4315.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_4315.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_4315.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_4315.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_4316.Title: [Vacation at the Beach]
_4316.Description:
Came here to cool off in the water…
But there're too many Digimons here who would interfere with my vacation! I won't be able to enjoy my time in the water like this.
If we show the strong ones that we are not to be messed with, won't the rest of them simply run away?
Defeat the Captains and Army Captains, and bring me the marks they carry.
_4316.Objective: Collect Mark of Captain, and Mark of Army Captain, 50ea each
_4316.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Mark of Captain 50ea%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Mark of Army Captain 50ea%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4316.CompletionText: Can't even enjoy my vacation like this…
_4316.CompletionSummary: This is great! Now, I'll be able to chill with no worries!

_4317.Title: [Vacation at the Beach]
_4317.Description:
The train that was carrying passengers got derailed!
We have to repair the train but the Digimons nearby ripped off the parts and ran off with them.
I will be going around to check if there's anybody injured. Could you get the stolen parts back from those Digimons?
_4317.Objective: Collect Bolt, Nut, and Steel Plate
_4317.CompletionSummary: Thanks for getting the parts back! Luckily, nobody seems to be injured.

_4318.Title: [Favor from Babamon and Jijimon]
_4318.Description:
Welome, dear huhu..
I, Jijimon, am trying to hold a Lucky Day event, and some lucky charms are needed.
The charms I need are Clover, Lucky Letter, and Complete Aura.
Clovers can be found in Silver Lake, Lucky Letter in File Island Waterfront, and Complete Aura in Digimon Maze Entrance.
Could you go and collect these goodies for this old man?
_4318.CompletionText: Sincerely hoping that luck comes to your way…
_4318.CompletionSummary: Thank you. These are good stuff!

_4319.Title: [Favor from Babamon and Jijimon]
_4319.Description:
Yes yes… You did Jijimon a favor, you say?
Now, since I received the paper with instructions on how to prevent misfortunes, I shall tell you how.
You can prevent misfortunes by defeating evil Digimons.
Defeat IceDevimon from Snowman Village, LadyDevimon from File Island Waterfront, and Devimon from Wilderness Area, 10 of each.
Please be careful out there!
_4319.Objective: Defeat 10 of IceDevimon, LadyDevimon, and Devimon. In possession of Paper on How to Prevent Misfortunes 1ea
_4319.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat IceDevimon 10ea%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Devimon 10ea%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat LadyDevimon 10ea%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4In possession of Paper on How to Prevent Misfortunes 1ea %qe %cc4/%mc4
_4319.CompletionSummary: I knew you would make it!

_4320.Title: [How to Spend Fun-filled June]
_4320.Description:
The weather has gotten really hot nowadays, right?
But I feel too chilly, freezing…
Which is because… umm… I have witnessed <Frigid>Panjyamon somehwere on File Island, who has a big, freezing presence…
Will you go and defeat <Frigid>Panjyamon>? That will give you the chills too... Take note, <Frigid>Panjyamon can be found every 60 minutes, in either Silver Lake, Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, or File Island Waterfront!
_4320.CompletionSummary: How is it? You got the chills yet? No more summer heat for us!!

_4321.Title: [Grateful to Teachers]
_4321.Description:
Yes, I heard you are preparing a bouquet of pretty carnation for me.
I am well aware that getting your hands on those flowers is no easy task…
You will have a chance to get those flowers by defeating evil Digimon at most places except Yokohama Village.
If you bring me 50 of carnation petals, I will give you 2 beautiful carnation flowers.
I will be waiting.
_4321.CompletionSummary: They are small carnation petals but very touching nevertheless~

_4322.Title: [Grateful to Teachers]
_4322.Description:
Hey~ I am Gabumon the class rep!
Since Teachers' Day is around the corner, we were planning to give our collected Hearts to White-bearded Guru, but mean LadyDevimon stole all of them!
Get those Hearts back from LadyDevimon, I beg of you!
I heard LadyDevimon, are seen popping up at either Silver Lake, Lost Historic Site, or Snowstorm Village, at about 4AM, 8AM, and 10AM!
_4322.CompletionText: The Hearts that we put our hearts into…
_4322.CompletionSummary: Thank you. We have them back thanks to you!

_4323.Title: [Final Flower Fest]
_4323.Description:
Sadly, I think this flower fest is going to be the last one this year.
I really want to attend the fest, so would you help me?
If you defeat 30 of <Pretty Flower>Floramon and 15 of <Frightening Flower>Blossomon at Lost Historic Site, Server Continent Pyramid, and Forest Area, I will get the right to attend the flower fest!
3 of <Frightening Flower>Blossomon will appear when you defeat 10 of <Pretty Flower>Floramon!
I hope you would help me out!
_4323.CompletionText: It's the last flower fest… So sad…
_4323.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Looks like I get to enjoy the last flower fest of the year thanks to you!

_4324.Title: [Final Flower Fest]
_4324.Description:
I am the perfumer of the flower fest, Palmon!
Just looking at those flowers makes me feel good!
Speaking of which, could you bring me some Mystical Fragrance Capsule?
They can be found from evil Digimon at Silver Lake, Digimon Maze Entrance, and Cloud Area!
_4324.CompletionText: What kind of fragrance shall I create?
_4324.CompletionSummary:
You've got them all?
Thank you~ I will try to make the best fragrance in the world!

_4325.Title: [There Are Many Kinds of Colorful Marbles]
_4325.Description:
Hello!
I am T.K. the marble collector.
I heard there are marbles of all kinds of colors around here!
I will give you an empty box so fill it with various kinds of marbles and give it to me, and I will give you the goods you need in return~
See ya!
_4325.CompletionSummary:
Here, take this empty box!
Bring it back to me with marbles!

_4326.Title: [The Planet We Borrowed]
_4326.Description:
Sigh… I think the environment is really important.
But I heard <Made of Garbage>Raremon has been popping up around the village..!
What if that Raremon ends up severely damaging the Earth..?
Would you defeat Raremon appearing in one of these places: Shinjuku Western Area (Day), File Island WaterFront, Snowman Village,
and bring 1 [Garbage Pile] to me?
_4326.CompletionSummary: Thanks for taking care of Raremon!

_4327.Title: [May is for the Family Event]
_4327.Description:
Upamon wants to grow and for that, [Essence of Earth Data] is needed.
I heard it can be collected from most regions but I can't leave Upamon's side now.
If you go and gather [Strength of Earth Fragments] in my stead, I will turn them into [Essence of Earth Data].
What do you say, can you help Upamon, who is eager to grow?
_4327.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Wilderness Area, and Silver Lake to collect item
_4327.CompletionSummary:
Thanks!
Can you help tomorrow again?

_4328.Title: [May is for the Family Event]
_4328.Description:
Digimons like Upamon here are lovely children but they are a big pain every time we are on a picnic…
It's not just me, other caretakers are not having an easy time as well.
That is why I make food for those who are tired!
But nowadays, everyone is exhausted and can't really go out.
So I want to prepare something special, and I wonder if you can help me collec the ingredients?
_4328.Objective: Defeat Digimon at File Island WaterFront to collect item Defeat Digimon at Snowman Vill. ,Snowstorm Vill. to collect item
_4328.CompletionText: I wish we could go on picnics again soon…
_4328.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!
Hope everyone regains their strength..!

_4329.Title: [Masters Match]
_4329.Description:
Masters Match Mission : F refers to missions that pertain to basic activities during Masters Match period.
Most evil Digimon have been provided with something called [Masters Match : F].
If you bring me [Masters Match : F] from them, I will reward you appropriately.
_4329.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at most area except Yokohama Village to collect item
_4329.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1In possession of Mission : F%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2F : Collect Activity Certification%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4329.CompletionSummary: You've done it. You may take the reward.

_4330.Title: [Masters Match]
_4330.Description:
One of the things most feared by the DigiDestined was Devimon's presence.
If you face and defeat Devimon who will remind you of the fear the DigiDestined felt at Infinite Mountain back then, I will reward you appropriately.
_4330.Objective: Defeat raid boss of Infinite Mountain, <Masters Match>Devimon 1 time.
_4330.CompletionSummary: Should not have been that difficult for you. Well done.

_4331.Title: [Masters Match]
_4331.Description:
Think you can handle this mission as well?
I asked for a little favor from Etemon at Pyramid, to test the Tamers durig this period.
If you defeat Etemon, who is waiting for you at Pyramid, and come back, I will reward you appropriately.
_4331.Objective: Defeat raid boss of Pyramid, <Masters Match>Etemon 1 time.
_4331.CompletionSummary: You did a splendid work. Well done.

_4332.Title: [Masters Match]
_4332.Description:
Think you can handle this mission as well?
I asked VenomMyotismon to test the Tamers' mettle durig this period.
If you defeat VenomMyotismon at Odaiba and come back, I will reward you appropriately.
_4332.Objective: Defeat raid boss of Odaiba, <Masters Match>VenomMyotismon 1 time.
_4332.CompletionSummary: You did a splendid work. Well done.

_4333.Title: Ordinemon
_4333.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! We are in trouble!! No time to chit-chat here~! Culu~!
We must go see Commander Sampson! He looked really serious...culu…! Good luck…culu…!
_4333.CompletionText: I have a bad feeling…culu… I hope nothing bad will happen…culu…
_4333.CompletionSummary: Huh? You are late...! We all know the situation, so I'll start right away...!

_4334.Title: Ordinemon
_4334.Description:
However, there was something different with the realizing this time. Miki and Thomas went to the site of realizing to grasp the situation so far. The location of the realizing is the Big Sight.
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, you too must go and support Miki and Thomas! Over!
_4334.Objective: Move to Big Sight Talk with Miki
_4334.CompletionSummary: Huh, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> when did you get here?

_4335.Title: Ordinemon
_4335.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! ImperialDramon appeared suddenly out of the dimensional crack and is destroying the Big Sight area!
But there is something different with the ImperialDramon we know! It’s more… vicious and ferocious?
We need to hurry and defeat ImperialDramon! Otherwise, there will be innocent victims!
_4335.CompletionText: What is this dimensional crack and how is ImperialDramon here…?
_4335.CompletionSummary: Well done! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Fortunately it seems there were no victims!

_4336.Title: Ordinemon
_4336.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Look at this… It’s data I got after defeating ImperialDramon, but there is something strange… Something different from the data we’ve seen so far… It just don’t feel right …
We should go back to Dats Center and ask Nanomon to take a look. Let head back to Dats Center…!
_4336.Objective: Move to Dats Center Talk with Nanomon Suspicious Data
_4336.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Dats Center%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk with Nanomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Suspicious Data%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4336.CompletionText: Hm…I think something bad will happen…?
_4336.CompletionSummary: What? You again? @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, you always bother me, but since you always bring me fun data, I’ll forgive you…! So, what interesting data did you bring me today?

_4337.Title: Ordinemon
_4337.Description:
Hmm... Sorry to keep you waiting... Even I the great Nanomon, it takes some time to analyze data I see for the first time... But I analyzed it accurately and clearly. I hate repeating myself, so listen carefully.
This data you brought is infected data. In other words, it means that it is infected with a virus, and this virus will cause Digimon to become mad and lose temper, leaving only destructive instincts...
_4337.CompletionText: This was enough for you to understand, right?
_4337.CompletionSummary: But the scariest thing about this virus is that it is highly contagious! If you come into contact with Digimon infected with this virus, it will be contagious and you will lose your temper and only destructive instinct will be left...!

_4338.Title: Ordinemon
_4338.Description:
So, since you fought against EmperialDramon, you are already exposed to this virus and are in a dangerous situation. Of course, the same is true of me who analyzed this data...
So, from now on, I will make cure that can remove the infectious virus and vaccines that can prevent it.
You guys have to go to Richard Sampson and ask him what his plan is.
_4338.CompletionText: Don't bother me anymore, I don't have much time now… I need to hurry and develop the vaccine and cure…! I don't wish to lose my superior knowledge…
_4338.CompletionSummary:
Report the situation so far... !
(Reporting…)
Hmm... is it so… that is serious…

_4339.Title: Ordinemon
_4339.Description:
You all heard it, right? A dimensional crack has appeared in the eastern part of Shinjuku (Night)!
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Thomas! Dispatch!
_4339.Objective: Move to Boulevard Talk with Thomas
_4339.CompletionSummary: Over there! There's a dimensional crack over there!

_4340.Title: Ordinemon
_4340.Description:
What? Digimon..! That Digimon is…?! Meicrackmon Vicious Mode!! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! be careful! It is very dangerous since it moves only with its destructive instinct!
If you look at the natural instinct alone, it can be said it is the cause of this series of incidents!! Stay upright and let's get rid of that Digimon!
_4340.CompletionSummary: Pant... pant... It calmed down now... @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, are you okay?

_4341.Title: Ordinemon
_4341.Description: Oh my~ Have you already beaten up like this? No, not yet~ no no no~
_4341.CompletionText: It's not fun if you fall down already~
_4341.CompletionSummary:
Now, Meicrackmon Vicious Mode... It's still too early to fall down here like this~
But this time since you retired like this, shall we step back today?
Hey~ Dats guys~ Then see you next time~? Bye~
_4341.ReservedText: Akihiro Kurata? Akihiro was the culprit behind all of this?

_4342.Title: Ordinemon
_4342.Description:
Akihiro Kurata is here... The situation is getting serious...
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, let's quickly go back to Dats Center and report to Commander Sampson... !
_4342.Objective: Move to Dats Center Talk with Richard Sampson
_4342.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Dats Center%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk with Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4342.CompletionText: Let's go back to Dats Center..!
_4342.CompletionSummary: You are back. Report everything step by step… !

_4343.Title: Ordinemon
_4343.Description:
This time, it's Odaiba.
Now, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Thomas! Dispatch! Go and catch Akihiro Kurata so that the case can be closed! Over!
_4343.Objective: Move to Odaiba Talk with Thomas
_4343.CompletionSummary: Over there! There's a dimensional crack over there, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! and Akihiro Kurata... !

_4344.Title: Ordinemon
_4344.Description:
Unbelievable… ! MirageGaogamon became infected... Why didn't I notice it... ! What's more, the Meicrackmon Vicious Mode evolved into Raguelmon...
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>… I know it's an unreasonable request, but... Stop Akihiro Kurata... ! And MirageGaogamon as well... !
_4344.CompletionSummary: Ohh~ Not bad, you were able to deal with these two... Let's step back at this point again... The time is ripe. Next time, I’ll prepare for something more fun. Let’s go, Raguelmon... !

_4345.Title: Ordinemon
_4345.Description:
Gaomon! Ugh... !
Thanks, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>… For saving Gaomon...
Let's go back to the Dats Center and report to the Commander…
_4345.Objective: Move to Dats Center Talk with Richard Sampson
_4345.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Dats Center%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk with Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4345.CompletionSummary: You are back! Report what happened there... !

_4346.Title: Ordinemon
_4346.Description:
Is it Minato City this tiem...
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I'm sorry, but since Gaomon’s condition is like that, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, You'll have to carry out the mission by yourself.
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, go to Minato City and stop Akihiro Kurata's conspiracy! Over!
_4346.Objective: Move to Minato City Talk with Ophanimon
_4346.CompletionSummary: You’ve finally came! I was waiting~!!

_4347.Title: Ordinemon
_4347.Description:
Ah~ It’s so noisy! You all need to get punished~
Raguelmon, that guy... Take care of him.
_4347.CompletionText: Don't tell me what to do!
_4347.CompletionSummary: Ohh~ Like before... You are not easy~?! It's fun~! It's fun~!

_4348.Title: Ordinemon
_4348.Description:
Ha ha ha ha ha! My identity? That doesn't matter~!! What will happen in the future! About the change that will happen in the future! You’d better be curious!
Raguelmon! Ophanimon Falldown Mode! Get more and more angry! Be more and more sorrowful! And!! Let madness take over your bodies!!!

_4349.Title: Ordinemon
_4349.Description:
Muhahahahaha!!! Ha ha ha ha ha!!!
Finally!! Finally!! It went according to my plan!! Ordinemon!!
Destroy everything!! This rotten garbage world!! Destroy them all!!
_4349.CompletionText: Go on rampage! Ordinemon!! Destroy all of this dirty world! Ordinemon!!!
_4349.CompletionSummary: Well, well… Is this the end…

_4350.Title: Ordinemon
_4350.Description: Kuhaha! I’m surprised you would interfere with my plan like this~ It is unexpected! Well, there must be such a hindrance, so when the plan is successful, the joy and fun are doubled…
_4350.CompletionText: Kekeke…I didn't think my plan would fail like this~! Kekekekekeke…
_4350.CompletionSummary:
What~ever~ Let's step back from here this time~ Who will we use next to destroy this trash world... ?
Daemon? Diablomon? Hahahaha!!

_4351.Title: Ordinemon
_4351.Description:
Thank you. Human... Thanks to you, I was able to forsake my evil mind. Thank you again.
It’s a little weird to say it’s a sign of gratitude, but let me give you this.
_4351.CompletionSummary:
It is a Digicore fragment of Raguelmon that was obtained through Jogress with Raguelmon. If you give this to Digimon with good technology, you will surely get data that will help you. So please accept it.
I'm going to go back to the Digital World. It's embarrassing... but if the news that I was kidnapped by someone spreads far away, bad things can happen to the digital world.
I'll go back now. Thank you so much for saving me. See you again...

_4352.Title: Ordinemon
_4352.Description:
Eh, this is Richard Sampson.
I heard the report that the mission was successful. Good job.
We have good news for you, so hurry back to Dats Center! Over!
_4352.Objective: Move to Dats Center Talk with Richard Sampson
_4352.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Dats Center%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk with Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4352.CompletionSummary: Glad you are back and safe. Well done.

_4353.Title: Ordinemon
_4353.Description:
