@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, make sure you go to Nanomon to get the vaccine and cure.
Your partner has been in contact with the infected Digimon the most, so hurry up!
_4353.CompletionText: I'm glad it's all over now…!
_4353.CompletionSummary: You are back. You heard the word form Richard Sampson?

_4354.Title: Ordinemon
_4354.Description:
Of course I have successfully developed the vaccine and cure. Take it, your partner is in danger. It's amazing that there are no signs of infection so far.
What? You have something for me? Give it to me. I’ll take a look.
Hm… this is Raguelmon’s digicore fragment… It even contains information from Jogress evolution… Strange…
Wait a moment, I’ll give you a gift.
_4354.Objective: Talk with Nanomon Raguelmon's Digicore Fragment
_4354.CompletionText: I knew it, you are so good at bringing fun data~
_4354.CompletionSummary:
All done. Take it. I processed some of the Digicore fragments of Raguelmon you brought.
If you give this data to Raguelmon, it will be able to evolve into Digimon you saw before. Of course, since the madness data has been removed, it will not lose its mind, so rest assured.
Why? Of course, I kept the evolution information intact.
There is nothing to be amazed. Because it is natural to do so!
Well, go ahead. I still have some data to analyze!

_4355.Title: [Ordinemon Event]
_4355.Description:
We have a report of a Digimon in despair, in Minato City.
I want you to go see the Digimon and stop it.
It's a dangerous area, so think carefully before you go.
_4355.Objective: Defeat <Despair>Ordinemon 1 time, which appears periodically in Minato City

_4356.Title: [Ordinemon Event]
_4356.Description:
Can you show me the relieved Ordinemon?
I'm alright now, but I'm hoping Ordinemon will calm down too.
_4356.Objective: Show Ordinemon as partnermon to Hikari
_4356.CompletionSummary:
Thank goodness.
It’s all Okay now.
Here, take this.

_4357.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4357.Description:
Greetings. I am Leomon.
I see many humans whose hearts have been unsettled by the onset of Spring.
What about you? Are you together with someone?
Would you tell Joe and Sora over there your status and accept their requests?
_4357.Objective: Talk to Leomon and inform him that you would accept their request
_4357.CompletionSummary: Understood. Take this with you and go to the human suitable for you.

_4358.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4358.Description:
Hello?
If you are with someone, could you help us couples?
_4358.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Sora%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2In possession of Pledge of Truth%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4358.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Mimi, T.K, and… Matt want help.

_4359.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4359.Description:
Hi,
Everybody is being that way, but I can't seem to feel the same.
I am lonely… If you are lonely like me, could you do something for me?
_4359.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Joe%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2In possession of Pledge of Truth%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4359.CompletionSummary: Thanks! In that case, help me and Taichi!

_4360.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4360.Description:
Hi there!
Hikari is struggling a lot recently because of a certain Digimon.
I want to prepare something for her, so I was wondering if you could help?
You can do so by bringing me flowers from Silver Lake and Silent Forest.
_4360.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Silever Lake, and Silent Forest to collect [Gift Flower] 30ea
_4360.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I hope this would cheer Hikari up.

_4361.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4361.Description:
I am lonely.. And so bored..
Could you bring me something to help me deal with this loneliness?
Last time I checked, there seemed to be just the right thing for me at Silver Lake and Silent Forest.
Could you bring it to me?
_4361.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Silever Lake, and Silent Forest to collect [Puppet for Playing by Oneself] 30ea
_4361.CompletionText: It's Spring but why is it cold..
_4361.CompletionSummary:
Thanks.
With this, I could keep boredom in check for a while.

_4362.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4362.Description:
Seriously!
Where did Izzy run off to! He seems to have gone to Digital World again.
Sigh.. Seems like he has forgotten our promise again.
Well, I did get a lot of help from him, so I want to be of help to him as well.
Could you get a battery for the laptop that Izzy carries around?
I would hate to lose contact with him.
_4362.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Lost Historic Site, and File Island WaterFront to collect [Laptop Battery] 30ea
_4362.CompletionText: Where is he off to now?
_4362.CompletionSummary:
Thanks!
With this, I will be able to stay in touch with him!

_4363.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4363.Description:
How lonesome…
Is there something to keep this lonely, isolated self mindlessly occupied?
_4363.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at Lost Historic Site, and File Island WaterFront to collect [Toy for Playing by Oneself] 30ea
_4363.CompletionText: Won't there be Spring in my heart too, someday?
_4363.CompletionSummary:
Thank you..
This will comfort me somewhat.

_4364.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4364.Description:
Hey there.
I am making a present for Sora but some ingredients are lacking. Could you help me with it?
I want to make a present that is undoubtedly better than the one made by Taichi over there.
The outcome is pretty much determined already though.
_4364.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at most area except Yokohama Village to collect [Matt's Gift Ingredient] 40ea
_4364.CompletionSummary:
Thank you.
Could you perhaps help me again tomorrow?

_4365.Title: [Couple and Single Event]
_4365.Description:
Hey there!
I want to give a present to Sora, wanna help?
Huh? Is that really a good idea? Why not!
Nothing wrong with giving a present!
_4365.Objective: Defeat evil Digimon at most area except Yokohama Village to collect [Taichi's Gift Ingredient] 40ea
_4365.CompletionSummary:
Huh? Cheer up?
Hm?
OK! Thanks!

_4366.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4366.Description: Hello, Tamer! Can you assist us in this season full of nature? We will really appreciate if you can help us today.
_4366.Objective: Tell <Tree Love>Rafflesimon that you will help
_4366.CompletionSummary: Open this and go to Palmon, and Palmon will guide you. Thank you again.

_4367.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4367.Description: Hello! Umm! Today's work is getting seedlings. It's very simple! You just have to collect [Tree Data] from the Silver Lake area!
_4367.Objective: Collect [Tree Data] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in Silver Lake area

_4368.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4368.Description: Hello! Umm! Today's work is to get quality soil. It is quite complicated! You have to collect [Soil of Beginning] from the Server Continent Desert area! Be careful! It is very dangerous out there!
_4368.Objective: Collect [Soil of Beginning] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in Server Continent Desert area
_4368.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Today's Task : Obtain Fertile Soil%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Soil of Beginning%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4368.CompletionSummary: Good job! Here, take this! I will reward you for the task completed if you collect more of these!

_4369.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4369.Description: Hmm! If you ask me what equipment you need for work…! It has to be the Red Latex Rubber Palm Coated Garden Gloves. You need a little something to make these, can you go to File Island Waterfront and collect some [Fish] for me? I need to exchange fish with garden gloves... Please?
_4369.Objective: Collect [Fish] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in File Island Waterfront
_4369.CompletionText: I think it's a good deal!

_4370.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4370.Description: Hello! Umm! Today's work is for nutrients. It's not difficult at all! Please collect [Ice] from Snowstorm Village, Snowman Village. I need a lot of ice to preserve the nutrients!
_4370.Objective: Collect [Ice] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in Snowstorm Village, Snowman Village
_4370.CompletionText: I can't move well in cold places…

_4371.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4371.Description: Hello! Can you help me with my personal request, not the request from Rafflesimon? I need seeds to make seedlings. You probably can get them from almost all areas. If you collect them for me, I will give you a rare plant!
_4371.Objective: Collect [Seed of Growth] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in almost all areas except Yokohama Village
_4371.CompletionSummary: Thank you! These are mysterious mugwort!

_4372.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4372.Summary: [Daily] Do you want the Seedling of Growth?
_4372.Description: There are a lot of ways to get Seedlings of Growth, but I can help. But first, I need materials to make wreath for Rafflesimon… Can you collect [Red Plant] from File Island area for me?
_4372.Objective: Collect [Red Plant] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in File Island area
_4372.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Here, take this seedling!

_4373.Title: [Plant Day Event]
_4373.Description: It may be a difficult request… but, I think I need some other plants besides the red plant to make the wreath look prettier. Can you please collect [Blue Plant] from Odaiba area?
_4373.Objective: Collect [Blue Plant] 30ea by defeating evil digimons in Odaiba area (except Camp Site)
_4373.CompletionSummary: Thank you! This will make it look prettier!

_4374.Title: [New Digimon Update Celebration]
_4374.Description: Rosemon X has joined the Digital World. Rosemon X wishes to battle against Tamers. Are you ready?
_4374.Objective: Use the [Rose Summon Card] at D-Terminal Summon Square. Defeat the summoned Rosemon X one time.
_4374.CompletionSummary: Well done. This is the reward for defeating Rosemon X.

_4375.Title: [Growth Box Event]
_4375.Description:
Mysterious objects are spotted in the real world and in the Digital World.
I am investigating these box-like objects.
Izzy and Nanomon, and I don’t know why but Piedmon is also interested in these objects.
Izzy said if you add certain Data to this box, it will change to something else.
I will give you some of these boxes. Try to change them.
_4375.Objective: Talk with the <Mysterious>White Bearded Guru> at Dats Center
_4375.CompletionSummary: I see. Well, when you obtain certain Data, come back to me with this box. It's up to you whether you will open it, or level it up.

_4376.Title: [Growth Box Event]
_4376.Description:
Hi, I am Izzy. I followed you after hearing about the White Bearded Guru and was too curious.
If you can bring me the objects that are found in the File Island area, I might be able to craft them into a certain Data.
If you need that Data, will you please accept my request?
_4376.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimon in Silver Lake, Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront. Collect [Mysterious Dust] 50ea
_4376.CompletionText: It shall be OK if it is at File Island area.
_4376.CompletionSummary: Thank you! If you need more, come back to me tomorrow.

_4377.Title: [Growth Box Event]
_4377.Description:
Huh! What do humans know!
Leave it to me!
I need those things found in the Odaiba area.
It may be difficult for you, human, but if you bring me those objects, I will help you.
_4377.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimon in Odaiba area (all) and collect [Mysterious Crystal] 30ea
_4377.CompletionSummary: Here! Take this! Come back tomorrow if necessary.

_4378.Title: [Growth Box Event]
_4378.Description:
Hello,
I Piedmon could not miss this, so I came here right away.
The objects I am investigating are in a letter form, and it is found everywhere except some areas.
You will be able to obtain them while going on adventures in other areas.
If you bring me those, I will make sure to reward you.
_4378.Objective: Defeat enemy Digimon in all areas except Yokohama Village and collect [Mysterious Letter] 60ea
_4378.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Do you wish to try the card game I have prepared with this?

_4379.Title: [Zhuqiaomon's Wrath Event]
_4379.Description:
Zhuqiaomon is trying to burn everything in the Lost Historic Site!
Can you calm down Zhuqiaomon’s wrath?
_4379.Objective: Defeat Zhuqiaomon in the Lost Historic Site - Disappears after 30 minutes - Reappears in 30 minutes after defeat/disappear

_4380.Title: [Moon Fest Event]
_4380.Summary: [Daily] How to get Moon Fest Coin : 1
_4380.Description:
You wish to get Moon Fest Coin?
I'll help you if you help me with my request!
You see, there are Digimons who interfere preparation of the Moon Fest.
I'll give you Moon Fest Coin if you punish the Digimons I tell you!
_4380.Objective: Defeat 20 each - RedVegiemon, Sabirdramon, Strikedramon, Pumpkinmon

_4381.Title: [Moon Fest Event]
_4381.Summary: [Daily] How to get Moon Fest Coin : 2
_4381.Description:
It is my duty to punish and change the attitude of Digimons that don't prepare for the Moon Fest reverently.
It's a tough job since there's only myself. Can you help me?
_4381.Objective: Collect [Traces of Deviation] 30ea from File Island Collect [Evidence of Reflection] 30ea from Server Continent
_4381.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Traces of Deviation%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Evidence of Reflection%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4382.Title: [Moon Fest Event]
_4382.Description:
It seems like some friends with broken hearts because they were alone for too long gathered together to do some bad things…
Can you go and see them to stop them from doing bad things?
_4382.CompletionSummary: Here! This will take you there.

_4383.Title: [Moon Fest Event]
_4383.Description:
Devimon became savage and is running wild!
It will be too dangerous to prepare for the Moon Fest like this…
If you can stop Devimon, I will make some of the things you need.
_4383.Objective: Defeat Devimon 1 time which appears in Snowstorm Village (Devimon will re-appear in 3 minutes after defeat)

_4384.Title: [Jogress Alphamon Ouryuken(X-Antibody)]
_4384.Description:
There's a new fight coming up, Culu. And I think you'll also need a new power, Culu.
Go and find Gallantmon X in Verdandi Terminal, who returned from thte Data Ocean, Culu.
_4384.Objective: Talk with Gallantmon X who will appear when progressing through the main quest in Verdandi Terminal

_4385.Title: [Jogress Alphamon Ouryuken(X-Antibody)]
_4385.Description:
As the Digital World is changing rapidly, a new power is needed to prevent Yggdrasil's rampage. However, I don't see the necessary power in your partner.
I don't know whose intention caused it, but it seems the power is applied to the DexDoruGreymon who exists here in the Verdandi Terminal.
If you collect the power form DexDoruGreymon, I think I can unleash the power of your partner.
_4385.Objective: Collect [Stabilized X-Antibody] 40ea by completing daily quest [Fragments of the Power]
_4385.CompletionSummary: With this, you will be able to unleash the original power your partner should have.

_4386.Title: [Jogress Alphamon Ouryuken(X-Antibody)]
_4386.Description:
Once you collect the power from DexDoruGreymon, I will work on fixing it so the power will go back to the original owner, your partner.
However, it will be in an unstable and dangerous state because it went through DexDoruGreymon. There is a limit on the amount I can process, so you need to be patient.
_4386.Objective: Defeat (Colossal)DexDoruGreymon who appears in Verdandi Terminal periodically

_4387.Title: [Jogress Alphamon Ouryuken(X-Antibody)]
_4387.Description: Take this and go back to Culumon. My work is done.
_4387.Objective: Take [Collected X-Antibody] and talk with Culumon at Dats Center
_4387.CompletionSummary:
Take this to Digitamamon, Culu! This won't be enough,
Check what else you need from Digitamamon, and if you bring those to him and ask him, he will help, Culu!
_4387.ReservedText:
Culu!
Gallantmon X helped a lot, Culu.

_4388.Title: Fanglongmon(Shin)
_4388.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! It's been a while~ Culu~ I was looking for you~ Culu~ I was told from Nanomon that if I see you @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, send you to him~ Culu~
So go ahead and go to Nanomon~ Culu~!
_4388.CompletionText: What is it? Culu? I don't know what Nanomon thinks..Culu...
_4388.CompletionSummary: You here now? You are as slow as Kamemon...

_4389.Title: Fanglongmon(Shin)
_4389.Description:
The reason I found you is because of your partner Fanglongmon.
I didn’t believe that Fanglongmon as a partner on your spec, but looking at Fanglongmon status, I thought it could be.
Because your Fanglongmon is not in perfect condition. You didn't noticed?
_4389.CompletionSummary:
I guess Fanglongmon didn't tell you...
Seeing what he haven’t told you yet Fanglongmon doesn't seem to trust you 100% yet.

_4390.Title: Fanglongmon(Shin)
_4390.Description:
Fanglongmon is a Digimon that has both Negative and Positive powers.
But your Fanglongmon has only positive power... That means that the negative power is still sealed by ancient angels, It is asleep in the depths of the digital world.
Don't you want your partner, Fanglongmon to be perfect? Then, go to Fanglongmon Dungeon!
There, you will find the negative power of Fanglongmon, sealed by an ancient angel!
_4390.CompletionSummary:
However, Fanglongmon's negative power is not unique to Fanglongmon. His subordinate 4 Holy Beasts also has the negative power of Fanglongmon. You must also recover the power of negative from them.
If you gather all the negative power from them I will blend the power well and give it to you.
Ah! I haven't told anything important yet! Ah! The kind of power to be fused can be found through my production list. Keep this in mind!
If your Fanglongmon gets the fused negative power he will be reborn in full shape.
Then go ahead! I will be preparing to fuse the negative powers!

_4391.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4391.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Long time no see~ Culu~ I was looking for you~ Culu~
'The reason why I looked @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> is… Because something is happened now~! Culu~!
I need your partner Digimon! Culu~!
_4391.CompletionText: Come on~ Culu~ We need to hurry~ Culu~!!
_4391.CompletionSummary: Hurry up, We need to go to the New Digital World~! Culu~! Digimons there are in great danger~! Culu~!

_4392.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4392.Description:
First, Let's move to the Verdandi Terminal in New Digital world~! Culu~!
I will tell you everything there~! Culu~!
_4392.Objective: Move to Verdandi Terminal Talk to Culumon
_4392.CompletionSummary: Thank you for coming with me~! Culu~! Arrived at the Verdandi Terminal, as promised, I will inform you of the situation.~! Culu~!

_4393.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4393.Description:
Our goal is to subdue the deviant Royal Knights and steal their X-anti body to strengthen Alphamon, so that it will never happen again! Culu~!!
First of all, we will get their X-antibody by defeating the DexDoruGreymon who are harassing the good Digimons.! Culu!!
DexDoruGreymons inhabit the lake at Verdandi Terminal~! Culu~! Let's defeats the DexDoruGreymons~! Culu~!!
_4393.CompletionSummary:
You've already defeated all the DexDoruGreymon?? Culu? Well done~! Culu~!
Digimons here will be safe now~ Culu~! And Alphamon must have gotten stronger~ Culu~!

_4394.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4394.Description:
The Digimon who stays here told me~ Culu~! It is said that there is a giant DexDoruGreymon that controls many DexDoruGreymon.~ Culu~!
We have to defeat that giant DexDoruGreymon, then the Digimons here will be safe.~ Culu~!
Let's defeat Giant DexDoruGreymons~! Culu~!
_4394.CompletionText:
Giant DexDoruGreymon is said to appear and disappear somewhere in the Verdandi Terminal~ Culu~!
It is said that it appears and disappears during a certain period, so be careful.~! Culu~!
_4394.CompletionSummary: Have you done it already?? Culu? Awesome~ Culu~!

_4395.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4395.Description:
The Digimon who stays here gave me another information~ Culu~!
There are Digimons that collect X-Anti Body using DexDoruGreymon.~ Culu~!
The name of Digimon who does this bad behavior is GranDracmon.~! Culu~! GranDracmon is said to be unable to meet because he usually does not reveal his body~ Culu~!
So we have to defeat GranDracmon's minions so that GranDracmon appears.~ Culu~!
Let's defeat GranDracmon minions Dracomon, Sangloupmon, and Matadormon.~! Culu~!
_4395.Objective: Defeat Dracmon Defeat Sangloupmon Defeat Matadormon
_4395.CompletionText: GranDracmon's power is enormous, so there will be a lot of minions....Culu… Good Luck~! Culu~!!
_4395.CompletionSummary: You've been defeating all of those minions... Really great~ Culu~!

_4396.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4396.Description:
Hoo hoo hoo... I'm looking forward to…
Well~ what are you waiting for!
Don't forget your opponent is GranDramon, who has absorbed tens of thousands of X-Anti Body.!!
_4396.CompletionText: I was disappointed that there was no place to test this power... That's good... !
_4396.CompletionSummary: Unbelievable… I have absorbed tens of thousands of X-antibodies...and defeated... So...powerful... What a great power of Alphamon... It was a force that I couldn't overcome…

_4397.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4397.Description:
A lot has happened in Digital World while you were away for humans.
While our Royal Knights are struggling to turn our world into a New Digital World! You were using that power for humans! Do you have a face to come back and reappear? Unbeliverble…
You were the most noble Digimon of our royal knights.… You were…
I Duftmon….I can not forgive you...! So ...For the first time... I will be against you. It will be different from before...! Be prepared!!
_4397.CompletionSummary:
Errk...Checkmate...
finally… It turned out like this... I will accept the results...
I will trust you one more time…
Oh, I'll let you know by thinking of one thing...
There are other Royal Knights besides me at this Verdandi Terminal.
You know, right? That they all act according to their own definition...
They used to listen to me, but they don't listen to me after I get the X-antibody.
Will you be able to curb these ones again as before... I will watch it at the Royal Base... then…

_4398.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4398.Description:
You defeat the Duftmon…! Thank you for your hard work.~! Culu~!
But as Duftmon said, we still have work to do.~! Culu~! I can feel the fear, fear, and anxiety of Digimon around here~! Culu~!
So let's go! Can't wait to go there~! Culu~!
_4398.Objective: Move to Forest of Jungle Law Talk to Culumon
_4398.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Forest of Jungle Law%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Culumon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4398.CompletionSummary: Here~! Culu~! I can feel the fear of the Digimons here~! Culu~!

_4399.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4399.Description:
I've always wanted to dominate the Real World… But Alphamon… I've been blocked by you many times…
But now it's different!!
I have been collected numerous X-Anti bodies by defeating the Digimons here. I would have surpassed you are now!!
Alphamon!! Be prepared!
_4399.CompletionSummary:
Unbelievable… Even after doing this... Ugh... Alphamon… Are you stopping me again...
I still don't know why you're spending your strength for humans… Certainly humans would also betray and use us... !
You will surely regret today… ! I will be watching at the Royal Base... the distorted look of yours...!

_4400.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4400.Description: Hmm… I thought who defeated Dynasmon... It was you... Alphamon… Well done... If I had met Dynasmon first, I would be the one who defeated Dynasmon… Only an inch to have a vacancy in Royal Knights …Hahaha~!
_4400.CompletionSummary:
By the way…Alphamon!
You've been throwing the Royal Knights and stayed in the real world... Isn't it shameless to reappear in Digital World to manage Royal Knights now?

_4401.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4401.Description:
Alphamon…! You who have neglected our Royal Knights do not deserve control of us!
That's why I'm here to take you down and become the true leader of the Royal Knights and lead the members!
So I, Craniummon! Now I am asking you to a duel Alphamon...!!!
I am not the one who I used to be! You must be very prepared!
_4401.CompletionSummary:
I guess you haven't been rusty yet... There is still not been seen in the disparity between you and I ....
I will clearly admit defeat and withdraw.

_4402.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4402.Description:
It's hard to fight the Royal Knights one after another~ Culu~!
I'm sorry, but no time to rest~ Culu~! Because I can hear someone asking for help around here.~ Culu~!
Let's go~ Culu~!
_4402.Objective: Go Forest Abandoned Mine Meet someone needs help
_4402.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go Forest Abandoned Mine%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Meet someone need help%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4402.CompletionSummary: It... was you…Alphamon… I was….. Was…. Waiting you…….

_4403.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4403.Description:
I tried to stop the brutality of Omegamon and the other Royal Knights, but... I wasn't able to work alone… I shouldn't have been hurt like this...
...Alphamon... Please accept this... This is my X-Anti Body... Only You Can Stop Omegamon... So.. Please use my X-Anti Body to block Omegamon...
_4403.CompletionSummary: You are the only one who can solve this situation.…Alphamon..… Please… Stop…. Omegamon….. Please stop my old friend…..

_4404.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4404.Description:
!!!
I can feel it! I can feel it!! Culu~! I hear Digimon's voice calling for help near here.~! Culu~!
Let's go there~! Culu~!
_4404.Objective: Move toWilderness Hill Talk to Omegamon X
_4404.CompletionText: Omegamon X must be stopped as long as Gallantmon X is asked to do this.~! Culu~!
_4404.CompletionSummary: Alphamon…! and…Human… Not a good combination….

_4405.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4405.Description:
Hahahahahaha!!
It's not your place! Alphamon!
When Digital World was in chaos, you were attached to human beings. There's nothing I can say.!!
If you want to stop me, go ahead! Alphamon! I will bring judgment with my sword so that you can never say that again.…!
_4405.CompletionSummary: Huh…I lost….? You blocked me again…Alphamon…

_4406.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4406.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Well done~ Culu~ Every Digimon in this room will appreciate @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>~ Culu~!
So, shall we go back to the Dats Center now?? Culu~?
_4406.CompletionSummary: You've gone through a lot.~Culu~! Thanks to you, peace has come to the new Digital World~ Culu~!!

_4407.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4407.Description:
One thing that I concern..Culu… That the Royal Knights can do the same thing in the future....Culu...
so! Alphamon should be stronger than it is now~ Culu~! Find Nanomon and he will give you a clear answer.~! Culu~!
_4407.CompletionSummary: Long time no see …What's going on?

_4408.Title: Alphamon: Ouryuken(Awaken)
_4408.Description:
What? Culumon sent you? Culumon said I could make your Alphamon stronger?
Well, Of course! I can do Everything and knows Everything!
When I checked Alphamon, he absorbed several Digimon X-Antibody. But...It was not 100% fused with Alphamon.
However, if I touch it a little, it can be used with other Digimon X-Antibody and Alphamon will be 100% fully fused.
Then I'll start the work right away.
_4408.CompletionSummary:
All done. Now your Alphamon is a completely different digimon.
If you see Alphamon's strength, you will know his physical ability, and My mighty skills!
Then go ahead... I want to take this opportunity to analyze more of the Alphamon data…!

_4409.Title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
_4409.Description:
Hello, I am Taomon, the fortune teller for the year of 2021. Are you curious of your luck today? If so, could you bring me the Torn Fortune-Teller's Fee? I will see to your luck then.
The Torn Fortune-Teller's Fee can be found by hunting Digimons in the Lost Historic Site. Good luck!
_4409.CompletionText: Did you bring the fortune-teller's fee?
_4409.CompletionSummary: Oh, thank you. Now go test your luck.

_4410.Title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
_4410.Description:
The acts I have committed over time… I'm ashamed of myself…
I've been reborn!! I, Impmon, have been completely rehabilitated!
It's said that at the Digimon Maze Entrance, my illusions of evil days are roaming.
Gather 50 Toy Guns from my wicked past. Also, can you bring me 50 New Year Diaries from the Digimons of Server Continent?
Thank you!
_4410.Objective: Gather 50 Toy Gun Gather 50 New Year Diary
_4410.CompletionText: I've been completely rehabilitated! I'm no longer the Impmon from before!
_4410.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much I've decided! I won't ever turn bad again! Maybe!? Phw… Stick with nothing?… Not going to be happen!

_4411.Title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
_4411.Description:
H..Hey… I'm Dats Agent Thomas… Can you please help me??
There is a Dats Agent with long hair who is extremely beautiful… I want to give her a special New Year's gift…
I want to giift her a new set of cosmetics to help her maintain her flawless skin even in the new year. Do you think you can help me gather the ingredients to make this?
Go to the Lost Historic Site and gather 'Honey' from Waspmon, 'Aloe' from Blossomon, and 'Herb' from Palmon!
If you do this for me I'll surely repay your generosity! Thank you~
_4411.Objective: Gather Honey Gather Aloe Gather Herb
_4411.CompletionText: You can find all the ingredients at the Lost Historic Site
_4411.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!! As a token of gratitude, I'll send you a small New Year's gift to you as well
Once you eat this, you will gain 50% of your ATT! However, if you gather 21 of these, I can exchange them for Pouch of New Year's Luck for you!
The Pouch of New Year's Luck… it will be more than what you expect~

_4412.Title: Move to Digital World!
_4412.Description:
Help me, Digital World is in crisis... I'm not alone, I need your help!
<Heavy weight in the Area>If you defeat Jagyamon, I will give you a good reward!
When tamers join forces and defeat 200 Makuramon in 4 Holy Beasts Area, Caturamon appears.
And if you defeat 5 Caturamon, you can call <Heavy weight in the Area> Jagyamon.
<Heavy weight in the Area> Defeat Jagyamon and I'll give you a small reward!
_4412.Objective: Defeat <Heavy weight in the Area> Jagamon at Four Holy Beasts Area
_4412.CompletionText: I wish the Digital World should be safe…
_4412.CompletionSummary: Thanks! I'm a little relieved thanks to you.

_4413.Title: Move to Digital World!
_4413.Description:
Uh... I'm really upset...!
Leomon, Jeri's partner Digimon... Leomon is gone.
Find and defeat the Digimon who defeated Leomon.
I heard that the Digimon that defeated Leomon appears in the Wasteland and Forest Area.
I will definitely take revenge!
_4413.CompletionSummary:
I took revenge, but why am I not relieved?
I thought it would end with revenge, but I knew that wasn't all...
Leomon and Jeri wouldn't even want it.
Thanks for accepting my request anyway.

_4414.Title: [Masters Match]
_4414.Description:
A long time ago, the chosen children had encountered Centalmon influenced by Black Cogwheel at the Lost Historic Site.
During this Masters Match period, we periodically asked Centalmon to recreate the situation at that time.
With Centalmon's consent, I will give a reward if you beat Centalmon at the Lost Historic Site.
_4414.Objective: Defeat <Masters Match> Centalmon Once from Lost Historic Site Regeneration Time: 30 mins : 30mins

_4415.Title: [Masters Match]
_4415.Description:
I asked Ogremon, who had fought numerous fights with me from File Island, to help test the Tamers during this period.
If you come after defeating Ogremon waiting for you in the Silent forest, I will give you a reward appropriate for it.
_4415.Objective: Defeat <Masters Match> Kuwagamon Once from Silver Lake Regeneration Time: 30 mins : 30mins
_4415.CompletionSummary: Is Ogremon okay? You must have suffered. Here it is.

_4416.Title: [Masters Match]
_4416.Description:
One of the greatest fears of the chosen children was the existence of Kuwagamon.
If you come back from the fight against Kuwagamon, who reminds you of the fear of that time in Silver Lake, we will give you the right reward.
_4416.Objective: Defeat <Masters Match> Kuwagamon Once from Silver Lake Regeneration Time: 30 mins : 30mins
_4416.CompletionSummary: Kuwagamon has always been in that role. Well done.

_4417.Title: [Masters Match]
_4417.Description:
Masters Match Mission: F is a mission for basic activities during the Masters Match period.
Most of the Monsters have been received [Masters Match: F].
If you collect [Masters Match: F] from them, we will give you a reward accordingly.
_4417.Objective: Collect 50ea of [F : Activity certificate] by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village
_4417.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect F : Activity certificate%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Hold Match Mission : F %qe %cc2/%mc2

_4418.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4418.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Long time no see~ Culu~ How have you been?
Uh~ What was it~…. Umm~ … … ...
Aha! Captain Richard Sampson called all the Dats members! Culu! Go ahead! Culu! Even today, he had a terrifying face! Culu~!
_4418.CompletionSummary:
Oh, It's you.
Wait a minute... Let's start talking when the crew gets together...!

_4419.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4419.Description: Hmm~ It's good that I won't be on the mission for a while... Having to do school homework, that's a little sad... Marcus said he didn't do any homework, How much homework did Thomas do?
_4419.CompletionSummary: Of course it was done perfectly... What about you guys?

_4420.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4420.Description:
Wh… ! what… ! does not make any sense… ! What an earth are you talking about!!??
I disagree with this opinion!!
_4420.CompletionSummary:
Of course, the homework itself will not be finished that easily because it is hardly found in the real world... Also, it's kinda hard to take things from the digital world to the real world...
Hmm... what should we do...?

_4421.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4421.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!! Let's go Together! Let's do the Homework Passionately!
_4421.CompletionSummary: Then, let's do that... I've done my homework anyway, so I'll be left out of these troublesome things.

_4422.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4422.Description:
I can't help it... I'll go with you... It makes me very uncomfortable to send only you two to the Digital world... I think have to watch over to make sure it doesn't do anything weird...
If there is anything similar to insects and plants in the real world, we can also collect them too...
Let's go to the Digital world, guys... !
_4422.Objective: Move to Lost Historic Site Talk to Yoshino
_4422.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Lost Historic Site%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Yoshino%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4422.CompletionSummary: We end up in the digital world, What should we do now? Can I just walk around and collect insects and plants?

_4423.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4423.Description:
Hmm... Guys~ I thought about it a bit, but first of all, it is easier to collect plants than insects, so let's start collecting plants.
Fortunately, there seems to be a lot of flowers and plants around here to collect. Let's try to gather plants that look like they would be in the real world after being scattered and see them again.
Digimons may appear suddenly, so be careful!
_4423.Objective: Collect Yellow Tropical Plant Collect Red Tropical Plant Collect Purple Tropical Plant
_4423.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Yellow Tropical Plant%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Red Tropical Plant%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Purple Tropical Plant%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4423.CompletionSummary: Everyone has been collecting well. I have collected this and that, but I don't know if there are plants similar to these plants in the real world... "

_4424.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4424.Description:
Wait!! you!! Human?
Why are humans coming to this place to harass the lovely plants?
_4424.CompletionSummary: Yes! You humans! Why are you doing this nasty thing?

_4425.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4425.Description:
Ah-ha! You guys are one with them too! We'll punish the bad guys who harm the plants!!
We protect this place!

_4426.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4426.Description:
Thank you so much for helping me~! Obviously, Queen Rafflesimon would thank you too!
Currently, Queen Rafflesimon is in a place called Silver Lake~ We will guide you safely~
_4426.CompletionSummary: Ha... my head hurts... can't help it... Let's go... guys…
_4426.ReservedText: I think something interesting is going to happen! Let's go!

_4427.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4427.Description: Hey, guys~ This is the mighty Queen, Rafflesimon~

_4428.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4428.Description:
Everyone… First of all, please stop the insect Digimons from harming the forest. They were close to us before. But suddenly...
Please help us to live in peace again without damaging the forest we love.

_4429.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4429.Description:
Oh! Look over there! It's Waspmon and Dokugumon!! Those guys... They were violent guys, but still It didn't hurt the forest...
Guys~ Please!! Stop harming the forest by scolding Waspmon and Dokugumon!!
_4429.CompletionSummary: Of course...you guys are really strong~! Thanks~!! For stopping Waspmon and Dokugumon from doing bad things!!

_4430.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4430.Description:
So... you are the one who hurting our dear subordinates...?
How dare the Human... I won't let you go!! Be prepared!
_4430.Objective: Defeat CannonBeemon Defeat TigerVespamon Defeat Parasimon

_4431.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4431.Description:
Well, you guys will become Digimon eggs soon, If you become a Digimon egg while wondering, that'll be a pity, so let me tell you...
One day, mechanical Digimons came and said this…
If I help create a huge factory complex after destroying the forest here, By overseeing the place, he promised to give me the power to control the surrounding areas of the factory... Hahaha...
What do you think? Isn't that a very attractive offer?? I know that Rafflesimon will die soon, so I betrayed you because I wanted to be this time... haha...
All questions answered now? Then let me destroy you and your friends now...!
_4431.CompletionSummary: This... can't be...! I will be the king of this area... To these human rooks... Ahhh... !

_4432.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4432.Description:
Wow…you guys are amazing…!! You defeate 'that' strong TyrantKabuterimon... ! It's really great.. great!!
I have to inform Queen Rafflesimon about this good thing as soon as possible!! Let's hurry up and go to the Silver Lake!!
_4432.Objective: Move to Silver lake Talk to Rafflesimon
_4432.CompletionSummary: Your back… looks like things have worked out…

_4433.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4433.Description:
Because Rafflesimon says it feels bad I also suddenly feel anxious...
I hope this anxious feeling ends with just feeling...
_4433.CompletionSummary:
Hu…I think that my bad feelings disappear like snow melting… I don't think I need to worry about you anymore...
Then hope you go home safely...! And I wish you only good things…!
_4433.ReservedText: Don't worry too much! Even if something bad happens, just defeat it like a man and finish it!

_4434.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4434.Description: Welcome back! Oh! It's a mechanical Digimon...! No, why is Digimon in this place?? As expected, Rafflesimon feeling was right!! First, let's get rid of those Digimons and think about what to do!
_4434.CompletionSummary: It seems that all the mechanical Digimons around here have been destroyed... Yoshino! What should I do now?

_4435.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4435.Description: It's here! Be careful, everyone!! We never know what Akihiro Kurata did again!!
_4435.CompletionSummary:
Krrrrrrk…! Dats!! Distrub again~!!
That kinda bring bad memories!!!

_4436.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4436.Description:
Hahaha!!! I know that you cheeky Dats guys will interfere, so I have prepared a number of treasures!!
Show me the power of the mechanical Digimon who follow my mighty words!! Come out!! Chaosdramon!!
Show your strength to those desperate Dats! Hahaha!!
_4436.Objective: Defeat Chaosdramon Defeat Gizumon XT Defeat Gizumon AT
_4436.CompletionSummary: Krrrrrk...! That guy!! To the end! To the end! To the end!!! You are disturbing me!! This time I go back like this!! It won't be like this next time!! Be prepared! Ha ha ha ha ha!!

_4437.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4437.Description:
I missed Akihiro Kurata again...!! He runs really well!!
Seems like to be finished soon?
_4437.Objective: Move to Silver Lake Talk to Marcus
_4437.CompletionSummary: You are back... When I look at my face, it looks like there's something unexpected... Is that right… ?
_4437.ReservedText: Yea... I'm sorry we missed Akihiro Kurata, but can't help it because I have already run away... Let's go back to the digital world and let Rafflesimon know this.

_4438.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4438.Description:
Wow~ How did you know??
I found a guy trying to destroy this forest... Unfortunately, I missed it... Sorry… Still, since all the mechanical Digimons that helped him have been destroyed, will this forest be safe now...?
_4438.CompletionSummary:
Wouldn't it be? I think this forest will be safe for the time being because you have made such efforts. After that, it's up to us, so don't worry.
Hmm… Looks like the time is up now…
In return for helping us, let's give my Digicore... Although it is a Digicore that contains my data that is going to be short like this, if you have it, I think it can be helpful to you. Please accept it.
Although it was a short relationship, I was able to feel a little more happiness and joy to meet you. Thank you.
Palmon, Floramon... please give them prepared thing...
Then bye...

_4439.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4439.Description: Weep Weep... Here, take it... You guys came here to get this, right?...
_4439.CompletionSummary: Did you say homework???? That's it... Queen Rafflesimon took care of it... you better take this...sob...sob…

_4440.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4440.Description: I see… Thank you for giving this to me... I'll use it well!!
_4440.CompletionSummary: Okay… sob…sob… Take care~ Thank you very much~~ I will never forget your help…!!

_4441.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4441.Description:
Hmm…? What's going on? A Digimon reaction just appeared at the refinery and then suddenly disappeared. I'm busy investigating it.
If it's not urgent, talk to me later!
_4441.CompletionSummary:
"Hmm... Was it Akihiro Kurata...
You didn't intend, but you did a great job! Good!
Go home early today! Dismiss!
_4441.ReservedText:
I'm going to tell you about that case. So what happens...
(Like this, like that)
Akihiro Kurata appeared and played an opponent, but eventually ran away.

_4442.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4442.Description:
What about Rafflesimon's Digicore?
If you show this to Captain Richard Sampson, you will know that we went to the digital world secretly…
_4442.Objective: Talk to Yoshino Talk to White-bearded Guru
_4442.CompletionSummary: It's been a long time~ Looking at the expression, it seems that you are having some trouble…
_4442.ReservedText: Let's go to White-bearded Guru. He will know what to do.

_4443.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4443.Description:
Hmm…I see… That happens...
Oh... This Digicore... It's a very precious Digimon's Digicore... Did you just said Rafflesimon?? Um~ Yeah... ! I remember...! It's very hard to see, so it's a Digimon called 'miracle flower'... I wonder how you meet her...
When it comes to Digicore, why don't you go to Nanomon rather than me...? I think Nanomon will give you a cool idea of ??what to do with this Digicore...
_4443.CompletionSummary: What is it? What else are you going to ask for?

_4444.Title: Jogress[Rafflesimon]
_4444.Description:
Is this the Rafflesimon's Digicore? How can this precious thing...
What?? Can I bring Rafflesimon back to life with this Digicore?
No matter how many times I try, I cannot bring back the dead Digimon... But I can use this Digicore to create data that can evolve into Rafflesimon...!
Okay, let me shine my equipment! I am ready!
_4444.CompletionSummary:
Okay, done. Rafflesimon's Digicore was processed to create data that could evolve into Rafflesimon.
There is a caveat in using this data. In short, this data should only be used for plant-type Digimon.
If you keep this in mind and use it well You will be able to meet Rafflesimon, who can be active longer than the existing Rafflesimon.
Then, leave me alone. I want to analyze more about Rafflesimon...!

_4445.Title: [Cookie Master]
_4445.Description:
Hi!
I got a Chance that I can show off my baking talent in this Christmas!
But… there are some times that I have to leave the place during the baking…
And most of the time I leave, some of the cookies disappeared.
So I want to make a bait to lead the thief, and there is a rumer that some digimon has the materials.
Can you negotiate with them? I will make a bait for you!
_4445.Objective: Defeat Dokunemon(Leader) at Silver Lake Defeat Candlemon(Leader) at Western Vil. Defeat Icemon(Leader) at Snowstorm Vil.
_4445.CompletionSummary: Here you go! You may use this at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.

_4446.Title: [New Digimon Event]
_4446.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I detected Digimon. Appeared Digimon is Vikaralamon. Before this guy makes a scene, we need to stop him! Move to Stadium!

_4447.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4447.Description: Welcome to the Digimon Masters Online 9th birthday festival
_4447.Objective: <9th Year> Announce that you will participate in the 9th Birthday celebration on a birthday cake
_4447.CompletionSummary: Thank you! You can enjoy 9th birthday festival for now on!
_4447.ReservedText: Would you like to join the 9th birthday Festival?

_4448.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4448.Summary: Thank you for joining the Festa!
_4448.Description:
Thank you for enjoying Digimon Masters' 9th birthday!
Thank you for loving Digimon Masters, and would you like to receive a gift prepared by Dats Center?
_4448.CompletionSummary:
I will give you this.
We look forward to your continued love.

_4449.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4449.Description: We will be grateful if you gather one of four badges by helping <Eat>Jijimon who prepared foods.
_4449.Objective: Collect [Festival Chef] and help the <Eat>Jijimon to preparing Food for festival from Dats Center
_4449.CompletionSummary:
Thank you very much!
If you can help us prepare all four, we have a special reward awaiting you.

_4450.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4450.Description: We will be grateful if you gather one of four badges by helping <Drink>Babamon Who prepared drinks
_4450.Objective: Collect [Festival Barista] and help the <Drink>Babamon to preparing Drink for festival at Dats Center
_4450.CompletionSummary:
Thank you very much!
If you can help us prepare all four, we have a special reward awaiting you.

_4451.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4451.Summary: Fun Stuff to complete the festival
_4451.Description: We will be grateful if you gather one of four badges by helping <Dance>Chuchidarumon Who prepared a fun stuff.
_4451.Objective: Collect [Festival Dancer] and help the <Dance>Chuchidarumon to preparing fun stuff for festival at Dats Center
_4451.CompletionSummary:
Thank you very much!
If you can help us prepare all four, we have a special reward awaiting you.

_4452.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4452.Description: We will be grateful if you gather one of four badges by helping <Enjoy> Yukidarumon Who prepared a music
_4452.Objective: Collect [Festival Musician] and help the <Enjoy>Yukidarumon to preparing music for festival at Dats Center
_4452.CompletionSummary:
Thank you very much!
If you can help us prepare all four, we have a special reward awaiting you.

_4453.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4453.Description: We are giving one more [9th Year B.D Festa Coin] to Tamers who have helped a lot in preparing for the 9th birthday festival. Would you like to receive it?
_4453.Objective: <9th Year> Let the Cake knows that you will receive 1 more [9th B.D Festival Coin]
_4453.CompletionSummary:
Here you go!
All the best!

_4454.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4454.Description:
Welcome! I'm a Jijimon preparing food for this world's 9th birthday celebration.
Since more people and Digimons are coming than I thought, the food I prepared seems to be hanging by a thread
Would you like to join me in preparing the dishes?
Spice is in western Areas except for western villages, Ingredients are available from the Oil Factory Areas.
_4454.Objective: Collect [Spice of Digital World] at Western Areas except Western Village Collect [Real world ingredients] at Oil refinery
_4454.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Spice of Digital World%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Real world ingredients%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4454.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I hope you continue to help during the festival!

_4455.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4455.Description:
Noooo! If there is nothing to drink at the festival, it will be the saddest thing!
I think you already heard from the Jijimon next door, but thankfully, too many people come to the festival to prepare, but the ingredients are too short!
Help me!
I need materials from the Glacier Area and the File Island area!
_4455.Objective: Collect [Clear Water] by defeat Monsters at Glacier Area Collect [Tasty Fruit] by defeat Monsters at File Island Areas
_4455.CompletionSummary:
'Thank you very much!
I hope you help tomorrow too!

_4456.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4456.Summary: The excitement is broken, so take responsibility
_4456.Description:
Hello.
I am Chuchidarumon in charge of dancing at this 9th birthday festival.
Digimons who were not invited to this festival is said to be preparing a shocking dance to break the excitement of this festival. Could you hanging out with them and scold them a bit?
_4456.Objective: Talk to <Dance> Chuchidarumon that you're going to match the dance they've prepared and scold them.
_4456.CompletionSummary:
I'll give you this.
With this, I can send it to the ballroom they invited.
_4456.ReservedText:
It could be shocking...
But if you're okay!

_4457.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4457.Description:
Welcome.
This is where they dance.
I have an invitation from them.
If you use this invitation, one of the Digimon will show up.
They are never being friendly before, so please be careful.
Would you like to receive this invitation?
_4457.Objective: Talk to <Dance>Chuchidarumon in Ballroom of Sin to inform them that you will receive [Invitation of Wrath]
_4457.CompletionSummary: If you scold one Digimon, you will be able to get an invitation from another Digimon.

_4458.Title: [Year 9 Festa Event]
_4458.Description:
Hi!
I am Yukidarumon who is in charge of music at this festival.
However, the stuff I prepared hard for the music at this festival... half of it became dust by Tanemon.
It is said that it appears periodically in a Silent forest... It requires the strength of many tamers to know what he ate.
What did he take to make only half of it into dust? Please scold him a little, I will repay you.
_4458.Objective: Defeat <Inevitable existence> Tanemon at Silent Forest
_4458.CompletionSummary:
This... Why is it here...?
Well... Thank you very much! I'm worried that Tanemon will do that again tomorrow.

_4459.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4459.Description:
My love doll family Pumpkinss are so cute friends.
But... Some Bad Digimons tore the part of Pumpkinss to pieces.. As if they revenged for being smashed at me.
First of all, can you find the 3 parts of my friend?
Head, left leg, right leg.
_4459.Objective: Collect the Materials by [Pumpkin Doll Pouch]. Pouch can be obtained by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama.
_4459.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Right Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Left Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Pumpkin Head%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4459.CompletionSummary: Yeeeeessssss!! My Pumpkinss!!! Thank you! I will fix you right away, Pumpkinss!

_4460.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4460.Description:
Because of the cuteness of my Pumpkinss, other Digimons asked me to shake Pumpkinss hands so I let them do it... Among them, the bad Digimon ripped off their right arms.
Can you get the Pumpkinss right arms back from them?
Please…
_4460.Objective: Collect the Materials by [Pumpkin Doll Pouch]. Pouch can be obtained by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama.
_4460.CompletionSummary: Yeeeeessssss!! My Pumpkinss!!! Thank you! I will fix you right away, Pumpkinss!

_4461.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4461.Description:
Pumpkinss have a cute body, but above all, the green cape is the charming point.
Not surprisingly... There were some Digimon who coveted it and stole it.
You know what I'm talking about, right?
If you find the cape and other parts, I'll give you a special gift.
_4461.Objective: Collect the Materials by [Pumpkin Doll Pouch]. Pouch can be obtained by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama.
_4461.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Right Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Left Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3호박 망토%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4461.CompletionSummary: Yeeeeessssss!! My Pumpkinss!!! Thank you! I will fix you right away, Pumpkinss!

_4462.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4462.Description:
Pumpkinss' heart is hotter and more affectionate than anyone else. The source comes from the heart.
That heart is probably owned by other Digimons.
Look for other parts and find the heart as well!
_4462.Objective: Collect the Materials by [Pumpkin Doll Pouch]. Pouch can be obtained by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama.
_4462.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Right Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Left Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Pumpkin Heart%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4462.CompletionSummary: Yeeeeessssss!! My Pumpkinss!!! Thank you! I will fix you right away, Pumpkinss!

_4463.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4463.Description:
You know all the parts of the Pumpkinss are scattered.
Besides, the left arm has to be specially made.
If you help me to remake Pumpkinss and find all the parts
I'll give you a special... really special gift!
_4463.Objective: Collect the Materials by [Pumpkin Doll Pouch]. Pouch can be obtained by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama.
_4463.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Right Arm of Pumpkin%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Left Arm of Pumpkin%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Right Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc3/%mc3 '%qs4Left Leg of Pumpkin%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Pumpkin Head%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4463.CompletionSummary: Yeeeeessssss!! My Pumpkinss!!! Thank you! I will fix you right away, Pumpkinss!

_4464.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4464.Description: The left arm.. is... Hmm! Pumpkinmon took it! Defeat him and you'll find the left arm! You can do it right?
_4464.Objective: Defeat <Old Generation> Pumpkinmon at Silent Forest
_4464.CompletionSummary: Good! You defeat him. Hoohoo... Now, the left arm...

_4465.Title: [Halloween Event]
_4465.Description:
Hoo... That damping Wizardmon... Still have a doll.
Well! Come on, friend. You know how I feel.
He said that the dread and painted guy is a great wizard, but I can't stand it because I'm below him.
Now, friend. Can you help me? Find the SpellBooks scattered throughout the Digital World. Then... I'll regenerate that guy.
_4465.Objective: Collect [Ripped SpellBook] by defeating Monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village
_4465.CompletionSummary: Oh-oh!! You finally got it! Take this coin. Go and challenge.

_4466.Title: [Returned Bancho Disciple]
_4466.Description:
Hello. Long time no see!
Thank you for punishing the executioners who harassed me. They descended, leaving only me and the alumni. So, I expected a peaceful life, but the seniors were not the only thing that bothered me. There were more Digimons who bothered me..
There are more Digimon that bother me if I try to rest my tired body on the weekend. They think I'm a troublemaker Digimon because I made a fuss about something I shouldn't have done last time. Could you help me one more time?
_4466.Objective: <Banchou Disciple> Announced that you would help by talking to Leomon
_4466.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now I can send you to
_4466.ReservedText: As expected...I knew that you would help me..!

_4467.Title: [Beelzebumon X Event]
_4467.Description: Beelzebumon X! Finally in this world... Looking at your partner Digimon, I want to give you a present…
_4467.CompletionSummary: Take this. This belongs to you.

_4468.Title: [Beelzebumon X Event]
_4468.Description:
BeelzebumonX, one of the seven great demon kings, has finally come to this world.
Can you really fight against Beelzebumon X with your strength?
I will admit it if I win the fight against the illusion of Beelzebumon X I made.
_4468.Objective: Defeat <Illusion> Beelzebumon X by using [Illusion Summon Card] at Underground Summon Square.
_4468.CompletionSummary: at least you can handle the basic.

_4469.Title: [Thanksgiving Day Event]
_4469.Description:
Hello! I am Turuiemon who grinds the ingredients!
Working on grinding is hard, but it relieves stress. But, I have failed to control my strength because I am very stressed these days.
The millstone has been smashed... Can you get me the material to make it again?
_4469.Objective: Collect 40 ea of [Solid Wood] by defeating Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village
_4469.CompletionText: I have a lot of stress these days…
_4469.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I think I can grind well for about a day!

_4470.Title: [Thanksgiving Day Event]
_4470.Description:
When I make food, I think the taste, visual, must be guaranteed, and the appetizing aroma is important.
This year, I decided to do the turkey, but I don't have enough pepper to add flavor to the meat.
It is said that there are a lot of decent peppercorns in the File Island area. Can you get it for me for the ultimate flavor of the roast turkey?
_4470.Objective: Collect 30 ea of [Fine Pepper] by defeating Monsters at Silver Lake, Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront
_4470.CompletionText: Whoo... I will make a taste that you don't know even if one dies while eating.
_4470.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. Please take this as a return.

_4471.Title: [Thanksgiving Day Event]
_4471.Description:
The reason I smashed the millstone under stress...
It's because of Turuiemon, who runs away to be comfortable on his own whenever he's always busy.
If you bring him to me through an appropriate 'conversation', I will definitely reward you.
_4471.Objective: Defeat <The Fugitive> Turuiemon who appears at Silent Forest in 07:00, 22:00 everyday
_4471.CompletionText: There's a lot of work to do including baking the pie…
_4471.CompletionSummary: I don't know when I will run again but thank you. This is the last thing the Turuiemon had. If you collect several of it, I will exchange it for other items.

_4472.Title: [MASK Event]
_4472.Description:
Welcome.
The virus that circulated in the digital world and in the real world seemed to be over, and then it reached a dangerous level again.
We've been trying to end this situation as much as possible behind the scenes, but as it continues for a long time, we are seeing tired people... It can happen and already expected.
Could you do some work on behalf of the person taking a break?
_4472.Objective: Talk with Dr.Yoshima to inform him that you will help
_4472.CompletionSummary: Thank you. If you have the certificate in here, you can hear from Kamemon next door what to do.

_4473.Title: [MASK Event]
_4473.Description:
I would like you to provide masks to those who are always working in the Dats Center. I couldn't get away... I don't have a time even for toilet break...
After wearing it well for a while, I wonder if you felt relaxed... I saw you weren't wearing a mask well.
We would appreciate it if you could give it one more time emphasizing the importance of the mask.
_4473.Objective: Use [Mask : Entry model] to Miki, Mary, Megumi, Dr. Kevin Krier, and Doruphin at Dats Center
_4473.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver to Miki%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver to Mary%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Deliver to Megumi%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Deliver to Dr.Kevin Krier%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Deliver to Doruphin%qe %cc5/%mc5

_4474.Title: [MASK Event]
_4474.Description:
It seems that the Dats Center will be fine now.
However, it is now a stage of concern about inflow from outside.
Many Tamers visit various places and come to the Dats Center, but it is believed that they can carry the virus from outside.
It's okay because the virus doesn't affect Digimon at all, but it can be spread by contact with Tamers.
We would be grateful if you could 'collect' the virus hidden from Digimons in the outside area.
_4474.Objective: Collect 40 ea of [Hidden Virus] by defeating Monsters at All area except Yokohama Village
_4474.CompletionSummary: Thank you. For the time being, I think we will continue to do this.

_4475.Title: [MASK Event]
_4475.Summary: If there are 5 humans gathered, surely...
_4475.Description:
Now it seems to have regained some stability. However... a bad situation has been reported...
There has been a case where items we have sent to support other regions have been stolen for their own benefit. They tracked down and arrested the criminals who had been stolen, but they sprinkled things so that they could not prove their sins.
According to the history, I went to the Pile Island area, the server continent area, the Odaiba area, and the Verdandy Terminal.
I would like to ask you to collect the items scattered there.
_4475.Objective: Collect 50 ea of [Embezzlement stuff] by defeating Monsters at File Island, Server Continent, Odaiba, Verdandi Terminal areas.
_4475.CompletionText: When there are 5 people, there must be something... It was true.
_4475.CompletionSummary: Thank you. It looks like this will deliver it back to areas in need.

_4476.Title: Kaiser's Laboratory
_4476.Description: Do you want to go into the deepest part of my lab? If you want, I will give you a chance to experience my lab.
_4476.Objective: Inform Digimon Kaiser that you want to enter Kaiser's laboratory [H]

_4477.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4477.Summary: [Daily] To get into the depths of
_4477.Description: There are things you need to get into Kaiser's lab [H]. There are only two things I can get in a day. Is it necessary?
_4477.Objective: Talk to <Jogress Quest> Leomon and let him know you need it
_4477.CompletionSummary: Here it is. I'll get 2 more by tomorrow.

_4478.Title: Chaosmon Event
_4478.Description:
My name is Chaosmon! No need to explain more under this name… Because I'm a style that acts rather than words. Probably the influence of the guy in my right hand...
Anyway!
If you want to know about me, you will have to compete with me! If you want to battle with me, come to the Underground Summon Square!
_4478.Objective: Defeat Chaosmon at Underground Summon Square
_4478.CompletionText:
I may be a difficult opponent to you.
You'll have to use powerful skills to make it even better!
_4478.CompletionSummary: It was a magnificent Battle! I will present the certificate of winning me!

_4479.Title: [Dream of Pigeon Event]
_4479.Description: Good! Thank you, I think I can go back this time for sure!
_4479.Objective: Tell the <Injured> Pigeon that you are perfectly prepared with [Pigeon's Happy Dream]!
_4479.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Pigeon's Happy Dreams%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk again to Pigeon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4479.CompletionSummary: So... goodbye for sure this time!
_4479.ReservedText:
Alright, it's my time!
You better not cry!

_4480.Title: [Dream of Pigeon Event]
_4480.Description:
I must have been... proud to myself too much... no! I'm not saying I can't fly! There was some of mistake in trying to fly! The insurance company told me why the accident happened, but it said that the material to make the wings was poor... As an additional comment, he said that it would be possible with materials available from Server Continent.
Just one more time... can you help me?
I believe I can fly!
_4480.Objective: Collect 30 of [White Fur] by defeating Monsters at Server Continent Areas.
_4480.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! I think we need all 6 of them!

_4481.Title: [Dream of Pigeon Event]
_4481.Objective: Tell the <Dreaming> Pigeon that you are ready... with [ Pigeon's Anxiety Dream]
_4481.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Pigeon's Anxiety Dream%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Pigeon No.2%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4482.Title: [Dream of Pigeon Event]
_4482.Description:
Hello.
My name is Pigeon No.3, Pigeon No.2's younger brother. My brother recently said he wants to fly back to where our kinds are. He asked the Tamers to gather what we needed to fly...
A part of flying, but I am more worried about when things go wrong. If you look at us, you know...flying... Hmm!
I am worried that my brother will be in an accident.
I think there must be something that the our kind in the land could have arrived safely.
Could you please get them?
_4482.Objective: Collect 30 of [Senior Penguin's stuff] by defeating Monsters at Glacier Area

_4483.Title: [Dream of Pigeon Event]
_4483.Description:
Hello! Nice to meet you, I'm Pigeon.
I didn't know because I grew up here with my younger brother, Pigeon No.3.. I heard that there are places where my kind live and our families are.
But it's too dangerous to go through the sea to that place, so I try to fly away.
Huh? Can't I fly?
...
Who says that!
I can fly too!
Of course there is something to prepare, but...
Would you like to help me?
_4483.Objective: Collect 30 of [Black Fur] by defeating Monsters at File Island Areas.

_4484.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4484.Description: A thing that can't happen' happened in the western part, Culu! The investigation team started, but something serious seems to have happened., Culu! Can you go to the Western Area!? Culu!
_4484.Objective: Finding the researcher team departing for the western Area.
_4484.CompletionText: Culu…Go to Western Area. Hurry. Culu.

_4485.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4485.Description: I barely arrived in the western village where I was supposed to assemble in an emergency as determined in advance... The other members of the Corps have yet to hear what happened... Find the scattered researchers.
_4485.Objective: Find members of the research team scattered in Western Area: Outskirts
_4485.CompletionText: “There may be someone outside in the Western Area: Outskirts. Please be safe... "

_4486.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4486.Description: We need to find out the cause of this.' 'There must be some clues in this area.' 'Let's look for the missing items of Leomon.'
_4486.Objective: Obtain [???] by using [Leomon's stuff]. [stuff] can be obtain monsters at Western Area:Outskirts. Checking Leomon's death sign
_4486.CompletionText: Pity… ' 'There may be a clue to the Digimons around here.'
_4486.CompletionSummary: 'It seems to have found the cause of death.'
_4486.ReservedText: 'Some sticky stuff attached here and there.'

_4487.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4487.Description: I think he was hit by Digimon, who made the spider web.' 'If you look at the direction of Leomon's fall and the wound, the Digimon will be on the opposite side of the direction he fell.' 'That Digimon couldn't have gone far, seeing that Leomon also had traces of battle.'
_4487.Objective: Defeat the perpetrators who harmed Leomon outside the western village. Deliver news to Lemon in Western Village after defeat.
_4487.CompletionText: ……' 'Criminal will be in the opposite direction from where Leomon fell.'"
_4487.ReservedText: How come that kind of thing happened…

_4488.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4488.Description:
The first place we were attacked was the Western Area: East. Except for the deceased Leomon, the research team has the captain BanchouLeomon and other Leomon and CommanDramon.
If there were only Leomon on the Western Area : Outskirts, it would still be possible to remain in the Western Area : East. I don't know why, but I think the probability is very high.
Find them at Western Village East area.
_4488.Objective: Find other research teams in the Western Village: East
_4488.CompletionText: Must be in Western Area: East. Please be safe…
_4488.CompletionSummary: Sorry, we need your Help. Welcome.

_4489.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4489.Description:
Leomon has arrived in Western Village?... Good.
As you can see, there was an injured person and couldn't move. You came while I was wondering what to do. I can't do anything to protect the injured Leomon, and the CommanDramonis terrified and anxious.
Won't you help Leomon recover from the injury?
_4489.Objective: Collect 40 of [Healing Disk Data] by defeating monsters at Western Area : East
_4489.CompletionText: To cure Leomon, I need [Healing Disk Data] from Digimons around here. Please.

_4490.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4490.Objective: Use 5 of [Emergency Healing Disk] to injured Leomon
_4490.CompletionText: Please use this [Emergency Healing Disk] to Leomon.
_4490.CompletionSummary: What a relief.. Now I can go back to the Western Village. Thank you.

_4491.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4491.Description: Please! I'm so scared! Who is that human? Please bring Leomon and me to the safe place! You said there was another operator, Leomon, right? Please save us!
_4491.Objective: Bring CommanDramon and Healed Leomon to the Leomon in Western Area.
_4491.CompletionText: Please…let's go to Western Village together…

_4492.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4492.Description: I got information from other Digimons going to and from this place. The human and BanchouLeomon that you talked move Western Area: West. However, he said that BanchouLeomon's condition looked strange... I heard that he avoided from something terrifying. I have recovered to some extent, so let's pursue them together.
_4492.Objective: Talk to Leomon after chasing with Leomon to the western village: West

_4493.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4493.Objective: Ask what to do to Leomon
_4493.CompletionSummary: We need to make BanchouLeomon into rendered incapacitated...
_4493.ReservedText: We need to stop BanchouLeomon. In that state, BanchouLeomon could cause a huge catastrophe…

_4494.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4494.Description: BanchouLeomon seems to be barely holding on against Digimon Kaiser's nonsense. In the meantime, BanchouLeomon will continue to suffer forever... Let him... Let BanchouLeomon, free from pain.
_4494.Objective: Defeat BanchouLeomon in Pain. [The time required to reappear : 30mins]
_4494.CompletionSummary: Thank you… This came out from BanchouLeomon, and I am not sure what this thing is. Check this.

_4495.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4495.Summary: The result of the experiment : BanchouLEomon
_4495.Description: This is... this seems like the things that Digimon Kaiser did some crap on BanchouLeomon. Culumon might know something. Go find Culumon.
_4495.Objective: Bring [Unstable DigiCore] to Culumon at Dats Center.
_4495.CompletionSummary: Here, spoiled Digicore of BanchouLeomon, Culu! You know you should be careful with this, Culu!
_4495.ReservedText: This is…. It seems like it was BanchouLeomon's DigiCore, Culu! BanchouLeomon's DigiCore is twisted into chaos. I don't know what Digimon Kaiser did this for! Culu!

_4496.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4496.Description: Digimon Kaiser went to the Dark tower Wasteland. Since his experiment room is there, I think he is doing something terrible experimenting with data from BanchouLeomon there. Go there. I will be waiting there too.
_4496.Objective: Meet Leomon in Dark tower Wasteland
_4496.CompletionSummary: I need to know what's going on over there!
_4496.ReservedText: So that is the place... the entrance to Kaiser's Labatory...

_4497.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4497.Description: I think it has something to do with Chimairamon, which was born in kaiser's Laboratory. To know what Digimon Kaiser's Experiment is, we need to gather data from Chimairamon.
_4497.Objective: Collect 11 of [Experiment Data : Chimairamon] by completing the quest of [Daily] [Lab Area A]
_4497.CompletionSummary: Umm…Did Kaiser tried to do something bad on BanchouLeomon, just like Chimairamon…?

_4498.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4498.Description: Defeat Chimairamon at Kaiser's Laboratory (Easy). You can get Data of Chimairamon.
_4498.CompletionSummary: Hmm... what on earth were you trying to do with this...?

_4499.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4499.Description:
Looks like'Kaiser's Laboratory has been expanded.
Chimairamon's data obtained so far cannot be used to determine accurate information.
I think we need to get Experiment Data related to BanchouLeomon, which is being conducted in another Experiment section at Kaiser's Laboratory.
_4499.Objective: Collect 20 of [Experiment Data : BanchouLeomon] by completing the quest of [Daily] [Lab Area B]
_4499.CompletionSummary: Okay... In BanchouLeomon's experimental data, you can see traces of DarkDramon's Data... It looks like you were trying to do something like Chimairamon."

_4500.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4500.Description: It's difficult to say but… defeat...BanchouLeomon at Kaiser's Laboratory(Normal). We might able to get experiment Data which related to BanchouLeomon.

_4501.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4501.Description: I need the data of BanchouLeomon and DarkDramon used in the experiment. I need to collect DarkDramon's Experiment Data in the deepest section of Kaiser's Laboratory. Last, I think we'll have to analyze it to see what Digimon Kaiser did on BanchouLeomon's Digicore.
_4501.Objective: Collect 269 of [Experiment Data : DarkDramon] by completing the quest of [Daily] [Lab Area C]
_4501.CompletionSummary: Seems like there was an experiment for the combination of Digicore of DarkDramon and Digicore of BanchouLeomon.

_4502.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4502.Description: Defeat DarkDramon at Kaiser's Laboratory(Hard). I need Experiment Data about DarkDramon.
_4502.CompletionSummary: I've got the Data of DarkDramon. Hmm… I would need lots of Data for analysis…

_4503.Title: Jogress[Chaosmon]
_4503.Summary: The result of the experiment : DarkDramon
_4503.Description: Show this to Culumon. To be honest… I'm not even sure that the Culumon knows about this.
_4503.Objective: Bring [Unstable DigiCore] to Culumon at Dats Center.
_4503.CompletionSummary: From the stories I've heard so far, it seems that Digimon Kaiser tried to merge BanchouLeomon and DarkDramon's DigiCore through experiments, Culu! Luckily, the experiment wasn't fully done thanks to Tamer, Culu! Please be careful with this DarkDramon's DigiCore, Culu!"
_4503.ReservedText: Culu? Is this the Digicore of DarkDramon…?

_4504.Title: [Romantic Meeting]
_4504.Description: I'm the mighty Su~per star, the SuperStarmon. Same as my name. I'm the super star and Managing the stars. I'm here for Altair and Vega that only able to be together. Can you see them? Ahem! Anyway, to let the both stars to be together, I need [Sand of the Star]. Can you collect them for me?
_4504.Objective: Collect [Sand of Star] by defeating monsters at all area except Yokohama Village.

_4505.Title: [Romantic Meeting]
_4505.Description: Good. Now I need to find Altair star… Well, it's been a while since I was away from this work… Not sure…. Hm… While I am planing how, can you work for me at the area that where I am in charge of?
_4505.Objective: Defeat Devimon and Boarmon at [Wilderness Area] Defeat Strikedramon and WaruMonzaemon at [Digimon Farm]
_4505.CompletionSummary: Now! Show this to the person whos suitable for Altria. … To whom? Well… you're the one who decide it! If a person who is worthy of steadfastness is filled for Altair, his heart will be formed.

_4506.Title: [Romantic Meeting]
_4506.Description: Now, I need some stuff to seek the Vega's mind. I better be prepared. You see, people moves only with the stonemile. I! will prepare the stuff, so go to the Wilderness Area and Digimon Farm instead of me!
_4506.Objective: Defeat Goblimon, Stingmon at [Wilderness Area] Defeat Cerberusmon, Blossomon at [Digimon Farm]

_4507.Title: [Romantic Meeting]
_4507.Description: You say I'm the one for Altair? Alright, I will be breave! This time! If I re-track the pass-time when I was in File Island, I might gain more courage. Can you help me?
_4507.Objective: Defeat Woodmon Defeat Sharmamon, Bakemon Defeat Blossomon Hold [Altair's Note]
_4507.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Woodmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Sharmamon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Bakemon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Blossomon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Hold Altair's Note%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4507.CompletionSummary: So, this is my eagle… Hope I connected with Vega.

_4508.Title: [Romantic Meeting]
_4508.Description: I'm the one for Altair?... Are you sure? … Only if I remember the past… I must re-trace the way that I passed in File Island.
_4508.Objective: Defeat Seadramon Defeat Ogremon, Goblimon Defeat Cherrymon Hold [Altair's Note]
_4508.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Seadramon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Ogremon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Goblimon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Cherrymon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Hold Altair's Note%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4508.CompletionSummary: Alright! I made my choice! I hope my eagle connected with Vega.

_4509.Title: [Romantic Meeting]
_4509.Description: What? I'm the….Vega…? ….. I'm very confused. I'm not sure…. I really want to remember the File Island Waterfront where many things happened but… Please help me…
_4509.Objective: Defeat Archnemon, LadyDevimon Collect [Forbidden fruit] by monsters at [Waterfront] Hold [Vega's Note]
_4509.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Archnemon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat LadyDevimon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Forbidden fruit%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Hold Vega's Note%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4509.CompletionSummary: I'm so sorry. Even I don't know myself…

_4510.Title: Ogudomon
_4510.Description:
Long time no see, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>… How have you been?
I'm not sure if you've felt in the real world... It seems like something is going to happen in the Digital World right now...
What happened was…

_4511.Title: Ogudomon
_4511.Description:
Good Digimons and evil Digimons... Hmm... I don't think it's something to say here, so let's move on...
Come to the Western Area : East. I think it would be nice to talk there…
_4511.Objective: Move to Hideout Talk to White-Beard Guru
_4511.CompletionText: I wish I had a peaceful day…
_4511.CompletionSummary: Thank you for coming@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>… Now let's talk a little…

_4512.Title: Ogudomon
_4512.Description:
Hmm… Is it a war...
It has been said that a long time ago there was a war between beast-type Digimons and humanoid Digimons. It was Lucemon next to you who stopped the war. That's why Lucemon is a Digimon you can trust and follow.
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Help Lucemon find a way to stop the war.
In the meantime, I will find the scattered Royal Knights and prepare for war.
_4512.CompletionSummary:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>… I also agree with Omegamon.
Lucemon is very strong and just Digimon, although a child-like appearance. If you help Lucemon well, I don't think there will be a war and it will go well.
Good luck…

_4513.Title: Ogudomon
_4513.Description:
This is Barbamon. He's a very greedy and cunning guy... Since Barbamon is the 7th Demon, it's very difficult to kill alone, but if the two of us join forces, we can stop him!
To get to Barbamon's base, you'll have to move to Ruined Historic in the western region.
Then shall we go to the path of trials of the Ruined Historic, Street of Trial?
_4513.Objective: Move to Street of Trial Talk to Lucemon
_4513.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Street of Trial%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Lucemon%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4514.Title: Ogudomon
_4514.Description:
This is not the base of Barbamon. We need to move a little further from here.
Then shall we move?
_4514.Objective: Move to Barbamon's Base Talk to Barbamon
_4514.CompletionSummary: Ho... Did you come here after all... ?

_4515.Title: Ogudomon
_4515.Description:
Well said! It is possible if the two of us work together!
Let's go now! To defeat Barbamon!
_4515.CompletionSummary: Your arrogance is endless... okay… I'm looking forward to this already happening…
