_4516.Title: Ogudomon
_4516.Description:
Oh, give it to me! It is a human must not have! Especially the one of the 7th Demon!
Come on! Give it to me!
_4516.CompletionSummary:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, sorry to speak out loud. Whenever I talk about the devil-like Digimon, I easily excited. This thing is called a Data code…
It's a Digital Code that contains dead Digimon's data... In the case of the devil-type Digimon or other angelic Digimon data codes, it is a very dangerous object that can corrupt the Digimon that holds the data codes.
So I asked you to come. So please don't be too sad...

_4517.Title: Ogudomon
_4517.Description:
Now that you have defeated Barbamon, you must go to stop Lilithmon. Lilithmon base is located west of the western town.
Then shall we move the western area of Western Village?
_4517.Objective: Move to Unknown Ruins Talk to Lucemon
_4517.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Western Area : West%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Lucemon%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4518.Title: Ogudomon
_4518.Description: Like Barbamon, you need to move a little further here to get to Lilithmon Base. Let's move!
_4518.Objective: Move to Lilithmon's Base Talk to Lilithmon

_4519.Title: Ogudomon
_4519.Description:
They are coming! If the two of us join forces, we can win!
Let's do a little more power! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!
_4519.CompletionSummary: I...I defeated like this... I'm in vain... Lucemon!! I will remember this forever!!

_4520.Title: Ogudomon
_4520.Description: Thank you for your hard work! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Thanks to this, I was able to knock down Lilithmon easily! So, give me the Lilithmon data code! I will keep it well.
_4520.CompletionSummary:
Thank you! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!
It's going well as planned... Whoa...

_4521.Title: Ogudomon
_4521.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! According to the news that has just arrived, Belphemon and the Demon are holding hands and moving to fight the angelic Digimons!
They're trying to attack the Ophanimon in the Silver Lake... Ophanimon is dangerous! Let's go to the silver lake!
_4521.Objective: Move to Silver Lake Talk to Lucemon
_4521.CompletionSummary: I'm glad! I don't think they're here yet… !

_4522.Title: Ogudomon
_4522.Description:
Currently, you are very exhausted. This is a natural result since they faced both Barbamon and Lilithmon in a row.
So, before fighting the Demon and Belphemon, restoring your health is a top priority.
There are many ingredients in Silver Lake that can make healing items. If @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> seeks ingredients, I'll make a recovery Item.
_4522.Objective: Cherrymon's Fruit Petals of Lilithmon The Bark of a Woodmon Flame of Birdramon Leaf of Tanemon
_4522.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Cherrymon's Fruit%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Petals of Lilithmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3The Bark of a Woodmon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Flame of Birdramon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Leaf of Tanemon%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4522.CompletionSummary: You've got the ingredients! Then, right now, I will make a recovery medicine and give it to you.

_4523.Title: Ogudomon
_4523.Description:
Looks like you're done recovering.
So shall we go somewhere else? You can't fight Belphemon and the Demon here. Other good Digimons and Ophanimon may be at risk... So let's greet Demon and Belphemon in a Silent forest a little far from the silver lake…
_4523.Objective: Move to Silent Forest Talk to Lucemon
_4523.CompletionSummary: Demon and Belphemon… they've been here...

_4524.Title: Ogudomon
_4524.Description: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! I think we can fight as we said earlier! Belphemon is going to mark me well, so please ask the Demon! good luck…!
_4524.CompletionSummary: I knew it! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, I thought you could do it

_4525.Title: Ogudomon
_4525.Description:
After defeating the Demon, it will be very difficult to deal with Belphemon immediately. But to stop the war, there is no other way... But don't worry, I can support you this time!
Ah!! Because of the battle with the Demon, Belphemon has awakened...But don't panic and calmly fight with Belphemon Rage Mode...!
Then shall we go stop Belphemon?
_4525.CompletionSummary: You are amazing… Are there any human beings who can defeat four of the seven devils... I am really impressed… !

_4526.Title: Ogudomon
_4526.Description:
Thank you! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! Thanks to that, we were able to defeat the Demon and Belphemon!
Please give me the data codes of the Demon and Belphemon! I will keep it.
_4526.Objective: Data Code of Demon Data Code of Belphemon
_4526.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Data Code of Demon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Data Code of Belphemon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4526.CompletionSummary: Thank you! @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>! It's going well as planned... Whoa…

_4527.Title: Ogudomon
_4527.Description:
Well, good job, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!
Thanks to you, I was able to get the Data codes of the guys without effort...
And your stamina, which seems to be more intrusive than the Royal Knights, has been consumed too much... How does it flow as planned... I keep laughing, but it was so hard to bear it... Whoo...

_4528.Title: Ogudomon
_4528.Description:
The power is... overflowing... I think I can achieve everything...
Kid... look at it... I will show you the overwhelming power...!
_4528.CompletionSummary: I became a transcendental being beyond God... To humans... I... like this... Suffer...ni…

_4529.Title: Ogudomon
_4529.Description:
I think it would be good to talk about Ogudomon with White-Beard Guru. So come to the eastern hideout in the western town.
Ogudomon will be transferred by our Royal Knights. Then, let's look at the hideout!
_4529.Objective: Move to Hideout Talk to White-Beard Guru
_4529.CompletionSummary: Welcome... you had a lot of trouble... I'd love to hear your heroic story, but... I think I need to tell you something about the future…

_4530.Title: Ogudomon
_4530.Description: First of all, it seems that Culumon needs to purify the evil power of Ogudomon... Even if Ogudomon wakes up, it will be a big deal... Let's ask Culumon to purify the evil powers of Ogudomon…
_4530.CompletionSummary: You want to purify the power of Ogudomon, Culu? I will try, Culu~

_4531.Title: Ogudomon
_4531.Description: I tried to purify the power of Ogudomon to my fullest, Culu~ However, since Ogudomon is a strong Digimon, you have too much to purify all of Ogudomon's evil powers with my own power... Culu… Ogudomon still has evil powers... I don't know if it's good... Culu...

_4532.Title: Ogudomon
_4532.Description:
I think there's only this way, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>. I want you to take over Ogudomon...
I think that you defeated Ogu domon by yourself, you will have enough control over him. Culumon also purged some of Ogudomon's evil powers and removed them...
Ah, go to Nanomon once... He will help you to control Ogudomon well...
_4532.CompletionSummary:
Well… Is it you again... ? What's huge behind...
no! This Digimon!!! how… Where to get this Digimon... !

_4533.Title: Ogudomon
_4533.Description:
Um... Um... Well… Got it. The content was definitely entered in my head.
If the Culumon had been purified it, most of the evil power would have disappeared. Of course, not all of them were removed. Culumon did not lie.
As a result of my analysis, the power of Ogudomon has been reduced by 80% by Culumon. It is very unfortunate.
It's ridiculous that the Digimon called the Evil King is so weak. So I'll give you something.
_4533.CompletionSummary:
It is a data code that strengthens the power of Ogudomon, which is the Ogudomon enhancement data.
Don't worry, I made this object. No function exists to revive the evil powers of the lost Ogudomon.
However, the story is different if the remaining 20% ??of the evil power and the strengthened power of Ogudomon are synergistic.
So you need to take good control of it. How do you control it?
That is your homework. Don't ask me. Now please go. I have to analyze the data...!

_4534.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4534.Description:
Why don't you join the members of Dats Agents for Vacation?
Oh.no.. After distributing the items needed for the summer vacation, the materials are running out.
If you collect the materials, I will make things and find out where the Dats Agent who went on vacation while I was getting materials are now.
You can get the ingredients anywhere.
_4534.Objective: Collect 30 of [Craft Data] by defeating monsters at all area except Yokohama Village, Event Areas
_4534.CompletionText: For young people who have suffered so far, it's about acting for a while…

_4535.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4535.Description: Dats Agents are heading to File Island Waterfront. In the meantime, looks like Mary wants to do something at Silver Lake for a while. Still, it's dangerous to be separated from people, so can you go and find out what's going on?
_4535.CompletionText: I told you to move together!

_4536.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4536.Summary: Can't pass the Lake with nothing
_4536.Description:
Ah! I remembered my childhood memories while I was walking by this lake. I want to play a game that I always won. It's Stone skipping!
But there aren't any useful stones around here, so can you help me to find some?
_4536.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I will be with the agents very soon. I won’t make you worried.

_4537.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4537.Description:
Mary and Miki...They supposed to have a really happy rest and come back, and I wonder what happened to Mickey in the Silent forest…
I don't know what is she doing in that dark place. Please go and see what's going on.
_4537.Objective: Talk to Mary at Silent Forest
_4537.CompletionText: Hope there would be no issue…

_4538.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4538.Description: I was with Mary just a seconds ago, but all in a sudden, she's gone. I've already talked to Richard Sampson that I will get ready first and wait for Mary here. But, it's too dark and also scary here... Could you Please get me some of Firewood for lightning?
_4538.Objective: Collect [Usefull Firewood] by defeating Monsters at Silent Forest
_4538.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Ah! You meet Mary at Silver Lake? Good to hear that!

_4539.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4539.Summary: Richard Sampson from File Island Shore
_4539.Description:
It's a big deal!
The emergency line that was only used in emergency cases, which was only connected with Richard Sampson and me.
Something staggered and didn't say everything, but it's clear something big happened to Richard on the File Island Waterfront.
Please go urgently!
_4539.Objective: Talk to Richard Sampson at File Island Waterfront

_4540.Title: [Summer Vacation]
_4540.Description:
The... Mary and Miki never barbecued outdoors, so I said I'd have the best barbecue party in my life...
While waiting for Mary and Miki, I fell asleep for a while and all the meat I prepared was gone!!!
The Digimons on the File Island Waterfront must have done it.
Please... help me out.
_4540.Objective: Defeat 3 Monsters Collect [Meat for Barbecue] by defeat monsters Buy [Mysterious Seasoning] from Chuchidarumon at Waterfront
_4540.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Crowmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat MegaSeadramon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Archnemon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Meat for Barbecue%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Mysterious Seasoning%qe %cc5/%mc5

_4541.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4541.Description:
Welcome, Tamer. When KingChessmon and QueenChessmon's quarrels began and became serious, I tried to intercede... but I've already crossed the line of what I can do.
Now that I'm exhausted, I wonder if it would be better to sit down.
I'll give you a recommendation letter, so why don't you pick a camp every day and try it out?
_4541.Objective: Talk to <Exhausted>BanchouLeomon that you are ready for the fight
_4541.CompletionSummary: Receive this letter of recommendation and go to each Camp's PawnChessmon.

_4542.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4542.Description: Hmm? Are you a human who wants to add strength to KingChessmon?
_4542.Objective: Talk to <King's Servant>PawnChessmon W that you are going to be on King's Camp for today
_4542.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to PawnChessmon W%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Hold The Letter of Reference%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4542.CompletionSummary: Good. I know you will do your best.

_4543.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4543.Description: Will you be on the side of Her Majesty?
_4543.Objective: Talk to <Queen's Servant>PawnChessmon B that you are going to be on Queen's Camp for today
_4543.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to PawnChessmon B%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Hold The Letter of Reference%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4543.CompletionSummary: Great! I know you will do your best!

_4544.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4544.Summary: The Pawn's Two step forward(King's Order)
_4544.Description:
I'm in the King's camp collecting the [Black Gemstone] we need.
In addition, I play the role of scolding other Digimons on Queen's side.
Would you help me with the orders I received from KingChessmon?
_4544.Objective: Collect Black Gemstone by defeating Monsters and Defeat Seadramon(Queen's Camp), Mushroomon(Queen's Camp) at Silver Lake

_4545.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4545.Summary: The Pawn's Two step forward(Queen's Order)
_4545.Description:
I'm in the Queen's camp collecting the [White Gemstone] we need.
In addition, I play the role of scolding other Digimons on King's side.
Would you help me with the orders I received from QueenChessmon?
_4545.Objective: Collect White Gemstone by defeating Monsters and Defeat Rockmon(King's Camp), Lillymon(King's Camp) at Silver Lake

_4546.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4546.Description:
I was given a command from KingChessmon to settle the flock of File Island Waterfront on Queen's side.
The Digimons I tell you... You know what to do, right?
_4546.Objective: Defeat 10 each of Rapidmon, Giromon, Cherubimon, Argomon Ultimate at File Island Waterfront
_4546.CompletionSummary: Well, you do a little, aren't you!?

_4547.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4547.Description:
I have been given the Nobel QueenChessmon the order to settle the flock of File Island Waterfront on King's side.
The Digimons I tell you... You know what to do, right?
_4547.Objective: Defeat 10 each of Zudomon, MegaSeadramon, Cherubimon White, GrandisKuwagamon at File Island Waterfront
_4547.CompletionSummary: Hmm! Thank you in advance. Will you help us tomorrow, too?

_4548.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4548.Description:
I'm going to deal with the Digimons who have dared not to stand on KingChessmon side in the desert area.
They haven't said they will be on QueenChessmon's side yet, but I have to pluck the shoots.
_4548.Objective: Defeat 10 each of Gazimon, Digmon, Rockmon, Flymon at Desert Areas
_4548.CompletionSummary: All right, this made my mind a little easier.

_4549.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4549.Description:
I am under the command of the great QueenChessmon to enlist Digimons to help us in the desert.
Some Digimons have said they can help us by proving their strength... but I can not do this by myself.
Would you please help me?
_4549.Objective: Defeat 10 each of Drimogemon, Neptunemon, Dokugumon, Devidramon at Desert Areas

_4550.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4550.Description:
So… You are the Tamer that going to help us, right?
Are you ready to get into the Queen's Territory?
_4550.Objective: Talk to <King>KingChessmon that you are ready to go to the Queen's Territory
_4550.CompletionSummary: Now, I can send you to the Queen's Territory.

_4551.Title: [King VS Queen Event]
_4551.Description:
Greetings, Tamer.
Deliver my will to that cheeky King, who resting in his territory.
Talk back to me when you are ready!
_4551.Objective: Talk to <Queen>QueenChessmon that you are ready to go to the King's Territory
_4551.CompletionSummary: Take this. I will send you to the King's Territory with this.

_4552.Title: Boltboutamon
_4552.Description:
Hi~It's been a long time~ culu~ These days, the suspicious feeling is often felt little by little... But strangely... The feeling disappears immediately culu… So I told Richard Sampson. And he assembled all the members of the Dats~ culu~!
Oh~~? But why are you here? You'd better go to the command room immediately before you get scold by him! culu~~
_4552.Objective: Move to Command Room Talk to Richard Sampson
_4552.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Command Room%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4552.CompletionText: Richard's face was as scary as a goblin... I hope that friend to be alive... Culu…
_4552.CompletionSummary: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>...You're late... Since the situation is serious, I will nag later...!

_4553.Title: Boltboutamon
_4553.Description: Yes...! So, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> immediately goes to Yokohama Village, where the kidnapping took place, to get an accurate picture of what happened! Over!
_4553.Objective: Move to A Housing Estate Talk to Sayuri Daimon
_4553.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to A Housing Estate%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Sayuri Daimon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4553.CompletionText: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>… You always come late... I think I need to prepare a room of truth in the command room... Hmm…
_4553.CompletionSummary: Hey~@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, You here~ How are you?

_4554.Title: Boltboutamon
_4554.Description:
Thank you… Kristy said there was a PE class this afternoon. So if you go to school at this time, you may be able to meet Kristy on the playground~
Go to Yokohama Elementary School and tell Kristy to come home right after school…
_4554.Objective: Move to Yokohama Elementery School Talk to Kristy
_4554.CompletionSummary: Wow! You surprised me! What are you upto?

_4555.Title: Boltboutamon
_4555.Description:
It's me. Did you have any income from the survey?
(…...)
Seems like there is something… First, return to headquarters and report to me what you have seen and heard so far. Over!
_4555.Objective: Move to Command Room Talk to Richard Sampson
_4555.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Command Room%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4556.Title: Boltboutamon
_4556.Description: Okay, it's a big one. Good job, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>. But more information is needed. Tokyo-The Odaiba area also had an incident like this, so go ahead and find out more! Over!
_4556.Objective: Move to the Valley of Light Station Talk to the Citizen of the Valley of Light
_4556.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Valley of Light Station%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to the Citizen%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4556.CompletionText: If the performance is this high...I don't know what to say, but...Hmm…

_4557.Title: Boltboutamon
_4557.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Taichi! Digimon has appeared. That's the parking lot over there!!
Let's check which Digimon appeared! Give me a moment!
It...It's Soulmon! … The number is substantial! I think we should be ready!
Go ahead and take care of the Soulmons! Before going to another place to abduct children!!
_4557.CompletionSummary: Zero response... It looks like you've done all the soulmons in the parking lot! I'm relieved for now!

_4558.Title: Boltboutamon
_4558.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Taichi! Sorry! I thought it was too easy...
Soulmon also appeared on the parking lot side...! However, it seems that Digimon, which is more powerful than ever, has appeared… !
Hurry up! Soulmons are starting to move!
_4558.Objective: Defeat Soulmon (Army Captain) Defeat Soulmon (Captain) Defeat Soulmon (Colossal)
_4558.CompletionSummary: Digimon's reaction has disappeared. There are no signs to reappear here.

_4559.Title: Boltboutamon
_4559.Description:
The most recent place of kidnapping occurred in Minato City. it happened in my apartment complex.
It is said that the killer appears again at the scene. I think it would be better to go to Minato City and check the case again. Then shall we move to Minato City?
_4559.Objective: Move to Taichi's Home Talk to Taichi
_4559.CompletionSummary: I came to Minato city... Where should I start investigating... .?

_4560.Title: Boltboutamon
_4560.Description:
I don't think Taichi needs to worry about that. Digimon's reaction just happened!
Digimon reactions are taking place in the forest in front of the waterfront. The Digimon that appeared... Wait… .Well… Witchmon!
It's mature Digimon! Like Soulmon, the numbers are substantial! Witchmon flying on a broom so we can't let them go anywhere else Hurry up and go! Come on!
_4560.Objective: Defeat Witchmon Defeat Witchmon (Army Captain) Defeat Witchmon (Captainl)
_4560.CompletionSummary: Digimon's reaction is all gone... ! All the Witchmons in this forest are defeated!

_4561.Title: Boltboutamon
_4561.Description:
If you keep that crazy Digimon, all the kids here will be kidnapped...!
I can't let it happen, so let's defeat the Boltboutamon!
_4561.CompletionSummary:
Hoo~ I am impressed...!
I don't want to make an ending… You can't end the show in this shabby place... Shouldn't the pleasant show stop in front of a large audience?
I will prepare a better stage for you... Then, Adios!

_4562.Title: Boltboutamon
_4562.Description:
As Izzy said, Boltboutamon is likely to appear in Shibuya! So you'd better go to Shibuya and be prepared in advance!
Let's move to Shibuya!
_4562.Objective: Shibuya Scramble Crossing Talk to Izzy
_4562.CompletionSummary: Well… It seems that Boltboutamon hasn't appeared yet… Probably waiting for us to appear...?

_4563.Title: Boltboutamon
_4563.Description:
You Boltboutamon! I can't believe you're calling Digimon to such a crowded area.!
The longer you wait, the more damage you'll have to people! So let's hurry up and get rid of them!! We need to minimize the damage to people!
_4563.Objective: Defeat Blackgatomon Defeat Roachmon Defeat Vegiemon Defeat Soulmon Defeat Sangloupmon
_4563.CompletionSummary: Boltboutamon can be solved. All Digimons sung by Boltboutamon has been defeated.

_4564.Title: Boltboutamon
_4564.Description: Let's call it a day! Get rid of the Boltboutamon and save the children he kidnapped! All right, everybody, be prepared! I think he's very strong!
_4564.CompletionSummary: Boltboutamon's reaction has disappeared. @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>, Taichi had a lot of trouble…

_4565.Title: Boltboutamon
_4565.Description: Well, I think we're done talking. We have to get the kids home, so I'll be going. Take care, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>.
_4565.CompletionSummary: Please take care of that mask. Ominous feels very strong... Well, such as this ...

_4566.Title: Boltboutamon
_4566.Description:
I confirmed that the huge realization reaction disappeared from the headquarters. It seemed to have worked out well.
I will listen to the detailed story from headquarters. To return...! Over!
_4566.Objective: Move to Command Room Talk to Richard Sampson
_4566.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Command Room%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4566.CompletionSummary: Thanks for your hard work. What are you holding? A… Mask?

_4567.Title: Boltboutamon
_4567.Description:
The Digimon is defeated… And yet the Mask still remains? Hmm… Something strange...
I think it would be better to ask Nanomon about this. Go to Nanomon and ask about the mask! Well then!
_4567.CompletionSummary: You again!? What a digimon.. Keep bothering me…! You better explain to me why you are here otherwise I will Disssection…… ?? What a mask! Hand it to me!

_4568.Title: Boltboutamon
_4568.Description:
When Digimon dies, it must be dataised, but... The thing that this Digimon's object remains unchanged with data is that it contains the Digimon's thoughts.
In other words, if I extract evolutionary data with this mask, the Digimon you met earlier may appear again.
That's probably not what everyone here wants. Give me the mask back. Ask Culumon to take this mask and purify it. Culumon may be able to get rid of the thoughts in this mask.
_4568.CompletionSummary: Hi~ culu~ What a mask that you holding in your hand! culu~ From that mask, I can feel very evil energy culu~

_4569.Title: Boltboutamon
_4569.Description:
You want to cleanse this mask? culu? Ok~ If I leave this mask alone, I'm sure something bad will happen, so I'll clean it right away~ culu~
Purified~ The bad evil energy in this mask is now gone~ Then, goodbye~ culu~
_4569.CompletionSummary:
Well… It's definitely purified... If you create evolutionary data with this mask, you can evolve into the Digimon you met. Wait, I will make it right away...!
Now, it's done. Using this evolutionary data I made, It can evolve to Boltboutamon. It will not do anything ugly because the culumon has purged the thoughts, but it still doesn't know if you should watch it well or not.
Then go, because I want to do a little more analysis... !

_4570.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4570.Description: "Trouble! Big Trouble Culu-! ZekeGreymon got into a fight with Shoutmon culu! Why- what's wrong? I thought we became friends, culu... #<my_tname> ! Please make up with Shoutmon and ZekeGreymon, culu!"
_4570.CompletionText: "Shoutmon and ZekeGreymon are in Western Area: East, culu! Go to Shoutmon first, culu!"
_4570.CompletionSummary: Ahh-! Why are you doing this to me all of a sudden, you mean guy!!

_4571.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4571.Description: Let's go to ZekeGreymon right now!
_4571.CompletionSummary: Well, I thought the time has come, but I didn't expect you to bring #<my_tname> .

_4572.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4572.Description: He's keep saying things that are confusing until the end... Let's go back and think about it, #<my_tname> !
_4572.CompletionText: What drives me to live today? My power? What is that?
_4572.CompletionSummary: #<my_tname> , since you're helping me, can we think about it together?

_4573.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4573.Description: Shoutmon- #<my_tname> - Glad to see you again-
_4573.CompletionSummary: ZekeGreymon's puzzle? Puzzle of forgotten power-

_4574.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4574.Description: "This Digimon- DexDorugamon, often roams around here- Rumor has it that someone made it for pain- I heard- I'm Digimon like Ballistamon- It's enough to just chase them away- I'll give you my power when you come back-"
_4574.CompletionText: It's enough to just chase them away- if you frighten DexDorugamon, come back-
_4574.CompletionSummary: "Shoutmon- My friend- Take my power- I want to be part of your power- No matter what anyone says- Shoutmon is our Digimon King- Dorulumon thinks the same, right-?

_4575.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4575.Description: Suddenly all points toward to me...
_4575.CompletionSummary: Do you want to hear my story? There's nothing I can't tell you if you need to.

_4576.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4576.Description: "I'll have to do it by myself to satisfy Cutemon, so you can find anything that can give me a clue. Well, first of all... I can smell Cutemon on that bunch of Dobermon. They might have something. Please. I'll look elsewhere."
_4576.CompletionText: "I can smell Cutemon on that bunch of Dobermon. Would you find the clue that Cutemon left?"
_4576.CompletionSummary: "Take care of our day, Shoutmon! Now, my turn is over. Now let's listen to others. Yes, Starmons would be good."

_4577.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4577.Description: Bro, is it finally my turn?!
_4577.CompletionSummary: You can ask me anything. My Bro is curious, I'll tell you everything!

_4578.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4578.Description: "Then... Bro! The most awesome Bro in the universe! Why don't you defeat Deputymon for me? I don't like what they're doing! Just defeat them! Please Bro!"
_4578.CompletionText: "Don't ask me why I don't like them- I just don't like how they look! Just close your eyes and think that you're going to give them a clout!"
_4578.CompletionSummary: "This is my Bro! Different league- I mean! Your dream will be the coolest dream in the universe! With us, Starmons power!"

_4579.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4579.Description: Hello, Shoutmon! Is there Digimon I need to destroy?
_4579.CompletionSummary: You have a question for me? What's the question?

_4580.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4580.Description: "You know there's a lot of Rockmons around here, right? They're pushing everything away, rock or building that blocks them. Even if it's the same Digimon... Give Rockmon the iron mace of destruction that makeseveryone sad. Ah, if you find Rockmon's rock fragment, bring it to me."
_4580.CompletionText: "If you find Rockmon's rock fragment, would you bring it to me? I think I can warn Rockmons by showing them rock fragment to stop giving other Digimons a hard time. Please."
_4580.CompletionSummary: "Thank you for helping out Digimons that are not Xros Heart. I'm always ready. Use my power! For Nene and Mervamon's happiness! For all Xros Heart!"

_4581.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4581.Description: "Ballistamon, Dorulumon, Starmons, Sparrowmon... All Xros Hearts are fighting with their dreams as the driving force. Then You'd be the same, wouldn't it? Come on, this isn't the time to be here. #<my_tname> ! Let's get started! I'm going to coolly embrace all Xros Hearts' dreams. I'm Shoutmon, the future Digimon King!!"
_4581.CompletionText: "I'm ready! I'll deal with Power of Xros Heart (Summon Item's Name) without going too far!"
_4581.CompletionSummary: I think it's time to answer ZekeGreymon's puzzle.

_4582.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4582.Description: Let's go to ZekeGreymon! With the evolutionary power of Omegamon and the dream of Xros Heart!

_4583.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4583.Description: Shoutmon… No, it's OmegaShoutmon. Have you found the answer, kid.
_4583.CompletionSummary: Let's hear it. What's the 'Driving Force to Fight' that you found!

_4584.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4584.Description: Ambition to fight and win against the world's most powerful enemy…! I like it!!
_4584.CompletionText: "Come at me, OmegaShoutmon. If you are the future Digimon King, you can put the power of ZekeGreymon at your feet, too!"
_4584.CompletionSummary: "OmegaShoutmon! You stupid little boy who promised to burn all Digimons' soulful rock. I, ZekeGreymon, will bite all your enemies and blow up all obstacles!"

_4585.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4585.Description: You've waited a long time, #<my_tname> Now there's only one step left, so relax.
_4585.CompletionSummary: "I was able to come this far because #<my_tname> was with me, right? So I want you to watch my best performance until the end."

_4586.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4586.Description: "Keep your eyes on #<my_tname>. Omegamon's 'Power of Digivolution' to be completely united with that loony!"
_4586.CompletionText: "Clle the OmegaShoutmon's power here. In this desolate land, there's no problem with the power of Omegamon getting out of control."
_4586.CompletionSummary: That's great, Shoutmon. You have reached the most perfect answer!

_4587.Title: Shoutmon X7
_4587.Description: #<my_tname> You saw it clearly, right? This is the power of Digimon King!
_4587.CompletionText: I need to hurry up and tell Xros Heart about this! Let's go, let's go!
_4587.CompletionSummary: "Thank you so much for being with me, #<my_tname> With this new DigiXros that we found together... I'll fight with you till the end! It's... It's a promise from Shoutmon, who's going to be Digimon King!!"

_4588.Title: [Veteran Agent's equipment development preparation?]
_4588.Description: Hey Tamer! Help me out~~ I need some data from Digimon to develop equipment Would you collect them?
_4588.CompletionSummary: Thanks. I think I can make a great equipment because of you

_4589.Title: [Resolution Failed]
_4589.Description: I'm going to train every day now!! Care to join?!
_4589.Objective: Collect 30 [Certification Stamp] from all regions except Yokohama
_4589.CompletionSummary: It's difficult but you'll be with me tomorrow right!?

_4590.Title: [It's Spring Now]
_4590.Description: It was cold when I woke up before but now it's better... It's really spring now right...??
_4590.Objective: Collect 30 [Spring Petal] from all regions except Yokohama

_4591.Title: [Powerful and Rapid Growth]
_4591.Description: Digivolution isn't enough.. Hey Tamer!! I want a powerful Digivolution!! Would you help me?!
_4591.Objective: Collect 30 [A Sign of Digivolution] from all regions except Yokohama
_4591.CompletionSummary: Thanks. I'll use this to become stronger

_4592.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4592.Description: Are you ready for the quick training for growth?
_4592.Objective: Talk to Guilmon in DATS Center
_4592.ReservedText: Let's enjoy simple contents and I'm going to start the quick training!

_4593.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4593.Description: It's a Lv. 60 mission You can get it from Digivice, so check out the shiny exclamation mark at the bottom right of the screen!
_4593.Objective: Collect 3 [A Path to Growth - 1] from completing quest on Digivice
_4593.CompletionText: Check out the exclamation mark at the bottom right of the screen
_4593.CompletionSummary: Good~! You hold up pretty well? Shall we move on to the next step?

_4594.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4594.Objective: Talk to Guilmon in DATS Center
_4594.CompletionText: Talk to Guilmon in DATS Center
_4594.CompletionSummary: Good job. Let's move on to the next step

_4595.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4595.Objective: Talk to Guilmon to create practice crafting item
_4595.CompletionText: Talk to Guilmon to create practice crafting item!
_4595.CompletionSummary: Good job. I'll send you to Silver Lake this time!!

_4596.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4596.Description: We are going to hunt Don't let your guard down because it's easy!!!
_4596.Objective: Defeat each 10 of Tunomon, Koromon, and Tanemon in Silver Lake
_4596.CompletionSummary: You're good!! Lv. 60 mission is over!! Talk to Guilmon and move on to Lv. 65 mission!

_4597.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4597.Description: It's a Lv. 65 mission You can get it from Digivice, so check out the shiny exclamation mark at the bottom right of the screen!
_4597.Objective: Collect 4 [A Path to Growth - 2] from completing quest on Digivice
_4597.CompletionText: Check out the exclamation mark at the bottom right of the screen
_4597.CompletionSummary: Incredible!! Let's move on to the next step

_4598.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4598.CompletionText: Let's go to Silver Lake first! You can go comfortably by using the jump booster!

_4599.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4599.Description: Defeat raid Digimon in Silent Forest
_4599.Objective: Defeat Meramon and Ogremon in Silent Forest

_4600.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4600.Description: Leomon is strong so let's prepare!
_4600.Objective: Defeat Leomon in Lost Historic Site
_4600.CompletionText: We're halfway there! Let's hurry up and go to Lost Historic Site!
_4600.CompletionSummary: It's really.... I only can say it's amazing....

_4601.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4601.Description: Now, Raid Digimon in Water Front~! Monochromon!
_4601.CompletionSummary: Great job!! How about going to Guilmon for the next mission?

_4602.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4602.Description: It's a Lv. 70 mission You can get it from Digivice, so check out the shiny exclamation mark at the bottom right of the screen!
_4602.Objective: Collect 5 [A Path to Growth - 3] from completing quest on Digivice
_4602.CompletionText: Check out the exclamation mark at the bottom right of the screen
_4602.CompletionSummary: Good job~! When dealing with a tough enemy, it's better to put recovery items in the quick slot at the bottom left and use it while fighting

_4603.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4603.Description: We are going to visit Secret Ancient Ruins(Easy) in Lost Historic Site! Let's go in and defeat Parasimon~!
_4603.Objective: Defeat Parasimon in Secret Ancient Ruins
_4603.CompletionText: We're going to easy mode dungeon Don't worry too much~

_4604.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4604.Description: We are going to visit Secret Ancient Ruins(Easy) in Lost Historic Site!
_4604.Objective: Defeat Meramon in Secret Ancient Ruins
_4604.CompletionText: We'll see Meramon by following the road!
_4604.CompletionSummary: That's how you do it! Let's keep going!

_4605.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4605.Description: We are going to visit Secret Ancient Ruins(Easy) in Lost Historic Site!
_4605.Objective: Defeat Roachmon in Secret Ancient Ruins
_4605.CompletionText: Roachmon is next! It hides like a cockroach so you have to use the item!
_4605.CompletionSummary: You're doing well even if I don't tell you what to do

_4606.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4606.Description: We are going to visit Secret Ancient Ruins(Easy) in Lost Historic Site!
_4606.Objective: Defeat Centalmon in Secret Ancient Ruins
_4606.CompletionText: Centalmon is strong so be careful!

_4607.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4607.Description: We are going to visit Secret Ancient Ruins(Easy) in Lost Historic Site!
_4607.Objective: Defeat Leomon in Secret Ancient Ruins
_4607.CompletionText: Leomon....It has a powerful skill so be careful
_4607.CompletionSummary: We only have the last Lv. 75 mission left Keep up the good work!

_4608.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4608.Description: This is the last mission Please talk to me after you Digivolve your strongest Digimon
_4608.Objective: Collect [Complete Growth Certificate] by completing quest on Digivice
_4608.CompletionText: I'll give you the quest if you talk to me after Digivolve your strongest Digimon
_4608.CompletionSummary: Good work for coming all the way here It's a gift for Tamers who finished the quick training

_4609.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4609.Summary: The last step to rapid growth(Gallantmon)
_4609.Description: Our goal is to complete the quest Source of Evil(Party)! The quest Source of Evil(Party) is the follow up quest of [Commander's Urgent Summon] from Digivice!! It's going to be a long journey... It's the last mission, so keep up the good work!!
_4609.Objective: Start maze entrance quest at Digimon Maze Entrance You can start with the quest [Commander's Urgent Summon] from Digivice.
_4609.CompletionText: You have to complete Digimon Maze entrance quest
_4609.CompletionSummary: You did a great job Here! It's a gift for Tamers who finished the quick training

_4610.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4610.Summary: The last step to rapid growth(Dynasmon)
_4610.Description: Our goal is to complete the quest Source of Evil(Party)! The quest Source of Evil(Party) is the follow up quest of [Commander's Urgent Summon] from Digivice!! It's going to be a long journey... It's the last mission, so keep up the good work!!
_4610.Objective: Start maze entrance quest at Digimon Maze Entrance You can start with the quest [Commander's Urgent Summon] from Digivice.
_4610.CompletionText: You have to complete Digimon Maze entrance quest
_4610.CompletionSummary: You did a great job Here! It's a gift for Tamers who finished the quick training

_4611.Title: [Jumping Guide]
_4611.Summary: The last step to rapid growth(Ulforce V-D)
_4611.Description: Our goal is to complete the quest Source of Evil(Party)! The quest Source of Evil(Party) is the follow up quest of [Commander's Urgent Summon] from Digivice!! It's going to be a long journey... It's the last mission, so keep up the good work!!
_4611.Objective: Start maze entrance quest at Digimon Maze Entrance You can start with the quest [Commander's Urgent Summon] from Digivice.
_4611.CompletionText: You have to complete Digimon Maze entrance quest
_4611.CompletionSummary: You did a great job Here! It's a gift for Tamers who finished the quick training

_4612.Title: [Jumping Event]
_4612.Description: Now.. This is my last help I'll send you to DATS Center right away When you're ready, talk to me again
_4612.Objective: Talk to Agumon and move to DATS Center
_4612.CompletionSummary: There will be Guilmon and V-mon to help you if you go to DATS Center! I hope you meet them!
_4612.ReservedText: Good! So you are ready huh!?

_4613.Title: [Leomon's Destiny]
_4613.Description: I'm losing my strength... I'm Leomon. I've come here to experience countless deaths and overcome my destiny. I need scattered data to revive. If you collect Disperse Data, I can make the pieces necessary for my Revival. Can you bring it to me?
_4613.Objective: Collect 20 of [Disperse Data] by defeating monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village
_4613.CompletionSummary: Good. After collecting all 7 of them, I can revival.

_4614.Title: [Leomon's Destiny]
_4614.Description: If you bring all 7 of Revival Piece, I can make a Bundle of my First Destiny.
_4614.Objective: Collect 7 of [Piece of Leomon's Revival] by completing Daily quest of [Leomon's Destiny]
_4614.CompletionSummary: Okay, take this as a bundle of my first destiny.

_4615.Title: [Leomon's Destiny]
_4615.Description: I need something related to my first fate in order to go one step further to a complete resurrection. The destiny is related to MetalEtemon. I was told by the white-beard Guru next to me that MetalEtemon appeared in the Silent forest. If you defeat the MetalEtemon and come back, I can make a piece of it that contains the energy I need for my revival.
_4615.CompletionSummary:
Here it is.
If you collect 7 items, you can make something from me for the next fate.
After that, I asked the next story to White-beard Guru.

_4616.Title: [Leomon's Destiny]
_4616.Description: Welcome. Leomon could have been a revival, but it's not a complete revival yet. We need Beelzebumon's energy in relation to the second destiny to reach a full revival. It has been confirmed that you will appear in the desert areas of the Server Continent, so please go there and defeat the Beelzebumon.
_4616.Objective: Defeat <Destiny> Beelzebumon at Server Continent Desert
_4616.CompletionText: Leomon... I'm sorry to hear that.
_4616.CompletionSummary:
A piece which needed to reach the full revival of leomon.
If we collect seven, he'll have a full revival.

_4617.Title: [Leomon's Destiny]
_4617.Description: Lemon is now fully revival, but the destiny of facing the evil inside is still waiting. go to D-Terminal Underground Summon Square with the stuff I gave you. I'll give you something to help Leomon get stronger if you fight the inner evil in the terminal square.
_4617.Objective: Summon and Defeat <Destiny> ??? By using Item of [Leomon's opponent] at D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_4617.CompletionSummary:
I believe this will save him from his fate.
Here, take it.

_4618.Title: [Patamon's Destiny]
_4618.Description: I am Patamon! I'm here to show you the destiny that I had on File Island. However, it takes some preparation to get there. Can you do what I ask you to do?
_4618.Objective: Betamon at Silver Lake Monzaemon at A Silent Forest Gotsumon at Lost Historic Site MegaSeadramon at F.I Waterfront
_4618.CompletionSummary:
Good work!
If you collect 7 of these, I'll make an item for you to go to the Infinite Mountain of Destiny.

_4619.Title: [Patamon's Destiny]
_4619.Description: Did you bring anything to see Patamon's destiny?
_4619.Objective: Hold [Patamon's Destiny : Sacrifice] Talk to <Destiny> T.K
_4619.CompletionSummary: Right. I will show you now.

_4620.Title: [Patamon's Destiny]
_4620.Description: Are you ready to go to the Infinite mountain of Destiny?

_4621.Title: [Wizarmon's Destiny]
_4621.Description:
All the beads I always carried around...
I carried these around to show you my destiny.
I need the ingredients to make it again, but could you get it for me?
_4621.Objective: Scan the objtained items by defeating monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village.

_4622.Title: [Wizarmon's Destiny]
_4622.Description:
Cause I dropping the sky bead that I used to carry around...It's broken.
Could you get me some materials to make it again?
I'll make it up to you if you can come and get it.
_4622.Objective: Scan the objtained items by defeating monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village.

_4623.Title: [Wizarmon's Destiny]
_4623.Description:
Someone stole the Golden beads that the most cherished golden Bead of mine...
It's not even real gold.
I'd appreciate it if you could get the items you need to make it again.
_4623.Objective: Scan the objtained items by defeating monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village.
_4623.CompletionSummary: It is not a real gold. Here, take my grattitude.

_4624.Title: [Wizarmon's Destiny]
_4624.Description: The most beautiful Pure white bead I've ever had, it became so cloudy. I can't wash the beads, and I need a lot of materials to make them again, so if you bring them for me, I'll return your favor with the best things I have.
_4624.Objective: Scan the objtained items by defeating monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village.
_4624.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Transparent Destiny Bead%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Red Bead of Destiny%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Blue Bead of Destiny%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Green Bead of Destiny%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4624.CompletionSummary: Oh! That is the right color! Thank you!

_4625.Title: [ChaosPiedmon's Destiny]
_4625.Description:
Unlike the Wizarmon next to you, I can see if your future destiny is good or bad.
But I have to eat and live, so could you get me some items called [Piece of Destiny]?
I'll steal a glimpse of your destiny if you can bring the [Piece of Destiny] to me.
_4625.Objective: Collect [Piece of Destiny] by defeating monsters at all areas except Yokohama Village.
_4625.CompletionText: All you need to do is collect them.
_4625.CompletionSummary: Oh! You've collected them so quickly. Now I can spying your Destiny

_4626.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4626.Description:
Thank you for helping us. Now This is a device that can move to the Devimon's Crack.
If you show this to Andromon, it will send you to the Devimon's crack. But... there are only two things you can give a day to restore a File Island. Talk back to me when you are ready!

_4627.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4627.Description:
Thank you for helping us. Now This is a device that can move to the Devimon's Crack.
If you show this to Andromon, it will send you to the Devimon's crack. But... there are only five things you can give a day to restore a File Island. Talk back to me when you are ready!

_4628.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4628.Description: You will face Ogremons first when you enter the Crack of Devimon!! Ogremons(Crack of Devimon)' wicked energy became stronger after Devimon's experiments. Please stop the wicked energy of File Island from spreading by defeating Ogremons!
_4628.CompletionSummary: Wow! Incredible! I think you guys can defeat Devimons!!!

_4629.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4629.Description: Ogremons(Crack of Devimon) with stronger wicked power thru Devimon's experiment are stopping invaders coming into the Crack of Devimon with Underling. In order to defeat Devimon, it will be easier to defeat Ogremon's Underlings.
_4629.CompletionText: Cheer up! You will be able to defeat Gotsumon's Underlings!
_4629.CompletionSummary: I knew you guys can defeat Devimon's Underlings!!

_4630.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4630.Description: You can get Club of Ogremons after defeating Ogremons(Crack of Devimon). White-bearded Guru told me that data to destroy Black Cogwheels from the Club of Ogremons. So collect the Club of Ogremons and bring it to me!
_4630.CompletionText: Yet the crack of Devimon cannot be prevented…
_4630.CompletionSummary: You defeated Ogremon (Crack of Devimon)…. You guys are really strong!!

_4631.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4631.Summary: [Hard-Daily] Collect Club fragments from Ogremon's Underling
_4631.Description: You can get Club fragment of Ogremons after defeating Ogremon's Underling. White-bearded Guru told me that data to destroy Black Cogwheels from the Club fragments of Ogremons. So collect the Club fragments of Ogremons and bring it to me!
_4631.Objective: Collect club fragments of Ogremon's Underling
_4631.CompletionText: Cheer up! You will be able to defeat Gotsumon's Underlings!
_4631.CompletionSummary: I knew you guys can do it!!

_4632.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4632.Description: While you were moving more deeply into the Crack to meet Devimon, you will be able to meet Leomons whose minds are dominated by Devimon. Please save those dominated Leomons..
_4632.CompletionSummary: Leomons will also thank you guys…

_4633.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4633.Description: I would like you to persuade Leomon's Underlings dominated by Black Cogwheels of Devimon…!!

_4634.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4634.Summary: [Hard-Daily] Collect Leomon's Tail feathers (Crack of Devimon)
_4634.Description: If you fail to persuade and can't bring them back, please bring one item to remind Leomon.
_4634.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I will keep memory with Leomon with this tail feather..

_4635.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4635.Description: If you fail to persuade and can't bring them back, please bring one item to remind Leomon.
_4635.CompletionSummary: Thank you for bring me an item to remind Leomon.

_4636.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4636.Description: When you reach the deepest point of the Crack, Devimon you will face will use magic with wicked energy!! Especially that unknown wicked magic is trying to imbrue whole File Island with dark energy!! I believe you guys can defeat Devimon(Crack of Devimon) and bring peace to File Island!!
_4636.CompletionText: Cheer up!! Do not give up!
_4636.CompletionSummary: You guys are so great…. Thank you… File Island will get its old shape back..!!

_4637.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4637.Description: Defeat Devimon's Underlings at the end of the Crack of Devimon to make evil Devimon disappear from File Island!!
_4637.CompletionText: Cheer up!! Do not give up!
_4637.CompletionSummary: You guys are so great…. Thank you… File Island will get its old shape back..!!

_4638.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4638.Description: You can get Wing of Devimons after defeating Devimons(Crack of Devimon). White-bearded Guru told me that data to destroy Black Cogwheels from the Wing of Devimons. So collect the Wing of Devimons(Crack of Devimon) and bring it to me!
_4638.CompletionText: You did not get wing of Devimon yet…
_4638.CompletionSummary: Thank you… I think I can find a way to destroy Black Cogwheels!!

_4639.Title: Crack of Devimon
_4639.Summary: [Hard-Daily] Collect Wing fragments from Devimon's Underling
_4639.Description: You can get Wing fragment of Devimons after defeating Devimon's Underlings. White-bearded Guru told me that data to destroy Black Cogwheels from the Wing fragments of Devimons. So collect the Wing fragments of Devimons(Crack of Devimons) and bring it to me!
_4639.CompletionText: You did not get wing fragments of Devimon yet…
_4639.CompletionSummary: Thank you… I think I can find a way to destroy Black Cogwheels!!

_4640.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4640.Description:
Some of your hard-earned items were stolen by someone who was working with us.
Right next to me.
However, the Impmon who was found to have committed the crime together is currently on the run.
I'll give you a big reward if you catch him for me.
_4640.Objective: Defeat <Accomplice>Impmon at Silent Forest which appears [06:00, 21:00(GMT+9)] Everyday.
_4640.CompletionSummary: Thank you. It will be a good example.

_4641.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4641.Description:
In the meantime, there were many dangers in the world, and the power of Tamers was able to overcome them.
However, many wounds remain where the danger has passed and needs to be recovered. A lot of data is needed to recover.
Can you help me?
Talk to me again if you can help.
_4641.Objective: Talk to <Director>Gallantmon that you will help

_4642.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4642.Description:
Now, Yukidarumon, Elecmon, Etemon, and Wizadmon are here to help me.
They are responsible for collecting and managing supplies in their respective regions.
If I get their own certificate after performing their request, I will pay the compensation accordingly.
_4642.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Certificate of Yukidarumon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Certificate of Elecmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Certificate of Etemon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Certificate of Wizardmon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4642.CompletionText: Again, we're getting help from the Tamers…
_4642.CompletionSummary: It must have taken a long time. I appreciate it. I will give you these in return.

_4643.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4643.Description:
If you collect [Blue Data] that can be obtained in some of the Glacier areas that I am in charge of, I will reward you accordingly!
Are you able to help me?
_4643.Objective: Collect 100 of [Blue Data] by defeating monsters at Frozen Ground, Snowman Village areas.
_4643.CompletionText: There were a lot of things.

_4644.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4644.Summary: Collect Resources of File Island Area
_4644.Description: Could you collect the [Green Data] that you can get from the File island area that I am in charge of?
_4644.Objective: Collect 100 of [Green Ddata] by defeat monsters at Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront

_4645.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4645.Summary: Collect Resources of Server Continent Area
_4645.Description:
Hey~!
The request of me is to collect [Red Data] containing red energy from the Server continent.
If you come, I will reward to you!
_4645.Objective: Defeat Monsters and collect 100 of [Red Data] at Server Continent Desert, Server Continent Canyon, Server Continent Pyramid

_4646.Title: [Cure the wound of the World]
_4646.Description:
If you bring [Black Data] with black energy from the Odaiba area to me, I will give you one of the items for those who helped at the Dats Center.
And... this person next to me was caught trying to sneak out of the data that I had been trying to collect and deal with it.
I need to replenish as much data as I missed...
Can you help me?
_4646.Objective: Defeat Monsters and collect [Black Data] or obatain [Blue Data], [Green Data], [Red Data] and craft at Odaiba Area.
_4646.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Black Data%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Blue Data%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Green Data%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Collect Red Data%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4646.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. I put the best ones I have.

_4647.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4647.Description:
[Red Hat] is needed to help the Leomons go the way of Banchou.
At least there must be proof that you are stronger than my disciples.
I will give you [Banchou Mane] when you defeat the Digimons I have told you in the Silver Lake area.

_4648.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4648.Description:
... It is too hard. I'm tired of 'some' Digimons that make ridiculous chores. They just came in before me.
Would you please solve this problem with 'Banchou Mane'?
_4648.Objective: Talk to <Feeble>Leomon, that just count on me!
_4648.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much! Please accept this.

_4649.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4649.Description:
Whooooo… The training never ends. I'm currently in training at Silver Lake and the Lost Ruins area sent by Banchou Leomon. But, there is a problem with the Digimons that interfered with the training.
I am deeply concerned, so I would really appreciate it if you could help me!
_4649.Objective: Defeat Mushroomon at Silver Lake,Defeat Cherrymon, RedVegiemon, Blossomon at Lost Historic Site area.
_4649.CompletionText: Even accept this kind of request…

_4650.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4650.Description:
Big Brother ran away! Again! Left the quests from Manager which big brother had to solve... So I need to build up for accommodation with other Leomons, and we have a problem. We need more Fine sand and Shovel. I think... He ran away because he didn't want to do the quest...
If you can help me, I will repay you for sure!
_4650.Objective: Collect [Fine Sand] by defeating monsters at Desert area. Collect [Shovel] by defeating monsters at Pyramid area.
_4650.CompletionText:
Where is stupid… oops… Big Brother?
You… didn't hear from me, right?
_4650.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Um, have you seen Big Brother?

_4651.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4651.Description:
Hey! Yes, you! Come here. Can you do me a favor? I gave <Banchou Big Brother>Leomon a quest and he ran away again. He even tosses my quest to <Banchou Brother> Leomon.
I can not go after him because I got something important to do. Can you catch <Banchou Big Brother>Leomons for me? If you can help me, I will repay you.
_4651.Objective: Defeat <Banchou Big Brother>Leomon at Western Village, Oil refinery, and Distorted Data Village areas.
_4651.CompletionText: Even though I have been here as disciple… I am the manager.
_4651.CompletionSummary: Good work! Here's a box I specially prepared for you.

_4652.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4652.Summary: Out of Control! Stop the SaberLeomon
_4652.Description: Oh, thank you for stopping SaberLeomon... I think I need to have a word with him.
_4652.CompletionSummary: I can make a useful sword like this. If you collect it, I will turn it into something good.

_4653.Title: [Way to Banchou]
_4653.Summary: Out of Control! Stop the DinoTigermon
_4653.Description: What a strong power... you stopped the out of control DinoTigermon! I think... DinoTigermon needs to be punished…
_4653.CompletionSummary:
I can change it with a special knife like this.
If you collect this, I will exchange it with other things.
_4653.ReservedText: If I change this with my 20-year polished skills!

_4654.Title: [The coming Darkness]
_4654.Description: Good to see you again. I have a favour to you about recent movement of Dark forces. Before I ask you something, I want to make sure that how strong you are. Can you collect [Protection Data] from Monsters at Western Village, Western Area : Outskirts, Western Area : West areas?
_4654.Objective: Collect [Protection Data] by defeating Monsters at Western Village, Western Area : Outskirts, Western Area : West areas
_4654.CompletionSummary: You've been going through a lot. Then now you can entrust some dangerous things.

_4655.Title: [The coming Darkness]
_4655.Description:
I need to do the research for this happening.
Right now, Digimon's Data seems not running normally. So I need to check something.
I heard that Digimons at Snowman Village and Snowstorm Village have seveir situation now, would you collect [Damaged Data] by defeating the monstsers there?
_4655.Objective: Collect [Damaged Data] by defeating Monsters at Snowman Village, Snowstorm Village

_4656.Title: [The coming Darkness]
_4656.Description:
In the past, it is said that artificial Digimon, which has the power to destroy Digimon by indiscriminately attacking Digimon, has appeared again on the Frozen Ground.
Please defeat the Gizmons.
_4656.CompletionSummary: You've been going through a lot.

_4657.Title: [The coming Darkness]
_4657.Description:
I feel the huge will of evil... It seems that it is reacting to someone's will. In particular, the movements of the Lost Historic Site and the File Island Waterfront have changed significantly.
Go and find out why something changed.
_4657.Objective: Collect [Damaged Mission Paper] by defeating Monsters at Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront
_4657.CompletionSummary: Right. It was like that. There seems to be something wrong with the Dats Center. With this, I think it is necessary to find a person who wants destruction in the Dats Center.

_4658.Title: [The coming Darkness]
_4658.Objective: Hold [A Lie Detector], and talk to someone who was very close to Digimon, the Devil's King, and Talk to White-beard Guru.
_4658.CompletionSummary: Right. I see. The crisis of this time is that human will is not mixed.
_4658.ReservedText:
No! Its Not me this time!
... Take that down!
I'm just selling goods for you here!
What I only know is that the Digimon that needs them is 'The' Digimon!

_4659.Title: [The coming Darkness]
_4659.Description:
There has been informed that a huge evil has emerged. Although it is said to be asleep now, it is a very dangerous Digimon.
As a Digimon who wish for the peace, please. Defeat the Ultimate Evil with other Tamers.
_4659.Objective: Defeat Belphemin: Sleep Mode at A Silent Forest [GMT+9 11:00/19:00]

_4660.Title: [Jesmon X Event]
_4660.Description: I've stayed longer than I thought. It is said that my disciple, Jesmon, became Jesmon X through X-evolution. Why don't you fight with my disciple?
_4660.Objective: Talk to <Master>Gankoomon and let him know that you are ready to fight against Jesmon X.
_4660.ReservedText: Now, Are you ready for the fight?

_4661.Title: [Want to Play! Event]
_4661.Description: My my. Right now, there is danger outside because of Keramons and yet Tanemon keeps asking me that he wants to go out and play. To keep Tanemon strong, we will need [Puryfing Water]. If you could collect [Cloudy Water of Essence], I can create it into [Puryfied Water]. Could you help me? For me, I am already tired to keep my eyes on him...
_4661.Objective: Collect[Cloudy Water of Essence] by Monsters at Wilderness Area, Silver Lake area.
_4661.CompletionText: It's very difficult to do this by one person…
_4661.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I will ask you tomorrow again…

_4662.Title: [Want to Play! Event]
_4662.Description:
I think Elecmon is too tired to take care of me.
I think it's because he's worried about me that I came all the way here.
I'd like to make something to cheer up for the tired Elecmon. Can you help me?
_4662.Objective: Collect [Fresh Seafood] at File Island Waterfront Collect [Preservation ice] at Snowman, Snowstorm Village
_4662.CompletionText: I hope this could cheer you!
_4662.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I will make something delicious for Elecmon!

_4663.Title: [Jumping Event]
_4663.Description:
Welcome.
Hope it wasn't too bad of a journey?
_4663.Objective: Clear the quests at Yokohama Vill Use Time Dimension Bomb received from Richard Sampson Go to Silver Lake and talk to Agumon
_4663.CompletionSummary: Now, your adventure begins for real! Hope you put in your effort in protecting both the Real World and the Digital World, as a Tamer!

_4664.Title: [Jumping Event]
_4664.Description:
Great! You've become a Lv.60 Tamer in an instance… Not an easy job.
And I have one more present for you… You curious?
It's a must-have item!
_4664.Objective: Talk to Agumon to receive a token that will be exchanged for the hatching box
_4664.CompletionSummary:
With this, I can exchange for you a box that can help to hatch some powerful Digimon friends.
Got the incubator right here so please! Don't forget to hatch!

_4665.Title: [Jumping Event]
_4665.Description:
Well, shall we start now?
Ready for your jump?
If you are, come talk to me again!
_4665.Objective: Talk to Agumon to let him know that you are ready for the jump
_4665.CompletionSummary: Use all of this, become a Lv.60 Tamer, then talk to me again!
_4665.ReservedText: Great! Means you are ready, right?

_4666.Title: [Mother's Day Event]
_4666.Description:
Is this... the fragment of WarGreymon(Black)? I almost couldn't go home because of this, but I'm finally getting my mom a present.
Thank you! You saved my life!
_4666.Objective: Obtain the Fragment by defeating [WarGreymon(Black)] at A Silent Forest, Snowman Village, Western Area : Outskirts.
_4666.CompletionText: Now, which gift should I need to prepare…?
_4666.CompletionSummary: Here, take this instead. Let's do well together until things are over!

_4667.Title: [Mother's Day Event]
_4667.Description:
Nice to meet you. My name is Yushima.
I helped Mrs.daimon because she was worried about her son quite a lot... But I know that Marcus is preparing a gift for the upcoming Mother's Day. Marcus seems to be too busy to talk to his mom often because he is busy protecting the digital world. Can you help Marcus? I'll give you a reward for that.
_4667.Objective: Collect 60ea of [Defeat Mark] by defeating <Villan>Monsters at Western Village, Silver Lake, Snowstorm Village area.

_4668.Title: [Mother's Day Event]
_4668.Description:
Hi, kid. I'm sorry to bother you. you're busy protecting the world. But can you do me a favor?
Recently, it seems like my son Marcus is going to the digital world without many people knowing... Marcus hasn't spoken for days. Could you look into Marcus' work?
_4668.Objective: Collect 50ea of [Clue] by defeating Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village.
_4668.CompletionSummary: Great Work! Now go to the Underground Summon Square with this. It's given to me by Director Yushima , and it might show you what Marcus is doing.

_4669.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4669.Description: I remember that Ms.Mimi went this way. We need to be hurry before Mimi is dangerous! Hum…? I hear some strange sounds inside! Shall we go and check!?
_4669.Objective: Move to The strange sound Place
_4669.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to The strange sound place%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to the Owner of sound%qe %cc2/%mc2

_4670.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4670.Description: I thought we are safe because of Leomon ran away but… Devimon's power ruining the Time line of Ancient Ruins! Overthere, the same era is repeating again and again. We need to stop it before the Monsters been created more. Here! This is the Pass that I received from Centalmon before he get into the Ruin again. You can get into the Ruin again with this, so Prepare yourself. Let me know When you are ready.

_4671.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4671.Description: Oh, no! I thought Leomon ran away and was safe. Devimon's power is destroying the ruins' time zone! The same time zone is being repeated in there. We have to stop Monsters before they get any more at that time. Here! It's the pass that Tentomon gave me before he went back into the Ruins. You can use this to get in, so you should be prepared! When you are ready, talk to me again!

_4672.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4672.Description: Izzy find out where Mimi and Tentomon are located! But… Monsters are heading to that place right now! Tentamon is in danger! Go and help them quickly!!!
_4672.CompletionText: Hope Tentomon and Mimi are safe…
_4672.CompletionSummary: Oh, you finally found it! Thank you. I couldn't win by myself. But ... there's another problem. This ruin is also taken by Devimons.

_4673.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4673.Description: Oh, and the friend you're looking for, it looks like she went into that maze. I saw Centalmon and the others chasing her. Follow the path of Digimon and you'll find your friend.
_4673.Objective: %qs1Talk to Mimi%qe %cc1/%mc1 at Lost Historic Site
_4673.CompletionText: Roachmons made a room full of mess.
_4673.CompletionSummary: Ah! Finally! You are here! What keep you so long~!!

_4674.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4674.Description: This ruin was originally protected by Centalmon and Mystimon. Devimon made this place full of monsters by using Black cogwheels ... So... Centalmon came after us, and Mystimon tried to protect us, but he was forced by the black cogwheels and became a Monster. Meanwhile, I was separated from Mimi. Mystimon said Devimon would use his men to destroy the Ruins. Please defeat the Parasimon in the Dark Attribute Room for the revenge of Mystimon and the peace of Ancient Ruins.
_4674.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much. I found the Digicode while you were in fight. This will help to wake.

_4675.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4675.Description:
There's Meramon here, too!
I guess there's Meramon here who hasn't woken up yet!
And, Izzy said that a DigiCode is in here also.
Please help them! I'll quickly investigate where the DigiCode is!
_4675.CompletionSummary: I found it! Meramon seems okay now Now, let's find Mimi!

_4676.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4676.Description: Hey! Yes, it's you! Come here. I'm in trouble now! I'll tell you what, I am the Digimon who lived here for a long time! Last time, PicoDevimon came and made my room mess up, but this time, the Roachmons suddenly stormed in and smashed my room and these ruins. Besides, he hides under a jar that where I go to sleep in, because you were you coming? It's all your fault, right? Right? I won't say anything else. There's a Roachmon over there right now do the Night watcher duty, and he's got a lever to hold the pot, so get them out of here!
_4676.Objective: Obtain Lever by defeating Roachmon(Night Watcher). Summon Roachmon(Hidden Leader) and defeat at Lost Historic Site
_4676.CompletionText: I only wanted to live quietly…
_4676.CompletionSummary: Good! Now everything solved. Ah, of course, I will reward you. That I am the noble one. Here. Take this.

_4677.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4677.Description: There's a Centalmon in the room... He became just as violent as any other Monsters! I tried to go back because I was scared, but I can't because it's a maze. So how did I get here? I don't know! I've been wandering around and I've come all the way here. Are you going to keep asking me questions? Scold Centalmon~ Hurry up!
_4677.CompletionText: So Scared~ Hungrey~ Want to go Home~
_4677.CompletionSummary:
I think Centalmon is awake now! Look over there. Waiting for you over there?
Thanks! I can get out of here comfortably now!

_4678.Title: Ancient Ruins of Secret
_4678.Description: Why was I doing this? I remember meeting Leomon. What? Black cogwheels that make Digimon violent? So did you get rid of them by yourself? Thank you very much. But I don't think it's over yet. Leomon is going to the Holy Digivice Altar. Go ahead and stop him!
_4678.CompletionText: To reach the Digivice Altar, you need to across this Portal.
_4678.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Leomon escape but at least the Ancient Ruins is safe.

_4679.Title: [Cherry Blossom Event]
_4679.Summary: A Ghost that envies cherry blossoms
_4679.Description: Nice to meet you. I'm Rosemon. The cherry blossom season is perfect for going out to play. But this year is not a good time... It's a big problem that Cherrymon, who is now envious of cherry blossoms, appears here. Can you defeat defeat Cherrymon? Ah! And. Cherrymon moved from the Yokohama East Village to A Silent Forest. Cherrymon is show up secretly at bedtime and be despotic.
_4679.Objective: Defeat Cherrymon <Ghost> from every day in a Silent Forest. (Beware for the reseting time of Daily quest)

_4680.Title: [No more Lies! Event]
_4680.Description:
I am Piedmon. I wanted to present you a magic trick but I lost some of the magic tools at the File Island Waterfront.
If you help me to find it, I will give you a coin for the card game as a reward.
_4680.Objective: Collect [Piedmon's Magic Tool] by defeating Monsters at File Island Waterfront.
_4680.CompletionText: The Macig Tool might seems dangerous.
_4680.CompletionSummary: 'Hmm! Thank you! Playing magic can be a little dangerous, so let's play a card game with this.

_4681.Title: [No more Lies! Event]
_4681.Objective: Collect Black Heart by defeating <A Liar>Puppetmon at File Island area.

_4682.Title: [No more Lies! Event]
_4682.Summary: A Loud Ringing of the Phone
_4682.Description:
'(It's ringing very loudly.)
Is it a pizza Shop?
I'm going to die cold and hungry. When are you going to deliver the food!?
Do you ignore customers because it is an extreme area?
Why did you sprinkle the delivery flyer?
(The phone hung up.)
_4682.Objective: Collect [Letter of Apology] by defeating monsters at Snowstorm Village, Snowman Village, Frozen Ground

_4683.Title: [No more Lies! Event]
_4683.Summary: The faint ringing of a telephone bell
_4683.Description: '(The phone rings like it can be heard.) ....... ........ ......... W ... This is ... Western Village ... ........... ............ (The phone hung up.)
_4683.Objective: Defeat 10 each of Monsters that appear differently when clicked among the monsters at Western Village area.
_4683.CompletionSummary: (I don't think I have to pay any more attention today. As long as it doesn't ring loud...)

_4684.Title: [No more Lies! Event]
_4684.Description: [Notice] To use this Phone, Tamer must proof their ability. Use the Phone after defeat the monsters.
_4684.CompletionSummary:
From now on, Tamer able to use the Phone.
Tamer able to craft various Item with [Phone Card]

_4685.Title: [Jesmon Event]
_4685.Summary: The disciple has become the Master
_4685.Description: Nice to meet you. My disciple, Jesmon, has finally joined the world. Why don't you fight with my disciple? But, first, you have to pass the test to prove your power.
_4685.Objective: Collect 30 of [Proof of the Strength] by defeating Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village
_4685.CompletionSummary: My disciple won't be easy. Go ahead.

_4686.Title: [Masters Match]
_4686.Description: Here's for Mission Rank D. Gather the [Brown Egg] from Monsters at somewhere of Western area.
_4686.Objective: Collect the [Brown Egg] by defeating the Monsters at Wilderness Area, Digimon Farm, Wind Valley, Ruined Historic, Western Area

_4687.Title: [Masters Match]
_4687.Description: Here's for Mission Rank C. Gather the [Blue Egg] from Monsters at somewhere of Glacier Area.
_4687.Objective: Collect the [Blue Egg] by defeating the Monsters at Snowstorm Village, Frozen Ground, Snowman Village, Distorted Data Village
_4687.CompletionSummary: Was it cold? Good to see you back

_4688.Title: [Masters Match]
_4688.Description: Here's for Mission Rank B. Gather the [Green Egg] from Monsters at somewhere of File Island area.
_4688.Objective: Collect the [Green Egg] by defeating the Monsters at Silver Lake, A Silent Forest, File Island Waterfront

_4689.Title: [Masters Match]
_4689.Description:
Here's for Mission Rank A. Gather the [Yellow Egg] from Monsters at somewhere of Server Continent.
You sould be prepared yourself. It will be dangerous and difficult to complete the quest from Mission Rank A.
_4689.Objective: Collect the [Yellow Egg] by defeating the Monsters at Server Continent Desert, Canyon, Pyramid

_4690.Title: [Masters Match]
_4690.Description:
Here's for Mission Rank S. Gather the [Red Egg] from Monsters at somewhere of Odaiba area.
Mission Rank S is very dangerous, and the item of [Red Egg] might be very hard to find. So be careful.
_4690.Objective: Collect the [Red Egg] 5ea by defeating Monsters at Tokyo-Odaiba area except CampSite

_4691.Title: [Masters Match]
_4691.Description: Greetings. I am Leomon who manages the Missions for Masters Match. Would you like to start the Masters Match Mission?
_4691.CompletionSummary: Good, Let's start from Rank D.

_4692.Title: Mastemon
_4692.Description: Culu~. I was looking for you. Culu~ White-bearded Guru was looking for you Culu~ I think you should get going Culu~
_4692.CompletionSummary: Welcome~@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>~ I was looking for you…

_4693.Title: Mastemon
_4693.Description: Hahaha. Yeah, yeah. I'll tell you from now on. There is a Digimon who uses his power for justice, not evil, like the Seven Demon Lords... You can use both the power of good and evil, light and darkness at the same time, like in Luchemon Falldown Mode.
_4693.CompletionSummary: Because the warrior of light is the Angewomon right beside you...

_4694.Title: Mastemon
_4694.Description:
Angewomon, which you currently have as your partner... Angewomon is the warrior of light that ancient legends talk about. But I don't know exactly how to become a Mastemon...
Perhaps the three angels know the condition... So why don't you meet the three angels?
Maybe you should go first to Ophanimon who delivers mercy and mercy. Why don't you meet Ophanimon?
_4694.Objective: Go to Explorer camp of Lost Historic Site Talk to MagnaAngemon
_4694.CompletionText: if @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> could make it, you would have a strong ally...

_4695.Title: Mastemon
_4695.Description:
Human? What's going on here? This is where Ophanimon, one of the three angels, is located!
It's not a place where human beings can come!
If you approach me any more, I will take an action!
_4695.Objective: At Duel Sphere Defeat <Right-Hand man>MagnaAngemon Defeat <left-Hand man>MagnaAngemon
_4695.CompletionText: No one can get close to Ophanimon!
_4695.CompletionSummary: It's... strong. How can this power be in a human being…

_4696.Title: Mastemon
_4696.Description: The ancient legend you're talking about... Are you talking about a legend about the coexistence of good and evil? Do you want to know more about this legend?
_4696.CompletionSummary:
There are two reasons. One is that in order to evolve Jogress, two Digimons must have one meaning. So Angewomon and LadyDevimon have to think the same thing.
And the other one is...

_4697.Title: Mastemon
_4697.Description:
Another reason... That's because... you need to be recognized by our three angels.
Lady Devlmon is a Fallen Angel-type Digimon... we, angel-type Digimon, can be adversely affected because of jogress with a fallen angel.
So through our test with the three angels, we need to test Angewomon for its strength and strength that will not be swept away by evil. If you pass the test, you will be given the stamp of the three angels, meaning that it can evolve into a Mastemon.
Human, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>...... If you're going to run a test with our three angels to become a Mastemon, Would you like to have a fight with that ophanimon...!?
_4697.CompletionSummary: That's great...! Angewomon with this level of strength... It's amazing...!

_4698.Title: Mastemon
_4698.Description:
Your attitude might convince Cherubimon and Seraphimon.
I'll let you know where the two are for you. Cherubimon was found in the Ruined Historic at the western part of the country. The Seraphimon is in the Distorted Data Village.
First, go to the Ruined Historic in the western part of the country and meet Cherubimon. If you convince Cherubimon to get a stamp and show it to Seraphimon, Maybe he'll lose his weakest link.
Then good luck...
_4698.Objective: Go to Street of Trial Talk to Cherubimon
_4698.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Street of Trial%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Cherubimon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4698.CompletionText: Cherubimon is in Ruined Historic, Seraphimon is in Distorted Data Village.
_4698.CompletionSummary: Human? Why human is wondering around at this place?

_4699.Title: Mastemon
_4699.Description:
I see, the Ophanimon let you through... Maybe it's because Ophanimon saw potential in you...!
Ophanimon is a very careful Digimon. I wouldn't have thought wrong!
Good! I, Cherubimon, one of the third angel, I'll test your Angewomon is qualified to be a Mastemon.
And whether you deserve to be Mastemon's partner. Let's check it out!
_4699.CompletionSummary:
That's amazing...!' How could you do this against me... It's amazing...!
Since you passed, I'll give you my stamp!

_4700.Title: Mastemon
_4700.Description:
Passed! It was amazing! How can you show this much power against me! I don't think it would be a problem to Jogress evolution with the Fallen Angel!
So all we have left is Seraphimon?
Hmm... It must be very hard... Seraphimon, like me, opposes the Jogress evolution with the Fallen Angel Digimon By the way... Seraphimon is more stubborn than me. But you might change even with the stubborn one.
By any chance, did you hear where the Seraphimon is located from Ophanimon? You might have forgotten, so I'll let you know one more time. Seraphimon is in the twisted data village of the glacier station! Then cheer up!
_4700.Objective: Go to Ice Castle of Infinite Ice Wall Talk to Seraphimon
_4700.CompletionSummary: Human? Why human is wondering around at this place?

_4701.Title: Mastemon
_4701.Description:
Now let's take a look at the test.
Let me tell you one thing. Ophanimon and Cherubimon agreed, so I had to take the test. I'm still in the opposite position with the two.
So I'm not going to let it go, I'm going to do my best. Please be firm in your resolution.
So, let's start the test...!
_4701.CompletionSummary:
I can't believe it. Against the Seraphimon...This much...
Hmm... You passed. I'll give you a stamp…

_4702.Title: Mastemon
_4702.Description:
If you keep what you've shown me, Even with the Fallen Angel-type Digimon and the Jogress Evolution, they don't get carried away by evil, and can do the best for justice.
I'll trust you. Therefore, I ask you to work for justice so that my faith will not be cracked.
Go back to Ophanimon with three Stamps. I'm sure she has something to tell you....
_4702.Objective: Go to Explorer camp of Lost Historic Site Talk to Ophanimon
_4702.CompletionSummary: Welcome! Did you get the stamp from the two?

_4703.Title: Mastemon
_4703.Description:
You've collected all three Stamps! I believed it. You could be recognized by our three angels...!
