Phew~ I'm sorry, but it's not over yet. We still have to wrap it up.
Could you give me three stamps for a moment?
_4703.Objective: Ophanimon Stamp Cherubimon Stamp Seraphimon Stamp Talk to Ophanimon
_4703.CompletionSummary:
The three Stamps have been combined into one. There's a little bit of power in us little by little. Well, I think it's like a Amulet. It can prevent the situation from happening, or it can boost Holy power. Please give it to your partner, Angewomon.
Now the warrior of light from the ancient legend is perfectly ready. All we have to do is find LadyDevimon, who has the same opinion as us.
It's going to be hard. But I think you can do it.
May good luck be with you...

_4704.Title: [Mastemon Joined]
_4704.Summary: The boundary between Light and Darkness
_4704.Description: A new Digimon has joined the digital world. Why don't you have a match?
_4704.Objective: Talk to <Royal Knights>Omegamon at Dats Center
_4704.CompletionText: it could be difficult to defeat.
_4704.CompletionSummary: Go to Underground Summon Square with this.

_4705.Title: [Spring Event]
_4705.Description: If you also love the sweetness. Why don't you join the Sweet Guardian?
_4705.Objective: Summon someone using [Certificate of Sweet Guardian] and defeat at D-Terminal
_4705.CompletionText: Need to defeat at the Underground Summon Square!
_4705.CompletionSummary: Congratulation! Here, the Certificate and lollypop

_4706.Title: [Spring Event]
_4706.Description: Gya~ I'm Agumon, the sweet guardian!! I'm collecting ingredients to make delicious candy. We don't have enough black powder! Can you help me?
_4706.Objective: Defeat Monsters at WildernessArea, DigimonFarm, WindValley, RuinedHistoric, WesternArea:Outskirts,East,West and collect item
_4706.CompletionSummary: Great job! Here! I give you a gift and lollypop I made!

_4707.Title: [Spring Event]
_4707.Description:
I'm Gabumon! I was working in the ice field as a sweet Guardian. There are too many intrusive digimons...
Could you defeat them down?
_4707.Objective: Defeat Icemon at Snowstorm Village Defeat IceDevimon at Snowman Village Defeat Metal Etemon at Distorted Data Village
_4707.CompletionSummary: Here! I have collected the candy I made and the things you might need! Take it!

_4708.Title: [Spring Event]
_4708.Description:
Patamon asked me to collect some Brown Powder... I don’t know what I should do.
I heard that Brown Powder can be collected from File Island. Can you collect it for me?
Of course, I'll reciprocate!
_4708.Objective: Collect [Brown Powder] at Silver Lake, A Silent Forest, Lost Historic Site, File Island Waterfront
_4708.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Here, take this, I made this Box and Lolly pop while I was waiting. I don't know what's inside!

_4709.Title: Preparering New Semester
_4709.CompletionSummary:
Gizmon XT...I was fed up with this Digimon.
Digimon was shown by someone's false greed, but...
Thank you. If I had left it, other friends would have been hurt a lot.

_4710.Title: Preparering New Semester
_4710.Description:
Hoot! I was in a bit of a difficult situation while preparing for the new semester. There were friends who keep interrupting!
Can you help me out? I think we need to scold some of them.
I think we need to scold some digimons at the File Island area.
_4710.Objective: Silver Lake Sabirdramon A Silent Forest Bakemon Lost Historic Site Bakemon File Island Waterfront Archnemon
_4710.CompletionSummary:
Thank you very much
Take this and go to the Underground Summon Square to use it!

_4711.Title: Preparering New Semester
_4711.Description:
Hi, I'm Lalamon. I'm here to help you. It's been a while, hasn't it?
I hope you can help me while I'm busy preparing for the new semester!
I have two things, but can you help me with the easy one?
I have some materials I need to collect some materials in the Silver Lake. Other Digimons would keep bothering me and I wish you scold them for me!
_4711.Objective: Defeat Birdramon, Mushroomon, Seadramon, Woodmon 5 each at Silver Lake
_4711.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Here, With this...Hope you get a good one!

_4712.Title: Preparering New Semester
_4712.Description:
Then would you gather the energy of fire with this burning passion of mine?
I think I'll have courage if my passion is with burning Passion!
_4712.Objective: Defeat Monsters and Collect 50ea of [the Spirit of Fire] at Server Continent Desert, Canyon, Pyramid
_4712.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Burning Passion%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect the Spirit of Fire%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4712.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now I don't have a lot of worries.

_4713.Title: Preparering New Semester
_4713.Description:
With the new semester just around the corner, my heart is pounding, but there is also anxiety...
Why don't you help me get the courage?
_4713.CompletionSummary: Oh Really? Thank you! First I will receive this…

_4714.Title: Gankoomon
_4714.Description: Hum~ @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>It's you. Good. I will deliver you a good news.
_4714.CompletionSummary: Gankoomon is one of a Digimon in the Royal Knights like me. But, unlike us, he travels from place to place to place to prevent any signs of chaos.

_4715.Title: Gankoomon
_4715.Description:
I heard that the Gankoomon is in Versandi Terminal right now.
If Gankoomon join to Dats Center, it will be a great help. But Gankoomon moves a lot. I am not sure if he will able to help us...It's worthy to talk once. maybe we should talk about it once.,
Why don't you go to Versandi Terminal and meet the Gankoomon?
_4715.Objective: Go to Versandi Terminal Talk to Gankoomon
_4715.CompletionText: It would be very reassuring if Gankoomon would come...
_4715.CompletionSummary: It's been a long time since I saw a human!

_4716.Title: Gankoomon
_4716.Description: A human want to see me? Well If you want me to do something for Digital World, I will do my best to help you!
_4716.CompletionSummary: So, I can not join to Dats!

_4717.Title: Gankoomon
_4717.Description: I'm not the type to stay in one place for the long term. Soon, I will leave this Verdandi terminal... So go back now, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>.
_4717.CompletionSummary: Hmm... Okay. Then I'll make a suggestion!

_4718.Title: Gankoomon
_4718.Description:
I thought it would be good to get enter the enter the Dats Center after hearing you.
One thing I concern is do you think, a Gankumon, a member of the Royal Knights able to belong there?!
So I want to make a suggestion.
Pass all the tests I offer you! Then I'll go into the Dats.
_4718.CompletionSummary: Okay! Huckmon! Why don't you test @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>…!

_4719.Title: Gankoomon
_4719.Description:
Here's the first test. Relax and listen. There are a lot of disorganized Digimons living in this Verdandi terminal, trying to get the X-Antobody.
I'd like to solve this problem without defeating any of Digimon, but I am also thinking about defeating them down, and returning them to the Digimon egg.
Anyway! Go defeat Dorumon, Kunemon, Fanbeemon and Dracumon, who are out of control!
If you can't even beat these guys, you can't take the Master Gankoomon's test!
_4719.Objective: Defeat Dorumon Defeat Kunemon Defeat Fanbeemon Defeat Dracumon
_4719.CompletionText: Will you ever pass this test?
_4719.CompletionSummary: Hmm... you seem to have some skills…

_4720.Title: Gankoomon
_4720.Description:
Next test. This time it's a bit difficult, so you'll have to be prepared.
Besides of all the digimons I mentioned earlier, It's also a home of the Mushroomon, Leomon, Lillymon, DexDoruGreymon, MegaDramon.
Bring the proof that you defeat them! If you don't solve this, you'd better go back to Dats Center.
_4720.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Mushroomon's Mushroom%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Leomon's Knife%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Lillymon's Wings%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4DexDoruGreymon's Horn%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5MegaDramon's Metal hand%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4720.CompletionSummary: You're pretty good... I didn't expect you to pass this test...

_4721.Title: Gankoomon
_4721.Description:
Next time. I'm going to make the test more difficult!
Remember the Dorumon, Kunemon, FanBeemon, Dracmon that you defeat earlier? In fact, they have Digimon in command of them.
Defaet Dorugoramon, GrandisKuwagamon, TigerVespamon, GranDracmon.
Do you think you can pass this test too?
_4721.Objective: Defeat Dorugoramon Defeat GrandisKuwagamon Defeat TigerVespamon Defeat GranDracmon
_4721.CompletionSummary: No way... I didn't expect you to pass this test...

_4722.Title: Gankoomon
_4722.Description:
It's the last time. I'll watching you for this test. if you can pass this test.
It is said that here in the Verdandi terminal, a DinoTigermon sometimes appears... But few people say they have seen him...
Not only is it hard to see, but the person who saw it lost his life...
If you take down the DinoTigermon and bring his Teeth, I will acknowledge your ability...
_4722.CompletionText: He's a great Tamer. Do you think you can pass this test?
_4722.CompletionSummary: I can't believe you knocked down the DinoTigermon. I'll admit you...

_4723.Title: Gankoomon
_4723.Description:
You must have passed Huckmon's test...
Then you have some of power to test. All right...follow me...
I'll try to test your skills somewhere else.
_4723.Objective: Go to D-Terminal Talk to Gankoomon
_4723.CompletionSummary: This is a familiar place for you, too. Does it?

_4724.Title: Gankoomon
_4724.Description:
The Shadow Labyrinth, where you will be tested, is a bit of a special place.
Because every day of the week, appearing Digimon is different.
Now, Here's what you have to do. There's a lot of information, so don't forget!
On Monday, Collect Shimery Moonlight Stone by defeating Murmukusmon, GranDracmon. On Tuesday, collect Bloody Ruby by defeating MegaGalgomon, Justimon. On Wednesday, collect Clear-water Sapphire by defeating Dorugoramon, Sakuyamon. On Thursday, collect Green Emerald by defeating MarineAngemon, Zudomon. On Friday, collect Hard Diamond by defeating Qinglongmon, Baihumon.
Gather it and come back. I'll be waiting here for you to pass the test.
_4724.Objective: Mon - Shimery Moonlight Stone Tue - Bloody Ruby Wed - Clear-water Sappire Thu - Green Emerald Fri - Hard Diamond
_4724.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Shimery Moonlight Stone%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Bloody Ruby%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Clear-water Sappire%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Green Emerald%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Hard Diamond%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4724.CompletionText: Hahaha, too many information? On Mon, Moonlight Stone by Murmukusmon, GranDracmon. On Tue, Bloody Ruby by MegaGalgomon, Justimon. On Wed, Clear-water Sapphire by Dorugoramon, Sakuyamon. On Thu, Green Emerald by MarineAngemon, Zudomon. On Fri, Hard Diamond by Qinglongmon, Baihumon.
_4724.CompletionSummary: As expected, you passed this test too? You're pretty good!

_4725.Title: Gankoomon
_4725.Description:
Oh, I'm sorry, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>. There are some things I forgot to say.
The Shadow Labyrinth also haunts Digimon on Saturdays and Sunday. Maze is open all year round 24.
So... On Saturday, Collect Shinig Pearl by defeating Gallantmon, LordKnightmon.
On Sunday, Collect Stone of Sunlight by defeating Diablomon, Arkadimon(Ultimate)
I wish you luck...
_4725.Objective: Sat - Shining Pearl Sun - Stone of Sunlight
_4725.CompletionText: Hahaha, too many information? The Shadow Labyrinth also haunts Digimon on Saturdays and Sunday. Maze is open all year round 24/7. So... On Sat, Shinig Pearl by Gallantmon, LordKnightmon. On Sun, Stone of Sunlight by Diablomon, Arkadimon Ultimate.
_4725.CompletionSummary: As expected, you passed this test too? You're pretty good!

_4726.Title: Gankoomon
_4726.Description:
Now that you passed the test, I'll move on to the next one. It's a lot this time also, so you'd better listen carefully.
On Monday, Defeat Beelzebumon BlastMode. On Tuesday, Defeat Fujinmon. On Wednesday,Defeat Duftmon. On Thursday, Defeat Vikemon. On Friday, Defeat Fanglongmon.
Then I'll be watching what you'll get this time.
_4726.Objective: Mon - Beelzebumon BlastMode Tue - Fujinmon Wed - Duftmon Thu - Vikemon Fri - Huanglongmon
_4726.CompletionText:
Forgot again? Okay, I will kindly repeat again for you.
On Monday, Defeat Beelzebumon BlastMode. On Tuesday, Defeat Fujinmon. On Wednesday,Defeat Duftmon. On Thursday, Defeate Vikemon. On Friday, Defeat Fanglongmon.
_4726.CompletionSummary: Did you pass this test too? That's great!

_4727.Title: Gankoomon
_4727.Description:
Oh,I forgot again. I did not mention about Saturday and Sunday. I will tell you from now on, so please remember well.
On Saturday, Defeat Gallantmon Crimson Mode. On Sunday, Defeat Armagemon.
Well, good luck...
_4727.Objective: Defeat Sat - Gallantmon Crimson Mode Defeat Sun - Armagemon
_4727.CompletionText:
Forgot again? Okay, I will kindly repeat again for you.
On Saturday, Defeat Gallantmon Crimson Mode. On Sunday, Defeat Armagemon.
_4727.CompletionSummary: Did you pass this test too? That's great!

_4728.Title: Gankoomon
_4728.Description:
This is the Final test. I'll see if you can pass this test. There's a lot to tell you this time as well. So I hope you remember it well.
On Monday, Defeating Babarmon. On Tuesday, Defeating Cherubimon White. On Wednesday, Defeating by Tanemon. On Thursday, Defeating by Neptunemon On Friday, Defeating MetalGarurumon X
_4728.Objective: Mon - Barbamon Tue - Cherubimon White Wed - Tanemon Thu - Neptunemon Fri - MetalGarurumon X
_4728.CompletionText: Well, Since this is the Final test, I will tell you again. On Monday, Defeating Babarmon. On Tuesday, Defeating Cherubimon White. On Wednesday, Defeating by Tanemon. On Thursday, Defeating by Neptunemon On Friday, Defeating MetalGarurumon X
_4728.CompletionSummary: So you passed this test too…

_4729.Title: Gankoomon
_4729.Description:
Hahaha! I didn't forget this time! It's just a short pause. I will tell you what to do on Saturday and Sunday, so listen carefully.
On Saturday, Defeat ZekeGreymon. On Sunday, Defeat Apocalymon
Well, good luck...
_4729.Objective:
Defeat Sat - ZekeGreymon
Defeat Sun - Apocalymon
_4729.CompletionText: Well, Since this is the Final test, I will tell you again. On Saturday, Defeat ZekeGreymon. On Sunday, Defeat Apocalymon
_4729.CompletionSummary: So you passed this test too…

_4730.Title: Gankoomon
_4730.Description:
@<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>... You've passed all the tests I've prepared.
That means the Dats is a group of talented people like you…
_4730.CompletionSummary:
Good! I'm Gankoomon, the Digimon who keeps what I said once!
I'll go into the Dats and solve the cases that happen with you! So, please take good care of me from now on! Partner!!

_4731.Title: Romantic Valentine
_4731.Description:
Cloudy Sky and blurry moonlight…
The romantic Valentine's full moon is rising, but I don't think we can see the moon at this rate.
Why don't you help me to retrieve Super Moon?
_4731.Objective: Complete the Quest by talking to Angemon
_4731.CompletionSummary: Here, Take this Crystal. I am the one who can input the moonlight energy, but you can hear the method of how to get moonlight energy from Angewomon next to me.

_4732.Title: Romantic Valentine
_4732.Description:
Hi there~
I will tell you how to input the moonlight to the crystal from Angemon.
If you bring some of the Fragment of Moon from Monsters at the File Island area, I can help you to input the moonlight.
_4732.Objective: Collect of Fragment of Moon by defeating Monsters at File Island area.
_4732.CompletionSummary: Now, go to see Angemon with this. And this is the gift of my gratitude!

_4733.Title: Valentine Event
_4733.Description:
Ta da~
Hi, I am Lopmon, the Baking King!
I am making the Sweet stuff for Valentine again!
Would you collect the Chocolate for me? Maybe I can do something if you help me!
_4733.Objective: Collect of [Chocolate] by [Chocolate Box]. [Chocolate Box] able to collect by Monsters at Real World except Yokohama Village.
_4733.CompletionText: Tasty~ and Sweet~ Chocolate~ Don't forget to brush your teeth after!
_4733.CompletionSummary: Oh this much already? Thank you!

_4734.Title: Valentine Event
_4734.Description:
Sorry… I really wanted to make special Chocolate…but… All of a sudden, Raremon came and take all the rare materials!! Think Raremon went underground.
Could you retrieve items for me?
_4734.CompletionSummary: Now, you may able to attract Raremon with this!

_4735.Title: Valentine Event
_4735.Description:
Th.. that’s!
Is that the chocolate from Babarmon who has been alone for a long time? So sad…
Well, that is that! If you give that to me, I will exchange it with coins!
_4735.CompletionSummary: Here! I might make you some good stuff for you.

_4736.Title: Achievement Event
_4736.Description: If you want to inherit the Hermes's name, collect The Wings of a Myth from Monsters of all area.
_4736.Objective: Collect The Wings of a Myth from Monsters of all area.
_4736.CompletionText: You can gain the power of Wind after inherit the name of Mercuremon.

_4737.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4737.Description:
Culu~ Something strange culu! Did you felt it too? culu
I think there are cracks in time, because of someone.
If you can not understand, try to find Mrs.Daimon Sayuri culu~ she will notice this in instant!
_4737.CompletionText: I feel something very uncomportable again, culu…

_4738.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4738.Description:
Oh~! #<my_tname> ~ If you want to meet Chika, why don't you go to school?
Is that child in Elementary school? In that case, try Yokohama Elementary School!
_4738.Objective: move to Yokohama Elemebtary School Talk to Chika's Friend
_4738.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1move to Yokohama Elemebtary School%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Chika's Friend%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4738.CompletionText: Hmm… he is not an idle talker. Who is Chika? I feel so used to it somehow. Hmm…

_4739.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4739.Description:
I don't think you saw me or him. Maybe I'm a little... ordinary-looking and confused with another friend.
Anyway... I am sorry for not being able to help... Well, I'm... I'm kind of busy, so
_4739.Objective: Go back to Dats Center and talk to Richard Sampson
_4739.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Back to Dats Center and talk to Richard Sampson%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4739.CompletionText: Chika? Who is that? it is on my tip of my tongue...
_4739.CompletionSummary: Hey~ you here.. What makes you to come in this time?

_4740.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4740.Description: #<my_tname> Agent! Why are you looked suprised? I don't know Mickey and Mary...Do you know who he is? Are you a dot-tat crew I forgot about because of the time? Hmm... @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> If I'm affected by the twist of time, I'm afraid I can't help you! Then, it would be better to visit Culumon! I'm sure he will help you! Let's go! Dismissed!
_4740.CompletionText: Well, it looks like we've got a very difficult case.
_4740.CompletionSummary: you here, Culu? Well how was it? Did you noticed anything strange, Culu?

_4741.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4741.Description: don’t worry about that culu! We have White-beard Guru here! He might have a solution culu!
_4741.CompletionSummary: Hum~#<my_tname> Tamer~ I've been waiting for you…

_4742.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4742.Description:
No need to worry. I know the way to solve it.
According to legend,
[When a peacock, a goat, a vampire, and demons that govern each floor disappeared from the maze, the Evil God will come crossing time and space.…]
Well, no need to worry. I know Digimon which can support your back!
Go to Move to Wind Valley and look for Jijimon Jijimon will guide you to solve your curiosity.
_4742.Objective: Move to Wind Valley Talk to Jijimon
_4742.CompletionText: I'll make it through this difficulty..
_4742.CompletionSummary: Have been while I see Human in this place

_4743.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4743.Description:
Okay. If you are sure about that, I will help you with one condition.
From now on, you have to go through me! If you lost, You better prepare your self to die. It's a hundred times better than suffering by a ZeedMillenniumon. Hahaha
Please don’t get me wrong. I just want to test your strength. that's all.
Shall we do it in front of the garden?
_4743.Objective: Use Match with Jijimon at the garden of Jijimon and defeat Jijimon
_4743.CompletionSummary: Well Well, you have more talent than you looked~

_4744.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4744.Description:
The problem is Anubimon, the manager of the maze. We need his permission to enter the maze. He is the maze manager.
Whoever tries to enter the maze, Anubimon always asks the reason. If he doesn't like the reason, Anubimon will not allow you to enter.
But what is our purpose? We're going to defeat ZeedMillenniumon in the Maze. Who would love that in his own house? Well, I'm just saying there's a problem.
First of all, let's think about the good reason for this, and leave for the unknown.
_4744.Objective: Move to the Entrence of Digimon Maze Talk to Jijimon
_4744.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to the Entrence of Digimon Maze%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4744.CompletionText: I am really worried about if Anubimon will give a permission or not...
_4744.CompletionSummary: So this is The Maze Enterence. He will be here in any time

_4745.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4745.Description:
Well, thank you for telling me this, but I will not allow you to get enter.
As you already know, I don’t think you can defeat the ZeedMillenniumon nor the four sealed Monsters!
I've already noticed that the seal has been weaker and weaker. And you are going to the unsealed?
Nonsense!
_4745.CompletionSummary: Hum… I kind of knwe how the thing going, but…well…

_4746.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4746.Description:
Hahaha! Man challenges me! What a surprise! Great! Let's have a fight! Before that! I'll make a suggestion!
If you lose to me, I won't let you go.! Do you understand?
You need to pull yourself together very strongly!
_4746.Objective: Use Match with Anubimon at the Digimon Maze Gate and defeat Anubimon

_4747.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4747.Description:
I lost... As I promised, I will allow you and Jijimon to enter the palace...
If you're this strong... Hmm... no...
Go in...! Welcome to the Maze…
_4747.Objective: Move to Digimon Maze B2 Talk to Jijimon
_4747.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Digimon Maze B2%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4747.CompletionText: Maybe this person could solve this case..
_4747.CompletionSummary: Well we are here in maze at last!

_4748.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4748.Description:
Okay. I explained everything now, let’s move to F1.
As I already told you, this place is called 'Maze'. Pull your self together otherwise, you will be lost!
_4748.Objective: Move to Digimon Maze F1 Talk to Jijimon
_4748.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Move to Digimon Maze F1%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Jijimon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4748.CompletionSummary: We are arrived at F1 now. No time to be happy yet This is only a start point!

_4749.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4749.Description:
Just imagine there are 2 big rooms in F1.
what we need to do is gather DigiCore from them and make a key to unseal devil.
Your not allowed to feel sorry or showing pithiness. We are doing this to save the whole world! So you need to stay strong!
First, gather Digi Core from Digimons at F1. I will prepare to summon Devil in F1 while you collecting Digi Cores. Hurry!
_4749.Objective: Gotsumon's Digicore Wormmon's Digicore Bakemon's Digicore Bearmon's Digicore Candlemon's Digicore
_4749.CompletionSummary:
You've been through a lot! You've got a Digicores!
From now on, I'll make a key out of the Digicores you've been looking for!
Hub!
The key is complete! Now I'm ready to summon the Devil!

_4750.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4750.Description:
Use this key that I just hand it in to you, and the Devil will appear soon.
The Devil in F1 is Murmukusmon. You better prepare yourself, Murmukusmon is not just any other Monster. It's one of the Devil.
Good Luck
_4750.Objective: Use Summon Stone of Murmukusmon at the Anubimon's Traces and defeat Murmukusmon
_4750.CompletionSummary: It is you, Indeed! I had trust in you!

_4751.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4751.Description:
You must be exhausted, but we don't have much time. I'm sure a lot of people are suffering at this time.
This is where F2 comes out! If you go to F2, you'll collect Icemon, Gryzmon, Stingmon, Soulmon, and Digicor of Sidramon!
I'll be ready to summon the F2's Devil! Hurry up!
_4751.Objective: Icemon's Digicore Grizzmon's Digicore Stingmon's Digicore Soulmon's Digicore Seadramon's Digicore
_4751.CompletionSummary:
Thank you so much. You've been collected Digicore this time too!
Now I'll make a key!
Hub!
The key is complete! You're ready to summon him!

_4752.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4752.Description:
Use the Key that I just gave it to you!
Digimon gareupeumon.. that this is sealed in F2! Gareupeumon is huge and scary... So you need to be extra prepared yourself than before!
Beware and good luck...!
_4752.Objective: Use Summon Stone of Gulfmon at the Memories of Anubimon and defeat Gulfmon
_4752.CompletionSummary: You've got a knack for surprising Digimon the more you looked!

_4753.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4753.Description:
You've been through a lot. If this goes well, I'd like all the people and Digimons of the world to know your hard work...
It's F3 now! I want you to cheer up a little bit more!
If you go to F3, I want you to collect the digiore of Meteormon, JewelBeemon, Andromon, Phantomon, and MegaSeadramon!
Again, I must be preparing to summon the F3's Devil! Thank you for your hard work!
_4753.Objective: Meteormon's Digicore JewelBeemon's Digicore Andromon's Digicore Phantomon's Digicore MegaSeadramon's Digicore
_4753.CompletionSummary:
Good on you. Thank you for your hard work. I will make a key in hurry,
Hub!
There, its done. Now you have a key, all you need to do is summon!

_4754.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4754.Description:
Use this key to summon the Devil!
The Sealed Digimon of F3 is the GranDracmon. GranDracmon is not easily defeated by seven of the notorious Devils... So it's time to keep your mind very strong...
Good Luck...!
_4754.Objective: Use Summon Stone of GranDracmon at the Anubimon's Final Memories and defeat GranDracmon
_4754.CompletionSummary: My,My..What a suprise! You make me surprised again!?

_4755.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4755.Description:
This is the last preparation for summoning the ZeedMillenniumon!
This is the top floor of the maze, F4. There are trouble maker called Diablomon!
The Diablo Monsters were born during the process of sealing the Evils.
Anyway, if you go to F4, collect all the Diablomon's DigiCore!
I'll be ready to summon the F4's Devil! Good luck!
_4755.CompletionSummary:
You've worked hard!
I'll make a key now!
Hub!
Now, it's the last Devil's summons!

_4756.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4756.Description:
The Digimon sealed in this F4 is the Belial Vamdemon! Belial Vamdemon is a cruel Digimon...
It will not be easy again this time...
Good luck...!
_4756.Objective: Use Summon Stone of Belial Vamdemon at the Digimon Maze of Trial and defeat Belial Vamdemon
_4756.CompletionSummary: I haven't lived long enough... I never seen a Human beings like you...!

_4757.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4757.Description:
Now... it's the last time! As this is the final, I need to tell you something before I summon ZeedMillenniumon!
Good job so far! Even if you lose to ZeedMillenniumon, I will not going to blame you... I did watch you how much effort you made so far! So I want you to take it easy and fight with ZeedMillenniumon!
Good luck!
_4757.CompletionSummary: Anit … man … the … ZeedMillenniumon... What just I saw?? This is amazing …

_4758.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4758.Description:
You've really cheered me up. All time and space have been freed from the grip of the ZeedMillenniumon! Thank you so much!!
All I can do for you is... Spreading this heroic story to other Digimons, erasing their prejudices against humanity... I will work hard for the rest of my life...!
Then go home safely!
_4758.CompletionSummary: You've come back safely. Good job~

_4759.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4759.Description:
Your work was naturally felt as history returned to its original form. The past that had been changed is back when you knocked down the ZeedMillenniumon!
Well what are you waiting for? Go check everything is back to normal~

_4760.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4760.Description:
I really don't know what you are talking about, but you don't have to worry about me!
Uh! My class is going to start very soon. I got to go! Back to Dats Center safe~ bye~

_4761.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4761.Description:
Well you've checked everything is fine. Now It's all about the future.
Because the existence of the ZeedMillenniumon itself is a very anomalous digimon, maybe he will come back to life again.
So we'll have to prepare for the situation. For this point, try find Nanomon... nanomon will check our problems with his wise head....
_4761.CompletionSummary: Well, long time no see ... Did you bring something interesting?

_4762.Title: Jogress[ZeedMillenniumon]
_4762.Description:
Oh... this is the data of the ZeedMillenniumon! You brought this by yourself!? So what is your main concern?
(Explaining distress...)
Well... I see... The story is simple. We just need to have a ZeedMillenniumon. It is only a matter of time before the Dats Center will have the ZeedMillenniumon since you have brought the ZeedMillenniumon's Data.
_4762.CompletionSummary:
Completed.
This data I'm giving you now is the data that can evolve into a ZeedMillenniumon. If this data is used for a particular digimon, it can evolve into a ZeedMillenniumon.
'You want me to tell you what Digimon can evolve into a ZeedMillenniumon?
Try to find the Digimon while you travel. I don't think I'm obliged to tell you that, so now, I'm busy studying this work data.

_4763.Title: New Digimon Event
_4763.Description: Oh! You are Tamer from the other side! Can you help me to save the Digital World? We are facing a very hard time. ZeedMillenniumon has returend that once we thought defeated completely.. He is spreading evil seeds. If we go on like this, not only the Digital world but the Real world will be stained by his darkness throughout the past and present. I... I don't have enough strength to stop him. Can you collect his Data for me? With that data, we might able to state him in this world!
_4763.Objective: Obtain Data of Milleniumon by defeating Agumon(Dark Seeds) at all area
_4763.CompletionText: There are Agumon(Black) in Digital World as he's trace. Defeat them!
_4763.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now I will track him with this Data for the location. Please talk to me when you are ready!

_4764.Title: New Digimon Event
_4764.Description:
Well I guess your ready for it. Here, take this. This is the device that you can hold ZeedMillenniumon in this time paradocs. Please use this divice in safe zone, and he will appear right away. It is the best chance to take him down before he's power getting stronger.
Sorry that I can not help you. But please take a place to fight ZeedMillenniumon for Digital World and Real world! Defeat the ZeedMillenniumon and bring me a proof. I will give you a gift as award!
_4764.Objective: Summon and defeat the ZeedMillenniumon using time-space forced equipment, and obtained fragments of ZeedMillenniumon.
_4764.CompletionText: Only if I have a partner..
_4764.CompletionSummary: Good job! He will not able to come out for a while. Here! Take this as a gift!

_4765.Title: Event
_4765.Description:
Oh, yeah! Thanks for listening!
Isn't it... Winter?
I was looking for ingredients for food ingredients at Real World as Babarmon's request, and Turuiemon clans wiped everything from my ingredients!
I don't know if I'll be beaten to death by Babarmon!
So please! Can you defeat them first and gather their tracks? With it, we can go to the place where they have their food.
_4765.Objective: Scan the cryptic Digimon fortune talisman obtained by killing all local monsters to collect the items below.
_4765.CompletionText: Not yet? Bring it to me before Babarmon finds out!
_4765.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I'll make you a ticket to get to where they are! Please go there and find the ingredients for me!

_4766.Title: Event
_4766.Description:
Oh, that's great! I will tell you something.
I make an amulet every year for the well-being of the Digimons.
But because of the darkness of the digital world, Digimon's amulets are so polluted that they can't keep up the power.
I need you to replace it quickly, however, I can't leave because of the amulet and Digital World issue.
Can you collect the amulets of the Digimons instead?
Please.
_4766.Objective: Defeat Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village, and collect the Item below.
_4766.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Courage of Fortune Charm%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Friendship of Fortune Charm%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Love of Fortune Charm%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Sincerity of Fortune Charm%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4766.CompletionSummary: Great job! Take my gratitude. Enjoy the Winter!

_4767.Title: Event
_4767.Description:
Oh, that's great! I will tell you something.
I make an amulet every year for the well-being of the Digimons.
But because of the darkness of the digital world, Digimon's amulets are so polluted that they can't keep up the power.
I need you to replace it quickly, however, I can't leave because of the amulet and Digital World issue.
Can you collect the amulets of the Digimons instead?
Please.
_4767.Objective: Defeat Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village, and collect the Item below.
_4767.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Knowledge of Fortune Charm%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Reliability of Fortune Charm%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Hope of Fortune Charm%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Light of Fortune Charm%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4767.CompletionSummary: Great job! Take my gratitude. Enjoy the Winter!

_4768.Title: Event
_4768.Description:
Oh, you're here! Are you having a good Winter?
I'm... yes, I'm working on the Amulet.
For replace the amulets!
But... the old amulets are hardly being retrieved.
Hmm? You're going to help? Is it true?
I owe you for this. Yes... If you retrieve the old amulets, I will give you a gift of strong fortune.
_4768.Objective: Defeat Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village, and collect the Item below.
_4768.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Courage of Fortune Charm%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Friendship of Fortune Charm%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Love of Fortune Charm%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Sincerity of Fortune Charm%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4768.CompletionSummary: Great job! Take my gratitude. Enjoy the Winter!

_4769.Title: Event
_4769.Description:
Oh, hello there! Hope you having a good Winter time.
Um... sorry that i can not talk with you properly. I'm working on the Amulet now. For replace the amulets!
But... the old amulets are hardly being retrieved.
Hmm? You're going to help? Is it true?
I owe you for this. Yes... If you retrieve the old amulets, I will give you a gift of strong fortune.
_4769.Objective: Defeat Monsters at all area except Yokohama Village, and collect the Item below.
_4769.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Knowledge of Fortune Charm%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Reliability of Fortune Charm%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Hope of Fortune Charm%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Light of Fortune Charm%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4769.CompletionSummary: Great job! Take my gratitude. Enjoy the Winter!

_4770.Title: Event
_4770.Description:
Now, the task I'm going to present is!
Go to the Infinite Mountain instance Dungeon and defeat the Devimon!
What? You don't have time? Hurry up and come back!
_4770.Objective: Defeat Devimon(Ruler) at Infinite Mountain instance_Dungeon
_4770.CompletionText: We still got lots of things to do~
_4770.CompletionSummary: Wow, what a speed! Here. This is the reward for today!

_4771.Title: Event
_4771.Description:
Now, the task I'm going to present is!
Go Join the Arena! And getting a Daily Arena certificate!
Arena's just around the corner, so you can participate right away!
Let's try it!
_4771.Objective: Participate in the Arena to obtain a Daily Arena Certificate, which is a reward of 80 points for battle points.
_4771.CompletionText: We still got lots of things to do~
_4771.CompletionSummary: Wow, what a speed! Here. This is the reward for today!

_4772.Title: Event
_4772.Description:
Now, the task I'm going to present is!
Defeat Digimons at all area to get the Daily Hunting Certificate!
There's a Certificate coming from any area, so hurry up and get going!
_4772.Objective: Eliminate all Monsters to collect Daily Hunting Certificates.
_4772.CompletionText: We still got lots of things to do~
_4772.CompletionSummary: Wow, what a speed! Here. This is the reward for today!

_4773.Title: Event
_4773.Description:
Now, the task I'm going to present is!
You're going to play with me against Blizzarmon who's going to decorate the Winter. Defeat Blizzarmon, and claim the Certificate of Daily Raid!
Blizzarmon is waiting for you at Snowman Village. Hurry up and leave!
_4773.Objective: Success at the Blizzarmon Raid which appears in Snowman Village to Obtain Daily Raid Certificate
_4773.CompletionText: We still got lots of things to do~
_4773.CompletionSummary: Wow, what a speed! Here. This is the reward for today!

_4774.Title: Event
_4774.Summary: [Daily] Need to move more on Winter!
_4774.Description:
Now, the task I'm going to present is!
The events that Reclamation of Old Amulet1, and event with Jijimon and Babarmon's Winter story.
It's simple, isn't it? Hurry up and go!
_4774.Objective: Obtain a daily event certificate by conducting a quest for Reclamation of Old Amulet 1 event and Winter events of Jijimon.
_4774.CompletionText: We still got lots of things to do~
_4774.CompletionSummary: Wow, what a speed! Here. This is the reward for today!

_4775.Title: New Year 2020
_4775.Description:
Hi There! I am so excited about I do the firework This year! To Start the New Year! But… I am little bit short for firework..I gave it way too many last year. And meanwhile, some of fireworks were stolen by Girumon! I'm sure they are going to make some trouble with that!
Can you do me a favor? Please collect the Banished Gunpowder from Girumon of Digital World!
_4775.Objective: Defeat the Giromon(The Bomb expert)Collect 20 of Banished Gunpowder
_4775.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much!! Now I can make fireworks! I will give you some of Fireworks as a gift!

_4776.Title: New Year's Wish
_4776.Description: Well...let's just say they are. I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 1st Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card to make your wish come true!
_4776.Objective: Defeat the monsters of all Digimon world and Collect Seven of 1st Orbs
_4776.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4776.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of Dragon.

_4777.Title: New Year's Wish
_4777.Description: Well..let's just say they are.. I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 2nd Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card to make your wish come true!
_4777.Objective: Scan the 1st Orb to collect Seven of 2nd Orbs
_4777.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4777.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of Dragon.

_4778.Title: New Year's Wish
_4778.Description: Well..let's just say they are... I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 3rd Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card to make your wish come true!
_4778.Objective: Scan the 2nd Orb to collect Seven of 3nd Orbs
_4778.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4778.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of Dragon.

_4779.Title: New Year's Wish
_4779.Description: Well..let's just say they are... I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 4th Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card to make your wish come true!
_4779.Objective: Scan the 3rd Orb to collect Seven of 4th Orbs
_4779.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4779.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of Dragon.

_4780.Title: New Year's Wish
_4780.Description: Well..let's just say they are... I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 5th Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card to make your wish come true!
_4780.Objective: Scan the 4th Orb to collect Seven of 5th Orbs
_4780.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4780.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of Dragon.

_4781.Title: New Year's Wish
_4781.Description: Well..let's just say they are.. I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 6th Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card to make your wish come true!
_4781.Objective: Scan the 5th Orb to collect Seven of 6th Orbs
_4781.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4781.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of Dragon.

_4782.Title: New Year's Wish
_4782.Description: Well..let's just say they are.. I hide the Wish Orbs to some Digimons all area. Collect 7th Orbs and bring it to me. I will give you a Dragon Summon Card of me to make your wish come true!
_4782.Objective: Scan the 6th Orb to collect Seven of 7th Orbs
_4782.CompletionText: There will be no Digimon like this
_4782.CompletionSummary: Very Good! Here's the Summon Card of me.

_4783.Title: New Year 2020
_4783.Description: Greetings, tamer! Good to hear your New Year's greeting. You are better than the Four Holy Bests.. Even They did not came to see me for greeting. Somethig Fishy here. Can you find Xuanwumon? Look for any clue what they are thinking.
_4783.Objective: Open Time: 01:00~11:45 Snowman Village at 1hour interval from 1:00 Xuanwumon Appears
_4783.CompletionText: I wonder what they are thinking.

_4784.Title: New Year 2020
_4784.Summary: [Daily] The Perfect New Year Plan of 2 Digimon
_4784.Description: Hi Tamer! How are you doing on New Year's Plan so far? Strange… They used to bring the Year Plan for Digial World around this time, yet they have not been visited me. What taking so long? I feel very suspecious on both Xuanwumon and Baihumon.. Can you find them and check the plan for me?
_4784.Objective: Open Time: 01:00~11:45 At 00min Xuanwumon Lost Historic Site at 15min Baihumon
_4784.CompletionText: Hmm.. I couldn't help myself to think it was a bit weird..

_4785.Title: New Year 2020
_4785.Summary: [Daily] The Perfect New Year Plan of 3 Digimon
_4785.Description: New Year already! 2020 is already here! How's your plan for this year? I hear New Year Greeting everywhere but... Four Holy Beasts still not coming to see me for greeting. Zhuqiaomon the most suspecious one. There must be a proof. Can you collect a proof from Four Holy Beasts and bring it to me? I will give you a rewards.
_4785.Objective: Open Time: 01:00~11:45 At 00min Xuanwumon At 15min Baihumon Server Continent Desert at 30min Zhuqiaomon
_4785.CompletionSummary: Great work! Here's your rewards! Now I can see what they are thinking.

_4786.Title: New Year 2020
_4786.Summary: [Daily] Four Holy Beasts's Perfect New Year Plan
_4786.Description: Very good to see you again, Tamer! Are you planning for the Fresh Year? As you know, The Four Holy Beasts acting odd thesedays. Yes. Even that royal Qinglongmon.. Can you bring me a New Years Plan of them and bring it to me? You will get great Reward.
_4786.Objective: Open Time: 01:00~11:45 At 00min Xuanwumon At 15min Baihumon At 30min Zhuqiaomon Odaiba at 45min Qinglongmon
_4786.CompletionText: I guess I was right than...
_4786.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your hard work! I will give you a reward!

_4787.Title: Achievement Event
_4787.Description: If you want to inherit the Jupitermon's name, collect Thunder Gemstone of Myth from Monsters of all area.
_4787.Objective: Collect Thunder Gemstone of Myth from Monsters of all area.
_4787.CompletionText: You can gain the power of Thunder after inherit the name of Jupitermon.

_4788.Title: Christmas
_4788.Description: Hi! It's Christmas soon, are you ready for it? I was busy packing Christmas presents too. By the way, I wonder who will receive present from Taichi. Can you make it a secret and find it out for me?
_4788.CompletionText: I'm quite obvious who it will be, but still…
_4788.CompletionSummary: Of course I have someone in mind. I owe some debt to Sora, so it'll be her this time.

_4789.Title: Christmas
_4789.Description: Yes! I'm going to give the present, but I want something unique. I've heard Terriermon is helping Santa collecting Christmas materials. Can you get some of them from Terriermon secretly? Ah… well, don't get me wrong! I'm planning to pay back later!
_4789.Objective: Find and defeat <Christmas Fairy> Terriermon in Digital World to collect Christmas Gift Materials
_4789.CompletionText: Hmm… what shall I prepare for the present?
_4789.CompletionSummary: Wow! Thank you! Now I can make the present!

_4790.Title: Christmas
_4790.Description: Present is finally ready now. Can you deliver this to Sora for me? Gees, I'm a little nervous now.
_4790.Objective: Talk to Sora Possess Taichi's Christmas Present
_4790.CompletionSummary: Oh… it's a pity. Actually I…
_4790.ReservedText: What? Is this? A present from Tai?

_4791.Title: Christmas
_4791.Description: Well, I only prepared a present for Matt this time. Too bad that I forgot about Taichi this time. I'm sorry to ask, but can you deliver this present to Matt? In the meanwhile, I should worry about a present for Taichi.
_4791.Objective: Talk to Hikari Possess Sora's Christmas Present
_4791.CompletionText: Anyway… It is Taichi after all?

_4792.Title: Christmas
_4792.Description: I see. So Taichi prepared present for Sora, but Sora prepared present for Matt. Poor Tai… I guess he deserves something at least. Can you help me one more time? Please bring me the stuff I need! Thanks!
_4792.Objective: Find and defeat <Christmas Fairy> Terriermon in Digital World to collect Christmas Gift Materials
_4792.CompletionText: Well, poor Taichi, still thinking about Sora only.
_4792.CompletionSummary: Great. Thanks a lot! I'll make a present now.

_4793.Title: Christmas
_4793.Description: It's done now. Please give this to Taichi! Can you? I truly appreciate your help!
_4793.Objective: Talk to Taichi Possess Hikari's Christmas Present
_4793.CompletionText: Poor Taichi. I hope you don't get disappointed.
_4793.CompletionSummary: What? It's from my sister Hikari? Oh no, I've completely forgot about her!
_4793.ReservedText: What is this present? Is it a return from Sora?

_4794.Title: Christmas
_4794.Description: Oh well… the situation became a little complicated I guess. I think I should prepare one for Hikari too. Anyway, Sora haven't thought of a return present for me? Maybe my present wasn't very sincere to here then. Can you help me again? Please do me a favor for one more time. Thank you!
_4794.CompletionSummary: Ah, thanks a lot! The present is almost ready! I means, it's ready now! Can you delivere this to here? It's the same thing. I'll leave it to you now!

_4795.Title: Christmas
_4795.Description: Ah, you've came back? Have you gave the present to Matt? You came for something else this time? I see. So what can I do for you now?
_4795.Objective: Talk to Sora Possess Taichi's Christmas Present
_4795.CompletionSummary: Oh… I'm kinda confused right now. But thanks to you anyway. Take the present for yourself now. It's for you this time.

_4796.Title: Christmas
_4796.Description: Oh, it's you. How was Taichi's reaction for the present? Huh? He asked you for a favor?
_4796.Objective: Talk to Hikari Possess Taichi's Christmas Present
_4796.CompletionText: What did you say? It's a returning present from him?
_4796.CompletionSummary: Ah, I should have told you earlier to keep it a secret. But well, nevermind that. I just didn't want to see him depressed during Christmas. Take this as Christmas gift for yourself. I hope you like it!

_4797.Title: Christmas
_4797.Description: I've made special area for you guys after discussing with Santa. But I need one thing that I need your help with. A crowd of Monzaemon have stolen lots of Christmas presents recently. If you return some of them, I'll give you the admission ticket as reward. Can you do that for me?
_4797.CompletionSummary: Thanks a lot!! Here's the ticket as promised!!

_4798.Title: Tree Decorator Chakkumon
_4798.Description: Nice! Thanks for helping me making the tree. Basic materials are very important. Ribbon, Socks, Snow Cotton, Decoration Bulbs and so on. Please bring me as many as you can. I'll make your effort worthy!
_4798.CompletionText: Well, well, now what tree shall I pick?
_4798.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! Now we have the basics of Christmas Tree!

_4799.Title: Tree Decorator Chakkumon
_4799.Description: I really appreciate it! Ah… by the way, there's one more thing. Yeah, that thing, you know. With it makes everything perfect. Can you help me to complete the job?
_4799.CompletionSummary: Excellent! I knew you could do it!

_4800.Title: Tree Decorator Chakkumon
_4800.Description:
Today's the final day.
Decorating all the trees will be finished today! Let's make Christmas fancy! Aren't you excited? Haha!
_4800.CompletionSummary: Thank you my friend! Take this reward for the last favor today. You're outstanding!

_4801.Title: New Digimon Event
_4801.Description: It's been a while, human child. Do you still remember the last battle? Omegamon is becoming stronger day by day, and I can't just stand here watching. I finally figured out how to become stronger myself. Well, can you be my sparring partner one more time?
_4801.CompletionText: Have you made up your mind?
_4801.CompletionSummary: Ok, then I'll wait for you in D-Terminal Summon Square.
_4801.ReservedText: Have you made up your mind?

_4802.Title: Achievement Event
_4802.Description: If you want to succeed the title of Dianamon, collect the Arrows of Myth from monsters all over the areas.
_4802.Objective: Collect 200 Arrow of Myth from monsters of all areas
_4802.CompletionText: When you succeed title of Dianamon, you'll gain the power of Ice.

_4803.Title: Preparing for Winter
_4803.Summary: [Daily] Zudomon's Secret of Preparing for Winter
_4803.Description: What brings you here? Isn't it so cold here? Dude! The weather is freezing cold, especially when you don't have furs, I know that. So I'm willing to help you fight against the cold weather.. The secret is with the furs of <Glossy> Mammothmon and <Furry> Mojyamon, my friend! Mammothmon is in Snowman Village and Mojyamon is... somewhere among the Digital World! Trust me, my friend! Collect their furs and let the miracle happen!
_4803.Objective: Defeat <Glossy> Mammothmon Collect <Furry> Myojamon's Hair Tuft 20ea
_4803.CompletionText: Do you remember what I told you to collect? It's to keep you warm, my friend. Trust me!
_4803.CompletionSummary: Woooot!! This will keep you warm for the whole Winter! Here! This is a voucher dedicated to you!

_4804.Title: Xuanwumon's
_4804.Description: Good to see you, human child and partner. As you can feel it, the aura of Fall is not fading, so the weather of Digital World is quite fluctuating. I hope we can persuade Baihumon before Xuanwumon realizes the situation. Baihumon left his hallucination images in the Real World, so it's possible to track him down. Will you help?
_4804.Objective: Defeat <Junior> Baihumon from Real World and collect 30 Trace of Baihumon
_4804.CompletionText: We have to get it done quickly.
_4804.CompletionSummary: You've collected all the traces! Now I can make an orb that can call real Baihumon!

_4805.Title: Xuanwumon and Winter
_4805.Description: Use the orb from D-Terminal Summon Square to call Baihumon. However, I don't know how the conditions of Baihumon will be, so it can be risky. I'll ask for your help to persuade him if possible.
_4805.Objective: Summon and Defeat <Rampaging> Baihumon from D-Terminal Summon Square and collect Baihumon's Farewell Letter
_4805.CompletionText: Well, I'm not very sure if we can persuade him. But we should try.
_4805.CompletionSummary: He left a letter along with a gift? That's a surprise! I'll deliver the letter to Xuanwumon. Thank you, human! The gift seems to belong to you, so take it yourself!

_4806.Title: Xuanwumon and Winter
_4806.Description: Good to see you, human child and partner. The time of Winter is near us. You should remember that last time Zhuqiaomon spread energy of Summer and did not retrieve them. Unfortunately, Baihumon is doing the same thing. He's the youngest among us, so maybe he need to learn more. Can you help to retrieve the energy? "Purified Essence of Fall" that possess Baihumon's energy are permeated into his minion Meteormon, so you'll be able to find it from them.
_4806.Objective: Defeat <Baihumon's Minion> Meteormon and collect 50 Purified Essence of Fall
_4806.CompletionText: Meteormon can be a trouble, but you should be able to handle them.
_4806.CompletionSummary: Good job. Now, here's your reward.

_4807.Title: New Digimon Event
_4807.Description: New Digimon has joined Digital World. How about a duel against this new member?
_4807.CompletionText: Have you made up your mind?
_4807.ReservedText: Have you made up your mind?

_4808.Title: XrosWars
_4808.Description: Welcome, Culu! DigiXros evolution is an unique type of evolution, so it requires a special evolution chip, Culu. So I'll give you DigiXros Evolution Chip each day for you, Culu. Attach this on your Digivice and try the DigiXros evolution, Culu!
_4808.CompletionText: Here, take this Evolution Chip, Culu!
_4808.CompletionSummary: Here it is, Culu! Experience the new power, Culu!

_4809.Title: Achievement Event
_4809.Description: If you want to succeed the title of Minervamon, collect the Shields of Myth from monsters all over the areas.
_4809.Objective: Collect 200 Shield of Myth from monsters of all areas
_4809.CompletionText: When you succeed title of Minervamon, you'll gain the power of Light.

_4810.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4810.Description:
Hey, Tamer! Welcome to our 8th Anniversary Celebration party!
We have special challenge for you during this celebration. It's a special raid event actually, and it'll be a great opportunity for you to test your strength!
Me and my friends will appear in a very huge form from the Yokohama East Village
I'll show myself when you manage to defeat bunch of Rockmon. Do you wish to challenge?
_4810.CompletionText: Never underestimate your opponent just because he's in training!
_4810.CompletionSummary: Wonderful! Here's the proof that you beat Tanemon!

_4811.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4811.Description:
Hey, Tamer! Welcome to our 8th Anniversary Celebration party!
We have special challenge for you during this celebration. It's a special raid event actually, and it'll be a great opportunity for you to test your strength!
Me and my friends will appear in a very huge form from the Yokohama East Village
I'll show myself when you manage to defeat bunch of Rockmon. Do you wish to challenge?
_4811.CompletionText: Never underestimate your opponent just because he's in training!
_4811.CompletionSummary: Wonderful! Here's the proof that you beat Tsunomon!

_4812.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4812.Description:
Hey, Tamer! Welcome to our 8th Anniversary Celebration party!
We have special challenge for you during this celebration. It's a special raid event actually, and it'll be a great opportunity for you to test your strength!
Me and my friends will appear in a very huge form from the Yokohama East Village
I'll show myself when you manage to defeat bunch of Rockmon. Do you wish to challenge?
_4812.CompletionText: Never underestimate your opponent just because he's in training!
_4812.CompletionSummary: Wonderful! Here's the proof that you beat Upamon!

_4813.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4813.Description:
Welcome to 8th Anniversary Celebration Park! Fight against the monsters from this area and you'll gain a lot more EXP in a short time! Oh, and let me know if you want to receive the attendance stamp.
Don't miss if if you want the rewards!
_4813.ReservedText: Where was I keeping the stamps?

_4814.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4814.Description:
Welcome to 8th Anniversary Celebration Park! Fight against the monsters from this area and you'll gain a lot more EXP in a short time! Oh, and let me know if you want to receive the attendance stamp.
Don't miss if if you want the rewards!
_4814.ReservedText: Where was I keeping the stamps?

_4815.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4815.Description: (Huge Cake made for the celebration of 8th Anniversary. Rumors say that you can find a special gift when you finish decorating the cake with candles.)
_4815.Objective: Collect 8 8th Anniversary Candle Light Collect 8 8th Anniversary Candle Decoration Collect 2 Attendance Stamp
_4815.ObjectiveProgress: %qs18th Anniversary Candle Light%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs28th Anniversary Candle Decoration%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Attendance Stamp%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4815.CompletionSummary: (There's the Gift! What would it be?)

_4816.Title: 8th Anniversary Event
_4816.Description:
Hello, buddy! Are you enjoying the 8th Anniversary festival?
I'm Candlemon and I'm in charge of setting up the fireworks. However, I'm stuck right now, because the prepared fireworks are kind of unique. They require some kind of unique amber, and it can be found from the Digital World only. From what I know, they drop from DemiMeramon.
Can you do me a big favor, collecting those embers from <Kindling> DemiMeramon? I'll promise good reward if you do that for me, buddy!
_4816.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much!! Now I can have my job done! I'll give you some of the fireworks! You'll see that they are very high-quality!

_4817.Title: New Digimon Event
_4817.Description:
Greetings, human child and partner. Can we have a short conversation now? I have a request for you. The Royal Knights are getting stronger and stronger day by day influenced by X-Antibody, but I'm not fully confident with it. Because the great power can bring great conflicts as a side effect, and I'm worried about that.
My request is that, if can you test the power to see if it can be used for right purposes and avoid unnecessary conflicts. Will you accept my request?
_4817.CompletionSummary: Thank you. When you're ready, take this with you to D-Terminal Summon Square. You'll be able to summon UlforceVeedramon X!

_4818.Title: The Lost Halloween
_4818.Description:
Halloween has returned, and we've done our best to decorate this place but most important stuff is missing. The letters for HALLOWEEN. They didn't just disappear, so they must be stolen. You don't have to look very far. You'll probably find them from monsters in the Digital World.
Please find the letter boxes and bring me WE.
_4818.CompletionSummary: Thank you Tamer! You've just made a contribution to Halloween festival!

_4819.Title: The Lost Halloween
_4819.Description:
The letters missing are not just WE. Other letters were also stolen by those clumsy monsters.
Can you find some more letters and bring them to me?
Now the letters I need are NOW.
_4819.CompletionText: I wish we had more time…
_4819.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now we're one step closer to Halloween!

_4820.Title: The Lost Halloween
_4820.Description:
Thanks to your help, the situation is better now. However, we're still missing many letters.
If you can find and bring some more of them, it would be grateful!
Please find WHEE from the boxes and bring them to me.
_4820.CompletionText: The time is ticking. I'm getting nervous.
_4820.CompletionSummary: Whee! Thanks Tamer! With your assist, Halloween is getting in shape!

_4821.Title: The Lost Halloween
_4821.Description:
This is absurd! I didn't realize until now of how many letters have been stolen. This is crazy!
Can you help me find the rest of these letters? This time, please bring me ALOHAOE.
_4821.CompletionSummary: Outstanding performance! We're almost ready for perfection!

_4822.Title: The Lost Halloween
_4822.Description:
I thought we were done with find the missing letters, but there is a problem. We need more letters for decorating the trick or treat boxes to distribute to the children.
I heard that there are still many monsters who are carrying the box with letters. Please do me a favor. Bring me HALLOWEEN this time.
_4822.CompletionText: We can't ruin an event that takes place just once a year!
_4822.CompletionSummary: Excellent!! You're good to join the Halloween festival!

_4823.Title: The Lost Halloween
_4823.Description:
It may be quite depressing, but the letters are constantly being stolen whenever we're not aware. I don't know how they've done it.
Sorry for keep asking for help, but if you help me again for the last time, I'll reward you with something really worthy. Please bring me 5 of HALLOWEEN.
_4823.CompletionSummary: Perfect!! Perhaps now you can go for trick or treating!

_4824.Title: Achievement Event
_4824.Description:
Have you heard about the story of DigiDestined in the past? Those children had fought against the big threat against Real World.
If you make up your mind and follow their footsteps, I'll make it worthy for you.
_4824.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Aquilamon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Mammothmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Raremon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Phantomon%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5Defeat Shibuya Area Myotismon%qe %cc5/%mc5
_4824.CompletionText: Odaiba has currently became a very dangerous place.

_4825.Title: Achievement Event
_4825.Description:
The Chosen Children thought the darkness has met the dead end, but it wasn't.
Please continue to experience the history made by Chosen Children in the Real World.
_4825.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Okuwamon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Groundramon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Myotismon of Odaiba%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat VenomMyotismon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4825.CompletionText: I've helped Izzy in many ways.
_4825.CompletionSummary: Those children are true heroes. And so are you.

_4826.Title: White-beard Guru's Event
_4826.Description:
Do you happen to remember the story of Chosen Children that I told you from File Island area? The story of encountering MonoChromon in File Island Waterfront.
I'll tell you the rest of the story of Chosen Children.
The Chosen Children crossed the sea from File Island to Server Continent and fought against the evil Digimon.
The vestige of this history is still remaining.
Go to Server Continent Desert and deal with Neptunemon, FanBeemon and Greymon.
_4826.CompletionText: You'd better watch yourself when you get there.

_4827.Title: White-beard Guru's Event
_4827.Description:
The Chosen Children went to Canyon after battle in the desert.
From there, they had a lot of incidents related with Etemon.
Please take the second story memory you obtained from the desert and fight against MonoChromon, Gazimon and StrikeDramon from there.
_4827.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Memory of Second Story%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Monochromon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Gazimon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat Strikedramon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4827.CompletionText: The canyon is pretty complicated. Try not to get lost.

_4828.Title: White-beard Guru's Event
_4828.Description:
The Chosen Children had the final battle against Etemon from the Pyramid. After that, group of evil Digimon have occupied that area.
Take the third story memory with you and fight against Ogremon, Volcamon and CyberDramon.
_4828.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Memory of Third Story%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Ogremon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Volcamon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Defeat CyberDramon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4828.CompletionText: There's a place where it's hard to get out once you get in…
_4828.CompletionSummary: I'll give you this as reward.

_4829.Title: Achievement Event
_4829.Description: If you want to succeed the name of Bacchusmon, collect and bring me the Wine Glass of Myth from monsters all over the areas.
_4829.Objective: Collect 200 Wine Glass of Myth from monsters of all areas
_4829.CompletionText: When you succeed Bacchusmon's name, you'll gain the power of Earth.

_4830.Title: Baihumon and Fall
_4830.Description:
Hello there. As you know, it is time for my season to take over. But for some reason, Zhuqiaomon had spread energy of Summer more than enough, causing difficulty on retrieving them. I'm trying to purify the energy, so can you help?
"Zhuqiaomon's Heat" is permeated to local creatures, so you'll be able to get it when you defeat the monsters.
_4830.CompletionText: The Summer is gone, and Fall will take over.
_4830.CompletionSummary: Now, take a look. Combine the stuff I gave you and Zhuqiaomon's Heat together and the Summer heat will return to Zhuqiaomon. I'll do the crafting. When you're done, I'll reward you.

_4831.Title: Dynasmon X Event
_4831.Description: Hi, you must have heard the story. Some of my fellows have escaped Verdandi Terminal with the unstable X-Antibody. If they're unstopped, the X-Antibody will spread in Digital World and influence all creatures to become violent. Can you find them and re-claim them before it is too late? The ones that have the X-Antibody are hidden somewhere in Digital World, between the group of Candlemon.
_4831.Objective: Find the Boss among <Revolt> Candlemon and Collect X-Antibody
_4831.CompletionText: Do you think I have that power inside me too?
_4831.CompletionSummary: Thank you! With your help, I sence the unstable X-Antibody power has been neutralized!

_4832.Title: Dynasmon X Event
_4832.Description:
X-Antibody. Honestly, I'm curious about that power. I wonder how we will change when we possess the power. To this question, White-bearded Guru has made cards that show us the aspects of when our Digicore and X-Antibody are fused.
Also of what kind of power we can get.
This is the card I was talking about. Will you take a look on it?
_4832.Objective: Defeat Dynasmon X summoned from the Dynasmon X Summon Card
_4832.CompletionSummary: Great! I'll give you the reward.

_4833.Title: Title Event
_4833.Description: You must have heard of it. It's another aspect of Omegamon Zwart. If you can find it yourself, I'll give you a suiting name.
_4833.Objective: Talk to Omegamon with Omegamon Zwart D as your partner
_4833.CompletionText: It's nothing compulsory. Do as you wish.
_4833.CompletionSummary: That's it. Take this title with you.
_4833.ReservedText: So this is a dark reflection of myself? Interesting...

_4834.Title: New Digimon Event
_4834.Description: Do you want to experience the dark side of me, Omegamon Zwart D? If you wish to see it, just let me know.
_4834.Objective: Talk to Omegamon in DATS Center

_4835.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4835.Description: Culu~! Welcome back! I was looking for you, Culu! I hear the voice of someone who's looking for you from the East of Western Area, Culu~! I advise you to go there at once, Culu! Oh, you don't need to worry~! It's a voice from good-hearted being, Culu!
_4835.Objective: Talk to somebody in Western Village : East
_4835.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to somebody in Western Village : East%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4835.CompletionText: I hope nothing bad happens… Culu…

_4836.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4836.Description: The dark reflection of myself will bring destruction to the Digital World… I, Omegamon will stop it for good!
_4836.Objective: Summon Omegamon from Western Area : East Defeat Omegamon
_4836.CompletionSummary: Ha… You're quite tough. Now I can see why Yggdrasil had concerned.

_4837.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4837.Description: I've watched it very well. The collision between two Omegamon. Same but different, the light and darkness, good and evil, positive and negative energy. It was pretty amazing by the way~ hahahahaha!
_4837.CompletionText: Hey, what's the matter with you? You look like it's the end of world tomorrow.
_4837.CompletionSummary: Oh, your friend Omegamon Zwart… Seems to be badly injured. Not so strange that the opponent was Omegamon. It'd be more strange to be clean after fighting an opponent of same rank.

_4838.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4838.Description: Well, I understand that why you don't trust me. I can read from your expressions that you're thinking 'What the hell is this guy planning to do?'. But you better trust me for once at least… Because I know how to treat the wounds of your friend leaving not a single scratch behind.
_4838.CompletionText: Just trust me for once and I'll have your friend perfectly healed as you wish.
_4838.CompletionSummary: Very well, my friend. You've made a wise decision… I hope you keep in mind that the wound of your friend can only be restored by someone like me.

_4839.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4839.Description: Good. I guess I've explained enough already, so shall I talk about the requirements? I know that your friend is in injured state, but for healing the wounds cleanly, you need more effort. You should know it's necessary? What required now is the materials for making the cure. The first required material is Eye of Argomon(Mega) which is formed by Tree attribute and best on curing the cut wounds! When you bring it to me, I'll tell you the rest!
_4839.Objective: Defeat Argomon(Mega) and obtain Eye of Argomon
_4839.CompletionText: Argomon(Mega) can be found from Lost Historic.
_4839.CompletionSummary: Oh, you really did get it. Very good! But there are 2 more things required. Your friend seems to be getting worse by the meantime.

_4840.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4840.Description: The next thing we need is Pukumon's Helmet! Pukumon's Helmet is formed by Water attribute and it is very effective on neutralizing poison! The complete cure includes poisonous material, so that is why Pukumon's Helmet is needed. Bring it to me and I'll tell you what's next!
_4840.Objective: Defeat Pukumon and obtain Pukumon's Helmet
_4840.CompletionText: Pukumon can be found from File Island Waterfront!
_4840.CompletionSummary: Good job. You've got the material correctly! Omegamon Zwart, you're doing great so far. But you should continue until it's completely done.

_4841.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4841.Description: Now we're on the final step! Keep it up~! The final required material is Megidramon's Flame! Megidramon's Flame is formed by Fire attrtibute and it's highly effective on restoring the damage influenced by frostbite! When the cure is treated, it will be able to restore the wound made by Garuru Cannon. Bring it to me and I'll complete the cure.
_4841.Objective: Defeat Megidramon and obtain Megidramon's Flame
_4841.CompletionText: Megidramon can be found from Silent Forest!
_4841.CompletionSummary: It must have been tough deal, but seems like you went through it. However, there is one bad news. If you promise not to hit me, I can tell you. So, what do you say?

_4842.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4842.Description: The real final requirements are the Heart and Ivory of SkullMammothmon! These things are separate, but can be obtained from one SkullMammothmon, so we can still say they're final! The Heart and Ivory of SkullMammothmon will help the other materials to combine and become a complete cure. With these materials, I can finish the cure to heal your friend! What's hanging your back? Go and get them while I'll prepare to make the cure!
_4842.Objective: Defeat SkullMammothmon and obtain Heart of SkullMammothmon Defeat SkullMammothmon and obtain Ivory of SkullMammothmon
_4842.CompletionText: SkullMammothmon is known to be at Verdandi Terminal.
_4842.CompletionSummary: Oh, that's great~! Things are going as planned!

_4843.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4843.Description: Good~ Now I've finished making the cure to heal your friend's wounds! Here, take it. It's in a form of injection. It doesn't matter where you inject it. I'm just letting you heal your friend yourself.
_4843.Objective: Use the Cure in Kurata's Hideout
_4843.CompletionText: The Party Time is about to begin soon… hehe.
_4843.CompletionSummary: Have you injected the cure properly? If so, you'll see how it works soon.

_4844.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4844.Description:
Hmmm… Omegamon Zwart….You have a long life… Poor guy….. It will be much easier if you just give up on it… You are still holding your life....
Okay… then I’ll help you to release that life… My MugenDramons will attack Omegamon Zwart to accelerate its berserker…
MugenDramons!! Attack Omegamon Zwart~!
_4844.CompletionText: Rampaging holy knight? It's really attracting.
_4844.CompletionSummary:
Oh~ how amazing! He's holding up even after defeating MugenDramon… So he is Omegamon after all… what a surprise.
But the rampage from inside cannot be stopped. In the end, it will devour the soul. No hard feelings, but I'd say it's a proper maneuver for disturbing my plan of Armagemon!!
Enjoy watching how Omegamon Zwart's soul being swallowen by madness and suffer until the very end. I'm done here now. Maybe I'll come back with a more pleasant surprise next time. Hahaha...

_4845.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4845.Description:
Beep! It’s me! I found that a huge Digimon appeared on Western Area: East! Is it related to you?
I see... If it’s not a big deal, come back to headquarter and report the situation! Over!
_4845.CompletionSummary:
I see… It's Akihiro Kurata again after all…
By the way, I see that Omegamon Zwart is in a critical stage. That's terrible…

_4846.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4846.Description: Well, I understand that why you don't trust me. I can read from your expressions that you're thinking 'What the hell is this guy planning to do?'. But you better trust me for once at least… Because I know how to treat the wounds of your friend leaving not
_4846.CompletionSummary: Welcome again, Culu~! I've been expecting you at this time, Culu~!
_4846.ReservedText:
Oh… that's what happened… Unfortunately, neither I can help… I have some clues theoretically, but I don't have enough time for conclusions now.
How about asking for help to Calumon? Calumon may be able to give you a solution.

_4847.Title: Omegamon Zwart D
_4847.Description:
You've injected Akihiro Kurata's cure on Omegamon Zwart, Culu? Oh, why in the Earth have you done that, Culu? If Virus data gets into Vaccine attribute Digimon, it's only going to make bad results! Culu! Did you really not notice it, Culu? Silly! That was very poor decision, Culu!
But what happened is what happened. If you just leave Omegamon Zwart like this, it will eventually lead him to die, Culu!
_4847.CompletionText: I've found the only thing that can be done, Culu!
_4847.CompletionSummary:
Omegamon Zwart will face death if we don't do anything… Culu.
To save him from death, we need something that resists against Virus attribute, Culu! This stuff I have are devided to 2 parts and only effective when the 2 parts are together, but unfortunately I only have 1 part now, so it won't show it's full effect.
But if you can find the other part, your partner Omegamon Zwart can gain power to resist against Virus and can evolve into another form at the same time, Culu!
Anyway, even if it ends successfully, the evolution will lead to incomplete status. So I hope this accident never happens again, Culu!

_4848.Title: Event
_4848.Description:
Well… I know this may sound awkward at first, but I hope you not to get me wrong.
I just asked you if you're willing to use this Digivice, but it's not possible at this moment. Ah! Like I said, don't misunderstand me. I really want to let you use my new invention too. However, those weird looking group of Kokuwamon stole all the batteries that goes into the Digivice!
I'm sorry to ask you for a favor, but there's no other choice for me other than to ask for retrieving the batteries. If you do that, the new Digivice will be yours without additional cost!!
So what do you think? Isn't it fair enough? If you agree with me, please find and bring me those batteries!
_4848.CompletionText: New Digivice is for sale! Oh, is that you? My bad! Of course I have my word on you. Don't worry about the promise!
_4848.CompletionSummary: Thank you~ sincerely! You've done a great favor for me! I'll give you the new Digivice as I've promised. Experience the innovation as you use it! Oh, by the way, it's packed in a box. I hope you don't mind about that.

_4849.Title: Title Event
_4849.Description: If you want to succeed the title of Ceresmon, go and collect Grain of Myth from the monsters all over the world.
_4849.Objective: Collect 200 Grains of Myth from monsters all over the areas.
_4849.CompletionText: You can gain the power of woods when you succeed the title of Ceresmon.

_4850.Title: Decisive Rank Battle
_4850.Description:
Glad to see you. A tough looking Tamer and partner Digimon. Agumon family members have grouped uop together as we assemble once in a year when Moon rises in the sky of Autumn. However, we're having a dispute of proving who's the best of all of us. Uh… even though I think I'm the best.
So you've been helping others alot so far? Will you become a judge and make a fair rule? If you agree to do so, please do me a favor. I'll tell you the opponents you can fight, so you can prove yourself to become our judge.
_4850.CompletionText: I obviously think the new generation of Agumon is the mightiest of all. Don't you agree?
_4850.CompletionSummary: Wow! You've defeated them so fast!

_4851.Title: Decisive Rank Battle
_4851.Description: Good then, one of us will become your duel opponent. While you face one of us, you'll see who's the strongest among us. After you choose one, I'll give you a gift. When you're ready, please let me know.
_4851.CompletionSummary: Here you are. This is the card that you can summon one of us. If you defeat Agumon who has been summoned from the Summon Square, I'll give you the gift.

_4852.Title: Unique School Event
_4852.Description:
You must be the new student that just came!
Can I ask you a favor? I'm sorry to ask for help to a new student, but I have no other choice now. We've lost contact with the substitute teacher field trip group that went to the File Island Waterfront.
Can you get there and check what's going on?
_4852.CompletionText: If it's him, I have no worries.
_4852.CompletionSummary: Oh! You must be the new one?

_4853.Title: Unique School Event
_4853.Description:
The substitute teacher field trip groups are not just one.
There's another group that went to Server Continent Desert. We've lost contact with them also.
Can you check that area too?
_4853.CompletionSummary: Thanks! Now I can make the juice to wake Marcus!

_4854.Title: Unique School Event
_4854.Description:
New semester is pretty close now, but Marcus seems to forgot about it and keeps idling in the beaches. Even when our Digimon friends are helping us.
I think it's time for me to give him my specially made juice to wake him up. But for that, I need the ingredients first. Will you be kind enough to help me with this?
The ingredients must be available from the monsters around this area.
_4854.Objective: Collect Special Recipe Juice's Ingredient from monsters in File Island Waterfront
_4854.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much!! We'll return as soon as we complete!

_4855.Title: Unique School Event
_4855.Description:
You should be sent by Vice Principle Yushima? The research for class is almost done, but we have a problem. Mimi has been exhausted and passed out. I don't know if we can return before the next semester.
While we continue the research, can you get some water to Mimi? The water here is very difficult to find, so you should find from the monsters in this area.
I know it's harsh task, but you're the only one I can ask for help now.
_4855.CompletionText: This place is too hot and dry.

_4856.Title: Unique School Event
_4856.Description:
