To find the study materials and data for teaching the students in school, the Chosen Children and DATS agents are doing the activities in Digital World. The school has given them special position called substitute teacher, with the certificates that are given when they help other children.
When you happen to get the certificates, bring them to me and I'll compensate you.
_4856.CompletionSummary: Good. Please stay as a faithful student!

_4857.Title: School Uniform Event
_4857.Description: Welcome to the unique Digimon school. As a congratulations present for you, I'll give you this school uniform. Even though the data of this uniform is unstabilized and can last for only a day, I'll give you rechargeable energy everyday, so don't worry.
_4857.CompletionText: Now, let's see what we have here.

_4858.Title: School Uniform Event
_4858.Description: Welcome back! Have you returned to get the rechargeable energy?
_4858.CompletionText: How was it? Did it charge well enough?

_4859.Title: Duftmon X
_4859.Description: If your partner is Duftmon X who has both strength and wisdom, I'll give you a title that fits your position.
_4859.Objective: Talk to Omegamon with Duftmon X as partner Digimon
_4859.CompletionSummary: Here's the title. Please make it proud.
_4859.ReservedText: The true aspects of Duftmon who possess both power and intelligence? Impressive.

_4860.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4860.Description:
(What happened to Leomon again…)
(And this cat is…?)

_4861.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4861.Description:
My friend Leomon has passed out again… I haven't seen it from close distance so I'm not very sure, but the group of suspects scattered and ran into 3 directions.
Each one of my friends are chasing by each directions.
Look for my friend in Western Village Outskirts.
_4861.Objective: Talk to <Chaser> Atomeow in Western Village Outskirts
_4861.CompletionSummary: My name is not Atomic, but it's Atomeow!

_4862.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4862.Description:
My friend Leomon has passed out again… I haven't seen it from close distance so I'm not very sure, but the group of suspects scattered and ran into 3 directions.
Each one of my friends are chasing by each directions.
Look for my friend in Silent Forest.
_4862.Objective: Talk to <Chaser> Portomeow in Silent Forest

_4863.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4863.Description:
My friend Leomon has passed out again… I haven't seen it from close distance so I'm not very sure, but the group of suspects scattered and ran into 3 directions.
Each one of my friends are chasing by each directions.
Look for my friend in File Island Waterfront.
_4863.Objective: Talk to <Chaser> Arameow in File Island Waterfront

_4864.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4864.Description:
I've chased them down all the way to here. DemiMeramon and Candlemon
To find any decisive clue of this incident, some conversation with them is required.
Candlemon emerge when certain number of DemiMeramon are defeated.
_4864.Objective: Defeat 40 DemiMeramon in Western Village Outskirts Defeat 10 Candlemon in Western Village Outskirts
_4864.CompletionSummary: I've found a clue!... Something black like a shadow? I guess...

_4865.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4865.Description:
Bakemon! Soulmon! I've been chasing down all the way up to here, but for me to find who made Leomon to pass out, we need to use more hands.
Please help me find clues from Bakemon and Soulmon.
_4865.Objective: Defeat 40 Bakemon in Silent Forest Collect 20 Soulmon's Torn Hat in Silent Forest
_4865.CompletionSummary: I've found a clue… but I can only tell that it has wings.

_4866.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4866.Description:
I've came all the way up to here… but this area is too harsh for me…
The suspicious group I've been chasing down are DemiDevimon and Devidramon.
You know what comes next, don't you?
DeviDramon emerge when certain number of DemiDevimon are defeated.
_4866.Objective: Defeat 40 DemiDevimon in File Island Waterfront Defeat 10 DeviDramon in File Island Waterfront
_4866.CompletionSummary: It's written devil. Only that word is found.

_4867.Title: Finding the Truth.
_4867.Description:
The beacon does not shine on its own base…
These cards had the information of their plans… But in order to find the information, we need to get all 3 of them.
Take this card to D-Terminal Summon Square, defeat the suspect and bring back the damaged cards back.
Wish you luck.
_4867.Objective: Summon and defeat <Suspect> Devimon from D-Terminal Summon Square
_4867.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat <Suspect> Devimon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Damaged Card - OXX%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Damaged Card - XOX%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Damaged Card - XXO%qe %cc4/%mc4
_4867.CompletionSummary: Finally the debt has been paid. Thank you.

_4868.Title: Magnamon X
_4868.Description: If you're a partner of Magnamon X, I'll give you a title that fits the position.
_4868.Objective: Talk to Omegamon with Magnamon X as parter Digimon
_4868.CompletionText: Magnamon X is an X-evolution form of V-mon.
_4868.CompletionSummary: I guess you deserve this name.
_4868.ReservedText: As I thought, the reflection of light is dazzling.

_4869.Title: The Penguin Trio
_4869.Description: I usually travel with two friends of me, but recently have been scattered as we encountered a storm during crossing the oceans. If you happen to find where they are, please let me know.
_4869.Objective: Talk to Decimus in File Island Waterfront Talk to Meridius in Snowstorm Village

_4870.Title: The Penguin Trio
_4870.Description: Actually, me and my friends are expert in carving ice. We've made profits by making ice products and selling them to others around the world. I've been told that one of the finest products we made is the ice-flakes and it makes them cheer up. If you want to try, let me know.
_4870.Objective: Talk to Maximus in DATS Center
_4870.CompletionSummary: Here's the bowl. Since we've been seperated, you'll have to look for my friends to get the rest.
_4870.ReservedText: So you want to try it too. I knew it!

_4871.Title: The Penguin Trio
_4871.Description:
Have you heard from Maximus? To make ice-flakes, we need some ingredients, fruits. I used to get them whenever we make ice-flakes.
However, I'm too starving right now.
Looks like there are lots of fish around this area. Can you get some for me?
_4871.Objective: Collect 30 Chubby Looking Fish from monsters of File Island Waterfront
_4871.CompletionText: I can feel the emptiness in my stomach.

_4872.Title: The Penguin Trio
_4872.Description:
I determine ice used for making ice-flakes. By the way, this place seems to be very comfortable for us to stay.
I see other penguins here, and I even see a giant behind the hills… maybe I need to wear glasses.
Anyway, the ice here seems to be very clean and usable. The only thing that I'm worried is because of some of the monsters around this place.
_4872.Objective: Defeat 30 of each Icemon, Bearmon, Chrysalimon, Apemon from Snowstorm Village
_4872.CompletionText: Can you chase them out for me?
_4872.CompletionSummary: Thanks! I'll give you this beautiful ice as reward!

_4873.Title: Achievement Event
_4873.Description: If you want to succeed the title of Neptunemon, go and collect the Trident Symbol of Myth from villain monsters all over the areas.
_4873.Objective: Collect 200 Trident Symbol of Myth from Villain Monsters All Over the Areas
_4873.CompletionText: You may earn the power of water when you suceed title of Neptunemon

_4874.Title: Omegamon Alter-S
_4874.Description: Do you want to test the powers after becoming Omegamon Alter-S? If you do, just let me know.
_4874.Objective: Talk to Omegamon in DATS Center
_4874.CompletionText: If you know your enemy and yourself, you can win every battle.
_4874.CompletionSummary: You'll get to face your own self.
_4874.ReservedText: That's good. Let's get it started…

_4875.Title: Completing Assignment
_4875.Description: I've met strong monsters in Server Continent Pyramid. Such as Ogremon, Volcamon, Cyberdramon, Monochromon etc… They are becoming a big threat and I could not procede my research. Get them out of the area so I can continue my research.
_4875.Objective: Defeat 10 Ogremon, 10 Volcamon, 10 Cyberdramon, 10 Monochromon from Server Continent Pyramid
_4875.CompletionText: Those monsters can be tough opponent, so you should not lose your tension.

_4876.Title: Completing Assignment
_4876.Description: I've found DemiMeramon that are contaminated while I was passing by Silent Forest. So I'm trying to find out where the source of contamination is. Collect flame crystals from the DemiMeramon. It won't be a tough task for you.
_4876.Objective: Collect 10 Flame Crystals from Polluted DemiMeramon from Silent Forest
_4876.CompletionText: I wonder how long they've been exposed to the contamination.
_4876.CompletionSummary: Thank you! Now I shall find out the source soon.

_4877.Title: Completing Assignment
_4877.Description: This is the easiest assignment. I'm travelling from place to place in Digital World for research. And whenever I go to the Wilderness Area, pack of Boarmon bothers me and are being a headache. If you can deal with them, it would be grateful.
_4877.CompletionText: It's kinda scary when you get to encounter Boarmon alone.

_4878.Title: Achievement Event
_4878.Description: Collect Laurel of Myth from villain digimons all over the area if you want to succeed the title Apollomon
_4878.Objective: Collect 200 Laurel of Myth from Villain Digimons All Over the Area
_4878.CompletionText: You may get Power of Light when you succeed title Apollo

_4879.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4879.Description:
Ha! You! Friend! Where did you get that ticket~
That ticket is Odaiba Jumping Tour Package which is super duper hard to get! It's the one I couldn't get! I feel jealous..I want to go too… I can't go, but my friend Gabumon can go… If you talk to Gabumon, he will take you to the Odaiba Tour Package starting point... Have a nice trip...
_4879.Objective: Talk to Izzy at Camp Site
_4879.CompletionText: I will get the ticket no matter what!!!
_4879.CompletionSummary: Hello~ I'm a Izzy who take a guide for Odaiba Tour Package~ Nice to meet you~
_4879.ReservedText: Oh! Friend~ It's nice to meet you~ You have a ticke for Odaiba Jumping Tour Package~ My friend Agumon doesn't have the ticket yet So he can't go to Odaiba Tour with me…. I might get bored if I go alone, so would you join me to the Odaiba Tour if you’d lik

_4880.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4880.Description:
Wait~ let me see your ticket~ (Checking…)
You have the ticket~ You can enjoy Odaiba Tour Package which is provided by our Digimon Masters Tour~
First, you need some preparation materials to enjoy Odaiba Tour Package~
You don't have them? Don't worry~ We, Digimon Masters Tour, provide everything you need~
_4880.CompletionText: Odaiba Jumping Tour Package Ticket' is in your bag~ Press "I" to check~
_4880.CompletionSummary: There are three materials that help enjoying Odaiba Tour Package It consists from Jumping Digimon Box[Piyomon] to Jumping Digimon Box[Elecmon] and Jumping Digimon Box [Salamon] You can choose one of three

_4881.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4881.Description: Now, I'll guide you how to use Jumping Digimon Box correctly. 1. Go to the shop through me. 2. Now you can exchange Odaiba Jumping Tour Package Ticket to Jumping Digimon Box of your choice. Choose one and click it to purchase. 3. When the purchase is completed, press 'I' to open your bag and obtain all the components of Jumping Digimon Box by right-clicking it. 4. Right-click on your Jumping Digimon DigiEgg to instantly hatch it. And then, name your Digimon by your favor. 5. Switch your partner Digimon to Jumping Digimon that you just hatched! 6. Right-click on Moon Stone of Fortune to instantly level up your Jumping Digimon! Also use EXP Ruby for your Tamer to instantly level up just like your Jumping Digimon.
_4881.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Use Moon Stone of Fortune and EXP Ruby%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4881.CompletionText: 1. Right-click on Jumping Digimon DigiEgg to Hatch Digimon 2. Switch your partner to Jumping Digimon 3. Right-click on Moon Stone of Fortune and EXP Rupy
_4881.CompletionSummary: Wow~ You look very nice~ Shall we start the Odaiba Tour Package now?

_4882.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4882.Description: Now I'll explain about the overall Odaiba Tour Package. Odaiba Tour Package begins from this Camp Site. This place is where Digimon Adventure first began, me and my companions head to Valley of Light where we used to live 4 years ago. After that, we head to Shibuya, the background of episodes regarding Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon. And then we head to Tokyo Tower where the episode of SkullMeramon take place. That concludes Odaiba Tour Package.
_4882.CompletionText: Take time to look around Odaiba. Don't miss the sights!
_4882.CompletionSummary: Okay~ So shall we begin the Tour now?

_4883.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4883.Description: This small shrine here is where I've been staying before I went to Digital World. I was frustrated because of the difficulties on connection of communication signal. After that, I was surprised by a sudden blizzard. Don't you agree with that, Mimi?
_4883.CompletionSummary:
Yeah, I remember. It snowed in the middle of summer… I was really shocked at that time!!
Ah! Right! Have you looked around this place yet?
_4883.ReservedText: Right~ Snow Storm in Summer…. Doesn't make sense!!!

_4884.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4884.Description: Shall we move on to the next spot? I'll show you the buses that brought us here.
_4884.Objective: Go to In front of Buses
_4884.CompletionSummary: The bus you see now is the one which Chosen Children rode all the way to this Camp Site. But we could not ride it back when we left the Camp Site…

_4885.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4885.Description: How was it? Have you admired the view? Now we are about to move on to the Vallye of Light where we Chosen Children has been living 4 years ago. Do you need more time? After the tour is finished, you can come back here anytime, so you don't need to worry.
_4885.Objective: Go to Way to Valley of Light
_4885.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Way to Valley of Light%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4885.CompletionSummary: Throught this path, we can reach Valley of Light. I hope you had enough time to look around the whole Camp Site.

_4886.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4886.Description: Let's head to the Valley of Light leaving the Camp Site behind. Unlikely the name Valley of Light, this place is in the middle of a city. But most of the citizens that lived here has evacuated and it became very quiet now. Which ironically made it more comfortable for you to visit here for tour. Oh, and if the BGM is turned off, try to turn it on again now. It is believed to revive your old memories, if you've watched the original anime long time ago!
_4886.CompletionSummary: Welcome to the Valley of Light!

_4887.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4887.Description: You're now standing on Valley of Light. What do you think? Actually, this pedestiran overpass had been revealed in the past few times already, through Digimon Adventure series (TV version) and Digimon Adventure movie (Theater version). It was destroyed many times in the past, but had been rebuilt like now, so you can stand on it right here.
_4887.CompletionSummary: Oh, one more thing! I forgot to tell you! There is something you should be aware of from now on!

_4888.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4888.Description:
Valley of Light has been occupied by the crowds of Myotismon's Army who's trying to invade the Real World. They're Myotismon's minions, so they're very strong, but you don't need to worry! There's still a safe route to look around this place. 1. Press 'I' to open your bag. 2. You'll find item called 'Mode Selector'. Right-click on it, or press 'X' to open Digimon window. 3. Look for the Digimon icon that has '+' mark on top-right corner. 4. After the Riding Mode slot is opened, you can use ride on your Digimon by pressing 'R' key.
During the riding mode, you can travel safely around this area. Shall we continue the tour in Valley of Light then?
Oh, and there is one thing I'd like you to be aware of! In the Valley of Light, White-bearded Guru is standing there to send you back to D-Terminal. If you go back to D-Terminal in the middle of tour, it can become such a pain to return here, so please don't make a mistake!
_4888.Objective: Go to Valley of Light Station
_4888.CompletionText: 1. Press 'I' to open your bag. 2. You'll find item called 'Mode Selector'. Right-click on it, or press 'X' to open Digimon window. 3. Look for the Digimon icon that has '+' mark on top-right corner. 4. After the Riding Mode slot is opened, you can use ride on your Digimon by pressing 'R' key.
_4888.CompletionSummary:
Here's another core tip~! When you're riding on Digimon above Mega form, the aggressive monsters won't attack you first! So you can move around the map safely!
Now, shall we continue to look around Valley of Light?

_4889.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4889.Description:
This is the Valley of Light. We Chosen Children used the subway during our journey. I remember that we missed the stop we had to get off because all of us were asleep and very tired. Since we've taken a look around here, shall we move on to the next spot?
The next spot we'll visit is the place where the two of huge Digimon collide 4 years ago. Follow me.
_4889.Objective: Go to Place of Memory of 4 years ago
_4889.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Place of Memory of 4 years ago%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4889.CompletionSummary: This is the place where the two of huge Digimon collide 4 years ago. We Chosen Children had witnessed the battle.

_4890.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4890.Description:
The incident that occurred in this place 4 years ago was known to be a bomb terror. I don't exactly remember everything specifically now, but Joe seems to remember more things than me.
Since you've taken enough look at the pedestrian overpass, we'll move on to the next spot. The next spot is place where Garudamon and Mammothmon had fight each other.
_4890.CompletionSummary: This is where Mammothmon had been rampaging, and fighting Garudamon.

_4891.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4891.Description: How was it like? Did you look enough of the place Valley of Light? Now we're going to the next place leaving Vallye of Light behind us. Next place will be Shibuya, where we first met Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon. Are you ready to move on? Let's head to Shibuya now!

_4892.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4892.Description:
This is the place where we first met Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon. It's Shibuya!! Do you see Hachiko statue nearby? Isn't it so cute? T.K and his partner Patamon had a dispute, and Patamon waited for T.K from here to make up again.
Now to the next spot! It's a popular place of Japan, called Scramble Intersection!
_4892.CompletionSummary: It's right in front? Haha This place is one of the famous place to visit in Japan, called Scramble Intersection. It also was shown from Digimon Adventure TV!

_4893.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4893.Description:
This place is very popular, so it appears from many animations and games too. In Digimon Adventure series (TV), Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon appeared in a scene together making pratical jokes.
Let's move on to the next spot. The next spot is Shibuya Shopping Mall. The roads of Shibuya make a very complex structure, so be sure to follow the arrow carefully~!
_4893.CompletionSummary: This building is Shibuya Shopping Mall~! Was it not difficult for you to find this place?

_4894.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4894.Description:
This is the Shibuya Shopping Mall, which you may have already seen from the loading screen when we came here. Matt and T.K brothers had met Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon nearby, facing a several accidents. Which eventually made them friends.
Now, shall we head to the next spot? The next area is the construction site~
_4894.CompletionSummary: You're now at a construction site of Shibuya! At this place…

_4895.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4895.Description: Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon hide Matthew and T.K brothers at here, which gets them killed by Myotismon… It's a tragic story. However, Matt witness the death of Pumpkinmon and Gotsumon here. He swore revenge and it leads to his battle against Myotismon. Now, shall we move on to the place where WereGarurumon and Angelmon cooperate to defeat Myotismon?
_4895.CompletionSummary: This is where we fought against Myotismon. WereGarurumon and Angemon tried their best to defeat Myotismon from here… but it failed and Myotismon has got away...

_4896.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4896.Description: Now, let's leave the histories behind and move on to the next area, Tokyo Tower? Tokyo Tower is a background of SkullMeramon episode that appeared in Digimon Adventure series~ Shall we look around?
_4896.CompletionSummary: This place is Tokyo Tower! One of the most famous place to visit in Japan. Mimi and Sora used to search around this area.

_4897.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4897.Description: How is the atmosphere here? I think Tokyo Tower is quite a view. Shall we move a little more closer to get a better view?
_4897.Objective: Go to Park in front of Tokyo Tower
_4897.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Go to Park in front of Tokyo Tower%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4897.CompletionSummary: Ah~ Here is the park near Tokyo Tower~ There is an episode.

_4898.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4898.Description: In Digimon Adventure series, Mimi gets exhausted and takes rest on the bench in Tokyo Tower Park with a help from Sora. Sora looked like she was in very normal condition, but Mimi seem to be very tired. Isn't it right?
_4898.CompletionSummary: That's what they said~ hahaha We can see the stamina difference between MiMi and Sora~ Sora used to play soccer with Taichi, but MiMi hated exercising~
_4898.ReservedText: You have no idea how hard it was! My legs were in pain too!!

_4899.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4899.Description: While Mimi was taking rest on the bench, she sees Tokyo Tower and asks Sora to go up on Tokyo Tower Observatory. I wonder why she wanted to go there?
_4899.CompletionSummary: I see~ It was cool and nice when we were up there~ But…I never expected to see SkullMeramon all of sudden~!
_4899.ReservedText: Hmm~ It's just~ It was so hot that I wanted to get some rest in some place cool~

_4900.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4900.Description: I see~. I also saw that Tokyo Tower looked as if it was bent when I saw it from a distance~. I was shocked!! I saw it with Taichi's telescope~. I had this question, 'What's happening now?' as I heard Taichi saying 'Digimon is there!'…
_4900.CompletionSummary: Right~ Ah~ We talked to each other~!!! I'm sorry. How was Tokyo Tower Tour? Do you think it's an awesome area?
_4900.ReservedText: I see~ But thanks for coming just in time~

_4901.Title: Odaiba Tour Event
_4901.Description:
The Odaiba Tour Package ends from Tokyo Tower. I hope you had good experience today…
We're on the finish line now! I, instructor of this Odaiba Tour Package is Izzy, who brought you here~ It's such an honor to make progress so far on Odaiba Tour Package with you. I hope it becomes a good memory for you. That's it, thanks for coming.
_4901.CompletionSummary:
I will give you Jump Booster, sending you to Silver Lake in File Island~ If you would like to go back to Silver Lake in File Island, you can click the bomb-looking Jump Booster Item with the right click~
Thank you for participating Odaiba Tour Jumping Event~
_4901.ReservedText: You've found this place finally.. You, foolish chosen children…

_4902.Title: Journey to Digital World
_4902.Description: Among the Digital World, there is an area where it is covered with snow and icicles. It's called Ice Area. How about a journey to that area? If you collect DATA crystals from the monsters from there, I'll reward you.
_4902.Objective: Collect DATA Crystal of Ice Area
_4902.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I think I can do something with this…

_4903.Title: Journey to Digital World
_4903.Description: In Digital World, there is a deserted place just like the Server Continent. They call the whole region Western Area. If you collect DATA crystals from the monsters from there, I'll reward you. I need the DATA to continue my research.
_4903.Objective: Collect DATA Crystal of Western Area
_4903.CompletionSummary: Ha, this is it! I can do something else with this.
_4903.ReservedText: HaHaHa! It's too early to get discouraged, kids…

_4904.Title: Journey to Digital World
_4904.Description: Have you heard stories of File Island? If you collect DATA crystals from the monsters from there as final task, it would be very grateful. I aslo found some sealed DigiEgg and the DATA crystals can help me to break the seal. You'll be able to get them from the monsters in File Island.
_4904.Objective: Collect DATA Crystal of File Island Area
_4904.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect DATA Crystal of File Island Area%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4904.CompletionText: I will let you know these sealed Digieggs….after a few investigation.
_4904.CompletionSummary: It seems like I can unseal with this Crystal

_4905.Title: White-bearded Guru's Request
_4905.Description: I managed to defeat Devimon from File Island and I could contact the Chosen Children. The Chosen Children had to fight against Etemon and his group as soon as they arrived on Server Continent. At that time, Etemon installed black cables all around the Server Continent to defeat the Chosen Children. Even after Etemon was defeated by Chosen Children, the vestiges are remaining. Please get rid of Etemon's minions Gazimon, retrieve the black cables and bring them to me. Black cables can be found from any monsters in the Desert, Canyon, or Pyramid.
_4905.Objective: Defeat Gazimon<Desert> Defeat Gazimon<Canyon> Defeat Gazimon<Pyramid> Collect Black Cable
_4905.CompletionText: The chosen children didn't know that there's the 8th chosen child at that moment
_4905.CompletionSummary: Good job. I will give this to you. I put something useful in there.
_4905.ReservedText: Right, there's a way to get back to Real World… So it's too early to give up…

_4906.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4906.Description: Why don't you hear the story at Old Silver Lake?
_4906.Objective: Find <Beginning of Adventure>Agumon of Silver Lake.

_4907.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4907.Description: Let's go to Silent Forest and hear the story of Elecmon.

_4908.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4908.Description: Let's go to Lost Historic and hear the story of Palmon. He seems finding his friends.
_4908.Objective: Find <MiMi's Friend> Palmon in Lost Historic

_4909.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4909.Description: Go finding tentomon of File Island Waterfront. He will tell you the story of incide
_4909.Objective: Find <Guide of File Island Waterfront> tentomon
_4909.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to <Guide of File Island Waterfront> tentomon%qe %cc1/%mc1
_4909.CompletionSummary: It's the waterfront of File Island here!

_4910.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4910.Description:
I've first met taichi here! I was Koromon at that time. But Kuwagamon attacked us and we all evolved and defeated Kuwagamon!
Now we are worrying about other bad digimons…
Will you help me to defeat Gotsumon, Betamon, Candlemon, Mushroomon at Silver Lake?
_4910.Objective: Defeat 5 each Gotsumon, Betamon, Candlemon, Mushroomon at Silver Lake

_4911.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4911.Description: I've met T.K while caring other digimons! I attacked him as I thought he was harassing others…but we solved misunderstanding with Patamon. Will you help me in this Silent Forest for a bit? I'm worried about other bad digimons.
_4911.Objective: Collect 10 [Memory Fragment] item from bad digimons in Silent Forest

_4912.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4912.Description:
I, MiMi, Izzy and tentomon struggled with fanatic Leomon and Centarumon in the ruin. It was chaotic because of Black Cogwheel~
Fortunately, we could run away from the danger by realizing the force of Digivice.
Now we are defeating bad digimons here!
Will you defeat RedVegiemon, Fanbeemon, Dokugumon, and Cherrymon?
_4912.Objective: Defeat 5 each RedVegiemon, Fanbeemon, Dokumon, Cherrymon in Lost Historic

_4913.Title: Record of White-bearded Guru
_4913.Description: We were struggling among these Monochromons~ It was scary It's really bad that those bad Monochromons appear. Will you defeat those Monochromons?
_4913.Objective: Defeat 10 <In Memory>Monochromons at File Island Waterfront
_4913.CompletionSummary: I'm so touched by your works! Thank you so much!

_4914.Title: Achievement Event
_4914.Description: If you collect enough Records of Myth and bring them to me, I'll let you succeed the title of Olympus XII, Junomon.
_4914.CompletionText: You may learn the power of darkness when you succeed the title Junomon.

_4915.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4915.Description:
The Earth suddenly shuddered for a moment and I was thrown to this place called Yokohama Village! I managed to come here yelling out for help but there is a problem. Lots of aggressive has came along, they started to attack their surroundings and become threat to the whole community!
I was guided here by human who introduced himself as Teacher Mori after I was sent here.
We must defend from their attack! Please help!
_4915.Objective: Talk to Teacher Mori in Yokohama Village
_4915.CompletionText: What could possibly be the cause of this disaster…?
_4915.CompletionSummary: I don't care if it's a mouse or cat who can help. We seriously need help!

_4916.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4916.Description: Silver Lake is also in a situation! Agumon in Silver Lake is calling out for emergency assist, so if you can, please go and help Agumon!
_4916.Objective: Go to Agumon in Silver Lake and listen to what happened.

_4917.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4917.Description: We've received contact from someone called DATS Chief Yushima. It seems that Infinite Ice Wall is suffering the same situation. He should still be there now, so you should be able to hear from him.
_4917.Objective: Talk to <DATS Chief> Yushima in Infinite Ice Wall

_4918.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4918.Description:
Another contact was received from so called White-bearded Guru in the Server Continent Desert! The temperature has risen up more than usual and it's causing the locals to flee from there.
It's probably because of the same attack taking place there.
If you can help, it'd be a great idea, but the place is dangerous so you better watch out!
_4918.Objective: Talk to <Wise Old Man> White-bearded Guru
_4918.CompletionText: What in the world is going on?

_4919.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4919.Description:
A group of violent DemiMeramons are unleashed! They were mischievous sometimes, but at this time, they're different. They seem to be more aggressive and move systematically, as if they were ordered by someone.
Please stop them before it's too late!
_4919.CompletionText: The people are trembling in fear…

_4920.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4920.Description:
Glad to see you! Actually, Silver Lake is under attack by group of Sabirdramons!
If you can stop them and bring their Burnt Black Feathers, I'll repay you!
_4920.Objective: Defeat <Marauders> Sabirdramons and collect 10 Burnt Black Feathers from Silver Lake

_4921.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4921.Description: Thanks for coming! The place is quite harsh itself, and the group of Meramons suddenly came from nowhere, it became more dangerous. Please stop the Meramons.
_4921.Objective: Defeat <Marauders> Meramons of Infinite Ice Wall

_4922.Title: Attack of the Fire Infected with Darkness!!
_4922.Description: Welcome, child! All of a sudden, this place has been invaded by Cerberumons! Please get rid of them and bring me their fangs. If you do, I'll give you something worthy in return.
_4922.Objective: Defeat <Marauders> Cerberumons and collect 10 Fangs of Hellfire from Server Continent Desert.

_4923.Title: Jackpot Event
_4923.Description: Monzaemons have turned wild! They are stealing toys and attacking others. They were last found from Western Village, Silent Forest, and Snowstorm Village. The children are frightened, so please take care of them.
_4923.CompletionText: The children are trembling in fear…
_4923.CompletionSummary: Thank you for helping! Please take this reward.

_4924.Title: Mother's Day Event
_4924.Description: Please teach the evil monsters a good lesson.

_4925.Title: Jackpot Event
_4925.Description: The younglings are starving. I used to feed them, but unfortunately, I can't leave here now, so I need someone to help. Can you help me? I've heard that some of the monsters in Wind Valley, Silver Lake, and File Island are carrying fish.
_4925.CompletionSummary: Thank you very much! The Children will not cry for a while.

_4926.Title: PicoDevimon's Plot!
_4926.Description: Recently, Tonosama Gekomon woke up from sleep and making trouble. Please stop the madness for good.
_4926.CompletionText: What could be the reason for them to wake up all at once?

_4927.Title: Achievement Event
_4927.Description: Do you wish to succeed the title of Olympos XII? If you do, prove yourself by collecting the Token of Myth.
_4927.CompletionText: It can be a tough task for you.
_4927.CompletionSummary: So you've passed the test! I shall now grant you the name of Olympos XII.

_4928.Title: Spring Clean-up Event
_4928.Description: Oil Refinery has become very dusty these days, and I guess I know what's causing it. The mischievious Devimons that recently appeared must be causing the dusts. Please help me by kicking them out of the place, so I can clean up the dusts.
_4928.CompletionText: Let's save mother nature! Let's save the world!
_4928.CompletionSummary: Great! Since the dusts are removed, I can start planting the trees in this area!

_4929.Title: Cherry Blossoms Event
_4929.Description: The season is Spring, but I've been too busy to hang out. I still want to admire the view of Cherry Blossoms in the forest, but I can't leave now. Can you help me?
_4929.CompletionText: I need the energy of Silver Lake. I've been far away from home for too long.
_4929.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This is exactly what I was looking for. Perhaps now I can admire the view!

_4930.Title: Spring Trolls Event
_4930.Description: There are some trolls that bother planting new trees. But there are not enough evidences. If you find any clue, can you bring it to me?
_4930.Objective: Use Seed of Unknown Plant to Worried Palmon
_4930.CompletionSummary: So this is the evidence of trolls? We shall find it out then. By combining it with magic spell and this card. Try using this card and the suspect may be revealed.

_4931.Title: Title Event
_4931.Description: Pass the test and claim the title of Olympos XII if you think you're brave enough!
_4931.CompletionSummary: You passed the test. You deserve the title then. Good job!

_4932.Title: Event
_4932.Description: Hello there! You look like a student to me. How're you doing in your school? Anyway, I have a situation here. My class students are not showing up in class even after new semester has begun. Can you find and make them come back to class?
_4932.CompletionText: I hope my students can learn from you!
_4932.CompletionSummary: Thank you, buddy! As a moral of their laziness, I'll double their homeworks today! Hahaha… just kidding! I don't want my students to refuse coming to class again.

_4933.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4933.Description: The Dark Masters are more persistent than I've thought! They returned, in such a bad time. I've heard that they are lurking somewhere among the File Island Areas and Server Continent Areas. Can you drive them out of Digital World for the peace? If you do, it would be a great favor in restoring the damaged Digital World.
_4933.Objective: Defeat MetalSeadramon Defeat Puppetmon Defeat MachineDramon Defeat Piedmon
_4933.CompletionText: When will Digital World become peaceful again?
_4933.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I can't imagine what the world would be like without a friend like you. I guess we're maintaining peace with your support!

_4934.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4934.Description: The humans act like they're not bothered by the Digital World's damage and seem to not care about it. But it's wrong, and humans definitely have responsibility for Digital World being ruined. I hope you're different from them. If you cooperate on the reconstruction, I'll make you get paid for it, so don't take this as an unfair request. We need energy sources to repair the damages. Find them and bring them to me.
_4934.Objective: Collect Scar Essence Collect Uprising Flame Piece Collect Energy of Steel Collect Energy of Thunder God
_4934.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Scar Essence%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Collect Uprising Flame Piece%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Energy of Steel%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Collect Energy of Thunder God%qe %cc4/%mc4'
_4934.CompletionText: Digital World is ruined a lot, but when humans like you can help, there is still hope.
_4934.CompletionSummary: Good job so far. Here is the compensation.

_4935.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4935.Summary: [Daily] Training with the Humans Begins Now!
_4935.Description: Yes, I admit that we have lost the fight against you. The fight was fair and square and you beat us with your pure skills and strength. We have no excuses. However, we are Four Holy Beasts, the guardians of this world. Please fight us again like you did before. This can be a great opportunity for us to train!
_4935.Objective: Defeat Xuanwumon Defeat Zhuqiaomon Defeat Baihumon Defeat Qinglongmon
_4935.CompletionText: Training isn't only for the weak! It has no exceptions!
_4935.CompletionSummary: Impressive! We've failed to redeem our honor, but it was a good discipline. We may have chance to win in the future, so don't be lazy in your training!

_4936.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4936.Description: I wonder if you've heard, but recently Fanglongmon seems to be awakening. Unfortunately, we're not strong enough to stop it. Fanglongmon was once the leader of us, also an emperor who once ruled the world. Fanglongmon was defeated and sealed up by an angel Digimon a long time ago. However, nothing could stop Fanglongmon from regaining his power, and it started to break the seal. And when he's finally free from the seal, boundless power will be released instantly, influencing Digital World, and even the Real World too. We need your help on this.
_4936.CompletionSummary: I appreciate that. With your help, we can work things out.

_4937.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4937.Description: There's one important thing you must do in prior. Lucemon has emerged in the Real World. You should take care of Lucemon first. Lucemon's presence in the Real World may stimulate Fanglongmon's fury and our mission to stop Fanglongmon can fail before we can even start it. Lucemon was last found from Yokohama East Village. Please deal with Lucemon and make him weaker, so Fanglongmon does not become aware of him.
_4937.CompletionText: Lucemon may be planning something wicked. Don't fall into his trap!
_4937.CompletionSummary: Oh, you've already dealed with Lucemon? That was pretty fast. No wonder you could beat us.

_4938.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4938.Summary: Treatment for the Four Holy Beasts
_4938.Description: Now we won't have to worry about Lucemon for a while. However, Qinglongmon, Zhuqiaomon, and Baihumon they all seem to be exhausted from the reconstruction of Digital World. If you can help, can you find and bring something for a good health care? I heard that Digimons these days carry Tonic for taking care of their conditions.
_4938.CompletionText: I wonder how this drink effect on our bodies. Aren't you?
_4938.CompletionSummary: So this is the Tonic people were talking about.

_4939.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4939.Summary: Digimon Who Failed Becoming a Holy Beast
_4939.Description: The Tonic that you brought us was very helpful indeed. I greatly appreciate it. Oh, and if you don't mind, can you deliver this to Megadramon? I'll explain later.
_4939.CompletionText: I hope he likes my present.
_4939.CompletionSummary: A long time ago, in the past, we have had human partners with us and were defending the Digital World. 5 Humans and their partners, us. We pretty managed well to secure the world in peace. But once we had a fierce battle against the enemies so called Dark Masters. We were defeated by them and facing crisis to be eliminated. But at that time, there was a friend who threw himself into battle to save us. That is, MegaDramon, who you've delivered the Digicore. I wanted to repay him.
_4939.ReservedText: What is this? Oh… I'm feeling much stronger. Is this the power of Xuanwumon?

_4940.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4940.Summary: A Battle to Save the World
_4940.Description: I feel much better as we could repay Megadramon for his debt. Without any burden in my mind, I think I'm ready to return to the plan. Now, let's go to stop Fanglongmon, for the world's peace!
_4940.CompletionText: Are you prepared for the battle? Let me know when you're ready.
_4940.CompletionSummary: Amazing! We could truly stop Fanglongmon by ourselves.

_4941.Title: Fanglongmon Event
_4941.Summary: Final Battle, for Saving the World Again
_4941.Description: The last battle was not enough to stop Fanglongmon for good, so we should try again to for a perfect conclusion. We've already faced Fanglongmon before, so I don't worry too much this time. Let's go again to save the world.
_4941.CompletionText: Are you prepared for the battle? Let me know when you're ready.
_4941.CompletionSummary: As we thought, you've done it again. I guess we won't have to worry about the peace of Digital World and Real World in this century!!

_4942.Title: Gallantmon X Event
_4942.Description: Hi there. Are you willing to be kind enough to help your neighborhood? Then I can give you the opportunity.
_4942.CompletionSummary: Yes? I appreciate that. I was studying about the survival and resistance against X-Program and by some kind of coincidence, I've discovered a new way of evolution. However, I felt that the power I gained is too strong for myself to take control. So I want a match to test controlling my new powers. Take this with you on the way to D-Terminal Summon Square and use it there. Duel with me there in the evoluted form.

_4943.Title: Gallantmon X Event
_4943.Description: I finally found out how to evolute in Digital World. I can give you advice how to evolve your friend to Gallantmon X! If you succeed on it, I'll give you a nice present!
_4943.CompletionText: Did you find the way to evolve your friend?
_4943.CompletionSummary: So you've figured the way out to evolve your partner to Gallantmon X? You can become the real champion from now!

_4944.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_4944.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_4944.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_4944.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_4945.Title: The Famous Detective
_4945.Description: Continued from the incident that happened last year, let me explain about the entire affairs. There's a place that looks exactly like Village of the beginning, but actually somewhere of different time and space. Apocalymon was preparing to attack our world from that place. Luckily, I managed to stop its plan by installing firewalls. Then I went there for investigation, but could not proceed because of Apocalymon's evil spirits.
_4945.CompletionText: I haven't seen Apocalymon itself, but the evil spirits of Apocalymon are already tough enemies to deal with. I've made a report of the situation to DATS Center already, and the firewall will keep off Apocalymon from invasion. It's certain that this world may get into big trouble when Apocalymon really invades.
_4945.CompletionSummary: I don't think it's a good idea to go there. You shouldn't risk your life after you just saved me. And there are still many investigations to be done.
_4945.ReservedText: I haven't seen Apocalymon itself, but the evil spirits of Apocalymon are already tough enemies to deal with. I've made a report of the situation to DATS Center already, and the firewall will keep off Apocalymon from invasion. It's certain that this world

_4946.Title: The Famous Detective
_4946.Description: My colleague fell into a trap during the investigation! Who'd have imagined such trap to be set in this place. It's the Giromons who set this up! Can you find the key from them to set this friend free?
_4946.CompletionText: My friend's not going to be trapped there forever, isn't he?
_4946.CompletionSummary: Oh my! You've really found the key! Finally, I can save my colleague. Take this as a reward!

_4947.Title: The Famous Detective
_4947.Description: With luck, I could receive your help and get free, but it's still not good that there are disrupters on the investigation. To continue on, they must be eliminated. Can you help the investigation by eliminating the disrupters? The leader of those bastards are known to be HiAndromon. He's quite a tough enemy, and emerges from somewhere among the Western areas. I promise to reward you sufficiently.
_4947.CompletionText: HiAndromon is tough enemy. When you face him, don't lose your concentration.
_4947.CompletionSummary: Wow, you've really defeated HiAndromon! Even though they seem to emerge from time to time… your achievement will be great help for the investigation. Oh, and don't forget to claim your reward.

_4948.Title: The Famous Detective
_4948.Description: The Warp Fragments are not perfectly stabilized, but that's still fine with me. Bring them to me and I'll exchange them to Detective's Badge. You may already know, but these badges are pretty valuable. Collect as many Warp Fragments as you can and bring them to me.
_4948.CompletionText: Warp Fragments are required to build the Teleporters. Yet, the chance to succeed is not so high. But you can just focus on collecting them for now.
_4948.CompletionSummary: Ugghh… it really is very very difficult to succeed on combining these fragments… they just got ruined. Anyway, I appreciate your effort. Take the reward.

_4949.Title: New Year's Event
_4949.Description: I don't know if you've heard of this already, but there are secret diagrams found from the wild Digimons recently. If you're interested in unlocking the secret boxes, can you find the diagrams for me?
_4949.CompletionText: Haha… there seem to be so many of them. It's a tough deal, I know. But keep up the good work, you'll be rewarded fairly.
_4949.CompletionSummary: That's so many diagrams in a short period. You're very diligent! I guess you deserve a nice reward.

_4950.Title: New Year's Event
_4950.Description: I've recently lost most of the new year's fortune cards. They've been stolen somehow, but they're very important to me. Can you help me find those cards? I'll definitely reward you for the favor.
_4950.CompletionText: The cards are not just ordinary cards. They're made specially for fortune telling during the New Year season. I really need them.
_4950.CompletionSummary: That's it! Thank you! Let me tell your fortune as a returning of favor.

_4951.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4951.Description: Hi, friends! Will you play along with us? It's a simple Tag game. We brothers will be running around the places in Digital World. The tag won't attack you first, so you find the tag and challenge the Tag. Easy, isn't it? If you beat us in the game, I'll give you an item that you can make in to something special as a reward.
_4951.CompletionText: You'd better keep your eyes wide open!
_4951.CompletionSummary: Finished already? I thought we just began!

_4952.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4952.Description: Hi, buddy! If you don't mind, can you help us? We are 3 Agumon(Black) brothers! Recently our youngest brother seems to be depressed and is not talking with us. Can you ask him, or find out what's make him so depressed?
_4952.CompletionText: I wonder what makes him so silent.
_4952.CompletionSummary: Yes, there is something that bothers me.
_4952.ReservedText: Who are you by the way? Me? Looking depressed?

_4953.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4953.Description: My elder brothers are able to evolve into stronger forms! But the only problem is with me. I'm not old and experienced enough for the evolution. I've heard about a dragon-type Digimon's appearance recently, so I want to find out about its evolution, but I'm not strong enough. Can you find out the true aspects of Digimon from the rumors?
_4953.CompletionText: The rumors say that the newly found Digimon looks awesome!

_4954.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4954.Description: BlitzGreymon is a very fascinating Digimon indeed! However, there are not many people who knows well about it… Will you be able to track down the rumors? If you find a clue, I'll give you something good in return!!
_4954.CompletionText: What would I look like when I turn into BlitzGreymon?
_4954.CompletionSummary: Haha! Now I'm one step closer to evolve into BlitzGreymon myself!

_4955.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4955.Description: Now I decided my path, so the only question left is, how to become strong enough for the evolution!! Can you bring Agumon(Black) friend so we can find the way to evolution fast? I'll get my brothers for some help. Let's do this! This chances don't come to us everyday!
_4955.CompletionText: Let me know when you're ready!

_4956.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4956.Description: My elder brothers agreed to help us training. My brothers can evolve into Millenniumon and Omegamon Zwart! So don't let your guard down, and try best on the duels! I was told that they'll be moving around the areas every 1 hour, so let's go around the areas really quickly!
_4956.CompletionText: My brothers will be waiting for us from somewhere.
_4956.CompletionSummary: Hew! That was a pretty a tough duel!

_4957.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4957.Description: The training must be continued. We should be able to beat my brothers in duel more perfectly. I can sence that you and I have grown much stronger than before, but still not perfect yet. I know you should feel the same about it.
_4957.CompletionText: When you find my brothers, don't hesistate!
_4957.CompletionSummary: Very nice! The training should be helpful indeed!

_4958.Title: Agumon(Black) Brothers Event
_4958.Description: Ok, we've been through the hard trials so far. Evolution should be not a difficult task to us anymore. I've sucessfully evolved myself into BlitzGreymon. Can you show me your result now?
_4958.CompletionText: You don't need to be shy. You should be proud of this evolution!
_4958.CompletionSummary: Now, you turned into BlitzGreymon too! Congratulations!! This evolution is a live evidence that shows our efforts of overcoming the trials!

_4959.Title: Jumping Event
_4959.Description:
Do you know that there are unique DigiEggs in the File Island Waterfront? DigiEgg of Shoreline's Breeze.
Can you get it for me? I'd greatly appreciate it if you do.
_4959.CompletionText: The DigiEgg can be found from the local monsters there. File Island Waterfront.
_4959.CompletionSummary:
This DigiEgg is amazing. So beautiful!
Thank you for finding the egg for me!

_4971.Title: 점핑 이벤트
_4971.Description: 고민이 많은 얼굴이로군. 너 자신이 왜 태어났는지, 이 곳에 왜 있는지, 너 자신은 왜 살아야 하는지 알고 싶은건가?
_4971.CompletionText: 진실은 멀지 않은 곳에 있다. 언제나 가까운 곳에 있지.

_4972.Title: 이벤트
_4972.Description: 시험 - 왕족의 후예이다. 로얄 베이스의 이그드라실 방에 있는 데크스몬을 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.

_4973.Title: 이벤트
_4973.Description: 시험 - 악의 탄생이다. 로얄 베이스(중심부)에 있는 데크스돌그레몬의 알 10개를 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.

_4974.Title: 이벤트
_4974.Description: 시험 - 포식자의 굶주림이다. 로얄 베이스(중심부)에 있는 데크스돌고라몬을 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.

_4975.Title: 이벤트
_4975.Description: 시험 - 개척자의 살육이다. 로얄 베이스에 있는 로드나이트몬과 듀나스몬을 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.
_4975.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1듀크몬의 시험 - 개척자의 살육%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2로드나이트몬의 증표%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3듀나스몬 의 증표%qe %cc3/%mc3

_4978.Title: 이벤트

_4979.Title: 이벤트
_4979.Description: 시험 - 용제의 폭정이다. 로얄 베이스에 있는 엑자몬을 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.

_4980.Title: 이벤트
_4980.Description: 시험 - 비룡의 날개이다. 로얄 베이스에 있는 듀나스몬을 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.

_4981.Title: 이벤트
_4981.Description: 시험 - 장미의 시련이다. 로얄 베이스에 있는 로드나이트몬을 처치하고 와라. 그럼 해답을 알 수 있을 것이다. 무운을 빈다.

_4982.Title: Event
_4982.Description: I'm Digital World's greatest son of Greymon family, Agumon X! There are too many dragons that brag themselves to be the strongest dragon type Digimon! I want to prove them that they're wrong! Please defeat them and make the shameful. And if you can bring some of their precious stuffs, it would be nice!
_4982.Objective: Defeat DexDoruGreymon Defeat MegaDramon Collect DexDoruGreymon's Horn Collect MegaDramon's Machine Arm
_4982.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat DexDoruGreymon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat MegaDramon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect DexDoruGreymon's Horn%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs3Collect MegaDramon's Machine Arm%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4982.CompletionText: The shameless and arrogant dragons I was talking about are DexDoruGreymon and MegaDramon!
_4982.CompletionSummary: So have you made them shameful? Thank you! I feel better now.

_4983.Title: Event
_4983.Description:
I thought plants should be quiet, but some of them are not! They are being too noisy in Verdandi Terminal.
Mushroomon acts like they're the strongest and Lilymon seems to think they're guardians of justice. Please defeat them so they can change their minds. And if you can bring some of their precious stuffs, it would be nice!
_4983.Objective: Defeat Lilymon Defeat Mushroomon Collect Lilimon's Wings Collect Mushroomon's Mushroom
_4983.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Lilymon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Mushroomon(Violent)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Lilymon's Wings%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs3Collect Mushroomon's Mushroom%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4983.CompletionText: Mushrooms and wings would make this plan perfect!
_4983.CompletionSummary: I really hate these plants! But these loots look nice though. Thank you!

_4984.Title: Event
_4984.Description: Verdandi Terminal is full of freaks! Leomons are insane, they are aggressive to anyone near them, and Kunemons are making annoying noises everytime when someone trespasses. Please defeat them and bring peace to the area. And if you can bring some of their precious stuffs, it would be nice!
_4984.Objective: Defeat Leomon Defeat Kunemon Collect Leomon's Blade Collect Kunemon's Antenna
_4984.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Leomon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Kunemon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Collect Leomon's Blade%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs3Collect Kunemon's Antenna%qe %cc3/%mc3
_4984.CompletionText: You can find blades from Leomons, and antennas from Kunemons.
_4984.CompletionSummary: Hew~ I feel much relieved now~ Thanks!

_4985.Title: Event
_4985.Description: On the way back to Thomas, can you deliver this to him? It's a present that I've prepared. Because I'd like to repay for the favor. Thank you~!
_4985.CompletionSummary: A returning present from Kristy? She must have been happy with the present then. Thank you for the support.

_4986.Title: Event
_4986.Description: We defeated Apocalymon long time ago, but it resurrected somehow and becoming threat to us again! I'll guide you to the place where it is found. Please defeat Apocalymon and stop the potential disaster!
_4986.CompletionSummary: It's not alone this time. Watch out for its minions!

_4987.Title: Event
_4987.Objective: Set up the 7th Anniversary Cake Candle

_4988.Title: Event
_4988.Description: Another guest? Glad to see you! I wonder if this isn't rude to ask, but I was looking for someone who can help. You see, my friend Agumon is pretty hungry now since he hasn't eat for a while. I can't leave here now because I need to prepare for the 7th Anniversary party. Please help me if you don't mind!
_4988.CompletionText: Agumon eats a lot, so I guess 10 Chickens will be enough!
_4988.CompletionSummary: Wow~ Did you bring me those Chickens? For me? Thanks very much~~~!

_4989.Title: Event
_4989.Description: Uh oh~ mate~ I'm really glad you gave me chickens and they were very tasty… but I ate too fast and now I'm thirsty~ Can you bring me something to drink? Something popping like Soda would be nice~
_4989.CompletionText: Ask Marcus bro, he may know where to get it~!
_4989.CompletionSummary: Really? Agumon must have eaten too fast so he needs water…

_4990.Title: Event
_4990.Description: So, Agumon asked you for something to drink? Then, I guess I'll give you some of the beverages. It's a Pop Soda prepared for the 7th Anniversary Party, but I'm giving it for Agumon. Please don't tell the others.
_4990.Objective: Passing the Pop Soda to Agumon
_4990.CompletionSummary: Wow~!! Is this really Soda? You have my love~!

_4991.Title: Event
_4991.Description: Hello there, I'm Gaomon. My Master seems to be worried about something, not like he used to be. If it's ok for you, can you ask him what is troubling him?
_4991.CompletionSummary: Oh? Hi. How did you come here?

_4992.Title: Event
_4992.Description: You came as Gaomon asked you? That's quite understandable. I should have spoke with him earlier. It's nothing so serious. I was just thinking of Marcus' mother and sister as they could not join the 7th Anniversary Party. If you came to help me, can you deliver a letter and a present for them? Thanks in advance...
_4992.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Sarah Damon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Letter to Sarah Damon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4992.CompletionText: She should be at her house by now.

_4993.Title: Event
_4993.Description:
That is really Thomas. He's very sencitive. Kristy? She's at School now~ You'll be able to see her there now.
So what could Thomas have written for me?
_4993.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Kristy Damon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Present to Kristy Damon%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4993.CompletionSummary: A present?? It's from Thomas? He's so kind! Please tell him thanks. And thank you too!

_4994.Title: Event
_4994.Description: Hi there. I introduced myself before. I'm Yoshino. What? You are here to help me because I don't look like I'm in a good mood?
_4994.CompletionText: I guess I can't deny that.
_4994.CompletionSummary: Hmm… that's probably because… I was remembering of someone.

_4995.Title: Event
_4995.Description:
I once had a friend, who fell into a bad path for a moment… his name is G. Neon… I'm quite curious of how he's doing now.
Can you deliver this to G. Neon?
_4995.CompletionText: G. Neon should be somewhere in the village.
_4995.CompletionSummary: Yoshino told you to deliver this? Thanks, but please tell her I can't accept that request. She's probably just worried about my future, which is unnecessary for herself.

_4996.Title: Event
_4996.Description: That is how G. Neon responded? Not very surprising, but still a pity… By the way, I guess I can't leave our captain lonely? Please deliver this present to captain Sampson. Thank you!
_4996.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Richard Sampson%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Present to Richard Sampson%qe %cc2/%mc2
_4996.CompletionSummary: A present from Yoshino? Thank you, and please tell her my thanks.

_4997.Title: Event
_4997.Description: Unfortunately, we have a situation. I don't like to give you a task during a celebration, but first thing's first. There's a report that there are Digimons realized in Yokohama Village, unleashed. Please take care of them and return.
_4997.CompletionText: If you deal with this task, I'll invite you to this party, guranteed.
_4997.CompletionSummary: Good job! You can enjoy the party now!

_4998.Title: Event
_4998.Description:
Huh? What are you talking about? I look like I don't belong to the party? What's your problem?
No? You're just worried about me? That's a little awkward. Ok, I'll tell you why then. It's simple. My father could not attend the party even when he deserves to. If you're here to help, can you see how he's doing outside? Thanks!
_4998.CompletionSummary: Did you say Keenan? My son?

_4999.Title: Event
_4999.Description:
Can you tell him, my son that I'm doing just fine? Oh, and if you can help, please take care of the rampageous Digimons in the D-Terminal.
I know you can handle it easily!
_4999.Objective: Talk to Keenan Krier Defeat Drimogemon
_4999.CompletionText: Those monsters are loitering around in D-Terminal Dungeon B1!
_4999.CompletionSummary: My father said that he's fine? Hmm… I thought he may have been disappointed. It's good to hear that he's not unhappy. Thanks for helping!

_5000.Title: Event
_5000.Description: Sorry to bother, but if you don't mind, please do me a favor once more. Please deliver this present to my father.
_5000.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Kevin Krier%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Present to Kevin Krier%qe %cc2/%mc2
_5000.CompletionSummary: A present for me from my son?? Oh… it's very… touching… Thank you very much!

_5001.Title: Event
_5001.Description: Hi~! I'm Miki. You came to help? That's very kind of you. Do you see PawnChessmon B who's next to me? She's pretty quiet but very deligent, and I want to thank her with a little present. Can you ask her what she wants as a present? Oh, please don't tell that I told you to do so.

_5002.Title: Event
_5002.CompletionSummary: She's remaining silent? Ugghh… that's not as what I was expecting.

_5003.Title: Event
_5003.Description:
I guess we should ask Mary for help this time! Can you ask Mary what PawnChessmon W and PawnChessmon B prefers?
Thank you~

_5004.Title: Event
_5004.Description:
So that is Miki's question? But I had the same question myself.
How about you go and ask PawnChessmon W as if you're curious about it?
When you get the answer from him, please tell me too. Thanks!
_5004.CompletionText: Did I sound like our captain?

_5005.Title: Event
_5005.Description:
Well… not that I expected them to talk… but… Let me guess! I have a feeling that the PawnChessmon friends will like this present!
Please give this present to PawnChessmon W!
_5005.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to PawnChessmon W%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Present to PawnChessmon W%qe %cc2/%mc2

_5006.Title: Event
_5006.Description:
So Mary had prepared 'that' as present? It's funny that I have the same thing with me. Then all I have to do now is give it as a present, I guess?
Please pass this present to PawnChessmon B. Thank you very much!
_5006.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to PawnChessmon B%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Present to PawnChessmon B%qe %cc2/%mc2

_5007.Title: Event
_5007.Description: Welcome! As the party is going on, something keeps bothering me. There's a friend who used to be quiet, not beside me now, but someone I could always rely on. Please do me a favor and deliver a present to Kudamon. I appreciate your cooperation!
_5007.CompletionText: You should be able to find Kudamon from Western Village.
_5007.CompletionSummary: A present from Richard Sampson? That's something unexpected.

_5008.Title: Event
_5008.Description:
Thanks. And please tell Richard thanks for the present. Oh… and please also pass him the information of Western Village that I collected.
I have to remain here for a while.
_5008.CompletionSummary: It's good that Kudamon seems to like the present.

_5009.Title: Event
_5009.Description: By the way, by analyzing the information sent from Kudamon, there are some symptoms of potential disaster going on. Can you handle it now? I'm sure it's an easy task for you.

_5010.Title: Event
_5010.Description: There's someone I would like to give thanks to. If you don't mind, please deliver my thanks for him too.
_5010.CompletionText: Who is he? You should know him very well. He's chief Yushima.
_5010.CompletionSummary: Haha… a present from Sampson? That's something I don't see everyday.

_5011.Title: Event
_5011.Description: The present from Sampson reminds me of Kamemon. Actually, Kamemon needs this present more than me. But Kamemon seems to be outside now. Can you deliver this to Kamemon for me? Thank you.
_5011.CompletionText: Kamemon is known to be somewhere in the Snowstorm Village.

_5012.Title: Event
_5012.CompletionSummary: Kamemon received the present silently? I see…

_5013.Title: Event
_5013.Description: So Kamemmon seem to be anxious of something? Then there must be something going on. I'm sorry to ask again, but can you go and ask Kamemon what his trouble is?

_5014.Title: Event
_5014.Description: … There are bad guys nearby. Please help me to chase them out.

_5015.Title: Event
_5015.Description:
We're in a middle of celebration, but there's a man we should keep an eye on. He is Akihiro Kurata!
Please check what Kurata is upto, and tell me.
_5015.CompletionText: That man can be planning something stupid to do.
_5015.CompletionSummary: Hashima told you that? How arrogant…

_5016.Title: Event
_5016.Description:
Hey, I desire to live in peace now. There is a Gizumon that I used to research, but now its unleashed and causing some trouble.
I'd like to handle it myself if I can, but I have nothing left on me. So if you're here to help, why don't you deal with it?
_5016.CompletionText: Gizumon must be somewhere around the factory. It was programmed to create a disorder in the city a long time ago.

_5017.Title: Event
_5017.Description: Anyway, I'm living quietly and peacefully now, so you can tell Hashima to mind his own business!
_5017.CompletionSummary: That's what the man said? Akihiro Kurata? Unbelievable… but that doesn't mean I don't believe what you've just said. Good job by the way.

_5018.Title: Event
_5018.Description: I told Fanglongmon that I'd serve him Turkey Cuisine during the Thanksgiving… but unfortunately, I couldn't prepare it yet. Can you help me get the ingredients to make the Turkey Cuisine?
_5018.CompletionText: Those ingredients can be obtained from Xuanwumon, Zhuqiaomon, and Baihumon!
_5018.CompletionSummary: Really? Qinglongmon has prepared the Turkey Cuisine for me? I didn't know he really meant it. Wonderful! And thank you for delivering the delious roasted turkey~!

_5019.Title: Event
_5019.Description: Fight and win against Meramon and I'll give you a fitting title. I wonder how you would look like with a title "Burning"…
_5019.CompletionText: You can find Meramon from Silent Forest.
_5019.CompletionSummary: So you've defeated them successfully? Good! You're a skill tamer just as I expected. I hope this title "Burning" fits you (chuckles).

_5020.Title: Event

_5020.CompletionText: You can find Knightmon from Oil Refinery and Mystimon from Lost Historic Site.

_5034.Title: Event
_5034.Description:
Hi there. You seem to be curious about my X-evolution aspect.
Then why not go through it yourself? If you accomplish X-evolution and come to me, I'll give you something useful for you.
_5034.CompletionText: For the X-evolution, you should have the X-antibody factor!
_5034.CompletionSummary: Great! Now you can X-evolute yourself like me!

_5035.Title: Event
_5035.Description:
Good! How about trying the next step to X-evolution?
If you succeed on X-evolution to Garurumon X, I'll give you another useful thing!
_5035.CompletionText: For the X-evolution, you should have the X-antibody factor!
_5035.CompletionSummary: Cool! Now you can X-evolute to Garurumon X!

_5036.Title: Event

Good! How about trying the next step to X-evolution?
If you succeed on X-evolution to WereGarurumon X, I'll give you another useful thing!

_5036.CompletionSummary: Awesome! Now you can X-evolute to WereGarurumon X!

_5037.Title: Event

Good! How about trying the next step to X-evolution?
If you succeed on X-evolution to MetalGarurumon X, I'll give you another useful thing!
_5037.CompletionText: For the X-evolution, you should have the X-antibody factor!

_5041.Title: Event
