Good! How about trying the next step to X-evolution?
If you succeed on X-evolution to WarGreymon X, I'll give you another useful thing!
_5041.CompletionText: For the X-evolution, you should have the X-antibody factor!
_5041.CompletionSummary: Wow! I actually didn't expect you to reach WarGreymon X this fast. Congratulations!

_5042.Title: Event
_5042.Description: Welcome, my friend! You've came in a good time! We have a situation of some rampageous X-Antibody Digimons trying to steal other Digimon's X-Antibody from Verdandi Terminal! Please bring justice among the evil Digimons!
_5042.Objective: GrandisKuwagamon's Voucher GranDracmon's Voucher TigerVespamon's Voucher Dorugoramon's Voucher DexDoruGreymon's Voucher
_5042.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1GrandisKuwagamon's Voucher%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2GranDracmon's Voucher%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3 TigerVespamon's Voucher%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Dorugoramon's Voucher%qe %cc4/%mc4 %qs5DexDoruGreymon's Voucher%qe %cc5/%mc5
_5042.CompletionText: X-Antibody Digimons that steal X-Antibody from others? How cruel! Please stop them for good!
_5042.CompletionSummary: I see that you've dealt with the evil X-Antibody Digimons! Thank you!

_5043.Title: Event
_5043.Description: You've came in a good time! We have a situation of Royal Knights killing innocent Digimons by the name of purifying New Digital World! This is crazy! Please stop the Royal Knights and teach them a lesson!
_5043.Objective: Dynasmon's Voucher Crusadermon's Voucher UlforceVeedramon's Voucher
_5043.CompletionText: I hope you can enlighten the Royal Knights by showing them true justice!
_5043.CompletionSummary: You've tought the arrogant Royal Knights a lesson! Thank you!

_5044.Title: Event
_5044.Description: Good to see you again! The Royal Knights are still killing innocent Digimons by the name of purifying New Digital World! Please stop the Royal Knights and teach them a lesson once again!
_5044.Objective: Craniamon's Voucher Sleipmon's Voucher Examon 's Voucher
_5044.CompletionText: I hope you can enlighten the Royal Knights by showing them true justice!
_5044.CompletionSummary: You've tought the arrogant Royal Knights a lesson! Thank you!

_5045.Title: Event
_5045.Description: The leader of Royal Knights Omegamon has appeared in Verdandi Terminal and massacre towards innocent Digimons is about to happen again! Please use your power to bring peace to the New Digital World!
_5045.CompletionText: Please use your power to bring true peace in New Digital World!
_5045.CompletionSummary: You've save the New Digital World! Thank you very much!

_5046.Title: Event
_5046.Description: It's Spring now, but the flowers are not blooming. Yukidarumon must be the cause of this cold. Young Palmons are not strong enough to fight the cold. For the Spring to come to us normally, we need to do something. Yukidarumon(Frost) has stolen seeds that we should retrieve. The stolen seeds possess enough energy, so if we get them back, we'll be able to revive Spring.
_5046.CompletionText: Please bring the seeds to us. The longlasting cold is becoming painful.
_5046.CompletionSummary: That's it. These seeds are the seeds I talked about! Thank you! I'll give you this flower in return.

_5047.Title: Event
_5047.Description: It should be Spring by now, but isn't it too cold? It's March already, third month of the year. Unbelieveable! The way I heard from people, a group of Yukidarumons have invaded Real World and making a disorder. Can you chase them away so the temperature becomes normal again?
_5047.CompletionText: I'm sure that the cause of this abnormal coldness is because of them.
_5047.CompletionSummary: Believe or not, the temperature become warmer! Thanks to you that now we can finally greet our Spring with happiness!

_5048.Title: Event
_5048.Summary: Items Lost by Betting with ToyAgumon…
_5048.Description: I've lost my items on bet with ToyAgumon… I know it's my fault, but I realized that the bet was unfair. Please help me get my stuffs back!
_5048.CompletionSummary: Use this block to bet ToyAgumon and you'll be able to play the card game with him.

_5049.Title: Event
_5049.Description: I need some help. Recently, DemiMeramon has increased in numbers drastically and it's causing Whamon's water pouch to dry-up. He can't stay here longer without any water. Since I became desperate, I came here and found you. Can you drive some of DemiMeramon from here for me?
_5049.CompletionText: Whamon can regain water in his pouch when the number of DemiMeramons decrease.
_5049.CompletionSummary: Good Job!! Now please take out the water drops from this water pouch and hand them to Whamon! Thank you!

_5050.Title: Event
_5050.Description: We're in a difficult situation. Meramon is spreading heat all over the world to take his revenge. Please collect Meramon's Heat to prevent any possible disaster.
_5050.CompletionSummary: Thanks!! I've prepared a nice gift for you!

_5051.Title: Qinglongmon Event
_5051.Summary: Rehearsal before facing the True Qinglongmon
_5051.Description: Finally there is a chance to see Qinglongmon.. Even though it took a very long time, this may be a great opportunity to save Digital World!
_5051.Objective: Defeat Xuanwumon from Scar of Water Crystal Defeat Zhuqiaomon from Uprising Flame Defeat Baihumon from Trace of Black Steel
_5051.CompletionText: Have you completed the rehearsal yet?
_5051.CompletionSummary: Looks like you've done the rehearsal already.. Here, take this reward with you, as it's the only reward I can give you. Please help us maintain the peace of Digital World and Real World.

_5052.Title: Qinglongmon Event
_5052.Description: Culu? Are you sure you're going straight to Qinglongmon in this condition? Qinglongmon is the strongest among all the Four Holy Beasts, culu! Trust me that you won't have a chance if you go now!
_5052.CompletionText: Could you feel the mighty force of Qinglongmon, Culu?
_5052.CompletionSummary: For the Digital World! Culu! This is the only thing I can help you now, Culu!

_5053.Title: Event
_5053.Description: Welcome. Tamer who's got some talent! Today is a perfect day to carry out the mission for the peace of Digital World. This holy water purifies aggression and can bring peace. Let's start from the Western Area. Shall we?
_5053.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Impmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Devimon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defat Dark SkullMeramon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Central Dark Tower - Holy Water of Purification%qe %cc4/%mc4
_5053.CompletionText: The mission location is Western Area. Be sure to check the point where you can sprinkle the holy water!
_5053.CompletionSummary: Good job! Western Area became a little more quiet, I guess.

_5054.Title: Event
_5054.Description: The next target is Ice Area. Sprinkle the holy water into Ice Area and neutralize all aggressiveness!
_5054.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Apemon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat SuperStarmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Vikemon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Central Data Lava Area - Holy Water of Purification%qe %cc4/%mc4
_5054.CompletionText: The mission location is Ice Area. Be sure to check the point where you can sprinkle the holy water!
_5054.CompletionSummary: Well done! The Ice Area should be a little more peaceful now.

_5055.Title: Event
_5055.Description: File Island Area is next. The mission logic is pretty much same!
_5055.Objective: CommanDramon's Mission in File Island Area
_5055.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Kuwagamon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Blossomon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defat Dark Zudomon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Strange Payphone - Holy Water of Purification%qe %cc4/%mc4
_5055.CompletionText: The mission location is File Island Area. Be sure to check the point where you can sprinkle the holy water!
_5055.CompletionSummary: Oops… combining warp fragments has failed once again… Anyway, you've done well on your mission. Take the loot box.

_5056.Title: Event
_5056.Description: Now we move onto Server Continent, with the same mission!
_5056.Objective: CommanDramon's Mission in Server Continent Area
_5056.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Digmon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Vegiemon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defat Gazimon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Home of the Sphinx - Holy Water of Purification%qe %cc4/%mc4
_5056.CompletionText: The mission location is Server Continent Area. Be sure to check the point where you can sprinkle the holy water!
_5056.CompletionSummary: Great! The heavy atmosphere of Server Continent Area seems to be lightened!

_5057.Title: Event
_5057.Description: Finally the last target. It's the Four Holy Beasts Area! The aggression in this area is much stonger than other places, so please be careful.
_5057.Objective: CommanDramon's Mission in Four Holy Beasts Area
_5057.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Xuanwumon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Zhuqiaomon (Easy)%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Home of the Zhuqiaomon - Holy Water of Purification%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5057.CompletionText: The mission location is Four Holy Beasts Area. Be sure to check the point where you can sprinkle the holy water!
_5057.CompletionSummary: Mission accomplished! As the aggression of strongest Digimons have faded, our plan of domination is one step closer… wait, what's with your serious looking face? I was just kidding, relax!

_5058.Title: Warrior's test
_5058.Description: Welcome to take the warrior's test. Warrior's test will be a battle against the enemy Digimon in the Hall of strife. I'm sure you'll pass this test well enough!
_5058.Objective: Defeat <Stained by Evil>Cherubimon (Evil) and <Stained by Evil>ShadowSeraphimon in Hall of strife
_5058.CompletionText: You can enter the Hall of strife by talking to me with the [Test Hall Pass]
_5058.CompletionSummary: As expected, I thought you'd pass this test well enough

_5059.Title: Warrior's test
_5059.Description:
If you want to become a true warrior, you'll have to pass my trial. Beep!
The first trial is to defeat the enemy Digimon that are disturbing the sea in File Island Water Front. Beep!
_5059.Objective: Defeat Calamaramon 3ea by defeating <Polluting the sea>Lanamon 15ea in File Island Water Front
_5059.CompletionText: <Queen of the Sea>Calamaramon will only appear if certain conditions are met.
_5059.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on passing the first trial. Beep!

_5060.Title: Warrior's test
_5060.Description: Now that you have passed the first trial, the second one. Beep! The second trial is to defeat the apostle of evil that appeared in Yokohama Village and Silent Forest. Beep! Unlike the first one, these guys aren't easy, so prepare yourself. Beep!
_5060.Objective: Yokohama Village <Apostle of Evil>Sefirotmon Silent Forest <Apostle of Evil>Petaldramon
_5060.CompletionText: It's Yokohama Village and the Silent Forest Beep!

_5061.Title: Our Bond!
_5061.Description: Finally!! Our bond paved the way for a new evolution

_5062.Title: Bond of Friendship - Last Evolution
_5062.Description: Use the Voucher of Friendship to check the new evolution of bond.
_5062.Objective: Defeat Gabumon - Bond of Friendship in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5062.CompletionText: It can be summoned from the Underground Summon Square.
_5062.CompletionSummary: What do you think about the new evolution Agumon - Bond of Friendship?

_5063.Title: Legend! Level-up Reward
_5063.Description: Nice to meet you, Tamer! I've been waiting for you to inherit the power of the 10 warriors.
_5063.Objective: Talk to Bokomon in Yokohama Village
_5063.CompletionText: If you want to inherit the power of the 10 warrior, tell me!
_5063.CompletionSummary: Good! Let's take over the power of the 10 warriors and start preparing for it.

_5064.Title: Legend! Level-up Reward
_5064.Description: You've met the minimum requirement to become a 10 warriors Talk to me again when you're ready to set off on your journey!
_5064.Objective: Talk to Bokomon in Yokohama Village
_5064.CompletionSummary: Ok! Let's gon on a journey!

_5065.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5065.Description: Let's check if you're ready one more time before you go on your journey.
_5065.Objective: Talk to Bokomon in Yokohama Village
_5065.CompletionSummary: Good! Now let's go on our first journey

_5066.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5066.Description:
The first journey!
After completing the Yokohama main quest(purple exclamation mark) and then accepting the quest [To the Digital World!] from Richard Sampson in DATS Center and come to Silver Lake
Then I will be waiting for you at Silver Lake.
_5066.Objective: After completing the quest [Dats Agent Ceremony], talk to Bokomon in Silver Lake
_5066.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5066.CompletionSummary: You've done it! This is the real beginning

_5067.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5067.Description:
The second journey!
Complete the main quest of Silver Lake(purple exclamation mark) and come to Silent Forest
Then I will be waiting for you at Silent Forest.
_5067.Objective: After completing the quest [Deeper into the File Island], talk to Bokomon in Silent Forest.
_5067.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.

_5068.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5068.Description:
The third journey!
Complete the main quest of Silent Forest(purple exclamation mark) and come to Lost Historic Site
Then I will be waiting for you at Lost Historic Site.
_5068.Objective: After completing the quest [Outta My Way!], talk to Bokomon in Lost Historic Site
_5068.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5068.CompletionSummary: You're doing great! Don't give up like this, let's go to the end!

_5069.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5069.Description:
The fourth journey!
Complete the main quest of Lost Historic Site(purple exclamation mark) and come to File Island Water Front
Then I will be waiting for you at File Island Water Front.
_5069.Objective: After completing the quest [Wake Spirit Up!], talk to Bokomon in File Island Water Front
_5069.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5069.CompletionSummary: I think you can be the best fighter ever to reach this far.

_5070.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5070.Description:
The fifth journey!
Complete the main quest of File Island Water Front(purple exclamation mark) and come to Infinite Mountain
I will be waiting for you at Infinite Mountain.
_5070.Objective: After completing the quest [Showdown! Monochromon!], talk to Bokomon in Infinite Mountain
_5070.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5070.CompletionSummary: This is a place where Digimon with powerful evil powers live. I believe you can defeat him!

_5071.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5071.Description:
The sixth journey
Complete the main quest of Infinite Mountain(purple exclamation mark) and come to Server Continent
I will be waiting for you at Server Continent.
After completing the quest [최종결전!!], someone will be waiting for you on the Water Front. Talk to him and come to the Server Continent.
_5071.Objective: After completing the quest [Final Battle!!], talk to Bokomon in Server Continent Dessert.
_5071.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5071.CompletionSummary: You're doing great! It's not long now, so let's do your best

_5072.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5072.Description:
The seventh journey!
Complete the main quest of Server Continent - Dessert(purple exclamation mark) and come to Server Continent - Canyon
I will be waiting for you at Server Continent - Canyon.
_5072.Objective: After completing the quest [Power to move forward], talk to Bokomon in Server Continent Canyon.
_5072.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5072.CompletionSummary: Now the end of this journey is nearing Let's try a little harder.

_5073.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5073.Description:
The eighth journey!
Complete the main quest of Server Continent - Canyon(purple exclamation mark) and come to Server Continent - Pyramid
I will be waiting for you at Server Continent - Pyramid.
_5073.Objective: After completing the quest [Feeling sorry], talk to Bokomon in Server Continent Pyramid.
_5073.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.

_5074.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5074.Description:
Finally, the last ninth journey!
Complete the main quest of Server Continent - Pyramid(purple exclamation mark) and come to Camp Site
Then I will be waiting for you at Camp Site.
_5074.Objective: After completing the quest [Fake Card is!], talk to Bokomon in Camp Site
_5074.CompletionText: You will be able to come easily.
_5074.CompletionSummary: You did it! Now, only the final process to inherit the power of 10 warriors remain I'll be waiting for you at DATS Center

_5075.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5075.Description:
Come here! Tamer. Now you have to find the Guider's Jewel Fragments scattered in each area and prepare to become true warrior!
Talk to me again when you're ready.
_5075.CompletionText: Talk to me again when you're ready
_5075.CompletionSummary: If you open the map box, you'll get with the location of the Guider's Jewel Fragment.

_5076.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5076.Description: Looking at the map, I think there is a Guider's Jewel Fragment buried in a specific area of the Server Continent Pyramid
_5076.Objective: Use Shovel in Server Continent Pyramid - The Home of the Sphinx
_5076.CompletionSummary: Great job. We need to find more Guider's Jewel Fragments!

_5077.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5077.Description: Looking at the map, I think there is a Guider's Jewel Fragment buried in a specific area of the Server Continent Dessert
_5077.Objective: Use Flippers in Server Continent Dessert - Oasis
_5077.CompletionSummary: Great job. We need to find more Guider's Jewel Fragments!

_5078.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5078.Description: Looking at the map, it seems to be pointing somewhere on the Infinite Ice Wall
_5078.CompletionText: It's Infinite Ice Wall of Ice area!
_5078.CompletionSummary: Great job. I didn't expected that Digimon took the power of fragments. We almost got into trouble.

_5079.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5079.Description: Looking at the map, it seems to be pointing somewhere on the Silver Lake
_5079.Objective: Defeat <Playing with fragments>Gekomon in Silver Lake
_5079.CompletionText: It's Silver Lake of File Island!

_5080.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5080.Description: Looking at the map, it seems to be pointing somewhere on the File Island Water Front.
_5080.Objective: Defeat <Takes Power>Piedmon in File Island Water Front
_5080.CompletionSummary: I'm glad that you defeat Piedmon before he took all the power of fragments

_5081.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5081.Description: Checking the map, this time it seems to be pointing somewhere in the Silent Forest.

_5082.Title: Legend! Guidance of 10 Warriors!
_5082.Description: Checking the map, this time it seems to be pointing somewhere in the Western Village <West>
_5082.Objective: Talk to <Legend>Bokomon appearing in Western Village <West>

_5083.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5083.Description: You had a hard time helping us. Now go to Antylamon, because he needs some help.

_5084.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5084.Description: If you defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Antylamon in Server Continent - Pyramid, you will be able to get a piece of strong power.
_5084.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Antylamon in Server Continent Pyramid
_5084.CompletionSummary: Good job. If you collect more pieces of strong power, you will be able to completely restore the beads.

_5085.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5085.Description:
The energy of lightning is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Majiramon in Server Continent - Canyon, you'll get a piece of power.
_5085.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Majiramon in Server Continent Canyon
_5085.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5086.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5086.Description:
The energy of lightning is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Mihiramon in Server Continent - Canyon, you'll get a piece of power.
_5086.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Mihiramon in Server Continent Dessert.
_5086.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5087.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5087.Description: This is a bead containing the energy of lightning. Something happened, and the power contained within it was fragmented and scattered. Can you find the pieces of my scattered power and restore the beads?
_5087.CompletionText: If you have any intention of going to find the pieces of my scattered power, come and tell me
_5087.CompletionSummary: Now, here is the beads of my power.

_5088.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5088.Description:
You have succeeded in completely restoring the bead's power.
Now help the other Four Holy Beasts.

_5089.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5089.Description: If you go to Shadow Labyrinth and bring [Stiff fur of Baihu] back, it will be of great help in restoring the power of bead.
_5089.Objective: Collect [Stiff fur of Baihu] by clearing Shadow Labyrinth once
_5089.CompletionText: It's Shadow Labyrinth that can be accessed from the D-Terminal.
_5089.CompletionSummary: Good job. If you collect more pieces of strong power, you will be able to completely restore the beads.

_5090.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5090.Description: The energy of steel is scattered among various Digimon. First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon in Lost Historic Site, you'll get a piece of power.
_5090.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon 30ea in Lost Historic Site.
_5090.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5091.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5091.Description:
The energy of steel is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Baihu>SaberLeomon in Silver Lake, you'll get a piece of power.
_5091.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>SaberLeomon 30ea in Silver Lake
_5091.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5094.Objective: Collect [Burning feather of Zhuqiao] by clearing Arena Round 10
_5094.CompletionSummary: Good job. If you collect more pieces of strong power, you will be able to completely restore the beads.

_5095.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5095.Description:
The energy of flame is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon in Western Village West, you'll get a piece of power.
_5095.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon 30ea in Western Village West.
_5095.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Birdramon in Western Village, you'll get a piece of power.

_5096.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5099.CompletionSummary: Good job. If you collect more pieces of strong power, you will be able to completely restore the beads.

_5100.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5100.Description:
The energy of water is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon in Snowman Village, you'll get a piece of power.
_5100.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon 30ea in Snowman Village.
_5100.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5101.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5101.Description:
The energy of water is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Icemon in Snowstorm Village, you'll get a piece of power.
_5101.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Icemon 30ea in Snowstorm Village.
_5101.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the bead's power.

_5102.Title: Energy of Four Holy Beast
_5102.Description:
This is a bead containing the energy of water.
Something happened, and the power contained within it was fragmented and scattered. Can you find the pieces of my scattered power and restore the beads?
_5102.CompletionText: If you have any intention of going to find the pieces of my scattered power, come and tell me
_5102.CompletionSummary: Now, here is the beads of my power.

_5103.Title: Fanglongmon's Energy
_5103.Description:
This time we're getting signal from Oil Refinery-3.
Let's go together.
_5103.Objective: Talk to <Agent of Fanglongmon>Antylamon in Oil Refinery-3
_5103.CompletionText: I will go to Oil Refinery-3 first.
_5103.CompletionSummary: We are lucky in this time.
_5103.ReservedText: Lucky for us. We were able to find it before the other Digimon noticed it.

_5104.Title: Fanglongmon's Energy
_5104.Description:
This time we're getting a signal in a very unusal area.
Arena…Thank you again this time
_5104.Objective: Obtain [Trace of Fanglong] by completing Arena round 10
_5104.CompletionText: The signal is being picked up on the 10th floor of the Arena.

_5105.Title: Fanglongmon's Energy
_5105.Description:
This time it's pointing Western Village <West> .
Lets go
_5105.Objective: Defeat <Obsessed with power>Sabirdramon 30ea in Western Village <West>
_5105.CompletionSummary: Many Digimon seem to have been obsessed with power. But I'm glad we stopped it before it caused more damage.

_5106.Title: Fanglongmon's Energy
_5106.Description: The signal on the Location Tracker is pointing towards Western Village. Come on, let's go.
_5106.Objective: Defeat <Became huge> Birdramon in Western Village

_5107.Title: Fanglongmon's Energy
_5107.Description:
Hello. Tamer
Thank you for helping the 4 Holy Beasts.
As Qinglongmon said, we are currently in need of Tamer's help.
Due to current circumstances, the power of Fanglongmon has been scattered. And some Digimon have become violent due to the scattered power. We need to subdue these Digimon and find and retrieve the Trace of Fanglongmon's power. Can you help me?
_5107.CompletionText: If you retrieve all traces of power, we will give you a special reward.
_5107.CompletionSummary: Thank you. If you use this Location Tracker Box, you will be able to find the scattered power.

_5108.Title: Lucemon's Resurrection
_5108.Description: It's urgent!! Lucemon, which was sealed by the legendary 10 warriors of the past, is about to awaken. It seems that he knows that a new warrior is about to appear and is trying to stop it. We have to defeat him now that he hasn't completely unsealed it yet.
_5108.Objective: Defeat summoned <Sealed>Lucemon by using [Summoning Device] in D-Terminal Undergrond Summon Square
_5108.CompletionText: Take this to the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and summon him!

_5109.Title: Warrior tainted with evil
_5109.Description: Hello Tamer. Due to an unknown evil energy, the fighters are stained with evil. We must first subdue them to prevent further damage.
_5109.Objective: Defeat <Tainted with Evil>Agnimon 10ea and <Tainted with Evil>Wolfmon 10ea in Western Area : Outskirts
_5109.CompletionText: The warriors are confirmed to be located outside the Western Village now.
_5109.CompletionSummary: Fortunately, more damage could have been prevented.

_5110.Title: Warrior tainted with evil
_5110.Description:
Urgent!!
The Digimon of the Digital World are becoming violent due to the unknown evil energy
I think we need to stop the Digimon that have become violent and find the reason.
_5110.Objective: Obtain [Thoughts of evil] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digmon except Yokohama Village
_5110.CompletionSummary: Thank you for your effort. I will investigate these powers.

_5111.Title: Warrior tainted with evil
_5111.Description:
I found the reason.
The evil energy created by the awakening of the sealed Lucemon settled in some parts of the Digital World.
You will be able to purify the area by using the jewels containing the power of the 3 Great Angels.
_5111.Objective: Use [Power of 3 Great Angels] in Dark tower Wasteland - Central Dark Tower, Northwest Dark Tower, and Southwest Dark Tower.
_5111.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Central Dark Tower%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Northwest Dark Tower%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Southwest Dark Tower%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5111.CompletionSummary: There will be no more problems in this area now. This is all thanks to the Tamer. Thank you.

_5112.Title: Card Game
_5112.Description:
Did you come to play a card game with me?
Unfortunately, I think it will be difficult now. I accidentally lost the most precious keyrings in the world. If you find it, we'll play a special card game.
_5112.Objective: Obtain [Precious Keyring] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent
_5112.CompletionText: Probably I lost on the Server Continent.
_5112.CompletionSummary:
Wow! Thank you.
These were my most precious keyrings.
What kind of keyring is that?
It's keyring for the Chosen Children.

_5113.Title: Card Game
_5113.Description:
Win or lose?!!!
Will you win? Or not?
If you collect the Mysterious Card Pieces right now, I will give you a Mysterious Card that can check your luck.
_5113.Objective: Obtain [Mysterious Card Pieces] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digmons except Yokohama Village
_5113.CompletionText: If you are curious, hurry up and collect the Mysterious Card Pieces.

_5114.Title: Sudden heat
_5114.Description: I'm worried. The plants are drying up because of the sudden heat. Can you help keep the plants alive?
_5114.Objective: Lost Historic Site - Fruit Forest Server Continent Dessert - Giant Cactus Digimon Farm - Digimon Farm Grassland Area
_5114.CompletionText: You can use this Water Jewel in each place
_5114.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, the plants are healthy

_5115.Title: Sudden heat
_5115.Description:
Hot..It's hot!!
Help me, Tamer.
Hel me overcome this heat!
_5115.Objective: Collect [Ice] 30ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Ice Area
_5115.CompletionSummary: Phew! I think I can overcome the heat with these Ice

_5116.Title: Sudden heat
_5116.Description:
This artificial heat must have been planned by someone!
This famous detective, SuperStarmon, will solve it.
Tamer! Help me solve this problem as my assistant
_5116.CompletionText: Talk to me when you're ready!
_5116.CompletionSummary: Okay! There must be a culprit among these Wanted paper. Let's investigate these guys.

_5117.Title: Sudden heat
_5117.Description:
I've got a feeling.
SkullMeramon must be the culprit.
_5117.CompletionText: Let's go find him right now.
_5117.CompletionSummary: As expected, I was right! He was someone's subordinate.

_5118.Title: Sudden heat
_5118.Description:
I've got a feeling.
Those Meramon guys must be the culprits.
_5118.CompletionText: I thought they were suspicious from long ago.
_5118.CompletionSummary: As expected, I was right! They were someone's subordinates.

_5119.Title: Sudden heat
_5119.Description:
I've got a feeling.
Garudamon guys are probably the culprits behind this incidents.
_5119.CompletionText: Let's hurry and defeat the Garudamon before he runs away.
_5119.CompletionSummary: As expected, I was right! They were someone's subordinates.

_5120.Title: Sudden heat
_5120.Description: After a result of investigating the orders obtained the Wanted guys, I found traces of Chimairamon! If you use this traces, you will be able to summon him.
_5120.Objective: Defeat summoned <The Culprit>Chimairamon after using [Traces of Culprit] in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5120.CompletionText: You can summon him using the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.
_5120.CompletionSummary: This famous detective, SuperStarmon, has solved all these problems!

_5121.Title: Sudden heat
_5121.Summary: [Daily] Heat came to the Real World
_5121.Description:
Hello Tamer?
I came here because I need your help
As DemiMeramon appeared in the Real World, it started to get hotter and hotter
Can you stop them with me?
_5121.Objective: Defeat <Cause of Heat>DemiMeramon 20ea in Shinjuku Western area(Day)
_5121.CompletionText: We have to stop them before they multiply!

_5122.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_5122.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_5122.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_5122.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_5123.Title: Beat the heat
_5123.Description:
Tamer..... It's too hot
I think I can overcome the heat by eating delicious shaved ice made with special red beans and fruits that only grow on File Island. Can you bring me some?
_5123.Objective: Obtain [Special Red Bean] 10ea and [Special Fruit] 10ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in File Island
_5123.CompletionText: I think the ice I received last time will be enough!
_5123.CompletionSummary: This is it!! With this, I don't have to worry about the heat!

_5124.Title: Beat the heat
_5124.Description:
Oooh!
I miss my hometown.
I really want to eat the special smelt I ate in my hometown.
_5124.Objective: Obtain [Special Smelt] 20ea by defeating enemy Digimon in Snowstorm Village and Snowman Village
_5124.CompletionSummary:
Special smelt!!
Thank you Tamer, thank you very much!!

_5125.Title: Beat the heat
_5125.Description:
I found the reason why this heat continues.
The Chimairamon you defeated last time seems to be fake, So you have to defeat the real Chimairamon to end this heat wave.
_5125.Objective: Defeat <Endless Heat> Chimairamon in Shinjuku Western area(Day)
_5125.CompletionText: I think it's time for this SuperStarmon to come out again.

_5126.Title: Beat the heat
_5126.Description:
As expected, we should go to the sea in the summer.
Let's hurry up and go play
_5126.Objective: Talk to <Tired from the heat>Mimi in File Island Water Front
_5126.CompletionText: To the File Island Water Front!!

_5127.Title: Beat the heat
_5127.Description:
What are those guys
Why are they interrupting us from here to the beach
Let's kick them out!
_5127.Objective: Defeat <Interrupting Summer Vacation>Seadramon 20ea in File Island Water Front
_5127.CompletionText: It's hot, why are you interfering?
_5127.CompletionSummary: Alright, now there won't be any guys in the way. Let's go into the sea.

_5128.Title: EP Thief
_5128.Description:
Hello Tamer...
The precious EP I've collected so far have been stolen.
Could you ask <Private Detective>Astamon to catch the culprit who stole my EP?

_5129.Title: EP Thief
_5129.Description:
Whoa... Now that the request came in, I'll have to investigate.
Tamer, you should help me too. First, let's find out if any Digimon witnessed the culprit.
_5129.Objective: Talk to <D-terminal>Elecmon in VOB, <DAT Member>PawnChessmon W in West Vil, <DAT Member>PawnChessmon B in Shinjuku West(D)
_5129.CompletionSummary: Hmm… It's a small and mischievous Digimon
_5129.ReservedText:
Suspicious Digimon??
Come to think of it, I saw a small and mischievous Digimon carrying a heavy box the other day.

_5130.Title: EP Thief
_5130.Description: That guy may have left traces as they ran away, so have tem wander around and look for them.
_5130.Objective: Collect [EP Piece] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in All Shinjuku area and Western Area
_5130.CompletionSummary: He spilled pieces of the EP.

_5131.Title: EP Thief
_5131.Description:
I found the guy.
This is the guy I thought of when I got a clue that it was a small, mean Digimon.
Use this to lure and catch him.
_5131.Objective: Defeat Summoned <EP Thief>Impmon by using [Bait] in D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5131.CompletionText: You can use the bait at the D-Terminal.

_5132.Title: EP Thief
_5132.Description:
Hmm… Tamer
In fact, there seems to be more than one EP Thief. Fortunately, I was able to find him right away. Can you catch him?
_5132.CompletionSummary: Stealing my precious EP with such a cute look.

_5133.Title: EP Thief
_5133.Description:
Tamer, can you please do me a favor?
Because of this incident I'm planning to build a new sturdy safe to store the EP, and I need the materials.
_5133.Objective: Collect [Very Hard Ore] 20ea by defeating enemy Digimon in Shinjuku, File Island, and Spiral Mountain.
_5133.CompletionText: I'm going to make a very sturdy safe.
_5133.CompletionSummary: Thank you. There will be no more Eps stolen in the future.

_5134.Title: EP Thief
_5134.Description:
Nice to meet you.
I'm the security officer hired by Anubismon.
According to the information I have received, another Digimon is targeting EP.
Can you help me defeat them?
_5134.Objective: Defeat <Aiming for EP>Armadimon 30ea in Western Area : Outskirts
_5134.CompletionText: It's the outskirts of the Western Village.
_5134.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, the work was completed easily.

_5135.Title: EP Thief
_5135.Description:
It seems that more people will be needed to protect Anubismon's EP.
Could you go to the Infinite Ice Wall and ask BanchoLeomon if he can help me?.
_5135.Objective: Talk to <Hot-blooded Digimon>BanchoLeomon in Infinite Ice Wall
_5135.CompletionText: BanchoLeomon will be on the Infinite Ice Wall.

_5136.Title: EP Thief
_5136.Description:
You need my help??
Alright! Tamer, If you pass my test, I will help you protect EP.
Defeat the Enemy Digimon in the Glacier Area and prove your skills.
_5136.Objective: Collect [Token] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Glacier Area
_5136.CompletionSummary:
Good!! I've confirmed your skills.
I will help you keep the EP as you wish.

_5137.Title: EP Thief
_5137.Description:
Thank you very much.
Thanks to Tamer, we were able to keep EP safe.
_5137.Objective: Talk to <EP Manager>Anubismon in DATS Center
_5137.CompletionSummary:
Thank you, Tamer.
This is my small gift to express my gratitude. If you collect several together, I will exchange them for other items.

_5138.Title: Energy of Moon
_5138.Description:
I need your help.
A special full moon is approaching, but energy of the moon has been dispersed by an unknown force.
Please help us collect the Dispersed Energy of Moon so that a special full moon can appear.
_5138.Objective: Collect [Broken Energy of Moon] 30ea by defeating all enemy Digimons in Verdandi Terminal and File Island
_5138.CompletionText: Most of the pieces were dispersed around Verdandi Terminal and File Island.
_5138.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, Energy of Moon is recovering slightly. My service to you.

_5139.Title: Energy of Moon
_5139.Summary: [Daily] Energy of Moon in the maze
_5139.Description:
I heard that you are looking for Dispersed Energy of Moon.
I can feel the energy of the moon dispersed in the maze I found this time. Can you defeat Togemons which are seeking energy while I'm looking for energy?
_5139.Objective: Talk to MirageGaogamon in Maze after defeating <Seeking Energy> Togemons
_5139.CompletionText:
Talk to me with Entry Ticket of Maze then I'll take you to the maze.
For your information, Maze is unstable because of Energy of Moon, so the time you can stay in the maze is limited
_5139.CompletionSummary:
You're here.
Thanks to you, we can retrieve the energy.

_5140.Title: Energy of Moon
_5140.Description:
Tamer.
Among the Dispersed Energy of Moon, there are special pieces of the moon that shine brightly.
Bring it to me then I’ll show you how to get a special gift.
_5140.Objective: Collect [Piece of Shining Moon] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent
_5140.CompletionText: It is said that special pieces of moon can be obtained on the server continent.

_5141.Title: Energy of Moon
_5141.Summary: [Daily] Do rabbits live on the moon?
_5141.Description:
Tamer! Tamer!
I heard from Sakuyamon that there are rabbits living on the moon. Is it true?
_5141.CompletionText: If you have any pictures of the moon, show me.
_5141.CompletionSummary:
Waaaaaah!
There really were rabbits living there.

_5142.Title: Energy of Moon
_5142.Description:
It’s a big trouble.
While investigating the cause of Dispersed Energy of Moon converging around Western Village, I captured a scene that MoonMillenniumon was absorbing Energy of Moon.
We have to stop MoonMillenniumon from absorbing Energy of Moon. If we let it, it will be a great danger to the Digital World.”
_5142.Objective: Defeat <Absorbing Energy of Moon>MoonMillenniummon in Western Village Outskirts
_5142.CompletionText: It’s on Western Village Outskirt. Hurry up, please.
_5142.CompletionSummary: I’m so glad. Thank you. Tamer.

_5143.Title: Attribute Arena
_5143.Description: The first objective is to defeat the gatekeepers on the 5th stage! I believe you can do it easily!
_5143.Objective: Defeat the gatekeepers in 5th Stage of the Attribute Arena
_5143.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Kabuterimon<5th Gatekeeper - Thunder>%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Thunderballmon<5th Gatekeeper - Thunder>%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Kabuterimon<5th Gatekeeper - Thunder>%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5143.CompletionSummary: Great job! But, it starts from now!

_5144.Title: Attribute Arena
_5144.Description: The next is the 10th stage gatekeeper! It may be easy so far, but you must not let down your guard!
_5144.Objective: Defeat the gatekeeper in 10th Stage of the Attribute Arena
_5144.CompletionSummary: We are about half way there now!

_5145.Title: Attribute Arena
_5145.Description: The third objective is the gatekeeper on the 15th stage! There really isn't much left, so let's try our best.
_5145.Objective: Defeat the gatekeeper in 15th Stage of the Attribute Arena
_5145.CompletionSummary: You worked really hard! Just challenge a little more and you will see the end!

_5146.Title: Attribute Arena
_5146.Description: Finally, the final gatekeeper of the Attribute Arena! He's stronger than any gatekeeper you've ever fought, so be careful!
_5146.Objective: Defeat the gatekeeper in 20th Stage of the Attribute Arena
_5146.CompletionSummary: Awesome Tamer! You are such a strong person!

_5147.Title: Energy of Moon
_5147.Description:
Queen of Cooking!! Mimi appears~
For this feast, I plan to cook it myself~
Please get me the ingredients I need to cook
_5147.Objective: Collect [Black peas] and [Shellfish] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in File Island
_5147.CompletionSummary: I'm going to cook something delicious

_5148.Title: Energy of Moon
_5148.Description:
Queen of Cooking!! Queen of Cooking~
For this feast, I plan to cook it myself~
I'm going to make a very, very delicious dish, so please get me the ingredients I need to cook it
_5148.Objective: Collect [Banana] and [Cherry] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent.
_5148.CompletionText: I'm going to cook something delicious
_5148.CompletionSummary: Even if we eat together and both die, we won't recognize this.

_5149.Title: Energy of Moon
_5149.Description:
Hello? Tamer
I'm preparing small gifts for the friends who are participating in this party. If you are okay, can you help me prepare a gift?
_5149.Objective: Collect [Present Box] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Shinjuku area
_5149.CompletionText: Thank you so much for your help.
_5149.CompletionSummary: Tamer this is a present for you.

_5150.Title: Energy of Moon
_5150.Description:
I cannot miss this party!!
Please forward this invitation to other Digimon immediately
If they don't come even after receiving this invitation, they should be in trouble!
_5150.Objective: Talk to Yushima in Yokohama Village, Elecmon in Village of Beginning, and Angemon in Infinite Mountain
_5150.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Deliver Invitation to Yushima%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Deliver Invitation to Elecmon%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Deliver Invitation to Angemon%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5150.CompletionText: Since I am in charge of promoting this feast, all Digimon must come!
_5150.CompletionSummary: Everyone said they would definitely come to see me, right?
_5150.ReservedText:
Invitation?
Etemon said that if I don’t participate in feast, I will be in big trouble?
I will definitely go!

_5151.Title: Energy of Moon
_5151.Description:
I need your help.
Beelzebumon took away all the food that was being prepared for the feast.
Can you please bring back the food for the dishes that Beelzebumon brought?
_5151.CompletionText: We have to hurry and find the dishes before Beelzebumon eats all the food.
_5151.CompletionSummary: Thank you. We were able to protect the food that would be used for the feast.

_5152.Title: Awakening
_5152.Description: Finally, it is time for the new appearance of the ultimate giant machine, MegaGalgomon
_5152.CompletionText: Go ahead and show everyone to its appearance.

_5153.Title: Awakening
_5153.Description:
You are here, Tamer.
A final test is needed before introducing the ultimate giant machine, MegaGalgomon, to the world.
_5153.Objective: Summon and defeat <Ultimate Giant Machine>MegaGalgomon by using [Giant Machine summoning device] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5153.CompletionText: Use this summoning device at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.
_5153.CompletionSummary: Thank you for helping me with the final test.

_5154.Title: Awaken
_5154.Description: Finally, Sakuyamon entered a higher realm.
_5154.CompletionText: Now it's time to show everyone the Awakened Sakuyamon.

_5155.Title: Awaken
_5155.Description:
Welcome Tamer.
Sakuyamon, who has ascended to a higher grade, wants to meet you.
_5155.Objective: Summon and defeat <Awakened>Sakuyamon by using [Izuna] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5155.CompletionText: Izuna can be used in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.
_5155.CompletionSummary: What would it be like when Sakuyamon awakens in a new form?

_5156.Title: Harvest Season
_5156.Description:
Hurray!
The season has finally arrived to harvest the pumpkins that I have grown with care for a year.
Can you help me harvest pumpkins?
_5156.Objective: Collect [Pumpkin] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in File Island
_5156.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, it was able to be completed quickly.

_5157.Title: Harvest Season
_5157.Description:
Help me Tamer!!
Those bad Kiwimons are targeting my pumpkin.
Get those guys out.
_5157.Objective: Defeat <Pumpkin Lover>Kiwimon 20ea in Lost Historic Site

_5158.Title: Harvest Season
_5158.Description:
It's big problem...
It seems like the leader of Kiwimons we chased out before is targeting the pumpkin.
Can you possibly Get him out?
_5158.CompletionText: Stop <Captain>Kiwimon before it takes all the pumpkins

_5159.Title: Harvest Season
_5159.Description:
I want to carve pumpkin with Pumpkinmon's Pumpkin, but I don't have any carving knives on hand right now.
If you don't mind, can you get me a carving knife?
_5159.Objective: Collect [Carving knife] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Shinjuku area
_5159.CompletionText: My artistic soul is on fire.
_5159.CompletionSummary: I will make the most amazing pumpkin carvings.

_5160.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5160.Description:
Nice to meet you. Tamer
This is Yamaki Mitsuo, who is in charge of this 12th Anniversary. <DATS leader> Richard Sampson said he has prepared a gift for you in celebration of the 12th Anniversary, so go see him quickly.
_5160.CompletionText: Thank you for being with us for our 12th Anniversary
_5160.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for being with us for 12th years.
This is a gift prepared with all our hearts.

_5161.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5161.Description:
If you have time, could you help me with some work?
Please pass out promotional flyers to people and Digimon who don't yet know that it's 12th Anniversary
_5161.Objective: Talk to Sora's Mom in Youkohama Village, Starmon of Passion in Western Village, BlitzGreymon in File Island Water Front, and Yukidarumon in Snowman Village.
_5161.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Sora's Mom%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Talk to Starmon of Passion%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Talk to BlitzGreymon%qe %cc3/%mc3 %qs4Talk to Yukidarumon%qe %cc4/%mc4
_5161.CompletionText: Please deliver it to Yokohama Village, Western Village, File Island Water Front, and Snowman Village
_5161.ReservedText: I was already planning to go there, but thank you for coming. I'll definitely go

_5162.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5162.Description:
Oh Tamer!
The boxes containing the supplies needed for this party were scattered during the move.
If you have time, could you help me find some of the party supplies scattered around File Island?
_5162.Objective: Collect [Party Supplies] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in File Island
_5162.CompletionSummary:
Thank you, Tamer.
Thanks to you, We can successfully complete our 12th birthday party.

_5163.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5163.Description:
It's big problem~
The amount of flour and eggs needed to make a 12th Anniversary cake is less than expected~
Could you please bring me some flour and eggs??
_5163.Objective: Collect [Egg] 20ea and [Flour] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon except Yokohama Village.
_5163.CompletionText: I'll make a really delicious cake for you, Tamer!
_5163.CompletionSummary:
Thank you~
I'll make you a delicious cake.

_5164.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5164.Description:
Holy!!!!!
My fireworks!!!
Tamer, I'm begging you to find my missing firecracker.
That is a special fireworks display created to commemorate the 12th Anniversary!
_5164.Objective: Collect [Fireworks] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent
_5164.CompletionSummary:
Hahaha!!
Please look forward to showing you the best fireworks.

_5165.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5165.Description:
Hmm… I'm embarrassed.
I didn't send an invitation to MugenDramon because I was afraid of ruining the 12th anniversary, but he was in a weirder state than usual, so I came to ruin the festival.
Can you help me stop him?
_5165.Objective: Defeat <Thoughts of Evil>MugenDramon in Yokohama Village
_5165.CompletionText: He is causing trouble in Yokohama Village.
_5165.CompletionSummary: Hmm…. MugenDramon wasn't that bad, but that's strange.

_5166.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5166.Description:
Nice to meet you.
If you have time, could you get me some ingredients for the magic?
If you bring me the ingredients, I will reward you with a magic card that can give you a special gift.
_5166.Objective: Collect [Full Moon] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Western Area
_5166.CompletionText: Full Moon can be collected in the Western Area.
_5166.CompletionSummary: Thank you. This is the promised reward. Have a happy 12th Anniversary

_5167.Title: The best Royal Knights
_5167.Summary: [Sub] Who is the best Royal Knights(Omegamon/Alphamon)?
_5167.Description:
Omegamon and Alphamon
Who is the best Royal Knights among the two Digimon?
What do you think about it, Tamer?
_5167.CompletionSummary: Now, take this and get a chance to obtain the Royal Knights you think are the best.

_5168.Title: The best Royal Knights
_5168.Description:
Oops.. I was so caught up in the festival that I was late in preventing the virus from infiltrating.
We must stop the virus before it spreads further!
_5168.Objective: Collect [Virus] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Shinjuku Area
_5168.CompletionSummary: Huh… I'm glad we stopped it before it was too late.

_5169.Title: 12th Anniversary
_5169.Description:
Ah, you came at a good time.
No matter how much a festival is, order must be maintained, but because of those Piximon guys, the order of the festival is being disrupted.
I think we need to catch and educate them.
_5169.Objective: Defeat <Not Keeping Order>Piximon 30ea in File Island Water Front
_5169.CompletionText: No matter how much fun you have, you must not forget the order you must follow.
_5169.CompletionSummary: Now, these guys will come to their senses.

_5170.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_5170.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_5170.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_5170.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_5171.Title: The Legend Started again
_5171.Description:
Nice to meet you, Tamer!
A new legend awaits you.
_5171.CompletionText: Talk to me when you're ready
_5171.CompletionSummary: Are you ready? Let's get started now!

_5172.Title: Explore the Digital World
_5172.Description: Are you ready to go to the Digital World?
_5172.CompletionSummary: Now! Let's go to the Digital World.

_5173.Title: Digital World
_5173.Description: First of all, in order to go to File Island in the Digital World, complete the main quest(purple exclamation mark) in Yokohama Village and then accepting the quest [To the Digital World!] from Richard Sampson in DATS Center
_5173.Objective: After completing the quest [Dats Agent Ceremony], talk to Bokomon in Silver Lake
_5173.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5173.CompletionSummary: How about the Silver Lake, the beginning of File Island?

_5174.Title: Digital World
_5174.Description:
Now, shall we move to the next area?
To get the next area, the Silent Forest, you'll need to follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in Silver Lake.
_5174.Objective: After completing the quest [Deeper into the File Island], talk to Bokomon in Silent Forest.
_5174.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5174.CompletionSummary: It's quite different from Silver Lake, right?

_5175.Title: Digital World
_5175.Description: Next destination is the Lost Historic Site. If you follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in the Silent Forest., you can reach the Lost Historic Site.
_5175.Objective: After completing the quest [Outta My Way!], talk to Bokomon in Lost Historic Site
_5175.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.

_5176.Title: Digital World
_5176.Description: The end of File Island part is soon. The next destination is File Island Water Front. If you follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) of the Lost Historic Site, you can reach the File Island Water Front.
_5176.Objective: After completing the quest [Wake Spirit Up!], talk to Bokomon in File Island Water Front
_5176.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5176.CompletionSummary: How do you think? File Island Water Front is beautiful, isn't it?

_5177.Title: Digital World
_5177.Description: This is end of File Island part. If you follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) in the File Island Water Front, you can reach the Infinite Mountain.
_5177.Objective: After completing the quest [Showdown! Monochromon!], talk to Bokomon in Infinite Mountain
_5177.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5177.CompletionSummary: Doesn't that seem really scary? This is where Digimon with strong evil power live.

_5178.Title: Digital World
_5178.Description: The end of File Island's journey is Infinite Mountain._x000D_ Now, let's move on to the next Continent. Follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) of Infinite Mountain and complete the [Final Battle!!]. After then someone will be waiting for you on the Water Front. Talk to him and come to the Server Continent.
_5178.Objective: After completing the quest [Final Battle!!], talk to Bokomon in Server Continent Dessert.
_5178.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5178.CompletionSummary: This is the Server Continent! Does it feel different from File Island?

_5179.Title: Digital World
_5179.Description: What kind of place will we find if we cross this desert? If you follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) of the Server Continent Desert, you will reach the next destination, Server Continent Canyon!
_5179.Objective: After completing the quest [Final Battle!!], talk to Bokomon in Server Continent Dessert.
_5179.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5179.CompletionSummary: After passing the desert, Canyon appears!

_5180.Title: Digital World
_5180.Description: Now only the last location remains on the Server Continent. If you follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) of the Server Continent Canyon, you will reach the next destination, Server Continent Pyramid!
_5180.Objective: After completing the quest [Feeling sorry], talk to Bokomon in Server Continent Pyramid.
_5180.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5180.CompletionSummary: The mysterious pyramid that appears after crossing the Canyon is really cool!

_5181.Title: Digital World
_5181.Description: This journey will end soon... If you follow the main quest (purple exclamation mark) of the Server Continent Canyon, you will reach the last destination, Camp Site!
_5181.Objective: After completing the quest [Fake Card is!], talk to Bokomon in Camp Site
_5181.CompletionText: You will be get there without difficulty.
_5181.CompletionSummary: Unfortunately, this is the end of exploration. But that doesn't mean we've seen everything in the Digital World. There are many places I haven't yet. But I think it would be good idea for you to explore such a place yourself

_5182.Title: New Myth
_5182.Description:
Ohhh!!!
I can't believe I met a Tamer here who is ready to write a new myth. What a honor!
From the Darkness, Servant of Darkness have crossed into the Real World to stop the myth you writing.
Stop them and complete the myth.
_5182.Objective: Defeat <Servant of Darkness>LordKnightmon and <Servant of Darkness>Dynasmon
_5182.CompletionSummary: Wow, I witness the moment a new myth was born.

_5183.Title: Winter Preparation
_5183.Description:
It's time for the Digital World to become cold too.
I'm trying to collect some Hot Packs for the winter. Tamer, if you don't mind, can you get me some?
_5183.Objective: Collect [Hot Pack] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in File Island.
_5183.CompletionText: I need to prepare before it gets colder.
_5183.CompletionSummary: Thank you Tamer, I was able to obtain enough Hot Packs to use all winter

_5184.Title: Winter Preparation
_5184.Description:
Hello Tamer!
This winter, I'm planning to prepare something called the Fire Energy that can be obtained on the Server Continent as a Cold Weather item. Can you get it for me?
_5184.Objective: Collect [Fire Energy] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent.
_5184.CompletionText: Since it is a product created by combining the hot energy of the Server Continent, you may not need any other cold weather products this winter.
_5184.CompletionSummary: Wow! It's really warm. Thank you

_5185.Title: Winter Preparation
_5185.Description:
It's big deal..
This time, I tried to serve warm food to everyone since the weather is cold, but the bad Digimon ran away with the ingredients.
Would you like to help me find the cooking ingredients?
_5185.Objective: Collect [Stolen Cooking ingredients] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Shinjuku Area.
_5185.CompletionText: We have to find it quickly before they eat them all!
_5185.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we can serve delicious food to everyone.

_5186.Title: Servant of Darkness
_5186.Description:
Hello.
With the emergence of a new mythology, the Servant of Darkness began to appear in the Real World.
Please help us stop them.
_5186.Objective: Defeat <Servant of Darkness>LordKnightmon and <Servant of Darkness>Dynasmon

_5187.Title: Abnormal phenomenon
_5187.Description:
An abnormal phenomenon was observed.
Check out the Monochromon in File Island Water Front.
_5187.Objective: Defeat Raid Monster Monochromon in File Island Water Front
_5187.CompletionText: Abnormalities are getting more and more....

_5188.Title: Abnormal phenomenon
_5188.Description:
A 2nd abnormal phenomenon was observed.
Check out the Etemon in Sever Continent.
_5188.Objective: Defeat Raid Monster Etemon in Server Continent Desert
_5188.CompletionText: Abnormalities are getting more and more....

_5189.Title: Abnormal phenomenon
_5189.Description:
A 3rd abnormal phenomenon was observed.
Check out the SkullGreymon in Sever Continent.
_5189.Objective: Defeat Raid Monster SkullGreymon in Server Continent Desert
_5189.CompletionText: Abnormalities are getting more and more....

_5190.Title: Abnormal phenomenon
_5190.Description:
A 4th abnormal phenomenon was observed.
Check out the Mammothmon in Valley of Light.
_5190.Objective: Defeat Raid Monster Mammothmon in Valley of Light
_5190.CompletionText: Abnormalities are getting more and more....

_5191.Title: Abnormal phenomenon
_5191.Description:
A 5th abnormal phenomenon was observed.
This is the last mission.
Check out the Myotismon in Sibuya.
_5191.Objective: Defeat Raid Monster Myotismon in Sibuya
_5191.CompletionText: Abnormalities are getting more and more....
_5191.CompletionSummary:
This is the end of the abnormal phenomenon observation.
But that doesn't mean we can let our guard down.

_5192.Title: Support from DATS Center!
_5192.Description:
You came just in time.
This time, DATS Center decided to provide support items in the hope that your life in the Digital World would be a little more comfortable.

_5193.Title: Maze Runner
_5193.Description:
There are many scary monsters in the Maze
You must be able to overcome fear together with your party members!
_5193.CompletionText: When you are ready, talk to me again.
_5193.CompletionSummary: Here is the Ticket! Good luck to you!

_5194.Title: Our Future!
_5194.Description: The time is coming when we must embrace sadness and determination and go through a new evolution.
_5194.CompletionSummary: Finally, revealing a new evolution embracing sadness and determination to the world.

_5195.Title: Awaken
_5195.Description: Finally, Sakuyamon entered a higher realm.
_5195.CompletionText: Now it's time to show everyone the Awakened Sakuyamon.

_5196.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5196.Description:
Congratulations!! You've finally gathered all the 4 Holy Beasts' equipment.
You know what?
This is not the end!!
_5196.CompletionSummary: You can obtain equipment that contains the power of an emperor that surpasses the 4 Holy Beast!

_5197.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5197.Description: I think the last piece of power is held by Majiramon, who absorbed Qinglongmon's energy.
_5197.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Majiramon in Server Continent Canyon

_5198.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5198.Description:
The energy of lightning is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Mihiramon in Server Continent - Canyon, you'll get a piece of power.
_5198.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Majiramon in Server Continent Canyon
_5198.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the power of the bead.

_5199.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5199.Description: You will need to collect pieces with the power of lightning to obtain the Qinglongmon's Earring
_5199.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Qinglong>Mihiramon in Server Continent Dessert.
_5199.CompletionSummary: If you collect these pieces, you will be able to receive recognition for the equipment.

_5200.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5200.Summary: [Sub] The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5200.Description: The pieces of equipment that I will give you this time is Qinglongmon's Earring.
_5200.CompletionText: The procedure is the same as before!
_5200.CompletionSummary: First of all, it is a bead of light filled with the energy of the Qinglong. If you collect the pieces of power with this bead, you can get an earring.

_5201.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5201.Description:
Great job.
I think you got recognition from the Necklace of Baihumon.
_5201.CompletionSummary: Now, let’s go get the next equipment?

_5202.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5202.Description: It seems that KaiserLeomon holds the last pieces of power.
_5202.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon 30ea in Lost Historic Site.

_5203.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5203.Description: The energy of steel is scattered among various Digimon. First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon in Lost Historic Site, you'll get a piece of power.
_5203.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>KaiserLeomon 30ea in Lost Historic Site.
_5203.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the power of the bead.

_5204.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5204.Description: You will need to collect pieces with the power of steel to obtain the Necklace of Baihumon.
_5204.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Baihu>SaberLeomon 30ea in Silver Lake
_5204.CompletionSummary: If you collect these pieces, you will be able to receive recognition for the equipment.

_5205.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5205.Summary: [Sub] The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5205.Description: The pieces of equipment that I will give you this time is Necklace of Baihumon.
_5205.CompletionText: The procedure is the same as before!
_5205.CompletionSummary: First of all, it is a bead of light filled with the energy of the Baihu. If you collect the pieces of power with this bead, you can get a necklace.

_5206.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5206.Description:
Good job.
I think you got recognition from the Ring of Zhuqiaomon.
_5206.CompletionSummary: Now, let’s go get the next equipment?

_5207.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5207.Description: It seems that Sabirdramon holds the last pieces of power.
_5207.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon 30ea in Western Village West.

_5208.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5208.Description:
The energy of flame is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon in Western Village West, you'll get a piece of power.
_5208.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Sabirdramon 30ea in Western Village West.
_5208.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the power of the bead.

_5209.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5209.Description: You will need to collect pieces with the power of flame to obtain the Ring of Zhuqiaomon.
_5209.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Zhuqiao>Birdramon 30ea in Western Village.
_5209.CompletionSummary: If you collect these pieces, you will be able to receive recognition for the equipment.

_5210.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5210.Summary: [Sub] The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5210.Description: The pieces of equipment that I will give you this time is Ring of Zhuqiaomon
_5210.CompletionText: The procedure is the same as Bracelet!
_5210.CompletionSummary: First of all, it is a bead of light filled with the energy of the Zhuqiao. If you collect the pieces of power with this bead, you can get a ring.

_5211.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5211.Description:
Great.
I think you got recognition from the Xuanwumon's Bracelet.
_5211.CompletionSummary: Now, let’s go get the next equipment?

_5212.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5212.Description: Now, if you collect the pieces of power, you can obtain the next equipment.
_5212.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon 30ea in Snowman Village.

_5213.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5213.Description:
The energy of water is scattered among various Digimon.
First of all, if you defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon in Snowman Village, you'll get a piece of power.
_5213.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Mammothmon 30ea in Snowman Village.
_5213.CompletionSummary: By collecting these pieces, you will be able to restore the power of the bead.

_5214.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5214.Description: You must be recognized as the true owner of the equipment in order to obtain the next equipment.
_5214.Objective: Defeat <Energy of Xuanwu>Icemon 30ea in Snowstorm Village.
_5214.CompletionSummary: If you collect these pieces, you will be able to receive recognition for the equipment.

_5215.Title: The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5215.Summary: [Sub] The mystic Energy of 4 Holy Beast
_5215.Description:
Hello, Tamer.
This time, DATS Center has decided to provide equipment containing the power of the 4 Holy Beasts for you.
_5215.CompletionSummary: First of all, it is a bead of light filled with the energy of the Xuanwu. If you collect the pieces of power with this bead, you can get a bracelet.

_5216.Title: Accessories containing the Emperor's power
_5216.Description:
Finally, there is a chance to obtain an accessory containing the Emperor's power!!
All you have to do is defeat the Emperor's clones and gather their power!
_5216.Objective: Defeat <Emperor's clone>Fanglongmon in Shinjuku Western area(Day)
_5216.CompletionText: You can find it in Shinjuku Western area(Day)
_5216.CompletionSummary: If you continue to collect traces of the Fanglong and bring them to me, I will upgrade your accessories..

_5217.Title: Fight against Virus
_5217.Description:
Hello, Culu!
Tamer, it seems like the number of Virus Digimon in the Digital World is increasing.
Furthermore, it seems like they've crossed over into Real World!
Let's stop them from coming over any further !
_5217.CompletionText: Virus Digimon that have crossed over to the Real World has appeared in Shinjuku Western area(Day).
_5217.CompletionSummary:
Great job
Thanks to you, I think we stopped them to some extent.

_5218.Title: Unfinished Invasion
_5218.Description:
I thought I had definitely defeated them all, but I guess that wasn't the case.
Once again, Dark minions are coming out into the world to stop a new myth.
Could you please help me stop them?
_5218.Objective: Defeat <Servant of Darkness>LordKnightmon and <Servant of Darkness>Dynasmon in Yokohama Village
_5218.CompletionText: The composure of the dark minions exceeded our expectation.
_5218.CompletionSummary: It seems like their attack has finally ended.

_5219.Title: Win or Lose?!
_5219.Description:
I'm back after a long time.
Tamer, if you find and bring back the mysterious boxes scattered around Shinjuku, I will give you a fun box.
_5219.Objective: Collect [Piedmon's Mystery Box] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Shinjuku Area.
_5219.CompletionText: Is there really such a thing as a loss?
_5219.CompletionSummary: Now here is the gift box.

_5220.Title: Christmas Present
_5220.Description:
It's a big deal. I think I dropped Christmas presents for the children in the Glacial Area.
Can you find me a Christmas Present?
_5220.Objective: Collect [Santa's lost Gift] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Glacial Area.
_5220.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I can finally give gifts to the children.

_5221.Title: Awaken
_5221.Description: My true power has descended. Humans, feel my power!

_5222.Title: Awaken
_5222.Description: I never thought… I'd fall asleep again…

_5223.Title: Christmas Present
_5223.Description: Hello, Tamer. My sleigh broke while delivering presents this Christmas.. First of all, I'm looking for a wooden plank, but it's hard to do it by myself. Can you help me?
_5223.Objective: Collect [Wooden plank] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent
_5223.CompletionText: Wooden plank can be collected on the Server Continent
_5223.CompletionSummary: Thank to you, I was able to fix the sleigh completely. Thank you.

_5224.Title: Royal Base(Hard)
_5224.Description: If you defeat Death-X-mon in Royal Base(Hard), you will receive a special achievement.
_5224.Objective: Defeat Death-X-mon 10 times in Royal Base(Hard)
_5224.CompletionText: Defeat Death-X-mon 10 times in Royal Base(Hard) and come to me

_5225.Title: The last of 2023
_5225.Description:
Hello Tamer.
It's already end of this year. So I prepared a gift for you, but I accidently lost it on the way home. Can you find it for me?
_5225.Objective: Collect [Last Gift] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Shinjuku area.

_5226.Title: Dragon
_5226.Description: Hi, Tamer. As soon as the new year started, I think Qinglongmon got angry for some reason. Can you stop him before Yokohama Village is destroyed?
_5226.Objective: Defeat <Violent> Qinglongmon appeared in Yokohama Village
_5226.CompletionText: Yokohama Village might disappear if it's too late.
_5226.CompletionSummary: I think he's calmed down a bit.

_5227.Title: Dragon
_5227.Description: Tamer!! I know why I'm not getting evolved like other digimons!! Gabumon informed that I need Dragon's Factor to evlove, so can you help me to get that in Server Continent?
_5227.Objective: Acquire 20 [Dragon's Factor] which can be obtained from digimons appear throughout Server Continent

_5228.Title: Mystery
_5228.Description: Kekekeke Tamer. Do you have time? I went to Shinjuku this time and lost my precious eggs. If you bring me those eggs, I'll give you a gift. Kekekeke.
_5228.Objective: Acquire 20 [Mysterious Egg] which can be obtained from digimons appear throughout Shinjuku

_5229.Title: [Ticket Exchange]
_5229.Description:
(<Exclusive Ticket Exchange for STEAM>
[Exchangeable List] - Fanglongmon (Awaken) Complete Package

_5230.Title: [Ticket Exchange]
_5230.Description:
(<Exclusive Ticket Exchange for STEAM>
[Exchangeable List] - Fanglongmon (Awaken) Core Package

_5231.Title: [Ticket Exchange]
_5231.Description:
(<Exclusive Ticket Exchange for STEAM>
[Exchangeable List] - Miracle Accessory[Lv.10] Package

_5232.Title: Malicious Prank
_5232.Description:
Have you ever given an item called [Dragon's Factor] to Agumon?
I think Agumon dark digivolved because of that item.
Will you help me to stop him?
_5232.Objective: Defeat <Dark Evolution> SkullGreymon in Village of the Beginning
_5232.CompletionText: It's attacking Village of the Beginning.
_5232.CompletionSummary: I need to find out who told Agumon about such an item.

_5233.Title: Malicious Prank
_5233.Description:
Hello Tamer!!
I want to make friends, and Gabumon told me that a toy, which can be obtained in Western Area, is popular these days.
I think I could make a friend with that toy, so can you get that one for me?
_5233.Objective: Acquire 20 [Toy tainted with evil] which can be obtained from digimons appear throughout Western Area
_5233.CompletionText: Hehe, I will say thank you to Gabumon.

_5234.Title: Malicious Toy
_5234.Description:
Kekekeke Hello Tamerr?!
If it's okay, could you sprinkle the items in this pouch in various places?
Oh! This is nothing strange but it's like a nutritional supplement. Don't Worry. Kekekekeke.
_5234.Objective: Use [Suspicious Pouch] in Three-way Lake in Silver Lake, Wilderness Lake in Wilderness Area, Oasis in Desert in Server Continent-Desert
_5234.CompletionText: Kekekeke thank you for helping me.

_5235.Title: Sweet Gift
_5235.Description:
Glad to see you, Tamer. I prepared some gifts, but I accidently dropped it on the Server Continent.
If you have time, can you find my gift?
_5235.Objective: Collect [Gift Set] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Server Continent
_5235.CompletionText: These are the gifts for children.
_5235.CompletionSummary: Phew~ Luckily there are no broken items. Here! This is a gift for your help

_5236.Title: Sweet Gift
_5236.Description:
Tamer, it's late, but in celebration of Valentine's Day, I would like to send a special bouquet of flowers to my loved ones.
You can get the Red blossom from the Digimon in Glacial Area.
I have work to do, so I wish you would bring me red blossom insted
_5236.Objective: Collect [Red Blossom] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in File Island
_5236.CompletionText: I want to convey my feelings before it's too late.
_5236.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, I can make a special bouquet.

_5237.Title: Sweet Gift
_5237.Description:
Hello Tamer.....
Diablomon stole the Candy Bouquet I received this Lunar New Year...
Hmm... If you don't mind, could you help me get my candy bouquet back?
_5237.Objective: Defeat <Candy Bouquet Thief>Diablomon in Yokohama Village
_5237.CompletionText: Diablomon will be in Yokohama Village.

_5238.Title: New Friend
_5238.Description:
Hello Tamer! Are you about to go on an adventure?
There are a lot of strong people in the Digital World, so you might get hurt…
So! I will give you a DigiEgg as a gift! He's a strong guy, so he'll protect you if you go an adventure with him!
_5238.CompletionText: Please tell me when you're ready!
_5238.CompletionSummary: Hope you have fun adventures with your new friend!

_5239.Title: 숨은 디지몬 찾기
_5239.Description:
으으윽!!
이번 설날도 무사히 넘기나 했더니 로프몬 녀석 내 물건을 어지럽히고 도망가 버렸어.
마지막으로 목격된 게 고요한 숲이라고 하는데 녀석 좀 혼내줄 수 있을까?
_5239.CompletionText: 로프몬 녀석이 매우 작아서 찾기 힘들 거야

_5240.Title: 오늘의~
_5240.Description:
오늘의 레이드는~
안녕! 난 지금 전 세계를 돌아다니면서 레이드 몬스터를 사냥하는 중이야
혹시 너도 관심 있으면 이번 레이드 몬스터 사냥에 참여해 봐
_5240.Objective: 요코하마 마을에 등장한 <오늘의 레이드> 루체몬 사탄모드 (각성) 처치

_5241.Title: 오늘의~
_5241.Description:
이번에 아레나 등반을 해보려고 하는데 너도 같이 참여할래?
10층에서 등장하는 몬스터를 처치 시 등반 증표 1개를 얻을 수 있을거야.
그 증표를 2개 가져다 주면 등반 코인을 선무로 줄게.
_5241.Objective: 난이도 상관 없이 아레나 10층 클리어 시 획득 가능한 [등반 증표] 2개 획득
_5241.CompletionText: 한번의 아레나 등반에 1개의 증표를 얻을 수 있어

_5242.Title: 오늘의~
_5242.Description:
이번에 아레나 등반을 해보려고 하는데 너도 같이 참여할래?
난이도 상관없이 15층에서 등장하는 몬스터를 처치 시 상급 등반 증표 1개를 얻을 수 있을거야.
그 증표를 2개 가져다 주면 등반 코인을 선무로 줄게.
_5242.Objective: 난이도 상관 없이 아레나 15층 클리어 시 획득 가능한 [상급 등반 증표] 2개 획득
_5242.CompletionText: 한번의 아레나 등반에 1개의 증표를 얻을 수 있어

_5243.Title: Awakening
_5243.Summary: [Sub] Awakening of Demon King of Gluttony
_5243.Description:
Finally, It's my turn!!
Let's quickly show everyone my new self!
_5243.CompletionText: Hehehe... I waited just for this day.
_5243.CompletionSummary: How is it? Isn't this cool look amazing?

_5244.Title: Season Pass
_5244.Description:
Help me!!!
I lost my new school supplies that I bought for the new semester.
Please find a pencil among my stationery. I'm begging you!
_5244.Objective: Collect [Pencil] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon except Yokohama Village.
_5244.CompletionText: I don't know where I lost them…
_5244.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!! This is the bag I was planning to take to school, but I accidently ordered several. I'll give it to you as a gift.
I accidently ordered several of them.

_5245.Title: Season Pass
_5245.Description:
Help me!!!
I lost my new school supplies that I bought for the new semester.
Please find a notebook among my stationery. I'm begging you!
_5245.Objective: Collect [Notebook] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon except Yokohama Village.
_5245.CompletionText: I don't know where I lost them…
_5245.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!! This is the bag I was planning to take to school, but I accidently ordered several. I'll give it to you as a gift.
I accidently ordered several of them.

_5246.Title: Season Pass
_5246.Description:
Help me!!!
I lost my new school supplies that I bought for the new semester.
Please find a eraser among my stationery. I'm begging you!
_5246.Objective: Collect [Eraser] 20ea by defeating all enemy Digimon except Yokohama Village.
_5246.CompletionText: I don't know where I lost them…
_5246.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!! This is the bag I was planning to take to school, but I accidently ordered several. I'll give it to you as a gift.
I accidently ordered several of them.

_5247.Title: New Semester Jumping
_5247.Summary: [Sub] Jumping to celebrate the new semester
_5247.Description:
Hello Tamer!
