_5269.Title: Family Month
_5269.Description:
May is the Month of Moms! It comes around every year, but expressing our gratitude never seems easy, does it?
So this time, we’ve prepared a chance for you to share your heart with your mom. Be honest, be warm, and say the things you haven’t been able to before.
And when you come back, a small but special gift will be waiting just for you, Tamer!
Now, are you ready to go share your precious feelings with your mom?
_5269.Objective: Go talk to Inoue mama, Sora's Mom, Sarah Damon
_5269.CompletionText: Still haven’t greeted your mom? She must be waiting with a smile!
_5269.CompletionSummary:
You did it! your heartfelt message reached your mom safely!
It’s not always easy to say the things we hold inside, but you did it and it was so nice. We’re sure a warm flower has bloomed in her heart.
And now, a small but special gift is waiting just for you. because it’s your turn to feel that love, too.

We need to chase them all away.

It's definitely because of him that it's so hot."

_5318.Title: Dungeon Rewards
_5318.Description:
I am Gankoomon, a member of the Royal Knights.
What? You want to train under me? Hahaha! You’ve come to the right place!
If you train with me, you will definitely become stronger!
However, it will be very tough... Are you prepared? If you’re ready, talk to me again...!

Of course, in the end, I myself will test you!
If you endure my training to the end, you’ll be rewarded accordingly!
So, will you accept my training?

_5320.Title: Dungeon Rewards
_5320.Description:
I am Gankoomon, a member of the Royal Knights.
What? You want to train under me? Hahaha! You’ve come to the right place!
If you train with me, you will definitely become stronger!
However, it will be very tough... Are you prepared? If you’re ready, talk to me again...!
_5320.CompletionSummary:
Good! It looks like you’re ready!
Each day, different Digimon will appear to help with your training.
Of course, in the end, I myself will test you!
If you endure my training to the end, you’ll be rewarded accordingly!
So, will you accept my training?

_5325.Title: Neverland
_5325.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Do you read me!? We’ve received an urgent report that the DigiDestined are losing consciousness. Get to the D-Terminal immediately!
_5325.Objective: Talk to <Dungeon Guide> Izzy at the D-Terminal

_5326.Title: Neverland
_5326.Description: The DigiDestined are still collapsing one by one... Go to Neverland and stop Eosmon!!
_5326.Objective: Defeat Eosmon, the boss of the Neverland [NORMAL] dungeon
_5326.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, they’re back! Thank you so much!!

_5327.Title: Neverland
_5327.Description: The DigiDestined are still collapsing one by one... Go to Neverland and stop Eosmon!!
_5327.Objective: Defeat Eosmon, the boss of the Neverland [NORMAL] dungeon
_5327.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, they’re back! Thank you so much!!

_5328.Title: Neverland
_5328.Description: The DigiDestined are still collapsing one by one... Go to Neverland and stop Eosmon!!
_5328.Objective: Defeat Eosmon, the boss of the Neverland [NORMAL] dungeon
_5328.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, they’re back! Thank you so much!!

_5329.Title: Nightmare
_5329.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Do you read me!? An urgent report just came in — Darkness Seeds are being found on the kids. Head to the D-Terminal immediately.
_5329.Objective: Talk to V-mon, the <Dungeon Guide> of the D-Terminal

_5330.Title: Nightmare
_5330.Description: Darkness Seeds are continuously being found on the kids...
_5330.CompletionText: The Seed of Darkness is gradually...
_5330.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we were able to save the kids. Thank you!!

_5331.Title: Nightmare
_5331.Description: Darkness Seeds are continuously being found on the kids...
_5331.CompletionText: The Seed of Darkness is gradually...
_5331.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we were able to save the kids. Thank you!!

_5332.Title: Nightmare
_5332.Description: Darkness Seeds are continuously being found on the kids...
_5332.CompletionText: The Seed of Darkness is gradually...
_5332.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we were able to save the kids. Thank you!!

_5333.Title: Powerdigimon
_5333.Description: This is the DATs Center, Commander Richard Sampson speaking. We've received reports that something strange is happening with the Digimon in the Digital World. Any Tamers receiving this message, head to Mary at the D-Terminal immediately. Over.
_5333.Objective: Talk to Mary at the <Digital World> in the D-Terminal
_5333.CompletionSummary: Ah, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> Tamer, you're here!! I've been waiting!!

_5334.Title: Powerdigimon
_5334.Description: I’ve been waiting after receiving reports that Digimon in the Digital World are rampaging. Please help resolve this issue for the peace of the Digital World.
_5334.Objective: Talk to Mary at the <Digital World> in the D-Terminal
_5334.CompletionText: Tamer, have you made your decision??
_5334.CompletionSummary: @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc> Tamer, thank you so much. Please take care of this mission as well!!
_5334.ReservedText: Agent, have you made your decision??

_5335.Title: Powerdigimon
_5335.Description: If you’re ready, head to the Digital World immediately.
_5335.Objective: Talk to Gatomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5335.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Gatomon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5335.CompletionText: I will transport you to the Digital World.
_5335.CompletionSummary: Are you the Tamer dispatched from the DATs Center?

_5336.Title: Powerdigimon
_5336.Description: The Digimon Kaiser is currently controlling Digimon through Evil Ring, and we need the Tamers' help.
_5336.Objective: Talk to Gatomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5336.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Gatomon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5336.CompletionText: Before the Digimon Kaiser causes more trouble...
_5336.CompletionSummary: The Digimon Kaiser's domain is growing larger and larger.

_5337.Title: Powerdigimon
_5337.Description: Digimon in the forest are attacking each other right now. Gotsumon have started fighting with their friends. Hurry and help them, and check on the other Digimon as well.
_5337.Objective: Defeat Gotsumon in the Kaiser's Domain

_5338.Title: Powerdigimon
_5338.Description: The Piyomon I was traveling with has gone strange. Please save Piyomon.
_5338.Objective: Defeat Piyomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5338.CompletionText: Remove the Evil Ring from Piyomon.

_5339.Title: Powerdigimon
_5339.Description: Hello? I’m Veemon. I was resting in the cave when Monochromon suddenly attacked me. Something’s definitely wrong. Please investigate what’s wrong with Monochromon.
_5339.Objective: Defeat Monochromon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5339.CompletionText: Be careful! Monochromon is very aggressive!
_5339.CompletionSummary: Thank you! I can't believe I got violent because of the Digimon Kaiser... It seems like the Digital World is in danger.

_5340.Title: Powerdigimon
_5340.Description: The Digital World seems to be in danger. Tell the other Digimon!
_5340.Objective: Talk to Gatomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5340.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Gatomon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5340.CompletionSummary: Thank you! It seems the Digimon in the forest have returned to normal!
_5340.ReservedText: I found the Holy Ring I lost in the forest!

_5341.Title: Powerdigimon
_5341.Description: The Digimon in the forest seem to be back to normal, but I need to get to the other Digimon in the ruins. Dokunemon is blocking the path.
_5341.Objective: Defeat Dokunemon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5341.CompletionText: I wonder if the other Digimon are okay..?
_5341.CompletionSummary: The ruins are in danger right now... Can you help?

_5342.Title: Powerdigimon
_5342.Description: Digimon near the ruins are constantly attacking the ruins. It seems something's wrong with the Digimon around here~ Ask Hawkmon what’s going on.
_5342.Objective: Talk to Hawkmon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5342.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Hawkmon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5342.CompletionText: I want to play... but the Digimon are acting strange..
_5342.ReservedText: The movements of the Digimon around here seem suspicious...

_5343.Title: Powerdigimon
_5343.Description: Recently, the surrounding Digimon have become aggressive. After analysis, it seems something called Evil Ring is causing the Digimon to change. Please destroy the Evil Ring and save the Digimon.
_5343.Objective: Defeat Durimon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5343.CompletionText: Please make sure the Digimon don't get hurt.
_5343.CompletionSummary: It seems we have saved most of the Digimon nearby~

_5344.Title: Powerdigimon
_5344.Description: I want to investigate Evil Ring. Please investigate the Digimon carrying Evil Ring.
_5344.Objective: Defeat Mojyamon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5344.CompletionText: We need to investigate the Evil Ring...
_5344.CompletionSummary: So, Hawkmon also asked for your help!
_5344.ReservedText: Hawkmon only gives me these kinds of tasks... Hmph!

_5345.Title: Powerdigimon
_5345.Description: Hawkmon said that tower near the ruins seems to be the problem~ Check if there are any bad Digimon near the tower.
_5345.Objective: Defeat SkullGreymon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5345.CompletionText: Are there any bad Digimon around the tower?
_5345.CompletionSummary: Sorry... I asked you to do something dangerous..

_5346.Title: Powerdigimon
_5346.Description: The ruins seem safe now. Hawkmon will continue to investigate, but please help the Digimon in other areas~
_5346.Objective: Talk to Mimi in the Kaiser's Domain
_5346.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Mimi in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5346.CompletionText: Now that there are no more bad Digimon... I'm going to play~
_5346.CompletionSummary: You're the DATs Tamer from the Real World!
_5346.ReservedText: Oh! You're from the Real World...

_5347.Title: Powerdigimon
_5347.Description: Hello? My name is Mimi. I came to the Digital World to see Palmon after a long time, but I can’t find her.... I want to find Palmon, but the nearby Digimon are acting strange... I'm scared, so please find Palmon for me~
_5347.Objective: Defeat Gekomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5347.CompletionSummary: Why did you take so long! I was scared!

_5348.Title: Powerdigimon
_5348.Description: When I came to the Digital World last time, the Digimon I was close to started acting weird... Could you go and investigate for me?
_5348.Objective: Defeat Otamamon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5348.CompletionText: I really want to see Palmon soon..
_5348.CompletionSummary: The Ebling was the problem... Thank you!!

_5349.Title: Powerdigimon
_5349.Description: But... doesn't it seem like the forest is getting darker? I'm scared... Eek!! There's a strange Digimon watching us... Let's hurry and find Palmon..
_5349.Objective: Defeat Roachmon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5349.CompletionText: I'm scared... I want to leave this forest quickly..
_5349.CompletionSummary: So, this is Roachmon's Forest... It's creepy...

_5350.Title: Powerdigimon
_5350.Description: Eek!! There's another Digimon over there... I'm scared, let's quickly pass by...
_5350.Objective: Defeat Tonosama Gekomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5350.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Tonosama Gekomon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5350.CompletionText: I want to meet Palmon and play...

_5351.Title: Powerdigimon
_5351.Description: It's getting late today... Thanks to you, I think I can safely go home! Thank you!! Please tell Palmon I came to visit~
_5351.Objective: Talk to Palmon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5351.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Palmon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5351.CompletionText: I just want to go home and rest...
_5351.CompletionSummary: Did Mimi come looking for me..?

_5352.Title: Powerdigimon
_5352.Description: Sniff... Mimi was here... I got lost in Roachmon's Forest. It seems that Dark Tower over there is affecting the Digimon in the forest, please help destroy it.
_5352.Objective: Defeat Roachmon <Story> in the Kaiser's Domain
_5352.CompletionText: The Roachmon are guarding the Dark Tower. Let's make the Roachmon fight each other.
_5352.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Thanks to you, I made it out of the forest safely. I wanted to see Mimi after so long... What a shame...

_5353.Title: Powerdigimon
_5353.Description: Roachmon's Forest has brightened up again, thank you. I'll stay in the forest, to leave just head that way.
_5353.Objective: Talk to Digitamamon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5353.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Digitamamon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5353.CompletionText: I wonder when Mimi will come back~ I hope she comes soon.
_5353.CompletionSummary: Welcome~ Would you like some food?
_5353.ReservedText: Hello. Welcome to the Digitamamon Restaurant. We’re starting fresh with a new mindset.

_5354.Title: Powerdigimon
_5354.Description: Your food is here. Enjoy your meal~
_5354.Objective: Talk to Digitamamon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5354.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Digitamamon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5354.CompletionText: We only accept dollars for payment.
_5354.CompletionSummary: You don't have money, you say? Then work for it!!

_5355.Title: Powerdigimon
_5355.Description: You have to work as much as you eat! First, chase away the Digimon disturbing business by the lake in front of the restaurant!! Hurry!!
_5355.Objective: Defeat Seadramon and Betamon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5355.CompletionText: Did you finish everything I asked??
_5355.CompletionSummary: You did well with what I asked. Now the next task...

_5356.Title: Powerdigimon
_5356.Description: One of the employees is missing... Rookie!! Go find the runaway employee!!
_5356.Objective: Defeat Vegiemon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5356.CompletionText: The employees these days... Tsk tsk...
_5356.CompletionSummary: If you found it, go and wash the dishes!

_5357.Title: Powerdigimon
_5357.Description: You've worked enough for what you ate, now get out quickly!
_5357.Objective: Talk to Agumon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5357.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Agumon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5357.CompletionSummary: The Digimon Kaiser is conducting experiments...

_5358.Title: Powerdigimon
_5358.Description: The Digimon Kaiser is experimenting on Digimon. We must stop it. It seems that many Digimon in the village are being controlled by the Digimon Kaiser, let's go save them quickly.
_5358.Objective: Defeat Starmon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5358.CompletionText: I never want to go back... The Digimon Kaiser is so scary..
_5358.CompletionSummary: I'm so glad everyone is safe. Let's hurry and chase after the Digimon Kaiser!

_5359.Title: Powerdigimon
_5359.Description: The Digimon Kaiser is conducting experiments to perfectly control Digimon through Evil Ring. We have to stop him before things get worse. Talk to me when you're ready.
_5359.Objective: Talk to Agumon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5359.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Agumon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5359.CompletionText: Are we going to stop the Digimon Kaiser?
_5359.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Let's follow the path I escaped along the railroad tracks!

_5360.Title: Powerdigimon
_5360.Description: There seem to be more Digimon still controlled in the village, go check with Tentomon!
_5360.Objective: Talk to Tentomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5360.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Tentomon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5360.CompletionSummary: Hello~ You're the tamer Agumon mentioned, right?

_5361.Title: Powerdigimon
_5361.Description: Gotsumon in the village have started rampaging. Destroy the Evil Ring on Gotsumon’s body.
_5361.Objective: Defeat Gazimon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5361.CompletionText: Oh no, oh no... This is a disaster...

_5362.Title: Powerdigimon
_5362.Description: A wild WaruMonzaemon controlled by Evil Ring has appeared. Locomon's resting area is disappearing. Please save the village.
_5362.Objective: Defeat WaruMonzaemon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5362.CompletionText: I need to ask Hansol for an analysis...
_5362.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Because of you, we were able to investigate a lot.

_5363.Title: Powerdigimon
_5363.Description: Let's go, if we follow the tracks, we will reach the Digimon Kaiser's base!
_5363.Objective: Talk to Veemon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5363.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Veemon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5363.CompletionText: I wonder how Tai is doing...
_5363.CompletionSummary: Hello~ We meet again here, Agumon asked for help, so I came too.

_5364.Title: Powerdigimon
_5364.Description: Digimon in the wilderness... They've all gone wild because of Evil Ring... let's go save them quickly.
_5364.Objective: Defeat Woodmon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5364.CompletionText: I can’t forgive that Digimon Kaiser.
_5364.CompletionSummary: Thank you for helping to rescue the Digimon. Let's quickly stop the Digimon Kaiser's plan.
_5364.ReservedText: I can’t forgive that Digimon Kaiser.

_5365.Title: Powerdigimon
_5365.Description: The Digimon Kaiser's Digimon have started appearing!! Let's defeat them quickly!!
_5365.Objective: Defeat DarkTyrannomon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5365.CompletionSummary: Agumon... has been captured again by the Digimon Kaiser...

_5366.Title: Powerdigimon
_5366.Description: Agumon captured by the Digimon Kaiser has evolved through the power of Evil Ring. Attack the Evil Ring to rescue Agumon.
_5366.Objective: Defeat MetalGreymon (Black) in the Kaiser's Domain
_5366.CompletionText: They've grown stronger through the power of Evil Ring...
_5366.CompletionSummary: Thank you!! Thanks to you, I was able to save Agumon. It seems the Digimon Kaiser has escaped.

_5367.Title: Powerdigimon
_5367.Description: We still haven't caught the Digimon Kaiser yet... It's okay, if we keep chasing him, we'll catch him eventually. You did a lot, thank you!
_5367.Objective: Talk to Flamedramon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5367.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Flamedramon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5367.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we might be able to find the Digimon Kaiser's base.

_5368.Title: Powerdigimon
_5368.Description: It seems like there's a path at the end of the tracks leading to the Digimon Kaiser's base, let's go check it out.
_5368.Objective: Talk to Veemon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5368.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Veemon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5368.CompletionText: If we go this way, we can reach the Digimon Kaiser's base.
_5368.CompletionSummary: Are you returning to the Real World for a while? Alright, see you next time!

_5369.Title: Powerdigimon
_5369.Description: It looks like the Digimon Kaiser is holding other Digimon hostage, we need to rescue them quickly.
_5369.Objective: Talk to Flamedramon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5369.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Talk to Flamedramon in the Kaiser's Domain%qe %cc1/%mc1

_5370.Title: Powerdigimon
_5370.Description: It seems like the hostages are tied to that rock over there, let's go rescue the Digimon!
_5370.Objective: Defeat Bakemon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5370.CompletionSummary: Thank you for helping me escape safely!

_5371.Title: Powerdigimon
_5371.Description: It seems like the hostages are tied to that rock over there, let's go rescue the Digimon!
_5371.Objective: Defeat Deltamon in the Kaiser's Domain
_5371.CompletionSummary: Thank you for helping me escape safely!

_5372.Title: Powerdigimon
_5372.Description: Please defeat the powerful Digimon disturbing the Digital World!!
_5372.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Monochromon <Field Boss>%qe %cc1/%mc1_x000D_ %qs2Defeat SkullGreymon <Field Boss>%qe %cc2/%mc2_x000D_ %qs3Defeat Roachmon <Field Boss>%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5372.CompletionText: Please defeat the powerful Digimon disturbing the Digital World!!

_5373.Title: Powerdigimon
_5373.Description: Please defeat the powerful Digimon disturbing the Digital World!!
_5373.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Seadramon <Field Boss>%qe %cc1/%mc1_x000D_ %qs2Defeat Starmon <Field Boss>%qe %cc2/%mc2_x000D_ %qs3Defeat WaruMonzaemon <Field Boss>%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5373.CompletionText: Please defeat the powerful Digimon disturbing the Digital World!!

_5374.Title: Powerdigimon
_5374.Description: Stop the strong Digimon disturbing the ruins.
_5374.Objective: Defeat Durimon <Boss> in the Kaiser's Domain
_5374.CompletionText: Stop the strong Digimon disturbing the ruins.
_5374.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much. Here’s a gift~

_5375.Title: Powerdigimon
_5375.Objective: Defeat Gekomon <Boss> in the Kaiser's Domain
_5375.CompletionSummary: Yay~ Thank you. Here's a gift.

_5376.Title: Powerdigimon
_5376.Objective: Defeat Roachmon <Boss> in the Kaiser's Domain
_5376.CompletionSummary: Yay~ Thank you. Here's a gift.

_5377.Title: Powerdigimon
_5377.Description: Stop the Digimon dirtying the village!
_5377.Objective: Defeat Starmon <Boss> in the Kaiser's Domain
_5377.CompletionText: Stop the Digimon dirtying the village!

_5378.Title: Powerdigimon
_5378.Objective: Defeat DarkTyrannomon <Boss> in the Kaiser's Domain

_5379.Title: Powerdigimon
_5379.Description: This is a piece of the Dark Tower discovered in the Digital World!! If we gather these, we can figure out the location of the Digimon Kaiser!!
_5379.CompletionText: Find the Digimon Kaiser and rescue the captured Agumon….
_5379.CompletionSummary: Find the Digimon Kaiser and rescue the captured Agumon….

_5380.Title: Powerdigimon
_5380.Description: Digimons are rampaging because of the Evil Spiral. Please save them...
_5380.CompletionText: Digimons are rampaging because of the Evil Spiral. Please save them...
_5380.CompletionSummary: Digimons are rampaging because of the Evil Spiral. Please save them...

_5381.Title: Kaiser's Base
_5381.Description: This is DATS Center, Commander Richard Sampson speaking. It seems we've found a clue about Kaiser's base. Any agents receiving this message, hurry to V-mon in Kaiser's territory. Over.
_5381.Objective: Talk to <Portal Assistant> V-mon in Kaiser's territory.

_5382.Title: Kaiser's Base
_5382.Description: I found a clue about Kaiser's base! Gather clues from the Digimon in the wilderness
_5382.Objective: Defeat Digimon in the Digital World Wilderness to obtain 5 [Unknown Gears].
_5382.CompletionText: Bring me the clues, and I'll analyze them!
_5382.CompletionSummary: This... is a power room gear from Kaiser's base!If we follow the trail of fallen gears, we might be able to find Kaiser's base!"

_5385.Title: Special Seal
_5385.Description:
Hello, Tamer
I've been gathering items that everyone considers special while traveling through time.
But when I checked this morning, all the items I've collected so far have disappeared!
Could you possibly help me find them?
_5385.Objective: Defeat the <Seal Thief> Piedmon that appeared on the File Island Coast
_5385.CompletionText: The culprit is Piedmon trying to escape from the File Island Coast.
_5385.CompletionSummary: Thank you, Tamer. It's a pity, but I'll give you some of these items as a reward.

_5386.Title: Gallantmon Crimson Mode
_5386.Description:
Establishing myself
that is the beginning of everything.
If I transcend myself, I won't be shaken by any hardship.
_5386.Objective: Move to the underground summoning area, use [Gungnir], and defeat the summoned Gallantmon Crimson Mode.
_5386.CompletionText: Please help me. It won't be an easy path.
_5386.CompletionSummary: Thank you, Tamer. May tomorrow be better than today.

_5387.Title: Gallantmon Crimson Mode
_5387.Description:
For the sake of knowing what is right!
To uphold my own justice!
I will surpass my limits and judge the injustice.
_5387.CompletionSummary: Not by the will of others, but by my own will! I will bring justice to this world!

_5388.Title: Valentine's Day
_5388.Description: You are going to help me? Thank you! I was on my way to give Hikari the chocolate I made with my brother, but Digimons stole my milk chocolate. I think it looked too delicious. Digimons who took the chocolate are scattered throughout all areas.
_5388.Objective: Collect [Milk Chocolate] 214ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Digital World.
_5388.CompletionText: I spent all night to make this.
_5388.CompletionSummary: Thanks for finding the chocolate! Here, take this special gift.

_5389.Title: Valentine's Day
_5389.Description: I made a big batch of dark chocolate for my friends, but digimons took it all away…Digimons who stole the chocolate are hiding all over the various areas.
_5389.Objective: Collect [Dark Chocolate] 2140ea by defeating all enemy Digimon in Digital World.
_5389.CompletionText: I know it's difficult because there are so many, but I hope you can find it.
_5389.CompletionSummary: You found all of it? Then I must give you this gift.

_5390.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_5390.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_5390.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_5390.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_5391.Title: [Ticket Exchange]
_5391.Description:
(<Exclusive Ticket Exchange for STEAM>
[Exchangeable List] - Level-up Spike Package\nExchange Ticket

_5392.Title: Find Hiding Digimon
_5392.Description:
I won't let you get away with this, Lopmon!
You made a mess of my room and ran away...
The last sighting was in the Quiet Forest. Can you teach it a lesson?
_5392.Objective: Defeat 1 <Small> Lopmon hiding in the Quiet Forest
_5392.CompletionText: Lopmon is very small, so it will be hard to find
_5392.CompletionSummary: Now, he will be sorry, right?

_5393.Title: Find Hiding Digimon
_5393.Description:
I won't let this slide, Terriermon!
You made a mess of my room and ran away...
The last sighting was in the Quiet Forest. Can you teach it a lesson?
_5393.Objective: Defeat 1 <Small> Terriermon hiding in the Quiet Forest
_5393.CompletionText: Terriermon is very small, so it will be hard to find
_5393.CompletionSummary: Now, he will be sorry, right?

_5402.Title: Season Pass
_5402.Description:
Tamer... Can you feel it?
The Digital World is being engulfed by the power of darkness...
Could you first find the traces of darkness scattered throughout the Digital World?
_5402.Objective: Obtain 20 [Traces of Darkness] from Digimon that appear in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5402.CompletionText: The power of darkness is growing stronger…
_5402.CompletionSummary: If we analyze this trace of darkness, we might find an answer.

_5403.Title: Season Pass
_5403.Description:
I can feel the darkness covering the Digital World...
The biggest problem is that DarkTyrannomon, consumed by the power of darkness, is affecting not only the Digital World but also the real world.
_5403.Objective: Defeat 20 <Dark Ring> DarkTyrannomon that appeared in Server Continent, Valley of Light, and Shibuya.
_5403.CompletionText: DarkTyrannomon has been observed in the Server Continent, Shibuya, and Valley of Light.

_5404.Title: Season Pass
_5404.Description:
This is bad!!
SkullGreymon, consumed by darkness, is attacking Yokohama Village.
We must stop it right now!
_5404.Objective: Defeat the <Consumed by the Dark Tower> SkullGreymon that appeared in Yokohama Village.
_5404.CompletionSummary: This is serious... more and more Digimon are being consumed by the power of darkness.

_5405.Title: [Gankoomon's Training Ground]
_5405.Description:
Hmm… You are a fascinating human…
To ask for training from my master, Gankoomon, to become strong…
Who am I? I am Hackmon, who will be your senior should you start training under master Gankoomon!
If you start training under my master, I will give you a special present!
_5405.CompletionText: Hmm… I wonder if you can survive master's training?
_5405.CompletionSummary:
Oh! You must have a firm resolve! To be willing to train under my master, whose training is supposedly the toughest in the entire Digital World!
Good! I will give you a present! When you are enduring my master's training and working hard, this will be helpful for sure.
I shall be watching you from the side as you receive your training.

_5406.Title: 13th Anniversary
_5406.Description:
Tamer!!
Time really flies; can you believe it's already the 13th anniversary of Digimon Masters?
Oh, Richard Sampson has something to give you, so you better go see him.
_5406.CompletionText: "It seems like they've prepared a small gift for you.
_5406.CompletionSummary: Thank you for being with us for such a long time. This is a gift we've prepared with all our hearts.

_5407.Title: 13th Anniversary
_5407.Description:
Tamer~
We're running short of balloons for the 13th anniversary celebration party. Could you gather some for us?
_5407.Objective: Collect 20 [Balloons] from Digimon that appear in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5407.CompletionSummary:
Thank you!
Thanks to you, we can have an even more wonderful birthday celebration.

_5408.Title: 13th Anniversary
_5408.Description:
Wow!!
Tamer, the Death-X-mon doll we prepared as a prize suddenly started moving on its own!
Oh... It's trying to destroy the town!!!
You need to stop it, quickly.
_5408.Objective: Defeat <Toy> Death-X-mon that appeared in Yokohama Village.
_5408.CompletionText: It was so cool that I almost forgot I had to stop it.

_5409.Title: 13th Anniversary
_5409.Description: Are you willing to take the Royal Knights' trial?
_5409.Objective: Collect 20 [Data Fragments] from villain Digimon appearing in Adventure and Tamers areas.

_5410.Title: 13th Anniversary
_5410.Description:
Hmm?
Such a powerful presence felt from afar...
It's you, Tamer.
If you have the time, would you like to have a battle with me?
_5410.Objective: Move to the Underground Summoning Room and use the [Caller] to summon and defeat Omegamon X.
_5410.CompletionText: Take this item to the D-Terminal Summoning Room.

_5411.Title: 13th Anniversary
_5411.Description:
Ahaha!!
Nice to meet you, Tamer.
Huh? Why am I called 'Yggdrasil's Right Hand'? Of course, it's because I've never failed even once when upgrading equipment.
If you bring me the materials for that duck pajamas, I'll upgrade it for free.
_5411.Objective: Collect 20 [Suspicious Materials] from villain Digimon appearing in Adventure and Tamers areas.

_5412.Title: Season Pass
_5412.Description:
Oh no, this is a disaster...
It seems I accidentally sent out the birthday party invitations to everyone except Mojyamon from Snowstorm Village.
Now, it looks like Mojyamon is causing a ruckus over there because he noticed he didn’t get an invite. Could you go and calm him down?
_5412.Objective: Defeat the <Shocked> Mojyamon that appeared in Snowstorm Village.
_5412.CompletionText: Every year, it seems like there's always someone who doesn't get an invitation...
_5412.CompletionSummary:
Thank you.
It seems things have finally calmed down.

_5413.Title: Season Pass
_5413.Description:
Oh, Tamer.
You’re just in time. It looks like we’ll need more party supplies than I originally planned. Could you help gather some for me?
_5413.CompletionText: Why do we keep running out of supplies every time we prepare?
_5413.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, the party preparations are going much smoother.

_5414.Title: Season Pass
_5414.Summary: [Daily] Tidying Up the Village of Beginnings
_5414.Description:
Sigh... As expected, troublemakers have shown up for this birthday party again.
I’ve heard that V-mon are causing a mess in the Village of Beginnings right now. Could you go and stop them?
_5414.Objective: Defeat 20 <Troublemaker> V-mon that appeared in the Village of Beginnings.
_5414.CompletionText: Sigh... I thought this year's birthday party would be a quiet one.
_5414.CompletionSummary: Thank you for stopping those troublemakers.

_5415.Title: Happy Halloween
_5415.Description:
Hello, Tamer!
I'm super excited right now! You know why?
Because Halloween Day, which represents me, Pumpmon, is approaching!
Should I make a doll this Halloween and give it to Gotsumon as a gift... Tamer, do you want to make it with me?
The method is quite tricky, so make sure to follow along closely!
Let me know if you'd like any further adjustments or refinements!
_5415.Objective: Obtain 10 [Pumpkin Doll DIY Kit 1]s from Digimon appearing in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5415.CompletionSummary: I've just barely finished making the right arm!

_5416.Title: Happy Halloween
_5416.Description:
Hello, Tamer!
I'm super excited right now! You know why?
Because Halloween Day, which represents me, Pumpmon, is approaching!
Should I make a doll this Halloween and give it to Gotsumon as a gift... Tamer, do you want to make it with me?
The method is quite tricky, so make sure to follow along closely!
Let me know if you'd like any further adjustments or refinements!
_5416.Objective: Obtain 10 [Pumpkin Doll DIY Kit 2]s from Digimon appearing in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5416.CompletionSummary: I've just barely finished making the right leg!

_5417.Title: Happy Halloween
_5417.Description:
Hello, Tamer!
I'm super excited right now! You know why?
Because Halloween Day, which represents me, Pumpmon, is approaching!
Should I make a doll this Halloween and give it to Gotsumon as a gift... Tamer, do you want to make it with me?
The method is quite tricky, so make sure to follow along closely!
Let me know if you'd like any further adjustments or refinements!
_5417.Objective: Obtain 10 [Pumpkin Doll DIY Kit 3]s from Digimon appearing in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5417.CompletionSummary: Finally, I've made the left arm!

_5418.Title: Happy Halloween
_5418.Description:
Hello, Tamer!
I'm super excited right now! You know why?
Because Halloween Day, which represents me, Pumpmon, is approaching!
Should I make a doll this Halloween and give it to Gotsumon as a gift... Tamer, do you want to make it with me?
The method is quite tricky, so make sure to follow along closely!
Let me know if you'd like any further adjustments or refinements!
_5418.Objective: Obtain 10 [Pumpkin Doll DIY Kit 4]s from Digimon appearing in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5418.CompletionSummary:
I can finally complete the doll!
Gotsumon will absolutely love it~

_5419.Title: Happy Halloween
_5419.Description: Happy Halloween~ Happy Halloween~ Huh? Tamer, you have something to give me? Pumpmon prepared a gift for me?
_5419.CompletionSummary: This is the best gift I've ever received!

_5420.Title: Ticket Exchange
_5420.Description: Hello, Tamer! Just give me a special draw ticket voucher!

_5421.Title: Imperialdramon Fighter Mode
_5421.Description:
Hello!!!
You've come to admire the new look of Imperialdramon Fighter Mode (Awakened) in the Digital World, haven't you?
_5421.Objective: Move to the Underground Summoning Room and use the [Dragon's Trace] to summon and defeat Imperialdramon Fighter Mode (Awakened).
_5421.CompletionText: Take this item to the D-Terminal Summoning Room.
_5421.CompletionSummary: How is it? Isn't it cool?

_5422.Title: Imperialdramon Fighter Mode
_5422.Description: Show me the new form of Imperialdramon Fighter Mode!

_5423.Title: Ticket Exchange
_5423.Description: Hello, Tamer! Just give me a special draw ticket voucher!

_5424.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5424.Description: There was a time when the world was peaceful... But these days, the balance between light and darkness is faltering. It seems the time has come for someone to take action to protect the dawn.
_5424.CompletionSummary: Neither light nor darkness alone can protect the world. I hope you come to understand that balance. Good, it seems you’re ready. I hope you overcome the trials ahead. This is the beginning of your journey.

_5425.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5425.Description: Recently, Light-attribute Digimon have been behaving strangely. We need to deal with them before it gets dangerous. Taking care of around 30 should be enough.
_5425.CompletionText: Just because it’s light doesn’t mean it’s always safe. Don’t let your guard down.
_5425.CompletionSummary: Good job, you handled it well. With your skills, the next challenge won’t be a problem.

_5426.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5426.Description: This time, it's the Dark-attribute Digimon causing trouble. It's hard to even sense their presence, and they've become more aggressive. Defeat 30 of them for me.
_5426.CompletionText: Be careful not to be swallowed by the darkness. It’s more persistent than you think.
_5426.CompletionSummary: As expected. You fought calmly even in the darkness.

_5427.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5427.Description: You've handled both light and darkness well. Before moving on to the next stage, let me speak with you for a moment. This is a special summon card. If you use it, a powerful Digimon will appear. Defeat it, and the trial will be over.
_5427.Objective: <Light> Shoutmon X7, <Light> Alphamon Ouryuken, <Darkness> Lucemon: Wild 2nd Mode, <Darkness> ZeedMillenniummon Defeat
_5427.CompletionText: Your judgment will set the course for your next actions. Think carefully. That one won’t be easy. Be prepared for the fight.
_5427.CompletionSummary: Alright, I respect your choice. I’ll prepare for what’s next. Excellent. With this, the Jumping Mission is nearly complete.

_5428.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5428.Description: You've finally met the requirements to begin the Tale, Tamer!!
_5428.CompletionSummary: For meeting the initial requirements of the Brilliant Tale, I present you with the chance to start a new story! May luck be with you on your journey ahead.

_5429.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5429.Summary: [Daily] Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5429.Description: Apocalymon has appeared again. It's a dangerous presence at the heart of chaos. Once again, I need your help to maintain the balance today.
_5429.CompletionText: Chaos is always waiting for an opening. It’s best to finish it quickly.
_5429.CompletionSummary: Good, you’ve maintained the balance again today. Your efforts have been a great help.

_5430.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5430.Description: Knightmon is on a rampage. It's acting aggressively, unlike usual. As the Guardian of Dawn, you must restore it to its place.
_5430.CompletionText: Even the Guardian of Light can lose their way. You need to set things right.
_5430.CompletionSummary: It’s calmed down safely. Thank you, you helped prevent any harm.

_5431.Title: Brilliant Tale of Light and Darkness
_5431.Description: BlackKnightmon has started to move. The signs of darkness are becoming clear. Take care of it before it's too late.
_5431.CompletionText: That one is strong, so don’t let your guard down.
_5431.CompletionSummary: Good, you stopped the apocalypse today. I’ll need you again tomorrow.

_5432.Title: Eosmon
_5432.Description:
Owner of Neverland appeared in the Digital World, Tamer.
Defeat him for friendship of you and your partner Digimon.
_5432.Objective: Move to the Underground Summon square and after use [Neverland], defeat the summoned EOSMON.
_5432.CompletionText: Go to D-terminal Summon square with this item.
_5432.CompletionSummary: Maybe it will keep trying to cross over into this world.

_5433.Title: Eosmon
_5433.Description:
Owner of Neverland.
EOSMON that Devastator in the mirror appeared in the Digital World.

_5434.Title: Ticket Exchange
_5434.Description: Hello, Tamer! Just give me a special draw ticket voucher!

_5435.Title: Welcome, 2025!
_5435.Description:
Hello~
Joe is still complaining about the cold, but I’m so excited!
Can you believe 2025 is almost here?
Since the new year is coming, I’ve prepared a gift for you! But, I’ll only give it to you after you’ve dealt with some dangerous guys to get ready to enjoy the new year.
_5435.Objective: Defeat Etemon, VenomMyotismon, and Apocalymon <The Dark Force>
_5435.CompletionText: I'm so excited for the upcoming 2025!
_5435.CompletionSummary:
Wow! You came back so quickly! Great job.
Here’s the promised gift—I hope it helps you out~
Let’s work hard in 2025, Tamer!

_5436.Title: Happy Christmas? Happy DMO!
_5436.Description: Hello, Tamer! Are you having a Happy Christmas? I’m Yukidarumon, here to decorate the DATS Center with a beautiful tree! But the Starmons have fled to the Village of Beginnings!!!!! A tree without stars isn’t a real tree! If you help me, I’ll give you a wonderful Christmas present!
_5436.CompletionText: Bring back the Starmons! Repeat after me! The completion of a tree is the star!
_5436.CompletionSummary: Yahoo! Thank you so much! Wishing you a wonderful and happy Christmas!!

_5437.Title: Happy Christmas? Happy DMO!
_5437.Description: Hello, Tamer! Merry Christmas! I’m Yukidarumon, here to decorate the DATS Center with a beautiful tree! But while decorating so hard, I ran out of trees…. Could you get some Christmas trees from the vending machine at the DATS Center? If you help me, I’ll give you a wonderful Christmas present!
_5437.Objective: Buy 10 Christmas Trees from the vending machine at the DATS Center.
_5437.CompletionText: Thank you so much! It’s not because I’m broke, okay...?
_5437.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much, Tamer! Have a joyful DMO!!

_5438.Title: Happy Christmas? Happy DMO!
_5438.Summary: [Daily] A warm year-end..! But it's too warm.
_5438.Description:
Hello, Tamer! Are you having a warm year-end? I’m Yukidarumon, excited to welcome winter! I’m glad you’re enjoying a warm year-end, but isn’t it a bit too warm? Something feels strange… Gasp!
The Meramons in Yokohama Village are too hot, and all the snow is melting! This is serious!! Please stop the Meramons in Yokohama Village!
_5438.Objective: Defeat the <Too Warm> Meramons in Yokohama Village.
_5438.CompletionText: Ahhh… I’m melting, I’m melting, everything’s melting… Somebody help me!
_5438.CompletionSummary: Phew~ I barely made it, Tamer. If I melt now, I won’t be back until next year. Please! Have a moderately warm year-end, Tamer!

_5439.Title: Chapter 5: Symbiosis
_5439.Summary: [Daily] Showdown: Wrath of the Fallen Angel
_5439.Description:
Tamer... Please help me.
Gatomon has been swept away by the corrupted power because of me...
If this continues, the Fallen Angel will engulf the real world in fear and despair...
Before that happens, can you step up and stop the Fallen Angel?
_5439.Objective: Defeat 1 Ordinemon <Fallen Angel of Rage and Sorrow>.
_5439.CompletionSummary:
I'm so relieved... truly relieved...
Thanks to you, Tamer, both Gatomon and the real world have been saved.

_5440.Title: Chapter 5: Symbiosis
_5440.Description:
Tamer, with the power to protect the real world, it seems you can handle the Fallen Angel.
If you bring the Fallen Angel to me, I will give you a gift.
_5440.CompletionText: Bring the Fallen Angel to me.
_5440.CompletionSummary: I hope you'll continue to stand by and prevent the Fallen Angel from threatening the real world again.

_5441.Title: Jumping
_5441.Description:
Tamer! To celebrate the arrival of 2025, I, Piximon, have prepared a new event!
You'll find out when you visit Yokohama Village!
_5441.CompletionSummary:
Good job!
Here's a gift for you. You can exchange this coin for the item you want!

_5442.Title: Year of the Blue Serpent
_5442.Description:
Tamer, I’ve learned something fun. Would you like to give it a try? I’ll test your luck for 2025!
But first, you need to defeat 30 Seadramons in the Starting Village.
_5442.Objective: Defeat 30 Seadramon <Year of the Blue Serpant>
_5442.CompletionSummary: Use this ticket to test your luck. Go ahead!

_5443.Title: Ghost Game
_5443.Description: This is Richard Sampson. Can you hear me!? An emergency report has come in about an unidentified Digimon appearing in the real world. Head to the D-Terminal immediately.
_5443.Objective: Talk to Hiro at the D-Terminal

_5444.Title: Ghost Game
_5444.Description: We were attacked by an unidentified Digimon. Bokomon tried to save us but…
_5444.Objective: Talk to Hiro at the D-Terminal
_5444.CompletionText: Gammamon is rampaging because of Bokomon's death!!

_5445.Title: Awakened Courage and Friendship
_5445.Description:
Tamer, it's been a while!!
The power of Shining Courage is leading you and us to even greater heights.
Let's overcome the trial and prove our Shining Courage!!
_5445.Objective: Move to the Underground Summon square and after use [Trial of Shining Courage], defeat the summoned WarGreymon<Shining Courage>
_5445.CompletionSummary:
You did it!! Tamer!!
With your Shining Courage, you were able to overcome the trial.
I hope you carry that courage forward as you move ahead.

_5446.Title: Awakened Courage and Friendship
_5446.Description:
It's been a while, Tamer!!
The power of your Friendship is guiding you and us toward a hopeful future.
Let's overcome the trial and move forward with our Hopeful Friendship!!
_5446.Objective: Move to the Underground Summon square and after use [Trial of Hopeful Friendship], defeat the summoned WarGreymon<Hopeful Friendship>
_5446.CompletionSummary:
Tamer!! You succeeded!!
With your Hopeful Friendship, you overcame the trial.
I hope you continue to protect that friendship in the future.

_5447.Title: Awakened Courage and Friendship
_5447.Description:
Tamer, it's been a while!!
The power of Shining Courage is leading you and us to even greater heights.
_5447.CompletionSummary: With WarGreymon growing even stronger, things will get easier from now on.

_5448.Title: Awakened Courage and Friendship
_5448.Description:
It's been a while, Tamer!!
The power of your Friendship is guiding you and us toward a hopeful future.
_5448.CompletionSummary: With MetalGarurumon growing even stronger, things will get easier from now on.

_5449.Title: Season Pass
_5449.Description:
Hello, Tamer~?
I still can't believe that 2025 is here. Are you still writing 2024 in your diary and then deleting it?
So, why don't you, Tamer, write a diary every day like me?
You can get the diary by defeat Digimon!
_5449.Objective: Obtain 20 [diary] from Digimon that appears in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5449.CompletionText: Have you found the diary yet? yet?
_5449.CompletionSummary: You didn't just take the diary and leave it unused, right? I'll check it tomorrow~

_5450.Title: Season Pass
_5450.Description:
Hello, Tamer!
My goal this year is to learn a lot of new IT technologies. however… wait for a sec… Where's my laptop?
“I think the Digimon took it while I was sleeping.”
_5450.Objective: Obtain 1 [Laptop] from Digimon that appears in all areas except Yokohama Village.
_5450.CompletionSummary: If it wasn’t for Tamer, it would have been a big trouble… thank you! I won’t forget this favor!

_5451.Title: Season Pass
_5451.Description:
Hello, Tamer.
This year, you will be able to see me grow even more. Tamer, do you want to grow like me?
I will assign homework. Follow me!
_5451.Objective: Defeat the <Stronger> Lucemon: Wild 2nd Mode that appeared in Yokohama Village Defeat the <More stronger> Apocalymon that appeared in the Village of Beginnings
_5451.CompletionSummary: You have to do your homework every day to become strong like me~ You have to come tomorrow too!

_5452.Title: Valentine's Day
_5452.Summary: [Daily] I still want you to kiss
_5452.Description: I'm telling you this in confidence, but... there's someone I like... it's T.K! I'm too scared to confess, so could you tell him how I feel instead?
_5452.Objective: Defeat monsters in all areas except Yokohama and obtain 214 [Hikari's piece of heart] and 2 [Special piece of heart]
_5452.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Hikari's piece of heart%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs1Special piece of heart%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5452.CompletionSummary: What? Hikari? Hmm... actually, I've liked Hikari for a long time too. Here's a gift with my feelings. Could you give it to Hikari for me?

_5453.Title: Season Pass
_5453.Description: A new Season Pass has begun! Here, take this! I have a gift for you.
_5453.CompletionSummary: Enjoy this season to the fullest~

_5454.Title: Flourishing Nature
_5454.CompletionText: A fitting title for the Guardian of Nature!
_5454.CompletionSummary: You can feel the powerful energy of great nature protecting the Digital World.

_5455.Title: Flourishing Nature
_5455.Description:
At last, we meet, BloomLordmon.
Now, this is the continuation of our last battle! Let's see it through to the end!
_5455.Objective: Defeat 1 <Guardian of Nature> BloomLordmon in the D-Terminal Underground Summon
_5455.CompletionText:
Hey... I don't need your help to be strong.
This time, you think you can save everyone?
_5455.CompletionSummary: Both in bloom and in decay, it remains magnificent.

_5468.Title: [Ticket Exchange]

_5473.Title: Maintenance Reward
_5473.Description: Tamer, thank you for your patience during the maintenance!
_5473.CompletionText: From now on, you can receive Maintenance Compensation Coins from me every Tuesday!

_5474.Title: Spring Event
_5474.Description:
Tamer! Hello?
I've brought a really fun event today! You need to find the hidden letters scattered around the town~
If you find all the letters, I'll give you a special reward!
The letters you need to find are B L O S S O M, a total of 7 letters!
_5474.CompletionText: Can't find it? Open your eyes wide and look carefully!
_5474.CompletionSummary: You found your way here! Ta-da~ This is a special gift just for you! Doesn't it perfectly match the springtime?

_5475.Title: Spring Event

_5475.CompletionText: Here, I'll give you a B.

_5482.Title: Roar of the Destroyer
_5482.Description: You can feel the ominous and overwhelming aura of the Destroyer around you...
_5482.CompletionText: You've obtained the destructive power of ZeedMillenniummon.
_5482.CompletionSummary: Be careful not to succumb to the temptation of absolute destruction.

_5483.Title: Roar of the Destroyer
_5483.Summary: [Daily] Stop the Destruction of Time and Space!!
_5483.Description:
ZeedMillenniummon has become even stronger and is trying to destroy the Digital World.
Tamer!! Help me protect the Digital World!!
_5483.Objective: Defeat <Destroyer> ZeedMillenniummon in the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area.
_5483.CompletionText: It seems that distortions in time and space are being observed in the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area. Let's hurry and check it out.
_5483.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, we were able to defeat ZeedMillenniummon. Thank you, Tamer!!

_5484.Title: April Fools
_5484.Description: Hello~ Tamer! Did you know that April 1st is April Fools’ Day? So I’ve prepared a gift you can’t even see here…! And that is…
_5484.CompletionText: This is the gift I prepared.
_5484.CompletionSummary: How is it? Do you like it? You can’t tell what number it is~? That’s the charm of this item!

_5485.Title: Advent of Darkness
_5485.Description:
You worthless insects dare defy me? Mere data dares to oppose me? Listen carefully, you foolish minions.
Eliminate Magnamon who interfered with my plan! Teach him his place!!
_5485.CompletionText: “Hurry up, you lazy fool!!!! You still haven’t completed the mission?! Useless wretch!!!”
_5485.CompletionSummary:
So you’ve finally taken him down!
Listen well! This is nothing more than a game I’m playing! I will soon be the victor, the ruler, your god! Hahahahahaha!!!!

_5486.Title: Vampiric Overlord
_5486.Description:
Hahahahaha!!! I have returned. The reason I was defeated by them… was because I lacked competent minions!
You pathetic fools… Hey, you, Tamer! You seem slightly more useful than those idiots! Gather the despair of the weak so I can recover my strength! By feeding on pure despair, I shall regain my power and rule this world once more!
_5486.CompletionText: Pure despair… Those fools have no idea of its true power.
_5486.CompletionSummary: At last, it seems I’ve found a minion worth keeping. Very well… I am the noble Vampiric Overlord. And I know how to reward a worthy servant.

_5487.Title: Easter Day
_5487.Description: Lopmon stole my precious egg! Please hurry and take care of that Digimon!
_5487.CompletionText: Don't you find that guy yet?

_5488.Title: Easter Day
_5488.Description: In the Digital World, there’s a rabbit-like Digimon carrying an adorable egg. Could you catch it for me?
_5488.CompletionText: Don't you see the Digimon that resembles rabbits yet?

_5489.Title: D-Unit
_5489.Description:
A powerful reaction has been detected in a recent dungeon.
To uncover the truth behind this reaction, you will need to investigate it yourself.
Please clear the Marketplace [Normal] dungeon and return.
_5489.Objective: Defeat GulusGammamon, the boss of the Marketplace [Normal] dungeon.
_5489.CompletionText: Defeat the powerful dungeon boss and uncover the truth behind the powerful reaction.
_5489.CompletionSummary:
So this was the source of the powerful reaction.
If we harness this immense power well, we may become even stronger than before.

_5501.Description:
The founder of the Royal Knights and the ultimate Dragon Warrior...
A powerful ancient being has returned.
If you succeed in obtaining its power, I’ll reward you.
_5501.CompletionText: The ultimate Dragon Warrior passed down from ancient times!!
_5501.CompletionSummary: You can feel the aura of the Ultimate Dragon Warrior surrounding you...

_5502.Title: Return: Founder of the Royal Knights
_5502.Description:
I can’t believe the founder of the Royal Knights has returned to the Digital World!
I’ll prove my strength and earn the recognition of the founder!
Tamer, will you help me?
_5502.Objective: Defeat <Ultimate Dragon Warrior> Imperialdramon Paladin Mode at D-Terminal Underground Summoning Room.
_5502.CompletionText: Try using the item I gave you at the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Room!
_5502.CompletionSummary:
The founder of the Royal Knights... To witness the return of the Ultimate Dragon Warrior.
Maybe one day, I can become that strong too?

_5522.Title: Halloween Event
_5522.Summary: [Sub] Trick or Treat! Come get your Halloween gift!
_5522.Description: Can’t you smell that sweet candy scent? We're giving all Tamers a special gift during the event~

_5522.CompletionSummary: Trick or Treat~! Come visit again soon!

_5523.Title: Halloween Event
_5523.Description: Lately, I’ve heard that Soulmon in the Village of the Beginning has been hiding Halloween Boxes! When you open one, you might find a letter — one of ‘H’, ‘W’, ‘E’, or ‘N’! Sounds fun, right?
_5523.Objective: Scan the <Halloween Letter Box> to collect letters
_5523.CompletionText: Don’t stop hunting! Monsters keep dropping boxes~
_5523.CompletionSummary: Wow! You completed "HWEEN"!? Here’s your reward!

_5524.Title: Card Game
_5524.Description: It’s been a while, but I’ve prepared a card game. Want to give it a try?
_5524.CompletionText: Test your luck and see what you get!

_5525.Title: Beyond the Limit, Seat of the Void
_5525.Description:
"What is this tremendous energy?
You've finally surpassed your limits.
I will bestow upon you a fitting title for the new Seat of the Void."
_5525.Objective: Talk to Omegamon with [Extreme] Alphamon Ouryuken.
_5525.CompletionSummary: A new realm beyond the ultimate... I hope we can meet again at an even higher level.

_5526.Title: Beyond the Limit, Seat of the Void
_5526.Description:
Face the Seat of the Void that has reached Extreme beyond Awakening
Tamer!! Prove your own resistance!!
_5526.Objective: Defeat <Evolution Beyond the Ultimate> Alphamon Ouryuken in the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Room.
_5526.CompletionText: If you use the item I gave you in the D-Terminal, you can summon the Seat of the Void.
_5526.CompletionSummary:
Tamer, it was an excellent battle.
Please take this as well!
