As a reward, you can obtain a powerful Digimon Buff.
<Designated Villain Digimon> - Appears on Friday: Examon
_5530.CompletionText:
Clear Shadow Digimon Labyrinth [Hard]!!
<Defeat Evil Digimon> - Appears on Friday: Examon
_5530.CompletionSummary: You have successfully cleared Shadow Digimon Labyrinth [Hard]. Here is your promised reward.

_5531.Title: Shadow Digimon Labyrinth
_5531.Description:
Defeat the designated villain Digimon in Shadow Digimon Labyrinth (Hard) and break through the dungeon.
As a reward, you can obtain a powerful Digimon Buff.
<Designated Villain Digimon> - Appears on Saturday: Gallantmon Crimson Mode
_5531.Objective: Defeat Gallantmon Crimson Mode appearing on Saturday.
_5531.CompletionText:
Clear Shadow Digimon Labyrinth [Hard]!!
<Defeat Evil Digimon> - Appears on Saturday: Gallantmon Crimson Mode
_5531.CompletionSummary: You have successfully cleared Shadow Digimon Labyrinth [Hard]. Here is your promised reward.

_5532.Title: Shadow Digimon Labyrinth
_5532.Description:
Defeat the designated villain Digimon in Shadow Digimon Labyrinth (Hard) and break through the dungeon.
As a reward, you can obtain a powerful Digimon Buff.
<Designated Villain Digimon> - Appears on Sunday: Apocalymon
_5532.CompletionText:
Clear Shadow Digimon Labyrinth [Hard]!!
<Defeat Evil Digimon> - Appears on Sunday: Apocalymon
_5532.CompletionSummary: You have successfully cleared Shadow Digimon Labyrinth [Hard]. Here is your promised reward.

_5533.Title: Dungeon Reward
_5533.Description: Stop Susanoomon who is trying to destroy the world!!
_5533.Objective: Defeat the God of Destruction and Regeneration.
_5533.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat the God of Destruction and Regeneration%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5533.CompletionText: Stop Susanoomon who is trying to destroy the world!!

_5534.Title: Dungeon Reward
_5534.Description:
The entrance of Royal Base has opened.
Now, show your faith to Yggdrasill!
_5534.CompletionText:
The entrance of Royal Base has opened.
Now, show your faith to Yggdrasill!
_5534.CompletionSummary: I have confirmed your conviction. Thank you.

_5535.Title: Valentine
_5535.Description: Hello, Tamer! The Valentine’s energy has faded, and the fairy has gone missing. If you search for the fairy and collect Valentine Coins, I’ll give you a gift filled with Valentine’s blessing.
_5535.Objective: Collect Valentine Coins in the Forest of Marionette and the Lake of the Beginning.
_5535.CompletionText: They say a fairy has disappeared in the forest where Valentine’s energy has faded. Tamer, would you like to follow these mysterious traces?
_5535.CompletionSummary: Well done, Tamer! You found the fairy and restored Valentine’s energy. Here, please accept this gift filled with Valentine’s blessing!

_5536.Title: Valentine
_5536.Description: Sob… I don’t know why tears keep falling… I don’t understand why I was hurt like this. Please find him in the forest and uncover the reason, Tamer!
_5536.Objective: Defeat Angemon in the Forest of Marionette or the Lake of the Beginning.
_5536.CompletionText: Sob… Tamer, please help me. Find Angemon in the Forest of Marionette and the Forest of the Beginning, and uncover the reason why I was made to cry.
_5536.CompletionSummary: Sob… thank you, Tamer…! Thanks to you, my heart feels much lighter now. At last, I can stop crying and present you with this achievement.

_5537.Title: Hot Summer Festival
_5537.Summary: A gift for our thankful Tamers
_5537.Description:
Hello! The Hot Summer Festival has begun! Just like the blazing heat of summer, our hearts have been fired up thanks to all you Tamers. So, we’ve prepared a special gift for you.
Will you accept it, Tamer?
(This quest reward can only be claimed once during the event period.)
_5537.CompletionSummary: This is a token of gratitude for protecting the Digital World all this time. Be sure not to forget, and claim your reward before the Hot Summer Festival ends.

_5538.Title: Satan's Wrath
_5538.Description:
.....
(The Dragon of the Apocalypse reacts to the power of the Seven Deadly Sins.)
_5538.CompletionText: I will become a god-like being.
_5538.CompletionSummary:
Finally, I have become complete.
I will restore order to this world. Even if I have to destroy it to do so.

_5539.Title: Satan's Wrath
_5539.Description:
This world is only complete in chaos.
You must be reborn by my will.
So, Tamer…Will you dare to challenge me like this?
_5539.Objective: Summon and defeat <Dragon of the Apocalypse>Lucemon: Wild 2nd Mode at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square.
_5539.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Lucemon: Wild 2nd Mode<Dragon of the Apocalypse>%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5539.CompletionText: The Apocalypse of World's End begins right here.
_5539.CompletionSummary: Don’t be relieved, Tamer. You cannot escape the fate already set by the Apocalypse.

_5540.Title: Hot Summer Festival
_5540.Summary: Don’t miss your Ticket Exchange Coupon!
_5540.Description:
During the Hot Summer Festival event, you can collect watermelons of all sizes!!
Bring enough watermelons to me, and I’ll give you an Exchange Coupon that can be traded for a very valuable ticket!
(This quest reward can only be claimed once during the event period.)
_5540.CompletionSummary: The ticket is given only once, so please be careful not to lose it!!

_5541.Title: Season Pass
_5541.Description:
It’s so hot that even the espresso machine seems to be sweating from the lingering summer heat.
For a robot like me, this late heat is truly my weakness.
It’s gotten so hot that I’ve been dropping pieces of my data all around the Digital World.
Could you spare a moment to help me, Tamer?
_5541.Objective: Collect 30 Data Fragments dropped by Ballistamon.
_5541.CompletionText: (Data Fragments dropped by Ballistamon can be obtained by defeating villain Digimon in all areas except Yokohama Village and Kaiser’s Domain.)
_5541.CompletionSummary:
Thanks to you, I feel much more at ease and less sluggish.
Thank you, Tamer.

_5542.Title: Season Pass
_5542.Summary: [Daily] Catch the Flames of Late Summer Heat
_5542.Description:
The lingering heat is getting worse due to Zhuqiaomon, who suddenly appeared in town.
Tamer, could you help drive out the cause of this lingering summer heat?
_5542.Objective: Defeat Zhuqiaomon <Bringer of Late Summer Heat> 1 time.
_5542.CompletionText: The culprit, Zhuqiaomon <Bringer of Late Summer Heat>, has been spotted in Yokohama Village.
_5542.CompletionSummary: Thanks to your help, this lingering summer heat will soon be gone. I appreciate your efforts.

_5543.Title: Last Evolution
_5543.Description:
I never thought the day would come for us to fight together again.
Tamer, let’s join forces and defeat Eosmon!!
_5543.Objective: Talk to Agumon located at the DATS Center
_5543.CompletionText: (Gripping the Digivice of Courage tightly, you look at Agumon.)
_5543.CompletionSummary: Yeah, I’m ready, Agumon. It’s time to show the power of our Courage.

_5544.Title: Last Evolution
_5544.Description:
Izzy has succeeded in tracking down Eosmon.
Let’s chase them to prevent Eosmon from entering the Real World.
_5544.Objective: Use Izzy’s laptop at the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area
_5544.CompletionText: At the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area, you can summon Eosmon by using Izzy’s laptop.
_5544.CompletionSummary: I think we’ve succeeded in stopping Eosmon. As expected, we’re the best partners.

_5545.Title: Last Evolution
_5545.Description:
I’m sure we took down all the Eosmon...
There’s information that Eosmon has appeared in Yokohama Village.
I can sense a power on a whole different level from the Eosmon we saw before... But as long as you’re by my side, I’ll never back down!
_5545.Objective: Defeat Eosmon appearing in Yokohama Village
_5545.CompletionText: Let’s defeat Eosmon appearing in Yokohama Village.
_5545.CompletionSummary: This time, it was a really tough battle…

_5546.Title: Last Evolution
_5546.Description:
Eosmon is controlling the partner Digimons’ data with powerful force!!
It’s not over yet, Tai!!
Let’s go save our friends!
_5546.Objective: Use the Faded Pattern at the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area
_5546.CompletionText: At the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area, you can summon controlled partner Digimon by using the Faded Pattern.

_5547.Title: Last Evolution
_5547.Description:
This could be our last battle. But it’s okay. You’re my best partner.
Digivolve me, Tai!!
_5547.Objective: Defeat Eosmon appearing in Minato City
_5547.CompletionText: Your Courage and my strength as one! Now… let’s finish this!
_5547.CompletionSummary: We… we won! But why does my chest hurt so much… Tai, what’s going to happen?

_5548.Title: Last Evolution
_5548.Description:
It’s all over now…
I’m still the same, but you’ve grown up, haven’t you?
_5548.Objective: Check the Digivice together with Agumon.
_5548.CompletionText: Tai… thank you. I was happy because you were with me.
_5548.CompletionSummary: Next time we meet… I want to be friends with you again.

_5549.Title: Last Evolution
_5549.Description:
Let’s go, Agumon!!
This is our bond of Courage!!
_5549.Objective: Defeat Eosmon in Yokohama Village. Defeat Eosmon in Minato City.
_5549.CompletionText: Eosmon appears in Yokohama Village, and in Minato City at set intervals.
_5549.CompletionSummary: I’m glad you’ve been with me until now. You were the first to believe in me… thank you.

_5550.Title: Last Evolution
_5550.Description:
Let’s go, Agumon!!
This is you and my… our final evolution!!
_5550.Objective: Defeat Eosmon [Ultimate] in Yokohama Village. Defeat Eosmon [Mega] in Minato City.
_5550.CompletionText: Eosmon appears in Yokohama Village, and in Minato City at set intervals.
_5550.CompletionSummary:
(Tai, you’ve really grown up)
I’m still the same. That’s right!!
Together we…
(No answer comes back.)

_5551.Title: Last Evolution
_5551.Description:
I never thought the day would come for us to fight together again.
Tamer, let’s join forces and defeat Eosmon!!
_5551.Objective: Talk to Gabumon located at the DATS Center
_5551.CompletionText: (Gripping the Digivice of Friendship tightly, you look at Gabumon.)
_5551.CompletionSummary:
Yeah, I’m ready, Agumon.
It’s time to show the power of our Courage.

_5552.Title: Last Evolution
_5552.Description:
Izzy has succeeded in tracking Eosmon.
Let’s chase them down to keep the Eosmon from entering the Real World.
_5552.Objective: Use Izzy’s laptop at the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area
_5552.CompletionText: At the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area, you can summon Eosmon by using Izzy’s laptop.
_5552.CompletionSummary: I think we’ve succeeded in stopping Eosmon. As expected, we’re the best partners.

_5553.Title: Last Evolution
_5553.Description:
I’m sure we took down all the Eosmon…
But we’ve got intel that Eosmon has appeared in Yokohama Village.
This one feels far stronger than the Eosmon we saw before… But as long as you’re by my side, I’ll never back down!
_5553.Objective: Defeat Eosmon appearing in Yokohama Village
_5553.CompletionText: Let’s defeat Eosmon appearing in Yokohama Village.
_5553.CompletionSummary: This time, it was a really tough battle…

_5554.Title: Last Evolution
_5554.Description:
Eosmon is controlling the data of partner Digimon with immense power!!
It’s not over yet, Matt!!
Let’s go save our friends!
_5554.Objective: Use the Faded Pattern at the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area
_5554.CompletionText: At the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area, you can summon controlled partner Digimon by using the Faded Pattern.

_5555.Title: Last Evolution
_5555.Description:
This could be our last battle. But it’s okay. You’re my best partner.
Let’s go, Matt!! Digivolve me!!
_5555.Objective: Defeat Eosmon appearing in Minato City
_5555.CompletionText: It’s time to show the power of our Friendship!!
_5555.CompletionSummary: We… we won! But why does my chest hurt so much… Matt, what’s going to happen?

_5556.Title: Last Evolution
_5556.Description:
It’s all over now…
Matt… what will you do tomorrow?
_5556.Objective: Check the Digivice together with Gabumon.
_5556.CompletionText: Matt, because I was with you, we were able to grow.
_5556.CompletionSummary: Matt, you’re my best partner. Thanks to you, we’ve made it this far.

_5557.Title: Last Evolution
_5557.Description:
Now, Gabumon!!
This is our bond of Friendship!!
_5557.Objective: Defeat Eosmon in Yokohama Village. Defeat Eosmon in Minato City.
_5557.CompletionText: Eosmon appears in Yokohama Village, and in Minato City at set intervals.
_5557.CompletionSummary: The me I am now exists because of you, my friend. Thank you, Gabumon.

_5558.Title: Last Evolution
_5558.Description:
Now, Gabumon!!
This is you and my… our final evolution!!
_5558.Objective: Defeat Eosmon in Yokohama Village. Defeat Eosmon [Mega] in Minato City.
_5558.CompletionText: Eosmon appears in Yokohama Village, and in Minato City at set intervals.
_5558.CompletionSummary:
(Matt, you’re my proud partner)
That’s right, tomorrow…
(No answer comes back.)

_5559.Title: Last Evolution
_5559.Description:
With our Courage and Friendship, we were able to overcome any crisis.
Grateful for the one and only Kizuna that connected us, I’ll hand you the Proof of Kizuna.
_5559.CompletionText: Receive the Proof of our Courage and Friendship.

_5560.Title: Last Evolution
_5560.Description:
No matter what obstacles come our way, nothing can stop our Courage and Friendship.
So, Tamer, do you think you can surpass our bond?
_5560.Objective: Defeat Last Evolution: Kizuna at the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area
_5560.CompletionText: At the D-Terminal Underground Summoning Area, you can summon Last Evolution: Kizuna by using the Chosen Digivice.
_5560.CompletionSummary:
Your bond as Tamers and partner Digimon is quite something.
I hope that Kizuna and possibility will continue on.

_5561.Title: Tutorial
_5561.Summary: For the Rapid Maintenance of DATS Members! (Preset)
_5561.Description:
You’ve become a respectable DATS member.
This time, something new has been added for the rapid maintenance of DATS members.
Here, use the card key I give you to unlock the faster path of maintenance, [Preset].
_5561.Objective: Talk to Richard Sampson and receive the card key to unlock the Preset system.
_5561.CompletionText: (Talk to Richard Sampson and receive the [Preset Unlock Card Key].)
_5561.CompletionSummary:
Insert this card key into the place where the Preset is unlocked, and once you unlock it, you can use the Preset permanently.
Since the Preset unlock applies to each slot individually, it’s best to carefully check the slot before deciding.

_5562.Title: Digimon Cheer Captain
_5562.Description: Join me in cheering for Dramon! Amazing rewards await!
_5562.CompletionSummary: Who will win – Goddramon or Holydramon?

_5563.Title: Thanksgiving
_5563.Description:
Hi~! It’s Thanksgiving~! The table is decorated beautifully, but there’s no food at all?! I can’t finish everything in time by myself… will you help me~?”
We need to make both Pumpkin Pie and Roast Turkey! Once both dishes are complete, everyone can sit happily at the table!
You can enter the dungeon guided by Palmon, get the ingredient boxes, and cook the dishes!
_5563.Objective: Craft Pumpkin Pie and Roast Turkey
_5563.CompletionText:
You opened the ingredient box, right~? You’ll need ingredients like pumpkin, flour, butter, honey, cinnamon, turkey meat, cranberries, herbs, salt, and secret sauce to cook!
Make the Pumpkin Pie sweet, and the Roast Turkey golden and crispy! Doesn’t the smell alone make you hungry?
_5563.CompletionSummary:
Wow~ You made everything look so beautiful! And the smell is amazing! Thanks to you, our village’s Table of Gratitude is complete~! Thank you so much!
Here, this is from me. Please take the ‘Basket of Abundance’! Hehe~

_5564.Title: The power of the Four Great Dragons
_5564.Description: I can feel the radiant power of the golden martial dragon, Goddramon, within you. Wishing that you may defeat the evil forces threatening the Digital World together with Goddramon, I grant you a special power.
_5564.CompletionText: If you're ready to accept a special power from me, talk to me.
_5564.CompletionSummary: I hope you can drive out the evil from the Digital World together with the Golden Martial Dragon.

_5565.Title: The power of the Four Great Dragons
_5565.Description: I sense the power of Holydramon, the righteous prince of the sky, within you. With the wish that you protect justice in the Digital World alongside Holydramon, I grant you a special power.
_5565.CompletionText: I will grant you a special power. If you're ready, talk to me.
_5565.CompletionSummary: I hope you can protect justice in the Digital World together with the Prince of the Sky.

_5566.Title: The power of the Four Great Dragons
_5566.Summary: [Daily] Trial of the Four Great Dragons - Goddramon
_5566.Description: If you pass the trial of Goddramon, one of the Four Great Dragons, it’s said you will gain the power to confront evil Digimon. Will you take on the challenge, Tamer?
_5566.Objective: Defeat <Golden Martial Dragon> Goddramon in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5566.CompletionText: If you use [Goddramon’s Holy Ring] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you can challenge the Goddramon trial.
_5566.CompletionSummary: You passed the trial… I can feel your power to confront evil has grown.

_5567.Title: The power of the Four Great Dragons
_5567.Summary: [Daily] Trial of the Four Great Dragons - Holydramon
_5567.Description: If you pass the trial of Holydramon, one of the Four Great Dragons, it’s said you will gain the power to purify evil with the light of justice. How about giving it a try?
_5567.Objective: Defeat <Prince of the Sky> Holydramon in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5567.CompletionText: If you use [Holydramon's Light Energy] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you can challenge the Holydramon trial.
_5567.CompletionSummary: You passed the trial… I can feel the justice within you has grown.

_5568.Title: The power of the Four Great Dragons
_5568.Summary: [Sub] Legend of the Four Great Dragons
_5568.Description: Do you know the legend of the Four Great Dragons that exist in the Digital World? According to their legend, those who overcome their trials are greatly blessed. So, Tamer, aren’t you curious?
_5568.Objective: Defeat <Evil-Banisher> Goddramon in the Forest of Beginnings Defeat <Light of Justice> Holydramon in Puppet's Forest Defeat <Ferocious!!> Megidramon in the Gray Empire Defeat Qinglongmon in the Descending Thunder God (Normal) dungeon
_5568.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Goddramon<Evil-Banisher>%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat Holydramon<Light of Justice>%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs2Defeat Megidramon<Ferocious!!>%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs2Qinglongmon 처치%qe %cc2/%mc2
_5568.CompletionText: To find the Four Great Dragons, you’ll need to thoroughly explore the Digital World.
_5568.CompletionSummary: You’ve overcome all the trials of the Four Great Dragons!! It feels like you can sense their energy.

_5569.Title: The power of the Four Great Dragons
_5569.Description: Holydramon has recognized your trial. That’s truly remarkable!! Let’s begin a great adventure to protect the Digital World together with the righteous prince of the sky!!
_5569.CompletionText: I can feel Holydramon's powerful strength…
_5569.CompletionSummary: Righteous Prince of the Sky!! Holydramon!!

_5570.Title: Passionate! Blazing Jumping!
_5570.Description: Where do you think a Tamer's true strength comes from? Digimon? Digivice? No! A Tamer’s strength comes from the power of the fist born from the heart! There’s a gift to celebrate this once-in-a-lifetime day! But I can’t give it to just anyone! Prove you deserve it with your fist!
_5570.CompletionText: Prove your worth with your fists!
_5570.CompletionSummary: Alright! But it's not enough! Even the strongest shield will break under two fists!! The potential of humans is infinite!!!!!

_5571.Title: Passionate! Blazing Jumping!
_5571.Description: Before we knew it, it’s already the 16th Anniversary of Digimon Masters. Think too much time has passed? No way! With passion and fire, it's no different from the very beginning! Take this gift and clench your fist once more! A man’s fight starts now!
_5571.CompletionText: Even now, I burn just like at the beginning!
_5571.CompletionSummary: Celebrating Digimon Masters’ 16th anniversary! You will grow even stronger with this gift!

_5572.Title: Event Pass
_5572.Summary: [Daily] One more time!! Essence of Destruction
_5572.Description:
I am Agunimon, the Warrior of Flame.
Bring me the powerful traces of Susanoomon’s strength, and with the power of Spirit, I will refine them into the Essence of Destruction.
_5572.Objective: Collect 100 Traces of Destruction and Regeneration in areas excluding Yokohama Village and Kaiser Domain
_5572.CompletionText: The Trace of Destruction and Regeneration items can be found by defeating villain Digimon in areas excluding Yokohama Village and Kaiser’s Domain.
_5572.CompletionSummary:
Thank you. Here is the promised Essence of Destruction.
Don’t forget to stop by every day to accept quests from me.

_5573.Title: Event Pass
_5573.Summary: [Daily] One more time!! Essence of Regeneration
_5573.Description:
I am Wolfmon, the Warrior of Light.
If you gather the mighty energy of dungeon bosses, I will condense it into the Essence of Regeneration through the power of Spirit.
_5573.Objective: Defeat Death-X-mon in the Royal Base Dungeon (Hard) Defeat the God of Destruction and Regeneration in the Destruction and Regeneration Dungeon Defeat Huanglongmon in the Huanglongmon Dungeon(Hard)
_5573.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Death-X-mon%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat God of Destruction and Regeneration%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Defeat Huanglongmon(Hard)%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5573.CompletionText: Defeat the bosses in Huanglongmon (Hard), Royal Base (Hard), and the Destruction and Regeneration dungeons to face their powerful energies.
_5573.CompletionSummary:
The powerful energy of the bosses can be felt around the Tamer.
As promised, I will turn it into the Essence of Regeneration. Don’t forget to stop by every day to accept quests from me.

_5574.Title: EP
_5574.Description:
Everyone’s in a festive mood!!
They say if you prove your strength to Gankoomon, who appeared in Yokohama Village, you’ll earn the right to receive a 16th Anniversary Balloon.
Shall we prove our strength to Gankoomon?
_5574.CompletionText: It seems that Gankoomon appears in Yokohama Village.
_5574.CompletionSummary:
Gankoomon has acknowledged your strength!!
A 16th anniversary balloon — the festival atmosphere is so vivid!

_5575.Title: Season Pass
_5575.Description:
To celebrate the 16th Anniversary, Dats Center has prepared commemorative coins.
But... a lot of the coins seem to be missing...
It must be the work of those mischievous villain Digimons.
Can you check it out for me?
_5575.Objective: Collect 40 16th Anniversary Silver Coins in areas excluding Yokohama Village and Kaiser Domain
_5575.CompletionText: By defeating villain Digimon that appear outside of Yokohama Village and Kaiser’s Domain, you have a chance to obtain 16th Anniversary Coins.
_5575.CompletionSummary:
Thank you for your help, Tamer.
I’ll give you a special 16th anniversary gold coin. Use it wisely!

_5576.Title: Ultimate Nothingness
_5576.Description: The power that destroys everything and the power that regenerates everything. If you embrace these two contradictory powers as one, could that be the Ultimate Nothingness? Feel the fragments of that power yourself.
_5576.Objective: Defeat <Eastern Ultimate Divine Warrior> Susanoomon in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5576.CompletionText: Using [Harmony of Contradiction] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you can witness the Ultimate Divine Warrior who harmonizes the two contradictory powers.
_5576.CompletionSummary: The Ultimate Warrior who harmoniously embraces even the contradiction of destruction and regeneration. How did it feel to experience that power?

_5577.Title: Ultimate Nothingness
_5577.Description: The Ultimate Divine Warrior who controls the power of destruction and regeneration! Feel that transcendental power.
_5577.CompletionText: The extreme of the warrior who freely controls the two contradictory powers fused into one!
_5577.CompletionSummary: Witness the power that surpasses the extreme!

_5578.Title: Seventh Fascinate
_5578.Description:
Lilithmon’s newfound power is luring the Digital World toward destruction.
If we fall for her temptation, the weaker Digimon will be the first to perish.
Tamer, will you join me in saving the Digital World from Lilithmon’s dark schemes?
_5578.Objective: Defeat <The Goddess of Death> Lilithmon (Resistance) in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5578.CompletionText: Use [Sweet Destruction] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square to summon Lilithmon (Resistance).
_5578.CompletionSummary:
That was truly a tough battle…
I couldn’t have overcome it with my courage alone.
You have my gratitude, Tamer.

_5579.Title: Seventh Fascinate
_5579.Description:
The goddess of death who brings forth a sweet and beautiful ruin…
Be careful not to be consumed by her power, or you too may fall into destruction.
_5579.CompletionSummary:
I can feel the gracious embrace of ultimate beauty…
May you use that power for the good of all…

_5580.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5580.Description: The third Dungeon Masters has begun!
_5580.CompletionSummary: Take on the challenge of the preliminaries!

_5581.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5581.Description: To celebrate your participation in the preliminary round, we will be giving out reward!!
_5581.CompletionSummary: You can produce with bigger rewards by participating in the contest.

_5582.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5582.Description: Want to enter the Pro Group Dungeon??
_5582.CompletionSummary: I'll give you a dungeon entry ticket, so challenge yourself to the semi-finals!

_5583.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5583.Description: Shall we try the pro group dungeon?!
_5583.CompletionSummary: That's really great!! Now the team with the highest record will advance to the semifinals!!

_5584.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5584.Description: Should we try the Amateur Group (Normal)?! If you select the (Normal) quest, you will not be able to accept the Amateur (Easy) quest.
_5584.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on clearing the Amateur Group (Normal) quest!

_5585.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5585.Description: Should we try the Amateur Group (EASY)?! If you select the (EASY) quest, you will not be able to accept the Amateur (Normal) quest.
_5585.CompletionSummary: Congratulations on clearing the Amateur Group (EASY) quest!

_5586.Title: Title Event
_5586.Description: You must have heard of it. It's another aspect of Omegamon Zwart. If you can find it yourself, I'll give you a suiting name.
_5586.Objective: Talk to Omegamon with Omegamon Alter-B as your partner
_5586.CompletionText: It's nothing compulsory. Do as you wish.
_5586.CompletionSummary: That's it. Take this title with you.
_5586.ReservedText: So this is a dark reflection of myself? Interesting...

_5587.Title: Tutorial
_5587.Description:
The Unique Tamer Skills have been revamped so you can select a Tamer Skill for your free activities!
Tamer Skills are the Tamer's most powerful tools to support partner Digimon! How you support your Digimon in battle is entirely up to you!
Receive this and choose your desired skill to enjoy an even more exciting adventure!
_5587.CompletionText: Talk to Richard Sampson to receive the Tamer Skill Selection Box.
_5587.CompletionSummary: The new Tamer Skills are permanent! Once learned, you can use them forever! If you want to use a different skill, you can pay the exchange NPC to change it, so don’t worry too much. Good luck!

_5588.Title: Be careful of the winter wind!!
_5588.Description:
Winter is approaching...
When the weather gets colder, it may feel like heaven for us...
But sometimes, there are Digimon friends who cannot handle the chill and become aggressive.
Would you help calm down the ones who've turned violent?
_5588.CompletionText: They say a <Violent> Yukidarumon is appearing in the Snowstorm Village, where the cold energy gathers.
_5588.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much for your help, Tamer!!

_5589.Title: Be careful of the winter wind!!
_5589.Description: They say a Wendimon appearing in Yokohama Village has taken all the cocoa in town!!
_5589.Objective: Defeat the Wendimon that appeared in Yokohama Village and collect Hot Cocoa.
_5589.CompletionText:
Let's defeat the Wendimon in Yokohama Village and retrieve the Cocoa!
How about sharing the recovered Cocoa with your closest friend?
_5589.CompletionSummary:
Ah—hot!!!!
Giving hot Cocoa to a snowman!! I could melt if you're not careful!!
...
(But it seems the Cocoa has cooled down just enough to drink.)

_5590.Title: Final Phase of the Adventure Story
_5590.Description:
The power of Minus Data is truly magnificent…
To conduct research on the power of Minus Data, an enormous amount of battle data is required.
If you help me, I will provide a corresponding reward.
_5590.Objective: Defeat <Final Phase> DoneDevimon in the D-terminal Underground Summon Square
_5590.CompletionText: Using [Minus Data Aggregator] in the D-terminal Underground Summon Square, you can summon DoneDevimon.
_5590.CompletionSummary:
Thanks to you, we now have enough data on Minus Data.
I appreciate it, Tamer.

_5591.Title: Final Phase of the Adventure Story
_5591.Summary: [Sub] Final Phase of the Adventure Story
_5591.Description:
The goddess of death who brings sweet destruction…
You must always be careful not to become so intoxicated by her power that you bring about your own ruin.
_5591.CompletionSummary:
I can feel the generous embrace of ultimate beauty…
May you use your power in a way that benefits everyone…

_5592.Title: Christmas
_5592.Description:
Ho ho! Christmas has arrived in Yokohama Village! It’s time for Santa to test the kindness in your heart. Now then, which path will you choose?
You have chosen the path of the Good Child.
_5592.CompletionSummary: Ho ho, I knew you had a kind heart! Helping others and spreading small joys throughout the world—that is the true spirit of Christmas.

_5593.Title: Christmas
_5593.Description:
Ho ho! Christmas has arrived in Yokohama Village! It’s time for Santa to test the kindness in your heart. Now then, which path will you choose?
You have chosen the path of the Naughty Child.
_5593.CompletionSummary: Ho ho ho? Choosing the path of mischief—how bold of you! Santa is eager to see just how far your playful spirit will go.

_5594.Title: Christmas
_5594.Description:
Ho ho, I knew you had a kind heart! Helping others and spreading small joys across the world— that is the true spirit of Christmas.
If you’re willing, could you go to Snowman Village and defeat Bakemon?
_5594.Objective: Defeat <Nightmare of Christmas> Bakemon appearing in Snowman Village.
_5594.CompletionText: Never lose your kind heart. Even the smallest act of kindness can bring about a great miracle. Ho ho!
_5594.CompletionSummary: Wonderful job! Your good deeds have reached all the way to the North Pole. This reward is Santa’s small token of gratitude for your kind heart. Ho ho ho!

_5595.Title: Christmas
_5595.Description:
Now then, it’s time for the true trial of a mischievous child. Defeat monsters scattered across all maps and bring me 50 Naughty Child Tokens.
But be careful, dear child— monsters in Yokohama Village and Kaiser’s Domain won’t drop any tokens. Ho ho ho!
_5595.Objective: Defeat villain Digimon in all areas except Yokohama Village and Kaiser’s Domain to obtain 50 [Naughty Child Tokens!]
_5595.CompletionText: Too much mischief is never good, but a little harmless fun can bring smiles to everyone! Ho ho.
_5595.CompletionSummary: Mischievous, yes—but quite fun! Even Santa needs a bit of lively energy now and then. Here, this is a special reward prepared thanks to your playful antics. Ho ho ho!

_5596.Title: Christmas
_5596.Description: Wait, hold on! Something terrible happened! A single Naughty Snowman has slipped into the event dungeon! Rudolph tried to track it down, but it’s so cunning that it left no trace at all!
_5596.Objective: Find and defeat the Naughty Yukidarumon in the event dungeon.
_5596.CompletionText: Sniff, sniff… the scent is really faint! It must be hiding somewhere nearby… Be careful! It’s only one, but it’s surprisingly clever!
_5596.CompletionSummary:
You found it?! Really? Wow… you’re amazing, just as I expected! Thanks to you catching that lone Naughty Snowman, Santa Village is much safer now!
Here—this is a gift from Rudolph as thanks! Please take it!

_5597.Title: Arena
_5597.Summary: [Sub] Arena Coin[Hard] for the Climber’s Emblem!
_5597.Description: Bring the Arena Challenge Badge from the top floor through the Arena challenge!!
_5597.CompletionSummary: Here is the emblem awarded to Tamers who succeed in the Arena climb!!

_5598.Title: Powerful Energy of the Four Holy Beasts
_5598.Summary: [Sub] Obtain the Powerful Equipment of the Four Holy Beasts
_5598.Description: Defeat the rampaging Four Heavenly Beasts!!
_5598.Objective: Scar of Water Crystal (Easy) Clear Uprising Flame (Easy) Clear Trace of Black Steel (Easy) Clear Descending Thunder God (Easy) Clear
_5598.CompletionText: If this continues, the Digital World will...
_5598.CompletionSummary: Amazing work stopping the rampaging Four Heavenly Beasts, Tamer!!

_5599.Title: Cry of Destruction
_5599.Summary: [Daily] From the Abyss of the Digital World
_5599.Objective: Defeat Abbadomon<Fear of the Abyss> at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5599.CompletionText: Using [Sphere of the Abyss] at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square allows you to summon Abbadomon<Fear of the Abyss>.
_5599.CompletionSummary:
(...)
I feel as though Negamon is watching me more closely.

_5600.Title: Cry of Destruction
_5600.Description: The cry it releases when destruction is born echoes through the empty air.
_5600.Objective: Set your partner Digimon to Abbadomon, then talk to Negamon
_5600.CompletionText: The cry of Abbadomon being born from the abyss…

_5601.Title: Cry of Destruction
_5601.Description:
(...!..!.!!....!..)
An ominous presence can be felt around Negamon.
Is it just my imagination?
_5601.Objective: Defeat Abbadomon Core<Destroyer of Nothingness> at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5601.CompletionText: Using [Shattered Nothingness] at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square allows you to summon Abbadomon Core<Destroyer of Nothingness>.
_5601.CompletionSummary:
(...)
From Negamon’s eyes, a negative energy beyond emptiness can be felt.

_5602.Title: Cry of Destruction
_5602.Description: Are you afraid. I devour, I devour. Fear, pain, there is nothing of the sort—emptiness, thirst, deficiency, sorrow. I continue to devour. In the end, nothing is born. I, the one who has nothing. I, the one who erases everything. Emptiness, lamentation, I devour, pain, the end… fear… there is nothing… pain… emptiness… lamentation…
_5602.Objective: Set your partner Digimon to Abbadomon Core, then talk to Negamon
_5602.CompletionText: Lamentation... thirst... emptiness... lamentation... I devour... pain. Thirst... deficiency…
_5602.CompletionSummary: The power of great destruction can be felt.

_5603.Title: Season Pass
_5603.Description:
A path of exploration is opening in the Digital World,
and a new wind is blowing.
How about looking back on past journeys and reflecting on them?
_5603.Objective: Defeat villain monsters across all regions except the Frontier area and collect [Emblem of Effort].
_5603.CompletionText: You can obtain [Emblem of Effort] through hunting in all regions you’ve passed through, except the Frontier area.
_5603.CompletionSummary: The effort from your past journey is shining so brightly.

_5604.Title: Season Pass
_5604.Description:
While looking back on past journeys is important, it's also crucial to scout the path ahead.
To ensure the Tamer's path is solid, how about chasing away misfortune?
_5604.Objective: Defeat <Unlucky Lump> Numemon in West Village.
_5604.CompletionText: I’ve heard that a creature wrapped in bad luck appears in West Village. How about checking it out?
_5604.CompletionSummary: Having overcome the bad luck, you’ll be filled with fortune for a while.

_5605.Title: New Year
_5605.Summary: [Daily] Awaken Your Luck! An Unusual New Year!
_5605.Description:
With the New Year, unusual luck is gathering in the Digital World.
Especially, an unusual creature has appeared at the camping site could you take a look?
_5605.Objective: Defeat <Unusual> Sleipmon at the Camping Site.
_5605.CompletionText: Please defeat the <Unusual> villain Digimon that appears at the Camping Site.
_5605.CompletionSummary:
Thank you, Tamer.
We’ll share this unusual luck with you as well!

_5606.Title: Ultimate Nothingness
_5606.Description:
The Ultimate guardian god governing Destruction and Regeneration.
If you wish to gain the power of Destruction and Regeneration, defeat the Destruction and Regeneration that appeared in the Digital World and bring me the Mark of the Cycle.
_5606.Objective:
Defeat <Circulating Destruction> KaiserGreymon appearing in Western Village and collect the Mark of the Cycle.
Defeat <Circulating Regeneration> MagnaGarurumon appearing in Snowstorm Village and collect the Mark of the Cycle.
_5606.CompletionText: [Mark of the Cycle] can be obtained by defeating <Circulating Destruction> KaiserGreymon appearing in Western Village and <Circulating Regeneration> MagnaGarurumon appearing in Snowstorm Village.
_5606.CompletionSummary: You can feel the energy of Destruction and Regeneration beginning to circulate around you. Keep advancing dilig

_5607.Title: New Semester Jumping
_5607.Summary: [Daily] Enjoy the New Semester with Flame Jumping!!
_5607.Description: Gather the New Semester Flame in the Digital World, and defeat the Dazzling Flame [DemiMeramon] to make the Flame of Leap burn even brighter!!
_5607.Objective: Defeat <Dazzling Flame>DemiMeramon in the Silent Forest or File Island Waterfront. Defeat villain Digimon across all areas and collect [New Semester Flame].
_5607.CompletionText: The Dazzling Flame [DemiMeramon] appears in the Slient Forest and File Island Waterfront.
_5607.CompletionSummary: Let's make our flame burn even brighter tomorrow, Tamer!!

_5608.Title: New Semester Jumping
_5608.Description: Won't you help me make the new semester's flame shine brilliantly??
_5608.Objective: Defeat <Dazzling Flame>DemiMeramon in the Silent Forest and File Island Waterfront. Defeat <Brilliant Flame>DemiMeramon in Western Village.
_5608.CompletionText:
In Western Village, the Brilliant Flame [DemiMeramon] appears to light up the dark night.
It's best to wait by timing its appearance carefully.
_5608.CompletionSummary:
Our flame has become even more dazzlingly bright!
Thank you, Tamer!!

_5609.Title: Go Go's Holy Knight
_5609.Description:
(Is this the true essence of Yggdrasil...)
But I... and we!!
We shall resist this cruel fate!!
_5609.Objective: Defeat Omegamon X<Essence of Yggdrasil> in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5609.CompletionText: Using [Essence of Yggdrasil] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square will summon Omegamon X<Essence of Yggdrasil>
_5609.CompletionSummary: All life is said to survive…

_5610.Title: Go Go's Holy Knight
_5610.Description:
Omegamon, whose extreme battle sense and potential have blossomed!!
Who dares to face this noble Pure White Holy Knight!!
_5610.Objective: Set your partner Digimon to [Extreme] Omegamon X, then talk to Dorumon
_5610.CompletionSummary:
Eradicate with the Sword of Erasure!
The Silver White Holy Knight, armed with the Blade of Courage and the Cannon of Friendship!!"

_5611.Title: Season Pass
_5611.Description: I found a pretty old zero score test paper while walking along the road.\n Whose test paper could this zero score paper belong to?
_5611.Objective: Defeat villain Digimon in all regions and collect the [Zero Score Test Papers] that someone intentionally hid.
_5611.CompletionText: You can probably obtain [Zero Score Test Papers] by defeating villain Digimon throughout the Digital World.
_5611.CompletionSummary:
(No! That test paper...!) (I’m sure I hid it properly...!)
Ahem... You’ve collected "Paper Scraps" in the Digital World for everyone.
I’ll personally recycle these "Paper Scraps" so no one else can find them.
Thank you, Tamer.

_5612.Title: Season Pass
_5612.Summary: [Daily] Owner of the Nameless Test Paper
_5612.Description:
Huh? While grading test papers, I found one with no name written on it.
Whose test paper could it be? Can you check for me?
_5612.Objective: Use the [Nameless Test Paper] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square and defeat the Digimon that appears.
_5612.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1The Digimon that forgot to write its name%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5612.CompletionText:
Can you help find the owner?!
If you use the [Test Paper] in the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, the owner of the test paper will appear.
_5612.CompletionSummary:
So many friends didn’t write their names?
Let’s make sure to double-check whether we wrote our names and marked our test papers properly.

_5613.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5613.Description: Do you want to participate in Dungeon Masters?
_5613.CompletionText: If you are ready to participate in Dungeon Masters, talk to me again.
_5613.CompletionSummary: Let's hatch and raise the Digimon egg I gave you well and challenge the Preliminary Round!

_5614.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5614.Description:
Are you ready for the Preliminary Round? Hurry up!
Did you raise the Digimon I gave you well?
_5614.CompletionSummary: I am the Level-Up Master of Dungeon Masters!!

_5615.Title: Dungeon Masters
_5615.Description:
Congratulations on advancing to the Main Round!!
Shall we now officially enter the competition of Dungeon Masters?
_5615.CompletionText:
The real competition starts now!!
Enter the prepared Main Round dungeon and prove your strength!!
_5615.CompletionSummary: I am the Conqueror of the Main Round of Dungeon Masters!!

_5616.Title: What day is it today?
_5616.Description: Don’t you want to open that box you have?
_5616.Objective: Obtain [Key] by hunting in all areas except the Frontier region.
_5616.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Find the key that fits the April Fools’ Box%qe %cc1/%mc1
_5616.CompletionText:
Hehehe, bring me a key if you want to open the box.
Defeat Villain Digimon in all areas except the Frontier region; a key might drop… or it might not…

_5617.Title: Let's Plant Trees!!!
_5617.Description: Hello, Tamer. It's a really nice day. It's a perfect day to plant trees full of vitality. With that in mind, could you bring me some seeds so I can plant trees? I want to plant new trees full of life.
_5617.Objective: Defeat Woodmon in all regions and collect seeds.
_5617.CompletionText: Let's plant new trees full of life.
_5617.CompletionSummary: You can feel the overflowing vitality. It will surely grow into a magnificent tree!

_5618.Title: New Semester Jumping
_5618.Summary: [Daily][Event Pass] Enjoy the New Semester with Flame Jumping!!
_5618.Description: Gather the New Semester Flame in the Digital World, and defeat the Dazzling Flame [DemiMeramon] to make the Flame of Leap burn even brighter!!
_5618.Objective: Defeat <Dazzling Flame>DemiMeramon in the Silent Forest or File Island Waterfront. Defeat villain Digimon across all areas and collect [New Semester Flame].
_5618.CompletionText: The Dazzling Flame [DemiMeramon] appears in the Slient Forest and File Island Waterfront.
_5618.CompletionSummary: Let's make our flame burn even brighter tomorrow, Tamer!!

_5619.Title: New Semester Jumping
_5619.Description: Won't you help me make the new semester's flame shine brilliantly??
_5619.Objective: Defeat <Dazzling Flame>DemiMeramon in the Silent Forest and File Island Waterfront. Defeat <Brilliant Flame>DemiMeramon in Western Village.
_5619.CompletionText:
In Western Village, the Brilliant Flame [DemiMeramon] appears to light up the dark night.
It's best to wait by timing its appearance carefully.
_5619.CompletionSummary:
Our flame has become even more dazzlingly bright!
Thank you, Tamer!!

_5620.Title: Spring Cleaning!
_5620.Description: Hello, Tamer! Warm spring has arrived! To celebrate spring, we’re doing a big cleanup! A tough cleanup wouldn’t be fair without rewards! Bring the accumulated winter dust and you’ll get a reward! Clean thoroughly and welcome the spring!
_5620.Objective: Defeat monsters in all areas and collect [Sparkling Spring Energy].
_5620.CompletionText: It’s warm spring~ It must feel great to clean up nicely, right?
_5620.CompletionSummary: Yahoo~ I like spring the best~

_5621.Title: 2026 Family Month
_5621.Description:
Nice to meet you, Cucu!
It's Family Month, Cucu!
If you do good deeds with me, Culumon, I'll give you something nice!
_5621.Objective: Talk to <Family Month>Culumon and check today's good deed.
_5621.CompletionSummary: Open the Good Deed Pouch I gave you and check what today's good deed is!!

_5622.Title: 2026 Family Month
_5622.Summary: [Daily] Let's show filial piety to Babamon, Cucu!
_5622.Description:
Welcome.
You want to help this Babamon? What a kind Tamer.
Jijimon has gone missing somewhere, and I was just looking for him.
Take this clock. If you show it to him, he'll understand what it's about.
_5622.Objective: Defeat Jijimon <Aching All Over> at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square
_5622.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Jijimon <Aching All Over>%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Possess Today's Good Deed Note%qe %cc2/%mc2
_5622.CompletionText: If you use [Jijimon's Secret Clock] at the D-Terminal Underground Summon Square, you can summon Jijimon <Aching All Over>.
_5622.CompletionSummary:
(So you found out about the secret clock I carefully bought...)
It looks like your walk outside lasted quite a while. Thank you for coming to tell me, Tamer.
I should... head back in now...
(I wonder if it's just my imagination that Jijimon's steps look heavier...)

_5623.Title: 2026 Family Month
_5623.Description:
Welcome, Tamer.
You came to help me? How kind of you!
Then since the weather is so nice, please help me clean up the surroundings.
_5623.Objective: Defeat villain Digimon and collect [Environmental Cleanup! Cucu!].
_5623.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Collect Environmental Cleanup! Cucu!%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Possess Today's Good Deed Note%qe %cc2/%mc2
_5623.CompletionText: [Environmental Cleanup! Cucu!] can be obtained at a low rate by defeating villain Digimon across all areas except the Frontier region.
_5623.CompletionSummary:
Good job, Tamer.
Thanks to you, the surroundings have become much cleaner! I would appreciate it if you could help again from time to time.

_5624.Title: 2026 Family Month
_5624.Description:
Hello, Tamer?
The weather is nice, do you want to play with me?
You won't play with me...? You will, right?
_5624.ObjectiveProgress: %qs1Defeat Puppetmon <Shall we play?>%qe %cc1/%mc1 %qs2Defeat WaruMonzaemon <Shall we play?>%qe %cc2/%mc2 %qs3Possess Today's Good Deed Note%qe %cc3/%mc3
_5624.CompletionText: <Shall we play?>Puppetmon and WaruMonzaemon appear in Yokohama Village and the Silent Forest respectively.
_5624.CompletionSummary:
Hehehe... that was fun...
Don't forget about me, and let's play together again next time, okay?

_5625.Title: Silver Lake
_5625.Description: Hello! Welcome to the Beautiful Silver Lake in the Digital World! Let me introduce you to my friends!
_5625.CompletionText: I'm Agumon! While meeting my friends, take a look around the beautiful Silver Lake!
_5625.CompletionSummary: The first friend I’d like to introduce is Patamon! Go see Patamon!

_5626.Title: Silver Lake
_5626.Description: Hello! I'm Patamon. You must have been introduced by Agumon! Welcome to the Silver Lake!
_5626.CompletionText: Explore Silver Lake and talk with the friends you'll meet!
_5626.CompletionSummary: Next up is Salamon! Head over to Salamon!

_5627.Title: Silver Lake
_5627.Description: Nice to meet you, Tamer! I'm Salamon! May your journey be blessed! Hehe
_5627.CompletionText: Hehe. Silver Lake is as beautiful as ever today, thanks to the kind Tamers.
_5627.CompletionSummary: While you’ve been exploring Silver Lake, I’ve contacted Armadimon. Armadimon should be waiting for you!

_5628.Title: Silver Lake
_5628.Description: Yahoo! Hello! You must be the Tamer Agumon mentioned!
_5628.CompletionText: How did you like the Silver Lake you've seen so far? Isn't it fun to see so many Digimon living together?
_5628.CompletionSummary: Always stay safe and have fun! Elder Cherrymon is waiting for you. Go pay him a visit!

_5629.Title: Silver Lake
_5629.Description: Hello there. I am Cherrymon, the Elder of Silver Lake.
_5629.CompletionText:
“What do you think of the Silver Lake you've seen? Peaceful and beautiful, right?
Thanks to the efforts of countless Tamers, Silver Lake has become what it is today. There are many places in the Digital World like Silver Lake that are waiting for a helping hand.
Take this token and bag, and continue your adventure, Tamer. I've already contacted the Silent Forest. I wish you luck in the journey ahead.”
_5629.CompletionSummary: We are always grateful for your help.

_5630.Title: Silent Forest
_5630.Description: Hohoho, nice to meet you. I heard about you from Cherrymon. I'm Babamon. And this old fella here is Jijimon.
_5630.CompletionText: You've worked hard to get this far. How do you like the Silent Forest? Quite peaceful, isn't it?
_5630.CompletionSummary: This Silent Forest used to be quite lively. That old storyteller Jijimon might tell you all about it.

_5631.Title: Silent Forest
_5631.Description: Hahaha, nice to meet you! I'm Jijimon! Just an old Digimon who enjoys telling tales from the past.
_5631.CompletionText:
“In the past, this Silent Forest was anything but silent. Contrary to its name, Digimon were constantly at odds, leading to endless conflicts.
But it was Tamers like you who restored peace and tranquility to the Silent Forest. Seeing you reminds me of those Tamers from back then!”
_5631.CompletionSummary: “Your adventure is just beginning. You may still be inexperienced. But Tamer, everyone starts that way. May shining wisdom and fitting fortune accompany your path. Hahaha!”

_5632.Title: Silent Forest
_5632.Description:
“Oh dear! This old man has talked too long again. Another friend of yours is waiting.
Go on, head over to Elecmon. I've marked the location on your map, so you should have no trouble finding it.”
_5632.CompletionText: Are you that Tamer? You don't look as reliable as I expected.
_5632.CompletionSummary: To become a hero, you need to be much more confident and reliable!

_5633.Title: Silent Forest
_5633.Description:
“Anyway, nice to meet you! I'm Elecmon. You could say I'm the Guardian of the Silent Forest!
From what I see, you still have a long way to go!”
_5633.CompletionText: Well, fine! I'll let it slide! Take this and walk with more confidence from now on!
_5633.CompletionSummary: “Hmm! Standing tall and confident looks much better on you! Do you see that bonfire over there? Leomon is waiting for you, so go see him! I hope this turns out to be an amazing adventure!”

_5634.Title: Silent Forest
_5634.Description: “So, you’re that Tamer! Nice to meet you! I’m Leomon! I serve as the Sentinel of the Silent Forest!
_5634.CompletionText: “Here! Take this token! This token is only given to Tamers who show potential. You received a token from Elder Cherrymon too, right? Take good care of it.”
_5634.CompletionSummary: “The Sentinel of the Historic is also waiting for you! Have a pleasant journey!”

_5635.Title: Lost Historic
_5635.Description: Nice to meet you! I’m Hawkmon, the Sentinel of this Historic site! I’ve heard a lot about you from other Sentinels!
_5635.CompletionText: “But right now, it's hard to give you the token. After the strange cogwheel was found in the ruins, Digimon have started to act ferociously. While I'm dealing with it, please assist Terriermon, who's investigating the origin of the cogwheel!”
_5635.CompletionSummary: Making Digimon behave strangely… what could be the cause?

_5636.Title: Lost Historic
_5636.Summary: What is the identity of the Cogwheel?
_5636.CompletionText: Hello! I'm Terriermon, Hawkmon's assistant. I'm investigating the path through which Digimon have become ferocious. From what I've found, the Digimon started becoming more aggressive from that direction! I'll try to stop the ferocious Digimon on this side, so please investigate over there!”
_5636.CompletionSummary: I was peacefully exploring the ruins, and now this… what’s going on?

_5637.Title: Lost Historic
_5637.CompletionText: “Ah!!!! You can't go that way now! Leomon, the Sentinel of the Silent Forest, has suddenly gone berserk and is attacking everyone…..”
_5637.CompletionSummary: “A cogwheel? I don’t think I saw anything like that while escaping. But Elder Cherrymon is over there. Ask him about it!”

_5638.Title: Lost Historic
_5638.Description: “This is really bad. Even the Sentinel Leomon has fallen—who could have done such a thing? Signs of the end of peace are upon us.”
_5638.CompletionText: “I'm glad you made it here safely, Tamer! For now, we need to bring Leomon back to his senses. Wise Jijimon might know how to do it.”
_5638.CompletionSummary: Hurry, Tamer. Once Leomon regains his senses, we might find out who’s behind all this.

_5639.Title: Lost Historic
_5639.Summary: How to make Leomon regain consciousness?
_5639.Description: This way, Tamer! Hahaha, you’ve been through a lot.
_5639.CompletionText:
“That Leomon… he used to be so cool-headed, and now he's suddenly like this. It seems to be because of that strange black cogwheel… We probably need to destroy it.
Babamon is watching over Leomon over there. Go find her quickly.”

_5640.Title: Lost Historic
_5640.Description: “Hohoho… this way, Tamer! To bring Leomon back to his senses, you need to destroy this Black Cogwheel!
_5640.CompletionText: Take this cogwheel and destroy it!
_5640.CompletionSummary: Oh dear… he’s really rampaging fiercely.

_5641.Title: Lost Historic
_5641.Description: Please destroy the cogwheel!” “To think that Leomon and other Digimon could be driven to this point… Who could have created this cogwheel… Wait? This energy!!!!”
_5641.CompletionText: “This energy… it’s Devimon’s energy… It seems Devimon is plotting a terrible scheme.”
_5641.CompletionSummary: Hmm… this is serious, truly serious.

_5642.Title: Lost Historic
_5642.Description:
Have you been to shore? Not the shore in Real World. Shore of File Island is very famous for resting place.
However, Black Cogwheels energy is affecting Digimons of the shore. Speak with Gawappamon at the shore to solve problems they have.
_5642.CompletionText: Black Cogwheels are affecting all over the File Island…
_5642.CompletionSummary: Welcome. You are new to the shore, right?

_5643.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5643.Description:
Hmm?? You must have crossed over from the Lost Historic Site. We have lots of dangerous Digimons here. We haven't had any visitors from the Lost Historic Site to the File Island Waterfront for a while.
Did you have any trouble while you were at the Lost Historic Site? We have plenty here... This is all because of Devimons, their underlings and the Black Cogwheels.
There is much you can do to help, Tamer. But, first, go and speak with Gawappamon. He will tell you all about the troubles over at the Beach.
_5643.CompletionText: Have you spoken with Gawappamon yet? You should be able to see him from here.
_5643.CompletionSummary: You have come from the Lost Historic Site, have you? I suppose danger abounds there as much as here.

_5644.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5644.Description:
Welcome to the File Island Waterfront. You must have had quite an adventure to get here.
When you hear the word Waterfront, you may think of rest and leisure, but things are not so comfortable on the File Island Waterfront.
You are looking for a place where you can look at the entire region, you say?
Beyond the beach and the forest, go up the rock mountain. From there, you can get to the Infinite Mountain, the highest point on this island.
_5644.CompletionText: Welcome to the File Island Waterfront!
_5644.CompletionSummary: The highest point on this island is a rock mountain. It was once a green forest, though...

_5645.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5645.Summary: The Story behind the File Island Waterfront 1
_5645.Description:
This is your first time an the File Island Waterfront, so there must be a lot that you want to know. I'm glad you came when you did. There is a lot you can do to help us.
If you help me, and I will tell you many things about the File Island Waterfront and what you need to watch out for.
Lately, Zudomons have been far too noisy. Drive them out for me, will you?
_5645.CompletionText: Did you drive out the Zudomons?
_5645.CompletionSummary: Ah! Thanks to you, some peace and quiet.

_5646.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5646.Description:
If Monochromon loves the mountains, I love this beach.
But we've been seeing evil Digimons around here, too, and they are defiling the beach!
Lopmon has sent me here to take care of it, but I can't do it alone. Take care of Silphymons and tell Lopmon what's been happening here.
_5646.Objective: Defeat 5 Silphymons and speak with Lopmon.
_5646.CompletionText: Look at this fine sand on this beach.
_5646.CompletionSummary: Thank you. I am going to protect this beach to my dying breath.

_5647.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5647.Description:
Who goes there?!
Oh, Gawappamon sent you? I'm sorry for the yelling.
I'm rather edgy what with all the evil Digimons on the beach lately.
_5647.CompletionText: You are not a bad person, are you?
_5647.CompletionSummary: The beach used to be a really beautiful place...

_5648.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5648.Summary: The Story behind the File Island Waterfront 2
_5648.Description:
As I said before, there are more and more Digimons who seek to destroy the File Island Waterfront.
When the situation on the beach is stable, we'll talk more. Remove Rapidmons for me.
_5648.CompletionText: Did you take care of Rapidmons?

_5649.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5649.Description:
Since *that* Digimon appeared on the File Island Waterfront, Monochromon began to become vicious.
Monochromon used to love the mountains and the trees. Yet, when the Black Cogwheels got stuck on him, he started to demolish the mountains and the trees that he spend all his life building with his friends.
_5649.CompletionText: He used to love the forest more than anyone else...
_5649.CompletionSummary: Will you go to the mountains and help Monochromon? Just remove the Black Cogwheels, and he'll come back to his old self.

_5650.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5650.Description:
We are waiting for the 'Children of the Rumor'.
I've only heard Gatomon mention it briefly. Talk to him for more details, but I know this one thing:
The Children of the Rumor are on our side.
_5650.CompletionSummary: The Children of the Rumor, huh?

_5651.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5651.Description:
You want to know about the Children of the Rumor? Well, I would be happy to tell you more about them. But, first, you have probably seen how desperate we are on the beach. You spoke with Gawappamon and Lopmon, right?
If we take care of business around these parts, the beach should be stabilized somewhat.
Help me defeat the Digimons on the beach. Those are evil Digimons that ruin the beach.
_5651.CompletionText: Did you take care of them?
_5651.CompletionSummary: Thank you. But we still have a long way to go...

_5652.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5652.Description:
So, you have heard about the Children of the Rumor, have you? Yes, there is a rumor that is going around in the Digital World.
The rumor speaks of the Chosen Children from another world who will come in our darkest hour to rescue the Digital World.
We don't know when this will be. All we can do is wait for their arrival.
_5652.CompletionText: When will they come, I wonder?

_5653.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5653.Description:
I am told that the Chosen Children have the power to evolve Digimons.
Apparently, you can evolve Digimons beyond the Ultimate stage by using a certain crest and necklace.
_5653.CompletionSummary: Seeing that you have suddenly crossed over into the Digital World from another world, it is likely that you are a 'Chosen Child'.

_5654.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5654.Description:
It is probably best for you to go to the rock mountain yourself. From there, you will be able to view the entire File Island.
While you're at it, tell my friend, Hawkmon, the good of news of Giromons defeated.
_5654.CompletionSummary: I've heard a lot about you. From here, you can get to the rock mountain.

_5655.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5655.Description:
It's you. I knew you would come here...
You are all witnesses to the incident on the Hill of Light..
All of you also met Digimons four years ago. Yes. You are the 8th Chosen Children.
The Digimon that helped you back then was Greymon. That's me.
_5655.CompletionText: Good to see you. You seem rather familiar...
_5655.CompletionSummary: That you are all here means that the time is nigh when we will put an end to this chaos.

_5656.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5656.Description:
The incident on the Hill of Light, the Chosen Children, the Black Cogwheels... Has it clicked yet?
To put an end to all of this, you have no choice but to face Devimon.
You must defeat Devimon in order for you to become unnecessary beings in this world. That is to say, you can return home.
_5656.CompletionText: Are you starting to understand why you are in the Digital World now?
_5656.CompletionSummary: Now, prepare yourselves to go up to the Infinite Mountain.

_5657.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5657.Description:
“To reach Infinity Mountain, we need to solve two major problems.
First, Monochromon's rampage is becoming extremely severe. If we can't stop Monochromon, it will be difficult to proceed to Infinity Mountain.
Monochromon was originally a kind and gentle Digimon… It must have fallen victim to Devimon's scheme and the Black Cogwheel.
The other issue is that this area is teeming with Devimon's minions, as it's on the path to Infinity Mountain. Let's defeat Devimon's minions first!”
_5657.CompletionText: Have you defeated all the minions?
_5657.CompletionSummary: You’ve done great. Now, let’s go save Monochromon!

_5658.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5658.Description: Right now, the one holding Monochromon in check is Leomon up there. Let’s go see Leomon first!
_5658.CompletionSummary: Get a grip, Monochromon! You’re the guardian of the mountains who loves them!!!!

_5659.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5659.Description:
You’ve come to stop Monochromon? I am Leomon, a friend of Monochromon!
I haven’t given up on trying to talk to Monochromon yet. I want to see the kind and gentle Monochromon of the past again.
However, it refuses to listen… Is force truly the only way? Since the root of the problem lies in the Black Cogwheel, if we can remove the Black Cogwheel, Monochromon will regain its senses.
Remove Monochromon’s Black Cogwheel and restore the File Island coast to its former glory!
_5659.CompletionText: Did you remove Monochromon’s Black Cogwheel?
_5659.CompletionSummary:
Thank you… really, thank you! Monochromon will be so grateful once it regains its senses.
Now the File Island coast will be rebuilt. With Monochromon, who loves mountains and forests, we’ll create an even more wonderful File Island coast! Thank you so much!!

_5660.Title: File Island Waterfront
_5660.Description:
It’s time to face Devimon now.
Before that, you’ve collected tokens from the regions you’ve passed through, right? Take those tokens and get your reward from Greymon over there!
_5660.CompletionText: Have you greeted your new partner?
_5660.CompletionSummary: Let’s head to Infinity Mountain now!

_5661.Title: RoyalBase
_5661.Description:
A suspicious DigiCore has been discovered in Death-X-mon at Royal Base (Normal)....
I don't know what other conspiracies might be lurking.
_5661.CompletionText: We might need to investigate Royal Base again...
_5661.CompletionSummary: Hmm... take this DigiCore and talk to me again.

_5662.Title: RoyalBase
_5662.Description:
A suspicious DigiCore has been discovered in Death-X-mon at Royal Base (Normal)....
I don't know what other conspiracies might be lurking.
Defeat the Death-X-mon at Royal Base (Normal) and return.
_5662.Objective: Defeat Death-X-mon at Royal Base (Normal) difficulty
_5662.CompletionText: The fate of the Digital World rests on you.
_5662.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much. This DigiCore fragment from Death-X-mon will surely be of help.

_5663.Title: Crisis in the Real World
_5663.Summary: Evil Lurking in the Real World
_5663.Description: Evil Lurking in the Real World
_5663.Objective:
There are countless evils lurking in our world...
Stop the Digimon attacking the Real World!!
_5663.CompletionSummary: You accomplished a difficult task!! Amazing work! Receive this DigiDevice, containing the journey we've shared!

_5664.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5664.Description: This is Dats Center, Captain Richard Sampson speaking. We've received a report that regions in the Digital World are disappearing. Agents who have confirmed this message should quickly go to Marcus at D-Terminal.
_5664.CompletionSummary: This must be the companion going on the mission with me, @<tc:900>#<my_tname>@</tc>!
_5664.ReservedText: No time to talk, let's go!

_5665.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5665.Description: The Digital World is in chaos, let's hurry!
_5665.CompletionText: I heard the Digital World is in chaos, let's hurry!
_5665.CompletionSummary: So this is Flame Terminal, huh? Let's go!
_5665.ReservedText: So this is Flame Terminal, huh? Let's head inside!

_5666.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5666.Description: First, we need to find out what's happening. Let's ask the other Digimon!
_5666.Objective: Talk to <Flame Terminal>Bokomon in Flame Terminal
_5666.CompletionText: First, we need to find out what's going on. Let's ask other Digimon!
_5666.CompletionSummary: Ah! Hello! Are you from Dot Headquarters by any chance?! Right now… a huge crisis is happening!
_5666.ReservedText: Ah! Hello! Are you from Dot Headquarters?! Right now… this is a huge crisis!

_5667.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5667.Description: Th-this is serious!! Right now, Cerberumon is trying to steal the Digicode at Flame Terminal!!
_5667.CompletionText: Th-this is serious!! Cerberusmon is trying to steal the DigiCode from Flame Terminal right now!!
_5667.CompletionSummary: Ah, thank you so much! Thanks to you, the DigiCode has been restored!

_5668.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5668.Description: Agunimon should be able to explain the current situation in more detail!
_5668.Objective: Talk to <Legendary 10 Warriors>Agunimon in Flame Terminal
_5668.CompletionText: Agunimon should be able to explain the situation in more detail!
_5668.CompletionSummary: This isn’t a coincidence. Someone is acting intentionally.
_5668.ReservedText: This isn’t a coincidence. Someone is acting intentionally.

_5669.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5669.Description: To stop this crisis, we need their power.
_5669.Objective: Talk to <Digital World>Agunimon in Digital World
_5669.CompletionText: We'll need their power to stop this crisis.
_5669.CompletionSummary: I’ve heard that the Legendary 10 Warriors are sleeping throughout the Digital World.
_5669.ReservedText: I’ve heard that the Legendary 10 Warriors are sleeping throughout the Digital World.

_5670.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5670.Description: The number of rampaging Digimon has noticeably increased. Even if it's dangerous, let's move forward.
_5670.CompletionText: The number of aggressive Digimon has noticeably increased. It's dangerous, but let's move forward.
_5670.CompletionSummary: The other 10 Warriors must be asleep somewhere too...
_5670.ReservedText: The other 10 Warriors must be asleep somewhere too...

_5671.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5671.Description: B-be careful! All the Digimon nearby have become ferocious!
_5671.CompletionText: B-be careful! All the Digimon around here have become ferocious!
_5671.CompletionSummary: Phew… all the aggressive Digimon have disappeared!
_5671.ReservedText: Phew… all the aggressive Digimon have disappeared!

_5672.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5672.Description: C-can you feel it?! The power of the Legendary 10 Warriors can be felt from below!
_5672.CompletionText: C-can you feel it?! The power of the Legendary 10 Warriors can be felt below!
_5672.CompletionSummary: Ah… the Light Warrior, Wolfmon, was here!
_5672.ReservedText: Ah… the Light Warrior, Wolframmon, was here!

_5673.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5673.Description: Now let's go find the other Legendary 10 Warriors!
_5673.CompletionText: Now, let's set out to find the other Legendary 10 Warriors!

_5674.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5674.Description: Hey, over there... The rampaging Digimon in the Wasteland have increased drastically! Could you help us?
_5674.Objective: Defeat Deputymon and SuperStarmon in Digital World
_5674.CompletionText: Hey, look… the aggressive Digimon in the Wilderness have multiplied! Can you help us?
_5674.CompletionSummary: I almost threw a punch waiting for you!
_5674.ReservedText: I almost threw a punch while waiting for you!

_5675.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5675.Description: We need to find the Legendary 10 Warriors?
_5675.Objective: Talk to <Digital World>Marcus in Digital World
_5675.CompletionText: We need to find the Legendary 10 Warriors?
_5675.CompletionSummary: Good, let's find them all and wake them up.
_5675.ReservedText: Good, let’s find them all and wake them up.

_5676.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5676.Description: The path ahead is blocked. Then let's go down.
_5676.CompletionText: The path ahead is blocked. Then let's go down.
_5676.CompletionSummary: You did well. That must have been tough, right?
_5676.ReservedText: You did well. That must have been tough, right?

_5677.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5677.Description: There are strange Digimon ahead. Let's check it out.
_5677.CompletionText: There are some strange Digimon ahead. Let's check it out.
_5677.CompletionSummary: Oh, my apologies… we didn’t expect you to come and save us!
_5677.ReservedText: Oh, my apologies… we didn’t realize you came to save us!

_5678.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5678.Description: There's an Ice Spirit in the Ice Cave, but Wizardmon are interfering... Please help!
_5678.CompletionText: There are Ice Spirits in the Ice Cave, but Wizardmon are getting in the way… please help!
_5678.CompletionSummary: Thank you so much! I’ll fix the broken bridge up there!
_5678.ReservedText: Thank you so much! I’ll fix the broken bridge up there!

_5679.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5679.Description: The bridge has been repaired. You can now cross safely!
_5679.Objective: Talk to Chakkumon at <Legendary 10 Warriors> in Digital World
_5679.CompletionText: The bridge has been repaired. You can now cross safely!
_5679.CompletionSummary: Hello, I’m Chakkumon. Let’s hurry and find the other 10 Warriors.
_5679.ReservedText: Hello, I’m Chakkumon. Let’s hurry and find the other 10 Warriors.

_5680.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5680.Description: We've reached a fork. I'll go this way first.
_5680.CompletionText: We've reached a fork. I'll go this way first.
_5680.CompletionSummary: We’ve reached the canyon. Let’s proceed carefully.
_5680.ReservedText: We’ve reached the canyon. Let’s proceed carefully.

_5681.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5681.Description: There are many rampaging Roachmons ahead. Let's pass carefully.
_5681.CompletionText: There are many aggressive Roachmon ahead. Let's pass carefully.
_5681.CompletionSummary: Hello! I’m Kokuwamon! Something dangerous is happening nearby…
_5681.ReservedText: Hello! I’m Kokuwamon! Something dangerous is happening nearby…

_5682.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5682.Description: Our Kokuwamons have been kidnapped and are working at the Wind Factory! Help us!
_5682.Objective: Defeat Goblimon and Ogremon in Wind Factory
_5682.CompletionText: Our Kokuwamon have been kidnapped and are working in the Wind Factory! Help us!
_5682.CompletionSummary: I’m Blitzmon, one of the Legendary 10 Warriors. I see you’re helping Kokuwamon as well.
_5682.ReservedText: I’m Blitzmon, one of the Legendary 10 Warriors. I see you’re helping Kokuwamon as well.

_5683.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5683.Description: It seems roughly organized here. Let's go to the houses where the Kokuwamons live.
_5683.Objective: Defeat Sharmamon and Apemon in Wind Factory
_5683.CompletionText: It seems things are mostly organized here. Let's go to the houses where Kokuwamon live.

_5684.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5684.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, Kokuwamon can return to the forest safely!
_5684.ReservedText: Thanks to you, Kokuwamon can return to the forest safely!

_5685.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5685.Description: We'll head back to the forest. Thank you very much!
_5685.Objective: Talk to <Gentle Breeze Village>Floramon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5685.CompletionText: We will return to the forest. Truly, thank you so much!
_5685.CompletionSummary: Hello! Welcome to Gentle Breeze Village!
_5685.ReservedText: Hello! Welcome to Gentle Breeze Village!

_5686.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5686.Description: The rampaging Digimon are causing the village to wither... Please help!
_5686.Objective: Defeat Kunemon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5686.CompletionText: The village is wilting due to the aggressive Digimon… please help!

_5687.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5687.Description: When I woke up, the trees had withered... Can you help me?
_5687.Objective: Defeat Flymon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5687.CompletionText: I woke up to find the tree withering... can you help me?
_5687.CompletionSummary: Thank you. Because of you, I could protect the tree.
_5687.ReservedText: Thank you. Because of you, I could protect the tree.

_5688.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5688.Description: There seems to be a problem in FloraMon Village under the tree. Let's go quickly.
_5688.Objective: Talk to <Floramon Village>Floramon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5688.CompletionText: It seems there’s a problem in Floramon Village under the tree. Let's go quickly.
_5688.CompletionSummary: Our village is… in grave danger right now…!
_5688.ReservedText: Our village is… in grave danger right now…!

_5689.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5689.Description: Mushroomon and Woodmon are attacking our village! Help us!
_5689.Objective: Defeat Mushroomon and Woodmon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5689.CompletionText: Mushumon and Woodmon are attacking our village! Please help!
_5689.CompletionSummary: Thanks to you, flowers are blooming in the village again! Thank you so much!!
_5689.ReservedText: Thanks to you, flowers are blooming in the village again! Thank you so much!!

_5690.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5690.Description: The next village can be reached by following the railway!
_5690.Objective: Talk to <Floramon Village>Floramon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5690.CompletionText: The next village can be reached by following the railroad tracks.
_5690.CompletionSummary: Thank you for protecting the forest and village!!
_5690.ReservedText: Thank you for protecting the forest and village!!

_5691.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5691.Description: The number of rampaging Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5691.CompletionText: The number of aggressive Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5691.CompletionSummary: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared.
_5691.ReservedText: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared.

_5692.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5692.Description: The number of rampaging Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5692.CompletionText: The number of aggressive Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5692.CompletionSummary: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared.
_5692.ReservedText: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared.

_5693.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5693.Description: The number of rampaging Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5693.Objective: Defeat Digimon in Gentle Breeze Village
_5693.CompletionText: The number of aggressive Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5693.CompletionSummary: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared
_5693.ReservedText: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared.

_5694.Title: Digimon Frontier
_5694.Description: The number of rampaging Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5694.Objective: Defeat Raremon in the Frontier Dungeon
_5694.CompletionText: The number of aggressive Digimon has increased. Let's help out.
_5694.CompletionSummary: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared
_5694.ReservedText: Thank you. The aggressive Digimon have disappeared.
